import React, { Suspense, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { AppUser } from '../types';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Plus, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { doc, setDoc, deleteDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from "../lib/firebase";
import { matchesAdvancedSearch } from '../lib/utils';
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from './DebouncedSearchInput';
import { bumpConfigVersion } from '../lib/configCacheService';
import { lazyWithRetry } from '../lib/lazyWithRetry';
import { AccControlUserTable } from './AccControlTabParts/AccControlUserTable';
import { AccControlRbacMatrix } from './AccControlTabParts/AccControlRbacMatrix';
import { AccControlTabProps, AccConfirmModalState } from './AccControlTabParts/accControlTypes';

const ConfirmModal = lazyWithRetry(() => import('./ConfirmModal').then(m => ({ default: m.ConfirmModal })), 'ConfirmModal');

export function AccControlTab({ users, locationVisibility = {}, onEditUser, onAddUser }: AccControlTabProps) {
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const parties = useAppStore(state => state.parties);

  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState<AccConfirmModalState>({
    isOpen: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    onConfirm: () => {}
  });

  const updateUserInStore = (userId: string, updateFn: (u: AppUser) => AppUser) => {
    const setAppUsers = useAppStore.getState().setAppUsers;
    const currentList = useAppStore.getState().appUsers;
    const updatedList = currentList.map(u => u.id === userId ? updateFn(u) : u);
    setAppUsers(updatedList);
  };

  const handleAddParty = async (party: string) => {
    if (parties.includes(party)) return;
    try {
      const newList = [...parties, party];
      useAppStore.getState().setParties(newList);
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_config', 'parties'), { list: newList }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('parties');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const removeParty = async (party: string) => {
    try {
      const newList = parties.filter(p => p !== party);
      useAppStore.getState().setParties(newList);
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_config', 'parties'), { list: newList }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('parties');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const handleAddLocation = async (loc: string) => {
    if (locations.includes(loc)) return;
    try {
      const newList = [...locations, loc];
      useAppStore.getState().setLocations(newList);
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_config', 'locations'), { list: newList }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('locations');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const removeLocation = async (loc: string) => {
    try {
      const newList = locations.filter(l => l !== loc);
      useAppStore.getState().setLocations(newList);
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_config', 'locations'), { list: newList }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('locations');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const toggleLocationVisibility = async (loc: string, currentVisible: boolean) => {
    try {
      const newVisibility = { ...locationVisibility, [loc]: !currentVisible };
      useAppStore.getState().setLocationVisibility(newVisibility);
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_config', 'locations'), { visibility: newVisibility }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('locations');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteUser = (id: string) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: 'Delete Account',
      message: 'Delete this account?',
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          const setAppUsers = useAppStore.getState().setAppUsers;
          const currentList = useAppStore.getState().appUsers;
          setAppUsers(currentList.filter(u => u.id !== id));
          await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', id));
          await bumpConfigVersion('app_users');
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        } finally {
          setConfirmModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
        }
      }
    });
  };

  const isAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const baseUsers = isAdmin ? users : users.filter(u => u.id === currentUser?.id);

  const displayUsers = useMemo(() => {
    return baseUsers.filter(u => {
      if (!searchTerm) return true;
      return matchesAdvancedSearch(searchTerm, [u.username, u.role, (u as any).department, (u as any).position], [], (term) => {
        if (u.locationPermissions && Object.keys(u.locationPermissions).some(loc => u.locationPermissions![loc] && loc.toLowerCase().includes(term))) {
          return true;
        }
        if (u.partyPermissions && Object.keys(u.partyPermissions).some(party => u.partyPermissions![party] && party.toLowerCase().includes(term))) {
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      });
    });
  }, [baseUsers, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col flex-grow bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        {confirmModal.isOpen && (
          <ConfirmModal 
            isOpen={confirmModal.isOpen}
            title={confirmModal.title}
            message={confirmModal.message}
            onConfirm={confirmModal.onConfirm}
            onCancel={() => setConfirmModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }))}
          />
        )}
      </Suspense>

      <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">{isAdmin ? 'User Account Control' : 'My Account'}</h2>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 z-10" />
            <DebouncedSearchInput
              placeholder="Search users..."
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(val) => setSearchTerm(val)}
              debounceMs={500}
              className="pl-9 pr-8 py-1.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg text-sm bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 w-64"
            />
          </div>
          {isAdmin && (
            <button
              title={t("Add User")} 
              onClick={onAddUser}
              className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-slate-900 dark:bg-blue-600 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg shadow-md flex items-center gap-2 h-full"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />{t("Add User")}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-grow p-4 space-y-8">
        <AccControlUserTable 
          displayUsers={displayUsers}
          isAdmin={isAdmin}
          locations={locations}
          parties={parties}
          locationVisibility={locationVisibility}
          onEditUser={onEditUser}
          onDeleteUser={handleDeleteUser}
          toggleLocationVisibility={toggleLocationVisibility}
          removeLocation={removeLocation}
          handleAddLocation={handleAddLocation}
          removeParty={removeParty}
          handleAddParty={handleAddParty}
          updateUserInStore={updateUserInStore}
        />

        {isAdmin && (
          <AccControlRbacMatrix 
            permissionMatrix={permissionMatrix}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default AccControlTab;

import React, { FC, Fragment } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../../lib/LanguageContext";
import { PermissionMatrix, AppRole, PermissionAction, PermissionModule } from "../../types";
import { useAppStore } from "../../store/useAppStore";
import { doc, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from "../../lib/firebase";
import { bumpConfigVersion } from "../../lib/configCacheService";

interface AccControlRbacMatrixProps {
  permissionMatrix: PermissionMatrix;
}

const ROLES: AppRole[] = ['Manager', 'Staff', 'External', 'CP'];
const MODULES: PermissionModule[] = [
  'general',
  'detail',
  'calendar',
  'budget',
  'costDetail',
  'report',
  'layout',
  'taskDelegation',
  'pictureMapping',
  'importCsv',
];

export const AccControlRbacMatrix: React.FC<AccControlRbacMatrixProps> = ({
  permissionMatrix,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const updatePermission = async (role: AppRole, action: PermissionAction, module: PermissionModule, value: boolean) => {
    try {
      const newMatrix = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(permissionMatrix));
      if (!newMatrix[role]) newMatrix[role] = {};
      if (!newMatrix[role][action]) newMatrix[role][action] = {};
      newMatrix[role][action][module] = value;
      useAppStore.getState().setPermissionMatrix(newMatrix);
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_settings', 'permissions'), newMatrix);
      bumpConfigVersion("permissions");
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const renderCell = (role: AppRole, action: PermissionAction, module: PermissionModule) => (
    <td key={`${role}-${action}-${module}`} className="px-2 py-2 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">
      <div className="flex justify-center">
        <input 
          type="checkbox" 
          checked={permissionMatrix[role]?.[action]?.[module] || false}
          onChange={(e) => updatePermission(role, action, module, e.target.checked)}
          className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500 cursor-pointer" 
        />
      </div>
    </td>
  );

  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
      <table className="w-full text-sm text-center text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg overflow-hidden min-w-[800px]">
        <thead className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
          <tr>
            <th rowSpan={2} colSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]"></th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">{t("General")}</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">{t("Detail")}</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">{t("Calendar")}</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">{t("Budget")}</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">Cost detail</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">{t("Report")}</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">Layout</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">{t("Delegation")}</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">Picture mapping</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">Import CSV</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {ROLES.map((role) => (
            <React.Fragment key={role}>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">
                <td rowSpan={2} className="px-2 py-2 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] align-middle">
                  {role}
                </td>
                <td className="px-2 py-2 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] text-left">See</td>
                {MODULES.map((module) => renderCell(role, 'See', module))}
              </tr>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
                <td className="px-2 py-2 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] text-left">Write</td>
                {MODULES.map((module) => renderCell(role, 'Write', module))}
              </tr>
            </React.Fragment>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { FC, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { AppUser, AppRole } from "../../types";
import { useAppStore } from "../../store/useAppStore";
import { doc, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from "../../lib/firebase";
import { bumpConfigVersion } from "../../lib/configCacheService";

interface AccControlUserTableProps {
  displayUsers: AppUser[];
  isAdmin: boolean;
  locations: string[];
  parties: string[];
  locationVisibility: Record<string, boolean>;
  onEditUser: (u: AppUser) => void;
  onDeleteUser: (id: string) => void;
  toggleLocationVisibility: (loc: string, currentVisible: boolean) => Promise<void>;
  removeLocation: (loc: string) => Promise<void>;
  handleAddLocation: (loc: string) => Promise<void>;
  removeParty: (party: string) => Promise<void>;
  handleAddParty: (party: string) => Promise<void>;
  updateUserInStore: (userId: string, updateFn: (u: AppUser) => AppUser) => void;
}

export const AccControlUserTable: React.FC<AccControlUserTableProps> = ({
  displayUsers,
  isAdmin,
  locations,
  parties,
  locationVisibility,
  onEditUser,
  onDeleteUser,
  toggleLocationVisibility,
  removeLocation,
  handleAddLocation,
  removeParty,
  handleAddParty,
  updateUserInStore,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [newLocation, setNewLocation] = useState('');
  const [newParty, setNewParty] = useState('');

  const changeRole = async (userId: string, role: string) => {
    try {
      const canWrite = role === 'Manager' || role === 'Staff' || role === 'CP' || role === 'admin';
      const canSee = true;
      updateUserInStore(userId, u => ({ ...u, role: role as AppRole, canWrite, canSee }));
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', userId), { role, canWrite, canSee }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('app_users');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const toggleUserPermission = async (userId: string, category: 'storePermissions' | 'locationPermissions', field: string, currentValue: boolean) => {
    try {
      const newValue = !currentValue;
      updateUserInStore(userId, u => ({
        ...u,
        [category]: {
          ...(u[category] || {}),
          [field]: newValue
        }
      }));
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', userId), {
        [category]: {
          [field]: newValue
        }
      }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('app_users');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const toggleNotificationPermission = async (userId: string, currentValue: boolean) => {
    try {
      const newValue = !currentValue;
      updateUserInStore(userId, u => ({ ...u, notification: newValue }));
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', userId), {
        notification: newValue
      }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('app_users');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const toggleUserPartyTag = async (userId: string, party: string, currentValue: boolean) => {
    try {
      const newValue = !currentValue;
      updateUserInStore(userId, u => ({
        ...u,
        partyPermissions: {
          ...(u.partyPermissions || {}),
          [party]: newValue
        }
      }));
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', userId), {
        partyPermissions: {
          [party]: newValue
        }
      }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('app_users');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const toggleByPartyPermission = async (userId: string, currentValue: boolean) => {
    try {
      const newValue = !currentValue;
      updateUserInStore(userId, u => ({ ...u, byPartyAccess: newValue }));
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', userId), {
        byPartyAccess: newValue
      }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('app_users');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const toggleAllPermissions = async (userId: string, isCurrentlyAll: boolean) => {
    const newValue = !isCurrentlyAll;
    const locPerms: Record<string, boolean> = { all: newValue };
    locations.forEach(loc => {
      locPerms[loc.toLowerCase()] = newValue;
    });

    updateUserInStore(userId, u => ({
      ...u,
      notification: newValue,
      storePermissions: {
        hcm: newValue,
        hn: newValue
      },
      locationPermissions: locPerms,
      partyPermissions: {
        all: newValue
      }
    }));

    try {
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', userId), {
        notification: newValue,
        storePermissions: {
          hcm: newValue,
          hn: newValue
        },
        locationPermissions: locPerms,
        partyPermissions: {
          all: newValue
        }
      }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion('app_users');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const onAddLocationSubmit = async () => {
    if (!newLocation.trim()) return;
    await handleAddLocation(newLocation.trim());
    setNewLocation('');
  };

  const onAddPartySubmit = async () => {
    if (!newParty.trim()) return;
    await handleAddParty(newParty.trim());
    setNewParty('');
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <h3 className="text-md font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] mb-3 text-center">
        {isAdmin ? 'Ma trận phân quyền' : 'Tài khoản của tôi'}
      </h3>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className={`w-full text-sm text-center text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg overflow-hidden ${isAdmin ? 'min-w-[1200px]' : ''}`}>
          <thead className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] uppercase bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
            <tr>
              <th rowSpan={isAdmin ? 2 : 1} className="px-6 py-4 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-left whitespace-normal break-words">User</th>
              <th rowSpan={isAdmin ? 2 : 1} className="px-6 py-4 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">Password</th>
              {isAdmin && (
                <>
                  <th rowSpan={2} className="px-6 py-4 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">Ma trận phân quyền</th>
                  <th rowSpan={2} className="px-6 py-4 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">All</th>
                  <th rowSpan={2} className="px-6 py-4 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">By Party</th>
                  <th rowSpan={2} className="px-6 py-4 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">Notification</th>
                  <th colSpan={2} className="px-6 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">{t("Store")}</th>
                  <th rowSpan={2} className="px-4 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] align-top min-w-[200px]">
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                      <span>{t("Location")}</span>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 justify-center">
                        {Array.from(new Set(locations)).map(loc => {
                          const isVisible = locationVisibility[loc] ?? true;
                          return (
                            <span key={loc} className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]">
                              <input 
                                type="checkbox" 
                                checked={isVisible} 
                                onChange={() => toggleLocationVisibility(loc, isVisible)}
                                className="w-2.5 h-2.5 cursor-pointer accent-blue-500 rounded-sm"
                                title="Toggle visibility"
                              />
                              {loc}
                              <button onClick={() => removeLocation(loc)} className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700">
                                <Trash2 className="w-2 h-2" />
                              </button>
                            </span>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-1 justify-center">
                        <input 
                          type="text" 
                          value={newLocation}
                          onChange={(e) => setNewLocation(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="Add..."
                          className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555558] rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 w-20 normal-case font-normal bg-transparent text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
                          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && onAddLocationSubmit()}
                        />
                        <button onClick={onAddLocationSubmit}
                          className="p-0.5 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th rowSpan={2} className="px-4 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] align-top min-w-[200px]">
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                      <span>{t("Party")}</span>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 justify-center">
                        {Array.from(new Set(parties)).map(party => (
                          <span key={party} className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] whitespace-nowrap">
                            {party}
                            <button onClick={() => removeParty(party)} className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700">
                              <Trash2 className="w-2 h-2" />
                            </button>
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-1 justify-center">
                        <input 
                          type="text" 
                          value={newParty}
                          onChange={(e) => setNewParty(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="Add..."
                          className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555558] rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 w-20 normal-case font-normal bg-transparent text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
                          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && onAddPartySubmit()}
                        />
                        <button onClick={onAddPartySubmit}
                          className="p-0.5 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </th>
                </>
              )}
              <th rowSpan={isAdmin ? 2 : 1} className="px-6 py-4 font-bold">{t("Action")}</th>
            </tr>
            {isAdmin && (
              <tr>
                <th className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">HCM</th>
                <th className="px-2 py-2 font-bold border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] whitespace-normal break-words">HN</th>
              </tr>
            )}
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {displayUsers.map(u => (
              <tr key={u.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a]/50 transition-colors">
                <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] text-left">{u.username}</td>
                <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-mono tracking-widest border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">{u.password?.length === 64 ? '••••••••' : u.password}</td>
                {isAdmin && (
                  <>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">
                      <div className="flex justify-center">
                        <select 
                          value={u.role || 'External'}
                          onChange={(e) => changeRole(u.id, e.target.value)}
                          className="px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555558] rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <option value="Manager">Manager</option>
                          <option value="Staff">Staff</option>
                          <option value="CP">CP</option>
                          <option value="External">External</option>
                          {u.role === 'admin' && <option value="admin">Admin</option>}
                        </select>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-2 py-2 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50">
                      <div className="flex justify-center">
                        <input

                          onChange={() => toggleAllPermissions(u.id, !!(u.notification !== false && u.storePermissions?.hcm && u.storePermissions?.hn && (u.locationPermissions?.['all'] || locations.every(loc => u.locationPermissions?.[loc.toLowerCase()])) && u.partyPermissions?.['all']))} 
                          className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500 cursor-pointer" 
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex justify-center">
                        <input 
                          type="checkbox" 
                          checked={u.byPartyAccess || false} 
                          onChange={() => toggleByPartyPermission(u.id, u.byPartyAccess || false)} 
                          className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500 cursor-pointer" 
                        />
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-2 py-2 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">
                      <div className="flex justify-center">
                        <input 
                          type="checkbox" 
                          checked={u.notification !== false} 
                          onChange={() => toggleNotificationPermission(u.id, u.notification !== false)} 
                          className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500 cursor-pointer" 
                        />
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-2 py-2 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">
                      <div className="flex justify-center">
                        <input type="checkbox" checked={u.storePermissions?.hcm || false} onChange={() => toggleUserPermission(u.id, 'storePermissions', 'hcm', u.storePermissions?.hcm || false)} className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500 cursor-pointer" />
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-2 py-2 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">

                          {Array.from(new Set(['all', ...locations])).filter(loc => u.locationPermissions?.[loc.toLowerCase()]).map(loc => (
                            <div key={loc} className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-green-50 text-green-700 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs">
                              <span className="truncate max-w-[100px]" title={loc}>{loc}</span>
                              <button onClick={() => toggleUserPermission(u.id, 'locationPermissions', loc.toLowerCase(), true)} className="text-green-500 hover:text-red-500 font-bold p-0.5">
                                &times;
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <select 
                            className="px-2 py-1 text-xs border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555558] rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-500 flex-grow w-full max-w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
                            onChange={(e) => {
                               if (e.target.value) {
                                  toggleUserPermission(u.id, 'locationPermissions', e.target.value.toLowerCase(), false);
                                  e.target.value = '';
                               }
                            }}
                            defaultValue=""
                          >
                            <option value="">Add Location...</option>
                            {Array.from(new Set(['all', ...locations])).filter(loc => !u.locationPermissions?.[loc.toLowerCase()]).map(loc => (
                               <option key={loc} value={loc}>{loc}</option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] align-top max-w-[200px]">
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                          {['all', ...Array.from(new Set(parties))].filter(party => u.partyPermissions?.[party.toLowerCase()]).map(party => (
                            <div key={party} className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs">
                              <span className="truncate max-w-[100px]" title={party}>{party}</span>
                              <button onClick={() => toggleUserPartyTag(u.id, party.toLowerCase(), true)} className="text-purple-500 hover:text-red-500 font-bold p-0.5">
                                &times;
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <select 
                            className="px-2 py-1 text-xs border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555558] rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-purple-500 flex-grow w-full max-w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
                            onChange={(e) => {
                               if (e.target.value) {
                                  toggleUserPartyTag(u.id, e.target.value.toLowerCase(), false);
                                  e.target.value = '';
                               }
                            }}
                            defaultValue=""
                          >
                            <option value="">Add Party...</option>
                            {['all', ...Array.from(new Set(parties))].filter(party => !u.partyPermissions?.[party.toLowerCase()]).map(party => (
                               <option key={party} value={party}>{party}</option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </>
                )}
                <td className="px-6 py-4 flex justify-center gap-2">
                  <button onClick={() => onEditUser(u)}
                    className="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-[#444446] rounded text-xs font-bold transition-colors"
                  >{t("Edit")}</button>
                  {isAdmin && (
                    <button onClick={() => onDeleteUser(u.id)}
                      className="p-1 bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-100 rounded transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { FC, Suspense, memo } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { lazyWithRetry } from '../lib/lazyWithRetry';
import { TabErrorBoundary } from './TabErrorBoundary';
import { AppUser } from '../types';

const LoginModal = lazyWithRetry(() => import('./LoginModal').then(m => ({ default: m.LoginModal })), 'LoginModal');
const ProjectModal = lazyWithRetry(() => import('./ProjectModal').then(m => ({ default: m.ProjectModal })), 'ProjectModal');
const TaskModal = lazyWithRetry(() => import('./TaskModal').then(m => ({ default: m.TaskModal })), 'TaskModal');
const UserModal = lazyWithRetry(() => import('./UserModal').then(m => ({ default: m.UserModal })), 'UserModal');
const CalendarSyncModal = lazyWithRetry(() => import('./CalendarSyncModal').then(m => ({ default: m.CalendarSyncModal })), 'CalendarSyncModal');
const ZoomableImageViewer = lazyWithRetry(() => import('./ZoomableImageViewer').then(m => ({ default: m.ZoomableImageViewer })), 'ZoomableImageViewer');

interface AppModalsProps {
  onLogin: (appUser: AppUser) => void;
  onTabChange: (tab: any) => void;
}

export const AppModals: React.FC<AppModalsProps> = React.memo(({ onLogin, onTabChange }) => {
  const isLoginModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.isLoginModalOpen);
  const setIsLoginModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.setIsLoginModalOpen);
  
  const isProjectModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.isProjectModalOpen);
  const setIsProjectModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.setIsProjectModalOpen);
  
  const isTaskModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.isTaskModalOpen);
  const setIsTaskModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.setIsTaskModalOpen);
  
  const isUserModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.isUserModalOpen);
  const setIsUserModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.setIsUserModalOpen);
  
  const isCalendarSyncModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.isCalendarSyncModalOpen);
  
  const editingProject = useAppStore(state => state.editingProject);
  const editingTask = useAppStore(state => state.editingTask);
  const setEditingTask = useAppStore(state => state.setEditingTask);
  const editingUser = useAppStore(state => state.editingUser);
  
  const modalInitialTab = useAppStore(state => state.modalInitialTab);
  const setModalInitialTab = useAppStore(state => state.setModalInitialTab);
  const isReadOnlyModal = useAppStore(state => state.isReadOnlyModal);
  const setIsReadOnlyModal = useAppStore(state => state.setIsReadOnlyModal);
  
  const prefillProjectCode = useAppStore(state => state.prefillProjectCode);
  const prefillProjectYear = useAppStore(state => state.prefillProjectYear);
  const prefillProjectStore = useAppStore(state => state.prefillProjectStore);

  const { filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();

  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      {isLoginModalOpen && (
        <LoginModal
          isOpen={isLoginModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsLoginModalOpen(false)}
          onLogin={onLogin}
        />
      )}

      {isProjectModalOpen && (
        <ProjectModal
          isOpen={isProjectModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsProjectModalOpen(false)}
          project={editingProject}
          isReadOnly={isReadOnlyModal}
          initialTab={modalInitialTab}
          onOpenTask={(taskId) => {
            const t = tasks.find((item) => item.id === taskId);
            if (t) {
              setEditingTask(t);
              setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
              setModalInitialTab("chat");
              setIsProjectModalOpen(false);
              setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
            }
          }}
        />
      )}

      {isTaskModalOpen && (
        <TabErrorBoundary tabKey="TaskModal">
          <TaskModal
            isOpen={isTaskModalOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsTaskModalOpen(false)}
            task={editingTask}
            visibleDelegationGroups={visibleDelegationGroups}
            prefillProjectCode={prefillProjectCode}
            prefillProjectYear={prefillProjectYear}
            prefillProjectStore={prefillProjectStore}
            isReadOnly={isReadOnlyModal}
            initialTab={modalInitialTab === "chat" ? "chat" : "details"}
            onNavigateToDelegation={(groupId) => {
              setIsTaskModalOpen(false);
              onTabChange("taskDelegation");
              setTimeout(() => {
                window.dispatchEvent(
                  new CustomEvent("taka_open_delegation_group", {
                    detail: { groupId },
                  })
                );
              }, 400);
            }}
          />
        </TabErrorBoundary>
      )}

      {isUserModalOpen && (
        <UserModal
          isOpen={isUserModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsUserModalOpen(false)}
          user={editingUser}
        />
      )}

      {isCalendarSyncModalOpen && <CalendarSyncModal />}
      <ZoomableImageViewer />
    </Suspense>
  );
});

import React, { Dispatch, FC, Profiler, SetStateAction, Suspense, memo } from 'react';

interface AppTabRouterProps {

  activeNotifications: ActiveNotification[];
  readNotifs: string[] | Set<string>;
  notificationFilterId: string | null;
  setNotificationFilterId: (val: string | null) => void;
  unreadCount: number;
  handleRequestPermission: () => Promise<void>;
  notifActions: any;
  notificationRules: NotificationRule[];
  handleTabChange: (tab: TabId) => void;
  handleNavigateToLayout: (projectCode: string, store: string, location?: string, taskId?: string) => void;
  handleNavigateToTaskDetail: (projectCode: string, store: string, taskId?: string) => void;
  setQuickNavTarget: (target: any) => void;
  setEditingProject: (p: Project | null) => void;
  setEditingTask: (t: Task | null) => void;

  setPrefillProjectYear: (val: number | null) => void;
  setPrefillProjectStore: (val: string | null) => void;

  executeDeepLinkRef: React.MutableRefObject<((type: string, id: string | number, extra?: any) => void) | null>;

export const AppTabRouter: React.FC<AppTabRouterProps> = React.memo(({
  activeTab,
  currentUser,
  userRole,
  permissionMatrix,
  layoutTabFilters,
  setLayoutTabFilters,
  ganttTabFocusTaskId,
  setGanttTabFocusTaskId,
  detailTabFilterCode,
  setDetailTabFilterCode,
  globalStoreFilter,
  globalYearFilter,
  setGlobalStoreFilter,
  setGlobalYearFilter,
  detailTabFocusTaskId,
  setDetailTabFocusTaskId,
  detailReturnScrollId,
  setDetailReturnScrollId,
  budgetTabSearchTerm,
  setBudgetTabSearchTerm,
  costTabSearchTerm,
  setCostTabSearchTerm,
  tabHistory,
  setTabHistory,
  locationVisibility,
  activeNotifications,
  readNotifs,
  notificationFilterId,
  setNotificationFilterId,
  unreadCount,
  handleRequestPermission,
  notifActions,
  notificationRules,
  handleTabChange,
  handleNavigateToLayout,
  handleNavigateToTaskDetail,
  setQuickNavTarget,
  setEditingProject,
  setEditingTask,
  setEditingUser,
  setIsReadOnlyModal,
  setModalInitialTab,
  setIsProjectModalOpen,
  setIsTaskModalOpen,
  setIsUserModalOpen,
  setPrefillProjectCode,
  setPrefillProjectYear,
  setPrefillProjectStore,
  isAppReadyRef,
  executeDeepLinkRef,
  onRenderCallback,
}) => {
  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const appUsers = useAppStore(state => state.appUsers);
  const setActiveTab = useAppStore(state => state.setActiveTab);

  return (
    <div className="flex-grow flex flex-col min-h-0 relative z-[10]">
      <TabErrorBoundary tabKey={activeTab}>
        <Suspense fallback={
          <div className="flex-1 w-full h-full p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 animate-pulse bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0e0e11]">
            <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full space-y-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="h-8 w-48 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-lg"></div>
                <div className="h-8 w-24 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-lg"></div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                {[1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => <div key={i} className="h-24 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-xl"></div>)}
              </div>
              <div className="h-[400px] w-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-xl"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        }>
          <motion.div
            key={activeTab}
            initial={{ opacity: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.06 }}
            className="flex flex-col flex-grow min-h-0"
          >
              {activeTab === "layout" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.layout) && (
                  <LayoutTab
                    initialStore={layoutTabFilters?.store}
                    initialLocation={layoutTabFilters?.location}
                    initialProjectCode={layoutTabFilters?.projectCode}
                    onClearFocus={() => setLayoutTabFilters(null)}
                    onBackToGantt={() => {
                      if (layoutTabFilters?.sourceTaskId) {
                        setGanttTabFocusTaskId(layoutTabFilters.sourceTaskId);
                      } else {
                        setGanttTabFocusTaskId("");
                      }
                      handleTabChange("gantt");
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "summary" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" ||
                  permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.summary ||
                  permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.report) && (
                  <SummaryTab />
                )}

              {activeTab === "general" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.general) && (
                  <GeneralTab
                    onProjectClick={(p) => {
                      setQuickNavTarget({ project: p });
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "detail" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.detail) && (
                  <Profiler id="DetailTab" onRender={onRenderCallback}>
                    <DetailTab
                      initialFilterCode={detailTabFilterCode}
                      initialStoreFilter={globalStoreFilter}
                      initialFocusTaskId={detailTabFocusTaskId}
                      returnScrollId={detailReturnScrollId}
                      onClearFocus={() => {
                        setDetailReturnScrollId(detailTabFocusTaskId);
                        setDetailTabFocusTaskId("");
                      }}
                      onBackToGantt={() => {
                        setDetailReturnScrollId(detailTabFocusTaskId);
                        setDetailTabFocusTaskId("");
                        setDetailTabFilterCode("");
                        handleTabChange("gantt");
                      }}
                      onAddProject={() => {
                        setEditingProject(null);
                        setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                        setModalInitialTab("details");
                        setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      onAddTask={(p) => {
                        if (!isAppReadyRef.current) return;
                        const safeP = p || (projects && projects.length > 0 ? projects[0] : null);
                        setPrefillProjectCode(safeP?.code || "");
                        setPrefillProjectYear(safeP?.year || null);
                        setPrefillProjectStore(safeP?.store || null);
                        setEditingTask(null);
                        setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                        setModalInitialTab("details");
                        setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      onEditProject={(p, isReadOnly, initialTab) => {
                        setEditingProject(p);
                        setIsReadOnlyModal(isReadOnly || false);
                        setModalInitialTab((initialTab as "details" | "chat") || "details");
                        setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      onEditTask={(t, isReadOnly, initialTab) => {
                        setEditingTask(t);
                        setIsReadOnlyModal(isReadOnly || false);
                        setModalInitialTab((initialTab as "details" | "chat") || "details");
                        setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      onNavigateToDelegation={(groupId, sourceTaskId) => {
                        if (sourceTaskId) setDetailReturnScrollId(sourceTaskId);
                        handleTabChange("taskDelegation");
                        setTimeout(() => {
                          window.dispatchEvent(
                            new CustomEvent("taka_open_delegation_group", {
                              detail: { groupId },
                            }),
                          );
                        }, 400);
                      }}
                    />
                  </Profiler>
                )}

              {activeTab === "calendar" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" ||
                  permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.calendar ||
                  permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.report) && (
                  <CalendarTab
                    onEditTask={(t, isReadOnly) => {
                      setEditingTask(t);
                      setIsReadOnlyModal(isReadOnly || false);
                      setModalInitialTab("details");
                      setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                    }}
                    onEditProject={(p, isReadOnly) => {
                      setEditingProject(p);
                      setIsReadOnlyModal(isReadOnly || false);
                      setModalInitialTab("details");
                      setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "gantt" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.report) && (
                  <Profiler id="GanttTab" onRender={onRenderCallback}>
                    <div className="flex flex-col flex-grow min-h-0">
                      <GanttTab
                        initialFocusTaskId={ganttTabFocusTaskId}
                        onClearFocus={() => setGanttTabFocusTaskId("")}
                        onNavigateToLayout={handleNavigateToLayout}
                        onNavigateToTaskDetail={handleNavigateToTaskDetail}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </Profiler>
                )}

              {activeTab === "budget" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.budget) && (
                  <BudgetTab
                    initialSearchTerm={budgetTabSearchTerm}
                    onGoToCost={(code) => {
                      setCostTabSearchTerm(code ? String(code).replace(/["']/g, '').trim() : "");
                      handleTabChange("cost");
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "taskDelegation" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.taskDelegation) && (
                  <TaskDelegationTab
                    onBackFromFocus={() => {
                      if (tabHistory.length > 0) {
                        const prev = tabHistory[tabHistory.length - 1];
                        setTabHistory((h) => h.slice(0, -1));
                        setActiveTab(prev);
                      } else {
                        setActiveTab("detail");
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "taskDelegationCalendar" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.taskDelegation) && (
                  <DelegationCalendarTab
                    groups={visibleDelegationGroups}
                    onTabChange={handleTabChange}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "cost" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.costDetail) && (
                  <CostTab
                    initialSearchTerm={costTabSearchTerm}
                    onGoToBudget={(code) => {
                      setBudgetTabSearchTerm(code);
                      handleTabChange("budget");
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "accControl" && (
                <AccControlTab
                  users={appUsers}
                  locationVisibility={locationVisibility}
                  onEditUser={(u) => {
                    setEditingUser(u);
                    setIsUserModalOpen(true);
                  }}
                  onAddUser={() => {
                    setEditingUser(null);
                    setIsUserModalOpen(true);
                  }}
                />
              )}

              {activeTab === "notification" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || currentUser.notification !== false) && (
                  <NotificationTab
                    activeNotifications={activeNotifications}
                    readNotifs={readNotifs}
                    filterId={notificationFilterId}
                    initialStatusFilter={unreadCount > 0 ? "unread" : "all"}
                    onClearFilter={() => setNotificationFilterId(null)}
                    onRequestPermission={handleRequestPermission}
                    onTogglePushEnabled={notifActions.onTogglePushEnabled}
                    onToggleRead={notifActions.onToggleRead}
                    onMarkAllRead={() => notifActions.onMarkAllRead(activeNotifications)}
                    onActionAgree={notifActions.onActionAgree}
                    onActionReject={notifActions.onActionReject}
                    onQuickCompleteTask={notifActions.onQuickCompleteTask}
                    onSnoozeNotif={notifActions.onSnoozeNotif}
                    onClearStaleNotifs={() => notifActions.onClearStaleNotifs(activeNotifications)}
                    onNotificationClick={(notif) => {
                      notifActions.onNotificationClick(notif);

                      if (notif.targetId && notif.targetType) {
                        if (notif.targetType === "notification") {
                          setNotificationFilterId(notif.targetId);
                          handleTabChange("notification");
                          return;
                        }

                        const canSeeLayout = currentUser.role === "admin" || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.layout;
                        const combinedProjects = (projects && projects.length > 0) ? projects : (useAppStore.getState().allProjectsForNotifs || []);
                        const combinedTasks = (tasks && tasks.length > 0) ? tasks : (useAppStore.getState().allTasksForNotifs || []);
                        const layoutMatch = canSeeLayout ? findProjectLayoutUnit(notif, combinedProjects, combinedTasks) : null;

                        if (canSeeLayout && layoutMatch) {
                          const targetYear = layoutMatch.year || (layoutMatch.project?.year ? String(layoutMatch.project.year) : (notif.projectYear ? String(notif.projectYear) : ''));
                          if (targetYear && targetYear !== globalYearFilter && targetYear !== 'all') {
                            setGlobalYearFilter(targetYear);
                          }
                          const targetStore = layoutMatch.store || notif.projectStore || 'HCM';
                          if (targetStore && targetStore !== 'all') {
                            setGlobalStoreFilter(targetStore);
                          }
                          const targetLocation = layoutMatch.location || 'L1';
                          if (targetLocation && targetLocation !== 'ALL') {
                            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalLocationFilter([targetLocation]);
                          }

                          const targetUnitCode = layoutMatch.unitCode || layoutMatch.project?.code || notif.projectCode || (notif.title && notif.title.includes(' - ') ? notif.title.split(' - ')[0].trim() : '');

                          setLayoutTabFilters({
                            store: targetStore,
                            location: targetLocation,
                            projectCode: targetUnitCode,
                            sourceTaskId: layoutMatch.task?.id,
                          });

                          handleTabChange("layout");

                          if (layoutMatch.isComment) {
                            if (layoutMatch.isTaskComment && layoutMatch.task) {
                              setEditingTask(layoutMatch.task);
                              setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                              setModalInitialTab("chat");
                              setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                            } else if (layoutMatch.project) {
                              setEditingProject(layoutMatch.project);
                              setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                              setModalInitialTab("chat");
                              setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                            }
                          }
                          return;
                        }

                        if (notif.targetType === "task_delegation") {
                          handleTabChange("detail");
                          const targetProject =
                            layoutMatch?.project ||
                            combinedProjects.find(
                              (p) =>
                                (notif.projectCode && p.code?.toLowerCase() === notif.projectCode.toLowerCase()) ||
                                String(p.id) === String(notif.targetId) ||
                                String(p.no) === String(notif.targetId)
                            );

                          if (targetProject) {
                            setEditingProject(targetProject);
                            setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                            setModalInitialTab("chat");
                            setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                          } else if (layoutMatch?.task) {
                            setEditingTask(layoutMatch.task);
                            setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                            setModalInitialTab("chat");
                            setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                            return;
                          }
                        }

                        executeDeepLinkRef.current?.(
                          notif.targetType,
                          notif.targetId,
                          {
                            store: notif.projectStore,
                            year: String(notif.projectYear),
                            code: notif.projectCode,
                          }
                        );
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "setting" && (
                <SettingTab rules={notificationRules} />
              )}

              {activeTab === "manual" && (
                <ManualTab />
              )}

              {activeTab === "audit" && (currentUser.role === "admin" || (permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See as any)?.audit) && (
                <AuditLogTab />
              )}

              {activeTab === "csv_export" && (currentUser.role === "admin" || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.importCsv || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.Write?.importCsv) && (
                <CsvExportTab />
              )}

              {activeTab === "picture_mapping" && (currentUser.role === "admin" || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.pictureMapping || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.Write?.pictureMapping) && (
                <PictureMappingTab />
              )}
            </motion.div>
        </Suspense>
      </TabErrorBoundary>
    </div>
  );
});
