import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import { X, ChevronRight, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';

interface AppTourProps {
  onClose: () => void;
}

const steps = [
  {
    title: "Welcome to the App!",
    content: "Since this is your first time here as a guest, let's take a quick tour to help you get started.",
  },
  {
    title: "Navigation",
    content: "Use the tabs at the top to switch between Dashboard, Gantt chart, Tasks, and more. This is how you access all the main features.",
  },
  {
    title: "Notifications",
    content: "The bell icon in the top right shows your notifications. You'll see alerts here when someone mentions you or assigns a task.",
  },
  {
    title: "Settings & Options",
    content: "Click the icons on the top right to customize your experience, switch to Dark Mode, change the language, or manage your keyboard shortcuts.",
  },
];

export function AppTour({ onClose}: AppTourProps) {

  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const theme = useAppStore(state => state.theme);
  const appUsers = useAppStore(state => state.appUsers);
  const subAppUsers = useAppStore(state => state.subAppUsers);
  const parties = useAppStore(state => state.parties);

  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  const nextStep = () => {
    if (currentStep < steps.length - 1) {
      setCurrentStep(prev => prev + 1);
    } else {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Portal>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
        <div 
          className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl shadow-xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden relative"
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          
          <button onClick={onClose} className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          
          <div className="p-6">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] mb-2">{steps[currentStep].title}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mb-8 min-h-[60px]">
              {steps[currentStep].content}
            </p>
            
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                {steps.map((_, idx) => (
                  <div 
                    key={idx} 
                    className={cn(
                      "w-2 h-2 rounded-full transition-colors",
                      idx === currentStep ? "bg-blue-600" : "bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336]"
                    )}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
              
              <button
                onClick={nextStep}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm transition-colors"
              >
                {currentStep === steps.length - 1 ? (
                  <>Get Started <Check className="w-4 h-4" /></>
                ) : (
                  <>Next <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /></>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          
        </div>
      </div>
    </Portal>
  );
}


=== FILE: src/components/AuditDiffViewerModal.tsx ===
import React, { ReactNode, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import { AuditLog } from '../types';
import { formatDisplayDateTime } from '../lib/utils';
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from './DebouncedSearchInput';
import { 
  X, GripHorizontal, ArrowRight, Copy, Check, ShieldCheck, 
  Layers, Clock, User, FileText, Search, Code2, Columns2, 
  PlusCircle, MinusCircle, RefreshCw
} from 'lucide-react';

interface AuditDiffViewerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  log: AuditLog | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function AuditDiffViewerModal({ isOpen, log, onClose }: AuditDiffViewerModalProps) {
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'visual' | 'side-by-side' | 'raw'>('visual');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen || !log) return null;

  const handleCopyJson = () => {
    try {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(log, null, 2));
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch {}
  };

  const isFinancialKey = (key: string) => {
    const k = key.toLowerCase();
    return k.includes('budget') || k.includes('cost') || k.includes('fee') || k.includes('amount') || k.includes('price') || k.includes('total');
  };

  const formatValue = (key: string, val: any): React.ReactNode => {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) {
      return <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic font-mono text-xs">null</span>;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'boolean') {
      return (
        <span className={`inline-flex px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold ${val ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300'}`}>
          {val ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE'}
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (typeof val === 'number') {
      if (isFinancialKey(key) || Math.abs(val) >= 10000) {
        return (
          <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
            {new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(val)} <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-normal">₫</span>
          </span>
        );
      }
      return <span className="font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-semibold">{val}</span>;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
      // Check for ISO Date
      if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(val)) {
        return <span className="font-mono text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-medium">{val}</span>;
      }
      // Status badges
      const lower = val.toLowerCase();
      if (lower === 'completed' || lower === 'finished' || lower === 'done' || lower === 'active') {
        return <span className="inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 font-semibold text-xs">{val}</span>;
      }
      if (lower === 'in progress' || lower === 'doing' || lower === 'ongoing') {
        return <span className="inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 font-semibold text-xs">{val}</span>;
      }
      if (lower === 'pending' || lower === 'waiting' || lower === 'delayed') {
        return <span className="inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/40 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-semibold text-xs">{val}</span>;
      }
      return <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 break-words">{val}</span>;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'object') {
      return (
        <pre className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#121214] p-1.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 overflow-x-auto max-h-32">
          {JSON.stringify(val, null, 2)}
        </pre>
      );
    }
    return String(val);
  };

  // Compile all changed keys
  const prevObj = log.previousData || {};
  const currentObj = log.data || {};
  const allKeysSet = new Set<string>();

  if (typeof prevObj === 'object' && prevObj !== null) {
    Object.keys(prevObj).forEach(k => allKeysSet.add(k));
  }
  if (typeof currentObj === 'object' && currentObj !== null) {
    Object.keys(currentObj).forEach(k => allKeysSet.add(k));
  }

  const allKeys = Array.from(allKeysSet).filter(k => 
    !searchTerm || k.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const getActionBadgeClass = (action: string) => {
    switch (action) {
      case 'CREATE': return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800';
      case 'UPDATE': return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800';
      case 'DELETE': return 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800';
      default: return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
    }
  };

  const getEntityBadgeClass = (entity?: string) => {
    switch (entity) {
      case 'project': return 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300 border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-800';
      case 'task': return 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300 border-sky-300 dark:border-sky-800';
      case 'cost': return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800';
      case 'user': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/60 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800';
      case 'delegation': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 dark:bg-orange-950/60 dark:text-orange-300 border-orange-300 dark:border-orange-800';
      default: return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
    }
  };

  return (
    <Portal>
      <div 
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-[9999] p-2 md:p-6"
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
        }}
      >
        <Draggable 
          disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} 
          handle=".modal-handle" 
          bounds="parent" 
          nodeRef={nodeRef} 
          cancel="button, input, select, textarea, pre"
        >
          <div 
            ref={nodeRef} 
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 pointer-events-auto"
          >
            {/* Modal Draggable Header */}
            <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#2e2e32] flex items-center justify-between select-none">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                  <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white">
                    Audit Event Diff Viewer
                  </h2>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={handleCopyJson}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3a3a3e] bg-white dark:bg-[#252528] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#2e2e32] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                  title="Copy full JSON event"
                >
                  {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy JSON'}</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#2e2e32] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                  title="Close (Esc)"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Event Metadata Bar */}
            <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-slate-100/70 dark:bg-[#141416] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#2e2e32] flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold border text-[11px] ${getActionBadgeClass(log.action)}`}>
                  {log.action}
                </span>
                <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold border uppercase text-[10px] ${getEntityBadgeClass(log.entityType)}`}>
                  {log.entityType || 'Document'}
                </span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 ml-1">
                  <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                  <span className="font-semibold">{log.userEmail}</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-mono">({log.userId})</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                  <span>{formatDisplayDateTime(new Date(log.timestamp).toISOString())}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-[220px] truncate" title={log.docPath}>
                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">{log.docId}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Controls & View Mode Tabs */}
            <div className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#28282b] flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#222226] p-1 rounded-xl w-full sm:w-auto">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('visual')}
                  className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                    viewMode === 'visual'
                      ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#2e2e34] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Visual Changes</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('side-by-side')}
                  className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                    viewMode === 'side-by-side'
                      ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#2e2e34] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Columns2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Side-by-Side</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('raw')}
                  className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                    viewMode === 'raw'
                      ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#2e2e34] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Code2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Raw Event</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {viewMode !== 'raw' && (
                <div className="relative w-full sm:w-64">
                  <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5 z-10 pointer-events-none" />
                  <DebouncedSearchInput
                    placeholder="Filter field changes..."
                    value={searchTerm}
                    onChange={(val) => setSearchTerm(val)}
                    debounceMs={200}
                    className="w-full pl-8 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#222226] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Main Diff Content Container */}
            <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto max-h-[60vh] space-y-4">
              {/* TAB 1: VISUAL FIELD CHANGES */}
              {viewMode === 'visual' && (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {allKeys.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-400 text-sm">
                      No matching field differences found.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    allKeys.map((key) => {
                      const prevVal = prevObj[key];
                      const nextVal = currentObj[key];
                      const hasPrev = key in prevObj;
                      const hasNext = key in currentObj;

                      const isChanged = hasPrev && hasNext && JSON.stringify(prevVal) !== JSON.stringify(nextVal);
                      const isAdded = !hasPrev && hasNext;
                      const isRemoved = hasPrev && !hasNext;

                      return (
                        <div 
                          key={key} 
                          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e22] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#2e2e32] rounded-xl p-3.5 transition-all hover:border-indigo-200 dark:hover:border-indigo-900"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282c] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383c]">
                                {key}
                              </span>
                              {isAdded && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                                  <PlusCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> ADDED
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {isRemoved && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                                  <MinusCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> REMOVED
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {isChanged && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                                  <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" /> MODIFIED
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* Comparison Grid */}
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-1 text-xs">
                            {/* Before */}
                            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg border ${
                              isChanged || isRemoved 
                                ? 'bg-rose-50/70 dark:bg-rose-950/20 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/40 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200' 
                                : 'bg-white dark:bg-[#252528] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336]'
                            }`}>
                              <div className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span>Before</span>
                                {isChanged && <span className="text-rose-500 font-mono">- OLD</span>}
                              </div>
                              <div className="break-words">
                                {hasPrev ? formatValue(key, prevVal) : <span className="text-slate-400 italic">Not set</span>}
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* After */}
                            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg border ${
                              isChanged || isAdded 
                                ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200' 
                                : 'bg-white dark:bg-[#252528] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336]'
                            }`}>
                              <div className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span>After</span>
                                {(isChanged || isAdded) && <span className="text-emerald-500 font-mono">+ NEW</span>}
                              </div>
                              <div className="break-words">
                                {hasNext ? formatValue(key, nextVal) : <span className="text-slate-400 italic">Removed</span>}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* TAB 2: SIDE-BY-SIDE JSON */}
              {viewMode === 'side-by-side' && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 rounded-xl p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-x-auto border border-slate-800">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 mb-2 border-b border-slate-800 text-rose-400 font-bold">
                      <span>PREVIOUS STATE (BEFORE)</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Snapshot</span>
                    </div>
                    <pre>{JSON.stringify(prevObj, null, 2)}</pre>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 rounded-xl p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-x-auto border border-slate-800">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 mb-2 border-b border-slate-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                      <span>CURRENT STATE (AFTER)</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Committed Payload</span>
                    </div>
                    <pre>{JSON.stringify(currentObj, null, 2)}</pre>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* TAB 3: RAW EVENT INSPECTOR */}
              {viewMode === 'raw' && (
                <div className="bg-slate-950 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-x-auto border border-slate-800 shadow-inner max-h-[50vh]">
                  <pre>{JSON.stringify(log, null, 2)}</pre>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Modal Footer */}
            <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1a1a1d] border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#28282b] flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Takashimaya Immutable Audit Trail • Enterprise Security
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-900 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              >
                Close Viewer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Draggable>
      </div>
    </Portal>
  );
}

};

import { AuditLog } from '../../types';

export interface AuditLogTabProps {}

export type AuditActionFilter = 'ALL' | 'CREATE' | 'UPDATE' | 'DELETE';
export type AuditEntityFilter = 'ALL' | 'project' | 'task' | 'cost' | 'delegation' | 'user';

export const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

export const getActionColor = (action: string) => {
  switch (action) {
    case 'CREATE':
      return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300';
    case 'UPDATE':
      return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300';
    case 'DELETE':
      return 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-500/20 dark:text-rose-300';
    default:
      return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-500/20 dark:text-slate-300';
  }
};

export const getEntityBadgeColor = (entity?: string) => {
  switch (entity) {
    case 'project':
      return 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 dark:bg-indigo-500/20 dark:text-indigo-300';
    case 'task':
      return 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-500/20 dark:text-sky-300';
    case 'cost':
      return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300';
    case 'user':
      return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-500/20 dark:text-purple-300';
    case 'delegation':
      return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 dark:bg-orange-500/20 dark:text-orange-300';
    default:
      return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-700/50 dark:text-slate-300';
  }
};


=== FILE: src/components/AuditLogParts/useAuditLogData.ts ===
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  collection,
  query,
  orderBy,
  limit,
  startAfter,
  getDocs,
  where,
  QueryConstraint,
} from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { AuditLog } from '../../types';
import { PAGE_SIZE } from './auditLogTypes';

export function useAuditLogData() {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<AuditLog[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedLog, setSelectedLog] = useState<AuditLog | null>(null);

  // Pagination state
  const [lastVisible, setLastVisible] = useState<any>(null);
  const [firstVisible, setFirstVisible] = useState<any>(null);
  const [pageHistory, setPageHistory] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);

  // Filters
  const [actionFilter, setActionFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [entityFilter, setEntityFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [userEmailFilter, setUserEmailFilter] = useState<string>('');
  const [indexWarningUrl, setIndexWarningUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fetchLogs = async (direction: 'next' | 'prev' | 'initial' = 'initial') => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const qConstraints: QueryConstraint[] = [orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')];

      if (actionFilter !== 'ALL') {
        qConstraints.push(where('action', '==', actionFilter));
      }
      if (entityFilter !== 'ALL') {
        qConstraints.push(where('entityType', '==', entityFilter));
      }
      if (userEmailFilter.trim()) {
        qConstraints.push(where('userEmail', '==', userEmailFilter.trim()));
      }

      qConstraints.push(limit(PAGE_SIZE));

      if (direction === 'next' && lastVisible) {
        qConstraints.push(startAfter(lastVisible));
      } else if (direction === 'prev') {
        const prevDoc = pageHistory[currentPage - 2];
        if (prevDoc) {
          qConstraints.push(startAfter(prevDoc));
        }
      }

      let snapshot;
      try {
        const q = query(collection(db, 'audit_logs'), ...qConstraints);
        snapshot = await getDocs(q);
      } catch (queryErr: any) {
        const msg = queryErr?.message || '';
        if (
          msg.includes('requires an index') ||
          msg.includes('indexes?create_composite') ||
          queryErr?.code === 'failed-precondition'
        ) {
          console.warn('Firestore composite index not found, falling back to in-memory filtering:', msg);

          const matchUrl = msg.match(/https:\/\/console\.firebase\.google\.com[^\s]+/);
          if (matchUrl && matchUrl[0]) {
            setIndexWarningUrl(matchUrl[0]);
          }

          const fallbackQ = query(
            collection(db, 'audit_logs'),
            orderBy('timestamp', 'desc'),
            limit(200)
          );
          const fallbackSnap = await getDocs(fallbackQ);

          const filteredLogs: AuditLog[] = [];
          fallbackSnap.forEach((doc) => {
            const data = doc.data();
            let keep = true;
            if (actionFilter !== 'ALL' && data.action !== actionFilter) keep = false;
            if (entityFilter !== 'ALL' && data.entityType !== entityFilter) keep = false;
            if (userEmailFilter.trim()) {
              const term = userEmailFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
              const email = (data.userEmail || '').toLowerCase();
              const uid = (data.userId || '').toLowerCase();
              if (!email.includes(term) && !uid.includes(term)) keep = false;
            }
            if (keep) {
              filteredLogs.push({ id: doc.id, ...data } as AuditLog);
            }
          });

          setLogs(filteredLogs.slice(0, PAGE_SIZE));
          setHasMore(filteredLogs.length > PAGE_SIZE);
          setFirstVisible(filteredLogs.length > 0 ? filteredLogs[0] : null);
          setLastVisible(
            filteredLogs.length > 0
              ? filteredLogs[Math.min(PAGE_SIZE - 1, filteredLogs.length - 1)]
              : null
          );
          setCurrentPage(1);
          setPageHistory([]);
          setLoading(false);
          setError(null);
          return;
        }
        throw queryErr;
      }

      const newLogs: AuditLog[] = [];
      snapshot.forEach((doc) => {
        newLogs.push({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as AuditLog);
      });

      setLogs(newLogs);

      if (snapshot.docs.length > 0) {
        if (direction === 'next' || direction === 'initial') {
          if (direction === 'next') {
            setPageHistory((prev) => [...prev, lastVisible]);
            setCurrentPage((p) => p + 1);
          } else {
            setPageHistory([]);
            setCurrentPage(1);
          }
        } else if (direction === 'prev') {
          setPageHistory((prev) => prev.slice(0, prev.length - 1));
          setCurrentPage((p) => p - 1);
        }

        setFirstVisible(snapshot.docs[0]);
        setLastVisible(snapshot.docs[snapshot.docs.length - 1]);
        setHasMore(snapshot.docs.length === PAGE_SIZE);
      } else {
        if (direction === 'initial') {
          setHasMore(false);
          setFirstVisible(null);
          setLastVisible(null);
        } else if (direction === 'next') {
          setHasMore(false);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch audit logs:', err);
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to fetch logs');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchLogs('initial');
  }, [actionFilter, entityFilter]);

  const handleSearch = () => {
    fetchLogs('initial');
  };

  return {
    logs,
    loading,
    error,
    selectedLog,
    setSelectedLog,
    currentPage,
    hasMore,
    actionFilter,
    setActionFilter,
    entityFilter,
    setEntityFilter,
    userEmailFilter,
    setUserEmailFilter,
    indexWarningUrl,
    fetchLogs,
    handleSearch,
  };
}

=== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/BudgetEditableCell.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { formatCurrencyValue, cn } from '../../lib/utils';

export interface BudgetEditableCellProps {
  value: any;
  type?: string;
  onSave: (val: any) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
  isCurrency?: boolean;
  currency?: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate?: number;
  usdRate?: number;
  wrapText?: boolean;
}

export function BudgetEditableCell({
  value,
  type = 'text',
  onSave,
  canWrite,
  isCurrency = false,
  currency = 'VND',
  jpyRate = 160,
  usdRate = 25000,
  wrapText = false
}: BudgetEditableCellProps) {
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [val, setVal] = useState(value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : '');
  const isTypingRef = React.useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTypingRef.current) {
      setVal(value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : '');
    }
  }, [value]);

  const handleBlur = () => {
    isTypingRef.current = false;
    setIsEditing(false);
    const newVal = type === 'number' ? Number(String(val).replace(',', '.')) : val;
    if (newVal !== value) {
      onSave(newVal);
    }
  };

  const displayValue = isCurrency
    ? (value === null || value === undefined ? '-' : formatCurrencyValue(value, currency, jpyRate, usdRate))
    : (value || '-');

  const isMoneyLocked = isCurrency && currency !== 'VND';
  const effectiveCanWrite = canWrite && !isMoneyLocked;

  if (!effectiveCanWrite) {
    return (
      <span
        title={isMoneyLocked ? `Editing locked in ${currency}. Switch to VND to edit.` : undefined}
        className={isMoneyLocked ? "cursor-not-allowed select-text opacity-95 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]" : ""}
      >
        {displayValue}
      </span>
    );
  }

  if (isEditing) {
    return (
      <input
        autoFocus
        type={type === 'number' ? 'text' : type}
        inputMode={type === 'number' ? 'decimal' : 'text'}
        value={val}
        onFocus={(e) => {
          isTypingRef.current = true;
          e.target.select();
        }}
        onChange={(e) => setVal(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
        }}
        className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-400 rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none text-inherit font-inherit text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}
      className={cn(
        "cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] px-1 py-0.5 rounded border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200 min-h-[24px]",
        wrapText ? "whitespace-normal break-words" : "truncate"
      )}
      title={typeof displayValue === 'string' ? displayValue : undefined}
    >
      {displayValue}
    </div>
  );
}

  onClose,

  setParentSearchTerm,
  childSearchTerm,
  setChildSearchTerm,
  candidateParentProjects,
  candidateChildProjects,
  linkedChildrenCount,
  getProjectFinancials,
  handleLinkParent,
  formatCurrency,
  projects,
  initialYear,
  initialStore,
  initialLocation

  const dragControls = useDragControls();

  const [modalYearFilter, setModalYearFilter] = useState<string>(initialYear || 'all');
  const [modalStoreFilter, setModalStoreFilter] = useState<string>(initialStore || 'all');

        if (selectedParentProject.store) setModalStoreFilter(String(selectedParentProject.store).toUpperCase());
      } else {
        setModalYearFilter(initialYear || 'all');
        setModalStoreFilter(initialStore || 'all');
        setModalLocationFilter(initialLocation || 'all');
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, selectedParentProject, initialYear, initialStore, initialLocation]);

  const allProjects = projects && projects.length > 0 ? projects : candidateParentProjects;

  const availableYears = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    allProjects.forEach(p => {
      if (p.year) set.add(String(p.year).trim());
      else if (p.start) set.add(String(p.start).substring(0, 4));
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
  }, [allProjects]);

  const availableLocations = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    allProjects.forEach(p => {
      if (p.location && p.location.trim()) {
        set.add(p.location.trim());
      }
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [allProjects]);

  const filteredParentProjects = useMemo(() => {
    const term = parentSearchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    return allProjects.filter(p => {
      if (modalYearFilter !== 'all') {
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '');
        if (pYear && pYear !== modalYearFilter) return false;
      }
      if (modalStoreFilter !== 'all') {
        const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (pStore && pStore !== modalStoreFilter.toUpperCase()) return false;
      }
      if (modalLocationFilter !== 'all') {
        if (p.location !== modalLocationFilter) return false;
      }
      if (!term) return true;
      const searchPool = [
        p.code,
        p.name,
        p.year,
        p.store,
        p.location,
        p.type,
        p.note
      ].map(v => String(v || '').toLowerCase());
      return searchPool.some(val => val.includes(term));
    }).slice(0, 100);
  }, [allProjects, parentSearchTerm, modalYearFilter, modalStoreFilter, modalLocationFilter]);

  const filteredChildProjects = useMemo(() => {
    const parentCode = selectedParentProject ? String(selectedParentProject.code || '').trim().toUpperCase() : '';
    const parentId = selectedParentProject?.id || (selectedParentProject ? `${selectedParentProject.code}-${selectedParentProject.year}-${selectedParentProject.store}-${selectedParentProject.no}` : '');
    const term = childSearchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    const filtered = allProjects.filter(p => {
      const pId = p.id || `${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.store}-${p.no}`;
      const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();

      if (selectedParentProject && (pId === parentId || pCode === parentCode)) return false;
      if (selectedParentProject?.parentId && String(selectedParentProject.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === pCode) return false;

      const targetYear = selectedParentProject?.year 
        ? String(selectedParentProject.year).trim() 
        : (modalYearFilter !== 'all' ? modalYearFilter : '');
      if (targetYear) {
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '');
        if (pYear && pYear !== targetYear) return false;
      }

      const targetStore = selectedParentProject?.store 
        ? String(selectedParentProject.store).trim().toUpperCase() 
        : (modalStoreFilter !== 'all' ? modalStoreFilter.toUpperCase() : '');
      if (targetStore) {
        const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (pStore && pStore !== targetStore) return false;
      }

      if (modalLocationFilter !== 'all') {
        if (p.location !== modalLocationFilter) return false;
      }

      if (!term) return true;
      const searchPool = [
        p.code,
        p.name,
        p.year,
        p.store,
        p.location,
        p.type,
        p.note
      ].map(v => String(v || '').toLowerCase());
      return searchPool.some(val => val.includes(term));
    });

    if (parentCode) {
      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const aIsChild = a.parentId && String(a.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === parentCode ? 1 : 0;
        const bIsChild = b.parentId && String(b.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === parentCode ? 1 : 0;
        return bIsChild - aIsChild;
      });
    }

    return filtered.slice(0, 100);
  }, [allProjects, selectedParentProject, childSearchTerm, modalYearFilter, modalStoreFilter, modalLocationFilter]);

  if (!isOpen && !selectedParentProject) return null;

  const parentStats = selectedParentProject ? getProjectFinancials(selectedParentProject) : null;

  return (
    <div className={`fixed inset-0 ${getZIndexClass('MODAL_MODULAR')} flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs p-2 sm:p-4 overflow-hidden pointer-events-auto`}>
      <motion.div
        drag
        dragControls={dragControls}
        dragListener={false}
        dragMomentum={false}
        className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-[96vw] max-w-6xl xl:max-w-7xl h-[90vh] max-h-[860px] flex flex-col border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
      >
        {/* Modal Drag Header */}
        <div 
          onPointerDown={(e) => dragControls.start(e)}
          className="p-3.5 sm:p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-[#18181a] cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing select-none shrink-0"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
              <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-base md:text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">
              {t('Project Modular (Link Budget)')}
            </h3>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button 
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200/50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Scope Filter Toolbar: Year, Store, Location */}
        <div className="px-3.5 sm:px-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#18181a] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 mr-1">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]" />
              <span>{t('Filter Scope')}:</span>
            </div>

            {/* Year Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t('Year')}:</span>
              <select
                value={modalYearFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setModalYearFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="text-xs bg-white dark:bg-[#222225] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
              >
                <option value="all">{t('All Years')}</option>
                {availableYears.map(y => (
                  <option key={y} value={y}>{y}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Store Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t('Store')}:</span>
              <select
                value={modalStoreFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setModalStoreFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="text-xs bg-white dark:bg-[#222225] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
              >
                <option value="all">{t('All Stores')}</option>
                <option value="HCM">HCM</option>
                <option value="HN">HN</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Location Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t('Location')}:</span>
              <select
                value={modalLocationFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setModalLocationFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="text-xs bg-white dark:bg-[#222225] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer shadow-2xs max-w-[140px] truncate"

              onClick={() => {

                setModalStoreFilter('all');
                setModalLocationFilter('all');
              }}
              className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8] flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>{t('Reset Filter')}</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Main Content: 2 Columns Side-by-Side */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:gap-4 p-3 sm:p-4 overflow-y-auto lg:overflow-hidden">
          {/* Column 1: Parent Projects */}
          <BudgetLinkParentColumn
            filteredParentProjects={filteredParentProjects}
            selectedParentProject={selectedParentProject}
            setSelectedParentProject={setSelectedParentProject}
            parentSearchTerm={parentSearchTerm}
            setParentSearchTerm={setParentSearchTerm}
            parentStats={parentStats}
            linkedChildrenCount={linkedChildrenCount}
            formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
          />

          {/* Column 2: Child Projects */}
          <BudgetLinkChildColumn
            selectedParentProject={selectedParentProject}
            childSearchTerm={childSearchTerm}
            setChildSearchTerm={setChildSearchTerm}
            filteredChildProjects={filteredChildProjects}
            handleLinkParent={handleLinkParent}
            getProjectFinancials={getProjectFinancials}
            formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
          />
        </div>

  );
}

            "px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded border uppercase shrink-0", 
            node.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hcm' 
              ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/80 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800' 
              : node.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hn' 
              ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800' 
              : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
          )}>
            {node.store || '-'}
          </span>
          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold font-mono rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800 shrink-0">
            {node.code}
          </span>
          {(node.location || node.project?.location) && (
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium truncate">
              • {node.location || node.project?.location}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="shrink-0">
          <span className={cn("px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg border", vBg, vColor)}>
            {formatCurrency(node.remaining)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Project Name */}
      <div 
        onClick={() => node.project && onProjectClick(node.project)}
        className={cn(
          "font-bold text-sm leading-snug cursor-pointer hover:underline hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8]",
          node.isParentNode ? "text-slate-900 dark:text-[#ffffff]" : (isSubRow ? "text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200 font-semibold" : "text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]")
        )}
      >
        {cleanNodeName}
      </div>

      {/* Key Metrics Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#161618] rounded-lg p-2 border border-slate-100 dark:border-[#2e2e32] text-center">
        <div className="flex flex-col">
          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase">{t('Budget')}</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] truncate">
            {formatCurrency(node.totalBudget ?? node.budget)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col border-x border-slate-200 dark:border-[#2e2e32] px-1">
          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5">
            {t('Actual')}
            {node.hasForc && <span className="text-[8px] text-orange-600 font-extrabold">(F)</span>}
          </span>
          <span 
            onClick={() => onGoToCost(node.code)}
            className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 truncate cursor-pointer hover:underline"
          >
            {formatCurrency(node.totalActual)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col">
          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase">{t('Support Fee')}</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 truncate">
            {formatCurrency(node.totalSupportingFee ?? node.ownSupportingFee)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Note & Actions row */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#2e2e32]/60 text-xs">
        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 italic truncate flex-1 min-w-0">
          {node.note || <span className="opacity-40">{t('No notes')}</span>}
        </div>

          <QuickNavButton project={node.project} title={`Quick Navigator (${node.code})`} />
          <QRCodeButton title={node.name || node.code} url={`${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}?tab=budget&q=${encodeURIComponent(node.code || '')}`} />

              {node.isParentNode ? (

                  onClick={() => handleOpenLinkModal(node.project)}
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                  title="Project Modular (Set as Main)"
                >
                  <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              ) : (
                !node.isSelf && (
                  <>
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => handleOpenLinkModal(node.project)}
                      className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                      title="Project Modular (Set as Main)"
                    >
                      <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => handleLinkParent(node.project, null)}
                      className="p-1 text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 rounded bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-red-950/50 transition-colors active:scale-95"
                      title="Unlink (Make Standalone Parent)"
                    >
                      <Unlink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </>
                )
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});


=== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/BudgetMobileView.tsx ===
import React, { Dispatch, ReactNode, SetStateAction } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { BudgetTreeNode } from './budgetTypes';
import { BudgetMobileCard } from './BudgetMobileCard';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';

interface BudgetMobileViewProps {
  filteredRoots: BudgetTreeNode[];
  visibleCount: number;
  setVisibleCount: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
  canWrite: boolean;
  searchTerm: string;
  collapsedInSearch: Set<string>;
  expandedParents: Set<string>;
  toggleExpand: (id: string) => void;
  toggleAllParents: () => void;
  onGoToCost: (code: string) => void;
  onProjectClick: (p: Project) => void;
  handleOpenLinkModal: (p?: Project) => void;
  handleLinkParent: (childProject: Project, parentCode: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
}

export function BudgetMobileView({
  filteredRoots,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount,
  canWrite,
  searchTerm,
  collapsedInSearch,
  expandedParents,
  toggleExpand,
  toggleAllParents,
  onGoToCost,
  onProjectClick,
  handleOpenLinkModal,
  handleLinkParent,
  formatCurrency
}: BudgetMobileViewProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const renderMobileCards = (nodes: BudgetTreeNode[], depth = 0): React.ReactNode[] => {
    let cards: React.ReactNode[] = [];
    nodes.forEach((node) => {
      const isParent = node.isParentNode && node.filteredChildren && node.filteredChildren.length > 0;
      const isExpanded = searchTerm.trim() 
        ? !collapsedInSearch.has(node.id || node.code) 
        : expandedParents.has(node.id || node.code);

      cards.push(
        <BudgetMobileCard
          key={`mobile-${node.id || `${node.code}-${node.year}-${node.store}-${node.no}`}`}
          node={node}
          depth={depth}
          isExpanded={isExpanded}
          canWrite={canWrite}
          onGoToCost={onGoToCost}
          onProjectClick={onProjectClick}
          toggleExpand={toggleExpand}
          handleOpenLinkModal={handleOpenLinkModal}
          handleLinkParent={handleLinkParent}
          formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
        />
      );

      if (isParent && isExpanded && node.filteredChildren) {
        cards = cards.concat(renderMobileCards(node.filteredChildren, depth + 1));
      }
    });
    return cards;
  };

  const paginatedRoots = filteredRoots.slice(0, visibleCount);

  return (
    <div className="xl:hidden flex-grow overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-3 p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#121214] relative min-h-0">
      {/* Expand / Collapse All Parents for Mobile */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-1">
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
          {t('Showing')} {Math.min(visibleCount, filteredRoots.length)} {t('of')} {filteredRoots.length} {t('projects')}
        </span>
        <button 
          onClick={toggleAllParents} 
          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-semibold hover:underline touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
        >
          {expandedParents.size === 0 ? (
            <><ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {t('Expand Parents')}</>
          ) : (
            <><ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {t('Collapse Parents')}</>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Cards List */}
      {renderMobileCards(paginatedRoots)}

      {/* Load More on Mobile */}
      {visibleCount < filteredRoots.length && (
        <div className="py-2 text-center">
          <button
            onClick={() => setVisibleCount(prev => prev + 30)}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors text-xs w-full max-w-xs touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
          >
            {t('Load More Projects')} ({filteredRoots.length - visibleCount} {t('remaining')})
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Layers, Unlink } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { BudgetTreeNode } from './budgetTypes';
import { BudgetEditableCell } from './BudgetEditableCell';
import { QuickNavButton } from '../QuickNavButton';
import { QRCodeButton } from '../QRCodeButton';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';

interface BudgetTableRowProps {
  node: BudgetTreeNode;
  idx: number;
  depth: number;
  isExpanded: boolean;
  visibleColumns: string[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  currency: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate: number;
  usdRate: number;
  onGoToCost: (code: string) => void;
  onProjectClick: (p: Project) => void;
  toggleExpand: (id: string) => void;
  handleUpdateProject: (p: Project, field: keyof Project, value: any) => Promise<void>;
  handleOpenLinkModal: (p?: Project) => void;
  handleLinkParent: (childProject: Project, parentCode: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
}

export const BudgetTableRow = memo(function BudgetTableRow({
  node,
  idx,
  depth,
  isExpanded,
  visibleColumns,
  canWrite,
  currency,
  jpyRate,
  usdRate,
  onGoToCost,
  onProjectClick,
  toggleExpand,
  handleUpdateProject,
  handleOpenLinkModal,
  handleLinkParent,
  formatCurrency
}: BudgetTableRowProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const isParent = node.isParentNode && node.filteredChildren && node.filteredChildren.length > 0;
  const vColor = (node.remaining || 0) < 0 ? 'text-red-500 dark:text-red-400' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400';
  
  const isSelfRow = !node.isParentNode && node.isSelf;
  const isSubRow = !node.isParentNode && !node.isSelf;
  const isHighlightedChild = !node.isParentNode && Boolean(node.isSearchMatch);

  let rowBgClass = "";
  if (node.isParentNode) {
    rowBgClass = isParent 
      ? "bg-blue-50/35 dark:bg-[#1a2030]/60 hover:bg-blue-50/60 font-semibold" 
      : (idx % 2 === 0 ? "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-blue-50/30" : "bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#1b1b1d] hover:bg-blue-50/30");
  } else if (isHighlightedChild) {
    rowBgClass = isSelfRow 
      ? "bg-blue-100/80 dark:bg-blue-950/70 font-semibold ring-2 ring-blue-500 dark:ring-blue-400 ring-inset shadow-xs relative z-10" 
      : "bg-amber-100/80 dark:bg-amber-950/70 font-semibold ring-2 ring-amber-500 dark:ring-amber-400 ring-inset shadow-xs relative z-10";
  } else if (isSelfRow) {
    rowBgClass = "bg-blue-50/20 dark:bg-[#151926]/50 hover:bg-blue-50/40 border-l-2 border-l-blue-400/80";
  } else {
    rowBgClass = "bg-amber-50/25 dark:bg-[#221a12]/50 hover:bg-amber-50/40 border-l-2 border-l-amber-500/80";
  }

  return (
    <tr 
      className={cn(
        "table-row-optimized border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] transition-all text-xs",
        rowBgClass
      )}
    >
      {visibleColumns.includes('no') && (
        <td className="px-2 py-2.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 min-w-0">
            {isParent && (
              <button 
                onClick={() => toggleExpand(node.id || node.code)} 
                className={cn(
                  "p-1 text-white rounded transition-colors flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs font-bold shrink-0 shadow-2xs",
                  (node.filteredChildren?.length ?? 0) >= 2
                    ? "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500"
                    : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700"
                )}
                title={isExpanded ? "Collapse" : `Expand (${node.filteredChildren?.length})`}
              >
                {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                <span className="text-[10px]">({node.filteredChildren?.length})</span>
              </button>
            )}
            {isSelfRow && (
              <span className="text-[8.5px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-800 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] uppercase shrink-0 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 flex items-center gap-0.5 leading-none" title="Dòng tự thân (Self)">
                ↳ SELF
              </span>
            )}
            {isSubRow && (
              <span className="text-[8.5px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 uppercase shrink-0 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 flex items-center gap-0.5 leading-none" title="Dòng con (Sub)">
                ↳ SUB
              </span>
            )}
            {isHighlightedChild && (
              <span className="text-[8.5px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 text-white uppercase shrink-0 shadow-2xs leading-none">
                MATCH
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('year') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
          {node.isParentNode ? (

          ) : (

          )}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('store') && (
        <td className={cn("px-4 py-3 font-bold", node.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hcm' ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]' : node.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hn' ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]')}>
          {node.isParentNode ? (
            <BudgetEditableCell 
              value={node.store} 
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateProject(node.project, 'store', val)} 
              canWrite={canWrite} 
            />
          ) : (
            <span>{node.store || '-'}</span>
          )}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('location') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">

            canWrite={canWrite} 
          />
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('code') && (

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-mono font-extrabold uppercase whitespace-nowrap min-w-0">
            {node.isParentNode ? (
              <BudgetEditableCell

                canWrite={canWrite} 
              />
            ) : (
              <span 
                onClick={() => node.project && onProjectClick(node.project)}
                className={cn(
                  "font-semibold whitespace-nowrap text-xs tracking-tight cursor-pointer hover:underline hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8]", 
                  isSubRow ? "text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200" : "text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]"

            node.isParentNode ? "font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]" : (isSubRow ? "font-medium text-amber-950/90 dark:text-amber-200/90" : "font-normal text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]")

              jpyRate={jpyRate}

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { buildBudgetTreeData } from './useBudgetTreeData';

describe('Budget Tree Scope & Cross-Year Guard', () => {
  it('does not attach children of year 2026 to a parent of year 2027 with identical code', () => {
    const mockProjects: any[] = [
      {
        id: 'p_2026_parent',
        code: 'L3-CORRIDOR',
        name: 'Corridor replacement',
        year: 2026,
        store: 'HCM',
        location: 'L3',
        budget: 3000000,
        actual: 2379610,
        no: 1,
      },
      {
        id: 'p_2027_parent',
        code: 'L3-CORRIDOR',
        name: 'Corridor replacement, Reserve',
        year: 2027,
        store: 'HCM',
        location: 'L3',
        budget: 200000,
        actual: 820500,
        no: 2,
      },
      {
        id: 'p_2026_child',
        code: 'L3-CORRIDOR-SUB1',
        name: 'Floor tiles',
        year: 2026,
        store: 'HCM',
        location: 'L3',
        parentId: 'L3-CORRIDOR',
        budget: 500000,
        actual: 400000,
        no: 3,
      },
    ];

    const tree = buildBudgetTreeData(mockProjects, []);
    expect(tree).toHaveLength(2);

    const node2026 = tree.find((n) => n.year === 2026);
    const node2027 = tree.find((n) => n.year === 2027);

    expect(node2026).toBeDefined();
    expect(node2027).toBeDefined();

    // 2026 parent should have 2 children: selfChild + p_2026_child
    expect(node2026?.children).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(node2026?.children?.some((c) => c.code === 'L3-CORRIDOR-SUB1')).toBe(true);

    // 2027 parent must NOT contain the 2026 child! It should only have its selfChild
    expect(node2027?.children).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(node2027?.children?.[0].isSelf).toBe(true);
    expect(node2027?.children?.some((c) => c.code === 'L3-CORRIDOR-SUB1')).toBe(false);
  });
});

=== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/useBudgetCsvOps.ts ===
import React from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { BudgetTreeNode } from './budgetTypes';
import { downloadCSV, parseCSV, generateCSV } from '../../lib/csvUtils';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface UseBudgetCsvOpsParams {
  projects: Project[];
  filteredRoots: BudgetTreeNode[];
}

export function useBudgetCsvOps({ projects, filteredRoots }: UseBudgetCsvOpsParams) {
  const handleExportBudget = () => {
    const headers = ['store', 'location', 'year', 'code', 'name', 'budget'];
    const data = filteredRoots.map(node => [
      node.store || '',
      node.location || '',
      node.year || '',
      node.code || '',
      node.name || '',
      node.budget || 0
    ]);
    const csv = generateCSV(headers, data);
    downloadCSV(csv, 'taka_budget_filtered.csv');
  };

  const handleImportBudget = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = async (event) => {
      try {
        const text = event.target?.result as string;
        const rows = parseCSV(text);
        if (rows.length < 2) throw new Error('CSV is empty or invalid.');
        const headers = rows[0].map(h => h.trim().toLowerCase());
        const dataRows = rows.slice(1);
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        let importCount = 0;

        for (const row of dataRows) {
          if (row.every(cell => !cell.trim())) continue;
          const p: any = {};
          headers.forEach((h, i) => {
            let key = h;
            if (h === 'project code' || h === 'code') key = 'code';
            if (h === 'project name' || h === 'name') key = 'name';
            
            if (['code', 'name', 'year', 'store', 'location', 'budget'].includes(key)) {
              let val: any = row[i];
              if (key === 'year' || key === 'budget') val = isNaN(Number(val)) ? val : Number(val);
              p[key] = val;
            }
          });
          if (!p.code) continue;
          
          const match = projects.find(proj => 
            String(proj.code).trim().toLowerCase() === String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase() && 
            String(proj.year || '') === String(p.year || '') && 
            String(proj.store || '') === String(p.store || '')
          );
          
          if (match && p.budget !== undefined) {
            batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', match.id), { 
              budget: p.budget, 
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() 
            });
            importCount++;
          }
        }
        
        if (importCount > 0) {
          try {
            await batch.commit();
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({ 
              title: "Thông báo", 
              message: `Successfully updated budget for ${importCount} projects.` 
            });
          } catch (error: any) {
            console.error("Batch commit failed", error);
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({ 
              title: "Save Failed", 
              message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", 
              type: "error" 
            });
          }
        } else {
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ 
            title: "Thông báo", 
            message: 'No matching projects found to update budget.' 
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ 
          title: "Thông báo", 
          message: 'Error importing CSV: ' + (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)) 
        });
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  return {
    handleExportBudget,
    handleImportBudget
  };
}

import React, { useDeferredValue, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Project, Cost, AppUser, AppRole } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import {

} from '../../lib/utils';

interface UseBudgetDataParams {
  projects: Project[];
  costs: Cost[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  initialSearchTerm?: string;
}

export function useBudgetData({
  projects,
  costs,
  currentUser,
  initialSearchTerm = ''
}: UseBudgetDataParams) {
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const currency = useAppStore(state => state.currency);
  const jpyRate = useAppStore(state => state.jpyRate);
  const usdRate = useAppStore(state => state.usdRate);

  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setGlobalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalYearFilter);
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const setGlobalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalStoreFilter);
  const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
  const globalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalLocationFilter);
  const setGlobalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalLocationFilter);
  const setDetailTabFilterCode = useAppStore(state => state.setDetailTabFilterCode);
  const setDetailTabStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setDetailTabStoreFilter);
  const setActiveTab = useAppStore(state => state.setActiveTab);
  const budgetTabSearchTerm = useAppStore(state => state.budgetTabSearchTerm);

  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(initialSearchTerm || budgetTabSearchTerm || '');
  const deferredSearchTerm = useDeferredValue(searchTerm);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialSearchTerm) {
      setSearchTerm(initialSearchTerm);
    } else if (budgetTabSearchTerm) {
      setSearchTerm(budgetTabSearchTerm);
    }
  }, [initialSearchTerm, budgetTabSearchTerm]);

  const [collapsedInSearch, setCollapsedInSearch] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [moneyFilter, setMoneyFilter] = useState(() => {
    if ((initialSearchTerm || '').trim()) return 'all';
    return safeGetItemSession("taka_budget_money_filter") || 'has_money';
  });
  const lastSelectedMoneyFilterRef = useRef<string>(
    safeGetItemSession("taka_budget_money_filter") || 'has_money'
  );
  const lastSelectedLocationFilterRef = useRef<string[]>(globalLocationFilter);
  const wasSearchingRef = useRef<boolean>(!!(initialSearchTerm || '').trim());

  useEffect(() => {
    const isSearching = !!deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!wasSearchingRef.current && isSearching) {
      if (moneyFilter !== 'all') {
        lastSelectedMoneyFilterRef.current = moneyFilter;
        safeSetItemSession("taka_budget_money_filter", moneyFilter);
      }
      lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current = globalLocationFilter;
      setMoneyFilter('all');
      wasSearchingRef.current = true;
    } else if (wasSearchingRef.current && !isSearching) {
      const restored = lastSelectedMoneyFilterRef.current || safeGetItemSession("taka_budget_money_filter") || 'has_money';
      setMoneyFilter(restored);
      setGlobalLocationFilter(lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current || []);
      wasSearchingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [deferredSearchTerm]);

  const [visibleColumns, setVisibleColumns] = useState<string[]>(AVAILABLE_COLUMNS.map(c => c.id));
  const [colWidths, setColWidths] = useState<Record<string, number>>({
    no: 80,
    year: 80,
    store: 80,
    location: 130,
    code: 165,
    projectName: 220,
    totalBudget: 140,
    actual: 140,
    supportingFee: 140,
    variance: 140,
    type: 130,
    note: 200,
    actions: 90
  });

  const [expandedParents, setExpandedParents] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [selectedParentProject, setSelectedParentProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);
  const [isLinkModalOpen, setIsLinkModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [childSearchTerm, setChildSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [parentSearchTerm, setParentSearchTerm] = useState('');

  // 1. Build hierarchy tree data
  const treeData = useBudgetTreeData({ projects, costs });

  // 2. Filter, search and sort tree roots
  const {
    sortConfig,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    filteredRoots,
    handleBudgetScroll,
    handleSort,
    totalGlobalBudget,
    totalGlobalActual,
    totalGlobalSupportingFee,
