    totalVarianceColor
  } = useBudgetFilterSort({
    treeData,
    globalYearFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    moneyFilter,
    searchTerm,
    deferredSearchTerm
  });

  // 3. Export / Import CSV
  const { handleExportBudget, handleImportBudget } = useBudgetCsvOps({ projects, filteredRoots });

  const getProjectFinancials = (p: Project): ProjectFinancials => {
    const fin = p.financial || { totalApproved: p.budget || 0, totalActualPaid: p.actual || 0, totalForecastPaid: 0 };
    const budget = fin.totalApproved || p.budget || 0;
    const actual = fin.totalActualPaid;
    const hasForc = fin.totalForecastPaid > 0;
    const supportingFee = p.supportingFee || 0;
    const remaining = budget - (actual + fin.totalForecastPaid) + supportingFee;
    return { budget, actual, supportingFee, hasForc, remaining };
  };

  // Candidates for Parent Project Selection
  const candidateParentProjects = useMemo(() => {
    if (!projects || projects.length === 0) return [];
    const term = parentSearchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    return projects.filter(p => {
      if (!term) return true;
      const searchPool = [
        p.code,
        p.name,
        p.year,
        p.store,
        p.location,
        p.type,
        p.note
      ].map(v => String(v || '').toLowerCase());
      
      return searchPool.some(val => val.includes(term));
    }).slice(0, 100);
  }, [projects, parentSearchTerm]);

  // Candidates for Child Project Selection
  const candidateChildProjects = useMemo(() => {
    if (!projects || projects.length === 0) return [];
    const parentCode = selectedParentProject ? String(selectedParentProject.code || '').trim().toUpperCase() : '';
    const parentId = selectedParentProject?.id || (selectedParentProject ? `${selectedParentProject.code}-${selectedParentProject.year}-${selectedParentProject.store}-${selectedParentProject.no}` : '');
    const term = childSearchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    const filtered = projects.filter(p => {
      const pId = p.id || `${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.store}-${p.no}`;
      const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();

      if (selectedParentProject && (pId === parentId || pCode === parentCode)) return false;
      if (selectedParentProject?.parentId && String(selectedParentProject.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === pCode) return false;

      // Restrict candidate children to same fiscal year and store as selected parent
      if (selectedParentProject) {
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '');
        const parentYear = selectedParentProject.year ? String(selectedParentProject.year).trim() : (selectedParentProject.start ? String(selectedParentProject.start).substring(0, 4) : '');
        if (pYear && parentYear && pYear !== parentYear) return false;

        const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        const parentStore = String(selectedParentProject.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (pStore && parentStore && pStore !== parentStore) return false;
      }

      if (!term) return true;
      const searchPool = [
        p.code,
        p.name,
        p.year,
        p.store,
        p.location,
        p.type,
        p.note
      ].map(v => String(v || '').toLowerCase());
      
      return searchPool.some(val => val.includes(term));
    });

    if (parentCode) {
      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const aIsChild = a.parentId && String(a.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === parentCode ? 1 : 0;
        const bIsChild = b.parentId && String(b.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === parentCode ? 1 : 0;
        return bIsChild - aIsChild;
      });
    }

    return filtered.slice(0, 100);
  }, [projects, selectedParentProject, childSearchTerm]);

  const linkedChildrenCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedParentProject) return 0;
    const parentCode = String(selectedParentProject.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const parentYear = selectedParentProject.year ? String(selectedParentProject.year).trim() : (selectedParentProject.start ? String(selectedParentProject.start).substring(0, 4) : '');
    const parentStore = String(selectedParentProject.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    return projects.filter(p => {
      if (!p.parentId || String(p.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() !== parentCode) return false;
      const cYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '');
      const cStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (parentYear && cYear && cYear !== parentYear) return false;
      if (parentStore && cStore && cStore !== parentStore) return false;
      return true;
    }).length;
  }, [projects, selectedParentProject]);

  // Handle Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (isLinkModalOpen || selectedParentProject) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          setIsLinkModalOpen(false);
          setSelectedParentProject(null);
          return;
        }
        const state = useAppStore.getState();
        const hasOpenModal =
          state.isProjectModalOpen ||
          state.isTaskModalOpen ||
          state.isUserModalOpen ||
          state.isLoginModalOpen ||
          state.isCalendarSyncModalOpen;
        if (hasOpenModal) return;
        if (searchTerm) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const activeElement = document.activeElement;
          if (activeElement && typeof (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur === "function") {
            (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur();
          }
          setSearchTerm("");
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isLinkModalOpen, selectedParentProject, searchTerm]);

  const prevScreenTypeRef = useRef(getDeviceScreenType());

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadDeviceConfig = () => {
      const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_budget_col_widths', currentUser.id);
      if (saved) {
        try { 
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          if (parsed.code && parsed.code < 165) {
            parsed.code = 165;
          }
          if (parsed.no && parsed.no < 60) {
            parsed.no = 80;
          }
          setColWidths(prev => ({ ...prev, ...parsed })); 
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      const savedCols = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_budget_visible_cols', currentUser.id);
      if (savedCols) {
        try { 
          const parsed = JSON.parse(savedCols);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
            let cleaned = parsed.filter((id: string) => id !== 'budget' && id !== 'linkCost');
            if (!cleaned.includes('no')) {
              cleaned = ['no', ...cleaned];
            }
            setVisibleColumns(cleaned);
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      } else {
        const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768;
        if (isMobile) {
          setVisibleColumns(['no', 'code', 'projectName', 'totalBudget', 'actual', 'variance']);
        }
      }
    };

    loadDeviceConfig();

    const handleResize = () => {
      const currentScreenType = getDeviceScreenType();
      if (currentScreenType !== prevScreenTypeRef.current) {
        prevScreenTypeRef.current = currentScreenType;
        loadDeviceConfig();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, [currentUser.id]);

  const handleResize = (col: string, newWidth: number) => {
    setColWidths(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev, [col]: newWidth };
      safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_budget_col_widths', JSON.stringify(next), currentUser.id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleToggleColumn = (colId: string) => {
    setVisibleColumns(prev => {
      const next = prev.includes(colId) ? prev.filter(id => id !== colId) : [...prev, colId];
      safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_budget_visible_cols', JSON.stringify(next), currentUser.id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const toggleExpand = (id: string) => {
    if (searchTerm.trim()) {
      setCollapsedInSearch(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
        else next.add(id);
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      setExpandedParents(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
        else next.add(id);
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  const toggleAllParents = () => {
    if (expandedParents.size === 0) {
      const allParentIds = new Set<string>();
      const collectParents = (nodes: any[]) => {
        nodes.forEach(n => {
          if (n.filteredChildren && n.filteredChildren.length > 0) {
            allParentIds.add(n.id || n.code);
            collectParents(n.filteredChildren);
          }
        });
      };
      collectParents(filteredRoots);
      setExpandedParents(allParentIds);
    } else {
      setExpandedParents(new Set());
    }
  };

  const isAdmin = currentUser.role === 'admin';
  const role = currentUser.role as AppRole;
  const isArchiveYear = globalYearFilter !== 'all' && Number(globalYearFilter) < new Date().getFullYear();
  const canWrite = (isAdmin || !!permissionMatrix[role]?.Write?.budget) && !isArchiveYear;

  const formatCurrency = (val: number | undefined) => {
    return formatCurrencyValue(val, currency, jpyRate, usdRate);
  };

  const years = useMemo(() => {
    const projYears = projects.map(p => {
      if (p.year) return String(p.year);
      if (p.start) return String(p.start).substring(0, 4);
      return null;
    }).filter(Boolean) as string[];
    const baseYears = ['2026', '2027'];
    const unique = Array.from(new Set([...projYears, ...baseYears])).filter(Boolean).sort();
    return unique.length > 0 ? unique : ['2026', '2027'];
  }, [projects, currentUser?.role]);

  const allowedStores = useMemo(() => getUserAllowedStores(currentUser), [currentUser]);
  const stores = allowedStores;
  const locationOptions = useLocationOptions();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (locationOptions.length > 0 && globalLocationFilter.length > 0) {
      const valid = globalLocationFilter.filter(loc => locationOptions.includes(loc));
      if (valid.length !== globalLocationFilter.length) {
        setGlobalLocationFilter(valid);
      }
    }
  }, [locationOptions, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  const handleOpenLinkModal = (projectToSelect?: Project) => {
    if (projectToSelect) {
      setSelectedParentProject(projectToSelect);
      setParentSearchTerm(String(projectToSelect.code || '').trim());
    } else {
      if (!selectedParentProject && filteredRoots.length > 0) {
        setSelectedParentProject(filteredRoots[0].project);
        setParentSearchTerm(String(filteredRoots[0].project.code || '').trim());
      } else if (selectedParentProject) {
        setParentSearchTerm(String(selectedParentProject.code || '').trim());
      }
    }
    setIsLinkModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleProjectLinkClick = (p: Project) => {
    if (!p) return;
    setDetailTabFilterCode(p.code);
    setDetailTabStoreFilter(p.store || "all");
    if (p.year) {
      setGlobalYearFilter(String(p.year));
      safeSetItemSession("taka_detail_year", String(p.year));
    } else {
      setGlobalYearFilter("all");
      safeSetItemSession("taka_detail_year", "all");
    }
    if (p.store) {
      setGlobalStoreFilter(p.store);
      safeSetItemLocal(`taka_store_filter_${currentUser.id}`, String(p.store));
    } else {
      setGlobalStoreFilter("all");
      safeSetItemLocal(`taka_store_filter_${currentUser.id}`, "all");
    }
    setActiveTab("detail");
  };

  return {
    currency,
    jpyRate,
    usdRate,
    canWrite,
    globalYearFilter,
    setGlobalYearFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    setGlobalStoreFilter,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    deferredSearchTerm,
    moneyFilter,
    setMoneyFilter,
    lastSelectedMoneyFilterRef,
    collapsedInSearch,
    expandedParents,
    sortConfig,
    visibleColumns,
    colWidths,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    years,
    stores,
    locationOptions,
    filteredRoots,
    totalGlobalBudget,
    totalGlobalActual,
    totalGlobalSupportingFee,
    totalGlobalRemaining,
    totalVarianceColor,
    candidateParentProjects,
    candidateChildProjects,
    linkedChildrenCount,
    selectedParentProject,
    setSelectedParentProject,
    isLinkModalOpen,
    setIsLinkModalOpen,
    parentSearchTerm,
    setParentSearchTerm,
    childSearchTerm,
    setChildSearchTerm,
    getProjectFinancials,
    handleResize,
    handleToggleColumn,
    toggleExpand,
    toggleAllParents,

    handleBudgetScroll,
    handleOpenLinkModal,
    handleExportBudget,
    handleImportBudget,
    handleProjectLinkClick,
    formatCurrency
  };

=== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/useBudgetFilterSort.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { matchesAdvancedSearch } from '../../lib/utils';
import { BudgetTreeNode, BudgetSortConfig } from './budgetTypes';

interface UseBudgetFilterSortParams {
  treeData: BudgetTreeNode[];
  globalYearFilter: string;
  effectiveStore: string;
  globalLocationFilter: string[];
  setGlobalLocationFilter: (locs: string[]) => void;
  moneyFilter: string;
  searchTerm: string;
  deferredSearchTerm: string;
}

export function useBudgetFilterSort({
  treeData,
  globalYearFilter,
  effectiveStore,
  globalLocationFilter,
  setGlobalLocationFilter,
  moneyFilter,
  searchTerm,
  deferredSearchTerm
}: UseBudgetFilterSortParams) {
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState<BudgetSortConfig | null>(null);
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(30);

  const isChildMatchSearch = (child: any, term: string): boolean => {
    if (!term) return false;
    const cSearchFields = [
      child.code,
      child.name,
      child.store,
      child.location,
      child.type,
      child.note,
      child.year,
      child.budget,
      child.totalActual,
      child.remaining
    ];
    return matchesAdvancedSearch(term, cSearchFields);
  };

  const isParentMatchSearch = (node: any, term: string): boolean => {
    if (!term) return false;
    const searchFields = [
      node.code,
      node.name,
      node.store,
      node.location,
      node.type,
      node.note,
      node.year,
      node.totalBudget,
      node.totalActual,
      node.remaining
    ];
    return matchesAdvancedSearch(term, searchFields);
  };

  // Auto-jump to matched project location(s) when searching (Debounced)
  useEffect(() => {
    const term = searchTerm.trim();
    if (!term) return;
    if (!treeData || treeData.length === 0) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const matchedLocationsList: string[] = [];

      treeData.forEach((node: any) => {
        const pYear = node.year ? String(node.year) : (node.start ? String(node.start).substring(0, 4) : null);
        if (globalYearFilter !== 'all' && pYear !== globalYearFilter) return;
        if (effectiveStore !== 'all' && node.store !== effectiveStore) return;

        const parentMatch = isParentMatchSearch(node, term);
        if (parentMatch && node.location) {
          matchedLocationsList.push(node.location);
        }

        if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
          node.children.forEach((child: any) => {
            const cYear = child.year ? String(child.year) : null;
            if (globalYearFilter !== 'all' && cYear && cYear !== globalYearFilter) return;
            if (effectiveStore !== 'all' && child.store && child.store !== effectiveStore) return;

            if (isChildMatchSearch(child, term) || parentMatch) {
              if (child.location) matchedLocationsList.push(child.location);
              else if (node.location) matchedLocationsList.push(node.location);
            }
          });
        }
      });

      const matchedLocations = Array.from(
        new Set(matchedLocationsList.filter((loc): loc is string => !!loc && loc.trim() !== ''))
      );

      if (matchedLocations.length > 0) {
        const currentLocs = globalLocationFilter || [];
        const isSame = currentLocs.length === matchedLocations.length && currentLocs.every(l => matchedLocations.includes(l));
        if (!isSame) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter(matchedLocations);
        }
      }
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchTerm, treeData, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  const filterNode = (node: any): boolean => {
    const pYear = node.year ? String(node.year).trim() : (node.start ? String(node.start).substring(0, 4) : null);
    const matchesYear = globalYearFilter === 'all' || (pYear !== null && pYear === String(globalYearFilter).trim());
    const matchesStore = effectiveStore === 'all' || (Boolean(node.store) && String(node.store).toUpperCase().trim() === effectiveStore.toUpperCase().trim());
    
    // Strict Scope Guard: A parent project that does not belong to the selected Year or Store scope MUST NOT be displayed
    if (!matchesYear || !matchesStore) {
      return false;
    }

    const matchesLocation = globalLocationFilter.length === 0 || (node.location && globalLocationFilter.includes(node.location));
    
    const hasBudget = (node.totalBudget || 0) !== 0;
    const hasActForc = (node.totalActual || 0) !== 0;
    let matchesMoney = true;
    if (moneyFilter === 'has_money') matchesMoney = hasBudget || hasActForc;
    else if (moneyFilter === 'has_budget') matchesMoney = hasBudget;
    else if (moneyFilter === 'has_act_forc') matchesMoney = hasActForc;
    
    const baseParentMatch = matchesLocation && matchesMoney;
    const parentMatchesSearch = !deferredSearchTerm || isParentMatchSearch(node, deferredSearchTerm);

    if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
      const validChildren = node.children.filter((child: any) => {
        const cYear = child.year ? String(child.year).trim() : (child.start ? String(child.start).substring(0, 4) : pYear);
        const cMatchesYear = globalYearFilter === 'all' || !cYear || cYear === String(globalYearFilter).trim();
        const cStore = child.store ? String(child.store).toUpperCase().trim() : (node.store ? String(node.store).toUpperCase().trim() : '');
        const cMatchesStore = effectiveStore === 'all' || !cStore || cStore === effectiveStore.toUpperCase().trim();
        const cMatchesLocation = globalLocationFilter.length === 0 || (!child.location) || globalLocationFilter.includes(child.location);
        
        const cHasBudget = (child.budget || 0) !== 0;
        const cHasActForc = (child.totalActual || 0) !== 0;
        let cMatchesMoney = true;
        if (moneyFilter === 'has_money') cMatchesMoney = cHasBudget || cHasActForc || matchesMoney;
        else if (moneyFilter === 'has_budget') cMatchesMoney = cHasBudget || hasBudget;
        else if (moneyFilter === 'has_act_forc') cMatchesMoney = cHasActForc || hasActForc;

        return cMatchesYear && cMatchesStore && cMatchesLocation && cMatchesMoney;
      });

      const hasMultiChildren = node.children.length >= 2;

      if (!deferredSearchTerm.trim()) {
        node.filteredChildren = validChildren.map((c: any) => ({ ...c, isSearchMatch: false }));
        return baseParentMatch || validChildren.length > 0;
      }

      const matchingChildIds = new Set<string>();
      validChildren.forEach((child: any) => {
        if (isChildMatchSearch(child, deferredSearchTerm)) {
          matchingChildIds.add(child.id);
        }
      });

      const anyChildMatchesSearch = matchingChildIds.size > 0;

      if (hasMultiChildren) {
        if (anyChildMatchesSearch || (baseParentMatch && parentMatchesSearch)) {
          const shouldFilterChildren = !parentMatchesSearch && anyChildMatchesSearch;
          node.filteredChildren = validChildren
            .filter((child: any) => shouldFilterChildren ? matchingChildIds.has(child.id) : true)
            .map((child: any) => ({
              ...child,
              isSearchMatch: matchingChildIds.has(child.id)
            }));
          return true;
        }
        node.filteredChildren = [];
        return false;
      } else {
        if (anyChildMatchesSearch) {
          node.filteredChildren = validChildren
            .filter((c: any) => matchingChildIds.has(c.id))
            .map((c: any) => ({ ...c, isSearchMatch: true }));
          return true;
        } else if (baseParentMatch && parentMatchesSearch) {
          node.filteredChildren = validChildren.map((c: any) => ({ ...c, isSearchMatch: false }));
          return true;
        }
        node.filteredChildren = [];
        return false;
      }
    } else {
      node.filteredChildren = [];
      return baseParentMatch && parentMatchesSearch;
    }
  };

  const filteredRoots = useMemo(() => {
    let roots = treeData.filter(filterNode);
    if (sortConfig) {
      const sortFn = (a: any, b: any) => {
        let valA = 0, valB = 0;
        if (sortConfig.key === 'totalBudget') { valA = a.totalBudget || 0; valB = b.totalBudget || 0; }
        else if (sortConfig.key === 'actual') { valA = a.totalActual || 0; valB = b.totalActual || 0; }
        else if (sortConfig.key === 'variance') { valA = a.remaining || 0; valB = b.remaining || 0; }

        if (valA < valB) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        if (valA > valB) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        return 0;
      };
      roots = [...roots].sort(sortFn);
    }
    return roots;
  }, [treeData, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter, moneyFilter, deferredSearchTerm, sortConfig]);

  const handleBudgetScroll = useCallback((e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.currentTarget;
    const st = target.scrollTop;
    const sh = target.scrollHeight;
    const ch = target.clientHeight;
    if (sh - (st + ch) < 350) {
      if (visibleCount < filteredRoots.length) {
        setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + 30, filteredRoots.length));
      }
    }
  }, [visibleCount, filteredRoots.length]);

  const handleSort = (key: string) => {
    setSortConfig(prev => {
      if (prev && prev.key === key) {
        if (prev.direction === 'asc') return { key, direction: 'desc' };
        return null;
      }
      return { key, direction: 'asc' };
    });
  };

  const totalGlobalBudget = filteredRoots.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.totalBudget || 0), 0);
  const totalGlobalActual = filteredRoots.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.totalActual || 0), 0);
  const totalGlobalSupportingFee = filteredRoots.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.totalSupportingFee || 0), 0);
  const totalGlobalRemaining = totalGlobalBudget - totalGlobalActual + totalGlobalSupportingFee;
  const totalVarianceColor = totalGlobalRemaining < 0 ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400';

  return {
    sortConfig,
    setSortConfig,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    filteredRoots,
    handleBudgetScroll,
    handleSort,
    totalGlobalBudget,
    totalGlobalActual,
    totalGlobalSupportingFee,
    totalGlobalRemaining,
    totalVarianceColor
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/useBudgetMutations.ts ===
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { undoManager } from '../../lib/undoManager';

interface UseBudgetMutationsParams {
  projects: Project[];
}

export function useBudgetMutations({ projects }: UseBudgetMutationsParams) {
  const handleUpdateProject = async (p: Project, field: keyof Project, value: any) => {
    if (!p) return;
    const docId = p.id || String(p.no);
    const prevValue = p[field];
    if (prevValue === value) return;

    // Optimistic store update
    const currentProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
    useAppStore.getState().setProjects(
      currentProjects.map(item => item.id === p.id ? { ...item, [field]: value } : item)
    );

    // Register undo
    undoManager.push({
      description: `Update ${field} on project ${p.code}`,
      revert: async () => {
        const projs = useAppStore.getState().projects;
        useAppStore.getState().setProjects(
          projs.map(item => item.id === p.id ? { ...item, [field]: prevValue } : item)
        );
        try {
          const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId);
          await writeBatch(db).update(docRef, { [field]: prevValue, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }).commit();
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Failed to revert project update', err);
        }
      }
    });

    try {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId);
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      batch.update(docRef, { [field]: value, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
      await batch.commit();
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error('Error updating project:', e);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Save Failed",
        message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.",
        type: "error"
      });
    }
  };

  const handleLinkParent = async (childProject: Project, parentCode: string | null) => {
    if (!childProject) return;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    
    // Gán parentId cho con trực tiếp
    const childDocId = childProject.id || String(childProject.no);
    const childRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', childDocId);
    batch.set(childRef, { parentId: parentCode, updatedAt: now }, { merge: true });

    // Nếu gán vào Cha lớn (parentCode != null), tìm toàn bộ các dự án đang coi childProject là cha để đưa lên cùng cấp con của Cha lớn
    if (parentCode) {
      const childCode = String(childProject.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const allDescendants: Project[] = [];
      const queue = [childCode];
      const visitedCodes = new Set<string>([childCode]);

      while (queue.length > 0) {
        const currParentCode = queue.shift()!;
        const directChildren = projects.filter(p => 
          p.parentId && String(p.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === currParentCode
        );

        for (const directChild of directChildren) {
          const directChildCode = String(directChild.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
          if (!visitedCodes.has(directChildCode)) {
            allDescendants.push(directChild);
            visitedCodes.add(directChildCode);
            queue.push(directChildCode);
          }
        }
      }

      // Chuyển toàn bộ các con này sang làm con của parentCode (Cha lớn nhất)
      allDescendants.forEach(desc => {
        const descDocId = desc.id || String(desc.no);
        const descRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', descDocId);
        batch.set(descRef, { parentId: parentCode, updatedAt: now }, { merge: true });
      });
    }

    try {
      await batch.commit();
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error("Batch commit failed", error);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Save Failed",
        message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.",
        type: "error"
      });
    }
  };

  return {
    handleUpdateProject,
    handleLinkParent
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/useBudgetTreeData.ts ===
import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { Project, Cost } from '../../types';
import { calculateParentBudgetRollup } from '../../lib/financialService';
import { BudgetTreeNode } from './budgetTypes';

interface UseBudgetTreeDataParams {
  projects: Project[];
  costs: Cost[];
}

export function buildBudgetTreeData(projects: Project[], costs: Cost[]): BudgetTreeNode[] {
  const projectMap = new Map<string, any>();
  const codeToProjects = new Map<string, any[]>();

    projects.forEach(p => {
      const key = `${String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.year || '')}_${String(p.store || '')}`;
      const projectCosts = costs.filter(c => {
        const costCode = String(c.projectCode || (c as any).code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (costCode !== pCode) return false;

        const costYear = String(c.projectYear || (c as any).year || '').trim();
        const pYear = String(p.year || (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '')).trim();
        const matchesYear = !costYear || !pYear || costYear === pYear;
        if (!matchesYear) return false;

        const costStore = String(c.projectStore || (c as any).store || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const matchesStore = !costStore || !pStore || costStore === pStore;
        if (!matchesStore) return false;

        return true;
      });
      
      const computedActual = projectCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.actual) || 0), 0);
      const computedForc = projectCosts.filter(c => c.costType === 'forc').reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.actual) || 0), 0);
      const computedSupportingFee = projectCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.supportingFee) || 0), 0);

      const fin = p.financial || { totalApproved: p.budget || 0, totalActualPaid: p.actual || 0, totalForecastPaid: 0 };
      const hasCosts = projectCosts.length > 0;
      const finalActual = hasCosts ? computedActual : (fin.totalActualPaid || p.actual || 0);
      const finalForc = hasCosts ? computedForc : (fin.totalForecastPaid || 0);
      const finalSupportingFee = hasCosts ? computedSupportingFee : (p.supportingFee || 0);

      const pData = {
        ...p,
        ownActual: finalActual,
        ownForc: finalForc,
        ownSupportingFee: finalSupportingFee,
        hasForc: finalForc > 0,
        ownBudget: fin.totalApproved || p.budget || 0,
      };

      projectMap.set(key, pData);

      const codeKey = String(p.code).trim().toUpperCase();
      if (!codeToProjects.has(codeKey)) {
        codeToProjects.set(codeKey, []);
      }
      codeToProjects.get(codeKey)!.push(pData);
    });

    const getProjectYear = (p: any): string => 
      p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '');

    const getProjectStore = (p: any): string => 
      String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    // Map linked children to parent codes, scoped by parentCode + year + store
    const parentToChildrenMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
    const linkedChildIds = new Set<string>();

    projects.forEach(p => {
      if (p.parentId && String(p.parentId).trim()) {
        const parentCode = String(p.parentId).trim().toUpperCase();
        const candidateParents = codeToProjects.get(parentCode);
        if (candidateParents && candidateParents.length > 0) {
          let childYear = getProjectYear(p);
          let childStore = getProjectStore(p);

          // If child year/store missing, inherit from candidate parent if unambiguous
          if (!childYear && candidateParents.length === 1) {
            childYear = getProjectYear(candidateParents[0]);
          }
          if (!childStore && candidateParents.length === 1) {
            childStore = getProjectStore(candidateParents[0]);
          }

          const scopedKey = `${parentCode}_${childYear}_${childStore}`;
          if (!parentToChildrenMap.has(scopedKey)) {
            parentToChildrenMap.set(scopedKey, []);
          }
          const key = `${String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.year || '')}_${String(p.store || '')}`;
          const pData = projectMap.get(key) || p;
          parentToChildrenMap.get(scopedKey)!.push(pData);
          linkedChildIds.add(p.id || `${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.store}-${p.no}`);
        }
      }
    });

    const roots: BudgetTreeNode[] = [];

    projects.forEach(p => {
      const pId = p.id || `${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.store}-${p.no}`;

      // If project is linked as child of another project, it is only a child, not a root parent
      if (linkedChildIds.has(pId)) {
        return;
      }

      const key = `${String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.year || '')}_${String(p.store || '')}`;
      const pData = projectMap.get(key) || p;
      const parentCode = String(p.code).trim().toUpperCase();
      const pYear = getProjectYear(p);
      const pStore = getProjectStore(p);
      const scopedKey = `${parentCode}_${pYear}_${pStore}`;

      // Child 1: Self-Child of this project (its own budget)
      const selfBudget = pData.ownBudget ?? 0;
      const selfActual = pData.ownActual ?? 0;
      const selfSupportingFee = pData.ownSupportingFee ?? 0;
      const selfRemaining = selfBudget - selfActual + selfSupportingFee;

      const selfChild: BudgetTreeNode = {
        id: `${pId}_self`,
        isSelf: true,
        isParentNode: false,
        code: p.code,
        name: p.name,
        year: p.year,
        store: p.store,
        location: p.location,
        type: p.type,
        note: p.note,
        budget: selfBudget,
        totalBudget: selfBudget,
        ownActual: selfActual,
        totalActual: selfActual,
        ownSupportingFee: selfSupportingFee,
        totalSupportingFee: selfSupportingFee,
        hasForc: pData.hasForc,
        remaining: selfRemaining,
        project: p,
        children: [],
      };

      // Child 2+: Any other projects linked as children under this parent in the same year and store
      const matchedChildren = parentToChildrenMap.get(scopedKey) || [];
      const linkedProjects: BudgetTreeNode[] = matchedChildren.map((childP: any) => {
        const childId = childP.id || `${childP.code}-${childP.year}-${childP.store}-${childP.no}`;
        const cBudget = childP.ownBudget ?? 0;
        const cActual = childP.ownActual ?? 0;
        const cSupportingFee = childP.ownSupportingFee ?? 0;
        const cRemaining = cBudget - cActual + cSupportingFee;

        return {
          id: childId,
          isSelf: false,
          isParentNode: false,
          code: childP.code,
          name: childP.name,
          year: childP.year,
          store: childP.store,
          location: childP.location,
          type: childP.type,
          note: childP.note,
          budget: cBudget,
          totalBudget: cBudget,
          ownActual: cActual,
          totalActual: cActual,
          ownSupportingFee: cSupportingFee,
          totalSupportingFee: cSupportingFee,
          hasForc: childP.hasForc,
          remaining: cRemaining,
          parentId: childP.parentId,
          project: childP,
          children: [],
        };
      });

      const allChildren = [selfChild, ...linkedProjects];

      // Roll-up sums for Parent Node (Budget Mẹ) utilizing central financialService
      const rollup = calculateParentBudgetRollup(allChildren);

      const parentNode: BudgetTreeNode = {
        ...pData,
        id: pId,
        isParentNode: true,
        isSelf: false,
        totalBudget: rollup.totalBudget,
        totalActual: rollup.totalActual,
        totalSupportingFee: rollup.totalSupportingFee,
        ownSupportingFee: selfSupportingFee,
        hasForc: rollup.hasForc,
        remaining: rollup.remaining,
        children: allChildren,
        project: p,
      };

      roots.push(parentNode);
    });

    return roots;
}

export function useBudgetTreeData({ projects, costs }: UseBudgetTreeDataParams): BudgetTreeNode[] {
  return useMemo(() => buildBudgetTreeData(projects, costs), [projects, costs]);
}

import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { generateIcsString, downloadIcsFile, toWebcalUrl } from '../lib/icalGenerator';

import { CalendarSyncGuideTab } from './CalendarTabParts/CalendarSyncGuideTab';
import { CalendarSyncQrTab } from './CalendarTabParts/CalendarSyncQrTab';

export const CalendarSyncModal: React.FC = () => {
  const isOpen = useAppStore(state => state.isCalendarSyncModalOpen);
  const setIsOpen = useAppStore(state => state.setIsCalendarSyncModalOpen);
  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Filters
  const [storeFilter, setStoreFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [yearFilter, setYearFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [scopeFilter, setScopeFilter] = useState<'all' | 'mine'>('all');
  const [includeProjects, setIncludeProjects] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [includeSubtasks, setIncludeSubtasks] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Active view tab
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'subscribe' | 'qr' | 'guide'>('subscribe');

  // Cloud sync state
  const [isPublishing, setIsPublishing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [publishedUrl, setPublishedUrl] = useState<string>(() => {
    return safeGetItemLocal('taka_calendar_feed_url_all') || '';
  });
  const [lastPublishedTime, setLastPublishedTime] = useState<string>(() => {
    return safeGetItemLocal('taka_calendar_feed_time_all') || '';
  });
  const [copiedWebcal, setCopiedWebcal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedHttps, setCopiedHttps] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Close on Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, setIsOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = safeGetItemLocal(`taka_calendar_feed_url_${storeFilter}`);
    const savedTime = safeGetItemLocal(`taka_calendar_feed_time_${storeFilter}`);
    setPublishedUrl(saved || '');
    setLastPublishedTime(savedTime || '');
  }, [storeFilter]);

  // Generate local ICS string on the fly based on selected filters
  const currentIcsContent = useMemo(() => {
    const onlyAssignedTo = scopeFilter === 'mine' ? (currentUser?.name || currentUser?.email || '') : '';
    return generateIcsString({
      tasks,
      projects,
      calendarName: storeFilter !== 'all' 
        ? `Takashimaya ${storeFilter} Projects` 
        : 'Takashimaya Projects',
      calendarDesc: `Lịch công việc và dự án Takashimaya - ${storeFilter.toUpperCase()}`,
      storeFilter: storeFilter === 'all' ? '' : storeFilter,
      yearFilter: yearFilter === 'all' ? '' : yearFilter,
      onlyAssignedTo,
      includeProjects,
      includeSubtasks,
    });

  const handlePublishCalendar = async () => {
    setIsPublishing(true);
    try {
      const filename = `takashimaya_schedule_${storeFilter.toLowerCase()}.ics`;
      const fileRef = storageRef(storage, `taka_attachments/${APP_ID}/${filename}`);
      const blob = new Blob([currentIcsContent], { type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8' });

      // Create a timeout promise
      const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => 
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("Upload timeout after 15 seconds")), 15000)
      );

      // Race the upload against the timeout
      await Promise.race([
        uploadBytes(fileRef, blob, {
          contentType: 'text/calendar; charset=utf-8',
          cacheControl: 'public, max-age=300' // 5 min cache
        }),
        timeoutPromise
      ]);

      const downloadUrl = await getDownloadURL(fileRef);
      const timeStr = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });

      setPublishedUrl(downloadUrl);
      setLastPublishedTime(timeStr);
      safeSetItemLocal(`taka_calendar_feed_url_${storeFilter}`, downloadUrl);
      safeSetItemLocal(`taka_calendar_feed_time_${storeFilter}`, timeStr);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to publish calendar to Firebase Storage:", err);
      // If upload fails, create data URI fallback
      const blob = new Blob([currentIcsContent], { type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8' });
      const fallbackUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      setPublishedUrl(fallbackUrl);
      setLastPublishedTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
    } finally {
      setIsPublishing(false);
    }
  };

  // Auto-publish once if no URL exists yet
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && !publishedUrl && tasks.length > 0) {
      handlePublishCalendar();
    }
  }, [isOpen, publishedUrl, tasks.length]);

  const webcalUrl = useMemo(() => {
    return publishedUrl ? toWebcalUrl(publishedUrl) : '';
  }, [publishedUrl]);

  // Copy helpers
  const handleCopyWebcal = () => {
    if (!webcalUrl) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(webcalUrl);
    setCopiedWebcal(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedWebcal(false), 2000);

  const handleCopyHttps = () => {
    if (!publishedUrl) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(publishedUrl);

  const handleDownloadIcs = () => {
    const filename = `Takashimaya_${storeFilter.toUpperCase()}_Calendar_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.ics`;
    downloadIcsFile(currentIcsContent, filename);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <Draggable disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} handle=".modal-handle" bounds="parent" nodeRef={nodeRef} cancel="button, input, select">
        <div 
          ref={nodeRef}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] w-full max-w-2xl rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[92vh] pointer-events-auto"
          onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#28282a]/50">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                <CalendarIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f0f0f0] flex items-center gap-2">
                  Đồng bộ Apple Calendar (iOS)
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300">
                    {eventCount} sự kiện
                  </span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
                  Tự động hiển thị và cập nhật lịch trình dự án vào app Lịch của iPhone/iPad
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
              className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-[#e3e3e3] rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors"
              title="Đóng (Esc)"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>

=== FILE: src/components/CalendarTab.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, dateFnsLocalizer, View } from 'react-big-calendar';
import {
  format,
  parse,
  startOfWeek,
  getDay,
  startOfDay,
  isSameDay,
} from 'date-fns';
import { enUS } from 'date-fns/locale/en-US';
import 'react-big-calendar/lib/css/react-big-calendar.css';

import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { safeGetItemLocal, safeSetItemLocal } from '../lib/storage';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { getDefaultStoreFilter } from '../lib/utils';
import { CalendarEvent, CalendarTabProps } from './CalendarTabParts/calendarTypes';
import {
  CustomWeekView,
  CustomAgendaView,
} from './CalendarTabParts/CustomVerticalView';
import { CalendarFilterToolbar } from './CalendarTabParts/CalendarFilterToolbar';
import { CalendarMonthDayList } from './CalendarTabParts/CalendarMonthDayList';
import { useCalendarEvents } from './CalendarTabParts/useCalendarEvents';
import { exportEventsToICS } from './CalendarTabParts/calendarExportUtils';

const locales = { 'en-US': enUS };
const localizer = dateFnsLocalizer({
  format,
  parse,
  startOfWeek,
  getDay,
  locales,
});

export function CalendarTab({ onEditTask, onEditProject }: CalendarTabProps) {
  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.currentUser)!;
  const locations = useAppStore((state) => state.locations);
  const isTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.isTasksRequested);
  const setIsTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsTasksRequested);

  // Tri-Gate Lazy Loading (Rule 3)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTasksRequested) {
      setIsTasksRequested(true);
    }
  }, [isTasksRequested, setIsTasksRequested]);

  const [currentDate, setCurrentDate] = useState(new Date());
  const [currentView, setCurrentView] = useState<View>('month');
  const [searchDate, setSearchDate] = useState('');
  const [filterStore, setFilterStore] = useState<string>(() => {
    const def = getDefaultStoreFilter(currentUser);
    return def === 'all' ? '' : def;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    safeSetItemLocal(`taka_store_filter_${currentUser.id}`, filterStore || 'all');
  }, [filterStore, currentUser.id]);

  const [filterLocation, setFilterLocation] = useState('');
  const [selectedMonthDate, setSelectedMonthDate] = useState<Date>(new Date());
  const [showSubTasksInMonth, setShowSubTasksInMonth] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    return safeGetItemLocal('taka_calendar_show_subtasks') === 'true';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    safeSetItemLocal(
      'taka_calendar_show_subtasks',
      showSubTasksInMonth ? 'true' : 'false'
    );
  }, [showSubTasksInMonth]);

  const uniqueStores = useMemo(() => {
    return [...new Set(projects.map((p) => p.store).filter(Boolean))].sort();
  }, [projects]);

  const handleSearchDate = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setSearchDate(val);
    if (val) {
      const parsed = new Date(val);
      if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
        setCurrentDate(parsed);
        setCurrentView('day');
      }
    }
  };

  const { events } = useCalendarEvents({
    projects,
    tasks,
    filterStore,
    filterLocation,
    currentView,
    showSubTasksInMonth,
  });

  const handleExportICS = () => {
    exportEventsToICS(events);
  };

  const eventStyleGetter = (event: CalendarEvent) => {
    const backgroundColor =
      event.color || (event.colorIndex === 0 ? '#10b981' : '#fb923c');

    return {
      style: {
        backgroundColor,
        borderRadius: '6px',
        opacity: 0.95,
        color: 'white',
        border: '0px',
        display: 'block',
        fontSize: '11px',
        fontWeight: '600',
        padding: '3px 6px',
        lineHeight: '1.3',
      },
    };
  };

  const CustomDateHeader = ({ label, date }: any) => {
    const dayEvents = events.filter((e) => {
      return (
        startOfDay(e.start) <= startOfDay(date) &&
        startOfDay(e.end) >= startOfDay(date)
      );
    });
    const hasEvents = dayEvents.length > 0;

    const dayColors: string[] = [];
    dayEvents.forEach((e) => {
      const c =
        e.color ||
        (eventStyleGetter(e).style.backgroundColor as string) ||
        (e.colorIndex === 0 ? '#10b981' : '#fb923c');
      if (!dayColors.includes(c)) dayColors.push(c);
    });

    const isSelected = isSameDay(date, selectedMonthDate);

    return (
      <div
        className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer mt-1 mx-auto w-10 h-10 ${
          isSelected ? 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 rounded-full' : ''
        }`}
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          setSelectedMonthDate(date);
        }}
      >
        <span
          className={`text-[13px] font-medium leading-none ${
            isSameDay(date, new Date())
              ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center'
              : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]'
          }`}
        >
          {label}
        </span>
        <div className="h-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mt-1">
          {hasEvents &&
            (dayColors.length > 0 ? (
              dayColors
                .slice(0, 4)
                .map((c, i) => (
                  <div
                    key={i}
                    className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: c }}
                  />
                ))
            ) : (
              <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full"></div>
            ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-grow flex flex-col min-h-[600px] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-sm p-4">
      <style>{`
        .rbc-time-content { display: none !important; }
        .rbc-time-header-gutter { display: none !important; }
        .rbc-time-view .rbc-time-header { flex: 1 1 auto !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
        .rbc-time-header-content { flex: 1 1 auto !important; display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important; border-left: none !important; }
        .rbc-allday-cell { flex: 1 1 auto !important; height: 100% !important; max-height: none !important; }
        .rbc-event { white-space: normal !important; word-break: break-word !important; height: auto !important; min-height: 24px; margin-bottom: 2px !important; }
        .rbc-event-content { white-space: normal !important; word-break: break-word !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-row-segment { display: none !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-month-row { flex: 1 0 50px !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-date-cell { text-align: center !important; padding: 0 !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-button-link { pointer-events: none !important; }
      `}</style>

      <CalendarFilterToolbar
        currentView={currentView}
        showSubTasksInMonth={showSubTasksInMonth}
        setShowSubTasksInMonth={setShowSubTasksInMonth}
        searchDate={searchDate}
        onSearchDateChange={handleSearchDate}
        filterStore={filterStore}
        setFilterStore={setFilterStore}
        uniqueStores={uniqueStores}
        filterLocation={filterLocation}
        setFilterLocation={setFilterLocation}
        locations={locations}
        onExportICS={handleExportICS}
      />

      <div className="flex-grow min-h-[600px]">
        <Calendar
          localizer={localizer}
          events={events}
          startAccessor="start"
          endAccessor="end"
          style={{ height: '100%', minHeight: '600px' }}
          eventPropGetter={eventStyleGetter}
          date={currentDate}
          onNavigate={(newDate) => setCurrentDate(newDate)}
          view={currentView}
          onView={(newView) => setCurrentView(newView)}
          onSelectEvent={(event) => {
            if (event.type === 'task' && event.resource) {
              onEditTask(event.resource, true);
            } else if (event.type === 'project' && event.resource) {
              onEditProject(event.resource, true);
            }
          }}
          components={{
            month: {
              dateHeader: CustomDateHeader,
            },
          }}
          views={{
            month: true,
            week: CustomWeekView,
            day: true,
            agenda: CustomAgendaView,
          }}
          popup
        />
      </div>

      {currentView === 'month' && (
        <CalendarMonthDayList
          selectedMonthDate={selectedMonthDate}
          events={events}
          onEditTask={onEditTask}
          onEditProject={onEditProject}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default CalendarTab;

  showSubTasksInMonth,
  setShowSubTasksInMonth,
  searchDate,
  onSearchDateChange,
  filterStore,
  setFilterStore,
  uniqueStores,
  filterLocation,
  setFilterLocation,
  locations,
  onExportICS,

      {/* Top Row: Title and Legend */}
      <div className="flex flex-col xl:flex-row xl:items-center justify-between gap-3">

            Task Calendar
          </h2>
        </div>

import React, { FC } from 'react';
import { format, startOfDay } from 'date-fns';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { CalendarEvent } from './calendarTypes';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';

interface CalendarMonthDayListProps {
  selectedMonthDate: Date;
  events: CalendarEvent[];
  onEditTask: (t: Task, isReadOnly?: boolean) => void;
  onEditProject: (p: Project, isReadOnly?: boolean) => void;
}

export const CalendarMonthDayList: React.FC<CalendarMonthDayListProps> = ({
  selectedMonthDate,
  events,
  onEditTask,
  onEditProject,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const dayEvents = events.filter(
    (e) =>
      startOfDay(e.start) <= startOfDay(selectedMonthDate) &&
      startOfDay(e.end) >= startOfDay(selectedMonthDate)
  );

  return (
    <div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] pt-4">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] mb-3">
        {format(selectedMonthDate, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')}
      </h3>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {dayEvents.length > 0 ? (
          dayEvents.map((event, idx) => (
            <div
              key={`${event.id}-${idx}`}
              onClick={() => {
                if (event.type === 'task' && event.resource) {
                  onEditTask(event.resource, true);
                } else if (event.type === 'project' && event.resource) {
                  onEditProject(event.resource, true);
                }
              }}
              className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-white text-sm font-medium shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
              style={{
                backgroundColor:
                  event.color ||
                  (event.colorIndex === 0 ? '#10b981' : '#fb923c'),
              }}
            >
              <span className="truncate">{event.title}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/20 text-white shrink-0 uppercase tracking-wider">
                {event.type === 'project' ? t('Project') : t('Task')}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="text-slate-400 text-sm italic px-2 py-1">
            {t('No events scheduled for this day.')}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

=== FILE: src/components/CalendarTabParts/CustomVerticalView.tsx ===
import React, { FC, useMemo } from 'react';
import { format, addDays, subDays, startOfDay, endOfDay } from 'date-fns';
import { CalendarEvent } from './calendarTypes';

interface CustomVerticalViewProps {
  date: Date;
  events: CalendarEvent[];
  onSelectEvent?: (event: CalendarEvent) => void;
  daysCount: number;
}

export const CustomVerticalView: React.FC<CustomVerticalViewProps> = ({
  date,
  events,
  onSelectEvent,
  daysCount,
}) => {
  const range = useMemo(() => {
    let start: Date;
    let end: Date;
    if (daysCount === 7) {
      start = startOfDay(date);
      end = addDays(date, 6);
    } else {
      start = startOfDay(date);
      end = addDays(date, 30);
    }

    const daysArray: Date[] = [];
    let current = start;
    while (current <= end) {
      daysArray.push(current);
      current = addDays(current, 1);
    }
    return daysArray;
  }, [date, daysCount]);

  const eventsByDay = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, CalendarEvent[]>();
    range.forEach((day) => {
      map.set(day.toDateString(), []);
    });

    events.forEach((event: CalendarEvent) => {
      range.forEach((day) => {
        const dayStart = startOfDay(day);
        const dayEnd = endOfDay(day);
        if (event.start <= dayEnd && event.end >= dayStart) {
          map.get(day.toDateString())?.push(event);
        }
      });
    });
    return map;
  }, [events, range]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 overflow-y-auto h-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 rounded-b-xl">
      {range.map((day) => {
        const dayEvents = eventsByDay.get(day.toDateString()) || [];
        if (daysCount !== 7 && dayEvents.length === 0) return null; // hide empty days in agenda

        return (
          <div
            key={day.toDateString()}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
          >
            <div className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a]/80 px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-sm flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{format(day, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')}</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-sm">
                {dayEvents.length} {dayEvents.length === 1 ? 'task' : ''}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 flex flex-col gap-2">
              {dayEvents.length > 0 ? (
                dayEvents.map((event, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={`${event.id}-${idx}`}
                    onClick={() => onSelectEvent && onSelectEvent(event)}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-white text-sm font-medium shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor:
                        event.color ||
                        (event.colorIndex === 0 ? '#10b981' : '#fb923c'),
                    }}
                  >
                    {event.title}
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="text-slate-400 text-sm italic px-2 py-1">
                  No scheduled for this day.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export const CustomWeekView: any = (props: any) => (
  <CustomVerticalView {...props} daysCount={7} />
);
CustomWeekView.range = (date: Date) => [startOfDay(date), addDays(date, 6)];
CustomWeekView.navigate = (date: Date, action: string) => {
  switch (action) {
    case 'PREV':

=== FILE: src/components/CalendarTabParts/calendarExportUtils.ts ===
import { format, addDays } from 'date-fns';
import { CalendarEvent } from './calendarTypes';

export function exportEventsToICS(events: CalendarEvent[]) {
  if (events.length === 0) {
    alert('No events to export.');
    return;
  }

  const formatDate = (date: Date) => {
    return date.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').split('.')[0] + 'Z';
  };

  const icsContent = [
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
    'VERSION:2.0',
    'PRODID:-//Takashimaya Project Management//Calendar//EN',
    'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
    'METHOD:PUBLISH',
  ];

  events.forEach((event) => {
    icsContent.push('BEGIN:VEVENT');
    icsContent.push(`UID:${event.id}@taka.app`);
    icsContent.push(`DTSTAMP:${formatDate(new Date())}`);
    if (event.allDay) {
      const startStr = format(event.start, 'yyyyMMdd');
      const endStr = format(addDays(event.start, 1), 'yyyyMMdd');
      icsContent.push(`DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:${startStr}`);
      icsContent.push(`DTEND;VALUE=DATE:${endStr}`);
    } else {
      icsContent.push(`DTSTART:${formatDate(event.start)}`);
      icsContent.push(`DTEND:${formatDate(event.end)}`);
    }
    icsContent.push(`SUMMARY:${event.title.replace(/[,;]/g, '\\$&')}`);
    if (event.resource && event.resource.detail) {
      icsContent.push(
        `DESCRIPTION:${(event.resource.detail || '')
          .replace(/\n/g, '\\n')
          .replace(/[,;]/g, '\\$&')}`
      );
    }
    icsContent.push('END:VEVENT');
  });

  icsContent.push('END:VCALENDAR');

  const blob = new Blob([icsContent.join('\r\n')], {
    type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8',
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `Takashimaya_Calendar_${format(new Date(), 'yyyyMMdd')}.ics`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
