      'firstPaid',
      'firstPaidAt',
      'secondPaid',
      'secondPaidAt',
      'thirdPaid',
      'thirdPaidAt',
      'supportingFee',
      'description',
      'vendor',
    ];
    const data = filteredCostsForTotals.map((c) => {
      const p = projects.find(
        (proj) =>
          String(proj.code).trim().toLowerCase() ===
            String(c.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase() &&
          (String(proj.year || '') === String(c.projectYear || '') ||
            (!proj.year && !c.projectYear))
      );
      return [
        p?.store || '',
        p?.location || '',
        c.projectYear || p?.year || '',
        c.projectCode,
        p?.budget || 0,
        c.actual || 0,
        c.firstPaid || 0,
        c.firstPaidAt || '',
        c.secondPaid || 0,
        c.secondPaidAt || '',
        c.thirdPaid || 0,
        c.thirdPaidAt || '',
        c.supportingFee || 0,
        c.description || '',
        c.vendor || '',
      ];
    });
    const csv = generateCSV(headers, data);
    downloadCSV(csv, 'taka_costs_filtered.csv');
  };

  const handleImportCosts = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = async (event) => {
      try {
        const text = event.target?.result as string;
        const rows = parseCSV(text);
        if (rows.length < 2) {
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: 'Thông báo',
            message: 'CSV file is empty or has no data rows.',
          });
          return;
        }

        const headers = rows[0].map((h) => h.trim().toLowerCase());
        const dataRows = rows.slice(1);

        // Required Field Validation
        let hasError = false;
        let errorMsg = '';
        for (let idx = 0; idx < dataRows.length; idx++) {
          const row = dataRows[idx];
          if (row.every((c) => !String(c).trim())) continue;

          let hasYear = false,
            hasStore = false,
            hasCode = false;
          headers.forEach((h, i) => {
            const val = String(row[i] || '').trim();
            if ((h === 'year' || h === 'projectyear') && val) hasYear = true;
            if ((h === 'store' || h === 'projectstore') && val) hasStore = true;
            if ((h === 'code' || h === 'projectcode') && val) hasCode = true;
          });

          if (!hasYear || !hasStore || !hasCode) {
            hasError = true;
            errorMsg = `Row ${idx + 2} is missing Year, Store, or Code. All imported data must include these three fields.`;
            break;
          }
        }

        if (hasError) {
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: 'Thông báo',
            message: 'Import failed: ' + errorMsg,
          });
          return;
        }

        const parseCSVNumber = (val: any) => {
          if (typeof val === 'string') {
            const cleaned = val.replace(/,/g, '').trim();
            if (cleaned === '-' || cleaned === '') return 0;
            const num = Number(cleaned);
            return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num;
          }
          return Number(val) || 0;
        };

        let importCount = 0;
        const processedCosts = new Map<string, Cost>();
        costs.forEach((c) => {
          if (c.projectCode) {
            const key = `${String(c.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(
              c.projectYear || ''
            ).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(
              c.projectStore || ''
            ).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(
              c.description || ''
            ).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(
              c.vendor || ''
            ).trim().toLowerCase()}`;
            processedCosts.set(key, c);
            if (c.id) {
              processedCosts.set(c.id, c);
            }
          }
        });

        const previousStates = new Map<string, any>();
        const newIds = new Set<string>();
        const previousProjectBudgets = new Map<string, number | undefined>();

        for (const row of dataRows) {
          if (row.length < headers.length) continue;

          const c: any = {};
          headers.forEach((h, i) => {
            let val: any = row[i];
            if (
              h === 'budget' ||
              h === 'actual' ||
              h === 'firstpaid' ||
              h === 'secondpaid' ||
              h === 'thirdpaid' ||
              h === 'supportingfee'
            ) {
              val = parseCSVNumber(val);
            }
            const keyMap: Record<string, string> = {
              projectcode: 'projectCode',
              projectyear: 'projectYear',
              year: 'projectYear',
              projectstore: 'projectStore',
              store: 'projectStore',
              firstpaid: 'firstPaid',
              firstpaidat: 'firstPaidAt',
              secondpaid: 'secondPaid',
              secondpaidat: 'secondPaidAt',
              thirdpaid: 'thirdPaid',
              thirdpaidat: 'thirdPaidAt',
              supportingfee: 'supportingFee',
            };
            const field = keyMap[h] || h;
            c[field] = val;
          });

          if (!c.projectCode || !c.description) continue;

          if (c.projectYear !== undefined && c.projectYear !== null) {
            c.projectYear = Number(c.projectYear);
          }

          let existingCost: Cost | undefined;
          if (c.id && processedCosts.has(c.id)) {
            existingCost = processedCosts.get(c.id);
          } else {
            const key = `${String(c.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(
              c.projectYear || ''
            ).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(
              c.projectStore || ''
            ).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(
              c.description || ''
            ).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(
              c.vendor || ''
            ).trim().toLowerCase()}`;
            existingCost = processedCosts.get(key);
          }

          const docId = existingCost?.id || c.id || doc(db, 'dummy').id;
          c.id = docId;
          c.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

          if (existingCost) {
            previousStates.set(docId, existingCost);
          } else {
            newIds.add(docId);
          }

          const batch = writeBatch(db);
          batch.set(
            doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', docId),
            c,
            { merge: true }
          );

          if (c.budget !== undefined) {
            const matchedProject = projects.find(
              (p) =>
                String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase() ===
                  String(c.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase() &&
                (String(p.year || '') === String(c.projectYear || '') ||
                  (!p.year && !c.projectYear))
            );
            if (matchedProject) {
              const projectNo = String(matchedProject.no || matchedProject.id);
              if (!previousProjectBudgets.has(projectNo)) {
                previousProjectBudgets.set(projectNo, matchedProject.budget);
              }
              batch.update(
                doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', projectNo),
                { budget: c.budget }
              );
            }
          }

          await batch.commit();
          importCount++;
        }

        if (importCount > 0) {
          undoManager.push({
            description: `Import Costs (${importCount} entries)`,
            revert: async () => {
              const batch = writeBatch(db);
              newIds.forEach((id) => {
                batch.delete(
                  doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', id)
                );
              });
              previousStates.forEach((oldData, id) => {
                batch.set(
                  doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', id),
                  oldData
                );
              });
              previousProjectBudgets.forEach((oldBudget, projectNo) => {
                batch.update(
                  doc(
                    db,
                    'artifacts',
                    APP_ID,
                    'public',
                    'data',
                    'taka_projects',
                    projectNo
                  ),
                  { budget: oldBudget || 0 }
                );
              });
              await batch.commit().catch((e) =>
                console.error('Batch commit undo failed', e)
              );
            },
          });
        }

        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: 'Notice',
          message: `Import Costs completed! Processed ${importCount} records.`,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Import error:', err);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: 'Error',
          message:
            'Error importing CSV: ' +
            (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)),
        });
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  return {
    handleExportCosts,
    handleImportCosts,
  };
}

    const baseYears = ['2026', '2027'];

    return unique.length > 0 ? unique : ['2026', '2027'];

=== FILE: src/components/CostParts/useCostDateFilter.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Cost } from '../../types';
import { parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { PaidDateMatches } from './costTypes';

export function useCostDateFilter() {
  const [isPaidDateFilterOpen, setIsPaidDateFilterOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [paidDateStart, setPaidDateStart] = useState<string>('');
  const [paidDateEnd, setPaidDateEnd] = useState<string>('');
  const [paidStageFilter, setPaidStageFilter] = useState<'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd'>('all');

  const [tempDateStart, setTempDateStart] = useState<string>('');
  const [tempDateEnd, setTempDateEnd] = useState<string>('');
  const debounceTimerRef = useRef<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const commitDateFilter = (newStart?: string, newEnd?: string) => {
    if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
      debounceTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    const s = newStart !== undefined ? newStart : tempDateStart;
    const e = newEnd !== undefined ? newEnd : tempDateEnd;
    setPaidDateStart(s);
    setPaidDateEnd(e);
  };

  const scheduleDebouncedDateCommit = (newStart: string, newEnd: string) => {
    if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
    }
    debounceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setPaidDateStart(newStart);
      setPaidDateEnd(newEnd);
    }, 500);
  };

  const handleTempStartChange = (val: string) => {
    setTempDateStart(val);
    scheduleDebouncedDateCommit(val, tempDateEnd);
  };

  const handleTempEndChange = (val: string) => {
    setTempDateEnd(val);
    scheduleDebouncedDateCommit(tempDateStart, val);
  };

  const handleClearPaidDateFilter = () => {
    if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
      debounceTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    setTempDateStart('');
    setTempDateEnd('');
    setPaidDateStart('');
    setPaidDateEnd('');
    setPaidStageFilter('all');
  };

  const checkDateInRange = (dateVal: string | undefined, start: string, end: string): boolean => {
    if (!dateVal) return false;
    const s = String(dateVal).trim();
    if (!s) return false;
    let isoDate = s.substring(0, 10);
    if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(isoDate)) {
      const parsed = parseDateTime(s);
      if (!parsed || isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return false;
      const y = parsed.getFullYear();
      const m = String(parsed.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      const d = String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      isoDate = `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
    }
    if (start && isoDate < start) return false;
    if (end && isoDate > end) return false;
    return true;
  };

  const getCostPaidMatches = useCallback(
    (c: Cost, start: string, end: string, stage: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd'): PaidDateMatches => {
      if (!start && !end) {
        return { matches: true, firstMatch: false, secondMatch: false, thirdMatch: false };
      }
      const firstMatch = checkDateInRange(c.firstPaidAt, start, end);
      const secondMatch = checkDateInRange(c.secondPaidAt, start, end);
      const thirdMatch = checkDateInRange(c.thirdPaidAt, start, end);

      let matches = false;
      if (stage === '1st') matches = firstMatch;
      else if (stage === '2nd') matches = secondMatch;
      else if (stage === '3rd') matches = thirdMatch;
      else matches = firstMatch || secondMatch || thirdMatch;

      return { matches, firstMatch, secondMatch, thirdMatch };
    },
    []
  );

  return {
    isPaidDateFilterOpen,
    setIsPaidDateFilterOpen,
    paidDateStart,
    paidDateEnd,
    paidStageFilter,
    setPaidStageFilter,
    tempDateStart,
    tempDateEnd,
    handleTempStartChange,
    handleTempEndChange,
    commitDateFilter,
    handleClearPaidDateFilter,
    getCostPaidMatches,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/CostParts/useCostMutations.ts ===
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch, setDoc, deleteDoc } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { Cost, Project } from '../../types';
import { generateId } from '../../lib/utils';
import { deleteStorageFiles, extractStorageUrls } from '../../lib/storageUtils';
import { undoManager } from '../../lib/undoManager';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface UseCostMutationsParams {
  canWrite: boolean;
  expandedCodes: string[];
  toggleProjectExpansion: (key: string) => void;
}

export function useCostMutations({
  canWrite,
  expandedCodes,
  toggleProjectExpansion,
}: UseCostMutationsParams) {
  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => void;
  }>({
    isOpen: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    onConfirm: () => {},
  });

  const handleAddCost = async (project: Project) => {
    if (!canWrite) return;

    const derivedYear = project.year
      ? project.year
      : project.start
      ? Number(String(project.start).substring(0, 4))
      : undefined;

    const newCost: Cost = {
      id: generateId(),
      projectCode: project.code || '',
      actual: 0,
      firstPaid: 0,
      secondPaid: 0,
      thirdPaid: 0,
      supportingFee: 0,
      description: 'New Cost Entry',
      vendor: '',
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (derivedYear !== undefined && derivedYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(derivedYear))) {
      newCost.projectYear = derivedYear;
    }
    if (project.store !== undefined && project.store !== null) {
      newCost.projectStore = project.store;
    }

    // Safety check: remove ANY undefined values to prevent Firestore crash
    Object.keys(newCost).forEach((key) => {
      if ((newCost as any)[key] === undefined) {
        delete (newCost as any)[key];
      }
    });

    try {
      setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', newCost.id), newCost);
      const groupKey = `${project.code}-${derivedYear}-${project.store}-${project.no}`;
      if (
        !expandedCodes.includes(groupKey) &&
        !expandedCodes.includes(String(project.id))
      ) {
        toggleProjectExpansion(groupKey);
      }

      undoManager.push({
        description: `Add Cost to ${project.code} (${derivedYear})`,
        revert: async () => {
          deleteDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', newCost.id));
        },
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[CostTab] Error saving cost:', e);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteCost = async (c: Cost) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: 'Delete Cost',
      message: 'Delete this Cost?',
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
          const batch = writeBatch(db);
          batch.set(
            doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', c.id),
            { id: c.id, isDeleted: true, updatedAt: nowIso },
            { merge: true }
          );

          const urlsToDelete = extractStorageUrls(c);
          if (urlsToDelete.length > 0) {
            deleteStorageFiles(urlsToDelete).catch(console.error);
          }
          batch.commit().catch((e) => console.error('Batch commit cost delete failed:', e));

          undoManager.push({
            description: `Delete Cost`,
            revert: async () => {
              setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', c.id), c);
            },
          });
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleUpdateCost = async (c: Cost, field: keyof Cost, value: any) => {
    try {
      const updates: any = { [field]: value, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };

      if (field === 'firstPaid') updates.firstPaidAt = new Date().toISOString();
      if (field === 'secondPaid') updates.secondPaidAt = new Date().toISOString();
      if (field === 'thirdPaid') updates.thirdPaidAt = new Date().toISOString();

      const newCostData = { ...c, ...updates };
      if (
        newCostData.projectYear !== undefined &&
        newCostData.projectYear !== null &&
        newCostData.projectYear !== '' &&
        !isNaN(Number(newCostData.projectYear))
      ) {
        newCostData.projectYear = Number(newCostData.projectYear);
      }

      Object.keys(newCostData).forEach((key) => {
        if ((newCostData as any)[key] === undefined) {
          delete (newCostData as any)[key];
        }
      });

      // Optimistically update the UI to prevent input lag
      useAppStore.getState().optimisticUpdateCosts([newCostData]);

      setDoc(
        doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', c.id),
        newCostData
      );

      undoManager.push({
        description: `Update Cost: ${field}`,
        revert: async () => {
          useAppStore.getState().optimisticUpdateCosts([c]);
          setDoc(
            doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', c.id),
            c
          );
        },
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  return {
    confirmModal,
    setConfirmModal,
    handleAddCost,
    handleDeleteCost,
    handleUpdateCost,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/CostParts/useCostSearchFilter.ts ===
import React, { useDeferredValue, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Project, Cost, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { matchesAdvancedSearch } from '../../lib/utils';
import { safeSetItemSession, safeGetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface UseCostSearchFilterParams {
  projects: Project[];
  costs: Cost[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  initialSearchTerm?: string;
  costTabSearchTerm?: string;
  globalYearFilter: string;
  effectiveStore: string;
  globalLocationFilter: string[];
  setGlobalLocationFilter: (locs: string[]) => void;
  getGroupCostsForProject: (p: Project) => Cost[];
}

export function useCostSearchFilter({
  projects,
  costs,
  currentUser,
  initialSearchTerm = '',
  costTabSearchTerm = '',
  globalYearFilter,
  effectiveStore,
  globalLocationFilter,
  setGlobalLocationFilter,
  getGroupCostsForProject,
}: UseCostSearchFilterParams) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(
    initialSearchTerm || costTabSearchTerm || ''
  );
  const deferredSearchTerm = useDeferredValue(searchTerm);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialSearchTerm) {
      setSearchTerm(initialSearchTerm);
    } else if (costTabSearchTerm) {
      setSearchTerm(costTabSearchTerm);
    }
  }, [initialSearchTerm, costTabSearchTerm]);

  const [hasActForcFilter, setHasActForcFilter] = useState(() => {
    if ((initialSearchTerm || '').trim()) return 'all';
    return safeGetItemSession('taka_cost_act_forc_filter') || 'has_value';
  });
  const lastSelectedActForcFilterRef = useRef<string>(
    safeGetItemSession('taka_cost_act_forc_filter') || 'has_value'
  );
  const lastSelectedLocationFilterRef = useRef<string[]>(globalLocationFilter);
  const wasSearchingRef = useRef<boolean>(!!(initialSearchTerm || '').trim());

  useEffect(() => {
    const isSearching = !!deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!wasSearchingRef.current && isSearching) {
      if (hasActForcFilter !== 'all') {
        lastSelectedActForcFilterRef.current = hasActForcFilter;
        safeSetItemSession('taka_cost_act_forc_filter', hasActForcFilter);
      }
      lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current = globalLocationFilter;
      setHasActForcFilter('all');
      wasSearchingRef.current = true;
    } else if (wasSearchingRef.current && !isSearching) {
      const restored =
        lastSelectedActForcFilterRef.current ||
        safeGetItemSession('taka_cost_act_forc_filter') ||
        'has_value';
      setHasActForcFilter(restored);
      setGlobalLocationFilter(lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current || []);
      wasSearchingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [deferredSearchTerm]);

  // Auto-jump to matched project location(s) when searching in CostTab (Debounced)
  useEffect(() => {
    const term = deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!term) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const matchedProjects = projects.filter((p) => {
        const pYear = p.year
          ? String(p.year).trim()
          : p.start
          ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4)
          : null;
        if (
          globalYearFilter !== 'all' &&
          (pYear === null || pYear !== String(globalYearFilter).trim())
        )
          return false;
        if (
          effectiveStore !== 'all' &&
          (!p.store ||
            String(p.store).toUpperCase().trim() !== effectiveStore.toUpperCase().trim())
        )
          return false;

        const groupCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);

        const isMatch = matchesAdvancedSearch(
          term,
          [
            p.store,
            p.location,
            p.year,
            p.code,
            p.linkCodes,
            p.name,
            p.detail,
            (p as any).description,
            p.note,
          ],
          [],
          (tLower) => {
            return groupCosts.some((c) => {
              const cBalance =
                (c.actual || 0) -
                (c.firstPaid || 0) -
                (c.secondPaid || 0) -
                (c.thirdPaid || 0);
              const costFields = [
                c.description,
                c.vendor,
                c.actual,
                c.firstPaid,
                c.secondPaid,
                c.thirdPaid,
                c.supportingFee,
                cBalance,
              ];
              return costFields.some((val) =>
                String(val || '').toLowerCase().includes(tLower)
              );
            });
          }
        );
        return isMatch;
      });

      const matchedLocations = Array.from(
        new Set(
          matchedProjects
            .map((p) => p.location)
            .filter((loc): loc is string => !!loc && loc.trim() !== '')
        )
      );

      if (matchedLocations.length > 0) {
        const currentLocs = globalLocationFilter || [];
        const isSame =
          currentLocs.length === matchedLocations.length &&
          currentLocs.every((l) => matchedLocations.includes(l));
        if (!isSame) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter(matchedLocations);
        }
      }
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [
    deferredSearchTerm,
    projects,
    globalYearFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    getGroupCostsForProject,
  ]);

  // Handle Escape key globally to clear search
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && searchTerm) {
        const state = useAppStore.getState();
        const hasOpenModal =
          state.isProjectModalOpen ||
          state.isTaskModalOpen ||
          state.isUserModalOpen ||
          state.isLoginModalOpen ||
          state.isCalendarSyncModalOpen;
        if (hasOpenModal) return;

        e.preventDefault();
        const activeElement = document.activeElement;
        if (activeElement && typeof (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur === 'function') {
          (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur();
        }
        setSearchTerm('');
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [searchTerm]);

  return {
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    deferredSearchTerm,
    hasActForcFilter,
    setHasActForcFilter,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/CostParts/useCostTotals.ts ===
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Project, Cost } from '../../types';
import { PaidDateMatches } from './costTypes';

interface UseCostTotalsParams {
  filteredProjectsForDisplay: Project[];
  projects: Project[];
  costs: Cost[];
  paidDateStart: string;
  paidDateEnd: string;
  paidStageFilter: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd';
  getGroupCostsForProject: (p: Project) => Cost[];
  getCostPaidMatches: (
    c: Cost,
    start: string,
    end: string,
    stage: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd'
  ) => PaidDateMatches;
}

export function useCostTotals({
  filteredProjectsForDisplay,
  projects,
  costs,
  paidDateStart,
  paidDateEnd,
  paidStageFilter,
  getGroupCostsForProject,
  getCostPaidMatches,
}: UseCostTotalsParams) {
  const filteredCostsForTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const includedKeys = new Set(
      filteredProjectsForDisplay.map((p) => {
        const pDerivedYear = p.year
          ? p.year
          : p.start
          ? Number(String(p.start).substring(0, 4))
          : undefined;
        return `${String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase()}-${String(
          pDerivedYear || ''
        ).trim()}-${String(p.store || '').trim().toLowerCase()}`;
      })
    );
    return costs.filter((c) => {
      const cCode = String(c.projectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const cYear = String(c.projectYear || '').trim();
      const cStore = String(c.projectStore || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const cProjMatched = projects.find((proj) => {
        const projDerivedYear = proj.year
          ? proj.year
          : proj.start
          ? Number(String(proj.start).substring(0, 4))
          : undefined;
        return (
          String(proj.code).trim().toLowerCase() === cCode &&
          (String(projDerivedYear || '').trim() === cYear ||
            (!String(projDerivedYear || '').trim() && !cYear)) &&
          (!cStore ||
            !String(proj.store || '').trim().toLowerCase() ||
            String(proj.store || '').trim().toLowerCase() === cStore)
        );
      });
      if (!cProjMatched) return false;
      const projDerivedYear = cProjMatched.year
        ? cProjMatched.year
        : cProjMatched.start
        ? Number(String(cProjMatched.start).substring(0, 4))
        : undefined;
      const isIncluded = includedKeys.has(
        `${String(cProjMatched.code).trim().toLowerCase()}-${String(
          projDerivedYear || ''
        ).trim()}-${String(cProjMatched.store || '').trim().toLowerCase()}`
      );
      if (!isIncluded) return false;

      if (paidDateStart || paidDateEnd) {
        return getCostPaidMatches(c, paidDateStart, paidDateEnd, paidStageFilter).matches;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [
    costs,
    projects,
    filteredProjectsForDisplay,
    paidDateStart,
    paidDateEnd,
    paidStageFilter,
    getCostPaidMatches,
  ]);

  const totalActAll = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjectsForDisplay.reduce((sum, p) => {
      const pGroupCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);
      if (pGroupCosts.length > 0) {
        return sum + pGroupCosts.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.actual || 0), 0);
      }
      return sum + (p.financial?.totalActualPaid || p.actual || 0);
    }, 0);
  }, [filteredProjectsForDisplay, getGroupCostsForProject]);

  const totalFirstPaidAll = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjectsForDisplay.reduce((sum, p) => {
      const pGroupCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);
      if (pGroupCosts.length > 0) {
        return sum + pGroupCosts.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.firstPaid || 0), 0);
      }
      return sum;
    }, 0);
  }, [filteredProjectsForDisplay, getGroupCostsForProject]);

  const totalSecondPaidAll = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjectsForDisplay.reduce((sum, p) => {
      const pGroupCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);
      if (pGroupCosts.length > 0) {
        return sum + pGroupCosts.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.secondPaid || 0), 0);
      }
      return sum;
    }, 0);
  }, [filteredProjectsForDisplay, getGroupCostsForProject]);

  const totalThirdPaidAll = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjectsForDisplay.reduce((sum, p) => {
      const pGroupCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);
      if (pGroupCosts.length > 0) {
        return sum + pGroupCosts.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.thirdPaid || 0), 0);
      }
      return sum;
    }, 0);
  }, [filteredProjectsForDisplay, getGroupCostsForProject]);

  const totalBalanceAll = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjectsForDisplay.reduce((sum, p) => {
      const pGroupCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);
      if (pGroupCosts.length > 0) {
        return (
          sum +
          pGroupCosts.reduce(
            (s, c) =>
              s +
              ((c.actual || 0) -
                (c.firstPaid || 0) -
                (c.secondPaid || 0) -
                (c.thirdPaid || 0)),
            0
          )
        );
      }
      return sum;
    }, 0);
  }, [filteredProjectsForDisplay, getGroupCostsForProject]);

  const totalSupAll = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjectsForDisplay.reduce((sum, p) => {
      const pGroupCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);
      if (pGroupCosts.length > 0) {
        return sum + pGroupCosts.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.supportingFee || 0), 0);
      }
      return sum + (p.supportingFee || 0);
    }, 0);
  }, [filteredProjectsForDisplay, getGroupCostsForProject]);

  const totalRemainingAll = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjectsForDisplay.reduce((sum, p) => {
      const projectCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);
      const hasCosts = projectCosts.length > 0;
      const computedActual = projectCosts.reduce((s, c) => s + (Number(c.actual) || 0), 0);
      const computedSup = projectCosts.reduce(
        (s, c) => s + (Number(c.supportingFee) || 0),
        0
      );

      const fin = p.financial || {
        totalApproved: p.budget || 0,
        totalActualPaid: p.actual || 0,
      };
      const finalActual = hasCosts ? computedActual : fin.totalActualPaid || p.actual || 0;
      const finalSup = hasCosts ? computedSup : p.supportingFee || 0;
      const finalBudget = fin.totalApproved || p.budget || 0;

      return sum + (finalBudget - finalActual + finalSup);
    }, 0);
  }, [filteredProjectsForDisplay, getGroupCostsForProject]);

  return {
    filteredCostsForTotals,
    totalActAll,
    totalFirstPaidAll,
    totalSecondPaidAll,
    totalThirdPaidAll,
    totalBalanceAll,
    totalSupAll,
    totalRemainingAll,
  };
}

=== FILE: src/components/CsvExportParts/csvExportProcessing.ts ===
import { TAB_CONFIG } from './csvExportTypes';

export const formatDateTime = (val: any, colName: string) => {
  if (!val && val !== 0) return '';

  const defaultTime =
    colName === 'start' ? '22:00' : colName === 'finish' ? '10:00' : '00:00';

  if (typeof val === 'number') {
    const date = new Date(Math.round((val - 25569) * 86400 * 1000));
    const m = date.getUTCMonth() + 1;
    const d = date.getUTCDate();
    const y = date.getUTCFullYear();

    if (colName === 'date' || colName === 'start month') {
      return `${m}/${d}/${y}`;
    }

    const hasTime = val % 1 !== 0;

    if (hasTime) {
      const hh = String(date.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0');
      const min = String(date.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
      return `${m}/${d}/${y} ${hh}:${min}`;
    } else {
      return `${m}/${d}/${y} ${defaultTime}`;
    }
  }

  const dateStr = String(val);
  const parsedDate = new Date(dateStr);

  if (!isNaN(parsedDate.getTime())) {
    const m = parsedDate.getMonth() + 1;
    const d = parsedDate.getDate();
    const y = parsedDate.getFullYear();

    if (colName === 'date' || colName === 'start month') {
      return `${m}/${d}/${y}`;
    }

    if (dateStr.includes(':')) {
      const hh = String(parsedDate.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
      const min = String(parsedDate.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
      return `${m}/${d}/${y} ${hh}:${min}`;
    } else {
      return `${m}/${d}/${y} ${defaultTime}`;
    }
  }

  return val;
};

export const getCellValue = (
  row: any,
  colName: string,
  activeTab: string,
  mapping: Record<string, string>,
  constantMapping: Record<string, string>,
  keepOriginal: Record<string, boolean>,
  unitSizeMap: Record<string, string>
) => {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return '';

  let val = constantMapping[colName] || row[mapping[colName]];

  if (
    activeTab === 'task' &&
    colName.toLowerCase() === 'predecessor' &&
    !keepOriginal[colName]
  ) {
    const projCode =
      constantMapping['projectCode'] || row[mapping['projectCode']] || '';
    if (val !== undefined && val !== null && String(val).trim() !== '') {
      val = `${projCode}-${val}`;
    }
  }

  if (activeTab === 'size_unit') {
    if (colName === 'unit') {
      if (val === undefined || val === null || String(val).trim() === '')
        return 'Temp';
      return val;
    }
    if (colName === 'size') {
      if (val === undefined || val === null || String(val).trim() === '') {
        let u = constantMapping['unit'] || row[mapping['unit']];
        if (u === undefined || u === null || String(u).trim() === '') u = 'Temp';
        val = unitSizeMap[u];
      }
    }
  }

  const dateCols = ['date', 'start month', 'start', 'finish'];
  if (dateCols.includes(colName.toLowerCase())) {
    return formatDateTime(val, colName.toLowerCase());
  }

  return val !== undefined && val !== null ? String(val) : '';
};

interface ExportDataParams {
  activeTab: string;
  sheetNames: string[];
  workbook: any;
  mapping: Record<string, string>;
  constantMapping: Record<string, string>;
  keepOriginal: Record<string, boolean>;
  templateData: any[];
  excelData: any[];
  unitSizeMap: Record<string, string>;
  setError: (msg: string) => void;
}

export async function executeCsvExport({
  activeTab,
  sheetNames,
  workbook,
  mapping,
  constantMapping,
  keepOriginal,
  templateData,
  excelData,
  unitSizeMap,
  setError,
}: ExportDataParams) {
  const targetCols = TAB_CONFIG[activeTab].columns;
  const xlsx = await import('xlsx');

  if (activeTab === 'investment') {
    const wb = xlsx.utils.book_new();
    for (const name of sheetNames) {
      const sourceJson = xlsx.utils.sheet_to_json(workbook!.Sheets[name], {
        defval: '',
      }) as any[];

      const headerRows = [
        [
          'Takashimaya Vietnam - MD Investment Plan',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
        ],
        [
          'Noted: ※Permanent shop / ※POP up shop / ※New Event Hall',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
        ],
        [],
        targetCols,
      ];

      const rowsByLevel: Record<string, any[]> = {};
      sourceJson.forEach((row) => {
        const levelKey = row[mapping['Level']] || 'Other';
        if (!rowsByLevel[levelKey]) rowsByLevel[levelKey] = [];

        const mappedRow = targetCols.map((col: string) => {
          if (constantMapping[col]) return constantMapping[col];
          return row[mapping[col]] || '';
        });
        rowsByLevel[levelKey].push(mappedRow);
      });

      const finalRows = [...headerRows];
      Object.keys(rowsByLevel).forEach((level) => {
        finalRows.push([
          level,
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          'Subtotal',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
        ]);
        rowsByLevel[level].forEach((r) => finalRows.push(r));
      });

      const ws = xlsx.utils.aoa_to_sheet(finalRows);
      xlsx.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, name.substring(0, 31));
    }
    xlsx.writeFile(wb, `${TAB_CONFIG[activeTab].fileNamePrefix}.xlsx`);
  } else if (activeTab === 'mass_task') {
    if (!templateData || templateData.length === 0) {
      setError('Vui lòng tải lên file template (Attached)');
      return;
    }

    const finalJson: any[] = [];
    for (const proj of excelData) {
      const projStore = getCellValue(
        proj,
        'store',
        activeTab,
        mapping,
        constantMapping,
        keepOriginal,
        unitSizeMap
      );
      const projLocation = getCellValue(
        proj,
        'location',
        activeTab,
        mapping,
        constantMapping,
        keepOriginal,
        unitSizeMap
      );
      const projCode = getCellValue(
        proj,
        'projectCode',
        activeTab,
        mapping,
        constantMapping,
        keepOriginal,
        unitSizeMap
      );
      const projYear =
        getCellValue(
          proj,
          'projectYear',
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        ) ||
        getCellValue(
          proj,
          'YEAR',
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        );

      for (const taskDef of templateData) {
        const taskName = taskDef['Task name'] || '';
        const tcKey = Object.keys(taskDef).find((k) => {
          const clean = k
            .toLowerCase()
            .replace(/á»¥/g, 'ụ')
            .replace(/\s+/g, '');
          return clean.includes('taskcodeph') || clean.includes('taskcodephu');
        });
        let taskCodePhu = tcKey ? taskDef[tcKey] : '';
        if (
          !keepOriginal['Task code phụ'] &&
          taskCodePhu !== undefined &&
          taskCodePhu !== null &&
          String(taskCodePhu).trim() !== ''
        ) {
          taskCodePhu = projCode
            ? `${projCode}#${String(taskCodePhu).trim()}`
            : String(taskCodePhu).trim();
        }
        let start = taskDef['start'] || '';
        let finish = taskDef['finish'] || '';

        const formatExcelDate = (val: any) => {
          if (typeof val !== 'number') return val;
          const date = new Date((val - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
          return (
            date.toLocaleDateString('en-US') +
            ' ' +
            date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
              hour: '2-digit',
              minute: '2-digit',
              hour12: false,
            })
          );
        };
        if (typeof start === 'number') start = formatExcelDate(start);
        if (typeof finish === 'number') finish = formatExcelDate(finish);

        const party = taskDef['party'] || '';
        const duration =
          taskDef['duration'] !== undefined ? taskDef['duration'] : '';
        const predKey = Object.keys(taskDef).find(
          (k) => k.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '') === 'predecessor'
        );
        const templatePred = predKey ? taskDef[predKey] : '';
        const mappedPred =
          constantMapping['predecessor'] || proj[mapping['predecessor']];
        let pred =
          mappedPred !== undefined &&
          mappedPred !== null &&
          String(mappedPred).trim() !== ''
            ? mappedPred
            : templatePred;
        if (
          !keepOriginal['predecessor'] &&
          pred !== undefined &&
          pred !== null &&
          String(pred).trim() !== ''
        ) {
          pred = projCode ? `${projCode}-${String(pred).trim()}` : String(pred).trim();
        }
        const delegation =
          taskDef['delegation'] !== undefined
            ? taskDef['delegation']
            : constantMapping['delegation'] || 'true';
        const comments =
          taskDef['comments'] !== undefined
            ? taskDef['comments']
            : constantMapping['comments'] || '';

        finalJson.push({
          store: projStore,
          location: projLocation,
          projectYear: projYear,
          projectCode: projCode,
          'Task code phụ': taskCodePhu,
          'Task name': taskName,
          start: start,
          finish: finish,
          duration: duration,
          party: party,
          predecessor: pred,
          delegation: delegation,
          comments: comments,
        });
      }
    }

    const wb = xlsx.utils.book_new();
    const wsData = xlsx.utils.json_to_sheet(finalJson, { header: targetCols });
    xlsx.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, wsData, 'Data');

    const methodRows = [
      ['QUY ĐỊNH & HƯỚNG DẪN IMPORT DATA'],
      [],
      ['Cột', 'Quy tắc / Hướng dẫn'],
      [
        'Predecessor',
        "Nếu không check 'Giữ nguyên', hệ thống sẽ tự ghép với Project Code. (VD: 23 thành VN26-23). Nếu nhiều task cách nhau bằng dấu phẩy.",
      ],
      ['Task code phụ', 'Hệ thống tự động ghép với Project Code ở đầu.'],
      [
        'Comments',
        "Để xóa nội dung comments hiện tại trên hệ thống, bạn hãy điền một khoảng trắng (Space) vào ô này, hoặc nhập khoảng trắng ở 'Giá trị tĩnh'.",

      ],
      ['Delegation', "Mặc định nếu để trống sẽ là 'true'."],
      [],
      [
        'LƯU Ý QUAN TRỌNG:',
        "Hệ thống Takashimaya hiện tại chỉ import được file đuôi .csv. Bạn hãy chỉnh sửa trên file này, sau đó mở Sheet 'Data' và chọn Save As -> định dạng CSV (Comma delimited) trước khi import nhé!",
      ],

    const wsMethod = xlsx.utils.aoa_to_sheet(methodRows);
    xlsx.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, wsMethod, 'Method');

    xlsx.writeFile(wb, `${TAB_CONFIG[activeTab].fileNamePrefix}.xlsx`);
  } else {
    const exportJson = excelData.map((row) => {
      const out: any = {};
      targetCols.forEach((col: string) => {
        out[col] = getCellValue(
          row,
          col,
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,

      return out;
    });

    const wb = xlsx.utils.book_new();
    const wsData = xlsx.utils.json_to_sheet(exportJson, { header: targetCols });
    xlsx.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, wsData, 'Data');

    const methodRows = [
      ['QUY ĐỊNH & HƯỚNG DẪN IMPORT DATA'],
      [],
      ['Cột', 'Quy tắc / Hướng dẫn'],
      [

      ],

export const safeJSONParse = (data: string | null) => {
  try {
    return data ? JSON.parse(data) : {};
  } catch (e) {
    return {};
  }
};

export const safeGetStorage = (key: string) => {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(key);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Browser blocked localStorage reading offline', e);
    return null;
  }
};

export const safeSetStorage = (key: string, value: string) => {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, value);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Browser blocked localStorage write', e);
  }
};

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  TAB_CONFIG,
  safeJSONParse,
  safeGetStorage,
  safeSetStorage,
} from './csvExportTypes';
import { getCellValue, executeCsvExport } from './csvExportProcessing';

export function useCsvExportState() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [workbook, setWorkbook] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [sheetNames, setSheetNames] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [activeSheet, setActiveSheet] = useState<string>('');
  const [excelData, setExcelData] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [excelHeaders, setExcelHeaders] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [templateFile, setTemplateFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [templateData, setTemplateData] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('project');
  const [showUnlockModal, setShowUnlockModal] = useState(false);
  const [passwordInput, setPasswordInput] = useState('');
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState('');

  const [isLocked, setIsLocked] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    return safeGetStorage('taka_locked_project') === 'true';
  });

  const [mapping, setMapping] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetStorage('taka_mapping_project');
    const parsed = safeJSONParse(saved);
    return TAB_CONFIG['project'].columns.reduce(
      (acc: any, col: string) => ({ ...acc, [col]: parsed[col] || '' }),
      {}
    );
  });

  const [keepOriginal, setKeepOriginal] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetStorage('taka_keeporiginal_project');
    const parsed = safeJSONParse(saved);
    return TAB_CONFIG['project'].columns.reduce(
      (acc: any, col: string) => ({ ...acc, [col]: !!parsed[col] }),
      {}
    );
  });

  const [constantMapping, setConstantMapping] = useState<
    Record<string, string>
  >(() => {
    const saved = safeGetStorage('taka_constant_project');
    const parsed = safeJSONParse(saved);
    return TAB_CONFIG['project'].columns.reduce(
      (acc: any, col: string) => ({
        ...acc,
        [col]:
          parsed[col] !== undefined
            ? parsed[col]
            : col === 'delegation'
              ? 'true'
              : '',
      }),
      {}
    );
  });

  const unitSizeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (
      activeTab !== 'size_unit' ||
      !Array.isArray(excelData) ||
      excelData.length === 0
    )
      return map;

    excelData.forEach((row) => {
      if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return;

      let u = constantMapping['unit'] || row[mapping['unit']];
      if (u === undefined || u === null || String(u).trim() === '') u = 'Temp';

      const s = constantMapping['size'] || row[mapping['size']];
      if (s !== undefined && s !== null && String(s).trim() !== '') {
        map[u] = s;
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [activeTab, excelData, mapping, constantMapping]);

  const switchTab = (tabId: string) => {
    setActiveTab(tabId);
    setFile(null);
    setExcelData([]);
    setExcelHeaders([]);
    setWorkbook(null);
    setSheetNames([]);
    setActiveSheet('');
    setTemplateFile(null);
    setTemplateData([]);
    setError('');

    const savedMapping = safeGetStorage(`taka_mapping_${tabId}`);
    const parsedMapping = safeJSONParse(savedMapping);
    setMapping(
      TAB_CONFIG[tabId].columns.reduce(
        (acc: any, col: string) => ({ ...acc, [col]: parsedMapping[col] || '' }),
        {}
      )
    );

    const savedConstant = safeGetStorage(`taka_constant_${tabId}`);
    const parsedConstant = safeJSONParse(savedConstant);
    setConstantMapping(
      TAB_CONFIG[tabId].columns.reduce((acc: any, col: string) => {
        let val = parsedConstant[col];
        if (val === undefined || !savedConstant) {
          val = col === 'delegation' ? 'true' : val || '';
        }
        return { ...acc, [col]: val };
      }, {})
    );

    const savedKeepOriginal = safeGetStorage(`taka_keeporiginal_${tabId}`);
    const parsedKeepOriginal = safeJSONParse(savedKeepOriginal);
    setKeepOriginal(
      TAB_CONFIG[tabId].columns.reduce(
        (acc: any, col: string) => ({ ...acc, [col]: !!parsedKeepOriginal[col] }),
        {}
      )
    );

    setIsLocked(safeGetStorage(`taka_locked_${tabId}`) === 'true');
  };

  const processSheet = async (worksheet: any) => {
    try {
      if (!worksheet) throw new Error('Sheet bị trống.');

      const xlsx = await import('xlsx');
      const jsonData =
        (xlsx.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { defval: '' }) as any[]) || [];
      setExcelData(jsonData);

      if (jsonData.length > 0) {
        const headers = Object.keys(jsonData[0] || {});
        setExcelHeaders(headers);

        if (!isLocked) {
          const newMapping = { ...(mapping || {}) };
          TAB_CONFIG[activeTab].columns.forEach((targetCol: string) => {
            const match = headers.find(
              (h) => h && h.toLowerCase().includes(targetCol.toLowerCase())
            );
            if (match) newMapping[targetCol] = match;
          });
          setMapping(newMapping);
        }
      } else {
        setExcelHeaders([]);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError('Đã xảy ra lỗi khi trích xuất dữ liệu từ Sheet này.');
      setExcelData([]);
      setExcelHeaders([]);
    }
  };

  const handleTemplateUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const uploadedFile = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!uploadedFile) return;
    setTemplateFile(uploadedFile);

    const isCSV = uploadedFile.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv');
    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onload = async (event) => {
      try {
        const result = event.target?.result;
        if (!result) throw new Error('File tải lên trống.');

        const xlsx = await import('xlsx');
        let wb;
        if (isCSV) {
          wb = xlsx.read(result, { type: 'string' });
        } else {
          wb = xlsx.read(new Uint8Array(result as ArrayBuffer), { type: 'array' });
        }

        const firstSheet = wb.SheetNames[0];
        const json = xlsx.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets[firstSheet], {
          defval: '',
        }) as any[];
        setTemplateData(json);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(`Lỗi đọc template: ${err.message}`);
      }
    };

    if (isCSV) {
      reader.readAsText(uploadedFile, 'UTF-8');
    } else {
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(uploadedFile);
    }
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const uploadedFile = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!uploadedFile) return;

    setError('');
    setFile(uploadedFile);
    setWorkbook(null);
    setSheetNames([]);
    setActiveSheet('');
    setExcelData([]);
    setExcelHeaders([]);

    const isCSV = uploadedFile.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv');
    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onload = async (event) => {
      try {
        const result = event.target?.result;
        if (!result) throw new Error('File tải lên trống.');

        const xlsx = await import('xlsx');
        let wb;
        try {
          if (isCSV) {
            wb = xlsx.read(result, { type: 'string' });
          } else {
            const data = new Uint8Array(result as ArrayBuffer);
            wb = xlsx.read(data, { type: 'array' });
          }
        } catch (xlsxErr) {
          console.error('XLSX Parse Error:', xlsxErr);
          throw new Error(
            'Định dạng file không được hỗ trợ hoặc cấu trúc file bị lỗi.'
          );
        }

        if (!wb.SheetNames || wb.SheetNames.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('Không thể tìm thấy sheet dữ liệu nào trong file.');
        }

        setWorkbook(wb);
        setSheetNames(wb.SheetNames);
        const firstSheet = wb.SheetNames[0];
        setActiveSheet(firstSheet);
        processSheet(wb.Sheets[firstSheet]);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(`Không thể xử lý file: ${err.message}`);
        console.error(err);
        setExcelData([]);
      }
    };

    reader.onerror = () => {
      setError('Trình duyệt gặp lỗi trong quá trình nạp file.');
    };

    if (isCSV) {
      reader.readAsText(uploadedFile, 'UTF-8');
    } else {
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(uploadedFile);
    }

    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleCancelUpload = () => {
    setFile(null);
    setWorkbook(null);
    setSheetNames([]);
    setActiveSheet('');
    setExcelData([]);
    setExcelHeaders([]);
    setError('');
  };

  const handleSaveMapping = () => {
    safeSetStorage(`taka_mapping_${activeTab}`, JSON.stringify(mapping));
    safeSetStorage(`taka_constant_${activeTab}`, JSON.stringify(constantMapping));
    safeSetStorage(`taka_keeporiginal_${activeTab}`, JSON.stringify(keepOriginal));
    safeSetStorage(`taka_locked_${activeTab}`, 'true');
    setIsLocked(true);
  };

  const handleUnlock = () => {
    if (passwordInput === '1641985') {
      safeSetStorage(`taka_locked_${activeTab}`, 'false');
      setIsLocked(false);
      setShowUnlockModal(false);
      setPasswordInput('');
      setPasswordError('');
    } else {
      setPasswordError('Mật khẩu không đúng!');
    }
  };

  const previewData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData || excelData.length === 0) return [];

    if (activeTab === 'mass_task') {
      if (!templateData || templateData.length === 0) return [];
      const finalJson: any[] = [];
      for (const proj of excelData) {
        const projStore = getCellValue(
          proj,
          'store',
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        );
        const projLocation = getCellValue(
          proj,
          'location',
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        );
        const projCode = getCellValue(
          proj,
          'projectCode',
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        );
        const projYear =
          getCellValue(
            proj,
            'projectYear',
            activeTab,
            mapping,
            constantMapping,
            keepOriginal,
            unitSizeMap
          ) ||
          getCellValue(
            proj,
            'YEAR',
            activeTab,
            mapping,
            constantMapping,
            keepOriginal,
            unitSizeMap
          );

        for (const taskDef of templateData) {
          if (finalJson.length >= 10) return finalJson;
          const taskName = taskDef['Task name'] || '';
          const tcKey = Object.keys(taskDef).find((k) => {
            const clean = k
              .toLowerCase()
              .replace(/á»¥/g, 'ụ')
              .replace(/\s+/g, '');
            return clean.includes('taskcodeph') || clean.includes('taskcodephu');
          });
          let taskCodePhu = tcKey ? taskDef[tcKey] : '';
          if (
            !keepOriginal['Task code phụ'] &&
            taskCodePhu !== undefined &&
            taskCodePhu !== null &&
            String(taskCodePhu).trim() !== ''
          ) {
            taskCodePhu = projCode
              ? `${projCode}#${String(taskCodePhu).trim()}`
              : String(taskCodePhu).trim();
          }
          let start = taskDef['start'] || '';
          let finish = taskDef['finish'] || '';

          const formatExcelDate = (val: any) => {
            if (typeof val !== 'number') return val;
            const date = new Date((val - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
            return (
              date.toLocaleDateString('en-US') +
              ' ' +
              date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
                hour: '2-digit',
                minute: '2-digit',
                hour12: false,
              })
            );
          };
          if (typeof start === 'number') start = formatExcelDate(start);
          if (typeof finish === 'number') finish = formatExcelDate(finish);

          const party = taskDef['party'] || '';
          const duration =
            taskDef['duration'] !== undefined ? taskDef['duration'] : '';
          const predKey = Object.keys(taskDef).find(
            (k) => k.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '') === 'predecessor'
          );
          const templatePred = predKey ? taskDef[predKey] : '';
          const mappedPred =
            constantMapping['predecessor'] || proj[mapping['predecessor']];
          let pred =
            mappedPred !== undefined &&
            mappedPred !== null &&
            String(mappedPred).trim() !== ''
              ? mappedPred
              : templatePred;
          if (
            !keepOriginal['predecessor'] &&
            pred !== undefined &&
            pred !== null &&
            String(pred).trim() !== ''
          ) {
            pred = projCode
              ? `${projCode}-${String(pred).trim()}`
              : String(pred).trim();
          }
          const delegation =
            taskDef['delegation'] !== undefined
              ? taskDef['delegation']
              : constantMapping['delegation'] || 'true';
          const comments =
            taskDef['comments'] !== undefined
              ? taskDef['comments']
              : constantMapping['comments'] || '';

          finalJson.push({
            store: projStore,
            location: projLocation,
            projectYear: projYear,
            projectCode: projCode,
            'Task code phụ': taskCodePhu,
            'Task name': taskName,
            start: start,
            finish: finish,
            duration: duration,
            party: party,
            predecessor: pred,
            delegation: delegation,
            comments: comments,
          });
        }
      }
      return finalJson;
    }

    return excelData.slice(0, 10).map((row) => {
      const parsedRow: any = {};
      TAB_CONFIG[activeTab].columns.forEach((c: string) => {
        parsedRow[c] = getCellValue(
          row,
          c,
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        );
      });
      return parsedRow;
    });
  }, [
    activeTab,
    excelData,
    templateData,
    mapping,
    constantMapping,
    keepOriginal,
    unitSizeMap,
  ]);

  const exportData = async () => {
    await executeCsvExport({
      activeTab,
      sheetNames,
      workbook,
      mapping,
      constantMapping,
      keepOriginal,
      templateData,
      excelData,
      unitSizeMap,
      setError,
    });
  };

  return {
    file,
    workbook,
    sheetNames,
    activeSheet,
    setActiveSheet,
    excelData,
    excelHeaders,
    templateFile,
    setTemplateFile,
    setTemplateData,
    error,
    activeTab,
    showUnlockModal,
    setShowUnlockModal,
    passwordInput,
    setPasswordInput,
    passwordError,
    isLocked,
    mapping,
    setMapping,
    keepOriginal,
    setKeepOriginal,
    constantMapping,
    setConstantMapping,
    switchTab,
    processSheet,
    handleTemplateUpload,
    handleFileUpload,
    handleCancelUpload,
    handleSaveMapping,
    handleUnlock,
    previewData,
    exportData,
  };
}

=== FILE: src/components/DebouncedSearchInput.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

interface DebouncedSearchInputProps extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'onChange'> {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  debounceMs?: number;
  triggerOnEnter?: boolean;
}

export function DebouncedSearchInput({ 
  value, 
  onChange, 
  debounceMs = 300, 
  triggerOnEnter = false, 
  ...props
}: DebouncedSearchInputProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [innerValue, setInnerValue] = useState(value || "");
  const lastReportedValue = useRef(value || "");
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const [, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const isFocusedRef = useRef(false);

  // Sync external value changes into local state (only when not actively typing/focused)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isFocusedRef.current && value !== lastReportedValue.current) {
      setInnerValue(value || "");
      lastReportedValue.current = value || "";
    }
  }, [value]);

  const commitSearch = (valToCommit: string) => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (valToCommit !== lastReportedValue.current) {
      lastReportedValue.current = valToCommit;
      startTransition(() => {
        onChange(valToCommit);
      });
    }
  };

  // Debounce mechanism: triggers filtering after user has finished typing (300ms pause)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (triggerOnEnter) return;

    if (innerValue === lastReportedValue.current) return;

    timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      if (innerValue !== lastReportedValue.current) {
        lastReportedValue.current = innerValue;
        startTransition(() => {
          onChange(innerValue);
        });
      }
    }, debounceMs);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [innerValue, onChange, debounceMs, triggerOnEnter]);

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full">
      <input
        autoCapitalize="none"
        autoCorrect="off"
        spellCheck={false}
        autoComplete="off"
        enterKeyHint="search"
        {...props}
        className={props.className ? (props.className.includes('pr-') ? props.className.replace(/pr-\d+/, 'pr-10') : props.className + ' pr-10') : 'pr-10'}
        value={innerValue}
        onChange={(e) => setInnerValue(e.target.value)}
        onFocus={(e) => {
          isFocusedRef.current = true;
          if (props.onFocus) props.onFocus(e);
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (props.onKeyDown) props.onKeyDown(e);
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && innerValue) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            setInnerValue("");
            commitSearch("");
          } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            commitSearch(innerValue);
          }
        }}
        onBlur={(e) => {
          isFocusedRef.current = false;
          if (props.onBlur) props.onBlur(e);
          commitSearch(innerValue);
        }}
      />
      {innerValue && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setInnerValue("");
            commitSearch("");
          }}
          className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors z-10"
          title={t("Clear") || "Clear"}
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { FC } from 'react';
import { format, startOfDay } from 'date-fns';
import { DelegationCalendarEvent } from './delegationCalendarTypes';
import { CustomEventComponent } from './DelegationCustomEvent';

interface DelegationCalendarMonthListProps {
  selectedMonthDate: Date;
  events: DelegationCalendarEvent[];
  onSelectEvent: (event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => void;
}

export const DelegationCalendarMonthList: React.FC<DelegationCalendarMonthListProps> = ({
  selectedMonthDate,
  events,
  onSelectEvent,
}) => {
  const dayEvents = events.filter(
    (e) =>
      startOfDay(e.start) <= startOfDay(selectedMonthDate) &&
      startOfDay(e.end) >= startOfDay(selectedMonthDate)
  );

  return (
    <div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] pt-4">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] mb-3">
        {format(selectedMonthDate, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')}
      </h3>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {dayEvents.length > 0 ? (
          dayEvents.map((event, idx) => (
            <div
              key={`${event.id}-${idx}`}
              className="cursor-pointer bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded p-2 hover:shadow-sm transition-shadow"
              onClick={() => onSelectEvent(event)}
            >
              <CustomEventComponent event={event} />
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="text-slate-400 text-sm italic px-2 py-1">
            No scheduled for this day.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const CustomEventComponent: React.FC<CustomEventComponentProps> = ({

          </span>
        )}

import React, { FC, useMemo } from 'react';
import { format, addDays, subDays, startOfDay, endOfDay } from 'date-fns';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { DelegationCalendarEvent } from './delegationCalendarTypes';

interface DelegationCustomVerticalViewProps {
  date: Date;
  events: DelegationCalendarEvent[];
  onSelectEvent?: (event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => void;
  daysCount: number;
}

export const DelegationCustomVerticalView: React.FC<DelegationCustomVerticalViewProps> = ({
  date,
  events,
  onSelectEvent,
  daysCount,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const range = useMemo(() => {
    let start: Date;
    let end: Date;
    if (daysCount === 7) {
      start = startOfDay(date);
      end = addDays(date, 6);
    } else {
      start = startOfDay(date);
      end = addDays(date, 30);
    }

    const daysArray: Date[] = [];
    let current = start;
    while (current <= end) {
      daysArray.push(current);
      current = addDays(current, 1);
    }
    return daysArray;
  }, [date, daysCount]);

  const eventsByDay = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, DelegationCalendarEvent[]>();
    range.forEach((day) => {
      map.set(day.toDateString(), []);
    });

    events.forEach((event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => {
      range.forEach((day) => {
        const dayStart = startOfDay(day);
        const dayEnd = endOfDay(day);
        if (event.start <= dayEnd && event.end >= dayStart) {
          map.get(day.toDateString())?.push(event);
        }
      });
    });

    return map;
  }, [events, range]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 overflow-y-auto h-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 rounded-b-xl">
      {range.map((day) => {
        const dayEvents = eventsByDay.get(day.toDateString()) || [];
        if (daysCount !== 7 && dayEvents.length === 0) return null;

        return (
          <div
            key={day.toDateString()}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
          >
            <div className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a]/80 px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-sm flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{format(day, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')}</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-sm">
                {dayEvents.length} {dayEvents.length === 1 ? 'task' : ''}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 flex flex-col gap-2">
              {dayEvents.length > 0 ? (
                dayEvents.map((event, idx) => {
                  const flowTxt =
                    event.resource.subTask.delegationStatus ||
                    event.resource.subTask.status ||
                    'Assigned';
                  const isStart = event.resource.isStartNode;
                  const isFinish = event.resource.isFinishNode;

                  let bgColor = 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50';
                  let borderColor = 'border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555558]';

                  if (flowTxt === 'Completed') {
                    bgColor = 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-[#1a3821]';
                    borderColor = 'border-green-200';
                  } else if (
                    flowTxt === 'On process' ||
                    flowTxt === 'Accepted'
                  ) {
                    bgColor = 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a]';
                    borderColor = 'border-blue-200';
                  } else if (
                    flowTxt === 'Delayed' ||
                    [
                      'requested',
                      'hold',
                      'waiting for approval',
                      'pending completed',
                    ].includes(flowTxt.toLowerCase())
                  ) {
                    bgColor = 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-[#3b2a1a]';
                    borderColor = 'border-orange-200';
                  } else if (
                    flowTxt === 'Approved' ||
                    flowTxt === 'Rejected' ||
                    flowTxt === 'Request Delay' ||
                    flowTxt === 'Needs Rework'
                  ) {
                    bgColor = 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-[#322a36]';
                    borderColor = 'border-purple-200';
                  } else if (flowTxt === 'Assigned') {
                    bgColor = 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-[#3b2a1a]';
                    borderColor = 'border-orange-200';
                  }

                  const priority = event.resource.subTask.priority || 'Mid';
                  const prioColors =
                    priority === 'High'
                      ? 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-[#3b2a1a] text-orange-700 border-orange-200'
                      : priority === 'Mid-high'
                        ? 'bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-[#3b3a1a] text-yellow-700 border-yellow-200'
                        : priority === 'Low'
                          ? 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]'
                          : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-700 border-blue-200';

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={`${event.id}-${idx}`}
                      onClick={() => onSelectEvent && onSelectEvent(event)}
                      className={`cursor-pointer rounded border ${borderColor} ${bgColor} overflow-hidden flex flex-col sm:flex-row shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 text-xs min-h-[28px]`}
                    >
                      <div
                        className="flex-1 text-slate-900 dark:text-white px-3 py-2 font-bold whitespace-normal break-words sm:border-r border-b sm:border-b-0 border-black/10 flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap"
                        title={event.title}
                      >
                        {event.resource.projectName && (
                          <span className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider flex-shrink-0">
                            {event.resource.projectName}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span
                          className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] tracking-wider flex-shrink-0 max-w-[100px] truncate"
                          title={event.resource.subTask.party || 'N/A'}
                        >
                          {event.resource.subTask.party || 'N/A'}
                        </span>
                        {isStart && (
                          <span className="bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider flex-shrink-0">
                            {t('Start')}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {isFinish && (
                          <span className="bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider flex-shrink-0">
                            {t('Finish')}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span className="leading-tight">{event.title}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 sm:max-w-[150px] sm:min-w-[120px] px-3 py-2 whitespace-normal break-words flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-black/5 dark:border-white/5">
                        <span
                          className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1.5 py-1 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold border border-black/5 dark:border-white/5"
                          title={flowTxt}
                        >
                          {flowTxt}
                        </span>
                        <span
                          className={`px-1.5 py-1 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold border ${prioColors}`}
                          title={priority}
                        >
                          {priority}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              ) : (
                <div className="text-slate-400 text-sm italic px-2 py-1">
                  No scheduled for this day.
                </div>

            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
