=== FILE: src/components/DelegationCalendarParts/delegationExportUtils.ts ===
import { format, addDays } from 'date-fns';
import { DelegationCalendarEvent } from './delegationCalendarTypes';

export function exportDelegationEventsToICS(events: DelegationCalendarEvent[]) {
  if (events.length === 0) {
    alert('No events to export.');
    return;
  }

  const formatDate = (date: Date) => {
    return date.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').split('.')[0] + 'Z';
  };

  const icsContent = [
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
    'VERSION:2.0',
    'PRODID:-//Takashimaya Project Management//Delegation Calendar//EN',
    'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
    'METHOD:PUBLISH',
  ];

  events.forEach((event) => {
    icsContent.push('BEGIN:VEVENT');
    icsContent.push(`UID:${event.id}@taka.app`);
    icsContent.push(`DTSTAMP:${formatDate(new Date())}`);
    if (event.allDay) {
      const startStr = format(event.start, 'yyyyMMdd');
      const endStr = format(addDays(event.start, 1), 'yyyyMMdd');
      icsContent.push(`DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:${startStr}`);
      icsContent.push(`DTEND;VALUE=DATE:${endStr}`);
    } else {
      icsContent.push(`DTSTART:${formatDate(event.start)}`);
      icsContent.push(`DTEND:${formatDate(event.end)}`);
    }
    icsContent.push(`SUMMARY:${event.title.replace(/[,;]/g, '\\$&')}`);
    if (event.resource && event.resource.group) {
      const groupDesc = `Group: ${event.resource.group.name || ''}\nTask: ${event.title}\nStatus: ${event.resource.subTask?.status || ''}`;
      icsContent.push(
        `DESCRIPTION:${groupDesc
          .replace(/\n/g, '\\n')
          .replace(/[,;]/g, '\\$&')}`
      );
    }
    icsContent.push('END:VEVENT');
  });

  icsContent.push('END:VCALENDAR');

  const blob = new Blob([icsContent.join('\r\n')], {
    type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8',
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `Takashimaya_Delegation_${format(new Date(), 'yyyyMMdd')}.ics`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}


=== FILE: src/components/DelegationCalendarParts/useDelegationCalendarEvents.ts ===
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { parseDateTime, getTaskStatus, getStatus } from '../../lib/utils';
import { DelegationCalendarEvent } from './delegationCalendarTypes';

interface UseDelegationCalendarEventsParams {
  groups: DelegationGroup[];
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  filterStore: string;
  filterLocation: string;
  filterParty: string;
  currentView: string;
}

export function useDelegationCalendarEvents({
  groups,
  projects,
  tasks,
  currentUser,
  filterStore,
  filterLocation,
  filterParty,
  currentView,
}: UseDelegationCalendarEventsParams) {
  const events = useMemo(() => {
    const projectMap = new Map<string, Project>();
    projects.forEach((p) => {
      if (p.code) projectMap.set(p.code, p);
    });
    const calendarEvents: DelegationCalendarEvent[] = [];

    const filteredGroups = groups.filter((g) => {
      const project =
        projectMap.get(g.projectCode) || projectMap.get(g.parentTaskId);

      if (filterStore && project && project.store !== filterStore) return false;
      if (filterLocation && project && project.location !== filterLocation)
        return false;

      return true;
    });

    filteredGroups.forEach((group) => {
      const project =
        projectMap.get(group.projectCode) || projectMap.get(group.parentTaskId);
      let subTasksToMap = group.subTasks;
      const isAdmin = currentUser.role === 'admin';

      if (!isAdmin && group.createdBy !== currentUser.id) {
        subTasksToMap = subTasksToMap.filter((st) => {
          if (
            st.createdBy === currentUser.id ||
            (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id))
          )
            return true;
          const pLower = String(st.party || '')
            .toLowerCase()
            .trim();
          const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
            ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
                .filter((k) => currentUser.partyPermissions![k])
                .map((k) => k.toLowerCase().trim())
            : [];
          if (userParties.includes('all')) return true;
          const usernameMatch =
            pLower === String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim();
          return userParties.includes(pLower) || usernameMatch;
        });
      }

      subTasksToMap.forEach((st) => {
        if (filterParty) {
          if (filterParty === 'unassigned') {
            if (st.party && st.party.trim() !== '') return;
          } else {
            if (st.party !== filterParty) return;
          }
        }

        const startVal =
          st.startAct ||
          group.updatedAt?.substring(0, 10) ||
          new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
        const endVal = st.finishAct || startVal;

        const start = parseDateTime(startVal);
        const end = parseDateTime(endVal);

        if (start && end) {
          const evtStart = new Date(start);
          evtStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          const evtEnd = new Date(end);
          evtEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

          if (currentView === 'month') {
            calendarEvents.push({
              id: `del_${st.id}_start`,
              title: `${group.name} - ${st.name || 'Delegation'}`,
              start: evtStart,
              end: evtStart,
              allDay: true,
              resource: {
                group,
                subTask: st,
                isStartNode: true,
                projectName: project ? project.name : '',
                currentView,
              },
              colorIndex: 0,
            });
            if (evtStart.toDateString() !== evtEnd.toDateString()) {
              calendarEvents.push({
                id: `del_${st.id}_end`,
                title: `${group.name} - ${st.name || 'Delegation'}`,
                start: evtEnd,
                end: evtEnd,
                allDay: true,
                resource: {
                  group,
                  subTask: st,
                  isFinishNode: true,
                  projectName: project ? project.name : '',
                  currentView,
                },
                colorIndex: 0,
              });
            }
          } else {
            calendarEvents.push({
              id: `del_${st.id}`,
              title: `${group.name} - ${st.name || 'Delegation'}`,
              start: evtStart,
              end: evtEnd,
              allDay: true,
              resource: {
                group,
                subTask: st,
                projectName: project ? project.name : '',
                currentView,
              },
              colorIndex: 0,
            });
          }
        }
      });
    });

    calendarEvents.sort((a, b) => {
      const parentTaskA = a.resource.group.parentTaskId
        ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === a.resource.group.parentTaskId)
        : null;
      const parentTaskB = b.resource.group.parentTaskId
        ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === b.resource.group.parentTaskId)
        : null;

      let plStatusA = 'Upcoming';
      if (parentTaskA) {
        plStatusA = getTaskStatus(parentTaskA.start, parentTaskA.finish);
      } else {
        const pA =
          projectMap.get(a.resource.group.projectCode) ||
          projectMap.get(a.resource.group.parentTaskId);
        if (pA) {
          plStatusA = getStatus(
            pA.computedTakStart || pA.start,
            pA.computedTakCompl,
            pA.computedOpening || pA.opening,
            pA.code
          );
        }
      }

      let plStatusB = 'Upcoming';
      if (parentTaskB) {
        plStatusB = getTaskStatus(parentTaskB.start, parentTaskB.finish);
      } else {
        const pB =
          projectMap.get(b.resource.group.projectCode) ||
          projectMap.get(b.resource.group.parentTaskId);
        if (pB) {
          plStatusB = getStatus(
            pB.computedTakStart || pB.start,
            pB.computedTakCompl,
            pB.computedOpening || pB.opening,
            pB.code
          );
        }
      }

      const statusPriority: Record<string, number> = {
        'On process': 1,
        Handover: 2,
        Upcoming: 3,
        Completed: 4,
        Canceled: 5,
      };

      const priA = statusPriority[plStatusA] || 99;
      const priB = statusPriority[plStatusB] || 99;
      if (priA !== priB) return priA - priB;

      if (plStatusA === 'On process') {
        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        const finishA = parseDateTime(a.resource.subTask.finishAct);
        const finishB = parseDateTime(b.resource.subTask.finishAct);
        if (finishA && finishB) {
          const diffA = Math.abs(finishA.getTime() - today.getTime());
          const diffB = Math.abs(finishB.getTime() - today.getTime());
          if (diffA !== diffB) return diffA - diffB;
        }
      }

      const startA = a.resource.subTask.startAct || '9999-12-31';
      const startB = b.resource.subTask.startAct || '9999-12-31';
      if (startA < startB) return -1;
      if (startA > startB) return 1;

      return 0;
    });

    return calendarEvents;
  }, [
    groups,
    projects,
    tasks,
    currentUser,
    filterStore,
    filterLocation,
    filterParty,
    currentView,
  ]);

  return { events };
}

  };

  const eventStyleGetter = (event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => {
    let backgroundColor = '#f8fafc';
    let borderColor = '#cbd5e1';

    const flowTxt =
      event.resource.subTask.delegationStatus ||
      event.resource.subTask.status ||
      'Assigned';
    if (flowTxt === 'Completed') {
      backgroundColor = '#f0fdf4';
      borderColor = '#bbf7d0';
    } else if (flowTxt === 'On process' || flowTxt === 'Accepted') {
      backgroundColor = '#eff6ff';
      borderColor = '#bfdbfe';
    } else if (
      flowTxt === 'Delayed' ||
      [
        'requested',
        'hold',
        'waiting for approval',
        'pending completed',
      ].includes(flowTxt.toLowerCase())
    ) {
      backgroundColor = '#fff7ed';
      borderColor = '#fed7aa';
    } else if (
      flowTxt === 'Approved' ||
      flowTxt === 'Rejected' ||
      flowTxt === 'Request Delay' ||
      flowTxt === 'Needs Rework'
    ) {
      backgroundColor = '#faf5ff';
      borderColor = '#e9d5ff';
    } else if (flowTxt === 'Assigned') {
      backgroundColor = '#fff7ed';
      borderColor = '#fed7aa';
    }

    return {
      style: {
        backgroundColor,
        borderRadius: '6px',
        opacity: 0.95,
        color: '#0f172a',
        border: `1px solid ${borderColor}`,
        display: 'block',
        fontSize: '11px',
        fontWeight: '600',
        padding: '3px 6px',
        lineHeight: '1.3',
        boxShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)',
      },
    };
  };

  const handleSelectEvent = (event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => {
    onTabChange('taskDelegation');
    setTimeout(() => {
      const el = document.getElementById(`delegation-group-${event.resource.group.id}`);
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      }
    }, 300);
  };

  const CustomDateHeader = ({ label, date }: any) => {
    const dayEvents = events.filter(
      (e) =>
        startOfDay(e.start) <= startOfDay(date) &&
        startOfDay(e.end) >= startOfDay(date)
    );
    const hasEvents = dayEvents.length > 0;
    const isSelected = isSameDay(date, selectedMonthDate);

    return (
      <div
        className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer mt-1 mx-auto w-10 h-10 ${
          isSelected ? 'bg-blue-100 rounded-full' : ''
        }`}
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          setSelectedMonthDate(date);
        }}
      >
        <span
          className={`text-[13px] font-medium leading-none ${
            isSameDay(date, new Date())
              ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center'
              : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]'
          }`}
        >
          {label}
        </span>
        <div className="h-2 flex items-center justify-center mt-1">
          {hasEvents && (
            <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full"></div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-grow flex flex-col min-h-[600px] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-sm p-4">
      <style>{`
        .rbc-time-content { display: none !important; }
        .rbc-time-header-gutter { display: none !important; }
        .rbc-time-view .rbc-time-header { flex: 1 1 auto !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
        .rbc-time-header-content { flex: 1 1 auto !important; display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important; border-left: none !important; }
        .rbc-allday-cell { flex: 1 1 auto !important; height: 100% !important; max-height: none !important; }
        .rbc-event { white-space: normal !important; word-break: break-word !important; height: auto !important; min-height: 24px; margin-bottom: 2px !important; background: transparent !important; padding: 0 !important; border: 0 !important; }
        .rbc-event-content { white-space: normal !important; word-break: break-word !important; height: 100%; display: flex; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-row-segment { display: none !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-month-row { flex: 1 0 50px !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-date-cell { text-align: center !important; padding: 0 !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-button-link { pointer-events: none !important; }
      `}</style>

      <DelegationCalendarFilterToolbar
        totalEvents={events.length}
        searchDate={searchDate}
        onSearchDateChange={handleSearchDate}
        filterStore={filterStore}
        setFilterStore={setFilterStore}
        uniqueStores={uniqueStores}
        filterLocation={filterLocation}
        setFilterLocation={setFilterLocation}
        locations={locations}
        filterParty={filterParty}
        setFilterParty={setFilterParty}
        uniqueParties={uniqueParties}
        onExportICS={handleExportICS}
      />

      <div className="flex-grow min-h-[600px]">
        <Calendar
          localizer={localizer}
          events={events}
          startAccessor="start"
          endAccessor="end"
          style={{ height: '100%', minHeight: '600px' }}
          eventPropGetter={eventStyleGetter}
          components={{
            event: CustomEventComponent as any,
            month: {
              dateHeader: CustomDateHeader,
            },
          }}
          onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent}
          date={currentDate}
          onNavigate={(newDate) => setCurrentDate(newDate)}
          view={currentView}
          onView={(newView) => setCurrentView(newView)}
          views={{
            month: true,
            week: CustomWeekView,
            day: true,
            agenda: CustomAgendaView,
          }}
          popup
        />
      </div>

      {currentView === 'month' && (
        <DelegationCalendarMonthList
          selectedMonthDate={selectedMonthDate}
          events={events}
          onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default DelegationCalendarTab;


=== FILE: src/components/DelegationParts/MultiSelectInput.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export function MultiSelectInput({ 
  value, 
  options, 
  onSave, 
  disabled, 
  className,
  placeholder
}: { 
  value: string; 
  options: string[]; 
  onSave: (val: string) => void; 
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
}) {
  const [val, setVal] = useState(value || '');
  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false);
  const valRef = useRef(val);
  const valueRef = useRef(value);
  const isComponentMounted = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    isComponentMounted.current = true;
    return () => { isComponentMounted.current = false; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setVal(value || '');
    valueRef.current = value || '';
  }, [value]);

  useEffect(() => {
    valRef.current = val;
  }, [val]);

  const currentPart = String(valRef.current || val || '').split(',').pop()?.trim() || '';
  
  // Deduplicate options case-insensitively, preferring the first encountered case
  const seenLower = new Set<string>();
  const uniqueOptions: string[] = [];
  for (const opt of options) {
    const lower = opt.toLowerCase();
    if (!seenLower.has(lower)) {
      seenLower.add(lower);
      uniqueOptions.push(opt);
    }
  }

  const suggestions = uniqueOptions.filter(v => 
    v.toLowerCase().includes(currentPart.toLowerCase()) && currentPart.toLowerCase() !== v.toLowerCase()
  );

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full">
      <input
        type="text"
        value={val}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setVal(e.target.value);
          setShowSuggestions(true);
        }}
        onFocus={() => setShowSuggestions(true)}
        onBlur={() => {
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (!isComponentMounted.current) return;
            const currentVal = valRef.current;
            const oldVal = valueRef.current;
            if (currentVal && currentVal.trim() !== '') {
              const parts = currentVal.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
              const correctedParts = parts.map(p => {
                const matchedOption = options.find(opt => opt.toLowerCase() === p.toLowerCase());
                return matchedOption || p;
              });
              const invalidParts = correctedParts.filter(p => !options.includes(p));
              if (invalidParts.length > 0) {
                setVal(oldVal || '');
              } else {
                const newParts = correctedParts.join(', ');
                setVal(newParts);
                if (newParts !== oldVal) onSave(newParts);
              }
            } else {
              if (oldVal !== '') onSave('');
            }
            setShowSuggestions(false);
          }, 200);
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            const currentPartStr = String(valRef.current || val || '').split(',').pop()?.trim() || '';
            const match = uniqueOptions.find(opt => opt.toLowerCase().startsWith(currentPartStr.toLowerCase()) || opt.toLowerCase().includes(currentPartStr.toLowerCase()));
            if (currentPartStr && match) {
              const parts = String(valRef.current).split(',');
              parts.pop();
              const newParts = parts.map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
              newParts.push(match);
              const newValue = newParts.join(', ');
              setVal(newValue);
              valRef.current = newValue;
            }
            setTimeout(() => {
              e.currentTarget.blur();
            }, 0);
          }
        }}
        disabled={disabled}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        className={className}
      />
      {showSuggestions && suggestions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="absolute top-full left-0 mt-1 min-w-[200px] w-full max-h-40 overflow-y-auto bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded shadow-xl z-[9999]">
          {suggestions.map(s => (
            <div 
              key={s} 
              className="px-3 py-2 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] cursor-pointer text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]"
              onMouseDown={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const parts = String(valRef.current).split(',');
                parts.pop();
                const newParts = parts.map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                newParts.push(s);
                const newValue = newParts.join(', ') + ', ';
                setVal(newValue);
                setShowSuggestions(false);
              }}
              onClick={() => {
                const parts = String(valRef.current).split(',');
                parts.pop();
                const newParts = parts.map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                newParts.push(s);
                const newValue = newParts.join(', ') + ', ';
                setVal(newValue);
                setShowSuggestions(false);
                onSave(newValue.trim().replace(/,\s*$/, ''));
              }}
            >
              {s}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function DesktopOptimizationModal({ isOpen, onClose }: DesktopOptimizationModalProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [activeBrowser, setActiveBrowser] = useState<'chrome' | 'edge'>('chrome');
  const [copiedUrl, setCopiedUrl] = useState(false);
  const [copiedSettingsPath, setCopiedSettingsPath] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const appUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined' 
    ? `${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}`.replace(/\/+$/, '') 
    : 'https://takashimaya.app';

  const chromeSettingsUrl = 'chrome://settings/performance';
  const edgeSettingsUrl = 'edge://settings/system';

  const handleCopyUrl = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(appUrl);
      setCopiedUrl(true);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Đã sao chép",
        message: "Đã sao chép URL ứng dụng vào bộ nhớ tạm!",
        type: "success"
      });
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedUrl(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Thông báo",
        message: "Không thể tự động sao chép. Vui lòng bôi đen và copy URL thủ công.",
        type: "info"
      });
    }
  };

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(path);

        message: `Đã sao chép đường dẫn ${path}`,

    }

            {/* Header */}

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/50">
                  <Monitor className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                    Cấu Hình Tối Ưu Desktop & Chống Ngủ Tab

  const setGlobalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalYearFilter);
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const setGlobalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalStoreFilter);
  const globalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalLocationFilter);

  const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);

  const setDetailTabFilterCode = useAppStore(state => state.setDetailTabFilterCode);

  const setIsTasksRequested = useAppStore(state => state.setIsTasksRequested);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTasksRequested) setIsTasksRequested(true);

    const onChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setIsDesktop(e.matches);
    mql.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  });

  // Reordering & Predecessor Synchronization

    tasks,
    filteredProjects,

    handleSortSubTasks,
  });

  // Project & Task Mutations
  const {
    handleDeleteProject,

    projects,

    setConfirmModal,
  });

  const {

                    headers.forEach((h, i) => {
                      let key = h;
                      if (h === 'task name') key = 'name';
                      if (h === 'projectcode') key = 'projectCode';
                      if (h === 'year' || h === 'projectyear') key = 'projectYear';
                      if (h === 'store' || h === 'projectstore') key = 'projectStore';
                      if (h === 'sub-task code' || h === 'sub task code' || h === 'subtask code' || h === 'sub_task_code' || h === 'taskcodephu' || h === 'task code phu' || h === 'task_code_phu') key = 'taskCodePhu';
                      if (h === 'orderindex' || h === 'order_index') key = 'orderIndex';
                      if (h === 'delegation' || h === 'task delegation' || h === 'task_delegation' || h === 'isdelegation') key = 'delegation';
                      if (h === 'task flexible' || h === 'task_flexible' || h === 'taskflexible' || h === 'flexible' || h === 'realtimeupdate' || h === 'realtime_update') key = 'realtimeUpdate';
                      if (['projectCode', 'projectYear', 'projectStore', 'name', 'start', 'finish', 'duration', 'party', 'predecessor', 'taskCodePhu', 'orderIndex', 'delegation', 'realtimeUpdate', 'id'].includes(key)) {
                        let val: any = row[i];
                        if (key === 'start' || key === 'finish') val = parseCSVDate(val);
                        else if (key === 'delegation' || key === 'realtimeUpdate') {
                          const strVal = String(val || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                          val = (strVal === 'true' || strVal === '1' || strVal === 'yes' || strVal === 'on');
                        } else if (key === 'projectYear') {
                          val = isNaN(Number(val)) ? val : Number(val);
                        }
                        t[key] = val;
                      }
                    });
                    if (!t.projectCode || !t.name) return null;
                    return t;
                  }}
                  onRecordSave={(record, batch) => {
                     if (record.delegation) {
                        const now = new Date().toISOString();
                        const dateStr = now.substring(0, 10);
                        const activeUser = useAppStore.getState().currentUser || currentUser;
                        const activeUserId = activeUser?.id && activeUser.id !== 'guest' ? activeUser.id : (activeUser?.username || 'system');
                        const rawParty = (record.party && record.party.trim()) ? record.party.trim() : '';
                        const parsedParty = rawParty.split(/[,;/+]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[0] || rawParty;
                        const deterministicGroupId = `del_${record.id}`;

                        if (parsedParty) {
                          const newGroup = {
                            id: deterministicGroupId,
                            parentTaskId: record.id,
                            name: record.name || 'Delegated Task',
                            projectCode: record.projectCode,
                            projectStore: record.projectStore,
                            projectYear: (record.projectYear !== undefined && record.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(record.projectYear))) ? Number(record.projectYear) : (Number(projects.find(p => p.code === record.projectCode)?.year) || new Date().getFullYear()),

                               name: '', 
                               comments: '', 
                               status: 'Assigned', 
                               delegationStatus: 'Assigned', 
                               priority: 'Mid', 
                               party: parsedParty, 
                               startAct: dateStr, 
                               finishAct: dateStr, 
                               updatedAt: now 
                            }],
                            updatedAt: now,
                            createdBy: activeUserId
                          };

                          batch.set(delRef, newGroup, { merge: true });
                        }
                     }
                  }}
                  id="detail-full-import-tasks-btn"
                  hiddenBtn={true}
                />
              )}
              <button id="detail-export-tasks-btn" onClick={handleExportTasks} className="hidden" />
              <input id="detail-import-tasks-input" type="file" accept=".csv, .xlsx, .xls" onChange={handleImportTasks} className="hidden" />

          </>

export function parseStackedDate(dateStr: string | undefined): { month: string; day: string; year: string } | null {
  if (!dateStr) return null;
  const d = parseDateTime(dateStr);
  if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
  return {
    month: d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short' }),
    day: `${d.getDate()},`,
    year: String(d.getFullYear())
  };
}

  const pKey = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}-${p.id || p.no}`;
  const pInfo = projectInfoMap.get(pKey) || getProjectInfo(p);
  const rawSorted = pInfo.sortedTasks || [];
  const sortedTasks = rawSorted.filter((t: Task) => {
    if ((!t.name || !String(t.name).trim()) && (!t.start || !String(t.start).trim()) && (!t.finish || !String(t.finish).trim())) {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  const groupTasks = sortConfig ? [...sortedTasks].sort((a, b) => {
    if (!sortConfig) return 0;
    let valA = '';
    let valB = '';
    let direction = sortConfig.direction;
    if (sortConfig.key === 'start') {
      valA = a.start || '9999-12-31';
      valB = b.start || '9999-12-31';
    } else if (sortConfig.key === 'finish') {
      valA = a.finish || '9999-12-31';
      valB = b.finish || '9999-12-31';
    } else if (sortConfig.key === 'taskName') {
      valA = a.name || '';
      valB = b.name || '';
    } else if (sortConfig.key === 'duration') {
      const numA = Number(a.duration || '0');
      const numB = Number(b.duration || '0');
      if (numA < numB) return direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (numA > numB) return direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    }
    if (valA < valB) return direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
    if (valA > valB) return direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
    return 0;
  }) : sortedTasks;

  const computedTakStart = pInfo.computedTakStart || p.computedTakStart || p.start;
  const computedTakCompl = pInfo.computedTakCompl || p.computedTakCompl || p.handover;
  const computedOpening = pInfo.computedOpening || p.opening;
  const rawStatus = pInfo.status || getStatus(computedTakStart, computedTakCompl, computedOpening, p.code) || p.mdStatus || (p as any).status;
  const status = (!rawStatus || rawStatus === '—' || rawStatus === '-') ? getStatus(computedTakStart, computedTakCompl, computedOpening, p.code) || 'On process' : rawStatus;
  const statusUpper = String(status || 'ON PROCESS').toUpperCase();
  
  let statusBadgeClass = 'bg-amber-500 text-white dark:bg-amber-500 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-amber-400';
  let borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-amber-500';
  let bgCardTint = 'bg-amber-50/30 dark:bg-amber-950/20';

  if (status === 'Completed' || statusUpper === 'COMPLETED') {
    statusBadgeClass = 'bg-emerald-600 text-white dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-emerald-500';
    borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-emerald-500';
    bgCardTint = 'bg-emerald-50/25 dark:bg-emerald-950/15';
  } else if (status === 'Handover' || statusUpper === 'HANDOVER') {
    statusBadgeClass = 'bg-blue-600 text-white dark:bg-blue-600 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-blue-500';
    borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-blue-500';
    bgCardTint = 'bg-blue-50/25 dark:bg-blue-950/15';
  } else if (status === 'On process' || statusUpper === 'ON PROCESS') {
    statusBadgeClass = 'bg-amber-500 text-white dark:bg-amber-500 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-amber-400';
    borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-amber-500';
    bgCardTint = 'bg-amber-50/30 dark:bg-amber-950/20';
  } else if (status === 'Canceled' || statusUpper === 'CANCELED') {
    statusBadgeClass = 'bg-rose-600 text-white dark:bg-rose-600 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-rose-500';
    borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-rose-500';
    bgCardTint = 'bg-rose-50/25 dark:bg-rose-950/15';
  } else {
    statusBadgeClass = 'bg-indigo-600 text-white dark:bg-indigo-600 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-indigo-500';
    borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-indigo-500';
    bgCardTint = 'bg-indigo-50/25 dark:bg-indigo-950/15';
  }

  const storeUpper = (p.store || '').toUpperCase();
  let storeBadgeClass = 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700';
  if (storeUpper === 'HCM') {
    storeBadgeClass = 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/80 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800 font-bold';
  } else if (storeUpper === 'HN') {
    storeBadgeClass = 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800 font-bold';
  }

  const isExpanded =
    expandedCodes.includes(String(p.id || '')) ||
    (p.code ? expandedCodes.includes(p.code) : false) ||
    (p.no !== undefined && p.no !== null ? expandedCodes.includes(String(p.no)) : false);

  const isProjectMatch = lowerSearchTerm
    ? matchesAdvancedSearch(lowerSearchTerm, [p.store, p.location, p.year, p.code, p.linkCodes, p.name, p.detail, (p as any).description, p.note, p.party])
    : true;
  const tasksToRender = isProjectMatch ? groupTasks : groupTasks.filter((t, idx) => {
    const taskFields = [
      t.taskCodePhu,
      `${p.code}#${(t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex : idx) + 1}`,
      t.name,
      t.duration,
      t.start,
      t.finish,
      t.party,
      formatDisplayDateMain(t.start),
      formatDisplayDateMain(t.finish)
    ];
    return taskFields.some(val => String(val || "").toLowerCase().includes(lowerSearchTerm));
  });

  const summaryCount = (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries)) ? p.taskSummaries.length : (p.taskCount ?? 0);
  const projectDocCount = Math.max(p.taskCount ?? 0, summaryCount);
  const loadedTaskCount = groupTasks.length;
  const authoritativeCount = Math.max(loadedTaskCount, projectDocCount);
  const effectiveTaskCount = (lowerSearchTerm && !isProjectMatch)
    ? tasksToRender.length
    : authoritativeCount;

  const isProjectDelegationOn = groupTasks.some(t => Boolean(t.delegation)) || (p.taskSummaries?.some(ts => Boolean(ts.delegation)) ?? false);

  let planProgressPercent = 0;
  let actProgressPercent = 0;
  if (groupTasks.length > 0) {
    planProgressPercent = computePlanProgressPercent(groupTasks);
    actProgressPercent = computeActProgressPercent(groupTasks, delegationGroups);
  } else if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
    planProgressPercent = computePlanProgressFromSummaries(p.taskSummaries);
    actProgressPercent = computeActProgressFromSummaries(p.taskSummaries);
  } else {
    planProgressPercent = p.computedPlanProgress ?? 0;
  }

  const startParts = parseStackedDate(computedTakStart || p.start);
  const complParts = parseStackedDate(computedTakCompl || p.handover || p.opening);
  const displayParty = p.party || Array.from(new Set(groupTasks.map(t => t.party?.trim()).filter(Boolean))).join(', ');

  return (
    <div 
      id={`detail-project-${p.no ?? p.code}`}
      data-project-item="true"
      data-project-id={String(p.id || p.no || p.code)}
      data-project-code={p.code}
      data-project-year={p.year || ''}
      data-project-store={p.store || ''}
      className={cn(
        "mobile-card-optimized rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#38383b] shadow-xs hover:shadow-md p-3 flex flex-col gap-2.5 relative transition-all",
        bgCardTint,
        borderAccentClass
      )}
    >
      {/* Top controls: Badges & Link Codes on left, Program Status on right */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 w-full">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap min-w-0 flex-1">
          {p.year && (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
              {p.year}
            </span>
          )}
          {p.store && (
            <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] rounded border font-bold ${storeBadgeClass}`}>
              {p.store}
            </span>
          )}
          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold font-mono rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800">
            {p.code}
          </span>
          {p.linkCodes && p.linkCodes !== p.code && (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-normal">
              ({p.linkCodes})
            </span>
          )}
          {p.location && (
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
              • {p.location}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="shrink-0">
          <div className={`text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs ${statusBadgeClass}`}>
            {statusUpper === 'ON PROCESS' ? 'ON PROCESS' : (statusUpper === 'UPCOMING' ? 'UPCOMING' : (statusUpper === 'COMPLETED' ? 'COMPLETED' : statusUpper))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Project Title with Expand button on left & Quick Navigation on right */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 w-full">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 flex-1 min-w-0">
          <button 
            onClick={() => toggleGroup(String(p.id || p.code || p.no || ''))} 
            className={cn(
              "flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 mt-0.5 shrink-0 rounded text-white font-extrabold text-[10px] shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer",
              effectiveTaskCount > 0 
                ? "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500" 
                : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500"
            )}
            title={isExpanded ? "Collapse" : `Expand (${effectiveTaskCount})`}
          >
            {!isExpanded ? <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
            <span>({effectiveTaskCount})</span>
          </button>

          <div 
            onClick={() => onEditProject?.(p, !canWrite, "chat")}
            className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#ffffff] text-sm sm:text-base leading-snug cursor-pointer hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8] transition-colors break-words flex-1 min-w-0"

          {tasksToRender.length === 0 ? (

            </div>
          ) : (

              <DetailMobileTaskItem
                key={`mobile-task-${p.id || p.code || p.no}-${t.id || index}`}

                index={index}
                taskCode={taskCodeMap.get(t.id) || t.taskCode || ''}

            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Add Task
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { ChevronUp, ChevronDown, Maximize2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { FastToggle } from './FastToggle';
import { EditableCell } from './EditableCell';
import { cleanDurationString } from '../../lib/taskImportService';
import { cn, formatDisplayDateMain, calculateDays, getTaskStatus, getActStatusPercent } from '../../lib/utils';

export interface DetailMobileTaskItemProps {
  task: Task;
  project: Project;
  groupTasks: Task[];
  index: number;
  taskCode: string;
  actStatus: { label: string; color: string };
  isFocused: boolean;
  canWrite: boolean;
  isProjectDelegationOn?: boolean;
  onEditTask: (t: Task, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  handleMoveTask: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[], index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => void;
  handleUpdateTask: (task: Task, updates: Partial<Task>) => void;
  handleDeleteTask: (task: Task) => void;
}

export const DetailMobileTaskItem = memo(function DetailMobileTaskItem({
  task: t,
  project: p,
  groupTasks,
  index: i,
  taskCode,
  actStatus,
  isFocused,
  canWrite,
  isProjectDelegationOn,
  onEditTask,
  handleMoveTask,
  handleUpdateTask,
  handleDeleteTask
}: DetailMobileTaskItemProps) {
  const taskStatus = getTaskStatus(t.start, t.finish);

  let taskStatusColorClass = 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 font-bold';
  if (taskStatus === 'Completed') {
    taskStatusColorClass = 'bg-emerald-600 text-white dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:text-white border-emerald-500 font-extrabold shadow-2xs';
  } else if (taskStatus === 'On process') {
    taskStatusColorClass = 'bg-amber-500 text-white dark:bg-amber-500 dark:text-white border-amber-400 font-extrabold shadow-2xs';
  }

  const delStatusText = actStatus?.label || 'Pending';
  const delStatusColorClass = actStatus?.color || 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-600';

  const showActStatus = Boolean(isProjectDelegationOn && t.delegation);

  const taskBorderAccent = taskStatus === 'Completed' 
    ? 'border-l-[4px] border-l-emerald-500' 
    : taskStatus === 'On process' 
    ? 'border-l-[4px] border-l-amber-500' 
    : 'border-l-[4px] border-l-slate-400';

  return (
    <div 
      id={`detail-task-${t.id}`} 
      style={{ contentVisibility: 'auto', containIntrinsicSize: '120px' }}
      className={cn(
        "bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-[#252528] rounded-xl p-3 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#444446] text-sm shadow-xs flex flex-col gap-2.5 transition-all", 
        taskBorderAccent,
        isFocused ? "ring-2 ring-inset ring-yellow-400 !bg-yellow-50 dark:!bg-yellow-900/20" : ""
      )} 
      onClick={() => canWrite && onEditTask(t, false, "chat")}
    >
      <div className="flex gap-3">
        {canWrite && (
          <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center -mr-1">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleMoveTask(p, groupTasks, i, 'up'); }}
              disabled={i === 0}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8] disabled:opacity-20 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
              title="Move Up"
            >
              <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleMoveTask(p, groupTasks, i, 'down'); }}
              disabled={i === groupTasks.length - 1}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8] disabled:opacity-20 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
              title="Move Down"
            >
              <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex flex-col w-20 shrink-0 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] gap-1 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] pr-2">
          <div className="font-mono text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-bold">{formatDisplayDateMain(t.start)}</div>
          <div className="font-mono text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-400 font-bold">{formatDisplayDateMain(t.finish)}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] mt-1">
            {canWrite ? (
              <EditableCell
                value={t.duration !== undefined && t.duration !== null ? t.duration : calculateDays(t.start, t.finish).replace('d', '')}
                type="number"
                className="text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] font-mono font-medium text-[10px] px-0.5 py-0"
                onSave={(val) => {
                  const cleanVal = cleanDurationString(val);
                  handleUpdateTask(t, { duration: cleanVal, durationManual: true });
                }}
                canWrite={canWrite}
              />
            ) : (
              <span className="italic">{t.duration !== undefined ? `${t.duration}d` : calculateDays(t.start, t.finish)}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-grow flex flex-col gap-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">

              {taskCode || t.taskCodePhu || `${p.code}#${i + 1}`}

            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#ffffff] text-sm leading-snug">
              {t.name || '(Unnamed Task)'}
            </span>

              {t.predecessor && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800">
                  Pred: {t.predecessor}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <FastToggle value={Boolean(t.delegation)} canWrite={canWrite} onToggle={(val) => handleUpdateTask(t, { delegation: val })} />
            </div>

import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, memo, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { DetailMobileProjectCard } from './DetailMobileProjectCard';

interface DetailMobileViewProps {
  filteredProjects: Project[];
  expandedCodes: string[];
  setExpandedCodes: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  visibleCount: number;
  setVisibleCount: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
  projectInfoMap: Map<string, any>;
  getProjectInfo: (p: Project) => any;
  sortConfig: { key: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' } | null;
  delegationGroupByParentKey?: Map<string, DelegationGroup>;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string;
  canWrite: boolean;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  lowerSearchTerm: string;
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  toggleGroup: (id: string) => void;
  onEditProject?: (p: Project, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  onAddTask: (p?: Project | null) => void;
  onEditTask: (t: Task, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  handleUpdateProject: (p: Project, field: string, val: any) => void;
  handleMoveTask: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[], index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => void;
  handleUpdateTask: (task: Task, updates: Partial<Task>) => void;
  handleDeleteTask: (task: Task) => void;
  taskCodeMap?: Map<string, string>;
  taskActualStatusMap?: Map<string, { label: string; color: string }>;
  onSortSubTasks?: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[]) => void;
  onNavigateToDelegation?: (groupId: string, sourceTaskId?: string) => void;
}

export const DetailMobileView = memo(function DetailMobileView({
  filteredProjects,
  expandedCodes,
  setExpandedCodes,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount,
  projectInfoMap,
  getProjectInfo,
  sortConfig,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  canWrite,
  tasks = [],
  projects = [],
  lowerSearchTerm,
  delegationGroups,
  toggleGroup,
  onEditProject,
  onAddTask,
  onEditTask,
  handleUpdateProject,
  handleMoveTask,
  handleUpdateTask,
  handleDeleteTask,
  taskCodeMap,
  taskActualStatusMap,
  onSortSubTasks
}: DetailMobileViewProps) {
  const handleMobileScroll = useCallback((e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.currentTarget;
    const st = target.scrollTop;
    const sh = target.scrollHeight;
    const ch = target.clientHeight;

    if (sh - (st + ch) < 450) {
      if (visibleCount < filteredProjects.length) {
        setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + 25, filteredProjects.length));
      }
    }
  }, [visibleCount, filteredProjects.length, setVisibleCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!filteredProjects || filteredProjects.length === 0) return;
    const visibleSlice = filteredProjects.slice(0, visibleCount);
    const visibleIds = new Set<string>();
    for (const p of visibleSlice) {
      if (p.id) visibleIds.add(String(p.id));
      if (p.code) visibleIds.add(String(p.code));
    }
    const arr = Array.from(visibleIds).filter(Boolean);
    if (arr.length > 0) {
      useAppStore.getState().setVisibleActiveProjectIds(arr);
    }
  }, [filteredProjects, visibleCount]);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="xl:hidden flex justify-between items-center px-2 pb-2">
        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">Projects ({filteredProjects.length})</span>
        <button 
          onClick={() => setExpandedCodes(expandedCodes.length === 0 ? filteredProjects.map(p => String(p.id!)) : [])} 
          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-medium hover:text-blue-800 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          {expandedCodes.length === 0 ? (
            <><ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /> Expand All</>
          ) : (
            <><ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" /> Collapse All</>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div 
        onScroll={handleMobileScroll}
        className="xl:hidden flex-grow overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-4 pb-16 px-2 bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-[#131314] overscroll-y-contain transition-colors"
      >
        {filteredProjects.slice(0, visibleCount).map((p) => (
          <DetailMobileProjectCard
            key={p.id || p.no}
            project={p}
            projectInfoMap={projectInfoMap}
            getProjectInfo={getProjectInfo}
            sortConfig={sortConfig}
            expandedCodes={expandedCodes}
            delegationGroups={delegationGroups}
            lowerSearchTerm={lowerSearchTerm}
            canWrite={canWrite}
            tasks={tasks}
            projects={projects}
            toggleGroup={toggleGroup}
            onEditProject={onEditProject}
            onAddTask={onAddTask}
            onEditTask={onEditTask}
            handleUpdateProject={handleUpdateProject}
            handleMoveTask={handleMoveTask}
            handleUpdateTask={handleUpdateTask}
            handleDeleteTask={handleDeleteTask}
            taskCodeMap={taskCodeMap}
            taskActualStatusMap={taskActualStatusMap}
            onSortSubTasks={onSortSubTasks}
            initialFocusTaskId={initialFocusTaskId}
          />
        ))}
        {visibleCount < filteredProjects.length && (
          <div className="py-6 flex justify-center w-full">
            <button 
              onClick={() => setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + 25, filteredProjects.length))}
              className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-full text-sm font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] shadow-sm hover:shadow hover:border-blue-300 dark:hover:border-blue-500 transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer touch-manipulation"
            >
              Load More Projects ({filteredProjects.length - visibleCount} remaining)
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
});

  visibleColumns: string[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  isAllTasksSelected: boolean;
  allowedStoreOptions: { label: string; value: string }[];
  allowedLocationOptions: string[];
  onToggleGroup: (id: string) => void;
  onSelectAllTasksInProject: (groupTasks: Task[], select: boolean) => void;
  onUpdateProject: (p: Project, field: keyof Project, value: any) => Promise<void>;
  onSortSubTasks: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[]) => void;
  onEditProject: (p: Project) => void;
  onAddTask: (p: Project) => void;
  onDeleteProject: (p: Project) => void;
}

export const DetailProjectRow = React.memo(function DetailProjectRow({
  item,
  visibleColumns,
  canWrite,
  isAllTasksSelected,
  allowedStoreOptions,
  allowedLocationOptions,
  onToggleGroup,
  onSelectAllTasksInProject,
  onUpdateProject,
  onSortSubTasks,
  onEditProject,
  onAddTask,
  onDeleteProject,
}: DetailProjectRowProps) {
  const p = item.project;
  const isExpanded = item.isExpanded;
  const groupTasks = item.groupTasks;
  const effectiveTaskCount = item.effectiveTaskCount;
  const isProjDelegationOn = item.isProjDelegationOn;
  const planProgressPercent = item.planProgressPercent;
  const actProgressPercent = item.actProgressPercent;

  const computedStart = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (groupTasks && groupTasks.length > 0) {
      let minStart: string | undefined = undefined;
      for (const t of groupTasks) {
        if (t.start && (!minStart || t.start < minStart)) minStart = t.start;
      }
      if (minStart) return minStart;
    }
    return p.computedTakStart || p.start;
  }, [groupTasks, p.computedTakStart, p.start]);

  const computedFinish = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (groupTasks && groupTasks.length > 0) {
      let maxFinish: string | undefined = undefined;
      for (const t of groupTasks) {
        if (t.finish && (!maxFinish || t.finish > maxFinish)) maxFinish = t.finish;
      }
      if (maxFinish) return maxFinish;
    }
    return p.computedTakCompl || p.handover || p.opening;
  }, [groupTasks, p.computedTakCompl, p.handover, p.opening]);

  const computedDuration = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!computedStart || !computedFinish) return '-';
    return calculateDays(computedStart, computedFinish);
  }, [computedStart, computedFinish]);

  const { isFlashed } = useIsRowFlashed(p.id);

  return (
    <tr
      id={`detail-project-${p.no ?? p.code}`}
      data-project-item="true"
      data-project-id={String(p.id || p.no || p.code)}
      data-project-code={p.code}
      data-project-year={p.year || ''}
      data-project-store={p.store || ''}
      className={cn(
        "table-row-optimized border-b-2 border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] transition-all duration-700",
        item.projectIndex % 2 === 0 ? "bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/80" : "bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-[#28282a]",
        isFlashed && "ring-2 ring-emerald-500/80 bg-emerald-50/90 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 z-10 shadow-sm"
      )}
    >
      {visibleColumns.includes('drag') && (

            <GripVertical size={14} />
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('checkbox') && (
        <td className="px-2 py-2 text-center select-none">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={isAllTasksSelected}
            onChange={(e) => onSelectAllTasksInProject(groupTasks, e.target.checked)}
            className="rounded text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 h-4 w-4 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border-slate-300 dark:border-[#444446]"
            title="Select all tasks in this project"
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('no') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f5f5f7]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onToggleGroup(String(p.id || p.code || p.no || ''));
              }}
              className={cn(
                "px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white transition-all shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer font-semibold active:scale-95 touch-manipulation text-xs",
                isExpanded
                  ? "bg-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-600"
                  : effectiveTaskCount > 0
                  ? "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500"
                  : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500"
              )}
              title={isExpanded ? "Collapse tasks" : `Expand tasks (${effectiveTaskCount})`}
            >

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { ResizableHeader } from '../ResizableHeader';
import { Project } from '../../types';

export interface DetailTableHeaderProps {
  columnsWithWidths?: Array<{ id: string; label: string; width?: number }>;
  sortConfig: { key: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' } | null;
  onSort: (key: string) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
  selectedTaskIds: Set<string>;
  allVisibleTaskIds: string[];
  onSelectAllVisibleTasks?: (select: boolean) => void;
  onResize: (col: string, width: number) => void;
  onResetWidth?: (col: string) => void;
  visibleColumns?: string[];
  colWidths?: Record<string, number>;
  expandedCodes?: string[];
  filteredProjects?: Project[];
  availableColumnsForUser?: { id: string; label: string }[];
  onToggleColumn?: (col: string) => void;
  onSelectAllChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  onToggleExpandAll?: () => void;
}

export const DetailTableHeader = memo(function DetailTableHeader({
  columnsWithWidths,
  visibleColumns,
  colWidths = {},
  canWrite,
  selectedTaskIds,
  allVisibleTaskIds,
  expandedCodes = [],
  sortConfig,
  onResize,
  onResetWidth: _onResetWidth,
  onToggleColumn,
  onSort,
  onSelectAllChange,
  onToggleExpandAll,
  onSelectAllVisibleTasks
}: DetailTableHeaderProps) {
  const isAllSelected = selectedTaskIds.size > 0 && selectedTaskIds.size === allVisibleTaskIds.length;
  const handleSelectAll = (checked: boolean) => {
    if (onSelectAllVisibleTasks) onSelectAllVisibleTasks(checked);
    if (onSelectAllChange) onSelectAllChange(checked);
  };

  // If columnsWithWidths is provided, render dynamically
  if (columnsWithWidths && columnsWithWidths.length > 0) {
    return (
      <thead className="sticky top-0 z-20 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] uppercase bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-xs">
        <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] sticky top-0 z-20">
          {columnsWithWidths.map((col) => {
            if (col.id === 'checkbox') {
              return (
                <th
                  key="checkbox"
                  style={{ width: col.width || 40 }}
                  className="px-2 py-3 text-center select-none bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]"
                >
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    title="Select All Visible Tasks"
                    onChange={(e) => handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
                    checked={isAllSelected}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 h-4 w-4 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500"
                  />
                </th>
              );
            }

            const isSortable = col.id === 'start' || col.id === 'finish';
            const isSorted = sortConfig?.key === col.id;

            return (
              <ResizableHeader
                key={col.id}
                width={col.width || 100}
                onResize={(w) => onResize(col.id, w)}
                className={`px-4 py-3 font-bold select-none text-left ${isSortable ? 'cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors' : ''}`}
                onClick={isSortable ? () => onSort(col.id) : undefined}
                hideable={!!onToggleColumn}
                onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn(col.id) : undefined}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  {col.id === 'no' && canWrite && !columnsWithWidths.some(c => c.id === 'checkbox') && (
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      title="Select All Visible Tasks"
                      onChange={(e) => handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
                      checked={isAllSelected}
                      className="cursor-pointer rounded border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 mr-1"
                    />
                  )}
                  <span>
                    {col.label}
                    {isSorted && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? ' ↑' : ' ↓')}
                  </span>
                  {col.id === 'no' && onToggleExpandAll && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={onToggleExpandAll}
                      className="p-0.5 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded transition-colors text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] cursor-pointer ml-1"
                    >
                      {expandedCodes.length === 0 ? <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {col.id === 'party' && (
                    <div className="ml-1 inline-flex items-center">
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] normal-case leading-none mr-1">deleg</span>
                      <div className="relative inline-flex h-3 w-5 items-center rounded-full bg-green-500">
                        <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 transform translate-x-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </ResizableHeader>
            );
          })}
        </tr>
      </thead>
    );
  }

  // Fallback to visibleColumns rendering
  const visCols = visibleColumns || [];
  return (
    <thead className="sticky top-0 z-20 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] uppercase bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-xs">
      <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] sticky top-0 z-20">
        {visCols.includes('checkbox') && (
          <th className="px-2 py-3 w-10 text-center select-none bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
            <input 
              type="checkbox" 
              title="Select All Visible Tasks"
              onChange={(e) => handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
              checked={isAllSelected}
              className="cursor-pointer rounded border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 h-4 w-4 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500"

            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
              {canWrite && !visCols.includes('checkbox') && (
                <input 
                  type="checkbox" 
                  title="Select All Visible Tasks"
                  onChange={(e) => handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
                  checked={isAllSelected}
                  className="cursor-pointer rounded border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 mr-1"
                />
              )}
              No.
              {onToggleExpandAll && (
                <button 
                  type="button"

                  className="p-0.5 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded transition-colors text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] cursor-pointer"

import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, memo } from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { DetailTableRow, SortConfig } from './detailTypes';
import { DetailTableHeader } from './DetailTableHeader';
import { DetailProjectRow } from './DetailProjectRow';
import { DetailTaskRow } from './DetailTaskRow';

export interface DetailTableViewProps {
  tableContainerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  handleTableScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
  totalTableWidth: number;
  effectiveVisibleColumns: string[];
  colWidths: Record<string, number>;
  canWrite: boolean;
  selectedTaskIds: Set<string>;
  allVisibleTaskIds: string[];
  expandedCodes: string[];
  setExpandedCodes: (codes: string[]) => void;
  filteredProjects: Project[];
  availableColumnsForUser: { id: string; label: string }[];
  sortConfig: SortConfig | null;
  onResize: (col: string, newWidth: number) => void;
  onToggleColumn: (colId: string) => void;
  onSort: (key: string) => void;
  setSelectedTaskIds: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Set<string>>>;
  paddingTop: number;
  paddingBottom: number;
  flatTableRows: DetailTableRow[];
  startIndex: number;
  endIndex: number;
  allowedStoreOptions: { label: string; value: string }[];
  allowedLocationOptions: string[];
  toggleGroup: (id: string) => void;
  handleSelectAllTasksInProject: (groupTasks: Task[], isSelected: boolean) => void;
  handleUpdateProject: (p: Project, field: keyof Project, val: any) => Promise<void>;
  handleSortSubTasks: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[]) => void;
  onEditProject?: (p: Project, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  onAddTask: (p?: Project | null) => void;
  handleDeleteProject: (p: Project) => Promise<void>;
  taskActualStatusMap: Map<string, { label: string; color: string }>;
  taskCodeMap: Map<string, string>;
  childTasksCountMap?: Map<string, number>;
  draggingTaskIds: string[];
  dragOverTaskId: string | null;
  dropPosition: 'before' | 'after' | null;
  draggingTaskNames: string;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  handleToggleSelectTask: (taskId: string, shiftKey: boolean) => void;
  onEditTask: (t: Task, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  handleUpdateTask: (t: Task, updates: Partial<Task>, options?: { skipPredecessorRecalc?: boolean; skipProjectRollup?: boolean }) => Promise<void>;
  handleMoveTask: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[], index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => Promise<void>;
  handleDeleteTask: (t: Task) => Promise<void>;
  handleDetailTaskDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  handleDetailTaskDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  handleDetailTaskDragLeave: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  handleDetailTaskDragEnd: (e: React.DragEvent) => void;
  handleDetailTaskDrop: (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, targetProject: Project) => Promise<void>;
  visibleCount: number;
  setVisibleCount: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
}

export const DetailTableView = memo(function DetailTableView({
  tableContainerRef,
  handleTableScroll,
  totalTableWidth,
  effectiveVisibleColumns,
  colWidths,
  canWrite,
  selectedTaskIds,
  allVisibleTaskIds,
  expandedCodes,
  setExpandedCodes,
  filteredProjects,
  availableColumnsForUser,
  sortConfig,
  onResize,
  onToggleColumn,
  onSort,
  setSelectedTaskIds,
  paddingTop,
  paddingBottom,
  flatTableRows,
  startIndex,
  endIndex,
  allowedStoreOptions,
  allowedLocationOptions,
  toggleGroup,
  handleSelectAllTasksInProject,
  handleUpdateProject,
  handleSortSubTasks,
  onEditProject,
  onAddTask,
  handleDeleteProject,
  taskActualStatusMap,
  taskCodeMap,
  childTasksCountMap,
  draggingTaskIds,
  dragOverTaskId,
  dropPosition,
  draggingTaskNames,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  tasks,
  projects,
  handleToggleSelectTask,
  onEditTask,
  handleUpdateTask,
  handleMoveTask,
  handleDeleteTask,
  handleDetailTaskDragStart,
  handleDetailTaskDragOver,
  handleDetailTaskDragLeave,
  handleDetailTaskDragEnd,
  handleDetailTaskDrop,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount
}: DetailTableViewProps) {
  return (
    <div className="hidden xl:block flex-grow pb-16">
      <div 
        ref={tableContainerRef}
        onScroll={handleTableScroll}
        className="overflow-auto border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-xs bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]"
        style={{ height: "calc(100vh - 210px)", minHeight: "520px" }}
      >
        <table 
          className="text-sm text-left text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] table-fixed min-w-full"
          style={{ width: `${totalTableWidth}px` }}
        >
          <DetailTableHeader
            visibleColumns={effectiveVisibleColumns}
            colWidths={colWidths}
            canWrite={canWrite}
            selectedTaskIds={selectedTaskIds}
            allVisibleTaskIds={allVisibleTaskIds}
            expandedCodes={expandedCodes}
            filteredProjects={filteredProjects}
            availableColumnsForUser={availableColumnsForUser}
            sortConfig={sortConfig}
            onResize={onResize}
            onToggleColumn={onToggleColumn}
            onSort={onSort}
            onSelectAllChange={(checked) => {
              if (checked) {
                setSelectedTaskIds(new Set(allVisibleTaskIds));
              } else {
                setSelectedTaskIds(new Set());
              }
            }}
            onToggleExpandAll={() => setExpandedCodes(expandedCodes.length === 0 ? filteredProjects.map(p => String(p.id!)) : [])}
          />
          <tbody>
            {paddingTop > 0 && (
              <tr style={{ height: `${paddingTop}px` }}>
                <td colSpan={effectiveVisibleColumns.length} style={{ padding: 0, border: 'none' }} />
              </tr>
            )}
            {flatTableRows.slice(startIndex, endIndex).map((item) => {
              if (item.type === "project") {
                const groupTasks = item.groupTasks;
                const isAllTasksSelected = groupTasks.length > 0 && groupTasks.every(t => selectedTaskIds.has(t.id));
                return (
                  <DetailProjectRow
                    key={item.key}
                    item={item}
                    visibleColumns={effectiveVisibleColumns}
                    canWrite={canWrite}
                    isAllTasksSelected={isAllTasksSelected}
                    allowedStoreOptions={allowedStoreOptions}
                    allowedLocationOptions={allowedLocationOptions}
                    onToggleGroup={toggleGroup}
                    onSelectAllTasksInProject={handleSelectAllTasksInProject}
                    onUpdateProject={handleUpdateProject}
                    onSortSubTasks={handleSortSubTasks}
                    onEditProject={onEditProject || (() => {})}
                    onAddTask={onAddTask}
                    onDeleteProject={handleDeleteProject}
                  />
                );
              }
              const t = item.task;
              const actStatus = taskActualStatusMap.get(t.id) || { label: 'Pending', color: 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-600' };
              const childCount = (childTasksCountMap?.get(t.id) || 0) + (t.taskCodePhu && t.taskCodePhu !== t.id ? (childTasksCountMap?.get(t.taskCodePhu) || 0) : 0);
              return (
                <DetailTaskRow
                  key={item.key}
                  item={item}
                  visibleColumns={effectiveVisibleColumns}
                  canWrite={canWrite}
                  isSelected={selectedTaskIds.has(t.id)}
                  isDragging={draggingTaskIds.includes(t.id)}
                  isDragOver={dragOverTaskId === t.id}
                  dropPosition={dragOverTaskId === t.id ? dropPosition : null}
                  draggingTaskNames={draggingTaskNames}
                  taskCode={taskCodeMap.get(t.id) || ''}
                  isFocused={initialFocusTaskId === t.id}
                  delStatusText={actStatus.label}
                  delStatusColorClass={actStatus.color}
                  childTasksCount={childCount}
                  onToggleSelectTask={handleToggleSelectTask}
                  onEditTask={onEditTask}
                  onUpdateTask={handleUpdateTask}
                  onMoveTask={handleMoveTask}
                  onDeleteTask={handleDeleteTask}
                  onDragStart={handleDetailTaskDragStart}
                  onDragOver={handleDetailTaskDragOver}
                  onDragLeave={handleDetailTaskDragLeave}
                  onDragEnd={handleDetailTaskDragEnd}
                  onDrop={handleDetailTaskDrop}
                />
              );
            })}
            {paddingBottom > 0 && (
              <tr style={{ height: `${paddingBottom}px` }}>
                <td colSpan={effectiveVisibleColumns.length} style={{ padding: 0, border: 'none' }} />
              </tr>
            )}
            {visibleCount < filteredProjects.length && (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={effectiveVisibleColumns.length} className="py-4 text-center bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/90 backdrop-blur-sm border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + 30, filteredProjects.length))}
                    className="px-6 py-2 bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-full shadow-xs transition-colors text-sm cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
                  >
                    Load More Projects ({filteredProjects.length - visibleCount} remaining)
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

interface DetailTaskRowProps {
  item: DetailTableRow & { type: 'task' };
  visibleColumns: string[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  isSelected: boolean;
  isDragging: boolean;
  isDragOver: boolean;
  dropPosition: 'before' | 'after' | null;
  draggingTaskNames: string;
  taskCode: string;
  isFocused: boolean;
  delStatusText: string;
  delStatusColorClass: string;
  childTasksCount: number;
  tasks?: Task[];
  projects?: Project[];
  onToggleSelectTask: (id: string, shiftKey: boolean) => void;
  onEditTask: (t: Task) => void;
  onUpdateTask: (t: Task, updates: Partial<Task>) => Promise<void>;
  onMoveTask: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[], index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => Promise<void>;
  onDeleteTask: (t: Task) => void;
  onDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  onDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  onDragLeave: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  onDragEnd: (e: React.DragEvent) => void;
  onDrop: (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, targetProject: Project) => Promise<void>;
}

export const DetailTaskRow = React.memo(function DetailTaskRow({
  item,
  visibleColumns,
  canWrite,
  isSelected,
  isDragging,
  isDragOver,
  dropPosition,
  taskCode,
  isFocused,
  delStatusText,
  delStatusColorClass,
  childTasksCount = 0,
  tasks,
  projects,
  onToggleSelectTask,
  onEditTask,
  onUpdateTask,
  onMoveTask,
  onDeleteTask,
  onDragStart,
  onDragOver,
  onDragLeave,
  onDragEnd,
  onDrop,
}: DetailTaskRowProps) {
  const t = item.task;
  const p = item.project;
  const groupTasks = item.groupTasks;
  const i = item.taskIndex;
  const isChildTask = Boolean(t.parentTaskId);
  const { isFlashed, updatedBy } = useIsRowFlashed(t.id);

  return (
    <tr
      id={`detail-task-${t.id}`}
      data-task-item="true"
      data-task-id={t.id}
      data-project-code={t.projectCode}
      draggable={canWrite}
      onDragStart={(e) => onDragStart(e, t.id)}
      onDragOver={(e) => onDragOver(e, t.id)}
      onDragLeave={(e) => onDragLeave(e, t.id)}
      onDragEnd={onDragEnd}
      onDrop={(e) => onDrop(e, t, p)}
      className={cn(
        "table-row-optimized border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] transition-all duration-700 relative",
        item.taskIndex % 2 === 0 ? "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]" : "bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#252528]",
        isSelected && "bg-blue-50/80 dark:bg-blue-900/20",
        isDragging && "opacity-40",
        isFocused && "ring-2 ring-blue-500 z-10",
        isFlashed && "ring-2 ring-emerald-500/80 bg-emerald-50/80 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 z-10 shadow-sm"
      )}
    >
      {visibleColumns.includes('drag') && (
        <td className="px-2 py-2 text-center select-none w-8 text-slate-400">
          {canWrite && (
            <div className="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing flex justify-center items-center">
              <GripVertical size={14} />
            </div>
          )}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('checkbox') && (
        <td className="px-2 py-2 text-center select-none">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={isSelected}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const isShift = Boolean(
                (e.nativeEvent as MouseEvent)?.shiftKey ||
                (e as any).shiftKey ||
                (window.event as any)?.shiftKey
              );
              onToggleSelectTask(t.id, isShift);
            }}
            className="rounded text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 h-4 w-4 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border-slate-300 dark:border-[#444446] cursor-pointer"
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('no') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] text-xs font-mono">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pl-1">
            {canWrite && (
              <div className="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200">
                <GripVertical size={13} />
              </div>
            )}
            <span className="font-semibold">{i + 1}</span>
            {childTasksCount > 0 && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/90 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-200 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-600 shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-0.5 leading-none" title={`${childTasksCount} task con`}>
                ({childTasksCount})
              </span>
            )}
            {isChildTask && (
              <span className="text-[8.5px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 uppercase shrink-0 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 flex items-center gap-0.5 leading-none" title="Task con (Sub-task)">
                ↳ SUB
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('year') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] text-xs">
          {t.projectYear || p.year}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('store') && (
        <td className={cn(
          "px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold",
          (t.projectStore || p.store)?.toLowerCase() === 'hcm'
            ? "text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]"
            : (t.projectStore || p.store)?.toLowerCase() === 'hn'
            ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
            : "text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]"
        )}>

        </td>
