import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { usePerformanceStore } from '../store/usePerformanceStore';
import { matchesAdvancedSearch } from '../lib/utils';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { GlobalFleetMonitorView } from './GlobalFleetMonitorView';
import { FirestorePerformanceDashboardProps, CollectionStatItem } from './PerformanceDashboardParts/performanceTypes';
import { PerformanceHeader } from './PerformanceDashboardParts/PerformanceHeader';
import { PerformanceMetricsCards } from './PerformanceDashboardParts/PerformanceMetricsCards';
import { PerformanceCollectionTable } from './PerformanceDashboardParts/PerformanceCollectionTable';
import { PerformanceEventLogs } from './PerformanceDashboardParts/PerformanceEventLogs';

export function FirestorePerformanceDashboard({
  onClose,
}: FirestorePerformanceDashboardProps = {}) {
  const [activeViewMode, setActiveViewMode] = useState<'session' | 'fleet'>('session');
  const serverReads = usePerformanceStore((state) => state.serverReads);
  const cacheReads = usePerformanceStore((state) => state.cacheReads);
  const activeListeners = usePerformanceStore((state) => state.activeListeners);
  const sessionStartTime = usePerformanceStore((state) => state.sessionStartTime);
  const collectionStats = usePerformanceStore((state) => state.collectionStats);
  const events = usePerformanceStore((state) => state.events);
  const resetStats = usePerformanceStore((state) => state.resetStats);

  const setToast = useAppStore((state) => state.setToast);
  const currentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.currentUser);

  const deviceInfo = useMemo(() => {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;
    let browser = 'Unknown';
    if (ua.indexOf('Firefox') > -1) browser = 'Firefox';
    else if (ua.indexOf('SamsungBrowser') > -1) browser = 'Samsung Browser';
    else if (ua.indexOf('Opera') > -1 || ua.indexOf('OPR') > -1) browser = 'Opera';
    else if (ua.indexOf('Edge') > -1 || ua.indexOf('Edg') > -1) browser = 'Edge';
    else if (ua.indexOf('Chrome') > -1) browser = 'Chrome';
    else if (ua.indexOf('Safari') > -1) browser = 'Safari';

    let os = 'Unknown OS';
    if (ua.indexOf('Win') > -1) os = 'Windows';
    else if (ua.indexOf('Mac') > -1) os = 'MacOS';
    else if (ua.indexOf('Linux') > -1) os = 'Linux';
    else if (ua.indexOf('Android') > -1) os = 'Android';
    else if (ua.indexOf('like Mac') > -1) os = 'iOS';

    return `${browser} on ${os}`;
  }, []);

  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState<'all' | 'server' | 'cache'>('all');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sessionDuration, setSessionDuration] = useState('0m 0s');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!onClose) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  // Live timer for session duration
  useEffect(() => {
    const updateTimer = () => {
      const elapsedSec = Math.floor((Date.now() - sessionStartTime) / 1000);
      const m = Math.floor(elapsedSec / 60);
      const s = elapsedSec % 60;
      setSessionDuration(`${m}m ${s}s`);
    };
    updateTimer();
    const interval = setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [sessionStartTime]);

  const totalOps = serverReads + cacheReads;
  const cacheEfficiency =
    totalOps > 0 ? ((cacheReads / totalOps) * 100).toFixed(1) : '100.0';

  // Filtered Events
  const filteredEvents = useMemo(() => {
    return events.filter((ev) => {
      if (filterType === 'server' && ev.fromCache) return false;
      if (filterType === 'cache' && !ev.fromCache) return false;
      if (
        searchTerm &&
        !matchesAdvancedSearch(searchTerm, [ev.collection, ev.type, ev.details, ev.id])
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [events, filterType, searchTerm]);

  // Query health assessment
  const collectionsArray: CollectionStatItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.entries(collectionStats).map(([name, stat]) => ({
      name,
      ...stat,
      efficiency:
        stat.serverReads + stat.cacheReads > 0
          ? ((stat.cacheReads / (stat.serverReads + stat.cacheReads)) * 100).toFixed(1)
          : '100.0',
    }));
  }, [collectionStats]);

  const heavyCollections = useMemo(
    () => collectionsArray.filter((c) => c.serverReads > 500),
    [collectionsArray]
  );

  const handleCopySummary = () => {
    const report = `=== FIRESTORE PERFORMANCE SESSION REPORT ===
Session Duration: ${sessionDuration}
Billable Server Reads: ${serverReads.toLocaleString()}
Cache Saved Reads: ${cacheReads.toLocaleString()}
Cache Efficiency: ${cacheEfficiency}%
Active Listeners: ${activeListeners}

Collection Breakdown:
${collectionsArray
  .map(
    (c) =>
      `- ${c.name}: Server ${c.serverReads} | Cache ${c.cacheReads} | Listeners ${c.activeListeners} | Eff: ${c.efficiency}%`
  )
  .join('\n')}
=============================================`;

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(report);
    setCopied(true);
    setToast({
      title: 'Copied!',
      message: 'Firestore session report copied to clipboard.',
    });
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleExportJson = () => {
    const data = {
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      sessionDuration,
      serverReads,
      cacheReads,
      cacheEfficiency: `${cacheEfficiency}%`,
      activeListeners,
      collectionStats,
      recentEvents: events,
    };
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], {
      type: 'application/json',
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `firestore-performance-${new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10)}.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div
      id="firestore-performance-dashboard"
      className="flex flex-col gap-5 p-5 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#18181b]/50 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46]"
    >
      <PerformanceHeader
        activeViewMode={activeViewMode}
        setActiveViewMode={setActiveViewMode}
        copied={copied}
        onCopySummary={handleCopySummary}
        onExportJson={handleExportJson}
        onResetStats={resetStats}
        onClose={onClose}
      />

      {activeViewMode === 'fleet' ? (
        <GlobalFleetMonitorView />
      ) : (
        <>
          <PerformanceMetricsCards
            serverReads={serverReads}
            cacheReads={cacheReads}
            cacheEfficiency={cacheEfficiency}
            activeListeners={activeListeners}
            sessionDuration={sessionDuration}
            heavyCollections={heavyCollections}
          />

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4">
            <PerformanceCollectionTable collectionsArray={collectionsArray} />
            <PerformanceEventLogs
              currentUserInfo={currentUser?.username || currentUser?.id || 'Anonymous'}
              deviceInfo={deviceInfo}
              filterType={filterType}
              setFilterType={setFilterType}
              searchTerm={searchTerm}
              setSearchTerm={setSearchTerm}
              filteredEvents={filteredEvents}
              totalEventCount={events.length}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default FirestorePerformanceDashboard;


=== FILE: src/components/FullReplaceImport.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { Upload, X, ShieldAlert, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {  db, APP_ID , writeBatch } from "../lib/firebase";
import { collection, getDocs, doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { parseCSV } from '../lib/csvUtils';
import { markRestoreVersionCompleted } from '../lib/deltaSyncService';

interface FullReplaceImportProps {
  collectionName: string;
  onImportSuccess: (count: number) => void;
  title?: string;
  onParseRow: (row: string[], headers: string[], rowIndex: number) => any;
  headersOrder?: string[];
  id?: string; hiddenBtn?: boolean;
  onRecordSave?: (record: any, batch: import('firebase/firestore').WriteBatch) => void;
}

export function FullReplaceImport({ 
  collectionName, onImportSuccess, title, onParseRow, id, hiddenBtn = false, onRecordSave}: FullReplaceImportProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const nodeRef = React.useRef(null);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const ADMIN_PWD = '1641985';

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleImport = async () => {
    if (password !== ADMIN_PWD) {
      setError('Incorrect password');
      return;
    }
    if (!file) {
      setError('Please select a CSV file');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      const text = await file.text();
      const rows = parseCSV(text);
      if (rows.length < 2) {
        throw new Error('CSV file is empty or has no data');
      }

      const headers = rows[0].map(h => h.trim().toLowerCase());
      const dataRows = rows.slice(1);

      // Pre-validation to ensure required fields
      const parsedDataList: any[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < dataRows.length; i++) {
        const row = dataRows[i];
        if (row.every(cell => !String(cell).trim())) continue; // Skip completely empty rows
        
        const data = onParseRow(row, headers, i);
        if (!data) continue;

        const codeVal = data.code || data.projectCode;
        const yearVal = data.year || data.projectYear;
        const storeVal = data.store || data.projectStore;

        if (!String(codeVal || '').trim() || !String(yearVal || '').trim() || !String(storeVal || '').trim()) {
           throw new Error(`Row ${i + 2} is missing required data. All imported records must have Year, Store, and Project Code.`);
        }
        
        parsedDataList.push(data);
      }

      if (parsedDataList.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('No valid data found to import.');
      }

      // 1. Clear existing collection
      const collRef = collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', collectionName);
      const snapshot = await getDocs(collRef);
      
      const deleteBatches = [];
      let currentDeleteBatch = writeBatch(db);
      let deleteCount = 0;

      for (const d of snapshot.docs) {
        currentDeleteBatch.delete(d.ref);
        deleteCount++;
        if (deleteCount === 500) {
          deleteBatches.push(currentDeleteBatch.commit());
          currentDeleteBatch = writeBatch(db);
          deleteCount = 0;
        }
      }
      if (deleteCount > 0) {
        deleteBatches.push(currentDeleteBatch.commit());
      }
      await Promise.all(deleteBatches);

      // 2. Import new data
      const writeBatches = [];
      let currentWriteBatch = writeBatch(db);
      let writeCount = 0;
      let totalImported = 0;

      for (const data of parsedDataList) {
        // Ensure ID
        let finalId = data.id;
        if (!finalId && data.no && !isNaN(Number(data.no))) {
          finalId = String(data.no);
        }
        if (!finalId) {
          finalId = `id_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
        }
        
        const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', collectionName, finalId);
        
        const recordToSave = { ...data, id: finalId, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        if (recordToSave.year !== undefined && recordToSave.year !== null && recordToSave.year !== '' && !isNaN(Number(recordToSave.year))) {
          recordToSave.year = Number(recordToSave.year);
        }
        if (recordToSave.projectYear !== undefined && recordToSave.projectYear !== null && recordToSave.projectYear !== '' && !isNaN(Number(recordToSave.projectYear))) {
          recordToSave.projectYear = Number(recordToSave.projectYear);
        }

        currentWriteBatch.set(docRef, recordToSave);
        if (onRecordSave) {
          onRecordSave(recordToSave, currentWriteBatch);
        }
        writeCount++;
        totalImported++;

        if (writeCount === 500) {
          writeBatches.push(currentWriteBatch.commit());
          currentWriteBatch = writeBatch(db);
          writeCount = 0;
        }
      }
      if (writeCount > 0) {
        writeBatches.push(currentWriteBatch.commit());
      }
      await Promise.all(writeBatches);

      // Lock out pre-restore historical deltas so future updates won't re-read or re-apply faulty changes
      markRestoreVersionCompleted(Date.now());

      onImportSuccess(totalImported);
      setIsOpen(false);
      setPassword('');
      setFile(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error during import');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) {
    return (
      <button id={id}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}
        className={hiddenBtn ? "hidden" : "p-2 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-100 transition-colors shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold"}
        title={`Full Replace ${title}`}
      >
        <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4" />
        Full Import
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <Draggable disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} handle=".modal-handle" bounds="parent" nodeRef={nodeRef} cancel="button">
        <div ref={nodeRef} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] animate-in fade-in zoom-in duration-200">
          <div className="modal-handle cursor-move bg-red-600 p-6 text-white flex justify-between items-center">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-6 h-6" />
            <h2 className="text-xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight">Full Replace: {title}</h2>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} className="hover:bg-red-700 p-1 rounded-full transition-colors">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-8 space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-100 p-4 rounded-xl text-red-800 text-sm leading-relaxed font-medium">
            <p><strong>Warning:</strong> This action will <span className="font-bold underline">DELETE ALL</span> existing records in the <span className="font-bold">"{collectionName}"</span> collection and replace them with data from your CSV file. This cannot be undone by normal means.</p>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">CSV File</label>
              <div className="relative group">
                <input 
                  type="file" 
                  accept=".csv"
                  onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
                  className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10"
                />
                <div className={`p-4 border-2 border-dashed rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-all ${file ? 'border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50' : 'border-slate-200 group-hover:border-blue-400 group-hover:bg-blue-50'}`}>
                  <Upload className={`w-8 h-8 mb-2 ${file ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-slate-400 group-hover:text-blue-500'}`} />
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 truncate max-w-full px-4">
                    {file ? file.name : "Choose CSV File"}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1 uppercase tracking-tight">Only .csv files allowed</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Admin Password</label>
              <input 
                type="password" 
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Enter password to authorize cleanup"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500 text-slate-900 shadow-inner"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-100 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg animate-pulse">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex gap-3 pt-2">
            <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
              className="flex-1 py-3 px-4 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-all active:scale-95"
              disabled={loading}
            >{t("Cancel")}</button>
            <button onClick={handleImport}
              disabled={loading || !file || !password}
              className="flex-1 py-3 px-4 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-red-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-all shadow-lg active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 group"
            >
              {loading ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
                  Processing...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 group-hover:animate-bounce" />
                  Execute Replace
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div></Draggable>
    </div>
  );
}


=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttBar.tsx ===
import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { cn, parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { positionTooltip, formatGanttDate } from './GanttUtils';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { GanttBarTooltip } from './GanttBarTooltip';
import { useGanttBarDateDrag } from './useGanttBarDateDrag';

export interface GanttBarProps {
  startStr: string | undefined;
  endStr: string | undefined;
  status: string;
  label: string;
  id: string;
  extraVars?: {
    actStatus?: string;
    actStatusColor?: string;
    party?: string;
    actPrg?: number;
    duration?: string | number;
    taskCode?: string;
    predecessors?: string;
    highlight?: 'assignee' | 'creator' | null;
    isSimulation?: boolean;
    hasChildren?: boolean;
    childCount?: number;
    task?: Task;
    tasks?: Task[];
    projects?: Project[];
    canWrite?: boolean;
    onProcessChildTasks?: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      taskCode?: string;
      actPrg?: number;
      start?: string;
      finish?: string;
      duration?: string | number;
    }>;
  };
  startDate: Date;
  dayWidth: number;
  activeTooltip: string | null;
  setActiveTooltip: (id: string | null) => void;
  isEditMode: boolean;
  getBarColor: (status: string, duration?: string | number) => string;
  onBarClick?: (ev: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  onUpdateTaskDates?: (taskId: string, newStart: string, newFinish: string) => Promise<void> | void;
}

export const getExactDays = (d1: Date, d2: Date) => {
  return (d2.getTime() - d1.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
};

export const GanttBar = React.memo(function GanttBar({
  startStr,
  endStr,
  status,
  label,
  id,
  extraVars,
  startDate,
  dayWidth,
  activeTooltip,
  setActiveTooltip,
  isEditMode,
  getBarColor,
  onBarClick,
  onUpdateTaskDates,
}: GanttBarProps) {
  const isSimulation = !!extraVars?.isSimulation;
  const isTask = id.startsWith('task-') || id.startsWith('sim-task-');
  const rawTaskId = id.startsWith('task-') ? id.replace('task-', '') : id;

  const dStartInitial = parseDateTime(startStr);
  const dEndInitial = parseDateTime(endStr);
  const isMilestone = Number(extraVars?.duration) === 0 ||
                      (dStartInitial && dEndInitial && Math.abs(dStartInitial.getTime() - dEndInitial.getTime()) < 3600000) ||
                      (label.toLowerCase().includes('opening') && Number(extraVars?.duration || 0) <= 1);

  const {
    isDraggingDate,
    deltaDays,
    previewStart,
    previewEnd,
    handleBarDragStart,
    handleLeftResizeStart,
    handleRightResizeStart,
  } = useGanttBarDateDrag({
    taskId: rawTaskId,
    startStr: startStr || '',
    endStr: endStr || '',
    dayWidth,
    isEditMode: isEditMode && isTask && !isMilestone,
    onUpdateTaskDates,
  });

  const activeStart = isDraggingDate ? previewStart : startStr;
  const activeEnd = isDraggingDate ? previewEnd : endStr;
  const dStart = parseDateTime(activeStart);
  const dEnd = parseDateTime(activeEnd);

  const customColor = extraVars?.task?.textColor;
  
  const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);
  const [isDismissed, setIsDismissed] = useState(false);
  const [isEditingPredecessor, setIsEditingPredecessor] = useState(false);
  const tooltipRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const lastMousePos = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const moveRafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const isDraggingTooltipRef = useRef(false);
  const dragStartPos = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const tooltipStartPos = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const hoverTimeoutRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const handleBarMouseEnter = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (hoverTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(hoverTimeoutRef.current);
      hoverTimeoutRef.current = null;
    }
    setIsDismissed(false);
    lastMousePos.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    setIsHovered(true);
  };

  const handleBarMouseLeave = () => {
    hoverTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setIsHovered(false);
      setIsDismissed(false);
    }, 200);
  };

  const handleTooltipMouseEnter = () => {
    if (hoverTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(hoverTimeoutRef.current);
      hoverTimeoutRef.current = null;
    }
    setIsHovered(true);
  };

  const handleTooltipMouseLeave = () => {
    hoverTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setIsHovered(false);
      setIsDismissed(false);
    }, 150);
  };

  const handleCloseTooltip = React.useCallback(() => {
    setIsDismissed(true);
    setIsHovered(false);
    setActiveTooltip(null);
    setIsEditingPredecessor(false);
  }, [setActiveTooltip]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (hoverTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(hoverTimeoutRef.current);
      }
      if (moveRafRef.current !== null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(moveRafRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const isPinned = activeTooltip === id || isEditingPredecessor;

  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!tooltipRef.current) return;
    isDraggingTooltipRef.current = true;
    (e.target as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
    dragStartPos.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    const rect = tooltipRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    tooltipStartPos.current = { x: rect.left, y: rect.top };
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!isDraggingTooltipRef.current || !tooltipRef.current) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - dragStartPos.current.x;
    const dy = e.clientY - dragStartPos.current.y;
    const newX = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 100, tooltipStartPos.current.x + dx));
    const newY = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 80, tooltipStartPos.current.y + dy));
    tooltipRef.current.style.left = `${newX}px`;
    tooltipRef.current.style.top = `${newY}px`;
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    isDraggingTooltipRef.current = false;
    try {
      (e.target as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
    } catch {}
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if ((isHovered || isPinned) && tooltipRef.current && !isDraggingTooltipRef.current) {
      positionTooltip(tooltipRef.current, lastMousePos.current.x, lastMousePos.current.y);
    }
  }, [isHovered, isPinned]);

  if (!dStart || !dEnd) {
    return null;
  }

  const offsetDays = getExactDays(startDate, dStart);
  const durationDays = Math.max(getExactDays(dStart, dEnd) + 1, 1);
  const leftPx = offsetDays * dayWidth;
  const widthPx = isMilestone ? 16 : Math.max(durationDays * dayWidth, 8);

  const barColor = isMilestone 
    ? "bg-[#f97316] border border-[#ea580c]" 
    : getBarColor(status, extraVars?.duration);

  const actProgress = extraVars?.actPrg ?? 0;

  return (
    <>
      <div
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          lastMousePos.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
          if (onBarClick) {
            onBarClick(e);
          } else {
            setIsDismissed(false);
            const nextPinned = activeTooltip !== id;
            setActiveTooltip(nextPinned ? id : null);
            if (nextPinned && tooltipRef.current) {
              positionTooltip(tooltipRef.current, e.clientX, e.clientY);
            }
          }
        }}
        onMouseEnter={handleBarMouseEnter}
        onMouseMove={(e) => {
          if (!isPinned && !isDraggingTooltipRef.current) {
            const clientX = e.clientX;
            const clientY = e.clientY;
            lastMousePos.current = { x: clientX, y: clientY };
            if (moveRafRef.current === null) {
              moveRafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                if (tooltipRef.current) {
                  positionTooltip(tooltipRef.current, lastMousePos.current.x, lastMousePos.current.y);
                }
                moveRafRef.current = null;
              });
            }
          }
        }}
        onMouseLeave={handleBarMouseLeave}
        className={cn(
          "absolute top-1.5 bottom-1.5 flex items-center transition-all cursor-pointer select-none group shadow-2xs before:absolute before:-inset-y-1.5 before:-inset-x-1 before:content-['']",
          isMilestone ? "w-4 h-4 rotate-45 rounded-[2px] mt-1.5 shadow-md z-20" : "h-6 rounded-md",
          !customColor && barColor,
          isSimulation && "border-2 border-dashed border-purple-400 opacity-80",
          extraVars?.highlight === 'assignee' && "ring-2 ring-emerald-400 ring-offset-1",
          extraVars?.highlight === 'creator' && "ring-2 ring-blue-400 ring-offset-1",
          isPinned && "ring-2 ring-blue-500 shadow-md",
          isHovered && "brightness-110 shadow-md scale-[1.01]"
        )}
        style={{
          left: `${leftPx}px`,
          width: `${widthPx}px`,
          zIndex: isPinned ? 30 : isHovered ? 20 : 10,
          ...(customColor && !isMilestone ? { backgroundColor: customColor, borderColor: customColor } : {})
        }}
      >
        {/* Left Resize Handle for Start Date */}
        {isEditMode && isTask && !isMilestone && (
          <div
            onPointerDown={handleLeftResizeStart}
            className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-2.5 cursor-w-resize hover:bg-white/40 active:bg-white/60 z-30 rounded-l-md flex items-center justify-center transition-colors group/hleft"
            title="Drag to resize Start Date"
          >
            <div className="w-0.5 h-3 bg-white/70 rounded-full" />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Center Move Handle for Shifting entire bar */}
        {isEditMode && isTask && !isMilestone && (
          <div
            onPointerDown={handleBarDragStart}
            className="absolute inset-x-2.5 top-0 bottom-0 cursor-move z-20"
            title="Drag bar to shift task dates"
          />
        )}

        {/* Right Resize Handle for Finish Date */}
        {isEditMode && isTask && !isMilestone && (
          <div
            onPointerDown={handleRightResizeStart}
            className="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-2.5 cursor-e-resize hover:bg-white/40 active:bg-white/60 z-30 rounded-r-md flex items-center justify-center transition-colors group/hright"
            title="Drag to resize Finish Date"
          >
            <div className="w-0.5 h-3 bg-white/70 rounded-full" />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Actual Progress Fill */}
        {!isMilestone && actProgress > 0 && (
          <div
            className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 bg-black/20 dark:bg-white/20 rounded-l-md pointer-events-none transition-all duration-300"
            style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, actProgress)}%` }}
          />
        )}

        {/* Bar Label text */}
        {!isMilestone && widthPx > 30 && (
          <div className="px-2 w-full flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-white drop-shadow-xs truncate pointer-events-none">
            <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
            {actProgress > 0 && widthPx > 70 && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono opacity-90 pl-1">{actProgress}%</span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Floating Date Drag Indicator Badge */}
      {isDraggingDate && (
        <div className="fixed top-14 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[99999] pointer-events-none bg-slate-900/95 text-white font-mono text-xs px-4 py-2 rounded-full shadow-2xl border border-blue-400 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center gap-2.5 animate-in fade-in">
          <span className="text-blue-300 font-bold">{label}:</span>
          <span>{formatGanttDate(previewStart)} ➔ {formatGanttDate(previewEnd)}</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] bg-blue-600 text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
            {deltaDays >= 0 ? `+${deltaDays}d` : `${deltaDays}d`}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Floating Tooltip via Portal */}
      {!isDismissed && (isHovered || isPinned) && (
        <GanttBarTooltip
          id={id}
          label={label}
          startStr={startStr}
          endStr={endStr}
          status={status}
          extraVars={extraVars}
          isPinned={isPinned}
          isEditingPredecessor={isEditingPredecessor}
          setIsEditingPredecessor={setIsEditingPredecessor}
          setActiveTooltip={setActiveTooltip}
          tooltipRef={tooltipRef}
          handlePointerDown={handlePointerDown}
          handlePointerMove={handlePointerMove}
          handlePointerUp={handlePointerUp}
          onMouseEnter={handleTooltipMouseEnter}
          onMouseLeave={handleTooltipMouseLeave}
          onClose={handleCloseTooltip}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
});


=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttBarTooltip.tsx ===
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useLayoutEffect } from "react";
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { X, GripHorizontal, Pin, ExternalLink, ChevronDown, Target } from 'lucide-react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { formatGanttDate, ensureTooltipInViewport } from './GanttUtils';
import { GanttTooltipPredecessor } from './GanttTooltipPredecessor';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface GanttBarTooltipProps {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  startStr?: string;
  endStr?: string;
  status: string;
  extraVars?: {
    actStatus?: string;
    actStatusColor?: string;
    party?: string;
    actPrg?: number;
    duration?: string | number;
    taskCode?: string;
    predecessors?: string;
    highlight?: 'assignee' | 'creator' | null;
    isSimulation?: boolean;
    hasChildren?: boolean;
    childCount?: number;
    task?: Task;
    tasks?: Task[];
    projects?: Project[];
    canWrite?: boolean;
    onNavigateToTaskDetail?: (taskId: string) => void;
    onProcessChildTasks?: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      taskCode?: string;
      actPrg?: number;
      start?: string;
      finish?: string;
      duration?: string | number;
    }>;
  };
  isPinned: boolean;
  isEditingPredecessor: boolean;
  setIsEditingPredecessor: (val: boolean) => void;
  setActiveTooltip: (id: string | null) => void;
  tooltipRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  handlePointerDown: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
  handlePointerMove: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
  handlePointerUp: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
  onMouseEnter?: () => void;
  onMouseLeave?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

export function GanttBarTooltip({
  id,
  label,
  startStr,
  endStr,
  status,
  extraVars,
  isPinned,
  isEditingPredecessor,
  setIsEditingPredecessor,
  setActiveTooltip,
  tooltipRef,
  handlePointerDown,
  handlePointerMove,
  handlePointerUp,
  onMouseEnter,
  onMouseLeave,
  onClose
}: GanttBarTooltipProps) {
  const [isSubtasksOpen, setIsSubtasksOpen] = useState(true);

  const handleContainerPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (target.closest('button, input, select, textarea, a, [role="button"]')) {
      return;
    }
    handlePointerDown(e);
  };

  const rawTaskId = extraVars?.task?.id || (id.startsWith('task-') ? id.replace('task-', '') : id);

  // Tự động căn chỉnh vị trí Tooltip trên màn hình bất cứ khi nào kích thước tooltip thay đổi (vd: khi bật/tắt Edit Predecessor)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!tooltipRef.current) return;
    const el = tooltipRef.current;
    ensureTooltipInViewport(el);

    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
      const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          ensureTooltipInViewport(el);
        });
      });
      ro.observe(el);
      return () => ro.disconnect();
    }
  }, [tooltipRef, isEditingPredecessor]);

  return createPortal(
    <div
      ref={tooltipRef}
      onMouseEnter={onMouseEnter}
      onMouseLeave={onMouseLeave}
      onPointerDown={handleContainerPointerDown}
      onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
      onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
      onPointerCancel={handlePointerUp}
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (!isPinned) setActiveTooltip(id);
      }}
      className={`fixed z-[100000] bg-slate-900/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 text-white text-[11px] rounded-xl shadow-2xl p-2.5 w-64 sm:w-72 md:w-[340px] max-w-sm border backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-150 flex flex-col gap-1.5 max-h-[calc(100vh-20px)] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain ${
        isPinned ? 'ring-2 ring-blue-500 border-blue-400' : 'border-slate-700/80'
      }`}
      style={{
        left: 0,
        top: 0,
        transform: 'none',
        pointerEvents: 'auto',
        touchAction: 'none'
      }}
    >
      {/* Header with Title and Pin / Focus / Close Controls */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-700/60 pb-2.5 mb-2.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-slate-100 text-xs min-w-0 flex-1">
          <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing shrink-0" />
          {extraVars?.taskCode && (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 font-mono text-[10px] rounded border border-blue-500/30 font-bold shrink-0">
              {extraVars.taskCode}
            </span>
          )}
          <span className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-white" title={label}>{label}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
          {extraVars?.task?.id && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (extraVars?.onNavigateToTaskDetail) {
                  extraVars.onNavigateToTaskDetail(extraVars.task.id);
                }
              }}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Open in Task Detail"
            >
              <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setActiveTooltip(isPinned ? null : id);
            }}
            className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              isPinned ? 'text-blue-400 bg-blue-500/20 border border-blue-500/30' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800'
            }`}
            title={isPinned ? 'Unpin' : 'Pin tooltip'}
          >
            <Pin className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isPinned ? 'fill-current' : ''}`} />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              if (onClose) {
                onClose();
              } else {
                setActiveTooltip(null);
                setIsEditingPredecessor(false);
              }
            }}
            className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Close tooltip"
          >
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttBaseline.tsx ===
import React from 'react';
import { parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { getExactDays } from './GanttBar';

export interface GanttBaselineProps {
  startStr?: string;
  endStr?: string;
  baselineStart?: string;
  baselineFinish?: string;
  baseStart?: string;
  baseFinish?: string;
  type?: "project" | "task";
  startDate: Date;
  dayWidth: number;
}

export const GanttBaseline: React.FC<GanttBaselineProps> = React.memo(({ 
  startStr, 
  endStr, 
  baselineStart, 
  baselineFinish, 
  baseStart,
  baseFinish,
  startDate, 
  dayWidth 
}) => {
  const effectiveStart = baselineStart || baseStart || startStr;
  const effectiveEnd = baselineFinish || baseFinish || endStr;
  if (!effectiveStart || !effectiveEnd) return null;
  const s = parseDateTime(effectiveStart);
  const e = parseDateTime(effectiveEnd);
  if (!s || !e || isNaN(s.getTime()) || isNaN(e.getTime())) return null;

  const leftDays = getExactDays(startDate, s);
  const widthDays = Math.max(getExactDays(s, e) + 1, 1);

  const leftPx = leftDays * dayWidth;
  const widthPx = Math.max(widthDays * dayWidth, 6);

  return (
    <div
      className="absolute bottom-0.5 h-[5px] rounded-xs bg-amber-400 dark:bg-amber-400 border border-amber-600/90 dark:border-amber-500/90 shadow-[0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)] pointer-events-none z-[45] ring-1 ring-white/20 transition-all"
      style={{ left: `${leftPx}px`, width: `${widthPx}px` }}
      title={`Baseline Plan: ${effectiveStart} -> ${effectiveEnd}`}
    />
  );
}, (prev, next) => {
  const prevStart = prev.baselineStart || prev.baseStart || prev.startStr;
  const prevEnd = prev.baselineFinish || prev.baseFinish || prev.endStr;
  const nextStart = next.baselineStart || next.baseStart || next.startStr;
  const nextEnd = next.baselineFinish || next.baseFinish || next.endStr;
  return prevStart === nextStart &&
         prevEnd === nextEnd &&
         prev.dayWidth === next.dayWidth &&
         prev.startDate.getTime() === next.startDate.getTime();
});

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { DependencyLine } from './ganttTypes';

export interface GanttDependencyLinksProps {
  dependencyLines: DependencyLine[];
}

export const GanttDependencyLinks: React.FC<GanttDependencyLinksProps> = React.memo(({
  dependencyLines
}) => {
  const [hoveredLineId, setHoveredLineId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mousePos, setMousePos] = useState<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const mouseRafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (mouseRafRef.current !== null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(mouseRafRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  if (dependencyLines.length === 0) return null;

  const activeLine = dependencyLines.find(l => l.id === hoveredLineId);

  return (
    <>
      <svg className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-[15] overflow-visible print:hidden" width="100%" height="100%">
        <defs>
          <marker
            id="arrowhead-default"
            markerWidth="7"
            markerHeight="7"
            refX="6"
            refY="3.5"
            orient="auto"
          >
            <polygon points="0 0, 7 3.5, 0 7" fill="#2563eb" />
          </marker>
          <marker
            id="arrowhead-hover"
            markerWidth="8"
            markerHeight="8"
            refX="7"
            refY="4"
            orient="auto"
          >
            <polygon points="0 0, 8 4, 0 8" fill="#1d4ed8" />
          </marker>
          <filter id="gantt-dep-shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
            <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="1" floodColor="#000" floodOpacity="0.18" />
          </filter>
        </defs>

        {dependencyLines.map((line, idx) => {
          const lineKey = line.id || `dep-${idx}`;
          const isHovered = hoveredLineId === lineKey;

          return (
            <g key={lineKey}>
              {/* Invisible wider hit target for easy mouse hover */}
              <path
                d={line.d}
                fill="none"
                stroke="transparent"
                strokeWidth="12"
                className="cursor-pointer pointer-events-auto"
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  setHoveredLineId(lineKey);
                  setMousePos({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
                }}
                onMouseMove={(e) => {
                  const clientX = e.clientX;
                  const clientY = e.clientY;
                  if (mouseRafRef.current === null) {
                    mouseRafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                      setMousePos({ x: clientX, y: clientY });
                      mouseRafRef.current = null;
                    });
                  }
                }}
                onMouseLeave={() => {
                  if (mouseRafRef.current !== null) {
                    cancelAnimationFrame(mouseRafRef.current);
                    mouseRafRef.current = null;
                  }
                  setHoveredLineId(null);
                  setMousePos(null);
                }}
              />

              {/* Visible rendered path */}
              <path
                d={line.d}
                fill="none"
                stroke={isHovered ? "#1d4ed8" : (line.color || "#2563eb")}
                strokeWidth={isHovered ? "2.5" : "1.75"}
                strokeDasharray={line.isAnimated ? "4 2" : undefined}
                markerEnd={isHovered ? "url(#arrowhead-hover)" : "url(#arrowhead-default)"}
                filter="url(#gantt-dep-shadow)"
                className={`transition-all duration-150 ${isHovered ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-80 hover:opacity-100"}`}
              />
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </svg>

      {/* Floating Hover Tooltip */}
      {activeLine && mousePos && (
        <div
          className="fixed z-50 pointer-events-none bg-slate-900/95 dark:bg-slate-800/95 text-white text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-xl border border-slate-700 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center gap-2 transform -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-full mb-2 transition-opacity duration-150 font-sans"
          style={{ left: mousePos.x, top: mousePos.y - 8 }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-blue-300">
            <span className="font-mono bg-blue-900/60 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] text-blue-200 uppercase font-extrabold">
              {activeLine.fromTaskCode || 'Task'}
            </span>
            <span className="max-w-[140px] truncate text-slate-200">
              {activeLine.fromTaskName || 'Predecessor'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <span className="text-slate-400 font-bold">➔</span>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-emerald-300">
            <span className="font-mono bg-emerald-900/60 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] text-emerald-200 uppercase font-extrabold">
              {activeLine.toTaskCode || 'Task'}
            </span>
            <span className="max-w-[140px] truncate text-slate-200">
              {activeLine.toTaskName || 'Successor'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
});

GanttDependencyLinks.displayName = 'GanttDependencyLinks';

=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttHooks.ts ===
import React, { RefObject, useRef } from 'react';

export function useSyncScroll() {
  const topScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const mainScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const isSyncingTop = useRef(false);
  const isSyncingMain = useRef(false);

  const handleTopScroll = () => {
    if (isSyncingMain.current) {
      isSyncingMain.current = false;
      return;
    }
    if (mainScrollRef.current && topScrollRef.current) {
      isSyncingTop.current = true;
      mainScrollRef.current.scrollLeft = topScrollRef.current.scrollLeft;
    }
  };

  const handleMainScroll = () => {
    if (isSyncingTop.current) {
      isSyncingTop.current = false;
    } else {
      if (mainScrollRef.current && topScrollRef.current) {
        isSyncingMain.current = true;
        topScrollRef.current.scrollLeft = mainScrollRef.current.scrollLeft;
      }
    }
  };

  return {
    topScrollRef,
    mainScrollRef,
    handleTopScroll,
    handleMainScroll,
  };
}

  const startColWidth = colWidths?.start ?? 85;
  const finishColWidth = colWidths?.finish ?? 85;
  const partyColWidth = colWidths?.party ?? 80;
  const durationColWidth = colWidths?.duration ?? 60;
  const predecessorColWidth = colWidths?.predecessor ?? 90;

  return (
    <div
      className="sticky left-0 z-30 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282b] flex items-center border-r border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] shrink-0"
      style={{ width: `${sideWidth}px` }}
    >
      <div className="w-10 px-1 py-2 text-center border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0">
        {isEditMode ? (
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={isAllSelected}
            onChange={handleToggleSelectAll}
            className="rounded border-slate-300 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 w-3.5 h-3.5"
            title="Select All"
          />
        ) : (
          <span>#</span>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-[140px] px-2 py-1 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 truncate flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleToggleExpandAll}
            className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 active:scale-90 transition-all shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            title={isAllExpanded ? "Collapse All Projects" : "Expand All Projects"}
          >
            {isAllExpanded ? (
              <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold" />
            )}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleToggleExpandAllModular}
            disabled={!hasModularTasks}
            className={cn(
              "p-0.5 rounded shrink-0 active:scale-90 transition-all touch-manipulation cursor-pointer",
              !hasModularTasks
                ? "opacity-25 cursor-not-allowed bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600"
                : isAllModularExpanded
                ? "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white dark:bg-purple-600 dark:hover:bg-purple-500 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-purple-400/50"
                : "bg-purple-100 hover:bg-purple-200 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/60 dark:hover:bg-purple-900/90 dark:text-purple-200 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-600/70"

        >

          {handleToggleColumn && (

              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {

import React, { Dispatch, FC, SetStateAction, memo, useMemo } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { getStatus, computeActProgressPercent, computeActProgressFromSummaries } from '../../lib/utils';
import { formatGanttDate, renderGanttDateCell } from './GanttUtils';
import { GanttBar } from './GanttBar';
import { GanttBaseline } from './GanttBaseline';

export interface GanttProjectRowProps {
  p: Project;
  pIdx: number;
  projectTasks?: Task[];
  isExpanded: boolean;
  expandedModularTasks?: string[];
  setExpandedModularTasks?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  isEditMode?: boolean;
  canWrite?: boolean;
  selectedProjectSet?: Set<string>;
  selectedProjectIds?: string[];
  selectedTaskIds?: string[];
  selectedTaskSet?: Set<string>;
  setSelectedProjectIds?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  setSelectedTaskIds?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  toggleProject?: (id: string) => void;
  toggleProjectExpansion?: (id: string) => void;
  isResizingSide?: boolean;
  startResizingSide?: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  sideWidth: number;
  showStart?: boolean;
  startColWidth?: number;
  showFinish?: boolean;
  finishColWidth?: number;
  showParty?: boolean;
  partyColWidth?: number;
  showDuration?: boolean;
  durationColWidth?: number;
  showPredecessor?: boolean;
  predecessorColWidth?: number;
  timeUnits?: any[];
  delegationGroups?: any[];
  getRowVisibilityClass?: (id: string) => string;
  startDate: Date;
  dayWidth: number;
  activeTooltip: string | null;
  setActiveTooltip: (id: string | null) => void;
  getBarColor?: (status: string, duration?: string | number) => string;
  isHideMode?: boolean;
  toggleHideRow?: (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  handleTogglePin?: (p: any) => void | Promise<void>;
  onNavigateToLayout?: (
    store: string,
    location: string,
    projectCode?: string,
    sourceTaskId?: string,
  ) => void;
}

export const GanttProjectRow: React.FC<GanttProjectRowProps> = React.memo(({
  p, pIdx, projectTasks = [], isExpanded, expandedModularTasks = [], setExpandedModularTasks, isEditMode = false, canWrite = false,
  selectedProjectSet = new Set(), selectedProjectIds = [], selectedTaskIds = [], selectedTaskSet = new Set(), setSelectedProjectIds, setSelectedTaskIds,
  toggleProject, toggleProjectExpansion, isResizingSide = false, startResizingSide,
  sideWidth, showStart = false, startColWidth = 80, showFinish = false, finishColWidth = 80, showParty = false, partyColWidth = 70, showDuration = false, durationColWidth = 50, showPredecessor = false, predecessorColWidth = 90,
  timeUnits = [], delegationGroups = [], getRowVisibilityClass = () => '', startDate, dayWidth, activeTooltip, setActiveTooltip, getBarColor = () => 'bg-blue-500',
  isHideMode = false, toggleHideRow, handleTogglePin, onNavigateToLayout
}) => {
  const setQuickNavTarget = useAppStore(state => state.setQuickNavTarget);
  const handleToggle = toggleProjectExpansion || toggleProject;
  const pStart = p.computedTakStart || p.start;
  const pEnd = p.computedTakCompl || p.handover;

  let projectDuration = "-";
  if (pStart && pEnd) {
    const sD = new Date(pStart);
    const eD = new Date(pEnd);
    if (!isNaN(sD.getTime()) && !isNaN(eD.getTime())) {
      const days = Math.round((eD.getTime() - sD.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      projectDuration = String(days);
    }
  }

  const baseStatus = p.computedStatus || getStatus(pStart, pEnd, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
  const pActPrg = projectTasks && projectTasks.length > 0
    ? computeActProgressPercent(projectTasks, delegationGroups)
    : (p.computedActProgress && p.computedActProgress > 0 
        ? p.computedActProgress 
        : (p.taskSummaries && p.taskSummaries.length > 0 ? computeActProgressFromSummaries(p.taskSummaries) : (p.computedActProgress ?? 0)));
  const effectiveProjectStatus = pActPrg >= 100 
    ? 'Completed' 
    : (p.computedActStatus && p.computedActStatus !== 'Planned' ? p.computedActStatus : baseStatus);
  const pStatus = effectiveProjectStatus;
  const summaryCount = (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries)) ? p.taskSummaries.length : (p.taskCount ?? 0);
  const projectDocCount = Math.max(p.taskCount ?? 0, summaryCount);
  const effectiveTaskCount = Math.max(projectTasks?.length || 0, projectDocCount);
  const canToggle = effectiveTaskCount > 0 || Boolean(p.id);

  const rowId = `project-${p.no}`;

  // Find modular parent tasks belonging to this project
  const projectModularParentIds = React.useMemo(() => {
    const childParentIds = new Set<string>();
    (projectTasks || []).forEach((t) => {
      if (t.parentTaskId) {
        childParentIds.add(String(t.parentTaskId));
      }
    });
    return (projectTasks || [])
      .filter((t) => childParentIds.has(String(t.id)))
      .map((t) => String(t.id));
  }, [projectTasks]);

  const hasModularTasks = projectModularParentIds.length > 0;
  const isProjectModularExpanded =
    hasModularTasks &&
    projectModularParentIds.some((id) => expandedModularTasks.includes(id));

  const handleToggleProjectModular = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!hasModularTasks) return;
    if (isProjectModularExpanded) {
      setExpandedModularTasks((prev) =>
        prev.filter((id) => !projectModularParentIds.includes(id))
      );
    } else {
      setExpandedModularTasks((prev) =>
        Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...projectModularParentIds]))
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      id={`gantt-project-row-${p.no}`}
      className={cn(
        "flex h-12 min-h-[48px] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] transition-colors relative group project-row",
        "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a]",
        getRowVisibilityClass(rowId)
      )}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "print-sticky-x sticky left-0 z-30 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] flex items-center shrink-0 overflow-hidden",
          "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] group-hover:bg-slate-50 dark:group-hover:bg-[#28282a]"
        )}
        style={{ width: sideWidth, minWidth: sideWidth, maxWidth: sideWidth }}
      >
        {/* Project Name Column */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 p-1.5 flex items-center overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 w-full relative min-w-0">
            {isEditMode && (() => {
              const pKey = String(p.id || p.no);
              const pCodeNorm = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
              const pYearNorm = p.year !== undefined && p.year !== null ? String(p.year).trim() : '';
              const pStoreNorm = p.store ? String(p.store).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
              const allStoreTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];

              // 1. Gather all tasks directly associated with this project
              const taskMap = new Map<string, Task>();
              (projectTasks || []).forEach(t => { if (t && t.id && !t.isDeleted) taskMap.set(t.id, t); });

              allStoreTasks.forEach(t => {
                if (!t || !t.id || t.isDeleted) return;
                if (p.id && String(t.projectId) === String(p.id)) {
                  taskMap.set(t.id, t);
                  return;
                }
                if (t.projectCode) {
                  const codes = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase().split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim());
                  if (codes.includes(pCodeNorm)) {
                    if (pYearNorm && t.projectYear && String(t.projectYear).trim() !== pYearNorm) return;
                    if (pStoreNorm && t.projectStore && String(t.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() !== pStoreNorm) return;
                    taskMap.set(t.id, t);
                  }
                }
              });

              // 2. Also include any subtasks whose parent belongs to this project
              const parentIdSet = new Set(Array.from(taskMap.keys()));
              const parentCodeSet = new Set(
                Array.from(taskMap.values())
                  .map(t => t.taskCodePhu ? String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() : '')
                  .filter(Boolean)
              );

              allStoreTasks.forEach(t => {
                if (!t || !t.id || t.isDeleted || taskMap.has(String(t.id))) return;
                const rawParent = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
                if (rawParent) {
                  const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
                  if (parentIdSet.has(String(rawParent)) || parentCodeSet.has(rawStr)) {
                    taskMap.set(String(t.id), t);
                  }
                }
              });

              const allProjectTasks = Array.from(taskMap.values());
              const pTaskIds = allProjectTasks.map(t => String(t.id)).filter(Boolean);
              const sTaskSet = selectedTaskSet || new Set((selectedTaskIds || []).map(String));
              const isAllTasksSelected = pTaskIds.length > 0 && pTaskIds.every(id => sTaskSet.has(id));
              const isSomeTasksSelected = !isAllTasksSelected && pTaskIds.some(id => sTaskSet.has(id));
              const isChecked = pTaskIds.length > 0 ? isAllTasksSelected : Boolean(selectedProjectSet?.has(pKey) || selectedProjectSet?.has(String(p.no)) || (p.id && selectedProjectSet?.has(String(p.id))));

              return (
                <label
                  className="flex items-center justify-center p-1 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                >
                  <input
                    ref={(el) => {
                      if (el) el.indeterminate = isSomeTasksSelected;
                    }}
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={isChecked}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      // If not all tasks are selected, clicking toggles ON to select all.
                      // If all tasks were already selected, clicking toggles OFF to deselect all.
                      const willCheck = !isAllTasksSelected;
                      const currentProjectIds = (selectedProjectIds || []).map(String);
                      const projectKeys = [pKey, String(p.id), String(p.no)].filter(Boolean).map(String);

                      if (willCheck) {
                        if (setSelectedProjectIds) {
                          setSelectedProjectIds(Array.from(new Set([...currentProjectIds, ...projectKeys])));
                        }
                        if (setSelectedTaskIds) {
                          setSelectedTaskIds((prev: any) => Array.from(new Set([...(prev || []).map(String), ...pTaskIds])));
                        }
                      } else {
                        if (setSelectedProjectIds) {
                          const removeSet = new Set(projectKeys);
                          setSelectedProjectIds(currentProjectIds.filter(id => !removeSet.has(id)));
                        }
                        if (setSelectedTaskIds) {
                          const pTaskSet = new Set(pTaskIds);
                          setSelectedTaskIds((prev: any) => (prev || []).map(String).filter((id: string) => !pTaskSet.has(id)));
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded border-slate-300 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 bg-white cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all touch-manipulation"
                  />
                </label>
              );
            })()}
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  if (canToggle && handleToggle) {
                    handleToggle(p.id!);
                  }
                }}
                disabled={!canToggle}
                className={cn(
                  "p-0.5 rounded shrink-0 active:scale-90 transition-all touch-manipulation",
                  !canToggle
                    ? "opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600"
                    : isExpanded
                    ? "text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] cursor-pointer"
                    : "text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] cursor-pointer"
                )}
                title={
                  !canToggle
                    ? "Project has no tasks"
                    : isExpanded
                    ? "Collapse this project"
                    : `Expand this project (${effectiveTaskCount} tasks)`
                }
              >
                {isExpanded ? (
                  <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 pointer-events-none" />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 pointer-events-none" />
                )}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleToggleProjectModular}
                disabled={!hasModularTasks}
                className={cn(
                  "p-0.5 rounded shrink-0 active:scale-90 transition-all touch-manipulation",
                  !hasModularTasks
                    ? "opacity-25 cursor-not-allowed bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600"
                    : isProjectModularExpanded
                    ? "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white dark:bg-purple-600 dark:hover:bg-purple-500 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-purple-400/50 cursor-pointer"
                    : "bg-purple-100 hover:bg-purple-200 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/60 dark:hover:bg-purple-900/90 dark:text-purple-200 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-600/70 cursor-pointer"
                )}
                title={
                  !hasModularTasks
                    ? "Project has no modular tasks"
                    : isProjectModularExpanded
                    ? "Collapse modular tasks of this project"
                    : "Expand modular tasks of this project"
                }
              >
                {isProjectModularExpanded ? (
                  <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 pointer-events-none" />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 pointer-events-none" />

              </button>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                if (isEditMode) return;
                e.stopPropagation();
                // Open Quick Nav when clicking project row
                setQuickNavTarget({
                  project: p,
                  task: undefined,
                  taskCode: p.code,
                });
              }}
              onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (handleToggle) handleToggle(p.id!);
              }}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1 flex-1 min-w-0 text-left hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] p-1 rounded transition-colors group/pname overflow-hidden",
                !isEditMode ? "cursor-pointer" : ""
              )}
              title={
                !isEditMode
                  ? `Quick Navigator - Project: ${p.name} (${p.code})`
                  : p.name
              }
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0 flex-1 justify-center gap-0.5 overflow-hidden">
                <span 
                  className={cn(

                    !isEditMode && "group-hover/pname:text-blue-500 dark:group-hover/pname:text-blue-400 transition-colors"
                  )} 
                  title={p.name}
                >
                  {p.name}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate font-mono flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap leading-none">
                  <span className="px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold font-mono rounded bg-[#142340] text-[#60a5fa] border border-[#1d4ed8] shrink-0 leading-none">
                    {p.code}
                  </span>
                  <span className="px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold rounded bg-[#142340] text-[#60a5fa] border border-[#1d4ed8] uppercase shrink-0 leading-none">
                    {p.store}
                  </span>
                  {p.location && (
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-medium leading-none">
                      • {p.location}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="text-amber-400 text-[9px] font-bold leading-none">●</span>
                </span>
              </div>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Extra Columns inside Side Container */}
        {showStart && (
          <div
            className="border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: startColWidth, minWidth: startColWidth, maxWidth: startColWidth }}
          >
            {renderGanttDateCell(pStart, "text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]")}
          </div>
        )}

        {showFinish && (
          <div
            className="border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: finishColWidth, minWidth: finishColWidth, maxWidth: finishColWidth }}
          >
            {renderGanttDateCell(pEnd, "text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-400")}
          </div>
        )}

        {showParty && (
          <div
            className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: partyColWidth, minWidth: partyColWidth, maxWidth: partyColWidth }}
          >
            {p.party || "-"}
          </div>
        )}

        {showDuration && (
          <div
            className="font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center font-bold shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: durationColWidth, minWidth: durationColWidth, maxWidth: durationColWidth }}
          >
            {projectDuration}
          </div>
        )}

        {showPredecessor && (
          <div
            className="font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: predecessorColWidth, minWidth: predecessorColWidth, maxWidth: predecessorColWidth }}
          >
            -
          </div>
        )}

        {startResizingSide && (
          <div
            className={cn(
              "absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1.5 cursor-col-resize hover:bg-blue-400 z-40 transition-colors pointer-events-auto",
              isResizingSide ? "bg-blue-500" : "bg-transparent group-hover/header:bg-slate-200 dark:group-hover/header:bg-slate-600"
            )}
            onMouseDown={startResizingSide}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Right Timeline Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 relative h-full flex items-center">
        <GanttBar
          startStr={pStart}
          endStr={pEnd}
          status={pStatus}
          label={p.name}
          id={rowId}
          extraVars={{ actPrg: pActPrg, duration: projectDuration }}
          startDate={startDate}
          dayWidth={dayWidth}
          activeTooltip={activeTooltip}
          setActiveTooltip={setActiveTooltip}
          isEditMode={isEditMode}
          getBarColor={getBarColor}
        />
        <GanttBaseline
          baselineStart={p.baselineStart || (p as any).baseStart}
          baselineFinish={p.baselineFinish || (p as any).baseFinish}
          startStr={p.computedTakStart || p.start}
          endStr={p.computedTakCompl || p.opening || p.handover}
          type="project"
          startDate={startDate}
          dayWidth={dayWidth}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}, (prev, next) => {
  const prevModularExpanded = prev.projectTasks?.some(t => prev.expandedModularTasks?.includes(String(t.id)));
  const nextModularExpanded = next.projectTasks?.some(t => next.expandedModularTasks?.includes(String(t.id)));
  if (prevModularExpanded !== nextModularExpanded) return false;

  const prevSelected = prev.selectedProjectSet ? prev.selectedProjectSet.has(String(prev.p.no)) : false;
  const nextSelected = next.selectedProjectSet ? next.selectedProjectSet.has(String(next.p.no)) : false;

  return prev.isExpanded === next.isExpanded &&
         prev.isEditMode === next.isEditMode &&
         prev.canWrite === next.canWrite &&
         prevSelected === nextSelected &&
         prev.sideWidth === next.sideWidth &&
         prev.startColWidth === next.startColWidth &&
         prev.finishColWidth === next.finishColWidth &&
         prev.partyColWidth === next.partyColWidth &&
         prev.durationColWidth === next.durationColWidth &&
         prev.showStart === next.showStart &&
         prev.showFinish === next.showFinish &&
         prev.showParty === next.showParty &&
         prev.showDuration === next.showDuration &&
         prev.showPredecessor === next.showPredecessor &&
         prev.predecessorColWidth === next.predecessorColWidth &&
         prev.timeUnits?.length === next.timeUnits?.length &&
         prev.p === next.p &&
         prev.projectTasks === next.projectTasks &&
         prev.startDate?.getTime() === next.startDate?.getTime() &&
         prev.dayWidth === next.dayWidth &&
         (prev.activeTooltip === `project-${prev.p.no}` || next.activeTooltip === `project-${next.p.no}` ? prev.activeTooltip === next.activeTooltip : true);
});

import React, { FC, memo } from 'react';
import { Calculator } from 'lucide-react';

export interface GanttSumBadgeProps {
  isEditMode?: boolean;
  sumMode?: 'none' | 'duration';
  selectedTaskCount?: number;
  selectedProjectCount?: number;
  computedSum?: number | null;
  sumDuration?: number | null;
}

export const GanttSumBadge: React.FC<GanttSumBadgeProps> = React.memo(({
  isEditMode = true,
  sumMode = 'duration',
  selectedTaskCount,
  selectedProjectCount,
  computedSum,
  sumDuration,
}) => {
  const finalSum = sumDuration !== undefined ? sumDuration : computedSum;
  if (finalSum === null || finalSum === undefined) {
    return null;
  }
  if (!isEditMode && sumDuration === undefined) {
    return null;
  }
  if (sumMode === 'none' && sumDuration === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[200] bg-slate-900 dark:bg-white text-white dark:text-slate-900 px-6 py-4 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-4">
      <div className="p-2 bg-emerald-500 rounded-full">
        <Calculator className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 font-medium">Calculated Sum</span>
        <span className="text-xl font-bold">
          {finalSum} Days
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

GanttSumBadge.displayName = 'GanttSumBadge';
