import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useMemo } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project, Task, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { TimeUnit, GanttTableRow as GanttRowType, DependencyLine } from './ganttTypes';
import { GanttColumnWidths } from './useGanttColumnResize';
import { GanttProjectRow } from './GanttProjectRow';
import { GanttTaskRow } from './GanttTaskRow';
import { GanttTimelineHeader } from './GanttTimelineHeader';
import { GanttGridOverlay } from './GanttGridOverlay';
import { GanttTodayLine } from './GanttTodayLine';
import { GanttDependencyLinks } from './GanttDependencyLinks';
import { GanttSumBadge } from './GanttSumBadge';
import { GanttExportOverlay } from './GanttExportOverlay';
import { GanttEmptyState } from './GanttEmptyState';
import { GanttLeftHeader } from './GanttLeftHeader';
import { computeAllTaskCodes } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { useGanttZoomAndPan } from './useGanttZoomAndPan';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { safeSetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';

interface GanttTableViewProps {
  tableContainerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  mainScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  topScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  handleCombinedMainScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
  handleTopScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
  flatGanttRows?: GanttRowType[];
  visibleGanttRows: GanttRowType[];
  paddingTop: number;
  paddingBottom: number;
  totalDays: number;
  dayWidth: number;
  sideWidth: number;
  setSideWidth: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
  startResizingSide: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  colWidths?: GanttColumnWidths;
  startResizingColumn?: (colKey: keyof GanttColumnWidths, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  timeUnits: TimeUnit[];
  startDate: Date;
  customToday: Date;
  setCustomToday: (d: Date) => void;
  isDraggingToday: boolean;
  setIsDraggingToday: (v: boolean) => void;
  getDateFromOffsetPx: (offsetPx: number) => Date;
  activeTooltip: string | null;
  setActiveTooltip: (id: string | null) => void;
  getBarColor: (status: string, duration?: string | number) => string;
  visibleColumns: string[];
  handleToggleColumn?: (colId: string) => void;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  delegationGroups: any[];
  currentUser: AppUser | null;
  canWrite: boolean;
  isEditMode: boolean;
  isHideMode: boolean;
  toggleHideRow: (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  getRowVisibilityClass: (id: string) => string;
  selectedTaskSet: Set<string>;
  selectedTaskIds: string[];
  setSelectedTaskIds: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  selectedProjectSet: Set<string>;
  selectedProjectIds?: string[]; setSelectedProjectIds?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  handleTaskCheckboxChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement> | React.MouseEvent, id: string, isShift?: boolean, orderedTaskIds?: string[]) => void;
  handleToggleSelectAll: () => void;
  isAllSelected: boolean;
  toggleProjectExpansion: (id: string) => void;
  toggleModularParent: (taskId: string | number) => void;
  handleGroupModularTasks: (parentTaskId: string, childTaskIds: string[]) => void;
  handleUnlinkModularTasks: (childTaskIds: string[]) => void;
  handleTogglePin: (p: Project) => Promise<void>;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  ganttTabFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  draggingTaskIds: string[];
  handleTaskDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleTaskDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleContainerDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent) => void;
  handleTaskDragLeave: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleTaskDrop: (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, parentProject?: Project) => Promise<void> | void;
  handleTaskDragEnd: () => void;
  dragOverTaskId: string | null;
  dropPosition: 'before' | 'after' | null;
  dependencyLines: DependencyLine[];
  computedSum: number | null;
  isExporting: boolean;
  onNavigateToTaskDetail?: (taskId: string) => void;
  onNavigateToLayout?: (store: string, location: string, projectCode?: string, sourceTaskId?: string) => void;
  paginatedProjects?: Project[];
  expandedModularTasks?: string[];
  setExpandedModularTasks?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  getGroupTasksForProject?: (p: Project) => Task[];
}

export function GanttTableView({
  tableContainerRef,
  mainScrollRef,
  topScrollRef,
  handleCombinedMainScroll,
  handleTopScroll,
  flatGanttRows = [],
  visibleGanttRows,
  paddingTop,
  paddingBottom,
  totalDays,
  dayWidth,
  sideWidth,
  startResizingSide,
  colWidths,
  startResizingColumn,
  timeUnits,
  startDate,
  customToday,
  setCustomToday,
  isDraggingToday,
  setIsDraggingToday,
  getDateFromOffsetPx,
  activeTooltip,
  setActiveTooltip,
  getBarColor,
  visibleColumns,
  handleToggleColumn,
  projects,
  tasks,
  delegationGroups,
  currentUser,
  canWrite,
  isEditMode,
  isHideMode,
  toggleHideRow,
  getRowVisibilityClass,
  selectedTaskSet,
  selectedTaskIds,
  setSelectedTaskIds,
  selectedProjectSet,
  selectedProjectIds = [],
  setSelectedProjectIds,
  handleTaskCheckboxChange,
  handleToggleSelectAll,
  isAllSelected,
  toggleProjectExpansion,
  toggleModularParent,
  handleGroupModularTasks,
  handleUnlinkModularTasks,
  handleTogglePin,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  ganttTabFocusTaskId,
  draggingTaskIds,
  handleTaskDragStart,
  handleTaskDragOver,
  handleContainerDragOver,
  handleTaskDragLeave,
  handleTaskDrop,
  handleTaskDragEnd,
  dragOverTaskId,
  dropPosition,
  dependencyLines,
  computedSum,
  isExporting,
  onNavigateToTaskDetail,
  onNavigateToLayout,
  paginatedProjects,
  expandedModularTasks = [],
  setExpandedModularTasks,
  getGroupTasksForProject
}: GanttTableViewProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const expandedProjects = useAppStore((state) => state.expandedProjectIds);
  const setExpandedProjectIds = useAppStore((state) => state.setExpandedProjectIds);

  const currentProjects = (paginatedProjects && paginatedProjects.length > 0) ? paginatedProjects : projects;
  const isAllExpanded = currentProjects.length > 0 && currentProjects.every((p) => expandedProjects.includes(p.id!));

  const handleToggleExpandAll = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (isAllExpanded) {
      setExpandedProjectIds([]);
    } else {
      setExpandedProjectIds(currentProjects.map((p) => p.id!).filter(Boolean) as string[]);
    }
  };

  // Find all modular parent task IDs for currently displayed/searched projects
  const currentModularParentIds = useMemo(() => {
    const parentIdSet = new Set<string>();

    currentProjects.forEach((p) => {
      const pTasks = getGroupTasksForProject ? getGroupTasksForProject(p) : [];
      if (!pTasks || pTasks.length === 0) return;

      const projectTaskById = new Map<string, Task>();
      const projectTaskByCode = new Map<string, Task>();
      pTasks.forEach((t) => {
        if (t.id) projectTaskById.set(String(t.id), t);
        if (t.taskCodePhu) {
          projectTaskByCode.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase(), t);
        }
      });

      pTasks.forEach((t) => {
        const rawParentId = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
        if (rawParentId) {
          const parentKey = String(rawParentId).trim().toLowerCase();
          const matchedParent = projectTaskById.get(String(rawParentId)) || projectTaskByCode.get(parentKey);
          const effectiveParentId = matchedParent ? String(matchedParent.id) : String(rawParentId);
          parentIdSet.add(effectiveParentId);
        }
      });
    });

    return Array.from(parentIdSet);
  }, [currentProjects, getGroupTasksForProject]);

  const hasModularTasks = currentModularParentIds.length > 0;
  const isAnyModularExpanded =
    hasModularTasks &&
    currentModularParentIds.some((id) => expandedModularTasks.includes(id));

  const handleToggleExpandAllModular = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!hasModularTasks || !setExpandedModularTasks) return;

    if (isAnyModularExpanded) {
      const toRemove = new Set(currentModularParentIds);
      setExpandedModularTasks((prev) => {
        const next = prev.filter((id) => !toRemove.has(id));
        safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded", JSON.stringify(next));
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      setExpandedModularTasks((prev) => {
        const next = Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...currentModularParentIds]));
        safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded", JSON.stringify(next));
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  const showStart = visibleColumns.includes('start');
  const showFinish = visibleColumns.includes('finish');
  const showParty = visibleColumns.includes('party');
  const showDuration = visibleColumns.includes('duration');
  const showPredecessor = visibleColumns.includes('predecessor');

  const startColWidth = colWidths?.start ?? 85; const finishColWidth = colWidths?.finish ?? 85; const partyColWidth = colWidths?.party ?? 80; const durationColWidth = colWidths?.duration ?? 60; const predecessorColWidth = colWidths?.predecessor ?? 90;

  const taskCodeMap = useMemo(() => {
    return computeAllTaskCodes(projects, tasks);
  }, [projects, tasks]);

  const delegationGroupByTaskId = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, any>();
    (delegationGroups || []).forEach(g => {
      if (g.taskId) map.set(g.taskId, g);
      if (g.parentTaskId) map.set(g.parentTaskId, g);
      if (g.subTasks) {
        g.subTasks.forEach((st: any) => {
          if (st.taskId) map.set(st.taskId, g);
        });
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [delegationGroups]);

  const totalTimelineWidth = totalDays * dayWidth;

  const { isPanning, handlePointerDown } = useGanttZoomAndPan({
    mainScrollRef,
    topScrollRef,
    sideWidth
  });

  const allOrderedTaskIds = useMemo(() => {
    const fromRows = (flatGanttRows && flatGanttRows.length > 0 ? flatGanttRows : visibleGanttRows)
      .filter(r => r.type === 'task')
      .map(r => r.task.id);
    if (fromRows.length > 0) return fromRows;
    const fallbackIds: string[] = [];
    currentProjects.forEach(p => {
      const pTasks = getGroupTasksForProject ? getGroupTasksForProject(p) : [];
      pTasks.forEach(t => {
        if (t && t.id && !t.isDeleted && !fallbackIds.includes(t.id)) fallbackIds.push(t.id);
      });
    });
    return fallbackIds;
  }, [flatGanttRows, visibleGanttRows, currentProjects, getGroupTasksForProject]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={tableContainerRef}
      onDragOver={handleContainerDragOver}
      className="flex-grow overflow-hidden flex flex-col bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] relative min-h-0 select-none"
    >
      {/* Top Synchronized Timeline Header */}
      <div
        ref={topScrollRef}
        onScroll={handleTopScroll}
        className="overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-hidden border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#18181a] flex shrink-0"
      >
        {/* Left Side Header */}
        <GanttLeftHeader
          sideWidth={sideWidth}
          isEditMode={isEditMode}
          isAllSelected={isAllSelected}
          handleToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
          isAllExpanded={isAllExpanded}
          handleToggleExpandAll={handleToggleExpandAll}
          isAllModularExpanded={isAnyModularExpanded}
          handleToggleExpandAllModular={handleToggleExpandAllModular}
          hasModularTasks={hasModularTasks}
          visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
          colWidths={colWidths}
          handleToggleColumn={handleToggleColumn}
          startResizingColumn={startResizingColumn}
        />

        {/* Right Side Timeline Units Header */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-visible" style={{ width: `${totalTimelineWidth}px` }}>
          <GanttTimelineHeader timeUnits={timeUnits} dayWidth={dayWidth} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Scrollable Table & Timeline Canvas */}
      <div
        ref={mainScrollRef}
        onScroll={handleCombinedMainScroll}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        className={cn(
          "flex-grow overflow-auto relative flex min-h-0",
          isPanning ? "cursor-grabbing select-none" : "cursor-grab"
        )}
      >
        {/* Left Side Resizable Divider Bar */}
        <div
          onMouseDown={startResizingSide}
          className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 z-40 w-1.5 cursor-col-resize hover:bg-blue-500 active:bg-blue-600 transition-colors"
          style={{ left: `${sideWidth - 1}px` }}
        />

        {/* Rows Virtual Container */}
        <div
          className="flex flex-col relative w-full"
          style={{
            minWidth: `${sideWidth + totalTimelineWidth}px`,
            paddingTop: `${paddingTop}px`,
            paddingBottom: `${paddingBottom}px`
          }}
        >
          {/* Background Grid Lines */}
          <GanttGridOverlay
            totalDays={totalDays}
            dayWidth={dayWidth}
            sideWidth={sideWidth}
            timeUnits={timeUnits}
          />

          {/* Today Indicator Line */}
          <GanttTodayLine
            customToday={customToday}
            setCustomToday={setCustomToday}
            isDraggingToday={isDraggingToday}
            setIsDraggingToday={setIsDraggingToday}
            startDate={startDate}
            dayWidth={dayWidth}
            sideWidth={sideWidth}
            showStart={showStart} startColWidth={startColWidth} showFinish={showFinish} finishColWidth={finishColWidth}
            showParty={showParty} partyColWidth={partyColWidth} showDuration={showDuration} durationColWidth={durationColWidth}
            showPredecessor={showPredecessor} predecessorColWidth={predecessorColWidth}
            getDateFromOffsetPx={getDateFromOffsetPx}
          />

          {/* SVG Dependency Lines */}
          {dependencyLines.length > 0 && (
            <GanttDependencyLinks dependencyLines={dependencyLines} />
          )}

          {/* Virtualized Rows List */}
          {visibleGanttRows.length === 0 ? (
            <GanttEmptyState />
          ) : (
            visibleGanttRows.map((row) => {
              if (row.type === 'project') {
                return (
                  <GanttProjectRow
                    key={row.key}
                    p={row.project}
                    pIdx={row.projectIndex} projectTasks={getGroupTasksForProject ? getGroupTasksForProject(row.project) : []}
                    isExpanded={row.isExpanded}
                    expandedModularTasks={expandedModularTasks}
                    setExpandedModularTasks={setExpandedModularTasks}
                    toggleProjectExpansion={toggleProjectExpansion}
                    sideWidth={sideWidth}
                    showStart={showStart} startColWidth={startColWidth} showFinish={showFinish} finishColWidth={finishColWidth}
                    showParty={showParty} partyColWidth={partyColWidth} showDuration={showDuration} durationColWidth={durationColWidth}
                    showPredecessor={showPredecessor} predecessorColWidth={predecessorColWidth}
                    startDate={startDate}
                    dayWidth={dayWidth}
                    activeTooltip={activeTooltip}
                    setActiveTooltip={setActiveTooltip}
                    isEditMode={isEditMode}
                    canWrite={canWrite}
                    selectedProjectSet={selectedProjectSet}
                    selectedProjectIds={selectedProjectIds}
                    selectedTaskSet={selectedTaskSet}
                    selectedTaskIds={selectedTaskIds}
                    setSelectedProjectIds={setSelectedProjectIds}
                    setSelectedTaskIds={setSelectedTaskIds}
                    getBarColor={getBarColor}
                    handleTogglePin={handleTogglePin}
                    getRowVisibilityClass={getRowVisibilityClass}
                    isHideMode={isHideMode}
                    toggleHideRow={toggleHideRow}
                  />
                );
              }

              return (
                <GanttTaskRow
                  key={row.key}
                  t={row.task}
                  taskIndex={row.taskIndex}
                  p={row.project}
                  isChild={row.isChild}
                  parentTask={row.parentTask}
                  hasChildren={row.hasChildren}
                  childCount={row.childCount}
                  childTasks={row.type === 'task' ? row.childTasks : undefined}
                  isModularExpanded={row.isModularExpanded}
                  projects={projects}
                  tasks={tasks}
                  delegationGroups={delegationGroups}
                  isHighlightDelegationOn={false}
                  currentUser={currentUser}
                  selectedTaskSet={selectedTaskSet}

import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, GripVertical, EyeOff, Unlink } from 'lucide-react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { cn } from './GanttUtils';
import { computeTaskCode } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface GanttTaskLeftColumnsProps {
  t: Task;
  taskIndex?: number;
  taskCode?: string;
  projects?: Project[];
  tasks?: Task[];
  isChild: boolean;
  parentTask?: Task;
  hasChildren: boolean;
  childCount: number;
  isModularExpanded: boolean;
  toggleModularParent: (taskId: string | number) => void;
  selectedTaskSet: Set<string>;

  isHideMode: boolean;

  isDragging: boolean;
  handleTaskDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleTaskDragEnd: () => void;
  isEditMode?: boolean;
  isFocused?: boolean;
  onNavigateToTaskDetail?: (taskId: string) => void;
  handleUnlinkModularTasks?: (childTaskIds: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
}

export function GanttTaskLeftColumns({
  t,
  taskIndex,
  taskCode: propTaskCode,
  projects = [],
  tasks = [],
  isChild,
  hasChildren,
  childCount,
  isModularExpanded,
  toggleModularParent,
  selectedTaskSet,
  handleTaskCheckboxChange,
  isHideMode,
  toggleHideRow,
  isDragging,
  handleTaskDragStart,
  handleTaskDragEnd,
  isEditMode = false,
  isFocused = false,
  onNavigateToTaskDetail,
  handleUnlinkModularTasks
}: GanttTaskLeftColumnsProps) {
  const isSelected = selectedTaskSet.has(String(t.id)) || selectedTaskSet.has(t.id);
  const taskCode = propTaskCode || (projects.length > 0 && tasks.length > 0 ? computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, t) : (t.taskCodePhu || ''));
  const shiftClickedRef = useRef(false);
  const isParentTask = hasChildren || childCount > 0 || Boolean((t as any).isModularParent);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center w-full h-full overflow-hidden">
      {/* Selection Checkbox & Drag Handle & Hide Button - ONLY in Edit Mode */}
      {isEditMode ? (
        <div className="w-10 px-1 py-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shrink-0 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336]">
          {isHideMode ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => toggleHideRow(`task-${t.id}`, e)}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-amber-500 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Hide this task"
            >
              <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
              {!isParentTask ? (
                <div
                  draggable
                  onDragStart={(e) => handleTaskDragStart(e, t.id)}
                  onDragEnd={handleTaskDragEnd}
                  className="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5"
                  title="Drag to reorder task"
                >
                  <GripVertical className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 p-0.5 cursor-not-allowed" title="Dragging disabled for parent tasks">
                  <GripVertical className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-30" />
                </div>
              )}
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isSelected}
                onPointerDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.shiftKey) shiftClickedRef.current = true;
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.shiftKey) shiftClickedRef.current = true;
                }}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  if (e.shiftKey) shiftClickedRef.current = true;
                }}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const isShift = Boolean(
                    shiftClickedRef.current ||
                    (e.nativeEvent as MouseEvent)?.shiftKey ||
                    (e as any).shiftKey ||
                    (window.event as any)?.shiftKey
                  );
                  shiftClickedRef.current = false;
                  handleTaskCheckboxChange(e, String(t.id), isShift);
                }}
                className="rounded border-slate-600 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 w-3.5 h-3.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="w-10 px-1 py-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold select-none">
          {taskIndex !== undefined ? taskIndex + 1 : (t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex + 1 : '#')}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Task Name Column with indentation for child tasks */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 px-2 py-1 flex items-center gap-1 overflow-hidden">
        {isChild && <div className="w-3 shrink-0" />}
        
        {hasChildren && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => toggleModularParent(t.id)}
            className="p-0.5 rounded bg-purple-600 text-white hover:bg-purple-700 shadow-xs shrink-0 cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-90"
            title="Toggle Grouped Tasks"
          >
            {isModularExpanded ? (
              <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white font-bold stroke-[2.5]" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white font-bold stroke-[2.5]" />
            )}
          </button>
        )}

        {(isChild || Boolean(t.parentTaskId)) && handleUnlinkModularTasks && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              handleUnlinkModularTasks([String(t.id)]);
            }}
            className="p-0.5 rounded text-amber-600 hover:text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 dark:hover:text-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-50 dark:hover:bg-amber-950/50 shrink-0 cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-90"
            title="Unlink child task from parent group"
          >
            <Unlink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        )}

        <div 
          onClick={(e) => {
            if (isEditMode) return;
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (onNavigateToTaskDetail) {
              onNavigateToTaskDetail(t.id);
            }
          }}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate flex-1 min-w-0 p-0.5 rounded transition-colors group/tname overflow-hidden",
            !isEditMode ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]" : ""
          )}
          title={isEditMode ? (isParentTask ? `Parent task (${t.name}) - Dragging disabled` : `Click and drag row to reorder task (${t.name})`) : `Click to view task in Task Detail (${t.name})`}
        >
          {isEditMode && (
            (t.party?.toLowerCase().includes('tenant') || t.party?.toLowerCase().includes('contractor') || t.party?.toLowerCase().includes('nt') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('tenant') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('design guideline') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('opening') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('fit-out') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('shop drawing') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('re-instatement')) ? (
              <span className="text-blue-400 text-[10px] shrink-0 font-black">▶</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-emerald-400 text-xs shrink-0">📌</span>
            )
          )}

          <span className="text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 truncate font-semibold flex-1 min-w-0 group-hover/tname:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover/tname:text-[#8ab4f8]" title={t.name}>
            {t.name || '(Unnamed Task)'}
          </span>

          {hasChildren && (
            <span className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold shrink-0">
              ({childCount})
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { memo, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { Project, Task, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { getTaskStatus, computeActProgressPercent, resolveActualStatus, getUserDelegationRoleForTask, parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { computeTaskCode, computeAllTaskCodes } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { GanttBar } from './GanttBar';
import { GanttBaseline } from './GanttBaseline';
import { GanttTaskLeftColumns } from './GanttTaskLeftColumns';
import { cn, formatGanttDate, renderGanttDateCell } from './GanttUtils';
import { useIsRowFlashed } from '../../lib/changeFlashService';

export interface GanttTaskRowProps {
  t: Task;
  taskIndex?: number;
  isChild: boolean;
  parentTask?: Task;
  hasChildren: boolean;
  childCount: number;
  childTasks?: Task[];
  isModularExpanded: boolean;

  isHighlightDelegationOn: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser | null;
  selectedTaskSet: Set<string>;
  selectedTaskIds: string[];
  setSelectedTaskIds: (ids: string[] | ((prev: string[]) => string[])) => void;
  isEditMode: boolean;
  canWrite: boolean;
  handleGroupModularTasks: (parentTaskId: string, childTaskIds: string[]) => void;
  handleUnlinkModularTasks: (childTaskIds: string[]) => void;
  toggleModularParent: (taskId: string | number) => void;
  getRowVisibilityClass: (id: string) => string;
  sideWidth: number;
  showStart: boolean;
  startColWidth: number;
  showFinish: boolean;
  finishColWidth: number;
  showParty: boolean;
  partyColWidth: number;
  showDuration: boolean;
  durationColWidth: number;
  showPredecessor?: boolean;
  predecessorColWidth?: number;

  timeUnits: any[];
  startDate: Date;
  dayWidth: number;

  setActiveTooltip: (id: string | null) => void;
  getBarColor: (status: string, duration?: string | number) => string;

  ganttTabFocusTaskId?: string | null;

  handleTaskDragEnd: () => void;

  isHideMode: boolean;
  toggleHideRow: (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  onNavigateToTaskDetail?: (taskId: string) => void;
}

export const GanttTaskRow = React.memo(function GanttTaskRow({
  t,
  taskIndex,
  isChild,
  parentTask,
  hasChildren,
  childCount,
  childTasks,
  isModularExpanded,
  p,
  projects,
  tasks,
  delegationGroups,
  isHighlightDelegationOn,
  currentUser,
  selectedTaskSet,
  selectedTaskIds,
  setSelectedTaskIds,
  isEditMode,
  canWrite,
  handleGroupModularTasks,
  handleUnlinkModularTasks,
  toggleModularParent,
  getRowVisibilityClass,
  sideWidth,
  showStart,
  startColWidth,
  showFinish,
  finishColWidth,
  showParty,
  partyColWidth,
  showDuration,
  durationColWidth,
  showPredecessor = false,
  predecessorColWidth = 90,
  taskCodeMap,  delegationGroupByTaskId,  timeUnits,
  startDate,
  dayWidth,
  activeTooltip,
  setActiveTooltip,
  getBarColor,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  ganttTabFocusTaskId,
  draggingTaskIds,
  handleTaskDragStart,
  handleTaskDragOver,
  handleTaskDragLeave,
  handleTaskDrop,
  handleTaskDragEnd,
  dragOverTaskId,
  dropPosition,
  handleTaskCheckboxChange,
  isHideMode,
  toggleHideRow,
  onNavigateToTaskDetail
}: GanttTaskRowProps) {
  const isSelected = selectedTaskSet.has(String(t.id)) || selectedTaskSet.has(t.id);
  const isTarget = dragOverTaskId === t.id;
  const isDragging = draggingTaskIds.includes(t.id);
  const isFocused = initialFocusTaskId === t.id || ganttTabFocusTaskId === t.id;

  const userRole = currentUser ? getUserDelegationRoleForTask(t, currentUser, delegationGroups || []) : null;
  const highlightRole = isHighlightDelegationOn ? userRole : null;

  const planStatus = getTaskStatus(t.start, t.finish);
  const linkedGroup = delegationGroupByTaskId?.get(t.id) || (delegationGroups || []).find((g: any) => g.taskId === t.id || g.parentTaskId === t.id);
  const actStatusObj = resolveActualStatus(planStatus, linkedGroup?.subTasks || []);
  const actPrg = computeActProgressPercent([t], delegationGroups || []);
  const taskCode = taskCodeMap?.get(t.id) || t.taskCodePhu || computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, t);

  // Compute accurate lifecycle status taking into account runningStatus, delegation, approvals, progress, and dates
  let effectiveStatus = planStatus;
  const running = (t.runningStatus || '').toLowerCase();
  const actLabel = (actStatusObj.label || '').toLowerCase();

  if (running.includes('complete') || t.approval === 'Approved' || actPrg >= 100 || actLabel.includes('complete')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'Completed';
  } else if (running.includes('delay') || actLabel.includes('reject') || actLabel.includes('delay')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'Delayed';
  } else if (running.includes('cancel')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'Canceled';
  } else if (running.includes('process') || running.includes('progress') || (actPrg > 0 && actPrg < 100) || actLabel.includes('progress') || actLabel.includes('process')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'On process';
  } else if (running.includes('upcoming') || actLabel.includes('planned') || actLabel.includes('upcoming')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'Upcoming';
  } else {
    // Check if task is overdue (past finish date but not completed)
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const dFinish = parseDateTime(t.finish);
    if (dFinish) dFinish.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    if (dFinish && today > dFinish && actPrg < 100 && t.approval !== 'Approved') {
      effectiveStatus = 'Delayed';
    }
  }

  const onProcessChildTasks = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!hasChildren || !childTasks || childTasks.length === 0) return [];

    return childTasks
      .filter((ct) => {
        const plSt = getTaskStatus(ct.start, ct.finish);
        const lg = delegationGroupByTaskId?.get(ct.id) || (delegationGroups || []).find((g: any) => g.taskId === ct.id || g.parentTaskId === ct.id);
        const actStObj = resolveActualStatus(plSt, lg?.subTasks || []);
        const prg = computeActProgressPercent([ct], delegationGroups || []);
        const running = (ct.runningStatus || '').toLowerCase();
        const actLabel = (actStObj.label || '').toLowerCase();

        if (running.includes('complete') || ct.approval === 'Approved' || prg >= 100 || actLabel.includes('complete')) {
          return false;
        }

        if (
          running.includes('process') ||
          running.includes('progress') ||
          actLabel.includes('process') ||
          actLabel.includes('progress') ||
          plSt === 'On process'
        ) {
          return true;
        }

        if (prg > 0 && prg < 100) {
          return true;
        }

        return false;
      })
      .map((ct) => {
        const ctPrg = computeActProgressPercent([ct], delegationGroups || []);
        const ctCode = ct.taskCodePhu || taskCodeMap?.get(ct.id) || computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, ct);
        return {
          id: String(ct.id),
          name: ct.name,
          taskCode: ctCode,
          actPrg: ctPrg,
          start: ct.start,
          finish: ct.finish,
          duration: ct.duration,
        };
      });
  }, [hasChildren, childTasks, delegationGroups, projects, tasks]);

  const extraVars = {
    actStatus: effectiveStatus,
    actStatusColor: actStatusObj.color,
    party: t.party,
    actPrg,
    duration: t.duration,
    taskCode,
    predecessors: t.predecessor,
    highlight: highlightRole,
    hasChildren,
    childCount,
    task: t,
    tasks,
    projects,
    canWrite,
    onNavigateToTaskDetail,
    onProcessChildTasks,
  };

  const { isFlashed } = useIsRowFlashed(t.id);
  const isParentTask = hasChildren || childCount > 0 || Boolean((t as any).isModularParent);

  return (
    <div
      id={`gantt-task-row-${t.id}`}
      draggable={isEditMode && !isParentTask}
      onDragStart={(e) => {
        if (!isEditMode || isParentTask) {
          e.preventDefault();
          return;
        }
        const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
        if (target.closest('input, button, a, [role="button"]')) {
          e.preventDefault();
          return;
        }
        handleTaskDragStart(e, t.id);
      }}
      onDragEnd={() => isEditMode && !isParentTask && handleTaskDragEnd()}
      onDragOver={(e) => isEditMode && handleTaskDragOver(e, t.id)}
      onDragLeave={(e) => isEditMode && handleTaskDragLeave(e, t.id)}
      onDrop={(e) => isEditMode && handleTaskDrop(e, t, p)}
      className={cn(
        "flex h-10 min-h-[40px] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 transition-all duration-700 relative group",
        getRowVisibilityClass(`task-${t.id}`),
        isSelected ? "bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-blue-950/30" : "hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40",
        isEditMode && !isParentTask && "cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:bg-blue-50/70 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/30",
        isEditMode && isParentTask && "hover:bg-purple-50/40 dark:hover:bg-purple-950/20 cursor-default",
        isDragging && "opacity-40",
        isTarget && dropPosition === 'before' && "border-t-2 border-t-blue-500",
        isTarget && dropPosition === 'after' && "border-b-2 border-b-blue-500",
        isFlashed && "ring-2 ring-emerald-500/80 bg-emerald-50/80 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 z-20 shadow-sm"
      )}
    >
      {/* Left Side Columns Container */}
      <div
        className="sticky left-0 z-20 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] flex border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0 h-full items-center overflow-hidden"
        style={{ width: `${sideWidth}px` }}
      >
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 h-full flex items-center overflow-hidden">
          <GanttTaskLeftColumns
            t={t}
            taskIndex={taskIndex}
            taskCode={taskCode}
            projects={projects}
            tasks={tasks}
            isChild={isChild}
            parentTask={parentTask}
            hasChildren={hasChildren}
            childCount={childCount}
            isModularExpanded={isModularExpanded}
            toggleModularParent={toggleModularParent}
            selectedTaskSet={selectedTaskSet}
            handleTaskCheckboxChange={handleTaskCheckboxChange}
            isHideMode={isHideMode}
            toggleHideRow={toggleHideRow}
            isDragging={isDragging}
            handleTaskDragStart={handleTaskDragStart}
            handleTaskDragEnd={handleTaskDragEnd}
            isEditMode={isEditMode}
            isFocused={isFocused}
            onNavigateToTaskDetail={onNavigateToTaskDetail}
            handleUnlinkModularTasks={handleUnlinkModularTasks}
          />
        </div>

        {showStart && (
          <div
            className="border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: startColWidth, minWidth: startColWidth, maxWidth: startColWidth }}
          >
            {renderGanttDateCell(t.start, "text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]")}
          </div>
        )}

        {showFinish && (
          <div
            className="border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: finishColWidth, minWidth: finishColWidth, maxWidth: finishColWidth }}
          >
            {renderGanttDateCell(t.finish, "text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400")}
          </div>
        )}

        {showParty && (
          <div
            className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: partyColWidth, minWidth: partyColWidth, maxWidth: partyColWidth }}
          >
            {t.party || "-"}
          </div>
        )}

        {showDuration && (
          <div
            className="font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center font-bold shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: durationColWidth, minWidth: durationColWidth, maxWidth: durationColWidth }}
          >
            {t.duration ? `${t.duration}d` : "-"}
          </div>
        )}

        {showPredecessor && (
          <div
            className="font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-semibold border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: predecessorColWidth, minWidth: predecessorColWidth, maxWidth: predecessorColWidth }}
            title={t.predecessor || ""}
          >
            <span className="truncate">{t.predecessor || "-"}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Right Timeline Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 relative h-full flex items-center">
        {/* Baseline Bar (from baselineStart/baseStart or plan start to baselineFinish/baseFinish or plan finish) */}
        <GanttBaseline
          baselineStart={t.baselineStart || (t as any).baseStart}
          baselineFinish={t.baselineFinish || (t as any).baseFinish}
          startStr={t.start}
          endStr={t.finish}
          startDate={startDate}
          dayWidth={dayWidth}
        />

        {/* Task Main Gantt Bar */}
        <GanttBar
          id={`task-${t.id}`}
          label={t.name}
          startStr={t.start}
          endStr={t.finish}
          status={effectiveStatus}
          extraVars={extraVars}
          startDate={startDate}
          dayWidth={dayWidth}
          activeTooltip={activeTooltip}
          setActiveTooltip={setActiveTooltip}
          isEditMode={isEditMode}
          getBarColor={getBarColor}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );

=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttTodayLine.tsx ===
import React, { FC, memo } from 'react';
import { format } from 'date-fns';

export interface GanttTodayLineProps {
  showToday?: boolean;
  sideWidth?: number;
  showStart?: boolean;
  startColWidth?: number;
  showFinish?: boolean;
  finishColWidth?: number;
  showParty?: boolean;
  partyColWidth?: number;
  showDuration?: boolean;
  durationColWidth?: number;
  showPredecessor?: boolean;
  predecessorColWidth?: number;
  todayLeftPx?: number;
  customToday: Date;
  setCustomToday?: (d: Date) => void;
  isDraggingToday?: boolean;
  setIsDraggingToday?: (v: boolean) => void;
  startDate?: Date;
  dayWidth?: number;
  getDateFromOffsetPx?: (offsetPx: number) => Date;
}

export const GanttTodayLine: React.FC<GanttTodayLineProps> = React.memo(({
  showToday = true,
  sideWidth = 0,
  showStart = false,
  startColWidth = 0,
  showFinish = false,
  finishColWidth = 0,
  showParty = false,
  partyColWidth = 0,
  showDuration = false,
  durationColWidth = 0,
  showPredecessor = false,
  predecessorColWidth = 0,
  todayLeftPx,
  customToday,
  setCustomToday,
  isDraggingToday,
  setIsDraggingToday,
  startDate,
  dayWidth = 30,
  getDateFromOffsetPx,
}) => {
  if (!showToday) return null;

  let calculatedTodayLeft = todayLeftPx;
  if (calculatedTodayLeft === undefined && startDate) {
    const diffDays = (customToday.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
    calculatedTodayLeft = diffDays * dayWidth;
  }

  const leftPosition = sideWidth + (calculatedTodayLeft || 0);

  const formattedDate = format(customToday, 'dd/MM/yyyy');

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (!setIsDraggingToday || !setCustomToday || !getDateFromOffsetPx) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDraggingToday(true);

    const onMouseMove = (moveEvent: MouseEvent) => {
      const containerRect = (e.currentTarget.parentElement?.parentElement as HTMLElement)?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!containerRect) return;
      const mouseOffset = moveEvent.clientX - containerRect.left - sideWidth;
      const newDate = getDateFromOffsetPx(mouseOffset);
      setCustomToday(newDate);
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingToday(false);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 pointer-events-none z-[60] group/today"
      style={{ left: `${leftPosition}px`, width: '0px' }}
      title={`Today: ${formattedDate}`}
    >
      {/* Today Pin Header Badge centered directly above the vertical line */}
      <div 
        onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
        className="sticky top-1.5 z-[65] select-none pointer-events-auto cursor-ew-resize flex flex-col items-center -translate-x-1/2"
      >
        <div className="bg-[#f43f5e] text-white font-extrabold text-[9px] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow-lg tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap ring-1 ring-white/40 border border-white/20">
          <span>TODAY</span>
          <span className="opacity-95 font-mono font-bold">({formattedDate})</span>
        </div>
        {/* Pointer arrow connecting badge center directly to the line */}
        <div className="w-0 h-0 border-x-4 border-x-transparent border-t-4 border-t-[#f43f5e] -mt-[1px]" />
      </div>

      {/* Glowing Today Line centered at the exact middle */}
      <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-0 -translate-x-1/2 w-0.5 bg-[#f43f5e] shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(244,63,94,0.7)]" />
    </div>
  );
});

GanttTodayLine.displayName = 'GanttTodayLine';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Palette, Play, Layers, Unlink, Trash2, Eye, EyeOff, Save, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

interface GanttToolbarActionsProps {
  selectedProjectIds: string[];
  selectedTaskIds: string[];
  handleSetTextColor: (color: string | null) => void;
  handleSetBaselineSelected: () => void;
  handleUnlinkModularTasks?: (childTaskIds?: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
  setIsTaskModularModalOpen: (val: boolean) => void;
  sumMode: "none" | "duration";
  setSumMode: (val: "none" | "duration") => void;
  handleDeleteSelected: () => void;
  isHideMode: boolean;
  setIsHideMode: (val: boolean) => void;
  hiddenRows: string[];
  setHiddenRows: (rows: string[]) => void;
  handleExportToPDF: () => void;
  isExporting: boolean;
}

const COLOR_OPTIONS = [
  { label: 'Default', color: null, bg: 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700' },
  { label: 'Red', color: '#ef4444', bg: 'bg-red-500' },
  { label: 'Blue', color: '#3b82f6', bg: 'bg-blue-500' },
  { label: 'Green', color: '#10b981', bg: 'bg-emerald-500' },
  { label: 'Amber', color: '#f59e0b', bg: 'bg-amber-500' },
  { label: 'Purple', color: '#8b5cf6', bg: 'bg-purple-500' },
];

export function GanttToolbarActions({
  selectedProjectIds,
  selectedTaskIds,
  handleSetTextColor,
  handleSetBaselineSelected,
  handleUnlinkModularTasks,
  setIsTaskModularModalOpen,
  sumMode,
  setSumMode,
  handleDeleteSelected,
  isHideMode,
  setIsHideMode,
  hiddenRows,
  setHiddenRows,
  handleExportToPDF,
  isExporting
}: GanttToolbarActionsProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isColorMenuOpen, setIsColorMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const colorMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const totalSelected = selectedProjectIds.length + selectedTaskIds.length;

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (colorMenuRef.current && !colorMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsColorMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
      {/* Color Palette Menu */}
      <div className="relative" ref={colorMenuRef}>
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={totalSelected === 0}
          onClick={() => setIsColorMenuOpen(!isColorMenuOpen)}
          className={cn(
            "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
            totalSelected > 0
              ? "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-50"
              : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400"
          )}
          title={t('Set text color for selected items')}
        >
          <Palette className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-500" />
          <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Color')}</span>
        </button>

        {isColorMenuOpen && (
          <div className="absolute top-full left-0 mt-1 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-xl p-2 z-50 flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
            {COLOR_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
              <button
                key={opt.label}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  handleSetTextColor(opt.color);
                  setIsColorMenuOpen(false);
                }}
                className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full ${opt.bg} border-2 border-white dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm hover:scale-110 transition-transform`}
                title={opt.label}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Set Baseline */}
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={totalSelected === 0}
        onClick={handleSetBaselineSelected}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          totalSelected > 0

            : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400"
        )}

      >
        <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Baseline')}</span>
      </button>

      <button
        type="button"

        )}

      >
        <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Modular')}</span>
      </button>

      {/* Unlink Selected Tasks from Parent Link */}
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={selectedTaskIds.length < 1}
        onClick={() => {
          if (handleUnlinkModularTasks) {
            handleUnlinkModularTasks(selectedTaskIds);
          }
        }}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          selectedTaskIds.length >= 1
            ? "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-100 cursor-pointer"
            : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400"
        )}
        title={t('Unlink selected tasks from parent modular link')}
      >
        <Unlink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
        <span>{t('Unlink')}{selectedTaskIds.length > 0 ? ` (${selectedTaskIds.length})` : ''}</span>
      </button>

      {/* Sum Duration */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setSumMode(sumMode === 'none' ? 'duration' : 'none')}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          sumMode !== 'none'
            ? "bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-600 text-white shadow-xs"
            : "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-50"
        )}
        title={t('Toggle sum duration calculation for selected tasks')}
      >
        <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs">∑</span>
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Sum')}</span>
      </button>

        type="button"
        disabled={totalSelected === 0}
        onClick={handleDeleteSelected}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          totalSelected > 0
            ? "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 border-red-200 dark:border-red-900 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-100"
            : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400"
        )}
        title={t('Delete selected projects or tasks')}
      >
        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Delete')} ({totalSelected})</span>
      </button>

      {/* Hide / Unhide Mode */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsHideMode(!isHideMode)}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          isHideMode
            ? "bg-amber-500 border-amber-500 text-white shadow-xs"
            : "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-50"
        )}
        title={t('Toggle Hide Rows Mode')}
      >
        {isHideMode ? <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />}
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{isHideMode ? t('Done') : t('Hide Rows')}</span>
      </button>

      {/* PDF Export */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleExportToPDF}
        disabled={isExporting}
        className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-xs shadow-xs transition-colors active:scale-95 shrink-0"
        title="Export Gantt Timeline as PDF"
      >
        {isExporting ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : null}
        <span>{t('PDF')}</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, Target, Save, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

interface GanttToolbarDateFilterProps {
  handleTodayClick: () => void;
  viewMode: ViewMode;
  setViewMode: (mode: ViewMode) => void;
  scaleInput: string;
  setScaleInput: (val: string) => void;
  dayWidth: number;
  setDayWidth: (val: number) => void;
  isWidthChanged: boolean;
  setIsWidthChanged: (val: boolean) => void;
  saveDayWidth: () => void;
  tempStartDate: string;
  setTempStartDate: (val: string) => void;
  tempEndDate: string;
  setTempEndDate: (val: string) => void;
  setFilterStartDate: (val: string) => void;
  setFilterEndDate: (val: string) => void;
}

export function GanttToolbarDateFilter({
  handleTodayClick,
  viewMode,
  setViewMode,
  scaleInput,
  setScaleInput,
  dayWidth,
  setDayWidth,
  isWidthChanged,
  setIsWidthChanged,
  saveDayWidth,
  tempStartDate,
  setTempStartDate,
  tempEndDate,
  setTempEndDate,
  setFilterStartDate,
  setFilterEndDate
}: GanttToolbarDateFilterProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isDateFilterOpen, setIsDateFilterOpen] = useState(false);
  const dateFilterRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dateFilterRef.current && !dateFilterRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsDateFilterOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const handleApplyDateRange = () => {
    setFilterStartDate(tempStartDate);
    setFilterEndDate(tempEndDate);
    setIsDateFilterOpen(false);
  };

  const handleResetDateRange = () => {
    setTempStartDate('');
    setTempEndDate('');
    setFilterStartDate('');
    setFilterEndDate('');
    setIsDateFilterOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
      {/* Date Range Popover */}
      <div className="relative" ref={dateFilterRef}>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsDateFilterOpen(!isDateFilterOpen)}
          className={cn(
            "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-xs cursor-pointer",
            tempStartDate || tempEndDate
              ? "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#182338] border-blue-600 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold"
              : "bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/80 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#252528]"

          <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">
              <span>{t('Filter Timeline Range')}</span>
              <button
                type="button"

                className="p-0.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200"

=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttTooltipPredecessor.tsx ===
import React, { memo, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { PredecessorSearchSuggest } from '../TaskModalParts/PredecessorSearchSuggest';
import { resolvePredecessorString } from '../../lib/predecessorMatchUtils';
import { 
  buildTaskNoMap, 
  parsePredecessors, 
  calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors, 
  scheduleDependentTasks, 
  splitPredecessors 
} from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { ensureProjectTasksLoaded } from '../../lib/taskStateService';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { Edit2, Check, X, Link, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

interface GanttTooltipPredecessorProps {
  task: Task;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  isEditing?: boolean;
  setIsEditing?: (val: boolean) => void;
  onEditingChange?: (isEditing: boolean) => void;
  compact?: boolean;
}

export const GanttTooltipPredecessor = React.memo(function GanttTooltipPredecessor({
  task,
  tasks,
  projects,
  canWrite,
  isEditing: controlledIsEditing,
  setIsEditing: controlledSetIsEditing,
  onEditingChange,
  compact = false,
}: GanttTooltipPredecessorProps) {
  const [internalIsEditing, setInternalIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const isEditing = controlledIsEditing !== undefined ? controlledIsEditing : internalIsEditing;
  const setIsEditing = (val: boolean) => {
    if (controlledSetIsEditing) controlledSetIsEditing(val);
    else setInternalIsEditing(val);
    if (onEditingChange) onEditingChange(val);
  };

  const [val, setVal] = useState(task.predecessor || '');
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditing) {
      setVal(task.predecessor || '');
    }
  }, [task.predecessor, isEditing]);

  const handleStartEdit = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!canWrite) return;
    setIsEditing(true);
    onEditingChange?.(true);
  };

  const handleCancel = (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    setIsEditing(false);
    setVal(task.predecessor || '');
    onEditingChange?.(false);
  };

  const handleSave = async (rawVal: string) => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const context = {
        projectId: task?.projectId,
        projectCode: task?.projectCode,
        projectYear: task?.projectYear,
        projectStore: task?.projectStore,
        projectLocation: task?.location,
      };

      const resolved = resolvePredecessorString(rawVal, tasks, projects, task?.projectCode, context);
      setVal(resolved);

      if (resolved === (task.predecessor || '')) {
        setIsEditing(false);
        onEditingChange?.(false);
        setIsSaving(false);
        return;
      }

      let currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || tasks;
      const updatedTask: Task = {
        ...task,
        predecessor: resolved,
        realtimeUpdate: Boolean(resolved.trim()),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      // 1. Build map and parse predecessors
      let taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, currentTasks);
      let parsed = parsePredecessors(resolved, taskNoMap, updatedTask);

      // 2. Load external project tasks if not resolved
      if (resolved.trim() && (!parsed.length || parsed.some((p) => !p.task))) {
        const parts = splitPredecessors(resolved, Array.from(taskNoMap.keys()));
        for (const token of parts) {
          const cleanToken = token.replace(/(fs|ss|ff|sf|[+-]\s*\d+|\s+\d+)$/i, '').trim();
          const matchedProj = projects.find((p) => p.code && cleanToken.toLowerCase().startsWith(p.code.toLowerCase()));
          if (matchedProj && matchedProj.code !== task.projectCode) {
            const loaded = await ensureProjectTasksLoaded(matchedProj.code);
            if (loaded.length > 0) {
              currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || currentTasks;
              taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, currentTasks);
              parsed = parsePredecessors(resolved, taskNoMap, updatedTask);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // 3. Recalculate dates for updatedTask
      const calcResult = calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors(updatedTask, parsed);
      if (calcResult) {
        updatedTask.start = calcResult.start;
        updatedTask.finish = calcResult.finish;
        updatedTask.duration = calcResult.duration;
        updatedTask.durationManual = calcResult.durationManual;
      }

      // 4. Schedule dependent tasks cascading
      const updatesToDependents = scheduleDependentTasks(updatedTask, currentTasks, projects);

      // 5. Update Zustand store (0ms optimistic)
      const allTasksMap = new Map(currentTasks.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
      allTasksMap.set(updatedTask.id, updatedTask);
      updatesToDependents.forEach((u) => {
        const t = allTasksMap.get(u.id);
        if (t) {
          allTasksMap.set(u.id, {
            ...t,
            start: u.start,
            finish: u.finish,
            duration: u.duration,
            updatedAt: u.updatedAt,
          });
        }
      });
      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(Array.from(allTasksMap.values()));

      // 6. Persist to Firestore
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', updatedTask.id), updatedTask, { merge: true });
      updatesToDependents.forEach((u) => {
        batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', u.id), u, { merge: true });
      });
      batch.commit().catch((err) => {
        console.error('Failed to persist task predecessor update:', err);
      });

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: 'Predecessor Updated',
        message: resolved ? `Linked to ${resolved}` : 'Predecessor removed',
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error saving predecessor:', err);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: 'Update Failed',
        message: err.message || 'Could not update predecessor',
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
      setIsEditing(false);
      onEditingChange?.(false);
    }
  };

  if (!canWrite && !task.predecessor) {
    return null;
  }

  if (isEditing) {
    return (
      <div 
        ref={containerRef} 
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} 
        onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/95 dark:bg-slate-950/95 border border-blue-500/50 shadow-md my-1 w-full min-w-[240px] max-w-[320px] max-h-[360px] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-300">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Link className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-400" />
            Edit Predecessor
          </span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isSaving}
              onClick={handleCancel}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded transition-colors"
              title="Close"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="w-full relative" onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            handleCancel();
          }
        }}>
        <PredecessorSearchSuggest 
          task={task}
          canWrite={canWrite}
        />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (compact) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-slate-400">Pred:</span>
        {task.predecessor ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span 
              className="font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-300 bg-blue-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-700/50 max-w-[180px] truncate"
              title={task.predecessor}
            >
              {task.predecessor}
            </span>
            {canWrite && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleStartEdit}
                className="p-0.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-300 hover:bg-slate-700/80 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Edit Predecessor"
              >
                <Edit2 className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : canWrite ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleStartEdit}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
            Add Predecessor
          </button>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-slate-400">N/A</span>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 flex-1 min-w-[120px]">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
          Predecessors
        </span>
        {canWrite && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleStartEdit}
            className="text-[10px] text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer"
            title={task.predecessor ? "Edit Predecessor" : "Add Predecessor"}
          >
            {task.predecessor ? (
              <>
                <Edit2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                Edit
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Plus className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                Add
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {task.predecessor ? (
        <div 
          onClick={canWrite ? handleStartEdit : undefined}
          className={cn(
            "font-medium font-mono text-[11px] text-blue-300 bg-blue-950/50 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-blue-800/60 whitespace-normal break-words shadow-xs",
            canWrite ? "cursor-pointer hover:border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-900/50 transition-colors" : ""
          )}
          title={task.predecessor}
        >
          {task.predecessor}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={canWrite ? handleStartEdit : undefined}
          className="text-left text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-300 italic px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-500/70 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Plus className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-400" />
          <span>Add Predecessor...</span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});


=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttUtils.tsx ===
import React from 'react';
import { parseDateTime, cn } from "../../lib/utils";

export { cn };

export const formatGanttDate = (dateStr: string | undefined): string => {
  if (!dateStr) return "";
  const d = parseDateTime(dateStr);
  if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateStr || "";

  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
  const month = months[d.getMonth()];
  const year = d.getFullYear();

  const hasExplicitTime = dateStr.includes('T') || (dateStr.includes(':') && (d.getHours() !== 0 || d.getMinutes() !== 0));
  if (hasExplicitTime) {
    const hours = d.getHours();
    const minutes = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    const period = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    const displayHours = hours % 12 || 12;
    return `${day} ${month} ${year}, ${displayHours}:${minutes} ${period}`;
  }
  return `${day} ${month} ${year}`;
};

export const renderGanttDateCell = (dateStr: string | undefined, colorClass?: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) {
    return <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono text-xs">-</span>;
  }
  const d = parseDateTime(dateStr);
  if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) {
    return <span className={cn("font-mono text-[11px] leading-tight", colorClass)}>{dateStr}</span>;
  }

  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
  const month = months[d.getMonth()];
  const year = d.getFullYear();
  const dateFormatted = `${day} ${month} ${year}`;

  const hasExplicitTime = dateStr.includes('T') || (dateStr.includes(':') && (d.getHours() !== 0 || d.getMinutes() !== 0));
  const hours = d.getHours();
  const minutes = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const period = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const displayHours = hours % 12 || 12;
  const timeFormatted = `${displayHours}:${minutes} ${period}`;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center leading-tight whitespace-nowrap select-none py-0.5 w-full text-center">
      <span className={cn("font-mono font-bold tracking-tight text-[11px] leading-tight", colorClass || "text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200")}>
        {dateFormatted}
      </span>
      {hasExplicitTime && (
        <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono font-medium tracking-tighter opacity-70 leading-none mt-0.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          {timeFormatted}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const positionTooltip = (
  tooltipOrEvent: HTMLElement | null | React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent | { clientX: number; clientY: number },
  xOrTooltip?: number | HTMLElement | null,
  yCoord?: number
) => {
  let tooltip: HTMLElement | null = null;
  let clientX = 0;
  let clientY = 0;

  if (tooltipOrEvent && typeof (tooltipOrEvent as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect === 'function' && typeof xOrTooltip === 'number') {
    tooltip = tooltipOrEvent as HTMLElement;
    clientX = xOrTooltip;
    clientY = typeof yCoord === 'number' ? yCoord : 0;
  } else if (xOrTooltip && typeof (xOrTooltip as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect === 'function') {
    tooltip = xOrTooltip as HTMLElement;
    const e = tooltipOrEvent as any;
    if ('touches' in e && e.touches.length > 0) {
      clientX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      clientY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    } else {
      clientX = e.clientX || 0;
      clientY = e.clientY || 0;
    }
  }

  if (!tooltip) return;

  const tw = tooltip.offsetWidth || 250;
  const th = tooltip.offsetHeight || 150;

  let x = clientX + 15;
  let y = clientY + 15;

  if (x + tw > window.innerWidth - 10) {
    x = window.innerWidth - tw - 15;
    if (x < 10) x = 10;
  }

  if (y + th > window.innerHeight - 10) {
    y = window.innerHeight - th - 15;
    if (y < 10) y = 10;
  }

  tooltip.style.zIndex = '999999';
  tooltip.style.left = `${Math.max(10, x)}px`;
  tooltip.style.top = `${Math.max(10, y)}px`;
};

/**
 * Tự động căn chỉnh lại vị trí của Tooltip trên màn hình để không bao giờ bị tràn ra ngoài màn hình
 * (đặc biệt khi mở panel Edit Predecessor hoặc danh sách gợi ý).
 */
export const ensureTooltipInViewport = (tooltip: HTMLElement | null) => {
  if (!tooltip) return;
  const rect = tooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tw = rect.width || tooltip.offsetWidth || 340;
  const th = rect.height || tooltip.offsetHeight || 200;

  let x = rect.left;
  let y = rect.top;

  let changed = false;

  if (x + tw > window.innerWidth - 10) {
    x = Math.max(10, window.innerWidth - tw - 15);
    changed = true;
  }

  if (y + th > window.innerHeight - 10) {
    y = Math.max(10, window.innerHeight - th - 15);
    changed = true;
  }

  if (x < 10) { x = 10; changed = true; }
  if (y < 10) { y = 10; changed = true; }

  if (changed) {
    tooltip.style.left = `${x}px`;
    tooltip.style.top = `${y}px`;
  }
};

export const getBarColor = (status: string, duration?: string | number): string => {
  if (
    duration !== undefined &&
    duration !== "" &&
    parseFloat(String(duration)) === 0
  ) {
    return "bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 border border-amber-600";
  }
  const s = String(status || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  if (s === "completed" || s === "done") {
    return "bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 border border-emerald-600";
  }
  if (s === "on process" || s === "in progress") {
    return "bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-blue-600";
  }
  if (s === "delayed" || s === "delay" || s === "overdue") {
    return "bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-600 border border-rose-600";
  }
  if (s === "upcoming" || s === "planned") {
    return "bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-500 dark:hover:bg-slate-400 border border-slate-500/80";
  }
  if (s === "handover") {
    return "bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-blue-600";
  }
  if (s === "canceled" || s === "cancelled") {
    return "bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-400 text-slate-600 border border-slate-400";
  }
  return "bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-500 border border-slate-500/80";
};
