=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttBarDateDrag.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { parseDateTime, formatToDatetimeLocal } from '../../lib/utils';

export interface UseGanttBarDateDragParams {
  taskId: string;
  startStr?: string;
  endStr?: string;
  dayWidth: number;
  isEditMode?: boolean;
  onUpdateTaskDates?: (taskId: string, start: string, end: string) => void;
}

export function useGanttBarDateDrag({
  taskId,
  startStr,
  endStr,
  dayWidth,
  isEditMode = false,
  onUpdateTaskDates,
}: UseGanttBarDateDragParams) {
  const [isDraggingDate, setIsDraggingDate] = useState(false);
  const [dragType, setDragType] = useState<'move' | 'resize-start' | 'resize-end' | null>(null);
  const [deltaDays, setDeltaDays] = useState(0);
  const [previewStart, setPreviewStart] = useState(startStr || '');
  const [previewEnd, setPreviewEnd] = useState(endStr || '');

  const dragStartXRef = useRef(0);
  const initialDatesRef = useRef<{ start: Date; end: Date } | null>(null);

  const handleDragStart = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent | React.PointerEvent, type: 'move' | 'resize-start' | 'resize-end') => {
      if (!isEditMode) return;
      e.stopPropagation();

      const dStart = parseDateTime(startStr);
      const dEnd = parseDateTime(endStr);
      if (!dStart || !dEnd) return;

      setIsDraggingDate(true);
      setDragType(type);
      dragStartXRef.current = e.clientX;
      initialDatesRef.current = { start: new Date(dStart), end: new Date(dEnd) };
      setDeltaDays(0);
      setPreviewStart(startStr || '');
      setPreviewEnd(endStr || '');
    },
    [isEditMode, startStr, endStr]
  );

  const handleBarDragStart = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.PointerEvent) => handleDragStart(e, 'move');
  const handleLeftResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.PointerEvent) => handleDragStart(e, 'resize-start');
  const handleRightResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.PointerEvent) => handleDragStart(e, 'resize-end');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingDate) return;

    const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!initialDatesRef.current || !dragType) return;

      const diffX = e.clientX - dragStartXRef.current;
      const days = Math.round(diffX / dayWidth);
      setDeltaDays(days);

      const msPerDay = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      const newStart = new Date(initialDatesRef.current.start.getTime());
      const newEnd = new Date(initialDatesRef.current.end.getTime());

      if (dragType === 'move') {
        newStart.setTime(newStart.getTime() + days * msPerDay);
        newEnd.setTime(newEnd.getTime() + days * msPerDay);
      } else if (dragType === 'resize-start') {
        newStart.setTime(newStart.getTime() + days * msPerDay);
        if (newStart.getTime() > newEnd.getTime()) {
          newStart.setTime(newEnd.getTime());
        }
      } else if (dragType === 'resize-end') {
        newEnd.setTime(newEnd.getTime() + days * msPerDay);
        if (newEnd.getTime() < newStart.getTime()) {
          newEnd.setTime(newStart.getTime());
        }
      }

      setPreviewStart(formatToDatetimeLocal(newStart));
      setPreviewEnd(formatToDatetimeLocal(newEnd));
    };

    const handlePointerUp = () => {
      if (isDraggingDate && onUpdateTaskDates && (previewStart !== startStr || previewEnd !== endStr)) {
        onUpdateTaskDates(taskId, previewStart, previewEnd);
      }
      setIsDraggingDate(false);
      setDragType(null);
      initialDatesRef.current = null;
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingDate, dragType, dayWidth, taskId, onUpdateTaskDates, previewStart, previewEnd, startStr, endStr]);

  return {
    isDraggingDate,
    deltaDays,
    previewStart,
    previewEnd,
    handleBarDragStart,
    handleLeftResizeStart,
    handleRightResizeStart,
    handleDragEnd: () => setIsDraggingDate(false), // fallback
  };
}

export default useGanttBarDateDrag;


=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttBatchOps.ts ===
import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Task, Project, AppUser, TakaDeltaItem } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc, deleteField } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { safeGetItemSession, safeSetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';
import { recordBatchDeltas, recordDelta } from '../../lib/deltaSyncService';
import { deleteTaskStateUnified } from '../../lib/taskStateService';

interface UseGanttBatchOpsParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  paginatedProjects: Project[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  getGroupTasksForProject: (p: Project) => Task[];
  setConfirmModal: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
  }>>;
}

export function useGanttBatchOps({
  tasks,
  projects,
  paginatedProjects,
  currentUser,
  getGroupTasksForProject,
  setConfirmModal
}: UseGanttBatchOpsParams) {
  const [selectedTaskIds, setSelectedTaskIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const lastSelectedTaskIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedProjectIds, setSelectedProjectIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [sumMode, setSumMode] = useState<"none" | "duration">("none");
  const [isHighlightDelegationOn, setIsHighlightDelegationOn] = useState(false);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);

  // Modular task states
  const [isTaskModularModalOpen, setIsTaskModularModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [expandedModularTasks, setExpandedModularTasks] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded");
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
  });

  const selectedTaskSet = useMemo(() => new Set(selectedTaskIds), [selectedTaskIds]);
  const selectedProjectSet = useMemo(() => new Set(selectedProjectIds), [selectedProjectIds]);
  const expandedModularSet = useMemo(() => new Set(expandedModularTasks), [expandedModularTasks]);

  const toggleModularParent = useCallback((taskId: string | number) => {
    const idStr = String(taskId);
    setExpandedModularTasks(prev => {
      const next = prev.includes(idStr) ? prev.filter(id => id !== idStr) : [...prev, idStr];
      safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded", JSON.stringify(next));
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  // Hidden rows state
  const [hiddenRows, setHiddenRows] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_hidden_rows");
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
  });
  const [isHideMode, setIsHideMode] = useState(false);
  const hiddenRowsSet = useMemo(() => new Set(hiddenRows), [hiddenRows]);

  const toggleHideRow = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setHiddenRows(prev => {
      const next = prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter(r => r !== id) : [...prev, id];
      safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_hidden_rows", JSON.stringify(next));
      return next;
    });
  };

  const getRowVisibilityClass = (id: string) => {
    return hiddenRowsSet.has(id) ? (isHideMode ? "opacity-30 line-through" : "hidden") : "";
  };

  // Checkbox selection with Shift-range
  const isShiftHeldRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Shift') isShiftHeldRef.current = true;
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
        if (target && (target.tagName === 'INPUT' || target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || target.isContentEditable)) {
          return;
        }
        setSelectedTaskIds((prev) => (prev.length > 0 ? [] : prev));
        setSelectedProjectIds((prev) => (prev.length > 0 ? [] : prev));
      }
    };
    const onKeyUp = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Shift') isShiftHeldRef.current = false;
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleTaskCheckboxChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement> | React.MouseEvent, taskId: string, isShiftClick?: boolean, orderedTaskIds?: string[]) => {
      const isShift = isShiftClick !== undefined
        ? isShiftClick
        : Boolean((e.nativeEvent as MouseEvent)?.shiftKey ?? (e as React.MouseEvent).shiftKey ?? (window.event as any)?.shiftKey ?? isShiftHeldRef.current);
      const isChecked = 'checked' in e.target ? (e.target as HTMLInputElement).checked : true;
      const strTaskId = String(taskId);

      if (isChecked) {
        if (isShift && lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current && lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current !== strTaskId) {
          const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
          const candidateIds = orderedTaskIds && orderedTaskIds.length > 0 
            ? orderedTaskIds.map(String) 
            : currentTasks.map(t => String(t.id));
          let startIdx = candidateIds.indexOf(lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current);
          let endIdx = candidateIds.indexOf(strTaskId);
          let targetList = candidateIds;
          if (startIdx === -1 || endIdx === -1) {
            const allStoreIds = currentTasks.map(t => String(t.id));
            const sIdx = allStoreIds.indexOf(lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current);
            const eIdx = allStoreIds.indexOf(strTaskId);
            if (sIdx !== -1 && eIdx !== -1) {
              startIdx = sIdx;
              endIdx = eIdx;
              targetList = allStoreIds;
            }
          }
          if (startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1) {
            const range = targetList.slice(Math.min(startIdx, endIdx), Math.max(startIdx, endIdx) + 1);
            setSelectedTaskIds(prev => Array.from(new Set([...prev.map(String), ...range])));
          } else {
            setSelectedTaskIds(prev => Array.from(new Set([...prev.map(String), strTaskId])));
          }
        } else {
          setSelectedTaskIds(prev => Array.from(new Set([...prev.map(String), strTaskId])));
        }
        lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current = strTaskId;
      } else {
        if (isShift && lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current && lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current !== strTaskId) {
          const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
          const candidateIds = orderedTaskIds && orderedTaskIds.length > 0 
            ? orderedTaskIds.map(String) 
            : currentTasks.map(t => String(t.id));
          let startIdx = candidateIds.indexOf(lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current);
          let endIdx = candidateIds.indexOf(strTaskId);
          let targetList = candidateIds;
          if (startIdx === -1 || endIdx === -1) {
            const allStoreIds = currentTasks.map(t => String(t.id));
            const sIdx = allStoreIds.indexOf(lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current);
            const eIdx = allStoreIds.indexOf(strTaskId);
            if (sIdx !== -1 && eIdx !== -1) {
              startIdx = sIdx;
              endIdx = eIdx;
              targetList = allStoreIds;
            }
          }
          if (startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1) {
            const rangeSet = new Set(targetList.slice(Math.min(startIdx, endIdx), Math.max(startIdx, endIdx) + 1));
            setSelectedTaskIds(prev => prev.map(String).filter(id => !rangeSet.has(id)));
          } else {
            setSelectedTaskIds(prev => prev.map(String).filter(id => id !== strTaskId));
          }
        } else {
          setSelectedTaskIds(prev => prev.map(String).filter(id => id !== strTaskId));
        }
        lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current = strTaskId;
      }
    },
    []
  );

  // Group / Unlink modular tasks
  const handleGroupModularTasks = async (parentTaskId: string, childTaskIds: string[]) => {
    if (!parentTaskId || !childTaskIds || childTaskIds.length === 0) return;

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const prevTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
    const childIdSet = new Set(childTaskIds.map(String));
    const parentIdStr = String(parentTaskId);

    // 0ms Optimistic UI update
    const updatedTasks = prevTasks.map((t) => {
      const tIdStr = String(t.id);
      if (childIdSet.has(tIdStr)) {
        return { ...t, parentTaskId: parentIdStr, parentId: parentIdStr, updatedAt: now };
      }
      if (tIdStr === parentIdStr) {
        return { ...t, isModularParent: true, updatedAt: now };
      }
      return t;
    });
    useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);

    // Auto-expand the parent task in Gantt view so grouped subtasks appear immediately!
    setExpandedModularTasks(prev => {
      const nextSet = new Set(prev.map(String));
      nextSet.add(parentIdStr);
      return Array.from(nextSet);
    });

    setIsTaskModularModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedTaskIds([]);

    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    childTaskIds.forEach((id) => {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', String(id));
      batch.set(docRef, { parentTaskId: parentIdStr, parentId: parentIdStr, updatedAt: now }, { merge: true });
    });
    const parentDocRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', parentIdStr);
    batch.set(parentDocRef, { isModularParent: true, updatedAt: now }, { merge: true });

    // Update Dexie (IndexedDB)
    try {
      const { localDb } = await import('../../lib/localDb');
      await Promise.all([
        ...childTaskIds.map(id => (localDb.tasks.update as any)(String(id), { parentTaskId: parentIdStr, parentId: parentIdStr, updatedAt: now })),
        (localDb.tasks.update as any)(parentIdStr, { isModularParent: true, updatedAt: now })
      ]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[useGanttBatchOps] Dexie update on group failed:', e);
    }

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = [
        ...childTaskIds.map(id => {
          const t = prevTasks.find(item => String(item.id) === String(id));
          return {
            docId: String(id),
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
            action: 'update' as const,
            isPatch: true,
            data: { parentTaskId: parentIdStr, parentId: parentIdStr, updatedAt: now },
            year: t?.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
          };
        }),
        {
          docId: parentIdStr,
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
          action: 'update' as const,
          isPatch: true,
          data: { isModularParent: true, updatedAt: now },
        }
      ];
      recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Grouped ${childTaskIds.length} tasks under parent modular task.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[handleGroupModularTasks] Batch commit error:', err);
      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(prevTasks);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Error",
        message: "Failed to group tasks on server. Changes reverted."
      });
    }
  };

  const handleUnlinkModularTasks = async (childTaskIds?: string[]) => {
    const targetIds = childTaskIds && childTaskIds.length > 0 ? childTaskIds : selectedTaskIds;
    if (!targetIds || targetIds.length === 0) return;

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const prevTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
    const targetSet = new Set(targetIds.map(String));

    // Collect all task IDs that need unlinking:
    const parentCodeSet = new Set<string>();
    prevTasks.forEach(t => {
      if (targetSet.has(String(t.id)) && t.taskCodePhu) {
        parentCodeSet.add(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
      }
    });

    const allIdsToUnlink = new Set<string>();
    targetIds.forEach(id => allIdsToUnlink.add(String(id)));
    prevTasks.forEach(t => {
      const rawParent = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
      if (rawParent) {
        const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (targetSet.has(String(rawParent)) || parentCodeSet.has(rawStr)) {
          allIdsToUnlink.add(String(t.id));
        }
      }
    });

    const unlinkedArray = Array.from(allIdsToUnlink);

    // 0ms Optimistic UI update
    const updatedTasks = prevTasks.map((t) => {
      if (!allIdsToUnlink.has(String(t.id))) return t;
      const copy: any = { ...t, parentTaskId: undefined, parentId: undefined, updatedAt: now };
      delete copy.parentTask;
      delete copy.parentTaskCode;
      delete copy.parentCode;
      return copy as Task;
    });
    useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);
    setIsTaskModularModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedTaskIds([]);

    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    unlinkedArray.forEach((id) => {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', String(id));
      batch.set(docRef, { parentTaskId: deleteField(), parentId: null, updatedAt: now }, { merge: true });
    });

    // Update Dexie (IndexedDB)
    try {
      const { localDb } = await import('../../lib/localDb');
      await Promise.all(
        unlinkedArray.map(id => (localDb.tasks.update as any)(String(id), { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now }))
      );
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[useGanttBatchOps] Dexie update on unlink failed:', e);
    }

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = unlinkedArray.map(id => {
        const t = prevTasks.find(item => String(item.id) === String(id));
        return {
          docId: String(id),
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
          action: 'update' as const,
          isPatch: true,
          data: { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now },
          year: t?.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
        };
      });
      if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
      }
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Unlinked ${unlinkedArray.length} modular task(s).`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[handleUnlinkModularTasks] Batch commit error:', err);
      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(prevTasks);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Error",
        message: "Failed to unlink tasks on server. Changes reverted."
      });
    }
  };

  // Batch text color update
  const handleSetTextColor = async (color: string | null) => {
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
      batch.update(docRef, { textColor: color, updatedAt: now });
    });

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = selectedTaskIds.map(id => {
        const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
        return {
          docId: id,
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
          action: 'update',
          isPatch: true,
          data: { textColor: color, updatedAt: now },
          year: t?.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
        };
      });
      recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Updated text color for ${selectedTaskIds.length} tasks.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Batch baseline update
  const handleSetBaselineSelected = async () => {
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
      const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
      if (t && t.start && t.finish) {
        const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
        batch.update(docRef, {
          baselineStart: t.start,
          baselineFinish: t.finish,
          updatedAt: now
        });
      }
    });

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = [];
      selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
        const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
        if (t && t.start && t.finish) {
          deltaItems.push({
            docId: id,
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
            action: 'update',
            isPatch: true,
            data: { baselineStart: t.start, baselineFinish: t.finish, updatedAt: now },
            year: t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
          });
        }
      });
      if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
      }
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Saved baseline dates for selected tasks.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Batch realtime sync toggle
  const handleToggleRealtimeUpdate = async () => {
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
      const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
      if (t) {
        const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
        batch.update(docRef, {
          realtimeUpdate: !t.realtimeUpdate,
          updatedAt: now
        });
      }
    });

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = [];
      selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
        const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
        if (t) {
          deltaItems.push({
            docId: id,
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
            action: 'update',
            isPatch: true,
            data: { realtimeUpdate: !t.realtimeUpdate, updatedAt: now },
            year: t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
          });
        }
      });
      if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
      }
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Toggled realtime sync on selected tasks.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Toggle Pin project
  const handleTogglePin = async (p: Project) => {
    const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', p.id);
    try {
      await writeBatch(db).update(docRef, {
        isPinned: !p.isPinned,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      }).commit();
      recordDelta({
        docId: p.id,
        collectionName: 'taka_projects',
        action: 'update',
        isPatch: true,
        data: { isPinned: !p.isPinned, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() },
        year: p.year ? String(p.year) : undefined,
        updatedBy: currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username,
      }).catch(() => {});
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Batch delete selected tasks/projects
  const handleDeleteSelected = () => {
    const total = selectedTaskIds.length + selectedProjectIds.length;
    if (total === 0) return;

    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: "Delete Selected Items",
      message: `Are you sure you want to delete ${total} selected item(s)? This action cannot be undone.`,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
        const currentProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
        const deletedTaskIds = [...selectedTaskIds];
        const deletedProjectIds = [...selectedProjectIds];
        const taskSet = new Set(deletedTaskIds.map(String));
        const projSet = new Set(deletedProjectIds.map(String));

        // If any deleted task is a parent task, unlink its subtasks so they don't break
        const parentCodeSet = new Set<string>();
        currentTasks.forEach(t => {
          if (taskSet.has(String(t.id)) && t.taskCodePhu) {
            parentCodeSet.add(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
          }
        });

        const childrenToUnlink = currentTasks.filter(t => {
          if (taskSet.has(String(t.id))) return false; // will be deleted anyway
          const rawParent = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
          if (rawParent) {
            const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
            return taskSet.has(String(rawParent)) || parentCodeSet.has(rawStr);
          }
          return false;
        });

        // 1. Optimistic UI update (0ms)
        if (deletedTaskIds.length > 0) {
          deleteTaskStateUnified(deletedTaskIds).catch(() => {});
          if (childrenToUnlink.length > 0) {
            const unlinkedChildIds = new Set(childrenToUnlink.map(c => String(c.id)));
            const tasksAfterUnlink = useAppStore.getState().tasks.map(t => 
              unlinkedChildIds.has(String(t.id)) ? { ...t, parentTaskId: undefined, parentId: undefined, updatedAt: now } : t
            );
            useAppStore.getState().setTasks(tasksAfterUnlink);
          }
        }

        if (deletedProjectIds.length > 0) {
          const remainingProjects = currentProjects.filter(p => 
            !projSet.has(String(p.id)) && !projSet.has(String(p.no))
          );
          useAppStore.getState().setProjects(remainingProjects);
          try {
            const { localDb } = await import('../../lib/localDb');
            await localDb.projects.bulkDelete(deletedProjectIds);
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        if (childrenToUnlink.length > 0) {
          try {
            const { localDb } = await import('../../lib/localDb');
            await Promise.all(
              childrenToUnlink.map(c => (localDb.tasks.update as any)(c.id, { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now }))
            );
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        setSelectedTaskIds([]);
        setSelectedProjectIds([]);

        // 2. Commit batch to Firestore
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        deletedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
          const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
          batch.delete(docRef);
        });
        childrenToUnlink.forEach(child => {
          const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', child.id);
          batch.update(docRef, { parentTaskId: deleteField(), parentId: null, updatedAt: now });
        });
        deletedProjectIds.forEach(id => {
          const p = currentProjects.find(item => String(item.id) === id || String(item.no) === id);
          const docId = p?.id ? String(p.id) : id;
          const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId);
          batch.delete(docRef);
        });

        try {
          await batch.commit();
          const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = [
            ...deletedTaskIds.map(id => ({
              docId: id,
              collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
              action: 'delete' as const,
              isPatch: false,
              data: null
            })),
            ...childrenToUnlink.map(child => ({
              docId: child.id,
              collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
              action: 'update' as const,
              isPatch: true,
              data: { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now }
            })),
            ...deletedProjectIds.map(id => {
              const p = currentProjects.find(item => String(item.id) === id || String(item.no) === id);
              const docId = p?.id ? String(p.id) : id;
              return {
                docId,
                collectionName: 'taka_projects' as const,
                action: 'delete' as const,
                isPatch: false,
                data: null
              };
            })
          ];
          if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
            recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
          }

          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Success",
            message: `Deleted ${total} item(s).`
          });
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(err);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Error",
            message: "Failed to delete item(s) on server."
          });
        }
      }
    });
  };

  // Computed sum duration
  const computedSum = useMemo(() => {
    if (sumMode !== 'duration') return null;
    let sum = 0;
    selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
      const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
      if (t && t.duration) {
        sum += Number(t.duration) || 0;
      }
    });
    return sum;
  }, [sumMode, selectedTaskIds, tasks]);

  const isAllSelected = useMemo(() => {
    if (paginatedProjects.length === 0) return false;
    return paginatedProjects.every(p => {
      const pTasks = getGroupTasksForProject(p);
      return pTasks.length > 0 && pTasks.every(t => selectedTaskSet.has(t.id));
    });
  }, [paginatedProjects, getGroupTasksForProject, selectedTaskSet]);

  const handleToggleSelectAll = useCallback(() => {
    if (isAllSelected) {
      setSelectedTaskIds([]);
      setSelectedProjectIds([]);
    } else {
      const allIds: string[] = [];
      const projIds: string[] = [];
      paginatedProjects.forEach(p => {
        projIds.push(p.id || p.code);
        const pTasks = getGroupTasksForProject(p);
        pTasks.forEach(t => allIds.push(t.id));
      });
      setSelectedTaskIds(allIds);
      setSelectedProjectIds(projIds);
    }
  }, [isAllSelected, paginatedProjects, getGroupTasksForProject]);

  return {
    selectedTaskIds,
    setSelectedTaskIds,
    selectedProjectIds,
    setSelectedProjectIds,
    selectedTaskSet,
    selectedProjectSet,
    isAllSelected,
    handleToggleSelectAll,
    handleTaskCheckboxChange,
    handleDeleteSelected,
    handleSetTextColor,
    handleSetBaselineSelected,
    handleToggleRealtimeUpdate,
    handleTogglePin,
    handleGroupModularTasks,
    handleUnlinkModularTasks,
    isTaskModularModalOpen,
    setIsTaskModularModalOpen,
    expandedModularTasks,
    setExpandedModularTasks,
    expandedModularSet,
    toggleModularParent,
    sumMode,
    setSumMode,
    computedSum,
    isHighlightDelegationOn,
    setIsHighlightDelegationOn,
    isEditMode,
    setIsEditMode,
    isHideMode,
    setIsHideMode,
    hiddenRows,
    setHiddenRows,
    hiddenRowsSet,
    toggleHideRow,
    getRowVisibilityClass
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttColumnResize.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { safeGetDeviceItemLocal, safeSetDeviceItemLocal } from '../../lib/storage';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

export interface GanttColumnWidths {
  start: number;
  finish: number;
  party: number;
  duration: number;
  predecessor: number;
}

export const DEFAULT_GANTT_COL_WIDTHS: GanttColumnWidths = {
  start: 85,
  finish: 85,
  party: 80,
  duration: 60,
  predecessor: 90,
};

export function useGanttColumnResize() {
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  
  const [colWidths, setColWidths] = useState<GanttColumnWidths>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_col_widths', currentUser?.id);
      if (saved) {
        return { ...DEFAULT_GANTT_COL_WIDTHS, ...JSON.parse(saved) };
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return DEFAULT_GANTT_COL_WIDTHS;
  });

  const resizingColRef = useRef<{
    colKey: keyof GanttColumnWidths;
    startX: number;
    startWidth: number;
  } | null>(null);

  const startResizingColumn = useCallback((colKey: keyof GanttColumnWidths, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    const startX = e.clientX;
    const startWidth = colWidths[colKey] || DEFAULT_GANTT_COL_WIDTHS[colKey];
    resizingColRef.current = { colKey, startX, startWidth };

    const onMouseMove = (moveEvent: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!resizingColRef.current) return;
      const { colKey: key, startX: sX, startWidth: sW } = resizingColRef.current;
      const delta = moveEvent.clientX - sX;
      
      const minW = key === 'duration' ? 35 : 45;
      const maxW = 350;
      const newWidth = Math.max(minW, Math.min(maxW, Math.round(sW + delta)));

      setColWidths(prev => {
        return { ...prev, [key]: newWidth };
      });
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
      if (resizingColRef.current) {
        setColWidths(latest => {
          safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_col_widths', JSON.stringify(latest), currentUser?.id);
          return latest;
        });
        resizingColRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
  }, [colWidths, currentUser?.id]);

  return {
    colWidths,
    setColWidths,
    startResizingColumn,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttDependencies.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { DependencyLine, GanttTableRow } from './ganttTypes';
import { computeAllTaskCodes } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';

interface UseGanttDependenciesParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  delegationGroups: any[];
  visibleGanttRows?: GanttTableRow[];
  startDate?: Date;
  dayWidth?: number;
  sideWidth?: number;
  paddingTop?: number;
  showStart?: boolean;
  startColWidth?: number;
  showFinish?: boolean;
  finishColWidth?: number;
  showParty?: boolean;
  partyColWidth?: number;
  showDuration?: boolean;
  durationColWidth?: number;
  showPredecessor?: boolean;
  predecessorColWidth?: number;
}

function generateOrthogonalPath(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number): string {
  const r = 5;
  const minGap = 20;

  if (Math.abs(y1 - y2) < 1) {
    return `M ${x1} ${y1} L ${x2} ${y2}`;
  }

  const isDown = y2 > y1;
  const dy = isDown ? r : -r;

  if (x2 >= x1 + minGap) {
    const xMid = Math.round(x1 + Math.min(24, (x2 - x1) / 2));
    return [
      `M ${x1} ${y1}`,
      `L ${xMid - r} ${y1}`,
      `Q ${xMid} ${y1} ${xMid} ${y1 + dy}`,
      `L ${xMid} ${y2 - dy}`,
      `Q ${xMid} ${y2} ${xMid + r} ${y2}`,
      `L ${x2} ${y2}`,
    ].join(' ');
  }

  const marginOut = 14;
  const marginIn = 14;
  const yMid = Math.round(y1 + (y2 - y1) / 2);

  return [
    `M ${x1} ${y1}`,
    `L ${x1 + marginOut - r} ${y1}`,
    `Q ${x1 + marginOut} ${y1} ${x1 + marginOut} ${y1 + dy}`,
    `L ${x1 + marginOut} ${yMid - dy}`,
    `Q ${x1 + marginOut} ${yMid} ${x1 + marginOut - r} ${yMid}`,
    `L ${x2 - marginIn + r} ${yMid}`,
    `Q ${x2 - marginIn} ${yMid} ${x2 - marginIn} ${yMid + dy}`,
    `L ${x2 - marginIn} ${y2 - dy}`,
    `Q ${x2 - marginIn} ${y2} ${x2 - marginIn + r} ${y2}`,
    `L ${x2} ${y2}`,
  ].join(' ');
}

export function useGanttDependencies({
  tasks,
  projects,
  delegationGroups,
  visibleGanttRows = [],
  startDate,
  dayWidth = 24,
  sideWidth = 220,
  paddingTop = 0,
  showStart = false,
  startColWidth = 80,
  showFinish = false,
  finishColWidth = 80,
  showParty = false,
  partyColWidth = 70,
  showDuration = false,
  durationColWidth = 50,
  showPredecessor = false,
  predecessorColWidth = 90,
}: UseGanttDependenciesParams) {
  const [activeTooltip, setActiveTooltip] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const taskNoMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Task>();
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      if (t.taskCodePhu) {
        map.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toUpperCase(), t);
      }
      if (t.id) {
        map.set(String(t.id).trim().toUpperCase(), t);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [tasks]);

  const allCodesMap = useMemo(() => {
    return computeAllTaskCodes(projects, tasks);
  }, [projects, tasks]);

  const taskCodeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Task>();
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      const code = allCodesMap.get(t.id);
      if (code) {
        map.set(code.trim().toUpperCase(), t);
      }
      if (t.taskCodePhu) {
        map.set(t.taskCodePhu.trim().toUpperCase(), t);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [tasks, allCodesMap]);

  const delegationGroupByTaskId = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, any>();
    delegationGroups.forEach(g => {
      if (g.subTasks) {
        g.subTasks.forEach((st: any) => {
          if (st.taskId) {
            map.set(st.taskId, g);
          }
        });
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [delegationGroups]);

  const dependencyLines = useMemo(() => {
    if (!startDate || visibleGanttRows.length === 0) return [];

    const taskPosMap = new Map<string, { xStart: number; xEnd: number; yCenter: number; t: Task }>();
    let currentY = paddingTop;
    const timelineLeft = sideWidth + (showStart ? startColWidth : 0) + (showFinish ? finishColWidth : 0) + (showParty ? partyColWidth : 0) + (showDuration ? durationColWidth : 0) + (showPredecessor ? predecessorColWidth : 0);

    visibleGanttRows.forEach((row) => {
      const rowHeight = row.type === 'project' ? 40 : 36;
      const yCenter = currentY + rowHeight / 2;
      currentY += rowHeight;

      if (row.type === 'task' && row.task) {
        const t = row.task;
        const dStart = t.start ? parseDateTime(t.start) : null;
        const dEnd = t.finish ? parseDateTime(t.finish) : null;
        if (dStart && dEnd) {
          const startDays = (dStart.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
          const endDays = (dEnd.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) + 1;
          const xStart = timelineLeft + Math.max(0, startDays * dayWidth);
          const xEnd = timelineLeft + Math.max(0, endDays * dayWidth);

          const posObj = { xStart, xEnd, yCenter, t };
          taskPosMap.set(t.id, posObj);
          if (t.taskCodePhu) {
            taskPosMap.set(t.taskCodePhu.trim().toUpperCase(), posObj);
          }
          const computedCode = allCodesMap.get(t.id);
          if (computedCode) {
            taskPosMap.set(computedCode.trim().toUpperCase(), posObj);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    const lines: DependencyLine[] = [];

    visibleGanttRows.forEach((row) => {
      if (row.type !== 'task' || !row.task) return;
      const succTask = row.task;
      if (!succTask.predecessor) return;

      const succPos = taskPosMap.get(succTask.id);
      if (!succPos) return;

      const predCodes = String(succTask.predecessor)
        .split(/[,;]/)
        .map((s) => s.trim().toUpperCase())
        .filter(Boolean);

      predCodes.forEach((code) => {
        const predPos = taskPosMap.get(code);
        if (!predPos) return;

        const x1 = predPos.xEnd;
        const y1 = predPos.yCenter;
        const x2 = succPos.xStart;
        const y2 = succPos.yCenter;

        const d = generateOrthogonalPath(x1, y1, x2, y2);

        lines.push({
          id: `${predPos.t.id}->${succTask.id}`,
          d,
          fromTaskId: predPos.t.id,
          toTaskId: succTask.id,
          fromTaskCode: predPos.t.taskCodePhu || allCodesMap.get(predPos.t.id) || "",
          fromTaskName: predPos.t.name,
          toTaskCode: succTask.taskCodePhu || allCodesMap.get(succTask.id) || "",
          toTaskName: succTask.name,
          color: '#2563eb',
        });
      });
    });

    return lines;
  }, [
    visibleGanttRows,
    startDate,
    dayWidth,
    sideWidth,
    paddingTop,
    showStart,
    startColWidth,
    showFinish,
    finishColWidth,
    showParty,
    partyColWidth,
    showDuration,
    durationColWidth,
    showPredecessor,
    predecessorColWidth,
    projects,
    tasks,
  ]);

  return {
    activeTooltip,
    setActiveTooltip,
    dependencyLines,
    taskNoMap,
    taskCodeMap,
    delegationGroupByTaskId,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttDragReorder.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { 
  buildTaskNoMap, 
  getPredecessorCodeUpdates, 
  updatePredecessorsStrings, 
  healAllTasksPredecessors 
} from '../../lib/ganttUtils';

interface UseGanttDragReorderParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  mainScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
}

export function useGanttDragReorder({
  tasks,
  projects,
  mainScrollRef
}: UseGanttDragReorderParams) {
  const [dragOverTaskId, setDragOverTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dropPosition, setDropPosition] = useState<'before' | 'after' | null>(null);
  const [draggingTaskIds, setDraggingTaskIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const dragScrollInterval = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const dragMouseY = useRef<number>(0);

  const startDragAutoScroll = useCallback(() => {
    if (dragScrollInterval.current) return;
    dragScrollInterval.current = setInterval(() => {
      const container = mainScrollRef.current;
      if (!container) return;
      const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      const y = dragMouseY.current;
      const threshold = 60;
      const maxSpeed = 15;

      if (y < rect.top + threshold && y > rect.top - 50) {
        const factor = Math.max(0, (rect.top + threshold - y) / threshold);
        container.scrollTop -= Math.round(maxSpeed * factor);
      } else if (y > rect.bottom - threshold && y < rect.bottom + 50) {
        const factor = Math.max(0, (y - (rect.bottom - threshold)) / threshold);
        container.scrollTop += Math.round(maxSpeed * factor);
      }
    }, 16);
  }, [mainScrollRef]);

  const stopDragAutoScroll = useCallback(() => {
    if (dragScrollInterval.current) {
      clearInterval(dragScrollInterval.current);
      dragScrollInterval.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      stopDragAutoScroll();
    };
  }, [stopDragAutoScroll]);

  const handleTaskDragStart = (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const targetTask = tasks.find(t => String(t.id) === String(taskId));
    const isParentTask = targetTask && (
      Boolean((targetTask as any).isModularParent) ||
      tasks.some(other => {
        const rawParent = other.parentTaskId || (other as any).parentId;
        if (!rawParent) return false;
        const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
        return String(rawParent) === String(targetTask.id) ||
          (targetTask.taskCodePhu && rawStr === String(targetTask.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
      })
    );
    if (isParentTask) {
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    setDraggingTaskIds([taskId]);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', taskId);
    startDragAutoScroll();
  };

  const handleTaskDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    dragMouseY.current = e.clientY;

    if (draggingTaskIds.includes(taskId)) return;

    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const relativeY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const isTopHalf = relativeY < rect.height / 2;
    const pos = isTopHalf ? 'before' : 'after';

    if (dragOverTaskId !== taskId || dropPosition !== pos) {
      setDragOverTaskId(taskId);
      setDropPosition(pos);
    }
  };

  const handleContainerDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    dragMouseY.current = e.clientY;
  };

  const handleTaskDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => {
    if (e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node)) return;
    if (dragOverTaskId === taskId) {
      setDragOverTaskId(null);
      setDropPosition(null);
    }
  };

  const handleTaskDragEnd = () => {
    setDraggingTaskIds([]);
    setDragOverTaskId(null);
    setDropPosition(null);
    stopDragAutoScroll();
  };

  const handleTaskDrop = async (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, parentProject?: Project) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    stopDragAutoScroll();

    const draggedId = draggingTaskIds[0] || e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    if (!draggedId || draggedId === targetTask.id) {
      handleTaskDragEnd();
      return;
    }

    const draggedTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === draggedId);
    if (!draggedTask) {
      handleTaskDragEnd();
      return;
    }

    // Reorder inside the same project & parent group
    const pCode = targetTask.projectCode || draggedTask.projectCode;

    // Check if draggedTask is a parent task (has child tasks in the store)
    const childTasksOfDragged = tasks.filter(t => {
      if (!t || t.id === draggedTask.id) return false;
      const rawPId = String(t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId || '').trim();
      if (!rawPId) return false;
      return (
        rawPId === String(draggedTask.id) ||
        (draggedTask.taskCodePhu && rawPId.toLowerCase() === String(draggedTask.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase())
      );
    });
    const isParentTask = childTasksOfDragged.length > 0;

    // Determine targetParentId:
    // 1) If draggedTask is a parent task (task gộp cha), force targetParentId to null (root level).
    // 2) If draggedTask is a child task, check if targetTask is a parent task or subtask.
    let targetParentId: string | null = null;
    if (isParentTask) {
      targetParentId = null;
    } else {
      const targetIsParent = tasks.some(t => {
        if (!t || t.id === targetTask.id) return false;
        const rawPId = String(t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId || '').trim();
        return rawPId === String(targetTask.id) || (targetTask.taskCodePhu && rawPId.toLowerCase() === String(targetTask.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
      });

      if (targetIsParent && !targetTask.parentTaskId && !(targetTask as any).parentId) {
        // Dropped onto a parent task -> attach as child of targetTask
        targetParentId = targetTask.id;
      } else {
        // Otherwise match targetTask's parentTaskId
        targetParentId = targetTask.parentTaskId || (targetTask as any).parentId || null;
      }
    }

    // Sibling tasks (either root tasks of the project or child tasks of the same parent)
    const siblingTasks = tasks
      .filter(t => 
        (t.projectCode || '') === (pCode || '') && 
        (t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId || null) === targetParentId
      )
      .sort((a, b) => (a.orderIndex !== undefined ? a.orderIndex : ((a as any).order || 0)) - (b.orderIndex !== undefined ? b.orderIndex : ((b as any).order || 0)));

    const cleanList = siblingTasks.filter(t => t.id !== draggedTask.id);
    const targetIdx = cleanList.findIndex(t => t.id === targetTask.id);
    const insertIdx = targetIdx === -1 ? cleanList.length : (dropPosition === 'before' ? targetIdx : targetIdx + 1);

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const movedTask: Task = {
      ...draggedTask,
      parentTaskId: targetParentId || undefined,
      updatedAt: nowIso
    };
    if (targetParentId) {
      (movedTask as any).parentId = targetParentId;
    } else {
      delete (movedTask as any).parentId;
    }
    cleanList.splice(insertIdx, 0, movedTask);

    const oldTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);

    const reorderedWithOrder = cleanList.map((t, idx) => {
      const pCodeVal = t.projectCode || '';
      const newCode = pCodeVal ? `${pCodeVal}#${idx + 1}` : (t.taskCodePhu || '');
      return {
        ...t,
        orderIndex: idx,
        order: (idx + 1) * 10,
        taskCodePhu: newCode || t.taskCodePhu,
        updatedAt: nowIso
      };
    });

    const updatesMap = new Map<string, Task>();
    reorderedWithOrder.forEach(t => updatesMap.set(t.id, t));

    // Preserve parent-child relationships: ensure all child tasks point to parent's canonical ID
    const parentCodeToIdMap = new Map<string, string>();
    reorderedWithOrder.forEach(pt => {
      parentCodeToIdMap.set(pt.id, pt.id);
      if (pt.taskCodePhu) parentCodeToIdMap.set(pt.taskCodePhu.trim().toLowerCase(), pt.id);
    });

    let allUpdatedTasks = tasks.map(t => {
      const updatedSibling = updatesMap.get(t.id);
      if (updatedSibling) return updatedSibling;

      // Check if this task is a child of any reordered parent task
      const rawPId = String(t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId || '').trim();
      if (rawPId) {
        const canonicalParentId = parentCodeToIdMap.get(rawPId) || parentCodeToIdMap.get(rawPId.toLowerCase());
        if (canonicalParentId && (t.parentTaskId !== canonicalParentId || (t as any).parentId !== canonicalParentId)) {
          const res = {
            ...t,
            parentTaskId: canonicalParentId,
            updatedAt: nowIso
          };
          (res as any).parentId = canonicalParentId;
          return res;
        }
      }
      return t;
    });
    const newTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, allUpdatedTasks);
    const oldCodeToNewCode = getPredecessorCodeUpdates(oldTaskNoMap, newTaskNoMap, projects, allUpdatedTasks);
    const predUpdates = updatePredecessorsStrings(oldCodeToNewCode, allUpdatedTasks, projects, oldTaskNoMap);

    if (predUpdates.length > 0) {
      const predMap = new Map(predUpdates.map(pu => [pu.id, pu]));
      allUpdatedTasks = allUpdatedTasks.map(t => {
        const pu = predMap.get(t.id);
        return pu ? { ...t, predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt } : t;
      });
    }

    const healed = healAllTasksPredecessors(allUpdatedTasks, projects);
    if (healed.changedCount > 0) {
      allUpdatedTasks = healed.updatedTasks;
    }

    // 0ms Optimistic UI update in Zustand
    useAppStore.getState().optimisticUpdateTasks(allUpdatedTasks);

    // Save to Firestore in batch with dirty-checking to eliminate redundant writes
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    let writeCount = 0;

    allUpdatedTasks.forEach(t => {
      const orig = tasks.find(o => o.id === t.id);
      
      // Dirty check: Only write to Firestore if fields actually changed
      const isNew = !orig;
      const orderChanged = orig ? (orig as any).order !== (t as any).order : true;
      const orderIndexChanged = orig ? orig.orderIndex !== t.orderIndex : true;
      const codeChanged = orig ? orig.taskCodePhu !== t.taskCodePhu : true;
      const predChanged = orig ? orig.predecessor !== t.predecessor : true;
      const parentChanged = orig ? (orig.parentTaskId || null) !== (t.parentTaskId || null) : true;

      if (isNew || orderChanged || orderIndexChanged || codeChanged || predChanged || parentChanged) {
        const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id);
        batch.update(docRef, {
          order: (t as any).order,
          orderIndex: t.orderIndex,
          taskCodePhu: t.taskCodePhu,
          predecessor: t.predecessor,
          parentTaskId: t.parentTaskId || null,
          parentId: t.parentTaskId || null,
          updatedAt: t.updatedAt
        });
        writeCount++;
      }
    });

    if (writeCount > 0) {
      try {
        await batch.commit();
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Success",
          message: `Reordered task ${draggedTask.name}`
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Task reorder error:", err);
      }
    }

    handleTaskDragEnd();
  };

  return {
    dragOverTaskId,
    dropPosition,
    draggingTaskIds,
    handleTaskDragStart,
    handleTaskDragOver,
    handleContainerDragOver,
    handleTaskDragLeave,
    handleTaskDragEnd,
    handleTaskDrop
  };
}

import React, { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface UseGanttExportParams {
  tableRef: React.RefObject<HTMLTableElement | HTMLDivElement | null>;
}

export function useGanttExport({ tableRef }: UseGanttExportParams) {
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState(false);

  const handleExportToPDF = async () => {
    const el = tableRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    setIsExporting(true);
    useAppStore.getState().setToast({
      title: "Exporting PDF",
      message: "Rendering high-resolution vector layout..."
    });

    try {
      const html2canvas = (await import('html2canvas')).default;
      const { jsPDF } = await import('jspdf');

      const canvas = await html2canvas(el as HTMLElement, {
        scale: 2,
        useCORS: true,
        logging: false,
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff'
      });

      const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      const pdf = new jsPDF({
        orientation: 'landscape',
        unit: 'px',
        format: [canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2]
      });

      pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, 0, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
      pdf.save(`taka_gantt_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.pdf`);

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: "Gantt chart exported to PDF."
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("PDF export error:", err);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Export Error",
        message: "Failed to export PDF.",
        type: "error"
      });
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportToPNG = useCallback(async () => {
    const el = tableRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const html2canvas = (await import('html2canvas')).default;
      const canvas = await html2canvas(el as HTMLElement, {
        scale: 2,
        useCORS: true,
        logging: false,
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff'
      });

      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.download = `taka_gantt_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.png`;
      link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      link.click();

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: "Gantt chart exported to PNG."
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("PNG export error:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  }, [tableRef]);

  return {
    isExporting,
    isPrinting,
    setIsPrinting,
    handleExportToPDF,
    handleExportToPNG
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttFocus.ts ===
import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { safeSetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';

export interface UseGanttFocusParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  initialFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  ganttTabFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  setGanttTabFocusTaskId: (id: string | null) => void;
  setExpandedModularTasks: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  mainScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  topScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  startDate: Date;
  dayWidth: number;
  sideWidth: number;
  onClearFocus?: () => void;
}

export function useGanttFocus({
  tasks,
  projects,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  ganttTabFocusTaskId,
  setGanttTabFocusTaskId,
  setExpandedModularTasks,
  mainScrollRef,
  topScrollRef,
  startDate,
  dayWidth,
  sideWidth,
  onClearFocus,
}: UseGanttFocusParams) {
  const activeFocusId = ganttTabFocusTaskId || initialFocusTaskId || null;

  const focusedTask = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeFocusId || !tasks || tasks.length === 0) return null;
    const cleanId = String(activeFocusId).replace('task-', '').trim();
    return tasks.find(t => String(t.id) === cleanId) || null;
  }, [activeFocusId, tasks]);

  const focusedProject = useMemo(() => {
    if (!focusedTask || !projects || projects.length === 0) return null;
    return projects.find(
      p => (p.id && String(p.id) === String(focusedTask.projectId)) ||
           (p.code && focusedTask.projectCode && p.code.trim().toUpperCase() === focusedTask.projectCode.trim().toUpperCase())
    ) || null;
  }, [focusedTask, projects]);

  const lastFocusedIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Clear focus helper
  const handleClearFocus = useCallback(() => {
    setGanttTabFocusTaskId(null);
    useAppStore.getState().setGanttTabFilterProjectId('');
    if (onClearFocus) onClearFocus();
  }, [setGanttTabFocusTaskId, onClearFocus]);

  // Locate task: smoothly scroll horizontally to task bar and vertically to task row
  const locateTask = useCallback(() => {
    if (!focusedTask || !mainScrollRef.current) return;
    const scrollContainer = mainScrollRef.current;

    // 1. Horizontal Timeline centering
    const dStart = parseDateTime(focusedTask.start);
    const dFinish = parseDateTime(focusedTask.finish);

    let targetScrollLeft = scrollContainer.scrollLeft;
    if (dStart && startDate) {
      const diffMs = dStart.getTime() - startDate.getTime();
      const diffDays = diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
      const taskLeftPx = diffDays * dayWidth;
      const durationDays = dFinish ? Math.max(1, (dFinish.getTime() - dStart.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) : 1;
      const taskCenterPx = taskLeftPx + (durationDays * dayWidth) / 2;
      const visibleTimelineWidth = Math.max(150, scrollContainer.clientWidth - sideWidth);
      targetScrollLeft = Math.max(0, taskCenterPx - visibleTimelineWidth / 2);
    }

    // 2. Vertical Row centering
    const rowEl = document.getElementById(`gantt-task-row-${focusedTask.id}`);
    let targetScrollTop = scrollContainer.scrollTop;
    if (rowEl) {
      const containerRect = scrollContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
      const rowRect = rowEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const currentTopOffset = rowRect.top - containerRect.top;
      targetScrollTop = scrollContainer.scrollTop + currentTopOffset - (containerRect.height / 2) + (rowRect.height / 2);
    }

    scrollContainer.scrollTo({
      left: targetScrollLeft,
      top: Math.max(0, targetScrollTop),
      behavior: 'smooth'
    });

    if (topScrollRef.current) {
      topScrollRef.current.scrollTo({
        left: targetScrollLeft,
        behavior: 'smooth'
      });
    }
  }, [focusedTask, startDate, dayWidth, sideWidth, mainScrollRef, topScrollRef]);

  // Auto-Reveal & Auto-Center when activeFocusId changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeFocusId || !focusedTask) return;

    // Only trigger full auto-reveal on new focus selection
    const isNewFocus = lastFocusedIdRef.current !== activeFocusId;
    lastFocusedIdRef.current = activeFocusId;

    if (!isNewFocus) return;

    // A. Auto-reveal parent project
    const pId = focusedProject?.id || (focusedTask.projectId ? String(focusedTask.projectId) : null);
    if (pId) {
      const currentExpandedProjects = useAppStore.getState().expandedProjectIds;
      if (!currentExpandedProjects.includes(pId)) {
        useAppStore.getState().setExpandedProjectIds([...currentExpandedProjects, pId]);
      }
    }

    // B. Auto-reveal parent modular task (if child task)
    if (focusedTask.parentTaskId) {
      const ancestorIds: string[] = [];
      let curParentId: any = focusedTask.parentTaskId;
      const visited = new Set<string>();

      while (curParentId && !visited.has(String(curParentId))) {
        const parentIdStr = String(curParentId);
        visited.add(parentIdStr);
        ancestorIds.push(parentIdStr);
        const parent = tasks.find(
          t => String(t.id) === parentIdStr ||
               (t.taskCodePhu && String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() === parentIdStr.toLowerCase())
        );
        curParentId = parent?.parentTaskId;
      }

      if (ancestorIds.length > 0) {
        setExpandedModularTasks(prev => {
          const next = Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...ancestorIds]));
          safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded", JSON.stringify(next));
          return next;
        });
      }
    }

    // C. Auto-center with cascading timeouts to allow DOM & virtualization to mount row
    const timer1 = setTimeout(() => {
      locateTask();
    }, 120);

    const timer2 = setTimeout(() => {
      locateTask();
    }, 320);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer1);
      clearTimeout(timer2);
    };
  }, [activeFocusId, focusedTask, focusedProject, tasks, setExpandedModularTasks, locateTask]);

  // Global Escape keyboard shortcut to exit Focus Mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeFocusId) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleClearFocus();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [activeFocusId, handleClearFocus]);

  return {
    activeFocusId,
    focusedTask,
    focusedProject,
    locateTask,
    handleClearFocus,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttLayoutState.ts ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  safeGetDeviceItemLocal,
  safeSetDeviceItemLocal,
  getDeviceScreenType,
} from '../../lib/storage';

export function useGanttLayoutState(currentUserId?: string) {
  const [filterStartDate, setFilterStartDate] = useState('');
  const [filterEndDate, setFilterEndDate] = useState('');
  const [tempStartDate, setTempStartDate] = useState('');
  const [tempEndDate, setTempEndDate] = useState('');

  const [sideWidth, setSideWidth] = useState<number>(() => {
    const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768;
    if (isMobile) {
      const savedMobile = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_side_width', currentUserId);
      return savedMobile
        ? Math.max(140, Math.min(260, Number(savedMobile)))
        : Math.max(160, Math.min(220, Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.52)));
    }
    const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_side_width', currentUserId);
    return saved ? Math.max(180, Math.min(600, Number(saved))) : 360;
  });

  const [visibleColumns, setVisibleColumns] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_visible_columns', currentUserId);
    if (saved) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(saved);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768;
    return isMobile ? ['start', 'finish'] : ['start', 'finish', 'party', 'duration'];
  });

  const prevScreenTypeRef = useRef(getDeviceScreenType());

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      const currentScreenType = getDeviceScreenType();
      if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
        const maxMobileWidth = Math.max(
          160,
          Math.min(220, Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.52))
        );
        setSideWidth((prev) => Math.min(prev, maxMobileWidth));
      }

      if (currentScreenType !== prevScreenTypeRef.current) {
        prevScreenTypeRef.current = currentScreenType;
        const savedCols = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_visible_columns', currentUserId);
        if (savedCols) {
          try {
            setVisibleColumns(JSON.parse(savedCols));
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        const savedSide = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_side_width', currentUserId);
        if (savedSide) {
          setSideWidth(Number(savedSide));
        }
      }
    };
    handleResize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, [currentUserId]);

  const handleToggleColumn = (colId: string) => {
    setVisibleColumns((prev) => {
      const next = prev.includes(colId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== colId) : [...prev, colId];
      safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_visible_columns', JSON.stringify(next), currentUserId);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return {
    filterStartDate,
    setFilterStartDate,
    filterEndDate,
    setFilterEndDate,
    tempStartDate,
    setTempStartDate,
    tempEndDate,
    setTempEndDate,
    sideWidth,
    setSideWidth,
    visibleColumns,
    handleToggleColumn,
  };
}
