interface UseGeneralDataParams {
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
}

const statusWeight: Record<string, number> = {
  'On process': 1,
  'Upcoming': 2,
  'Completed': 3,
  'Handover': 4,
  'Canceled': 5
};

export function useGeneralData({
  projects,
  tasks,
  currentUser
}: UseGeneralDataParams) {
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setGlobalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalYearFilter);
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const setGlobalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalStoreFilter);
  const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
  const globalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalLocationFilter);
  const setGlobalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalLocationFilter);
  const pinnedProjects = useAppStore(state => state.pinnedProjects);
  const setPinnedProjects = useAppStore(state => state.setPinnedProjects);
  const theme = useAppStore(state => state.theme);

  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const deferredSearchTerm = useDeferredValue(searchTerm);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState(() => safeGetItemSession("taka_general_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days');
  const lastSelectedStatusFilterRef = useRef<string>(safeGetItemSession("taka_general_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days');
  const lastSelectedLocationFilterRef = useRef<string[]>(globalLocationFilter);
  const wasSearchingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  const [flashToggle, setFlashToggle] = useState(true);
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState<SortConfig | null>(null);
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(20);

  // Status and Location Filter Preservation when Searching
  useEffect(() => {
    const isSearching = !!deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!wasSearchingRef.current && isSearching) {
      if (statusFilter !== 'all') {
        lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current = statusFilter;
        safeSetItemSession("taka_general_status_filter", statusFilter);
      }
      lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current = globalLocationFilter;
      setStatusFilter('all');
      wasSearchingRef.current = true;
    } else if (wasSearchingRef.current && !isSearching) {
      const restored = lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current || safeGetItemSession("taka_general_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days';
      setStatusFilter(restored);
      setGlobalLocationFilter(lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current || []);
      wasSearchingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [deferredSearchTerm]);

  // Auto-jump to matched project location(s) when searching (Debounced)
  useEffect(() => {
    const term = deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!term) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const matchedProjects = projects.filter(p => {
        const status = getStatus(p.computedTakStart, p.computedTakCompl, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
        const searchFields = [p.no, p.store, p.code, p.linkCodes, p.name, p.detail, (p as any).description, p.note, p.party, status, p.year];
        const matchesSearch = matchesAdvancedSearch(term, searchFields);
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year) : (p.computedTakStart ? String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : null);
        const matchesYear = globalYearFilter === 'all' || pYear === globalYearFilter;
        const matchesStore = effectiveStore === 'all' || p.store === effectiveStore;
        return matchesSearch && matchesYear && matchesStore;
      });
      const matchedLocations = Array.from(
        new Set(matchedProjects.map(p => p.location).filter((loc): loc is string => !!loc && loc.trim() !== ''))
      );
      if (matchedLocations.length > 0) {
        const currentLocs = globalLocationFilter || [];
        const isSame = currentLocs.length === matchedLocations.length && currentLocs.every(l => matchedLocations.includes(l));
        if (!isSame) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter(matchedLocations);
        }
      }
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [deferredSearchTerm, projects, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  // Handle Escape key globally to clear search when not in modal
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && searchTerm) {
        const state = useAppStore.getState();
        const hasOpenModal =
          state.isProjectModalOpen ||
          state.isTaskModalOpen ||
          state.isUserModalOpen ||
          state.isLoginModalOpen ||
          state.isCalendarSyncModalOpen;
        if (hasOpenModal) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const activeElement = document.activeElement;
        if (activeElement && typeof (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur === "function") {
          (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur();
        }
        setSearchTerm("");
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [searchTerm]);

  const years = useMemo(() => {
    const projYears = projects.map(p => {
      if (p.year) return String(p.year);
      if (p.computedTakStart) return String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4);
      return null;
    }).filter(Boolean) as string[];
    const taskYears = tasks.map(t => {
      if (t.projectYear) return String(t.projectYear);
      if (t.start) return String(t.start).substring(0, 4);
      return null;
    }).filter(Boolean) as string[];
    const baseYears = ['2026', '2027'];
    const unique = Array.from(new Set([...projYears, ...taskYears, ...baseYears])).filter(Boolean).sort();
    return unique.length > 0 ? unique : ['2026', '2027'];
  }, [projects, tasks, currentUser?.role]);

  const allowedStores = useMemo(() => getUserAllowedStores(currentUser), [currentUser]);
  const stores = allowedStores;
  const locationOptions = useLocationOptions();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (locationOptions.length > 0 && globalLocationFilter.length > 0) {
      const valid = globalLocationFilter.filter(loc => locationOptions.includes(loc));
      if (valid.length !== globalLocationFilter.length) {
        setGlobalLocationFilter(valid);
      }
    }
  }, [locationOptions, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  const filteredProjects = useMemo(() => {
    // Pre-calculate project dates & status once (O(N)) to eliminate O(N log N) recalculations during sorting
    const infoMap = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof getProjectDatesAndStatus>>();
    projects.forEach(p => {
      const pKey = p.id || p.code || String(p.no || '');
      infoMap.set(pKey, getProjectDatesAndStatus(p, tasks));
    });

    const getMemoizedInfo = (p: Project) => {
      const pKey = p.id || p.code || String(p.no || '');
      return infoMap.get(pKey) || getProjectDatesAndStatus(p, tasks);
    };

    return projects.filter(p => {
      const { computedTakStart, computedTakCompl, computedOpening, status } = getMemoizedInfo(p);
      const searchFields = [p.no, p.store, p.code, p.linkCodes, p.name, p.detail, (p as any).description, p.note, p.party, status, p.year];
      const matchesSearch = matchesAdvancedSearch(deferredSearchTerm, searchFields);
      const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (computedTakStart ? String(computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : null));
      const matchesYear = globalYearFilter === 'all' || (pYear !== null && pYear === String(globalYearFilter).trim());
      const matchesStore = effectiveStore === 'all' || (Boolean(p.store) && String(p.store).toUpperCase().trim() === effectiveStore.toUpperCase().trim());
      const matchesLocation = globalLocationFilter.length === 0 || (p.location && globalLocationFilter.includes(p.location));

      const matchesStatus = matchProjectStatusFilter(status, statusFilter, computedTakStart);

      return matchesSearch && matchesYear && matchesStore && matchesLocation && matchesStatus;
    }).sort((a, b) => {
      const isPinnedA = a.id && pinnedProjects.includes(a.id);
      const isPinnedB = b.id && pinnedProjects.includes(b.id);
      
      if (isPinnedA !== isPinnedB) {
        return isPinnedA ? -1 : 1;
      }
      if (isPinnedA && isPinnedB) {
        const orderA = pinnedProjects.indexOf(a.id as string);
        const orderB = pinnedProjects.indexOf(b.id as string);
        if (orderA !== orderB) return orderA - orderB;
      }

      const infoA = getMemoizedInfo(a);
      const infoB = getMemoizedInfo(b);

      if (sortConfig) {
        let valA = '';
        let valB = '';
        if (sortConfig.key === 'start') {
          valA = infoA.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
          valB = infoB.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'handover') {
          valA = infoA.computedTakCompl || '9999-12-31';
          valB = infoB.computedTakCompl || '9999-12-31';
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'opening') {
          valA = infoA.computedOpening || a.opening || '9999-12-31';
          valB = infoB.computedOpening || b.opening || '9999-12-31';
        }
        
        if (valA < valB) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        if (valA > valB) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        return 0;
      }

      const statusA = infoA.status;
      const statusB = infoB.status;
      
      const weightA = statusWeight[statusA] || 99;
      const weightB = statusWeight[statusB] || 99;
      if (weightA !== weightB) {
        return weightA - weightB;
      }

      // Special sorting for 'On process' : prioritize finish date proximity to today
      if (statusA === 'On process') {
        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        
        const finishA = parseDateTime(a.computedTakCompl || a.handover || a.computedOpening || a.opening);
        const finishB = parseDateTime(b.computedTakCompl || b.handover || b.computedOpening || b.opening);
        
        if (finishA && finishB) {
          const diffA = Math.abs(finishA.getTime() - today.getTime());
          const diffB = Math.abs(finishB.getTime() - today.getTime());
          if (diffA !== diffB) {
            return diffA - diffB;
          }
        } else if (finishA) {
          return -1;
        } else if (finishB) {
          return 1;
        }
      }

      const startA = a.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
      const startB = b.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
      if (startA !== startB) {
        return startA.localeCompare(startB);
      }

      const complA = a.computedTakCompl || '9999-12-31';
      const complB = b.computedTakCompl || '9999-12-31';
      if (complA !== complB) {
        return complA.localeCompare(complB);
      }

      const openA = a.computedOpening || a.opening || '9999-12-31';
      const openB = b.computedOpening || b.opening || '9999-12-31';
      if (openA !== openB) {
        return openA.localeCompare(openB);
      }
      
      return a.code.localeCompare(b.code) || String(a.year || '').localeCompare(String(b.year || ''));
    });
  }, [projects, tasks, deferredSearchTerm, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter, statusFilter, pinnedProjects, sortConfig]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => setFlashToggle(prev => !prev), 600);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const paginatedProjects = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjects.slice(0, visibleCount);
  }, [filteredProjects, visibleCount]);

  return {
    globalYearFilter,
    setGlobalYearFilter,
    globalStoreFilter,
    setGlobalStoreFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    pinnedProjects,
    setPinnedProjects,
    theme,
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    deferredSearchTerm,
    statusFilter,
    setStatusFilter,
    lastSelectedStatusFilterRef,
    flashToggle,
    sortConfig,
    setSortConfig,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    years,
    stores,
    locationOptions,
    filteredProjects,
    paginatedProjects
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/GeneralTabParts/useGeneralDragDrop.ts ===
import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { DragOverTarget } from './generalTypes';

interface UseGeneralDragDropParams {
  projects: Project[];
  paginatedProjects: Project[];
  pinnedProjects: string[];
  setPinnedProjects: (ids: string[]) => void;
  canvasRef: React.RefObject<HTMLCanvasElement | null>;
  t: (key: string) => string;
}

export function useGeneralDragDrop({
  projects,
  paginatedProjects,
  pinnedProjects,
  setPinnedProjects,
  canvasRef,
  t
}: UseGeneralDragDropParams) {
  const [draggedPinnedId, setDraggedPinnedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOverTarget, setDragOverTarget] = useState<DragOverTarget | null>(null);
  const [justDroppedId, setJustDroppedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successToast, setSuccessToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const toastTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const triggerSuccessFeedback = (id: string, message: string) => {
    setJustDroppedId(id);
    setSuccessToast(message);
    if (toastTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimeoutRef.current);
    toastTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setJustDroppedId(null);
      setSuccessToast(null);
    }, 2400);
  };

  const reorderPinnedProjects = (
    currentPinned: string[],
    draggedId: string,
    targetId: string,
    position: 'above' | 'below'
  ): string[] => {
    if (draggedId === targetId) return currentPinned;
    const listWithoutDragged = currentPinned.filter(id => id !== draggedId);
    const targetIndexInCleanList = listWithoutDragged.indexOf(targetId);
    if (targetIndexInCleanList === -1) return currentPinned;
    const insertIndex = position === 'above' ? targetIndexInCleanList : targetIndexInCleanList + 1;
    const result = [...listWithoutDragged];
    result.splice(insertIndex, 0, draggedId);
    return result;
  };

  const handlePinToggle = (e: React.MouseEvent, projectId: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (pinnedProjects.includes(projectId)) {
      setPinnedProjects(pinnedProjects.filter(id => id !== projectId));
    } else {
      setPinnedProjects([...pinnedProjects, projectId]);
    }
  };

  const handleMovePinned = (e: React.MouseEvent, projectId: string, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const currIdx = pinnedProjects.indexOf(projectId);
    if (currIdx === -1) return;
    const newIdx = direction === 'up' ? currIdx - 1 : currIdx + 1;
    if (newIdx < 0 || newIdx >= pinnedProjects.length) return;
    const newPinned = [...pinnedProjects];
    const [moved] = newPinned.splice(currIdx, 1);
    newPinned.splice(newIdx, 0, moved);
    setPinnedProjects(newPinned);
    
    const proj = projects.find(p => p.id === projectId);
    triggerSuccessFeedback(
      projectId,
      direction === 'up'
        ? `Moved ${proj?.code || 'project'} up to position ${newIdx + 1}`
        : `Moved ${proj?.code || 'project'} down to position ${newIdx + 1}`
    );
  };

  const handleDragStart = (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => {
    setDraggedPinnedId(id);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', id);
  };

  const handleRowDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent, targetProject: Project, idx: number) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!draggedPinnedId || !targetProject.id || draggedPinnedId === targetProject.id) {
      return;
    }
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const relativeY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const isAbove = relativeY < rect.height / 2;
    const position = isAbove ? 'above' : 'below';

    if (dragOverTarget?.id !== targetProject.id || dragOverTarget?.position !== position) {
      setDragOverTarget({
        id: targetProject.id,
        position,
        index: idx,
        projectCode: targetProject.code,
        projectName: targetProject.name,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleRowDrop = (e: React.DragEvent, targetId: string, position: 'above' | 'below') => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!draggedPinnedId || draggedPinnedId === targetId) {
      setDraggedPinnedId(null);
      setDragOverTarget(null);
      return;
    }

    const newPinned = reorderPinnedProjects(pinnedProjects, draggedPinnedId, targetId, position);
    setPinnedProjects(newPinned);

    const movedProj = projects.find(p => p.id === draggedPinnedId);
    const targetProj = projects.find(p => p.id === targetId);
    const code = movedProj?.code || 'Project';

    triggerSuccessFeedback(
      draggedPinnedId,
      position === 'above'
        ? `Moved ${code} before ${targetProj?.code || ''}!`
        : `Moved ${code} after ${targetProj?.code || ''}!`
    );

    setDraggedPinnedId(null);
    setDragOverTarget(null);
  };

  const handleDragEnd = () => {
    setDraggedPinnedId(null);
    setDragOverTarget(null);
  };

  const handleCanvasDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!draggedPinnedId) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const headerHeight = 60;
    const rowHeight = 70;

    if (y > headerHeight) {
      const idx = Math.floor((y - headerHeight) / rowHeight);
      if (idx >= 0 && idx < paginatedProjects.length) {
        const targetProject = paginatedProjects[idx];
        if (targetProject.id && pinnedProjects.includes(targetProject.id) && targetProject.id !== draggedPinnedId) {
          const rowY = headerHeight + idx * rowHeight;
          const relativeY = y - rowY;
          const position = relativeY < rowHeight / 2 ? 'above' : 'below';

          setDragOverTarget({
            id: targetProject.id,
            position,
            index: idx,
            projectCode: targetProject.code,
            projectName: targetProject.name,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const handleCanvasDrop = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!draggedPinnedId) return;
    if (dragOverTarget && dragOverTarget.id !== draggedPinnedId) {
      handleRowDrop(e, dragOverTarget.id, dragOverTarget.position);
    } else {
      setDraggedPinnedId(null);
      setDragOverTarget(null);
    }
  };

  return {
    draggedPinnedId,
    dragOverTarget,
    justDroppedId,
    successToast,
    handlePinToggle,
    handleMovePinned,
    handleDragStart,
    handleRowDragOver,
    handleRowDrop,
    handleDragEnd,
    handleCanvasDragOver,
    handleCanvasDrop
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/GeneralTabParts/useGeneralGoogleSync.ts ===
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Project, DelegationGroup, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { getStatus, formatDisplayDateMain } from '../../lib/utils';

interface UseGeneralGoogleSyncParams {
  currentUser: AppUser;
  projects: Project[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
}

export function useGeneralGoogleSync({
  currentUser,
  projects,
  delegationGroups
}: UseGeneralGoogleSyncParams) {
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);

  const handleGoogleSync = async () => {
    if (currentUser.role !== 'admin') return;
    if (!useAppStore.getState().isDelegationsRequested) {
      useAppStore.getState().setIsDelegationsRequested(true);
    }
    const WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwPAZcZ8wGQ1CVPYn_5h4arJ2dqX7T9rpWPMAmEuc3Q2G4BB7l59Mbxb8Ep0aQE6GA1/exec';
    
    setIsSyncing(true);
    
    const projectsData = projects.map(p => {
      const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year) : (p.computedTakStart ? String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : '');
      const status = getStatus(p.computedTakStart, p.computedTakCompl, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
      
      const projectDelegations = delegationGroups.filter(g => g.projectCode === p.code);
      let delegationTaskStr = '';
      if (projectDelegations.length > 0) {
        delegationTaskStr = projectDelegations.map(g => {
          let st = g.subTasks?.[0]?.delegationStatus || g.subTasks?.[0]?.status || 'Assigned';
          if (st === 'Accepted') st = 'On process';
          return `${g.name} (${st})`;
        }).join('; ');
      }
      
      const now = new Date();
      let activeTaskNames: string[] = [];
      if (p.taskSummaries) {
        const activeTasks = p.taskSummaries.filter(t => {
          if (!t.start || !t.finish) return false;
          const start = new Date(t.start);
          const finish = new Date(t.finish);
          return now >= start && now <= finish;
        });
        activeTaskNames = activeTasks.map(t => t.name);
      }
      let taskLines: string[] = [];
      activeTaskNames.forEach(name => {
        taskLines.push(...name.split('\n').filter((l: string) => l.trim() !== ''));
      });
      let detailString = taskLines.length > 0 ? taskLines.join('\n') : (p.detail || '');
      
      return {
        projectId: p.id || p.no, // Unique ID for upsert
        year: pYear,
        store: p.store || '',
        location: p.location || '',
        code: p.code || '',
        linkCodes: p.linkCodes || p.code || '',
        projectName: p.name || '',
        status: status,
        detail: detailString,
        startPlan: p.computedTakStart ? formatDisplayDateMain(p.computedTakStart) : '',
        finishPlan: p.computedTakCompl ? formatDisplayDateMain(p.computedTakCompl) : '',
        delegationTask: delegationTaskStr
      };
    });

    try {
      await fetch(WEBHOOK_URL, {
        method: 'POST',
        mode: 'no-cors',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'upsert', projects: projectsData })
      });
      
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Sent project sync request to Google Sheets!" });
    } catch(err) {
      console.error(err);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)) });
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    isSyncing,
    handleGoogleSync
  };
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { collection, onSnapshot, query, orderBy, doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import {   db, APP_ID , writeBatch , deleteDoc } from "../lib/firebase";
import { DevicePerformanceData } from "../store/usePerformanceStore";
import { reportDevicePerformance, getOrCreateDeviceId } from "../lib/deviceTelemetry";
import { useAppStore } from "../store/useAppStore";
import { matchesAdvancedSearch } from "../lib/utils";
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from './DebouncedSearchInput';
import {
  Smartphone,
  Monitor,
  Laptop,
  Server,
  HardDrive,
  RefreshCw,
  Radio,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  Trash2,
  ShieldAlert,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Users,
} from "lucide-react";

export function GlobalFleetMonitorView() {
  const [devices, setDevices] = useState<DevicePerformanceData[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const setToast = useAppStore((state) => state.setToast);
  const currentDeviceId = getOrCreateDeviceId();

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const colRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_device_metrics");
    const q = query(colRef);

    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(
      q,
      (snapshot) => {
        const loaded: DevicePerformanceData[] = [];
        const now = Date.now();

        snapshot.forEach((docSnap) => {
          const data = docSnap.data() as DevicePerformanceData;
          // Determine activity status: active within 3 mins = online, within 15 mins = idle, else offline
          const diffMs = now - (data.lastActiveTimestamp || 0);
          let status: "online" | "idle" | "offline" = "offline";
          if (diffMs < 3 * 60 * 1000) {
            status = "online";
          } else if (diffMs < 15 * 60 * 1000) {
            status = "idle";
          }

          loaded.push({
            ...data,
            deviceId: docSnap.id,
            status,
          });
        });

        // Sort: Current device first, then most recently active
        loaded.sort((a, b) => {
          if (a.deviceId === currentDeviceId) return -1;
          if (b.deviceId === currentDeviceId) return 1;
          return (b.lastActiveTimestamp || 0) - (a.lastActiveTimestamp || 0);
        });

        setDevices(loaded);
        setIsLoading(false);
      },
      (err) => {
        console.error("Error listening to taka_device_metrics:", err);
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    );

    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, [currentDeviceId]);

  const handleManualSyncThisDevice = async () => {
    setIsRefreshing(true);
    await reportDevicePerformance(true);
    setTimeout(() => setIsRefreshing(false), 600);
    setToast({
      title: "Đồng bộ thành công",
      message: "Chỉ số thiết bị hiện tại đã được cập nhật lên hệ thống.",
      type: "success",
    });
  };

  const handleClearStaleDevices = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm("Bạn có muốn xóa dữ liệu của các thiết bị không hoạt động trên 24 giờ khỏi bảng theo dõi?")) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const now = Date.now();
      const twentyFourHours = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      const stale = devices.filter((d) => d.deviceId !== currentDeviceId && now - (d.lastActiveTimestamp || 0) > twentyFourHours);

      if (stale.length === 0) {
        setToast({ title: "Thông báo", message: "Không có thiết bị cũ nào quá 24h cần xóa." });
        return;
      }

      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      stale.forEach((d) => {
        const ref = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_device_metrics", d.deviceId);
        batch.delete(ref);
      });
      batch.commit().catch(e => console.error("Batch commit failed", e));

      setToast({
        title: "Đã dọn dẹp",
        message: `Đã xóa ${stale.length} thiết bị cũ không còn hoạt động.`,
        type: "success",
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setToast({ title: "Lỗi", message: "Không thể dọn dẹp thiết bị.", type: "error" });
    }
  };

  // Aggregated fleet metrics
  const totalFleetServerReads = devices.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.serverReads || 0), 0);
  const totalFleetCacheReads = devices.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.cacheReads || 0), 0);
  const totalFleetOps = totalFleetServerReads + totalFleetCacheReads;
  const fleetHitRate = totalFleetOps > 0 ? ((totalFleetCacheReads / totalFleetOps) * 100).toFixed(1) : "100.0";
  const onlineCount = devices.filter((d) => d.status === "online").length;

  const filteredDevices = devices.filter((d) => {
    if (roleFilter !== "all" && d.userRole !== roleFilter) return false;
    if (searchTerm) {
      return matchesAdvancedSearch(searchTerm, [d.deviceName, d.userName, d.platform, d.deviceId]);
    }
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {/* Fleet KPI Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5">
        {/* Total Fleet Server Reads */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#27272a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a1a1aa]">
              Tổng Server Reads (All)
            </span>
            <Server className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {totalFleetServerReads.toLocaleString()}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">docs</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Từ tất cả các máy kết nối
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Total Fleet Cache Reads */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#27272a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a1a1aa]">
              Cache Tiết Kiệm (All)
            </span>
            <HardDrive className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                {totalFleetCacheReads.toLocaleString()}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">docs</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">

                            }`}

                              {dev.userName}
                              {isCurrent && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-blue-600 text-white">
                                  Máy này (Current)
                                </span>
                              )}
                              <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#3f3f46] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 uppercase font-mono">
                                {dev.userRole}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                              ID: {dev.deviceId.substring(0, 14)}...
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Platform */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium">
                        <div>{dev.deviceName}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{dev.platform}</div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Server Reads */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold">
                        {dev.serverReads > 0 ? (
                          <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
                            {dev.serverReads.toLocaleString()}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">0</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Cache Reads */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {dev.cacheReads.toLocaleString()}
                      </td>

                      {/* Cache Hit Rate */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right">
                        <span
                          className={`font-black ${
                            dev.cacheHitRate >= 90
                              ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                              : dev.cacheHitRate >= 50
                              ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                              : "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {dev.cacheHitRate}%
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Status */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-center">
                        {dev.status === "online" ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-300/40">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
                            Online
                          </span>
                        ) : dev.status === "idle" ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-300/40">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
                            Chờ (Idle)
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#3f3f46] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-400" />
                            Offline
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Last Active */}
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono text-[11px]">
                        <div>{dev.lastActiveAt || "-"}</div>
                        {dev.sessionDurationSec ? (
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            Đã mở {Math.floor(dev.sessionDurationSec / 60)} phút
                          </div>
                        ) : null}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

              >

              className="h-8 px-2 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-2xs active:scale-95 touch-manipulation flex items-center justify-center"

              )}
            </button>

              title={`Today: ${formatFullTime(currentTime)}`}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold border border-blue-100 dark:border-[#444446] hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs transition-colors shrink-0 select-none whitespace-nowrap"

              <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]" />
              <span>{formatCompactTime(currentTime)}</span>
            </div>

            {/* Ribbon Display Options on Header */}
            <RibbonDisplayMenu variant="header" className="hidden lg:inline-flex shrink-0" />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      {isQRScannerOpen && (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <QRScannerModal 
            isOpen={isQRScannerOpen} 
            onClose={() => setIsQRScannerOpen(false)} 
            onScan={(url) => {
              if (!url) return;
              setIsQRScannerOpen(false);
              if (onDeepLink) {
                onDeepLink(url);
              } else {
                window.location.href = url;
              }
            }} 
          />
        </Suspense>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { Settings, Calendar, SlidersHorizontal, Sun, Moon, Upload, Download, ShieldAlert, Printer } from 'lucide-react';

import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface HeaderMenuDrawerProps {
  isMenuOpen: boolean;
  setIsMenuOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  activeTab: TabId;
  onTabChange: (tab: TabId) => void;
  onLoginClick: () => void;
  onLogoutClick: () => void;
  onToggleTheme?: () => void;
  theme: 'light' | 'dark';
  canWriteImportCsv?: boolean;
  isPrintPreview?: boolean;
  onPrintPreviewToggle?: () => void;
}

export function HeaderMenuDrawer({
  isMenuOpen,
  setIsMenuOpen,
  currentUser,
  activeTab,
  onTabChange,
  onLoginClick,
  onLogoutClick,
  onToggleTheme,
  theme,
  canWriteImportCsv = false,
  isPrintPreview = false,
  onPrintPreviewToggle,
}: HeaderMenuDrawerProps) {
  const { language, setLanguage, t } = useLanguage();

  const ganttViewMode = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttViewMode);
  const setGanttViewMode = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttViewMode);
  const ganttDayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttDayWidth);
  const setGanttDayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttDayWidth);
  const ganttScaleInput = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttScaleInput);
  const setGanttScaleInput = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttScaleInput);
  const isGanttWidthChanged = useAppStore((state) => state.isGanttWidthChanged);
  const setIsGanttWidthChanged = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsGanttWidthChanged);
  const saveGanttDayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.saveGanttDayWidth);

  if (!isMenuOpen) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 z-[9998] bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-[0.5px]"

      />

        <div className="py-1.5">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              if (currentUser.role === 'guest') onLoginClick();
              else onLogoutClick();
              setIsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] mb-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span
              className={cn(
                'w-2 h-2 rounded-full',
                currentUser.role === 'guest'
                  ? 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-600'
                  : 'bg-emerald-500'
              )}
            />
            {currentUser.role === 'guest' ? t('Login') : t('Logout')}
          </button>

          {currentUser.role !== 'guest' && (
            <button
              title={t('Settings')}
              onClick={() => {
                onTabChange('setting');
                setIsMenuOpen(false);
              }}
              className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] mb-1 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Settings className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]" />
              {t('Settings')}
            </button>
          )}

          {currentUser.role !== 'guest' && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                onTabChange('accControl');
                setIsMenuOpen(false);
              }}
              className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] cursor-pointer"
            >

                setIsMenuOpen(false);
              }}
              className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] cursor-pointer"

                          setGanttScaleInput(val);
                          const num = Number(val);
                          if (!isNaN(num) && num >= 0 && num <= 150) {
                            const calculatedDayWidth =
                              num === 0
                                ? 0.6
                                : Math.max(
                                    0.6,
                                    Math.round((num / 75) * 8 * 10) / 10
                                  );
                            setGanttDayWidth(calculatedDayWidth);
                            setIsGanttWidthChanged(true);
                          }
                        }}
                        className="w-12 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-center font-mono font-bold bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1c1c1e] border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded outline-none"
                      />
                      <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-bold">
                        %
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="range"
                      min="0.6"
                      max="20"
                      step="0.2"
                      value={ganttDayWidth}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const num = Number(e.target.value);
                        setGanttDayWidth(num);
                        setGanttScaleInput(
                          String(Math.round((num / 8) * 75))
                        );
                        setIsGanttWidthChanged(true);
                      }}
                      className="flex-1 h-1.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-blue-500"
                    />
                    {isGanttWidthChanged && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={saveGanttDayWidth}
                        className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 rounded shadow-2xs cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                      >
                        Save
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {activeTab === 'layout' && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setIsMenuOpen(false);
                setTimeout(() => {
                  window.dispatchEvent(
                    new CustomEvent('open-layout-edit-mode')
                  );
                }, 50);
              }}
              className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-purple-50 dark:hover:bg-purple-950/30 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <SlidersHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
              <span className="font-semibold text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300">
                Edit Mode
              </span>
            </button>
          )}

          {currentUser.role !== 'guest' && activeTab === 'detail' && (
            <>
              {canWriteImportCsv && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    document.getElementById('detail-import-projects-input')?.click();
                    setIsMenuOpen(false);

import { Undo2, Redo2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';

export interface HeaderUndoRedoControlsProps {
  onUndo?: () => void;
  canUndo?: boolean;
  hasDataToUndo?: boolean;
  undoDescription?: string;
  onRedo?: () => void;
  canRedo?: boolean;
  hasDataToRedo?: boolean;
  redoDescription?: string;
}

export const HeaderUndoRedoControls: React.FC<HeaderUndoRedoControlsProps> = ({
  onUndo,
  canUndo = false,
  hasDataToUndo = false,
  undoDescription,
  onRedo,
  canRedo = false,
  hasDataToRedo = false,
  redoDescription,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  if (!onUndo && !onRedo) return null;

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
      {onUndo && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onUndo}
          disabled={!canUndo && !hasDataToUndo}
          title={undoDescription || t('Undo last action')}
          className={cn(
            'px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation',
            canUndo || hasDataToUndo
              ? 'bg-amber-100 hover:bg-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/80 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700'
              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
          )}
        >
          <Undo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span className="hidden md:inline">{t('Undo')}</span>
        </button>
      )}

      {onRedo && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRedo}
          disabled={!canRedo && !hasDataToRedo}
          title={redoDescription || t('Redo last action')}
          className={cn(
            'px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation',
            canRedo || hasDataToRedo
              ? 'bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/80 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700'
              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
          )}
        >
          <Redo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span className="hidden md:inline">{t('Redo')}</span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default HeaderUndoRedoControls;

export const LayoutBottomActionBar: React.FC<LayoutBottomActionBarProps> = React.memo(({
  hoverInfo,
  layoutTooltipVisibility,
  activeGroups,
  totalFloorAlerts,
  filterOnlyAlerts,
  setFilterOnlyAlerts,
  onOpenLegendModal,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className={`absolute bottom-3 sm:bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all duration-150 hide-on-actual-print print:hidden ${hoverInfo?.visible ? 'max-sm:opacity-0 max-sm:pointer-events-none' : 'opacity-100'}`}>

          layoutTooltipVisibility?.legendColor !== false
            ? "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white border-purple-500"

        )}

          </span>
        )}
      </button>

      {totalFloorAlerts > 0 && (
        <button
          onClick={() => setFilterOnlyAlerts(prev => !prev)}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 sm:px-3.5 py-1.5 sm:py-2 backdrop-blur-md border shadow-xl rounded-full text-xs font-bold active:scale-95 touch-manipulation transition-all whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer",
            filterOnlyAlerts
              ? "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white border-red-500 shadow-red-500/20 ring-2 ring-red-400"
              : "bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-800/95 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/60"
          )}
          title={filterOnlyAlerts ? "Click to show all units" : "Highlight only units with active alerts"}

          <AlertTriangle className={cn("w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4", filterOnlyAlerts ? "text-white" : "text-red-500 animate-pulse")} />
          <span>{filterOnlyAlerts ? "Show All" : "Focus Alerts"}</span>

          )}>
            {totalFloorAlerts}
          </span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

  stageRef,
  dimensions,
  stageScale,
  setStageScale,
  stagePos,
  setStagePos,
  pixelRatio,
  isProjectModalOpen,
  miniGanttProject,
  handleDragStart,
  handleDragMove,
  handleDragEnd,
  stopInertia,
  isPinnedRef,
  setHoverInfo,
  touchStateRef,
  pendingTouchRef,
  rafTouchIdRef,
  isInteractingRef,
  fitToScreen,
  lastWheelPointerRef,
  pendingWheelDeltaRef,
  rafWheelIdRef,
  wheelTimeoutRef,
  bgImage,
  version,
  visibleUnits,
  layoutTooltipVisibility,
  focusedUnitId,
  selectedLegendGroupId,
  getContrastStyle,
  aggregatedData,
  focusedUnit,
  handleMouseEnterUnit,
  handleMouseMoveUnit,
  handleMouseLeaveUnit,
  handleClickUnit,
  handleTapUnit,
  hasStoredUnitImages,
  storeFilter,
}) => {
  return (
    <div 
      id="live-layout-canvas-container"
      ref={containerRef} 
      className="flex-grow w-full h-full relative cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing"
      style={{ touchAction: 'none' }}
    >
      <Stage 
        ref={stageRef} 
        width={dimensions.width} 
        height={dimensions.height}
        scaleX={stageScale}
        scaleY={stageScale}
        x={stagePos.x}
        y={stagePos.y}
        pixelRatio={pixelRatio}
        draggable={!isProjectModalOpen && !miniGanttProject}
        style={{ touchAction: 'none', userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' }}
        onDragStart={handleDragStart}
        onDragMove={handleDragMove}
        onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          stopInertia();
          if (e.target === stageRef.current) {
            isPinnedRef.current = false;
            setHoverInfo(null);
          }
        }}
        onTap={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          stopInertia();
          if (e.target === stageRef.current) {
            isPinnedRef.current = false;
            setHoverInfo(null);
          }
        }}
        onDblClick={() => {
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          stopInertia();
          const stage = stageRef.current;
          if (!stage) return;
          const pointer = stage.getPointerPosition();
          if (!pointer) return;
          const oldScale = stage.scaleX();
          const newScale = oldScale > 2.5 ? Math.max(0.1, oldScale / 2.2) : Math.min(20, oldScale * 2.2);
          const mousePointTo = {
            x: (pointer.x - stage.x()) / oldScale,
            y: (pointer.y - stage.y()) / oldScale,
          };
          const newPos = {
            x: pointer.x - mousePointTo.x * newScale,
            y: pointer.y - mousePointTo.y * newScale,
          };
          stage.to({
            scaleX: newScale,
            scaleY: newScale,
            x: newPos.x,
            y: newPos.y,
            duration: 0.22,
            easing: (window as any).Konva?.Easings?.EaseOut,
            onFinish: () => {
              setStageScale(newScale);
              setStagePos(newPos);
            }
          });
        }}
        onTouchStart={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          stopInertia();
          if (e.evt.touches.length === 2) {
            const touch1 = e.evt.touches[0];
            const touch2 = e.evt.touches[1];
            const dist = Math.hypot(touch1.clientX - touch2.clientX, touch1.clientY - touch2.clientY);
            const center = {
              x: (touch1.clientX + touch2.clientX) / 2,
              y: (touch1.clientY + touch2.clientY) / 2,
            };
            touchStateRef.current = { lastDist: dist, lastCenter: center, lastTap: 0 };
            const stage = stageRef.current;
            if (stage) stage.draggable(false);
            isInteractingRef.current = true;
            setHoverInfo(null);
          } else if (e.evt.touches.length === 1) {
            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - touchStateRef.current.lastTap < 300) {
              fitToScreen(true);
              touchStateRef.current.lastTap = 0;
            } else {
              touchStateRef.current.lastTap = now;
            }
          }
        }}
        onTouchMove={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (e.evt.touches.length === 2) {
            e.evt.preventDefault();
            const touch1 = e.evt.touches[0];
            const touch2 = e.evt.touches[1];
            const dist = Math.hypot(touch1.clientX - touch2.clientX, touch1.clientY - touch2.clientY);
            const center = {
              x: (touch1.clientX + touch2.clientX) / 2,
              y: (touch1.clientY + touch2.clientY) / 2,
            };
            pendingTouchRef.current = { dist, center };

            if (rafTouchIdRef.current === null) {
              rafTouchIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                rafTouchIdRef.current = null;
                if (!pendingTouchRef.current) return;
                const { dist: curDist, center: curCenter } = pendingTouchRef.current;
                const { lastDist, lastCenter } = touchStateRef.current;
                const stage = stageRef.current;
                if (stage && lastDist > 0 && lastCenter) {
                  const oldScale = stage.scaleX();
                  const scaleDelta = curDist / lastDist;
                  const newScale = Math.max(0.04, Math.min(oldScale * scaleDelta, 20));
                  
                  const stageBox = stage.container().getBoundingClientRect();
                  const lastPointerX = lastCenter.x - stageBox.left;
                  const lastPointerY = lastCenter.y - stageBox.top;
                  const currentPointerX = curCenter.x - stageBox.left;
                  const currentPointerY = curCenter.y - stageBox.top;

                  const worldPointX = (lastPointerX - stage.x()) / oldScale;
                  const worldPointY = (lastPointerY - stage.y()) / oldScale;

                  const newPos = {
                    x: currentPointerX - worldPointX * newScale,
                    y: currentPointerY - worldPointY * newScale,
                  };

                  stage.scale({ x: newScale, y: newScale });
                  stage.position(newPos);
                  stage.batchDraw();

                  touchStateRef.current.lastDist = curDist;
                  touchStateRef.current.lastCenter = curCenter;
                }
              });
            }
          }
        }}
        onTouchEnd={() => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (rafTouchIdRef.current !== null) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(rafTouchIdRef.current);
            rafTouchIdRef.current = null;
          }
          pendingTouchRef.current = null;
          touchStateRef.current.lastDist = 0;
          touchStateRef.current.lastCenter = null;
          const stage = stageRef.current;
          if (stage) {
            stage.draggable(true);
            setStageScale(stage.scaleX());
            setStagePos({ x: stage.x(), y: stage.y() });
          }
          isInteractingRef.current = false;
        }}
        onWheel={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          e.evt.preventDefault();
          stopInertia();
          const stage = stageRef.current;
          if (!stage) return;
          
          isInteractingRef.current = true;
          setHoverInfo(null);

          const pointer = stage.getPointerPosition();
          if (!pointer) return;

          lastWheelPointerRef.current = pointer;
          pendingWheelDeltaRef.current += e.evt.deltaY;

          if (rafWheelIdRef.current === null) {
            rafWheelIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
              rafWheelIdRef.current = null;
              const currentStage = stageRef.current;
              const ptr = lastWheelPointerRef.current;
              if (!currentStage || !ptr) return;

              const deltaY = pendingWheelDeltaRef.current;
              pendingWheelDeltaRef.current = 0;

              const oldScale = currentStage.scaleX();
              const zoomFactor = Math.exp(-deltaY * 0.0008);
              const newScale = Math.max(0.04, Math.min(oldScale * zoomFactor, 20));

              const mousePointTo = {
                x: (ptr.x - currentStage.x()) / oldScale,
                y: (ptr.y - currentStage.y()) / oldScale,
              };

              const newPos = {
                x: ptr.x - mousePointTo.x * newScale,
                y: ptr.y - mousePointTo.y * newScale,
              };

              currentStage.scale({ x: newScale, y: newScale });
              currentStage.position(newPos);
              currentStage.batchDraw();

              if (wheelTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(wheelTimeoutRef.current);
              wheelTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
                setStageScale(currentStage.scaleX());
                setStagePos({ x: currentStage.x(), y: currentStage.y() });
                isInteractingRef.current = false;
              }, 120);
            });
          }
        }}
      >
        <LayoutKonvaLayers
          bgImage={bgImage}
          version={version}
          visibleUnits={visibleUnits}
          layoutTooltipVisibility={layoutTooltipVisibility}
          focusedUnitId={focusedUnitId}
          selectedLegendGroupId={selectedLegendGroupId}
          getContrastStyle={getContrastStyle}
          stageScale={stageScale}
          aggregatedData={aggregatedData}
          focusedUnit={focusedUnit}
          onMouseEnterUnit={handleMouseEnterUnit}
          onMouseMoveUnit={handleMouseMoveUnit}
          onMouseLeaveUnit={handleMouseLeaveUnit}
          onClickUnit={handleClickUnit}
          onTapUnit={handleTapUnit}
          hasStoredUnitImages={hasStoredUnitImages}
          storeFilter={storeFilter}
        />
      </Stage>
    </div>
  );
});

import React, { Dispatch, FC, SetStateAction, memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import {
  Palette,
  ChevronUp,
  ChevronDown,
  Download,
  RefreshCw,
  FileText,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Printer,
  GripHorizontal,
  Compass,
  Search,
  X,
  Layers
} from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

export type LegendDockPosition = 'top-right' | 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left';

export interface LayoutColorLegendBarProps {
  layoutTooltipVisibility: any;
  activeGroups: any[];
  selectedLegendGroupId: string | null;
  setSelectedLegendGroupId: (id: string | null) => void;
  setShowLegendModal?: (show: boolean) => void;
  isLegendStripCollapsed?: boolean;
  setIsLegendStripCollapsed?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  canWrite?: boolean;
  handleTriggerExport?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  isExporting?: boolean;
  exportStatus?: string;
  handleExport?: (type: 'jpeg' | 'pdf') => void;
  setIsPrintPreview?: (show: boolean) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_DOCK_STORAGE_KEY = 'taka_layout_legend_dock_pos';

export const LayoutColorLegendBar: React.FC<LayoutColorLegendBarProps> = React.memo(({
  layoutTooltipVisibility,
  activeGroups,
  selectedLegendGroupId,
  setSelectedLegendGroupId,
  setShowLegendModal,
  isLegendStripCollapsed: propIsCollapsed,
  setIsLegendStripCollapsed: propSetIsCollapsed,
  canWrite = false,
  handleTriggerExport,
  isExporting = false,
  exportStatus = '',
  handleExport,
  setIsPrintPreview,
}) => {
  const [internalCollapsed, setInternalCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [showExportMenu, setShowExportMenu] = useState(false);
  const [groupSearch, setGroupSearch] = useState('');
  const [dockPosition, setDockPosition] = useState<LegendDockPosition>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(DEFAULT_DOCK_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved === 'top-right' || saved === 'bottom-right' || saved === 'bottom-left') {
        return saved;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
    return 'top-right';
  });

  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const exportMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const isCollapsed = propIsCollapsed !== undefined ? propIsCollapsed : internalCollapsed;
  const toggleCollapsed = () => {
    if (propSetIsCollapsed) {
      propSetIsCollapsed(!isCollapsed);
    } else {
      setInternalCollapsed(prev => !prev);
    }
  };

  const cycleDockPosition = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setDockPosition(prev => {
      let next: LegendDockPosition = 'top-right';
      if (prev === 'top-right') next = 'bottom-right';
      else if (prev === 'bottom-right') next = 'bottom-left';
      else next = 'top-right';
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(DEFAULT_DOCK_STORAGE_KEY, next);
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Close export menu when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (exportMenuRef.current && !exportMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setShowExportMenu(false);
      }
    };
    if (showExportMenu) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [showExportMenu]);

  // Filter active groups based on groupSearch
  const filteredGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!groupSearch.trim()) return activeGroups;
    const q = groupSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
    return activeGroups.filter(g => g.name?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [activeGroups, groupSearch]);

  if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.legendColor === false) return null;

  // Dock positioning classes
  const dockClasses = {
    'top-right': 'top-14 sm:top-16 right-2.5 sm:right-4',
    'bottom-right': 'bottom-3 sm:bottom-4 right-2.5 sm:right-4',
    'bottom-left': 'bottom-3 sm:bottom-4 left-2.5 sm:left-4',
  }[dockPosition];

  return (
    <Draggable
      handle=".legend-drag-handle"
      cancel="button, input, select, textarea, .no-drag"
      nodeRef={nodeRef}
      bounds="parent"
    >
      <div
        ref={nodeRef}
        className={cn(
          "absolute z-30 pointer-events-auto hide-on-actual-print print:hidden transition-shadow select-none",
          dockClasses,
          isCollapsed ? "max-w-xs" : "w-[300px] sm:w-[340px]"
        )}
      >
        <div className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#1a1a1c]/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#333336] shadow-2xl p-2 sm:p-2.5 transition-all text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
          {/* Header Bar */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
            {/* Grip Handle + Palette Icon + Title */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
              <span
                className="legend-drag-handle p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors shrink-0"
                title="Drag to reposition anywhere on canvas"
              >
                <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={toggleCollapsed}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 p-1 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/80 transition-colors text-left cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation min-w-0"
                title={isCollapsed ? "Expand Color Legend" : "Collapse Color Legend"}
              >
                <span className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/70 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-300 shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                  <Palette className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4" />
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap">
                  Color Legend
                </span>
                {activeGroups.length > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-purple-100/90 dark:bg-purple-900/60 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 shrink-0">
                    {activeGroups.length}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Header Action Tools */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
              {/* Clear Filter Button */}
              {selectedLegendGroupId && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedLegendGroupId(null)}
                  className="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 hover:bg-purple-100 dark:hover:bg-purple-950 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/60 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all whitespace-nowrap"
                  title="Clear active group filter"
                >
                  Clear Filter
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Dock Position Switcher */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={cycleDockPosition}
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 active:scale-95"
                title={`Dock Position: ${dockPosition} (Click to switch Top-Right / Bottom-Right / Bottom-Left)`}
              >
                <Compass className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>

              {/* View All Groups Details Modal */}
              {setShowLegendModal && activeGroups.length > 0 && (
                <button

                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 active:scale-95"
                  title="Open full groups modal"
                >
                  <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Export Menu Dropdown */}
              <div className="relative" ref={exportMenuRef}>
                <button

                  disabled={isExporting}

                  />
                  {groupSearch && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setGroupSearch('')}
                      className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Group Swatches */}
              {activeGroups.length === 0 ? (
                /* Default Project Status Legend */
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs">

                    <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-500 shrink-0 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-white/50 dark:ring-black/30" />

                            <span

                            />
                            <span className="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold">
                              {g.name}
                            </span>

                            {g.matchCount} {g.matchCount === 1 ? 'unit' : 'units'}
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Draggable>
  );

import React, { FC, useRef } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { Palette, X, GripHorizontal, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { useOverlayStack } from '../../lib/zIndexManager';

export interface LayoutColorLegendModalProps {
  showLegendModal: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  activeGroups: any[];
  selectedLegendGroupId: string | null;
  setSelectedLegendGroupId: (id: string | null) => void;
}

export const LayoutColorLegendModal: React.FC<LayoutColorLegendModalProps> = ({
  showLegendModal,
  onClose,
  activeGroups,
  selectedLegendGroupId,
  setSelectedLegendGroupId,
}) => {
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const zInfo = useOverlayStack({
    layer: 'MODAL_BASE',
    isOpen: showLegendModal,
    onClose,
    closeOnTabChange: true,
  });

  if (!showLegendModal) return null;

  const content = (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-0 ${zInfo.zClass} bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-3 animate-in fade-in duration-150 hide-on-actual-print print:hidden`}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <Draggable
        handle=".modal-handle"
        cancel="button, input, select, textarea, .no-drag"
        nodeRef={nodeRef}
        bounds="parent"
      >
        <div
          ref={nodeRef}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md p-5 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 shadow-2xl space-y-4 max-h-[85vh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col select-none"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="modal-handle flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-base text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
              <span className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200">
                <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <Palette className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
              <span>Color Legend & Group Inspector</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Close modal"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Active Groups Section */}
          <div className="space-y-3 flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="text-[11px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
                Active Classification Groups ({activeGroups.length})
              </div>
              {selectedLegendGroupId && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSelectedLegendGroupId(null)}
                  className="text-xs text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 hover:underline font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Clear filter
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {activeGroups.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 italic py-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 rounded-xl p-3 text-center border border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                Map colors currently reflect standard project progress status or have no custom classification groups.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {activeGroups.map((g: any) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedLegendGroupId === g.id;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={g.id}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedLegendGroupId(isSelected ? null : g.id)}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/40 border-purple-400 shadow-sm ring-2 ring-purple-400/40'
                          : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <div
                            className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full shadow-xs border border-black/15 shrink-0"
                            style={{ backgroundColor: g.color }}
                          />
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                            {g.name}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          {isSelected && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 flex items-center gap-0.5">
                              <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> Filtered
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {g.matchCount} {g.matchCount === 1 ? 'unit' : 'units'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {g.matchedUnits && g.matchedUnits.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">
                          {g.matchedUnits.slice(0, 15).map((u: any) => (
                            <span
                              key={u.id}
                              className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"
                            >
                              {u.name}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                          {g.matchedUnits.length > 15 && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 self-center">
                              +{g.matchedUnits.length - 15} more...
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Footer */}
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="w-full py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Draggable>
    </div>
  );

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    return createPortal(content, document.body);
  }
  return content;
};

      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    return createPortal(content, document.body);
  }
  return content;
};
