import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import * as pdfjsLib from 'pdfjs-dist';
import { 
  ChevronLeft, 
  ChevronRight, 
  ZoomIn, 
  ZoomOut, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Maximize2, 
  Download, 
  ExternalLink, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Loader2, 
  Layers,
  Maximize,
  RefreshCw,
  Eye
} from 'lucide-react';
import { TransformWrapper, TransformComponent } from 'react-zoom-pan-pinch';

// Configure pdfjs worker URL cleanly
if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions) {
  pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = `https://unpkg.com/pdfjs-dist@${pdfjsLib.version || '4.10.38'}/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`;
}

export interface PdfNativeCanvasViewerProps {
  url: string;
  isFullscreen?: boolean;
  onOpenFullscreen?: () => void;
  className?: string;
  onFallbackToIframe?: () => void;
}

export function PdfNativeCanvasViewer({
  url,
  isFullscreen = false,
  onOpenFullscreen,
  className = '',
  onFallbackToIframe,
}: PdfNativeCanvasViewerProps) {
  const [pdfDoc, setPdfDoc] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [numPages, setNumPages] = useState<number>(0);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
  const [pageInput, setPageInput] = useState<string>('1');
  const [scale, setScale] = useState<number>(1.2);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [loadingProgress, setLoadingProgress] = useState<number>(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isRendering, setIsRendering] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'single' | 'fitWidth' | 'fitPage'>('fitWidth');

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const renderTaskRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const activePdfRef = useRef<any>(null);

  // Load PDF Document asynchronously
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setLoadingProgress(5);
    setPdfDoc(null);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setPageInput('1');

    // Cancel previous document if active
    if (activePdfRef.current) {
      try {
        (activePdfRef.current as any).destroy?.() || (activePdfRef.current as any).cleanup?.();
      } catch (e) {
        // ignore cleanup error
      }
      activePdfRef.current = null;
    }

    const loadingTask = pdfjsLib.getDocument({
      url,
      cMapUrl: 'https://unpkg.com/pdfjs-dist@4.10.38/cmaps/',
      cMapPacked: true,
    });

    loadingTask.onProgress = (progress: { loaded: number; total: number }) => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      if (progress.total > 0) {
        const pct = Math.min(99, Math.round((progress.loaded / progress.total) * 100));
        setLoadingProgress(pct);
      } else {
        setLoadingProgress((prev) => Math.min(90, prev + 15));
      }
    };

    loadingTask.promise
      .then((doc) => {
        if (!isMounted) {
          (doc as any).destroy?.() || (doc as any).cleanup?.();
          return;
        }
        activePdfRef.current = doc;
        setPdfDoc(doc);
        setNumPages(doc.numPages);
        setIsLoading(false);
        setLoadingProgress(100);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        console.warn('Native PDF loading failed or blocked by CORS:', err);
        setError('Cannot load PDF natively (CORS or network policy).');
        setIsLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      if (renderTaskRef.current) {
        try { renderTaskRef.current.cancel(); } catch (e) {}
      }
      if (activePdfRef.current) {
        try { (activePdfRef.current as any).destroy?.() || (activePdfRef.current as any).cleanup?.(); } catch (e) {}
        activePdfRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [url]);

  // Render Page to Canvas
  const renderPage = useCallback(
    async (pageNum: number, pageScale: number) => {
      if (!pdfDoc || !canvasRef.current) return;

      if (renderTaskRef.current) {
        try { renderTaskRef.current.cancel(); } catch (e) {}
        renderTaskRef.current = null;
      }

      setIsRendering(true);
      try {
        const page = await pdfDoc.getPage(pageNum);
        const canvas = canvasRef.current;
        if (!canvas) return;

        const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
        if (!context) return;

        // Calculate auto scale for fitWidth / fitPage
        let targetScale = pageScale;
        if (containerRef.current) {
          const containerWidth = containerRef.current.clientWidth - 32;
          const containerHeight = containerRef.current.clientHeight - 80;
          const unscaledViewport = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });

          if (viewMode === 'fitWidth' && containerWidth > 100) {
            targetScale = containerWidth / unscaledViewport.width;
          } else if (viewMode === 'fitPage' && containerHeight > 100) {
            const scaleX = containerWidth / unscaledViewport.width;
            const scaleY = containerHeight / unscaledViewport.height;
            targetScale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
          }
        }

        const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: Math.max(0.4, Math.min(4, targetScale)) });
        const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

        canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height * dpr);
        canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(viewport.width)}px`;
        canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(viewport.height)}px`;

        context.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        context.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';

        const transform = dpr !== 1 ? [dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0] : undefined;

        const renderContext = {
          canvasContext: context,
          transform,
          viewport,
        };

        const renderTask = page.render(renderContext);
        renderTaskRef.current = renderTask;
        await renderTask.promise;
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err?.name !== 'RenderingCancelledException') {
          console.error('PDF page render error:', err);
        }
      } finally {
        setIsRendering(false);
      }
    },
    [pdfDoc, viewMode]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (pdfDoc && currentPage >= 1 && currentPage <= numPages) {
      renderPage(currentPage, scale);
    }
  }, [pdfDoc, currentPage, scale, viewMode, renderPage]);

  const handlePageChange = (newPage: number) => {
    if (newPage >= 1 && newPage <= numPages) {
      setCurrentPage(newPage);
      setPageInput(String(newPage));
    }
  };

  const handlePageInputSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const parsed = parseInt(pageInput, 10);
    if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed >= 1 && parsed <= numPages) {
      setCurrentPage(parsed);
    } else {
      setPageInput(String(currentPage));
    }
  };

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-slate-200 text-center bg-slate-900 rounded-xl">
        <AlertCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-amber-400 mb-3 shrink-0" />
        <p className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-100">Cannot load PDF directly in canvas</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 max-w-md">
          The document server prevents direct binary access. You can use embedded mode or open in new window.
        </p>
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
          {onFallbackToIframe && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onFallbackToIframe}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Switch to Embed Viewer
            </button>
          )}
          <a
            href={url}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 text-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95"
          >
            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Open File in New Tab
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`w-full h-full relative flex flex-col bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 overflow-hidden select-none ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Top Toolbar: Navigation & Per-Page Zoom Controls */}
      <div className="z-[60] flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-900/95 border-b border-slate-800 backdrop-blur-md shrink-0">
        {/* Left: Page Navigation */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={currentPage <= 1 || isLoading}
            onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage - 1)}
            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 rounded-lg text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
            title="Previous Page"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          <form onSubmit={handlePageInputSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium hidden sm:inline">Page</span>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={pageInput}
              onChange={(e) => setPageInput(e.target.value)}
              onBlur={() => setPageInput(String(currentPage))}
              className="w-10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-center bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
            />
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono font-medium">/ {numPages || 1}</span>
          </form>

          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={currentPage >= numPages || isLoading}
            onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage + 1)}
            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 rounded-lg text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
            title="Next Page"
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Center: Zoom & View Mode */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setViewMode('single'); setScale((s) => Math.max(0.5, s - 0.25)); }}
            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
            title="Zoom Out"
          >
            <ZoomOut className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-300 bg-slate-800/80 rounded border border-slate-700">
            {Math.round(scale * 100)}%
          </span>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setViewMode('single'); setScale((s) => Math.min(3.5, s + 0.25)); }}
            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
            title="Zoom In"
          >
            <ZoomIn className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-slate-800 mx-1 hidden sm:block" />

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setViewMode('fitWidth'); setScale(1); }}
            className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded transition-colors ${
              viewMode === 'fitWidth' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
            }`}
            title="Fit Width"
          >
            Fit Width

          <button

            onClick={() => { setViewMode('fitPage'); setScale(1); }}
            className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded transition-colors hidden sm:inline-block ${
              viewMode === 'fitPage' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
            }`}
            title="Fit Page"
          >
            Fit Page
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { ZoomIn, ZoomOut, Maximize, Maximize2, ExternalLink, FileText, AlertCircle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { TransformWrapper, TransformComponent } from 'react-zoom-pan-pinch';
import { PdfNativeCanvasViewer } from './PdfNativeCanvasViewer';

export interface PdfOrImageViewerProps {
  url: string;
  getCleanUrl?: (u: string | undefined | null) => string | undefined;
  fallbackSvg?: string;
  cacheBuster?: number;
  isAdmin?: boolean;
  onOpenFullscreen?: () => void;
  isFullscreen?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  alt?: string;
}

export function isPdfOrDocUrl(url?: string): boolean {
  if (!url) return false;
  const lower = url.toLowerCase();
  if (/\.pdf($|\?|#)/i.test(lower)) return true;
  if (lower.includes('type=pdf') || lower.includes('format=pdf') || lower.includes('application/pdf')) return true;
  if (lower.includes('drive.google.com') && !lower.includes('thumbnail')) return true;
  if (lower.includes('docs.google.com')) return true;
  return false;
}

export function resolvePdfIframeUrl(url: string, useGdocsFallback: boolean = false): string {
  if (!url) return '';
  const driveMatch =
    url.match(/drive\.google\.com\/(?:file\/d\/|open\?id=|uc\?id=)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i) ||
    url.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);
  if (driveMatch && driveMatch[1]) {
    return `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${driveMatch[1]}/preview`;
  }
  if (url.includes('docs.google.com')) {
    return url;
  }
  if (useGdocsFallback) {
    return `https://docs.google.com/viewer?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}&embedded=true`;
  }
  return url;
}

export const PdfOrImageViewer: React.FC<PdfOrImageViewerProps> = ({
  url,
  getCleanUrl = (u) => u || undefined,
  fallbackSvg = '',
  cacheBuster = 0,
  onOpenFullscreen,
  isFullscreen = false,
  className = '',
  alt = 'Layout Preview',
}) => {
  const [hasPdfError, setHasPdfError] = useState(false);
  const [useGdocsFallback, setUseGdocsFallback] = useState(false);
  const [useIframeFallback, setUseIframeFallback] = useState(false);

  const cleanUrl = getCleanUrl(url) || url;
  const isPdf = isPdfOrDocUrl(cleanUrl);

  if (!url) {
    return (
      <div className={`w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900 ${className}`}>
        <FileText className="w-12 h-12 mb-3 opacity-20" />
        <p className="text-sm font-medium">No document or layout available</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // PDF or Google Drive / Docs document mode
  if (isPdf) {
    if (!useIframeFallback) {
      return (
        <PdfNativeCanvasViewer
          url={cleanUrl}
          isFullscreen={isFullscreen}
          onOpenFullscreen={onOpenFullscreen}
          className={className}
          onFallbackToIframe={() => setUseIframeFallback(true)}
        />
      );
    }

    const iframeSrc = resolvePdfIframeUrl(cleanUrl, useGdocsFallback);

    return (
      <div className={`w-full h-full relative flex flex-col bg-slate-900 ${className}`}>
        {/* Floating action controls */}
        <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 z-[50] flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md p-1 border border-slate-700 shadow-md rounded-xl">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setUseIframeFallback(false)}
            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation flex items-center gap-1 text-xs"
            title="Switch to Native Canvas Viewer"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline font-medium text-[11px]">Native Mode</span>
          </button>

          <a
            href={cleanUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation flex items-center gap-1 text-xs"
            title="Open in new window"
          >
            <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline font-medium text-[11px]">Open File</span>
          </a>

          {!useGdocsFallback && cleanUrl.startsWith('http') && !cleanUrl.includes('drive.google.com') && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setUseGdocsFallback(true)}
              className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation text-xs flex items-center gap-1"
              title="Use Google Docs Preview Mode"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline font-medium text-[11px]">GDocs Mode</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {onOpenFullscreen && !isFullscreen && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenFullscreen}
              className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              title="Fullscreen"
            >
              <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {hasPdfError ? (
          <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-slate-300 text-center">
            <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-amber-400 mb-3" />
            <p className="text-base font-semibold">Cannot embed this PDF document directly</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 max-w-md">
              The external host may restrict embedding. You can view or download the file directly in a new window.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3">
              <a
                href={cleanUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
                Open PDF in New Window
              </a>
              {!useGdocsFallback && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setUseGdocsFallback(true);
                    setHasPdfError(false);
                  }}
                  className="px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium"
                >
                  Try GDocs Embed
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <iframe
            key={`${cacheBuster}_${iframeSrc}`}
            src={iframeSrc}
            width="100%"
            height="100%"
            style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', minHeight: isFullscreen ? '100vh' : '600px', border: 'none' }}
            allow="autoplay; fullscreen"
            title="PDF or Document Viewer"
            onError={() => setHasPdfError(true)}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Image mode with interactive zoom and pan
  return (
    <div className={`w-full h-full relative flex-grow flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 ${className}`}>
      <TransformWrapper
        initialScale={1}
        minScale={0.5}
        maxScale={12}
        centerOnInit={true}
        smooth={false}
        wheel={{ step: 0.25 }}
        zoomAnimation={{ disabled: true }}
        pinch={{ step: 12 }}
        panning={{ disabled: false }}
        doubleClick={{
          mode: 'toggle',
          step: 2.2,
        }}
      >
        {({ zoomIn, zoomOut, resetTransform, state }) => (
          <>
            <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 z-[50] flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md p-1 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-md rounded-xl">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => zoomIn(0.5)}
                className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
                title="Zoom In"
              >
                <ZoomIn className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => zoomOut(0.5)}
                className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
                title="Zoom Out"
              >
                <ZoomOut className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border-l border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                {Math.round((state.scale || 1) * 100)}%
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => resetTransform()}
                className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
                title="Reset"
              >
                <Maximize className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
              {onOpenFullscreen && !isFullscreen && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onOpenFullscreen}
                  className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
                  title="Fullscreen"
                >
                  <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            <TransformComponent
              wrapperStyle={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
              contentStyle={{
                width: '100%',
                height: '100%',
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                alignItems: 'center',
                padding: '1rem',
              }}
            >
              <img
                src={cleanUrl}
                alt={alt}
                loading="lazy"
                decoding="async"
                className="max-w-full max-h-full object-contain shadow-lg rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing"
                onError={(e) => {
                  if (fallbackSvg) {
                    (e.target as HTMLImageElement).src = fallbackSvg;
                  }
                }}
              />
            </TransformComponent>
          </>
        )}
      </TransformWrapper>
    </div>
  );
};

=== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/TooltipDetailsSection.tsx ===
import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../../lib/utils';

interface TooltipDetailsSectionProps {
  v: any;
  taskLines: string[];
  detailText: string;
  descriptionText: string;
}

export const TooltipDetailsSection: React.FC<TooltipDetailsSectionProps> = ({
  v,
  taskLines,
  detailText,
  descriptionText,
}) => {
  const uniqueTaskLines = Array.from(new Set((taskLines || []).map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean)));
  const hasDetails = (v.detail && (uniqueTaskLines.length > 0 || detailText)) || (v.description && (descriptionText || detailText));
  if (!hasDetails) return null;

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-[#161618] rounded-lg p-2 sm:p-2.5 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-[#2e2e32] text-xs shadow-2xs flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
      {/* Active Subtasks / Detail */}
      {v.detail && uniqueTaskLines.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
          <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
            Detail
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
            {uniqueTaskLines.map((line, idx) => (
              <div 
                key={idx} 
                className={`font-medium text-xs leading-tight ${idx % 2 === 0 ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]' : 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400'}`}
              >
                • {line}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Description (p.detail or descriptionText) */}
      {(uniqueTaskLines.length === 0 ? (v.detail && detailText) : (v.description && (detailText || descriptionText))) && (
        <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-0.5", v.detail && uniqueTaskLines.length > 0 ? "pt-1 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#2e2e32]" : "")}>
          <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
            {uniqueTaskLines.length > 0 ? 'Description' : 'Detail'}
          </div>
          <div className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
            {detailText || descriptionText}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

=== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/TooltipImageGalleryPanel.tsx ===
import React, { Dispatch, FC, SetStateAction, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  Plus, 
  X, 
  Link as LinkIcon, 
  Check, 
  Maximize2, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Copy, 
  Trash2,
  Upload,
  Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { TooltipImageItem } from './tooltipTypes';
import { normalizeImageUrl } from '../LayoutUnitLightboxModal';
import { uploadPictureToTakaFolder } from '../../../lib/r2StorageUtils';
import { TooltipZoomableThumbnail } from './TooltipZoomableThumbnail';

interface TooltipImageGalleryPanelProps {
  showImagePanel: boolean;
  setShowImagePanel: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  showAddLinkInput: boolean;
  setShowAddLinkInput: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  newLinkInput: string;
  setNewLinkInput: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string>>;
  allUnitImages: TooltipImageItem[];
  copiedLink: string | null;
  handleAddCustomImage: (e?: React.FormEvent, customUrl?: string) => void;
  handleDeleteCustomImage: (id: string, urlToDelete?: string) => void;
  handleCopyLink: (url: string) => void;
  setEnlargedImage: (img: { url: string; title?: string; initialScale?: number } | null) => void;
  unitCode?: string;
  activeStore?: string;
}

export const TooltipImageGalleryPanel: React.FC<TooltipImageGalleryPanelProps> = ({
  showImagePanel,
  setShowImagePanel,
  showAddLinkInput,
  setShowAddLinkInput,
  newLinkInput,
  setNewLinkInput,
  allUnitImages,
  copiedLink,
  handleAddCustomImage,
  handleDeleteCustomImage,
  handleCopyLink,
  setEnlargedImage,
  unitCode,
  activeStore = 'HCM',
}) => {
  const [addMode, setAddMode] = useState<'link' | 'picture'>('link');
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploadSuccessUrl, setUploadSuccessUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  if (!showImagePanel && !showAddLinkInput) return null;

  const handlePictureFileSelected = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
    const file = files[0];

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError(null);
    setUploadSuccessUrl(null);

    try {
      const res = await uploadPictureToTakaFolder(file, unitCode, activeStore);
      if (res.success && res.publicUrl) {
        const feedback = `${res.publicUrl}${(res as any).compressionInfo || ''}`;
        setUploadSuccessUrl(feedback);
        setNewLinkInput(res.publicUrl);
        // Save link immediately into gallery
        handleAddCustomImage(undefined, res.publicUrl);
        setTimeout(() => setUploadSuccessUrl(null), 4500);
      } else {
        setUploadError(res.error || 'Upload failed');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setUploadError(err?.message || 'Lỗi kết nối upload');
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full bg-slate-50/95 dark:bg-[#161618] rounded-xl p-2.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] shadow-inner flex flex-col gap-2 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 my-1">
      {/* Panel Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 pb-1.5 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 min-w-0">
          <ImageIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] shrink-0" />
          <span className="truncate">Hình ảnh liên kết ({activeStore})</span>
          <span className={cn(
            "text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono shrink-0 font-bold",
            activeStore.toUpperCase() === 'HN'
              ? "bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-950/80 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400"
              : "bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]"
          )}>
            {allUnitImages.length}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
          {/* Top "+ Thêm" Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowAddLinkInput(prev => !prev)}
            className={cn(
              "px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer shadow-xs",
              showAddLinkInput 
                ? "bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200" 
                : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white"
            )}
            title={showAddLinkInput ? "Đóng ô nhập link" : "Thêm link ảnh / bài viết"}
          >
            <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>Thêm</span>
          </button>
          {/* Close Image Panel Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setShowImagePanel(false);
              setShowAddLinkInput(false);
            }}
            className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded hover:bg-slate-200/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Đóng bảng ảnh"
          >
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Add / Post Link Input or Upload Picture Section (Only visible when clicking "+ Thêm") */}
      {showAddLinkInput && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 w-full animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-150 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-900 rounded-xl p-2 shadow-xs">
          {/* Mode Switcher Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-1.5 gap-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setAddMode('link');
                  setUploadError(null);
                }}
                className={cn(
                  "px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer",
                  addMode === 'link'
                    ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-2xs"
                    : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200"
                )}
              >
                <LinkIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Dán Link URL</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setAddMode('picture');
                  setUploadError(null);
                }}
                className={cn(
                  "px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer",
                  addMode === 'picture'
                    ? "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-2xs"
                    : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200"
                )}
              >
                <Upload className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Add Picture (Upload R2)</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setNewLinkInput('');
                setShowAddLinkInput(false);
                setUploadError(null);
              }}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Đóng"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Mode 1: Dán Link URL */}
          {addMode === 'link' && (
            <form onSubmit={handleAddCustomImage} className="flex gap-1.5 items-center w-full pt-0.5">
              <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
                <LinkIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                <input 
                  type="url"
                  value={newLinkInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewLinkInput(e.target.value)}
                  onFocus={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  placeholder="Dán link ảnh hoặc link bài viết (https://...)..."
                  className="w-full pl-7 pr-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-400 dark:border-blue-500 rounded-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 transition-all font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <button

=== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/TooltipZoomableThumbnail.tsx ===
import React, { FC, lazy, useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Maximize2, ZoomIn } from 'lucide-react';
import { TooltipImageItem } from './tooltipTypes';
import { normalizeImageUrl } from '../LayoutUnitLightboxModal';

interface TooltipZoomableThumbnailProps {
  img: TooltipImageItem;
  onOpenFullscreen: (img: { url: string; title?: string; initialScale?: number }) => void;
}

export const TooltipZoomableThumbnail: React.FC<TooltipZoomableThumbnailProps> = ({
  img,
  onOpenFullscreen,
}) => {
  const [previewScale, setPreviewScale] = useState(1);
  const [isPinching, setIsPinching] = useState(false);
  const [showZoomHint, setShowZoomHint] = useState(false);
  const [isImgError, setIsImgError] = useState(false);

  const touchStateRef = useRef<{
    initialDist: number;
    triggered: boolean;
  } | null>(null);

  const singleTouchStartRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; time: number } | null>(null);
  const lastTapRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // 1. Pinch-to-zoom & Drag-to-zoom gesture on touch devices (iOS / iPad / mobile)
  const handleTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (e.touches.length === 2) {
      const p1 = e.touches[0];
      const p2 = e.touches[1];
      const dist = Math.hypot(p2.clientX - p1.clientX, p2.clientY - p1.clientY);
      touchStateRef.current = { initialDist: dist, triggered: false };
      setIsPinching(true);
      setShowZoomHint(true);
      singleTouchStartRef.current = null;
    } else if (e.touches.length === 1) {
      singleTouchStartRef.current = {
        x: e.touches[0].clientX,
        y: e.touches[0].clientY,
        time: Date.now(),
      };
    }
  };

  const handleTouchMove = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (e.touches.length === 2 && touchStateRef.current) {
      const p1 = e.touches[0];
      const p2 = e.touches[1];
      const currentDist = Math.hypot(p2.clientX - p1.clientX, p2.clientY - p1.clientY);
      const ratio = currentDist / Math.max(touchStateRef.current.initialDist, 1);

      // User spreading fingers to zoom into thumbnail
      if (ratio > 1.05) {
        if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
        setPreviewScale(Math.min(2.2, ratio));

        // When zoom expansion crosses threshold, auto-expand to fullscreen and continue zooming
        if (ratio >= 1.15 && !touchStateRef.current.triggered) {
          touchStateRef.current.triggered = true;
          const targetScale = Math.min(4, Math.max(1.35, ratio * 1.3));
          onOpenFullscreen({
            url: img.url,
            title: img.title,
            initialScale: targetScale,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const handleTouchEnd = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    singleTouchStartRef.current = null;
    if (touchStateRef.current) {
      touchStateRef.current = null;
      setIsPinching(false);
      setPreviewScale(1);
      setTimeout(() => setShowZoomHint(false), 800);
      return;
    }

    // Double-tap zoom detection for single touch
    if (e.changedTouches.length === 1) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastTapRef.current < 320) {
        // Double-tap detected -> auto open fullscreen at 2x zoom
        lastTapRef.current = 0;
        if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
        onOpenFullscreen({
          url: img.url,
          title: img.title,
          initialScale: 2.0,
        });
      } else {
        lastTapRef.current = now;
      }
    }
  };

  // Regular click to open full display mode directly
  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    onOpenFullscreen({
      url: img.url,
      title: img.title,
      initialScale: 1,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
      onTouchMove={handleTouchMove}
      onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
      onTouchCancel={handleTouchEnd}
      onClick={handleClick}
      onMouseEnter={() => setShowZoomHint(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setShowZoomHint(false)}
      className="relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/80 w-full max-h-[190px] sm:max-h-[280px] flex items-center justify-center group/thumb p-1 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
      title="Click to view full display HD"
    >
      {!isImgError ? (
        <img
          src={normalizeImageUrl(img.url)}
          alt={img.title}
          loading="lazy"
          decoding="async"
          onError={() => setIsImgError(true)}
          style={{
            transform: previewScale > 1 ? `scale(${previewScale})` : undefined,
            transition: isPinching ? 'none' : 'transform 0.15s ease-out',
          }}
          draggable={false}
          className="w-full h-auto max-h-[180px] sm:max-h-[270px] object-contain hover:scale-[1.01] duration-150 rounded-md select-none"
        />
      ) : (
        <div
          className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 p-3 text-center w-full"
        >
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
            Web Link / Article Preview
          </span>
          <span className="truncate max-w-[200px] text-[9px] font-mono text-blue-500">
            {img.url}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Floating Action Bar: Maximize & Zoom HD */}
      <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-90 group-hover/thumb:opacity-100 transition-opacity z-10">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleClick}
          className="p-1.5 bg-black/75 hover:bg-black/95 text-white rounded-md backdrop-blur-xs transition-all active:scale-90 cursor-pointer shadow-md flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-medium"
          title="Zoom HD Fullscreen (Escape to close)"
        >
          <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Zoom HD</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Interactive Micro-badge feedback */}
      {(showZoomHint || previewScale > 1) && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 bg-slate-900/85 backdrop-blur-xs text-white text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full pointer-events-none flex items-center gap-1 font-mono shadow-md animate-in fade-in duration-100 z-10">
          <ZoomIn className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-blue-400" />
          <span>
            {previewScale > 1
              ? `Zooming ${(previewScale * 100).toFixed(0)}%...`
              : 'Click to open full display'}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TooltipZoomableThumbnail;


=== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/tooltipStoreIsolation.test.ts ===
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { extractProjectMetadata, projectMatchesScope } from '../../../lib/utils';

// Simple in-memory localStorage mock for node test environment
const mockStorage: Record<string, string> = {};
const mockLocalStorage = {
  getItem: (k: string) => mockStorage[k] ?? null,
  setItem: (k: string, v: string) => { mockStorage[k] = String(v); },
  removeItem: (k: string) => { delete mockStorage[k]; },
  clear: () => {
    Object.keys(mockStorage).forEach(k => delete mockStorage[k]);
  }
};

describe('Tooltip Store Isolation (HCM vs HN)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockLocalStorage.clear();
  });

  it('partitions localStorage keys by store strictly', () => {
    const hnUnitKey = 'taka_unit_images_HN_1F-01';
    const hcmUnitKey = 'taka_unit_images_HCM_1F-01';

    const hnImages = [
      { id: 'img_1', url: 'https://hcm.taka-pm.org/Taka-Pm-folder/HN_1F-01_photo.jpg', title: 'HN Photo', store: 'HN' }
    ];
    const hcmImages = [
      { id: 'img_2', url: 'https://hcm.taka-pm.org/Taka-Pm-folder/HCM_1F-01_photo.jpg', title: 'HCM Photo', store: 'HCM' }
    ];

    mockLocalStorage.setItem(hnUnitKey, JSON.stringify(hnImages));
    mockLocalStorage.setItem(hcmUnitKey, JSON.stringify(hcmImages));

    // When reading HN partition
    const loadedHn = JSON.parse(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hnUnitKey) || '[]');
    expect(loadedHn).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(loadedHn[0].store).toBe('HN');
    expect(loadedHn[0].title).toBe('HN Photo');

    // When reading HCM partition
    const loadedHcm = JSON.parse(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hcmUnitKey) || '[]');
    expect(loadedHcm).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(loadedHcm[0].store).toBe('HCM');
    expect(loadedHcm[0].title).toBe('HCM Photo');

    // Cross-check: HCM partition does not contain HN image
    expect(loadedHcm.some((item: any) => item.store === 'HN')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('migrates legacy un-prefixed key when viewing HN and prevents it from leaking into HCM', () => {
    const unitCode = 'L3-314';
    const legacyKey = `taka_unit_images_${unitCode}`;
    const hnStoreKey = `taka_unit_images_HN_${unitCode}`;
    const hcmStoreKey = `taka_unit_images_HCM_${unitCode}`;

    // Simulate legacy un-prefixed image added while in HN
    const legacyData = [
      { id: 'img_legacy', url: 'https://hcm.taka-pm.org/Taka-Pm-folder/Slide6.JPG', title: 'Salomon HN' }
    ];
    mockLocalStorage.setItem(legacyKey, JSON.stringify(legacyData));

    // HCM check should not see legacy items as HCM
    expect(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hcmStoreKey)).toBeNull();

    // Migrate when HN accesses it
    const legacyRaw = mockLocalStorage.getItem(legacyKey);
    if (legacyRaw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(legacyRaw);
      const tagged = parsed.map((item: any) => ({ ...item, store: 'HN' }));
      mockLocalStorage.setItem(hnStoreKey, JSON.stringify(tagged));
      mockLocalStorage.removeItem(legacyKey);
    }

    // After migration:
    expect(mockLocalStorage.getItem(legacyKey)).toBeNull(); // Legacy removed
    expect(JSON.parse(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hnStoreKey) || '[]')).toHaveLength(1); // Saved to HN
    expect(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hcmStoreKey)).toBeNull(); // HCM remains clean
  });

  it('correctly isolates project metadata matching between HCM and HN', () => {
    const hnProject = {
      id: 'proj_hn_1',
      code: 'L1-112',
      name: 'MBB - Dior Pop-up',
      store: 'HN',
      year: 2027,
    };

    const hcmProject = {
      id: 'proj_hcm_1',
      code: 'L1-112',
      name: 'HCM Cosmetics',
      store: 'HCM',
      year: 2026,
    };

    const hnMeta = extractProjectMetadata(hnProject);
    const hcmMeta = extractProjectMetadata(hcmProject);

    expect(hnMeta.store).toBe('HN');
    expect(hcmMeta.store).toBe('HCM');

    // Matching scope test
    expect(projectMatchesScope(hnMeta, { store: 'HN' })).toBe(true);
    expect(projectMatchesScope(hnMeta, { store: 'HCM' })).toBe(false);

    expect(projectMatchesScope(hcmMeta, { store: 'HCM' })).toBe(true);
    expect(projectMatchesScope(hcmMeta, { store: 'HN' })).toBe(false);
  });
});

export function getMdStatusColorClass(mdStatus: string): string {
  if (!mdStatus) return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
  
  const s = mdStatus.trim().toLowerCase();

  // 1. Signed agreement / Contract Signed / Fully Executed / Finalized (Emerald Green)
  if (s === 'signed agreement' || s.includes('signed agreement') || s.includes('contract signed') || s.includes('executed') || s.includes('fully signed') || s.includes('finalized') || s.includes('agreement signed')) {
    return 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/80';
  }

  // 2. MOU signed / LOI Signed / Pre-Agreed (Teal / Cyan)
  if (s === 'mou signed' || s.includes('mou') || s.includes('loi') || s.includes('loa') || s.includes('pre-agreed') || s.includes('intent')) {
    return 'bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border-teal-300 dark:bg-teal-950/70 dark:text-teal-300 dark:border-teal-800/80';
  }

  // 3. Verbally agreed / Verbal / Initial Talk (Warm Amber / Gold)
  if (s === 'verbally agreed' || s.includes('verbal') || s.includes('initial agreement') || s.includes('talks agreed')) {
    return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800/80';
  }

  // 4. negotiation / Discussion / Under Review (Sky Blue)
  if (s === 'negotiation' || s.includes('negotiat') || s.includes('discuss') || s.includes('proposal') || s.includes('offer') || s.includes('review') || s.includes('draft') || s.includes('pending')) {
    return 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border-sky-300 dark:bg-sky-950/70 dark:text-sky-300 dark:border-sky-800/80';
  }

  // 5. approached / Contacted / Outreach (Indigo)
  if (s === 'approached' || s.includes('approach') || s.includes('contact') || s.includes('reach')) {
    return 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-300 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-800/80';
  }

  // 6. Rejected / Cancelled / Refused (Rose / Red)
  if (s === 'rejected' || s.includes('reject') || s.includes('cancel') || s.includes('terminat') || s.includes('drop') || s.includes('vacant') || s.includes('hold') || s.includes('fail') || s.includes('refus')) {
    return 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800/80';
  }

  // Default Fallback
  return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
}


=== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/useTooltipImages.ts ===
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc, deleteField } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { setDoc } from '../../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../../lib/firebase';
import { extractAllProjectCodes, projectMatchesUnitCode, extractProjectMetadata } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { TooltipImageItem } from './tooltipTypes';
import { deleteR2ImageCleanly } from '../../../lib/r2StorageUtils';
import { recordDelta } from '../../../lib/deltaSyncService';

interface UseTooltipImagesParams {
  p?: Project;
  data: any;
  unitCode: string;
  tooltipRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  positionTooltip: (forceRecalculate?: boolean) => void;
  storeFilter?: string;
}

export function useTooltipImages({
  p,
  data,
  unitCode,
  tooltipRef,
  positionTooltip,
  storeFilter,
}: UseTooltipImagesParams) {
  const [showImagePanel, setShowImagePanel] = useState(false);
  const [showAddLinkInput, setShowAddLinkInput] = useState(false);
  const [newLinkInput, setNewLinkInput] = useState('');
  const [copiedLink, setCopiedLink] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [enlargedImage, setEnlargedImage] = useState<{ url: string; title?: string; initialScale?: number } | null>(null);
  const [customUnitImages, setCustomUnitImages] = useState<Array<{ id: string; url: string; title?: string; createdAt?: string; store?: string }>>([]);

  const activeStore = (
    p?.store ||
    data?.store ||
    (p ? extractProjectMetadata(p).store : '') ||
    (storeFilter && storeFilter.toUpperCase() !== 'ALL' ? storeFilter : '') ||
    'HCM'
  ).toUpperCase().trim();

  const cleanCode = String(data?.code || unitCode || 'default').trim();
  const activeUnitStorageKey = `taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${cleanCode}`;

  // Load custom images from localStorage with strict store separation
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // 1. Primary: load store-partitioned key
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(activeUnitStorageKey);
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
          const matching = parsed.filter(item => !item.store || item.store.toUpperCase() === activeStore);
          setCustomUnitImages(matching);
          return;
        }
      }

      // 2. Legacy key check: only migrate to HN if currently in HN (never load into HCM!)
      const legacyKey = `taka_unit_images_${cleanCode}`;
      const legacySaved = localStorage.getItem(legacyKey);
      if (legacySaved) {
        try {
          const parsedLegacy = JSON.parse(legacySaved);
          if (Array.isArray(parsedLegacy) && parsedLegacy.length > 0) {
            if (activeStore === 'HN') {
              const tagged = parsedLegacy.map(item => ({ ...item, store: 'HN' }));
              localStorage.setItem(activeUnitStorageKey, JSON.stringify(tagged));
              localStorage.removeItem(legacyKey);
              setCustomUnitImages(tagged);
              return;
            }
          }
        } catch {}
      }

      setCustomUnitImages([]);
    } catch {
      setCustomUnitImages([]);
    }
  }, [activeUnitStorageKey, activeStore, cleanCode]);

  // Reset panel open state when unit changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setShowImagePanel(false);
    setShowAddLinkInput(false);
  }, [data.code, unitCode]);

  // Re-evaluate position & smoothly scroll tooltip down to reveal image panel expanding below description box when image button is pressed
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tooltipRef.current) {
      if (showImagePanel) {
        positionTooltip(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (tooltipRef.current) {
            tooltipRef.current.scrollTo({
              top: tooltipRef.current.scrollHeight,
              behavior: 'smooth'
            });
          }
        }, 50);
      }
    }
  }, [showImagePanel, positionTooltip, tooltipRef]);

  // Close enlarged image modal with Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enlargedImage) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setEnlargedImage(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [enlargedImage]);

  const handleAddCustomImage = (e?: React.FormEvent, customUrl?: string) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    const targetUrl = customUrl || newLinkInput;
    const trimmed = targetUrl.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;

    const newEntry = {
      id: `img_${Date.now()}`,
      url: trimmed,
      title: `Link ${customUnitImages.length + 1}`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      store: activeStore,
    };
    const updated = [newEntry, ...customUnitImages];
    setCustomUnitImages(updated);
    setNewLinkInput('');
    setShowAddLinkInput(false);

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(activeUnitStorageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch {}

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taka_unit_images_changed'));
    }

    // Persist link to project ONLY IF project strictly belongs to activeStore
    try {
      const allProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
      const targetProj = (p && extractProjectMetadata(p).store === activeStore ? p : null) || allProjects.find(item => {
        if (item.id === p?.id && extractProjectMetadata(item).store === activeStore) return true;
        const itemStore = extractProjectMetadata(item).store;
        if (itemStore && itemStore !== activeStore) return false;
        const itemCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(item).map(c => c.toLowerCase());
        const targetCode = String(data.code || unitCode || '').toLowerCase();
        return itemCodes.includes(targetCode) || projectMatchesUnitCode(itemCodes, targetCode);
      });

      if (targetProj && extractProjectMetadata(targetProj).store === activeStore) {
        // Purge any legacy fake "Link / Photo:" tasks from taskSummaries to keep the task list & detail box clean
        const cleanedSummaries = (targetProj.taskSummaries || []).filter(
          ts => !ts.name?.startsWith('Link / Photo:') && !ts.name?.startsWith('http://') && !ts.name?.startsWith('https://')
        );

        const existingLinks: any[] = Array.isArray(targetProj.imageLinks) ? targetProj.imageLinks : [];
        const hasLinkAlready = existingLinks.some(l => (typeof l === 'string' ? l === trimmed : l?.url === trimmed));
        const newLinkObj = {
          id: newEntry.id,
          url: trimmed,
          title: newEntry.title,
          createdAt: newEntry.createdAt,
          store: activeStore,
        };
        const updatedImageLinks = hasLinkAlready ? existingLinks : [newLinkObj, ...existingLinks];

        const updatedProject: Project = {
          ...targetProj,
          taskSummaries: cleanedSummaries,
          imageUrl: targetProj.imageUrl || trimmed,
          thumbnail: targetProj.thumbnail || trimmed,
          imageLinks: updatedImageLinks,
        };

        // 1. Instant Zustand 0ms optimistic update
        useAppStore.getState().setProjects(
          allProjects.map(proj => proj.id === targetProj.id ? updatedProject : proj)
        );

        // 2. Cloud Firestore persistence for real-time multi-device sync (iOS <-> Desktop)
        if (targetProj.id) {
          const updateData = {
            taskSummaries: cleanedSummaries,
            imageUrl: updatedProject.imageUrl,
            thumbnail: updatedProject.thumbnail,
            imageLinks: updatedImageLinks,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
          setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_projects", targetProj.id), updateData, { merge: true }).catch(err => {
            console.error("Failed to sync to Firestore:", err);
          });
          recordDelta({
            docId: targetProj.id,
            collectionName: 'taka_projects',
            action: 'update',
            data: updateData,
            year: String(targetProj.year || '')
          }).catch(console.error);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error updating project image link:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteCustomImage = (id: string, urlToDelete?: string) => {
    const updated = customUnitImages.filter(item => item.id !== id && (urlToDelete ? item.url !== urlToDelete : true));
    setCustomUnitImages(updated);
    try {
      if (updated.length === 0) {
        localStorage.removeItem(activeUnitStorageKey);
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${data.code || ''}`);
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${unitCode || ''}`);
        if (p?.code) localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${p.code}`);
        // Also remove legacy keys if any
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${cleanCode}`);
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${data.code || ''}`);
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${unitCode || ''}`);
        if (p?.code) localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${p.code}`);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem(activeUnitStorageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      }
    } catch {}

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taka_unit_images_changed'));
    }

    // Clean up from project.taskSummaries & project.imageLinks ONLY if project belongs to activeStore
    try {
      const targetUrl = urlToDelete || customUnitImages.find(item => item.id === id)?.url;
      if (targetUrl) {
        deleteR2ImageCleanly(targetUrl).catch(err => {
          console.warn("[R2 Purge] Deep clean error:", err);
        });
      }

      const allProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
      const targetProj = (p && extractProjectMetadata(p).store === activeStore ? p : null) || allProjects.find(item => {
        if (item.id === p?.id && extractProjectMetadata(item).store === activeStore) return true;
        const itemStore = extractProjectMetadata(item).store;
        if (itemStore && itemStore !== activeStore) return false;
        const itemCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(item).map(c => c.toLowerCase());
        const targetCode = String(data.code || unitCode || '').toLowerCase();
        return itemCodes.includes(targetCode) || projectMatchesUnitCode(itemCodes, targetCode);
      });

      if (targetProj && extractProjectMetadata(targetProj).store === activeStore) {
        const filteredSummaries = (targetProj.taskSummaries || []).filter(
          ts => ts.link !== urlToDelete && ts.imageUrl !== urlToDelete && !ts.name?.includes(urlToDelete || '') && !ts.name?.startsWith('Link / Photo:')
        );
        const existingLinks: any[] = Array.isArray(targetProj.imageLinks) ? targetProj.imageLinks : [];
        const updatedImageLinks = existingLinks.filter(l => {
          const lUrl = typeof l === 'string' ? l : l?.url;
          const lId = typeof l === 'object' ? l?.id : null;
          if (id && lId === id) return false;
          if (urlToDelete && lUrl === urlToDelete) return false;
          return true;
        });

        const newImageUrl = targetProj.imageUrl === urlToDelete ? '' : targetProj.imageUrl;
        const newThumbnail = targetProj.thumbnail === urlToDelete ? '' : targetProj.thumbnail;
        const newPhoto = (targetProj as any).photo === urlToDelete ? '' : (targetProj as any).photo;
        const newImage = (targetProj as any).image === urlToDelete ? '' : (targetProj as any).image;

        const updatedProject: Project = {
          ...targetProj,
          taskSummaries: filteredSummaries,
          imageUrl: newImageUrl,
          thumbnail: newThumbnail,
          photo: newPhoto,
          image: newImage,
          imageLinks: updatedImageLinks,
        } as Project;

        useAppStore.getState().setProjects(
          allProjects.map(proj => proj.id === targetProj.id ? updatedProject : proj)
        );

        if (targetProj.id) {
          const firestoreUpdate: Record<string, any> = {
            taskSummaries: filteredSummaries,
            imageLinks: updatedImageLinks,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
          if (targetProj.imageUrl === urlToDelete) {
            firestoreUpdate.imageUrl = deleteField();
          }
          if (targetProj.thumbnail === urlToDelete) {
            firestoreUpdate.thumbnail = deleteField();
          }
          if ((targetProj as any).photo === urlToDelete) {
            firestoreUpdate.photo = deleteField();
          }
          if ((targetProj as any).image === urlToDelete) {
            firestoreUpdate.image = deleteField();
          }

          setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_projects", targetProj.id), firestoreUpdate, { merge: true }).catch(console.error);
          recordDelta({
            docId: targetProj.id,
            collectionName: 'taka_projects',
            action: 'update',
            data: firestoreUpdate,
            year: String(targetProj.year || '')
          }).catch(console.error);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error removing from project taskSummaries:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyLink = (url: string) => {
    try {
      navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url);
      setCopiedLink(url);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedLink(null), 2000);
    } catch {}
  };

  // Consolidate all image items (user-added cloud links, taskSummaries, layout image/thumbnail, project attachments)
  const allUnitImages = useMemo(() => {
    const list: TooltipImageItem[] = [];
    const seenUrls = new Set<string>();

    const projStore = p ? extractProjectMetadata(p).store : '';
    const isProjMatchingStore = !p || !projStore || !activeStore || projStore === activeStore;

    // 1. Cloud-backed project.imageLinks (Realtime synchronized across iOS, Android, and Desktop)
    if (isProjMatchingStore && p?.imageLinks && Array.isArray(p.imageLinks)) {
      p.imageLinks.forEach((imgItem: any, idx: number) => {
        const url = typeof imgItem === 'string' ? imgItem : imgItem?.url;
        const itemStore = typeof imgItem === 'object' ? imgItem?.store : '';
        if (url && typeof url === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(url)) {
          if (!itemStore || itemStore.toUpperCase() === activeStore) {
            seenUrls.add(url);
            list.push({
              id: typeof imgItem === 'object' && imgItem.id ? imgItem.id : `img_cloud_${idx}`,
              url: url,
              title: (typeof imgItem === 'object' && imgItem.title) || `Link ${list.length + 1}`,
              source: `${activeStore} Link`,
              isCustom: true,
            });
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // 2. Project taskSummaries links (Prioritized cloud-backed task summarize, strictly matching store)
    if (isProjMatchingStore && p?.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries)) {
      p.taskSummaries.forEach((ts, tsIdx) => {
        const url = ts.link || ts.imageUrl || ts.thumbnail || (typeof ts.name === 'string' ? ts.name.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/)?.[0] : null);
        if (url && typeof url === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(url)) {
          seenUrls.add(url);
          list.push({
            id: `ts_${ts.id || tsIdx}_${url.slice(-8)}`,
            url: url,
            title: ts.name || `Task Summary Link ${list.length + 1}`,
            source: 'Task Summarize',
            isCustom: true,
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // 3. Custom user-posted links from localStorage (fallback for offline/local cache, strictly filtered by activeStore)
    customUnitImages.forEach((c) => {
      if (c.url && !seenUrls.has(c.url)) {
        if (!c.store || c.store.toUpperCase() === activeStore) {
          seenUrls.add(c.url);
          list.push({
            id: c.id,
            url: c.url,
            title: c.title || 'Attached Link',
            source: `${activeStore} Link`,
            isCustom: true,
          });
        }
      }
    });

    // 3. Project direct image / thumbnail fields (strictly matching activeStore)
    if (isProjMatchingStore) {
      if (p?.thumbnail && typeof p.thumbnail === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(p.thumbnail)) {
        seenUrls.add(p.thumbnail);
        list.push({
          id: 'proj_thumb',
          url: p.thumbnail,
          title: 'Project Thumbnail',
          source: 'Project Data',
          isCustom: true,
        });
      }
      if (p?.imageUrl && typeof p.imageUrl === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(p.imageUrl)) {
        seenUrls.add(p.imageUrl);
        list.push({
          id: 'proj_image',
          url: p.imageUrl,
          title: 'Project Image',
          source: 'Project Data',
          isCustom: true,
        });
      }
      if ((p as any)?.image && typeof (p as any).image === 'string' && !seenUrls.has((p as any).image)) {
        seenUrls.add((p as any).image);
        list.push({
          id: 'proj_img',
          url: (p as any).image,
          title: 'Project Image',
          source: 'Project Data',
          isCustom: true,
        });
      }
      if ((p as any)?.photo && typeof (p as any).photo === 'string' && !seenUrls.has((p as any).photo)) {
        seenUrls.add((p as any).photo);
        list.push({
          id: 'proj_photo',
          url: (p as any).photo,
          title: 'Project Photo',
          source: 'Project Data',
          isCustom: true,
        });
      }
    }

    // 4. Unit image from layout data (strictly matching activeStore)
    const dataStore = (data.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
    const isDataMatchingStore = !dataStore || !activeStore || dataStore === activeStore;
    if (isDataMatchingStore) {
      if (data.imageUrl && typeof data.imageUrl === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(data.imageUrl)) {
        seenUrls.add(data.imageUrl);
        list.push({
          id: 'data_image',
          url: data.imageUrl,
          title: 'Unit Layout Image',
          source: 'Layout Data',
        });
      }
      if (data.thumbnail && typeof data.thumbnail === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(data.thumbnail)) {
        seenUrls.add(data.thumbnail);
        list.push({
          id: 'data_thumb',
          url: data.thumbnail,
          title: 'Unit Thumbnail',
          source: 'Layout Data',
        });
      }
      if (data.image && typeof data.image === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(data.image)) {
        seenUrls.add(data.image);
        list.push({
          id: 'data_img',
          url: data.image,
          title: 'Floor Image',
          source: 'Layout Data',
        });
      }
    }

    // 5. Project comments attachments (strictly matching activeStore)
    if (isProjMatchingStore && p?.comments && Array.isArray(p.comments)) {
      p.comments.forEach((c, cIdx) => {
        if (c.attachments && Array.isArray(c.attachments)) {
          c.attachments.forEach((att, aIdx) => {
            if (att.url && !seenUrls.has(att.url)) {
              seenUrls.add(att.url);
              list.push({
                id: `comm_${cIdx}_${aIdx}`,
                url: att.url,
                title: att.name || `Attachment ${list.length + 1}`,
                source: `Comment by ${c.userName || 'User'}`,
              });
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }

    return list;
  }, [customUnitImages, activeStore, data.store, data.imageUrl, data.thumbnail, data.image, p, p?.comments, p?.taskSummaries, p?.thumbnail, p?.imageUrl, (p as any)?.image, (p as any)?.photo]);

  return {
    showImagePanel,
    setShowImagePanel,
    showAddLinkInput,
    setShowAddLinkInput,
    newLinkInput,
    setNewLinkInput,
    copiedLink,
    enlargedImage,
    setEnlargedImage,
    allUnitImages,
    handleAddCustomImage,
    handleDeleteCustomImage,
    handleCopyLink,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/useTooltipPosition.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { TooltipHoverInfo } from './tooltipTypes';

interface UseTooltipPositionParams {
  hoverInfo: TooltipHoverInfo;
  tooltipRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  showImagePanel: boolean;
}

export function useTooltipPosition({
  hoverInfo,
  tooltipRef,
  containerRef,
  showImagePanel,
}: UseTooltipPositionParams) {
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
  const hasUserDraggedRef = useRef(false);
  const hasInitialPositionRef = useRef(false);
  const dragStartRef = useRef<{ startX: number; startY: number; initialLeft: number; initialTop: number }>({
    startX: 0,
    startY: 0,
    initialLeft: 0,
    initialTop: 0
  });

  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (e.button !== 0 && e.pointerType === 'mouse') return;
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button') || (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('a') || (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input')) {
      return;
    }
    const el = tooltipRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    hasUserDraggedRef.current = true;
    dragStartRef.current = {
      startX: e.clientX,
      startY: e.clientY,
      initialLeft: rect.left,
      initialTop: rect.top
    };
    try {
      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    const el = tooltipRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - dragStartRef.current.startX;
    const dy = e.clientY - dragStartRef.current.startY;
    const newLeft = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - el.offsetWidth - 8, dragStartRef.current.initialLeft + dx));
    const newTop = Math.max(60, Math.min(window.innerHeight - el.offsetHeight - 8, dragStartRef.current.initialTop + dy));
    el.style.left = `${newLeft}px`;
    el.style.top = `${newTop}px`;
    el.style.right = 'auto';
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    try {
      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  // Reset user dragged flag and initial position flag whenever a new unit is searched/focused
  useEffect(() => {
    hasUserDraggedRef.current = false;
    hasInitialPositionRef.current = false;
  }, [hoverInfo.unitName, hoverInfo.clientX, hoverInfo.clientY]);

  // Auto Anti-Collision & Obstruction-Proof Positioning Engine
  const positionTooltip = useCallback((forceRecalculate = false) => {
    if (!tooltipRef.current || hasUserDraggedRef.current) return;
    if (hasInitialPositionRef.current && !forceRecalculate) return;

    const el = tooltipRef.current;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const tooltipWidth = rect.width > 0 ? rect.width : 350;
    const tooltipHeight = rect.height > 0 ? rect.height : 220;

    const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const visualVp = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.visualViewport : null;
    const viewportHeight = visualVp ? visualVp.height : window.innerHeight;
    const isMobile = viewportWidth < 640;

    const pad = 12;
    // Bottom clearance: 80px on mobile to leave room for Menu button & Home indicator, 64px on desktop
    const bottomMargin = isMobile ? 80 : 64;

    // Calculate safe top clearance to ensure the tooltip is NEVER covered by the App Header or Layout toolbars
    let safeTop = isMobile ? 152 : 115;

    // 1. Check if the map container element exists
    const containerEl = containerRef?.current || (typeof document !== 'undefined' ? (document.getElementById('live-layout-canvas-container') || document.querySelector('.cursor-grab')) : null);
    if (containerEl) {
      const cRect = containerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (cRect.top > 0) {
        // Place below the container top and clear floating top controls (HCM • L1 & Zoom)
        safeTop = Math.max(safeTop, cRect.top + (isMobile ? 48 : 42));
      }
    }

    // 2. Also inspect the App Header (.sticky or header)
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const headerEl = document.querySelector('.sticky.top-0') || document.querySelector('header');
      if (headerEl) {
        const hRect = headerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (hRect.bottom > 0) {
          safeTop = Math.max(safeTop, hRect.bottom + (isMobile ? 64 : 50));
        }
      }
    }

    const bounds = hoverInfo.unitScreenBounds;

    if (isMobile) {
      // Mobile: Horizontal Auto-Centering with 12px margin
      const left = pad;
      const right = pad;
      
      let top = safeTop;
      if (!showImagePanel && bounds) {
        if (bounds.centerY > viewportHeight * 0.52) {
          top = safeTop;
        } else {
          top = Math.max(safeTop, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin);
        }
      }

      el.style.position = 'fixed';
      el.style.zIndex = '999999';
      el.style.left = `${left}px`;
      el.style.right = `${right}px`;
      el.style.top = `${Math.max(safeTop, top)}px`;
      el.style.width = `calc(100vw - ${pad * 2}px)`;
      el.style.maxWidth = '420px';
      el.style.maxHeight = `calc(${Math.max(160, viewportHeight - safeTop - bottomMargin)}px)`;
      el.style.margin = '0 auto';
      el.style.transform = 'none';
    } else {
      // Desktop / Tablet: Smart 4-Way Anti-Obstruction Clamping
      let left: number;
      let top: number;

      if (bounds) {
        const spaceRight = viewportWidth - bounds.right;
        const spaceLeft = bounds.left;

        if (spaceRight >= tooltipWidth + pad + 20) {
          // Place cleanly to the right of the unit
          left = bounds.right + 24;
        } else if (spaceLeft >= tooltipWidth + pad + 20) {
          // Place cleanly to the left of the unit
          left = bounds.left - tooltipWidth - 24;
        } else {
          left = Math.max(pad, viewportWidth - tooltipWidth - pad);
        }
        top = Math.max(safeTop, Math.min(bounds.top, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin));
      } else {
        const clientX = hoverInfo.clientX !== undefined ? hoverInfo.clientX : viewportWidth / 2;
        const clientY = hoverInfo.clientY !== undefined ? hoverInfo.clientY : viewportHeight / 2;

        left = clientX + 16;
        if (left + tooltipWidth > viewportWidth - pad) {
          left = clientX - tooltipWidth - 16;
        }
        left = Math.max(pad, Math.min(left, viewportWidth - tooltipWidth - pad));

        top = clientY + 16;
        if (top + tooltipHeight > viewportHeight - bottomMargin) {
          top = clientY - tooltipHeight - 16;
        }
        top = Math.max(safeTop, Math.min(top, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin));
      }

      el.style.position = 'fixed';
      el.style.zIndex = '999999';
      el.style.left = `${left}px`;
      el.style.right = 'auto';
      el.style.top = `${top}px`;
      el.style.width = '370px';
      el.style.maxWidth = `calc(100vw - ${pad * 2}px)`;
      el.style.maxHeight = `calc(${Math.max(160, viewportHeight - safeTop - bottomMargin)}px)`;
      el.style.margin = '0';
      el.style.transform = 'none';
    }

    hasInitialPositionRef.current = true;
  }, [hoverInfo.clientX, hoverInfo.clientY, hoverInfo.unitScreenBounds, tooltipRef, containerRef, showImagePanel]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    positionTooltip();
  }, [positionTooltip]);

  // Handle browser window resize cleanly without jumping on internal input focus or size changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tooltipRef.current) return;
    const handleWindowResize = () => {
      positionTooltip(true);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleWindowResize);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleWindowResize);
    };
  }, [positionTooltip, tooltipRef]);

  return {
    handlePointerDown,
    handlePointerMove,
    handlePointerUp,
    positionTooltip,
  };
}

import { Project } from '../../types';
import { 
  getStatus, 
  computeProjectActStatus,

export interface BuildAggregatedUnitDataParams {
  units: any[];
  summaryData: any[];
  enrichedProjects: Project[];
  tasks: any[];
  projectLinkData: any[];
  storeFilter: string;
  locationFilter: string;

  hasStoredUnitImages: (key: string | undefined | null, store?: string) => boolean;
}

export function buildAggregatedUnitData({
  units,
  summaryData,
  enrichedProjects,
  tasks,
  projectLinkData,
  storeFilter,
  locationFilter,
  targetLoc,
  effectiveLayoutYear,
  delegationGroups,
  layoutTooltipVisibility,
  restrictedProjectCodes,
  hasStoredUnitImages,
}: BuildAggregatedUnitDataParams) {
  const dataMap: Record<string, any> = {};
  
  units.forEach((u: any) => {
    const uName = (u?.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!uName) return;
    const isRestricted = restrictedProjectCodes.has(uName);
    dataMap[uName] = {
      name: u.name || '',
      id: u.id,
      unit: u.name || '',
      isRestricted,
      hasImage: Boolean(u.imageUrl || u.thumbnail || u.image),
      year: effectiveLayoutYear,
      size: 0, sales: 0, salesByCp: 0, salesByHcmcate: 0,
      profit: 0, profitByCp: 0, profitByHcmcate: 0,
      margin: 0, marginByCp: 0, hcmSalesEffi: 0, hcmMargin: 0,
      mdStatus: "", task: "", projectStatus: "", actStatus: "",
      endDate: "", status: "", vendorCode: "",
      brandCode: "", brandName: "", classCode: "", floor: u.location || locationFilter || "",
      appProjectStatus: "", appProjectBudget: 0, appProjectActual: 0, appProjectCode: "", appProjectYear: "", projectName: "", startDate: "", handoverDate: "", openingDate: "", detail: "", party: "",
      appProjectMdStatus: "", appMdStatus: "", appProjectActStatus: "", appActStatus: "", appProjectDetail: "", appDetail: "", appProjectDescription: "", appDescription: "", appProjectParty: "", appParty: ""
    };
  });

  summaryData.forEach((sumData) => {
    const key = sumData.unit?.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (key && dataMap[key]) {
      if (dataMap[key].isRestricted || restrictedProjectCodes.has(key)) {
        dataMap[key].isRestricted = true;
        return;
      }
      Object.assign(dataMap[key], {
          size: sumData.size || 0,
          sales: sumData.salesAmount || 0,
          profit: sumData.profitAmount || 0,
          margin: sumData.margin || 0,
          hcmSalesEffi: sumData.hcmSalesEffi || 0,
          mdStatus: sumData.mdStatus || "",
          projectStatus: sumData.projectStatus || "",
          status: sumData.status || "",
          brandName: sumData.brandName || "",
          floor: dataMap[key].floor || (sumData as any).floor || "",
      });
    }
  });

  // Pre-index tasks by code map and projectId for O(1) lookup (Filtered by store and year)
  const tasksByCodeMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
  const tasksByProjIdMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
  tasks.forEach(t => {
    if (!t || !t.name) return;
    const tStore = String(t.projectStore || t.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
    if (tStore && tStore !== 'ALL' && storeFilter && storeFilter !== 'all' && tStore !== storeFilter.toUpperCase().trim()) return;

      let list = tasksByProjIdMap.get(pId);

      }

    }
    if (t.projectCode) {
