      const codeParts = rawCode.split(/[+;,/]/).map(c => c.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      codeParts.forEach(c => {
        let list = tasksByCodeMap.get(c);
        if (!list) {
          list = [];
          tasksByCodeMap.set(c, list);
        }
        list.push(t);
      });
    }
  });

  // Pre-index projectLink: maps unit name -> list of linked project codes
  const unitToProjectCodesMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
  projectLinkData.forEach((pl: any) => {
    const u = String(pl?.unit || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const pCode = String(pl?.code || pl?.projectCode || pl?.project || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (u && pCode) {
      if (!unitToProjectCodesMap.has(u)) unitToProjectCodesMap.set(u, []);
      unitToProjectCodesMap.get(u)!.push(pCode);
    }
  });

  const now = new Date();

      if (!startStr || !finishStr) return false;
      const start = new Date(startStr);
      const finish = new Date(finishStr);
      return now >= start && now <= finish;
    });
    const activeTaskNames = Array.from(new Set(activeTasks.map(t => t.name).filter(Boolean)));

    const isUrlOrImageLine = (str: string | undefined | null) => {

      const lower = str.toLowerCase().trim();

        lower.startsWith('https://') ||

        lower.startsWith('photo:') ||
        lower.startsWith('image:') ||
        lower.includes('.jpg') ||

        lower.includes('.png') ||
        lower.includes('.webp') ||
        lower.includes('.gif')
      );

    const descStr = p.detail || (p as any).description || '';

                    ? computeActProgressFromSummaries(p.taskSummaries)

          );

          dataMap[code].hasProjectDelegation = hasProjectDelegation;

            (p.thumbnail && typeof p.thumbnail === 'string' && p.thumbnail.trim()) ||
            (p.imageUrl && typeof p.imageUrl === 'string' && p.imageUrl.trim()) ||
            ((p as any).image && typeof (p as any).image === 'string' && (p as any).image.trim()) ||
            ((p as any).photo && typeof (p as any).photo === 'string' && (p as any).photo.trim()) ||
            (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.some((ts: any) => ts.link || ts.imageUrl || ts.thumbnail || (typeof ts.name === 'string' && ts.name.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/)))) ||
            (p.comments && Array.isArray(p.comments) && p.comments.some((c: any) => c.attachments && c.attachments.length > 0)) ||
            (p as any).imageUrl || (p as any).thumbnail || (p as any).image ||
            dataMap[code].imageUrl || dataMap[code].thumbnail || dataMap[code].image ||
            hasStoredUnitImages(code, uStore) ||
            hasStoredUnitImages(p.code, uStore)
          );
          dataMap[code].hasImage = hasProjectImages || dataMap[code].hasImage;

          const todayStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0];
          const alertReasons: string[] = [];
          let alertLevel: 'critical' | 'warning' | null = null;

          const isProjectCompleted = (p.computedActProgress ?? 0) >= 100 || 
            String(status).toLowerCase() === 'completed' || 
            String(actStatus).toLowerCase() === 'completed';

          if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.notifications !== false && !isProjectCompleted) {
            const subTasksList = allMatchedTasks.length > 0 ? allMatchedTasks : (p.taskSummaries || []);
            let overdueCount = 0;
            if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertOverdue !== false) {
              subTasksList.forEach((st: any) => {
                if (st.finish && st.finish < todayStr) {
                  const prog = st.progress ?? st.computedActProgress ?? 0;
                  if (prog < 100 && st.status !== 'Completed' && st.status !== 'Done' && st.status !== 'Canceled') {
                    overdueCount++;
                  }
                }
              });
            }

            let isDelayed = false;
            if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertDelay !== false) {
              const lowerStat = String(status).toLowerCase();
              const lowerAct = String(actStatus).toLowerCase();
              isDelayed = lowerStat.includes('delay') || lowerStat.includes('late') || lowerAct.includes('delay') || lowerAct.includes('late');
            }

            if (isDelayed && overdueCount > 0) {
              alertReasons.push(`Project delayed (${overdueCount} overdue task${overdueCount > 1 ? 's' : ''})`);
              alertLevel = 'critical';
            } else if (isDelayed) {
              alertReasons.push('Project delayed');
              alertLevel = 'critical';
            } else if (overdueCount > 0) {
              alertReasons.push(`${overdueCount} overdue task${overdueCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
              alertLevel = 'critical';
            }

            if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertHandover !== false) {
              const hDate = p.handover || p.computedTakCompl;
              if (hDate && hDate >= todayStr && (p.computedActProgress ?? 0) < 100) {
                const diffDays = Math.ceil((new Date(hDate).getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                if (diffDays >= 0 && diffDays <= 3) {
                  alertReasons.push(`Handover ${diffDays === 0 ? 'Today' : 'in ' + diffDays + 'd'}`);
                  if (!alertLevel) alertLevel = 'warning';
                }
              }
            }

            if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertOpening !== false) {
              const oDate = p.opening || p.computedOpening;
              if (oDate && oDate >= todayStr && (p.computedActProgress ?? 0) < 100) {
                const diffDays = Math.ceil((new Date(oDate).getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                if (diffDays >= 0 && diffDays <= 5) {
                  const actProg = p.computedActProgress ?? 0;
                  if (actProg < 80 && layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertOpeningRisk !== false) {
                    alertReasons.push(`Opening at risk (<80% prg, ${diffDays === 0 ? 'Today' : 'in ' + diffDays + 'd'})`);
                    alertLevel = 'critical';
                  } else if (diffDays <= 3) {
                    alertReasons.push(`Opening ${diffDays === 0 ? 'Today' : 'in ' + diffDays + 'd'}`);
                    if (!alertLevel) alertLevel = 'warning';
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }

          dataMap[code].alerts = {
            hasAlert: alertReasons.length > 0,
            level: alertLevel,
            count: alertReasons.length,
            reasons: alertReasons
          };
       }
    });
  });

  return dataMap;
}

import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { extractFloorFromCodeOrName } from './layoutTabSearchUtils';

export interface UnitFocalPointResult {
  targetUnit: any;
  cx: number;
  cy: number;
  uW: number;
  uH: number;
}

export function calculateUnitFocalPoint(
  targetUnitOrName: string | any,
  units: any[],
  aggregatedData: Record<string, any>,
  restrictedProjectCodes: Set<string>
): UnitFocalPointResult | null {
  if (!targetUnitOrName || !Array.isArray(units) || units.length === 0) return null;

  let targetUnit: any = null;
  if (typeof targetUnitOrName === 'object' && targetUnitOrName?.id) {
    targetUnit = targetUnitOrName;
  } else {
    const q = String(targetUnitOrName).toLowerCase().trim();
    const qFloor = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(q);

    const isDifferentFloor = (u: any) => {
      if (!qFloor) return false;
      const uFloor = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(u.name || u.label || u.id);
      if (uFloor && uFloor.toUpperCase() !== qFloor.toUpperCase()) {
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    };

    // 1. Direct exact match by unit name, id, or label
    targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
      if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
      return (
        (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim() === q || 
        String(u.id).toLowerCase() === q ||
        (u.label && String(u.label).toLowerCase().trim() === q)
      );
    });

    // 2. Exact match in aggregated data (project code, brand name, unit, project name)
    if (!targetUnit) {
      targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
        if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
        const uName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const d = aggregatedData[uName];
        if (!d) return false;
        const matchCode = d.appProjectCode && String(d.appProjectCode).toLowerCase().trim() === q;
        const matchName = d.projectName && String(d.projectName).toLowerCase().trim() === q;
        const matchBrand = d.brandName && String(d.brandName).toLowerCase().trim() === q;
        const matchUnit = d.unit && String(d.unit).toLowerCase().trim() === q;
        return matchCode || matchName || matchBrand || matchUnit;
      });
    }

    // 3. Direct store lookup fallback if aggregatedData not ready or project not yet linked in dataMap
    if (!targetUnit) {
      try {
        const globalProjects = (useAppStore.getState?.() as any)?.projects || [];
        const activeStore = (useAppStore.getState?.() as any)?.globalStoreFilter || 'HCM';
        const activeYear = (useAppStore.getState?.() as any)?.globalYearFilter || '2026';

        const matchedProj = globalProjects.find((p: any) => {
          const pStore = p.store ? String(p.store).trim().toUpperCase() : 'HCM';
          const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : '';
          if (activeStore && activeStore !== 'ALL' && pStore && pStore !== activeStore.toUpperCase()) return false;
          if (activeYear && activeYear !== 'all' && pYear && pYear !== 'ALL' && pYear !== activeYear) return false;

          return (
            (p.code && String(p.code).toLowerCase().trim() === q) ||
            (p.id && String(p.id).toLowerCase().trim() === q) ||
            (p.name && String(p.name).toLowerCase().trim() === q) ||
            ((p as any).unit && String((p as any).unit).toLowerCase().trim() === q)
          );
        });
        if (matchedProj) {
          const pCodes = [
            matchedProj.code,
            (matchedProj as any).unit,
            matchedProj.name,
            ...((matchedProj as any).linkCodes || [])
          ].filter(Boolean).map((s: string) => String(s).toLowerCase().trim());

          targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
            if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
            const uName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            const uId = String(u.id || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            return pCodes.includes(uName) || pCodes.includes(uId);
          });
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    // 4. Normalized exact match (without hyphens/dots/spaces)
    if (!targetUnit) {
      const normQ = q.replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '');
      if (normQ.length >= 2) {
        targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
          if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
          const normUName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '');
          const normUId = String(u.id || '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '');
          return normUName === normQ || normUId === normQ;
        });
      }
    }

    // 5. Prefix / Stem match ONLY if same floor and significant length
    if (!targetUnit && q.length >= 3) {
      targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
        if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
        const uName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (uName.length < 3) return false;
        return (
          uName.startsWith(q + '-') ||
          uName.startsWith(q + '_') ||
          q.startsWith(uName + '-') ||
          q.startsWith(uName + '_')
        );
      });
    }
  }

  if (!targetUnit) return null;

  const targetUName = (targetUnit.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (restrictedProjectCodes.has(targetUName) || aggregatedData[targetUName]?.isRestricted) {
    return null;
  }

  let cx = targetUnit.x || 0;
  let cy = targetUnit.y || 0;
  let uW = 100;
  let uH = 60;

  if (targetUnit.type === 'rect') {
    uW = Math.abs(targetUnit.width || 100);
    uH = Math.abs(targetUnit.height || 60);
    cx = (targetUnit.x || 0) + uW / 2;
    cy = (targetUnit.y || 0) + uH / 2;
  } else if (targetUnit.type === 'circle') {
    const r = targetUnit.radius || 30;
    uW = r * 2;
    uH = r * 2;
    cx = targetUnit.x || 0;
    cy = targetUnit.y || 0;
  } else if (targetUnit.type === 'polygon' && targetUnit.points && targetUnit.points.length >= 2) {
    let sumX = 0, sumY = 0, count = 0;
    let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < targetUnit.points.length; i += 2) {
      const px = targetUnit.points[i];
      const py = targetUnit.points[i + 1];
      sumX += px;
      sumY += py;
      count++;
      minX = Math.min(minX, px);
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, px);
      minY = Math.min(minY, py);
      maxY = Math.max(maxY, py);
    }
    cx = count > 0 ? sumX / count : 0;
    cy = count > 0 ? sumY / count : 0;
    uW = maxX > minX ? maxX - minX : 100;
    uH = maxY > minY ? maxY - minY : 60;
  } else {
    cx = (targetUnit.textX || targetUnit.x || 0) + (targetUnit.textWidth || 100) / 2;
    cy = (targetUnit.textY || targetUnit.y || 0) + (targetUnit.textHeight || 30) / 2;
  }

  return { targetUnit, cx, cy, uW, uH };
}

export function computeTooltipPosition(
  clientX: number,
  clientY: number,
  tooltipWidth: number,
  tooltipHeight: number,
  viewportWidth: number,
  viewportHeight: number
) {
  const isMobile = viewportWidth < 640;
  const pad = 12;
  const bottomMargin = isMobile ? 84 : 72;

  let safeTop = isMobile ? 120 : 100;
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    const headerEl = document.querySelector('header') || document.querySelector('.sticky.top-0');
    if (headerEl) {
      const hRect = headerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (hRect.bottom > 0) {
        safeTop = Math.max(safeTop, hRect.bottom + 8);
      }
    }
  }

  if (isMobile) {
    let top: number;
    if (clientY > viewportHeight * 0.52) {
      top = safeTop;
    } else {
      top = Math.max(safeTop, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin);
    }

    return {
      position: 'fixed' as const,
      zIndex: 999999,
      left: `${pad}px`,
      right: `${pad}px`,
      top: `${top}px`,
      width: `calc(100vw - ${pad * 2}px)`,
      maxWidth: '420px',
      maxHeight: `calc(${viewportHeight - safeTop - bottomMargin}px)`,
      margin: '0 auto',
      transform: 'none',
    };
  }

  let left = clientX + 16;
  if (left + tooltipWidth > viewportWidth - pad) {
    left = clientX - tooltipWidth - 16;
  }
  left = Math.max(pad, Math.min(left, viewportWidth - tooltipWidth - pad));

  let top = clientY + 16;
  if (top + tooltipHeight > viewportHeight - bottomMargin) {
    top = clientY - tooltipHeight - 16;
  }
  top = Math.max(safeTop, Math.min(top, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin));

  return {
    position: 'fixed' as const,
    zIndex: 999999,
    left: `${left}px`,
    right: 'auto',
    top: `${top}px`,
    width: '350px',
    maxWidth: `calc(100vw - ${pad * 2}px)`,
    maxHeight: `calc(${viewportHeight - safeTop - bottomMargin}px)`,
    margin: '0',
    transform: 'none',
  };
}

export function exportStageHighRes(
  stage: any,
  bgImage: any,
  version: any,
  units: any[],
  dpi: number = 200
) {
  if (!stage) return null;

  let contentX = 0;
  let contentY = 0;
  let contentW = 1000;
  let contentH = 800;

  if (bgImage) {
    const imgNaturalW = (bgImage as HTMLImageElement).naturalWidth || bgImage.width || 1000;
    const imgNaturalH = (bgImage as HTMLImageElement).naturalHeight || bgImage.height || 800;
    const imgScale = version?.imageScale || 1;
    contentW = imgNaturalW * imgScale;
    contentH = imgNaturalH * imgScale;
    contentX = version?.imagePos?.x || 0;
    contentY = version?.imagePos?.y || 0;
  } else if (units && units.length > 0) {
    let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    units.forEach((u: any) => {
      const ux = u.x || 0;
      const uy = u.y || 0;
      const uw = u.width || 100;
      const uh = u.height || 100;
      minX = Math.min(minX, ux);
      minY = Math.min(minY, uy);
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, ux + uw);
      maxY = Math.max(maxY, uy + uh);
    });
    if (minX !== Infinity && maxX > minX) {
      contentX = minX;
      contentY = minY;
      contentW = Math.max(100, maxX - minX);
      contentH = Math.max(100, maxY - minY);
    }
  }

  const oldW = stage.width();
  const oldH = stage.height();
  const oldScaleX = stage.scaleX();
  const oldScaleY = stage.scaleY();
  const oldX = stage.x();
  const oldY = stage.y();

  const targetW = Math.max(100, Math.round(contentW));
  const targetH = Math.max(100, Math.round(contentH));
  stage.width(targetW);
  stage.height(targetH);
  stage.scale({ x: 1, y: 1 });
  stage.position({ x: -contentX, y: -contentY });
  stage.batchDraw();

  const exportRatio = Math.min(2.5, Math.max(1.0, dpi / 96));
  const dataUrl = stage.toDataURL({
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    width: targetW,
    height: targetH,
    pixelRatio: exportRatio,
    mimeType: 'image/jpeg',
    quality: 0.94
  });

  stage.width(oldW);
  stage.height(oldH);
  stage.scale({ x: oldScaleX, y: oldScaleY });
  stage.position({ x: oldX, y: oldY });
  stage.batchDraw();

  return {
    dataUrl,
    width: Math.round(targetW * exportRatio),
    height: Math.round(targetH * exportRatio),
  };
}

export function triggerStageDownload(stage: any) {
  if (!stage) return;
  const dataURL = stage.toDataURL({ pixelRatio: 2 });
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.download = `Thematic_Map_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.png`;
  link.href = dataURL;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
}

export function findUnitInOtherFloorVersions(q: string, availableStoreVersions: any[]) {
  if (!q || !Array.isArray(availableStoreVersions) || availableStoreVersions.length === 0) return null;
  const qLower = String(q).toLowerCase().trim();

  // 1. Direct version unit matching
  const matched = availableStoreVersions.find((v: any) => {
    if (v?.groupMappings) {
      const inGroup = Object.values(v.groupMappings).some((m: any) => 
        Array.isArray(m) && m.some(id => String(id).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower)
      );
      if (inGroup) return true;
    }
    const unitList = (Array.isArray(v?.mapUnits) ? v.mapUnits : (Array.isArray(v?.units) ? v.units : []));
    if (unitList.length > 0) {
      const inUnits = unitList.some((u: any) => 
        (u.name && String(u.name).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
        (u.id && String(u.id).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
        (u.label && String(u.label).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower)
      );
      if (inUnits) return true;
    }
    return false;
  });

  if (matched) return matched;

  // 2. Fallback: If q is a project code/name, find its floor location and matching version
  try {
    const globalProjects = (useAppStore.getState?.() as any)?.projects || [];
    const p = globalProjects.find((proj: any) => 
      (proj.code && String(proj.code).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
      (proj.id && String(proj.id).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
      (proj.name && String(proj.name).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
      ((proj as any).unit && String((proj as any).unit).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower)
    );
    if (p) {
      const pFloor = (p.location && p.location !== 'all' && p.location !== 'ALL') ? p.location : ((p as any).floor || extractFloorFromCodeOrName(p.code) || extractFloorFromCodeOrName((p as any).unit));
      if (pFloor && pFloor.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
        const pLoc = String(pFloor).trim().toUpperCase();
        const verForLoc = availableStoreVersions.find((v: any) => 
          String(v.location || '').trim().toUpperCase() === pLoc
        );
        if (verForLoc) return verForLoc;
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  // 3. Fallback: If q contains floor pattern (e.g. "L3-303-1" -> "L3")
  const qFloor = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(q);
  if (qFloor && qFloor.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    const floorLoc = qFloor.toUpperCase();
    const verForLoc = availableStoreVersions.find((v: any) => 
      String(v.location || '').trim().toUpperCase() === floorLoc
    );
    if (verForLoc) return verForLoc;
  }

  return null;
}

export function hasAggregatedDataChanged(prev: any, next: any): boolean {
  if (!prev || !next) return true;
  return (
    prev.code !== next.code ||
    prev.status !== next.status ||
    prev.budget !== next.budget ||
    prev.actual !== next.actual ||
    prev.commentsCount !== next.commentsCount ||
    prev.planProgress !== next.planProgress ||
    prev.actProgress !== next.actProgress ||
    prev.matchedTasksCount !== next.matchedTasksCount
  );
}

export interface UnitSuggestionItem {
  unit: string;
  location?: string;
  brand?: string;
  project?: string;
  code?: string;
  description?: string;
}

export const extractFloorFromCodeOrName = (str?: string | null): string | null => {
  if (!str) return null;
  const s = String(str).trim();
  const m = s.match(/(?:^|[^a-zA-Z0-9])(B\d|L\d|\d+F|\d+L|GF|MF|RF|BASEMENT\s*\d?|LEVEL\s*\d?|FLOOR\s*\d?)(?:[^a-zA-Z0-9]|$)/i);
  if (m) {
    let token = m[1].toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (token.startsWith('BASEMENT')) token = token.replace('BASEMENT', 'B') || 'B1';
    if (token.startsWith('LEVEL')) token = token.replace('LEVEL', 'L') || 'L1';
    if (token.startsWith('FLOOR')) token = token.replace('FLOOR', 'L') || 'L1';
    if (/^\d+F$/.test(token)) token = 'L' + token.replace('F', '');
    if (/^\d+L$/.test(token)) token = 'L' + token.replace('L', '');
    return token;
  }
  return null;
};

export const isValidUrl = (val: any): boolean => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return false;
  const str = String(val).trim();
  if (str === '' || str === '0' || str === '_' || str.toLowerCase() === 'null') return false;
  return true;
};

export function buildUnitSuggestions(
  storeUnits: any[],
  projects: any[],
  activeStore: string,
  availableLocations: string[],
  isAdmin: boolean
): UnitSuggestionItem[] {
  const map = new globalThis.Map<string, UnitSuggestionItem>();
  const allowedLocsSet = new Set(availableLocations.map(l => String(l).toLowerCase().trim()));

  storeUnits.forEach((u: any) => {
    if (u?.name) {
      let loc = u.location || '';
      if (!loc) {
        const m = String(u.name).match(/^(L\d|B\d|\d+F|\d+L|GF|MF|RF)/i);
        if (m) loc = m[1].toUpperCase();
      }
      if (isAdmin || !loc || allowedLocsSet.has(loc.toLowerCase().trim())) {
        const uName = String(u.name).trim();
        const key = `${uName.toLowerCase()}_${loc.toLowerCase().trim()}`;
        map.set(key, {
          unit: uName,
          location: loc,
          brand: '',
          project: '',
          code: uName
        });
      }
    }
  });

  projects.forEach((p: any) => {
    if (!p.store || p.store === activeStore || activeStore === 'all') {
      let loc = p.location || '';
      if (!loc) {
        const m = String(p.code || p.unit || '').match(/^(L\d|B\d|\d+F|\d+L|GF|MF|RF)/i);
        if (m) loc = m[1].toUpperCase();
      }
      if (isAdmin || !loc || allowedLocsSet.has(loc.toLowerCase().trim())) {
        const primaryCode = String(p.unit || p.code || p.name || '').trim();
        if (primaryCode) {
          const key = `${primaryCode.toLowerCase()}_${(p.code || '').toLowerCase().trim()}_${loc.toLowerCase().trim()}`;
          const existing = map.get(key) || { unit: primaryCode, location: loc, brand: '', project: '', code: '', description: '' };
          const desc = p.detail || (p as any).description || p.note || '';
          map.set(key, {
            unit: primaryCode,
            location: loc || existing.location || '',
            brand: p.brandName || existing.brand || '',
            project: p.name || existing.project || '',
            code: p.code || existing.code || primaryCode,
            description: desc || existing.description || ''
          });
        }
      }
    }
  });

  return Array.from(map.values());
}

export function scoreAndFilterUnitSuggestions(
  unitSuggestions: UnitSuggestionItem[],
  unitSearchInput: string,
  currentLocationFilter: string
): UnitSuggestionItem[] {
  if (!unitSearchInput.trim()) return [];
  
  const norm = (s: string) =>
    (s || '')
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      .trim();

  const qRaw = unitSearchInput.toLowerCase().trim();
  const q = norm(unitSearchInput);
  const currentLoc = norm(currentLocationFilter || '');

  const scoredList: Array<{ item: UnitSuggestionItem; score: number }> = [];

  unitSuggestions.forEach((item) => {
    const uRaw = (item.unit || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const bRaw = (item.brand || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const pRaw = (item.project || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const cRaw = (item.code || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const lRaw = (item.location || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const dRaw = (item.description || '').toLowerCase().trim();

    const uNorm = norm(item.unit);
    const bNorm = norm(item.brand || '');
    const pNorm = norm(item.project || '');
    const cNorm = norm(item.code || '');
    const lNorm = norm(item.location || '');
    const dNorm = norm(item.description || '');

    let score = 0;

    if (bNorm === q || bRaw === qRaw) score = 12000;
    else if (uNorm === q || uRaw === qRaw) score = 11000;
    else if (cNorm === q || cRaw === qRaw) score = 10000;
    else if (pNorm === q || pRaw === qRaw) score = 9000;
    else if (bNorm.startsWith(q) || bRaw.startsWith(qRaw)) score = 8000;
    else if (uNorm.startsWith(q) || uRaw.startsWith(qRaw)) score = 7000;
    else if (cNorm.startsWith(q) || cRaw.startsWith(qRaw)) score = 6000;
    else if (pNorm.startsWith(q) || pRaw.startsWith(qRaw)) score = 5000;
    else {
      const bWords = bNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);
      const uWords = uNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);
      const cWords = cNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);
      const pWords = pNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);
      const dWords = dNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);

      if (bWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 4000;
      else if (uWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 3500;
      else if (cWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 3000;
      else if (pWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 2500;
      else if (dWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 2200;
      else if (bNorm.includes(q) || bRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 2000;
      else if (uNorm.includes(q) || uRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 1700;
      else if (cNorm.includes(q) || cRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 1400;
      else if (pNorm.includes(q) || pRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 1100;
      else if (dNorm.includes(q) || dRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 900;
      else if (lNorm.includes(q) || lRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 600;
    }

    if (score > 0) {
      const matchLen = (bNorm.includes(q) ? bNorm.length : (uNorm.includes(q) ? uNorm.length : (cNorm.includes(q) ? cNorm.length : pNorm.length))) || 50;
      score += Math.max(0, 100 - Math.min(matchLen, 100));

      if (currentLoc && lNorm === currentLoc) {
        score += 50;
      }

      scoredList.push({ item, score });
    }
  });

  scoredList.sort((a, b) => {
    if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
    return (a.item.unit || '').localeCompare(b.item.unit || '');
  });

  return scoredList.map(s => s.item);
}

export function resolveTargetFloorForUnit(
  unitItem: { unit: string; location?: string; brand?: string; project?: string; code?: string },
  projects: any[]
): string {
  if (unitItem.location && unitItem.location.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    return String(unitItem.location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }
  const qCode = String(unitItem.unit).trim().toLowerCase();
  const matchedP = projects.find(p => 
    ((p as any).unit && String((p as any).unit).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (p.code && String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (p.name && String(p.name).trim().toLowerCase() === String(unitItem.project || '').trim().toLowerCase())
  );
  if (matchedP?.location && matchedP.location.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    return String(matchedP.location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }
  const extracted = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(unitItem.unit) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(matchedP?.code) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(matchedP?.name);
  return extracted || '';
}

export function resolveInitialTargetLocation(
  initialLocation: string,
  initialProjectCode: string,
  projects: any[],
  tasks: any[],
  allStoreVersions: any[],
  unitInfo: any[]
): string {
  let targetLoc = (initialLocation && initialLocation !== 'all') ? String(initialLocation).trim().toUpperCase() : '';
  if (!initialProjectCode || targetLoc) return targetLoc;

  const qCode = String(initialProjectCode).trim().toLowerCase();

  // 1. Search in projects
  const matched = projects.find(p => 
    (p.code && String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    ((p as any).unit && String((p as any).unit).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (p.name && String(p.name).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (p.id && String(p.id).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode)
  );
  if (matched?.location && matched.location.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    return String(matched.location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }

  // 2. Search in project tasks
  const matchedTask = tasks.find(t => 
    (t.projectCode && String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (matched?.id && (t as any).projectId === matched.id)
  );
  if ((matchedTask as any)?.location && (matchedTask as any).location.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    return String((matchedTask as any).location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }

  // 3. Search in unitInfo
  const matchedUInfo = unitInfo.find((u: any) => 
    (u.unit && String(u.unit).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (u.name && String(u.name).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (u.unitId && String(u.unitId).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode)
  );
  if (matchedUInfo?.floor || matchedUInfo?.location) {
    return String(matchedUInfo.floor || matchedUInfo.location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }

  // 4. Search in store versions
  for (const v of allStoreVersions) {
    if (!v.location) continue;
    if (v.groupMappings) {
      const hasUnit = Object.values(v.groupMappings).some((arr: any) => 
        Array.isArray(arr) && arr.some(id => String(id).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode)
      );
      if (hasUnit) {
        return String(v.location).trim().toUpperCase();
      }
    }
    if ((v as any).mapUnits && Array.isArray((v as any).mapUnits)) {
      const hasUnit = (v as any).mapUnits.some((u: any) => 
        (u.name && String(u.name).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
        (u.id && String(u.id).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode)
      );
      if (hasUnit) {
        return String(v.location).trim().toUpperCase();
      }
    }
  }

  // 5. Regex extraction
  const extracted = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(initialProjectCode) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(matched?.code) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(matched?.name) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName((matched as any)?.unit);

  return extracted || '';
}

export function sortLocationsByFloorRank(locList: string[]): string[] {
  const floorRank = (name: string) => {
    const n = name.toUpperCase().trim();
    if (n.startsWith('B')) {
      const num = parseInt(n.replace('B', ''), 10) || 1;
      return -100 + num;
    }
    if (n === 'GF' || n === 'G') return 0;
    if (n === 'MF' || n === 'M') return 0.5;
    if (n.startsWith('L')) {
      const num = parseInt(n.replace('L', ''), 10) || 1;
      return num;
    }
    if (/^\d+F$/.test(n)) {
      return parseInt(n.replace('F', ''), 10) || 1;
    }
    return 100;
  };

  return [...locList].sort((a, b) => floorRank(a) - floorRank(b) || a.localeCompare(b));
}

export interface ContrastStyle {
  text: string;
  shapeStroke: string;
}

// Calculate high-contrast text color based on background perceived luminance (No drop shadow, razor-sharp vector text)
export function getContrastStyle(hexColor: string): ContrastStyle {
  if (!hexColor || typeof hexColor !== 'string') {
    return {
      text: '#ffffff',
      shapeStroke: '#ffffff',
    };
  }
  let c = hexColor.replace('#', '').trim();
  if (c.length === 3) c = c.split('').map(x => x + x).join('');
  if (c.length !== 6) {
    return {
      text: '#ffffff',
      shapeStroke: '#ffffff',
    };
  }
  const r = parseInt(c.substring(0, 2), 16) || 0;
  const g = parseInt(c.substring(2, 4), 16) || 0;
  const b = parseInt(c.substring(4, 6), 16) || 0;
  // Perceived luminance (YIQ standard)
  const yiq = (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000;
  
  if (yiq >= 145) {
    // Light / bright color background -> Crisp deep dark slate text (#0f172a)
    return {
      text: '#0f172a',
      shapeStroke: '#1e293b',
    };
  } else {
    // Dark / saturated color background -> Crisp pure white text (#ffffff)
    return {
      text: '#ffffff',
      shapeStroke: '#ffffff',
    };
  }
}

  left: number;
  right: number;

  centerX: number;
  centerY: number;
}

  clientY?: number;

export function useLayoutAggregates({

  storeFilter,
  locationFilter,
  targetLoc,

  hasStoredUnitImages,
  unitImagesRev,
  focusedUnitId,
  filterOnlyAlerts,

  const summaryData = useSummaryData({ store: storeFilter, location: targetLoc, year: effectiveLayoutYear });

  // Compute set of project codes that the current user is NOT allowed to access (RBAC)
  const restrictedProjectCodes = useMemo(() => {

    const allowedCodeSet = new Set<string>();

      if (p.code) allowedCodeSet.add(String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase());
      if (p.linkCodes) {
        p.linkCodes.split(/[+;,/]/).forEach(c => {
          if (c.trim()) allowedCodeSet.add(c.trim().toLowerCase());
        });
      }
    });

    const restrictedSet = new Set<string>();
    allProjects.forEach(p => {
      const rawCodes = (p.linkCodes && p.linkCodes.trim()) ? p.linkCodes : String(p.code || '');
      const pCodes = rawCodes.split(/[+;,/]/).map(c => c.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);

  // Evaluate rules on the fly: STRICTLY depends ONLY on Task Summaries & Projects in active Year, Store, Location!
  const { unitColorMap, unitGroupMap, unitOpacityMap, activeGroups } = useMemo(() => {

    const groupMap: Record<string, string> = {};

      }

      if (dynamicItem.matchedGroupId && dynamicItem.color) {
        colorMap[u.id] = dynamicItem.color;
        groupMap[u.id] = dynamicItem.matchedGroupId;
        opacityMap[u.id] = dynamicItem.opacity ?? 0.85;

      const matchedUnits = matchedUnitsByGroup.get(group.id) || [];

      }
    });

  }, [version?.groups, units, aggregatedData, dynamicSummaryMap, restrictedProjectCodes]);

      if (uName && aggregatedData[uName]?.alerts?.hasAlert) {

      }

          minY = (unit.y || 0) - r;

            if (px < minX) minX = px;

  const prevVisibleUnitsRef = useRef<any[]>([]);

      const maxWorldX = ((vpW - stagePos.x) / scale) + bufferPadding;
      const minWorldY = (-stagePos.y / scale) - bufferPadding;
      const maxWorldY = ((vpH - stagePos.y) / scale) + bufferPadding;

        if (unit.id === focusedUnitId || deferredSearchQuery.trim()) {
          return true;
        }

        const uMinX = unit.minX ?? unit.x ?? 0;

    return filtered;
  }, [displayedUnits, stageScale, stagePos.x, stagePos.y, dimensions.width, dimensions.height, focusedUnitId, deferredSearchQuery, effectiveLayoutYear, storeFilter, targetLoc]);

  // Security defense: If non-admin user has NO accessible tasks or projects in this store & year, do not render layout
  const hasUserAccessInStoreYear = useMemo(() => {

        if (tStore && tStore !== storeFilter.toUpperCase()) return false;
      }
      const tYear = String(t.projectYear || '').trim();
      return tYear === yr;
    });
    return hasTask;
  }, [currUser, enrichedProjects, tasks, storeFilter, effectiveLayoutYear]);

  return {
    aggregatedData,
    activeGroups,
    totalFloorAlerts,
    displayedUnits,
    focusedUnit,
    visibleUnits,
    hasUserAccessInStoreYear,
    restrictedProjectCodes,
  };
}

  storeFilter,
  locationFilter,
  yearFilter,

  const localStoreLocationData = useDataStore((state) => state.storeLocationData);

  const targetLoc = locationFilter !== 'all' ? locationFilter : 'L1';

  const activeYear = (
    (yearFilter && yearFilter !== 'all' ? yearFilter : '') ||
    (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all' ? globalYearFilter : '') ||
    (storeFilter === 'HN' ? '2027' : '2026')
  ).trim();

  // 1. Gather all store versions across all sources (Zustand helper, local partitions, cloud partitions, and root config)
  const prevAvailVersionsRef = useRef<any[]>([]);
  const prevAvailVersionsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const availableStoreVersions = useMemo(() => {
    const versionsMap = new Map<string, any>();

    // From Zustand store helper
    try {
      const targetStoreParam = (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM');
      const storeVers = getAllStoreVersions(targetStoreParam);
      if (Array.isArray(storeVers)) {
        storeVers.forEach(v => {
          if (v?.id) versionsMap.set(v.id, v);
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // From local in-memory partitions
    if (localStoreLocationData) {
      Object.entries(localStoreLocationData).forEach(([key, part]: [string, any]) => {
        if (key.startsWith(`${storeFilter}_`) && Array.isArray(part?.mapVersions)) {
          part.mapVersions.forEach((v: any) => {
            if (v?.id) versionsMap.set(v.id, { ...v, location: v.location || key.split('_')[1] });
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // From cloud config partitions
    if (config?.storeLocationData) {
      Object.entries(config.storeLocationData).forEach(([key, part]: [string, any]) => {
        if (key.startsWith(`${storeFilter}_`) && Array.isArray(part?.mapVersions)) {
          part.mapVersions.forEach((v: any) => {
            if (v?.id) {
              const existing = versionsMap.get(v.id) || {};
              const resolvedBg = (existing.backgroundUrl && !existing.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://'))
                ? existing.backgroundUrl
                : (v.backgroundUrl && !v.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://'))
                  ? v.backgroundUrl
                  : (existing.backgroundUrl || v.backgroundUrl);
              versionsMap.set(v.id, { 
                ...v, 
                ...existing, 
                backgroundUrl: resolvedBg,
                location: existing.location || v.location || key.split('_')[1] 
              });
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // From cloud config root versions (legacy fallback for HCM only)
    if (storeFilter === 'HCM' && Array.isArray(config?.versions)) {
      config.versions.forEach((v: any) => {
        if (v?.id) {
          const existing = versionsMap.get(v.id) || {};
          const resolvedBg = (existing.backgroundUrl && !existing.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://'))
            ? existing.backgroundUrl
            : (v.backgroundUrl && !v.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://'))
              ? v.backgroundUrl
              : (existing.backgroundUrl || v.backgroundUrl);
          versionsMap.set(v.id, { 
            ...v, 
            ...existing, 
            backgroundUrl: resolvedBg,
            store: existing.store || v.store || 'HCM' 
          });
        }
      });
    }

    const finalVersions = Array.from(versionsMap.values());
    const key = `${storeFilter}_${finalVersions.map(v => `${v?.id || ''}_${v?.backgroundUrl || ''}`).join('|')}`;
    if (key === prevAvailVersionsKeyRef.current) {
      return prevAvailVersionsRef.current;
    }
    prevAvailVersionsKeyRef.current = key;
    prevAvailVersionsRef.current = finalVersions;
    return finalVersions;
  }, [getAllStoreVersions, storeFilter, localStoreLocationData, config]);

  // Pre-cache all floor maps for this store into IndexedDB
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableStoreVersions.length > 0) {
      const urls = availableStoreVersions
        .map(v => v?.backgroundUrl)
        .filter((u): u is string => typeof u === 'string' && u.length > 0 && !u.startsWith('r2://'));
      if (urls.length > 0) {
        preloadFloorImages(urls);
      }
    }
  }, [availableStoreVersions]);

  // 2. Filter versions specific to targetLoc (e.g. L2) and year from Picture Mapping / global setting
  const prevLocationVersionsRef = useRef<any[]>([]);
  const prevLocationVersionsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const locationVersions = useMemo(() => {
    if (availableStoreVersions.length === 0) return [];
    
    const tLoc = targetLoc.toUpperCase().trim();
    const tokenRegex = new RegExp(`(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9])${tLoc}([^a-zA-Z0-9]|$)`, 'i');

    const matched = availableStoreVersions.filter(v => {
      const vLoc = (v.location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      const vName = (v.name || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      return vLoc === tLoc || (vLoc === '' && tokenRegex.test(vName));
    });

    let result = matched;
    if (matched.length === 0) {
      result = [];
    } else if (activeYear && activeYear !== 'all') {
      const targetYear = String(activeYear).trim();
      const yearMatched = matched.filter(v => String(v.year || '').trim() === targetYear);
      if (yearMatched.length > 0) {
        result = yearMatched;
      } else {
        result = [...matched].sort((a, b) => {
          const yA = Number(a.year) || 0;
          const yB = Number(b.year) || 0;
          return yB - yA;
        });
      }
    }

    const key = `${targetLoc}_${activeYear}_${result.map(v => v?.id || '').join('|')}`;
    if (key === prevLocationVersionsKeyRef.current) {
      return prevLocationVersionsRef.current;
    }
    prevLocationVersionsKeyRef.current = key;
    prevLocationVersionsRef.current = result;
    return result;
  }, [availableStoreVersions, targetLoc, activeYear]);

  // 3. Resolve active version & units
  const { r2Version, r2Units } = useMemo(() => {
    const targetStoreParam = (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
    const tLoc = targetLoc.toUpperCase().trim();
    const pKey = `${targetStoreParam}_${tLoc}`;
    
    const localPart = localStoreLocationData?.[pKey] || (
      localStore === targetStoreParam && String(localLocation).toUpperCase().trim() === tLoc
        ? { mapUnits: localMapUnits, mapVersions: localMapVersions, activeMapVersionId: localActiveMapVersionId }
        : null
    );
    const cloudPart = config?.storeLocationData?.[pKey];
    const partition = (localPart && Array.isArray(localPart.mapVersions) && localPart.mapVersions.length > 0)
      ? localPart
      : cloudPart;

    // Pick version: check selectedVersionId first, then localActiveMapVersionId from Picture tab, then partition.activeMapVersionId, then matching location versions
    let v: any = null;
    if (selectedVersionId && locationVersions.some(lv => lv.id === selectedVersionId)) {
      v = locationVersions.find(lv => lv.id === selectedVersionId);
    } else if (localActiveMapVersionId && locationVersions.some(lv => lv.id === localActiveMapVersionId)) {
      v = locationVersions.find(lv => lv.id === localActiveMapVersionId);
    } else if (partition?.activeMapVersionId && locationVersions.some(lv => lv.id === partition.activeMapVersionId)) {
      v = locationVersions.find(lv => lv.id === partition.activeMapVersionId);
    } else if (locationVersions.length > 0) {
      // Prioritize version for this floor with dynamic rules or groups
      v = locationVersions.find(lv => lv.isDynamicActive !== false && Array.isArray(lv.groups) && lv.groups.length > 0) ||
          locationVersions.find(lv => Array.isArray(lv.groups) && lv.groups.length > 0) ||
          locationVersions[0];
    }

    if (!v) {
      return { r2Version: null, r2Units: [] };
    }

    // Resolve backgroundUrl if empty or r2://
    let bgUrl = v.backgroundUrl || '';
    if (!bgUrl || bgUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
      // Scan all cloud partitions and versions for resolved signed URL
      if (cloudPart?.mapVersions) {
        const matchingCloudV = cloudPart.mapVersions.find((cv: any) => cv.id === v.id || cv.name === v.name);
        if (matchingCloudV?.backgroundUrl && !matchingCloudV.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
          bgUrl = matchingCloudV.backgroundUrl;
        }
      }
      if ((!bgUrl || bgUrl.startsWith('r2://')) && config?.storeLocationData) {
        for (const part of Object.values(config.storeLocationData) as any[]) {
          const matchingCloudV = part?.mapVersions?.find((cv: any) => cv.id === v.id || cv.name === v.name);
          if (matchingCloudV?.backgroundUrl && !matchingCloudV.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
            bgUrl = matchingCloudV.backgroundUrl;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if ((!bgUrl || bgUrl.startsWith('r2://')) && config?.version?.backgroundUrl && !config.version.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
        if (config.version.id === v.id || config.version.name === v.name) {
          bgUrl = config.version.backgroundUrl;
        }
      }
    }
    const finalVersion = { ...v, backgroundUrl: bgUrl };
    const vLoc = (finalVersion.location || targetLoc || '').toUpperCase().trim();

    let candidateUnits: any[] = [];
    if (Array.isArray(finalVersion?.mapUnits) && finalVersion.mapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = finalVersion.mapUnits;
    } else if (localStore === targetStoreParam && String(localLocation).toUpperCase().trim() === tLoc && Array.isArray(localMapUnits) && localMapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = localMapUnits;
    } else if (localStoreLocationData?.[pKey]?.mapUnits && Array.isArray(localStoreLocationData[pKey].mapUnits) && localStoreLocationData[pKey].mapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = localStoreLocationData[pKey].mapUnits;
    } else if (config?.storeLocationData?.[pKey]?.mapUnits && Array.isArray(config.storeLocationData[pKey].mapUnits) && config.storeLocationData[pKey].mapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = config.storeLocationData[pKey].mapUnits;
    } else if (targetStoreParam === 'HCM' && Array.isArray(config?.mapUnits) && config.mapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = config.mapUnits;
    } else if (targetStoreParam === 'HCM' && Array.isArray(config?.units) && config.units.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = config.units;
    }

    // Sanitize, filter strictly to target floor & year, and deduplicate overlapping ghost shapes
    const unitsMap = new Map<string, any>();
    const seenCoordinates = new Map<string, string>(); // geometryKey -> id
    const seenUnitNames = new Map<string, string>(); // lowercase clean unit name -> id

    candidateUnits.forEach((u: any) => {
      if (!u || (!u.id && !u.name)) return;
      if (!u.type && !u.points && !(u.width && u.height)) return;

      const uLoc = String(u.location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      const uStore = String(u.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();

      // Store check
      if (uStore && uStore !== 'ALL' && uStore !== targetStoreParam) return;

      // Year check
      const uYr = String(u.year || '').trim();
      if (uYr && uYr !== 'ALL' && activeYear && activeYear !== 'all' && uYr !== activeYear) return;

      // Strict Floor check: accept units explicitly matching current floor, matching active version floor, or storewide
      const isStorewideUnit = uLoc === 'STORE' || uLoc === 'ALL' || uLoc === 'STOREWIDE' || uLoc === 'ALL FLOORS';
      if (uLoc && !isStorewideUnit && uLoc !== tLoc && uLoc !== vLoc) {
        return;
      }

      const id = String(u.id || u.name);
      const cleanName = String(u.name || '').trim();
      const lowerName = cleanName.toLowerCase();

      const taggedUnit = {
        ...u,
        id,
        name: cleanName,
        store: targetStoreParam,
        location: uLoc || tLoc,
      };

      // Geometry hash for deduplication (rect, circle, polygon)
      let coordKey = '';
      if (u.type === 'rect' && u.width > 0 && u.height > 0) {
        coordKey = `rect_${Math.round(u.x || 0)}_${Math.round(u.y || 0)}_${Math.round(u.width || 0)}_${Math.round(u.height || 0)}`;
      } else if (u.type === 'circle' && u.radius > 0) {
        coordKey = `circle_${Math.round(u.x || 0)}_${Math.round(u.y || 0)}_${Math.round(u.radius || 0)}`;
      } else if (u.type === 'polygon' && Array.isArray(u.points) && u.points.length >= 4) {
        let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
        for (let i = 0; i < u.points.length; i += 2) {
          const px = u.points[i];
          const py = u.points[i + 1];
          if (px < minX) minX = px;
          if (px > maxX) maxX = px;
          if (py < minY) minY = py;
          if (py > maxY) maxY = py;
        }
        coordKey = `poly_${Math.round(minX)}_${Math.round(minY)}_${Math.round(maxX - minX)}_${Math.round(maxY - minY)}`;
      }

      // Check Coordinate Collision: If two shapes occupy the exact same geometry spot
      if (coordKey && seenCoordinates.has(coordKey)) {
        const prevId = seenCoordinates.get(coordKey)!;
        const prev = unitsMap.get(prevId);
        if (!prev?.name && taggedUnit.name) {
          unitsMap.delete(prevId);
          unitsMap.set(id, taggedUnit);
          seenCoordinates.set(coordKey, id);
          if (lowerName) seenUnitNames.set(lowerName, id);
        }
        return;
      }

      // Check Name Collision: If two units on the same floor have the exact same unit name
      if (lowerName && seenUnitNames.has(lowerName)) {
        const prevId = seenUnitNames.get(lowerName)!;
        const prev = unitsMap.get(prevId);
        if (!prev || (!prev.type && taggedUnit.type)) {
          unitsMap.delete(prevId);
          unitsMap.set(id, taggedUnit);
          seenUnitNames.set(lowerName, id);
          if (coordKey) seenCoordinates.set(coordKey, id);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (coordKey) seenCoordinates.set(coordKey, id);
      if (lowerName) seenUnitNames.set(lowerName, id);
      unitsMap.set(id, taggedUnit);
    });

    const finalUnitsList = Array.from(unitsMap.values());
    return { r2Version: finalVersion, r2Units: finalUnitsList };
  }, [
    config, storeFilter, targetLoc, localStoreLocationData, localStore, localLocation,
    localMapUnits, localMapVersions, localActiveMapVersionId, selectedVersionId,
    locationVersions
  ]);

  const version = r2Version;
  const units = r2Units;

  const [resolvedBgUrl, setResolvedBgUrl] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const rawUrl = version?.backgroundUrl || '';
    if (!rawUrl) {
      setResolvedBgUrl(prev => prev === '' ? prev : '');
      return;
    }
    if (rawUrl.startsWith('r2://') || (!rawUrl.startsWith('http://') && !rawUrl.startsWith('https://') && !rawUrl.startsWith('data:') && !rawUrl.startsWith('blob:'))) {
      resolveR2UrlToHttp(rawUrl).then(url => {
        if (isMounted) setResolvedBgUrl(prev => prev === (url || rawUrl) ? prev : (url || rawUrl));
      }).catch(() => {
        if (isMounted) setResolvedBgUrl(prev => prev === rawUrl ? prev : rawUrl);
      });
    } else {
      setResolvedBgUrl(prev => prev === rawUrl ? prev : rawUrl);
    }
    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, [version?.backgroundUrl]);

  const [bgImage] = useOffscreenImage(resolvedBgUrl || version?.backgroundUrl || '', 'anonymous');

  // Helper to accurately check if unit has user-attached images in localStorage partitioned by store
  const hasStoredUnitImages = useCallback((key: string | undefined | null, overrideStore?: string): boolean => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !key) return false;
    try {
      const activeStore = (overrideStore || (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM')).toUpperCase();
      const storeKey = `taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${key}`;
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(storeKey);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return true;
      }
      // Migrate legacy un-prefixed key for HN if present
      if (activeStore === 'HN') {
        const legacyRaw = localStorage.getItem(`taka_unit_images_${key}`);
        if (legacyRaw) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(legacyRaw);
            if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
              const tagged = parsed.map((item: any) => ({ ...item, store: 'HN' }));
              localStorage.setItem(storeKey, JSON.stringify(tagged));
              localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${key}`);
              return true;
            }
          } catch {}
        }
      }
      return false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }, [storeFilter]);

  // Realtime image change subscription to update canvas badges instantly upon add/delete in Tooltip
  const [unitImagesRev, setUnitImagesRev] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorageChange = () => {
      setUnitImagesRev(prev => prev + 1);
    };
    window.addEventListener('taka_unit_images_changed', handleStorageChange);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('taka_unit_images_changed', handleStorageChange);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
    };
  }, []);

  // Reset selected version and ensure useDataStore partition syncs when locationFilter, storeFilter, or globalYearFilter changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedVersionId(prev => prev !== null ? null : prev);
    const targetStore = (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
    const targetFloor = locationFilter && locationFilter !== 'all' ? locationFilter : 'L1';
    if (!targetFloor || targetFloor.trim() === '' || targetFloor.toUpperCase() === 'ALL') {
      return;
    }
    const currStore = useDataStore.getState().store;
    const currLocation = useDataStore.getState().location;
    if (currStore !== targetStore || currLocation !== targetFloor) {
      useDataStore.getState().setStoreAndLocation(targetStore, targetFloor);
    }
  }, [locationFilter, storeFilter, globalYearFilter]);

  const effectiveLayoutYear = String(
    activeYear || 
    version?.year || 
    (storeFilter === 'HN' ? '2027' : '2026')
  ).trim();

  return {
    version,
    units,
    locationVersions,
    availableStoreVersions,
    bgImage,
    resolvedBgUrl,
    unitImagesRev,
    hasStoredUnitImages,
    selectedVersionId,
    setSelectedVersionId,
    targetLoc,
    activeYear,
    effectiveLayoutYear,
  };
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Konva from 'konva';

interface UseLayoutGesturesProps {
  stageRef: React.RefObject<any>;
  containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  dimensions: { width: number; height: number };
  stageScale: number;
  setStageScale: (s: number) => void;
  stagePos: { x: number; y: number };
  setStagePos: (pos: { x: number; y: number }) => void;
  bgImage: any;
  version: any;
  units: any[];
  setHoverInfo: (info: any) => void;
}

export function useLayoutGestures({
  stageRef,
  containerRef,
  dimensions,
  stageScale,
  setStageScale,
  stagePos,
  setStagePos,
  bgImage,
  version,
  units,
  setHoverInfo,
}: UseLayoutGesturesProps) {
  const isInteractingRef = useRef(false);
  const wheelTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const pendingWheelDeltaRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const rafWheelIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const rafTouchIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const pendingTouchRef = useRef<{ dist: number; center: { x: number; y: number } } | null>(null);
  const lastWheelPointerRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);

  const touchStateRef = useRef<{
    lastDist: number;
    lastCenter: { x: number; y: number } | null;
    lastTap: number;
  }>({
    lastDist: 0,
    lastCenter: null,
    lastTap: 0,
  });

  const dragVelocityTrackerRef = useRef<{
    history: Array<{ x: number; y: number; time: number }>;
  }>({
    history: [],
  });
  const rafInertiaIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const stopInertia = useCallback(() => {
    if (rafInertiaIdRef.current !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafInertiaIdRef.current);
      rafInertiaIdRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  // Cleanup timers & RAFs on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (wheelTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(wheelTimeoutRef.current);
      if (rafWheelIdRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafWheelIdRef.current);
      if (rafInertiaIdRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafInertiaIdRef.current);
      if (rafTouchIdRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafTouchIdRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Auto-fit floor plan background & units to perfectly fit and center in the viewport
  const fitToScreen = useCallback((animated: boolean = false) => {
    stopInertia();
    const containerW = containerRef.current?.offsetWidth || dimensions.width;
    const containerH = containerRef.current?.offsetHeight || dimensions.height;
    if (containerW <= 0 || containerH <= 0) return;

    let contentW = 1000;
    let contentH = 800;
    let contentX = 0;
    let contentY = 0;

    if (bgImage) {
      const imgNaturalW = (bgImage as HTMLImageElement).naturalWidth || bgImage.width || 1000;
      const imgNaturalH = (bgImage as HTMLImageElement).naturalHeight || bgImage.height || 800;
      const imgScale = version?.imageScale || 1;
      contentW = imgNaturalW * imgScale;
      contentH = imgNaturalH * imgScale;
      contentX = version?.imagePos?.x || 0;
      contentY = version?.imagePos?.y || 0;
    } else if (units && units.length > 0) {
      let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
      units.forEach((u: any) => {
        const ux = u.x || 0;
        const uy = u.y || 0;
        const uw = u.width || 100;
        const uh = u.height || 100;
        minX = Math.min(minX, ux);
        minY = Math.min(minY, uy);
        maxX = Math.max(maxX, ux + uw);
        maxY = Math.max(maxY, uy + uh);
      });
      if (minX !== Infinity && maxX > minX) {
        contentX = minX;
        contentY = minY;
        contentW = Math.max(100, maxX - minX);
        contentH = Math.max(100, maxY - minY);
      }
    }

    const pad = containerW < 640 ? 12 : 24;
    const availW = Math.max(10, containerW - pad * 2);
    const availH = Math.max(10, containerH - pad * 2);

    const scaleX = availW / contentW;
    const scaleY = availH / contentH;
    const fitScale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
    const clampedScale = Math.max(0.01, Math.min(fitScale, 10));

    const contentCenterX = contentX + contentW / 2;
    const contentCenterY = contentY + contentH / 2;
    const posX = containerW / 2 - contentCenterX * clampedScale;
    const posY = containerH / 2 - contentCenterY * clampedScale;

    const newPos = { x: posX, y: posY };

    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (stage) {
      if (animated) {
        stage.to({
          scaleX: clampedScale,
          scaleY: clampedScale,
          x: posX,
          y: posY,
          duration: 0.22,
          easing: Konva.Easings.EaseOut,
          onFinish: () => {
            setStageScale(clampedScale);
            setStagePos(newPos);
          }
        });
      } else {
        stage.scale({ x: clampedScale, y: clampedScale });
        stage.position(newPos);
        stage.batchDraw();
        setStageScale(clampedScale);
        setStagePos(newPos);
      }
    } else {
      setStageScale(clampedScale);
      setStagePos(newPos);
    }
  }, [bgImage, version?.id, version?.imageScale, version?.imagePos?.x, version?.imagePos?.y, units, dimensions.width, dimensions.height, containerRef, stageRef, setStageScale, setStagePos, stopInertia]);

  // Inertia momentum panning handlers
  const handleDragStart = useCallback(() => {
    if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) {
      const stage = stageRef.current;
      if (stage) stage.stopDrag();
      return;
    }
    stopInertia();
    isInteractingRef.current = true;
    setHoverInfo((current: any) => (current ? null : current));
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (stage) {
      dragVelocityTrackerRef.current.history = [
        { x: stage.x(), y: stage.y(), time: performance.now() }
      ];
    }
  }, [stageRef, setHoverInfo, stopInertia]);

  const handleDragMove = useCallback(() => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) return;
    const now = performance.now();
    const history = dragVelocityTrackerRef.current.history;
    history.push({ x: stage.x(), y: stage.y(), time: now });
    while (history.length > 2 && now - history[0].time > 100) {
      history.shift();
    }
  }, [stageRef]);

  const handleDragEnd = useCallback(() => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) {
      isInteractingRef.current = false;
      return;
    }

    const history = dragVelocityTrackerRef.current.history;
    const now = performance.now();
    while (history.length > 2 && now - history[0].time > 100) {
      history.shift();
    }

    let vx = 0;
    let vy = 0;
    if (history.length >= 2) {
      const oldest = history[0];
      const newest = history[history.length - 1];
      const dt = newest.time - oldest.time;
      if (dt > 10 && dt < 150) {
        vx = (newest.x - oldest.x) / dt;
        vy = (newest.y - oldest.y) / dt;
      }
    }

    const speed = Math.hypot(vx, vy);
    if (speed > 0.12) {
      const maxSpeed = 3.0;
      if (speed > maxSpeed) {
        const ratio = maxSpeed / speed;
        vx *= ratio;
        vy *= ratio;
      }

      let currentVx = vx;
      let currentVy = vy;
      let lastTime = performance.now();

      const step = (time: number) => {
        const frameDt = Math.min(32, time - lastTime);
        lastTime = time;

        const friction = Math.pow(0.925, frameDt / 16.6);
        currentVx *= friction;
        currentVy *= friction;

        const currentStage = stageRef.current;
        if (!currentStage) {
          isInteractingRef.current = false;
          return;
        }

        const nextX = currentStage.x() + currentVx * frameDt;
        const nextY = currentStage.y() + currentVy * frameDt;

        currentStage.position({ x: nextX, y: nextY });
        currentStage.batchDraw();

        if (Math.hypot(currentVx, currentVy) > 0.02) {
          rafInertiaIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
        } else {
          rafInertiaIdRef.current = null;
          setStagePos({ x: currentStage.x(), y: currentStage.y() });
          isInteractingRef.current = false;
        }
      };

      rafInertiaIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    } else {
      setStagePos({ x: stage.x(), y: stage.y() });
      isInteractingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [stageRef, setStagePos]);

  const handleZoomIn = useCallback(() => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) return;
    const oldScale = stage.scaleX();
    const newScale = Math.min(oldScale * 1.3, 20);
    const center = { x: dimensions.width / 2, y: dimensions.height / 2 };
    const mousePointTo = {
      x: (center.x - stage.x()) / oldScale,
      y: (center.y - stage.y()) / oldScale,
    };
    const newPos = {
      x: center.x - mousePointTo.x * newScale,
      y: center.y - mousePointTo.y * newScale,
    };
    stage.to({
      scaleX: newScale,
      scaleY: newScale,
      x: newPos.x,
      y: newPos.y,
      duration: 0.18,
      easing: Konva.Easings.EaseOut,
      onFinish: () => {
        setStageScale(newScale);
        setStagePos(newPos);
      }
    });
  }, [dimensions.width, dimensions.height, stageRef, setStageScale, setStagePos]);

  const handleZoomOut = useCallback(() => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) return;
    const oldScale = stage.scaleX();
    const newScale = Math.max(oldScale / 1.3, 0.04);
    const center = { x: dimensions.width / 2, y: dimensions.height / 2 };
    const mousePointTo = {
      x: (center.x - stage.x()) / oldScale,
      y: (center.y - stage.y()) / oldScale,
    };
    const newPos = {
      x: center.x - mousePointTo.x * newScale,
      y: center.y - mousePointTo.y * newScale,
    };
    stage.to({
      scaleX: newScale,
      scaleY: newScale,
      x: newPos.x,
      y: newPos.y,
      duration: 0.18,
      easing: Konva.Easings.EaseOut,
      onFinish: () => {
        setStageScale(newScale);
        setStagePos(newPos);
      }
    });
  }, [dimensions.width, dimensions.height, stageRef, setStageScale, setStagePos]);

  return {
    isInteractingRef,
    wheelTimeoutRef,
    pendingWheelDeltaRef,
    rafWheelIdRef,
    rafTouchIdRef,
    pendingTouchRef,
    lastWheelPointerRef,
    touchStateRef,
    dragVelocityTrackerRef,
    rafInertiaIdRef,
    stopInertia,
    fitToScreen,
    handleDragStart,
    handleDragMove,
    handleDragEnd,
    handleZoomIn,
    handleZoomOut,
  };
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Konva from 'konva';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { HoverInfo } from './layoutViewerTypes';
import { useLayoutGestures } from './useLayoutGestures';
import { useLayoutWindowListeners } from './useLayoutWindowListeners';
import { 
  calculateUnitFocalPoint, 
  computeTooltipPosition, 
  exportStageHighRes, 
  triggerStageDownload, 
  findUnitInOtherFloorVersions,
  hasAggregatedDataChanged
} from './layoutStageUtils';

interface UseLayoutStageInteractionsProps {
  bgImage: any;
  version: any;
  units: any[];
  targetUnitSearch?: string | null;
  onUnitSelected?: (unit: any) => void;
  onClearFocus?: () => void;
  availableStoreVersions: any[];
  selectedVersionId: string | null;
  setSelectedVersionId: (id: string | null) => void;
  storeFilter: string;
  targetLoc: string;
  isProjectModalOpen: boolean;
  miniGanttProject: any;
}

export function useLayoutStageInteractions({
  bgImage,
  version,
  units,
  targetUnitSearch,
  onUnitSelected,
  onClearFocus,
  availableStoreVersions,
  selectedVersionId,
  setSelectedVersionId,
  storeFilter,
  targetLoc,
  isProjectModalOpen,
  miniGanttProject,
}: UseLayoutStageInteractionsProps) {
  const isPrintPreview = useAppStore(state => state.isPrintPreview);

  const stageRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const tooltipRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState({ width: 800, height: 600 });
  const [hoverInfo, setHoverInfo] = useState<HoverInfo | null>(null);
  const isPinnedRef = useRef(false);
  const [stageScale, setStageScale] = useState(1);
  const [stagePos, setStagePos] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [focusedUnitId, setFocusedUnitId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const focusedTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const lastHandledSearchRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Mutable refs for data aggregates to eliminate circular dependencies and prevent infinite loops
  const aggregatedDataRef = useRef<Record<string, any>>({});
  const restrictedProjectCodesRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Zoom & Pan smoothly to target unit and highlight it
  const zoomAndPanToUnit = useCallback((targetUnitOrName: string | any) => {
    const focalPoint = calculateUnitFocalPoint(
      targetUnitOrName,
      units,
      aggregatedDataRef.current,
      restrictedProjectCodesRef.current
    );
    if (!focalPoint) return false;

    const { targetUnit, cx, cy } = focalPoint;

    const containerW = containerRef.current?.offsetWidth || dimensions.width || 800;
    const containerH = containerRef.current?.offsetHeight || dimensions.height || 600;

    const targetScale = 0.7;

    // Center unit perfectly at exact 50% width and 50% height of viewport
    const targetScreenCenterX = containerW * 0.50;
    const targetScreenCenterY = containerH * 0.50;

    const posX = targetScreenCenterX - cx * targetScale;
    const posY = targetScreenCenterY - cy * targetScale;
    const newPos = { x: posX, y: posY };

    setStageScale(targetScale);
    setStagePos(newPos);

    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (stage) {
      stage.scale({ x: targetScale, y: targetScale });
      stage.position(newPos);
      stage.batchDraw();
      stage.to({
        scaleX: targetScale,
        scaleY: targetScale,
        x: posX,
        y: posY,
        duration: 0.35,
        easing: Konva.Easings.EaseInOut,
        onFinish: () => {
          setStageScale(targetScale);
          setStagePos(newPos);
        }
      });
    }

    setFocusedUnitId(targetUnit.id);
    if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);

    isPinnedRef.current = false;
    setHoverInfo(null);

    return true;
  }, [units, dimensions.width, dimensions.height]);

  const updateAggregatedData = useCallback((data: Record<string, any>, restricted: Set<string>) => {
    aggregatedDataRef.current = data;
    restrictedProjectCodesRef.current = restricted;

    // If there is an active search query waiting to be focused and not yet focused, retry zooming now that aggregates are available
    if (targetUnitSearch && String(targetUnitSearch).trim() && !focusedUnitId) {
      const q = String(targetUnitSearch).trim();
      const success = zoomAndPanToUnit(q);
      if (success) {
        lastHandledSearchRef.current = q;
      }
    }
  }, [targetUnitSearch, focusedUnitId, zoomAndPanToUnit]);

  // Kinetic inertia, gestures and zoom engine
  const gestures = useLayoutGestures({
    stageRef,
    containerRef,
    dimensions,
    stageScale,
    setStageScale,
    stagePos,
    setStagePos,
    bgImage,
    version,
    units,
    setHoverInfo,
  });

  const {
    fitToScreen,
    stopInertia,
    handleDragStart,
    handleDragMove,
    handleDragEnd,
    handleZoomIn,
    handleZoomOut,
  } = gestures;

  // Export handlers
  const handleExport = useCallback(() => triggerStageDownload(stageRef.current), []);

  // Global window references for export
  useEffect(() => {
    (window as any).__taka_layout_stage = stageRef.current;
    (window as any).__taka_layout_export = (dpi: number = 200) => {
      return exportStageHighRes(stageRef.current, bgImage, version, units, dpi);
    };

    return () => {
      if ((window as any).__taka_layout_stage === stageRef.current) {
        (window as any).__taka_layout_stage = null;
        (window as any).__taka_layout_export = null;
      }
    };
  }, [bgImage, version, units]);

  const fitToScreenRef = useRef(fitToScreen);
  fitToScreenRef.current = fitToScreen;

  // Trigger fitToScreen when background image or partition version changes
  const lastFloorVersionKeyRef = useRef<string>('');
  useEffect(() => {
    // If version has a background URL, wait for bgImage to load before auto-fitting to prevent jumping
    if (version?.backgroundUrl && !bgImage) {
      return;
    }
    const currentKey = `${storeFilter}_${targetLoc}_${version?.year || ''}_${version?.id || ''}`;
    const floorChanged = lastFloorVersionKeyRef.current !== currentKey;
    if (floorChanged) {
      lastFloorVersionKeyRef.current = currentKey;
      if (!targetUnitSearch && !focusedUnitId && !lastHandledSearchRef.current) {
        fitToScreenRef.current();
      }
    }
  }, [storeFilter, targetLoc, version?.year, version?.id, version?.backgroundUrl, bgImage, targetUnitSearch, focusedUnitId]);

  // Sync with incoming targetUnitSearch prop from toolbar / Quick Navigation
  useEffect(() => {
    if (targetUnitSearch && String(targetUnitSearch).trim()) {
      const q = String(targetUnitSearch).trim();
      
      const tryZoom = () => {
        const success = zoomAndPanToUnit(q);
        if (success) {
          lastHandledSearchRef.current = q;
        } else {
          const foundInOther = findUnitInOtherFloorVersions(q, availableStoreVersions);
          if (foundInOther) {
            if (foundInOther.location) {
              const floorLoc = String(foundInOther.location).trim().toUpperCase();
              if (useAppStore.getState().globalLocationFilter[0] !== floorLoc) {
                useAppStore.getState().setGlobalLocationFilter([floorLoc]);
              }
            }
            if (foundInOther.id !== selectedVersionId) {
              setSelectedVersionId(foundInOther.id);
            }
          }
        }
      };

      tryZoom();
      // Multi-stage retry so that when tab switches and container DOM dimensions mount / re-measure, centering happens cleanly
      const t1 = setTimeout(tryZoom, 60);
      const t2 = setTimeout(tryZoom, 220);
      const t3 = setTimeout(tryZoom, 500);

      return () => {
        clearTimeout(t1);
        clearTimeout(t2);
        clearTimeout(t3);
      };
    } else if (targetUnitSearch === null || targetUnitSearch === '') {
      if (lastHandledSearchRef.current !== null || focusedUnitId !== null) {
        lastHandledSearchRef.current = null;
        setFocusedUnitId(null);
        setHoverInfo(null);
        if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);
        fitToScreenRef.current(true);
      }
    }
  }, [targetUnitSearch, zoomAndPanToUnit, availableStoreVersions, selectedVersionId, setSelectedVersionId]);

  // Keyboard listener: Escape key to exit zoom focus
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && (focusedUnitId || targetUnitSearch)) {
        lastHandledSearchRef.current = null;
        setFocusedUnitId(null);
        setHoverInfo(null);
        if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);
        fitToScreen(true);
        onClearFocus?.();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [focusedUnitId, targetUnitSearch, fitToScreen, onClearFocus]);

  // If units reload after floor switch and targetUnitSearch is waiting to be zoomed, zoom cleanly
  useEffect(() => {
    if (targetUnitSearch && String(targetUnitSearch).trim() && units.length > 0) {
      const q = String(targetUnitSearch).trim();
      if (lastHandledSearchRef.current !== q || !focusedUnitId) {
        const success = zoomAndPanToUnit(q);
        if (success) {
          lastHandledSearchRef.current = q;
        }
      }
    }
  }, [units, targetUnitSearch, zoomAndPanToUnit, focusedUnitId]);

  const activeTab = useAppStore(state => state.activeTab);

  // Auto-close tooltip and clear pinned state when navigating to another tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab !== 'layout') {
      setHoverInfo(null);
      isPinnedRef.current = false;
      if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);
    }
  }, [activeTab]);

  // Clean up tooltip state on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      setHoverInfo(null);
      isPinnedRef.current = false;
      if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Window listeners: resize observer, print preview, export, visibility wake-up
  useLayoutWindowListeners({
    isPrintPreview,
    fitToScreen,
    fitToScreenRef,
    handleExport,
    stageRef,
    containerRef,
    setDimensions,
  });

  // Handle position tooltip directly via DOM with RAF throttle and 2D collision clamping
  const rafTooltipIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (rafTooltipIdRef.current !== null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafTooltipIdRef.current);
      }

  }, []);

  const updateTooltipPos = useCallback((clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    if (rafTooltipIdRef.current !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafTooltipIdRef.current);
    }
    rafTooltipIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      rafTooltipIdRef.current = null;
      if (!tooltipRef.current) return;
      const el = tooltipRef.current;
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const tooltipWidth = rect.width > 0 ? rect.width : 340;
      const tooltipHeight = rect.height > 0 ? rect.height : 280;

      const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
      const visualVp = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.visualViewport : null;
      const viewportHeight = visualVp ? visualVp.height : window.innerHeight;

      const styleObj = computeTooltipPosition(
        clientX,
        clientY,
        tooltipWidth,
        tooltipHeight,
        viewportWidth,
        viewportHeight
      );

      Object.assign(el.style, styleObj);
    });

  const prevIsProjectModalOpenRef = useRef(isProjectModalOpen);

      }

    prevIsProjectModalOpenRef.current = isProjectModalOpen;
  }, [isProjectModalOpen, hoverInfo?.visible, hoverInfo?.clientX, hoverInfo?.clientY, updateTooltipPos]);

  // Keep hoverInfo.data in sync with latest aggregatedData if projects update
  useEffect(() => {

      const latestData = aggregatedDataRef.current[uName];
      if (latestData && latestData !== hoverInfo.data) {
        if (hasAggregatedDataChanged(hoverInfo.data, latestData)) {
          setHoverInfo(current => current ? { ...current, data: latestData } : null);
        }
      }
    }
  }, [hoverInfo?.visible, hoverInfo?.unitName, hoverInfo?.data]);

  const handleMouseEnterUnit = useCallback((unit: any, e: any) => {
    if (gestures.isInteractingRef.current || (e?.evt && e.evt.buttons > 0) || isPinnedRef.current || Boolean(miniGanttProject) || Boolean(isProjectModalOpen)) return;
    try {
      const container = e.target.getStage()?.container();
      if (container) container.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      const uName = (unit.name || '').toLowerCase();
      const aggregatedData = aggregatedDataRef.current;
      setHoverInfo({

        data: (uName && aggregatedData[uName]) ? aggregatedData[uName] : {},
        unitName: unit.name || 'Unknown',
        clientX: e.evt.clientX,
        clientY: e.evt.clientY

    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onMouseEnter unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err, unit);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, isProjectModalOpen, updateTooltipPos]);

  const handleMouseMoveUnit = useCallback((_unit: any, e: any) => {
    if (gestures.isInteractingRef.current || (e?.evt && e.evt.buttons > 0) || isPinnedRef.current || Boolean(miniGanttProject) || Boolean(isProjectModalOpen)) return;

    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onMouseMove unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, isProjectModalOpen, updateTooltipPos]);

  const handleMouseLeaveUnit = useCallback((unit: any, e: any) => {

      setHoverInfo(current => (current ? null : current));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onMouseLeave unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err, unit);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, isProjectModalOpen]);

  const pinAndShowTooltip = useCallback((unit: any, clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    isPinnedRef.current = true;
    const uName = (unit?.name || '').toLowerCase();
    const agg = aggregatedDataRef.current;
    setHoverInfo({
      visible: true,
      data: (uName && agg[uName]) ? agg[uName] : {},
      unitName: unit?.name || 'Unknown',
      clientX,
      clientY
    });
    setTimeout(() => updateTooltipPos(clientX, clientY), 0);
  }, [updateTooltipPos]);

  const handleClickUnit = useCallback((unit: any, e: any) => {
    if (gestures.isInteractingRef.current || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
