    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onClick unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err, unit);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, pinAndShowTooltip, onUnitSelected]);

  const handleTapUnit = useCallback((unit: any, e: any) => {
    if (gestures.isInteractingRef.current || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
    try {
      const clientX = e.evt.changedTouches ? e.evt.changedTouches[0].clientX : e.evt.clientX;
      const clientY = e.evt.changedTouches ? e.evt.changedTouches[0].clientY : e.evt.clientY;
      pinAndShowTooltip(unit, clientX, clientY);
      onUnitSelected?.(unit);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onTap unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err, unit);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, pinAndShowTooltip, onUnitSelected]);

  return {
    stageRef,
    containerRef,
    tooltipRef,
    dimensions,
    hoverInfo,
    setHoverInfo,
    isPinnedRef,
    stageScale,
    setStageScale,
    stagePos,
    setStagePos,
    focusedUnitId,
    setFocusedUnitId,
    focusedTimerRef,
    lastHandledSearchRef,
    touchStateRef: gestures.touchStateRef,
    pendingTouchRef: gestures.pendingTouchRef,
    rafTouchIdRef: gestures.rafTouchIdRef,
    isInteractingRef: gestures.isInteractingRef,
    wheelTimeoutRef: gestures.wheelTimeoutRef,
    pendingWheelDeltaRef: gestures.pendingWheelDeltaRef,
    rafWheelIdRef: gestures.rafWheelIdRef,
    lastWheelPointerRef: gestures.lastWheelPointerRef,
    dragVelocityTrackerRef: gestures.dragVelocityTrackerRef,
    rafInertiaIdRef: gestures.rafInertiaIdRef,
    stopInertia,

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { AppRole } from '../../types';
import { getUserAllowedStores, getEffectiveStoreFilter } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useDataStore } from '../PictureMapping/DataContext';
import { useLayoutTabSettings } from './useLayoutTabSettings';
import { 
  buildUnitSuggestions, 
  scoreAndFilterUnitSuggestions, 
  resolveTargetFloorForUnit, 
  resolveInitialTargetLocation,
  sortLocationsByFloorRank
} from './layoutTabSearchUtils';

export interface UseLayoutTabDataProps {
  propInitialStore?: string;
  propInitialLocation?: string;
  propInitialProjectCode?: string;
  onClearFocus?: () => void;
}

export function useLayoutTabData({
  propInitialStore,
  propInitialLocation,
  propInitialProjectCode,
  onClearFocus,
}: UseLayoutTabDataProps) {
  const layoutTabFilters = useAppStore(state => state.layoutTabFilters);
  const initialStore = propInitialStore !== undefined ? propInitialStore : (layoutTabFilters?.store || 'all');
  const initialLocation = propInitialLocation !== undefined ? propInitialLocation : (layoutTabFilters?.location || 'all');
  const initialProjectCode = propInitialProjectCode !== undefined ? propInitialProjectCode : (layoutTabFilters?.projectCode || '');

  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const locationVisibility = useAppStore(state => state.locationVisibility);

  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const setGlobalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalStoreFilter);
  const globalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalLocationFilter);
  const setGlobalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalLocationFilter);

  const [projectCodeFilter, setProjectCodeFilter] = useState(initialProjectCode);
  
  const isAdmin = currentUser.role === 'admin';
  const role = currentUser.role as AppRole;
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setGlobalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalYearFilter);
  const isArchiveYear = globalYearFilter !== 'all' && Number(globalYearFilter) < new Date().getFullYear();
  const canWrite = (isAdmin || !!permissionMatrix[role]?.Write?.layout) && !isArchiveYear;

  const allowedStores = useMemo(() => {
    return getUserAllowedStores(currentUser);
  }, [currentUser]);
  const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
  const activeStore = effectiveStore === 'all' ? (allowedStores[0] || '') : (allowedStores.includes(effectiveStore) ? effectiveStore : (allowedStores[0] || ''));

  const getAllStoreVersions = useDataStore((state) => state.getAllStoreVersions);
  const storeLocationData = useDataStore((state) => state.storeLocationData);
  const mapVersions = useDataStore((state) => state.mapVersions);

  // Stable memoized versions for activeStore to prevent reference churn across partition updates
  const prevStoreVersionsRef = useRef<any[]>([]);
  const prevStoreVersionsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const allStoreVersions = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const vers = getAllStoreVersions((activeStore === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM'));
      if (!Array.isArray(vers)) return [];
      const sig = `${activeStore}_${vers.map(v => `${v?.id || ''}_${v?.backgroundUrl || ''}`).join('|')}`;
      if (sig === prevStoreVersionsKeyRef.current) {
        return prevStoreVersionsRef.current;
      }
      prevStoreVersionsKeyRef.current = sig;
      prevStoreVersionsRef.current = vers;
      return vers;
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }, [getAllStoreVersions, activeStore, storeLocationData, mapVersions]);

  // Initial params sync effect - runs on mount or when props / layoutTabFilters change!
  const hasSyncedInitialRef = useRef(false);
  const lastInitialPropKeyRef = useRef('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const activeStoreParam = propInitialStore !== undefined ? propInitialStore : (layoutTabFilters?.store || '');
    const activeLocParam = propInitialLocation !== undefined ? propInitialLocation : (layoutTabFilters?.location || '');
    const activeCodeParam = propInitialProjectCode !== undefined ? propInitialProjectCode : (layoutTabFilters?.projectCode || '');
    const filterTs = (layoutTabFilters as any)?._ts || '';

    const propKey = `${activeStoreParam}_${activeLocParam}_${activeCodeParam}_${filterTs}`;
    if (hasSyncedInitialRef.current && propKey === lastInitialPropKeyRef.current) {
      return;
    }
    hasSyncedInitialRef.current = true;
    lastInitialPropKeyRef.current = propKey;

    if (activeStoreParam && activeStoreParam !== 'all') {
      setGlobalStoreFilter(activeStoreParam);
    }
    
    if (activeLocParam && activeLocParam !== 'all' && activeLocParam !== 'ALL') {
      setIsLiveMapMode(true);
      setGlobalLocationFilter([activeLocParam.toUpperCase().trim()]);
    }
    
    if (activeCodeParam) {
      setProjectCodeFilter(activeCodeParam);
      setUnitSearchInput(activeCodeParam);
      setTargetUnitSearch(activeCodeParam);
      setIsLiveMapMode(true);
    }

    const unitInfo = useDataStore.getState().unitInfo || [];
    const targetLoc = resolveInitialTargetLocation(
      activeLocParam, 
      activeCodeParam, 
      projects, 
      tasks, 
      allStoreVersions, 
      unitInfo
    );

    if (targetLoc && targetLoc.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
      setGlobalLocationFilter([targetLoc]);
    }
  }, [propInitialStore, propInitialLocation, propInitialProjectCode, layoutTabFilters, projects, tasks, allStoreVersions, setGlobalStoreFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  // Available years: based on user permissions, projects, tasks, and store versions
  const prevAvailableYearsRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const prevAvailableYearsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const availableYears = useMemo(() => {
    const storeProjects = projects.filter(p => {
      if (!activeStore || activeStore === 'all') return true;
      const pStore = String(p.store || 'HCM').toUpperCase().trim();
      return pStore === activeStore;
    });

    const projectYearsSet = new Set<string>();
    storeProjects.forEach(p => {
      const y = String(p.year || (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '')).trim();
      if (y && y.toLowerCase() !== 'all' && /^\d{4}$/.test(y)) {
        projectYearsSet.add(y);
      }
    });

    const storeTasks = tasks.filter(t => {
      if (!activeStore || activeStore === 'all') return true;
      const tStore = String(t.projectStore || 'HCM').toUpperCase().trim();
      return tStore === activeStore;
    });
    const taskYearsSet = new Set<string>();
    storeTasks.forEach(t => {
      const y = String(t.projectYear || (t.start ? String(t.start).substring(0, 4) : '')).trim();
      if (y && y.toLowerCase() !== 'all' && /^\d{4}$/.test(y)) {
        taskYearsSet.add(y);
      }
    });

    const userPermittedYears = new Set([...projectYearsSet, ...taskYearsSet]);

    const versionYears = Array.from(
      new Set(
        allStoreVersions
          .filter(v => {
            if (!activeStore || activeStore === 'all') return true;
            const vStore = String(v.store || (activeStore === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM')).toUpperCase().trim();
            return vStore === activeStore;
          })
          .map(v => (v.year ? String(v.year).trim() : ''))
          .filter(y => y && y.toLowerCase() !== 'all' && /^\d{4}$/.test(y))
      )
    );

    const defaultStoreYears = activeStore === 'HN' ? ['2027'] : ['2026', '2027'];

    const finalYears = Array.from(new Set([...userPermittedYears, ...versionYears, ...defaultStoreYears]))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));

    const key = finalYears.join('|');
    if (key === prevAvailableYearsKeyRef.current) {
      return prevAvailableYearsRef.current;
    }
    prevAvailableYearsKeyRef.current = key;
    prevAvailableYearsRef.current = finalYears;
    return finalYears;
  }, [allStoreVersions, projects, tasks, activeStore]);

  const effectiveYear = useMemo(() => {
    if (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all' && availableYears.includes(globalYearFilter)) {
      return globalYearFilter;
    }
    return availableYears[0] || '';
  }, [globalYearFilter, availableYears]);

  // Layout tab requires specific year selection (no 'all' option allowed)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableYears.length > 0 && (!globalYearFilter || globalYearFilter === 'all' || !availableYears.includes(globalYearFilter))) {
      setGlobalYearFilter(effectiveYear);
    }
  }, [globalYearFilter, availableYears, effectiveYear, setGlobalYearFilter]);

  // Layout tab only supports store-specific floor plans (HCM, HN), hide all-stores
  useEffect(() => {
    if (allowedStores.length > 0 && (!globalStoreFilter || globalStoreFilter === 'all' || !allowedStores.includes(globalStoreFilter))) {
      setGlobalStoreFilter(allowedStores[0]);
    }
  }, [globalStoreFilter, allowedStores, setGlobalStoreFilter]);

  // Danh sách location của Tab Layout (Cached to prevent array reference churn)
  const prevAvailableLocationsRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const prevAvailableLocationsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const availableLocations = useMemo(() => {
    const storeParam = (activeStore === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM');
    const isUserAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'admin';
    const locPerms = currentUser?.locationPermissions || {};
    const hasAll = isUserAdmin || locPerms['all'] === true;

    const isFloorName = (name: string) => {
      if (!name) return false;
      const n = name.toUpperCase().trim();
      const nonFloors = ['BUDGET', 'COST', 'ALL', 'SUMMARY', 'GENERAL', 'SETTING'];
      if (nonFloors.includes(n)) return false;
      return true;
    };

    const isPermitted = (loc: string) => {
      if (!loc || !isFloorName(loc)) return false;
      if (locationVisibility[loc] === false) return false;
      if (hasAll) return true;
      const lLower = loc.toLowerCase().trim();
      const cleanLoc = lLower.replace(/^md-/, '');
      return !!(locPerms[cleanLoc] || locPerms[`md-${cleanLoc}`] || locPerms[lLower]);
    };

    const pmLocationsSet = new Set<string>();

    allStoreVersions.forEach(v => {
      const loc = String(v.location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (loc && isPermitted(loc)) {
        pmLocationsSet.add(loc);
      }
    });

    if (storeLocationData) {
      Object.entries(storeLocationData).forEach(([key, partition]) => {
        if (key.startsWith(`${storeParam}_`)) {
          const loc = key.replace(`${storeParam}_`, '').toUpperCase().trim();
          if (loc && isPermitted(loc)) {
            if (
              (partition?.mapVersions && partition.mapVersions.length > 0) ||
              (partition?.mapUnits && partition.mapUnits.length > 0) ||
              partition?.activeMapVersionId
            ) {
              pmLocationsSet.add(loc);
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    let finalLocations: string[] = [];
    if (pmLocationsSet.size > 0) {
      finalLocations = Array.from(pmLocationsSet);
    } else {
      finalLocations = (locations || []).map(l => String(l).toUpperCase().trim()).filter(isPermitted);
    }

    const sorted = sortLocationsByFloorRank(finalLocations);
    const key = sorted.join('|');
    if (key === prevAvailableLocationsKeyRef.current) {
      return prevAvailableLocationsRef.current;
    }
    prevAvailableLocationsKeyRef.current = key;
    prevAvailableLocationsRef.current = sorted;
    return sorted;
  }, [allStoreVersions, storeLocationData, activeStore, currentUser, locationVisibility, locations]);

  // Ensure globalLocationFilter is never 'all' or empty in Layout tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableLocations.length > 0) {
      const currentLoc = (globalLocationFilter[0] || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (!currentLoc || currentLoc === 'ALL') {
        const initialTargetLoc = resolveInitialTargetLocation(
          propInitialLocation || layoutTabFilters?.location || '', 
          propInitialProjectCode || layoutTabFilters?.projectCode || '', 
          projects, 
          tasks, 
          allStoreVersions, 
          useDataStore.getState().unitInfo || []
        );
        if (initialTargetLoc && availableLocations.includes(initialTargetLoc)) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter([initialTargetLoc]);
          return;
        }
      }
      const matched = availableLocations.find(l => l.toUpperCase().trim() === currentLoc);
      if (matched) {
        if (globalLocationFilter[0] !== matched) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter([matched]);
        }
      } else {
        const initialTargetLoc = resolveInitialTargetLocation(
          propInitialLocation || layoutTabFilters?.location || '', 
          propInitialProjectCode || layoutTabFilters?.projectCode || '', 
          projects, 
          tasks, 
          allStoreVersions, 
          useDataStore.getState().unitInfo || []
        );
        if (initialTargetLoc && availableLocations.includes(initialTargetLoc)) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter([initialTargetLoc]);
        } else {
          setGlobalLocationFilter([availableLocations[0]]);
        }
      }
    }
  }, [availableLocations, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter, propInitialLocation, propInitialProjectCode, layoutTabFilters, projects, tasks, allStoreVersions]);

  const locFilterStr = useMemo(() => {
    const currentLoc = (globalLocationFilter[0] || '').toUpperCase().trim();
    if (currentLoc && currentLoc !== 'ALL') {
      const matched = availableLocations.find(l => l.toUpperCase().trim() === currentLoc);
      if (matched) return matched;
      return currentLoc;
    }
    return availableLocations[0] || '';
  }, [globalLocationFilter, availableLocations]);
  const [isLiveMapMode, setIsLiveMapMode] = useState(true);
  const [isFullscreenView, setIsFullscreenView] = useState(false);

  // Settings, URL persistence, and export triggers
  const {
    url,
    isEditing,
    setIsEditing,
    editUrl,
    setEditUrl,
    handleSave,
    isExporting,
    exportStatusMessage,
    handleTriggerReExport,
    getCleanUrl,
    fallbackSvg,
    cacheBuster,
    setCacheBuster,
  } = useLayoutTabSettings({ activeStore, locFilterStr });

  // Search Unit functionality next to Trigger Export
  const [unitSearchInput, setUnitSearchInput] = useState('');
  const [targetUnitSearch, setTargetUnitSearch] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false);
  const searchContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const getAllStoreUnits = useDataStore((state) => state.getAllStoreUnits);

  // Lazy autocomplete suggestions: ONLY compute when user opens or types into search box
  const unitSuggestions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!showSuggestions && !unitSearchInput.trim()) {
      return [];
    }
    const storeUnits: any[] = typeof getAllStoreUnits === 'function' ? (getAllStoreUnits as any)(activeStore) || [] : [];
    return buildUnitSuggestions(storeUnits, projects, activeStore, availableLocations, isAdmin);
  }, [getAllStoreUnits, activeStore, projects, availableLocations, isAdmin, showSuggestions, unitSearchInput]);

  const filteredUnitSuggestions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!unitSearchInput.trim()) return [];
    const currentLoc = globalLocationFilter[0] || '';
    return scoreAndFilterUnitSuggestions(unitSuggestions, unitSearchInput, currentLoc);
  }, [unitSuggestions, unitSearchInput, globalLocationFilter]);

  const handleSelectSearchUnit = useCallback((unitItem: { unit: string; location?: string; brand?: string; project?: string; code?: string }) => {
    setUnitSearchInput(unitItem.unit);
    setShowSuggestions(false);

    if (!isLiveMapMode) {
      setIsLiveMapMode(true);
    }

    const targetFloor = resolveTargetFloorForUnit(unitItem, projects);
    if (targetFloor && targetFloor.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
      setGlobalLocationFilter([targetFloor]);
    }

    setTargetUnitSearch(unitItem.unit);
  }, [isLiveMapMode, projects, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  const handleClearSearchAndFocus = useCallback(() => {
    setUnitSearchInput('');
    setTargetUnitSearch(null);
    setShowSuggestions(false);
    onClearFocus?.();
  }, [onClearFocus]);

  // Close suggestions on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOutsideClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (searchContainerRef.current && !searchContainerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setShowSuggestions(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
  }, []);

  // When activeStore, locFilterStr, or effectiveYear changes, reset search & focus states to default
  const prevFilterStateRef = useRef({ store: activeStore, loc: locFilterStr, yr: effectiveYear });
  useEffect(() => {
    const prev = prevFilterStateRef.current;
    if (prev.store !== activeStore || prev.loc !== locFilterStr || prev.yr !== effectiveYear) {
      prevFilterStateRef.current = { store: activeStore, loc: locFilterStr, yr: effectiveYear };
      setUnitSearchInput('');
      setTargetUnitSearch(null);
      setShowSuggestions(false);
      onClearFocus?.();
    }
  }, [activeStore, locFilterStr, effectiveYear, onClearFocus]);

  return {
    allowedStores, activeStore, setGlobalStoreFilter,
    globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter,
    availableLocations, locFilterStr,
    availableYears, effectiveYear, setGlobalYearFilter, globalYearFilter,
    canWrite, isAdmin, isEditing, setIsEditing, editUrl, setEditUrl, handleSave,
    isLiveMapMode, setIsLiveMapMode, url, getCleanUrl, fallbackSvg,
    isExporting, exportStatusMessage, handleTriggerReExport,
    unitSearchInput, setUnitSearchInput, targetUnitSearch, setTargetUnitSearch,
    showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions, searchContainerRef,
    filteredUnitSuggestions, handleSelectSearchUnit, handleClearSearchAndFocus,
    isFullscreenView, setIsFullscreenView,
  };
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { doc, onSnapshot, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { usePerformanceStore } from '../../store/usePerformanceStore';
import { executeTriggerExportProcess } from '../PictureMapping/lib/dynamicExportService';
import { isValidUrl } from './layoutTabSearchUtils';

interface UseLayoutTabSettingsProps {
  activeStore: string;
  locFilterStr: string;
}

export function useLayoutTabSettings({ activeStore, locFilterStr }: UseLayoutTabSettingsProps) {
  const [layoutSettings, setLayoutSettings] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [url, setUrl] = useState<string>('https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hxzPKKhQWhQ-tAThmgan8eNqqy5GN-Ds/preview');
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editUrl, setEditUrl] = useState('');
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);
  const [exportStatusMessage, setExportStatusMessage] = useState<string>('');
  const [cacheBuster, setCacheBuster] = useState<number>(Date.now());

  const docKey = `url_${activeStore}_${locFilterStr}`;

  // Listen to layout settings & triggers from Firestore
  useEffect(() => {
    usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener('taka_settings/layout');
    usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener('taka_settings/layout_trigger');

    const unsubLayout = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_settings', 'layout'), (docSnap) => {
      usePerformanceStore.getState().trackSnapshot('taka_settings/layout', docSnap);
      if (docSnap.exists()) {
        setLayoutSettings(docSnap.data());
      }
    }, (error) => {
      console.error('Error listening to layout settings', error);
    });

    const unsubTrigger = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_settings', 'layout_trigger'), (docSnap) => {
      usePerformanceStore.getState().trackSnapshot('taka_settings/layout_trigger', docSnap);
      if (docSnap.exists()) {
        const data = docSnap.data();
        if (data.is_ready_to_export === false) {
          setIsExporting(false);
          if (data.export_completed_at) {
            setCacheBuster(data.export_completed_at);
          }
        } else if (data.is_ready_to_export === true) {
          if (data.requested_at && Date.now() - data.requested_at < 15000) {
            setIsExporting(true);
          } else {
            setIsExporting(false);
          }
        }
      }
    }, (error) => {
      console.error('Error listening to layout_trigger', error);
    });

    return () => {
      unsubLayout();
      unsubTrigger();
      usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener('taka_settings/layout');
      usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener('taka_settings/layout_trigger');
    };
  }, []);

  // Synchronize URL when docKey, layoutSettings, or activeStore changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (layoutSettings[docKey] && isValidUrl(layoutSettings[docKey])) {
      setUrl(layoutSettings[docKey]);
    } else if (layoutSettings[`url_${activeStore}`] && isValidUrl(layoutSettings[`url_${activeStore}`])) {
      setUrl(layoutSettings[`url_${activeStore}`]);
    } else {
      setUrl('');
    }
  }, [docKey, layoutSettings, activeStore]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (isExporting) {
      timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        setIsExporting(false);
        setExportStatusMessage('');
      }, 30000);
    }
    return () => {
      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    };
  }, [isExporting]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    try {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_settings', 'layout');
      const updates: Record<string, any> = { [docKey]: editUrl };
      setDoc(docRef, updates, { merge: true });
      setUrl(editUrl);
      setIsEditing(false);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving layout URL', error);
    }
  };

  const handleTriggerReExport = async () => {
    if (isExporting) return;
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setExportStatusMessage('Bước 1/4: Đang tải dữ liệu từ Cloudflare R2...');
      const targetStore = (activeStore === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
      
      const res = await executeTriggerExportProcess(targetStore, (status) => {
        setExportStatusMessage(status);
      });

      setCacheBuster(Date.now());
      setIsExporting(false);
      setExportStatusMessage('');
      alert(`✅ ${res.message}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Error triggering layout export', error);
      setIsExporting(false);
      setExportStatusMessage('');
      alert(`⚠️ Lỗi khi Trigger Export:\n${error?.message || error}`);
    }
  };

  const getCleanUrl = useCallback((inputUrl: string | undefined | null) => {
    if (!inputUrl) return undefined;
    let cleanUrl = inputUrl;
    if (cleanUrl.includes('/view')) {
      cleanUrl = cleanUrl.replace('/view', '/preview');
    }
    if (cleanUrl) {
      const separator = cleanUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
      return `${cleanUrl}${separator}t=${cacheBuster}`;
    }
    return undefined;
  }, [cacheBuster]);

  const fallbackSvg = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="%2394a3b8" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"></circle><polyline points="21 15 16 10 5 21"></polyline></svg>';

  return {
    url,
    isEditing,
    setIsEditing,
    editUrl,
    setEditUrl,
    handleSave,
    isExporting,
    exportStatusMessage,
    handleTriggerReExport,
    getCleanUrl,
    fallbackSvg,
    cacheBuster,
    setCacheBuster,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/useLayoutWindowListeners.ts ===
import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

interface UseLayoutWindowListenersParams {
  isPrintPreview: boolean;
  fitToScreen: (animated?: boolean) => void;
  fitToScreenRef: React.MutableRefObject<(animated?: boolean) => void>;
  handleExport: () => void;
  stageRef: React.RefObject<any>;
  containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  setDimensions: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{ width: number; height: number }>>;
}

export function useLayoutWindowListeners({
  isPrintPreview,
  fitToScreen,
  fitToScreenRef,
  handleExport,
  stageRef,
  containerRef,
  setDimensions,
}: UseLayoutWindowListenersParams) {
  // ResizeObserver for canvas container: safely only update state when width/height actually changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const updateSize = () => {
      if (!containerRef.current) return;
      const newW = containerRef.current.offsetWidth || 800;
      const newH = containerRef.current.offsetHeight || 600;
      setDimensions(prev => (prev.width === newW && prev.height === newH) ? prev : { width: newW, height: newH });
    };

    updateSize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateSize);
    let ro: ResizeObserver | null = null;
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' && containerRef.current) {
      ro = new ResizeObserver(updateSize);
      ro.observe(containerRef.current);
    }
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', updateSize);
      if (ro) ro.disconnect();
    };
  }, [containerRef, setDimensions]);

  // When print preview activates or deactivates, automatically fit floor plan to screen
  const prevPrintPreviewRef = useRef(isPrintPreview);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevPrintPreviewRef.current !== isPrintPreview) {
      prevPrintPreviewRef.current = isPrintPreview;
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        fitToScreen(false);
      }, 150);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [isPrintPreview, fitToScreen]);

  // Handle browser native print & custom export events
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforePrint = () => fitToScreenRef.current(false);
    const handleExportPngEvent = () => handleExport();
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('export-png', handleExportPngEvent);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('export-png', handleExportPngEvent);
    };
  }, [handleExport, fitToScreenRef]);

  // Wake-up redraw handler after tab cold freeze or background sleep
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleWakeUp = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        stageRef.current?.batchDraw();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleWakeUp);
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleWakeUp);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleWakeUp);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleWakeUp);
    };
  }, [stageRef]);
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';

export const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'Jan',
  'Feb',
  'Mar',
  'Apr',
  'May',
  'Jun',
  'Jul',
  'Aug',
  'Sep',
  'Oct',
  'Nov',
  'Dec',
];

export const formatMonthDay = (d: Date | null): string => {
  if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const month = MONTH_NAMES[d.getMonth()];
  const day = d.getDate();
  return `${month} ${day}`;
};

export const getBarColor = (status: string, duration?: string | number) => {
  if (
    duration !== undefined &&
    duration !== '' &&
    parseFloat(String(duration)) === 0
  )
    return 'bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 border border-amber-600';
  const s = String(status || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (s === 'completed' || s === 'done')
    return 'bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 border border-emerald-600';
  if (s === 'on process' || s === 'in progress')
    return 'bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-blue-600';
  if (s === 'delayed' || s === 'delay' || s === 'overdue')
    return 'bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-600 border border-rose-600';
  if (s === 'upcoming' || s === 'planned')
    return 'bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-500 dark:hover:bg-slate-400 border border-slate-500/80';
  if (s === 'handover')
    return 'bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-blue-600';
  if (s === 'canceled' || s === 'cancelled')
    return 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-400 text-slate-600 border border-slate-400';
  return 'bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-500 border border-slate-500/80';
};

  childCount: number;
}

export function useMiniGanttData(project: Project | null, onClose: () => void) {
  const tasks = useAppStore((state) => state.tasks);
  const projects = useAppStore((state) => state.projects);
  const setActiveTab = useAppStore((state) => state.setActiveTab);
  const isTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.isTasksRequested);
  const setIsTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsTasksRequested);

  // Ensure tasks are fetched from Firestore when Mini Gantt is opened
  useEffect(() => {
    if (project && !isTasksRequested) {
      setIsTasksRequested(true);
    }
  }, [project, isTasksRequested, setIsTasksRequested]);

  // Always resolve the LIVE project object from Zustand (or fallback to passed project)
  const liveProject = useMemo(() => {
    if (!project) return null;
    const pId = project.id ? String(project.id) : '';
    const pCode = String(project.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const pYear = project.year ? String(project.year).trim() : '';
    const pStore = project.store ? String(project.store).trim().toUpperCase() : '';

    if (pId) {
      const foundById = projects.find((p) => p.id && String(p.id) === pId);
      if (foundById) return foundById;
    }

    const foundByCode = projects.find((p) => {
      const s = String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const y = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : '';
      const c = String(p.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (pStore && s && pStore !== s) return false;
      if (pYear && y && pYear !== y) return false;
      return c === pCode;
    });

    return foundByCode || project;
  }, [project, projects]);

  // Raw tasks for this project (matching Main Gantt getGroupTasksForProject logic)
  const rawProjectTasks = useMemo(() => {
    const currentProj = liveProject || project;
    if (!currentProj) return [];

    const pId = currentProj.id ? String(currentProj.id) : '';
    const pCode = (currentProj.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const pYear = currentProj.year ? String(currentProj.year).trim() : '';
    const pStore = currentProj.store ? String(currentProj.store).trim().toUpperCase() : '';

    const matchedZustandTasks = tasks.filter((t) => {
      if (t.isDeleted) return false;
      const tStore = t.projectStore ? String(t.projectStore).trim().toUpperCase() : '';
      const tYear = t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear).trim() : '';

      if (pStore && tStore && pStore !== tStore) return false;
      if (pYear && tYear && pYear !== tYear) return false;

      if (pId && t.projectId && String(t.projectId) === pId) {
        return true;
      }
      if (pId && t.projectId && String(t.projectId) !== pId) {
        return false;
      }

      const tCode = String(t.projectCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (!tCode || tCode !== pCode) return false;
      return true;
    });

    const summaryItems =
      (currentProj.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(currentProj.taskSummaries) && currentProj.taskSummaries.length > 0)
        ? currentProj.taskSummaries
        : (project?.taskSummaries || []);

    const mapSummaryToTask = (ts: any, idx: number): Task => {
      const subtaskNum = extractSubtaskIndex(ts.taskCodePhu);
      const derivedOrderIndex =
        subtaskNum !== null
          ? subtaskNum - 1
          : ts.orderIndex !== undefined && ts.orderIndex !== null
          ? ts.orderIndex
          : idx;
      const fallbackCode = subtaskNum !== null ? `#${subtaskNum}` : ts.taskCodePhu || '';

      let durStr = '1';
      if (ts.duration !== undefined && ts.duration !== null && String(ts.duration).trim() !== '') {
        durStr = String(ts.duration).trim();
      }

      return {
        id: ts.id || ts.taskId || `ts_${currentProj.code || currentProj.id}_${idx}`,
        name: ts.name || 'Task',
        start: ts.start || currentProj.computedTakStart || currentProj.start || '',
        finish: ts.finish || currentProj.computedTakCompl || currentProj.handover || '',
        duration: durStr,
        taskCodePhu: fallbackCode,
        runningStatus: ts.runningStatus || (ts.approval === 'Approved' ? 'Completed' : 'Upcoming'),
        approval: ts.approval,
        party: ts.party || currentProj.party || '',
        parentTaskId: ts.parentTaskId,
        projectCode: currentProj.code,
        projectId: currentProj.id,
        projectStore: currentProj.store,
        projectYear: currentProj.year,
        orderIndex: derivedOrderIndex,
        ...ts,
      } as Task;
    };

    if (matchedZustandTasks.length === 0) {
      if (summaryItems.length > 0) {
        return summaryItems.map((ts: any, idx: number) => mapSummaryToTask(ts, idx));
      }
      return [];
    }

    // If matchedZustandTasks count is less than taskSummaries, merge missing items from taskSummaries
    if (summaryItems.length > matchedZustandTasks.length) {
      const existingSummaryMap = new Set<string>();
      matchedZustandTasks.forEach((t) => {
        if (t.id) existingSummaryMap.add(String(t.id).toLowerCase());
        if (t.taskCodePhu) existingSummaryMap.add(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
        if (t.name) existingSummaryMap.add(String(t.name).trim().toLowerCase());
      });

      const mergedTasks = [...matchedZustandTasks];
      summaryItems.forEach((ts: any, idx: number) => {
        const tsId = ts.id ? String(ts.id).toLowerCase() : '';
        const tsCode = ts.taskCodePhu ? String(ts.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        const tsName = ts.name ? String(ts.name).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

        const hasMatch =
          (tsId && existingSummaryMap.has(tsId)) ||
          (tsCode && existingSummaryMap.has(tsCode)) ||
          (tsName && existingSummaryMap.has(tsName));

        if (!hasMatch) {
          mergedTasks.push(mapSummaryToTask(ts, idx));
        }
      });
      return mergedTasks;
    }

    return matchedZustandTasks;
  }, [liveProject, project, tasks]);

  // Exact Main Gantt (useGanttVirtualization.ts) task ordering & hierarchy
  const orderedGanttRows: MiniGanttRow[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (rawProjectTasks.length === 0) return [];

    const pTasks = sortGroupTasks(rawProjectTasks);

    // Group parent and child tasks (identical to Main Gantt)
    const parentTasks: Task[] = [];
    const childTasksMap = new Map<string, Task[]>();

    // Index tasks in project by ID and taskCodePhu for robust parent matching
    const projectTaskById = new Map<string, Task>();
    const projectTaskByCode = new Map<string, Task>();
    pTasks.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.id) projectTaskById.set(String(t.id), t);
      if (t.taskCodePhu) {
        projectTaskByCode.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase(), t);
      }
    });

    pTasks.forEach((t) => {
      const rawParentId = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
      if (rawParentId) {
        const parentKey = String(rawParentId).trim().toLowerCase();
        const matchedParent =
          projectTaskById.get(String(rawParentId)) || projectTaskByCode.get(parentKey);
        const effectiveParentId = matchedParent ? matchedParent.id : String(rawParentId);

        if (!childTasksMap.has(effectiveParentId)) {
          childTasksMap.set(effectiveParentId, []);
        }
        childTasksMap.get(effectiveParentId)!.push(t);
      } else {
        parentTasks.push(t);
      }
    });

    // Exactly like Main Gantt: sort parent tasks independently
    const sortedParentTasks = sortGroupTasks(parentTasks);

    const rows: MiniGanttRow[] = [];

    sortedParentTasks.forEach((t) => {
      const rawChildren = childTasksMap.get(t.id) || [];
      // Exactly like Main Gantt: sort child tasks of this parent independently
      const children = sortGroupTasks(rawChildren);
      const hasChildren = children.length > 0;

      rows.push({
        task: t,
        isChild: false,
        hasChildren,
        childCount: children.length,
      });

      if (hasChildren) {
        children.forEach((c) => {
          rows.push({
            task: c,
            isChild: true,
            hasChildren: false,
            childCount: 0,
          });
        });
      }
    });

    return rows;
  }, [rawProjectTasks]);

  // Calculate timeline bounding dates
  const timelineBounds = useMemo(() => {
    if (!project) {
      const now = new Date().getTime();
      return {
        startDate: new Date(now),
        finishDate: new Date(now + 30 * 86400000),
        totalDays: 30,
      };
    }
    const dates: number[] = [];

    const projStart = parseDateTime(project.computedTakStart || project.start);
    const projFinish = parseDateTime(
      project.computedTakCompl || project.handover || project.opening
    );
    if (projStart) dates.push(projStart.getTime());
    if (projFinish) dates.push(projFinish.getTime());

    rawProjectTasks.forEach((t) => {
      const s = parseDateTime(t.start);
      const f = parseDateTime(t.finish);
      if (s) dates.push(s.getTime());
      if (f) dates.push(f.getTime());
    });

    const now = new Date().getTime();
    if (dates.length === 0) {
      return {
        startDate: new Date(now),
        finishDate: new Date(now + 30 * 86400000),
        totalDays: 30,
      };
    }

    const minTime = Math.min(...dates);
    const maxTime = Math.max(...dates);
    const totalDays = Math.max(1, Math.round((maxTime - minTime) / 86400000) + 1);

    return {
      startDate: new Date(minTime),
      finishDate: new Date(maxTime),
      totalDays,
    };
  }, [project, rawProjectTasks]);

  // Calculate Today position on timeline (Today Line)
  const todayData = useMemo(() => {
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const todayTime = today.getTime();

    const startTime = new Date(timelineBounds.startDate);
    startTime.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const totalDays = Math.max(1, timelineBounds.totalDays);
    const offsetDays = (todayTime - startTime.getTime()) / 86400000;
    const percent = (offsetDays / totalDays) * 100;

    const isInTimeline = percent >= 0 && percent <= 100;
    const clampedPercent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, percent));

    return {
      today,
      formattedToday: formatMonthDay(today),
      percent: clampedPercent,
      isInTimeline,
    };
  }, [timelineBounds]);

  // Overall task stats matching GanttTab logic
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = rawProjectTasks.length;
    let completed = 0;
    let inProgress = 0;
    let upcoming = 0;
    let milestone = 0;

    rawProjectTasks.forEach((t) => {
      const rawDur = parseFloat(String(t.duration || ''));
      if (!isNaN(rawDur) && rawDur === 0) {
        milestone++;
        return;
      }
      const s = (t.runningStatus || '').toLowerCase();
      let status = getTaskStatus(t.start, t.finish);
      if (t.approval === 'Approved' || s.includes('complete')) {
        status = 'Completed';
      } else if (s.includes('process') || s.includes('progress')) {
        status = 'On process';
      }

      if (status === 'Completed') {
        completed++;
      } else if (status === 'On process') {
        inProgress++;
      } else {
        upcoming++;
      }
    });

    return {
      total,
      completed,
      inProgress,
      upcoming,
      milestone,
    };
  }, [rawProjectTasks]);

  const handleOpenFullGantt = () => {
    if (!project) return;
    const yearVal = project.year;
    if (yearVal) {
      useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(String(yearVal));
    } else {
      useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter('all');
    }

    const storeVal = project.store;
    const currentUser = useAppStore.getState().currentUser;
    if (storeVal) {
      useAppStore.getState().setGlobalStoreFilter(storeVal);
      if (currentUser?.id) {
        safeSetItemLocal(`taka_store_filter_${currentUser.id}`, String(storeVal));
      }
    } else {
      useAppStore.getState().setGlobalStoreFilter('all');
      if (currentUser?.id) {
        safeSetItemLocal(`taka_store_filter_${currentUser.id}`, 'all');
      }
    }

    if (project.code) {
      safeSetItemSession('taka_gantt_search', project.code);
    }

    const targetProjectId = project.id ? String(project.id) : (project.code || '');
    useAppStore.getState().setGanttTabFilterProjectId(targetProjectId);

    if (project.location && project.location !== 'all' && project.location !== 'ALL') {
      useAppStore.getState().setGlobalLocationFilter([project.location]);
    } else {
      useAppStore.getState().setGlobalLocationFilter([]);
    }

    const currentExpanded = useAppStore.getState().expandedProjectIds;
    if (project.id && currentExpanded.includes(project.id)) {
      useAppStore.getState().setExpandedProjectIds(currentExpanded.filter(id => id !== project.id));
    }

    safeSetItemSession('taka_gantt_trigger_today', 'true');
    useAppStore.getState().triggerGanttToday();
    setActiveTab('gantt');
    onClose();
  };

  return {
    rawProjectTasks,
    orderedGanttRows,
    timelineBounds,
    todayData,
    stats,
    handleOpenFullGantt,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/LazyImage.tsx ===
import React, { lazy, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';

export function LazyImage({ src, alt, className }: { src: string, alt: string, className?: string }) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setIsVisible(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      {
        rootMargin: '50px',
      }
    );

    if (imgRef.current) {
      observer.observe(imgRef.current);
    }

    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={imgRef} className={cn("relative min-h-[100px] bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5 rounded flex items-center justify-center", className)}>
      {isVisible ? (
        <img
          src={src}
          alt={alt}
          className={cn("w-full h-auto rounded object-contain border border-black/10 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm", className)}
          loading="lazy"
          decoding="async"
          onError={(e) => {
            (e.target as HTMLElement).style.display = 'none';
            if (imgRef.current) {
              imgRef.current.style.display = 'none';
            }
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Loading thumbnail...</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// Contrast calculator for crisp text labels
function getContrastStyle(hexColor: string) {
  if (!hexColor || typeof hexColor !== 'string') {
    return { text: '#ffffff', shapeStroke: '#ffffff' };
  }
  let c = hexColor.replace('#', '').trim();
  if (c.length === 3) c = c.split('').map(x => x + x).join('');
  if (c.length !== 6) return { text: '#ffffff', shapeStroke: '#ffffff' };
  const r = parseInt(c.substring(0, 2), 16) || 0;
  const g = parseInt(c.substring(2, 4), 16) || 0;
  const b = parseInt(c.substring(4, 6), 16) || 0;
  const yiq = (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000;
  return {
    text: yiq >= 140 ? '#0f172a' : '#ffffff',
    shapeStroke: yiq >= 140 ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0',
  };
}

        return part.mapVersions.find((v: any) => v.isDynamicActive) || part.mapVersions[0];
      }

      {selectedUnit && (
        <LayoutUnitTooltip
          hoverInfo={{
            visible: true,
            data: selectedUnit,

            clientX: tooltipPos?.x,
            clientY: tooltipPos?.y,
          }}
          tooltipRef={tooltipRef}
          containerRef={containerRef}
          onClose={() => setSelectedUnit(null)}
          storeFilter={storeFilter}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

=== FILE: src/components/LiveLayoutParts/useLiveLayoutR2Config.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useDataStore } from '../PictureMapping/DataContext';
import { extractR2Key, getS3Sdk, downloadR2JsonFile } from '../PictureMapping/lib/r2Upload';
import { preloadFloorImages } from '../../lib/imageDBCache';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { doc, getDoc, setDoc, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';

export interface LiveLayoutR2ConfigState {
  config: any;
  setConfig: (config: any) => void;
  loading: boolean;
  setLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
  error: string | null;
  setError: (error: string | null) => void;
  showConfigModal: boolean;
  setShowConfigModal: (show: boolean) => void;
  cfgAccountId: string;
  setCfgAccountId: (id: string) => void;
  cfgBucketName: string;
  setCfgBucketName: (bucket: string) => void;
  cfgAccessKey: string;
  setCfgAccessKey: (key: string) => void;
  cfgSecretKey: string;
  setCfgSecretKey: (sec: string) => void;
  initFormFromStorage: () => void;
  loadConfig: () => Promise<void>;
  handleSaveR2Config: () => Promise<void>;
}

export function useLiveLayoutR2Config(): LiveLayoutR2ConfigState {
  const r2Config = useAppStore(state => state.r2Config);
  const setR2Config = useAppStore(state => state.setR2Config);

  const [config, setConfig] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showConfigModal, setShowConfigModal] = useState(false);

  // Form states for in-place R2 configuration
  const [cfgAccountId, setCfgAccountId] = useState('');
  const [cfgBucketName, setCfgBucketName] = useState('');
  const [cfgAccessKey, setCfgAccessKey] = useState('');
  const [cfgSecretKey, setCfgSecretKey] = useState('');

  // Load initial form values from localStorage
  const initFormFromStorage = useCallback(() => {
    setCfgAccountId(r2Config?.accountId || (localStorage.getItem('r2_account_id') || '').trim());
    setCfgBucketName(r2Config?.bucketName || (localStorage.getItem('r2_bucket_name') || '').trim());
    setCfgAccessKey(r2Config?.accessKeyId || (localStorage.getItem('r2_access_key') || localStorage.getItem('r2_access_key_id') || '').trim());
    setCfgSecretKey(r2Config?.secretAccessKey || (localStorage.getItem('r2_secret_key') || localStorage.getItem('r2_secret_access_key') || '').trim());
  }, [r2Config]);

  // Load config from R2
  const loadConfig = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      let accountId = r2Config?.accountId || (localStorage.getItem('r2_account_id') || '').trim();
      let accessKeyId = r2Config?.accessKeyId || (localStorage.getItem('r2_access_key') || localStorage.getItem('r2_access_key_id') || '').trim();
      let secretAccessKey = r2Config?.secretAccessKey || (localStorage.getItem('r2_secret_key') || localStorage.getItem('r2_secret_access_key') || '').trim();
      let bucketName = r2Config?.bucketName || (localStorage.getItem('r2_bucket_name') || '').trim();

      // If r2Config is not yet populated in store on fresh account boot, fetch directly from Firestore
      if (!accountId || !accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey || !bucketName) {
        try {
          const r2Doc = await getDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "r2_credentials"));
          if (r2Doc.exists()) {
            const r2Data = r2Doc.data() as any;
            if (r2Data?.accountId && r2Data?.accessKeyId) {
              accountId = r2Data.accountId;
              accessKeyId = r2Data.accessKeyId;
              secretAccessKey = r2Data.secretAccessKey;
              bucketName = r2Data.bucketName;
              useAppStore.getState().setR2Config(r2Data);
            }
          }
        } catch (fetchErr) {
          console.warn("Could not fetch r2_credentials from Firestore:", fetchErr);
        }
      }

      if (!accountId || !accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey || !bucketName) {
        initFormFromStorage();
        throw new Error('Chưa cấu hình R2 Cloudflare trên hệ thống. Vui lòng bấm "Cấu hình R2" bên dưới hoặc vào Tab Picture Mapping để kết nối Cloud Sync.');
      }

      const { S3Client, GetObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
      const s3 = new S3Client({
        region: 'auto',
        endpoint: `https://${accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
        credentials: { accessKeyId, secretAccessKey },
      });

      const downloadRes = await downloadR2JsonFile<any>('mapping_config.json', { accountId, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, bucketName }, s3);
      let data: any = (downloadRes.success && downloadRes.data) ? downloadRes.data : null;

      // Parallel check with Firestore backup to ensure newest timestamp is used
      try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "picture_mapping_config"));
        if (snap.exists()) {
          const fsData = snap.data() as any;
          if (fsData?.storeLocationData) {
            const fsTimestamp = fsData.timestamp || (fsData.updatedAt ? new Date(fsData.updatedAt).getTime() : 0);
            const r2Timestamp = data?.timestamp || 0;
            if (fsTimestamp > r2Timestamp || !data) {
              data = {
                ...(data || {}),
                ...fsData,
                storeLocationData: {
                  ...(data?.storeLocationData || {}),
                  ...fsData.storeLocationData,
                }
              };
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (fsErr) {
        console.warn('Could not check Firestore backup:', fsErr);
      }

      if (!data) {
        throw new Error(downloadRes.error || 'Không tìm thấy file cấu hình trên Cloud (mapping_config.json). Vui lòng kiểm tra lại Bucket hoặc xuất bản vẽ trước.');
      }
      
      // Resolve R2 URLs in storeLocationData if it exists (New Format)
      if (data.storeLocationData) {
        const resolvePromises: Promise<void>[] = [];
        
        for (const pKey in data.storeLocationData) {
          const partition = data.storeLocationData[pKey];
          if (!partition.mapVersions) continue;
          
          for (const v of partition.mapVersions) {
            const imgKey = extractR2Key(v.backgroundUrl);
            if (imgKey) {
              const imgCommand = new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: bucketName, Key: imgKey });
              resolvePromises.push(
                getSignedUrl(s3, imgCommand, { expiresIn: 3600 * 24 * 7 }).then(url => {
                  v.backgroundUrl = url;
                }).catch(err => {
                  console.warn('Could not resolve signed URL for', imgKey, err);
                })
              );
            }
          }
        }

        // Also resolve signed URLs for legacy data.versions array and data.version at root
        if (Array.isArray(data.versions)) {
          for (const v of data.versions) {
            const imgKey = extractR2Key(v.backgroundUrl);
            if (imgKey) {
              const imgCommand = new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: bucketName, Key: imgKey });
              resolvePromises.push(
                getSignedUrl(s3, imgCommand, { expiresIn: 3600 * 24 * 7 }).then(url => {
                  v.backgroundUrl = url;
                }).catch(err => {
                  console.warn('Could not resolve signed URL for', imgKey, err);
                })
              );
            }
          }
        }
        if (data.version) {
          const imgKey = extractR2Key(data.version.backgroundUrl);
          if (imgKey) {
            const imgCommand = new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: bucketName, Key: imgKey });
            resolvePromises.push(
              getSignedUrl(s3, imgCommand, { expiresIn: 3600 * 24 * 7 }).then(url => {
                data.version.backgroundUrl = url;
              }).catch(err => {
                console.warn('Could not resolve signed URL for', imgKey, err);
              })
            );
          }
        }

        await Promise.all(resolvePromises);
        setConfig(data);
        try {
          useDataStore.getState().setLoadedCloudData(data);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Could not sync loaded cloud data to store', e);
        }

        // Background Pre-cache all floor maps into IndexedDB for 0ms floor switching
        try {
          const bgUrlsToPreload: string[] = [];
          if (data?.storeLocationData) {
            Object.values(data.storeLocationData).forEach((part: any) => {
              if (Array.isArray(part?.mapVersions)) {
                part.mapVersions.forEach((v: any) => {
                  if (v?.backgroundUrl && !v.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
                    bgUrlsToPreload.push(v.backgroundUrl);
                  }
                });
              }
            });
          }
          if (Array.isArray(data?.versions)) {
            data.versions.forEach((v: any) => {
              if (v?.backgroundUrl && !v.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
                bgUrlsToPreload.push(v.backgroundUrl);
              }
            });
          }
          if (bgUrlsToPreload.length > 0) {
            preloadFloorImages(bgUrlsToPreload);
          }
        } catch (_preloadErr) {}
      } else if (data.versions && data.versions.length > 0) {
        // Legacy format fallback
        const activeVersion = data.versions.find((v: any) => v.isDynamicActive) || data.versions[0];
        const imgKey = extractR2Key(activeVersion?.backgroundUrl);
        if (activeVersion && imgKey) {
          const imgCommand = new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: bucketName, Key: imgKey });
          activeVersion.backgroundUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, imgCommand, { expiresIn: 3600 * 24 * 7 });
        }
        
        setConfig({
          ...data,
          version: activeVersion,
          units: data.mapUnits || data.units || []
        });
        try {
          useDataStore.getState().setLoadedCloudData(data);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Could not sync loaded cloud data to store', e);
        }
      } else {
        setConfig(data);
        try {
          useDataStore.getState().setLoadedCloudData(data);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Could not sync loaded cloud data to store', e);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Lỗi tải dữ liệu');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [r2Config, initFormFromStorage]);

  const handleSaveR2Config = useCallback(async () => {
    const acc = cfgAccountId.trim();
    const bkt = cfgBucketName.trim();
    const key = cfgAccessKey.trim();
    const sec = cfgSecretKey.trim();

    if (!acc || !bkt || !key || !sec) {
      alert('Vui lòng điền đủ 4 trường: Account ID, Bucket Name, Access Key và Secret Key.');
      return;
    }

    localStorage.setItem('r2_account_id', acc);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_bucket_name', bkt);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_access_key', key);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_access_key_id', key);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_secret_key', sec);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_secret_access_key', sec);

    // Save to global config
    const configData = {
      accountId: acc,
      bucketName: bkt,
      accessKeyId: key,
      secretAccessKey: sec
    };
    setR2Config(configData);

    try {
      await setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "r2_credentials"), configData);
      await setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "versions"), { 
        r2Version: Date.now(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      }, { merge: true });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Lỗi khi lưu cấu hình R2 lên server:", e);
    }

    setShowConfigModal(false);
    loadConfig();
  }, [cfgAccountId, cfgBucketName, cfgAccessKey, cfgSecretKey, setR2Config, loadConfig]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadConfig();

    const handleSyncUpdate = () => {
      loadConfig();
    };

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.addEventListener('taka_cloud_sync_updated', handleSyncUpdate);
    }

    let lastVersion = -1;
    // Realtime snapshot listener on taka_config/versions (version-guarded to eliminate duplicate read on mount)
    const unsubSnapshot = onSnapshot(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "versions"), (snap) => {
      if (snap.exists()) {
        const remoteVersion = (snap.data() as any)?.pictureMappingVersion ?? 0;
        if (lastVersion !== -1 && remoteVersion !== lastVersion) {
          loadConfig();
        }
        lastVersion = remoteVersion;
      }
    });

    return () => {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.removeEventListener('taka_cloud_sync_updated', handleSyncUpdate);
      }
      unsubSnapshot();
    };
  }, [loadConfig]);

  return {
    config,
    setConfig,
    loading,
    setLoading,
    error,
    setError,
    showConfigModal,
    setShowConfigModal,
    cfgAccountId,
    setCfgAccountId,
    cfgBucketName,
    setCfgBucketName,
    cfgAccessKey,
    setCfgAccessKey,
    cfgSecretKey,
    setCfgSecretKey,
    initFormFromStorage,
    loadConfig,
    handleSaveR2Config,
  };
}

export default useLiveLayoutR2Config;

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import Konva from 'konva';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { RefreshCw, Layers } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLiveLayoutR2Config } from './LiveLayoutParts/useLiveLayoutR2Config';
import { LiveLayoutViewerProps } from './LayoutTabParts/layoutViewerTypes';
import { LiveCanvas } from './LayoutTabParts/LiveCanvas';
import { AppRole } from '../types';

// Performance tuning for older iOS WebKit & high-fps dragging
Konva.hitOnDragEnabled = false;
Konva.dragDistance = 3;
Konva.dragButtons = [0];

export const LiveLayoutViewer = React.memo(function LiveLayoutViewer({
  storeFilter,
  locationFilter,
  yearFilter,
  targetUnitSearch,
  onUnitSelected,
  onClearFocus,
}: LiveLayoutViewerProps) {
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const isAdmin = currentUser ? currentUser.role === 'admin' : false;
  const role = (
    currentUser?.role === 'admin'
      ? 'admin'
      : (currentUser?.role as string)?.toUpperCase() === 'CP'
      ? 'CP'
      : (currentUser?.role as string)?.toLowerCase() === 'manager'
      ? 'Manager'
      : (currentUser?.role as string)?.toLowerCase() === 'staff'
      ? 'Staff'
      : (currentUser?.role as string)?.toLowerCase() === 'external'
      ? 'External'
      : currentUser?.role || 'viewer'
  ) as AppRole;
  const isArchiveYear = globalYearFilter !== 'all' && Number(globalYearFilter) < new Date().getFullYear();
  const canWrite = (isAdmin || !!permissionMatrix[role]?.Write?.layout || !!permissionMatrix[role]?.Write?.pictureMapping) && !isArchiveYear;

  const {
    config,
    loading,
    error,
    setShowConfigModal,
    initFormFromStorage,
    loadConfig,
  } = useLiveLayoutR2Config();

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
        <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mb-2" />
        <p className="text-sm font-medium">Đang tải cấu hình Bản đồ Chuyên đề (Thematic Map)...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !config) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 p-4">
        <Layers className="w-10 h-10 mb-2 opacity-50" />
        <p className="text-sm font-medium px-4 text-center max-w-md">{error}</p>
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <button 
            onClick={() => loadConfig()} 
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Thử lại
          </button>
          <button 
            onClick={() => { initFormFromStorage(); setShowConfigModal(true); }} 
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition"
          >
            Cấu hình R2 Manual
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <LiveCanvas 
      config={config} 
      storeFilter={storeFilter} 
      locationFilter={locationFilter} 
      yearFilter={yearFilter}
      targetUnitSearch={targetUnitSearch}
      onUnitSelected={onUnitSelected}
      onClearFocus={onClearFocus}
      onRefreshConfig={loadConfig} 
      onOpenR2Config={() => { initFormFromStorage(); setShowConfigModal(true); }} 
      canWrite={canWrite}
    />
  );
});

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { X, GripHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';

interface LoginModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onLogin: (user: AppUser) => void;
}

export function LoginModal({ isOpen, onClose, onLogin}: LoginModalProps) {

  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const theme = useAppStore(state => state.theme);
  const appUsers = useAppStore(state => state.appUsers);
  const subAppUsers = useAppStore(state => state.subAppUsers);
  const parties = useAppStore(state => state.parties);

  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const nodeRef = React.useRef(null);
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    
    const trimmedUsername = username.trim();
    const trimmedPassword = password.trim();

    const hashArray = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(trimmedPassword));
    const hashedPassword = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashArray)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');

    const found = appUsers.find(u => 
      String(u.username || '').toLowerCase() === trimmedUsername.toLowerCase() && 
      (String(u.password) === trimmedPassword || String(u.password) === hashedPassword)
    );
    if (found) {
      onLogin(found);
    } else if (trimmedUsername.toLowerCase() === 'admin' && trimmedPassword === 'admin') {
      // Auto-provision admin for Dev environment
      const newAdmin: AppUser = {
        id: 'admin_auto',
        username: 'admin',
        password: hashedPassword,
        role: 'admin',
        canSee: true,
        canWrite: true
      };
      try {
        const { doc, setDoc } = await import('firebase/firestore');
        const { db, APP_ID } = await import('../lib/firebase');
        setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', newAdmin.id), newAdmin);
        
        // Cập nhật local store để không phải load lại
        useAppStore.getState().setAppUsers([...appUsers, newAdmin]);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: 'System', message: 'Auto-created Admin account successfully (Dev Mode).' });
        
        onLogin(newAdmin);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to auto-provision admin:', err);
        setError('Incorrect username or password.');
      }
    } else {
      setError('Incorrect username or password.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] bg-slate-900/40 flex items-end md:items-center justify-center p-0 md:p-4 overflow-y-auto" style={{ WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch' }}>
      <Draggable disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} handle=".modal-handle" bounds="parent" nodeRef={nodeRef} cancel="button">
        <div ref={nodeRef} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-t-2xl md:rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md p-6 md:p-8 relative pb-[calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom)+1.5rem)] md:pb-8 my-auto border dark:border-[#333336]">
          <div className="modal-handle cursor-move absolute top-0 left-0 right-12 h-12"></div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-[#e3e3e3] p-2 z-10">
          <X className="w-6 h-6" />
        </button>
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-white dark:bg-[#111111] rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm mx-auto mb-4 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
            <svg className="w-12 h-12 text-red-600 dark:text-red-500" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="currentColor">
              <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="45" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="8"/>
              <text x="50" y="65" fontFamily="Arial" fontSize="50" textAnchor="middle" fill="currentColor" fontWeight="bold">高</text>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">System Login</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] text-sm mt-2">Enter credentials to manage Cloud Data</p>
        </div>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase mb-1">Username</label>
            <input 
              type="text" 
              autoCapitalize="none"
              autoCorrect="off"
              autoComplete="username"
              value={username}
              onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
              required 
              className="w-full p-4 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none text-base md:text-sm bg-white dark:bg-[#111111] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]" 
              placeholder="admin / Dep1..."
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase mb-1">Password</label>
            <input 
              type="password" 
              autoComplete="current-password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required 
              className="w-full p-4 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none text-base md:text-sm bg-white dark:bg-[#111111] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]" 
              placeholder="••••••"
            />
          </div>
          {error && <div className="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400 text-xs text-center font-medium">{error}</div>}
          <button title="Log In to Cloud" type="submit" className="w-full bg-slate-900 dark:bg-blue-600 text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm shadow-lg transition-all active:scale-95">
