=== FILE: src/components/MultiCheckboxSelect.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { ChevronDown, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';

export interface MultiCheckboxSelectProps {
  options: string[];
  value: string[];
  onChange: (value: string[]) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function MultiCheckboxSelect({
  options, value, onChange, placeholder = 'Select...', className}: MultiCheckboxSelectProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const toggleOption = (opt: string) => {
    if (value.includes(opt)) {
      onChange(value.filter((v) => v !== opt));
    } else {
      onChange([...value, opt]);
    }
  };

  const displayValue = value.length === 0 
    ? placeholder 
    : value.length === 1 
      ? value[0] 
      : `${value.length} selected`;

  const allOptions = Array.from(new Set([...options, ...value])).sort();

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className={cn("relative", className)}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/80 text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-xs rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 outline-none shadow-xs font-medium cursor-pointer h-8"
      >
        <span className="truncate">{displayValue}</span>
        <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-60 shrink-0" />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg shadow-xl z-[9999] p-1">
          {allOptions.map((opt) => (
            <div
              key={opt}
              onClick={() => toggleOption(opt)}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]"
            >
              <div className={cn(
                "w-4 h-4 border rounded flex items-center justify-center transition-colors shrink-0",
                value.includes(opt) 
                  ? "bg-blue-500 border-blue-500 text-white" 
                  : "border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555557]"
              )}>
                {value.includes(opt) && <Check className="w-3 h-3" />}
              </div>
              <span className="truncate">{opt}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


=== FILE: src/components/MultiSelect.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';

export interface MultiSelectProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  options: string[];
  placeholder?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export function MultiSelect({ value, onChange, options, placeholder = 'Select...', disabled, className}: MultiSelectProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [focusedIndex, setFocusedIndex] = useState(-1);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const selectedItems = value && typeof value === 'string' ? value.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];

  const handleSelectItem = (item: string) => {
    if (!selectedItems.includes(item)) {
      const newItems = [...selectedItems, item];
      onChange(newItems.join(', '));
    }
    setInputValue('');
    setIsOpen(false);
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  };

  const handleRemoveItem = (itemToRemove: string) => {
    if (disabled) return;
    const newItems = selectedItems.filter(item => item !== itemToRemove);
    onChange(newItems.join(', '));
  };

  const safeOptions = Array.isArray(options) ? options : [];
  const filteredOptions = safeOptions.filter(
    (opt) =>
      typeof opt === 'string' &&
      opt.toLowerCase().includes(inputValue.toLowerCase()) &&
      !selectedItems.includes(opt)
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (disabled) return;
    if (e.key === 'Backspace' && inputValue === '' && selectedItems.length > 0) {
      handleRemoveItem(selectedItems[selectedItems.length - 1]);
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (isOpen && focusedIndex >= 0 && focusedIndex < filteredOptions.length) {
        handleSelectItem(filteredOptions[focusedIndex]);
      } else if (inputValue.trim() !== '') {
        const match = safeOptions.find((opt) => typeof opt === 'string' && opt.toLowerCase() === inputValue.trim().toLowerCase());
        if (match) {
          handleSelectItem(match);
        } else {
          // If custom values are allowed we could add it, but requirement says to pick from options
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: String("Invalid party. Please select from the dropdown options.") });
        }
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!isOpen) {
        setIsOpen(true);
      }
      setFocusedIndex(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, filteredOptions.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setFocusedIndex(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className={cn("relative w-full", className)}>
      <div 
        className={cn(
          "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 p-1.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-blue-500 transition-shadow transition-colors",
          disabled && "bg-slate-50 opacity-100 cursor-not-allowed" // Ensure visually grayed out on disabled
        )}
        onClick={() => {
          if (!disabled) {
            inputRef.current?.focus();
            setIsOpen(true);
          }
        }}
      >
        {selectedItems.map((item) => (
          <span 
            key={item} 
            className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium"
          >
            {item}
            {!disabled && (
              <button 
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handleRemoveItem(item);
                }}
                className="hover:text-red-500 focus:outline-none"
              >
                <X className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            )}
          </span>
        ))}
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="text"
          value={inputValue}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setInputValue(e.target.value);
            setIsOpen(true);
            setFocusedIndex(-1);
          }}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          onFocus={() => setIsOpen(true)}
          disabled={disabled}
          placeholder={selectedItems.length === 0 ? placeholder : ''}
          className="flex-1 min-w-[60px] bg-transparent outline-none text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] disabled:cursor-not-allowed p-0.5"
        />
        {inputValue && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setInputValue("");
              inputRef.current?.focus();
            }}
            className="hover:text-slate-700 text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-300 focus:outline-none p-1"
          >
            <X className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {isOpen && filteredOptions.length > 0 && !disabled && (
        <div className="absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg shadow-xl z-[9999]">
          {filteredOptions.map((opt, index) => (
            <div
              key={opt}
              onClick={() => handleSelectItem(opt)}
              className={cn(
                "px-3 py-2 text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]",
                focusedIndex === index && "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#333336]"
              )}
            >
              {opt}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


=== FILE: src/components/Navigation.tsx ===
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  TabId,
  AppUser,
  PermissionMatrix,
  AppRole,
  PermissionModule,
} from "../types";
import { cn } from "../lib/utils";
import {
  Calendar,
  LayoutDashboard,
  List,
  PieChart,
  DollarSign,
  Shield,
  Bell,
  Settings,
  HelpCircle,
  BarChartHorizontal,
  FileText,
  Menu,
  X,
  ChevronDown,
  Image,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { RibbonDisplayMenu } from "./RibbonDisplayMenu";

interface NavigationProps {
  activeTab: TabId;
  onTabChange: (tab: TabId) => void;
}

type ParentTabId = "Report" | "Index" | "Financial" | "Delegation" | "Help";

const parentTabs: { id: ParentTabId; label: string }[] = [
  { id: "Report", label: "Report" },
  { id: "Index", label: "Index" },
  { id: "Financial", label: "Financial" },
  { id: "Delegation", label: "Delegation" },
  { id: "Help", label: "Help" },
];

const childTabMap: Record<ParentTabId, TabId[]> = {
  Report: ["calendar", "layout", "summary"],
  Index: ["general", "gantt", "detail"],
  Financial: ["budget", "cost"],
  Delegation: ["taskDelegationCalendar", "taskDelegation"],
  Help: ["manual", "csv_export", "picture_mapping"],
};

export function Navigation({
  activeTab, onTabChange}: NavigationProps) {

  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const theme = useAppStore(state => state.theme);
  const appUsers = useAppStore(state => state.appUsers);
  const subAppUsers = useAppStore(state => state.subAppUsers);
  const parties = useAppStore(state => state.parties);

  const isAdmin = currentUser.role === "admin";
  const role = (
    currentUser.role === "admin"
      ? "admin"
      : (currentUser.role as string)?.toUpperCase() === "CP"
      ? "CP"
      : (currentUser.role as string)?.toLowerCase() === "manager"
      ? "Manager"
      : (currentUser.role as string)?.toLowerCase() === "staff"
      ? "Staff"
      : (currentUser.role as string)?.toLowerCase() === "external"
      ? "External"
      : currentUser.role
  ) as AppRole;
  const perms = permissionMatrix[role]?.See;
  const writePerms = permissionMatrix[role]?.Write;
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const canSeeModule = (module: PermissionModule) => {
    if (module === 'taskDelegation') return isAdmin || !!perms?.[module];
    return isAdmin || !!perms?.[module] || !!writePerms?.[module];
  };

  const activeParentTab =
    (Object.keys(childTabMap) as ParentTabId[]).find((p) =>
      childTabMap[p].includes(activeTab),
    ) || "Report";
  const [expandedParent, setExpandedParent] = useState<ParentTabId | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [isMobileMenuOpen, setIsMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const mobileNavRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMobileMenuOpen && !expandedParent) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (isMobileMenuOpen) setIsMobileMenuOpen(false);
        if (expandedParent) setExpandedParent(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isMobileMenuOpen, expandedParent]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) => {
      if (
        mobileNavRef.current &&
        !mobileNavRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)
      ) {
        setExpandedParent(null);
      }
    };

    if (expandedParent) {
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
      document.addEventListener("touchstart", handleClickOutside);
    }

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener("touchstart", handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [expandedParent]);

  const tabs: {
    id: TabId;
    label: string;
    icon: React.ElementType;
    hidden?: boolean;
  }[] = [
    // Report
    {
      id: "calendar",
      label: t("Calendar"),
      icon: Calendar,
      hidden: !(canSeeModule("calendar") || canSeeModule("report")),
    },
    {
      id: "layout",
      label: "Layout",
      icon: LayoutDashboard,
      hidden: !canSeeModule("layout"),
    },
    {
      id: "summary",
      label: t("Summary"),
      icon: FileText,
      hidden: !(canSeeModule("summary") || canSeeModule("report")),
    },
    // Index
    {
      id: "general",
      label: t("General"),
      icon: LayoutDashboard,
      hidden: !canSeeModule("general"),
    },
    {
      id: "gantt",
      label: t("Gantt"),
      icon: BarChartHorizontal,
      hidden: !canSeeModule("report"),
    },
    {
      id: "detail",
      label: t("Task detail"),
      icon: List,
      hidden: !canSeeModule("detail"),
    },
    // Financial
    {
      id: "budget",
      label: t("Budget"),
      icon: PieChart,
      hidden: !canSeeModule("budget"),
    },
    {
      id: "cost",
      label: t("Cost"),
      icon: DollarSign,
      hidden: !canSeeModule("costDetail"),
    },
    // Delegation
    {
      id: "taskDelegationCalendar",
      label: t("Del. Calendar"),
      icon: Calendar,
      hidden: !canSeeModule("taskDelegation"),
    },
    {
      id: "taskDelegation",
      label: t("Delegation"),
      icon: List,
      hidden: !canSeeModule("taskDelegation"),
    },
    // Help
    { id: "manual", label: t("Manual"), icon: HelpCircle, hidden: false },
    { id: "csv_export", label: t("Import csv"), icon: FileText, hidden: !canSeeModule("importCsv") },
    { id: "picture_mapping", label: t("Picture mapping"), icon: Image, hidden: !canSeeModule("pictureMapping") },
    // Auxiliary hidden tabs
    { id: "accControl", label: t("Access"), icon: Shield, hidden: true },
    { id: "notification", label: t("Notifs"), icon: Bell, hidden: true },
    { id: "setting", label: t("Settings"), icon: Settings, hidden: true },
  ];

  const visibleParentTabs = parentTabs.filter((pt) => {
    return childTabMap[pt.id as ParentTabId].some((childId) => {
      const tab = tabs.find((t) => t.id === childId);
      return tab && !tab.hidden;
    });
  });

  const [hoveredParentTab, setHoveredParentTab] = useState<ParentTabId | null>(null);
  const hoverTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const handleMouseEnterParent = (parentId: ParentTabId) => {
    if (hoverTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(hoverTimeoutRef.current);
      hoverTimeoutRef.current = null;
    }
    setHoveredParentTab(parentId);
  };

  const handleMouseLeaveParent = () => {
    if (hoverTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(hoverTimeoutRef.current);
    hoverTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setHoveredParentTab(null);
    }, 180);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (hoverTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(hoverTimeoutRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleParentTabClick = (parentId: ParentTabId) => {
    const firstVisibleChild = childTabMap[parentId].find((childId) => {
      const tab = tabs.find((t) => t.id === childId);
      return tab && !tab.hidden;
    });
    if (firstVisibleChild) {
      onTabChange(firstVisibleChild);
    }
    setHoveredParentTab(null);
  };

  const activeTabObj = tabs.find((t) => t.id === activeTab);
  const activeChildLabel = activeTabObj ? activeTabObj.label : activeTab;
  const ActiveTabIcon = activeTabObj?.icon;

  return (
    <>
      {/* Desktop Navigation (Hidden on mobile) */}
      <div className="hidden lg:block border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] mb-3 shrink-0 sticky top-[48px] z-40 bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/95 pt-1.5 pb-2 transition-colors">
        <nav className="flex items-center gap-2.5 relative flex-wrap" aria-label="Parent Tabs">
          {visibleParentTabs.map((pt) => {
            const parentChildTabs = childTabMap[pt.id as ParentTabId]
              .map((childId) => tabs.find((t) => t.id === childId))
              .filter((t): t is (typeof tabs)[0] => !!t && !t.hidden);
            const isHovered = hoveredParentTab === pt.id;
            const isCurrentActiveParent = activeParentTab === pt.id;

            return (
              <div
                key={pt.id}
                className="relative"
                onMouseEnter={() => handleMouseEnterParent(pt.id as ParentTabId)}
                onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeaveParent}
              >
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleParentTabClick(pt.id as ParentTabId)}
                  className={cn(
                    "px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 select-none",
                    isCurrentActiveParent
                      ? "bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-200 text-white dark:text-slate-900 shadow-sm"
                      : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]",
                  )}
                >
                  <span>
                    {t(pt.id)}
                  </span>
                  <ChevronDown
                    className={cn(
                      "w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200 opacity-60",
                      isHovered ? "rotate-180 opacity-100" : ""
                    )}
                  />
                </button>

                {/* Hover Dropdown Menu */}
                {isHovered && parentChildTabs.length > 0 && (
                  <div
                    className="absolute top-full left-0 pt-1.5 z-50 min-w-[210px]"
                    onMouseEnter={() => handleMouseEnterParent(pt.id as ParentTabId)}
                    onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeaveParent}
                  >
                    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1.5 flex flex-col gap-0.5 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 backdrop-blur-sm">
                      <div className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] mb-1">
                        {t(pt.id)}
                      </div>
                      {parentChildTabs.map((childTab) => {
                        const Icon = childTab.icon;
                        const isActive = activeTab === childTab.id;
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={childTab.id}
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              onTabChange(childTab.id);
                              setHoveredParentTab(null);
                            }}
                            className={cn(
                              "flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors text-left w-full group",
                              isActive
                                ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-bold"
                                : "text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a]"
                            )}
                          >
                            <Icon
                              className={cn(
                                "w-4 h-4 shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110",
                                isActive
                                   ? "text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]"
                                  : "text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383]"
                              )}
                            />
                            <span className="truncate">{childTab.label}</span>
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}

          {/* Active Child Tab Indicator Button (Placed right after Help) */}
          {activeTabObj && (
            <div className="flex items-center ml-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onTabChange(activeTab)}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-bold bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white dark:bg-blue-500 dark:hover:bg-blue-600 dark:text-white shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ring-2 ring-blue-400/30 dark:ring-blue-400/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer select-none"
                title={`Đang mở tab: ${activeChildLabel}`}
              >
                {ActiveTabIcon && <ActiveTabIcon className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-white" />}
                <span className="font-extrabold tracking-wide">On {activeChildLabel}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </nav>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Navigation - Hamburger Menu */}
      <div className="lg:hidden">
        {/* Floating Menu Pill - Main Tab Switcher Menu */}
        <div className="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[60] print:hidden">
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(true)}
            className="bg-slate-800/95 dark:bg-slate-200/95 text-white dark:text-slate-900 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full shadow-2xl hover:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-white transition-all flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-sm border border-slate-600/30 dark:border-slate-300 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer pointer-events-auto"
            aria-label="Open Navigation Menu"
          >
            <Menu className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{t("Menu")}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Slide-out Drawer */}
        {isMobileMenuOpen && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex justify-end">
            {/* Overlay */}
            <div
              className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 transition-opacity backdrop-blur-sm"
              onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)}
            />
            {/* Drawer */}
            <div className="relative w-[280px] max-w-[80vw] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] h-full shadow-2xl flex flex-col animate-in slide-in-from-right duration-300 ease-out">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">
                <span className="font-bold text-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3]">Navigation</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                  className="p-2 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded-full transition-colors"
                  aria-label="Close Navigation Menu"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-6">
                {/* Mobile Ribbon Display Section */}
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-[#333336]">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">Ribbon Display</span>
                    <RibbonDisplayMenu variant="navbar" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                {visibleParentTabs.map((pt) => {
                  const childTabs = childTabMap[pt.id as ParentTabId]
                    .map((childId) => tabs.find((t) => t.id === childId))
                    .filter((t): t is (typeof tabs)[0] => !!t && !t.hidden);
                  if (childTabs.length === 0) return null;
                  return (
                    <div key={pt.id}>
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 px-2">
                        {t(pt.id)}
                      </h3>
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        {childTabs.map((tab) => {
                          const Icon = tab.icon;
                          const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={tab.id}
                              onClick={() => {
                                onTabChange(tab.id);
                                setIsMobileMenuOpen(false);
                              }}
                              className={cn(
                                "w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors",
                                isActive
                                  ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:text-[#8ab4f8]"
                                  : "text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]"
                              )}
                            >
                              <Icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                              {tab.label}
                            </button>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

import React, { Dispatch, FC, SetStateAction } from 'react';
import { RotateCcw, Archive, AlertCircle, Clock, Zap, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  NotificationStatusFilter,
  NotificationTypeFilter,
  NotificationStoreFilter,
  NotificationPriorityFilter,
  NotificationAssigneeFilter,
} from './notificationTypes';

interface NotificationFilterToolbarProps {
  filterId?: string | null;
  onClearFilter?: () => void;
  statusFilter: NotificationStatusFilter;
  setStatusFilter: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<NotificationStatusFilter>>;
  typeFilter: NotificationTypeFilter;
  setTypeFilter: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<NotificationTypeFilter>>;
  priorityFilter: NotificationPriorityFilter;
  setPriorityFilter: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<NotificationPriorityFilter>>;
  assigneeFilter: NotificationAssigneeFilter;
  setAssigneeFilter: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<NotificationAssigneeFilter>>;
  storeFilter: NotificationStoreFilter;
  setStoreFilter: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<NotificationStoreFilter>>;
  allowedStores: string[];
  unreadProjectCount: number;
  unreadTaskCount: number;
  unreadDelegationCount: number;
  unreadHcmCount: number;
  unreadHnCount: number;
  unreadCriticalCount: number;
  unreadUrgentCount: number;
  unreadActionCount: number;
  unreadAssignedToMeCount: number;
  snoozedCount?: number;
  onMarkAllRead?: () => void;
  onClearStaleNotifs?: () => void;
}

export const NotificationFilterToolbar: React.FC<NotificationFilterToolbarProps> = ({
  filterId,
  onClearFilter,
  statusFilter,
  setStatusFilter,
  typeFilter,
  setTypeFilter,
  priorityFilter,
  setPriorityFilter,
  assigneeFilter,
  setAssigneeFilter,
  storeFilter,
  setStoreFilter,
  allowedStores,
  unreadProjectCount,
  unreadTaskCount,
  unreadDelegationCount,
  unreadHcmCount,
  unreadHnCount,
  unreadCriticalCount,
  unreadUrgentCount,
  unreadActionCount,
  unreadAssignedToMeCount,
  snoozedCount,
  onMarkAllRead,
  onClearStaleNotifs,

  return (
    <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] flex flex-col gap-3 shrink-0">
      {/* Top Row: Title, Clear Filter, Assignee Switch, Status & Archive */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-3 w-full">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">
            Active Notifications
          </h2>
          {snoozedCount !== undefined && snoozedCount > 0 && (
            <span className="text-[11px] bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
              {snoozedCount} snoozed
            </span>
          )}
          {filterId && onClearFilter && (
            <button
              title="Clear Filter"
              onClick={onClearFilter}
              className="text-xs bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-300 px-2 py-1 rounded flex items-center gap-1 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
            >
              Clear Filter <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Proposal 2: Assignee Role Relevance (Assigned to Me vs All) */}
          <div className="flex bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 shadow-sm">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                if (filterId && onClearFilter) onClearFilter();
                setAssigneeFilter('all');
              }}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation ${
                assigneeFilter === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]'
                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]'
              }`}
            >
              All
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                if (filterId && onClearFilter) onClearFilter();
                setAssigneeFilter((prev) => (prev === 'assigned_to_me' ? 'all' : 'assigned_to_me'));
              }}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-colors relative flex items-center gap-1 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation ${
                assigneeFilter === 'assigned_to_me'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300'
                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]'
              }`}
            >
              <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>My Tasks</span>
              {unreadAssignedToMeCount > 0 && (
                <span className="bg-emerald-600 text-white text-[9px] font-extrabold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full min-w-[15px] text-center ml-0.5">
                  {unreadAssignedToMeCount > 99 ? '99+' : unreadAssignedToMeCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Status filters */}
          <div className="flex bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 shadow-sm">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                if (filterId && onClearFilter) onClearFilter();
                setStatusFilter((prev) => (!filterId && prev === 'unread' ? 'all' : 'unread'));
              }}

              }`}

                setStatusFilter((prev) => (!filterId && prev === 'read' ? 'all' : 'read'));

                statusFilter === 'read'
                  ? 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]'
                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]'

        {/* Proposal 1: Priority Tier Chips */}
        <div className="flex bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 shadow-sm items-center">
          <button
            onClick={() => setPriorityFilter('all')}
            className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-md transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation ${
              priorityFilter === 'all'
                ? 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]'
                : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]'
            }`}
          >
            All Priorities
          </button>
          <button

            className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation ${

interface NotificationItemCardProps {
  notif: ActiveNotification;
  isRead: boolean;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];

  onNotificationClick: (notif: ActiveNotification) => void;
  onToggleRead: (id: string) => void;
  onActionAgree?: (notif: ActiveNotification) => void;
  onActionReject?: (notif: ActiveNotification) => void;
  onQuickCompleteTask?: (notif: ActiveNotification) => Promise<void> | void;
  onSnoozeNotif?: (notifId: string, hours: number) => void;
}

export const NotificationItemCard: React.FC<NotificationItemCardProps> = React.memo(
  ({
    notif,
    isRead,
    tasks,
    projects,
    delegationGroups,
    onNotificationClick,
    onToggleRead,
    onActionAgree,
    onActionReject,
    onQuickCompleteTask,

      notif.projectStore ||
      (notif.targetType === 'task'
        ? tasks.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(notif.targetId))?.projectStore
        : '') ||
      (notif.targetType === 'project'
        ? projects.find(
            (p) =>
              (notif.targetId &&
                (String(p.id) === String(notif.targetId) ||
                  String(p.no) === String(notif.targetId))) ||
              (notif.projectCode && p.code === notif.projectCode)
          )?.store
        : '') ||
      (notif.targetType === 'task_delegation'
        ? delegationGroups.find((g) => g.id === notif.targetId)?.projectStore
        : '') ||
      ''
    ).trim();

    const isHn = notifStore.toUpperCase() === 'HN';
    const isHcm = notifStore.toUpperCase() === 'HCM';

    const isUrgent = notif.priority === 'urgent';
    const isActionReq = notif.priority === 'action_required';

    const priorityBorderClass = isCritical
      ? 'border-l-4 border-l-rose-500'

      ? 'border-l-4 border-l-amber-500'
      : isActionReq
      ? 'border-l-4 border-l-indigo-500'
      : 'border-l-4 border-l-blue-400';

    return (
      <div
        onClick={() => onNotificationClick(notif)}
        className={`bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-start gap-3.5 transition-all cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg ${priorityBorderClass} ${
          isRead
            ? 'border-slate-100 opacity-60 dark:border-slate-800'
            : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-md'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          <div
            className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border ${
              isCritical
                ? 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/50 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400'
                : isUrgent
                ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/50 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'
                : isActionReq

                : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900/50 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]'

            ) : (
              <Bell className="w-5 h-5" />

                  : isHcm

                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700'

                  <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Critical
                </span>
              )}
              {isUrgent && (

                  {notif.count} tasks
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
          {notif.subtitle &&

              const parts = notif.subtitle.split(' - ');
              const textColor = isRead

export type NotificationStatusFilter = 'read' | 'unread' | 'all';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { getUserAllowedStores } from '../../lib/utils';
import { ActiveNotification } from '../../types';
import {
  NotificationStatusFilter,
  NotificationTypeFilter,
  NotificationStoreFilter,
  NotificationPriorityFilter,
  NotificationAssigneeFilter,
} from './notificationTypes';
import { safeGetItemLocal } from '../../lib/storage';

interface UseNotificationDataProps {
  activeNotifications: ActiveNotification[];
  readNotifs: string[];
  filterId?: string | null;
  initialStatusFilter?: NotificationStatusFilter;
}

export function useNotificationData({
  activeNotifications,
  readNotifs,
  filterId,
  initialStatusFilter = 'unread',
}: UseNotificationDataProps) {
  const {
    enrichedProjects: projects,
    filteredTasks: tasks,
    visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups,
  } = useEnrichedData();

  const currentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.currentUser)!;
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalStoreFilter);

  const allowedStores = useMemo(() => getUserAllowedStores(currentUser), [currentUser]);

  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<NotificationStatusFilter>(initialStatusFilter);
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<NotificationTypeFilter>('all');
  const [priorityFilter, setPriorityFilter] = useState<NotificationPriorityFilter>('all');
  const [assigneeFilter, setAssigneeFilter] = useState<NotificationAssigneeFilter>('all');
  const [snoozedMap, setSnoozedMap] = useState<Record<string, number>>(() => {
    try {
      const raw = safeGetItemLocal('taka_snoozed_notifs');
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  });

  // Listen to external snooze changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleSnoozeChange = () => {
      try {
        const raw = safeGetItemLocal('taka_snoozed_notifs');
        setSnoozedMap(raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {});
      } catch {
        setSnoozedMap({});
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('taka_snoozed_notifs_changed', handleSnoozeChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('taka_snoozed_notifs_changed', handleSnoozeChange);
    };
  }, []);

  const [storeFilter, setStoreFilter] = useState<NotificationStoreFilter>(() => {
    const allowed = getUserAllowedStores(currentUser);
    if (globalStoreFilter === 'HCM' || globalStoreFilter === 'HN') {
      if (allowed.includes(globalStoreFilter)) return globalStoreFilter;
    }
    if (allowed.length === 1) return allowed[0] as 'HCM' | 'HN';
    return 'all';
  });

  // Keep store filter in sync if user changes global store selector
  useEffect(() => {
    if (globalStoreFilter === 'HCM' || globalStoreFilter === 'HN') {
      if (allowedStores.includes(globalStoreFilter)) {
        setStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter);
      }
    }
  }, [globalStoreFilter, allowedStores]);

  const unreadProjectCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      activeNotifications.filter(
        (n) => n.targetType === 'project' && !readNotifs.includes(n.id)
      ).length,
    [activeNotifications, readNotifs]
  );

  const unreadTaskCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      activeNotifications.filter(
        (n) => n.targetType === 'task' && !readNotifs.includes(n.id)
      ).length,
    [activeNotifications, readNotifs]
  );

  const unreadDelegationCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      activeNotifications.filter(
        (n) => n.targetType === 'task_delegation' && !readNotifs.includes(n.id)
      ).length,
    [activeNotifications, readNotifs]
  );

  const unreadHcmCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      activeNotifications.filter((n) => {
        if (readNotifs.includes(n.id)) return false;
        const s = (
          n.projectStore ||
          (n.targetType === 'task'
            ? tasks.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(n.targetId))?.projectStore
            : '') ||
          (n.targetType === 'project'
            ? projects.find(
                (p) =>
                  (n.targetId &&
                    (String(p.id) === String(n.targetId) ||
                      String(p.no) === String(n.targetId))) ||
                  (n.projectCode && p.code === n.projectCode)
              )?.store
            : '') ||
          (n.targetType === 'task_delegation'
            ? delegationGroups.find((g) => g.id === n.targetId)?.projectStore
            : '') ||
          ''
        )
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase();
        return s === 'HCM';
      }).length,
    [activeNotifications, readNotifs, tasks, projects, delegationGroups]
  );

  const unreadHnCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      activeNotifications.filter((n) => {
        if (readNotifs.includes(n.id)) return false;
        const s = (
          n.projectStore ||
          (n.targetType === 'task'
            ? tasks.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(n.targetId))?.projectStore
            : '') ||
          (n.targetType === 'project'
            ? projects.find(
                (p) =>
                  (n.targetId &&
                    (String(p.id) === String(n.targetId) ||
                      String(p.no) === String(n.targetId))) ||
                  (n.projectCode && p.code === n.projectCode)
              )?.store
            : '') ||
          (n.targetType === 'task_delegation'
            ? delegationGroups.find((g) => g.id === n.targetId)?.projectStore
            : '') ||
          ''
        )
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase();
        return s === 'HN';
      }).length,
    [activeNotifications, readNotifs, tasks, projects, delegationGroups]
  );

  const unreadCriticalCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      activeNotifications.filter(
        (n) => n.priority === 'critical' && !readNotifs.includes(n.id)
      ).length,
    [activeNotifications, readNotifs]
  );

  const unreadUrgentCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      activeNotifications.filter(
        (n) => n.priority === 'urgent' && !readNotifs.includes(n.id)
      ).length,
    [activeNotifications, readNotifs]
  );

  const unreadActionCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      activeNotifications.filter(
        (n) => n.priority === 'action_required' && !readNotifs.includes(n.id)
      ).length,
    [activeNotifications, readNotifs]
  );

  const unreadAssignedToMeCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      activeNotifications.filter(
        (n) => n.isAssignedToMe && !readNotifs.includes(n.id)
      ).length,
    [activeNotifications, readNotifs]
  );

  const snoozedCount = useMemo(() => {
    const now = Date.now();
    return Object.values(snoozedMap).filter((ts) => ts > now).length;
  }, [snoozedMap]);

  const filteredNotifications = useMemo(() => {
    let result = activeNotifications;
    if (filterId) {
      result = activeNotifications.filter((notif) => notif.id === filterId);
    } else {
      const now = Date.now();
      result = activeNotifications.filter((notif) => {
        // Skip snoozed notifications
        const snoozedUntil = snoozedMap[notif.id];
        if (snoozedUntil && snoozedUntil > now) {
          return false;
        }

        const isRead = readNotifs.includes(notif.id);

        if (statusFilter === 'read' && !isRead) return false;
        if (statusFilter === 'unread' && isRead) return false;

        if (typeFilter !== 'all' && notif.targetType !== typeFilter) return false;

        if (priorityFilter !== 'all' && notif.priority !== priorityFilter) return false;

        if (assigneeFilter === 'assigned_to_me' && !notif.isAssignedToMe) return false;

        if (storeFilter !== 'all') {
          const nStore = (
            notif.projectStore ||
            (notif.targetType === 'task'
              ? tasks.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(notif.targetId))?.projectStore
              : '') ||
            (notif.targetType === 'project'
              ? projects.find(
                  (p) =>
                    (notif.targetId &&
                      (String(p.id) === String(notif.targetId) ||
                        String(p.no) === String(notif.targetId))) ||
                    (notif.projectCode && p.code === notif.projectCode)
                )?.store
              : '') ||
            (notif.targetType === 'task_delegation'
              ? delegationGroups.find((g) => g.id === notif.targetId)?.projectStore
              : '') ||
            ''
          )
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase();
          if (nStore && nStore !== storeFilter.toUpperCase()) return false;
        }

        return true;
      });
    }

    return result.sort((a, b) => b.generatedAt - a.generatedAt);
  }, [
    activeNotifications,
    readNotifs,
    statusFilter,
    typeFilter,
    priorityFilter,
    assigneeFilter,
    storeFilter,
    filterId,
    snoozedMap,
    tasks,
    projects,
    delegationGroups,
  ]);

  return {
    allowedStores,
    statusFilter,
    setStatusFilter,
    typeFilter,
    setTypeFilter,
    priorityFilter,
    setPriorityFilter,
    assigneeFilter,
    setAssigneeFilter,
    storeFilter,
    setStoreFilter,
    unreadProjectCount,
    unreadTaskCount,
    unreadDelegationCount,
    unreadHcmCount,
    unreadHnCount,
    unreadCriticalCount,
    unreadUrgentCount,
    unreadActionCount,
    unreadAssignedToMeCount,
    snoozedCount,
    filteredNotifications,
    tasks,
    projects,
    delegationGroups,
  };
}

        unreadHcmCount={unreadHcmCount}
        unreadHnCount={unreadHnCount}
        unreadCriticalCount={unreadCriticalCount}
        unreadUrgentCount={unreadUrgentCount}
        unreadActionCount={unreadActionCount}
        unreadAssignedToMeCount={unreadAssignedToMeCount}
        snoozedCount={snoozedCount}
        onMarkAllRead={onMarkAllRead}

      />

        <div className="space-y-3 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
          {filteredNotifications.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-12">

              <p className="text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] font-medium">No active notifications</p>

                onActionReject={onActionReject}

                onSnoozeNotif={onSnoozeNotif}

    </div>
  );
}

          onClick={() => setActiveViewMode('fleet')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-2 ${
            activeViewMode === 'fleet'
              ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#18181b] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shadow-sm border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#3f3f46]'
              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
          Toàn Bộ Thiết Bị (All Devices Fleet)
          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/50 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold">
            Mới
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { UnitShape, MapVersion } from './components/DataMapping/types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

export interface StoreLocationRecord {
  mapUnits: UnitShape[];
  mapVersions: MapVersion[];
  activeMapVersionId: string | null;
}

export interface LoadedCloudDataPayload {
  storeLocationData: Record<string, StoreLocationRecord>;
  store?: 'HCM' | 'HN';
  location?: string;
  mapUnits?: UnitShape[];
  mapVersions?: MapVersion[];
  activeMapVersionId?: string | null;
  reviewSelectedLabels?: string[];
  reviewLabelColors?: Record<string, string>;
  unitInfo?: any[];
  classInfo?: any[];
  actualClassInfo?: any[];
  sales?: any[];
  profits?: any[];
  subFees?: any[];
  mdStatus?: any[];
  projectStatus?: any[];
  projectLink?: any[];
  basePlan?: any[];
  units?: any[];
}

const getPartitionKey = (store: string, location: string) => `${store}_${location}`;

let backupTimeout: any = null;
export function autoBackupStoreLocationData(data: Record<string, StoreLocationRecord>, store: string, location: string, activeMapVersionId?: string | null) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  if (backupTimeout) clearTimeout(backupTimeout);
  backupTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      const payload = JSON.stringify({
        storeLocationData: data,
        store,
        location,
        activeMapVersionId,
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      });
      // Safety guard: Chrome localStorage limit is ~5MB. Cap single backup at 1MB to prevent QuotaExceededError
      if (payload.length < 1000000) {
        localStorage.setItem('taka_mapping_config_backup', payload);
      } else {
        localStorage.removeItem('taka_mapping_config_backup');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      try { localStorage.removeItem('taka_mapping_config_backup'); } catch (_) {}
    }
  }, 1500);
}

interface DataStoreState {

export const useDataStore = create<DataStoreState>((set, get) => ({
  store: 'HCM',
  location: 'L1',
  storeLocationData: {},

  setStore: (newStore) => {
    const current = get();
    if (current.store === newStore) return;
    current.setStoreAndLocation(newStore, current.location);
  },

  setLocation: (newLocation) => {
    const current = get();
    if (current.location === newLocation) return;
    current.setStoreAndLocation(current.store, newLocation);
  },

  setStoreAndLocation: (newStore, newLocation) => {
    if (!newLocation || newLocation.trim() === '' || newLocation.toUpperCase() === 'ALL') {
      return;
    }
    const state = get();
    if (state.store === newStore && state.location === newLocation) {
      return;
    }
    const oldKey = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);
    const newKey = getPartitionKey(newStore, newLocation);

    // Persist current active partition data
    const updatedStoreLocationData = {
      ...state.storeLocationData,
      [oldKey]: {
        mapUnits: state.mapUnits,
        mapVersions: state.mapVersions,
        activeMapVersionId: state.activeMapVersionId,
      },
    };

    // Retrieve target partition data
    const target = updatedStoreLocationData[newKey];
    const newUnits = target?.mapUnits ?? [];
    const newVersions = target?.mapVersions ?? [];
    const newActiveVersionId = target?.activeMapVersionId ?? (newVersions.length > 0 ? newVersions[0].id : null);

    set({
      store: newStore,
      location: newLocation,
      storeLocationData: updatedStoreLocationData,
      mapUnits: newUnits,
      mapVersions: newVersions,
      activeMapVersionId: newActiveVersionId,
    });
    autoBackupStoreLocationData(updatedStoreLocationData, newStore, newLocation, newActiveVersionId);
  },

  setStoreLocationData: (data) => {
    const state = get();
    const currentKey = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);
    const target = data[currentKey];
    set({
      storeLocationData: data,
      ...(target ? {
        mapUnits: target.mapUnits || [],
        mapVersions: target.mapVersions || [],
        activeMapVersionId: target.activeMapVersionId || (target.mapVersions?.[0]?.id ?? null),
      } : {}),
    });
    autoBackupStoreLocationData(data, state.store, state.location, state.activeMapVersionId);
  },

  setLoadedCloudData: (payload: LoadedCloudDataPayload) => {
    const state = get();
    const targetStore = payload.store || state.store;
    const targetLocation = (payload.location || state.location).toUpperCase().trim();
    const pKey = getPartitionKey(targetStore, targetLocation);
    
    const storeLocationData = payload.storeLocationData || state.storeLocationData;
    const target = storeLocationData[pKey];
    
    // Strict priority: use partition data for this exact store & floor first, fallback to root legacy only if partition is empty
    const mapUnits = (target?.mapUnits && Array.isArray(target.mapUnits) && target.mapUnits.length > 0) 
      ? target.mapUnits 
      : (payload.mapUnits || []);
    const mapVersions = (target?.mapVersions && Array.isArray(target.mapVersions) && target.mapVersions.length > 0) 
      ? target.mapVersions 
      : (payload.mapVersions || []);
    const activeMapVersionId = target?.activeMapVersionId || payload.activeMapVersionId || (mapVersions[0]?.id ?? null);

    set({
      store: targetStore,
      location: targetLocation,
      storeLocationData,
      mapUnits,
      mapVersions,
      activeMapVersionId,
      ...(payload.reviewSelectedLabels ? { reviewSelectedLabels: payload.reviewSelectedLabels } : {}),
      ...(payload.reviewLabelColors ? { reviewLabelColors: payload.reviewLabelColors } : {}),
      ...(payload.unitInfo ? { unitInfo: payload.unitInfo } : {}),
      ...(payload.classInfo ? { classInfo: payload.classInfo } : {}),
      ...(payload.actualClassInfo ? { actualClassInfo: payload.actualClassInfo } : {}),
      ...(payload.sales ? { sales: payload.sales } : {}),
      ...(payload.profits ? { profits: payload.profits } : {}),
      ...(payload.subFees ? { subFees: payload.subFees } : {}),
      ...(payload.mdStatus ? { mdStatus: payload.mdStatus } : {}),
      ...(payload.projectStatus ? { projectStatus: payload.projectStatus } : {}),
      ...(payload.projectLink ? { projectLink: payload.projectLink } : {}),
      ...(payload.basePlan ? { basePlan: payload.basePlan } : {}),
      ...(payload.units ? { units: payload.units } : {}),
    });
  },

  getConsolidatedSaveData: () => {
    const state = get();
    const currentKey = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);
    const updatedStoreLocationData = {
      ...state.storeLocationData,
      [currentKey]: {
        mapUnits: state.mapUnits,
        mapVersions: state.mapVersions,
        activeMapVersionId: state.activeMapVersionId,
      },
    };
    return {
      storeLocationData: updatedStoreLocationData,
      store: state.store,
      location: state.location,
      mapUnits: state.mapUnits,
      mapVersions: state.mapVersions,
      activeMapVersionId: state.activeMapVersionId,
      reviewSelectedLabels: state.reviewSelectedLabels,
      reviewLabelColors: state.reviewLabelColors,
      unitInfo: state.unitInfo,
      classInfo: state.classInfo,
      actualClassInfo: state.actualClassInfo,
      sales: state.sales,
      profits: state.profits,
      subFees: state.subFees,
      mdStatus: state.mdStatus,
      projectStatus: state.projectStatus,
      projectLink: state.projectLink,
      basePlan: state.basePlan,
      units: state.units,
    };
  },

  mapUnits: [],
  setMapUnits: (mapUnits) => {
    const state = get();
    const taggedUnits = mapUnits.map(u => ({
      ...u,
      store: u.store || state.store,
      location: u.location || state.location,
    }));
    const key = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);
    const newStoreLocationData = {
      ...state.storeLocationData,
      [key]: {
        ...(state.storeLocationData[key] || { mapVersions: state.mapVersions, activeMapVersionId: state.activeMapVersionId }),
        mapUnits: taggedUnits,
      },
    };
    set({
      mapUnits: taggedUnits,
      storeLocationData: newStoreLocationData,
    });
    autoBackupStoreLocationData(newStoreLocationData, state.store, state.location, state.activeMapVersionId);
  },

  mapVersions: [],
  setMapVersions: (mapVersions) => {
    const state = get();
    const appYear = String(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter && useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter !== 'all' ? useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter : '2026');
    const taggedVersions = mapVersions.map(v => ({
      ...v,
      store: v.store || state.store,
      location: v.location || state.location,
      year: v.year ? String(v.year).trim() : appYear,
    }));
    const key = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);
    const newStoreLocationData = {
      ...state.storeLocationData,
      [key]: {
        ...(state.storeLocationData[key] || { mapUnits: state.mapUnits, activeMapVersionId: state.activeMapVersionId }),
        mapVersions: taggedVersions,
      },
    };
    set({
      mapVersions: taggedVersions,
      storeLocationData: newStoreLocationData,
    });
    autoBackupStoreLocationData(newStoreLocationData, state.store, state.location, state.activeMapVersionId);
  },

  activeMapVersionId: null,
  setActiveMapVersionId: (activeMapVersionId) => {
    const state = get();
    // Identify which partition this version belongs to
    let targetKey = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);
    if (activeMapVersionId) {
      for (const pKey in state.storeLocationData) {
        if (state.storeLocationData[pKey]?.mapVersions?.some(v => v.id === activeMapVersionId)) {
          targetKey = pKey;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    set({
      activeMapVersionId,
      storeLocationData: {
        ...state.storeLocationData,
        [targetKey]: {
          ...(state.storeLocationData[targetKey] || { mapUnits: [], mapVersions: [] }),
          activeMapVersionId,
        },
      },
    });
  },

  reviewSelectedLabels: [],
  setReviewSelectedLabels: (reviewSelectedLabels) => set({ reviewSelectedLabels }),
  reviewLabelColors: {},
  setReviewLabelColors: (reviewLabelColors) => set({ reviewLabelColors }),

  getAllStoreUnits: (targetStore) => {
    const state = get();
    const currentStore = targetStore || state.store;
    const currentKey = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);

    const mergedData = {
      ...state.storeLocationData,
      [currentKey]: {
        ...(state.storeLocationData[currentKey] || {}),
        mapUnits: state.mapUnits,
        mapVersions: state.mapVersions,
        activeMapVersionId: state.activeMapVersionId,
      },
    };

    const allUnits: UnitShape[] = [];
    const seenIds = new Set<string>();

    for (const key in mergedData) {
      if (key.startsWith(`${currentStore}_`)) {
        const partition = mergedData[key];
        const loc = (key.split('_')[1] || state.location).toUpperCase().trim();
        if (partition?.mapUnits) {
          for (const u of partition.mapUnits) {
            const compositeKey = `${key}_${u.id || u.name}`;
            if (!seenIds.has(compositeKey)) {
              seenIds.add(compositeKey);
              allUnits.push({
                ...u,
                store: u.store || currentStore,
                location: (u.location || loc).toUpperCase().trim(),
              });
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return allUnits;
  },

  getAllStoreVersions: (targetStore) => {
    const state = get();
    const currentStore = targetStore || state.store;
    const currentKey = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);

    const mergedData = { ...state.storeLocationData };
    if (!mergedData[currentKey] && state.mapVersions && state.mapVersions.length > 0) {
      mergedData[currentKey] = {
        mapUnits: state.mapUnits || [],
        mapVersions: state.mapVersions || [],
        activeMapVersionId: state.activeMapVersionId,
      };
    }

    const allVersions: MapVersion[] = [];
    const seenIds = new Set<string>();

    for (const key in mergedData) {
      if (key.startsWith(`${currentStore}_`)) {
        const partition = mergedData[key];
        const loc = key.split('_')[1] || state.location || 'L1';
        const appYear = String(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter && useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter !== 'all' ? useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter : '2026');
        if (partition?.mapVersions) {
          for (const v of partition.mapVersions) {
            if (!seenIds.has(v.id)) {
              seenIds.add(v.id);
              const resolvedLoc = (v.location && String(v.location).trim()) 
                ? String(v.location).trim().toUpperCase() 
                : (v.name?.match(/(b\d|l\d|\d+f|gf|ug)/i)?.[1]?.toUpperCase() || loc);
              const resolvedYear = (v.year && String(v.year).trim()) 
                ? String(v.year).trim() 
                : (v.name?.match(/(202\d|203\d)/i)?.[1] || appYear);
              
              allVersions.push({
                ...v,
                store: v.store || currentStore,
                location: resolvedLoc,
                year: resolvedYear,
              });
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return allVersions;
  },

  updateStoreUnitsAcrossLocations: (updatedUnits, targetStore) => {
    const state = get();
    const currentStore = targetStore || state.store;
    const currentKey = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);

    const unitsByPartition: Record<string, UnitShape[]> = {};
    for (const u of updatedUnits) {
      const uStore = u.store || currentStore;
      const uLoc = (u.location && String(u.location).trim()) 
        ? String(u.location).trim().toUpperCase() 
        : (u.name?.match(/(b\d|l\d|\d+f|gf|ug)/i)?.[1]?.toUpperCase() || state.location || 'L1');
      const pKey = getPartitionKey(uStore, uLoc);
      if (!unitsByPartition[pKey]) unitsByPartition[pKey] = [];
      unitsByPartition[pKey].push({ ...u, store: uStore, location: uLoc });
    }

    const updatedStoreLocationData = { ...state.storeLocationData };
    for (const pKey in updatedStoreLocationData) {
      if (pKey.startsWith(`${currentStore}_`)) {
        updatedStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
          ...(updatedStoreLocationData[pKey] || { mapVersions: [], activeMapVersionId: null }),
          mapUnits: unitsByPartition[pKey] || [],
        };
      }
    }
    for (const pKey in unitsByPartition) {
      if (!updatedStoreLocationData[pKey]) {
        updatedStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
          mapVersions: [],
          activeMapVersionId: null,
          mapUnits: unitsByPartition[pKey],
        };
      }
    }

    const activeUnits = updatedStoreLocationData[currentKey]?.mapUnits || [];

    set({
      storeLocationData: updatedStoreLocationData,
      mapUnits: activeUnits,
    });
    autoBackupStoreLocationData(updatedStoreLocationData, state.store, state.location, state.activeMapVersionId);
  },

  updateStoreVersionsAcrossLocations: (updatedVersions, targetStore) => {
    const state = get();
    const currentStore = targetStore || state.store;
    const currentKey = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);
    const appYear = String(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter && useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter !== 'all' ? useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter : '2026');

    const versionsByPartition: Record<string, MapVersion[]> = {};
    for (const v of updatedVersions) {
      const vStore = v.store || currentStore;
      const vLoc = (v.location && String(v.location).trim()) 
        ? String(v.location).trim().toUpperCase() 
        : (v.name?.match(/(b\d|l\d|\d+f|gf|ug)/i)?.[1]?.toUpperCase() || state.location || 'L1');
      const vYr = (v.year && String(v.year).trim()) 
        ? String(v.year).trim() 
        : (v.name?.match(/(202\d|203\d)/i)?.[1] || appYear);

      const pKey = getPartitionKey(vStore, vLoc);
      if (!versionsByPartition[pKey]) versionsByPartition[pKey] = [];
      versionsByPartition[pKey].push({
        ...v,
        store: vStore,
        location: vLoc,
        year: vYr,
      });
    }

    const updatedStoreLocationData = { ...state.storeLocationData };
    for (const pKey in updatedStoreLocationData) {
      if (pKey.startsWith(`${currentStore}_`)) {
        const existing = updatedStoreLocationData[pKey];
        const newVers = versionsByPartition[pKey] || [];
        updatedStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
          ...(existing || { mapUnits: [] }),
          mapVersions: newVers,
          activeMapVersionId: existing?.activeMapVersionId && newVers.some(v => v.id === existing.activeMapVersionId)
            ? existing.activeMapVersionId
            : (newVers[0]?.id || null),
        };
      }
    }
    for (const pKey in versionsByPartition) {
      if (!updatedStoreLocationData[pKey]) {
        const newVers = versionsByPartition[pKey];
        updatedStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
          mapUnits: [],
          activeMapVersionId: newVers[0]?.id || null,
          mapVersions: newVers,
        };
      }
    }

    const activePartition = updatedStoreLocationData[currentKey];
    const activeVersions = activePartition?.mapVersions || [];
    
    // Preserve current state.activeMapVersionId if it still exists in updatedVersions
    const isCurrentActiveValid = state.activeMapVersionId && updatedVersions.some(v => v.id === state.activeMapVersionId);
    const activeVersionId = isCurrentActiveValid
      ? state.activeMapVersionId
      : (activePartition?.activeMapVersionId || (activeVersions[0]?.id ?? null));

    set({
      storeLocationData: updatedStoreLocationData,
      mapVersions: activeVersions,
      activeMapVersionId: activeVersionId,
    });
    autoBackupStoreLocationData(updatedStoreLocationData, state.store, state.location, activeVersionId);
  },

  syncGroupsToAllStoreLocations: (groups, targetStore) => {
    const state = get();
    const currentStore = targetStore || state.store;
    const updatedStoreLocationData = { ...state.storeLocationData };

    for (const pKey in updatedStoreLocationData) {
      if (pKey.startsWith(`${currentStore}_`)) {
        const partition = updatedStoreLocationData[pKey];
        if (partition?.mapVersions) {
          const newVersions = partition.mapVersions.map((v) => ({
            ...v,
            groups,
          }));
          updatedStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
            ...partition,
            mapVersions: newVersions,
          };
        }
      }
    }

    const currentKey = getPartitionKey(state.store, state.location);
    const activeVersions = updatedStoreLocationData[currentKey]?.mapVersions || state.mapVersions;

    set({
      storeLocationData: updatedStoreLocationData,
      mapVersions: activeVersions,
    });
  },

  isCloudLoaded: false,
  setIsCloudLoaded: (isCloudLoaded) => set({ isCloudLoaded }),
  isLoading: false,
  setIsLoading: (isLoading) => set({ isLoading }),
  unitInfo: [],
  setUnitInfo: (unitInfo) => set({ unitInfo }),
  projectStatus: [],
  setProjectStatus: (projectStatus) => set({ projectStatus }),
  classInfo: [],
  setClassInfo: (classInfo) => set({ classInfo }),
  actualClassInfo: [],
  setActualClassInfo: (actualClassInfo) => set({ actualClassInfo }),
  sales: [],
  setSales: (sales) => set({ sales }),
  profits: [],
  setProfits: (profits) => set({ profits }),
  subFees: [],
  setSubFees: (subFees) => set({ subFees }),
  mdStatus: [],
  setMdStatus: (mdStatus) => set({ mdStatus }),
  projectLink: [],
  setProjectLink: (projectLink) => set({ projectLink }),
  basePlan: [],
  setBasePlan: (basePlan) => set({ basePlan }),
  units: [],
  setUnits: (units) => set({ units }),

  loadFullCloudData: (payload) => {
    const state = get();
    const storeLocationData = payload.storeLocationData || {};

    let activeStore = (payload.store || state.store) as 'HCM' | 'HN';
    let activeLoc = payload.location || state.location;
    let activeKey = getPartitionKey(activeStore, activeLoc);

    if (!storeLocationData[activeKey]) {
      const keys = Object.keys(storeLocationData);
      if (keys.length > 0) {
        const firstKey = keys[0];
        const parts = firstKey.split('_');
        activeStore = (parts[0] === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
        activeLoc = parts[1] || 'L1';
        activeKey = firstKey;
      }
    }

    const targetPartition = storeLocationData[activeKey] || {
      mapUnits: [],
      mapVersions: [],
      activeMapVersionId: null,
    };

    const targetUnits = targetPartition.mapUnits || [];
    const targetVersions = targetPartition.mapVersions || [];
    const targetActiveVerId = payload.activeMapVersionId || targetPartition.activeMapVersionId || (targetVersions[0]?.id ?? null);

    set({
      isCloudLoaded: true,
      store: activeStore,
      location: activeLoc,
      storeLocationData,
      mapUnits: targetUnits,
      mapVersions: targetVersions,
      activeMapVersionId: targetActiveVerId,
      ...(payload.reviewSelectedLabels ? { reviewSelectedLabels: payload.reviewSelectedLabels } : {}),
      ...(payload.reviewLabelColors ? { reviewLabelColors: payload.reviewLabelColors } : {}),
      ...(payload.unitInfo ? { unitInfo: payload.unitInfo } : {}),
      ...(payload.classInfo ? { classInfo: payload.classInfo } : {}),
      ...(payload.actualClassInfo ? { actualClassInfo: payload.actualClassInfo } : {}),
      ...(payload.sales ? { sales: payload.sales } : {}),
      ...(payload.profits ? { profits: payload.profits } : {}),
      ...(payload.subFees ? { subFees: payload.subFees } : {}),
      ...(payload.mdStatus ? { mdStatus: payload.mdStatus } : {}),
      ...(payload.projectStatus ? { projectStatus: payload.projectStatus } : {}),
      ...(payload.projectLink ? { projectLink: payload.projectLink } : {}),
      ...(payload.basePlan ? { basePlan: payload.basePlan } : {}),
      ...(payload.units ? { units: payload.units } : {}),
    });
  },
}));

# Hướng Dẫn Tích Hợp Tab Picture (DataMapping Canvas)

## 1. Cài đặt các thư viện cần thiết (NPM):
```bash
npm install react-konva konva use-image uuid lucide-react react-dropzone pdfjs-dist papaparse jspdf @aws-sdk/client-s3 @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner motion clsx tailwind-merge zustand firebase
```

## 2. Thư mục và file đã được cấu trúc sẵn:
- `src/components/DataMappingTab.tsx` (Component chính chứa các sub-tab Edit, Hierarchy, Dynamic Hierarchy, Review)
- `src/components/DataMapping/types.ts` (Các type định nghĩa UnitShape, MapVersion, Group...)
- `src/components/DataMapping/EditTab.tsx` (Bộ vẽ Canvas Konva, vẽ shape, đo kích thước, import ảnh/PDF mặt bằng)
- `src/components/DataMapping/HierarchyTab.tsx` (Phân cấp danh mục tĩnh)
- `src/components/DataMapping/DynamicHierarchyTab.tsx` (Bộ luật đổi màu linh hoạt theo tầng/khu vực)
- `src/components/DataMapping/ReviewTab.tsx` (Màn hình Review xuất ảnh JPEG, PDF, Cloudflare R2, Google Drive)
- `src/components/DataMapping/ReviewOnlyView.tsx` (Chế độ xem độc lập khi chia sẻ link)
- `src/hooks/useDynamicRules.ts`
- `src/lib/summaryData.ts`
- `src/lib/r2Upload.ts`
- `src/components/R2UploadModal.tsx`
- `src/lib/drive.ts`
- `src/lib/auth.ts`
- `src/lib/utils.ts`

## 3. Khởi tạo State trong Zustand (src/DataContext.tsx):
Component `DataMappingTab` đọc các biến state sau từ `useDataStore`:
- `store`: 'HCM' | 'HN'
- `mapUnits`: UnitShape[]
- `setMapUnits`: (units: UnitShape[]) => void
- `mapVersions`: MapVersion[]
- `setMapVersions`: (versions: MapVersion[]) => void
- `activeMapVersionId`: string | null
- `setActiveMapVersionId`: (id: string | null) => void
- `reviewSelectedLabels`: string[]
- `setReviewSelectedLabels`: (labels: string[]) => void
- `unitInfo`: any[]
- `projectStatus`: any[]

## 4. Sử dụng Component:
```tsx
import DataMappingTab from './components/DataMappingTab';

export default function App() {
  return (
    <div className="w-screen h-screen bg-slate-950 text-white">
      <DataMappingTab />
    </div>
  );
}
```

let hasGlobalAutoSyncStarted = false;

// Recursive sanitizer to ensure zero 'undefined' properties reach Firestore
function sanitizeForFirestore(val: any): any {
  if (val === undefined) return null;
  if (val === null || typeof val !== 'object') return val;
  if (Array.isArray(val)) return val.map(sanitizeForFirestore);
  const out: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(val)) {
    const v = val[k];
    if (v !== undefined) {
      out[k] = sanitizeForFirestore(v);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

    async function checkAutoLoad() {

      try {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem('taka_mapping_config_backup');

            });

            const fsData = snap.data() as any;
            if (fsData?.storeLocationData) {

                storeLocationData: fsData.storeLocationData,
                store: store,
                location: location,
                activeMapVersionId: activeMapVersionId,
                reviewSelectedLabels: fsData.reviewSelectedLabels || [],
                reviewLabelColors: fsData.reviewLabelColors || {},
              });
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[AutoLoad Fallback] Firestore boot fallback error:', e);
        }
      }
    }
    checkAutoLoad();
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleOpenSync = async (type: 'upload' | 'download', targetScope?: CloudSyncScope) => {
    setActionType(type);

    if (targetScope) setSelectedScope(targetScope);

      case 'dynamic': return 'Dynamic';

    }
  };

  const executeSync = async (forceAction?: 'upload' | 'download', isAuto = false, forceScope?: CloudSyncScope) => {
    const syncStartTime = Date.now();
    const currentAction = forceAction || actionType;
    const currentScope = forceScope || selectedScope;
    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setSyncing(true);
    setBackgroundSyncing(currentAction);

    // 1. INSTANT 0ms OPTIMISTIC COMMIT TO ZUSTAND & LOCALSTORAGE

    const currentLocation = (freshDataState.location || location || 'L1').trim();

      ...(freshDataState.storeLocationData || {})

    const currentActiveVersions = Array.isArray(freshDataState.mapVersions) ? freshDataState.mapVersions : (updatedStoreLocationData[currentActiveKey]?.mapVersions || []);
    const currentActiveVersionId = freshDataState.activeMapVersionId

      mapVersions: currentActiveVersions,

        mapVersions: currentActiveVersions,

          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
        if (payload.length < 1000000) {
          localStorage.setItem('taka_mapping_config_backup', payload);
        } else {
          localStorage.removeItem('taka_mapping_config_backup');
        }
      } catch {
        try { localStorage.removeItem('taka_mapping_config_backup'); } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    // 2. NETWORK ASYNC CLOUD SYNC (R2 & FIRESTORE)
    try {
      const creds = await getStoredR2CredentialsAsync();
      const credsValidation = isR2CredentialsValid(creds);

          }

              existingCloudData = snap.data();
            }

            console.warn('Could not pre-fetch Firestore backup for merge:', e);
          }
        }

          ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(existingCloudData.storeLocationData))

        const localStoreLocationData: Record<string, StoreLocationRecord> = {};

        // Merge all partitions across all stores and locations without dropping any floor
        const allPartitionKeys = Array.from(new Set([
          ...Object.keys(updatedStoreLocationData),

          const pLoc = pKey.split('_')[1] || 'L1';

            ? localPart.mapUnits
            : (cloudPart?.mapUnits || []);

          const pUnits = sourceUnits.map(u => ({

            store: u.store || pStore,
            location: u.location || pLoc,

            locked: !!u.locked,
            fill: (u.fill && u.fill !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.001)' && u.fill !== 'transparent') ? u.fill : '#3b82f6',
          }));

            ? localPart.mapVersions
            : (cloudPart?.mapVersions || []);

          const pVersionsCloud: MapVersion[] = [];
          const pVersionsLocal: MapVersion[] = [];
