                  const uploadRes = await uploadSingleR2File({ name: bgName, blob }, creds, s3ClientInstance);
                  if (uploadRes.success) {
                    r2Key = uploadRes.name;
                    const { GetObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
                    const signedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3ClientInstance, new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: creds.bucketName.trim(), Key: r2Key }), { expiresIn: 3600 * 24 * 7 });
                    displayUrl = signedUrl;
                  }
                }
              } catch (bgErr) {
                console.warn(`[Background Upload] Failed to upload background for ${v.name}:`, bgErr);
              }
            } else if (creds && s3ClientInstance && r2Key) {
              if (!displayUrl || displayUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
                try {
                  const { GetObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
                  displayUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3ClientInstance, new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: creds.bucketName.trim(), Key: r2Key }), { expiresIn: 3600 * 24 * 7 });
                } catch (e) {
                  console.warn('Could not generate signed url for key', r2Key, e);
                }
              }
            }

            if (r2Key) {
              allValidBgNames.push(r2Key);
            }

            const rawGroups = v.groups || [];
            const deepCopiedGroups = Array.isArray(rawGroups) ? rawGroups.map((g: any) => ({
              id: g.id,
              name: g.name,
              color: g.color,
              opacity: g.opacity,
              rules: Array.isArray(g.rules) ? g.rules.map((r: any) => ({
                field: r.field,
                operator: r.operator,
                value: r.value !== undefined ? String(r.value) : '',
              })) : [],
            })) : [];

            const versionYear = String(v.year || (useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter && useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter !== 'all' ? useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter : '2026'));

            pVersionsCloud.push({
              ...v,
              year: versionYear,
              store: v.store || pStore,
              location: v.location || pLoc,
              backgroundUrl: r2Key ? `r2://${r2Key}` : displayUrl,
              groups: deepCopiedGroups,
              groupMappings: v.groupMappings || {},
              isDynamicActive: true,
              mapUnits: pUnits,
            });

            pVersionsLocal.push({
              ...v,
              year: versionYear,
              store: v.store || pStore,
              location: v.location || pLoc,
              backgroundUrl: displayUrl,
              groups: deepCopiedGroups,
              groupMappings: v.groupMappings || {},
              isDynamicActive: true,
              mapUnits: pUnits,
            });
          }

          const activeVerId = localPart?.activeMapVersionId 
            || cloudPart?.activeMapVersionId 
            || (pVersionsCloud[0]?.id ?? null);

          cloudStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
            mapUnits: pUnits,
            mapVersions: pVersionsCloud,
            activeMapVersionId: activeVerId,
          };

          localStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
            mapUnits: pUnits,
            mapVersions: pVersionsLocal,
            activeMapVersionId: activeVerId,
          };
        }

        // 2. Dọn dẹp ảnh mồ côi nếu scope có liên quan tới edit hoặc all
        if (creds && s3ClientInstance && (currentScope === 'edit' || currentScope === 'all') && allValidBgNames.length > 0) {
          setProgress(60);
          setStatusText('Đang dọn dẹp ảnh nền cũ trên R2...');
          try {
            await purgeOldR2BackgroundImages(allValidBgNames, creds, s3ClientInstance, (status) => setStatusText(status));
          } catch (cleanErr) {
            console.warn('[CloudSync] Lỗi dọn dẹp ảnh nền cũ:', cleanErr);
          }
        }

        // 3. Build config Data
        setProgress(75);
        setStatusText(`Đang lưu cấu hình [${getScopeName(currentScope)}] lên Cloud...`);

        const activeCloudPartition = cloudStoreLocationData[currentActiveKey] 
          || Object.values(cloudStoreLocationData)[0] 
          || { mapUnits: [], mapVersions: [], activeMapVersionId: null };
        const currentAppYear = useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter;
        const targetYear = (currentAppYear && currentAppYear !== 'all') ? currentAppYear : (activeCloudPartition?.mapVersions?.[0]?.year || '2026');

        const configData = {
          ...(existingCloudData || {}),
          storeLocationData: cloudStoreLocationData,
          store,
          location,
          year: targetYear,
          globalYearFilter: targetYear,
          activeMapVersionId: activeCloudPartition.activeMapVersionId || activeMapVersionId,
          reviewSelectedLabels: reviewSelectedLabels || [],
          reviewLabelColors: reviewLabelColors || {},
          mapUnits: activeCloudPartition.mapUnits,
          versions: activeCloudPartition.mapVersions,
          unitInfo: existingCloudData?.unitInfo || unitInfo,
          classInfo: existingCloudData?.classInfo || classInfo,
          actualClassInfo: existingCloudData?.actualClassInfo || actualClassInfo,
          sales: existingCloudData?.sales || sales,
          profits: existingCloudData?.profits || profits,
          subFees: existingCloudData?.subFees || subFees,
          mdStatus: existingCloudData?.mdStatus || mdStatus,
          projectStatus: existingCloudData?.projectStatus || projectStatus,
          projectLink: existingCloudData?.projectLink || projectLink,
          basePlan: existingCloudData?.basePlan || basePlan,
          units: existingCloudData?.units || units,
          lastSavedScope: currentScope,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        };

        // Upload to Cloudflare R2 if creds available and valid
        let r2UploadSuccess = false;
        let r2ErrorMessage = '';

        if (creds && credsValidation.valid && s3ClientInstance) {
          try {
            const configBlob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(configData, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
            const uploadRes = await uploadSingleR2File({ name: 'mapping_config.json', blob: configBlob }, creds, s3ClientInstance);
            if (uploadRes.success) {
              r2UploadSuccess = true;
            } else {
              r2ErrorMessage = uploadRes.error || 'Cloudflare R2 không phản hồi';
              console.warn(`[R2 Upload Warning] ${r2ErrorMessage}`);
            }
          } catch (r2Err: any) {
            r2ErrorMessage = r2Err?.message || String(r2Err);
            console.warn('[R2 Upload Warning]', r2ErrorMessage);
          }
        } else if (creds && !credsValidation.valid) {
          r2ErrorMessage = credsValidation.reason || 'Cấu hình Cloudflare R2 không hợp lệ';
          console.warn('[R2 Upload Warning]', r2ErrorMessage);
        } else {
          console.warn('[CloudSync] Missing R2 credentials when saving. Data saved to Firestore backup only.');
        }

        // Parallel Backup: Always save snapshot to Firestore and LocalStorage (with size protection)
        let firestoreSaveSuccess = false;
        try {
          // Prepare sanitized Firestore backup copy (replace any heavy data: URLs to keep doc < 1MB)
          const firestoreStoreLocationData: Record<string, any> = {};
          for (const key in cloudStoreLocationData) {
            const part = cloudStoreLocationData[key];
            if (!part) continue;
            firestoreStoreLocationData[key] = {
              activeMapVersionId: part.activeMapVersionId || null,
              mapUnits: (part.mapUnits || []).map(u => ({
                id: u.id,
                name: u.name || '',
                type: u.type,
                x: u.x || 0,
                y: u.y || 0,
                width: u.width ?? null,
                height: u.height ?? null,
                radius: u.radius ?? null,
                points: u.points ?? null,
                rotation: u.rotation || 0,
                scaleX: (u as any).scaleX ?? null,
                scaleY: (u as any).scaleY ?? null,
                fill: u.fill || '#3b82f6',
                opacity: u.opacity ?? 0.5,
                visible: u.visible !== false,
                locked: !!u.locked,
                store: u.store || null,
                location: u.location || null,
                groupId: (u as any).groupId || null,
                groupName: (u as any).groupName || null,
              })),
              mapVersions: (part.mapVersions || []).map(v => {
                const bg = v.backgroundUrl || '';
                const safeBg = (bg.startsWith('data:') || bg.startsWith('blob:'))
                  ? ((v as any).r2Key ? `r2://${(v as any).r2Key}` : '')
                  : bg;
                return {
                  id: v.id,
                  name: v.name,
                  year: v.year,
                  store: v.store,
                  location: v.location,
                  backgroundUrl: safeBg,
                  groups: v.groups || [],
                  groupMappings: v.groupMappings || {},
                  isDynamicActive: v.isDynamicActive !== false,
                  // Do not duplicate mapUnits inside every version to keep Firestore doc well under 1MB
                };
              }),
            };
          }

          const firestorePayload = sanitizeForFirestore({
            storeLocationData: firestoreStoreLocationData,
            store,
            location,
            year: targetYear,
            globalYearFilter: targetYear,
            activeMapVersionId: activeCloudPartition.activeMapVersionId || activeMapVersionId || null,
            reviewSelectedLabels: configData.reviewSelectedLabels || [],
            reviewLabelColors: configData.reviewLabelColors || {},
            lastSavedScope: currentScope,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            timestamp: configData.timestamp,
          });

          await setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "picture_mapping_config"), firestorePayload, { merge: true });
          firestoreSaveSuccess = true;

          // Also update version timestamp to notify LiveLayoutViewer and other clients
          await setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "versions"), { 
            r2Version: configData.timestamp,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { merge: true });
        } catch (fsErr) {
          console.error('[Firestore Backup] Error saving backup:', fsErr);
        }

        try {
          const payload = JSON.stringify({
            storeLocationData: cloudStoreLocationData,
            store,
            location,
            year: targetYear,
            globalYearFilter: targetYear,
            activeMapVersionId: activeCloudPartition.activeMapVersionId || activeMapVersionId,
            updatedAt: Date.now(),
            timestamp: configData.timestamp,
          });
          if (payload.length < 1000000) {
            localStorage.setItem('taka_mapping_config_backup', payload);
          } else {
            localStorage.removeItem('taka_mapping_config_backup');
          }
        } catch {
          try { localStorage.removeItem('taka_mapping_config_backup'); } catch (_) {}
        }

        // 4. Update local React store
        loadFullCloudData({
          storeLocationData: localStoreLocationData,
          store,
          location,
          activeMapVersionId: activeCloudPartition.activeMapVersionId || activeMapVersionId,
          reviewSelectedLabels: reviewSelectedLabels || [],
          reviewLabelColors: reviewLabelColors || {},
        });

        // Broadcast to LiveLayoutViewer, ReviewTab, etc.
        try {
          if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taka_cloud_sync_updated', {
              detail: {
                timestamp: configData.timestamp,
                store,
                location,
                storeLocationData: localStoreLocationData,
              }
            }));
          }
        } catch (evtErr) {}

        setProgress(100);
        const totalVersions = Object.values(cloudStoreLocationData).reduce((acc, p) => acc + (p.mapVersions?.length || 0), 0);
        const totalUnits = Object.values(cloudStoreLocationData).reduce((acc, p) => acc + (p.mapUnits?.length || 0), 0);
        const elapsedSec = ((Date.now() - syncStartTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);

        if (r2UploadSuccess) {
          setStatusText(`Đã lưu thành công: ${totalUnits} units, ${totalVersions} versions lên Cloudflare R2 (${elapsedSec}s)!`);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Save Cloud Success",
            message: `Successfully saved ${totalUnits} units and ${totalVersions} versions across all floors to Cloudflare R2 & Firestore in ${elapsedSec}s!`,
            type: "success",
          });
        } else if (firestoreSaveSuccess) {
          const warnNote = r2ErrorMessage ? ` (Lưu ý: ${r2ErrorMessage})` : '';
          setStatusText(`Đã lưu ${totalUnits} units, ${totalVersions} versions vào Firestore Cloud (${elapsedSec}s)!`);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Saved to Firestore Cloud",
            message: `Data saved successfully to Firestore Cloud in ${elapsedSec}s!${warnNote}`,
            type: r2ErrorMessage ? "warning" : "success",
          });
        } else {
          setStatusText(`Lỗi lưu Cloud (${elapsedSec}s): ${r2ErrorMessage || 'Không thể ghi dữ liệu'}`);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Save Cloud Failed",
            message: `Could not save to Cloud: ${r2ErrorMessage || 'Permission denied or network failure'}.`,
            type: "error",
          });
        }

      } else if (currentAction === 'download') {
        setProgress(20);
        setStatusText(`Đang tải dữ liệu [${getScopeName(currentScope)}] từ Cloud...`);

        let data: any = null;
        let loadSource = '';

        // Try R2 download first if credentials are valid
        if (creds && credsValidation.valid) {
          try {
            const { S3Client } = await getS3Sdk();
            const s3 = new S3Client({
              region: 'auto',
              endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
              credentials: { accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId, secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey },
            });
            const downloadRes = await downloadR2JsonFile<any>('mapping_config.json', creds, s3);
            if (downloadRes.success && downloadRes.data) {
              data = downloadRes.data;
              loadSource = 'Cloudflare R2';
            }
          } catch (r2Err) {
            console.warn('[R2 Download] R2 fetch error, trying fallback:', r2Err);
          }
        }

        // Compare or fallback to Firestore backup
        try {
          const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "picture_mapping_config"));
          if (snap.exists()) {
            const fsData = snap.data() as any;
            if (fsData?.storeLocationData) {
              // Prefer Firestore if R2 had no data OR Firestore timestamp is strictly newer
              if (!data || (fsData.timestamp && (!data.timestamp || fsData.timestamp > data.timestamp))) {
                data = fsData;
                loadSource = 'Firestore Cloud';
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (fsErr) {
          console.warn('[Firestore Fallback] Error reading backup:', fsErr);
        }

        // Fallback to LocalStorage backup
        if (!data) {
          try {
            const cached = localStorage.getItem('taka_mapping_config_backup');
            if (cached) {
              data = JSON.parse(cached);
              loadSource = 'LocalStorage Cache';
            }
          } catch {}
        }

        if (!data) {
          if (isAuto) {
            setSyncing(false);
            return;
          }
          throw new Error('Chưa tìm thấy dữ liệu trên Cloud (Vui lòng bấm Save Cloud để lưu cấu hình đầu tiên).');
        }

        setProgress(50);
        setStatusText('Đang phân giải liên kết ảnh và dữ liệu...');

        let normalizedStoreLocationData: Record<string, StoreLocationRecord> = {};
        if (data.storeLocationData && typeof data.storeLocationData === 'object') {
          normalizedStoreLocationData = data.storeLocationData;
        } else if (Array.isArray(data.versions) || Array.isArray(data.mapUnits) || Array.isArray(data.units)) {
          const legacyKey = `${data.store || store || 'HCM'}_${data.location || location || 'L1'}`;
          normalizedStoreLocationData = {
            [legacyKey]: {
              mapUnits: data.mapUnits || data.units || [],
              mapVersions: data.versions || [],
              activeMapVersionId: data.activeMapVersionId || data.versions?.[0]?.id || null,
            },
          };
        }

        // Resolve background signed URLs if creds available and valid
        let s3ClientInstance: any = null;
        if (creds && credsValidation.valid) {
          const { S3Client } = await getS3Sdk();
          s3ClientInstance = new S3Client({
            region: 'auto',
            endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
            credentials: { accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId, secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey },
          });
        }

        for (const pKey in normalizedStoreLocationData) {
          const partition = normalizedStoreLocationData[pKey];
          if (!partition) continue;

          const pStore = (pKey.split('_')[0] === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
          const pLoc = pKey.split('_')[1] || 'L1';

          partition.mapUnits = (partition.mapUnits || []).map(u => ({
            ...u,
            store: u.store || pStore,
            location: u.location || pLoc,
            visible: u.visible !== false,
            locked: !!u.locked,
            fill: (u.fill && u.fill !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.001)' && u.fill !== 'transparent') ? u.fill : '#3b82f6',
          }));

          if (Array.isArray(partition.mapVersions)) {
            for (let j = 0; j < partition.mapVersions.length; j++) {
              const v = partition.mapVersions[j];
              const r2Key = extractR2Key(v.backgroundUrl) || (v as any).r2Key;

              if (creds && credsValidation.valid && s3ClientInstance && r2Key) {
                try {
                  const { GetObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
                  const imgCommand = new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: creds.bucketName, Key: r2Key });
                  const imgUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3ClientInstance, imgCommand, { expiresIn: 3600 * 24 * 7 });
                  v.backgroundUrl = imgUrl;
                  (v as any).r2Key = r2Key;
                } catch (imgErr) {
                  console.warn(`Lỗi tạo signed URL cho ảnh ${r2Key}:`, imgErr);
                }
              }

              v.store = v.store || pStore;
              v.location = v.location || pLoc;
              v.groups = v.groups || [];
              v.groupMappings = v.groupMappings || {};
              v.isDynamicActive = true;
            }
          }
        }

        // Scoped Application to local state (read directly from getState to avoid any stale closure)
        const currentLocalStoreLocationData = useDataStore.getState().storeLocationData || {};
        const localMergedStoreLocationData: Record<string, StoreLocationRecord> = { ...currentLocalStoreLocationData };

        if (currentScope === 'edit') {
          // Update ONLY coordinates & background transforms, keeping local dynamic rules
          for (const pKey in normalizedStoreLocationData) {
            const cloudPart = normalizedStoreLocationData[pKey];
            const localPart = localMergedStoreLocationData[pKey];
            if (!cloudPart) continue;

            const mergedVersions = (cloudPart.mapVersions || []).map((cv) => {
              const localV = localPart?.mapVersions?.find((lv) => 
                lv.id === cv.id || (lv.name === cv.name && String(lv.year || '').trim() === String(cv.year || '').trim())
              );
              return {
                ...cv,
                groups: localV?.groups || cv.groups || [],
                groupMappings: localV?.groupMappings || cv.groupMappings || {},
              };
            });

            localMergedStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
              mapUnits: cloudPart.mapUnits,
              mapVersions: mergedVersions,
              activeMapVersionId: cloudPart.activeMapVersionId || localPart?.activeMapVersionId || null,
            };
          }

          loadFullCloudData({
            storeLocationData: localMergedStoreLocationData,
            store: useDataStore.getState().store || store,
            location: useDataStore.getState().location || location,
            activeMapVersionId: useDataStore.getState().activeMapVersionId || activeMapVersionId,
            reviewSelectedLabels: reviewSelectedLabels || [],
            reviewLabelColors: reviewLabelColors || {},
          });

          setProgress(100);
          const elapsedSec = ((Date.now() - syncStartTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
          setStatusText(`Đã tải bản vẽ & tọa độ (Tab Edit) từ ${loadSource || 'Cloud'} (${elapsedSec}s)!`);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Load Cloud Success",
            message: `Successfully loaded map units and floor plans from ${loadSource || 'Cloud'} in ${elapsedSec}s!`,
            type: "success"
          });

        } else if (currentScope === 'dynamic') {
          // Update dynamic rules and groups, while preserving all versions and units
          for (const pKey in normalizedStoreLocationData) {
            const cloudPart = normalizedStoreLocationData[pKey];
            const localPart = localMergedStoreLocationData[pKey];
            if (!cloudPart) continue;

            const cloudVerList = cloudPart.mapVersions || [];
            const localVerList = localPart?.mapVersions || [];

            const versionMap = new Map<string, MapVersion>();
            for (const lv of localVerList) {
              if (lv?.id) versionMap.set(lv.id, { ...lv });
            }
            for (const cv of cloudVerList) {
              if (cv?.id) {
                const localV = versionMap.get(cv.id);
                const groupsToUse = cv.groups || localV?.groups || [];
                const deepCopied = Array.isArray(groupsToUse) ? groupsToUse.map((g: any) => ({
                  id: g.id,
                  name: g.name,
                  color: g.color,
                  opacity: g.opacity,
                  rules: Array.isArray(g.rules) ? g.rules.map((r: any) => ({
                    field: r.field,
                    operator: r.operator,
                    value: r.value !== undefined ? String(r.value) : '',
                  })) : [],
                })) : [];

                versionMap.set(cv.id, {
                  ...(localV || {}),
                  ...cv,
                  year: String(cv.year || localV?.year || data.year || data.globalYearFilter || '2026'),
                  groups: deepCopied,
                  groupMappings: cv.groupMappings || localV?.groupMappings || {},
                  isDynamicActive: true,
                });
              }
            }

            localMergedStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
              mapUnits: (cloudPart.mapUnits && cloudPart.mapUnits.length > 0) ? cloudPart.mapUnits : (localPart?.mapUnits || []),
              mapVersions: Array.from(versionMap.values()),
              activeMapVersionId: cloudPart.activeMapVersionId || localPart?.activeMapVersionId || null,
            };
          }

          if (data.globalYearFilter || data.year) {
            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(data.globalYearFilter || data.year);
          }

          loadFullCloudData({
            storeLocationData: localMergedStoreLocationData,
            store: useDataStore.getState().store || store,
            location: useDataStore.getState().location || location,
            activeMapVersionId: useDataStore.getState().activeMapVersionId || activeMapVersionId,
            reviewSelectedLabels: reviewSelectedLabels || [],
            reviewLabelColors: reviewLabelColors || {},
          });

          setProgress(100);
          setStatusText('Đã tải quy tắc dynamic & nhóm (Tab Dynamic) từ Cloud!');
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Load Cloud Success",
            message: "Successfully synchronized dynamic rules and group classifications from Cloud!",
            type: "success"
          });

        } else if (currentScope === 'review') {
          // Update ONLY reviewSelectedLabels and reviewLabelColors
          if (data.globalYearFilter || data.year) {
            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(data.globalYearFilter || data.year);
          }
          loadFullCloudData({
            storeLocationData: useDataStore.getState().storeLocationData || storeLocationData,
            store: useDataStore.getState().store || store,
            location: useDataStore.getState().location || location,
            activeMapVersionId: useDataStore.getState().activeMapVersionId || activeMapVersionId,
            reviewSelectedLabels: data.reviewSelectedLabels || [],
            reviewLabelColors: data.reviewLabelColors || {},
          });

          setProgress(100);
          setStatusText('Đã tải cấu hình review & nhãn (Tab Review) từ Cloud!');
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Load Cloud Success",
            message: "Successfully synchronized review label settings from Cloud!",
            type: "success"
          });

        } else {
          // 'all'
          if (data.globalYearFilter || data.year) {
            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(data.globalYearFilter || data.year);
          }
          loadFullCloudData({
            storeLocationData: normalizedStoreLocationData,
            store: useDataStore.getState().store || data.store || store,
            location: useDataStore.getState().location || data.location || location,
            activeMapVersionId: data.activeMapVersionId || useDataStore.getState().activeMapVersionId,
            reviewSelectedLabels: data.reviewSelectedLabels || [],
            reviewLabelColors: data.reviewLabelColors || {},
            unitInfo: data.unitInfo || [],
            classInfo: data.classInfo || [],
            actualClassInfo: data.actualClassInfo || [],
            sales: data.sales || [],
            profits: data.profits || [],
            subFees: data.subFees || [],
            mdStatus: data.mdStatus || [],
            projectStatus: data.projectStatus || [],
            projectLink: data.projectLink || [],
            basePlan: data.basePlan || [],
            units: data.units || [],
          });

          setProgress(100);
          setStatusText('Tải toàn bộ cấu hình từ Cloud thành công!');
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Load Cloud Success",
            message: "Successfully downloaded all floor plans, units, and dynamic rules from Cloud!",
            type: "success"
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (!isAuto) {
        console.error('[CloudSync Background Error]', err);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Cloud Sync Error",
          message: `Lỗi đồng bộ Cloud: ${err.message || err}. Dữ liệu trên máy vẫn an toàn.`,
          type: "warning",
        });
      }
    } finally {
      setBackgroundSyncing(null);
      setSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCleanR2Garbage = async () => {
    const creds = getStoredR2Credentials();
    if (!creds) {
      alert('Chưa cấu hình Cloudflare R2 trong hệ thống.');
      return;
    }

    if (!confirm('Hệ thống sẽ quét toàn bộ R2 Bucket và xóa tất cả ảnh nền cũ/mồ côi không còn thuộc bất kỳ version nào. Bạn có muốn tiếp tục?')) {
      return;
    }

    setSyncing(true);
    setStatusText('Đang quét và thu gom file rác R2...');

    try {
      const activeData = {
        storeLocationData,
        mapVersions,
      };

      const result = await cleanOrphanR2Files(activeData, {
        onProgress: (msg) => setStatusText(msg),
      });

      if (result.deletedCount > 0) {
        alert(`🧹 Đã dọn dẹp và giải phóng thành công ${result.deletedCount} file rác trên Cloudflare R2!`);
      } else {
        alert(`✅ R2 Bucket hoàn toàn sạch sẽ! Tất cả ${result.scannedCount} file đều đang được sử dụng.`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Lỗi khi dọn rác R2: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  const scopeBadgeColor = {
    edit: 'text-blue-400 bg-blue-500/10 border-blue-500/30',
    dynamic: 'text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30',
    review: 'text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30',
    all: 'text-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 border-purple-500/30',
  }[selectedScope];

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-1.5 relative", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
        {/* Main Save Button with non-blocking progress */}
        <button 
          onClick={() => handleOpenSync('upload')}
          disabled={backgroundSyncing === 'upload'}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-brand-400 hover:text-brand-300 transition-all shadow-sm active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer",
            backgroundSyncing === 'upload' && "opacity-90 cursor-wait",
            compact ? "text-[10px] px-2 py-1" : "text-[11px]"
          )}
          title={`Lưu dữ liệu (${getScopeName(selectedScope)}) lên Cloudflare R2 & Firestore`}
        >
          {backgroundSyncing === 'upload' ? (
            <RefreshCw size={13} className="shrink-0 animate-spin text-brand-400" />
          ) : (
            <CloudUpload size={13} className="shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
            {backgroundSyncing === 'upload' ? 'Saving Cloud...' : 'Save Cloud'}
          </span>
          {selectedScope !== 'all' && (

                </div>

                  className={cn(

                    selectedScope === 'dynamic' ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300" : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"
                  )}

                    <GitMerge size={12} className="text-amber-400" />
                    <span>Tab Dynamic (Rules)</span>
                  </span>
                  {selectedScope === 'dynamic' && <Check size={12} />}
                </button>

                  className={cn(
                    "flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors text-left cursor-pointer",
                    selectedScope === 'review' ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300" : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"
                  )}
                >
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Eye size={12} className="text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Tab Review (Nhãn)</span>
                  </span>

                    <span>Tất cả (All Tabs)</span>
                  </span>
                  {selectedScope === 'all' && <Check size={12} />}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* R2 Credentials Settings Button */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}
            className="p-1.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Cài đặt khóa kết nối Cloudflare R2"
          >
            <Settings size={12} />
          </button>

          {showCleanButton && (
            <button 
              onClick={handleCleanR2Garbage}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-slate-700 hover:border-emerald-700/50 text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300 transition-colors shadow-sm active:scale-95 cursor-pointer",
                compact ? "text-[10px] px-1.5 py-1" : "text-[11px]"
              )}
              title="Dọn dẹp & giải phóng tất cả ảnh nền mồ côi trên Cloudflare R2"
            >
              <Sparkles size={12} className="shrink-0" />
              <span className="font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hidden md:inline">Clean R2</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

      <R2UploadModal 
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        onStartExport={() => executeSync('upload', false, selectedScope)}
        uploading={false}
        uploadProgress={0}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

const normalizeRuleField = (f: string) => {
  if (f === "appStatus" || f === "app: status") return "appProjectStatus";
  if (f === "appTask" || f === "app: task" || f === "app: task summarize" || f === "app: task summaries" || f === "app: tasks" || f === "taskSummaries" || f === "taskSummarize") return "appTask";
  if (f === "appYear" || f === "app: year") return "appProjectYear";
  if (f === "appCode" || f === "app: project code") return "appProjectCode";
  if (f === "appFloor" || f === "app: floor") return "appProjectFloor";
  if (f === "appMdStatus" || f === "app: md status" || f === "app:md status") return "appProjectMdStatus";
  if (f === "appActStatus" || f === "app: act status" || f === "app:act status") return "appProjectActStatus";
  if (f === "appDetail" || f === "app: detail (project)") return "appProjectDetail";
  if (f === "appDescription" || f === "app: description (project)" || f === "description (project)") return "appProjectDescription";
  if (f === "appParty" || f === "app: party") return "appProjectParty";
  if (f === "appBudget" || f === "app: budget") return "appProjectBudget";
  if (f === "appActual" || f === "app: actual") return "appProjectActual";
  return f;
};

function DynamicHierarchyTab({

  setActiveVersionId,
  store: propStore,
  location: propLocation,
}: DynamicHierarchyTabProps) {
  const summaryData = useSummaryData();
  const projects = useAppStore(state => state.projects);
  const tasks = useAppStore(state => state.tasks);
  const delegationGroups = useAppStore(state => state.delegationGroups);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setGlobalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalYearFilter);

  const { currentStore, currentLocation } = useDataStore(useShallow(state => ({
    currentStore: state.store,
    currentLocation: state.location,
  })));

  const store = propStore || currentStore || 'HCM';
  const location = propLocation || currentLocation || 'L1';

  const availableYears = useMemo(() => {
    const currentYr = new Date().getFullYear().toString();
    const baseYears = ['2024', '2025', '2026', '2027', '2028'];
    const projectYears = projects.map(p => p.year ? String(p.year) : '').filter(Boolean);
    const taskYears = tasks.map(t => t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : '').filter(Boolean);
    const versionYears = versions.map(v => v.year ? String(v.year) : '').filter(Boolean);
    const allYrs = Array.from(new Set([currentYr, ...baseYears, ...projectYears, ...taskYears, ...versionYears]))
      .filter(y => y && y.toLowerCase() !== 'all')
      .sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
    return allYrs;
  }, [projects, tasks, versions]);

  const effectiveYear = (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all')

    : (availableYears[0] || new Date().getFullYear().toString());

      const matchStore = !v.store || v.store === store;
      const matchLoc = !v.location || v.location === location;

      return matchStore && matchLoc && matchYear;
    });
  }, [versions, store, location, effectiveYear]);

  useEffect(() => {

      if (!v.year || !String(v.year).trim()) {
        hasUntagged = true;

        return { ...v, year: String(inferredYear) };

      if (currentUntaggedFingerprint && currentUntaggedFingerprint !== normalizedYearVersionIdsRef.current) {
        normalizedYearVersionIdsRef.current = currentUntaggedFingerprint;
        setVersions(normalizedVersions);
      }
    }
  }, [versions, setVersions]);

  const isVersionActive = true; // Always permanently active per system mandate

  // 3-TIER ARCHITECTURE FOR DYNAMIC RULES
  // Tier 1: Memory Evaluation (0ms on RAM)
  // Tier 2: Debounce Cloud Saver (5000ms delay)
  // Pure In-Memory Version Management (Senior Coder Architecture: 0ms RAM, zero redundant R2 writes)
  const storeRef = useRef(store);
  storeRef.current = store;
  const versionsRef = useRef(versions);

      setCloudSyncStatus(status);
    });
    return unsub;
  }, []);

  // Wrap setVersions to update Zustand and RAM state instantly (0ms)
  const updateVersions = useCallback(
    (newVersions: MapVersion[]) => {
      setVersions(newVersions);
    },
    [setVersions]
  );

  // Tier 1: Auto-Evaluate in RAM (0ms execution, <3ms across all units, zero Firestore & R2 writes)
  useDynamicRules({
    units,
    versions,
    setVersions,
    setUnits,
    store,
    year: effectiveYear,
    autoEvaluate: true,
  });

  const toggleVersionActive = () => {
    if (!activeVersion) return;
    // Always keep isDynamicActive: true permanently
    updateVersions(versions.map(v => ({ ...v, isDynamicActive: true })));
  };

    store,
    location,

  });

  const enrichedProjects = useMemo(() => enrichProjects(projects, tasks, delegationGroups), [projects, tasks, delegationGroups]);

  const aggregatedData = useMemo(() => {
    const dataMap: Record<string, any> = {};

    // Pre-index tasks by project code
    const tasksByCodeMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
    tasks.forEach((t) => {
      if (!t || !t.name || !t.projectCode) return;
      const rawCode = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase();
      const codeParts = rawCode.split(/[+;,/]/).map((c) => c.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      codeParts.forEach((c) => {
        let list = tasksByCodeMap.get(c);
        if (!list) {
          list = [];
          tasksByCodeMap.set(c, list);
        }
        list.push(t);
      });
    });

    // Initialize with mapped shapes
    const parsedUnits = JSON.parse(unitNamesStr);
    parsedUnits.forEach((u: any) => {

      if (!uName) return;
      dataMap[uName] = {
        name: u.name || '',
        id: u.id,
        unit: u.name || '',

        profit: 0,

        marginByCp: 0,
        hcmSalesEffi: 0,
        hcmMargin: 0,

        actStatus: "",
        startDate: "",
        endDate: "",

        vendorCode: "",
        brandCode: "",
        brandName: "",
        classCode: "",
        appProjectStatus: "",
        appProjectBudget: 0,
        appProjectActual: 0,

        appProjectActStatus: "",
        appActStatus: "",
        appProjectDetail: "",
        appDetail: "",
        appProjectDescription: "",
        appDescription: "",
        appProjectParty: "",
        appParty: "",
      };
    });

      if (key && dataMap[key]) {

        dataMap[key].sales = sumData.salesAmount || 0;
        dataMap[key].salesByCp = sumData.salesByCp || 0;
        dataMap[key].salesByHcmcate = sumData.salesByHcmcate || 0;
        dataMap[key].profit = sumData.profitAmount || 0;

          const finish = new Date(t.finish);

        });

      } else if (p.taskSummaries && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
        const activeTasks = p.taskSummaries.filter((t: any) => {
          if (!t.start || !t.finish) return false;
          const start = new Date(t.start);
          const finish = new Date(t.finish);
          return now >= start && now <= finish;
        });
        activeTaskNames = activeTasks.map((t: any) => t.name);

        ? activeTaskNames.join('; ')
        : (allMatchedTasks.map((t: any) => t.name).join('; ') || (p.taskSummaries?.map((t: any) => t.name).join('; ') || ''));

        }
      });

            dataMap[code].year = pMeta.year || (p.year ? String(p.year) : String(effectiveYear));

            dataMap[code].appMdStatus = mdStatusStr;

            dataMap[code].appDetail = detailStr;

            dataMap[code].appDescription = descStr;

            dataMap[code].appProjectParty = partyStr;
            dataMap[code].appParty = partyStr;
         }
      });
    });

    return dataMap;
  }, [unitNamesStr, summaryData, enrichedProjects, tasks, store, location, effectiveYear, delegationGroups]);

  // Evaluates rules for a given group against a unit shape
  const matchRules = (unit: UnitShape, rules: GroupRule[] | undefined) => {
    if (!rules || rules.length === 0) return false;
    const uName = (unit.name || '').toLowerCase();
    const data = uName ? aggregatedData[uName] : null;
    if (!data) return false;

    // Must pass all rules (AND condition)
    return rules.every((rule) => {
      let val = data[rule.field];
      const f = String(rule.field || '').toLowerCase().trim();

      // 1. Explicit App Data / Real-time Project checks (Strictly from App Projects & Live Task Summaries - ZERO Excel)
      if (f === 'appprojectstatus' || f === 'appstatus' || f === 'app: status' || f === 'status' || f === 'projectstatus') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectStatus || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'apptask' || f === 'app: task' || f === 'app: task summarize' || f === 'app: task summaries' || f === 'app: tasks' || f === 'task' || f === 'tasks' || f === 'tasksummaries' || f === 'task summarize' || f === 'task summary' || f === 'task name') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.task || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'appprojectyear' || f === 'appyear' || f === 'app: year') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectYear || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'appprojectcode' || f === 'appcode' || f === 'app: project code') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectCode || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'appprojectfloor' || f === 'appfloor' || f === 'app: floor') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.location || data.floor || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'appprojectmdstatus' || f === 'appmdstatus' || f === 'app: md status' || f === 'app:md status') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectMdStatus || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'appprojectactstatus' || f === 'appactstatus' || f === 'app: act status' || f === 'app:act status' || f === 'actstatus') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectActStatus || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'appprojectdetail' || f === 'appdetail' || f === 'app: detail (project)' || f === 'detail') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectDetail || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'appprojectdescription' || f === 'appdescription' || f === 'app: description (project)' || f === 'description (project)') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectDescription || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'appprojectparty' || f === 'appparty' || f === 'app: party' || f === 'party') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectParty || '') : '';
      } else if (f === 'appprojectbudget' || f === 'appbudget' || f === 'app: budget' || f === 'budget') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectBudget ?? 0) : 0;
      } else if (f === 'appprojectactual' || f === 'appactual' || f === 'app: actual' || f === 'actual') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectActual ?? 0) : 0;
      } else if (val === undefined || val === null || String(val).trim() === '') {
        // 2. General attribute fallbacks
        if (f === 'floor' || f === 'location') {
          val = data.floor || unit.location || location || '';
        } else if (f === 'year') {
          val = data.year || String(effectiveYear);
        } else if (f === 'mdstatus') {
          val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectMdStatus || data.mdStatus || '') : (data.mdStatus || '');
        } else if (f === 'unit' || f === 'code') {
          val = data.unit || data.appProjectCode || unit.name || '';
        }
      }

      if (rule.field === "margin" || rule.field === "marginByCp") {
        val = val * 100; // evaluate margin as percentage, e.g. 25 instead of 0.25
      }

      const numVal = Number(rule.value);
      const isNum = !isNaN(numVal) && rule.value.trim() !== "";
      
      let res = false;
      
      let compareValStr = String(val || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      let compareRuleStr = String(rule.value || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      if (compareRuleStr === "in progress") compareRuleStr = "on process";
      if (compareValStr === "in progress") compareValStr = "on process";

      switch (rule.operator) {
        case ">":
          res = isNum ? Number(val) > numVal : false; break;
        case "<":
          res = isNum ? Number(val) < numVal : false; break;
        case ">=":
          res = isNum ? Number(val) >= numVal : false; break;
        case "<=":
          res = isNum ? Number(val) <= numVal : false; break;
        case "=":
          res = compareValStr === compareRuleStr; break;
        case "contains": {
          const searchTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/);
          res = searchTerms.every(term => compareValStr.includes(term));
          break;
        }
        case "or":
        case "OR": {
          const orTerms = compareRuleStr
            .split(/[\r\n\t,;+/&|]+|\s{2,}/)
            .map(t => {
              let tr = t.trim();
              if (tr === "in progress") tr = "on process";
              return tr;
            })
            .filter(Boolean);
          if (orTerms.length === 0) {
            const spaceTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
            res = spaceTerms.some(term => compareValStr === term || compareValStr.includes(term));
          } else {
            res = orTerms.some(term => {
              if (compareValStr === term) return true;
              if (compareValStr.includes(term)) return true;
              if (isNum && !isNaN(Number(term)) && Number(val) === Number(term)) return true;
              return false;
            });
          }
          break;
        }
        case "exclude": {
          const searchTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/);
          res = !searchTerms.some(term => compareValStr.includes(term));
          break;
        }
        default:
          res = false; break;
      }
      
      return res;
    });
  };

  const applyRules = async () => {
    try {
      const { totalEvaluatedUnits } = applyAllDynamicRulesForStore(store);
      const allUpdatedVersions = useDataStore.getState().getAllStoreVersions(store);
      const allUpdatedUnits = useDataStore.getState().getAllStoreUnits(store);

      setVersions(allUpdatedVersions);
      setUnits(allUpdatedUnits);

      // Immediately trigger background R2 sync when user confirms and applies rules
      await triggerBackgroundR2Sync(store);

      alert(`Đã áp dụng điều kiện logic cho toàn bộ các version trên tất cả các tầng tại ${store} (${totalEvaluatedUnits} units). Dữ liệu đã được lưu lên Cloudflare R2.`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Lỗi khi áp dụng rules:", err);
      alert(`Có lỗi xảy ra khi áp dụng rules: ${err?.message || err}`);
    }
  };

  const currentLocationUnits = useMemo(() => {
    if (!location) return units;
    const matched = units.filter(u => !u.location || u.location === location);
    return matched.length > 0 ? matched : units;
  }, [units, location]);

  const addVersion = () => {
    const name = prompt(`Tên version mới cho [${store} - ${location} - ${effectiveYear}]:`);
    if (name) {
      const existingVer = versions.find(v => (v.location === location || !v.location) && (v.groups || []).length > 0);
      const existingBg = versions.find(v => (v.location === location || !v.location) && v.backgroundUrl)?.backgroundUrl || null;
      
      const inheritedGroups = existingVer ? existingVer.groups.map(g => ({
        ...g,
        id: uuidv4(),
        rules: g.rules ? g.rules.map(r => ({ ...r })) : [],
      })) : [];

      const newVersion: MapVersion = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        name,
        backgroundUrl: existingBg,
        backgroundScale: 1,
        backgroundPos: { x: 0, y: 0 },
        groups: inheritedGroups,
        groupMappings: {},
        store,
        location,
        isDynamicActive: true,
        year: String(effectiveYear),
      };
      updateVersions([...versions, newVersion]);
      setActiveVersionId(newVersion.id);
    }
  };

  const duplicateVersion = () => {
    if (!activeVersion) return;
    const name = prompt("Tên version mới (bản sao):", `${activeVersion.name} (Copy)`);
    if (name) {
      const newVersionId = uuidv4();
      const newGroups = (activeVersion.groups || []).map(g => ({
        ...g,
        id: uuidv4(),
        rules: g.rules ? g.rules.map(r => ({ ...r })) : [],
      }));
      const newGroupMappings: Record<string, string[]> = {};
      (activeVersion.groups || []).forEach((g, idx) => {
        const newGId = newGroups[idx]?.id;
        if (newGId) {
          newGroupMappings[newGId] = [...(activeVersion.groupMappings?.[g.id] || [])];
        }
      });

      const newVersion: MapVersion = {
        ...activeVersion,
        id: newVersionId,
        name,
        store: store || activeVersion.store || 'HCM',
        location: location || activeVersion.location || 'L1',
        year: String(effectiveYear),
        groups: newGroups,
        groupMappings: newGroupMappings,
        isDynamicActive: true,
      };
      updateVersions([...versions, newVersion]);
      setActiveVersionId(newVersion.id);
    }
  };

  const deleteVersion = () => {
    if (!activeVersion) return;
    if (!confirm(`Bạn có chắc muốn xoá version "${activeVersion.name}" (${activeVersion.store || store} - ${activeVersion.location || location} - ${activeVersion.year || effectiveYear})?`))
      return;
    const newVersions = versions.filter((v) => v.id !== activeVersion.id);
    updateVersions(newVersions);

    // Find remaining version in the same partition (store, location, effectiveYear)
    const remainingInPartition = newVersions.filter(v => {
      const matchStore = !v.store || v.store === store;
      const matchLoc = !v.location || v.location === location;
      const matchYear = String(v.year || '').trim() === String(effectiveYear).trim();
      return matchStore && matchLoc && matchYear;
    });

    setActiveVersionId(remainingInPartition.length > 0 ? remainingInPartition[0].id : null);
  };

  const addGroup = () => {
    if (!activeVersion) return alert("Hãy tạo hoặc chọn một Version trước.");
    const name = prompt("Tên group mới cho version này:");
    if (name) {
      const color =
        "#" +
        Math.floor(Math.random() * 16777215)
          .toString(16)
          .padStart(6, "0");
      const newGroup = { id: uuidv4(), name, color, rules: [] };

      updateVersions(
        versions.map((v) => {
          if (v.id === activeVersion.id) {
            return {
              ...v,
              groups: [...(v.groups || []), newGroup],
              groupMappings: { ...v.groupMappings, [newGroup.id]: [] },
            };
          }
          return v;
        }),
      );
    }
  };

  const deleteGroup = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!confirm("Xoá group này khỏi version hiện tại?")) return;
    updateVersions(
      versions.map((v) => {
        if (v.id === viewVersionId) {
          const newMappings = { ...v.groupMappings };
          delete newMappings[id];
          return {
            ...v,
            groups: v.groups.filter((g) => g.id !== id),
            groupMappings: newMappings,
          };
        }
        return v;
      }),
    );
  };

  const renameGroup = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const group = activeVersion?.groups.find(g => g.id === id);
    if (!group) return;
    const newName = prompt("Đổi tên group:", group.name);
    if (newName && newName !== group.name) {
      updateVersions(
        versions.map((v) => {
          if (v.id === viewVersionId) {
            return {
              ...v,
              groups: v.groups.map((g) =>
                g.id === id ? { ...g, name: newName } : g,
              ),
            };
          }
          return v;
        }),
      );
    }
  };

  const updateGroupColor = (groupId: string, color: string) => {
    updateVersions(
      versions.map((v) => {
        if (v.id === viewVersionId) {
          return {
            ...v,
            groups: v.groups.map((g) =>
              g.id === groupId ? { ...g, color } : g,
            ),
          };
        }
        return v;
      }),
    );
  };

  const updateGroupOpacity = (groupId: string, opacity: number) => {
    updateVersions(
      versions.map((v) => {
        if (v.id === viewVersionId) {
          return {
            ...v,
            groups: v.groups.map((g) =>
              g.id === groupId ? { ...g, opacity } : g,
            ),
          };
        }
        return v;
      }),
    );
  };

  const addRuleToGroup = (groupId: string) => {
    updateVersions(
      versions.map((v) => {
        if (v.id === viewVersionId) {
          return {
            ...v,
            groups: v.groups.map((g) => {
              if (g.id === groupId) {
                const newRules = [
                  ...(g.rules || []),
                  { field: "sales", operator: ">", value: "0" },
                ];
                return { ...g, rules: newRules };
              }
              return g;
            }),
          };
        }
        return v;
      }),
    );
  };

  const updateRule = (
    groupId: string,
    ruleIndex: number,
    attr: keyof GroupRule,
    value: string,
  ) => {
    updateVersions(
      versions.map((v) => {
        if (v.id === viewVersionId) {
          return {
            ...v,
            groups: v.groups.map((g) => {
              if (g.id === groupId && g.rules) {
                const newRules = [...g.rules];
                newRules[ruleIndex] = { ...newRules[ruleIndex], [attr]: value };
                return { ...g, rules: newRules };
              }
              return g;
            }),
          };
        }
        return v;
      }),
    );
  };

  const deleteRule = (groupId: string, ruleIndex: number) => {
    updateVersions(
      versions.map((v) => {
        if (v.id === viewVersionId) {
          return {
            ...v,
            groups: v.groups.map((g) => {
              if (g.id === groupId && g.rules) {
                const newRules = [...g.rules];
                newRules.splice(ruleIndex, 1);
                return { ...g, rules: newRules };
              }
              return g;
            }),
          };
        }
        return v;
      }),
    );
  };

  const copyGroups = (sourceVersionId: string) => {
    const sourceVersion = versions.find((v) => v.id === sourceVersionId);
    if (!sourceVersion || !activeVersion) return;

    if (!confirm(`Bạn có chắc muốn copy groups từ version "${sourceVersion.name}"?\n(Các group hiện tại trong version này sẽ bị thay thế)`)) {
      return;
    }

    const newGroups = sourceVersion.groups.map(g => ({ ...g, id: uuidv4() }));
    const newGroupMappings: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    
    sourceVersion.groups.forEach((g, idx) => {
        const newId = newGroups[idx].id;
        newGroupMappings[newId] = [...(sourceVersion.groupMappings[g.id] || [])];
    });

    updateVersions(
      versions.map((v) => {
        if (v.id === activeVersion.id) {
          return {
            ...v,
            groups: newGroups,
            groupMappings: newGroupMappings,
          };
        }
        return v;
      }),
    );
  };

  const activeGroups = activeVersion?.groups || [];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full gap-6">
      <div className="flex-1 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800/50 p-6 glass flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-3">
              <Calculator className="text-brand-500" /> Dynamic Hierarchy
            </h3>

            {/* Year Filter */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-inner">
              <Calendar size={13} className="text-brand-400" />
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Year:</span>
              <select
                value={effectiveYear}
                onChange={(e) => setGlobalYearFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-transparent border-none text-xs text-white font-bold outline-none cursor-pointer hover:text-brand-300 transition-colors"
                title="Filter Dynamic Hierarchy by Year"
              >
                {availableYears.map(y => (
                  <option key={y} value={y} className="bg-slate-950 text-white font-semibold">{y}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Version Select */}
            <select
              className="bg-slate-950 text-white text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 outline-none cursor-pointer hover:border-brand-500 transition-colors"
              value={viewVersionId || ""}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setActiveVersionId(
                  e.target.value === "" ? null : e.target.value,
                )
              }
            >
              {!viewVersionId && <option value="">-- No Version for {location} ({effectiveYear}) --</option>}
              {filteredVersions.map((v) => (
                <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
                  {v.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-950 text-slate-300 border border-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold" title="Quy hoạch phân vùng dữ liệu theo Store, Vị trí và Năm">
              <span className="text-brand-400 font-bold">{store}</span>
              <span className="text-slate-600">•</span>
              <span className="text-purple-400 font-bold">{location}</span>
              <span className="text-slate-600">•</span>
              <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">{effectiveYear}</span>
              <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px]">({currentLocationUnits.length} units)</span>
            </div>
            {activeVersion && (
              <>
                <button
                  onClick={toggleVersionActive}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold uppercase transition-colors shrink-0 bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/50 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                  title="Dynamic Rules is permanently enabled (Always ON)"
                >
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                  Dynamic Active: ALWAYS ON
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={duplicateVersion}
                  className="p-2 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:text-brand-400 transition-colors"
                  title="Duplicate version"
                >
                  <Copy size={16} />
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={deleteVersion}
                  className="p-2 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors"
                  title="Delete version"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={16} />
                </button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={addVersion}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase shadow-lg hover:bg-brand-500 transition-colors"
            >
              <Plus size={14} /> New Version
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-2">
          {activeVersion ? (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-2 flex-wrap gap-2">
                <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-widest">
                  Rule-Based Groups
                </h4>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  {/* Memory & Cloud Status Indicator */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-[11px] shadow-sm">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" title="Tier 1: Đánh giá RAM 0ms" />
                    <span className="text-slate-300 font-semibold">RAM 0ms</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-600">•</span>
                    {cloudSyncStatus === 'syncing' ? (
                      <span className="text-cyan-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 animate-pulse">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400" />
                        Lưu R2...
                      </span>
                    ) : cloudSyncStatus === 'saved' ? (
                      <span className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Check size={12} className="text-emerald-400" />
                        R2 Đã lưu
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-slate-400 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Cloud size={12} className="text-slate-500" />
                        R2 Sẵn sàng
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <button
                    onClick={applyRules}
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase transition-colors shadow-lg shadow-brand-900/20 box-border border-2 border-brand-400 active:scale-95"
                  >
                    <Calculator size={12} /> Apply Rules
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={addGroup}
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-brand-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase transition-colors active:scale-95"
                  >
                    <Plus size={12} /> Create Group
                  </button>

                  {versions.filter(v => v.id !== activeVersion.id && (v.groups || []).length > 0).length > 0 && (
                    <select
                      className="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-brand-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 outline-none transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      value=""
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        if (e.target.value) {
                            copyGroups(e.target.value);
                            e.target.value = "";
                        }
                      }}
                    >
                        <option value="">[ Copy Groups From ]</option>
                        {versions
                          .filter(v => v.id !== activeVersion.id && (v.groups || []).length > 0)
                          .map(v => (
                            <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
                              {v.store ? `[${v.store}] ` : ""}{v.location ? `[${v.location}] ` : ""}{v.name}{v.year ? ` • ${v.year}` : ""} ({v.groups.length} {v.groups.length === 1 ? 'group' : 'groups'})
                            </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {activeGroups.length === 0 && (
                <div className="text-center py-10 px-6 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-800 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950/40 text-slate-400 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3">
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 border border-brand-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-brand-400">
                    <Calculator size={24} />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-300">
                    Phiên bản này ({activeVersion.name} • {activeVersion.year || effectiveYear}) chưa có nhóm phân loại & quy tắc.
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-md">
                    Mỗi phiên bản (theo từng năm) có nhóm quy tắc riêng. Bạn có thể sao chép nhanh từ phiên bản năm khác hoặc tự tạo nhóm mới.
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3 mt-2">
                    <button
                      onClick={addGroup}
                      className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase transition-colors shadow-md flex items-center gap-1.5"
                    >
                      <Plus size={14} /> Tạo nhóm mới
                    </button>
                    {versions.filter(v => v.id !== activeVersion.id && (v.groups || []).length > 0).map(v => (
                      <button
                        key={v.id}
                        onClick={() => copyGroups(v.id)}
                        className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-brand-400 border border-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5"
                      >
                        <Copy size={13} /> Copy từ {v.name} ({v.year || 'N/A'})
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                {activeGroups.map((group) => {
                  const groupMatchedItems = summaryList.filter((item) => item.matchedGroupId === group.id);
                  const assignedUnits = (group.rules && group.rules.length > 0)
                    ? groupMatchedItems.map((item) => item.unitId)
                    : (activeVersion.groupMappings[group.id] || []);
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={group.id}
                      className="border border-slate-700 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-900/80 hover:border-brand-500/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-slate-800 border-b border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <ColorPicker
                            color={group.color}
                            onChange={(color) => updateGroupColor(group.id, color)}
                            className="shrink-0"
                          />
                          <input
                            type="range"
                            min="0"
                            max="1"
                            step="0.1"
                            value={group.opacity ?? 0.6}
                            title={`Opacity: ${group.opacity ?? 0.6}`}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updateGroupOpacity(
                                group.id,
                                parseFloat(e.target.value),
                              )
                            }
                            className="w-12 h-1 accent-brand-500 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                          />
                          <span 
                            className="text-sm font-bold text-white ml-2 cursor-pointer hover:text-brand-400 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 group/title"
                            onClick={(e) => renameGroup(group.id, e)}
                          >
                            {group.name}
                            <Edit2 size={10} className="opacity-0 group-hover/title:opacity-100" />
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 bg-slate-700 px-2 py-1 rounded-md font-medium">
                            {assignedUnits.length} Matches
                          </span>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { DynamicUnitSummaryItem } from '../../lib/dynamicSummaryEngine';
import { Search, Filter, CheckCircle2, Clock, AlertTriangle, Building, Eye, ChevronDown, ChevronUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../../../lib/utils';
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from '../../../DebouncedSearchInput';

interface DynamicUnitSummaryTableProps {
  summaryList: DynamicUnitSummaryItem[];
  selectedUnitId?: string | null;
  onSelectUnit?: (unitId: string) => void;
  title?: string;
  isCompact?: boolean;
}

export const DynamicUnitSummaryTable: React.FC<DynamicUnitSummaryTableProps> = React.memo(({
  summaryList,
  selectedUnitId,
  onSelectUnit,
  title = "Bảng Tổng Hợp So Sánh & Màu Tô Thực Tế (Dynamic Unit Summary)",
  isCompact = false,
}) => {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('all');
  const [groupFilter, setGroupFilter] = useState('all');
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(true);

  // Available groups for filter dropdown
  const availableGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = new Set<string>();
    summaryList.forEach((item) => {
      if (item.matchedGroupName) groups.add(item.matchedGroupName);
    });
    return Array.from(groups);
  }, [summaryList]);

  // Filtered units list
  const filteredList = useMemo(() => {
    return summaryList.filter((item) => {
      const matchSearch =
        !searchTerm.trim() ||
        item.unitName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim()) ||
        item.appProjectCode.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim()) ||
        item.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim()) ||
        item.brandName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim());

      const matchStatus =
        statusFilter === 'all' ||
        (statusFilter === 'has_project' && item.hasAppProject) ||
        (statusFilter === 'no_project' && !item.hasAppProject) ||
        item.appProjectStatus.toLowerCase() === statusFilter.toLowerCase();

      const matchGroup =
        groupFilter === 'all' ||
        (groupFilter === 'unassigned' && !item.matchedGroupId) ||
        item.matchedGroupName === groupFilter;

      return matchSearch && matchStatus && matchGroup;
    });
  }, [summaryList, searchTerm, statusFilter, groupFilter]);

  const getStatusBadge = (item: DynamicUnitSummaryItem) => {
    if (!item.hasAppProject || !item.appProjectStatus) {
      return (
        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 border border-slate-700">
          No Project
        </span>
      );
    }

    const s = item.appProjectStatus.toLowerCase();
    if (s.includes('completed') || s.includes('done')) {
      return (
        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-1">
          <CheckCircle2 size={10} /> Completed
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (s.includes('on process') || s.includes('in progress')) {
      return (
        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center gap-1">
          <Clock size={10} /> On process
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (s.includes('upcoming') || s.includes('planning')) {
      return (
        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center gap-1">
          <Clock size={10} /> Upcoming
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (s.includes('delay') || s.includes('late')) {
      return (
        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30 flex items-center gap-1">
          <AlertTriangle size={10} /> Delay
        </span>
      );
    }

    return (
      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border border-slate-700">
        {item.appProjectStatus}
      </span>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
      {/* Header */}
      <div 
        onClick={() => setIsExpanded(!isExpanded)}
        className="px-4 py-3 bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer select-none hover:bg-slate-950 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Building className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-400" />
          <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
            {title}
          </h4>
          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold rounded-full bg-brand-600/20 text-brand-300 border border-brand-500/30">
            {filteredList.length} / {summaryList.length} units
          </span>
        </div>
        <button className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1">
          {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp size={16} /> : <ChevronDown size={16} />}
        </button>
      </div>

      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="p-3 space-y-3 flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0">
          {/* Filter Toolbar */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[140px]">
              <Search size={13} className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 z-10 pointer-events-none" />
              <DebouncedSearchInput
                placeholder="Tìm Unit, Project Code, Brand..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(val) => setSearchTerm(val)}
                debounceMs={250}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg pl-8 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </div>

            <select
              value={statusFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
            >
              <option value="all">Tất cả Status</option>
              <option value="has_project">Có Dự Án</option>

              <option value="on process">On Process</option>
              <option value="upcoming">Upcoming</option>
              <option value="completed">Completed</option>
              <option value="delay">Delay</option>
            </select>

            {availableGroups.length > 0 && (
              <select
                value={groupFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setGroupFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-300 outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              >
                <option value="all">Tất cả Nhóm Màu</option>
                {availableGroups.map((g) => (
                  <option key={g} value={g}>{g}</option>
                ))}
                <option value="unassigned">Chưa gán nhóm</option>
              </select>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Table */}
          <div className={cn("overflow-auto custom-scrollbar rounded-xl border border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-950/40", isCompact ? "max-h-56" : "max-h-80")}>
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">

                  <th className="px-3 py-2">Dự Án (App)</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2">App Status</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2">Nhóm Màu (Rule)</th>

                </tr>

              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-mono">
                {filteredList.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-slate-500 italic text-xs">
                      Không tìm thấy gian hàng nào khớp bộ lọc.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  filteredList.map((item) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedUnitId === item.unitId;
                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={item.unitId}
                        onClick={() => onSelectUnit?.(item.unitId)}
                        className={cn(
                          "hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer group",

                            <span className="text-slate-600">-</span>

                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          {getStatusBadge(item)}

import React, { Fragment, memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

interface EditTabProps {

function SearchableSelect({ 
    options, 
    value, 
    onChange 
}: { 
    options: { value: string, label: string }[], 
    value: string, 
    onChange: (val: string) => void 
}) {
    const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = React.useState(value || '');
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = React.useState(false);
    const wrapperRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    // Keep searchTerm in sync when the selected unit changes
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setSearchTerm(value || '');
    }, [value]);

    React.useEffect(() => {
        function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
            if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
                setIsOpen(false);
            }
        }
        document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
        return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    }, []);

    const filteredOptions = options.filter(opt => 
        (opt.label || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || (opt.value || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
    );

    const handleCommit = (valToCommit?: string) => {
        const finalVal = (valToCommit !== undefined ? valToCommit : searchTerm).trim();
        if (finalVal !== value) {
            onChange(finalVal);
        }
        setIsOpen(false);
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleCommit();
        }
    };

    return (
        <div ref={wrapperRef} className="relative w-full">
            <div className="relative">
                <input 
                    type="text"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg pl-3 pr-8 py-2 text-sm text-slate-200 outline-none focus:border-brand-500 transition-colors font-medium"
                    value={searchTerm}
