  marginByCp: number;
  hcmSalesEffi: number;
  hcmMargin: number;
  mdStatus: string;
  mdNotes: string;
  excelProjectStatus: string;
  vendorCode: string;
  brandCode: string;
  brandName: string;
  classCode: string;
  // Dynamic Evaluation Result
  matchedGroupId: string | null;
  matchedGroupName: string | null;
  color: string; // Hex color
  opacity: number;
  matchedRuleReason: string;
  isRestricted?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Pure function to evaluate if a rule matches a unit's aggregated data
 */
export function matchSingleRule(rule: GroupRule, data: DynamicUnitSummaryItem): boolean {
  let val: any = (data as any)[rule.field];

  if (val === undefined || val === null || String(val).trim() === '') {
    const f = String(rule.field || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (f === 'floor' || f === 'location') {
      val = data.location || '';
    } else if (f === 'app: floor' || f === 'appfloor' || f === 'appprojectfloor') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.location || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'year') {
      val = data.year || '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectyear' || f === 'app: year' || f === 'appyear') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectYear || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'status' || f === 'projectstatus' || f === 'appprojectstatus' || f === 'app: status' || f === 'appstatus') {
      val = (data.hasAppProject && data.appProjectStatus) ? data.appProjectStatus : '';
    } else if (f === 'unit' || f === 'code') {
      val = data.unitName || '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectcode' || f === 'app: project code' || f === 'appcode') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectCode || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'mdstatus') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectMdStatus || '') : (data.mdStatus || '');
    } else if (f === 'appprojectmdstatus' || f === 'appmdstatus' || f === 'app: md status' || f === 'app:md status') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectMdStatus || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'actstatus' || f === 'appprojectactstatus' || f === 'appactstatus' || f === 'app: act status' || f === 'app:act status') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectActStatus || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'detail' || f === 'appprojectdetail' || f === 'appdetail' || f === 'app: detail (project)') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectDetail || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'description (project)' || f === 'appprojectdescription' || f === 'appdescription' || f === 'app: description (project)') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectDescription || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'party' || f === 'appprojectparty' || f === 'appparty' || f === 'app: party') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectParty || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'budget' || f === 'appbudget' || f === 'appprojectbudget' || f === 'app: budget') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectBudget ?? 0) : 0;
    } else if (f === 'actual' || f === 'appactual' || f === 'appprojectactual' || f === 'app: actual') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectActual ?? 0) : 0;
    } else if (f === 'apptask' || f === 'app: task' || f === 'app: task summarize' || f === 'app: task summaries' || f === 'app: tasks' || f === 'task' || f === 'tasks' || f === 'tasksummaries' || f === 'task summarize' || f === 'task summary' || f === 'task name') {
      val = (data.hasAppProject && data.task) ? data.task : '';
    } else if (f === 'actprogress' || f === 'act progress') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.actProgress ?? 0) : 0;
    } else if (f === 'planprogress' || f === 'plan progress') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.planProgress ?? 0) : 0;
    }
  }

  if (rule.field === 'margin' || rule.field === 'marginByCp' || rule.field === 'hcmMargin') {
    val = Number(val || 0) * 100;
  }

  const numVal = Number(rule.value);
  const isNum = !isNaN(numVal) && String(rule.value || '').trim() !== '';

  let compareValStr = String(val ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  let compareRuleStr = String(rule.value ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();

  // Normalize synonym status strings
  if (compareRuleStr === 'in progress') compareRuleStr = 'on process';
  if (compareValStr === 'in progress') compareValStr = 'on process';

  switch (rule.operator) {
    case '>':
      return isNum ? Number(val) > numVal : false;
    case '<':
      return isNum ? Number(val) < numVal : false;
    case '>=':
      return isNum ? Number(val) >= numVal : false;
    case '<=':
      return isNum ? Number(val) <= numVal : false;
    case '=':
      return compareValStr === compareRuleStr;
    case 'contains': {
      const searchTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      return searchTerms.every((term) => compareValStr.includes(term));
    }
    case 'or':
    case 'OR': {
      const orTerms = compareRuleStr
        .split(/[\r\n\t,;+/&|]+|\s{2,}/)
        .map((t) => {
          let tr = t.trim();
          if (tr === 'in progress') tr = 'on process';
          return tr;
        })
        .filter(Boolean);
      if (orTerms.length === 0) {
        const spaceTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        return spaceTerms.some((term) => compareValStr === term || compareValStr.includes(term));
      }
      return orTerms.some((term) => {
        if (compareValStr === term) return true;
        if (compareValStr.includes(term)) return true;
        if (isNum && !isNaN(Number(term)) && Number(val) === Number(term)) return true;
        return false;
      });
    }
    case 'exclude': {
      const searchTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      return !searchTerms.some((term) => compareValStr.includes(term));
    }
    default:
      return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Event-Driven Unit Summary Engine Hook
 * Evaluates in RAM (<2ms) and updates ONLY when tasks, projects, versions or filters change.
 */
export function useDynamicUnitSummary({
  units = [],
  activeVersion,
  store = 'HCM',
  location = 'B1',
  year,
}: {
  units?: UnitShape[];
  activeVersion?: MapVersion | null;
  store?: 'HCM' | 'HN';
  location?: string;
  year?: string;
}) {
  const projects = useAppStore((state) => state.projects);
  const tasks = useAppStore((state) => state.tasks);
  const delegationGroups = useAppStore((state) => state.delegationGroups);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalYearFilter);
  const currentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.currentUser);

  const effectiveYear = String(year || globalYearFilter || new Date().getFullYear()).trim();

  // 1. Fetch Excel Master Data
  const unitInfo = useDataStore((state) => state.unitInfo);
  const classInfo = useDataStore((state) => state.classInfo);
  const actualClassInfo = useDataStore((state) => state.actualClassInfo);
  const sales = useDataStore((state) => state.sales);
  const profits = useDataStore((state) => state.profits);
  const subFees = useDataStore((state) => state.subFees);
  const mdStatus = useDataStore((state) => state.mdStatus);
  const projectStatus = useDataStore((state) => state.projectStatus);
  const projectLink = useDataStore((state) => state.projectLink);
  const basePlan = useDataStore((state) => state.basePlan);

  const summaryData = useMemo(() => {
    return calculateSummaryData({
      unitInfo,
      classInfo,
      actualClassInfo,
      sales,
      profits,
      subFees,
      mdStatus,
      projectStatus,
      projectLink,
      basePlan,
      units,
    });
  }, [unitInfo, classInfo, actualClassInfo, sales, profits, subFees, mdStatus, projectStatus, projectLink, basePlan, units]);

  // 2. Pre-enrich projects with live tasks
  const enrichedProjects = useMemo(() => {
    return enrichProjects(projects, tasks, delegationGroups);
  }, [projects, tasks, delegationGroups]);

  // 3. Compute restricted project codes (RBAC)
  const restrictedProjectCodes = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentUser || currentUser.role === 'admin') return new Set<string>();
    const allowedCodeSet = new Set<string>();
    enrichedProjects.forEach((p) => {
      if (p.code) allowedCodeSet.add(String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase());
      if (p.linkCodes) {
        p.linkCodes.split(/[+;,/]/).forEach((c) => {
          if (c.trim()) allowedCodeSet.add(c.trim().toLowerCase());
        });
      }
    });

    const restrictedSet = new Set<string>();
    projects.forEach((p) => {
      const rawCodes = p.linkCodes && p.linkCodes.trim() ? p.linkCodes : String(p.code || '');
      const pCodes = rawCodes.split(/[+;,/]/).map((c) => c.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
      pCodes.forEach((code) => {
        if (!allowedCodeSet.has(code)) {
          restrictedSet.add(code);
        }
      });
    });
    return restrictedSet;
  }, [projects, enrichedProjects, currentUser]);

  // 4. Main Event-Driven Rollup calculation
  const { summaryMap, summaryList, groupStats } = useMemo(() => {
    const sMap = new Map<string, DynamicUnitSummaryItem>();
    const sList: DynamicUnitSummaryItem[] = [];

    // Pre-index tasks by code and projectId for O(1) matching
    const tasksByCodeMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
    const tasksByProjIdMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
    tasks.forEach((t) => {
      if (!t || !t.name) return;
      const tStore = String(t.projectStore || (t as any).store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      const currentStore = String(store || '').trim();
      if (tStore && tStore !== 'ALL' && currentStore && currentStore !== 'all' && tStore !== currentStore.toUpperCase()) return;
      const tYear = String(t.projectYear || (t as any).year || '').trim();
      if (tYear && tYear !== 'ALL' && effectiveYear && effectiveYear !== 'all' && tYear !== String(effectiveYear).trim()) return;

      if (t.projectId) {
        const pId = String(t.projectId).trim().toLowerCase();
        let list = tasksByProjIdMap.get(pId);
        if (!list) {
          list = [];
          tasksByProjIdMap.set(pId, list);
        }
        list.push(t);
      }
      if (t.projectCode) {
        const rawCode = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase();
        const codeParts = rawCode.split(/[+;,/]/).map((c) => c.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        codeParts.forEach((c) => {
          let list = tasksByCodeMap.get(c);
          if (!list) {
            list = [];
            tasksByCodeMap.set(c, list);
          }
          list.push(t);
        });
      }
    });

    // Pre-index Excel summary data
    const summaryLookup = new Map<string, SummaryDataItem>();
    summaryData.forEach((s) => {
      if (s.unit) summaryLookup.set(s.unit.toLowerCase().trim(), s);
    });

    // Pre-index projectLink: maps unit name -> list of linked project codes
    const unitToProjectCodesMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
    (projectLink || []).forEach((pl: any) => {
      const u = String(pl?.unit || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const pCode = String(pl?.code || pl?.projectCode || pl?.project || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (u && pCode) {
        if (!unitToProjectCodesMap.has(u)) unitToProjectCodesMap.set(u, []);
        unitToProjectCodesMap.get(u)!.push(pCode);
      }
    });

    // Step A: Initialize summary item for each unit
    units.forEach((u) => {
      const uName = String(u.name || '').trim();
      const uKey = uName.toLowerCase();
      if (!uName) return;

      const excelItem = summaryLookup.get(uKey);
      const isRestricted = restrictedProjectCodes.has(uKey);

      const item: DynamicUnitSummaryItem = {
        unitId: u.id,
        unitName: uName,
        store: u.store || store,
        location: u.location || location,
        year: effectiveYear,
        hasAppProject: false,
        appProjectCode: '',
        projectName: '',
        appProjectStatus: '',
        appProjectYear: '',
        appProjectMdStatus: '',
        appProjectActStatus: '',
        appProjectDetail: '',
        appProjectDescription: '',
        appProjectParty: '',
        appProjectBudget: 0,
        appProjectActual: 0,
        planProgress: 0,
        actProgress: 0,
        matchedTasksCount: 0,
        task: '',
        activeTasks: [],
        size: typeof excelItem?.size === 'number' ? excelItem.size : (Number(excelItem?.size) || 0),
        sales: excelItem?.salesAmount || 0,
        salesByCp: excelItem?.salesByCp || 0,
        profit: excelItem?.profitAmount || 0,
        profitByCp: excelItem?.profitByCp || 0,
        margin: excelItem?.margin || 0,
        marginByCp: excelItem?.marginByCp || 0,
        hcmSalesEffi: excelItem?.hcmSalesEffi || 0,
        hcmMargin: excelItem?.hcmMargin || 0,
        mdStatus: excelItem?.mdStatus || '',
        mdNotes: excelItem?.mdNotes || '',
        excelProjectStatus: excelItem?.projectStatus || '',
        vendorCode: excelItem?.vendorCode || '',
        brandCode: excelItem?.brandCode || '',
        brandName: excelItem?.brandName || '',
        classCode: excelItem?.classCode || '',
        matchedGroupId: null,
        matchedGroupName: null,
        color: u.fill || '#3b82f6',
        opacity: 0.65,
        matchedRuleReason: 'Màu mặc định',
        isRestricted,
      };

      sMap.set(u.id, item);
      sMap.set(uKey, item);
      sList.push(item);
    });

    // Step B: Match Real-time App Project & Tasks (Filtered STRICTLY by Store, Location & Year)
    enrichedProjects.forEach((p) => {
      if (!p.code && !p.linkCodes) return;

      const pMeta = extractProjectMetadata(p);

      // Strict Scope Matching across all 3 components: Store, Location (Floor), Year
      if (!projectMatchesScope(pMeta, { store, location, year: effectiveYear })) {
        return;
      }

      const pCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(p);

      const status = getStatus(
        p.computedTakStart || p.start,
        p.computedTakCompl || p.handover,
        p.computedOpening || p.opening,
        p.code
      );
      const actStatus = (p as any).computedActStatus || (p as any).actStatus || computeProjectActStatus(p, delegationGroups);

      // Match tasks for this project (by ID, No, Code, linkCodes, and embedded taskSummaries)
      const matchedTaskSet = new Set<any>();
      if (p.id) {
        const pIdLower = String(p.id).trim().toLowerCase();
        const list = tasksByProjIdMap.get(pIdLower);
        if (list) list.forEach((t) => matchedTaskSet.add(t));
      }
      if (p.no) {
        const pNoLower = String(p.no).trim().toLowerCase();
        const list = tasksByProjIdMap.get(pNoLower);
        if (list) list.forEach((t) => matchedTaskSet.add(t));
      }
      pCodes.forEach((c) => {
        const list = tasksByCodeMap.get(c);
        if (list) list.forEach((t) => matchedTaskSet.add(t));
      });
      if (p.code) {
        const list = tasksByCodeMap.get(String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase());
        if (list) list.forEach((t) => matchedTaskSet.add(t));
      }
      if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries)) {
        p.taskSummaries.forEach((ts) => matchedTaskSet.add(ts));
      }

      const allMatchedTasks = Array.from(matchedTaskSet);
      const allTaskNames = allMatchedTasks.map((t: any) => t.name).filter(Boolean);

      const now = new Date();
      const activeTasks = allMatchedTasks.filter((t: any) => {
        const startStr = t.start || t.startDate || t.takStart;
        const finishStr = t.finish || t.end || t.endDate || t.takCompl || t.handover;
        if (!startStr || !finishStr) return false;
        const start = new Date(startStr);
        const finish = new Date(finishStr);
        return now >= start && now <= finish;
      });
      const activeTaskNames = activeTasks.map((t: any) => t.name).filter(Boolean);

      // Full task string contains all sub-tasks so dynamic rules can match any planned, active, or upcoming task
      const taskSummaryStr = allTaskNames.length > 0 
        ? allTaskNames.join('; ')
        : (activeTaskNames.join('; ') || (p.taskSummaries?.map((t: any) => t.name).join('; ') || ''));

      const targetUnitKeys = new Set<string>();
      sList.forEach(item => {
        // Unit must match store, location, and year
        const itemStore = (item.store || store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
        const itemLoc = (item.location || location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
        const itemYear = String(item.year || effectiveYear || '').trim();

        // Strict Store, Location, and Year Isolation
        if (pMeta.store && itemStore && itemStore !== 'ALL' && itemStore !== 'all' && pMeta.store !== itemStore) return;
        const isStorewide = pMeta.location === 'ALL' || pMeta.location === 'STORE' || pMeta.location === 'STOREWIDE' || pMeta.location === 'WHOLE STORE' || pMeta.location === 'ALL FLOORS';
        if (pMeta.location && itemLoc && !isStorewide && pMeta.location !== itemLoc) return;
        if (pMeta.year && itemYear && itemYear !== 'ALL' && itemYear !== 'all' && pMeta.year !== itemYear) return;

        const linkedCodes = [
          ...(unitToProjectCodesMap.get(item.unitName.toLowerCase()) || []),
          ...(unitToProjectCodesMap.get(item.unitId.toLowerCase()) || []),
        ];
        const isLinkedViaProjectLink = linkedCodes.some(lc => 
          pCodes.some(pc => pc.toLowerCase() === lc.toLowerCase() || projectMatchesUnitCode([pc], lc))
        );

        const isExactCode = pCodes.some(c => c.toLowerCase() === item.unitName.toLowerCase() || c.toLowerCase() === item.unitId.toLowerCase());
        const isMatch = isExactCode || isLinkedViaProjectLink || projectMatchesUnitCode(pCodes, item.unitName || item.unitId);

        if (isMatch) {
          targetUnitKeys.add(item.unitId);
          if (item.unitName) targetUnitKeys.add(item.unitName.toLowerCase());
        }
      });

      targetUnitKeys.forEach((code) => {
        const item = sMap.get(code);
        if (item) {
          item.hasAppProject = true;
          item.appProjectCode = String(p.code || code);
          item.projectName = p.name || '';
          item.appProjectStatus = status || '';
          item.appProjectYear = pMeta.year || effectiveYear;
          item.year = pMeta.year || effectiveYear;
          item.appProjectMdStatus = p.mdStatus || '';
          item.appProjectActStatus = actStatus || '';
          item.appProjectDetail = p.detail || '';
          item.appProjectDescription = p.detail || (p as any).description || '';
          item.appProjectParty = p.party || (p as any).contractor || '';
          item.appProjectBudget = p.budget || 0;
          item.appProjectActual = p.actual || 0;
          item.planProgress = p.computedPlanProgress ?? 0;
          item.actProgress = p.computedActProgress ?? 0;
          item.matchedTasksCount = matchedTaskSet.size;
          item.task = taskSummaryStr || item.task || '';
          item.activeTasks = activeTaskNames;
        }
      });
    });

    // Step C: Apply Dynamic Rules strictly from activeVersion (Rules-only evaluation)
    const stats: Record<string, { group: any; count: number; unitNames: string[] }> = {};

    if (activeVersion && Array.isArray(activeVersion.groups)) {
      activeVersion.groups.forEach((group) => {
        stats[group.id] = { group, count: 0, unitNames: [] };
      });

      // Strictly evaluate Dynamic Rules only - NO static manual groupMappings
      activeVersion.groups.forEach((group) => {
        if (!group.rules || group.rules.length === 0) return;

        sList.forEach((item) => {
          if (item.isRestricted) return;

          const isMatch = group.rules.every((rule) => matchSingleRule(rule, item));
          if (isMatch) {
            item.matchedGroupId = group.id;
            item.matchedGroupName = group.name;
            item.color = group.color;
            item.opacity = typeof group.opacity === 'number' ? group.opacity : 0.65;
            item.matchedRuleReason = group.rules
              .map((r) => `${r.field} ${r.operator} ${r.value}`)
              .join(' AND ');
          }
        });
      });

      // Calculate statistics
      sList.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.matchedGroupId && stats[item.matchedGroupId]) {
          stats[item.matchedGroupId].count++;
          stats[item.matchedGroupId].unitNames.push(item.unitName);
        }
      });
    }

    return {
      summaryMap: sMap,
      summaryList: sList,
      groupStats: Object.values(stats),
    };
  }, [units, activeVersion, store, location, effectiveYear, summaryData, enrichedProjects, tasks, projects, restrictedProjectCodes, delegationGroups]);

  return {
    summaryMap,
    summaryList,
    groupStats,
    effectiveYear,
  };
}

import type { S3Client as S3ClientType } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';

export async function getS3Sdk() {
  const [s3Module, presignerModule] = await Promise.all([
    import('@aws-sdk/client-s3'),
    import('@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner')
  ]);
  return {
    S3Client: s3Module.S3Client,
    PutObjectCommand: s3Module.PutObjectCommand,
    GetObjectCommand: s3Module.GetObjectCommand,
    ListObjectsV2Command: s3Module.ListObjectsV2Command,
    DeleteObjectCommand: s3Module.DeleteObjectCommand,
    getSignedUrl: presignerModule.getSignedUrl,
  };
}

export interface R2Credentials {

/**
 * Extracts R2 object key from an r2:// link, signed/public R2 URL, or direct object key
 */
export function extractR2Key(url: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!url) return null;
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  if (trimmed.startsWith('r2://')) {
    return trimmed.replace('r2://', '');
  }

  // If it's a full URL (signed R2 URL, dev/custom domain URL, or S3 endpoint URL)
  if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://')) {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(trimmed);
      const pathname = decodeURIComponent(parsed.pathname).replace(/^\/+/, '');
      // If pathname starts with bucket name (e.g. hcmlayout/key)
      const pathParts = pathname.split('/');
      const filename = pathParts[pathParts.length - 1];

      // Check if filename matches bg_* pattern
      const bgMatch = filename.match(/(bg_[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)/i);
      if (bgMatch) {
        return bgMatch[1];
      }

      if (filename) {
        return filename;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore URL parse error
    }

    // Match bg_* pattern anywhere in string
    const match = trimmed.match(/(bg_[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+\.(jpeg|jpg|png|webp|gif))/i);
    if (match) {
      return match[1];
    }
  } else {
    // If not a full URL or data URI, check if it's a plain filename/key
    if (!trimmed.startsWith('data:') && !trimmed.startsWith('blob:')) {
      return trimmed;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Retrieve saved R2 credentials from useAppStore or localStorage with multi-key fallback
 */
export function getStoredR2Credentials(): R2Credentials | null {
  let accountId = '';
  let accessKeyId = '';
  let secretAccessKey = '';
  let bucketName = '';

  try {
    const r2Config = useAppStore.getState().r2Config;
    if (r2Config) {
      accountId = (r2Config.accountId || '').trim();
      accessKeyId = (r2Config.accessKeyId || '').trim();
      secretAccessKey = (r2Config.secretAccessKey || '').trim();
      bucketName = (r2Config.bucketName || '').trim();
    }
  } catch {
    // fallback to localStorage if store not yet ready
  }

  // Check taka_cache_r2_config_v1
  if (!accountId || !accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey || !bucketName) {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem('taka_cache_r2_config_v1');
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        const a = parsed?.accountId || parsed?.account_id;
        const k = parsed?.accessKeyId || parsed?.access_key_id || parsed?.accessKey;
        const s = parsed?.secretAccessKey || parsed?.secret_access_key || parsed?.secretKey;
        const b = parsed?.bucketName || parsed?.bucket_name;
        if (a && k && s && b) {
          accountId = String(a).trim();
          accessKeyId = String(k).trim();
          secretAccessKey = String(s).trim();
          bucketName = String(b).trim();
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  if (!accountId) accountId = (localStorage.getItem('r2_account_id') || '').trim();
  if (!accessKeyId) accessKeyId = (localStorage.getItem('r2_access_key') || localStorage.getItem('r2_access_key_id') || '').trim();
  if (!secretAccessKey) secretAccessKey = (localStorage.getItem('r2_secret_key') || localStorage.getItem('r2_secret_access_key') || '').trim();
  if (!bucketName) bucketName = (localStorage.getItem('r2_bucket_name') || '').trim();

  if (!accountId || !accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey || !bucketName) {
    return null;
  }
  return { accountId, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, bucketName };
}

/**
 * Validates R2 credentials format to detect misconfigurations (such as pasting AccessKey into SecretKey)
 */
export function isR2CredentialsValid(creds: R2Credentials | null): { valid: boolean; reason?: string } {
  if (!creds) return { valid: false, reason: 'Chưa cấu hình Cloudflare R2' };
  if (!creds.accountId || !creds.bucketName || !creds.accessKeyId || !creds.secretAccessKey) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Thiếu thông tin tài khoản hoặc Access/Secret Key' };
  }
  if (creds.accessKeyId.trim() === creds.secretAccessKey.trim()) {
    return { 
      valid: false, 
      reason: 'Secret Access Key đang bị trùng với Access Key ID (Key bí mật của Cloudflare R2 là chuỗi 64 ký tự hex, không phải chuỗi 32 ký tự của Access Key ID).' 
    };
  }
  return { valid: true };
}

/**
 * Asynchronously retrieve R2 credentials, with fallback to Firestore taka_config/r2_credentials
 * on fresh accounts / cold boots before configCacheService sync completes.
 */
export async function getStoredR2CredentialsAsync(): Promise<R2Credentials | null> {
  const syncCreds = getStoredR2Credentials();
  if (syncCreds) return syncCreds;

  try {
    const { doc, getDoc } = await import('firebase/firestore');
    const { db, APP_ID } = await import('../../../lib/firebase');
    const r2Doc = await getDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "r2_credentials"));
    if (r2Doc.exists()) {
      const data = r2Doc.data() as any;
      const acc = (data?.accountId || data?.account_id || '').trim();
      const bkt = (data?.bucketName || data?.bucket_name || '').trim();
      const key = (data?.accessKeyId || data?.access_key_id || data?.accessKey || '').trim();
      const sec = (data?.secretAccessKey || data?.secret_access_key || data?.secretKey || '').trim();

      if (acc && bkt && key && sec) {
        const creds: R2Credentials = {
          accountId: acc,
          accessKeyId: key,
          secretAccessKey: sec,
          bucketName: bkt,
        };
        try {
          useAppStore.getState().setR2Config(creds);
        } catch {}
        try {
          localStorage.setItem('r2_account_id', creds.accountId);
          localStorage.setItem('r2_bucket_name', creds.bucketName);
          localStorage.setItem('r2_access_key', creds.accessKeyId);
          localStorage.setItem('r2_access_key_id', creds.accessKeyId);
          localStorage.setItem('r2_secret_key', creds.secretAccessKey);
          localStorage.setItem('r2_secret_access_key', creds.secretAccessKey);
          localStorage.setItem('taka_cache_r2_config_v1', JSON.stringify(creds));
        } catch {}
        return creds;
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[R2 Async Creds] Failed to fetch r2_credentials from Firestore:', err);
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Resolves an r2:// link, R2 object key, or expired signed URL into a valid presigned HTTP GET URL.
 */
export async function resolveR2UrlToHttp(url: string | null | undefined): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!url) return null;
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  if (trimmed.startsWith('blob:') || trimmed.startsWith('data:')) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  const r2Key = extractR2Key(trimmed);
  // If it's a regular external HTTP URL (not R2), return directly
  if (!r2Key && (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://'))) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  if (r2Key) {
    const creds = await getStoredR2CredentialsAsync();
    if (creds) {
      try {
        const { S3Client, GetObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
        const s3 = new S3Client({
          region: 'auto',
          endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
          credentials: { accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId, secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey },
        });
        const command = new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: creds.bucketName, Key: r2Key });
        return await getSignedUrl(s3, command, { expiresIn: 3600 * 24 * 7 });
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[R2 Resolve] Could not generate presigned url for key:', r2Key, err);
      }
    }
  }

  return trimmed.startsWith('r2://') ? null : trimmed;
}

/**
 * Test R2 connection and CORS policy by attempting a temporary test upload
 */
export async function testR2Connection(creds: R2Credentials): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message: string }> {
  try {
    const { S3Client, PutObjectCommand, DeleteObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
    const s3 = new S3Client({
      region: 'auto',
      endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId.trim()}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
      credentials: {
        accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId.trim(),
        secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey.trim(),
      },
    });

    const testKey = '.r2_cors_check.txt';
    const testBlob = new Blob(['cors-ok'], { type: 'text/plain' });
    const command = new PutObjectCommand({
      Bucket: creds.bucketName.trim(),
      Key: testKey,
      ContentType: 'text/plain',
    });

    const signedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, command, { expiresIn: 300 });
    const res = await fetch(signedUrl, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' },
      body: testBlob,
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      // Clean up test file
      try {
        const delCmd = new DeleteObjectCommand({
          Bucket: creds.bucketName.trim(),
          Key: testKey,
        });
        const delUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, delCmd, { expiresIn: 300 });
        await fetch(delUrl, { method: 'DELETE' });
      } catch (_) {}

      return { ok: true, message: 'Kết nối và quyền ghi Cloudflare R2 thành công (CORS hoạt động chuẩn)!' };
    }

    const errText = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    if (res.status === 403) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: 'Lỗi 403: Sai Access Key / Secret Key hoặc API Token không có quyền ghi ("Object Read & Write").',
      };
    }
    if (res.status === 404) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: `Lỗi 404: Không tìm thấy Bucket "${creds.bucketName}". Vui lòng kiểm tra lại tên Bucket.`,
      };
    }
    return { ok: false, message: `Lỗi R2 HTTP ${res.status}: ${errText.substring(0, 100)}` };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[R2 Test] Connection error:', err);
    const msg = err?.message || String(err);
    if (msg.includes('Failed to fetch') || msg.includes('NetworkError') || msg.includes('CORS')) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: 'Lỗi CORS: Bucket chưa được bật CORS trên Cloudflare R2 Dashboard. Trình duyệt đã chặn gửi file!',
      };
    }
    return { ok: false, message: `Lỗi kết nối: ${msg}` };
  }
}

/**
 * List objects in an R2 bucket (with presigned GET URL fallback for CORS safety)
 */
export async function listR2Objects(
  creds: R2Credentials,
  s3: S3ClientType,
  prefix?: string
): Promise<string[]> {
  try {
    const { ListObjectsV2Command, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
    const command = new ListObjectsV2Command({
      Bucket: creds.bucketName,
      Prefix: prefix || undefined,
    });
    const res = await s3.send(command);
    return (res.Contents || []).map((c) => c.Key).filter(Boolean) as string[];
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn('[R2 List] Direct list failed, trying presigned GET URL fallback:', err);
    try {
      const { ListObjectsV2Command, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
      const command = new ListObjectsV2Command({
        Bucket: creds.bucketName,
        Prefix: prefix || undefined,
      });
      const signedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, command, { expiresIn: 300 });
      const res = await fetch(signedUrl);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const text = await res.text();
      const keys: string[] = [];
      const regex = /<Key>([^<]+)<\/Key>/g;
      let match;
      while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
        keys.push(match[1]);
      }
      return keys;
    } catch (fallbackErr: any) {
      console.error('[R2 List] Failed to list objects:', fallbackErr);
      return [];
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Delete a single object in R2 with presigned DELETE fallback
 */
export async function deleteR2Object(
  key: string,
  creds: R2Credentials,
  s3: S3ClientType
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const { DeleteObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
    const command = new DeleteObjectCommand({
      Bucket: creds.bucketName,
      Key: key,
    });
    await s3.send(command);
    return true;
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn(`[R2 Delete] Direct delete failed for "${key}", trying presigned DELETE:`, err);
    try {
      const { DeleteObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
      const command = new DeleteObjectCommand({
        Bucket: creds.bucketName,
        Key: key,
      });
      const signedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, command, { expiresIn: 300 });
      const res = await fetch(signedUrl, { method: 'DELETE' });
      return res.ok || res.status === 204 || res.status === 404;
    } catch (fallbackErr: any) {
      console.error(`[R2 Delete] Failed to delete "${key}":`, fallbackErr);
      return false;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Purge or check exact export file in R2 bucket before upload.
 * ONLY targets the EXACT matching file name(s) to be updated, strictly protecting all other files in bucket.
 */
export async function purgeExactR2ExportFiles(
  fileNamesToReplace: string[],
  creds: R2Credentials,
  s3: S3ClientType,
  onStatus?: (text: string) => void
): Promise<{ deletedCount: number; deletedFiles: string[] }> {
  try {
    const deletedFiles: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < fileNamesToReplace.length; i++) {
      const key = fileNamesToReplace[i];
      onStatus?.(`Đang kiểm tra và cập nhật file: ${key}...`);
      // Delete existing exact key if present to guarantee clean replacement
      const ok = await deleteR2Object(key, creds, s3);
      if (ok) {
        deletedFiles.push(key);
      }
    }
    return { deletedCount: deletedFiles.length, deletedFiles };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[R2 Safe Replace] Error replacing exact file:', err);
    return { deletedCount: 0, deletedFiles: [] };
  }
}

/**
 * Purge old background images in R2 bucket (any file starting with bg_ that is not keepImageName)
 */
export async function purgeOldR2BackgroundImages(
  keepImageNames: string | string[],
  creds: R2Credentials,
  s3: S3ClientType,
  onStatus?: (text: string) => void
): Promise<{ deletedCount: number; deletedFiles: string[] }> {
  try {
    onStatus?.('Đang quét ảnh nền cũ trên R2...');
    const allKeys = await listR2Objects(creds, s3, 'bg_');
    const keepNames = Array.isArray(keepImageNames) ? keepImageNames : [keepImageNames];
    const keepSet = new Set(keepNames.map(n => n.toLowerCase()));

    const oldBgToDelete = allKeys.filter((key) => {
      const lower = key.toLowerCase();
      return lower.startsWith('bg_') && !keepSet.has(lower);
    });

    if (oldBgToDelete.length === 0) {
      return { deletedCount: 0, deletedFiles: [] };
    }

    onStatus?.(`Đang xóa ${oldBgToDelete.length} ảnh nền cũ trên R2...`);
    const deletedFiles: string[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < oldBgToDelete.length; i++) {
      const key = oldBgToDelete[i];
      const ok = await deleteR2Object(key, creds, s3);
      if (ok) {
        deletedFiles.push(key);
      }
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 40));
    }

    return { deletedCount: deletedFiles.length, deletedFiles };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[R2 Purge] Error purging old background images:', err);
    return { deletedCount: 0, deletedFiles: [] };
  }
}

/**
 * Downloads a JSON file from Cloudflare R2 using dual method:
 * Method 1: S3 SDK direct getObject with transformToString()
 * Method 2: Presigned GET URL fetch with custom CORS error classification
 */
export async function downloadR2JsonFile<T = any>(
  key: string,
  creds: R2Credentials,
  s3: S3ClientType
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: T; error?: string; notFound?: boolean }> {
  const { GetObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();

  // Method 1: S3Client SDK direct send
  try {
    const command = new GetObjectCommand({
      Bucket: creds.bucketName.trim(),
      Key: key,
    });
    const res = await s3.send(command);
    if (res.Body) {
      const text = await (res.Body as any).transformToString();
      const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
      return { success: true, data: parsed };
    }
  } catch (sdkErr: any) {
    const name = sdkErr?.name || '';
    const msg = sdkErr?.message || '';
    if (name === 'NoSuchKey' || name === 'NotFound' || msg.includes('does not exist') || msg.includes('404')) {
      return { success: false, notFound: true, error: `File "${key}" chưa tồn tại trên R2 Bucket (Vui lòng bấm Save Cloud để lưu cấu hình lần đầu).` };
    }
    console.warn(`[R2 Download] S3 send failed for "${key}", trying signed URL fallback:`, sdkErr);
  }

  // Method 2: Presigned GET URL fetch
  try {
    const command = new GetObjectCommand({
      Bucket: creds.bucketName.trim(),
      Key: key,
      ResponseCacheControl: 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate',
    });
    const signedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, command, { expiresIn: 3600 });
    // Append timestamp query parameter to strictly bypass any browser / CDN HTTP cache
    const cacheBusterUrl = signedUrl.includes('?') 
      ? `${signedUrl}&_t=${Date.now()}` 
      : `${signedUrl}?_t=${Date.now()}`;
    const res = await fetch(cacheBusterUrl, { 
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate',
        'Pragma': 'no-cache'
      }
    });
    if (res.status === 404) {
      return { success: false, notFound: true, error: `File "${key}" chưa tồn tại trên R2 Bucket (Vui lòng bấm Save Cloud để lưu cấu hình lần đầu).` };
    }
    if (!res.ok) {
      const txt = await res.text().catch(() => '');
      return { success: false, error: `Lỗi R2 HTTP ${res.status}: ${txt.substring(0, 100)}` };
    }
    const data = await res.json();
    return { success: true, data };
  } catch (fetchErr: any) {
    const errMsg = fetchErr?.message || String(fetchErr);
    if (errMsg.includes('Load failed') || errMsg.includes('Failed to fetch') || errMsg.includes('NetworkError') || errMsg.includes('CORS')) {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'Lỗi CORS / Mạng khi kết nối Cloudflare R2: Hãy đảm bảo CORS Policy trên R2 Bucket cho phép GET/PUT từ domain của bạn.' 
      };
    }
    return { success: false, error: errMsg };
  }
}

/**
 * Upload single file with multiple retry attempts and proxy fallback
 */
export async function uploadSingleR2File(
  file: R2FileItem,
  creds: {
    accountId: string;
    accessKeyId: string;
    secretAccessKey: string;
    bucketName: string;
  },
  s3: S3ClientType,
  maxRetries = 3
): Promise<R2UploadFileResult> {
  const originalName = file.name || 'Export.jpeg';
  const isJson = originalName.toLowerCase().endsWith('.json');
  const safeName = originalName.replace(/[\/\\]/g, '_').replace(/\s+/g, '_');
  const contentType = file.blob.type || (isJson ? 'application/json' : 'image/jpeg');
  const cacheControl = isJson ? 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, max-age=0' : 'public, max-age=604800, immutable';

  let lastError = '';

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    // Attempt Method 1: S3 SDK direct PutObjectCommand with ArrayBuffer
    try {
      const { PutObjectCommand } = await getS3Sdk();
      const arrayBuffer = await file.blob.arrayBuffer();
      const uint8Array = new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer);

      const command = new PutObjectCommand({
        Bucket: creds.bucketName.trim(),
        Key: safeName,
        Body: uint8Array,
        ContentType: contentType,
        CacheControl: cacheControl,
      });

      await s3.send(command);
      return { name: safeName, success: true };
    } catch (s3Err: any) {
      console.warn(`[R2 Upload] S3 SDK send failed (lần ${attempt}/${maxRetries}), trying presigned URL:`, s3Err);
    }

    // Attempt Method 2: Presigned PUT URL fetch
    try {
      const { PutObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
      const command = new PutObjectCommand({
        Bucket: creds.bucketName.trim(),
        Key: safeName,
        ContentType: contentType,
        CacheControl: cacheControl,
      });

      const signedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, command, { expiresIn: 3600 });
      const res = await fetch(signedUrl, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 
          'Content-Type': contentType,
          'Cache-Control': cacheControl,
        },
        body: file.blob,
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        return { name: safeName, success: true };
      }

      const errText = await res.text().catch(() => '');
      if (res.status === 403) {
        throw new Error('R2 từ chối quyền ghi (HTTP 403). Hãy đảm bảo API Token có quyền "Object Read & Write".');
      }
      if (res.status === 404) {
        throw new Error(`Không tìm thấy Bucket "${creds.bucketName}" (HTTP 404). Hãy kiểm tra lại tên Bucket.`);
      }
      throw new Error(`Cloudflare R2 từ chối lưu file (Mã lỗi: HTTP ${res.status}): ${errText.substring(0, 80)}`);
    } catch (directErr: any) {
      console.warn(`[R2 Upload] Lỗi tải lên presigned (lần ${attempt}/${maxRetries}):`, directErr);
      let errMsg = directErr?.message || 'Lỗi mạng khi tải lên R2.';
      if (errMsg.includes('Failed to fetch') || errMsg.includes('NetworkError')) {
        errMsg = 'Lỗi CORS / Mạng: Vui lòng vào Cloudflare R2 > Bucket > Settings > thêm CORS Policy cho phép PUT & GET.';
      }
      lastError = errMsg;
      
      if (attempt < maxRetries) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000 * attempt));
      }
    }
  }

  return { name: safeName, success: false, error: lastError };
}

/**
 * Sequentially uploads files to Cloudflare R2 with progress tracking,
 * strictly replacing only the exact matching file names, and purging Cloudflare CDN cache
 */
export async function uploadFilesToR2(
  files: R2FileItem[],
  onProgress?: (info: R2ProgressInfo) => void,
  options: { replaceExactFilesOnly?: boolean } = { replaceExactFilesOnly: true }
): Promise<R2BatchUploadResult> {
  const creds = getStoredR2Credentials();

  if (!creds) {
    throw new Error('Chưa cấu hình đầy đủ thông tin Cloudflare R2 trong cài đặt.');
  }

  const { S3Client } = await getS3Sdk();
  const s3 = new S3Client({
    region: 'auto',
    endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
    credentials: { accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId, secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey },
  });

  const results: R2UploadFileResult[] = [];
  let updatedExactCount = 0;

  // 1. Check / clean only the exact target file names to be replaced (preserving all other bucket data)
  if (options?.replaceExactFilesOnly !== false && files.length > 0) {
    const targetFileNames = files.map(f => (f.name || 'Export').replace(/[\/\\]/g, '_').replace(/\s+/g, '_') + '.jpeg');

    onProgress?.({
      current: 0,
      total: files.length,
      fileName: '',
      percent: 5,
      statusText: 'Đang kiểm tra và chuẩn bị ghi đè đúng tên file tương ứng trên Cloudflare R2...',
    });

    try {
      const purgeResult = await purgeExactR2ExportFiles(targetFileNames, creds, s3, (statusText) => {
        onProgress?.({
          current: 0,
          total: files.length,
          fileName: '',
          percent: 10,
          statusText,
        });
      });
      updatedExactCount = purgeResult.deletedCount;
    } catch (purgeErr) {
      console.warn('[R2 Safe Replace] Cảnh báo kiểm tra file trước upload:', purgeErr);
    }
  }

  // 2. Upload new version files
  for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
    const file = files[i];
    const safeName = (file.name || 'Export').replace(/[\/\\]/g, '_').replace(/\s+/g, '_') + '.jpeg';
    const percent = Math.round(15 + ((i / files.length) * 80));

    onProgress?.({
      current: i + 1,
      total: files.length,
      fileName: safeName,
      percent,
      statusText: `Đang tải lên bản vẽ: ${safeName} (${i + 1}/${files.length})...`,
    });

    const res = await uploadSingleR2File(file, creds, s3, 3);
    results.push(res);

    // Yield to let browser UI refresh
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60));
  }

  onProgress?.({
    current: files.length,
    total: files.length,
    fileName: '',
    percent: 98,
    statusText: 'Đang hoàn tất và xóa cache Cloudflare CDN...',
  });

  // Attempt cache purge if configured
  const cfZoneId = localStorage.getItem('cf_zone_id');
  const cfApiToken = localStorage.getItem('cf_api_token');
  if (cfZoneId && cfApiToken) {
    try {
      // Direct API call to cloudflare since the proxy doesn't work on the public hosting (405)
      await fetch(`https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/${cfZoneId}/purge_cache`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${cfApiToken}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ purge_everything: true }),
      });
    } catch (purgeErr) {
      console.warn('Purge cache error:', purgeErr);
    }
  }

  onProgress?.({
    current: files.length,
    total: files.length,
    fileName: '',
    percent: 100,
    statusText: `Hoàn tất cập nhật thành công ${files.length} bản vẽ lên Cloudflare R2!`,
  });

  const successCount = results.filter((r) => r.success).length;
  const failedCount = results.filter((r) => !r.success).length;

  return {
    total: files.length,
    successCount,
    failedCount,
    results,
    deletedOldCount: updatedExactCount,
  };
}

export function calculateSummaryData({
  unitInfo,
  classInfo,
  actualClassInfo,
  sales: salesData,
  profits: profitData,
  subFees: subFeesData,
  mdStatus: mdStatusData,
  projectStatus: projectStatusData,
  projectLink: projectLinkData,
  basePlan,
  units: unitsData,
  store,
  location,
  year,
}: {
  unitInfo?: any[];
  classInfo?: any[];
  actualClassInfo?: any[];
  sales?: any[];
  profits?: any[];
  subFees?: any[];
  mdStatus?: any[];
  projectStatus?: any[];
  projectLink?: any[];
  basePlan?: any[];
  units?: any[];
  store?: string;
  location?: string;
  year?: string;
}): SummaryDataItem[] {

  });

  const subFeesMap = new Map();
  (subFeesData || []).forEach(sf => {
    if (!sf?.brandCode) return;
    if (!subFeesMap.has(sf.brandCode)) subFeesMap.set(sf.brandCode, []);
    subFeesMap.get(sf.brandCode).push(sf);
  });

  const mdStatusMap = new Map();
  (mdStatusData || []).forEach(md => {
    if (md?.unit) mdStatusMap.set(md.unit, md);
  });

  const projectStatusMap = new Map();
  (projectStatusData || []).forEach(ps => {
    if (!ps?.unit) return;
    if (store && store !== 'all') {
      const psStore = String(ps.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (psStore && psStore !== 'ALL' && psStore !== store.toUpperCase().trim()) return;
    }
    if (location && location !== 'all') {
      let targetLoc = location.toUpperCase().trim();
      if (targetLoc.endsWith('F')) targetLoc = `L${targetLoc[0]}`;
      if (/^L\d+[A-Z]$/i.test(targetLoc)) targetLoc = targetLoc.slice(0, -1);
      let psLoc = String(ps.floor || ps.location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (psLoc.endsWith('F')) psLoc = `L${psLoc[0]}`;
      if (/^L\d+[A-Z]$/i.test(psLoc)) psLoc = psLoc.slice(0, -1);
      const isStorewide = psLoc === 'ALL' || psLoc === 'STORE' || psLoc === 'STOREWIDE' || psLoc === 'WHOLE STORE' || psLoc === 'ALL FLOORS';
      if (psLoc && !isStorewide && psLoc !== targetLoc) return;
    }
    if (year && year !== 'all') {
      const targetYear = String(year).trim();
      let psYear = String(ps.year || ps.projectYear || '').trim();
      if (!psYear) {
        const dStr = `${ps.startDate || ''} ${ps.endDate || ''} ${ps.code || ''}`;
        const m = dStr.match(/\b(202\d|203\d)\b/);
        if (m) psYear = m[1];
      }
      if (psYear && psYear !== 'ALL' && psYear !== targetYear) return;
    }
    projectStatusMap.set(ps.unit, ps);
  });

  const projectLinkMap = new Map();
  (projectLinkData || []).forEach(pl => {
    if (!pl?.unit) return;
    if (store && store !== 'all') {
      const plStore = String(pl.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (plStore && plStore !== 'ALL' && plStore !== store.toUpperCase().trim()) return;
    }
    if (location && location !== 'all') {
      let targetLoc = location.toUpperCase().trim();
      if (targetLoc.endsWith('F')) targetLoc = `L${targetLoc[0]}`;
      if (/^L\d+[A-Z]$/i.test(targetLoc)) targetLoc = targetLoc.slice(0, -1);
      let plLoc = String(pl.floor || pl.location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (plLoc.endsWith('F')) plLoc = `L${plLoc[0]}`;
      if (/^L\d+[A-Z]$/i.test(plLoc)) plLoc = plLoc.slice(0, -1);
      const isStorewide = plLoc === 'ALL' || plLoc === 'STORE' || plLoc === 'STOREWIDE' || plLoc === 'WHOLE STORE' || plLoc === 'ALL FLOORS';
      if (plLoc && !isStorewide && plLoc !== targetLoc) return;
    }
    if (year && year !== 'all') {
      const targetYear = String(year).trim();
      let plYear = String(pl.year || pl.projectYear || '').trim();
      if (!plYear) {
        const dStr = `${pl.startDate || ''} ${pl.endDate || ''} ${pl.code || ''} ${pl.projectCode || ''}`;
        const m = dStr.match(/\b(202\d|203\d)\b/);
        if (m) plYear = m[1];
      }
      if (plYear && plYear !== 'ALL' && plYear !== targetYear) return;
    }
    projectLinkMap.set(pl.unit, pl);
  });

  const classInfoMap = new Map();
  (classInfo || []).forEach(c => {
    const classCode = normalize(c.classCode || c['class code'] || c['classcode']);
    if (classCode) classInfoMap.set(classCode, c);
  });

  const actualClassInfoMap = new Map();
  (actualClassInfo || []).forEach(c => {
    const classCode = normalize(c.classCode || c['class code'] || c['classcode']);
    if (classCode) actualClassInfoMap.set(classCode, c);
  });

  const basePlanMap = new Map();
  (basePlan || []).forEach(bp => {
    const floor = normalize(bp.floor);
    if (floor) basePlanMap.set(floor, bp);
  });

  const unitsMap = new Map();
  (unitsData || []).forEach(u => {
    const unit = normalize(u.unit);
    if (unit) unitsMap.set(unit, u);
  });

  const appProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
  const appTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];
  const appDelegations = useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups || [];
  const enrichedAppProjects = enrichProjects(appProjects, appTasks).filter(p => {
    const pMeta = extractProjectMetadata(p);
    return projectMatchesScope(pMeta, { store, location, year });
  });

  const filteredUnitInfo = (unitInfo || []).filter((unit) => {
    if (store && store !== 'all') {
      const uStore = String(unit.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (uStore && uStore !== 'ALL' && uStore !== store.toUpperCase().trim()) return false;
    }
    if (location && location !== 'all') {
      let targetLoc = location.toUpperCase().trim();
      if (targetLoc.endsWith('F')) targetLoc = `L${targetLoc[0]}`;
      if (/^L\d+[A-Z]$/i.test(targetLoc)) targetLoc = targetLoc.slice(0, -1);
      let uLoc = String(unit.floor || unit.location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (uLoc.endsWith('F')) uLoc = `L${uLoc[0]}`;
      if (/^L\d+[A-Z]$/i.test(uLoc)) uLoc = uLoc.slice(0, -1);
      const isStorewide = uLoc === 'ALL' || uLoc === 'STORE' || uLoc === 'STOREWIDE' || uLoc === 'WHOLE STORE' || uLoc === 'ALL FLOORS';
      if (uLoc && !isStorewide && uLoc !== targetLoc) return false;
    }
    if (year && year !== 'all') {
      const uYear = String(unit.year || '').trim();
      if (uYear && uYear !== 'ALL' && uYear !== String(year).trim()) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  return filteredUnitInfo.map((unit) => {
    let salesAmount = 0;
    let salesByCpAmount = 0;

    const matches = (salesData || []).filter((s) => {
      if (!s?.vendorCode && !s?.brandCode && !s?.brandName && !s?.classCode)
        return false;
      let isMatch = true;
      if (s?.vendorCode) {
        if (unit.vendorCode !== s.vendorCode) isMatch = false;
      }
      if (s?.brandCode) {
        if (unit.brandCode !== s.brandCode) isMatch = false;
      }
      if (s?.brandName) {
        if (unit.brandName !== s.brandName) isMatch = false;
      }
      if (s?.classCode && unit.classCode) {
        if (unit.classCode !== s.classCode) isMatch = false;
      }
      return isMatch;
    });

    if (matches.length > 0) {
      salesAmount = matches.reduce((sum, s) => sum + (Number(s?.sales) || 0), 0);
      salesByCpAmount = matches.reduce((sum, s) => sum + (Number(s?.salesByCp) || 0), 0);
    }

    let profitAmount = 0;
    let profitByCpAmount = 0;
    const profitMatches = profitMap.get(unit.brandCode) || [];
    if (profitMatches.length > 0) {
      profitAmount = profitMatches.reduce((sum: number, p: any) => sum + (Number(p?.profit) || 0), 0);
      profitByCpAmount = profitMatches.reduce((sum: number, p: any) => sum + (Number(p?.profitByCp) || 0), 0);
    }

    const margin = salesAmount > 0 ? profitAmount / salesAmount : 0;
    const marginByCp = salesByCpAmount > 0 ? profitByCpAmount / salesByCpAmount : 0;

    const subFeesMatches = subFeesMap.get(unit.brandCode) || [];
    let mgmtFeeAmount = 0;
    if (subFeesMatches.length > 0) {
      mgmtFeeAmount = subFeesMatches.reduce((sum: number, sf: any) => sum + (Number(sf?.managementFee) || 0), 0);
    }

    const mdStatusMatch = mdStatusMap.get(unit.unit);
    const projectStatusMatch = projectStatusMap.get(unit.unit);
    const projectLinkMatch = projectLinkMap.get(unit.unit);

    let linkedAppProject: any = null;
    const targetLinkCode = String(projectLinkMatch?.code || projectLinkMatch?.projectCode || projectLinkMatch?.project || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    
    if (targetLinkCode && enrichedAppProjects.length > 0) {
      linkedAppProject = enrichedAppProjects.find((p: any) => {
        const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const pCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(p).map(c => c.toLowerCase());
        return pCode === targetLinkCode || pCodes.includes(targetLinkCode) || projectMatchesUnitCode(pCodes, targetLinkCode);
      });
    }

    if (!linkedAppProject && enrichedAppProjects.length > 0) {
      const uKey = String(unit.unit || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      linkedAppProject = enrichedAppProjects.find((p: any) => {
        const pCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(p).map(c => c.toLowerCase());
        return pCodes.includes(uKey) || projectMatchesUnitCode(pCodes, uKey);
      });
    }

    const appStatusFromProject = linkedAppProject
      ? getStatus(
          linkedAppProject.computedTakStart || linkedAppProject.start,
          linkedAppProject.computedTakCompl || linkedAppProject.handover,
          linkedAppProject.computedOpening || linkedAppProject.opening,
          linkedAppProject.code
        )
      : null;

    const appActStatusFromProject = linkedAppProject
      ? ((linkedAppProject as any).computedActStatus || (linkedAppProject as any).actStatus || computeProjectActStatus(linkedAppProject, appDelegations))
      : null;

    let statusVal = unit.status || "Active";
    if (statusVal === "act") statusVal = "Active";
    if (statusVal === "unact" || statusVal === "Inactive") statusVal = "Unactive";

    const matchedClass = classInfoMap.get(normalize(unit.classCode || unit['class code'] || unit['classcode']));
    const matchedActualClass = actualClassInfoMap.get(normalize(unit.classCode || unit['class code'] || unit['classcode']));

    const salesEffiStr = String(matchedClass?.salesEffi || matchedClass?.['sales effi'] || matchedClass?.['sales efficiency'] || matchedClass?.['hcm sales effi'] || 0);
    const profitEffiStr = String(matchedClass?.profitEffi || matchedClass?.['profit effi'] || matchedClass?.['profit efficiency'] || matchedClass?.['hcm profit effi'] || 0);
    
    const actualSalesEffiStr = String(matchedActualClass?.hcmSalesEffi || matchedActualClass?.['hcm sales effi'] || matchedActualClass?.['sales effi'] || 0);
    const actualProfitEffiStr = String(matchedActualClass?.hcmProfitEffi || matchedActualClass?.['hcm profit effi'] || matchedActualClass?.['profit effi'] || 0);
    
    const explicitMarginStr = String(matchedClass?.margin || matchedClass?.['hcm margin'] || matchedClass?.['margin (%)'] || matchedActualClass?.hcmMargin || matchedActualClass?.['hcm margin'] || 0);
    
    const salesEffi = Number(salesEffiStr.replace(/,/g, '').replace(/%/g, '')) || 0;
    const profitEffi = Number(profitEffiStr.replace(/,/g, '').replace(/%/g, '')) || 0;
    
    const actualSalesEffi = Number(actualSalesEffiStr.replace(/,/g, '').replace(/%/g, '')) || 0;
    const actualProfitEffi = Number(actualProfitEffiStr.replace(/,/g, '').replace(/%/g, '')) || 0;
    
    let explicitMargin = Number(explicitMarginStr.replace(/,/g, '').replace(/%/g, '')) || 0;
    if (explicitMargin > 1) {
      explicitMargin = explicitMargin / 100;
    }
    
    const finalSalesEffi = actualSalesEffi > 0 ? actualSalesEffi : salesEffi;
    const finalProfitEffi = actualProfitEffi !== 0 ? actualProfitEffi : profitEffi;
    
    let hcmMargin = Math.max(explicitMargin, finalSalesEffi > 0 ? finalProfitEffi / finalSalesEffi : 0);
    
    let unitSize = Number(String(unit.size).replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
    if (unitSize === 0) {
      const matchedUnit = unitsMap.get(normalize(unit.unit));
      if (matchedUnit) {
        unitSize = Number(String(matchedUnit.size).replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
      }
    }

    const matchedBasePlan = basePlanMap.get(normalize(unit.floor));
    const vsHCMStr = String(matchedBasePlan?.vshcm || matchedBasePlan?.Vshcm || 0);
    const vsHCM = Number(vsHCMStr.replace(/,/g, '').replace(/%/g, '')) || 0;

    const salesByHcmcate = finalSalesEffi * 12 * unitSize * (vsHCM / 100);
    const profitByHcmcate = finalProfitEffi * 12 * unitSize * (vsHCM / 100);

    return {
      ...unit,
      className: matchedClass?.name || matchedActualClass?.name || "",
      status: statusVal,
      update: unit?.update || "-",
      salesAmount,
      salesByCp: salesByCpAmount,
      profitAmount,
      profitByCp: profitByCpAmount,
      margin,
      marginByCp,
      mgmtFee: mgmtFeeAmount,
      mdStatus: mdStatusMatch ? mdStatusMatch.status : "-",
      mdNotes: mdStatusMatch?.mdNotes || "-",
      task: (() => {
        if (linkedAppProject?.taskSummaries && linkedAppProject.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
          return linkedAppProject.taskSummaries.map((t: any) => t.name).join('; ');
        }
        const psTask = projectStatusMatch?.task;
        const plTask = projectLinkMatch?.task;
        if (psTask && plTask && psTask !== plTask) return `${psTask} + ${plTask}`;
        return psTask || plTask || "-";
      })(),
      projectStatus: (() => {
        if (appStatusFromProject) return appStatusFromProject;
        const ps = projectStatusMatch?.status;
        const pl = projectLinkMatch?.status;
        if (ps && pl) return `${ps} + ${pl}`;
        return ps || pl || "N/A";
      })(),
      actStatus: 
        appActStatusFromProject || projectLinkMatch?.actStatus || projectStatusMatch?.actStatus || "-",
      taskDelegation: projectStatusMatch?.delegationStatus || "-",
      flowStatus: projectStatusMatch?.flowStatus || "-",
      party: linkedAppProject?.party || projectStatusMatch?.party || "-",
      startDate: (() => {
        if (linkedAppProject) {
          return linkedAppProject.computedTakStart || linkedAppProject.start || linkedAppProject.takStart || "-";
        }
        const psDate = projectStatusMatch?.startDate;
        const plDate = projectLinkMatch?.startDate;
        if (psDate && plDate && psDate !== plDate) return `${psDate} / ${plDate}`;
        return psDate || plDate || "-";
      })(),
      endDate: (() => {
        if (linkedAppProject) {
          return linkedAppProject.computedTakCompl || linkedAppProject.handover || linkedAppProject.opening || "-";
        }
        const psDate = projectStatusMatch?.endDate;
        const plDate = projectLinkMatch?.endDate;
        if (psDate && plDate && psDate !== plDate) return `${psDate} / ${plDate}`;
        return psDate || plDate || "-";
      })(),
      detail: linkedAppProject?.detail || projectStatusMatch?.detail || "-",
      description: linkedAppProject?.detail || (linkedAppProject as any)?.description || projectStatusMatch?.description || "-",
      projectCode: linkedAppProject?.code || (projectLinkMatch?.code || projectLinkMatch?.projectCode || "-"),
      projectName: linkedAppProject?.name || "-",
      salesByHcmcate,
      profitByHcmcate,
      hcmSalesEffi: finalSalesEffi,
      hcmMargin,
    };
  });
}

export function useSummaryData(scope?: { store?: string; location?: string; year?: string }) {
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const globalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalLocationFilter);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);

  const targetStore = scope?.store || (globalStoreFilter !== 'all' ? globalStoreFilter : undefined);
  const targetLocation = scope?.location || (globalLocationFilter[0] && globalLocationFilter[0] !== 'ALL' ? globalLocationFilter[0] : undefined);
  const targetYear = scope?.year || (globalYearFilter !== 'all' ? globalYearFilter : undefined);

  const { 
    unitInfo,
    classInfo,
    actualClassInfo,
    sales: salesData,
    profits: profitData,
    subFees: subFeesData,
    mdStatus: mdStatusData,
    projectStatus: projectStatusData,
    projectLink: projectLinkData,
    basePlan,
    units: unitsData,
   } = useDataStore(useShallow(state => ({
    unitInfo: state.unitInfo,
    classInfo: state.classInfo,
    actualClassInfo: state.actualClassInfo,
    sales: state.sales,
    profits: state.profits,
    subFees: state.subFees,
    mdStatus: state.mdStatus,
    projectStatus: state.projectStatus,
    projectLink: state.projectLink,
    basePlan: state.basePlan,
    units: state.units,
  })));

  const summaryData = useMemo(() => {
    return calculateSummaryData({
      unitInfo,
      classInfo,
      actualClassInfo,
      sales: salesData,
      profits: profitData,
      subFees: subFeesData,
      mdStatus: mdStatusData,
      projectStatus: projectStatusData,
      projectLink: projectLinkData,
      basePlan,
      units: unitsData,
      store: targetStore,
      location: targetLocation,
      year: targetYear,
    });
  }, [unitInfo, classInfo, actualClassInfo, salesData, profitData, subFeesData, mdStatusData, projectStatusData, projectLinkData, basePlan, unitsData, targetStore, targetLocation, targetYear]);

  return summaryData;
}

export const formatMoney = (val: any) => val ? Number(val).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }) : '0';
export const formatPercent = (val: any) => val ? (Number(val) * 100).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) + '%' : '0%';

export const generateSizeLabelLines = (unit: Record<string, any>, uInfo: any, selectedLabels: string[]) => {
    const lines: { key: string, text: string }[] = [];
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Unit ID')) lines.push({ key: 'Unit ID', text: unit.name });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Size SQM') && uInfo?.size) lines.push({ key: 'Size SQM', text: `${uInfo.size} SQM` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Floor') && uInfo?.floor) lines.push({ key: 'Floor', text: `Floor: ${uInfo.floor}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Brand Code') && uInfo?.brandCode) lines.push({ key: 'Brand Code', text: `Brand Code: ${uInfo.brandCode}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Brand Name') && uInfo?.brandName) lines.push({ key: 'Brand Name', text: uInfo.brandName });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Vendor Code') && uInfo?.vendorCode) lines.push({ key: 'Vendor Code', text: `Vendor Code: ${uInfo.vendorCode}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Name') && uInfo?.className) lines.push({ key: 'Name', text: uInfo.className });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Class Code') && uInfo?.classCode) lines.push({ key: 'Class Code', text: uInfo.classCode });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Update') && uInfo?.update) lines.push({ key: 'Update', text: `Update: ${uInfo.update}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Status') && uInfo?.status) lines.push({ key: 'Status', text: `Status: ${uInfo.status}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('MD Status') && uInfo?.mdStatus) lines.push({ key: 'MD Status', text: `MD Status: ${uInfo.mdStatus}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('MD Notes') && uInfo?.mdNotes) lines.push({ key: 'MD Notes', text: `MD Notes: ${uInfo.mdNotes}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Task') && uInfo?.task) lines.push({ key: 'Task', text: `Task: ${uInfo.task}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Project Status') && uInfo?.projectStatus) lines.push({ key: 'Project Status', text: `Project Status: ${uInfo.projectStatus}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Act: Status') && uInfo?.actStatus) lines.push({ key: 'Act: Status', text: `Act: Status: ${uInfo.actStatus}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Start Date') && uInfo?.startDate) lines.push({ key: 'Start Date', text: `Start Date: ${uInfo.startDate}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('End Date') && uInfo?.endDate) lines.push({ key: 'End Date', text: `End Date: ${uInfo.endDate}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Detail') && uInfo?.detail && uInfo.detail !== '-') lines.push({ key: 'Detail', text: `Detail: ${uInfo.detail}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Description') && uInfo?.description && uInfo.description !== '-') lines.push({ key: 'Description', text: `Desc: ${uInfo.description}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Project Code') && uInfo?.projectCode && uInfo.projectCode !== '-') lines.push({ key: 'Project Code', text: `Project: ${uInfo.projectCode}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Project Name') && uInfo?.projectName && uInfo.projectName !== '-') lines.push({ key: 'Project Name', text: `Project Name: ${uInfo.projectName}` });
    
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Sales') && uInfo?.salesAmount !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'Sales', text: `Sales: ${formatMoney(uInfo.salesAmount)}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Sales By CP') && uInfo?.salesByCp !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'Sales By CP', text: `Sales (CP): ${formatMoney(uInfo.salesByCp)}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Sales By HCM Categ') && uInfo?.salesByHcmcate !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'Sales By HCM Categ', text: `Sales (HCM): ${formatMoney(uInfo.salesByHcmcate)}` });
    
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Profit') && uInfo?.profitAmount !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'Profit', text: `Profit: ${formatMoney(uInfo.profitAmount)}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Profit By CP') && uInfo?.profitByCp !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'Profit By CP', text: `Profit (CP): ${formatMoney(uInfo.profitByCp)}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Profit By HCM Categ') && uInfo?.profitByHcmcate !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'Profit By HCM Categ', text: `Profit (HCM): ${formatMoney(uInfo.profitByHcmcate)}` });
    
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Margin') && uInfo?.margin !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'Margin', text: `Margin: ${formatPercent(uInfo.margin)}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('Margin By CP') && uInfo?.marginByCp !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'Margin By CP', text: `Margin (CP): ${formatPercent(uInfo.marginByCp)}` });
    if (selectedLabels.includes('HCM Margin') && uInfo?.hcmMargin !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'HCM Margin', text: `HCM Margin: ${formatPercent(uInfo.hcmMargin)}` });
    
    if (selectedLabels.includes('HCM Sales Effi') && uInfo?.hcmSalesEffi !== undefined) lines.push({ key: 'HCM Sales Effi', text: `HCM Sales Effi: ${formatMoney(uInfo.hcmSalesEffi)}` });
    
    if (lines.length === 0) lines.push({ key: 'Unit ID', text: unit.name });
    return lines;
};

export const generateSizeLabel = (unit: Record<string, any>, uInfo: any, selectedLabels: string[]) => {
    return generateSizeLabelLines(unit, uInfo, selectedLabels).map(l => l.text).join('\n') || unit.name;
};

import { clsx, type ClassValue } from 'clsx';
import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge';

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}

export function autoFormatRow(row: any): any {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return row;

  const newRow = { ...row };
  for (const key in newRow) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(newRow, key)) {
      const val = newRow[key];
      if (typeof val === 'string') {
        const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();
        
        // Auto-format dates
        if (lowerKey.includes('date') || lowerKey.includes('ngày') || lowerKey.includes('ngay') || lowerKey.includes('time') || lowerKey.includes('update')) {
          newRow[key] = standardizeDateToMMDDYYYY(val);
        }
        
        // Auto-format phone numbers
        if (lowerKey.includes('phone') || lowerKey.includes('điện thoại') || lowerKey.includes('sđt') || lowerKey.includes('sdt') || lowerKey.includes('tel')) {
          let cleaned = val.replace(/\D/g, '');
          if (cleaned.startsWith('84') && cleaned.length >= 10) {
            cleaned = '0' + cleaned.substring(2);
          } else if (cleaned.length >= 9 && !cleaned.startsWith('0')) {
             if (cleaned.length === 9) cleaned = '0' + cleaned;
          }
          if (cleaned) {
             newRow[key] = cleaned;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return newRow;
}

export function standardizeDateToMMDDYYYY(dateStr: string): string {

  if (!dateStr) return '';
  const str = String(dateStr).trim();

  // YYYY-MM-DD matches
  if (str.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)) {
    const [y, m, d] = str.split('-');
    return `${m.padStart(2, '0')}/${d.padStart(2, '0')}/${y}`;
  }

  // Slash or dash combinations
  if (str.includes('/') || str.includes('-')) {
    const parts = str.split(/[\/\-]/);
    if (parts.length === 3) {
      let m, d, y;

      if (parts[2].length === 4) {
        // Always enforce incoming as MM/DD/YYYY if year is last
        m = parts[0];
        d = parts[1];
        y = parts[2];
      } else if (parts[0].length === 4) {
        // YYYY/MM/DD
        y = parts[0];
        m = parts[1];
        d = parts[2];
      }
      
      if (m && d && y) {
        return `${m.padStart(2, '0')}/${d.padStart(2, '0')}/${y}`;
      }
    }
  }

  return str;
}

import React, { Component, useDeferredValue, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../types';
import { Search, X, Check, ExternalLink, Sparkles, ArrowRight, Link2, AlertTriangle, Loader2, Plus, Minus } from 'lucide-react';

function shortDate(s?: string): string {
  if (!s) return '—';
  const m = String(s).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
  return m ? `${m[3]}/${m[2]}/${m[1].slice(2)}` : String(s);
}
