type PredecessorType = 'FS' | 'SS' | 'FF' | 'SF';

export interface PredecessorChange {
  predecessor: string;
  predecessorTaskIds: string[];
  predecessors: { taskId: string; type: PredecessorType }[];
}

interface PredecessorMultiInputProps {
  task?: Task;
  value?: string;
  canWrite?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: ((change: PredecessorChange) => void | Promise<void>) | ((val: string) => void);
  onCommit?: (val: string) => void;
  storeTasks?: Task[];
  tasks?: Task[];
  projects?: Project[];
  currentProjectId?: string;
  currentProjectCode?: string;
  currentProjectYear?: number | string;
  currentProjectStore?: string;
  currentProjectLocation?: string;
  predecessorTaskIds?: string[];
  onPredecessorTaskIdsChange?: (ids: string[]) => void;
}

const REL_INFO: Record<PredecessorType, { hint: string }> = {
  FS: { hint: 'Finish → Start' },
  SS: { hint: 'Start → Start' },
  FF: { hint: 'Finish → Finish' },
  SF: { hint: 'Start → Finish' },
};

const SLOT_STYLE = [
  {
    tag: '1',
    border: 'border-l-blue-500',
    badge: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]',
    active: 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600 shadow-sm',
    caption: 'text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]',
  },
  {
    tag: '2',
    border: 'border-l-amber-500',
    badge: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300',
    active: 'bg-amber-600 text-white border-amber-600 shadow-sm',
    caption: 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300',
  },
];

function externalLabel(diffDetails: any, fallbackCode?: string) {
  if (!diffDetails || !diffDetails.diffFactors || diffDetails.diffFactors.length === 0) {
    return fallbackCode || "Cross-Project";
  }
  const factors = diffDetails.diffFactors;
  const factorLabels = factors.map((f: string) => {
    if (f === 'year') return 'Year';
    if (f === 'store') return 'Store';
    if (f === 'location') return 'Location';
    return 'Project';
  });
  return `Cross-Project (${factorLabels.join(', ')})`;
}

function lagToText(sign: string, v: number): string {
  return v ? `${sign}${v}` : '';
}

function tokenOf(it: LinkItem): string {
  if (!it.resolved) return it.raw;
  const lag = lagToText(it.lagSign, it.lagValue);
  const rel = it.type === 'FS' && !lag ? '' : it.type;
  return `${it.code}${rel}${lag}`;
}

function normalize(list: LinkItem[]): LinkItem[] {
  return list.slice(0, 2).map((it, i) =>
    i === 1 && it.resolved && it.type !== 'FF' && it.type !== 'SF' ? { ...it, type: 'FF' as PredecessorType } : it
  );
}

function milestoneDate(it: LinkItem): string {
  if (!it.resolved || !it.task) return '';
  const base = it.type === 'FS' || it.type === 'FF' ? it.task.finish : it.task.start;
  if (!base) return '';
  const d = new Date(base);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const signed = (it.lagSign === '-' ? -1 : 1) * it.lagValue;
  if (signed !== 0) d.setDate(d.getDate() + signed);
  return d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
}

function describe(it: LinkItem): string {
  if (!it.resolved || !it.task) return '';
  const n = it.task.name;
  const s = it.lagValue > 0 ? ` (lag ${it.lagSign}${it.lagValue} days)` : '';
  switch (it.type) {
    case 'FS': return `Start after «${n}» finishes${s}`;
    case 'SS': return `Start when «${n}» starts${s}`;
    case 'FF': return `Finish when «${n}» finishes${s}`;
    case 'SF': return `Finish when «${n}» starts${s}`;
  }
}

interface LinkItem {
  key: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  taskId: string;
  task?: Task;
  code: string;
  type: PredecessorType;
  lagSign: '+' | '-';
  lagValue: number;
  raw: string;
  isExternal: boolean;
  externalLabel: string;
}

async function persistDefault(source: Task, change: PredecessorChange, projects: Project[]): Promise<void> {
  if (!source?.id) throw new Error('Please save the task before linking a predecessor.');
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  
  const updatedTask = {
    ...source,
    predecessor: change.predecessor,
    predecessorTaskIds: change.predecessorTaskIds,
    predecessors: change.predecessors,
    updatedAt: now,
  } as Task;

  const { writeBatch } = await import('../lib/firestoreWrites');
  const { db, APP_ID } = await import('../lib/firebase');
  const { doc, serverTimestamp } = await import('firebase/firestore');

  const cleanData = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(updatedTask).filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined));
  if (!cleanData.parentTaskId) cleanData.parentTaskId = null;

  const batch = writeBatch(db);
  batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', source.id), {
    ...cleanData,
    _serverTimestamp: serverTimestamp()
  });

  await batch.commit();
}

/** Lag input */
function LagInput({ value, disabled, onCommit }: { value: number; disabled?: boolean; onCommit: (n: number) => void }) {
  const fmt = (n: number) => (n > 0 ? `+${n}` : String(n));
  const [txt, setTxt] = useState(fmt(value));
  const isTypingRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTypingRef.current) setTxt(fmt(value));
  }, [value]);

  const commit = () => {
    isTypingRef.current = false;
    const n = parseFloat(txt.replace(',', '.').replace('−', '-'));
    if (isNaN(n)) {
      setTxt(fmt(value));
      return;
    }
    const r = Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
    if (r !== value) onCommit(r);
    else setTxt(fmt(value));
  };

  return (
    <input
      type="text"
      inputMode="decimal"
      value={txt}
      disabled={disabled}
      onFocus={(e: any) => { isTypingRef.current = true; e.target.select?.(); }}
      onChange={(e: any) => setTxt(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9+-−.,]/g, ''))}
      onBlur={commit}
      onKeyDown={(e: any) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); commit(); e.target.blur?.();
        }
      }}
      title="Enter lag days, e.g. +2 or -1"
      className={cn(
        'h-6 w-12 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333] text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-colors',
        value === 0 ? 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400' : value > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400'
      )}
    />
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Component Main                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
export function PredecessorMultiInput({
  task,
  value,
  canWrite: canWriteProp,
  disabled,
  onChange,
  onCommit,
  storeTasks,
  tasks: tasksProp,
  projects: projectsProp,
  currentProjectId,
  currentProjectCode,
  currentProjectYear,
  currentProjectStore,
  currentProjectLocation,
  predecessorTaskIds: legacyIds,
  onPredecessorTaskIdsChange
}: PredecessorMultiInputProps) {
  const canWrite = canWriteProp !== undefined ? canWriteProp : !disabled;
  const liveTask = useAppStore((s) => s.tasks.find((t) => t.id === task?.id));
  
  const source: Task = useMemo(() => {
    if (task) return liveTask || task;
    return {
      id: '',
      name: '',
      predecessor: value || '',
      predecessorTaskIds: legacyIds || [],
      projectId: currentProjectId,
      projectCode: currentProjectCode,
      projectYear: currentProjectYear ? String(currentProjectYear) : undefined,
      projectStore: currentProjectStore,
      location: currentProjectLocation,
    } as Task;
  }, [task, liveTask, value, legacyIds, currentProjectId, currentProjectCode, currentProjectYear, currentProjectStore, currentProjectLocation]);
  
  const stateProjects = useAppStore(s => s.projects);
  const activeProjects = projectsProp || stateProjects;

  const wrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const deferredQuery = useDeferredValue(query);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [hi, setHi] = useState(0);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pendingExternal, setPendingExternal] = useState<RankedPredecessorMatch | null>(null);

  const ctx: PredecessorContext = useMemo(() => ({
    projectId: source?.projectId || currentProjectId,
    projectCode: source?.projectCode || currentProjectCode,
    projectYear: source?.projectYear || currentProjectYear,
    projectStore: source?.projectStore || currentProjectStore,
    projectLocation: source?.location || currentProjectLocation,
  }), [source, currentProjectId, currentProjectCode, currentProjectYear, currentProjectStore, currentProjectLocation]);

  const pool = useMemo(() => (storeTasks || tasksProp || useAppStore.getState().tasks || []).filter((t) => t && !t.isDeleted), [storeTasks, tasksProp]);
  const taskNoMap = useMemo(() => buildTaskNoMap(activeProjects, pool), [activeProjects, pool]);

  const items = useMemo<LinkItem[]>(() => {
    const str = String(source?.predecessor || '').trim();
    if (!str) return [];
    const ids = source?.predecessorTaskIds || [];
    const tokens = splitPredecessors(str, taskNoMap).slice(0, 2);

    return tokens.map((tok, i) => {
      let p: any;
      try { p = parsePredecessors(tok, taskNoMap, { ...source, predecessorTaskIds: [ids[i] || ''] } as Task)[0]; } catch {}
      if (p && p.task) {
        const diff = getTaskProjectDiffDetails(ctx, p.task, activeProjects);
        const code = computeTaskCode(activeProjects, pool, p.task) || p.task.taskCodePhu || p.no || tok;
        return {
          key: `${p.task.id}-${i}`,
          resolved: true,
          taskId: p.task.id,
          task: p.task as Task,
          code,
          type: (p.type || 'FS') as PredecessorType,
          lagSign: (p.lagSign === '-' ? '-' : '+') as '+' | '-',
          lagValue: Number(p.lagValue) || 0,
          raw: tok,
          isExternal: !!diff.isDifferent,
          externalLabel: externalLabel(diff, p.task.projectCode),
        };
      }
      const { query: q } = parsePredecessorToken(tok);
      return {
        key: `raw-${i}-${tok}`, resolved: false, taskId: '', code: q || tok, type: 'FS', lagSign: '+', lagValue: 0, raw: tok, isExternal: false, externalLabel: '',
      };
    });
  }, [source, taskNoMap, ctx, activeProjects, pool]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) => {
      if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handler);
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', handler, { passive: true });
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handler); document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handler); };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => setHi(0), [deferredQuery]);

  const excluded = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new Set<string>();
    if (source?.id) s.add(source.id);
    items.forEach((i) => i.taskId && s.add(i.taskId));
    return s;
  }, [source?.id, items]);

  const candidates = useMemo<RankedPredecessorMatch[]>(() => {
    if (!open) return [];
    const q = deferredQuery.trim();
    if (q) {
      return rankCandidateTasks(q, pool, activeProjects, pool, source?.projectCode, ctx).filter((m) => !excluded.has(m.task.id)).slice(0, 20);
    }
    let base = pool.filter((t) => !excluded.has(t.id));
    const sameCode = base.filter((t) => t.projectCode === source?.projectCode);
    if (sameCode.length > 0) base = sameCode;
    base = base.filter((t) => !getTaskProjectDiffDetails(ctx, t, activeProjects).isDifferent).sort((a, b) => (a.orderIndex ?? 0) - (b.orderIndex ?? 0)).slice(0, 25);
    return base.map((t) => ({
      task: t, score: 0, exactTaskCode: computeTaskCode(activeProjects, pool, t) || t.taskCodePhu || t.id, isExternal: !!getTaskProjectDiffDetails(ctx, t, activeProjects).isDifferent, diffDetails: getTaskProjectDiffDetails(ctx, t, activeProjects),
    } as RankedPredecessorMatch));
  }, [open, deferredQuery, pool, activeProjects, excluded, source?.projectCode, ctx]);

  const commit = async (list: LinkItem[]) => {
    const finalList = normalize(list);
    const change: PredecessorChange = {
      predecessor: finalList.map(tokenOf).filter(Boolean).join(', '),
      predecessorTaskIds: finalList.map((i) => i.taskId || ''),
      predecessors: finalList.filter((i) => i.resolved).map((i) => ({ taskId: i.taskId, type: i.type })),
    };
    setSaving(true); setError(null);
    try {
      if (onChange) {
        await (onChange as any)(change);
        if (typeof onChange === 'function') (onChange as any)(change.predecessor);
      }
      if (onCommit) onCommit(change.predecessor);
      if (onPredecessorTaskIdsChange) onPredecessorTaskIdsChange(change.predecessorTaskIds);
      if (!onChange && !onCommit && source.id) {
        await persistDefault(source, change, activeProjects);
      }
    } catch (e: any) { setError(e?.message || 'Không thể lưu liên kết'); } 
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const wouldCreateCycle = (candidate: Task): boolean => {
    if (!source?.id) return false;
    const visited = new Set<string>();
    const stack: Task[] = [candidate];
    while (stack.length > 0 && visited.size < 500) {
      const cur = stack.pop() as Task;
      if (cur.id === source.id) return true;
      if (visited.has(cur.id)) continue;
      visited.add(cur.id);
      if (!cur.predecessor) continue;
      try { parsePredecessors(cur.predecessor, taskNoMap, cur).forEach((p: any) => { if (p?.task) stack.push(p.task as Task); }); } catch {}
    }
    return false;
  };

  const addTask = (m: RankedPredecessorMatch, confirmed = false) => {
    const t = m.task;
    if (items.length >= 2) return;
    if (wouldCreateCycle(t)) { setError(`Lỗi: «${t.name}» sẽ tạo vòng lặp phụ thuộc.`); setPendingExternal(null); return; }
    if (m.isExternal && !confirmed) { setPendingExternal(m); setOpen(false); return; }
    const idx = items.length;
    const next: LinkItem = {
      key: `${t.id}-${idx}`, resolved: true, taskId: t.id, task: t, code: m.exactTaskCode || computeTaskCode(activeProjects, pool, t) || t.taskCodePhu || t.id,
      type: idx === 0 ? 'FS' : 'FF', lagSign: '+', lagValue: 0, raw: '', isExternal: !!m.isExternal, externalLabel: externalLabel(m.diffDetails, t.projectCode),
    };
    setPendingExternal(null); setQuery(''); setOpen(false); inputRef.current?.blur();
    commit([...items, next]);
  };

  const patchItem = (idx: number, patch: Partial<LinkItem>) => commit(items.map((it, i) => (i === idx ? { ...it, ...patch } : it)));
  const removeItem = (idx: number) => commit(items.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));

  const stepLag = (idx: number, delta: number) => {
    const it = items[idx];
    const signed = (it.lagSign === '-' ? -1 : 1) * it.lagValue;
    const n = Math.round((signed + delta) * 100) / 100;
    patchItem(idx, { lagSign: n < 0 ? '-' : '+', lagValue: Math.abs(n) });
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); if (!open) setOpen(true); else setHi((h) => Math.min(h + 1, Math.max(candidates.length - 1, 0))); } 
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); setHi((h) => Math.max(h - 1, 0)); } 
    else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); const m = candidates[hi] || candidates[0]; if (m) addTask(m); } 
    else if (e.key === 'Escape') { if (open) { e.stopPropagation(); setOpen(false); } }
  };

  const canAdd = canWrite && items.length < 2;
  const hasQuery = deferredQuery.trim().length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 w-full" ref={wrapperRef}>
      {/* Cảnh báo lỗi */}
      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-2 text-[11px] text-red-700 dark:border-red-900/60 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
          <span className="flex-1 font-semibold">{error}</span>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setError(null)} className="p-0.5 hover:bg-red-100 rounded dark:hover:bg-red-900/50"><X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Danh sách thẻ đã chọn */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        {items.map((it, idx) => {
          const style = SLOT_STYLE[idx] || SLOT_STYLE[1];
          const allowed: PredecessorType[] = idx === 0 ? ['FS', 'SS', 'FF', 'SF'] : ['FF', 'SF'];
          const signed = (it.lagSign === '-' ? -1 : 1) * it.lagValue;

          return (
            <div key={it.key} className={cn("flex flex-col p-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] shadow-xs", style.border, it.resolved ? 'border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333]' : 'border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700/60')}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pl-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className={cn("px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black shrink-0", style.badge)}>#{style.tag}</span>
                  {it.resolved && it.task ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 truncate text-xs">
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] shrink-0">{it.code}</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] font-semibold truncate" title={it.task.name}>{it.task.name}</span>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-amber-600 italic">Not found: {it.raw}</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                {canWrite && (
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => removeItem(idx)} disabled={saving} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1 shrink-0"><X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Link Options (TYPE & LAG placed on the SAME ROW) */}
              {it.resolved && canWrite && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 mt-1.5 pt-1.5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#2e2e32] pl-1 text-xs flex-nowrap overflow-x-auto">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">TYPE:</span>
                    <div className="inline-flex rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#252528] p-0.5 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#38383a]">
                      {allowed.map((rel) => {
                        const active = it.type === rel;
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={rel}
                            type="button"
                            disabled={saving}
                            onClick={() => !active && patchItem(idx, { type: rel })}
                            title={REL_INFO[rel].hint}
                            className={cn(
                              "px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-extrabold transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95",
                              active ? style.active : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-[#e3e3e3]"
                            )}
                          >
                            {rel}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">LAG:</span>
                    <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#252528] px-1 py-0.5 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#38383a]">
                      <button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => stepLag(idx, -1)} className="p-0.5 rounded bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 active:scale-95 transition-all"><Minus className="w-3 h-3" /></button>
                      <LagInput value={signed} disabled={saving} onCommit={(n) => patchItem(idx, { lagSign: n < 0 ? '-' : '+', lagValue: Math.abs(n) })} />
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 px-0.5">days</span>
                      <button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => stepLag(idx, 1)} className="p-0.5 rounded bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 active:scale-95 transition-all"><Plus className="w-3 h-3" /></button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Cross-Project Confirm Dialog */}
      {pendingExternal && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-2 text-[11px] dark:border-amber-700/60 dark:bg-amber-950/40">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <span className="font-medium leading-tight">
              «{pendingExternal.task.name}» belongs to another project. This may adjust current task dates. Confirm link?
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5 mt-1">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setPendingExternal(null)} className="px-3 py-1 rounded text-slate-600 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold">Cancel</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => addTask(pendingExternal, true)} className="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-amber-600 text-white font-bold hover:bg-amber-700 shadow-sm">Link</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search Input & Suggestions */}
      {canAdd && !pendingExternal && (
        <div className="relative mt-0.5">
          <div className="relative">
            <Link2 className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-blue-500" />
            <input
              ref={inputRef}
              type="text"
              value={query}
              disabled={saving}
              onChange={(e) => { setQuery(e.target.value); setOpen(true); }}
              onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
              onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
              placeholder="Type task name or code..."
              autoComplete="off"
              className="h-8 w-full rounded-lg border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50/50 pl-8 pr-7 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 outline-none placeholder:text-slate-400 placeholder:font-normal focus:border-blue-400 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 dark:border-blue-900/40 dark:bg-[#1a1c23] dark:text-white dark:focus:bg-[#1e1e20]"
            />
            {query && (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => { setQuery(''); inputRef.current?.focus(); }} className="absolute right-1.5 top-1/2 flex h-5 w-5 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700" tabIndex={-1}>
                <X className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            )}
            {saving && <Loader2 className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin text-blue-500" />}
          </div>

          {open && (
            <ul className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full z-[9999] mt-1 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-xl dark:border-[#444446] dark:bg-[#252528] overscroll-contain">
              {!hasQuery && candidates.length > 0 && <li className="px-2.5 pb-1 pt-1.5 text-[9px] font-extrabold uppercase text-slate-400">Suggestions (Same Project)</li>}
              {candidates.length === 0 ? (
                <li className="px-3 py-3 text-center text-[11px] italic text-slate-500">No tasks found</li>
              ) : (
                candidates.map((m, i) => {
                  const t = m.task;
                  return (
                    <li
                      key={t.id}
                      onMouseEnter={() => setHi(i)}
                      onClick={() => addTask(m)}
                      className={cn("flex cursor-pointer flex-col gap-0.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333] last:border-0", i === hi ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30' : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#2a2a2e]')}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] line-clamp-1">{t.name}</span>
                        {m.isExternal && <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/40 px-1 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">Cross-Project</span>}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px]">
                        <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">{m.exactTaskCode}</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">{shortDate(t.start)} → {shortDate(t.finish)}</span>
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { Building2, Calendar, FolderGit2, FileText } from "lucide-react";
import { PrintFilterContext } from "../lib/printFilterHelper";

interface PrintFilterHeaderProps {
  context: PrintFilterContext;
  className?: string;
  pageIndex?: number;
  totalPages?: number;
}

export const PrintFilterHeader: React.FC<PrintFilterHeaderProps> = ({
  context,
  className = "",
  pageIndex,
  totalPages,
}) => {
  const isFilteredProject = context.projectCodeDisplay !== "All Projects";
  const isFilteredYear = context.yearDisplay !== "All Years";
  const isHCM = context.storeRaw === "hcm";

  return (

      {/* Left: Brand & Document Type */}

=== FILE: src/components/PrintOptionsPanel.tsx ===
import React, { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { motion } from "motion/react";
import { X, GripHorizontal, Bookmark, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useAppStore } from "../store/useAppStore";
import { safeGetDeviceItemLocal, safeSetDeviceItemLocal } from "../lib/storage";
import { PrintPreset, BUILT_IN_PRESETS, PRESETS_STORAGE_KEY } from "./PrintParts/printPresetTypes";
export type { PrintPreset };

interface PrintOptionsPanelProps {
  activeTab: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onPrintToPDF: () => void;
  onExportToExcel: () => void;
}

export const PrintOptionsPanel: React.FC<PrintOptionsPanelProps> = React.memo(({
  activeTab,
  onClose,
  onPrintToPDF,
  onExportToExcel,
}) => {
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  const setToast = useAppStore(state => state.setToast);

  const printTarget = useAppStore(state => state.printTarget);
  const setPrintTarget = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintTarget);
  const printOrientation = useAppStore(state => state.printOrientation);
  const setPrintOrientation = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintOrientation);
  const printPaperSize = useAppStore(state => state.printPaperSize);
  const setPrintPaperSize = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintPaperSize);
  const printScaleMode = useAppStore(state => state.printScaleMode);
  const setPrintScaleMode = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintScaleMode);
  const printScaleCustom = useAppStore(state => state.printScaleCustom);
  const setPrintScaleCustom = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintScaleCustom);
  const printDpi = useAppStore(state => state.printDpi);
  const setPrintDpi = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintDpi);
  const printWatermark = useAppStore(state => state.printWatermark);
  const setPrintWatermark = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintWatermark);
  const printFilterHeader = useAppStore(state => state.printFilterHeader);
  const setPrintFilterHeader = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintFilterHeader);
  const printDate = useAppStore(state => state.printDate);
  const setPrintDate = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintDate);
  const printRangeType = useAppStore(state => state.printRangeType);
  const setPrintRangeType = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintRangeType);
  const printStartDate = useAppStore(state => state.printStartDate);
  const setPrintStartDate = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintStartDate);
  const printEndDate = useAppStore(state => state.printEndDate);
  const setPrintEndDate = useAppStore(state => state.setPrintEndDate);
  const isExportingPDF = useAppStore(state => state.isExportingPDF);

  const [selectedPresetId, setSelectedPresetId] = useState<string>("none");
  const [customPresets, setCustomPresets] = useState<PrintPreset[]>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal("taka_print_presets", currentUser?.id);
      if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch (_) {}
    return [];
  });
  const [isAddingPreset, setIsAddingPreset] = useState(false);
  const [newPresetName, setNewPresetName] = useState("");

  const handleApplyPreset = useCallback((preset: PrintPreset) => {
    if (preset.target) setPrintTarget(preset.target);
    if (preset.orientation) setPrintOrientation(preset.orientation);
    if (preset.paperSize) setPrintPaperSize(preset.paperSize);
    if (preset.scaleMode) setPrintScaleMode(preset.scaleMode);
    if (preset.scaleCustom) setPrintScaleCustom(preset.scaleCustom);
    if (preset.dpi) setPrintDpi(preset.dpi);
    if (preset.watermark) setPrintWatermark(preset.watermark);
    if (preset.filterHeader !== undefined) setPrintFilterHeader(preset.filterHeader);
    if (preset.showDate !== undefined) setPrintDate(preset.showDate);
    if (preset.rangeType) setPrintRangeType(preset.rangeType);

    setToast({
      title: "Preset Applied",
      message: `Applied print preset "${preset.name}"`
    });
  }, [
    setPrintTarget,
    setPrintOrientation,
    setPrintPaperSize,
    setPrintScaleMode,
    setPrintScaleCustom,
    setPrintDpi,
    setPrintWatermark,
    setPrintFilterHeader,
    setPrintDate,
    setPrintRangeType,
    setToast
  ]);

  const handleSelectPreset = (presetId: string) => {
    setSelectedPresetId(presetId);
    if (presetId === "none") return;

    const allPresets = [...BUILT_IN_PRESETS, ...customPresets];
    const found = allPresets.find(p => p.id === presetId);
    if (found) {
      handleApplyPreset(found);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveCustomPreset = () => {
    const trimmed = newPresetName.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;

    const newPreset: PrintPreset = {
      id: `custom-preset-${Date.now()}`,
      name: trimmed,
      isBuiltIn: false,
      target: printTarget,
      orientation: printOrientation,
      paperSize: printPaperSize,
      scaleMode: printScaleMode,
      scaleCustom: printScaleCustom,
      dpi: printDpi,
      watermark: printWatermark,
      filterHeader: printFilterHeader,
      showDate: printDate,
      rangeType: printRangeType
    };

    const updated = [...customPresets, newPreset];
    setCustomPresets(updated);
    safeSetDeviceItemLocal("taka_print_presets", JSON.stringify(updated), currentUser?.id);

    setSelectedPresetId(newPreset.id);
    setIsAddingPreset(false);
    setNewPresetName("");

    setToast({
      title: "Preset Saved",
      message: `Saved custom preset "${trimmed}"`
    });
  };

  const handleDeleteCustomPreset = (id: string) => {
    const updated = customPresets.filter(p => p.id !== id);
    setCustomPresets(updated);
    safeSetDeviceItemLocal("taka_print_presets", JSON.stringify(updated), currentUser?.id);
    if (selectedPresetId === id) {
      setSelectedPresetId("none");
    }
    setToast({
      title: "Preset Removed",
      message: "Deleted custom print preset"
    });
  };

  const selectedCustomPreset = customPresets.find(p => p.id === selectedPresetId);

  return (
    <motion.div 
      drag
      dragMomentum={false}
      className="fixed top-4 right-4 z-[9999] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] p-4 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] flex flex-col gap-3.5 animate-in slide-in-from-top-4 hide-on-actual-print min-w-[300px] max-w-[340px]"
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-move">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <GripHorizontal className="text-slate-400" size={16} />
          <span className="font-bold text-sm">Print Options</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={onClose}
          className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          title="Close"
        >
          <X size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Print Presets Section */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 pb-2.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336]">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] uppercase flex items-center gap-1">
            <Bookmark className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-500" />
            Print Presets
          </span>
          {!isAddingPreset && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsAddingPreset(true)}
              className="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
              title="Save current options as a new preset"
            >
              <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
              Save Preset
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {isAddingPreset ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Preset Name (e.g. Weekly Report)"
              value={newPresetName}
              onChange={(e) => setNewPresetName(e.target.value)}
              className="flex-1 text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#131314] border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-md px-2 py-1 outline-none text-slate-800 dark:text-white"
              autoFocus
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSaveCustomPreset();
                if (e.key === 'Escape') setIsAddingPreset(false);
              }}
            />
            <button
              onClick={handleSaveCustomPreset}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            >
              Save
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setIsAddingPreset(false);
                setNewPresetName("");
              }}
              className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded-md text-slate-400 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              title="Cancel"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <select
              value={selectedPresetId}
              onChange={(e) => handleSelectPreset(e.target.value)}
              className="flex-1 text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#131314] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 outline-none cursor-pointer text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-colors"
            >
              <option value="none">-- Select Print Preset --</option>
              <optgroup label="Built-in Presets">
                {BUILT_IN_PRESETS.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    {p.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </optgroup>
              {customPresets.length > 0 && (
                <optgroup label="Custom Saved Presets">
                  {customPresets.map((p) => (
                    <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                      {p.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </optgroup>
              )}
            </select>

            {selectedCustomPreset && (
              <button
                onClick={() => handleDeleteCustomPreset(selectedCustomPreset.id)}
                className="p-1.5 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                title={`Delete custom preset "${selectedCustomPreset.name}"`}
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        {/* Printer Target */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 col-span-2 mb-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] uppercase">Printer</span>
          <select
            value={printTarget}
            onChange={(e) => setPrintTarget(e.target.value as any)}

=== FILE: src/components/PrintPreviewOverlay.tsx ===
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";

interface PrintPreviewOverlayProps {
  printScale: number;
  printPaperSize: "A2" | "A3" | "A4";
  printOrientation: "portrait" | "landscape";
  printScaleMode: string;
}

const PX_PER_MM = 3.779527559;

export const PrintPreviewOverlay: React.FC<PrintPreviewOverlayProps> = ({
  printScale,
  printPaperSize,
  printOrientation,
}) => {
  const [pageBreaks, setPageBreaks] = useState<{ domStartY: number; domEndY: number }[]>([]);
  const [cols, setCols] = useState(1);
  const [usableWidthPx, setUsableWidthPx] = useState(0);

  const getPaperDimensions = () => {
    switch (printPaperSize) {
      case "A2":
        return { w: 420, h: 594 };
      case "A3":
        return { w: 297, h: 420 };
      case "A4":
      default:
        return { w: 210, h: 297 };
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let timeoutId: any;
    const calculatePreviewGrid = () => {
      const wrapper = document.querySelector('.print-content-wrapper') as HTMLElement;
      if (!wrapper) return;
      
      const naturalWidth = Math.max(100, wrapper.scrollWidth);
      const naturalHeight = Math.max(100, wrapper.scrollHeight);
      
      const { w: paperW, h: paperH } = getPaperDimensions();
      const printWidth = printOrientation === 'landscape' ? paperH : paperW;
      const printHeight = printOrientation === 'landscape' ? paperW : paperH;
      
      const currentScale = Math.max(0.1, (printScale || 100) / 100);
      const targetUsableWidthPx = ((printWidth - 20) * PX_PER_MM) / currentScale;
      const targetUsableHeightPx = ((printHeight - 20) * PX_PER_MM) / currentScale;
      
      const calculatedCols = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((naturalWidth - 2) / targetUsableWidthPx));
      
      let headerHeight = 0;
      const thead = wrapper.querySelector('thead');
      const wrapperRect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();

      if (thead) {
         const theadRect = thead.getBoundingClientRect();
         headerHeight = Math.max(0, (theadRect.bottom - wrapperRect.top) / currentScale);
      }
      
      const validBoundaries = [0];
      const trElements = Array.from(wrapper.querySelectorAll('tbody tr'));
      trElements.forEach(tr => {
          validBoundaries.push(Math.max(0, (tr.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - wrapperRect.top) / currentScale));
      });
      validBoundaries.push(naturalHeight);
      validBoundaries.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      
      const newPageBreaks: { domStartY: number; domEndY: number }[] = [];
      let domStartY = 0;
      
      while (domStartY < naturalHeight - 0.5) {
          let domEndY_theoretical: number;
          
          if (newPageBreaks.length === 0) {
              domEndY_theoretical = domStartY + targetUsableHeightPx;
          } else {
              domEndY_theoretical = domStartY + targetUsableHeightPx - headerHeight;
          }
          
          if (domEndY_theoretical >= naturalHeight) {
              newPageBreaks.push({ domStartY, domEndY: naturalHeight });
              break;
          }
          
          let breakY = domStartY;
          for (let i = 0; i < validBoundaries.length; i++) {
              if (validBoundaries[i] > domStartY && validBoundaries[i] <= domEndY_theoretical + 1) {
                  breakY = validBoundaries[i];
              }
          }
          
          if (breakY === domStartY) {
              breakY = domEndY_theoretical;
          }
          
          newPageBreaks.push({ domStartY, domEndY: breakY });
          domStartY = breakY;
      }
      
      setCols(calculatedCols);
      setUsableWidthPx(targetUsableWidthPx);
      setPageBreaks(newPageBreaks);
    };

    const wrapper = document.querySelector('.print-content-wrapper') as HTMLElement;
    let observer: ResizeObserver | null = null;
    if (wrapper) {
      observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        timeoutId = setTimeout(calculatePreviewGrid, 80);
      });
      observer.observe(wrapper);
    }
    
    timeoutId = setTimeout(calculatePreviewGrid, 120);
    
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    };
  }, [printScale, printPaperSize, printOrientation]);

  return (
    <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none z-[100] hide-on-actual-print">
      {/* Horizontal lines */}
      {pageBreaks.map((pb, index) => {
        if (index === pageBreaks.length - 1 && pb.domEndY >= (document.querySelector('.print-content-wrapper')?.scrollHeight || 0)) {
          return null;
        }
        return (
          <div 
            key={`h-${index}`} 
            className="absolute left-0 w-full border-b-2 border-red-500 border-dashed opacity-70"
            style={{ top: `${pb.domEndY}px` }}
          >
            <span className="absolute left-1 -top-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 font-bold text-xs bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/90 px-1 rounded shadow-sm">
              Page Break
            </span>
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {/* Vertical lines */}
      {Array.from({ length: cols - 1 }).map((_, index) => (
        <div 
          key={`v-${index}`} 
          className="absolute top-0 h-full border-r-2 border-red-500 border-dashed opacity-70"
          style={{ left: `${(index + 1) * usableWidthPx}px` }}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};


=== FILE: src/components/ProjectDelegationTab.tsx ===
import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Project, Task, AppUser, DelegationGroup } from '../types';
import { computeTaskCode } from '../lib/ganttUtils';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { deleteDoc, setDoc } from '../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from "../lib/firebase";
import { Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from './DebouncedSearchInput';
import { ProjectDelegationGroupCard } from './ProjectModalParts/ProjectDelegationGroupCard';

interface ProjectDelegationTabProps {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  project: Project;
  onInsertTaskTag?: (tagName: string) => void;
  setConfirmModal?: (modal: {isOpen: boolean, title: string, message: string, onConfirm: () => void}) => void;
}

export const ProjectDelegationTab = React.memo(function ProjectDelegationTab({
  project,
  tasks,
  projects,
  delegationGroups,
  currentUser,
  appUsers,
  onInsertTaskTag,
  setConfirmModal
}: ProjectDelegationTabProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  const handleDeleteGroup = async (group: DelegationGroup) => {
    const doDelete = async () => {
      deleteDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', group.id));
      if (group.parentTaskId) {
        const parentTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === group.parentTaskId);
        if (parentTask) {
          setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', parentTask.id), { ...parentTask, delegation: false, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }, { merge: true });
        }
      }
    };

    if (setConfirmModal) {
      setConfirmModal({
        isOpen: true,
        title: 'Delete Delegation Group',
        message: 'Delete this delegation group?',
        onConfirm: doDelete
      });
    } else {
      if (window.confirm('Delete this delegation group?')) {
        doDelete();
      }
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteSubTask = async (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string) => {
    const doDelete = async () => {
      const updatedSubTasks = (group.subTasks || []).filter(st => st.id !== subTaskId);
      if (updatedSubTasks.length === 0) {
        deleteDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', group.id));
        if (group.parentTaskId) {
          const parentTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === group.parentTaskId);
          if (parentTask) {
            setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', parentTask.id), { ...parentTask, delegation: false, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }, { merge: true });
          }
        }
      } else {
        const fallbackYear = (group.projectYear !== undefined && group.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(group.projectYear)))
          ? Number(group.projectYear)
          : (project?.year && !isNaN(Number(project.year)) ? Number(project.year) : new Date().getFullYear());
        const updatedGroup = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({
          ...group,
          projectYear: fallbackYear,
          subTasks: updatedSubTasks,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        }));
        setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', group.id), updatedGroup, { merge: true });
      }
    };

    if (setConfirmModal) {
      setConfirmModal({
        isOpen: true,
        title: 'Delete Delegation Task',
        message: 'Delete this delegation sub-task?',
        onConfirm: doDelete
      });
    } else {
      if (window.confirm('Delete this delegation sub-task?')) {
        doDelete();
      }
    }
  };

  const projectGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!project) return [];
    
    // Normalize current project identifiers
    const normalizedProjCode = String(project.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const projCodeParts = normalizedProjCode.split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    
    // Collect all task IDs and taskCodePhu belonging to this project
    const projectTaskIds = new Set<string>();
    const projectTaskCodePhuSet = new Set<string>();

    tasks.forEach(t => {
      if (!t) return;
      const tProjCode = String(t.projectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const codeParts = tProjCode.split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const matchesCode = projCodeParts.some(cp => codeParts.includes(cp));
      const matchesId = Boolean(project.id && t.projectId === project.id);
      
      if (matchesCode || matchesId) {
        if (t.id) projectTaskIds.add(t.id);
        if (t.taskCodePhu) projectTaskCodePhuSet.add(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
      }
    });

    return (delegationGroups || []).filter(g => {
      if (!g) return false;

      const gParentTaskId = String(g.parentTaskId || '').trim();
      const gParentTaskIdLower = gParentTaskId.toLowerCase();
      const gProjectCode = String(g.projectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const gProjectId = String((g as any).projectId || '').trim();

      // 1. Direct match with project tasks
      const matchesTask = Boolean(
        gParentTaskId && (projectTaskIds.has(gParentTaskId) || projectTaskCodePhuSet.has(gParentTaskIdLower))
      );

      // 2. Direct match with project code or project ID
      const matchesDirectProject = Boolean(
        (gProjectCode && projCodeParts.includes(gProjectCode)) ||
        (gProjectId && project.id && gProjectId === project.id) ||
        (gParentTaskId && projCodeParts.includes(gParentTaskIdLower)) ||
        (gParentTaskId && project.id && gParentTaskId === project.id)
      );

      // 3. Indirect match via parent task's project code
      const parentTask = tasks.find(x => x && (x.id === g.parentTaskId || (x.taskCodePhu && String(x.taskCodePhu).toLowerCase() === gParentTaskIdLower)));
      const matchesTaskProjectCode = parentTask ? Boolean(
        projCodeParts.some(cp => String(parentTask.projectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase().split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).includes(cp)) ||
        (project.id && parentTask.projectId === project.id)
      ) : false;

      return matchesTask || matchesDirectProject || matchesTaskProjectCode;
    }).map(g => {
      const gParentTaskIdLower = String(g.parentTaskId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const parentTask = tasks.find(t => t && (t.id === g.parentTaskId || (t.taskCodePhu && String(t.taskCodePhu).toLowerCase() === gParentTaskIdLower)));
      const isChildTask = parentTask ? Boolean(parentTask.parentTaskId) : false;
      const rootParentTask = isChildTask ? tasks.find(t => t.id === parentTask?.parentTaskId) : null;
      return {
        ...g,
        _taskCode: parentTask ? computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, parentTask) : (g.projectCode || ''),
        _taskName: parentTask?.name || g.name || 'Delegated Sub-tasks',
        _isChildTask: isChildTask,
        _parentTaskName: rootParentTask?.name || null
      };
    }).sort((a, b) => (a._taskCode || '').localeCompare(b._taskCode || '', undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
  }, [delegationGroups, tasks, project, projects]);

  const picOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const list = new Set<string>();
    (appUsers || []).forEach(u => u && u.username && list.add(u.username));
    projectGroups.forEach(g => {
       (g.subTasks || []).forEach(st => {
         if (st && st.party) {
           const parts = String(st.party).split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
           parts.forEach(p => list.add(p));
         }
       });
    });
    return Array.from(list).sort((a,b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [appUsers, projectGroups]);

  const filteredGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return projectGroups;
    const lowerQuery = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return projectGroups.filter(g => 
      (g._taskName && g._taskName.toLowerCase().includes(lowerQuery)) ||
      (g._taskCode && g._taskCode.toLowerCase().includes(lowerQuery))
    );
  }, [projectGroups, searchQuery]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col flex-1 min-h-0 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 relative overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-6 pb-20 sm:pb-24 overscroll-contain">
      <div className="relative w-full mb-4 flex-shrink-0">
        <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3 pointer-events-none text-blue-500">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
        </div>
        <DebouncedSearchInput
          placeholder="Search task name or code..."
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={(val) => setSearchQuery(val)}
          className="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800/50 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100 text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block w-full pl-9 pr-10 p-2 outline-none shadow-sm placeholder:text-blue-400"
        />
      </div>
      <datalist id="pic-list-modal-project">
        {picOptions.map((u, i) => <option key={i} value={u} />)}
      </datalist>

      {filteredGroups.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center text-slate-500 py-10">No delegated tasks for this project yet.</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          {filteredGroups.map(linkedGroup => (
            <ProjectDelegationGroupCard
              key={linkedGroup.id}
              linkedGroup={linkedGroup}
              project={project}
              tasks={tasks}
              projects={projects}
              currentUser={currentUser}
              appUsers={appUsers}
              picOptions={picOptions}
              onInsertTaskTag={onInsertTaskTag}
              handleDeleteGroup={handleDeleteGroup}
              handleDeleteSubTask={handleDeleteSubTask}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

=== FILE: src/components/ProjectModal/ProjectChat.tsx ===
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { Project, Task, AppUser, DelegationGroup, TaskComment } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { ChevronUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { useProjectChatActions } from './chat/useProjectChatActions';
import { ProjectCommentItem } from './chat/ProjectCommentItem';
import { ProjectChatInput, ProjectChatInputHandle } from './chat/ProjectChatInput';

export interface ProjectChatProps {
  project: Project;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  subAppUsers?: any[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  onOpenTask?: (taskId: string) => void;
  setConfirmModal?: any;
}

export const ProjectChat = React.memo(function ProjectChat({
  project,
  tasks,
  currentUser,
  appUsers,
  onOpenTask,
  setConfirmModal,
}: ProjectChatProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const focusCommentId = useAppStore((state) => state.focusCommentId);
  const setFocusCommentId = useAppStore((state) => state.setFocusCommentId);

  const [localComments, setLocalComments] = useState<TaskComment[]>(project.comments || []);
  const [editingCommentId, setEditingCommentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingText, setEditingText] = useState('');
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(25);

  const chatInputRef = useRef<ProjectChatInputHandle>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalComments(project.comments || []);
  }, [project.comments]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusCommentId && localComments.length > 0) {
      const idx = localComments.findIndex((c) => c.id === focusCommentId);
      if (idx !== -1) {
        const fromEnd = localComments.length - idx;
        if (fromEnd > visibleCount) {
          setVisibleCount(Math.min(localComments.length, fromEnd + 10));
        }
      }
    }
  }, [focusCommentId, localComments, visibleCount]);

  const displayedComments = useMemo(() => {
    if (localComments.length <= visibleCount) return localComments;
    return localComments.slice(localComments.length - visibleCount);
  }, [localComments, visibleCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusCommentId) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        const el = document.getElementById('comment-' + focusCommentId);
        if (el) {
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          el.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-blue-500', 'ring-offset-2', 'ring-offset-slate-50', 'dark:ring-offset-[#131314]');
          setTimeout(() => {
            el.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-blue-500', 'ring-offset-2', 'ring-offset-slate-50', 'dark:ring-offset-[#131314]');
          }, 3000);
          setFocusCommentId(null);
        }
      }, 300);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [focusCommentId, setFocusCommentId]);

  const projectTasks = useMemo(() => {
    return tasks.filter(
      (t) =>
        t.projectCode === project.code &&
        (String(t.projectYear) === String(project.year) || (!t.projectYear && !project.year)) &&
        (t.projectStore === project.store || (!t.projectStore && !project.store))
    );
  }, [tasks, project.code, project.year, project.store]);

  const { handleDeleteComment, handleEditComment, handleSendFromInput } = useProjectChatActions({
    project,
    localComments,
    setLocalComments,
    currentUser,
    setConfirmModal,
    editingText,
    setEditingText,
    setEditingCommentId,
    t
  });

  return (
    <div 
      className="flex flex-col h-full flex-grow overflow-hidden relative overscroll-contain"
      onWheel={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      onTouchStart={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      onTouchEnd={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
    >
      <div 
        className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-6 space-y-4 overscroll-contain touch-pan-y custom-scrollbar"
        style={{ touchAction: 'pan-y' }}
      >
        {localComments.length > visibleCount && (
          <div className="flex justify-center pb-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setVisibleCount((prev) => Math.min(localComments.length, prev + 25))}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded-full border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/60 shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
            >
              <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{t('Load older messages')} ({localComments.length - visibleCount} {t('remaining')})</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {displayedComments.map((c) => {
          const isMe = c.userId === currentUser.id;
          const isEditing = editingCommentId === c.id;

          return (
            <ProjectCommentItem
              key={c.id}
              comment={c}
              currentUser={currentUser}
              appUsers={appUsers}
              isMe={isMe}
              isEditing={isEditing}
              editingText={editingText}
              setEditingText={setEditingText}
              setEditingCommentId={setEditingCommentId}
              handleEditComment={handleEditComment}
              handleDeleteComment={handleDeleteComment}
              projectTasks={projectTasks}
              onOpenTask={onOpenTask}
            />
          );
        })}

        {localComments.length === 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-48 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] text-sm">
            <p>{t('No comments yet. Start the conversation!')}</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <ProjectChatInput
        ref={chatInputRef}
        onSend={handleSendFromInput}
        appUsers={appUsers}
        projectTasks={projectTasks}
      />
    </div>
  );
});


=== FILE: src/components/ProjectModal/chat/ProjectChatInput.tsx ===
import React, { forwardRef, memo, useImperativeHandle, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { AppUser, Task } from '../../../types';
import { storage, googleSignIn, getAccessToken } from '../../../lib/firebase';
import { ref as storageRef, uploadBytesResumable, getDownloadURL } from 'firebase/storage';
import { Paperclip, AtSign, Hash, Send, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { recordMention, getMentionFrequencies } from '../../TaskModalParts/chat/chatSharedUtils';

export interface ProjectChatInputHandle {
  insertTaskTag: (tagName: string) => void;
}

export interface ProjectChatInputProps {
  onSend: (text: string, mentions: string[]) => void;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  projectTasks: Task[];
}

export const ProjectChatInput = React.memo(
  React.forwardRef<ProjectChatInputHandle, ProjectChatInputProps>(function ProjectChatInput(
    { onSend, appUsers, projectTasks },
    ref
  ) {
    const { t } = useLanguage();
    const [commentText, setCommentText] = useState('');
    const [mentions, setMentions] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [mentionQuery, setMentionQuery] = useState('');
    const [showMentionMenu, setShowMentionMenu] = useState(false);
    const [taskQuery, setTaskQuery] = useState('');
    const [showTaskMenu, setShowTaskMenu] = useState(false);
    const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);

    const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    React.useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
      insertTaskTag: (tagName: string) => {
        setCommentText((prev) => `${prev} #${tagName} `);
        setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
      },
    }));

    const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const file = e.target.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;

      setIsUploading(true);
      try {
        let accessToken = await getAccessToken();
        if (!accessToken) {
          const result = await googleSignIn();
          if (result) accessToken = result.accessToken;
        }

        let downloadURL = '';
        try {
          const storageReference = storageRef(storage, `comments/${Date.now()}_${file.name}`);
          const uploadTask = await uploadBytesResumable(storageReference, file);
          downloadURL = await getDownloadURL(uploadTask.ref);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Firebase Storage upload failed:', err);
        }

        let driveUrl = '';
        if (accessToken) {
          try {
            const res1 = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              },
              body: JSON.stringify({ name: file.name, mimeType: file.type }),
            });
            const data1 = await res1.json();
            const fileId = data1.id;

            await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?uploadType=media`, {
              method: 'PATCH',
              headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
                'Content-Type': file.type,
              },
              body: file,
            });

            await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}/permissions`, {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              },
              body: JSON.stringify({ role: 'reader', type: 'anyone' }),
            });

            driveUrl = `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${fileId}/view`;
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Drive upload failed:', err);
          }
        }

        const finalUrl = [downloadURL, driveUrl].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
        if (!finalUrl) throw new Error('Upload failed');
        setCommentText((prev) => (prev ? `${prev} ${finalUrl} ` : `${finalUrl} `));
        if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Upload error', error);
      } finally {
        setIsUploading(false);
      }
    };

    const handleTextChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const text = e.target.value;
      setCommentText(text);

      const cursorPosition = e.target.selectionStart || 0;
      const textBeforeCursor = text.substring(0, cursorPosition);
      const mentionMatch = textBeforeCursor.match(/@(\S*)$/);
      const taskMatch = textBeforeCursor.match(/#([^#]*)$/);

      if (mentionMatch) {
        setMentionQuery(mentionMatch[1]);
        setShowMentionMenu(true);
        setShowTaskMenu(false);
      } else if (taskMatch) {
        setTaskQuery(taskMatch[1]);
        setShowTaskMenu(true);
        setShowMentionMenu(false);
      } else {
        setShowMentionMenu(false);
        setShowTaskMenu(false);
      }
    };

    const insertMention = (user: AppUser) => {
      recordMention(user.id);
      const cursorPosition = inputRef.current?.selectionStart || 0;
      const textBeforeMention = commentText.substring(0, cursorPosition).replace(/@\S*$/, '');
      const textAfterMention = commentText.substring(cursorPosition);

      setCommentText(`${textBeforeMention}@${user.username} ${textAfterMention}`);
      if (!mentions.includes(user.id)) {
        setMentions([...mentions, user.id]);
      }
      setShowMentionMenu(false);
      inputRef.current?.focus();
    };

    const insertTask = (task: Task) => {
      const cursorPosition = inputRef.current?.selectionStart || 0;
      const textBeforeTask = commentText.substring(0, cursorPosition).replace(/#([^#]*)$/, '');
      const textAfterTask = commentText.substring(cursorPosition);

      setCommentText(`${textBeforeTask}#${task.name} ${textAfterTask}`);
      setShowTaskMenu(false);
      inputRef.current?.focus();
    };

    const handleSend = () => {
      if (!commentText.trim()) return;

      const lowerCommentText = commentText.toLowerCase();
      const activeMentions = Array.from(
        new Set([
          ...mentions.filter((userId) => {
            const user = appUsers.find((u) => u.id === userId);
            return user && lowerCommentText.includes(`@${user.username.toLowerCase()}`);
          }),
          ...appUsers
            .filter((u) => lowerCommentText.includes(`@${u.username.toLowerCase()}`))
            .map((u) => u.id),
        ])
      );

      activeMentions.forEach((userId) => recordMention(userId));

      onSend(commentText, activeMentions);
      setCommentText('');
      setMentions([]);
    };

    const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
      const freqs = getMentionFrequencies();
      return appUsers
        .filter((u) => u.username.toLowerCase().includes(mentionQuery.toLowerCase()))
        .sort((a, b) => {
          const freqA = freqs[a.id] || 0;
          const freqB = freqs[b.id] || 0;
          if (freqA !== freqB) return freqB - freqA;
          return a.username.localeCompare(b.username);
        });
    }, [appUsers, mentionQuery]);

    const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => {
      return projectTasks.filter((t) => t.name?.toLowerCase().includes(taskQuery.toLowerCase()));
    }, [projectTasks, taskQuery]);

    return (
      <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] relative shrink-0">
        {showMentionMenu && filteredUsers.length > 0 && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-full left-4 mb-2 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-xl w-64 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto z-10">
            {filteredUsers.map((u) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={u.id}
                onClick={() => insertMention(u)}
                className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] dark:text-[#e3e3e3] transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-[10px]">
                  {u.username.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                </div>
                {u.username}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {showTaskMenu && filteredTasks.length > 0 && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-full left-4 mb-2 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-xl w-80 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto z-10">
            {filteredTasks.map((t) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={t.id}
                onClick={() => insertTask(t)}
                className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] dark:text-[#e3e3e3] transition-colors flex items-center justify-between"
              >
                <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] truncate">{t.name}</span>
                {t.party && <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">{t.party}</span>}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input
            type="file"
            ref={fileInputRef}
            onChange={handleImageUpload}
            className="hidden"
            accept="image/*,.pdf,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            disabled={isUploading}
            className="p-2 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200/50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
            title={t('Attach File / Image')}
          >
            {isUploading ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : <Paperclip className="w-5 h-5" />}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setCommentText((prev) => `${prev}@`);
              setShowMentionMenu(true);
              inputRef.current?.focus();
            }}
            className="p-2 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200/50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-colors"
            title={t('Mention User')}
          >
            <AtSign className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setCommentText((prev) => `${prev}#`);
              setShowTaskMenu(true);
              inputRef.current?.focus();
            }}
            className="p-2 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200/50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-colors"
            title={t('Tag Task')}
          >
            <Hash className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>

          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <input
              ref={inputRef}
              type="text"
              value={commentText}
              onChange={handleTextChange}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  handleSend();
                }
              }}
              placeholder={t('Write a comment... Use @ for users, # for tasks')}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl text-sm outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSend}
            disabled={!commentText.trim()}
            className="p-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl transition-all disabled:opacity-50 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation shadow-sm"
            title={t('Send')}
          >
            <Send className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  })

import React, { FC } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { TaskComment, AppUser, Task } from '../../../types';
import { cn } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { LazyImage } from '../../LazyImage';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';
import { Edit2, Trash2, FileText, Maximize2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface ProjectCommentItemProps {
  comment: TaskComment;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  isMe: boolean;
  isEditing: boolean;
  editingText: string;
  setEditingText: (text: string) => void;
  setEditingCommentId: (id: string | null) => void;
  handleEditComment: (commentId: string) => void;
  handleDeleteComment: (commentId: string) => void;
  projectTasks: Task[];
  onOpenTask?: (taskId: string) => void;
