export const ProjectCommentItem: React.FC<ProjectCommentItemProps> = ({
  comment: c,
  currentUser,
  appUsers,
  isMe,
  isEditing,
  editingText,
  setEditingText,
  setEditingCommentId,
  handleEditComment,
  handleDeleteComment,
  projectTasks,
  onOpenTask
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const setZoomableImageSrc = useAppStore((state) => state.setZoomableImageSrc);
  const author = appUsers.find((u) => u.id === c.userId);

  const renderTextWithHighlights = (text: string, isSelf?: boolean) => {
    const knownTags: string[] = [];
    projectTasks.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.name) {
        knownTags.push(`#${t.name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}`);
      }
    });

    const knownTagsPattern =
      knownTags.length > 0 ? `${knownTags.map((t) => `${t}(?:-approval)?`).join('|')}|` : '';
    const urlPattern = `https?:\\/\\/[^\\s]+`;
    const regex = new RegExp(`(${urlPattern}|${knownTagsPattern}#[\\w\\-]+\\b|@[\\w\\-]+\\b)`, 'g');

    return text.split(regex).map((chunk, i) => {
      if (!chunk) return null;
      if (chunk.match(/^https?:\/\//)) {
        const isImage =
          chunk.match(/\.(jpeg|jpg|gif|png|webp|svg|bmp)(\?.*)?$/i) ||
          chunk.match(/^https?:\/\/.*(images|img|photo|picture).*/i);
        const isPdf =
          chunk.match(/\.pdf($|\?|#)/i) ||
          chunk.match(/drive\.google\.com\/.*(?:file|document|pdf)/i) ||
          chunk.match(/docs\.google\.com/i);
        const googleDriveMatch = chunk.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);

        const link = (
          <a
            key={`link-${i}`}
            href={chunk}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className={cn(
              'underline font-medium break-all',
              isSelf ? 'text-blue-200 hover:text-white' : 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-800'
            )}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {chunk}
          </a>
        );

        if (isImage || googleDriveMatch) {
          const imgSrc = googleDriveMatch
            ? `https://drive.google.com/thumbnail?id=${googleDriveMatch[1]}&sz=w800`
            : chunk;
          return (
            <span key={i} className="inline-flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-1 mb-1 w-full">
              {link}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setZoomableImageSrc(chunk);
                }}
                className="block max-w-[220px] text-left hover:opacity-90 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-sm"
              >
                <LazyImage src={imgSrc} alt="Attachment" />
              </button>
            </span>
          );
        }

        if (isPdf) {
          return (
            <span key={i} className="inline-flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-1 mb-1 w-full">
              {link}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setZoomableImageSrc(chunk);
                }}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 border border-red-500/20 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer w-fit"
              >
                <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                <span>View PDF (Full Display)</span>
                <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 opacity-70" />
              </button>
            </span>
          );
        }

        return link;
      }
      if (chunk.startsWith('@')) {
        return (
          <span key={i} className={cn('font-bold', isSelf ? 'text-blue-200' : 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400')}>
            {chunk}
          </span>
        );
      }
      if (chunk.startsWith('#')) {
        const taskName = chunk.replace(/^#/, '').replace(/-approval$/, '');
        const matchedTask = projectTasks.find((t) => t.name === taskName);
        return (
          <span
            key={i}
            onClick={() => {
              if (matchedTask && onOpenTask) {
                onOpenTask(matchedTask.id);
              }
            }}
            className={cn(
              'font-bold cursor-pointer hover:underline',
              isSelf ? 'text-emerald-200' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
            )}
            title={matchedTask ? `Open task: ${matchedTask.name}` : undefined}
          >
            {chunk.replace(/-approval$/, '')}
          </span>
        );
      }
      return chunk;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div
      id={`comment-${c.id}`}
      className={cn('flex flex-col group', isMe ? 'items-end' : 'items-start')}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1 px-1 text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]">
        <span className="font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
          {author?.username || (isMe ? 'You' : 'Unknown')}
        </span>
        <span>•</span>
        <span>
          {c.createdAt
            ? new Date(c.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) +
              ' ' +
              new Date(c.createdAt).toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
            : ''}
        </span>
        {(isMe || currentUser.role === 'admin') && !isEditing && (
          <div className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center gap-1 ml-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setEditingCommentId(c.id);
                setEditingText(c.text);
              }}
              className="p-1 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300 rounded"
              title={t('Edit')}
            >
              <Edit2 className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleDeleteComment(c.id)}
              className="p-1 hover:text-red-500 rounded"
              title={t('Delete')}
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div
        className={cn(
          'p-3 rounded-xl max-w-[85%] text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap',
          isMe
            ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-tr-none'
            : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] rounded-tl-none'
        )}
      >
        {isEditing ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <textarea
              autoFocus
              value={editingText}
              onChange={(e) => setEditingText(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full min-w-[200px] p-2 bg-white/20 text-white placeholder-white/60 border border-white/30 rounded outline-none text-sm resize-none"
            />
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setEditingCommentId(null);
                  setEditingText('');
                }}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-white/80 hover:text-white px-2 py-1"
              >
                {t('Cancel')}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleEditComment(c.id)}
                className="text-xs font-bold bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] px-3 py-1 rounded shadow-sm hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-[#28282a]"
              >
                {t('Save')}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          renderTextWithHighlights(c.text, isMe)
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


=== FILE: src/components/ProjectModal/chat/useProjectChatActions.ts ===
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID, storage, googleSignIn, getAccessToken } from '../../../lib/firebase';
import { ref as storageRef, deleteObject } from 'firebase/storage';
import { generateId } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';
import { Project, TaskComment, AppUser } from '../../../types';

interface UseProjectChatActionsParams {
  project: Project;
  localComments: TaskComment[];
  setLocalComments: (comments: TaskComment[]) => void;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  setConfirmModal?: any;
  editingText: string;
  setEditingText: (text: string) => void;
  setEditingCommentId: (id: string | null) => void;
  t: (key: string) => string;
}

export function useProjectChatActions({
  project,
  localComments,
  setLocalComments,
  currentUser,
  setConfirmModal,
  editingText,
  setEditingText,
  setEditingCommentId,
  t
}: UseProjectChatActionsParams) {
  const docId = project.id || String(project.no);

  const handleDeleteComment = async (commentId: string) => {
    const doDelete = async () => {
      const commentToDelete = localComments.find((c) => c.id === commentId);
      if (commentToDelete) {
        const urls = commentToDelete.text.match(/(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)/g) || [];
        urls.forEach(async (url: string) => {
          if (url.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')) {
            try {
              const fileRef = storageRef(storage, url);
              await deleteObject(fileRef);
            } catch (e) {
              console.error('Failed to delete attached file from storage:', e);
            }
          }
          const driveMatch = url.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);
          if (driveMatch) {
            try {
              let accessToken = await getAccessToken();
              if (!accessToken) {
                const result = await googleSignIn();
                if (result) accessToken = result.accessToken;
              }
              if (accessToken) {
                await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${driveMatch[1]}`, {
                  method: 'DELETE',
                  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
                });
              }
            } catch (e) {
              console.error('Failed to delete from Drive:', e);
            }
          }
        });
      }

      const updatedComments = localComments.filter((c) => c.id !== commentId);
      setLocalComments(updatedComments);

      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      const updatedProject = {
        ...project,
        comments: updatedComments,
        updatedAt: nowIso,
      };

      // Optimistic update in Zustand store
      const allProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
      const updatedProjects = allProjects.map((p) =>
        (p.id && p.id === project.id) || p.no === project.no ? updatedProject : p
      );
      useAppStore.getState().setProjects(updatedProjects);

      try {
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        batch.update(
          doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId),
          { comments: updatedProject.comments, updatedAt: nowIso }
        );
        await batch.commit();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error deleting comment in firestore:', err);
        setLocalComments(project.comments || []);
      }
    };

    if (setConfirmModal) {
      setConfirmModal({
        isOpen: true,
        title: t('Delete Comment'),
        message: t('Are you sure you want to delete this comment?'),
        onConfirm: doDelete,
      });
    } else {
      doDelete();
    }
  };

  const handleEditComment = async (commentId: string) => {
    if (!editingText.trim()) return;

    const updatedComments = localComments.map((c) =>
      c.id === commentId ? { ...c, text: editingText } : c
    );
    setLocalComments(updatedComments);

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedProject = {
      ...project,
      comments: updatedComments,
      updatedAt: nowIso,
    };

    // Optimistic update in store
    const allProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
    const updatedProjects = allProjects.map((p) =>
      (p.id && p.id === project.id) || p.no === project.no ? updatedProject : p
    );
    useAppStore.getState().setProjects(updatedProjects);

    setEditingCommentId(null);
    setEditingText('');

    try {
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      batch.update(
        doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId),
        { comments: updatedProject.comments, updatedAt: nowIso }
      );
      await batch.commit();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error editing comment in firestore:', err);
      setLocalComments(project.comments || []);
    }
  };

  const handleSendFromInput = async (text: string, activeMentions: string[]) => {
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const newComment: TaskComment = {
      id: `c_${Date.now()}_${generateId().substring(0, 4)}`,
      text: text,
      createdAt: nowIso,
      userId: currentUser.id,
      mentions: activeMentions,
    };

    const updatedComments = [...localComments, newComment];
    setLocalComments(updatedComments);

    const updatedProject = {
      ...project,
      comments: updatedComments,
      updatedAt: nowIso,
    };

    // Optimistic store update
    const allProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
    const updatedProjects = allProjects.map((p) =>
      (p.id && p.id === project.id) || p.no === project.no ? updatedProject : p
    );
    useAppStore.getState().setProjects(updatedProjects);

    try {
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      batch.update(
        doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId),
        { comments: updatedProject.comments, updatedAt: nowIso }
      );
      await batch.commit();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to send comment', e);
    }
  };

  return {
    handleDeleteComment,
    handleEditComment,
    handleSendFromInput
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/ProjectModalParts/FastTextarea.tsx ===
import React, { forwardRef, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

interface FastTextareaProps extends Omit<React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>, 'onChange'> {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
}

export const FastTextarea = React.forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, FastTextareaProps>(
  ({ value, onChange, ...props }, ref) => {
    const [local, setLocal] = useState(value);
    const isCanceling = React.useRef(false);

    useEffect(() => {
      setLocal(value);
    }, [value]);

    return (
      <textarea
        {...props}
        ref={ref}
        value={local}
        onChange={(e) => {
          const val = e.target.value;
          setLocal(val);
          onChange(val);
          if (props.onChangeCapture) props.onChangeCapture(e);
        }}
        onBlur={(e) => {
          if (!isCanceling.current) {
            onChange(local);
          }
          isCanceling.current = false;
          if (props.onBlur) props.onBlur(e);
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            isCanceling.current = true;
            setLocal(value);
            onChange(value);
            e.currentTarget.blur();
          }
          if (props.onKeyDown) props.onKeyDown(e);
        }}
      />
    );
  }
);

FastTextarea.displayName = 'FastTextarea';

import { FileText, ExternalLink, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { ProjectDelegationSubTaskItem } from './ProjectDelegationSubTaskItem';

interface LinkedDelegationGroup extends DelegationGroup {
  _taskCode?: string;
  _taskName?: string;
  _isChildTask?: boolean;
  _parentTaskName?: string | null;
}

interface ProjectDelegationGroupCardProps {
  linkedGroup: LinkedDelegationGroup;
  project: Project;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  picOptions: string[];
  onInsertTaskTag?: (tagName: string) => void;
  handleDeleteGroup: (group: DelegationGroup) => Promise<void>;
  handleDeleteSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string) => Promise<void>;
}

export const ProjectDelegationGroupCard: React.FC<ProjectDelegationGroupCardProps> = React.memo(({
  linkedGroup,
  project,
  tasks,
  projects,
  currentUser,
  appUsers,
  picOptions,
  onInsertTaskTag,
  handleDeleteGroup,
  handleDeleteSubTask,
}) => {
  const firstSt = linkedGroup.subTasks[0];
  const flowTxtGroup = firstSt ? (firstSt.delegationStatus || firstSt.status || 'Assigned') : 'Assigned';
  
  const parentTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === linkedGroup.parentTaskId);
  const planStatus = parentTask ? getTaskStatus(parentTask.start, parentTask.finish) : 'Upcoming';
  const isRunning = planStatus === 'On process';
  
  let groupBgColor = 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/10 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/50';
  let groupHeaderBorder = 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/50';
  let groupTitleColor = 'text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100';
  let groupIconColor = 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400';
  let groupSubTitleColor = 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400';
  let groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200';

  if (flowTxtGroup === 'Completed') {
    groupBgColor = 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/10 border-green-200 dark:border-green-900/30';
    groupHeaderBorder = 'border-green-200 dark:border-green-900/50';
    groupTitleColor = 'text-green-900 dark:text-green-100';
    groupIconColor = 'text-green-600 dark:text-green-400';
    groupSubTitleColor = 'text-green-700 dark:text-green-300';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-800/50 hover:bg-green-200 dark:hover:bg-green-700 text-green-700 dark:text-green-200';
  } else if (flowTxtGroup === 'On process' || flowTxtGroup === 'Accepted') {
    groupBgColor = 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/10 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/30';
    groupHeaderBorder = 'border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/50';
    groupTitleColor = 'text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100';
    groupIconColor = 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400';
    groupSubTitleColor = 'text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-800/50 hover:bg-blue-200 dark:hover:bg-blue-700 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-200';
  } else if (flowTxtGroup === 'Pending completed' || flowTxtGroup === 'Pending Completed' || flowTxtGroup === 'Delayed' || ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(flowTxtGroup.toLowerCase())) {
    groupBgColor = 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-900/10 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/30';
    groupHeaderBorder = 'border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/50';
    groupTitleColor = 'text-orange-900 dark:text-orange-100';
    groupIconColor = 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400';
    groupSubTitleColor = 'text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-300';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-800/50 hover:bg-orange-200 dark:hover:bg-orange-700 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-200';
  } else if (flowTxtGroup === 'Approved' || flowTxtGroup === 'Rejected' || flowTxtGroup === 'Request Delay' || flowTxtGroup === 'Needs Rework') {
    groupBgColor = 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-900/10 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/30';
    groupHeaderBorder = 'border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/50';
    groupTitleColor = 'text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-100';
    groupIconColor = 'text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400';
    groupSubTitleColor = 'text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-800/50 hover:bg-purple-200 dark:hover:bg-purple-700 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-200';
  } else if (flowTxtGroup === 'Assigned') {

    groupHeaderBorder = 'border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/50';

    groupIconColor = 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400';
    groupSubTitleColor = 'text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-300';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-800/50 hover:bg-orange-200 dark:hover:bg-orange-700 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-200';
  }

  const proStatus = planStatus || 'On process';
  let proStatusColorClass = 'bg-amber-500 text-white dark:bg-amber-500 dark:text-white border-amber-400 font-extrabold';
  if (proStatus === 'Completed') {
    proStatusColorClass = 'bg-emerald-600 text-white dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:text-white border-emerald-500 font-extrabold';
  } else if (proStatus === 'Upcoming') {
    proStatusColorClass = 'bg-slate-500 text-white dark:bg-slate-600 dark:text-white border-slate-400 font-extrabold';
  } else if (proStatus === 'Delay') {
    proStatusColorClass = 'bg-rose-600 text-white dark:bg-rose-600 dark:text-white border-rose-500 font-extrabold';
  }
  const actualStatus = resolveActualStatus(planStatus, linkedGroup.subTasks);

            <FileText className={cn("w-4 h-4", groupIconColor)} />
            <span>{linkedGroup._taskName || linkedGroup.name || 'Delegated Sub-tasks'}</span>
            {linkedGroup._isChildTask && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 font-mono">
                ↳ SUB {linkedGroup._parentTaskName ? `(Cha: ${linkedGroup._parentTaskName})` : ''}
              </span>
            )}
          </h4>
          <span className={cn("text-[10px] font-mono mt-1", groupSubTitleColor)}>Task Code: {linkedGroup._taskCode}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span className={`text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-bold whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs ${proStatusColorClass}`}>
              Pro: {proStatus}
            </span>
            <span className={`text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold border whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs ${actualStatus.color}`}>
              Act: {actualStatus.label} ({computeDelegationGroupProgressPercent(linkedGroup)}%)
            </span>
          </div>
          <a
            href={`https://tracker.taka-pm.org/?search=${encodeURIComponent((linkedGroup.projectCode ? linkedGroup.projectCode + ' ' : '') + linkedGroup.name)}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            className={cn("flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full font-bold transition-colors shrink-0", groupTrackerBtn)}
            title="Open Tracker & Search"
          >
            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Tracker
          </a>
          {(currentUser.role === 'admin' || linkedGroup.createdBy === currentUser.id) && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleDeleteGroup(linkedGroup); }}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full font-bold transition-colors shrink-0 bg-red-50 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/20 dark:hover:bg-red-900/40"
              title="Delete Delegation Group"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2 mt-3">
        {linkedGroup.subTasks.map((st) => (
          <ProjectDelegationSubTaskItem
            key={st.id}
            st={st}
            linkedGroup={linkedGroup}
            currentUser={currentUser}
            appUsers={appUsers}
            project={project}
            tasks={tasks}
            projects={projects}
            picOptions={picOptions}

=== FILE: src/components/ProjectModalParts/ProjectDelegationSubTaskItem.tsx ===
import React, { FC, memo } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, AppUser, DelegationGroup, DelegationSubTask } from '../../types';
import { getTaskStatus, resolveActualStatus, parseDateTime, getSuggestedCompletionTime, cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { scheduleDependentTasks } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch, setDoc } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { Pin, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface ProjectDelegationSubTaskItemProps {
  st: DelegationSubTask;
  linkedGroup: DelegationGroup & {
    _taskCode?: string;
    _taskName?: string;
    _isChildTask?: boolean;
    _parentTaskName?: string | null;
  };
  currentUser: AppUser;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  project: Project;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  picOptions: string[];
  onInsertTaskTag?: (tagName: string) => void;
  handleDeleteSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string) => Promise<void>;
}

export const ProjectDelegationSubTaskItem: React.FC<ProjectDelegationSubTaskItemProps> = React.memo(({
  st,
  linkedGroup,
  currentUser,
  appUsers,
  project,
  tasks,
  projects,
  picOptions,
  onInsertTaskTag,
  handleDeleteSubTask,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const isCreator = (linkedGroup.createdBy === currentUser.id) || (currentUser.role === 'admin');
  const pPartyList = String(st.party || '').toLowerCase().split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions).filter(k => currentUser.partyPermissions![k]).map(k => k.toLowerCase().trim()) : [];
  const isPIC = userParties.includes('all') || pPartyList.some(p => userParties.includes(p)) || pPartyList.includes(String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim()) || (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id));

  let selectValue = 'None';
  const stStatus = String(st.delegationStatus || st.status || '').toLowerCase();
  const stApproval = String(st.approvalStatus || '').toLowerCase();
  if (stStatus === 'completed') selectValue = 'Approved';
  else if (stStatus === 'rejected') selectValue = 'Rejected';
  else if (stStatus === 'pending completed') selectValue = 'ReqApproval';
  else if (stStatus === 'needs rework') selectValue = 'ReqReview';
  else if (stStatus === 'on process' || stStatus === 'accepted') selectValue = 'AcceptTask';
  else if (['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stStatus) || ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stApproval)) selectValue = 'Hold';

  let cardBgColor = 'bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]';
  const flowTxt = st.delegationStatus || st.status || 'Assigned';

  if (flowTxt === 'Completed') {
    cardBgColor = 'bg-green-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-900/10 border-green-200 dark:border-emerald-900/30';
  } else if (flowTxt === 'On process' || flowTxt === 'Accepted') {
    cardBgColor = 'bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-blue-900/10 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/30';
  } else if (flowTxt === 'Pending completed' || flowTxt === 'Pending Completed') {
    cardBgColor = 'bg-orange-50/50 dark:bg-orange-900/10 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/30';
  } else if (flowTxt === 'Approved' || flowTxt === 'Rejected' || flowTxt === 'Request Delay' || flowTxt === 'Needs Rework') {
    cardBgColor = 'bg-purple-50/50 dark:bg-purple-900/10 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/30';
  } else if (flowTxt === 'Assigned') {
    cardBgColor = 'bg-orange-50/50 dark:bg-orange-900/10 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/30';
  }

  return (
    <div key={st.id} className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-2.5 rounded-lg border text-xs shadow-sm cursor-default", cardBgColor)}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
          <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">To:</span>
          <input
            type="text"
            list="pic-list-modal-project"
            defaultValue={st.party || ''}
            disabled={!(isCreator || currentUser.role === 'admin')}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                e.preventDefault();
                const val = e.currentTarget.value.trim();
                if (val) {
                  const match = picOptions.find(opt => opt.toLowerCase().startsWith(val.toLowerCase()) || opt.toLowerCase().includes(val.toLowerCase()));
                  if (match) {
                    e.currentTarget.value = match;
                  }
                }
                e.currentTarget.blur();
              }
            }}
            onBlur={async (e) => {
              const val = e.target.value.trim();
              const allowed = new Set([...picOptions, ""]);
              if (val !== "" && !allowed.has(val)) {
                useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Invalid PIC. Please select from the dropdown options." });
                e.target.value = st.party || "";
                return;
              }
              const updatedSubTasks = linkedGroup.subTasks.map(sub => sub.id === st.id ? { ...sub, party: val } : sub);
              try {
                setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', linkedGroup.id), {
                  ...linkedGroup,
                  subTasks: updatedSubTasks,
                }, { merge: true });
              } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
              }
            }}
            className="bg-transparent border-b border-transparent hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-[#444446] focus:border-blue-500 outline-none w-[120px] leading-tight truncate px-0 font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] disabled:text-slate-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            placeholder="Assign CP..."
          />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          {onInsertTaskTag && linkedGroup._taskName && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                onInsertTaskTag(linkedGroup._taskName!);
              }}
              className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/30 p-1 rounded transition-colors shrink-0"
              title="Pin this sub-task to comment box"
            >
              <Pin className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
          )}
          {linkedGroup.createdBy && (
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
              from {appUsers.find(u => u.id === linkedGroup.createdBy || (u.username && u.username.toLowerCase() === String(linkedGroup.createdBy).toLowerCase()))?.username || linkedGroup.createdBy || 'Unknown'}
            </span>
          )}
          {(currentUser.role === 'admin' || linkedGroup.createdBy === currentUser.id) && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                handleDeleteSubTask(linkedGroup, st.id);
              }}
              className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/30 p-1 rounded transition-colors shrink-0 ml-1"
              title="Delete this sub-task"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 mt-1">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <select
            value={selectValue === 'None' ? 'None' : selectValue}
            onChange={async (e) => {
              const val = e.target.value;
              let payload: any = { approvalStatus: val };
              if (val === 'Approved') {
                payload.status = 'Approved';
                payload.delegationStatus = 'Completed';
                payload.finishAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
                payload.approvedAt = new Date().toISOString();
              } else if (val === 'Rejected') {
                payload.status = 'Rejected';
                payload.delegationStatus = 'Rejected';
                payload.approvedAt = null;
              } else if (val === 'Hold') {
                payload.approvalStatus = 'Requested';
                payload.approvedAt = null;
              } else if (val === 'AcceptTask') {
                payload.status = 'On process';
                payload.delegationStatus = 'On process';
                payload.approvedAt = null;
              } else if (val === 'ReqApproval') {
                payload.status = 'Pending completed';
                payload.delegationStatus = 'Pending completed';
                payload.approvalStatus = 'Requested';
                payload.approvedAt = null;
              } else if (val === 'ReqReview') {
                payload.status = 'Needs Rework';
                payload.delegationStatus = 'Needs Rework';
                payload.approvedAt = null;
              } else {
                payload.approvedAt = null;
              }

              const updatedSubTasks = linkedGroup.subTasks.map(sub => sub.id === st.id ? { ...sub, ...payload } : sub);
              const parentTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === linkedGroup.parentTaskId);
              const isRealtime = parentTask?.realtimeUpdate || project?.realtimeUpdate;

              let newT: Task | null = null;
              let cascadeUpdates: Task[] = [];

              if (parentTask && isRealtime) {
                const computedPlStatus = getTaskStatus(parentTask.start, parentTask.finish);
                const oldActStatusLabel = resolveActualStatus(computedPlStatus, linkedGroup.subTasks).label;
                const newActStatusLabel = resolveActualStatus(computedPlStatus, updatedSubTasks).label;

                if (newActStatusLabel === 'Completed' && oldActStatusLabel !== 'Completed') {
                  const nowStr = parentTask.approval === 'Approved' && parentTask.approvedAt ? getSuggestedCompletionTime(parentTask.approvedAt) : getSuggestedCompletionTime();
                  const taskUpdates: Partial<Task> = { finish: nowStr, durationManual: true };

                  if (parentTask.start) {
                    const finishDate = parseDateTime(nowStr);
                    const startDate = parseDateTime(parentTask.start);
                    if (finishDate && startDate) {
                      const diffTime = finishDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime();
                      const diffDays = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
                      taskUpdates.duration = String(diffDays);
                    }
                  }

                  newT = { ...parentTask, ...taskUpdates };
                  cascadeUpdates = scheduleDependentTasks(newT, tasks, projects);
                } else if (newActStatusLabel === 'On Process' && oldActStatusLabel !== 'On Process' && oldActStatusLabel !== 'Completed') {
                  const nowStr = getSuggestedCompletionTime();
                  const taskUpdates: Partial<Task> = { start: nowStr };

                  if (parentTask.duration && !parentTask.finishManual) {
                    const dur = parseInt(parentTask.duration);
                    if (!isNaN(dur) && dur > 0) {
                      const sd = parseDateTime(nowStr);
                      if (sd) {
                        const ed = new Date(sd);
                        ed.setDate(ed.getDate() + dur - 1);
                        taskUpdates.finish = getSuggestedCompletionTime(ed.toISOString());
                      }
                    }
                  }
                  newT = { ...parentTask, ...taskUpdates };
                  cascadeUpdates = scheduleDependentTasks(newT, tasks, projects);
                }
              }

              try {
                const batch = writeBatch(db);
                batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', linkedGroup.id), {
                  ...linkedGroup,
                  subTasks: updatedSubTasks,
                }, { merge: true });

                if (newT) {
                  const allUpdates = [newT, ...cascadeUpdates];
                  allUpdates.forEach(t => {
                    batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id), t, { merge: true });
                  });
                }

                batch.commit().catch(e => console.error("Batch commit failed", e));
              } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
              }
            }}
            disabled={!isCreator && !isPIC}
            className={cn(
              "appearance-none text-[10px] sm:text-[9px] min-h-[22px] font-bold px-2 py-1 flex-1 min-w-[100px] rounded border outline-none cursor-pointer text-left",
              "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]",
              (!isCreator && !isPIC) && "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed"
            )}
            style={{ backgroundImage: "url('data:image/svg+xml;charset=US-ASCII,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2210%22%20height%3D%2210%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2024%2024%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%20stroke%3D%22%23334155%22%20stroke-width%3D%222%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%3E%3Cpolyline%20points%3D%226%209%2012%2015%2018%209%22%3E%3C%2Fpolyline%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E')", backgroundPosition: "calc(100% - 4px) center", backgroundRepeat: 'no-repeat', paddingRight: '12px' }}
          >
            <option value="None" disabled hidden>State... ▾</option>
            {(isPIC || isCreator) && <option value="AcceptTask">Accepted</option>}
            {(isPIC || isCreator) && <option value="ReqApproval">Requested Approval</option>}
            {isCreator && <option value="Approved">{t("Approved")}</option>}
            {isCreator && <option value="Rejected">{t("Rejected")}</option>}
          </select>
          <select
            value={st.priority || 'Mid'}
            onChange={async (e) => {
              const val = e.target.value;
              const updatedSubTasks = linkedGroup.subTasks.map(sub => sub.id === st.id ? { ...sub, priority: val } : sub);
              try {
                setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', linkedGroup.id), {
                  ...linkedGroup,
                  subTasks: updatedSubTasks,
                }, { merge: true });
              } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);

              "appearance-none text-[10px] sm:text-[9px] min-h-[22px] font-bold px-2 py-1 flex-1 min-w-[60px] max-w-[80px] rounded border outline-none cursor-pointer text-left shrink-0",
              st.priority === 'High' ? 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200' :
              st.priority === 'Mid-high' ? 'bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 border-yellow-200' :
              st.priority === 'Low' ? 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]' :
              'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-blue-200',
              (!isCreator && !isPIC) && "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed"

import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, memo } from 'react';

import { Project, AppUser } from '../../types';

import { LinkCodesValidationError } from './projectModalTypes';

interface ProjectDetailsFormProps {
  formData: Partial<Project>;
  setFormData: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Partial<Project>>>;
  linkCodesError: LinkCodesValidationError | null;
  canWrite: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser | null;
  locations: string[];
  parties: string[];
  isAddingLocation: boolean;
  setIsAddingLocation: (v: boolean) => void;
  newLocation: string;
  setNewLocation: (v: string) => void;
  handleAddNewLocation: () => Promise<void>;
  enrichedProject: any;
  project: Project | null;
  handleSubmit: (e: React.FormEvent) => Promise<void>;
  handleDelete: () => Promise<void>;
  onClose: () => void;
  yearRef: React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>;
}

export const ProjectDetailsForm = memo(function ProjectDetailsForm({
  formData,
  setFormData,
  linkCodesError,
  canWrite,
  currentUser,
  locations,
  parties,
  isAddingLocation,

                  })
                  .map((loc) => (
                    <option key={loc as string} value={loc as string}>{loc as string}</option>

              required

        </div>

        {/* Row 2: Project Code & Project Code Link */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-12 gap-4 mb-4">
          <div className="sm:col-span-5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase mb-1">
              Project Code *
            </label>
            <FastInput
              type="text"
              inputMode="text"
              value={formData.code || ''}
              onChange={(val) => {
                const cleanCode = val.replace(/\s+/g, '');
                setFormData((prev) => {
                  const newCode = cleanCode;
                  const currentLink = prev.linkCodes;
                  const oldCode = prev.code || '';
                  const shouldSync = !currentLink || currentLink.trim() === '' || currentLink.trim() === oldCode.trim();
                  return {
                    ...prev,
                    code: newCode,
                    linkCodes: shouldSync ? newCode : currentLink
                  };
                });
              }}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === ' ' || e.code === 'Space') {
                  e.preventDefault();
                }
              }}
              required
              readOnly={!canWrite}
              placeholder="e.g. PM-L1-HCM-2026-01"
              className="w-full p-2.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none text-sm font-mono font-bold uppercase"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-7">
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>Project Code Link</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-normal lowercase">(multi, separated by ",")</span>
            </label>
            <FastInput
              type="text"
              inputMode="text"
              value={formData.linkCodes ?? (formData.code || '')}
              onChange={(val) => setFormData({ ...formData, linkCodes: val })}
              placeholder="e.g. L3-303-1, L3-303-2"
              readOnly={!canWrite}
              className={cn(
                "w-full p-2.5 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 outline-none text-xs bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1a1a1c]",
                linkCodesError
                  ? "border-rose-500 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 focus:ring-rose-500"
                  : "border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] focus:ring-blue-500"
              )}
            />

=== FILE: src/components/ProjectModalParts/projectModalIdentityService.ts ===
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { removeCodeFromLinkCodesString, extractAllProjectCodes } from '../../lib/utils';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { undoManager } from '../../lib/undoManager';
import { getProjectCodeChangePredecessorUpdates } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { recordBatchDeltas } from '../../lib/deltaSyncService';

interface HandleProjectIdentityChangeParams {
  project: Project;
  formData: Partial<Project>;
  dataToSave: any;
  docId: string;
  yearNum: number;
  projects: Project[];
  setToast: (toast: any) => void;
}

export async function handleProjectIdentityChange({
  project,
  formData,
  dataToSave,
  docId,
  yearNum,
  projects,
  setToast
}: HandleProjectIdentityChangeParams) {
  const batch = writeBatch(db);
  const projectRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId);
  batch.set(projectRef, {
    ...dataToSave,
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  }, { merge: true });

  let rawTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];
  const oldPCode = String(project.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const oldPYear = String(project.year || '');
  const oldPStore = String(project.store || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  let relatedTasks = rawTasks.filter(t => {
    const matchesCode = String(t.projectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase() === oldPCode;
    const matchesYear = !t.projectYear || !oldPYear || String(t.projectYear) === oldPYear;
    const matchesStore = !t.projectStore || !oldPStore || String(t.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() === oldPStore;
    return matchesCode && matchesYear && matchesStore;
  });

  // If memory does not have tasks for this project (e.g. mobile lazy load), fetch them from Firestore
  if (relatedTasks.length === 0 && project.code) {
    try {
      const { collection, query, where, getDocs } = await import('firebase/firestore');
      const q = query(
        collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks'),
        where('projectCode', '==', project.code)
      );
      const snap = await getDocs(q);
      const loaded: Task[] = [];
      snap.forEach(d => {
        const dt = { id: d.id, ...d.data() } as Task;
        if (!dt.isDeleted) loaded.push(dt);
      });
      if (loaded.length > 0) {
        relatedTasks = loaded;
        rawTasks = [...rawTasks, ...loaded];
        useAppStore.getState().setTasks(rawTasks);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to fetch tasks for project identity change from Firestore:", err);
    }
  }

  const { taskUpdates, predecessorUpdates } = getProjectCodeChangePredecessorUpdates(
    project,
    String(formData.code).trim(),
    formData.year,
    formData.store,
    rawTasks,
    projects
  );

  const relatedTaskIds = new Set(relatedTasks.map(t => t.id));

  relatedTasks.forEach(t => {
    const tUpdate = taskUpdates.get(t.id) || {
      projectCode: String(formData.code).trim(),
      projectYear: yearNum,
      projectStore: formData.store
    };
    const pu = predecessorUpdates.find(p => p.id === t.id);
    const payload: any = {
      ...tUpdate,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    if (pu && pu.predecessor !== undefined) {
      payload.predecessor = pu.predecessor;
    }
    Object.keys(payload).forEach(k => {
      if (payload[k] === undefined) delete payload[k];
    });
    batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id), payload, { merge: true });
  });

  predecessorUpdates.forEach(pu => {
    if (!relatedTaskIds.has(pu.id)) {
      const payload: any = {
        predecessor: pu.predecessor,
        updatedAt: pu.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString()
      };
      Object.keys(payload).forEach(k => {
        if (payload[k] === undefined) delete payload[k];
      });
      batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', pu.id), payload, { merge: true });
    }
  });

  const storeCosts = useAppStore.getState().costs || [];
  const relatedCosts = storeCosts.filter(c => {
    const matchesCode = String(c.projectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase() === oldPCode;
    const matchesYear = !c.projectYear || !oldPYear || String(c.projectYear) === oldPYear;
    const matchesStore = !c.projectStore || !oldPStore || String(c.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() === oldPStore;
    return matchesCode && matchesYear && matchesStore;
  });

  relatedCosts.forEach(c => {
    const payload: any = {
      projectCode: String(formData.code).trim(),
      projectYear: yearNum,
      projectStore: formData.store,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    Object.keys(payload).forEach(k => {
      if (payload[k] === undefined) delete payload[k];
    });
    batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', c.id), payload, { merge: true });
  });

  const predMap = new Map(predecessorUpdates.map(pu => [pu.id, pu.predecessor]));
  const updatedTasks = rawTasks.map(t => {
    const tUpdate = taskUpdates.get(t.id);
    const newPred = predMap.get(t.id);
    if (tUpdate || newPred !== undefined) {
      return {
        ...t,
        ...(tUpdate || {}),
        ...(newPred !== undefined ? { predecessor: newPred, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : {})
      };
    }
    return t;
  });
  useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);

  const rawProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
  const savedCode = String(formData.code).trim().toLowerCase();
  const savedYearStr = String(formData.year || '').trim();
  const savedStoreStr = String(formData.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  const updatedProjects = rawProjects.map(p => {
    if ((p.id && p.id === project.id) || (p.no !== undefined && project.no !== undefined && p.no === project.no)) {
      return { ...p, ...dataToSave, id: project.id || docId, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const pYear = String(p.year || '').trim();
    if ((!savedStoreStr || !pStore || pStore === savedStoreStr) && (!savedYearStr || !pYear || pYear === savedYearStr)) {
      if (p.linkCodes) {
        const allCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(p);
        if (allCodes.includes(savedCode) && String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== savedCode) {
          const cleaned = removeCodeFromLinkCodesString(p.linkCodes, formData.code);
          batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', p.id || String(p.no)), {
            linkCodes: cleaned,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { merge: true });
          return { ...p, linkCodes: cleaned, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        }
      }
    }
    return p;
  });
  useAppStore.getState().setProjects(updatedProjects);

  batch.commit().then(() => {
    recordBatchDeltas([
      { docId, collectionName: 'taka_projects', action: 'update', data: dataToSave, year: String(yearNum) },
      ...relatedTasks.map(t => ({
        docId: t.id,
        collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
        action: 'update' as const,
        data: { projectCode: String(formData.code).trim(), projectYear: yearNum, projectStore: formData.store },
        year: String(yearNum)
      })),
      ...relatedCosts.map(c => ({
        docId: c.id,
        collectionName: 'taka_costs' as const,
        action: 'update' as const,
        data: { projectCode: String(formData.code).trim(), projectYear: yearNum, projectStore: formData.store },
        year: String(yearNum)
      }))
    ]).catch(console.error);
  }).catch(e => {
    console.error("Batch commit failed", e);
    setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
  });

  undoManager.push({
    description: `Update Identity: ${project.code}(${project.year}) -> ${formData.code}(${formData.year})`,
    revert: async () => {
      const revertBatch = writeBatch(db);
      revertBatch.set(projectRef, project, { merge: true });
      relatedTasks.forEach(t => {
        const tRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id);
        revertBatch.set(tRef, {
          projectCode: project.code,
          projectYear: project.year,
          projectStore: project.store,
          ...(t.taskCodePhu !== undefined ? { taskCodePhu: t.taskCodePhu } : {}),
          ...(t.predecessor !== undefined ? { predecessor: t.predecessor } : {})
        }, { merge: true });
      });
      predecessorUpdates.forEach(pu => {
        if (!relatedTaskIds.has(pu.id)) {
          const originalTask = rawTasks.find(st => st.id === pu.id);
          revertBatch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', pu.id), {
            predecessor: originalTask?.predecessor || ''
          }, { merge: true });
        }
      });
      relatedCosts.forEach(c => {
        const cRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', c.id);
        revertBatch.set(cRef, {
          projectCode: project.code,
          projectYear: project.year,
          projectStore: project.store
        }, { merge: true });
      });
      revertBatch.commit().catch(console.error);
    }
  });
}


=== FILE: src/components/ProjectModalParts/projectModalTypes.ts ===
import { Project } from '../../types';

export interface ProjectModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  project: Project | null;
  isReadOnly?: boolean;
  initialTab?: 'details' | 'chat' | 'delegation';
  onOpenTask?: (taskId: string) => void;
}

export interface LinkCodesValidationError {
  invalidCode: string;
  duplicateProjectCode: string;
  duplicateProjectName: string;
  duplicateProjectYear: string | number;
}

export function getLinkCodesValidationError(
  inputLinkCodes: string,
  currentCode: string,
  currentProjectId: string | undefined,
  allProjects: Project[],
  currentYear?: string | number | null,
  currentStore?: string | null
): LinkCodesValidationError | null {
  if (!inputLinkCodes || !inputLinkCodes.trim()) return null;

  const enteredCodes = inputLinkCodes
    .split(/[,;/]+/)
    .map((c) => c.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  const selfCodeLower = (currentCode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const currentYearStr = currentYear !== undefined && currentYear !== null ? String(currentYear).trim() : '';
  const currentStoreStr = currentStore ? String(currentStore).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

  for (const code of enteredCodes) {
    const codeLower = code.toLowerCase();
    if (codeLower === selfCodeLower) continue;

    const duplicate = allProjects.find((p) => {
      if (currentProjectId && p.id === currentProjectId) return false;
      const otherCodeLower = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (otherCodeLower !== codeLower || otherCodeLower === '') return false;

      // Condition: Compare Year / Project Year
      const pAny = p as any;
      const otherYearStr = p.year !== undefined && p.year !== null 
        ? String(p.year).trim() 
        : (pAny.projectYear !== undefined && pAny.projectYear !== null ? String(pAny.projectYear).trim() : '');

      if (currentYearStr && otherYearStr && currentYearStr !== otherYearStr) {
        return false; // Different year - no collision
      }

      // Condition: Compare Store if both present
      const otherStoreStr = p.store ? String(p.store).trim().toLowerCase() : (pAny.projectStore ? String(pAny.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() : '');
      if (currentStoreStr && otherStoreStr && currentStoreStr !== otherStoreStr) {
        return false; // Different store - no collision
      }

      return true;
    });

    if (duplicate) {
      const dupYear = duplicate.year || (duplicate as any).projectYear || '';
      return {
        invalidCode: code,
        duplicateProjectCode: duplicate.code,
        duplicateProjectName: duplicate.name,
        duplicateProjectYear: dupYear,
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { enrichProjects } from '../../lib/utils';
import { doc, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { bumpConfigVersion } from '../../lib/configCacheService';
import { getLinkCodesValidationError } from './projectModalTypes';
import { useProjectModalMutations } from './useProjectModalMutations';
import { hydrateDelegationsForProjects, hydrateDelegationsFromLocal, hydrateTasksForProjects } from '../../lib/backgroundSyncWorker';
import { ensureProjectTasksLoaded } from '../../lib/taskStateService';

interface UseProjectModalDataParams {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  project: Project | null;
  isReadOnly?: boolean;
  initialTab?: 'details' | 'chat' | 'delegation';
}

export function useProjectModalData({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  project,
  isReadOnly = false,
  initialTab = 'details'
}: UseProjectModalDataParams) {
  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const parties = useAppStore(state => state.parties);
  const appUsers = useAppStore(state => state.appUsers);
  const subAppUsers = useAppStore(state => state.subAppUsers);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'details' | 'chat' | 'delegation'>(initialTab);
  const [isAddingLocation, setIsAddingLocation] = useState(false);
  const [newLocation, setNewLocation] = useState("");
  const yearRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => void;
  }>({
    isOpen: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    onConfirm: () => {}
  });

  // JIT Targeted Local-First Task & Delegation Hydration for Project (0ms, 0 Read)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && project) {
      const keys = [project.id, project.code].filter(Boolean) as string[];
      if (keys.length > 0) {
        hydrateTasksForProjects(keys).catch(() => {});
        hydrateDelegationsForProjects(keys).catch(() => {});
        if (project.code) {
          ensureProjectTasksLoaded(project.code).catch(() => {});
        }
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, project?.id, project?.code]);

  // Tri-Gate Lazy Loading: Activate delegation pipeline if user selects delegation tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && activeTab === 'delegation') {
      const { isDelegationsRequested, setIsDelegationsRequested } = useAppStore.getState();
      if (!isDelegationsRequested) {
        setIsDelegationsRequested(true);
      }
      hydrateDelegationsFromLocal().catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [isOpen, activeTab]);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Partial<Project>>({
    store: 'HCM',
    location: '',
    year: new Date().getFullYear(),
    code: '',
    name: '',
    party: '',
    detail: '',
    startMode: 'auto',
    handoverMode: 'auto',
    openingMode: 'auto'
  });

  const isArchiveYear = globalYearFilter !== 'all' && Number(globalYearFilter) < new Date().getFullYear();
  const canWrite = !isReadOnly && (currentUser?.role === 'admin' || currentUser?.canWrite) && !isArchiveYear;

  const enrichedProject = useMemo(
    () => (project ? enrichProjects([project], tasks)[0] : null),
    [project, tasks]
  );

  const linkCodesError = useMemo(() => {
    const rawLink = formData.linkCodes !== undefined ? String(formData.linkCodes) : String(formData.code || '');
    return getLinkCodesValidationError(rawLink, String(formData.code || ''), project?.id, projects, formData.year, formData.store);
  }, [formData.linkCodes, formData.code, formData.year, formData.store, project?.id, projects]);

  const { isSubmitting, handleSubmit, handleDelete } = useProjectModalMutations({
    project,
    formData,
    canWrite,
    projects,
    tasks,
    linkCodesError,
    enrichedProject,
    onClose,
    setConfirmModal
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setActiveTab(initialTab);
    }
  }, [isOpen, initialTab]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (confirmModal.isOpen) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose, confirmModal.isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (project) {
      setFormData({
        ...project,
        linkCodes: project.linkCodes ?? project.code ?? ''
      });
    } else {
      let defaultStore = 'HCM';
      if (currentUser?.role !== 'admin') {
        const allowedStores: string[] = [];
        if (currentUser?.storePermissions?.hcm) allowedStores.push('HCM');
        if (currentUser?.storePermissions?.hn) allowedStores.push('HN');
        if (allowedStores.length === 1) {
          defaultStore = allowedStores[0];
        } else {
          defaultStore = '';
        }
      }

      let defaultLocation = '';
      if (currentUser?.role !== 'admin' && currentUser?.locationPermissions) {
        if (currentUser.locationPermissions['all']) {
          defaultLocation = '';
        } else {
          const allowedLocs = Object.entries(currentUser.locationPermissions)
            .filter(([_, allowed]) => allowed)
            .map(([loc]) => loc);

          if (allowedLocs.length === 1) {
            const matched = locations.find(l => l.toLowerCase() === allowedLocs[0]);
            defaultLocation = matched || allowedLocs[0];
          } else {
            defaultLocation = '';
          }
        }
      }

      setFormData({
        store: defaultStore,
        location: defaultLocation,
        year: new Date().getFullYear(),
        code: '',
        linkCodes: '',
        name: '',
        party: '',
        detail: '',
        startMode: 'auto',
        handoverMode: 'auto',
        openingMode: 'auto'
      });
    }
  }, [project, isOpen, currentUser, locations]);

  const handleAddNewLocation = async () => {
    if (!newLocation.trim()) {
      setIsAddingLocation(false);
      return;
    }
    const locName = newLocation.trim();
    if (!locations.includes(locName)) {
      const newLocs = [...locations, locName];
      useAppStore.getState().setLocations(newLocs);
      try {
        setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "locations"), { list: newLocs }, { merge: true });
        bumpConfigVersion('locations');
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      }
    }
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, location: locName }));
    setIsAddingLocation(false);
    setNewLocation('');
  };

  return {
    projects,
    tasks,
    delegationGroups,
    currentUser,
    locations,
    parties,
    appUsers,
    subAppUsers,
    activeTab,
    setActiveTab,
    isSubmitting,
    isAddingLocation,
    setIsAddingLocation,
    newLocation,
    setNewLocation,
    formData,
    setFormData,
    canWrite,
    enrichedProject,
    linkCodesError,
    confirmModal,
    setConfirmModal,
    yearRef,
    handleAddNewLocation,
    handleSubmit,
    handleDelete
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/ProjectModalParts/useProjectModalMutations.ts ===
import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useState } from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { removeCodeFromLinkCodesString, extractAllProjectCodes } from '../../lib/utils';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch, setDoc, deleteDoc } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { undoManager } from '../../lib/undoManager';
import { addPendingUpdate } from '../../lib/syncQueue';
import { calculateProjectComputedDates, getTasksForProject } from '../../lib/projectDatesService';
import { deleteStorageFiles, extractStorageUrls } from '../../lib/storageUtils';
import { recordDelta } from '../../lib/deltaSyncService';
import { LinkCodesValidationError } from './projectModalTypes';
import { handleProjectIdentityChange } from './projectModalIdentityService';

interface UseProjectModalMutationsParams {
  project: Project | null;
  formData: Partial<Project>;
  canWrite: boolean;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  linkCodesError: LinkCodesValidationError | null;
  enrichedProject: any;
  onClose: () => void;
  setConfirmModal: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => void;
  }>>;
}

export function useProjectModalMutations({
  project,
  formData,
  canWrite,
  projects,
  tasks,
  linkCodesError,
  enrichedProject,
  onClose,
  setConfirmModal
}: UseProjectModalMutationsParams) {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const setToast = useAppStore(state => state.setToast);
  const cloudStatus = useAppStore(state => state.cloudStatus);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (isSubmitting) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      if (!canWrite) {
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const allStoreProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
      const validNos = allStoreProjects.map(p => p.no).filter(n => typeof n === 'number' && !isNaN(n));
      let no = project ? project.no : (validNos.length ? Math.max(...validNos) + 1 : 1);
      if (isNaN(no)) no = (validNos.length ? Math.max(...validNos) + 1 : 1);

      const docId = project?.id || String(no);

      if (!formData.year || String(formData.year).trim() === '') {
        setToast({ title: 'Validation Error', message: 'Project Year is strictly required.', type: 'error' });
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
      const yearNum = Number(formData.year);
      if (isNaN(yearNum) || yearNum < 2000 || yearNum > 2100) {
        setToast({ title: 'Validation Error', message: 'Please enter a valid Project Year.', type: 'error' });
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const cleanCode = String(formData.code || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
      if (!cleanCode) {
        setToast({ title: 'Validation Error', message: 'Project Code is strictly required and cannot contain spaces.', type: 'error' });
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      if (linkCodesError) {
        const yearDetail = linkCodesError.duplicateProjectYear ? ` (Year ${linkCodesError.duplicateProjectYear})` : '';
        setToast({
          title: 'Duplicate Project Code',
          message: `Code "${linkCodesError.invalidCode}" is already assigned to project "${linkCodesError.duplicateProjectCode}"${yearDetail} (${linkCodesError.duplicateProjectName}). Another project's code cannot be used as Project Code Link.`,
          type: 'error'
        });
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const storeTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
      const storeDelegationGroups = useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups;
      const projectForDates = project ? { ...project, ...formData } : formData;
      const computedDates = calculateProjectComputedDates(
        projectForDates,
        getTasksForProject(projectForDates, storeTasks),
        storeDelegationGroups
      );

      const dataToSave: any = {
        ...formData,
        no,
        year: yearNum,
        code: String(formData.code).trim(),
        linkCodes: formData.linkCodes ? String(formData.linkCodes).trim() : String(formData.code).trim(),
        isDeleted: false,
        taskCount: computedDates.taskCount !== undefined ? computedDates.taskCount : (project?.taskCount || 0),
        taskSummaries: (computedDates.taskSummaries && computedDates.taskSummaries.length >= (project?.taskSummaries?.length || 0))
          ? computedDates.taskSummaries
          : (project?.taskSummaries || computedDates.taskSummaries || []),
        computedPlanProgress: computedDates.computedPlanProgress ?? project?.computedPlanProgress ?? 0,
        computedActProgress: computedDates.computedActProgress ?? project?.computedActProgress ?? 0,
        computedTakStart: computedDates.computedTakStart || project?.computedTakStart || enrichedProject?.computedTakStart || formData.start || "",
        computedTakCompl: computedDates.computedTakCompl || project?.computedTakCompl || enrichedProject?.computedTakCompl || formData.handover || "",
        computedOpening: computedDates.computedOpening || project?.computedOpening || enrichedProject?.computedOpening || formData.opening || "",
      };

      if (cloudStatus === 'offline') {
        const payload = { ...dataToSave, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        delete payload.id;
        Object.keys(payload).forEach(key => {
          if ((payload as any)[key] === undefined) delete (payload as any)[key];
        });
        addPendingUpdate({ collectionPath: `artifacts/${APP_ID}/public/data/taka_projects`, action: 'set', docId, data: payload } as any);
        setToast({ title: 'Draft Saved', message: 'Project saved offline. Will sync when connection returns.' });
        onClose();
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      delete dataToSave.id;
      Object.keys(dataToSave).forEach(key => {
        if (dataToSave[key] === undefined) {
          delete dataToSave[key];
        }
      });

      const isDuplicate = projects.some(p =>
        String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase() === String(formData.code || '').trim().toLowerCase() &&
        String(p.year) === String(formData.year) &&
        String(p.store || '').trim().toLowerCase() === String(formData.store || '').trim().toLowerCase() &&
        (!project || (project.id && p.id ? p.id !== project.id : String(p.no) !== String(project.no)))
      );

      if (isDuplicate) {
        setToast({ title: "Error", message: `Project code "${formData.code}" already exists in year ${formData.year} - Store ${formData.store}. Please enter a different code.`, type: "error" });
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const isIdentityChange = project && (
        String(project.code || '').trim() !== String(formData.code || '').trim() ||
        String(project.year) !== String(formData.year) ||
        String(project.store || '').trim() !== String(formData.store || '').trim()
      );

      if (isIdentityChange) {
        await handleProjectIdentityChange({
          project,
          formData,
          dataToSave,
          docId,
          yearNum,
          projects,
          setToast
        });
      } else {
        const fullProjectPayload = {
          ...dataToSave,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId), fullProjectPayload, { merge: true });

        // Record delta so Desktop and other devices receive instant realtime update via delta pipeline
        recordDelta({
          docId,
          collectionName: 'taka_projects',
          action: project ? 'update' : 'create',
          data: fullProjectPayload,
          year: String(yearNum),
        }).catch(console.error);

        const rawProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
        const savedCode = String(formData.code).trim().toLowerCase();
        const savedYearStr = String(formData.year || '').trim();
        const savedStoreStr = String(formData.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();

        const otherProjectsToClean: { id: string; linkCodes: string }[] = [];
        const updatedProjects = rawProjects.map(p => {
          if (project && ((p.id && p.id === project.id) || (p.no !== undefined && project.no !== undefined && p.no === project.no))) {
            return { ...p, ...dataToSave, isDeleted: false, id: project.id || docId, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
          }
          const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
          const pYear = String(p.year || '').trim();
          if ((!savedStoreStr || !pStore || pStore === savedStoreStr) && (!savedYearStr || !pYear || pYear === savedYearStr)) {
            if (p.linkCodes) {
              const allCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(p);
              if (allCodes.includes(savedCode) && String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== savedCode) {
                const cleaned = removeCodeFromLinkCodesString(p.linkCodes, formData.code);
                otherProjectsToClean.push({ id: p.id || String(p.no), linkCodes: cleaned });
                return { ...p, linkCodes: cleaned, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
              }
            }
          }
          return p;
        });

        otherProjectsToClean.forEach(item => {
          setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', item.id), {
            linkCodes: item.linkCodes,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          }, { merge: true }).catch(console.error);
        });

        if (project) {
          useAppStore.getState().setProjects(updatedProjects);
        } else {
          useAppStore.getState().setProjects([...updatedProjects, { ...dataToSave, isDeleted: false, id: docId, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } as any]);

          const currentYearFilter = useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter;
          const currentStoreFilter = useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter;
          let filterChangedNotice = '';

          if (currentYearFilter !== 'all' && String(currentYearFilter) !== String(yearNum)) {
            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(String(yearNum));
            filterChangedNotice += ` Năm ${yearNum}`;
          }
          if (currentStoreFilter !== 'all' && currentStoreFilter !== formData.store) {
            const curUser = useAppStore.getState().currentUser;
            const canSeeStore = curUser?.role === 'admin' || (formData.store === 'HCM' ? curUser?.storePermissions?.hcm : curUser?.storePermissions?.hn);
            if (canSeeStore) {
              useAppStore.getState().setGlobalStoreFilter(formData.store);
              filterChangedNotice += ` Chi nhánh ${formData.store}`;
            }
          }

          setToast({
            title: "Project Created Successfully",
            message: filterChangedNotice
              ? `Created project ${formData.code} (${yearNum} - ${formData.store}) and automatically switched active filter to${filterChangedNotice}.`
              : `Created project ${formData.code} successfully.`,
            type: "success"
          });
        }

        undoManager.push({
          description: project ? `Update Project: ${formData.code}` : `Create Project: ${formData.code}`,
          revert: async () => {
            if (project) {
              setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId), project, { merge: true });
            } else {
              deleteDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId));
            }
          }
        });
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error("Save project error:", e);
      setToast({ title: "Error", message: e?.message || "Failed to save project.", type: "error" });
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!project) return;
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: 'Delete Project',
      message: `Permanently delete project ${project.code || project.name || ''} and all associated tasks?`,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          const { deleteProjectStateUnified } = await import('../../lib/taskStateService');
          await deleteProjectStateUnified(project.id || String(project.no) || project.code, project);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Success",
            message: `Deleted project ${project.code} successfully.`,
            type: "success"
          });
          onClose();
        } catch (e: any) {
          console.error("Delete project error:", e);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Error",
            message: e?.message || "Failed to delete project.",
            type: "error"
          });
        }
      }
    });
  };

  return {
    isSubmitting,
    handleSubmit,
    handleDelete
  };
}

  target: QuickNavTarget | null;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onNavigate: (targetTab: TabId, target: QuickNavTarget) => void;
}

export function ProjectQuickNavModal({
  target,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onNavigate
}: ProjectQuickNavModalProps) {
  const [showTaskPreview, setShowTaskPreview] = useState(false);
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);

  // Reset showTaskPreview when target changes or modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setShowTaskPreview(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, target?.project?.id, target?.task?.id]);

  // Close on Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        onClose();

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);

  const zInfo = useOverlayStack({
    layer: 'QUICK_NAV',
    isOpen,

    closeOnTabChange: true
  });

  const displayName = isTaskMode ? (task.name || project.name) : (project.name || 'Project');
  const store = project.store || task?.projectStore;

  const canSeeDetail = isAdmin || !!perms.See?.detail;
  const canSeeBudget = isAdmin || !!perms.See?.budget;
  const canSeeCost = isAdmin || !!perms.See?.costDetail;

  // Exact 5 ordered tabs as requested:
  // 1/ Layout: Floor Plan (Indigo)
  // 2/ Gantt: Timeline (Emerald)
  // 3/ Detail: Task Detail (Blue)
  // 4/ Budget: Budget (Amber)
  // 5/ Cost: Expenses (Rose)
  const navItems = [

        iconBg: 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-900/60 dark:text-indigo-300',
        accentText: 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400',
      }
    },
    {
      id: 'gantt' as TabId,
      allowed: canSeeGantt,
      num: '2',
      icon: BarChartHorizontal,
      label: 'Gantt',
      desc: 'Timeline',
      theme: {
        border: 'hover:border-emerald-500/70 dark:hover:border-emerald-400/70',
        bgHover: 'hover:bg-emerald-50/80 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/40',
        iconBg: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
        accentText: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
      }
    },
    {
      id: 'detail' as TabId,
      allowed: canSeeDetail,
      num: '3',
      icon: ListOrdered,
      label: 'Detail',
      desc: 'Task Detail',
      theme: {
        border: 'hover:border-blue-500/70 dark:hover:border-blue-400/70',
        bgHover: 'hover:bg-blue-50/80 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/40',
        iconBg: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/60 dark:text-blue-300',
        accentText: 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400',
      }
    },
    {
      id: 'budget' as TabId,
      allowed: canSeeBudget,
      num: '4',
      icon: PieChart,
      label: 'Budget',
      desc: 'Allocations',
      theme: {
        border: 'hover:border-amber-500/70 dark:hover:border-amber-400/70',
        bgHover: 'hover:bg-amber-50/80 dark:hover:bg-amber-950/40',
        iconBg: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/60 dark:text-amber-300',
        accentText: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400',
      }
    },

        >
          {/* Draggable Header */}
          <div className="px-3 py-2 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-[#252528] flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
              <GripHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">

                      {store}

                      {location}

                  <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 truncate leading-tight" title={project.name}>
                    {project.name}
