              id="quick-nav-close-btn"
              onClick={onClose}

              aria-label="Close"

            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />

                  key={item.id}

                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    onNavigate(item.id, target);
                    onClose();
                  }}
                  className={`w-full h-9 px-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#333336] bg-white dark:bg-[#232326] transition-all flex items-center justify-between group active:scale-[0.98] cursor-pointer shadow-xs ${item.theme.border} ${item.theme.bgHover}`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                    <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold w-3 shrink-0 text-center">
                      {item.num}
                    </span>
                    <div className={`w-5 h-5 rounded flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${item.theme.iconBg}`}>
                      <IconComp className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 group-hover:text-slate-950 dark:group-hover:text-white truncate">
                      {item.label}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 ml-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hidden sm:inline">
                      {item.desc}
                    </span>
                    <ChevronRight className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-transform ${item.theme.accentText}`} />
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Quick Task Preview (0 Firestore Read - Embedded in Project) */}
          {project.taskSummaries && project.taskSummaries.length > 0 && (
            <div className="px-2 pb-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] pt-1.5 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]">
              <button
                type="button"
                id="quick-nav-task-preview-toggle"
                onClick={() => setShowTaskPreview(!showTaskPreview)}
                className="w-full py-1 px-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-[#28282b] hover:bg-slate-200/90 dark:hover:bg-[#323236] border border-slate-200/70 dark:border-[#38383c] flex items-center justify-between transition-colors text-left cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                  <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 truncate">
                    Tasks Preview ({project.taskSummaries.length})
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[8px] px-1 py-0.2 rounded bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300 font-semibold shrink-0">
                    0 Read
                  </span>
                </div>
                {showTaskPreview ? (
                  <ChevronUp className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                )}
              </button>

              {showTaskPreview && (
                <div className="mt-1.5 max-h-44 overflow-y-auto space-y-1 pr-0.5 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#38383c] rounded-lg p-1 bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#1a1a1c]/80 text-left">
                  {project.taskSummaries.map((ts, idx) => {
                    const startDisp = ts.start ? formatDisplayDateMain(ts.start) : '';
                    const finishDisp = ts.finish ? formatDisplayDateMain(ts.finish) : '';
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={ts.id || idx}
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (canSeeDetail) {
                            onNavigate('detail', { project, task: ts as any });
                            onClose();
                          }

                        className="p-1 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-50/80 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/40 border border-transparent hover:border-blue-200 dark:hover:border-blue-900/50 cursor-pointer transition-colors group"
                        title="Click to view details in Task Detail tab"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-1">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 line-clamp-2 leading-tight">
                            {ts.name || `Task #${idx + 1}`}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {(startDisp || finishDisp) && (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[8px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-0.5 font-mono">
                            <Clock className="w-2.5 h-2.5 shrink-0" />
                            <span>{startDisp || '...'} → {finishDisp || '...'}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Micro Footer */}
          <div className="px-2.5 py-1 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#202022] text-[9px] text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-blue-500" />
              <span>Quick Nav</span>
            </span>
            <span>Esc to close</span>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    return createPortal(modalContent, document.body);
  }

  return modalContent;
}


=== FILE: src/components/QRCodeButton.tsx ===
import React, { FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { QrCode, X, Copy, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';

interface QRCodeButtonProps {
  url: string;
  title: string;
}

export const QRCodeButton: React.FC<QRCodeButtonProps> = ({ url, title }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <button 
        type="button" 
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}
        className="p-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] dark:hover:text-blue-400 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
        title="Generate QR Code"
      >
        <QrCode className="w-5 h-5" />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] rounded-xl shadow-xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full relative">
            <button 
              onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
              className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-[#c3c3c3]"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] mb-4 text-center">
              QR Code: {title}
            </h3>
            <div className="flex justify-center bg-white p-4 rounded-lg mb-4">
              <QRCodeSVG value={url} size={200} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#2a2a2c] p-2 rounded-lg">
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] flex-1 font-mono break-all text-center">
                {url}
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={handleCopy}
                className="p-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors shrink-0"
                title="Copy URL"
              >
                {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};


=== FILE: src/components/QRScannerModal.tsx ===
import React, { FC, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { X, Loader2, Camera, AlertTriangle, RefreshCw, Upload, ExternalLink, SwitchCamera, Image as ImageIcon, GripHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';
import { Html5Qrcode, Html5QrcodeScannerState } from 'html5-qrcode';
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import { ErrorBoundary } from './ErrorBoundary';

interface QRScannerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onScan: (decodedText: string) => void;
}

const ScannerInner: React.FC<QRScannerModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onScan }) => {
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hasCamera, setHasCamera] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [cameras, setCameras] = useState<{ id: string; label: string }[]>([]);
  const [currentCameraIndex, setCurrentCameraIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isProcessingFile, setIsProcessingFile] = useState(false);
  const [fileError, setFileError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const scannerRef = useRef<Html5Qrcode | null>(null);
  const fileScannerRef = useRef<Html5Qrcode | null>(null);
  const isComponentUnmounted = useRef(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const startAttemptRef = useRef(0);
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const isInIframe = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.self !== window.top;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const stopActiveScanner = async () => {
    // Ensure all media stream tracks are cleanly stopped to release camera hardware
    try {
      const videoEls = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLVideoElement>('#reader video');
      videoEls.forEach((v) => {
        if (v.srcObject && 'getTracks' in (v.srcObject as any)) {
          (v.srcObject as MediaStream).getTracks().forEach((track) => {
            try { track.stop(); } catch (e) {}
          });
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    if (scannerRef.current) {
      const scanner = scannerRef.current;
      scannerRef.current = null;
      try {
        const state = scanner.getState();
        if (state === Html5QrcodeScannerState.SCANNING || state === Html5QrcodeScannerState.PAUSED) {
          await scanner.stop().catch(() => {});
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Ignore stop error
      }
      try {
        const el = document.getElementById("reader");
        if (el) {
          el.innerHTML = "";
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Ignore DOM reset error
      }
    }
  };

  const waitForReaderElement = async (maxAttempts = 25, delayMs = 60): Promise<HTMLElement | null> => {
    for (let i = 0; i < maxAttempts; i++) {
      if (isComponentUnmounted.current) return null;
      const el = document.getElementById("reader");
      if (el && el.clientWidth > 0) return el;
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, delayMs));
    }
    return document.getElementById("reader");
  };

  const startScannerWithConfig = async (cameraList?: { id: string; label: string }[], camIndex: number = 0) => {
    if (!isOpen || isComponentUnmounted.current) return;
    const attemptId = ++startAttemptRef.current;

    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setFileError(null);

    await stopActiveScanner();
    if (startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) return;

    // Ensure DOM element exists and has computed dimensions
    const readerEl = await waitForReaderElement();
    if (!readerEl || startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) {
      if (!isComponentUnmounted.current && isOpen) {
        setIsLoading(false);
        setError("Không thể khởi tạo khung hiển thị camera. Vui lòng thử lại.");
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      const html5QrCode = new Html5Qrcode("reader");
      scannerRef.current = html5QrCode;

      let targetCameraConfig: any = null;

      // 1. If cameras list is already known, pick from it
      if (cameraList && cameraList.length > 0) {
        const idx = Math.min(camIndex, cameraList.length - 1);
        targetCameraConfig = cameraList[idx].id;
      } else {
        // Try getting cameras first
        try {
          const availableDevices = await Html5Qrcode.getCameras();
          if (startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) {
            await stopActiveScanner();
            return;
          }
          if (availableDevices && availableDevices.length > 0) {
            setCameras(availableDevices);
            // Default to back camera on mobile if available, otherwise first camera (desktop webcam)
            const backIndex = availableDevices.findIndex(d => 
              d.label.toLowerCase().includes('back') || 
              d.label.toLowerCase().includes('rear') || 
              d.label.toLowerCase().includes('sau') ||
              d.label.toLowerCase().includes('environment')
            );
            const chosenIdx = backIndex >= 0 ? backIndex : 0;
            setCurrentCameraIndex(chosenIdx);
            targetCameraConfig = availableDevices[chosenIdx].id;
          }
        } catch (camErr) {
          console.warn("Could not enumerate cameras directly, will try permission prompt or facingMode fallbacks", camErr);
        }

        // Active permission request if no camera device ID found yet
        if (!targetCameraConfig && navigator?.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
          try {
            const tempStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true });
            tempStream.getTracks().forEach((track) => {
              try { track.stop(); } catch (e) {}
            });
            if (startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) {
              await stopActiveScanner();
              return;
            }
            const recheckedDevices = await Html5Qrcode.getCameras().catch(() => []);
            if (recheckedDevices && recheckedDevices.length > 0) {
              setCameras(recheckedDevices);
              const backIndex = recheckedDevices.findIndex(d => 
                d.label.toLowerCase().includes('back') || 
                d.label.toLowerCase().includes('rear') || 
                d.label.toLowerCase().includes('sau') ||
                d.label.toLowerCase().includes('environment')
              );
              const chosenIdx = backIndex >= 0 ? backIndex : 0;
              setCurrentCameraIndex(chosenIdx);
              targetCameraConfig = recheckedDevices[chosenIdx].id;
            }
          } catch (permErr) {
            console.warn("Active getUserMedia pre-check notice:", permErr);
          }
        }
      }

      if (startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) {
        await stopActiveScanner();
        return;
      }

      // Handler for successful scan
      const onScanSuccess = (decodedText: string) => {
        if (isComponentUnmounted.current) return;
        onScan(decodedText);
        onClose();
      };

      const scanConfig = {
        fps: 5,
        qrbox: (viewfinderWidth: number, viewfinderHeight: number) => {
          const minEdge = Math.min(viewfinderWidth || 250, viewfinderHeight || 250);
          const computed = Math.floor(minEdge * 0.7);
          const edgeSize = Math.max(computed, 100);
          return { width: edgeSize, height: edgeSize };
        },
        aspectRatio: 1.0,
      };

      // Double-check DOM element before starting stream
      const checkEl = document.getElementById("reader");
      if (!checkEl || startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) {
        await stopActiveScanner();
        return;
      }

      // 2. Start with chosen camera ID if found
      if (targetCameraConfig) {
        await html5QrCode.start(targetCameraConfig, scanConfig, onScanSuccess, () => {});
      } else {
        // Fallback 1: Try environment (mobile rear)
        try {
          await html5QrCode.start({ facingMode: "environment" }, scanConfig, onScanSuccess, () => {});
        } catch (envErr) {
          if (startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) {
            await stopActiveScanner();
            return;
          }
          console.warn("facingMode 'environment' failed, falling back to 'user' (desktop/front)", envErr);
          // Fallback 2: Try user (desktop webcam / front camera)
          try {
            await html5QrCode.start({ facingMode: "user" }, scanConfig, onScanSuccess, () => {});
          } catch (userErr) {
            if (startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) {
              await stopActiveScanner();
              return;
            }
            // Fallback 3: Re-query getCameras() in case permission was just granted
            const devs = await Html5Qrcode.getCameras().catch(() => []);
            if (devs && devs.length > 0) {
              setCameras(devs);
              setCurrentCameraIndex(0);
              await html5QrCode.start(devs[0].id, scanConfig, onScanSuccess, () => {});
            } else {
              throw userErr;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      if (startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) {
        await stopActiveScanner();
        return;
      }

      setHasCamera(true);
      setIsLoading(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (startAttemptRef.current !== attemptId || isComponentUnmounted.current) {
        return;
      }
      console.error("Camera start failed:", err);
      setHasCamera(false);
      setIsLoading(false);
      const msg = err?.message || String(err || "");
      if (msg.includes("NotAllowedError") || msg.includes("Permission denied") || msg.includes("denied")) {
        setError("Quyền truy cập Camera bị từ chối trong trình duyệt. Vui lòng cấp quyền Camera.");
      } else if (msg.includes("NotFoundError") || msg.includes("DevicesNotFoundError") || msg.includes("OverconstrainedError")) {
        setError("Không tìm thấy thiết bị Camera/Webcam phù hợp trên thiết bị này.");
      } else if (msg.includes("NotReadableError") || msg.includes("TrackStartError")) {
        setError("Camera đang được ứng dụng khác (Zoom, Teams...) sử dụng.");
      } else if (msg.includes("clientWidth") || msg.includes("null")) {
        setError("Khung camera chưa sẵn sàng. Vui lòng bấm 'Thử lại Camera' hoặc tải ảnh QR từ máy.");
      } else {
        setError(msg || "Không thể kết nối Camera.");
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    isComponentUnmounted.current = false;
    if (isOpen) {
      startScannerWithConfig();
    }

    return () => {
      isComponentUnmounted.current = true;
      stopActiveScanner();
      if (fileScannerRef.current) {
        fileScannerRef.current = null;
        try {
          const fileEl = document.getElementById("file-reader-hidden");
          if (fileEl) fileEl.innerHTML = "";
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    };
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSwitchCamera = async () => {
    if (cameras.length <= 1) return;
    const nextIndex = (currentCameraIndex + 1) % cameras.length;
    setCurrentCameraIndex(nextIndex);
    await startScannerWithConfig(cameras, nextIndex);
  };

  const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setIsProcessingFile(true);
    setFileError(null);

    try {
      if (!fileScannerRef.current) {
        fileScannerRef.current = new Html5Qrcode("file-reader-hidden");
      }
      const decodedText = await fileScannerRef.current.scanFile(file, false);
      if (decodedText) {
        onScan(decodedText);
        onClose();
      }
    } catch (scanErr: any) {
      console.error("File QR scan failed", scanErr);
      setFileError("Không tìm thấy mã QR hợp lệ trong bức ảnh này. Vui lòng chọn ảnh khác rõ nét hơn.");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessingFile(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) {
        fileInputRef.current.value = "";
      }
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <Portal>

import React from 'react';
import { ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project, Task } from '../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';

interface QuickNavButtonProps {
  project: Project;
  task?: Task | null;
  taskCode?: string;
  className?: string;
  title?: string;
}

export function QuickNavButton({ project, task, taskCode, className = "", title }: QuickNavButtonProps) {
  const setQuickNavTarget = useAppStore(state => state.setQuickNavTarget);

  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const effectiveCode = taskCode || (task ? (task.taskCodePhu || project?.code) : project?.code);
    setQuickNavTarget({
      project,
      task,
      taskCode: effectiveCode,
    });
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleClick}
      className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800/90 dark:bg-[#242426] hover:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] border border-slate-700/80 dark:border-[#444446] text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-400 transition-all shadow-xs active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center ${className}`}
      title={title || "Quick Navigator"}
      aria-label="Quick Navigator"
    >
      <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[2.2]" />
    </button>
  );
}


=== FILE: src/components/ResizableHeader.tsx ===
import React, { ReactNode, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

export function ResizableHeader({ 
  width, 
  minWidth = 50, 
  onResize, 
  children, 
  className, 
  onClick,
  onHide,
  hideable = false
}: { 
  width: number, 
  minWidth?: number, 
  onResize: (w: number) => void, 
  children: React.ReactNode, 
  className?: string, 
  onClick?: () => void,
  onHide?: () => void,
  hideable?: boolean
}) {
  const [isResizing, setIsResizing] = useState(false);

  const startResize = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsResizing(true);
    
    const startX = e.pageX;
    const startWidth = width;

    const onMouseMove = (moveEvent: MouseEvent) => {
      const newWidth = Math.max(minWidth, startWidth + (moveEvent.pageX - startX));
      onResize(newWidth);
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      setIsResizing(false);
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
  };

  return (
    <th 
      className={cn("relative group", className)} 
      style={{ width, minWidth: width, maxWidth: width }}
      onClick={onClick}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full h-full">
        <div className="flex-grow whitespace-normal break-words leading-tight">{children}</div>
        {hideable && onHide && (
          <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onHide(); }}
            className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-0.5 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] hover:text-red-500 transition-all z-10 ml-1 shrink-0"
            title="Hide column"
          >
            <X className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div 
        className={cn(
          "absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1.5 cursor-col-resize hover:bg-blue-400 z-20",
          isResizing ? "bg-blue-500" : "bg-transparent"
        )}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        onMouseDown={startResize}
      />
    </th>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { Check, Maximize2, LayoutGrid, SlidersHorizontal, PanelTop, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';

interface RibbonDisplayMenuProps {
  className?: string;
  variant?: 'navbar' | 'header' | 'floating';
}

export function RibbonDisplayMenu({ className = '', variant = 'navbar' }: RibbonDisplayMenuProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const ribbonDisplayMode = useAppStore(state => state.ribbonDisplayMode);
  const setRibbonDisplayMode = useAppStore(state => state.setRibbonDisplayMode);
  const showQuickAccessToolbar = useAppStore(state => state.showQuickAccessToolbar);
  const setShowQuickAccessToolbar = useAppStore(state => state.setShowQuickAccessToolbar);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  return (
    <div ref={menuRef} className={`relative inline-block ${className}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all border shadow-sm cursor-pointer select-none active:scale-95 touch-manipulation ${
          variant === 'floating'
            ? 'bg-slate-800 text-white dark:bg-slate-200 dark:text-slate-900 border-slate-700 dark:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
            : variant === 'header'
              ? 'bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]'

        }`}
        title="Ribbon Display Options"
      >
        <PanelTop className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]" />
        <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-1.5 z-[9999] w-72 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-2 text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 backdrop-blur-md">
          {/* Menu Title */}
          <div className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] mb-1">
            Show Ribbon
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            {/* 1. Full-screen mode */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setRibbonDisplayMode('fullscreen');
                setIsOpen(false);
              }}
              className={`w-full flex items-start gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs text-left transition-colors group ${
                ribbonDisplayMode === 'fullscreen'
                  ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-bold'
                  : 'hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                {ribbonDisplayMode === 'fullscreen' ? (
                  <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]" />
                ) : (
                  <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-slate-600 dark:group-hover:text-[#e3e3e3]" />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="font-bold underline decoration-slate-300 dark:decoration-slate-600 underline-offset-2">Full-screen mode</div>
                <div className="text-[11px] font-normal text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mt-0.5">
                  Tự động ẩn Ribbon để tối đa hóa không gian làm việc.
                </div>
              </div>
            </button>

            {/* 2. Show tabs only */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setRibbonDisplayMode('tabs_only');
                setIsOpen(false);
              }}
              className={`w-full flex items-start gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs text-left transition-colors group ${
                ribbonDisplayMode === 'tabs_only'
                  ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-bold'
                  : 'hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]'
              }`}

const ConfirmModal = lazyWithRetry(() => import('./ConfirmModal').then(m => ({ default: m.ConfirmModal })), 'ConfirmModal');
const DesktopOptimizationModal = lazyWithRetry(() => import('./DesktopOptimizationModal').then(m => ({ default: m.DesktopOptimizationModal })), 'DesktopOptimizationModal');

export function SettingTab({ rules }: SettingTabProps) {
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  
  const [showPerformanceDashboard, setShowPerformanceDashboard] = useState(false);
  const [showDataMaintenance, setShowDataMaintenance] = useState(false);
  const [showDesktopOptModal, setShowDesktopOptModal] = useState(false);

  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState<ConfirmModalState>({
    isOpen: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    onConfirm: () => {}
  });

  const canWrite = currentUser.role === 'admin' || currentUser.canWrite;
  const isAdmin = currentUser.role === 'admin';

  const jpyRate = useAppStore(state => state.jpyRate);
  const usdRate = useAppStore(state => state.usdRate);
  const [jpyRateInput, setJpyRateInput] = useState(jpyRate.toString());
  const [usdRateInput, setUsdRateInput] = useState(usdRate.toString());

  const handleSaveExchangeRates = async () => {
    const parsedJpy = parseFloat(jpyRateInput);
    const parsedUsd = parseFloat(usdRateInput);
    
    if (isNaN(parsedJpy) || isNaN(parsedUsd)) {
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Please enter valid numbers for exchange rates." });
      return;
    }
    
    useAppStore.getState().setJpyRate(parsedJpy);
    useAppStore.getState().setUsdRate(parsedUsd);
    
    try {
      await setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_settings", "exchange_rates"), { 
        jpyRate: parsedJpy,
        usdRate: parsedUsd
      }, { merge: true });
      bumpConfigVersion('rates');
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Exchange rates updated successfully." });
    } catch (error) { 
      console.error(error); 
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Failed to update exchange rates." });
    }
  };

  const handleEnablePush = async () => {
    if (currentUser.id === "guest") {
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Please login first to enable push notifications." });
      return;
    }
    if (currentUser.notification === false) {
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Push notifications are disabled for your account by the administrator." });
      return;
    }
    await requestNotificationPermission(currentUser.id);
  };

  const triggerConfirmAction = (title: string, message: string, onConfirm: () => Promise<void>) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title,
      message,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        await onConfirm();
        setConfirmModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col flex-grow bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden overflow-y-auto">
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        {confirmModal.isOpen && (
          <ConfirmModal 
            isOpen={confirmModal.isOpen}
            title={confirmModal.title}
            message={confirmModal.message}
            onConfirm={confirmModal.onConfirm}
            onCancel={() => setConfirmModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }))}
          />
        )}
      </Suspense>

      <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 shrink-0">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">{t("Settings")}</h2>
      </div>
      
      <div className="p-5 flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] items-center">
        {currentUser.role !== 'guest' && (
          <>
            <button 
              title="Refresh"
              onClick={() => {
                if (window.confirm("Do you want to refresh the app to update to the latest version?")) {
                  window.location.reload();

                />
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={handleSaveExchangeRates}

            rules={rules}

      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        {showDesktopOptModal && (
          <DesktopOptimizationModal 
            isOpen={showDesktopOptModal} 
            onClose={() => setShowDesktopOptModal(false)} 
          />
        )}
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { FC, useState } from 'react';
import { Database, Trash2, Calendar, FolderOutput, Sparkles, Hash, Layers, CheckCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { clearAllIDB } from "../../lib/idb";
import { clearDexieDatabase } from "../../lib/localDb";
import { useAppStore } from "../../store/useAppStore";
import { syncAllProjectsTaskCountsToFirestore } from "../../lib/projectDatesService";
import { convertAllSubtaskCodesAndPredecessorsToHash } from "../../lib/ganttUtils";
import { scanAndRemoveDuplicateTasksOnFirestore, deduplicateTasksInMemory } from "../../lib/taskDeduplicationService";
import { 
  purgeDeletedTombstones, 
  standardizeFiscalYears, 
  repairMissingTaskYears, 
  archiveHistoricalData 
} from "./maintenanceHelpers";
import { Project, Task } from "../../types";
import { doc, collection, getDocs } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from "../../lib/firebase";

interface SettingDataMaintenanceProps {
  isAdmin: boolean;
  onConfirmAction: (title: string, message: string, onConfirm: () => Promise<void>) => void;
}

export const SettingDataMaintenance: React.FC<SettingDataMaintenanceProps> = ({
  isAdmin,
  onConfirmAction,
}) => {
  const [isPurging, setIsPurging] = useState(false);
  const [isFixingMissingYears, setIsFixingMissingYears] = useState(false);
  const [isStandardizingYears, setIsStandardizingYears] = useState(false);
  const [isArchiving, setIsArchiving] = useState(false);
  const [isPruningDelegations, setIsPruningDelegations] = useState(false);
  const [isSyncingTaskCounts, setIsSyncingTaskCounts] = useState(false);
  const [isConvertingToHash, setIsConvertingToHash] = useState(false);
  const [isDeduplicating, setIsDeduplicating] = useState(false);

  const handleClearLocalCache = async () => {
    if (window.confirm("Do you want to clear all local IndexedDB cache, delta markers, and resync fresh data from server?")) {
      try {
        // 1. Wipe Dexie IndexedDB tables
        await clearDexieDatabase();
        // 2. Wipe legacy IDB store
        await clearAllIDB();
        
        // 3. Clear LocalStorage sync timestamps & fingerprint caches
        const keysToRemove = [
          "taka_last_delta_sync_time_v1",
          "taka_years_meta_fingerprint_v1",
          "taka_expanded_projects",
        ];
        if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
          for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
            const k = localStorage.key(i);
            if (k && (k.startsWith("taka_year_data_v1_") || k.startsWith("taka_read_notifs_"))) {
              keysToRemove.push(k);
            }
          }
          keysToRemove.forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
        }
        if (typeof sessionStorage !== "undefined") {
          sessionStorage.clear();
        }

        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Cache Cleared", message: "Local cache cleared completely. Reloading app...", type: "success" });
        setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 400);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to clear cache:", e);
        window.location.reload();
      }
    }
  };

  const handleDeduplicateTasks = () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    onConfirmAction(
      "Quét & Hợp nhất Task con trùng lặp",
      "Hệ thống sẽ quét toàn bộ task trên Firestore và bộ nhớ, tự động phát hiện các task con bị trùng tên trong cùng một dự án, giữ lại bản ghi đầy đủ/mới nhất và xóa các bản ghi dư thừa. Bạn có muốn tiếp tục?",
      async () => {
        setIsDeduplicating(true);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Đang quét...",
          message: "Đang phân tích và xử lý các task con trùng lặp trên Firestore...",
          type: "info"
        });
        try {
          const projects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
          const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
          const { dedupedTasks } = deduplicateTasksInMemory(currentTasks, projects);
          useAppStore.getState().setTasks(dedupedTasks);

          const result = await scanAndRemoveDuplicateTasksOnFirestore(projects);
          if (result.removedCount > 0) {
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({
              title: "Dọn dẹp thành công",
              message: `Đã phát hiện và xóa ${result.removedCount} task con trùng lặp trên Firestore!`,
              type: "success"
            });
          } else {
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({
              title: "Dữ liệu chuẩn",
              message: "Không phát hiện task con nào bị trùng lặp trên hệ thống.",
              type: "info"
            });
          }
        } catch (e: any) {
          console.error("Deduplicate tasks error:", e);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Lỗi dọn dẹp",
            message: e?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra khi xử lý task trùng lặp.",
            type: "error"
          });
        } finally {
          setIsDeduplicating(false);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  const handlePurgeOldTombstones = () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    onConfirmAction(
      "Purge Deleted Tombstones (> 60 days)",
      "This will permanently remove soft-deleted records older than 60 days from Firestore (projects, tasks, costs). Continue?",
      async () => {
        setIsPurging(true);
        try {
          const deletedCount = await purgeDeletedTombstones();
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Cleanup Complete", message: `Permanently purged ${deletedCount} obsolete tombstone record(s).` });
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Purge error:", e);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: "Failed to purge tombstones. Check permissions." });
        } finally {
          setIsPurging(false);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  const handleStandardizeYears = () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    onConfirmAction(
      "Standardize Fiscal Year Format",
      "The system will scan all Projects, Tasks, Costs, and Delegations to convert string year values ('2026', '2027') to uniform number format (2026, 2027). Do you want to proceed?",
      async () => {
        setIsStandardizingYears(true);
        try {
          const totalUpdated = await standardizeFiscalYears();
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Standardization Completed",
            message: `Successfully standardized ${totalUpdated} records to number format.`,
            type: "success"
          });
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Standardize years error:", e);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Error",
            message: "Failed to standardize fiscal year values.",
            type: "error"
          });
        } finally {
          setIsStandardizingYears(false);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  const handleFixMissingTaskYears = () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    onConfirmAction(
      "Repair Missing Project Years",
      "The system will scan Tasks, Costs, and Delegations with empty projectYear values and backfill the year from their matching parent Projects. Do you want to proceed?",
      async () => {
        setIsFixingMissingYears(true);
        try {
          const totalUpdated = await repairMissingTaskYears();
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Repair Completed",
            message: `Successfully backfilled projectYear for ${totalUpdated} records.`,
            type: "success"
          });
        } catch (error: any) {
          console.error("Error fixing missing years", error);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: error?.message || "An error occurred", type: "error" });
        } finally {
          setIsFixingMissingYears(false);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  const handleArchiveData = () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    onConfirmAction(
      "Archive Cold Storage (2024, 2025)",
      "The system will extract all Projects, Tasks, Costs, and Delegations from archived years (2024, 2025) and upload a compressed JSON bundle to Firebase Storage. This optimizes Firestore reads when selecting 'All Years'. Do you want to proceed?",
      async () => {
        setIsArchiving(true);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Archiving...", message: "Generating archive bundle for historical years. Please wait...", type: "info" });
        try {
          const count = await archiveHistoricalData();
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Archived Successfully",
            message: `Created archive containing ${count} records.`,
            type: "success"
          });
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Archive error:", e);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: "Failed to create archive data.", type: "error" });
        } finally {
          setIsArchiving(false);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  const handleSyncAllTaskCounts = () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    onConfirmAction(
      "Sync Project Task Counts",
      "The system will scan all Projects and Tasks on Firestore to recalculate accurate task counts, progress, and actual dates, then write them directly to each Project document. Do you want to proceed?",
      async () => {
        setIsSyncingTaskCounts(true);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Syncing...",
          message: "Aggregating and synchronizing task counts across all projects on Firestore...",
          type: "info"
        });
        try {
          const result = await syncAllProjectsTaskCountsToFirestore((processed, total) => {
            console.log(`[TaskCountSync] Processed ${processed}/${total} projects`);
          });
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Sync Complete",
            message: `Successfully updated task counts for ${result.updatedCount}/${result.totalProjects} projects on Firestore.`,
            type: "success"
          });
        } catch (error: any) {
          console.error("Error syncing task counts:", error);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Sync Failed",
            message: error?.message || "Failed to sync task counts",
            type: "error"
          });
        } finally {
          setIsSyncingTaskCounts(false);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  const handleConvertToHashFormat = () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    onConfirmAction(
      "Quét & Chuyển đổi '-' thành '#' (Subtask Code & Predecessor)",
      "Hệ thống sẽ quét toàn bộ dữ liệu công việc trong ứng dụng và chuyển đổi tất cả mã phụ (Subtask Code) và liên kết Predecessor từ dấu '-' sang '#' (Ví dụ: B2-B208-1 ➜ B2-B208#1, CP-01-2 ➜ CP-01#2). Bạn có muốn tiếp tục?",
      async () => {
        setIsConvertingToHash(true);
        try {
          const [projSnap, taskSnap] = await Promise.all([
            getDocs(collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects')),
            getDocs(collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks'))
          ]);

          const allProjects: Project[] = projSnap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() } as Project));
          const allTasks: Task[] = taskSnap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() } as Task));

          const result = convertAllSubtaskCodesAndPredecessorsToHash(allTasks, allProjects);

          if (result.changedCount > 0) {
            const CHUNK_SIZE = 400;
            for (let i = 0; i < result.updatesToSave.length; i += CHUNK_SIZE) {
              const chunk = result.updatesToSave.slice(i, i + CHUNK_SIZE);
              const batch = writeBatch(db);
              chunk.forEach(u => {
                const tRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', u.id);
                const updatePayload: any = { updatedAt: u.updatedAt };
                if (u.predecessor !== undefined) updatePayload.predecessor = u.predecessor;
                if (u.taskCodePhu !== undefined) updatePayload.taskCodePhu = u.taskCodePhu;
                batch.set(tRef, updatePayload, { merge: true });
              });
              await batch.commit();
            }

            useAppStore.getState().setTasks(result.updatedTasks);
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({
              title: "Chuyển đổi thành công",
              message: `Đã quét và chuyển đổi thành công ${result.changedCount} công việc sang định dạng '#' (Subtask Code & Predecessor)!`,
              type: "success"
            });
          } else {
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({
              title: "Hoàn tất kiểm tra",
              message: "Tất cả các mã Subtask Code và Predecessor đã ở định dạng '#' chuẩn.",
              type: "info"
            });
          }
        } catch (e: any) {
          console.error("Convert to hash error:", e);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Lỗi chuyển đổi",
            message: e?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra khi chuyển đổi sang định dạng '#'.",
            type: "error"
          });
        } finally {
          setIsConvertingToHash(false);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  const handlePruneEmptyDelegationsAction = () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    onConfirmAction(
      "Scan & Prune Empty Delegations",
      "The system will scan taka_delegation_groups on Firestore to detect auto-generated import placeholders with 0 subtasks, 0 comments, and 0 attachments, then safely delete them from Firestore and local cache to cut read usage by ~95%. Genuine delegations will be 100% preserved. Do you want to proceed?",
      async () => {
        setIsPruningDelegations(true);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Scanning...",
          message: "Analyzing delegation records on Firestore...",
          type: "info"
        });
        try {
          const { scanEmptyDelegations, pruneEmptyDelegations } = await import("../../lib/delegationMaintenanceService");
          const scanResult = await scanEmptyDelegations();
          if (scanResult.emptyCount === 0) {
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({
              title: "Delegations Clean",
              message: `Scanned ${scanResult.totalScanned} groups. All ${scanResult.genuineCount} records are active and genuine!`,
              type: "info"
            });
            return;
          }

          const pruneResult = await pruneEmptyDelegations(scanResult.emptyGroups.map(g => g.id));
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Pruning Complete",
            message: `Safely deleted ${pruneResult.deletedCount} empty placeholder delegations. Preserved ${scanResult.genuineCount} active groups!`,
            type: "success"
          });
        } catch (e: any) {
          console.error("Prune delegations error:", e);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Pruning Failed",
            message: e?.message || "Failed to prune empty delegations",
            type: "error"
          });
        } finally {
          setIsPruningDelegations(false);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <button
        onClick={handleClearLocalCache}
        title="Clear Local Cache & Resync"
        className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a]/50 transition-colors flex items-center gap-3 font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] shadow-sm text-sm"
      >
        <Database className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
        Clear & Resync Cache
      </button>

      <button
        onClick={handleDeduplicateTasks}
        disabled={isDeduplicating}
        title="Quét và xóa các task con bị trùng tên trong cùng một dự án"
        className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/40 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/20 transition-colors flex items-center gap-3 font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 shadow-sm text-sm disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
      >
        <CheckCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
        {isDeduplicating ? "Đang xử lý..." : "Deduplicate Tasks"}
      </button>

      <button
        onClick={handlePruneEmptyDelegationsAction}
        disabled={isPruningDelegations}
        title="Scan and delete empty/unused auto-imported delegation placeholders to save Firestore reads"
        className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/40 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-purple-50 dark:hover:bg-purple-950/20 transition-colors flex items-center gap-3 font-medium text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400 shadow-sm text-sm disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
      >
        <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-500" />
        {isPruningDelegations ? "Pruning..." : "Prune Empty Delegations"}
      </button>

      <button
        onClick={handlePurgeOldTombstones}
        disabled={isPurging}
        title="Purge soft-deleted records older than 60 days from Firestore"
        className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/40 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/20 transition-colors flex items-center gap-3 font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 shadow-sm text-sm disabled:opacity-50"
      >
        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
        {isPurging ? "Purging..." : "Purge Tombstones (>60d)"}
      </button>

      <button
        onClick={handleStandardizeYears}

const EMOJI_OPTIONS = ['🔔', '⚠️', '📅', '🚀', '💡', '📌', '⏳', '✅', '❌', '🔥', '🎉'];

const fieldLabels: Record<string, string> = {
  'start': 'Pj Start',
  'handover': 'Pj Compl',
  'opening': 'Opening',
  'finish': 'Finish',
  'flow_status': 'Flow Status'
};

interface SettingNotificationRulesProps {
  rules: NotificationRule[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  onConfirmDelete: (title: string, message: string, onConfirm: () => Promise<void>) => void;
}

export const SettingNotificationRules: React.FC<SettingNotificationRulesProps> = ({
  rules,
  canWrite,
  onConfirmDelete,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<'project' | 'task' | 'task_delegation'>('project');
  const [field, setField] = useState('start');
  const [days, setDays] = useState(3);
  const [hours, setHours] = useState(0);
  const [customMessage, setCustomMessage] = useState('');
  const [color, setColor] = useState('#3b82f6');
  const [icon, setIcon] = useState('🔔');

  const handleAddRule = async () => {
    if (!canWrite) return;
    const newRule: NotificationRule = {
      id: generateId(),
      target,
      field,
      daysBefore: days,
      hoursBefore: hours,
      customMessage: customMessage.trim() || "",
      color,
      icon
    };

      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_rules', newRule.id), newRule);
      await bumpConfigVersion('rules');
      setCustomMessage('');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRule = (id: string) => {
    onConfirmDelete('Delete Rule', 'Delete this notification rule?', async () => {
      try {
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_rules', id));
        await bumpConfigVersion('rules');
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      }
    });
  };

            <select
              value={target}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const val = e.target.value as 'project' | 'task' | 'task_delegation';
                setTarget(val);
                setField(val === 'project' ? 'start' : (val === 'task_delegation' ? 'flow_status' : 'start'));
              }}
              className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555558] text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none w-full md:w-40 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]"

=== FILE: src/components/SettingTabParts/maintenanceHelpers.ts ===
import { doc, collection, query, where, getDocs } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID, storage } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { ref, uploadString } from 'firebase/storage';

export async function purgeDeletedTombstones(): Promise<number> {
  const sixtyDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
  let deletedCount = 0;
  for (const colName of ["taka_projects", "taka_tasks", "taka_costs"]) {
    const q = query(
      collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", colName),
      where("isDeleted", "==", true),
      where("updatedAt", "<", sixtyDaysAgo)
    );
    const snap = await getDocs(q);
    if (!snap.empty) {
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      snap.docs.forEach(d => { batch.delete(d.ref); deletedCount++; });
      await batch.commit();
    }
  }
  return deletedCount;
}

export async function standardizeFiscalYears(): Promise<number> {
  let totalUpdated = 0;
  const collectionsConfig = [
    { name: "taka_projects", field: "year" },
    { name: "taka_tasks", field: "projectYear" },
    { name: "taka_costs", field: "projectYear" },
    { name: "taka_delegation_groups", field: "projectYear" }
  ];

  for (const item of collectionsConfig) {
    const colRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", item.name);
    const snap = await getDocs(colRef);
    let batch = writeBatch(db);
    let count = 0;

    for (const d of snap.docs) {
      const data = d.data();
      const rawYear = data[item.field];
      if (typeof rawYear === "string") {
        const numYear = Number(rawYear.trim());
        if (!isNaN(numYear) && numYear > 2000 && numYear < 2100) {
          batch.update(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", item.name, d.id), { [item.field]: numYear });
          count++;
          totalUpdated++;
          if (count >= 400) {
            await batch.commit();
            batch = writeBatch(db);
            count = 0;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (count > 0) await batch.commit();
  }
  return totalUpdated;
}

export async function repairMissingTaskYears(): Promise<number> {
  const projRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_projects");
  const projSnap = await getDocs(projRef);
  const projectYearMap = new Map<string, number>();
  projSnap.docs.forEach(docSnap => {
    const data = docSnap.data();
    if (data.code && data.year && typeof data.year === 'number') {
      projectYearMap.set(data.code, data.year);
    }
  });

  let totalUpdated = 0;
  const collectionsConfig = [
    { name: "taka_tasks", field: "projectYear" },
    { name: "taka_costs", field: "projectYear" },
    { name: "taka_delegation_groups", field: "projectYear" }
  ];

  for (const item of collectionsConfig) {
    const colRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", item.name);
    const snap = await getDocs(colRef);
    let batch = writeBatch(db);
    let count = 0;

    for (const d of snap.docs) {
      const data = d.data();
      const rawYear = data[item.field];
      if (rawYear === undefined || rawYear === null || rawYear === '' || isNaN(Number(rawYear))) {
        const code = data.projectCode || data.code;
        if (code && projectYearMap.has(code)) {
          const correctYear = projectYearMap.get(code);
          batch.update(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", item.name, d.id), {
            [item.field]: correctYear
          });
          count++;
          totalUpdated++;
          if (count >= 400) {
            await batch.commit();
            batch = writeBatch(db);
            count = 0;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (count > 0) {
      await batch.commit();
    }
  }
  return totalUpdated;
}

export async function archiveHistoricalData(): Promise<number> {
  const yearsToArchive = [2024, 2025];
  const archiveData: Record<string, any[]> = {
    taka_projects: [],
    taka_tasks: [],
    taka_costs: [],
    taka_delegation_groups: []
  };

  for (const colName of Object.keys(archiveData)) {
    for (const year of yearsToArchive) {
      const field = colName === "taka_projects" ? "year" : "projectYear";
      const q = query(
        collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", colName),
        where(field, "==", year)
      );
      const snap = await getDocs(q);
      snap.docs.forEach(d => archiveData[colName].push({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
    }
  }

  const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(archiveData);
  const archiveRef = ref(storage, `archives/${APP_ID}/cold_storage_2024_2025_${Date.now()}.json`);
  await uploadString(archiveRef, jsonStr, 'raw', { contentType: 'application/json' });
  return Object.values(archiveData).reduce((acc: number, arr: any) => acc + arr.length, 0);
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import { X, Command, GripHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';

interface ShortcutsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function ShortcutsModal({ isOpen, onClose}: ShortcutsModalProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const shortcuts = [
    { keys: ['/'], description: 'Global search (Projects, Tasks, Assignees)' },
    { keys: ['Backspace'], description: 'Back to previous page' },
    { keys: ['Esc'], description: 'Close modals / Clear Focus' },
    { keys: ['Shift', 'F'], description: 'Toggle focus mode' },
    { keys: ['Ctrl', 'Z'], description: 'Undo last action' },
    { keys: ['T'], description: 'New Task' },
    { keys: ['P'], description: 'New Project' },
    { keys: ['1', '-', '9'], description: 'Switch tabs' },
  ];

  return (
    <Portal>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
        <Draggable disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} handle=".modal-handle" bounds="parent" nodeRef={nodeRef} cancel="button">
          <div 
            ref={nodeRef}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl shadow-xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#252528] select-none">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">
                <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                <Command className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
                <h3 className="font-bold">Keyboard Shortcuts</h3>
              </div>
              <button onClick={onClose} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors">
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
              {shortcuts.map((shortcut, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">{shortcut.description}</span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    {shortcut.keys.map((k, i) => (
                      <span key={i} className="px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] rounded border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
                        {k}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </Draggable>
      </div>
    </Portal>
  );
}

              {data.map((entry, index) => (

          </PieChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>

  );

import { Project } from '../../types';

export interface SummaryTabProps {}

  'On process': '#ea580c', // Orange
  'Upcoming': '#94a3b8',   // Slate
  'Completed': '#16a34a',  // Green
  'Handover': '#3b82f6',   // Blue

=== FILE: src/components/SummaryParts/useSummaryData.ts ===
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { getStatus, parseDateTime, getUserAllowedStores, getEffectiveStoreFilter } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLocationOptions } from '../../hooks/useLocationOptions';
import { StatusCountItem } from './summaryTypes';

export function useSummaryData() {
  const { enrichedProjects: projects } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.currentUser)!;

  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<'project_summary' | 'exec_dashboard'>('project_summary');

  const years = useMemo(() => {
    const yearsSet = new Set<string>();
    projects.forEach((p) => {
      const year = p.year ? String(p.year) : (p.computedTakStart ? String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : null);
      if (year) yearsSet.add(year);
    });
    yearsSet.add('2026');
    yearsSet.add('2027');
    const arr = Array.from(yearsSet).sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));
    return arr.length > 0 ? arr : ['2027', '2026'];
  }, [projects, currentUser?.role]);

  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setGlobalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.setGlobalYearFilter);
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const setGlobalStoreFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.setGlobalStoreFilter);
  const globalLocationFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalLocationFilter);
  const setGlobalLocationFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.setGlobalLocationFilter);

  const [startMonth, setStartMonth] = useState<number>(1);
  const [endMonth, setEndMonth] = useState<number>(12);

  const allowedStores = useMemo(() => getUserAllowedStores(currentUser), [currentUser]);
  const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
  const stores = allowedStores;

  const locationOptions = useLocationOptions();

  const filteredProjects = useMemo(() => {
    return projects.filter((p) => {
      const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year) : (p.computedTakStart ? String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : null);
      const matchesYear = globalYearFilter === 'all' || pYear === globalYearFilter;
      const matchesStore = effectiveStore === 'all' || p.store === effectiveStore;
      const matchesLocation = globalLocationFilter.length === 0 || (p.location && globalLocationFilter.includes(p.location));
      return matchesYear && matchesStore && matchesLocation;
    });
  }, [projects, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter]);

  const projectsInPeriod = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjects.filter((p) => {
      const dateStr = p.computedTakStart || p.start;
      if (!dateStr) return false;
      const date = parseDateTime(dateStr);
      if (!date) return false;
      const month = date.getMonth() + 1; // 1-indexed

      const minM = Math.min(startMonth, endMonth);
      const maxM = Math.max(startMonth, endMonth);

      return month >= minM && month <= maxM;
    });
  }, [filteredProjects, startMonth, endMonth]);

  const yearChartData: StatusCountItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    filteredProjects.forEach((p) => {
      const status = getStatus(p.computedTakStart, p.computedTakCompl, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
      counts[status] = (counts[status] || 0) + 1;
    });
    return Object.entries(counts).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }));
  }, [filteredProjects]);

  const monthChartData: StatusCountItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    projectsInPeriod.forEach((p) => {
      const status = getStatus(p.computedTakStart, p.computedTakCompl, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
      counts[status] = (counts[status] || 0) + 1;
    });
    return Object.entries(counts).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }));
  }, [projectsInPeriod]);

  const totalBudget = useMemo(() => filteredProjects.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.budget || 0), 0), [filteredProjects]);
  const totalActual = useMemo(() => filteredProjects.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.actual || 0), 0), [filteredProjects]);
  const periodBudget = useMemo(() => projectsInPeriod.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.budget || 0), 0), [projectsInPeriod]);
  const periodActual = useMemo(() => projectsInPeriod.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.actual || 0), 0), [projectsInPeriod]);

  return {
    activeSubTab,
    setActiveSubTab,
    years,
    stores,
    locationOptions,
    globalYearFilter,
    setGlobalYearFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    setGlobalStoreFilter,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    startMonth,
    setStartMonth,
    endMonth,
    setEndMonth,
    filteredProjects,
    projectsInPeriod,
    yearChartData,
    monthChartData,
    totalBudget,
    totalActual,
    periodBudget,
    periodActual,
  };
}

import React, { Suspense } from 'react';
import { lazyWithRetry } from '../lib/lazyWithRetry';
import { SummaryTabProps } from './SummaryParts/summaryTypes';
import { useSummaryData } from './SummaryParts/useSummaryData';
import { SummaryFilterToolbar } from './SummaryParts/SummaryFilterToolbar';
import { SummaryMetricsCards } from './SummaryParts/SummaryMetricsCards';
import { SummaryChartsView } from './SummaryParts/SummaryChartsView';

const ExecutiveDashboard = lazyWithRetry(
  () => import('./ExecutiveDashboard').then((m) => ({ default: m.ExecutiveDashboard })),
  'ExecutiveDashboard'
);

export function SummaryTab({}: SummaryTabProps) {
  const {
    activeSubTab,
    setActiveSubTab,
    years,
    stores,
    locationOptions,
    globalYearFilter,
    setGlobalYearFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    setGlobalStoreFilter,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    startMonth,
    setStartMonth,
    endMonth,
    setEndMonth,
    filteredProjects,
    projectsInPeriod,
    yearChartData,
    monthChartData,
    totalBudget,
    totalActual,
    periodBudget,
    periodActual,
  } = useSummaryData();

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col flex-grow bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 p-4 md:p-8 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto">
      {/* 1. Filter & Sub-Tab Control Toolbar */}
      <SummaryFilterToolbar
        activeSubTab={activeSubTab}
        setActiveSubTab={setActiveSubTab}
        globalYearFilter={globalYearFilter}
        setGlobalYearFilter={setGlobalYearFilter}
        years={years}
        effectiveStore={effectiveStore}
        setGlobalStoreFilter={setGlobalStoreFilter}
        stores={stores}
        globalLocationFilter={globalLocationFilter}
        setGlobalLocationFilter={setGlobalLocationFilter}
        locationOptions={locationOptions}
        startMonth={startMonth}
        setStartMonth={setStartMonth}
        endMonth={endMonth}
        setEndMonth={setEndMonth}
      />

      {/* 2. Content Area: Exec Dashboard vs Project Summary */}
      {activeSubTab === 'exec_dashboard' ? (
        <Suspense
          fallback={
            <div className="flex-1 w-full p-6 animate-pulse space-y-4">
              <div className="h-8 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg w-1/3"></div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <div className="h-28 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl"></div>
                <div className="h-28 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl"></div>
                <div className="h-28 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl"></div>
              </div>
              <div className="h-72 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl"></div>
            </div>
          }
        >
          <ExecutiveDashboard
            filteredProjects={filteredProjects}
            globalYearFilter={globalYearFilter}
            effectiveStore={effectiveStore}
          />
        </Suspense>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Charts Section */}
          <SummaryChartsView
            yearChartData={yearChartData}
            monthChartData={monthChartData}
            globalYearFilter={globalYearFilter}
            startMonth={startMonth}
            endMonth={endMonth}
            projectsInPeriod={projectsInPeriod}
          />

          {/* Summary Stats Footer */}
          <SummaryMetricsCards
            totalProjectsCount={filteredProjects.length}
            periodProjectsCount={projectsInPeriod.length}
            periodBudget={periodBudget}
            periodActual={periodActual}
            totalBudget={totalBudget}
            totalActual={totalActual}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default SummaryTab;
