import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { safeGetItemLocal } from '../lib/storage';
import { Wifi, WifiOff, Database, ShieldAlert, RefreshCw, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { getPendingUpdates, clearPendingUpdates } from '../lib/syncQueue';
import { getLastDeltaSyncTime, getRestoreCutoffTimestamp, pullAndApplyDeltas } from '../lib/deltaSyncService';

/**
 * SyncMonitor: A floating debug panel to verify real-time sync, fingerprinting, and cutoff.
 * CRITICAL for multi-device troubleshooting.
 */
export const SyncMonitor: React.FC = () => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const cloudStatus = useAppStore(state => state.cloudStatus);
  const [pendingCount, setPendingCount] = useState(0);
  const [lastSync, setLastSync] = useState(0);
  const [cutoff, setCutoff] = useState(0);
  const [fingerprint, setFingerprint] = useState('');
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateStats = async () => {
      const pending = await getPendingUpdates();
      setPendingCount(pending.length);
      setLastSync(getLastDeltaSyncTime());
      setCutoff(getRestoreCutoffTimestamp());
      setFingerprint(safeGetItemLocal('taka_data_fingerprint_v1') || 'none');
    };

    updateStats();
    const interval = setInterval(updateStats, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const handleManualSync = async () => {
    setIsSyncing(true);
    try {
      await pullAndApplyDeltas();
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClearQueue = async () => {
    if (confirm('Clear local offline queue? This cannot be undone.')) {
      await clearPendingUpdates();
      setPendingCount(0);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) {
    return (
      <div 
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}
        className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-[9999] p-2 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full shadow-lg cursor-pointer border border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all flex items-center gap-2 group"
      >
        {cloudStatus === 'online' ? (
          <Wifi size={14} className="text-emerald-400" />
        ) : (
          <WifiOff size={14} className="text-rose-400" />
        )}
        {pendingCount > 0 && (
          <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-4 w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-500 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">
            {pendingCount}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-300 font-medium overflow-hidden w-0 group-hover:w-16 transition-all duration-300">Sync Monitor</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-[9999] w-72 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-4">
      <div className="p-3 bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-700">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Database size={16} className="text-sky-400" />
          <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100">Sync Monitor</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
          className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1"
        >
          <XIcon size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
        {/* Connection Status */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Connection</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {cloudStatus === 'online' ? (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                Online
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-rose-400 font-medium">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-400" />
                Offline
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Offline Queue */}
        <div className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800/50 rounded-lg border border-slate-700/50">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Offline Queue</span>
            <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${pendingCount > 0 ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
              {pendingCount} items
            </span>
          </div>
          {pendingCount > 0 && (
            <button 
              onClick={handleClearQueue}
              className="mt-2 w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-1 px-2 text-[10px] bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-500/20 rounded transition-colors border border-rose-500/20"
            >
              <Trash2 size={10} />
              Clear Queue
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Sync Metadata */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
            <span className="text-slate-500">Last Sync</span>
            <span className="text-slate-300 font-mono">{lastSync > 0 ? new Date(lastSync).toLocaleTimeString() : 'Never'}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
            <span className="text-slate-500">Restore Cutoff</span>
            <span className={`font-mono ${cutoff > 0 ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
              {cutoff > 0 ? new Date(cutoff).toLocaleTimeString() : 'None'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
            <span className="text-slate-500">Fingerprint</span>
            <span className="text-slate-400 font-mono truncate max-w-[120px]" title={fingerprint}>
              {fingerprint}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Recovery Warning */}
        {cutoff > 0 && (
          <div className="p-2 bg-rose-500/5 border border-rose-500/20 rounded flex gap-2">
            <ShieldAlert size={14} className="text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
            <p className="text-[10px] text-rose-300/80 leading-relaxed">
              Restore Version active. Stale local data is strictly blocked from syncing back.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Actions */}
        <button 
          onClick={handleManualSync}
          disabled={isSyncing}
          className="w-full py-2 bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all active:scale-95"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={14} className={isSyncing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
          {isSyncing ? 'Syncing...' : 'Sync Now'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const XIcon = ({ size }: { size: number }) => (
  <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
    <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
  </svg>
);


=== FILE: src/components/TabErrorBoundary.tsx ===
import React, { Component, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { RotateCw, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';

interface TabErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  tabKey?: string;
}

interface TabErrorBoundaryState {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: any;
}

export class TabErrorBoundary extends React.Component<TabErrorBoundaryProps, TabErrorBoundaryState> {
  constructor(props: TabErrorBoundaryProps) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: any): TabErrorBoundaryState {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: any, errorInfo: any) {
    console.error("TabErrorBoundary caught error:", error, errorInfo);
    
    const isChunkError = 
      error?.message?.includes('Importing a module script failed') ||
      error?.message?.includes('Failed to fetch dynamically imported module') ||
      error?.message?.includes('error loading dynamically imported module') ||
      error?.message?.includes('MIME type') ||
      error?.message?.includes('is not a valid JavaScript MIME type');
      
    const isIDBError = error?.message?.includes('Connection to Indexed Database server lost');
    
    if (isChunkError || isIDBError) {
      const reloadKey = isChunkError ? 'tab_chunk_reload' : 'tab_idb_reload';
      const hasReloaded = window.sessionStorage.getItem(reloadKey);
      if (!hasReloaded) {
        window.sessionStorage.setItem(reloadKey, 'true');
        window.location.reload();
      }
    }
  }

  componentDidUpdate(prevProps: TabErrorBoundaryProps) {
    if (prevProps.tabKey !== this.props.tabKey && this.state.hasError) {
      this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
    }
  }

  handleRetry = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
  };

  handleReload = () => {
    window.location.reload();
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      const isChunkError =
        this.state.error?.message?.includes('Importing a module script failed') ||
        this.state.error?.message?.includes('Failed to fetch dynamically imported module') ||
        this.state.error?.message?.includes('error loading dynamically imported module') ||
        this.state.error?.message?.includes('MIME type') ||
        this.state.error?.message?.includes('is not a valid JavaScript MIME type');

      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 m-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383a] rounded-2xl text-center shadow-xs">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center mb-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] mb-1">
            {isChunkError ? 'New Version Available / Module Loading' : 'Unable to Load Module'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] max-w-md mb-4 leading-relaxed">
            {isChunkError
              ? 'The system was updated or a transient network interruption occurred. Please retry or reload the page.'
              : (this.state.error?.message || 'An unexpected issue occurred while displaying this tab.')}
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={this.handleRetry}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RotateCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Retry Module
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={this.handleReload}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-[#2c2c30] dark:hover:bg-[#38383e] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-xs active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
            >
              Reload Page
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

import React, { Fragment, memo } from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Search, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { DelegationGroup, DelegationSubTask, AppUser, Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { cn, formatDisplayDateMain, getStatus, getTaskStatus, resolveActualStatus, parseDateTime, formatToDatetimeLocal, computeDelegationGroupProgressPercent } from '../../lib/utils';
import { resolveGroupParentProject } from './taskDelegationTypes';
import { TaskDelegationDesktopSubTaskRow } from './TaskDelegationDesktopSubTaskRow';

interface TaskDelegationDesktopGroupRowProps {
  group: DelegationGroup;
  isOrphan?: boolean;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  expandedGroups: string[];
  toggleGroup: (id: string) => void;
  visibleColumns: string[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  focusTarget: { groupId: string; subTaskId?: string } | null;
  picOptions: string[];
  uniqueParties: string[];
  handleUpdateGroup: (group: DelegationGroup, updates: Partial<DelegationGroup>) => void;
  handleDeleteGroup: (group: DelegationGroup) => void;
  handleUpdateSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string, updates: Partial<DelegationSubTask>) => void;
  handleDeleteSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string) => void;
  handleTextareaInput: (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
  setMultiSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
}

export const TaskDelegationDesktopGroupRow = React.memo(function TaskDelegationDesktopGroupRow({
  group,
  isOrphan = false,
  projects,
  tasks,
  expandedGroups,
  toggleGroup,
  visibleColumns,
  canWrite,
  currentUser,
  focusTarget,
  picOptions,
  uniqueParties,
  handleUpdateGroup,
  handleDeleteGroup,
  handleUpdateSubTask,
  handleDeleteSubTask,
  handleTextareaInput,
  setMultiSearchTerm,
}: TaskDelegationDesktopGroupRowProps) {
  const isExpanded = expandedGroups.includes(group.id);
  const parentTask = group.parentTaskId ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === group.parentTaskId) : null;
  const parentProject = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);

  let plStatus = 'Upcoming';
  if (parentTask) {
    plStatus = getTaskStatus(parentTask.start, parentTask.finish);
  } else if (parentProject) {
    const computedTakStart = parentProject.computedTakStart || parentProject.start;
    const computedTakCompl = parentProject.computedTakCompl;
    plStatus = getStatus(
      computedTakStart,
      computedTakCompl,
      parentProject.computedOpening || parentProject.opening,
      parentProject.code
    );
  }

  let plStatusColorClass =
    'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]';
  if (plStatus === 'Completed') plStatusColorClass = 'bg-green-50 text-green-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-green-200';
  else if (plStatus === 'On process' || plStatus === 'Handover')
    plStatusColorClass = 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-blue-200';
  else if (plStatus === 'Canceled') plStatusColorClass = 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 border-red-200';

  const isLinked = !!group.parentTaskId;

  return (
    <React.Fragment key={group.id}>
      {/* Group Header Row */}
      <tr
        id={`delegation-group-${group.id}`}
        className={cn(
          'table-row-optimized border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 transition-colors',
          isOrphan ? 'bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/80' : 'bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]',
          plStatus === 'On process' ? 'shadow-[inset_4px_0_0_0_#3b82f6]' : ''
        )}
      >
        {visibleColumns.includes('expand') && (
          <td className={cn('px-4 py-3 text-center', !isOrphan && 'pl-8')}>
            <button
              title="Toggle Expand"
              onClick={() => toggleGroup(group.id)}
              className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] rounded transition-colors text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] cursor-pointer"
            >
              {!isExpanded ? <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('taskName') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] break-words whitespace-normal">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              {!isOrphan && <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]">↳</span>}
              <div className="flex-grow">
                {!isLinked ? (
                  <textarea
                    defaultValue={group.name}
                    onBlur={(e) => handleUpdateGroup(group, { name: e.target.value })}
                    onInput={handleTextareaInput}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.currentTarget.blur();
                      }
                    }}
                    disabled={!canWrite}
                    rows={1}
                    className="bg-[#eaffea] dark:bg-[#1a3821] border border-green-200 dark:border-[#265330] outline-none w-full focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 rounded px-2 py-1 text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-bold resize-none overflow-hidden min-h-[28px]"
                    placeholder="Custom Delegation Name"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span>
                      {parentTask?.name || parentProject?.name || group.name}
                      {parentTask && parentProject?.name ? ` - ${parentProject.name}` : ''}
                    </span>
                    {(parentTask || parentProject) && (
                      <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-normal mt-0.5">
                        Start (Plan):{' '}
                        {formatDisplayDateMain(
                          parentTask?.start || parentProject?.computedTakStart || parentProject?.start
                        )}{' '}
                        | Finish (Plan):{' '}
                        {formatDisplayDateMain(parentTask?.finish || parentProject?.computedTakCompl)}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('projectCode') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-bold break-words whitespace-normal">
            {group.projectStore ? <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mr-1">{group.projectStore} -</span> : ''}
            {group.projectCode || '-'}
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('comments') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] italic text-xs break-words whitespace-normal">
            {group.subTasks.length} delegation task(s)
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('status') && <td className="px-4 py-3"></td>}
        {visibleColumns.includes('priority') && <td className="px-4 py-3"></td>}
        {visibleColumns.includes('party') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
              {Array.from(
                new Set(group.subTasks.map((st) => st.party).filter((p) => p && String(p).trim() !== ''))
              ).map((party, idx) => (
                <span
                  key={idx}
                  className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider inline-block max-w-[100px] truncate"
                  title={party}
                >
                  {party}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('actions') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <div
                className={`text-[10px] leading-tight font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full border whitespace-nowrap ${
                  resolveActualStatus(plStatus, group.subTasks).color
                }`}
              >
                Act: {resolveActualStatus(plStatus, group.subTasks).label} ({computeDelegationGroupProgressPercent(group)}%)
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  setMultiSearchTerm((parentProject?.code ? parentProject.code + ' ' : '') + group.name)
                }
                className="text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] p-1 rounded hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Filter by Tracker"
              >
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
              {canWrite && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleDeleteGroup(group)}
                  className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 p-1 rounded hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  title="Delete Group"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </td>
        )}
      </tr>

      {/* Sub Tasks Rows */}
      {isExpanded &&
        group.subTasks.map((st) => {
          const parsedStartObj = parseDateTime(
            parentTask?.start || parentProject?.computedTakStart || parentProject?.start
          );
          const defaultStartAct = parsedStartObj ? formatToDatetimeLocal(parsedStartObj) : '';
          const parsedFinishObj = parseDateTime(parentTask?.finish || parentProject?.computedTakCompl);
          const defaultFinishAct = parsedFinishObj ? formatToDatetimeLocal(parsedFinishObj) : '';

          return (
            <TaskDelegationDesktopSubTaskRow
              key={st.id}
              st={st}
              group={group}
              parentProject={parentProject}
              plStatus={plStatus}
              plStatusColorClass={plStatusColorClass}
              visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
              focusTarget={focusTarget}
              defaultStartAct={defaultStartAct}
              defaultFinishAct={defaultFinishAct}
              canWrite={canWrite}
              currentUser={currentUser}
              picOptions={picOptions}
              uniqueParties={uniqueParties}
              handleUpdateSubTask={handleUpdateSubTask}
              handleDeleteSubTask={handleDeleteSubTask}
              handleTextareaInput={handleTextareaInput}
              setMultiSearchTerm={setMultiSearchTerm}
            />
          );
        })}
    </React.Fragment>
  );
});


=== FILE: src/components/TaskDelegationParts/TaskDelegationDesktopSubTaskRow.tsx ===
import React, { Fragment, lazy, memo } from 'react';
import { Search, Trash2, Paperclip, ExternalLink, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import { DelegationGroup, DelegationSubTask, AppUser, Project } from '../../types';
import { cn, formatDisplayDateMain, formatDisplayDateTime, ensureUrlProtocol, resolveActualStatus, getActStatusPercent } from '../../lib/utils';
import { MultiSelectInput } from '../DelegationParts/MultiSelectInput';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface TaskDelegationDesktopSubTaskRowProps {
  st: DelegationSubTask;
  group: DelegationGroup;
  parentProject?: Project;
  plStatus: string;
  plStatusColorClass: string;
  visibleColumns: string[];
  focusTarget: { groupId: string; subTaskId?: string } | null;
  defaultStartAct?: string;
  defaultFinishAct?: string;
  canWrite: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  picOptions: string[];
  uniqueParties: string[];
  handleUpdateSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string, updates: Partial<DelegationSubTask>) => void;
  handleDeleteSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string) => void;
  handleTextareaInput: (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
  setMultiSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
}

export const TaskDelegationDesktopSubTaskRow = React.memo(function TaskDelegationDesktopSubTaskRow({
  st,
  group,
  parentProject,
  plStatus,
  plStatusColorClass,
  visibleColumns,
  focusTarget,
  defaultStartAct,
  defaultFinishAct,
  canWrite,
  currentUser,
  picOptions,
  uniqueParties,
  handleUpdateSubTask,
  handleDeleteSubTask,
  handleTextareaInput,
  setMultiSearchTerm,
}: TaskDelegationDesktopSubTaskRowProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const setZoomableImageSrc = useAppStore((state) => state.setZoomableImageSrc);

  const isCreator = group.createdBy === currentUser.id;
  const pPartyList = (st.party || '').split(',').map((p) => p.toLowerCase().trim());
  const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
    ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
        .filter((k) => currentUser.partyPermissions![k])
        .map((k) => k.toLowerCase().trim())
    : [];
  const isPIC =
    userParties.includes('all') ||
    pPartyList.some((p) => userParties.includes(p)) ||
    pPartyList.includes(String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim()) ||
    (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id));
  const canEditSubTask = canWrite || isCreator || isPIC;

  const stStatus = (st.delegationStatus || st.status || '').toLowerCase();
  const stApproval = (st.approvalStatus || '').toLowerCase();

  let selectValue = 'None';
  if (stStatus === 'approved' || stStatus === 'completed' || stApproval === 'approved') selectValue = 'Approved';
  else if (stStatus === 'rejected' || stApproval === 'rejected') selectValue = 'Rejected';
  else if (stStatus === 'pending completed' || stApproval === 'pending completed') selectValue = 'ReqApproval';
  else if (stStatus === 'needs rework') selectValue = 'ReqReview';
  else if (stStatus === 'on process' || stStatus === 'accepted') selectValue = 'AcceptTask';
  else if (
    ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stStatus) ||
    ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stApproval)
  )
    selectValue = 'Hold';

  return (
    <React.Fragment key={st.id}>
      <tr
        id={`delegation-subtask-${st.id}`}
        className={`table-row-optimized bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/30 transition-all duration-300 ${
          focusTarget?.subTaskId === st.id

        }`}
      >
        {visibleColumns.includes('expand') && <td className="px-4 py-3"></td>}
        {visibleColumns.includes('taskName') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 pl-8 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] break-words whitespace-normal">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 pl-4">
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col gap-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] font-bold ml-1">
                  Start (Act)
                </span>
                <div className="relative w-full min-h-[28px]">
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={
                      st.startAct
                        ? st.startAct.substring(0, 10)
                        : defaultStartAct
                        ? defaultStartAct.substring(0, 10)
                        : ''
                    }
                    onChange={(e) => handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, { startAct: e.target.value })}
                    disabled={!canEditSubTask}
                    className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10 disabled:cursor-auto"
                  />
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      'w-full bg-transparent border rounded p-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium min-h-[28px] flex items-center whitespace-nowrap',
                      !canEditSubTask ? 'border-transparent' : 'hover:border-slate-300'
                    )}
                  >
                    {formatDisplayDateMain(st.startAct || defaultStartAct)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col gap-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] font-bold ml-1">
                  Finish (Act)
                </span>
                <div className="relative w-full min-h-[28px]">
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={
                      st.finishAct
                        ? st.finishAct.substring(0, 10)
                        : defaultFinishAct
                        ? defaultFinishAct.substring(0, 10)
                        : ''
                    }
                    onChange={(e) => handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, { finishAct: e.target.value })}
                    disabled={!canEditSubTask}
                    className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10 disabled:cursor-auto"
                  />
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      'w-full bg-transparent border rounded p-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium min-h-[28px] flex items-center whitespace-nowrap',
                      !canEditSubTask ? 'border-transparent' : 'hover:border-slate-300'
                    )}
                  >
                    {formatDisplayDateMain(st.finishAct || defaultFinishAct)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('projectCode') && <td className="px-4 py-3"></td>}
        {visibleColumns.includes('comments') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3" title={st.comments}>
            <textarea
              defaultValue={st.comments}
              onBlur={(e) => handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, { comments: e.target.value })}
              onInput={handleTextareaInput}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  e.currentTarget.blur();
                }
              }}
              disabled={!canEditSubTask}
              className="w-full bg-transparent border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200 dark:hover:border-[#444446] focus:border-blue-500 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded p-1.5 outline-none resize-y min-h-[60px] text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap"
              placeholder="Add comments..."
            />
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('status') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 align-top pt-5">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 min-w-[120px] items-center justify-center">
              <div
                className={`text-[11px] leading-tight font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full border inline-block break-words max-w-[120px] text-center ${plStatusColorClass}`}
              >
                Pl: {plStatus}

              <div
                className={`text-[11px] leading-tight font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full border inline-block break-words max-w-[120px] text-center ${
                  resolveActualStatus(plStatus, group.subTasks).color

                Act: {resolveActualStatus(plStatus, group.subTasks).label}

              value={st.priority || 'Mid'}

              disabled={!canEditSubTask}
              style={{
                backgroundImage:
                  "url('data:image/svg+xml;charset=US-ASCII,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2212%22%20height%3D%2212%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2024%2024%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%20stroke%3D%22%23334155%22%20stroke-width%3D%222%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%3E%3Cpolyline%20points%3D%226%209%2012%2015%2018%209%22%3E%3C%2Fpolyline%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E')",
                backgroundPosition: 'calc(100% - 6px) center',

              className={cn(
                'w-full text-[10px] md:text-xs font-bold pl-1.5 md:pl-2 pr-5 md:pr-6 py-1 md:py-1.5 rounded-md border outline-none cursor-pointer appearance-none bg-[length:10px_10px] md:bg-[length:12px_12px] bg-no-repeat',
                st.priority === 'High'
                  ? 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200'

          <div className="flex flex-wrap md:flex-nowrap items-stretch gap-4 pl-8">
            {/* Report */}
            <div className="flex-1 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#333336]/40 p-2.5 rounded border border-blue-200">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-800 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] tracking-wider block mb-1 opacity-80">
                {t('Report')}

                    const isPdf = att.url?.match(/\.pdf($|\?|#)/i) || att.type === 'application/pdf';

                          title={att.name || att.url || 'Download Attached File'}

                          {att.name || att.url || 'Attached Link'}

              </span>

                    : (st.delegationStatus || st.status) === 'Approved' ||
                      (st.delegationStatus || st.status) === 'Rejected' ||
                      (st.delegationStatus || st.status) === 'Request Delay' ||
                      (st.delegationStatus || st.status) === 'Needs Rework'
                    ? 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200'
                    : (st.delegationStatus || st.status) === 'Assigned' || !(st.delegationStatus || st.status)
                    ? 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-200'
                    : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]'
                )}
              >
                Flow: {st.delegationStatus || st.status || 'Assigned'}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Approve/Reject */}
            <div className="w-48 shrink-0 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#333336]/40 p-2.5 rounded border border-blue-200 flex flex-col justify-center">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-800 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] tracking-wider block mb-1 opacity-80">
                Approval state
              </span>
              <select
                value={selectValue}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const val = e.target.value;
                  const payload: Partial<DelegationSubTask> = { approvalStatus: val };
                  if (val === 'Approved') {
                    payload.status = 'Approved';
                    payload.delegationStatus = 'Completed';
                    payload.finishAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
                    payload.approvedAt = new Date().toISOString();
                  } else if (val === 'Rejected') {
                    payload.status = 'Rejected';
                    payload.delegationStatus = 'Rejected';
                    payload.approvedAt = null;
                  } else if (val === 'Hold') {
                    payload.approvalStatus = 'Requested';
                    payload.approvedAt = null;
                  } else if (val === 'AcceptTask') {
                    payload.status = 'On process';
                    payload.delegationStatus = 'On process';
                    if (!st.startAct) {
                      payload.startAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
                    }
                    payload.approvedAt = null;
                  } else if (val === 'ReqApproval') {
                    payload.status = 'Pending completed';
                    payload.delegationStatus = 'Pending completed';
                    payload.approvalStatus = 'Requested';
                    payload.approvedAt = null;
                  } else if (val === 'ReqReview') {
                    payload.status = 'Needs Rework';
                    payload.delegationStatus = 'Needs Rework';
                    payload.approvedAt = null;
                  } else {
                    payload.approvedAt = null;
                  }
                  handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, payload);
                }}
                disabled={!canEditSubTask}
                className={cn(
                  'text-xs w-full font-bold px-2 py-1.5 rounded border outline-none cursor-pointer',
                  (['requested', 'hold', 'pending completed', 'waiting for approval'].includes(
                    (st.delegationStatus || '').toLowerCase()
                  ) ||
                    ['requested', 'hold', 'pending completed', 'waiting for approval'].includes(
                      (st.status || '').toLowerCase()
                    ) ||
                    ['requested', 'hold', 'pending completed', 'waiting for approval'].includes(
                      (st.approvalStatus || '').toLowerCase()
                    )) &&
                    st.delegationStatus !== 'Completed' &&
                    st.status !== 'Completed'
                    ? 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200'
                    : 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200'
                )}
              >
                <option value="None" disabled hidden>
                  State...
                </option>
                {(isPIC || isCreator) && <option value="AcceptTask">Accepted</option>}
                {(isPIC || isCreator) && <option value="ReqApproval">Requested Approval</option>}
                {isCreator && <option value="Approved">{t('Approved')}</option>}
                {isCreator && <option value="Rejected">{t('Rejected')}</option>}
              </select>
              {st.approvedAt && selectValue === 'Approved' && (
                <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 whitespace-nowrap">
                  {formatDisplayDateTime(st.approvedAt)}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </td>
      </tr>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
});

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Search, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { DelegationGroup, DelegationSubTask, AppUser, Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { formatDisplayDateMain, getStatus, getTaskStatus, resolveActualStatus, computeDelegationGroupProgressPercent } from '../../lib/utils';
import { resolveGroupParentProject } from './taskDelegationTypes';
import { TaskDelegationMobileSubTaskItem } from './TaskDelegationMobileSubTaskItem';

interface TaskDelegationMobileCardProps {
  group: DelegationGroup;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  expandedGroups: string[];
  toggleGroup: (id: string) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  focusTarget: { groupId: string; subTaskId?: string } | null;
  picOptions: string[];
  uniqueParties: string[];
  handleDeleteGroup: (group: DelegationGroup) => void;
  handleUpdateSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string, updates: Partial<DelegationSubTask>) => void;
  handleDeleteSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string) => void;
  setMultiSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
}

export const TaskDelegationMobileCard = React.memo(function TaskDelegationMobileCard({
  group,
  projects,
  tasks,
  expandedGroups,
  toggleGroup,
  canWrite,
  currentUser,
  focusTarget,
  picOptions,
  uniqueParties,
  handleDeleteGroup,
  handleUpdateSubTask,
  handleDeleteSubTask,
  setMultiSearchTerm,
}: TaskDelegationMobileCardProps) {
  const isExpanded = expandedGroups.includes(group.id);
  const parentTask = group.parentTaskId ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === group.parentTaskId) : null;
  const parentProject = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);

  let plStatus = 'Upcoming';
  if (parentTask) {
    plStatus = getTaskStatus(parentTask.start, parentTask.finish);
  } else if (parentProject) {
    const computedTakStart = parentProject.computedTakStart || parentProject.start;
    const computedTakCompl = parentProject.computedTakCompl;
    plStatus = getStatus(
      computedTakStart,
      computedTakCompl,
      parentProject.computedOpening || parentProject.opening,
      parentProject.code
    );
  }

  const plStatusColorClass =
    plStatus === 'Completed'
      ? 'bg-green-50 text-green-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-green-200'
      : plStatus === 'On process' || plStatus === 'Handover'
      ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-blue-200'
      : plStatus === 'Canceled'
      ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 border-red-200'
      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]';

  const isLinked = !!group.parentTaskId;

  return (
    <div
      id={`delegation-group-mobile-${group.id}`}
      key={group.id}
      className="mobile-card-optimized bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] flex flex-col"
    >
      <div
        className="p-3 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] flex items-start justify-between cursor-pointer"
        onClick={() => toggleGroup(group.id)}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 pr-2 flex-1">
          <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-sm leading-snug">
            {!isLinked
              ? group.name
              : parentTask
              ? `${parentTask.name}${parentProject?.name ? ` - ${parentProject.name}` : ''}`
              : parentProject?.name || group.name}
          </div>
          {isLinked && (
            <div className="text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-mono font-medium">
              {group.projectStore ? <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mr-1">{group.projectStore} -</span> : ''}
              {group.projectCode || '-'}
              {parentProject?.name ? (
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-sans font-normal ml-1 text-[11px]">
                  - {parentProject.name}
                </span>
              ) : (
                ''
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {isLinked && (parentTask || parentProject) && (
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-medium mt-1">
              P:{' '}
              {formatDisplayDateMain(parentTask?.start || parentProject?.computedTakStart || parentProject?.start)} -{' '}
              {formatDisplayDateMain(parentTask?.finish || parentProject?.computedTakCompl)}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex gap-2 max-w-full flex-wrap">
            <span className={`mt-1.5 text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded flex font-bold border break-words leading-tight text-center items-center justify-center ${plStatusColorClass}`}>
              Pl: {plStatus}
            </span>
            <span className={`mt-1.5 text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded flex font-bold border break-words leading-tight text-center items-center justify-center ${resolveActualStatus(plStatus, group.subTasks).color}`}>
              Act: {resolveActualStatus(plStatus, group.subTasks).label} ({computeDelegationGroupProgressPercent(group)}%)
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">
            {[...new Set(group.subTasks.map((st) => st.party).filter((p) => p && String(p).trim() !== ''))].map(
              (p) => (
                <span
                  key={String(p)}
                  className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[9.5px] tracking-wider flex-shrink-0 font-bold max-w-[80px] truncate"
                  title={String(p)}
                >
                  {String(p)}
                </span>
              )
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2 shrink-0">
          <div className="p-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded shadow-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
            {!isExpanded ? <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-2">
            <div
              className={`text-[10px] leading-tight font-bold px-1.5 py-1 rounded-full border whitespace-nowrap ${
                resolveActualStatus(plStatus, group.subTasks).color
              } shrink-0`}
            >
              Act: {resolveActualStatus(plStatus, group.subTasks).label} ({computeDelegationGroupProgressPercent(group)}%)
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setMultiSearchTerm((parentProject?.code ? parentProject.code + ' ' : '') + group.name);
              }}
              className="p-1.5 rounded bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-[#444446] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Filter by Tracker"
            >
              <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            {canWrite && (
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handleDeleteGroup(group);
                }}
                className="p-1.5 rounded bg-red-50 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Delete Group"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="flex flex-col bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 p-2 gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
          {group.subTasks.length === 0 && (
            <div className="py-4 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] text-xs italic">
              No delegation tasks.
            </div>
          )}
          {group.subTasks.map((st) => (
            <TaskDelegationMobileSubTaskItem
              key={st.id}
              st={st}
              group={group}
              parentTask={parentTask}
              parentProject={parentProject}
              plStatus={plStatus}
              canWrite={canWrite}
              currentUser={currentUser}
              focusTarget={focusTarget}
              picOptions={picOptions}
              uniqueParties={uniqueParties}
              handleUpdateSubTask={handleUpdateSubTask}
              handleDeleteSubTask={handleDeleteSubTask}
              setMultiSearchTerm={setMultiSearchTerm}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { Search, Trash2, Paperclip, Maximize2, ExternalLink, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import { DelegationGroup, DelegationSubTask, AppUser, Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { cn, formatDisplayDateMain, formatDisplayDateTime, resolveActualStatus, parseDateTime, formatToDatetimeLocal, ensureUrlProtocol, getActStatusPercent } from '../../lib/utils';
import { MultiSelectInput } from '../DelegationParts/MultiSelectInput';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface TaskDelegationMobileSubTaskItemProps {
  st: DelegationSubTask;
  group: DelegationGroup;
  parentTask: Task | null | undefined;
  parentProject: Project | null | undefined;
  plStatus: string;
  canWrite: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  focusTarget: { groupId: string; subTaskId?: string } | null;
  picOptions: string[];
  uniqueParties: string[];
  handleUpdateSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string, updates: Partial<DelegationSubTask>) => void;
  handleDeleteSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string) => void;
  setMultiSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
}

export const TaskDelegationMobileSubTaskItem = React.memo(function TaskDelegationMobileSubTaskItem({
  st,
  group,
  parentTask,
  parentProject,
  plStatus,
  canWrite,
  currentUser,
  focusTarget,
  picOptions,
  uniqueParties,
  handleUpdateSubTask,
  handleDeleteSubTask,
  setMultiSearchTerm,
}: TaskDelegationMobileSubTaskItemProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const isAdmin = currentUser.role === 'admin';

  const parsedStartObj = parseDateTime(
    parentTask?.start || parentProject?.computedTakStart || parentProject?.start
  );
  const defaultStartAct = parsedStartObj ? formatToDatetimeLocal(parsedStartObj) : '';
  const parsedFinishObj = parseDateTime(parentTask?.finish || parentProject?.computedTakCompl);
  const defaultFinishAct = parsedFinishObj ? formatToDatetimeLocal(parsedFinishObj) : '';

  const isCreator = isAdmin || group.createdBy === currentUser.id;
  const pPartyList = String(st.party || '').toLowerCase().split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
    ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
        .filter((k) => currentUser.partyPermissions![k])
        .map((k) => k.toLowerCase().trim())
    : [];
  const isPIC =
    userParties.includes('all') ||
    pPartyList.some((p) => userParties.includes(p)) ||
    pPartyList.includes(String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim()) ||
    (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id));
  const canEditSubTask = canWrite || isCreator || isPIC;

  let selectValue = 'None';
  const stStatus = String(st.delegationStatus || st.status || '').toLowerCase();
  const stApproval = String(st.approvalStatus || '').toLowerCase();
  if (stStatus === 'completed') selectValue = 'Approved';
  else if (stStatus === 'rejected') selectValue = 'Rejected';
  else if (stStatus === 'pending completed') selectValue = 'ReqApproval';
  else if (stStatus === 'needs rework') selectValue = 'ReqReview';
  else if (stStatus === 'on process' || stStatus === 'accepted') selectValue = 'AcceptTask';
  else if (
    ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stStatus) ||
    ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stApproval)
  )
    selectValue = 'Hold';

  const flowTxt = st.delegationStatus || st.status || 'Assigned';
  let flowColor =
    'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]';
  let cardBgColor = 'bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]';

  if (flowTxt === 'Completed') {
    flowColor = 'bg-green-50 text-green-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-green-200';
    cardBgColor = 'bg-green-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-900/10 border-green-200 dark:border-emerald-900/30';
  } else if (flowTxt === 'On process' || flowTxt === 'Accepted') {
    flowColor = 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-blue-200';
    cardBgColor = 'bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-blue-900/10 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/30';
  } else if (
    flowTxt === 'Delayed' ||
    ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval', 'pending completed'].includes(flowTxt.toLowerCase())
  ) {
    flowColor = 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-200';
    cardBgColor = 'bg-orange-50/50 dark:bg-orange-900/10 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/30';
  } else if (
    flowTxt === 'Approved' ||
    flowTxt === 'Rejected' ||
    flowTxt === 'Request Delay' ||
    flowTxt === 'Needs Rework'
  ) {
    flowColor = 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200';
    cardBgColor = 'bg-purple-50/50 dark:bg-purple-900/10 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/30';
  } else if (flowTxt === 'Assigned') {
    flowColor = 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-200';
    cardBgColor = 'bg-orange-50/50 dark:bg-orange-900/10 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/30';
  }

  return (
    <div
      id={`delegation-subtask-mobile-${st.id}`}
      key={st.id}
      className={cn(
        'border flex flex-col rounded-lg p-3 shadow-sm relative transition-all duration-300',
        cardBgColor,
        focusTarget?.subTaskId === st.id ? 'ring-2 ring-yellow-400 dark:ring-yellow-600' : ''
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2 mb-3 mt-1 w-full">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 pt-0.5 max-w-full">
          <select
            value={st.priority || 'Mid'}
            onChange={(e) => handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, { priority: e.target.value as any })}
            disabled={!canEditSubTask}
            title="Priority"
            style={{
              backgroundImage:
                "url('data:image/svg+xml;charset=US-ASCII,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2210%22%20height%3D%2210%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2024%2024%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%20stroke%3D%22%23334155%22%20stroke-width%3D%222%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%3E%3Cpolyline%20points%3D%226%209%2012%2015%2018%209%22%3E%3C%2Fpolyline%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E')",
              backgroundPosition: 'calc(100% - 6px) center',
            }}
            className={cn(
              'rounded pl-2 pr-6 md:pr-5 py-1.5 md:py-1.5 text-xs md:text-xs leading-tight font-bold outline-none appearance-none bg-[length:12px_12px] bg-no-repeat w-auto min-w-[70px] max-w-[85px] shrink-1 md:min-w-[80px] h-[32px] md:h-auto',
              st.priority === 'High'
                ? 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border border-orange-200'
                : st.priority === 'Mid-high'
                ? 'bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 border border-yellow-200'
                : st.priority === 'Low'
                ? 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]'
                : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border border-blue-200'
            )}
          >
            <option value="High">High</option>
            <option value="Mid-high">Mid-H</option>
            <option value="Mid">Mid</option>
            <option value="Low">Low</option>
          </select>
          <MultiSelectInput
            value={st.party || ''}
            options={[...picOptions, ...uniqueParties]}
            onSave={(val) => handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, { party: val })}
            disabled={!canEditSubTask}
            placeholder="PIC"
            className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded pl-2.5 pr-2 md:px-2 py-1.5 md:py-1.5 text-xs md:text-xs leading-tight font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] outline-none flex-grow shrink w-full min-w-[70px] h-[32px] md:h-[24px]"
          />
          <div
            className={`text-[9px] md:text-[10px] leading-tight font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 md:py-1 rounded-full border whitespace-nowrap ${
              resolveActualStatus(plStatus, [st]).color
            } shrink-0`}
          >
            Act: {resolveActualStatus(plStatus, [st]).label} ({getActStatusPercent(resolveActualStatus(plStatus, [st]).label)}%)
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() =>
              setMultiSearchTerm((parentProject?.code ? parentProject.code + ' ' : '') + (st.name || group.name))
            }
            className="p-1 md:p-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] hover:text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] rounded transition-colors ml-0.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            title="Filter by Tracker"
          >
            <Search className="w-3 h-3 md:w-4 md:h-4" />
          </button>
          {canWrite && (
            <button
              onClick={() => handleDeleteSubTask(group, st.id)}
              className="p-1 md:p-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-500 rounded transition-colors ml-0.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3 md:w-4 md:h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/80 border border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] rounded-lg p-2 min-h-[46px] justify-center">
          <span className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] mb-0.5 tracking-wider">
            Start (Act)
          </span>
          <div className="relative w-full">
            <input
              type="date"
              value={
                st.startAct
                  ? st.startAct.substring(0, 10)
                  : defaultStartAct
                  ? defaultStartAct.substring(0, 10)
                  : ''
              }
              onChange={(e) => handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, { startAct: e.target.value })}
              disabled={!canEditSubTask}
              className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 z-10"
            />
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">
              {formatDisplayDateMain(st.startAct || defaultStartAct)}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/80 border border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] rounded-lg p-2 min-h-[46px] justify-center">
          <span className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] mb-0.5 tracking-wider">
            Finish (Act)
          </span>
          <div className="relative w-full">
            <input
              type="date"
              value={
                st.finishAct
                  ? st.finishAct.substring(0, 10)
                  : defaultFinishAct
                  ? defaultFinishAct.substring(0, 10)
                  : ''
              }
              onChange={(e) => handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, { finishAct: e.target.value })}
              disabled={!canEditSubTask}
              className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 z-10"
            />
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">
              {formatDisplayDateMain(st.finishAct || defaultFinishAct)}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 mb-3 bg-blue-50/30 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] p-2 rounded-lg border border-blue-50">
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <span
            className={`text-[11px] leading-snug w-1/2 text-center break-words py-1.5 px-2 font-bold border rounded flex items-center justify-center ${flowColor}`}
          >
            Flow: {flowTxt}
          </span>
          <div className="w-1/2 flex flex-col items-end">
            <select
              value={selectValue}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const val = e.target.value;
                const payload: Partial<DelegationSubTask> = { approvalStatus: val };
                if (val === 'Approved') {
                  payload.status = 'Approved';
                  payload.delegationStatus = 'Completed';
                  payload.finishAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
                  payload.approvedAt = new Date().toISOString();
                } else if (val === 'Rejected') {
                  payload.status = 'Rejected';
                  payload.delegationStatus = 'Rejected';
                  payload.approvedAt = null;
                } else if (val === 'Hold') {
                  payload.approvalStatus = 'Requested';
                  payload.approvedAt = null;
                } else if (val === 'AcceptTask') {
                  payload.status = 'On process';
                  payload.delegationStatus = 'On process';
                  if (!st.startAct) {
                    payload.startAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
                  }
                  payload.approvedAt = null;
                } else if (val === 'ReqApproval') {
                  payload.status = 'Pending completed';
                  payload.delegationStatus = 'Pending completed';
                  payload.approvalStatus = 'Requested';
                  payload.approvedAt = null;
                } else if (val === 'ReqReview') {
                  payload.status = 'Needs Rework';
                  payload.delegationStatus = 'Needs Rework';
                  payload.approvedAt = null;
                } else {
                  payload.approvedAt = null;
                }
                handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, payload);
              }}
              disabled={!canEditSubTask}
              style={{ backgroundPosition: 'calc(100% - 4px) center' }}
              className="w-full text-xs font-bold pl-2 pr-6 py-1.5 rounded border border-blue-200 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] shadow-sm text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] outline-none h-[32px] appearance-none bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml;charset=US-ASCII,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2212%22%20height%3D%2212%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2024%2024%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%20stroke%3D%22%232563eb%22%20stroke-width%3D%222%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%3E%3Cpolyline%20points%3D%226%209%2012%2015%2018%209%22%3E%3C%2Fpolyline%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E')] bg-[length:12px_12px] bg-no-repeat"
            >
              <option value="None" disabled hidden>
                State...
              </option>
              {(isPIC || isCreator) && <option value="AcceptTask">Accepted</option>}
              {(isPIC || isCreator) && <option value="ReqApproval">Requested Approval</option>}
              {isCreator && <option value="Approved">{t('Approved')}</option>}
              {isCreator && <option value="Rejected">{t('Rejected')}</option>}
            </select>
            {st.approvedAt && selectValue === 'Approved' && (
              <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 whitespace-nowrap">
                {formatDisplayDateTime(st.approvedAt)}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-xs border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] pt-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 mt-1 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 rounded p-2">
          <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase tracking-wider">
            {t('Comments')}
          </span>
          <textarea
            defaultValue={st.comments || ''}
            onBlur={(e) => handleUpdateSubTask(group, st.id, { comments: e.target.value })}
            disabled={!canEditSubTask}
            rows={1}
            className="w-full text-base md:text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] bg-transparent outline-none border border-transparent rounded hover:border-slate-200 dark:hover:border-[#444446] focus:border-blue-500 focus:p-1 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-[#1e1e20] resize-none font-medium min-h-[24px]"
            placeholder="+ Add comments"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 mt-1 bg-blue-50/40 dark:bg-[#28282a] rounded border border-blue-100 p-2.5">
          <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] uppercase tracking-wider">
            {t('Report')}
          </span>
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap">
            {st.report || st.childReport || (
              <span className="italic text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] font-normal">No report yet</span>
            )}
          </div>
          {st.attachments && st.attachments.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[10px]">
              {st.attachments.map((att, iIdx) => {
                if (!att.url) return null;
                const isPdf = att.url.match(/\.pdf($|\?|#)/i) || att.type === 'application/pdf';
                return (
                  <div key={iIdx} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        useAppStore.getState().setZoomableImageSrc(att.url);
                      }}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] hover:text-blue-800 font-bold bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-200 shadow-sm rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 w-fit active:scale-95 transition"
                    >
                      {isPdf ? <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" /> : <Paperclip className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />}
                      <span className="truncate max-w-[150px]">{att.name || att.url || 'Attached File'}</span>
                      <Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 ml-1" />
                    </button>
                    <a
                      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                      href={ensureUrlProtocol(att.url)}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      title="Open Link"
                      className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-500 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-200 rounded"
                    >
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </a>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (
            (st.fileUrl || st.childFileUrl) && (
              <div className="mt-2 text-[10px]">
                {(() => {
                  const fUrl = st.fileUrl || st.childFileUrl;
                  if (!fUrl) return null;
                  const isPdf = fUrl.match(/\.pdf($|\?|#)/i);
                  return (

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          useAppStore.getState().setZoomableImageSrc(fUrl);
                        }}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] hover:text-blue-800 font-bold bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-200 shadow-sm rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 w-fit active:scale-95 transition"
                      >
                        {isPdf ? <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" /> : <Paperclip className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />}
                        <span className="truncate max-w-[150px]">{st.fileName || st.childFileName || 'Download file'}</span>
                        <Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 ml-1" />

                      <a

                      >
                        <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </a>
                    </div>
                  );
                })()}
              </div>
            )
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project, Task, AppUser, DelegationGroup, DelegationSubTask } from '../../types';
import { TaskDelegationMobileCard } from './TaskDelegationMobileCard';

interface TaskDelegationMobileViewProps {
  groupedDelegations: {
    orderedProjects: Array<{ project: Project; groups: DelegationGroup[] }>;
    orphans: DelegationGroup[];
  };
  expandedProjects: string[];
  toggleProject: (id: string) => void;
  expandedGroups: string[];
  toggleGroup: (id: string) => void;
  handleToggleAllGroups: () => void;
  isAllExpanded: boolean;
  visibleGroups: DelegationGroup[];

  setVisibleCount: (fn: (prev: number) => number) => void;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  focusTarget: { groupId: string; subTaskId?: string } | null;
  picOptions: string[];

  handleDeleteGroup: (group: DelegationGroup) => void;
  handleUpdateSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string, updates: Partial<DelegationSubTask>) => void;
  handleDeleteSubTask: (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string) => void;
  setMultiSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
}

export const TaskDelegationMobileView = React.memo(function TaskDelegationMobileView({
  groupedDelegations,
  expandedProjects,
  toggleProject,
  expandedGroups,
  toggleGroup,
  handleToggleAllGroups,
  isAllExpanded,
  visibleGroups,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount,
  projects,
  tasks,
  canWrite,
  currentUser,
  focusTarget,
  picOptions,
  uniqueParties,
  handleDeleteGroup,
  handleUpdateSubTask,
  handleDeleteSubTask,
  setMultiSearchTerm,
}: TaskDelegationMobileViewProps) {
  return (
    <div className="lg:hidden flex flex-col flex-grow overflow-y-auto bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 p-3 md:p-6 [-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch]">
      <div className="w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-4 md:gap-6">
        {visibleGroups.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <button
              onClick={handleToggleAllGroups}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:text-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-sm px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Toggle all"
            >
              {isAllExpanded ? (
                <>
                  <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Collapse All
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Expand All
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        {visibleGroups.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] flex items-center justify-center mb-2 shadow-sm">
              <Search className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]" />
            </div>
            <p className="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">No delegated tasks yet</p>
            <p className="text-xs">Search above or add a custom delegation.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {groupedDelegations.orderedProjects.map(({ project, groups }) => {
              const projectId = project.id || String(project.no);
              const isProjectExpanded = expandedProjects.includes(projectId);
              return (
                <div key={`proj-${projectId}`} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                  <div
                    onClick={() => toggleProject(projectId)}
                    className="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a]/70 border border-blue-200 p-3 rounded-xl shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 pr-4">
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-sm leading-snug">
                        {project.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-mono">
                        {project.store ? `${project.store} - ` : ''}
                        {project.code || '-'}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mt-1 font-medium">
                        {groups.length} sub task(s)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-1 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] shadow-sm border border-blue-100 flex-shrink-0">
                      {isProjectExpanded ? <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {isProjectExpanded && (
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 md:pl-4 border-l-[3px] border-blue-100/50 ml-1.5 pl-2 mt-1">
                      {groups.map((group) => (
                        <TaskDelegationMobileCard
                          key={group.id}
                          group={group}
                          projects={projects}
                          tasks={tasks}
                          expandedGroups={expandedGroups}
                          toggleGroup={toggleGroup}
                          canWrite={canWrite}
                          currentUser={currentUser}
                          focusTarget={focusTarget}
                          picOptions={picOptions}
                          uniqueParties={uniqueParties}
                          handleDeleteGroup={handleDeleteGroup}
                          handleUpdateSubTask={handleUpdateSubTask}
                          handleDeleteSubTask={handleDeleteSubTask}
                          setMultiSearchTerm={setMultiSearchTerm}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}

            {groupedDelegations.orphans.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
                <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  Other Tasks ({groupedDelegations.orphans.length})
                </div>
                {groupedDelegations.orphans.map((group) => (
                  <TaskDelegationMobileCard
                    key={group.id}
                    group={group}
                    projects={projects}
                    tasks={tasks}
                    expandedGroups={expandedGroups}
                    toggleGroup={toggleGroup}
                    canWrite={canWrite}
                    currentUser={currentUser}
                    focusTarget={focusTarget}
                    picOptions={picOptions}
                    uniqueParties={uniqueParties}
                    handleDeleteGroup={handleDeleteGroup}
                    handleUpdateSubTask={handleUpdateSubTask}
                    handleDeleteSubTask={handleDeleteSubTask}
                    setMultiSearchTerm={setMultiSearchTerm}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {visibleCount < visibleGroups.length && (
        <div className="flex justify-center mt-4 mb-6">
          <button
            onClick={() => setVisibleCount((prev) => prev + 20)}
            className="px-6 py-2 bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm cursor-pointer"
          >
            Load More ({visibleGroups.length - visibleCount} remaining)
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

                <tr
                  className="border-b-2 border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555558] bg-blue-50/40 dark:bg-[#28282a] hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/70 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  onClick={() => toggleProject(projectId)}

                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">

                      {project.store ? <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mr-1">{project.store} -</span> : ''}
                      {project.code || '-'}
                    </td>

                    </td>

                  {visibleColumns.includes('status') && (

                        Pl: {plStatus}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  )}
                  {visibleColumns.includes('priority') && <td className="px-4 py-3"></td>}
                  {visibleColumns.includes('party') && <td className="px-4 py-3"></td>}

                      key={g.id}

                      isOrphan={false}

                      handleTextareaInput={handleTextareaInput}

              key={g.id}
              group={g}
              isOrphan={true}
              projects={projects}
              tasks={tasks}

              handleDeleteGroup={handleDeleteGroup}
              handleUpdateSubTask={handleUpdateSubTask}
              handleDeleteSubTask={handleDeleteSubTask}
              handleTextareaInput={handleTextareaInput}
              setMultiSearchTerm={setMultiSearchTerm}
            />
          ))}

          {visibleGroups.length === 0 && (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={visibleColumns.length} className="px-4 py-12 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] flex items-center justify-center mb-2">
                    <Search className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]" />
                  </div>
                  <p className="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">No delegated tasks yet</p>
                  <p className="text-sm">Search for a task above or create a custom delegation.</p>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>

      {visibleCount < visibleGroups.length && (
        <div className="flex justify-center p-6 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
          <button
            onClick={() => setVisibleCount((prev) => prev + 20)}
            className="px-6 py-2 bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm cursor-pointer"
          >
            Load More Tasks ({visibleGroups.length - visibleCount} remaining)
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
