=== FILE: src/components/TaskDelegationParts/delegationAutoSync.ts ===
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { Task, Project, DelegationSubTask } from '../../types';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { getTaskStatus, resolveActualStatus, getSuggestedCompletionTime, parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { scheduleDependentTasks } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { syncProjectDatesByCode } from '../../lib/projectDatesService';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

export async function checkAndSyncRealtimeSubTaskCompletion(
  parentTask: Task,
  parentProject: Project | undefined,
  oldSubTasks: DelegationSubTask[],
  newSubTasks: DelegationSubTask[],
  tasks: Task[],
  projects: Project[]
) {
  const isRealtime = parentTask?.realtimeUpdate || parentProject?.realtimeUpdate;
  if (!isRealtime) return;

  const computedPlStatus = getTaskStatus(parentTask.start, parentTask.finish);
  const oldActStatusLabel = resolveActualStatus(computedPlStatus, oldSubTasks).label;
  const newActStatusLabel = resolveActualStatus(computedPlStatus, newSubTasks).label;

  if (newActStatusLabel === 'Completed' && oldActStatusLabel !== 'Completed') {
    const nowStr =
      parentTask.approval === 'Approved' && parentTask.approvedAt
        ? getSuggestedCompletionTime(parentTask.approvedAt)
        : getSuggestedCompletionTime();
    const taskUpdates: Partial<Task> = { finish: nowStr, durationManual: true };

    if (parentTask.start) {
      const finishDate = parseDateTime(nowStr);
      const startDate = parseDateTime(parentTask.start);
      if (finishDate && startDate) {
        const diffTime = finishDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime();
        const diffDays = diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
        if (diffDays < 0) {
          taskUpdates.duration = '0';
          taskUpdates.finish = taskUpdates.start || parentTask.start;
        } else {
          taskUpdates.duration = String(parseFloat(diffDays.toFixed(1)));
        }
      }
    }

    const newT = {
      ...parentTask,
      ...taskUpdates,
      _isAutoActualized: true,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    const updatesToDependents = scheduleDependentTasks(newT, tasks, projects);
    delete (newT as any)._isAutoActualized;
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', newT.id), newT);
    for (const u of updatesToDependents) {
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', u.id), u as any);
    }
    try {
      await batch.commit();
      syncProjectDatesByCode(parentTask.projectCode, parentTask.projectStore, parentTask.projectYear);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Batch commit failed', error);
      useAppStore
        .getState()
        .setToast({ title: 'Save Failed', message: 'Network error or permission denied.', type: 'error' });
    }
  }
}


=== FILE: src/components/TaskDelegationParts/delegationFilterSort.ts ===
import { DelegationGroup, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { matchesAdvancedSearch } from '../../lib/utils';

interface FilterAndSortDelegationGroupsParams {
  groups: DelegationGroup[];
  isAdmin: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  filterFlowStatus: string;
  filterParty: string;
  multiSearchTerm: string;
  focusTarget: { groupId: string; subTaskId?: string } | null;
  sortConfig: { key: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' } | null;
}

export function filterAndSortDelegationGroups({
  groups,
  isAdmin,
  currentUser,
  filterFlowStatus,
  filterParty,
  multiSearchTerm,
  focusTarget,
  sortConfig,
}: FilterAndSortDelegationGroupsParams): DelegationGroup[] {
  return groups
    .filter((group) => {
      // 0. Focus Target Check
      if (focusTarget && focusTarget.groupId !== group.id) return false;

      // 1. Permission Check
      let hasAccess = false;
      if (isAdmin) {
        hasAccess = true;
      } else {
        const isCreator = group.createdBy === currentUser.id;
        const isSubTaskInvolved = group.subTasks.some(
          (st) => st.createdBy === currentUser.id || (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id))
        );
        const groupHasParty = group.subTasks.some((st) => {
          const pPartyList = String(st.party || '').toLowerCase().split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
          const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
            ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
                .filter((k) => currentUser.partyPermissions![k])
                .map((k) => k.toLowerCase().trim())
            : [];
          if (userParties.includes('all')) return true;
          const usernameMatch = pPartyList.includes(String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim());
          return userParties.some((p) => pPartyList.includes(p)) || usernameMatch;
        });

        hasAccess = isCreator || isSubTaskInvolved || groupHasParty;
      }
      if (!hasAccess) return false;

      // 2. Status Filter Check
      if (filterFlowStatus !== 'all') {
        const hasStatusMatch = group.subTasks.some((st) => {
          const flowStatusRaw = String(st.delegationStatus || st.status || 'Assigned').toLowerCase();
          if (filterFlowStatus === 'active_only') {
            return !['completed'].includes(flowStatusRaw);
          } else if (filterFlowStatus === 'assigned_inprogress') {
            return ['assigned', 'on process', 'in progress', 'accepted', 'approved'].includes(flowStatusRaw);
          } else if (filterFlowStatus === 'pending_rejected') {
            return [
              'pending completed',
              'rejected',
              'review late',
              'hold',
              'delayed',
              'requested',
              'request delay',
              'needs rework',
              'waiting for approval',
            ].includes(flowStatusRaw);
          } else if (filterFlowStatus === 'completed') {
            return flowStatusRaw === 'completed';
          }
          return true;
        });
        if (!hasStatusMatch) return false;
      }

      // Party Filter Check
      if (filterParty) {
        if (filterParty === 'unassigned') {
          const hasPartyMatch = group.subTasks.some((st) => !st.party || st.party.trim() === '');
          if (!hasPartyMatch) return false;
        } else {
          const hasPartyMatch = group.subTasks.some((st) => st.party === filterParty);
          if (!hasPartyMatch) return false;
        }
      }

      // 3. Multi-Search Check
      if (multiSearchTerm) {
        const groupFields = [group.name, group.projectCode, group.id];
        return matchesAdvancedSearch(multiSearchTerm, groupFields, [], (term, andTerms) => {
          return group.subTasks.some((st) => {
            return andTerms.every((tTerm) => {
              const inGroup = groupFields.some((v) => String(v || '').toLowerCase().includes(tTerm));
              if (inGroup) return true;
              const stFields = [st.name, st.party, st.delegationStatus, st.status, st.comments];
              return stFields.some((v) => String(v || '').toLowerCase().includes(tTerm));
            });
          });
        });
      }

      return true;
    })
    .map((group) => {
      let filteredSubTasks =
        focusTarget && focusTarget.subTaskId
          ? group.subTasks.filter((st) => st.id === focusTarget.subTaskId)
          : group.subTasks;

      if (!isAdmin && group.createdBy !== currentUser.id) {
        filteredSubTasks = filteredSubTasks.filter((st) => {
          if (st.createdBy === currentUser.id || (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id)))
            return true;
          const pPartyList = String(st.party || '').toLowerCase().split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
          const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
            ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
                .filter((k) => currentUser.partyPermissions![k])
                .map((k) => k.toLowerCase().trim())
            : [];
          if (userParties.includes('all')) return true;
          const usernameMatch = pPartyList.includes(String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim());
          return userParties.some((p) => pPartyList.includes(p)) || usernameMatch;
        });
      }

      if (filterFlowStatus !== 'all') {
        filteredSubTasks = filteredSubTasks.filter((st) => {
          const flowStatusRaw = String(st.delegationStatus || st.status || 'Assigned').toLowerCase();
          if (filterFlowStatus === 'active_only') {
            return !['completed'].includes(flowStatusRaw);
          } else if (filterFlowStatus === 'assigned_inprogress') {
            return ['assigned', 'on process', 'in progress', 'accepted', 'approved'].includes(flowStatusRaw);
          } else if (filterFlowStatus === 'pending_rejected') {
            return [
              'pending completed',
              'rejected',
              'review late',
              'hold',
              'delayed',
              'requested',
              'request delay',
              'needs rework',
              'waiting for approval',
            ].includes(flowStatusRaw);
          } else if (filterFlowStatus === 'completed') {
            return flowStatusRaw === 'completed';
          }
          return true;
        });
      }

      if (filterParty) {
        if (filterParty === 'unassigned') {
          filteredSubTasks = filteredSubTasks.filter((st) => !st.party || st.party.trim() === '');
        } else {
          filteredSubTasks = filteredSubTasks.filter((st) => st.party === filterParty);
        }
      }

      if (multiSearchTerm && !focusTarget) {
        filteredSubTasks = filteredSubTasks.filter((st) => {
          const groupFields = [group.name, group.projectCode, group.id];
          const stFields = [st.name, st.party, st.delegationStatus, st.status, st.comments];
          return matchesAdvancedSearch(multiSearchTerm, groupFields, stFields);
        });
      }

      const sortedSubTasks = [...filteredSubTasks].sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortConfig) {
          let valA = '';
          let valB = '';
          if (sortConfig.key === 'startAct') {
            valA = a.startAct || '9999-12-31';
            valB = b.startAct || '9999-12-31';
          } else if (sortConfig.key === 'finishAct') {
            valA = a.finishAct || '9999-12-31';
            valB = b.finishAct || '9999-12-31';
          }
          if (valA < valB) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
          if (valA > valB) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
          return 0;
        }

        const prioOrder: Record<string, number> = { High: 1, 'Mid-high': 2, Mid: 3, Low: 4 };
        const prioA = prioOrder[a.priority || 'Mid'] || 99;
        const prioB = prioOrder[b.priority || 'Mid'] || 99;
        if (prioA !== prioB) return prioA - prioB;

        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        const finishA = a.finishAct ? new Date(a.finishAct) : null;
        const finishB = b.finishAct ? new Date(b.finishAct) : null;

        if (finishA && finishB) {
          const diffA = Math.abs(finishA.getTime() - today.getTime());
          const diffB = Math.abs(finishB.getTime() - today.getTime());
          if (diffA !== diffB) return diffA - diffB;
        } else if (finishA) {
          return -1;
        } else if (finishB) {
          return 1;
        }

        const startA = a.startAct || '9999-12-31';
        const startB = b.startAct || '9999-12-31';
        if (startA < startB) return -1;
        if (startA > startB) return 1;
        return 0;
      });
      return { ...group, subTasks: sortedSubTasks };
    })
    .filter((group) => group.subTasks.length > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortConfig) {
        let valA = '';
        let valB = '';
        const direction = sortConfig.direction;
        if (sortConfig.key === 'startAct') {
          valA = a.subTasks[0]?.startAct || '9999-12-31';
          valB = b.subTasks[0]?.startAct || '9999-12-31';
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'finishAct') {
          valA = a.subTasks.map((t) => t.finishAct).filter(Boolean).sort()[0] || '9999-12-31';
          valB = b.subTasks.map((t) => t.finishAct).filter(Boolean).sort()[0] || '9999-12-31';
        }
        if (valA < valB) return direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        if (valA > valB) return direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        return 0;
      }

      const prioOrder: Record<string, number> = { High: 1, 'Mid-high': 2, Mid: 3, Low: 4 };
      const highestPrioA = Math.min(...a.subTasks.map((st) => prioOrder[st.priority || 'Mid'] || 99));
      const highestPrioB = Math.min(...b.subTasks.map((st) => prioOrder[st.priority || 'Mid'] || 99));
      if (highestPrioA !== highestPrioB) return highestPrioA - highestPrioB;

      const today = new Date();
      today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

      const getMinDiff = (group: any) => {
        let minDiff = Infinity;
        group.subTasks.forEach((st: any) => {
          if (st.finishAct) {
            const d = new Date(st.finishAct);
            const diff = Math.abs(d.getTime() - today.getTime());
            if (diff < minDiff) minDiff = diff;
          }
        });
        return minDiff;
      };

      const diffA = getMinDiff(a);
      const diffB = getMinDiff(b);
      if (diffA !== diffB) return diffA - diffB;

      const startA = a.subTasks[0]?.startAct || '9999-12-31';
      const startB = b.subTasks[0]?.startAct || '9999-12-31';
      if (startA < startB) return -1;
      if (startA > startB) return 1;

      return 0;
    });
}

import { DelegationGroup, Project, Task } from '../../types';

export interface TaskDelegationTabProps {

export interface DelegationColWidths {
  expand: number;
  taskName: number;
  projectCode: number;
  comments: number;
  status: number;
  startAct: number;
  finishAct: number;
  priority: number;
  party: number;
  actions: number;
}

export const resolveGroupParentProject = (
  group: DelegationGroup,
  projects: any[],
  tasks: any[]
): Project | undefined => {
  const parentTask = group.parentTaskId ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === group.parentTaskId) : null;
  const ps = group.projectStore || parentTask?.projectStore;
  const py = group.projectYear || parentTask?.projectYear;

  return projects.find(
    (p) =>
      ((group.parentTaskId && p.code === group.parentTaskId) ||
        (group.projectCode && p.code === group.projectCode)) &&
      (ps ? String(p.store) === String(ps) : true) &&
      (py ? String(p.year) === String(py) : true)
  );
};

export const computeFallbackYear = (
  yearVal?: number | string | null,
  parentProject?: Project | null,
  globalYearFilter?: string
): number => {
  if (yearVal !== undefined && yearVal !== null && !isNaN(Number(yearVal))) {
    return Number(yearVal);
  }
  if (parentProject?.year && !isNaN(Number(parentProject.year))) {
    return Number(parentProject.year);
  }
  if (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all' && !isNaN(Number(globalYearFilter))) {
    return Number(globalYearFilter);
  }
  return new Date().getFullYear();
};

  const [colWidths, setColWidths] = useState<DelegationColWidths>({
    expand: 50,
    taskName: 300,
    projectCode: 150,
    comments: 400,
    status: 120,
    startAct: 120,
    finishAct: 120,
    priority: 120,
    party: 150,
    actions: 80,
  });

  const availableColumnsForUser = useMemo(() => AVAILABLE_COLUMNS, []);
  const [visibleColumns, setVisibleColumns] = useState<string[]>(
    availableColumnsForUser.map((c) => c.id)
  );
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const prevScreenTypeRef = useRef(getDeviceScreenType());

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadDeviceConfig = () => {
      const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_delegation_col_widths', currentUser.id);
      if (saved) {
        try {
          setColWidths(JSON.parse(saved));
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
      }

      const savedCols = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_delegation_visible_cols', currentUser.id);
      if (savedCols) {
        try {
          setVisibleColumns(JSON.parse(savedCols));
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
      } else {
        const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768;
        if (isMobile) {
          setVisibleColumns(['expand', 'taskName', 'status', 'actions']);
        }
      }
    };

    loadDeviceConfig();

    const handleResize = () => {
      const currentScreenType = getDeviceScreenType();
      if (currentScreenType !== prevScreenTypeRef.current) {
        prevScreenTypeRef.current = currentScreenType;
        loadDeviceConfig();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, [currentUser.id]);

  const handleSort = (key: string) => {
    let direction: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'asc';
    if (sortConfig && sortConfig.key === key && sortConfig.direction === 'asc') {
      direction = 'desc';
    }
    setSortConfig({ key, direction });
  };

  const handleResize = (col: keyof DelegationColWidths, newWidth: number) => {
    setColWidths((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev, [col]: newWidth };
      safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_delegation_col_widths', JSON.stringify(next), currentUser.id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleToggleColumn = (colId: string) => {
    setVisibleColumns((prev) => {
      const next = prev.includes(colId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== colId) : [...prev, colId];
      safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_delegation_visible_cols', JSON.stringify(next), currentUser.id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const isAdmin = currentUser.role === 'admin';
  const role = currentUser.role as AppRole;
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalYearFilter);
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const isArchiveYear =
    globalYearFilter !== 'all' && Number(globalYearFilter) < new Date().getFullYear();
  const canWrite =
    (isAdmin || !!permissionMatrix[role]?.Write?.taskDelegation) && !isArchiveYear;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusTarget) {
      const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          setFocusTarget(null);
          onBackFromFocus?.();
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
  }, [focusTarget, onBackFromFocus]);

  const picOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const list = new Set<string>();
    appUsers.forEach((u) => u.username && list.add(u.username));
    subAppUsers.forEach((u) => {
      const vals = [
        u.username,
        u.name,
        u.fullName,
        u.displayName,
        u.email,
        u.title,
        u.id,
      ].filter((v) => v && typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '');
      vals.forEach((val) => list.add(val as string));
      for (const key of Object.keys(u)) {
        const val = (u as any)[key];
        if (val && typeof val === 'string' && val.trim() !== '' && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) {
          list.add(val);
        }
      }
    });
    return Array.from(list).sort();
  }, [appUsers, subAppUsers]);

  const uniqueParties = useMemo(() => {
    const partiesList = new Set<string>();
    groups.forEach((g) =>
      g.subTasks.forEach((st) => {
        if (st.party) partiesList.add(st.party);
      })
    );
    return [...partiesList].sort();
  }, [groups]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (searchRef.current && !searchRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsSearchFocused(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOpenGroup = (e: any) => {
      const { groupId, subTaskId } = e.detail;
      setFocusTarget({ groupId, subTaskId });

      const group = groups.find((g) => g.id === groupId);
      if (group) {
        const p = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);
        if (p) {
          const pId = p.id || String(p.no);
          setExpandedProjects((prev) => {
            if (!prev.includes(pId)) return [...prev, pId];
            return prev;
          });
        }
      }

      setExpandedGroups((prev) => {
        if (!prev.includes(groupId)) return [...prev, groupId];
        return prev;
      });

      setTimeout(() => {
        const el = document.getElementById(`delegation-subtask-${subTaskId}`);
        const elMob = document.getElementById(`delegation-subtask-mobile-${subTaskId}`);
        const targetEl = el && el.offsetHeight > 0 ? el : elMob && elMob.offsetHeight > 0 ? elMob : null;

        if (targetEl) {
          scrollToElement(targetEl);
          targetEl.classList.add('bg-yellow-50', 'transition-all');
          setTimeout(() => targetEl?.classList.remove('bg-yellow-50', 'transition-all'), 3000);
        } else {
          const groupEl = document.getElementById(`delegation-group-${groupId}`);
          const groupElMob = document.getElementById(`delegation-group-mobile-${groupId}`);
          const targetGroupEl = groupEl && groupEl.offsetHeight > 0 ? groupEl : groupElMob && groupElMob.offsetHeight > 0 ? groupElMob : null;

          if (targetGroupEl) {
            scrollToElement(targetGroupEl);
            targetGroupEl.classList.add('bg-yellow-100', 'transition-all');
            setTimeout(() => targetGroupEl?.classList.remove('bg-yellow-100', 'transition-all'), 3000);
          }
        }
      }, 500);
    };

    const handleClearFocus = () => {
      setFocusTarget(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('taka_open_delegation_group', handleOpenGroup);
    window.addEventListener('taka_clear_delegation_focus', handleClearFocus);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('taka_open_delegation_group', handleOpenGroup);
      window.removeEventListener('taka_clear_delegation_focus', handleClearFocus);
    };
  }, [groups, projects, tasks]);

  const availableItems: DelegatableItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    return [
      ...projects
        .filter(
          (p) =>
            p.delegation &&
            !groups.some((g) => g.parentTaskId === p.code && (!g.projectStore || g.projectStore === p.store))
        )
        .map((p) => ({
          type: 'project' as const,
          id: `${p.code}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}`,
          name: p.name,
          projectCode: p.code,
          projectStore: p.store,
          projectYear: p.year,
          projectName: p.name,
          party: '',
        })),
      ...tasks
        .filter((t) => t.delegation && !groups.some((g) => g.parentTaskId === t.id))
        .map((t) => {
          const p = projects.find(
            (proj) =>
              proj.code === t.projectCode &&
              (String(proj.year || '') === String(t.projectYear || '') || (!proj.year && !t.projectYear)) &&
              (String(proj.store || '') === String(t.projectStore || '') || (!proj.store && !t.projectStore))
          );
          return {
            type: 'task' as const,
            id: t.id,
            name: t.name,
            projectCode: t.projectCode,
            projectStore: t.projectStore,
            projectYear: t.projectYear,
            projectName: p?.name,
            party: t.party,
          };
        }),
    ];
  }, [projects, tasks, groups]);

  const searchResults = useMemo(() => {
    return searchTerm
      ? availableItems.filter((item) => {
          const searchStr = `${item.name} ${item.projectCode} ${item.projectName || ''} ${item.party || ''}`.toLowerCase();
          return searchStr.includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
        })
      : availableItems;
  }, [searchTerm, availableItems]);

  const toggleGroup = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedGroups((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((gId) => gId !== id) : [...prev, id]));
  };

  const toggleProject = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedProjects((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((pId) => pId !== id) : [...prev, id]));
  };

  const visibleGroups = useMemo(() => {
    return filterAndSortDelegationGroups({
      groups,
      isAdmin,
      currentUser,
      filterFlowStatus,
      filterParty,
      multiSearchTerm,
      focusTarget,
      sortConfig,
    });
  }, [groups, isAdmin, currentUser, filterFlowStatus, filterParty, multiSearchTerm, focusTarget, sortConfig]);

  const groupedDelegations = useMemo(() => {
    const byProject = new Map<string, typeof visibleGroups>();
    const orphans: typeof visibleGroups = [];

    const paginatedGroups = visibleGroups.slice(0, visibleCount);

    paginatedGroups.forEach((group) => {
      const p = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);
      if (p) {
        const key = p.id || String(p.no);
        if (!byProject.has(key)) {
          byProject.set(key, []);
        }
        byProject.get(key)!.push(group);
      } else {
        orphans.push(group);
      }
    });

    const orderedProjects = projects
      .filter((p) => {
        const key = p.id || String(p.no);
        return byProject.has(key);
      })
      .map((p) => {
        const key = p.id || String(p.no);
        return {
          project: p,
          groups: byProject.get(key)!,
        };
      });

    return { orderedProjects, orphans };
  }, [visibleGroups, visibleCount, projects, tasks]);

  const isAllExpanded =
    expandedGroups.length >= visibleGroups.length &&
    expandedProjects.length >= groupedDelegations.orderedProjects.length;

  const handleToggleAllGroups = () => {
    const allProjectIds = groupedDelegations.orderedProjects.map(
      (p) => p.project.id || String(p.project.no)
    );
    if (expandedGroups.length >= visibleGroups.length && expandedProjects.length >= allProjectIds.length) {
      setExpandedGroups([]);
      setExpandedProjects([]);
    } else {
      setExpandedGroups(visibleGroups.map((g) => g.id));
      setExpandedProjects(allProjectIds);
    }
  };

  const handleTextareaInput = (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    const target = e.target as HTMLTextAreaElement;
    target.style.height = 'auto';
    target.style.height = `${target.scrollHeight}px`;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const timers = [100, 500].map((delay) =>
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.querySelectorAll('textarea').forEach((textarea) => {
          textarea.style.height = 'auto';
          textarea.style.height = `${textarea.scrollHeight}px`;
        });
      }, delay)
    );
    return () => timers.forEach(clearTimeout);
  }, [expandedGroups, groups]);

  return {
    groups,
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    filterFlowStatus,
    setFilterFlowStatus,
    multiSearchTerm,
    setMultiSearchTerm,
    filterParty,
    setFilterParty,
    focusTarget,
    setFocusTarget,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    sortConfig,
    handleSort,
    colWidths,
    handleResize,
    visibleColumns,
    availableColumnsForUser,
    handleToggleColumn,
    isSearchFocused,
    setIsSearchFocused,
    searchRef,
    expandedProjects,
    setExpandedProjects,
    expandedGroups,
    setExpandedGroups,
    toggleGroup,
    toggleProject,
    handleToggleAllGroups,
    isAllExpanded,
    picOptions,
    uniqueParties,
    availableItems,
    searchResults,
    visibleGroups,
    groupedDelegations,
    handleTextareaInput,
    canWrite,
    isAdmin,
    globalYearFilter,
    globalStoreFilter,
  };
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { setDoc, deleteDoc } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { Project, Task, AppUser, DelegationGroup, DelegationSubTask } from '../../types';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { generateId, getTaskStatus, getStatus, resolveActualStatus } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { extractStorageUrls, deleteStorageFiles } from '../../lib/storageUtils';
import { DelegatableItem, resolveGroupParentProject, computeFallbackYear } from './taskDelegationTypes';
import { checkAndSyncRealtimeSubTaskCompletion } from './delegationAutoSync';

interface UseTaskDelegationMutationsParams {
  canWrite: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  groups: DelegationGroup[];
  globalYearFilter: string;
  globalStoreFilter: string;
  setSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
  setIsSearchFocused: (focused: boolean) => void;
}

export function useTaskDelegationMutations({
  canWrite,
  currentUser,
  projects,
  tasks,
  groups,
  globalYearFilter,
  globalStoreFilter,
  setSearchTerm,
  setIsSearchFocused,
}: UseTaskDelegationMutationsParams) {
  const setToast = useAppStore((state) => state.setToast);
  const [isAddingTask, setIsAddingTask] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => void;
  }>({
    isOpen: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    onConfirm: () => {},
  });

  const handleAddLinkedGroup = async (item: DelegatableItem) => {
    if (!canWrite) return;
    if (isAddingTask[item.id]) return;

    const alreadyExists = groups.some((g) => {
      if (item.type === 'task') return g.parentTaskId === item.id;
      return g.parentTaskId === item.projectCode && (!g.projectStore || g.projectStore === item.projectStore);
    });

    if (alreadyExists) {
      setToast({ title: 'Error', message: 'A Delegation Group already exists for this item.' });
      return;
    }

    setIsAddingTask((prev) => ({ ...prev, [item.id]: true }));
    try {
      const parentTask = item.type === 'task' ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === item.id) : null;
      const parentProject = projects.find(
        (p) =>
          p.code === item.projectCode &&
          (item.projectStore ? p.store === item.projectStore : true) &&
          (item.projectYear ? String(p.year) === String(item.projectYear) : true)
      );

      let startAct = parentTask?.start || parentProject?.computedTakStart || parentProject?.start;
      let finishAct = parentTask?.finish || parentProject?.computedTakCompl;

      if (!startAct) startAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
      if (!finishAct) finishAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);

      const rawParty =
        parentTask?.party && parentTask.party.trim()
          ? parentTask.party.trim()
          : parentProject?.party && parentProject.party.trim()
          ? parentProject.party.trim()
          : currentUser.username || '';
      const parsedParty = rawParty.split(/[,;/+]+/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[0] || rawParty;

      const initialSubTask: DelegationSubTask = {
        id: generateId(),
        name: '',
        comments: '',
        status: 'Assigned',
        delegationStatus: 'Assigned',
        priority: 'Mid',
        party: parsedParty,
        startAct,
        finishAct,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        createdBy: currentUser.id,
        involvedUsers: [currentUser.id],
      };

      const fallbackYear = computeFallbackYear(item.projectYear, parentProject, globalYearFilter);
      const parentKey = item.type === 'project' ? item.projectCode : item.id;
      const storeSuffix = item.projectStore || parentProject?.store || 'HCM';
      const existingGroup = groups.find((g) =>
        item.type === 'project'
          ? g.parentTaskId === item.projectCode &&
            (!g.projectStore || g.projectStore === storeSuffix) &&
            (!g.projectYear || String(g.projectYear) === String(fallbackYear))
          : g.parentTaskId === item.id
      );
      const targetGroupId =
        existingGroup?.id ||
        (item.type === 'project' ? `del_proj_${item.projectCode}_${storeSuffix}_${fallbackYear}` : `del_${item.id}`);

      if (existingGroup) {
        if (item.type === 'task' && existingGroup.subTasks && existingGroup.subTasks.length > 0) {
          setToast({ title: 'Notice', message: 'This task already has a delegation.' });
          return;
        }
        const updatedSubTasks = [...(existingGroup.subTasks || []), initialSubTask];
        setDoc(
          doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', targetGroupId),
          {
            ...existingGroup,
            subTasks: updatedSubTasks,
            projectYear: fallbackYear,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          },
          { merge: true }
        );
      } else {
        const newGroup: DelegationGroup = {
          id: targetGroupId,
          parentTaskId: parentKey,
          name: item.name,
          projectCode: item.projectCode,
          projectStore: item.projectStore || parentProject?.store || 'HCM',
          projectYear: fallbackYear,
          subTasks: [initialSubTask],
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          createdBy: currentUser.id,
        };
        setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', targetGroupId), newGroup, {
          merge: true,
        });
      }

      if (item.type === 'task') {
        const taskRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', item.id);
        if (parentTask) {
          setDoc(taskRef, { ...parentTask, delegation: true, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        }
      } else if (item.type === 'project') {
        const projRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', item.id);
        if (parentProject) {
          setDoc(projRef, { ...parentProject, delegation: true, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        }
      }

      setSearchTerm('');
      setIsSearchFocused(false);
    } finally {
      setIsAddingTask((prev) => ({ ...prev, [item.id]: false }));
    }
  };

  const handleAddCustomGroup = async () => {
    if (!canWrite) return;

    const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
    const initialSubTask: DelegationSubTask = {
      id: generateId(),
      name: '',
      comments: '',
      status: 'Assigned',
      delegationStatus: 'Assigned',
      priority: 'Mid',
      party: currentUser.username || '',
      startAct: dateStr,
      finishAct: dateStr,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    const fallbackYear = computeFallbackYear(null, null, globalYearFilter);
    const fallbackStore =
      globalStoreFilter && globalStoreFilter !== 'all'
        ? globalStoreFilter
        : currentUser?.storePermissions?.hcm
        ? 'HCM'
        : 'HN';

    const newGroup: DelegationGroup = {
      id: generateId(),
      name: 'New Custom Delegation',
      projectStore: fallbackStore,
      projectYear: fallbackYear,
      subTasks: [initialSubTask],
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      createdBy: currentUser.id,
    };
    setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', newGroup.id), newGroup);
  };

  const handleUpdateGroup = async (group: DelegationGroup, updates: Partial<DelegationGroup>) => {
    if (!canWrite) return;
    const parentProject = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);
    const fallbackYear = computeFallbackYear(group.projectYear, parentProject, globalYearFilter);
    const updated = {
      ...group,
      ...updates,
      projectYear:
        updates.projectYear !== undefined && !isNaN(Number(updates.projectYear))
          ? Number(updates.projectYear)
          : fallbackYear,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', group.id), updated);
  };

  const handleDeleteGroup = async (group: DelegationGroup) => {
    if (!canWrite) return;
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: 'Delete Delegation Group',
      message: 'Delete this delegation group?',
      onConfirm: async () => {
        // Deep clean attachments on Firebase Storage
        const urlsToDelete = extractStorageUrls(group);
        if (urlsToDelete.length > 0) {
          deleteStorageFiles(urlsToDelete).catch(console.error);
        }

        deleteDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', group.id));

        if (group.parentTaskId) {
          const parentTask = tasks.find((t) => t.id === group.parentTaskId);
          if (parentTask) {
            setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', parentTask.id), {
              ...parentTask,
              delegation: false,
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            });
          } else {
            const parentProject = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);
            if (parentProject) {
              setDoc(
                doc(
                  db,
                  'artifacts',
                  APP_ID,
                  'public',
                  'data',
                  'taka_projects',
                  parentProject.id || String(parentProject.no)
                ),
                { ...parentProject, delegation: false, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
              );
            }
          }
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleAddSubTask = async (group: DelegationGroup) => {
    if (!canWrite) return;

    const parentTask = group.parentTaskId ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === group.parentTaskId) : null;
    const parentProject = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);

    let startAct = parentTask?.start || parentProject?.computedTakStart || parentProject?.start;
    let finishAct = parentTask?.finish || parentProject?.computedTakCompl;

    if (!startAct) startAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
    if (!finishAct) finishAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);

    const newSubTask: DelegationSubTask = {
      id: generateId(),
      name: '',
      comments: '',
      status: 'Assigned',
      delegationStatus: 'Assigned',
      priority: 'Mid',
      party: currentUser.username || '',
      startAct,
      finishAct,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      createdBy: currentUser.id,
      involvedUsers: [currentUser.id],
    };
    const fallbackYear = computeFallbackYear(group.projectYear, parentProject, globalYearFilter);
    const updatedGroup = {
      ...group,
      projectYear: fallbackYear,
      subTasks: [...group.subTasks, newSubTask],
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', group.id), updatedGroup);

    if (group.parentTaskId) {
      const parentTask = tasks.find((t) => t.id === group.parentTaskId);
      if (parentTask) {
        setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', parentTask.id), {
          ...parentTask,
          projectYear: Number(parentTask.projectYear) || fallbackYear,
          delegation: true,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
      } else {
        const parentProj = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);
        if (parentProj) {
          setDoc(
            doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', parentProj.id || String(parentProj.no)),
            { ...parentProj, delegation: true, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
          );
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateSubTask = async (
    group: DelegationGroup,
    subTaskId: string,
    updates: Partial<DelegationSubTask>
  ) => {
    const subTask = group.subTasks.find((st) => st.id === subTaskId);
    if (!subTask) return;

    const isCreator = group.createdBy === currentUser.id;
    const pPartyList = (subTask.party || '').split(',').map((p) => p.toLowerCase().trim());
    const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
      ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
          .filter((k) => currentUser.partyPermissions![k])
          .map((k) => k.toLowerCase().trim())
      : [];
    const isPIC =
      userParties.includes('all') ||
      pPartyList.some((p) => userParties.includes(p)) ||
      pPartyList.includes(String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim()) ||
      (subTask.involvedUsers && subTask.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id));
    const canEditSubTask = canWrite || isCreator || isPIC;

    if (!canEditSubTask) return;

    const updatedSubTasks = group.subTasks.map((st) =>
      st.id === subTaskId
        ? {
            ...st,
            ...updates,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            involvedUsers: Array.from(new Set([...(st.involvedUsers || []), currentUser.id])),
          }
        : st
    );
    const parentProject = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);
    const fallbackYear = computeFallbackYear(group.projectYear, parentProject, globalYearFilter);
    const updatedGroup = JSON.parse(
      JSON.stringify({
        ...group,
        projectYear: fallbackYear,
        subTasks: updatedSubTasks,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
    );
    setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', group.id), updatedGroup);

    if (group.parentTaskId) {
      const parentTask = tasks.find((t) => t.id === group.parentTaskId);
      if (parentTask) {
        checkAndSyncRealtimeSubTaskCompletion(
          parentTask,
          parentProject,
          group.subTasks,
          updatedSubTasks,
          tasks,
          projects
        );
      }
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteSubTask = async (group: DelegationGroup, subTaskId: string) => {
    if (!canWrite) return;
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: 'Delete Delegation Task',
      message: 'Delete this delegation task?',
      onConfirm: async () => {
        const targetSubTask = group.subTasks.find((st) => st.id === subTaskId);
        if (targetSubTask) {
          const urlsToDelete = extractStorageUrls(targetSubTask);
          if (urlsToDelete.length > 0) {
            deleteStorageFiles(urlsToDelete).catch(console.error);
          }
        }

        const updatedSubTasks = group.subTasks.filter((st) => st.id !== subTaskId);
        if (updatedSubTasks.length === 0) {
          deleteDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', group.id));
          if (group.parentTaskId) {
            const parentTask = tasks.find((t) => t.id === group.parentTaskId);
            if (parentTask) {
              setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', parentTask.id), {
                ...parentTask,
                delegation: false,
                updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              });
            } else {
              const parentProject = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);
              if (parentProject) {
                setDoc(
                  doc(
                    db,
                    'artifacts',
                    APP_ID,
                    'public',
                    'data',
                    'taka_projects',
                    parentProject.id || String(parentProject.no)
                  ),
                  { ...parentProject, delegation: false, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
                );
              }
            }
          }
        } else {
          const parentProject = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);
          const fallbackYear = computeFallbackYear(group.projectYear, parentProject, globalYearFilter);
          const updatedGroup = JSON.parse(
            JSON.stringify({
              ...group,
              projectYear: fallbackYear,
              subTasks: updatedSubTasks,
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            })
          );
          setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', group.id), updatedGroup);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  // Synchronize plStatus and actStatus to Firestore
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canWrite) return;

    groups.forEach((group) => {
      const parentTask = group.parentTaskId ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === group.parentTaskId) : null;
      const parentProject = resolveGroupParentProject(group, projects, tasks);

      let computedPlStatus = 'Upcoming';
      if (parentTask) {
        computedPlStatus = getTaskStatus(parentTask.start, parentTask.finish);
      } else if (parentProject) {
        computedPlStatus = getStatus(
          parentProject.computedTakStart || parentProject.start,
          parentProject.computedTakCompl,
          parentProject.computedOpening || parentProject.opening,
          parentProject.code
        );
      }

      const computedActStatusObj = resolveActualStatus(computedPlStatus, group.subTasks);
      const computedActStatus = computedActStatusObj.label;

      if (group.plStatus !== computedPlStatus || group.actStatus !== computedActStatus) {
        handleUpdateGroup(group, {
          plStatus: computedPlStatus,
          actStatus: computedActStatus,
        });
      }
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [groups, canWrite]);

  return {
    confirmModal,
    setConfirmModal,
    isAddingTask,
    handleAddLinkedGroup,
    handleAddCustomGroup,
    handleUpdateGroup,
    handleDeleteGroup,
    handleAddSubTask,
    handleUpdateSubTask,
    handleDeleteSubTask,
  };
}

const PredecessorDatalist = React.memo(({ projects, tasks, currentProjectCode, currentProjectYear, currentProjectStore }: { projects: Project[], tasks: Task[], currentProjectCode?: string, currentProjectYear?: string | number, currentProjectStore?: string }) => {
  const options = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects || [], tasks || []);
      let ownOptions: React.ReactNode[] = [];
      let otherOptions: React.ReactNode[] = [];

      for (const [code, tList] of taskNoMap.entries()) {
        if (!tList || !tList.length || !tList[0]) continue;
        const t = tList[0];
        const isOwn = currentProjectCode && t.projectCode === currentProjectCode && 
                      (currentProjectYear ? String(t.projectYear) === String(currentProjectYear) : true) &&
                      (currentProjectStore ? String(t.projectStore) === String(currentProjectStore) : true);
                      
        const labelText = `${code}: ${t.name || ''}${t.finish ? ` (${t.finish.substring(0, 10)})` : ''}`;
        const opt = <option key={code} value={code} label={labelText}>{labelText}</option>;
        if (isOwn) {
          ownOptions.push(opt);
        } else {
          otherOptions.push(opt);
        }
      }
      return [...ownOptions, ...otherOptions];
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to build predecessor options:", err);
      return [];
    }
  }, [projects, tasks, currentProjectCode, currentProjectYear, currentProjectStore]);
  
  return (
    <datalist id="task-modal-predecessor-options">
      {options}
    </datalist>
  );
});

export interface PredecessorChange {
  /** Chuỗi predecessor chuẩn của hệ thống, ví dụ: "A01#2SS+1, A01#3FF" */
  predecessor: string;
  /** ID task tương ứng theo đúng thứ tự trong chuỗi (hard-link, tránh nhầm task trùng mã) */
  predecessorTaskIds: string[];
  /** Mảng object (giữ tương thích với dữ liệu cũ) */
  predecessors: { taskId: string; type: PredecessorType }[];
}

interface PredecessorSearchSuggestProps {
  /** Task đang sửa (hoặc bản nháp của task mới – id có thể rỗng) */

  canWrite: boolean;

   * Nếu truyền vào: component KHÔNG tự lưu, mà trả kết quả cho nơi gọi xử lý
   * (dùng cho Task Modal – lưu khi bấm Save, và cho bảng Detail – đi qua onUpdateTask).
   * Nếu không truyền: tự tính lại ngày, kéo theo task phụ thuộc và lưu Firestore.
   */
  onChange?: (change: PredecessorChange) => void | Promise<void>;
}

interface LinkItem {
  key: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  taskId: string;
  task?: Task;
  code: string;
  type: PredecessorType;
  lagSign: '+' | '-';
  lagValue: number;
  raw: string;
  isExternal: boolean;
  externalLabel: string;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/*  Constants & helpers                                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const REL_INFO: Record<PredecessorType, { hint: string }> = {
  FS: { hint: 'Finish → Start' },
  SS: { hint: 'Start → Start' },
  FF: { hint: 'Finish → Finish' },
  SF: { hint: 'Start → Finish' },
};

const SLOT_STYLE = [
  {
    tag: '①',
    title: 'Primary Predecessor',
    border: 'border-l-blue-500',
    badge: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-blue-300',
    active: 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600 shadow-sm',
    caption: 'text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300',
  },
  {
    tag: '②',
    title: 'Secondary Predecessor · FF / SF only',
    border: 'border-l-rose-500',
    badge: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300',
    active: 'bg-rose-600 text-white border-rose-600 shadow-sm',
    caption: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300',
  },
];

const FACTOR_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  year: 'Different year',
  store: 'Different store',
  location: 'Different floor/location',
  code: 'Different project',
};

function externalLabel(diff?: ProjectDiffDetails, fallbackCode?: string): string {
  const factors = (diff as any)?.diffFactors as string[] | undefined;
  if (factors && factors.length > 0) {
    return factors.map((f) => FACTOR_LABEL[f] || f).join(' · ');
  }
  return fallbackCode ? `Project ${fallbackCode}` : 'Cross-Project';
}

function shortDate(s?: string): string {
  if (!s) return '—';
  const m = String(s).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
  return m ? `${m[3]}/${m[2]}/${m[1].slice(2)}` : String(s);
}

function lagToText(sign: string, v: number): string {
  return v ? `${sign}${v}` : '';
}

function tokenOf(it: LinkItem): string {
  if (!it.resolved) return it.raw;
  const lag = lagToText(it.lagSign, it.lagValue);
  const rel = it.type === 'FS' && !lag ? '' : it.type;
  return `${it.code}${rel}${lag}`;
}

/** Secondary predecessor must be FF or SF */
function normalize(list: LinkItem[]): LinkItem[] {
  return list.slice(0, 2).map((it, i) =>
    i === 1 && it.resolved && it.type !== 'FF' && it.type !== 'SF' ? { ...it, type: 'FF' as PredecessorType } : it
  );
}

function describe(it: LinkItem): string {
  if (!it.task) return '';
  const name = `«${it.task.name}»`;
  const signed = (it.lagSign === '-' ? -1 : 1) * it.lagValue;
  const lag = signed === 0 ? '' : signed > 0 ? `, +${signed} days` : `, -${Math.abs(signed)} days`;
  switch (it.type) {
    case 'FS':
      return `Start after ${name} finishes${lag}`;
    case 'SS':
      return `Start when ${name} starts${lag}`;
    case 'FF':
      return `Finish when ${name} finishes${lag}`;
    case 'SF':
      return `Finish when ${name} starts${lag}`;
  }
  return '';
}

function milestoneDate(it: LinkItem): string {
  if (!it.task) return '';
  const ref = it.type === 'FS' || it.type === 'FF' ? it.task.finish : it.task.start;
  if (!ref) return '';
  const signed = (it.lagSign === '-' ? -1 : 1) * it.lagValue;
  try {
    return shortDate(addDays(ref, signed));
  } catch {
    return shortDate(ref);
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Persist default predecessor changes                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

async function persistDefault(
  source: Task,
  change: PredecessorChange,
  projects: Project[]
): Promise<void> {
  if (!source?.id) {
    throw new Error('Please save the task before linking a predecessor.');
  }
  const store = useAppStore.getState() as any;
  const currentTasks: Task[] = store.tasks || [];
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const updatedTask: Task = {
    ...source,
    predecessor: change.predecessor,
    predecessorTaskIds: change.predecessorTaskIds,
    predecessors: change.predecessors,
    realtimeUpdate: Boolean(change.predecessor.trim()),
    updatedAt: now,
  } as Task;

  const taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, currentTasks);
  const parsed = parsePredecessors(change.predecessor, taskNoMap, updatedTask);
  if (parsed.length >= 2) updatedTask.durationManual = false;

  const calc = calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors(updatedTask, parsed as any);
  if (calc) {
    updatedTask.start = calc.start;
    updatedTask.finish = calc.finish;
    updatedTask.duration = calc.duration;
    updatedTask.durationManual = calc.durationManual;
  }

  const dependents = scheduleDependentTasks(updatedTask, currentTasks, projects);

  const map = new Map<string, Task>(currentTasks.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
  map.set(updatedTask.id, updatedTask);
  dependents.forEach((u: any) => {
    const t = map.get(u.id);
    if (t) {
      map.set(u.id, { ...t, start: u.start, finish: u.finish, duration: u.duration, updatedAt: u.updatedAt });
    }
  });
  store.setTasks(Array.from(map.values()));

  const editing = store.editingTask;
  if (editing && editing.id === updatedTask.id && typeof store.setEditingTask === 'function') {
    store.setEditingTask({ ...editing, ...updatedTask });
  }

  const batch = writeBatch(db);
  batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', updatedTask.id), updatedTask as any, { merge: true });
  dependents.forEach((u: any) => {
    batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', u.id), u, { merge: true });
  });
  batch.commit().catch((err: any) => {
    console.error('Failed to persist predecessor update:', err);
    store.setToast?.({ title: 'Save failed', message: err?.message || 'Could not save predecessor', type: 'error' });
  });

  store.setToast?.({
    title: 'Predecessor Updated',
    message: change.predecessor ? `Link: ${change.predecessor}` : 'Predecessor removed',
    type: 'success',
  });
}

function LagInput({ value, disabled, onCommit }: { value: number; disabled?: boolean; onCommit: (n: number) => void }) {
  const fmt = (n: number) => (n > 0 ? `+${n}` : String(n));
  const [txt, setTxt] = useState(fmt(value));
  const isTypingRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTypingRef.current) {
      setTxt(fmt(value));
    }
  }, [value]);

  const commit = () => {
    isTypingRef.current = false;
    const n = parseFloat(txt.replace(',', '.').replace('−', '-'));
    if (isNaN(n)) {
      setTxt(fmt(value));
      return;
    }
    const r = Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
    if (r !== value) onCommit(r);
    else setTxt(fmt(value));
  };
  return (
    <input
      type="text"
      inputMode="decimal"
      value={txt}
      disabled={disabled}
      onFocus={(e: any) => {
        isTypingRef.current = true;
        e.target.select?.();
      }}
      onChange={(e: any) => setTxt(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9+\-−.,]/g, ''))}
      onBlur={commit}
      onKeyDown={(e: any) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          commit();
          e.target.blur?.();
        }
      }}
      title="Enter lag days, e.g. +2 or -1"
      className={cn(
        'h-6 w-12 rounded-md border border-slate-200/80 bg-white dark:border-[#38383a] dark:bg-[#18181a] text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors shadow-2xs',
        value === 0 ? 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400' : value > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400'
      )}
    />
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/*  Component                                                          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export const PredecessorSearchSuggest: React.FC<PredecessorSearchSuggestProps> = memo(
  ({ task, canWrite, onChange }) => {
    const storeTasks = useAppStore((s: any) => s.tasks) as Task[];
    const projects = (useAppStore((s: any) => s.projects) || []) as Project[];
    const liveTask = useAppStore((s: any) =>
      task?.id ? (s.tasks as Task[]).find((t) => t.id === task.id) : undefined
    ) as Task | undefined;

    const source: Task = onChange ? task : liveTask || task;

    const wrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    const listRef = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);

    const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
    const deferredQuery = useDeferredValue(query);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [hi, setHi] = useState(0);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [pendingExternal, setPendingExternal] = useState<RankedPredecessorMatch | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (open && listRef.current && listRef.current.children[hi]) {
        const activeEl = listRef.current.children[hi] as HTMLElement;
        if (activeEl) {
          activeEl.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      }
    }, [hi, open]);

    const ctx: PredecessorContext = useMemo(
      () => ({
        projectId: source?.projectId,
        projectCode: source?.projectCode,
        projectYear: source?.projectYear,
        projectStore: source?.projectStore,
        projectLocation: source?.location,
      }),
      [source?.projectId, source?.projectCode, source?.projectYear, source?.projectStore, source?.location]
    );

    const pool = useMemo(() => (storeTasks || []).filter((t) => t && !t.isDeleted), [storeTasks]);
    const taskNoMap = useMemo(() => buildTaskNoMap(projects, storeTasks || []), [projects, storeTasks]);

    const items = useMemo<LinkItem[]>(() => {
      const str = String(source?.predecessor || '').trim();
      if (!str) return [];
      const ids = source?.predecessorTaskIds || [];
      const tokens = splitPredecessors(str, taskNoMap).slice(0, 2);

      return tokens.map((tok, i) => {
        let p: any;
        try {
          p = parsePredecessors(tok, taskNoMap, { ...source, predecessorTaskIds: [ids[i] || ''] } as Task)[0];
        } catch {
          p = undefined;
        }
        if (p && p.task) {
          const diff = getTaskProjectDiffDetails(ctx, p.task, projects);
          const code = computeTaskCode(projects, storeTasks || [], p.task) || p.task.taskCodePhu || p.no || tok;
          return {
            key: `${p.task.id}-${i}`,
            resolved: true,
            taskId: p.task.id,
            task: p.task as Task,
            code,
            type: (p.type || 'FS') as PredecessorType,
            lagSign: (p.lagSign === '-' ? '-' : '+') as '+' | '-',
            lagValue: Number(p.lagValue) || 0,
            raw: tok,
            isExternal: !!diff.isDifferent,
            externalLabel: externalLabel(diff, p.task.projectCode),
          };
        }
        const { query: q } = parsePredecessorToken(tok);
        return {
          key: `raw-${i}-${tok}`,
          resolved: false,
          taskId: '',
          code: q || tok,
          type: 'FS' as PredecessorType,
          lagSign: '+' as const,
          lagValue: 0,
          raw: tok,
          isExternal: false,
          externalLabel: '',
        };
      });
    }, [
      source?.predecessor,
      source?.predecessorTaskIds,
      source?.projectId,
      source?.projectCode,
      source?.projectYear,
      source?.projectStore,
      source?.location,
      taskNoMap,
      ctx,
      projects,
      storeTasks,
    ]);

    useEffect(() => {
      const handler = (e: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) => {
        if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
          setOpen(false);
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handler);
      document.addEventListener('touchstart', handler, { passive: true });
      return () => {
        document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handler);
        document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handler);
      };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => setHi(0), [deferredQuery]);

    const excluded = useMemo(() => {
      const s = new Set<string>();
      if (source?.id) s.add(source.id);
      items.forEach((i) => i.taskId && s.add(i.taskId));
      return s;
    }, [source?.id, items]);

    const candidates = useMemo<RankedPredecessorMatch[]>(() => {
      if (!open) return [];
      const q = deferredQuery.trim();

      if (q) {
        return rankCandidateTasks(q, pool, projects, pool, source?.projectCode, ctx)
          .filter((m) => !excluded.has(m.task.id))
          .slice(0, 20);
      }

      let base = pool.filter((t) => !excluded.has(t.id));
      const sameCode = base.filter((t) => t.projectCode === source?.projectCode);
      if (sameCode.length > 0) base = sameCode;
      base = base
        .filter((t) => !getTaskProjectDiffDetails(ctx, t, projects).isDifferent)
        .sort((a, b) => (a.orderIndex ?? 0) - (b.orderIndex ?? 0))
        .slice(0, 25);

      return base.map((t) => {
        const diff = getTaskProjectDiffDetails(ctx, t, projects);
        return {
          task: t,
          score: 0,
          exactTaskCode: computeTaskCode(projects, pool, t) || t.taskCodePhu || t.id,
          isExternal: !!diff.isDifferent,
          diffDetails: diff,
        } as RankedPredecessorMatch;
      });
    }, [open, deferredQuery, pool, projects, excluded, source?.projectCode, ctx]);

    const commit = async (list: LinkItem[]) => {
      const finalList = normalize(list);
      const change: PredecessorChange = {
        predecessor: finalList.map(tokenOf).filter(Boolean).join(', '),
        predecessorTaskIds: finalList.map((i) => i.taskId || ''),
        predecessors: finalList.filter((i) => i.resolved).map((i) => ({ taskId: i.taskId, type: i.type })),
      };
      setSaving(true);
      setError(null);
      try {
        if (onChange) await onChange(change);
        else await persistDefault(source, change, projects);
      } catch (e: any) {
        setError(e?.message || 'Could not save predecessor link');
      } finally {
        setSaving(false);
      }
    };

    const wouldCreateCycle = (candidate: Task): boolean => {
      if (!source?.id) return false;
      const visited = new Set<string>();
      const stack: Task[] = [candidate];
      while (stack.length > 0 && visited.size < 500) {
        const cur = stack.pop() as Task;
        if (cur.id === source.id) return true;
        if (visited.has(cur.id)) continue;
        visited.add(cur.id);
        if (!cur.predecessor) continue;
        try {
          parsePredecessors(cur.predecessor, taskNoMap, cur).forEach((p: any) => {
            if (p?.task) stack.push(p.task as Task);
          });
        } catch {}
      }
      return false;
    };

    const addTask = (m: RankedPredecessorMatch, confirmed = false) => {
      const t = m.task;
      if (items.length >= 2) return;
      if (wouldCreateCycle(t)) {
        setError(
          `Cannot link: «${t.name}» depends on this task (directly or indirectly), causing a circular dependency.`
        );
        setPendingExternal(null);
        return;
      }
      if (m.isExternal && !confirmed) {
        setPendingExternal(m);
        setOpen(false);
        return;
      }
      const idx = items.length;
      const next: LinkItem = {
        key: `${t.id}-${idx}`,
        resolved: true,
        taskId: t.id,
        task: t,
        code: m.exactTaskCode || computeTaskCode(projects, pool, t) || t.taskCodePhu || t.id,
        type: idx === 0 ? 'FS' : 'FF',
        lagSign: '+',
        lagValue: 0,
        raw: '',
        isExternal: !!m.isExternal,
        externalLabel: externalLabel(m.diffDetails, t.projectCode),
      };
      setPendingExternal(null);
      setQuery('');
      setOpen(false);
      inputRef.current?.blur();
      commit([...items, next]);
    };

    const patchItem = (idx: number, patch: Partial<LinkItem>) => {
      commit(items.map((it, i) => (i === idx ? { ...it, ...patch } : it)));
    };

    const removeItem = (idx: number) => {
      commit(items.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
    };

    const stepLag = (idx: number, delta: number) => {
      const it = items[idx];
      const signed = (it.lagSign === '-' ? -1 : 1) * it.lagValue;
      const n = Math.round((signed + delta) * 100) / 100;
      patchItem(idx, { lagSign: n < 0 ? '-' : '+', lagValue: Math.abs(n) });
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!open) setOpen(true);
        else setHi((h) => Math.min(h + 1, Math.max(candidates.length - 1, 0)));
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setHi((h) => Math.max(h - 1, 0));
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        const m = candidates[hi] || candidates[0];
        if (m) addTask(m);
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (open) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          setOpen(false);
        }
      }
    };

    const canAdd = canWrite && items.length < 2;
    const hasQuery = deferredQuery.trim().length > 0;

    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 w-full" ref={wrapperRef} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {saving && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
            <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> Updating...
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/60 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 px-3 py-2 text-[12px] font-medium text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <span className="flex-1">{error}</span>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setError(null)} className="shrink-0 p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-900/50">
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {items.map((it, idx) => {
          const allowed: PredecessorType[] = idx === 0 ? ['FS', 'SS', 'FF', 'SF'] : ['FF', 'SF'];
          const signed = (it.lagSign === '-' ? -1 : 1) * it.lagValue;

          return (
            <div
              key={it.key}
              className={cn(
                'group flex flex-col gap-1.5 rounded-xl border bg-white dark:bg-[#1c1c1f] p-2 shadow-2xs transition-all hover:border-blue-300 dark:hover:border-blue-700',
                it.resolved ? 'border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383a]' : 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/40 dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/20'
              )}
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      'inline-flex h-5 min-w-[20px] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded px-1 text-[11px] font-black mt-0.5',
                      idx === 0
                        ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/80 dark:text-blue-300'
                        : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300'
                    )}
                  >
                    {idx === 0 ? '①' : '②'}
                  </span>

                  {it.resolved && it.task ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="font-mono text-xs font-black text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] shrink-0">
                          {it.code}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] leading-snug break-words">
                          {it.task.name}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {it.isExternal && (
                        <span className="mt-1 inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 w-fit rounded border border-amber-300 bg-amber-100/70 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-extrabold text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/40 dark:text-amber-300">
                          <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
                          {it.externalLabel}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300">
                      Not found «{it.raw}»
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {canWrite && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => removeItem(idx)}
                    disabled={saving}
                    title="Remove link"
                    className="shrink-0 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-500 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40 active:scale-95 transition-all touch-manipulation disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Row 2: Type Segmented Pills + Lag Controls placed on the SAME ROW */}
              {it.resolved && canWrite && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#2a2a2d] text-xs flex-nowrap overflow-x-auto">
                  {/* Type Segmented Control */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">TYPE:</span>
                    <div className="inline-flex rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#252528] p-0.5 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#38383a]">
                      {allowed.map((rel) => {
                        const active = it.type === rel;
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={rel}
                            type="button"
                            disabled={saving}
                            onClick={() => !active && patchItem(idx, { type: rel })}
                            className={cn(
                              'px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-black rounded-md transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation disabled:opacity-60 cursor-pointer',
                              active
                                ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-2xs dark:bg-blue-600'
                                : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
                            )}
                          >
                            {rel}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Lag Control Inline */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">LAG:</span>
                    <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#252528] px-1 py-0.5 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#38383a]">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={saving}
                        onClick={() => stepLag(idx, -1)}
                        className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded bg-white dark:bg-[#1c1c1f] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 shadow-2xs hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 active:scale-95 transition-all touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Minus className="h-3 w-3" />
                      </button>
                      <LagInput value={signed} disabled={saving} onCommit={(n) => patchItem(idx, { lagSign: n < 0 ? '-' : '+', lagValue: Math.abs(n) })} />
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 px-0.5">days</span>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={saving}
                        onClick={() => stepLag(idx, 1)}
                        className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded bg-white dark:bg-[#1c1c1f] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 shadow-2xs hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 active:scale-95 transition-all touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}

        {/* Confirm cross project link */}
        {pendingExternal && (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-2.5 text-xs dark:border-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5 font-medium text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p>
                «<b>{pendingExternal.task.name}</b>» belongs to another project (
                <b>{externalLabel(pendingExternal.diffDetails, pendingExternal.task.projectCode)}</b>). Confirm cross-project link?
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPendingExternal(null)}
                className="rounded-lg px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/50 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => addTask(pendingExternal, true)}
                className="rounded-lg bg-amber-600 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-2xs hover:bg-amber-700 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
              >
                Link
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Search input */}
        {canAdd && !pendingExternal && (
          <div className="relative w-full">
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                ref={inputRef}
                type="text"
                value={query}
                disabled={saving}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setQuery(e.target.value);
                  setOpen(true);
                }}
                onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
                onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                placeholder="Type task name or code..."
                autoComplete="off"
                className="h-8 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 pl-8 pr-7 text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 outline-none placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:bg-white dark:border-[#38383a] dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] dark:text-white dark:focus:bg-[#202023] transition-all shadow-2xs"
              />
              {query && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setQuery('');
                    inputRef.current?.focus();
                  }}
                  className="absolute right-1 top-1/2 flex h-6 w-6 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
                  tabIndex={-1}
                >
                  <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {open && (
              <ul
                ref={listRef}
                role="listbox"
                className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full z-[200] mt-1 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white dark:border-[#444446] dark:bg-[#252528] p-1 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md transition-all"
              >
                {!hasQuery && candidates.length > 0 && (
                  <li className="px-2.5 pb-1 pt-1 text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                    Suggestions (Same Project)
                  </li>
                )}
                {candidates.length === 0 ? (
                  <li className="px-3 py-2.5 text-center text-xs italic text-slate-400">
                    {hasQuery ? 'No tasks found' : 'No matching tasks'}
                  </li>
                ) : (
                  candidates.map((m, i) => {
                    const t = m.task;
                    const best = hasQuery && i === 0 && m.score >= 450;
                    return (
                      <li
                        key={t.id}
                        role="option"
                        aria-selected={i === hi}
                        onMouseEnter={() => setHi(i)}
                        onClick={() => addTask(m)}
                        className={cn(
                          'flex min-h-[38px] cursor-pointer flex-col gap-0.5 rounded-lg border-b border-slate-100/60 dark:border-slate-800/60 px-2.5 py-1.5 last:border-0 transition-colors',
                          i === hi ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40' : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#2e2e32]'
                        )}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                          <span className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3]">{t.name}</span>
                          <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                            {best && (

      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updated);
      await Promise.all(childIds.map(id => (localDb.tasks.update as any)(id, { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now })));
      const { doc, deleteField } = await import('firebase/firestore');
      const { writeBatch } = await import('../../lib/firestoreWrites');
      const { db, APP_ID } = await import('../../lib/firebase');
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      childIds.forEach(id => {
        const ref = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
        batch.update(ref, { parentTaskId: deleteField(), parentId: null, updatedAt: now });
      });
      await batch.commit();
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Success", message: `Unlinked ${childIds.length} subtask(s).` });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

                  ...formData,
                  projectCode: val.code,
                  projectYear: val.year,

                });

          >
            {projects.map(p => (

              >
                {p.code} {p.store ? `(${p.store})` : ''} {p.year ? `[${p.year}]` : ''}

            readOnly
            className="w-full p-2 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg text-sm outline-none bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] cursor-not-allowed"
