            readOnly
            className="w-full p-2 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg text-sm outline-none bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] cursor-not-allowed"

import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, AppUser, DelegationGroup } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from "../../store/useAppStore";
import { TaskChatDelegationSection } from './chat/TaskChatDelegationSection';
import { TaskChatReportsList } from './chat/TaskChatReportsList';
import { TaskChatCommentItem } from './chat/TaskChatCommentItem';
import { TaskChatInput, TaskChatInputHandle } from './chat/TaskChatInput';
import { useTaskChatActions } from './chat/useTaskChatActions';

export interface TaskChatProps {
  task: Task;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  subAppUsers?: any[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  onNavigateToDelegation?: (groupId: string, taskId?: string) => void;
  setConfirmModal: any;
}

export const TaskChat = React.memo(function TaskChat({
  task,
  projects,
  tasks,
  currentUser,
  appUsers,
  subAppUsers,
  delegationGroups,
  setConfirmModal
}: TaskChatProps) {
  const focusCommentId = useAppStore(state => state.focusCommentId);
  const setFocusCommentId = useAppStore(state => state.setFocusCommentId);

  const currentProject = useMemo(() => {
    return projects.find(p => 
      p.code === task.projectCode &&
      (task.projectStore ? p.store === task.projectStore : true) &&
      (task.projectYear ? String(p.year) === String(task.projectYear) : true)
    ) || projects.find(p => p.code === task.projectCode);
  }, [projects, task.projectCode, task.projectStore, task.projectYear]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusCommentId) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        const el = document.getElementById('comment-' + focusCommentId);
        if (el) {
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          el.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-blue-500', 'ring-offset-2', 'ring-offset-slate-50', 'dark:ring-offset-[#131314]');
          setTimeout(() => {
            el.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-blue-500', 'ring-offset-2', 'ring-offset-slate-50', 'dark:ring-offset-[#131314]');
          }, 3000);
          setFocusCommentId(null);
        }
      }, 300);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [focusCommentId, setFocusCommentId]);

  const chatInputRef = useRef<TaskChatInputHandle>(null);

  const [editingCommentId, setEditingCommentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingText, setEditingText] = useState('');
  const [localComments, setLocalComments] = useState(task.comments || []);

  const projectTasks = useMemo(() => {
    return tasks.filter(t => 
      t.projectCode === task.projectCode && 
      (t.projectYear == task.projectYear || (!t.projectYear && !task.projectYear)) &&
      (t.projectStore == task.projectStore || (!t.projectStore && !task.projectStore))
    );
  }, [tasks, task.projectCode, task.projectStore, task.projectYear]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalComments(task.comments || []);
  }, [task.comments]);

  const comments = localComments;

  const picOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const list = new Set<string>();
    appUsers.forEach(u => u.username && list.add(u.username));
    subAppUsers?.forEach(u => {
      const vals = [u.username, u.name, u.fullName, u.displayName, u.email, u.title, u.id].filter(v => v && typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '');
      if (vals.length > 0 && vals[0]) {
        list.add(vals[0]);
      }
    });

    if (task && task.party) {
      const parts = String(task.party).split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      parts.forEach(p => list.add(p));
    }

    const linkedGroup = delegationGroups.find(g => g.parentTaskId === task.id);
    if (linkedGroup && linkedGroup.subTasks) {
      linkedGroup.subTasks.forEach(st => {
        if (st.party) {
          const parts = String(st.party).split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
          parts.forEach(p => list.add(p));
        }
      });
    }

    return Array.from(list).sort();
  }, [appUsers, subAppUsers, task?.party, delegationGroups, task?.id]);

  const linkedGroup = delegationGroups.find(g => g.parentTaskId === task.id);

  const { handleDeleteComment, handleEditComment, handleSendFromInput } = useTaskChatActions({
    task,
    comments,
    setLocalComments,
    currentUser,
    appUsers,
    currentProject,
    linkedGroup,
    projectTasks,
    setConfirmModal,
    editingText,
    setEditingText,
    setEditingCommentId
  });

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden relative">
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-6 space-y-4">
        {linkedGroup && (
          <TaskChatDelegationSection
            linkedGroup={linkedGroup}
            task={task}
            currentProject={currentProject}
            currentUser={currentUser}
            appUsers={appUsers}
            picOptions={picOptions}
            chatInputRef={chatInputRef}
            tasks={tasks}
            projects={projects}
          />
        )}

        <TaskChatReportsList linkedGroup={linkedGroup} />

        {comments.map((c: any) => (
          <TaskChatCommentItem
            key={c.id}
            comment={c}
            currentUser={currentUser}
            appUsers={appUsers}
            subAppUsers={subAppUsers}
            editingCommentId={editingCommentId}
            editingText={editingText}
            setEditingText={setEditingText}
            setEditingCommentId={setEditingCommentId}
            handleEditComment={handleEditComment}
            handleDeleteComment={handleDeleteComment}
            task={task}
            tasks={tasks}
            currentProject={currentProject}
            linkedGroup={linkedGroup}
            delegationGroups={delegationGroups}
          />
        ))}

        {comments.length === 0 && !linkedGroup && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] text-sm">
            No comments yet. Start the conversation!
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <TaskChatInput
        ref={chatInputRef}
        onSend={handleSendFromInput}
        appUsers={appUsers}
        projectTasks={projectTasks}
        linkedGroup={linkedGroup}
      />
    </div>
  );
});

                  "p-0.5 rounded transition-colors",

                  canWrite ? "hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]" : "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed"
                )}
                title={!formData.durationManual ? "Manual Finish" : "Auto Finish"}
              >
                <Pin className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
              Finish (Plan) *
            </label>
            <input 
              type="datetime-local" 
              value={formData.finish}
              onChange={(e) => handleDateChange('finish', e.target.value)}
              required

            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {parseFloat(String(formData.duration || "0")) < 0 && (

import React, { memo, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Info, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { PredecessorSearchSuggest, PredecessorChange } from './PredecessorSearchSuggest';
import { Task } from '../../types';

interface TaskPredecessorSectionProps {
  task: Task;
  formData: any;
  canWrite: boolean;
  t: (key: string) => string;
  tasks: any[];
  projects: any[];
  resolvedPredecessors: any[];
  handlePredecessorChange: (val: string) => void;
  handleApplyPredecessorDates: () => void;
  /** Thêm mới: để lưu kèm predecessorTaskIds vào form (bấm Save mới ghi vào dữ liệu) */
  setFormData?: (updater: any) => void;
}

export const TaskPredecessorSection = memo(function TaskPredecessorSection({
  task,
  formData,
  canWrite,
  t,
  resolvedPredecessors,
  handlePredecessorChange,
  handleApplyPredecessorDates,
  setFormData,
}: TaskPredecessorSectionProps) {
  // Bản nháp phản ánh đúng những gì người dùng đang nhập trong form (kể cả task mới chưa lưu)
  const draft = useMemo(
    () =>
      ({
        ...(task || {}),
        id: task?.id || '',
        projectId: formData.projectId ?? task?.projectId,
        projectCode: formData.projectCode ?? task?.projectCode,
        projectYear: formData.projectYear ?? task?.projectYear,
        projectStore: formData.projectStore ?? task?.projectStore,
        location: formData.location ?? task?.location,
        name: formData.name || task?.name || '',
        start: formData.start,
        finish: formData.finish,
        duration: formData.duration,
        predecessor: formData.predecessor || '',
        predecessorTaskIds: formData.predecessorTaskIds ?? task?.predecessorTaskIds ?? [],
      } as Task),
    [
      task,
      formData.projectId,
      formData.projectCode,
      formData.projectYear,
      formData.projectStore,
      formData.location,
      formData.name,
      formData.start,
      formData.finish,
      formData.duration,
      formData.predecessor,
      formData.predecessorTaskIds,
    ]
  );

  const handleLinkChange = (change: PredecessorChange) => {
    // 1) cập nhật chuỗi predecessor + tự tính lại ngày (logic có sẵn của modal)
    handlePredecessorChange(change.predecessor);
    // 2) gắn thêm ID task để không bao giờ nhầm task trùng mã
    setFormData?.((prev: any) => ({
      ...prev,
      predecessorTaskIds: change.predecessorTaskIds,
      predecessors: change.predecessors,
    }));
  };

  const hasResolved = resolvedPredecessors.some((rp) => rp?.task);

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]">
          {t('Predecessor')}
        </label>

        {hasResolved && canWrite && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleApplyPredecessorDates}
            className="inline-flex min-h-[36px] shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 bg-white px-2.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-600 shadow-sm hover:bg-blue-50 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation dark:border-blue-700 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] dark:text-blue-400"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Sync Dates
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <PredecessorSearchSuggest task={draft} canWrite={canWrite} onChange={handleLinkChange} />
    </div>
  );
});


=== FILE: src/components/TaskModalParts/TaskPredecessorSelect.tsx ===
import React, { FC, memo, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Task, TaskPredecessor, PredecessorType } from '../../types';
import { Link, X, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTaskPredecessor } from '../../hooks/useTaskPredecessor';

interface TaskPredecessorSelectProps {
  currentTaskId: string;
  currentProjectCode: string;
  allTasks: Task[];
  currentPredecessors?: TaskPredecessor[];
  canWrite: boolean;
}

export const TaskPredecessorSelect: React.FC<TaskPredecessorSelectProps> = React.memo(({
  currentTaskId,
  currentProjectCode,
  allTasks,
  currentPredecessors = [],
  canWrite
}) => {
  const { updatePredecessors } = useTaskPredecessor();
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [selectedTaskId, setSelectedTaskId] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<PredecessorType>('FS');

  // Chỉ lấy task cùng project, ngoại trừ task hiện tại và các task đã được link
  const candidateTasks = useMemo(() => {
    return allTasks.filter(t => 
      t.projectCode === currentProjectCode && 
      t.id !== currentTaskId &&
      !currentPredecessors.some(p => p.taskId === t.id)
    );
  }, [allTasks, currentProjectCode, currentTaskId, currentPredecessors]);

  const handleAddPredecessor = async () => {
    if (!selectedTaskId) return;
    try {
      setError(null);
      const newPred: TaskPredecessor = { taskId: selectedTaskId, type: selectedType };
      await updatePredecessors(currentTaskId, [...currentPredecessors, newPred]);
      setSelectedTaskId('');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRemovePredecessor = async (removeTaskId: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      const newIds = currentPredecessors.filter(p => p.taskId !== removeTaskId);
      await updatePredecessors(currentTaskId, newIds);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1a1a1d] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336]">
      <label className="text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
        <Link className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" /> Predecessors
      </label>
      
      {/* Display linked tasks */}
      {currentPredecessors.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 mb-1">
          {currentPredecessors.map(pred => {
            const pTask = allTasks.find(t => t.id === pred.taskId);
            const displayName = pTask ? `${pTask.taskCodePhu || 'N/A'} - ${pTask.name}` : 'Unknown Task';
            
            return (
              <div key={pred.taskId} className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white dark:bg-[#252528] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-xs group hover:border-blue-300 transition-colors">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                  <span className="font-bold font-mono text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-900/50 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 shrink-0">
                    {pred.type}
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium" title={displayName}>
                    {displayName}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {canWrite && (
                  <button onClick={() => handleRemovePredecessor(pred.taskId)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1 rounded transition-colors shrink-0">
                    <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add new predecessor form */}
      {canWrite && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <select
            value={selectedTaskId}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedTaskId(e.target.value)}
            className="flex-1 text-xs p-2 border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555] rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-800 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 truncate min-w-0"
          >
            <option value="" disabled>+ Select Task...</option>
            {candidateTasks.map(t => (
              <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                {t.taskCodePhu || 'N/A'} - {t.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <select
            value={selectedType}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedType(e.target.value as PredecessorType)}
            className="w-16 text-xs font-bold p-2 border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555] rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-[#25252a] text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 outline-none shrink-0"
          >
            <option value="FS">FS</option>
            <option value="SS">SS</option>
            <option value="FF">FF</option>
            <option value="SF">SF</option>
          </select>

          <button
            onClick={handleAddPredecessor}
            disabled={!selectedTaskId}
            className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-colors shrink-0 shadow-sm"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {error && <span className="text-[10px] text-red-500 font-bold">{error}</span>}
    </div>
  );
});


=== FILE: src/components/TaskModalParts/chat/TaskChatApprovalBoard.tsx ===
import React, { FC } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { Task, AppUser, DelegationGroup, Project } from '../../../types';
import { cn } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { setDoc } from '../../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../../lib/firebase';

interface TaskChatApprovalBoardProps {
  text: string;
  isMe?: boolean;
  task: Task;
  tasks: Task[];
  currentProject?: Project;
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
}

export const TaskChatApprovalBoard: React.FC<TaskChatApprovalBoardProps> = ({
  text,
  isMe = false,
  task,
  tasks,
  currentProject,
  delegationGroups,
  currentUser
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  if (!text) return null;

  const taggedTasks = tasks.filter(t => 
    t.name && 
    t.projectCode === task.projectCode && 
    t.projectStore === task.projectStore && 
    t.projectYear === task.projectYear && 
    text.includes(`#${t.name}-approval`)
  );

  const uniqueTaggedTasks: Task[] = [];
  const seenNames = new Set<string>();
  for (const tg of taggedTasks) {
    if (!seenNames.has(tg.name)) {
      seenNames.add(tg.name);
      uniqueTaggedTasks.push(tg);
    }
  }

  const relevantGroups = uniqueTaggedTasks
    .map(tg => delegationGroups.find(g => g.parentTaskId === tg.id))
    .filter(Boolean) as DelegationGroup[];

  if (relevantGroups.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-3">
      {relevantGroups.map(g => (
        <div
          key={g.id}
          className={cn(
            "p-2 rounded-lg border text-xs shadow-sm",
            isMe ? "bg-blue-700 border-blue-500" : "bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]"
          )}
        >
          <div
            className="font-bold mb-2 pb-1 border-b flex items-center justify-between"
            style={{ borderColor: isMe ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' : 'var(--tw-border-opacity)' }}
          >
            <span>{g.name} - Approvals</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            {g.subTasks.map(st => {
              let selectValue = 'None';
              const stStatus = String(st.delegationStatus || st.status || '').toLowerCase();
              const stApproval = String(st.approvalStatus || '').toLowerCase();
              if (stStatus === 'completed') selectValue = 'Approved';
              else if (stStatus === 'rejected') selectValue = 'Rejected';
              else if (stStatus === 'pending completed') selectValue = 'ReqApproval';
              else if (stStatus === 'needs rework') selectValue = 'ReqReview';
              else if (stStatus === 'on process' || stStatus === 'accepted') selectValue = 'AcceptTask';
              else if (
                ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stStatus) ||
                ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stApproval)
              ) {
                selectValue = 'Hold';
              }

              let statusColor = isMe ? "text-white" : "text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400";
              let bgStatus = isMe ? "bg-white/20" : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#333336]";
              if (!isMe) {
                if (selectValue === 'Approved') {
                  statusColor = "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";
                  bgStatus = "bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30";
                } else if (selectValue === 'Rejected') {
                  statusColor = "text-red-700 dark:text-red-400";
                  bgStatus = "bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30";
                } else if (selectValue === 'ReqApproval') {
                  statusColor = "text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-400";
                  bgStatus = "bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-900/30";
                } else if (selectValue === 'Hold') {
                  statusColor = "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";
                  bgStatus = "bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/30";
                } else if (selectValue === 'AcceptTask') {
                  statusColor = "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400";
                  bgStatus = "bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30";
                }
              }

              const isCreator = (g.createdBy === currentUser.id) || (currentUser.role === 'admin');
              const pPartyList = String(st.party || '').toLowerCase().split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
              const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
                ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
                    .filter(k => currentUser.partyPermissions![k])
                    .map(k => k.toLowerCase().trim())
                : [];
              const isPIC =
                userParties.includes('all') ||
                pPartyList.some(p => userParties.includes(p)) ||
                pPartyList.includes(String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim()) ||
                (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id));

              if (!isCreator && !isPIC) return null;

              return (
                <div
                  key={st.id}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-2 rounded",
                    isMe ? "bg-blue-600" : "bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]"
                  )}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-xs line-clamp-1 flex-1">{st.party || 'No PIC'}</span>
                    <select
                      value={selectValue}
                      onChange={async (e) => {
                        const val = e.target.value;
                        const payload: any = { approvalStatus: val };
                        if (val === 'Approved') {
                          payload.status = 'Approved';
                          payload.delegationStatus = 'Completed';
                          payload.finishAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
                          payload.approvedAt = new Date().toISOString();
                        } else if (val === 'Rejected') {
                          payload.status = 'Rejected';
                          payload.delegationStatus = 'Rejected';
                          payload.approvedAt = null;
                        } else if (val === 'Hold') {
                          payload.approvalStatus = 'Requested';
                          payload.approvedAt = null;
                        } else if (val === 'AcceptTask') {
                          payload.status = 'On process';
                          payload.delegationStatus = 'On process';
                          payload.approvedAt = null;
                        } else if (val === 'ReqApproval') {
                          payload.status = 'Pending Completed';
                          payload.delegationStatus = 'Pending Completed';
                          payload.approvedAt = null;
                        }

                        const updatedSubTasks = g.subTasks.map((sub: any) =>
                          sub.id === st.id ? { ...sub, ...payload } : sub
                        );
                        const fallbackGrpYear =
                          g.projectYear !== undefined && g.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(g.projectYear))
                            ? Number(g.projectYear)
                            : Number(currentProject?.year) || new Date().getFullYear();
                        try {
                          await setDoc(
                            doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', g.id),
                            {
                              ...g,
                              projectYear: fallbackGrpYear,
                              subTasks: updatedSubTasks,
                            },
                            { merge: true }
                          );
                        } catch (err) {
                          console.error('Error updating approval status:', err);
                        }
                      }}
                      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                      className={cn(
                        "text-[10px] font-bold p-1 rounded outline-none border border-transparent cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity",
                        bgStatus,
                        statusColor,
                        isMe ? "border-white/20" : ""
                      )}
                    >
                      <option value="None" disabled hidden>State...</option>
                      {(isPIC || isCreator) && <option value="AcceptTask">Accepted</option>}
                      {(isPIC || isCreator) && <option value="ReqApproval">Requested Approval</option>}
                      {isCreator && <option value="Approved">{t("Approved")}</option>}
                      {isCreator && <option value="Rejected">{t("Rejected")}</option>}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  {(st.delegationStatus || st.status) && (
                    <div className={cn("text-[9px] opacity-70 mt-0.5", isMe ? "text-white" : "text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]")}>
                      Flow: {st.delegationStatus || st.status} {st.approvedAt && selectValue === 'Approved' ? `(${new Date(st.approvedAt).toLocaleDateString()})` : ''}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};


=== FILE: src/components/TaskModalParts/chat/TaskChatCommentItem.tsx ===
import React, { FC } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { Edit2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Task, AppUser, DelegationGroup, Project } from '../../../types';
import { cn } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { ChatHighlightedText } from './chatSharedUtils';
import { TaskChatApprovalBoard } from './TaskChatApprovalBoard';

interface TaskChatCommentItemProps {
  comment: any;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  subAppUsers?: any[];
  editingCommentId: string | null;
  editingText: string;
  setEditingText: (text: string) => void;
  setEditingCommentId: (id: string | null) => void;
  handleEditComment: (commentId: string) => void;
  handleDeleteComment: (commentId: string) => void;
  task: Task;
  tasks: Task[];
  currentProject: Project | undefined;
  linkedGroup: DelegationGroup | null | undefined;
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
}

export const TaskChatCommentItem: React.FC<TaskChatCommentItemProps> = ({
  comment: c,
  currentUser,
  appUsers,
  subAppUsers,
  editingCommentId,
  editingText,
  setEditingText,
  setEditingCommentId,
  handleEditComment,
  handleDeleteComment,
  task,
  tasks,
  currentProject,
  linkedGroup,
  delegationGroups
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const author = appUsers?.find(u => 
    u.id === c.userId || 
    (u.username && String(u.username).toLowerCase() === String(c.userId).toLowerCase()) ||
    (u.email && String(u.email).toLowerCase() === String(c.userId).toLowerCase())
  ) || subAppUsers?.find((u: any) => 
    u.id === c.userId || 
    (u.username && String(u.username).toLowerCase() === String(c.userId).toLowerCase()) ||
    (u.email && String(u.email).toLowerCase() === String(c.userId).toLowerCase())
  );

  const authorDisplayName = c.userName 
    || author?.username 
    || (currentUser && (
        c.userId === currentUser.id ||
        (currentUser.username && String(c.userId).toLowerCase() === currentUser.username.toLowerCase())
       ) ? currentUser.username : null)
    || (c.userId && c.userId !== 'Unknown' && c.userId !== 'null' && c.userId !== 'undefined' ? c.userId : null)
    || 'System';

  const isMe = Boolean(
    c.userId === currentUser.id ||
    (currentUser.username && String(c.userId).toLowerCase() === currentUser.username.toLowerCase()) ||
    (currentUser.email && String(c.userId).toLowerCase() === currentUser.email.toLowerCase()) ||
    currentUser.role === 'admin'
  );
  const isEditing = editingCommentId === c.id;

  return (
    <div
      id={`comment-${c.id}`}
      key={c.id}
      className={cn("flex flex-col group transition-shadow duration-1000 rounded-xl", isMe ? "items-end" : "items-start")}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">{authorDisplayName}</span>
        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{new Date(c.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
        {isMe && !isEditing && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setEditingCommentId(c.id);
                setEditingText(c.text);
              }}
              className="p-2 lg:p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-500 dark:text-[#838383] dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8] transition-colors"
            >
              <Edit2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                handleDeleteComment(c.id);
              }}
              className="p-2 lg:p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 dark:text-[#838383] dark:hover:text-[#f28b82] transition-colors"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div
        className={cn(
          "p-3 rounded-xl max-w-[85%] text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap",
          isMe
            ? "bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-tr-none"
            : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] rounded-tl-none"
        )}
      >
        {isEditing ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <textarea
              autoFocus
              value={editingText}
              onChange={(e) => setEditingText(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full min-w-[200px] p-2 bg-white/20 text-white placeholder-white/60 border border-white/30 rounded outline-none text-sm resize-none"
            />
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setEditingCommentId(null);
                  setEditingText('');
                }}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-white/80 hover:text-white px-2 py-1"
              >
                {t("Cancel")}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleEditComment(c.id)}
                className="text-xs font-bold bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] px-3 py-1 rounded shadow-sm hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-[#28282a]"
              >
                {t("Save")}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <ChatHighlightedText text={c.text} isMe={isMe} taskName={task.name} linkedGroup={linkedGroup} />
            <TaskChatApprovalBoard
              text={c.text}
              isMe={isMe}
              task={task}
              tasks={tasks}
              currentProject={currentProject}
              delegationGroups={delegationGroups}
              currentUser={currentUser}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

interface TaskChatDelegationSectionProps {

export const TaskChatDelegationSection: React.FC<TaskChatDelegationSectionProps> = ({

  appUsers,
  picOptions,
  chatInputRef,
  tasks,
  projects
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const firstSt = linkedGroup.subTasks[0];
  const flowTxtGroup = firstSt ? (firstSt.delegationStatus || firstSt.status || 'Assigned') : 'Assigned';

  const planStatus = getTaskStatus(task.start, task.finish);
  const isRunning = planStatus === 'On process';

  let groupBgColor = 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/10 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/50';

  let groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200';

  if (flowTxtGroup === 'Completed') {
    groupBgColor = 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/10 border-green-200 dark:border-green-900/30';
    groupTitleColor = 'text-green-900 dark:text-green-100';
    groupIconColor = 'text-green-600 dark:text-green-400';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-800/50 hover:bg-green-200 dark:hover:bg-green-700 text-green-700 dark:text-green-200';
  } else if (flowTxtGroup === 'On process' || flowTxtGroup === 'Accepted') {
    groupBgColor = 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/10 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/30';
    groupTitleColor = 'text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100';
    groupIconColor = 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-800/50 hover:bg-blue-200 dark:hover:bg-blue-700 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-200';
  } else if (
    flowTxtGroup === 'Pending completed' ||
    flowTxtGroup === 'Pending Completed' ||
    flowTxtGroup === 'Delayed' ||
    ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(flowTxtGroup.toLowerCase())
  ) {
    groupBgColor = 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-900/10 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/30';
    groupTitleColor = 'text-orange-900 dark:text-orange-100';
    groupIconColor = 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-800/50 hover:bg-orange-200 dark:hover:bg-orange-700 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-200';
  } else if (flowTxtGroup === 'Approved' || flowTxtGroup === 'Rejected' || flowTxtGroup === 'Request Delay' || flowTxtGroup === 'Needs Rework') {
    groupBgColor = 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-900/10 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/30';
    groupTitleColor = 'text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-100';
    groupIconColor = 'text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-800/50 hover:bg-purple-200 dark:hover:bg-purple-700 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-200';
  } else if (flowTxtGroup === 'Assigned') {
    groupBgColor = 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-900/10 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/30';
    groupTitleColor = 'text-orange-900 dark:text-orange-100';
    groupIconColor = 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400';
    groupTrackerBtn = 'bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-800/50 hover:bg-orange-200 dark:hover:bg-orange-700 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-200';
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn("mb-6 p-4 border rounded-xl shadow-sm transition-all duration-500", groupBgColor, isRunning ? "ring-2 ring-blue-500 dark:ring-blue-400 shadow-md" : "")}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <h4 className={cn("text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2", groupTitleColor)}>
          <FileText className={cn("w-4 h-4", groupIconColor)} />
          {task.name || 'Delegated Sub-tasks'}
        </h4>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {(() => {
            const actualStatus = resolveActualStatus(planStatus, linkedGroup.subTasks);
            return (
              <span className={`text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded-full font-bold border whitespace-nowrap ${actualStatus.color}`}>
                Act: {actualStatus.label} ({computeDelegationGroupProgressPercent(linkedGroup)}%)
              </span>
            );
          })()}
          <a
            href={`https://tracker.taka-pm.org/?search=${encodeURIComponent((linkedGroup.projectCode ? linkedGroup.projectCode + ' ' : '') + linkedGroup.name)}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            className={cn("flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full font-bold transition-colors", groupTrackerBtn)}
            title="Open Tracker & Search"
          >
            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Tracker
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <datalist id="pic-list-modal">
          {picOptions.map((u, i) => (
            <option key={i} value={u} />
          ))}
        </datalist>
        {linkedGroup.subTasks.map(st => {
          const isCreator = (linkedGroup.createdBy === currentUser.id) || (currentUser.role === 'admin');
          const pPartyList = String(st.party || '').toLowerCase().split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
          const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
            ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
                .filter(k => currentUser.partyPermissions![k])
                .map(k => k.toLowerCase().trim())
            : [];
          const isPIC =
            userParties.includes('all') ||
            pPartyList.some(p => userParties.includes(p)) ||
            pPartyList.includes(String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim()) ||
            (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id));

          let selectValue = 'None';
          const stStatus = String(st.delegationStatus || st.status || '').toLowerCase();
          const stApproval = String(st.approvalStatus || '').toLowerCase();
          if (stStatus === 'completed') selectValue = 'Approved';
          else if (stStatus === 'rejected') selectValue = 'Rejected';
          else if (stStatus === 'pending completed') selectValue = 'ReqApproval';
          else if (stStatus === 'needs rework') selectValue = 'ReqReview';
          else if (stStatus === 'on process' || stStatus === 'accepted') selectValue = 'AcceptTask';
          else if (
            ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stStatus) ||
            ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval'].includes(stApproval)
          ) {
            selectValue = 'Hold';
          }

          const flowTxt = st.delegationStatus || st.status || 'Assigned';
          let flowColor = 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]';
          let cardBgColor = 'bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]';

          if (flowTxt === 'Completed') {
            flowColor = 'bg-green-50 text-green-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-green-200';
            cardBgColor = 'bg-green-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-900/10 border-green-200 dark:border-emerald-900/30';
          } else if (flowTxt === 'On process' || flowTxt === 'Accepted') {
            flowColor = 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-blue-200';
            cardBgColor = 'bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-blue-900/10 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/30';
          } else if (flowTxt === 'Delayed' || ['requested', 'hold', 'waiting for approval', 'pending completed'].includes(flowTxt.toLowerCase())) {
            flowColor = 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-200';
            cardBgColor = 'bg-orange-50/50 dark:bg-orange-900/10 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/30';
          } else if (flowTxt === 'Approved' || flowTxt === 'Rejected' || flowTxt === 'Request Delay' || flowTxt === 'Needs Rework') {
            flowColor = 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200';
            cardBgColor = 'bg-purple-50/50 dark:bg-purple-900/10 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/30';
          } else if (flowTxt === 'Assigned') {
            flowColor = 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-200';
            cardBgColor = 'bg-orange-50/50 dark:bg-orange-900/10 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/30';
          }

          return (
            <div key={st.id} className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-2.5 rounded-lg border text-xs shadow-sm cursor-default", cardBgColor)}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">To:</span>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    list="pic-list-modal"
                    defaultValue={st.party || ''}
                    disabled={!(isCreator || currentUser.role === 'admin')}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const val = e.currentTarget.value.trim();
                        if (val) {
                          const match = picOptions.find(opt => opt.toLowerCase().startsWith(val.toLowerCase()) || opt.toLowerCase().includes(val.toLowerCase()));
                          if (match) {
                            e.currentTarget.value = match;
                          }
                        }
                        e.currentTarget.blur();
                      }
                    }}
                    onBlur={async (e) => {
                      const val = e.target.value.trim();
                      const allowed = new Set([...picOptions, ""]);
                      if (val !== "" && !allowed.has(val)) {
                        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Invalid PIC. Please select from the dropdown options." });
                        e.target.value = st.party || "";
                        return;
                      }
                      const updatedSubTasks = linkedGroup.subTasks.map(sub => sub.id === st.id ? { ...sub, party: val } : sub);
                      const fallbackGrpYear =
                        linkedGroup.projectYear !== undefined && linkedGroup.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(linkedGroup.projectYear))
                          ? Number(linkedGroup.projectYear)
                          : Number(currentProject?.year) || new Date().getFullYear();
                      try {
                        await setDoc(
                          doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', linkedGroup.id),
                          {
                            ...linkedGroup,
                            projectYear: fallbackGrpYear,
                            subTasks: updatedSubTasks,
                          },
                          { merge: true }
                        );
                      } catch (err) {
                        console.error('Error saving PIC:', err);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="bg-transparent border-b border-transparent hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-[#444446] focus:border-blue-500 outline-none w-[120px] leading-tight truncate px-0 font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] disabled:text-slate-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                    placeholder="Assign CP..."
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      const tagName = task.name;
                      if (tagName && chatInputRef.current) {
                        chatInputRef.current.insertTaskTag(tagName);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/30 p-1 rounded transition-colors shrink-0"
                    title="Pin this sub-task to comment box"
                  >
                    <Pin className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                  {linkedGroup.createdBy && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                      from {appUsers.find(u => u.id === linkedGroup.createdBy || (u.username && u.username.toLowerCase() === String(linkedGroup.createdBy).toLowerCase()))?.username || linkedGroup.createdBy || 'Unknown'}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 mt-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className={cn("px-1.5 py-0 rounded text-[10px] leading-none h-5 flex items-center font-bold border shrink-0", flowColor)}>
                    {flowTxt}
                  </span>
                  <select
                    value={selectValue === 'None' ? 'None' : selectValue}
                    onChange={async (e) => {
                      const val = e.target.value;
                      const payload: any = { approvalStatus: val };
                      if (val === 'Approved') {
                        payload.status = 'Approved';
                        payload.delegationStatus = 'Completed';
                        payload.finishAct = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
                        payload.approvedAt = new Date().toISOString();
                      } else if (val === 'Rejected') {
                        payload.status = 'Rejected';
                        payload.delegationStatus = 'Rejected';
                        payload.approvedAt = null;
                      } else if (val === 'Hold') {
                        payload.approvalStatus = 'Requested';
                        payload.approvedAt = null;
                      } else if (val === 'AcceptTask') {
                        payload.status = 'On process';
                        payload.delegationStatus = 'On process';
                        payload.approvedAt = null;
                      } else if (val === 'ReqApproval') {
                        payload.status = 'Pending completed';
                        payload.delegationStatus = 'Pending completed';
                        payload.approvalStatus = 'Requested';
                        payload.approvedAt = null;
                      } else if (val === 'ReqReview') {
                        payload.status = 'Needs Rework';
                        payload.delegationStatus = 'Needs Rework';
                        payload.approvedAt = null;
                      } else {
                        payload.approvedAt = null;
                      }

                      const updatedSubTasks = linkedGroup.subTasks.map(sub => sub.id === st.id ? { ...sub, ...payload } : sub);

                      const parentTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === linkedGroup.parentTaskId);
                      const parentProject = projects.find(p => String(p.no) === parentTask?.projectCode || p.id === parentTask?.projectCode);
                      const isRealtime = parentTask?.realtimeUpdate || parentProject?.realtimeUpdate;

                      let newT: Task | null = null;
                      let cascadeUpdates: Task[] = [];

                      if (parentTask && isRealtime) {
                        const computedPlStatus = getTaskStatus(parentTask.start, parentTask.finish);
                        const oldActStatusLabel = resolveActualStatus(computedPlStatus, linkedGroup.subTasks).label;
                        const newActStatusLabel = resolveActualStatus(computedPlStatus, updatedSubTasks).label;

                        if (newActStatusLabel === 'Completed' && oldActStatusLabel !== 'Completed') {
                          const nowStr = parentTask.approval === 'Approved' && parentTask.approvedAt ? getSuggestedCompletionTime(parentTask.approvedAt) : getSuggestedCompletionTime();
                          const taskUpdates: Partial<Task> = { finish: nowStr, durationManual: true };

                          if (parentTask.start) {
                            const finishDate = parseDateTime(nowStr);
                            const startDate = parseDateTime(parentTask.start);
                            if (finishDate && startDate) {
                              const diffTime = finishDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime();
                              const diffDays = diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
                              if (diffDays < 0) {
                                taskUpdates.duration = "0";
                                taskUpdates.finish = taskUpdates.start || parentTask.start;
                              } else {
                                taskUpdates.duration = String(parseFloat(diffDays.toFixed(1)));
                              }
                            }
                          }

                          newT = { ...parentTask, ...taskUpdates, _isAutoActualized: true, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } as any;
                          cascadeUpdates = scheduleDependentTasks(newT!, tasks, projects);
                          delete (newT as any)._isAutoActualized;
                        } else if (newActStatusLabel !== 'Completed' && oldActStatusLabel === 'Completed' && parentTask.baselineFinish) {
                          const taskUpdates: Partial<Task> = { finish: parentTask.baselineFinish };
                          const finalStart = parentTask.baselineStart || parentTask.start;
                          if (parentTask.baselineStart) {
                            taskUpdates.start = parentTask.baselineStart;
                          }
                          if (finalStart) {
                            const finishDate = parseDateTime(parentTask.baselineFinish);
                            const startDate = parseDateTime(finalStart);
                            if (finishDate && startDate) {
                              const diffTime = finishDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime();
                              const diffDays = diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
                              if (diffDays < 0) {
                                taskUpdates.duration = "0";
                                taskUpdates.finish = taskUpdates.start || parentTask.start;
                              } else {
                                taskUpdates.duration = String(parseFloat(diffDays.toFixed(1)));
                              }
                            }
                          }

                          newT = { ...parentTask, ...taskUpdates, _isAutoActualized: true, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } as any;
                          cascadeUpdates = scheduleDependentTasks(newT!, tasks, projects);
                          delete (newT as any)._isAutoActualized;
                        }
                      }

                      try {
                        const fallbackGrpYear =
                          linkedGroup.projectYear !== undefined && linkedGroup.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(linkedGroup.projectYear))
                            ? Number(linkedGroup.projectYear)
                            : Number(currentProject?.year) || new Date().getFullYear();
                        const batch = writeBatch(db);
                        batch.set(

                          {

                            projectYear: fallbackGrpYear,

                        }
                        for (const u of cascadeUpdates) {
                          batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', u.id), u);
                        }
                        await batch.commit();
                      } catch (err: any) {
                        console.error('Batch commit failed', err);
                        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });

                        ['requested', 'hold', 'pending completed', 'waiting for approval'].includes((st.approvalStatus || '').toLowerCase())) &&
                        st.delegationStatus !== 'Completed' &&

                        ? "bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200"

                      !isCreator && !isPIC && "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed"
                    )}
                    style={{
                      backgroundImage: "url('data:image/svg+xml;charset=US-ASCII,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2210%22%20height%3D%2210%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2024%2024%22%20fill%3D%22none%22%20stroke%3D%22%23334155%22%20stroke-width%3D%222%22%20stroke-linecap%3D%22round%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22round%22%3E%3Cpolyline%20points%3D%226%209%2012%2015%2018%209%22%3E%3C%2Fpolyline%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E')",
                      backgroundPosition: "calc(100% - 4px) center",

                    {isCreator && <option value="Rejected">{t("Rejected")}</option>}

                      const updatedSubTasks = linkedGroup.subTasks.map(sub => sub.id === st.id ? { ...sub, priority: val } : sub);

                        linkedGroup.projectYear !== undefined && linkedGroup.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(linkedGroup.projectYear))
                          ? Number(linkedGroup.projectYear)

                            subTasks: updatedSubTasks,

                          { merge: true }

                        console.error('Error saving priority:', err);
                      }

                    disabled={!isCreator && !isPIC}
                    className={cn(
                      "appearance-none text-[10px] sm:text-[9px] min-h-[22px] font-bold px-2 py-1 flex-1 min-w-[60px] max-w-[80px] rounded border outline-none cursor-pointer text-left shrink-0",
                      st.priority === 'High' ? 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200' :
                      st.priority === 'Mid-high' ? 'bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 border-yellow-200' :

import React, { forwardRef, lazy, memo, useImperativeHandle, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { AppUser, Task } from '../../../types';
import { APP_ID, storage, googleSignIn, getAccessToken } from '../../../lib/firebase';
import { ref as storageRef, uploadBytesResumable, getDownloadURL, deleteObject } from 'firebase/storage';
import { X, ImageIcon, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { recordMention, getMentionFrequencies } from './chatSharedUtils';

export interface TaskChatInputHandle {
  insertTaskTag: (tagName: string) => void;
}

interface TaskChatInputProps {
  onSend: (text: string, mentions: string[]) => void;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  projectTasks?: Task[];
  linkedGroup?: any;
}

export const TaskChatInput = React.memo(
  React.forwardRef<TaskChatInputHandle, TaskChatInputProps>(function TaskChatInput(
    { onSend, appUsers, projectTasks, linkedGroup },
    ref
  ) {
    const { t } = useLanguage();
    const [commentText, setCommentText] = useState('');
    const [mentions, setMentions] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [mentionQuery, setMentionQuery] = useState('');
    const [showMentionMenu, setShowMentionMenu] = useState(false);
    const [taskQuery, setTaskQuery] = useState('');
    const [showTaskMenu, setShowTaskMenu] = useState(false);
    const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
    const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const file = e.target.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;

      setIsUploading(true);
      try {
        let accessToken = await getAccessToken();

        const imageRef = storageRef(storage, `taka_attachments/${APP_ID}/${Date.now()}_${file.name}`);

        let downloadURL = '';
        try {
          const uploadTask = await uploadBytesResumable(imageRef, file);
          downloadURL = await getDownloadURL(uploadTask.ref);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Firebase Storage upload failed:", err);
        }

        let driveUrl = '';
        if (accessToken) {
          const res1 = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ name: file.name, mimeType: file.type })
          });
          const data1 = await res1.json();
          const fileId = data1.id;

          await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?uploadType=media`, {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers: {
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
              'Content-Type': file.type
            },
            body: file
          });

          await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}/permissions`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ role: 'reader', type: 'anyone' })
          });

          driveUrl = `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${fileId}/view`;
        }

        const finalUrl = [downloadURL, driveUrl].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
        if (!finalUrl) throw new Error("Both uploads failed");
        setCommentText(prev => prev ? `${prev} ${finalUrl} ` : `${finalUrl} `);
        if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Upload error", error);
      } finally {
        setIsUploading(false);
      }
    };

    React.useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
      insertTaskTag: (tagName: string) => {
        setCommentText(prev => `${prev} #${tagName} `);
        setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
      }
    }));

    const handleTextChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const text = e.target.value;
      setCommentText(text);

      const cursorPosition = e.target.selectionStart || 0;
      const textBeforeCursor = text.substring(0, cursorPosition);
      const mentionMatch = textBeforeCursor.match(/@(\S*)$/);
      const taskMatch = textBeforeCursor.match(/#([^#]*)$/);

      if (mentionMatch) {
        setMentionQuery(mentionMatch[1]);
        setShowMentionMenu(true);
        setShowTaskMenu(false);
      } else if (taskMatch) {
        setTaskQuery(taskMatch[1]);
        setShowTaskMenu(true);
        setShowMentionMenu(false);
      } else {
        setShowMentionMenu(false);
        setShowTaskMenu(false);
      }
    };

    const insertMention = (user: AppUser) => {
      recordMention(user.id);
      const cursorPosition = inputRef.current?.selectionStart || 0;
      const textBeforeMention = commentText.substring(0, cursorPosition).replace(/@\S*$/, '');
      const textAfterMention = commentText.substring(cursorPosition);

      setCommentText(`${textBeforeMention}@${user.username || 'user'} ${textAfterMention}`);
      if (!mentions.includes(user.id)) {
        setMentions([...mentions, user.id]);
      }
      setShowMentionMenu(false);
      inputRef.current?.focus();
    };

    const insertTask = (targetTask: Task, withApproval: boolean = false) => {
      const cursorPosition = inputRef.current?.selectionStart || 0;
      const textBeforeTask = commentText.substring(0, cursorPosition).replace(/#([^#]*)$/, '');
      const textAfterTask = commentText.substring(cursorPosition);

      setCommentText(`${textBeforeTask}#${targetTask.name || ''}${withApproval ? '-approval' : ''} ${textAfterTask}`);
      setShowTaskMenu(false);
      inputRef.current?.focus();
    };

    const handleSend = () => {
      if (!commentText.trim()) return;

      const lowerCommentText = commentText.toLowerCase();
      const activeMentions = Array.from(new Set([
        ...(mentions || []).filter(userId => {
          const user = (appUsers || []).find(u => u.id === userId);
          return user && lowerCommentText.includes(`@${user.username.toLowerCase()}`);
        }),
        ...(appUsers || []).filter(u => u.username && lowerCommentText.includes(`@${u.username.toLowerCase()}`)).map(u => u.id)
      ]));

      activeMentions.forEach(userId => recordMention(userId));

      onSend(commentText, activeMentions);
      setCommentText('');
      setMentions([]);
    };

    const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
      const freqs = getMentionFrequencies();

      const partyUsernames = (linkedGroup?.subTasks || [])
        .map((st: any) => st.party?.toLowerCase().trim())
        .filter(Boolean);

      return (appUsers || [])
        .filter(u => u.username && u.username.toLowerCase().includes(mentionQuery.toLowerCase()))
        .sort((a, b) => {
          const isPartyA = partyUsernames.includes(a.username.toLowerCase());
          const isPartyB = partyUsernames.includes(b.username.toLowerCase());

          if (isPartyA && !isPartyB) return -1;
          if (!isPartyA && isPartyB) return 1;

          const freqA = freqs[a.id] || 0;
          const freqB = freqs[b.id] || 0;
          if (freqA !== freqB) {
            return freqB - freqA;
          }
          return a.username.localeCompare(b.username);
        });
    }, [appUsers, mentionQuery, linkedGroup]);

    const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => {
      return (projectTasks || []).filter(t => t.name?.toLowerCase().includes(taskQuery.toLowerCase()));
    }, [projectTasks, taskQuery]);

    const previewUrls = useMemo(() => {
      return commentText.match(/(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)/g) || [];
    }, [commentText]);

    return (
      <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] relative shrink-0">
        {showMentionMenu && filteredUsers.length > 0 && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-full left-4 mb-2 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-xl w-64 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto z-10">
            {filteredUsers.map(u => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={u.id}
                onClick={() => insertMention(u)}
                className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] dark:text-[#e3e3e3] transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-[10px]">
                  {u.username.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                </div>
                {u.username}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        {showTaskMenu && filteredTasks.length > 0 && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-full left-4 mb-2 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-xl w-80 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto z-10">
            {filteredTasks.map(t => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={t.id}
                onClick={() => insertTask(t)}
                className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] dark:text-[#e3e3e3] transition-colors flex items-center justify-between"
              >
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 overflow-hidden">
                  <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] truncate">{t.name}</span>
                  {t.party && <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">{t.party}</span>}
                </div>
                {t.delegation && (
                  <div
                    className="relative inline-flex items-center h-4 rounded-full w-7 bg-orange-500 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                    title="Delegated Task - Include Approval Board"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      insertTask(t, true);
                    }}
                  >
                    <span className="translate-x-3.5 inline-block w-3 h-3 transform bg-white rounded-full transition-transform" />
                  </div>
                )}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleSend(); }} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {previewUrls.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 px-2">
              {previewUrls.map((url, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="relative group">
                  <img
                    src={url}
                    alt="preview"
                    loading="lazy"
                    decoding="async"
                    className="h-24 w-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] object-cover"
                    onError={(e) => { (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none'; }}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      setCommentText(prev => prev.replace(url, '').replace(/  +/g, ' ').trim());
                      if (url.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')) {
                        try {
                          const fileRef = storageRef(storage, url);
                          await deleteObject(fileRef);
                        } catch (e) { console.error("Error deleting", e); }
                      }
                      const driveMatch = url.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);
                      if (driveMatch) {
                        try {
                          let accessToken = await getAccessToken();
                          if (!accessToken) {
                            const result = await googleSignIn();
                            if (result) accessToken = result.accessToken;
                          }
                          if (accessToken) {
                            await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${driveMatch[1]}`, {
                              method: 'DELETE',
                              headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}` }
                            });
                          }
                        } catch (e) { console.error("Failed to delete from Drive:", e); }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full p-1 shadow-md opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                  >
                    <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="relative flex items-center">
            <input
              type="file"
              ref={fileInputRef}
              onChange={handleImageUpload}
              accept="image/*,.pdf,application/pdf"
              className="hidden"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isUploading}
              onClick={async () => {
                let accessToken = await getAccessToken();

                  try {

                    if (result) accessToken = result.accessToken;
                  } catch (e) {
                    console.error("Auth error", e);
                    return;
                  }
                }
                fileInputRef.current?.click();
              }}
              className="absolute left-3 p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] rounded-lg z-10"
              title="Upload Image/PDF"
            >
              {isUploading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
            <input
              ref={inputRef}

              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (showMentionMenu && filteredUsers.length > 0 && e.key === 'Enter') {

            >

import React, { FC } from 'react';
import { Paperclip, Maximize2, ExternalLink, FileText } from 'lucide-react';

interface TaskChatReportsListProps {
  linkedGroup: DelegationGroup | null | undefined;
}

export const TaskChatReportsList: React.FC<TaskChatReportsListProps> = ({ linkedGroup }) => {
  const setZoomableImageSrc = useAppStore((state) => state.setZoomableImageSrc);

  if (!linkedGroup) return null;

  return (
    <>
      {linkedGroup.subTasks.map(st => {
        const hasReport = !!st.report || !!st.childReport || (st.attachments && st.attachments.length > 0) || !!st.fileUrl || !!st.childFileUrl;
        if (!hasReport) return null;

        return (
          <div key={`report-${st.id}`} className="flex flex-col items-start mt-2">

              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">{st.party} (Report)</span>

              <div className="text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap">
                {st.report || st.childReport || <span className="italic text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] font-normal">No report yet</span>}
              </div>
              {st.attachments && st.attachments.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[10px]">
                  {st.attachments.map((att, iIdx) => {
                    if (!att.url) return null;
                    const isPdf = att.url.match(/\.pdf($|\?|#)/i) || att.type === 'application/pdf';
                    return (
                      <div key={iIdx} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            setZoomableImageSrc(att.url);
                          }}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] hover:text-blue-800 font-bold bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-200 shadow-sm rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 w-fit active:scale-95 transition"
                        >
                          {isPdf ? <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" /> : <Paperclip className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />}
                          <span className="truncate max-w-[150px]">{att.name || att.url || 'Attached File'}</span>
                          <Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 ml-1" />
                        </button>
                        <a
                          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                          href={ensureUrlProtocol(att.url)}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noreferrer"
                          title="Open Link"
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-500 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-200 rounded"
                        >
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ) : (st.fileUrl || st.childFileUrl) && (
                <div className="mt-2 text-[10px]">
                  {(() => {
                    const fUrl = st.fileUrl || st.childFileUrl;
                    if (!fUrl) return null;
                    const isPdf = fUrl.match(/\.pdf($|\?|#)/i);
                    return (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            setZoomableImageSrc(fUrl);
                          }}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] hover:text-blue-800 font-bold bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-200 shadow-sm rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 w-fit active:scale-95 transition"

                          <Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 ml-1" />

                        >
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })()}

              )}
            </div>
          </div>

    </>
