import React, { FC } from 'react';
import { safeGetItemLocal, safeSetItemLocal } from '../../../lib/storage';
import { LazyImage } from '../../LazyImage';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';
import { cn } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { DelegationGroup } from '../../../types';
import { FileText, Maximize2 } from 'lucide-react';

export const recordMention = (userId: string) => {
  try {
    const habitsStr = safeGetItemLocal('mentionHabits');
    const habits = habitsStr ? JSON.parse(habitsStr) : {};
    habits[userId] = (habits[userId] || 0) + 1;
    safeSetItemLocal('mentionHabits', JSON.stringify(habits));
  } catch (e) {}
};

export const getMentionFrequencies = (): Record<string, number> => {
  try {
    const habitsStr = safeGetItemLocal('mentionHabits');
    return habitsStr ? JSON.parse(habitsStr) : {};
  } catch (e) {
    return {};
  }
};

interface ChatHighlightedTextProps {
  text: string;
  isMe?: boolean;
  taskName?: string;
  linkedGroup?: DelegationGroup | null;
}

export const ChatHighlightedText: React.FC<ChatHighlightedTextProps> = ({
  text,
  isMe = false,
  taskName,
  linkedGroup
}) => {
  const setZoomableImageSrc = useAppStore(state => state.setZoomableImageSrc);

  const knownTags: string[] = [];
  if (taskName) {
    knownTags.push(`#${taskName.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}`);
  }
  if (linkedGroup) {
    linkedGroup.subTasks.forEach(st => {
      const pTag = st.party;
      if (pTag) {
        knownTags.push(`#${pTag.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}`);
      }
    });
  }

  const knownTagsPattern = knownTags.length > 0 ? `${knownTags.map(t => `${t}(?:-approval)?`).join('|')}|` : '';
  const urlPattern = `https?:\\/\\/[^\\s]+`;
  const regex = new RegExp(`(${urlPattern}|${knownTagsPattern}#[\\w\\-]+\\b|@[\\w\\-]+\\b)`, 'g');

  return (
    <>
      {text.split(regex).map((chunk, i) => {
        if (!chunk) return null;
        if (chunk.match(/^https?:\/\//)) {
          const isImage = chunk.match(/\.(jpeg|jpg|gif|png|webp|svg|bmp)(\?.*)?$/i) || chunk.match(/^https?:\/\/.*(images|img|photo|picture).*/i);
          const isPdf = chunk.match(/\.pdf($|\?|#)/i) || chunk.match(/drive\.google\.com\/.*(?:file|document|pdf)/i) || chunk.match(/docs\.google\.com/i);
          const googleDriveMatch = chunk.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);

          const link = (
            <a
              key={`link-${i}`}
              href={chunk}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className={cn("underline font-medium break-all", isMe ? "text-blue-200 hover:text-white" : "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-800")}
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
              {chunk}
            </a>
          );

          if (isImage || googleDriveMatch) {
            const imgSrc = googleDriveMatch ? `https://drive.google.com/thumbnail?id=${googleDriveMatch[1]}&sz=w800` : chunk;
            return (
              <span key={i} className="inline-flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-1 mb-1 w-full">
                {link}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setZoomableImageSrc(chunk);
                  }}
                  className="block max-w-[220px] text-left hover:opacity-90 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-sm"
                >
                  <LazyImage src={imgSrc} alt="Attachment" />
                </button>
              </span>
            );
          }

          if (isPdf) {
            return (
              <span key={i} className="inline-flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-1 mb-1 w-full">
                {link}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setZoomableImageSrc(chunk);
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 border border-red-500/20 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer w-fit"
                >
                  <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                  <span>View PDF (Full Display)</span>
                  <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1 opacity-70" />
                </button>
              </span>
            );
          }

          return link;
        }
        if (chunk.startsWith('@')) return <span key={i} className={cn("font-bold", isMe ? "text-blue-200" : "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400")}>{chunk}</span>;
        if (chunk.startsWith('#')) return <span key={i} className={cn("font-bold", isMe ? "text-emerald-200" : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400")}>{chunk.replace(/-approval$/, '')}</span>;
        return chunk;
      })}
    </>
  );
};


=== FILE: src/components/TaskModalParts/chat/useTaskChatActions.ts ===
import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useCallback } from 'react';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID, storage, googleSignIn, getAccessToken } from '../../../lib/firebase';
import { ref as storageRef, deleteObject } from 'firebase/storage';
import { generateId } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';
import { Task, AppUser, Project, DelegationGroup } from '../../../types';

interface UseTaskChatActionsParams {
  task: Task;
  comments: any[];
  setLocalComments: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<any[]>>;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  currentProject: Project | undefined;
  linkedGroup: DelegationGroup | undefined;
  projectTasks: Task[];
  setConfirmModal: any;
  editingText: string;
  setEditingText: (text: string) => void;
  setEditingCommentId: (id: string | null) => void;
}

export function useTaskChatActions({
  task,
  comments,
  setLocalComments,
  currentUser,
  appUsers,
  currentProject,
  linkedGroup,
  projectTasks,
  setConfirmModal,
  editingText,
  setEditingText,
  setEditingCommentId
}: UseTaskChatActionsParams) {

  const handleDeleteComment = async (commentId: string) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: 'Delete Comment',
      message: 'Are you sure you want to delete this comment?',
      onConfirm: async () => {
        const commentToDelete = comments.find((c: any) => c.id === commentId);
        if (commentToDelete) {
          const urls = commentToDelete.text.match(/(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)/g) || [];
          urls.forEach(async (url: string) => {
            if (url.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')) {
              try {
                const fileRef = storageRef(storage, url);
                await deleteObject(fileRef);
              } catch (e) {
                console.error("Failed to delete attached file from storage:", e);
              }
            }
            const driveMatch = url.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);
            if (driveMatch) {
              try {
                let accessToken = await getAccessToken();
                if (!accessToken) {
                  const result = await googleSignIn();
                  if (result) accessToken = result.accessToken;
                }
                if (accessToken) {
                  await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${driveMatch[1]}`, {
                    method: 'DELETE',
                    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}` }
                  });
                }
              } catch (e) {
                console.error("Failed to delete from Drive:", e);
              }
            }
          });
        }
        setLocalComments(prev => prev.filter((c: any) => c.id !== commentId));

        try {
          const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
          const batch = writeBatch(db);
          const updatedTask = {
            ...task,
            comments: comments.filter((c: any) => c.id !== commentId),
            updatedAt: nowIso
          };
          batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', task.id), {
            comments: updatedTask.comments,
            updatedAt: nowIso
          });

          if (commentToDelete && linkedGroup) {
            let groupUpdated = false;
            const textToMatch = commentToDelete.text.trim();
            const updatedSubTasks = linkedGroup.subTasks.map((st: any) => {
              let newComments = st.comments || '';
              let newReport = st.report || '';
              if (newComments.includes(textToMatch)) {
                newComments = newComments.split('\n').filter((line: string) => line.trim() !== textToMatch).join('\n');
                groupUpdated = true;
              }
              if (newReport.includes(textToMatch)) {
                newReport = newReport.split('\n').filter((line: string) => line.trim() !== textToMatch).join('\n');
                groupUpdated = true;
              }
              return { ...st, comments: newComments, report: newReport };
            });
            if (groupUpdated) {
              const fallbackGrpYear =
                linkedGroup.projectYear !== undefined && linkedGroup.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(linkedGroup.projectYear))
                  ? Number(linkedGroup.projectYear)
                  : (Number(currentProject?.year) || new Date().getFullYear());
              batch.set(
                doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', linkedGroup.id),
                { ...linkedGroup, projectYear: fallbackGrpYear, subTasks: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(updatedSubTasks)) },
                { merge: true }
              );
            }
          }
          await batch.commit();

          const allTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
          const updatedTasks = allTasks.map(t => t.id === task.id ? updatedTask : t);
          useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(err);
          setLocalComments(task?.comments || []);
        }
      }
    });
  };

  const handleEditComment = async (commentId: string) => {
    if (!editingText.trim()) return;

    const oldComment = comments.find((c: any) => c.id === commentId);
    setLocalComments(prev => prev.map((c: any) => c.id === commentId ? { ...c, text: editingText } : c));

    try {
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      const updatedTask = {
        ...task,
        comments: comments.map((c: any) => c.id === commentId ? { ...c, text: editingText } : c),
        updatedAt: nowIso
      };
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', task.id), {
        comments: updatedTask.comments,
        updatedAt: nowIso
      });

      if (oldComment && linkedGroup) {
        let groupUpdated = false;
        const oldText = oldComment.text.trim();
        const newText = editingText.trim();
        const updatedSubTasks = linkedGroup.subTasks.map((st: any) => {
          let newComments = st.comments || '';
          let newReport = st.report || '';
          if (newComments.includes(oldText)) {
            newComments = newComments.split('\n').map((line: string) => line.trim() === oldText ? newText : line).join('\n');
            groupUpdated = true;
          }
          if (newReport.includes(oldText)) {
            newReport = newReport.split('\n').map((line: string) => line.trim() === oldText ? newText : line).join('\n');
            groupUpdated = true;
          }
          return { ...st, comments: newComments, report: newReport };
        });
        if (groupUpdated) {
          const fallbackGrpYear =
            linkedGroup.projectYear !== undefined && linkedGroup.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(linkedGroup.projectYear))
              ? Number(linkedGroup.projectYear)
              : (Number(currentProject?.year) || new Date().getFullYear());
          batch.set(
            doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', linkedGroup.id),
            { ...linkedGroup, projectYear: fallbackGrpYear, subTasks: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(updatedSubTasks)) },
            { merge: true }
          );
        }
      }
      await batch.commit();

      const allTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
      const updatedTasks = allTasks.map(t => t.id === task.id ? updatedTask : t);
      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);

      setEditingCommentId(null);
      setEditingText('');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setLocalComments(task.comments || []);
    }
  };

  const handleSendFromInput = React.useCallback(async (text: string, activeMentions: string[]) => {
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const newComment = {
      id: `c_${Date.now()}_${generateId().substring(0, 4)}`,
      text: text,
      createdAt: nowIso,
      userId: currentUser.id,
      mentions: activeMentions
    };

    setLocalComments(prev => [...prev, newComment]);

    const updatedTask = {
      ...task,
      comments: [...comments, newComment],
      updatedAt: nowIso
    };

    // Optimistically update store
    const allTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
    const updatedTasks = allTasks.map(t => t.id === task.id ? updatedTask : t);
    useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);

    try {
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', task.id), {
        comments: updatedTask.comments,
        updatedAt: nowIso
      });

      const taggedTasks = projectTasks.filter(t => t.name && text.includes(`#${t.name}`) && t.id !== task.id);
      taggedTasks.forEach(t => {
        batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id), {
          comments: [...(t.comments || []), newComment],
          updatedAt: nowIso
        }, { merge: true });
      });

      if (linkedGroup) {
        const delegator = appUsers.find(u => u.id === linkedGroup.createdBy);
        const delegatorTag = delegator ? `@${delegator.username}` : null;
        const hasDelegatorTag = delegatorTag && text.includes(delegatorTag);

        let groupUpdated = false;
        const updatedSubTasks = linkedGroup.subTasks.map(st => {
          const taskTag = task.name ? `#${task.name}` : '#';
          const partyTag = st.party ? `#${st.party}` : '#';
          const partyMention = st.party ? `@${st.party}` : null;

          const hasTaskTag = taskTag !== '#' && text.includes(taskTag);
          const hasPartyTag = partyTag !== '#' && text.includes(partyTag);
          const hasMention = partyMention && text.includes(partyMention);
          const taskTagOld = task.name ? `#${task.name.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}` : '#';
          const hasTaskTagOld = taskTagOld !== '#' && text.includes(taskTagOld);

          const hasAnyTagAtAll = text.includes('#') || text.includes('@');

          if (hasTaskTag || hasTaskTagOld || hasPartyTag || hasMention || hasDelegatorTag || !hasAnyTagAtAll) {
            groupUpdated = true;
            return {
              ...st,
              comments: st.comments ? `${st.comments}\n${text}` : text,
              ...(hasDelegatorTag ? { report: st.report ? `${st.report}\n${text}` : text } : {})
            };
          }
          return st;
        });

        if (groupUpdated) {
          const fallbackGrpYear =
            linkedGroup.projectYear !== undefined && linkedGroup.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(linkedGroup.projectYear))
              ? Number(linkedGroup.projectYear)
              : (Number(currentProject?.year) || new Date().getFullYear());
          batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', linkedGroup.id), {
            ...linkedGroup,
            projectYear: fallbackGrpYear,
            subTasks: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(updatedSubTasks))
          }, { merge: true });
        }
      }

      await batch.commit();

      if (taggedTasks.length > 0) {
        const refreshedTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks.map(t => {
          if (taggedTasks.some(tt => tt.id === t.id)) {
            return { ...t, comments: [...(t.comments || []), newComment], updatedAt: nowIso };
          }
          return t;
        });
        useAppStore.getState().setTasks(refreshedTasks);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error("Failed to send comment", e);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
    }
  }, [task, comments, currentUser.id, linkedGroup, projectTasks, setLocalComments, appUsers, currentProject]);

  return {
    handleDeleteComment,
    handleEditComment,
    handleSendFromInput
  };
}


=== FILE: src/components/TaskModularModal.tsx ===
import React, { FC, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import Draggable from "react-draggable";
import {
  Layers,
  X,
  Search,
  Check,
  Unlink,
  AlertCircle,
  Calendar,
  Clock,
  Briefcase,
  Info,
  GripHorizontal,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Task, Project } from "../types";
import { cn, matchesAdvancedSearch } from "../lib/utils";
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from './DebouncedSearchInput';
import { getZIndexClass, useOverlayStack } from '../lib/zIndexManager';

interface TaskModularModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  selectedTaskIds: string[];
  tasks: Task[];
  projects?: Project[];
  onGroupTasks?: (parentTaskId: string, childTaskIds: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
  onUnlinkTasks?: (childTaskIds: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
  onGroup?: (parentTaskId: string, childTaskIds: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
  onUnlink?: (childTaskIds: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
}

export const TaskModularModal: React.FC<TaskModularModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  selectedTaskIds,
  tasks,
  projects = [],
  onGroupTasks,
  onUnlinkTasks,
  onGroup,
  onUnlink,
}) => {
  const [selectedParentTaskId, setSelectedParentTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [filterScope, setFilterScope] = useState<"same_project" | "all_projects">("same_project");
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Reset state when opened
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setSelectedParentTaskId(null);
      setSearchTerm("");
      setFilterScope("same_project");
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Handle Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && isOpen) {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  // Selected tasks (child candidates)
  const selectedTasks = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set(selectedTaskIds.map(String));
    return tasks.filter((t) => set.has(String(t.id)));
  }, [tasks, selectedTaskIds]);

  // Distinct project codes of selected tasks
  const selectedProjectCodes = useMemo(() => {
    return new Set(
      selectedTasks.map((t) => String(t.projectCode || "").trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)
    );
  }, [selectedTasks]);

  // Map of parentId -> count of existing children
  const childrenCountMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    tasks.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.parentTaskId) {
        const pKey = String(t.parentTaskId);
        map.set(pKey, (map.get(pKey) || 0) + 1);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [tasks]);

  // Check if any selected task already has a parent
  const hasAnyLinked = useMemo(() => {
    return selectedTasks.some((t) => !!t.parentTaskId);
  }, [selectedTasks]);

  // Selected parent tasks that currently have children
  const selectedParentsWithChildren = useMemo(() => {
    return selectedTasks.filter((t) => (childrenCountMap.get(String(t.id)) || 0) > 0);
  }, [selectedTasks, childrenCountMap]);

  // All task IDs that will be grouped into the chosen parent
  const allTargetTaskIds = useMemo(() => {
    const parentIdStr = selectedParentTaskId ? String(selectedParentTaskId) : null;
    const targetSet = new Set<string>();

    selectedTaskIds.forEach((id) => {
      const idStr = String(id);
      if (idStr !== parentIdStr) {
        targetSet.add(idStr);
      }
    });

    return Array.from(targetSet);
  }, [selectedTaskIds, selectedParentTaskId]);

  // Candidate parent tasks:
  // Must be a top-level task (no parentTaskId).
  // Can be one of the selected tasks if the user wants to pick a checked task as the parent!
  const candidateParentTasks = useMemo(() => {
    return tasks.filter((t) => {
      if (t.parentTaskId) return false;
      if (filterScope === "same_project" && selectedProjectCodes.size > 0) {
        const pCode = String(t.projectCode || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!selectedProjectCodes.has(pCode)) return false;
      }
      if (searchTerm.trim()) {
        const isMatch = matchesAdvancedSearch(searchTerm, [t.name, t.projectCode, t.party, t.taskCodePhu]);
        if (!isMatch) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [tasks, filterScope, selectedProjectCodes, searchTerm]);

  const zInfo = useOverlayStack({
    layer: 'MODAL_MODULAR',
    isOpen,
    onClose,
    closeOnTabChange: true
  });

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const chosenParentTask = selectedParentTaskId ? tasks.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(selectedParentTaskId)) : null;

  const handleConfirmGroup = () => {
    if (!selectedParentTaskId || allTargetTaskIds.length === 0) return;
    const groupFn = onGroupTasks || onGroup;
    if (typeof groupFn === 'function') groupFn(String(selectedParentTaskId), allTargetTaskIds);
  };

  const handleConfirmUnlink = () => {
    if (selectedTaskIds.length === 0) return;
    const unlinkFn = onUnlinkTasks || onUnlink;
    if (typeof unlinkFn === 'function') unlinkFn(selectedTaskIds);
  };

  return createPortal(
    <div 
      className={`fixed inset-0 ${zInfo.zClass} flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs p-2 sm:p-4 overflow-hidden pointer-events-auto animate-in fade-in duration-150`} 
      style={{ zIndex: zInfo.zValue || 185000 }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <Draggable disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} handle=".modal-handle" bounds="parent" nodeRef={nodeRef} cancel="button, input, select">
        <div 
          ref={nodeRef}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-[96vw] max-w-4xl max-h-[88vh] flex flex-col border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] overflow-hidden"
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing p-3.5 sm:p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-[#18181a] select-none shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
              <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300">
                <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base md:text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] flex items-center gap-2">
                  Task Modular
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/60 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800">
                    Gantt Only
                  </span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Group selected child tasks into a parent task (toggle collapse/expand on Gantt)
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}

=== FILE: src/components/TaskNoteModal.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { X, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Task, TaskNote } from '../types';
import { formatDisplayDateTime } from '../lib/utils';

interface TaskNoteModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  task: Task | null;
  onSave: (taskId: string, notes: TaskNote[]) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
}

export function TaskNoteModal({ isOpen, onClose, task, onSave, canWrite}: TaskNoteModalProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const nodeRef = React.useRef(null);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<TaskNote[]>([]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (task && isOpen) {
      setNotes(task.notes || []);
    }
  }, [task, isOpen]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen || !task) return null;

  const handleAddNote = () => {
    const newNote: TaskNote = {
      id: `note_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,
      content: '',
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    setNotes([...notes, newNote]);
  };

  const handleUpdateNote = (id: string, content: string) => {
    setNotes(notes.map(n => n.id === id ? { ...n, content, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : n));
  };

  const handleDeleteNote = (id: string) => {
    setNotes(notes.filter(n => n.id !== id));
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    onSave(task.id, notes);
    onClose();
  };

  const sortedNotes = [...notes].sort((a, b) => {
    const dateA = new Date(a.updatedAt || 0).getTime();
    const dateB = new Date(b.updatedAt || 0).getTime();
    return dateB - dateA;
  });

  return (
<Portal>
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm p-0 md:p-4 ">
      <Draggable disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} handle=".modal-handle" bounds="parent" nodeRef={nodeRef} cancel="button">
        <div ref={nodeRef} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] md:rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full h-full md:h-auto max-w-3xl flex flex-col max-h-screen md:max-h-[90vh] relative">
          <div className="modal-handle cursor-move flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 md:rounded-t-xl shrink-0 pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)] md:pt-4">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] truncate pr-4">Note-detail(update) - {task.name}</h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded-full transition-colors text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] shrink-0">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-4 flex-grow overflow-y-auto pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]">
          {canWrite && (
            <div className="mb-4 flex justify-end">
              <button title="Add Note" 
                onClick={handleAddNote}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 text-white text-sm font-medium rounded hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                Add Note
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
          
          <table className="w-full text-sm text-left text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-collapse">
            <thead className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] uppercase bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-bold w-2/3">Content</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-bold w-1/3">Update-date</th>
                {canWrite && <th className="px-4 py-3 font-bold w-12 text-center">{t("Action")}</th>}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {sortedNotes.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={canWrite ? 3 : 2} className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] italic">
                    No notes available.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                sortedNotes.map(note => (
                  <tr key={note.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a]/50">
                    <td className="px-4 py-2">
                      {canWrite ? (
                        <textarea
                          value={note.content}
                          onChange={(e) => handleUpdateNote(note.id, e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full min-h-[60px] p-2 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none resize-y"
                          placeholder="Enter note content..."
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{note.content}</div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
                      {formatDisplayDateTime(note.updatedAt)}
                    </td>
                    {canWrite && (
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-center">
                        <button onClick={() => handleDeleteNote(note.id)}
                          className="p-1.5 text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-50 rounded transition-colors"
                          title="Delete note"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    )}
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 md:rounded-b-xl flex justify-end gap-3 shrink-0 pb-[calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom)+1rem)] md:pb-4">
          <button onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors"
          >
            {canWrite ? 'Cancel' : 'Close'}
          </button>
          {canWrite && (
            <button title="Save Changes" 
              onClick={handleSave}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 dark:bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg font-medium hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
            >
              Save Changes
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div></Draggable>
        </div>
</Portal>
  );
}


=== FILE: src/components/Toast.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { X, Bell } from 'lucide-react';

interface ToastProps {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function Toast({ title, message, onClose}: ToastProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      onClose();
    }, 5000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [onClose]);

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-4 right-4 z-[200] max-w-sm w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] p-4 animate-in slide-in-from-top-5 fade-in duration-300">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
          <Bell className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex-grow min-w-0">
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] truncate">{title}</h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mt-1 line-clamp-2">{message}</p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={onClose} className="shrink-0 p-1 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-[#a3a3a3] rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-colors">
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { bumpConfigVersion } from "../lib/configCacheService";
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import { getZIndexClass } from '../lib/zIndexManager';

interface UserModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  user: AppUser | null;
}

export function UserModal({ isOpen, onClose, user}: UserModalProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  const nodeRef = React.useRef(null);
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const usernameRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  }, [user, isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const isAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const disableUsername = user && !isAdmin;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isAdmin && !user) return; // Non-admins can't add new users
    const id = user ? user.id : generateId();
    
    let finalPassword = user ? (user.password || '') : '';
    // Hash password if it's new or changed
    if (password && (!user || password !== user.password)) {
      const hashArray = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(password));
      finalPassword = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashArray)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    }

    try {
      const newUserObj: AppUser = {
        id,
        username,
        password: finalPassword,
        role: user ? user.role : 'Staff',
        canSee: user ? user.canSee : true,
        canWrite: user ? user.canWrite : true,
        ...(user || {})
      };
      const currentUsers = useAppStore.getState().appUsers;
      const exists = currentUsers.some(u => u.id === id);
      const updatedUsers = exists
        ? currentUsers.map(u => u.id === id ? { ...u, ...newUserObj } : u)
        : [...currentUsers, newUserObj];
      useAppStore.getState().setAppUsers(updatedUsers);

      await setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', id), {
        id,
        username,
        password: finalPassword,
        role: user ? user.role : 'Staff',
        canSee: user ? user.canSee : true,
        canWrite: user ? user.canWrite : true
      }, { merge: true });
      await bumpConfigVersion("app_users");
      onClose();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  return (
    <Portal>
      <div className={`fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 ${getZIndexClass('MODAL_BASE')} flex items-center justify-center p-0 md:p-4`}>
        <Draggable disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} handle=".modal-handle" bounds="parent" nodeRef={nodeRef} cancel="button">
          <div ref={nodeRef} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] md:rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full h-full md:h-auto max-w-sm relative flex flex-col pointer-events-auto">
            <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing px-4 md:px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 shrink-0 pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)] md:pt-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">{user ? 'Edit Account' : 'Add New Account'}</h3>
              </div>
              <button onClick={onClose} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-[#a3a3a3] p-2 -mr-2">
                <X className="w-6 h-6" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-4 md:p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto flex-grow pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase mb-1">Username</label>
                <input 
                  ref={usernameRef}
                  type="text" 
                  inputMode="text"
                  value={username}
                  onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                  required 
                  disabled={!!disableUsername}
                  className={`w-full p-3 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none text-sm bg-transparent dark:text-[#e3e3e3] ${disableUsername ? 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] cursor-not-allowed' : ''}`}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase mb-1">Password</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  inputMode="text"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  required={!user}
                  placeholder={user && user.password?.length === 64 ? '•••••••• (Leave blank to keep unchanged)' : ''}
                  className="w-full p-3 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none text-sm bg-transparent dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="pt-2">
                <button title="Save changes" type="submit" className="w-full bg-slate-900 dark:bg-blue-600 text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm shadow-lg transition-all active:scale-95">
                  Save changes
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </Draggable>
      </div>
    </Portal>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

export interface ZoomableImageViewerProps {
  isOpen?: boolean;
  onClose?: () => void;
  imageUrl?: string;
  url?: string;
  src?: string;
  title?: string;
  alt?: string;
  image?: { url: string; title?: string; initialScale?: number } | null;
  initialScale?: number;
}

export function isPdfUrl(url?: string): boolean {
  if (!url) return false;
  const lower = url.toLowerCase();
  if (/\.pdf($|\?|#)/i.test(lower)) return true;
  if (lower.includes('type=pdf') || lower.includes('format=pdf') || lower.includes('application/pdf')) return true;
  if (lower.includes('drive.google.com') && !lower.includes('thumbnail')) return true;
  if (lower.includes('docs.google.com')) return true;
  return false;
}

function getPdfIframeUrl(url: string, useGdocsViewer: boolean): string {
  if (!url) return '';
  const driveMatch = url.match(/drive\.google\.com\/(?:file\/d\/|open\?id=|uc\?id=)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i) ||
                     url.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);
  if (driveMatch && driveMatch[1]) {
    return `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${driveMatch[1]}/preview`;
  }
  if (url.includes('docs.google.com')) {
    return url;
  }
  if (useGdocsViewer) {
    return `https://docs.google.com/viewer?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}&embedded=true`;
  }
  return url;
}

export const ZoomableImageViewer: React.FC<ZoomableImageViewerProps> = ({
  isOpen: propIsOpen,
  onClose: propOnClose,
  imageUrl: propImageUrl,
  url: propUrl,
  src: propSrc,
  title: propTitle,
  alt: propAlt,
  image: propImage,
  initialScale: propInitialScale,
}) => {
  const storeZoomableImageSrc = useAppStore((state) => state.zoomableImageSrc);
  const setStoreZoomableImageSrc = useAppStore((state) => state.setZoomableImageSrc);

  // Global event listener state for uncontrolled / window-event usage
  const [eventState, setEventState] = useState<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    url: string;
    title?: string;
    initialScale?: number;
  }>({
    isOpen: false,
    url: '',
    title: '',
  });

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [useGdocsFallback, setUseGdocsFallback] = useState(false);
  const transformRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null);

  // Listen to window-level custom events: 'taka_open_image_viewer'
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOpenEvent = (e: Event) => {
      const customEvent = e as CustomEvent<{ url?: string; imageUrl?: string; src?: string; title?: string; initialScale?: number }>;
      const detail = customEvent.detail;
      if (detail) {
        const rawUrl = detail.url || detail.imageUrl || detail.src || '';
        if (rawUrl) {
          setEventState({
            isOpen: true,
            url: rawUrl,
            title: detail.title || '',
            initialScale: detail.initialScale,
          });
        }
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('taka_open_image_viewer', handleOpenEvent);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('taka_open_image_viewer', handleOpenEvent);
    };
  }, []);

  const isControlled = propIsOpen !== undefined;
  const isVisible = isControlled
    ? propIsOpen
    : (eventState.isOpen || Boolean(storeZoomableImageSrc));

  const rawTargetUrl = isControlled
    ? (propImageUrl || propUrl || propSrc || propImage?.url || '')
    : (storeZoomableImageSrc || eventState.url);

  const activeTitle = (isControlled ? (propTitle || propAlt || propImage?.title) : eventState.title) || 
    (isPdfUrl(rawTargetUrl) ? 'PDF Document Viewer' : 'Image Viewer');

  const effectiveInitialScale = (isControlled ? (propInitialScale || propImage?.initialScale) : eventState.initialScale) || 1;

  const isPdf = isPdfUrl(rawTargetUrl);
  const resolvedUrl = normalizeImageUrl(rawTargetUrl);
  const [currentSrc, setCurrentSrc] = useState(resolvedUrl);
  const [hasTriedCdnFallback, setHasTriedCdnFallback] = useState(false);

  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    if (isControlled) {
      propOnClose?.();
    } else {
      setEventState(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
      setStoreZoomableImageSrc(null);
    }
  }, [isControlled, propOnClose, setStoreZoomableImageSrc]);

  const handleImageError = useCallback(() => {
    const driveMatch = rawTargetUrl.match(/drive\.google\.com\/(?:file\/d\/|open\?id=|uc\?id=)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/) ||
                       rawTargetUrl.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
    if (driveMatch && driveMatch[1] && !hasTriedCdnFallback) {
      setHasTriedCdnFallback(true);
      setCurrentSrc(`https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/${driveMatch[1]}`);
      return;
    }
    setIsLoading(false);
    setHasError(true);
  }, [rawTargetUrl, hasTriedCdnFallback]);

  const handleImageLoad = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLoading(false);
    setHasError(false);
    if (effectiveInitialScale > 1) {
      try {
        transformRef.current?.centerView(effectiveInitialScale);
      } catch {}
    }
  }, [effectiveInitialScale]);

  // Reset loading and error states when URL changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentSrc(resolvedUrl);
    setHasTriedCdnFallback(false);
    setHasError(false);
    setUseGdocsFallback(false);

    if (!resolvedUrl) {
      setIsLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (isPdf) {
      setIsLoading(true);
      return;
    }

    const testImg = new Image();
    testImg.src = resolvedUrl;
    if (testImg.complete && testImg.naturalWidth > 0) {
      setIsLoading(false);
    } else {
      setIsLoading(true);
      testImg.onload = () => setIsLoading(false);
      testImg.onerror = () => handleImageError();
    }
  }, [resolvedUrl, isPdf, handleImageError]);

  // Handle ESC key to close
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isVisible) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isVisible, handleClose]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (!rawTargetUrl) return;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(rawTargetUrl);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  if (!isVisible || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[999999] flex flex-col bg-slate-950/95 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200 select-none"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
          handleClose();
        }
      }}
    >
      {/* Top Floating Header & Controls */}
      <div 
        className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-slate-900/95 border-b border-slate-800 text-white z-20 shrink-0"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 max-w-[45%] min-w-0">
          {isPdf ? (
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold truncate text-slate-100" title={activeTitle}>
            {activeTitle}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Toolbar Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
          {!isPdf && (
            <>
              {/* Zoom In */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => transformRef.current?.zoomIn()}
                title="Zoom In (+)"
                className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 hover:text-white transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              >
                <ZoomIn className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              {/* Zoom Out */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => transformRef.current?.zoomOut()}
                title="Zoom Out (-)"
                className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 hover:text-white transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              >
                <ZoomOut className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              {/* Reset Zoom */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => transformRef.current?.resetTransform()}
                title="Reset Zoom (1:1)"
                className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 hover:text-white transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </>
          )}

          {isPdf && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setUseGdocsFallback(prev => !prev)}
              title={useGdocsFallback ? "Switch to Direct Embed" : "Switch to Google Docs Viewer"}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-medium text-slate-200 hover:text-white transition-colors active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">{useGdocsFallback ? "Direct Embed" : "Google Docs Viewer"}</span>

          {rawTargetUrl && (

              type="button"
              onClick={handleCopy}

              {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}

          )}

          {/* Open In New Tab */}
          {rawTargetUrl && (

              href={rawTargetUrl}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"

            onClick={handleClose}
            title="Close (Esc)"
            className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-lg bg-rose-600/80 hover:bg-rose-600 text-white transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm"

              <TransformWrapper

        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}

import { doc, deleteField } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID, writeBatch } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { addPendingUpdate } from '../../lib/syncQueue';

  splitPredecessors
} from '../../lib/ganttUtils';

import { generateId, getDefaultDatetimeLocal, formatToDatetimeLocal, parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';

import { Project, Task, AppUser } from '../../types';

import { recordBatchDeltas } from '../../lib/deltaSyncService';
import { createPatchDeltaItem } from '../../lib/deltaPatchService';

export interface TaskSaveParams {
  formData: Partial<Task>;
  task: Task | null;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  cloudStatus: string;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  t: (key: string) => string;
  setToast: (toast: any) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  setIsSubmitting: (submitting: boolean) => void;
}

export async function executeTaskSave({
  formData,
  task,
  projects,
  tasks,
  cloudStatus,
  currentUser,
  setToast,
  onClose,
  setIsSubmitting
}: TaskSaveParams): Promise<boolean> {
  const currentProject = projects.find(p => 
    p.code === formData.projectCode &&
    (String(p.year || '') === String(formData.projectYear || '') || (!p.year && !formData.projectYear)) &&
    (String(p.store || '') === String(formData.projectStore || '') || (!p.store && !formData.projectStore))
  );

  if (!currentProject) {
    useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Please select a valid project." });
    setIsSubmitting(false);
    return false;
  }

  const currentYear = (!isNaN(Number(currentProject?.year)) && currentProject?.year !== null && currentProject?.year !== '') 
    ? Number(currentProject.year) 
    : (formData.projectYear && !isNaN(Number(formData.projectYear)) ? Number(formData.projectYear) : new Date().getFullYear());

  const targetPrjKey = buildCanonicalProjectKey(
    currentProject.code || formData.projectCode,
    currentProject.year || formData.projectYear,
    currentProject.store || formData.projectStore,
    projects
  );

  // Check for duplicate task name or code in the same project
  const normFormName = normalizeTaskNameForComparison(formData.name, formData.projectCode || currentProject?.code);
  const formTaskCode = formData.taskCodePhu ? String(formData.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

  const isDuplicate = tasks.some(t => {
    if (t.id === task?.id || t.isDeleted) return false;
    
    const tPrjKey = buildCanonicalProjectKey(t.projectCode, t.projectYear, t.projectStore, projects);
    const sameProject = (tPrjKey === targetPrjKey);
    if (!sameProject) return false;

    // Check exact name
    if (t.name && String(t.name).trim().toLowerCase() === String(formData.name || '').trim().toLowerCase()) {
      return true;
    }
    // Check normalized name
    const tNorm = normalizeTaskNameForComparison(t.name, t.projectCode);
    if (normFormName && tNorm && normFormName === tNorm) {
      return true;
    }
    // Check taskCodePhu
    if (formTaskCode && t.taskCodePhu && String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() === formTaskCode) {
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  });

  if (isDuplicate) {
    setToast({ title: "Duplicate Task", message: `Task "${formData.name}" already exists in this project. Duplicate sub-tasks are not allowed.` });
    setIsSubmitting(false);
    return false;
  }

  let id = task ? task.id : `t_${Date.now()}_${generateId().substring(0, 8)}`;
  if (id && id.startsWith('ts_')) {
    let realTask = tasks.find(t => 
      !t.id.startsWith('ts_') &&
      t.projectCode === currentProject.code &&
      (String(t.projectStore || '') === String(currentProject.store || '')) &&
      (String(t.projectYear || '') === String(currentProject.year || '')) &&
      ((task?.taskCodePhu && t.taskCodePhu === task.taskCodePhu) ||
       (task?.name && t.name && t.name.trim().toLowerCase() === task.name.trim().toLowerCase()))
    );
    if (!realTask && currentProject?.code) {
      try {
        const { collection, query, where, getDocs } = await import('firebase/firestore');
        const q = query(
          collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks'),
          where('projectCode', '==', currentProject.code)
        );
        const snap = await getDocs(q);
        const loaded: Task[] = [];
        snap.forEach(d => {
          const dt = { id: d.id, ...d.data() } as Task;
          if (!dt.isDeleted) loaded.push(dt);
        });
        if (loaded.length > 0) {
          const latestTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || tasks;
          useAppStore.getState().setTasks([...latestTasks.filter(tsk => !tsk.id.startsWith('ts_')), ...loaded]);
          realTask = loaded.find(t =>
            (task?.taskCodePhu && t.taskCodePhu === task.taskCodePhu) ||
            (task?.name && t.name && t.name.trim().toLowerCase() === task.name.trim().toLowerCase())
          );
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Failed to find real task for ts_ in Firestore:", err);
      }
    }
    if (realTask) {
      id = realTask.id;
    } else {
      id = `t_${Date.now()}_${generateId().substring(0, 8)}`;
    }
  }
  let newOrderIndex = task?.orderIndex;
  
  if (!task) {
    const existingProjectTasks = tasks.filter(t => 
      t.projectCode === currentProject.code && 
      (String(t.projectYear || '') === String(currentProject.year || '') || (!t.projectYear && !currentProject.year)) &&
      (String(t.projectStore || '') === String(currentProject.store || '') || (!t.projectStore && !currentProject.store))
    );
    let maxOrder = 0;
    existingProjectTasks.forEach(t => {
      const order = t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex : 0;
      if (order > maxOrder) maxOrder = order;
    });
    newOrderIndex = maxOrder + 1;
  }

  if (formData.predecessor !== undefined && (!task || formData.predecessor !== task.predecessor)) {
    if (formData.predecessor) {
      const predContext: PredecessorContext = {
        projectId: formData.projectId || task?.projectId || currentProject?.id,
        projectCode: formData.projectCode || task?.projectCode || currentProject?.code,
        projectYear: formData.projectYear || task?.projectYear || currentProject?.year,
        projectStore: formData.projectStore || task?.projectStore || currentProject?.store,
        projectLocation: formData.location || task?.location || currentProject?.location
      };
      formData.predecessor = resolvePredecessorString(formData.predecessor, tasks, projects, formData.projectCode, predContext, formData.predecessorTaskIds);
      const taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
      let parts = splitPredecessors(formData.predecessor, taskNoMap);
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        if (!/FF|SF/i.test(parts[1])) {
          if (!/SS|FS/i.test(parts[1])) parts[1] += "FF";
          else parts[1] = parts[1].replace(/SS|FS/ig, "FF");
        }
        formData.predecessor = parts.join(", ");
      }
    }
    const taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
    const dummyTask: any = {
      projectId: formData.projectId || task?.projectId || currentProject?.id,
      projectCode: formData.projectCode || task?.projectCode || currentProject?.code,
      projectYear: formData.projectYear || task?.projectYear || currentProject?.year,
      projectStore: formData.projectStore || task?.projectStore || currentProject?.store,
      location: formData.location || task?.location || currentProject?.location
    };
    parsePredecessors(formData.predecessor, taskNoMap, dummyTask);
  }

  try {
    const todayDate = getDefaultDatetimeLocal();
    let finalFormData = { ...formData };
    if (!finalFormData.start) finalFormData.start = todayDate;
    if (!finalFormData.finish) finalFormData.finish = finalFormData.start || todayDate;
    if (!finalFormData.baselineStart) finalFormData.baselineStart = finalFormData.start || todayDate;
    if (!finalFormData.baselineFinish) finalFormData.baselineFinish = finalFormData.finish || todayDate;
    if (finalFormData.duration === undefined || finalFormData.duration === null || String(finalFormData.duration).trim() === '') {
      finalFormData.duration = "0";
    }
    let durationVal = parseFloat(String(finalFormData.duration || "0"));
    if (durationVal < 0) {
      finalFormData.duration = "0";
      finalFormData.finish = finalFormData.start;
    }
    if (finalFormData.durationManual ?? true) {
      finalFormData.durationManual = true;
      if (finalFormData.start && finalFormData.duration !== undefined && finalFormData.duration !== '') {
        const s = parseDateTime(finalFormData.start);
        const days = parseFloat(String(finalFormData.duration));
        if (s && !isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(days)) {
          const f = new Date(s.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
          finalFormData.finish = formatToDatetimeLocal(f);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!finalFormData.party) {
      finalFormData.party = currentProject?.party || 'Takashimaya';
    }

    if (cloudStatus === 'offline') {
      let payload = {
        ...finalFormData,
        id,
        projectYear: Number(currentYear) || new Date().getFullYear(),
        comments: task?.comments || finalFormData.comments || [],
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        orderIndex: newOrderIndex
      };
      addPendingUpdate({ collectionPath: `artifacts/${APP_ID}/public/data/taka_tasks`, action: 'set', docId: id, data: payload } as any);
      setToast({ title: 'Draft Saved', message: 'Task saved offline. Will sync when connection returns.' });
      onClose();
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      return true;
    }
    
    let dataToSave: any = {
      ...finalFormData,
      id,
      projectYear: Number(currentYear) || new Date().getFullYear(),
      comments: task?.comments || finalFormData.comments || [],
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      orderIndex: newOrderIndex
    };

    if (dataToSave.predecessor && dataToSave.predecessor.trim()) {
      dataToSave.realtimeUpdate = true;
    } else {
      dataToSave.realtimeUpdate = false;
    }

    // Explicitly delete fields from Firestore if unlinked or cleared
    if (task?.parentTaskId && !finalFormData.parentTaskId) {
      dataToSave.parentTaskId = deleteField();
      dataToSave.parentId = null;
    }
    if (task?.taskCodePhu && (!finalFormData.taskCodePhu || !finalFormData.taskCodePhu.trim())) {
      dataToSave.taskCodePhu = deleteField();
    }

    Object.keys(dataToSave).forEach(key => {
      if ((dataToSave as any)[key] === undefined) {
        delete (dataToSave as any)[key];
      }
    });

    const oldTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
    const newTasksForMap = task 
       ? tasks.map(t => t.id === id ? dataToSave as Task : t) 
       : [...tasks, dataToSave as Task];
    const newTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, newTasksForMap);
    const oldCodeToNewCode = getPredecessorCodeUpdates(oldTaskNoMap, newTaskNoMap, projects, newTasksForMap);

    if (task) {
      const oldCode = (task.taskCodePhu || computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, task)).trim();
      const newCode = (dataToSave.taskCodePhu || computeTaskCode(projects, newTasksForMap, dataToSave as Task)).trim();
      if (oldCode && newCode && oldCode.toLowerCase() !== newCode.toLowerCase()) {
        oldCodeToNewCode.set(oldCode.toLowerCase(), newCode);
      }
    }

    const predecessorUpdatesOrig = updatePredecessorsStrings(oldCodeToNewCode, tasks, projects, oldTaskNoMap);
    const predecessorUpdates = predecessorUpdatesOrig.filter(pu => pu.id !== id);
    const predecessorUpdatesMap = new Map(predecessorUpdates.map(pu => [pu.id, pu]));

    const updatesToDependents = scheduleDependentTasks(dataToSave as Task, tasks, projects);
    
    const scheduledUpdatedTask = updatesToDependents.find(d => d.id === dataToSave.id);
    if (scheduledUpdatedTask) {
      dataToSave = scheduledUpdatedTask as any;
    }

    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    if (task) {
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id), dataToSave);
    } else {
      batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id), dataToSave);
    }

    const depUpdates = updatesToDependents.filter(d => d.id !== id);
    const mappedDepUpdates = new Set<string>();

    depUpdates.forEach(depTask => {
      const depProj = projects.find(p => p.code === depTask.projectCode);
      const depYear = (depTask.projectYear !== undefined && depTask.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(depTask.projectYear)))
        ? Number(depTask.projectYear)
        : (depProj?.year && !isNaN(Number(depProj.year)) ? Number(depProj.year) : new Date().getFullYear());
      const pu = predecessorUpdatesMap.get(depTask.id);
      const data = pu 
        ? { ...depTask, projectYear: depYear, predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } 
        : { ...depTask, projectYear: depYear, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      Object.keys(data).forEach(key => {
        if ((data as any)[key] === undefined) {
          delete (data as any)[key];
        }
      });
      batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', depTask.id), data, { merge: true });
      mappedDepUpdates.add(depTask.id);
    });

    predecessorUpdates.forEach(pu => {
      if (!mappedDepUpdates.has(pu.id)) {
         batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', pu.id), { predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt }, { merge: true });
      }
    });

    const optimisticList: any[] = [dataToSave];
    depUpdates.forEach(depTask => {
      const pu = predecessorUpdatesMap.get(depTask.id);
      if (pu) {
        optimisticList.push({ ...depTask, predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt });
      } else {
        optimisticList.push(depTask);
      }
    });
    predecessorUpdates.forEach(pu => {
      if (!mappedDepUpdates.has(pu.id)) {
        optimisticList.push({ id: pu.id, predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt });
      }
    });
    
    saveTaskStateUnified(optimisticList);

    const isNewTask = !task;
    const oldAny = (task || {}) as any;
    const newAny = dataToSave as any;
    const datesOrStatusChanged =
      isNewTask ||
      task?.start !== dataToSave.start ||
      task?.finish !== dataToSave.finish ||
      task?.runningStatus !== dataToSave.runningStatus ||
      task?.approval !== dataToSave.approval ||
      Boolean(oldAny.isCompleted) !== Boolean(newAny.isCompleted) ||
      (oldAny.status || '') !== (newAny.status || '') ||
      task?.projectCode !== dataToSave.projectCode ||
      task?.projectStore !== dataToSave.projectStore ||
      task?.projectYear !== dataToSave.projectYear ||
      depUpdates.length > 0;

    // Close modal INSTANTLY (0ms UI lag)
    onClose();
    setIsSubmitting(false);

    // Offload network commit, delta emission, and project date rollups to non-blocking background microtask
    setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        await batch.commit();
        const deltaItems = optimisticList.map(item => {
          const prev = tasks.find(t => t.id === item.id);
          return createPatchDeltaItem({
            docId: item.id,
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
            previous: prev,
            updated: item,
            action: prev ? 'update' : 'create',
            year: item.projectYear ? String(item.projectYear) : (task?.projectYear ? String(task.projectYear) : undefined),
          });
        });
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});

        if (datesOrStatusChanged) {
          const allTasksCurrent = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
          syncProjectDatesByCode(dataToSave.projectCode, dataToSave.projectStore, dataToSave.projectYear, allTasksCurrent);
          if (task && (task.projectCode !== dataToSave.projectCode || task.projectStore !== dataToSave.projectStore || task.projectYear !== dataToSave.projectYear)) {
            syncProjectDatesByCode(task.projectCode, task.projectStore, task.projectYear, allTasksCurrent);
          }
        }
      } catch (error: any) {
        console.error("Background task save failed:", error);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
      }
    }, 0);

    undoManager.push({
      description: task ? `Update Task: ${formData.name}` : `Create Task: ${formData.name}`,
      revert: async () => {
        const revertBatch = writeBatch(db);
        if (task) {
          revertBatch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id), { ...task, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        } else {
          revertBatch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id), { isDeleted: true, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }, { merge: true });
        }
        updatesToDependents.forEach(depTask => {
          const originalDep = tasks.find(tsk => tsk.id === depTask.id);
          if (originalDep) {
            revertBatch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', depTask.id), originalDep);
          }
        });
        predecessorUpdates.forEach(pu => {
          if (!mappedDepUpdates.has(pu.id)) {
             const originalTask = tasks.find(tk => tk.id === pu.id);
             if (originalTask) {
               revertBatch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', originalTask.id), { predecessor: originalTask.predecessor || '' });
             }
          }
        });
        revertBatch.commit().catch(console.error);
      }
    });

    return true;
  } catch (e: any) { 
    console.error(e); 
    useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: String(e.message || "An error occurred while saving the task.") });
    setIsSubmitting(false);
    return false;
  }
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { getDefaultDatetimeLocal, formatToDatetimeLocal, parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors, parsePredecessors, buildTaskNoMap } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

export interface UseTaskModalFormStateProps {
  task: Task | null;
  isOpen: boolean;
  prefillProjectCode: string | null;
  prefillProjectYear?: string | number | null;
  prefillProjectStore?: string | null;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  t: (key: string) => string;
}

export function useTaskModalFormState({
  task,
  isOpen,
  prefillProjectCode,
  prefillProjectYear,
  prefillProjectStore,
  projects,
  tasks,
  t
}: UseTaskModalFormStateProps) {
  const [dateErrors, setDateErrors] = useState<any>({});
  const nameRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Partial<Task>>(() => {
    if (task) return task;
    const defaultDate = getDefaultDatetimeLocal();
    const targetProj = projects?.find(p => 
      p.code === prefillProjectCode &&
      (prefillProjectStore ? p.store === prefillProjectStore : true) &&
      (prefillProjectYear ? String(p.year) === String(prefillProjectYear) : true)
    ) || projects?.find(p => p.code === prefillProjectCode) || (projects && projects.length > 0 ? projects[0] : null);

    return {
      projectId: targetProj?.id || undefined,
      projectCode: prefillProjectCode || targetProj?.code || '',
      projectYear: prefillProjectYear || targetProj?.year || undefined,
      projectStore: prefillProjectStore || targetProj?.store || undefined,
      location: targetProj?.location || undefined,
      name: '',
      start: defaultDate,
      finish: defaultDate,
      baselineStart: defaultDate,
      baselineFinish: defaultDate,
      duration: '0',
      durationManual: true,
      finishManual: false,
      party: targetProj?.party || 'Takashimaya',
      predecessors: task?.predecessors || []
    };
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    if (task) {
      setFormData({
        ...task,
        predecessor: task.predecessor || ''
      });
    } else {
      const defaultDate = getDefaultDatetimeLocal();
      const targetProj = projects?.find(p => 
        p.code === prefillProjectCode &&
        (prefillProjectStore ? p.store === prefillProjectStore : true) &&
        (prefillProjectYear ? String(p.year) === String(prefillProjectYear) : true)
      ) || projects?.find(p => p.code === prefillProjectCode) || (projects && projects.length > 0 ? projects[0] : null);

      setFormData({
        projectId: targetProj?.id || undefined,
        projectCode: prefillProjectCode || targetProj?.code || '',
        projectYear: prefillProjectYear || targetProj?.year || undefined,
        projectStore: prefillProjectStore || targetProj?.store || undefined,
        location: targetProj?.location || undefined,
        name: '',
        start: defaultDate,
        finish: defaultDate,
        baselineStart: defaultDate,
        baselineFinish: defaultDate,
        duration: '0',
        durationManual: true,
        finishManual: false,
        party: targetProj?.party || 'Takashimaya',
        predecessors: []
      });
    }
  }, [task?.id, isOpen, prefillProjectCode, prefillProjectYear, prefillProjectStore]);

  const currentProject = useMemo(() => {
    return projects.find(p => 
      p.code === (formData.projectCode || task?.projectCode) &&
      (formData.projectStore ? p.store === formData.projectStore : true) &&
      (formData.projectYear ? String(p.year) === String(formData.projectYear) : true)
    ) || projects.find(p => p.code === (formData.projectCode || task?.projectCode));
  }, [projects, formData.projectCode, formData.projectStore, formData.projectYear, task?.projectCode]);

  const resolvedPredecessors = useMemo(() => {
    if (!formData.predecessor?.trim()) return [];
    try {
      const taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects || [], tasks || []);
      const dummyTask: Task = {
        id: task?.id || 'temp',
        projectId: formData.projectId || task?.projectId || currentProject?.id,
        projectCode: formData.projectCode || task?.projectCode || currentProject?.code || '',
        projectYear: formData.projectYear || task?.projectYear || currentProject?.year,
        projectStore: formData.projectStore || task?.projectStore || currentProject?.store,
        location: formData.location || task?.location || currentProject?.location,
        name: formData.name || '',
        start: formData.start,
        finish: formData.finish,
        duration: formData.duration,
        durationManual: true,
        finishManual: false
      };
      return parsePredecessors(formData.predecessor, taskNoMap, dummyTask);

      return [];

    const isFilled = Boolean(val.trim());
    const parts = val.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const updated = { 
      ...formData, 
      predecessor: val, 
      realtimeUpdate: isFilled,
      ...(parts.length >= 2 ? { durationManual: false } : {})
    };

    if (isFilled) {
      try {
        const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || tasks || [];
        const taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects || [], currentTasks);
        const dummyTask: Task = {
          id: task?.id || 'temp',
          projectId: updated.projectId || task?.projectId || currentProject?.id,
          projectCode: updated.projectCode || currentProject?.code || '',
          projectYear: updated.projectYear || currentProject?.year,
          projectStore: updated.projectStore || currentProject?.store,
          location: updated.location || task?.location || currentProject?.location,
          name: updated.name || '',
          start: updated.start,
          finish: updated.finish,
          duration: updated.duration,
          durationManual: updated.durationManual ?? (parts.length >= 2 ? false : true),
          finishManual: updated.finishManual ?? false
        };
        const parsed = parsePredecessors(val, taskNoMap, dummyTask);

        if (parsed.length > 0) {
          const calcResult = calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors(dummyTask, parsed);
          if (calcResult) {
            updated.start = calcResult.start;
            updated.finish = calcResult.finish;
            updated.duration = calcResult.duration;
            updated.durationManual = calcResult.durationManual;

            if (!task?.baselineStart && !formData.baselineStart) {
              updated.baselineStart = calcResult.start;

            if (!task?.baselineFinish && !formData.baselineFinish) {
              updated.baselineFinish = calcResult.finish;
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Predecessor auto-calc err:", err);
      }
    }

    setFormData(updated);

          id: task?.id || 'temp',

          projectYear: formData.projectYear,
          projectStore: formData.projectStore,
          name: formData.name || '',

        };

            duration: calcResult.duration,
            durationManual: calcResult.durationManual,
            ...(!task?.baselineStart && !prev.baselineStart ? { baselineStart: calcResult.start } : {}),
            ...(!task?.baselineFinish && !prev.baselineFinish ? { baselineFinish: calcResult.finish } : {})
          }));
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: t("Dates Synced") || "Dates Synced",
            message: t("Task dates and duration synced with predecessors.") || "Task dates and duration synced with predecessors."
          });

        }
      }
      handlePredecessorChange(formData.predecessor);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: t("Dates Synced") || "Dates Synced",
        message: t("Task dates and duration synced with predecessors.") || "Task dates and duration synced with predecessors."
      });
    }
  };

  const handleDateChange = (field: 'start' | 'finish', value: string) => {
    const nextData = { ...formData, [field]: value };
    
    if (field === 'start') {
      if (nextData.durationManual) {
        if (nextData.start && nextData.duration !== undefined && nextData.duration !== '') {
          const s = parseDateTime(nextData.start);
          if (s && !isNaN(s.getTime())) {
            const days = parseFloat(String(nextData.duration));
            if (!isNaN(days)) {
              const f = new Date(s.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
              nextData.finish = formatToDatetimeLocal(f);
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (nextData.start && nextData.finish) {
          const s = parseDateTime(nextData.start);
          const f = parseDateTime(nextData.finish);
          if (s && f && !isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(f.getTime())) {
            const diffDays = (f.getTime() - s.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
            nextData.duration = String(diffDays >= 0 ? Number(diffDays.toFixed(2)) : 0);
          }
        }
      }
    } else {
      if (nextData.start && nextData.finish) {
        const s = parseDateTime(nextData.start);
        const f = parseDateTime(nextData.finish);
        if (s && f && !isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(f.getTime())) {
          const diffDays = (f.getTime() - s.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
          nextData.duration = String(diffDays >= 0 ? Number(diffDays.toFixed(2)) : 0);
        }
      }
    }

    if (!task?.baselineStart && !formData.baselineStart && nextData.start) {
      nextData.baselineStart = nextData.start;
    }
    if (!task?.baselineFinish && !formData.baselineFinish && nextData.finish) {
      nextData.baselineFinish = nextData.finish;
    }

    setFormData(nextData);
  };

  const handleDurationChange = (value: string) => {
    const sanitizedValue = value.replace(',', '.');
    const nextData = { ...formData, duration: sanitizedValue };
    
    if (nextData.start) {
      const s = parseDateTime(nextData.start);
      if (s && !isNaN(s.getTime())) {
        const days = parseFloat(sanitizedValue);
        if (!isNaN(days) && days >= 0) {
          const f = new Date(s.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
          nextData.finish = formatToDatetimeLocal(f);

          if (!task?.baselineFinish && !formData.baselineFinish && nextData.finish) {
            nextData.baselineFinish = nextData.finish;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    setFormData(nextData);
  };

  const toggleDurationManual = () => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, durationManual: !prev.durationManual }));
  };

  return {
    formData,
    setFormData,
    dateErrors,
    setDateErrors,
    nameRef,
    currentProject,
    resolvedPredecessors,
    handlePredecessorChange,
    handleApplyPredecessorDates,
    handleDateChange,
    handleDurationChange,
    toggleDurationManual
  };
}

export function useDeepLinkLogic(

      const pending = pendingDeepLinkRef.current;
      pendingDeepLinkRef.current = null;
      executeDeepLinkRef.current(pending.targetType, pending.targetId, pending.extraParams);
    }
  }, [currentUser?.id]);

  

const checkAccessLocally = useCallback((data: any): boolean => {
    const user = useAppStore.getState().currentUser;
    if (!user || user.role === "admin") return true;
    const store = String(data.store || data.projectStore || "").toUpperCase().trim();
    if (store === "HCM" && !user.storePermissions?.hcm) return false;
    if (store === "HN" && !user.storePermissions?.hn) return false;

  const executeDeepLink = useCallback(

      if (!user || user.id === "guest") {
        pendingDeepLinkRef.current = { targetType, targetId, extraParams };
        setIsLoginModalOpen(true);

      }

      // If extraParams contains year or store, proactively sync filters
      if (extraParams?.year && String(extraParams.year) !== useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter) {
        useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(String(extraParams.year));

        extraParams?.store &&
        useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter !== "all" &&
        extraParams.store.toLowerCase() !== useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter.toLowerCase()
      ) {
        useAppStore.getState().setGlobalStoreFilter("all");
      }

      // 1. PROJECT TARGET
