        const curProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
        const curNotifProjects = useAppStore.getState().allProjectsForNotifs || [];

        let p: Project | undefined =
          curEnriched.find(
            (item) =>
              String(item.no) === targetId ||
              String(item.id).toLowerCase() === normId ||
              String(item.code || "").toLowerCase() === normId
          ) ||
          curProjects.find(
            (item) =>
              String(item.no) === targetId ||
              String(item.id).toLowerCase() === normId ||
              String(item.code || "").toLowerCase() === normId
          ) ||
          curNotifProjects.find(
            (item) =>
              String(item.no) === targetId ||
              String(item.id).toLowerCase() === normId ||
              String(item.code || "").toLowerCase() === normId
          );

        if (p) {
          if (!checkAccessLocally(p)) {
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({
              title: "Access Denied",
              message: "You do not have permission to access this project's store.",
            });
            return;
          }

          }

            p.store &&
            useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter !== "all" &&

          ) {

            useAppStore.getState().setDetailTabFilterCode(p.code);
          }
          useAppStore.getState().setEditingProject(p);
          useAppStore.getState().setIsReadOnlyModal(true);
          useAppStore.getState().setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
          window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
          return;
        }

        // Fast Firestore point read (<100ms)
        try {
          let fetchedProj: Project | null = null;
          if (targetId.includes("_") || targetId.length > 8) {
            const docRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_projects", targetId);
            const snap = await getDoc(docRef);
            if (snap.exists()) {
              fetchedProj = { id: snap.id, ...snap.data() } as Project;
            }
          }
          if (!fetchedProj) {
            const isNum = !isNaN(Number(targetId));
            const constraints: any[] = [];
            if (isNum) {
              constraints.push(where("no", "==", Number(targetId)));
            } else {
              constraints.push(where("code", "==", targetId));
            }
            const q = query(
              collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_projects"),
              ...constraints,
              limit(1)
            );
            const snap = await getDocs(q);
            if (!snap.empty) {
              fetchedProj = { id: snap.docs[0].id, ...snap.docs[0].data() } as Project;
            }
          }

          if (fetchedProj) {

              window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
              useAppStore.getState().setToast({
                title: "Access Denied",
                message: "You do not have permission to access this project's store.",
              });
              return;
            }
            if (fetchedProj.year && String(fetchedProj.year) !== useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter) {
              useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(String(fetchedProj.year));
            }
            if (
              fetchedProj.store &&
              useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter !== "all" &&
              fetchedProj.store.toLowerCase() !== useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter.toLowerCase()
            ) {
              useAppStore.getState().setGlobalStoreFilter("all");
            }
            handleTabChange("detail");
            if (fetchedProj.code) {
              useAppStore.getState().setDetailTabFilterCode(fetchedProj.code);
            }
            useAppStore.getState().setEditingProject(fetchedProj);
            useAppStore.getState().setIsReadOnlyModal(true);
            useAppStore.getState().setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
          } else {
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({
              title: "Not Found",
              message: "This project was not found or data has been deleted.",
            });
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching project deep link:", err);
          window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Error",
            message: "Could not load project.",
          });
        }
        return;
      }

      // 2. TASK TARGET
      if (targetType === "task") {
        useAppStore.getState().setIsTasksRequested(true);
        const normId = String(targetId).trim().toLowerCase();
        const curFilteredTasks = filteredTasksRef.current || [];
        const curTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];
        const curNotifTasks = useAppStore.getState().allTasksForNotifs || [];

        let t: Task | undefined =
          curFilteredTasks.find((item) => item.id && item.id.toLowerCase() === normId) ||
          curTasks.find((item) => item.id && item.id.toLowerCase() === normId) ||
          curNotifTasks.find((item) => item.id && item.id.toLowerCase() === normId);

        if (t) {
          if (!checkAccessLocally(t)) {
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({
              title: "Access Denied",
              message: "You do not have permission to access this task's store.",
            });
            return;
          }
          if (t.projectYear && String(t.projectYear) !== useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter) {
            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(String(t.projectYear));
          }
          if (
            t.projectStore &&
            useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter !== "all" &&
            t.projectStore.toLowerCase() !== useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter.toLowerCase()
          ) {
            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalStoreFilter("all");
          }
          handleTabChange("detail");
          if (t.projectCode) {
            useAppStore.getState().setDetailTabFilterCode(t.projectCode);
          }
          useAppStore.getState().setDetailTabFocusTaskId(t.id);
          useAppStore.getState().setGanttTabFocusTaskId(t.id);
          useAppStore.getState().setEditingTask(t);
          useAppStore.getState().setIsReadOnlyModal(true);
          useAppStore.getState().setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
          window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
          return;
        }

        // Fast Firestore point read
        try {
          const docRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks", String(targetId));
          const snap = await getDoc(docRef);

            const fetchedTask = { id: snap.id, ...snap.data() } as Task;
            if (!checkAccessLocally(fetchedTask)) {
              window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);

                title: "Access Denied",

            useAppStore.getState().setEditingTask(fetchedTask);
            useAppStore.getState().setIsReadOnlyModal(true);
            useAppStore.getState().setIsTaskModalOpen(true);

          } else {
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({
              title: "Not Found",
              message: "This task was not found or data has been deleted.",
            });
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching task deep link:", err);
          window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Error",
            message: "Could not load task.",
          });
        }

      }

      // 3. TASK DELEGATION TARGET
      if (targetType === "task_delegation") {
        useAppStore.getState().setIsDelegationsRequested(true);
        handleTabChange("taskDelegation");
        setTimeout(() => {
          window.dispatchEvent(
            new CustomEvent("taka_open_delegation_group", { detail: { groupId: targetId } })

        window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
      }

    [checkAccessLocally, handleTabChange]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    executeDeepLinkRef.current = executeDeepLink;
  }, [executeDeepLink]);

  const handleDeepLinkString = useCallback(
    (rawInput: string) => {
      if (!rawInput) return;
      try {
        let searchStr = "";
        if (rawInput.includes("?")) {
          searchStr = rawInput.split("?")[1];
        } else if (
          rawInput.includes("targetType=") ||
          rawInput.includes("targetId=") ||
          rawInput.includes("notificationId=")
        ) {
          searchStr = rawInput;
        } else {
          try {
            const u = new URL(rawInput);
            searchStr = u.search.replace(/^\?/, "");
          } catch {
            if (rawInput.startsWith("http://") || rawInput.startsWith("https://")) {
              window.open(rawInput, "_blank");
            }
            return;
          }
        }

        const params = new URLSearchParams(searchStr);
        const notificationId = params.get("notificationId");
        const targetType = params.get("targetType");
        const targetId = params.get("targetId");
        const code = params.get("code") || undefined;
        const store = params.get("store") || undefined;
        const year = params.get("year") || undefined;
        const searchTab = params.get("tab") as any;
        const searchQuery = params.get("q");

        if (searchTab && searchQuery) {
          if (searchTab === 'detail') {
            useAppStore.getState().setDetailTabFilterCode(searchQuery);
          } else if (searchTab === 'budget') {
            useAppStore.getState().setBudgetTabSearchTerm(searchQuery);
          } else if (searchTab === 'cost') {
            // For cost, we might receive a description/vendor or a project code. 
            // In CostTab, searchTerm handles both. So we can just set costTabSearchTerm.
                        useAppStore.getState().setCostTabSearchTerm(searchQuery);
          }
          useAppStore.getState().setActiveTab(searchTab);
          window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
          return;
        }

        if (notificationId) {
          useAppStore.getState().setNotificationFilterId(notificationId);
          useAppStore.getState().setActiveTab("notification");
          window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
          return;
        }

        if (targetType && targetId) {
          executeDeepLink(targetType, targetId, { store, year, code });
        } else if (rawInput.startsWith("http://") || rawInput.startsWith("https://")) {
          window.open(rawInput, "_blank");
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Error parsing deep link:", e);
      }
    },
    [executeDeepLink, useAppStore.getState().setActiveTab, useAppStore.getState().setNotificationFilterId]
  );

  // Initial deep link handling on mount
  const initialUrlHandledRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialUrlHandledRef.current) return;
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const targetType = params.get("targetType");
    const targetId = params.get("targetId");
    const notificationId = params.get("notificationId");
    const tab = params.get("tab");
    const q = params.get("q");

    if (notificationId || (targetType && targetId) || (tab && q)) {
      initialUrlHandledRef.current = true;
      handleDeepLinkString(window.location.search);
    }
  }, [handleDeepLinkString]);

  

  // Also include the SW notification handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMessage = (event: MessageEvent) => {
      if (event.data && event.data.type === "NOTIFICATION_CLICK") {
        const { targetType, targetId, notificationId } = event.data.data;
        if (notificationId) {
          useAppStore.getState().setNotificationFilterId(notificationId);
          handleTabChange("notification");
        } else if (targetType && targetId) {
          executeDeepLink(targetType, targetId);
        }
      }
    };

    navigator.serviceWorker?.addEventListener("message", handleMessage);
    return () => {
      navigator.serviceWorker?.removeEventListener("message", handleMessage);
    };
  }, [executeDeepLink, handleTabChange]);

  return {
    handleDeepLinkString,
    pendingDeepLinkRef,
    executeDeepLinkRef
  };
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useDetailPredecessorSync.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, TakaDeltaItem } from '../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { db, APP_ID, writeBatch } from '../lib/firebase';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { healAllTasksPredecessors, convertAllSubtaskCodesAndPredecessorsToHash } from '../lib/ganttUtils';
import { getAppBootAgeMs, BOOT_SYNC_GUARD_MS } from '../lib/projectDatesService';
import { recordBatchDeltas } from '../lib/deltaSyncService';

interface UseDetailPredecessorSyncParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  hasWritePermission: boolean;
}

export function useDetailPredecessorSync({
  tasks,
  projects,
  hasWritePermission,
}: UseDetailPredecessorSyncParams) {
  const isSyncingPredecessorsRef = useRef(false);
  const [isSyncingPredecessors, setIsSyncingPredecessors] = useState(false);
  const isConvertingToHashRef = useRef(false);
  const [isConvertingToHash, setIsConvertingToHash] = useState(false);
  const hasAutoHealedRef = useRef(false);

  const handleSyncAllPredecessors = useCallback(async (showToast = false) => {
    if (isSyncingPredecessorsRef.current) return;
    if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0 || !projects || projects.length === 0) {
      if (showToast) {
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Thông báo",
          message: "Chưa có dữ liệu công việc để đồng bộ.",
          type: "info"
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      isSyncingPredecessorsRef.current = true;
      setIsSyncingPredecessors(true);

      const healed = healAllTasksPredecessors(tasks, projects);
      if (healed.changedCount > 0) {
        // Zero-delay optimistic UI update (0ms)
        useAppStore.getState().setTasks(healed.updatedTasks);

        // Batch update to Firestore in background (non-blocking) in chunks of 400
        const CHUNK_SIZE = 400;
        const commitChunks = async () => {
          for (let i = 0; i < healed.updatesToSave.length; i += CHUNK_SIZE) {
            const chunk = healed.updatesToSave.slice(i, i + CHUNK_SIZE);
            const batch = writeBatch(db);
            chunk.forEach(u => {
              const tRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks", u.id);
              const updatePayload: any = { updatedAt: u.updatedAt };
              if (u.predecessor !== undefined) updatePayload.predecessor = u.predecessor;
              if (u.taskCodePhu !== undefined) updatePayload.taskCodePhu = u.taskCodePhu;
              batch.set(tRef, updatePayload, { merge: true });
            });
            await batch.commit();
            const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = chunk.map((u) => ({
              docId: u.id,
              collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
              action: 'update',
              isPatch: true,
              data: {
                predecessor: u.predecessor,
                taskCodePhu: u.taskCodePhu,
                updatedAt: u.updatedAt,
              },
              year: (tasks.find((t) => t.id === u.id)?.projectYear) ? String(tasks.find((t) => t.id === u.id)!.projectYear) : undefined,
            }));
            recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, 'predecessor_heal').catch(() => {});
          }
        };
        commitChunks().catch(e => console.error("Background sync predecessors error:", e));

        if (showToast) {
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Đồng bộ thành công",
            message: `Đã chuẩn hóa và cập nhật ${healed.changedCount} mã tiền nhiệm (Predecessor) theo mã Subtask mới dạng #!`,
            type: "success"
          });
        }
      } else if (showToast) {
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Đồng bộ hoàn tất",
          message: "Tất cả các ô Predecessor đã khớp chính xác với mã Subtask hiện tại.",
          type: "info"
        });
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error("Sync predecessors error:", e);
      if (showToast) {
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Lỗi đồng bộ",
          message: e?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra khi đồng bộ tiền nhiệm.",
          type: "error"
        });
      }
    } finally {
      isSyncingPredecessorsRef.current = false;
      setIsSyncingPredecessors(false);
    }
  }, [tasks, projects]);

  const handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash = useCallback(async (showToast = true) => {
    if (isConvertingToHashRef.current) return;
    if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0 || !projects || projects.length === 0) {
      if (showToast) {
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Thông báo",
          message: "Chưa có dữ liệu công việc để quét chuyển đổi.",
          type: "info"
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      isConvertingToHashRef.current = true;
      setIsConvertingToHash(true);

      const result = convertAllSubtaskCodesAndPredecessorsToHash(tasks, projects);
      if (result.changedCount > 0) {
        // Zero-delay optimistic UI update (0ms)
        useAppStore.getState().setTasks(result.updatedTasks);

        // Batch update to Firestore in background in chunks of 400
        const CHUNK_SIZE = 400;
        const commitChunks = async () => {
          for (let i = 0; i < result.updatesToSave.length; i += CHUNK_SIZE) {
            const chunk = result.updatesToSave.slice(i, i + CHUNK_SIZE);
            const batch = writeBatch(db);
            chunk.forEach(u => {
              const tRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks", u.id);
              const updatePayload: any = { updatedAt: u.updatedAt };
              if (u.predecessor !== undefined) updatePayload.predecessor = u.predecessor;
              if (u.taskCodePhu !== undefined) updatePayload.taskCodePhu = u.taskCodePhu;
              batch.set(tRef, updatePayload, { merge: true });
            });
            await batch.commit();
            const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = chunk.map((u) => ({
              docId: u.id,
              collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
              action: 'update',
              isPatch: true,
              data: {
                predecessor: u.predecessor,
                taskCodePhu: u.taskCodePhu,
                updatedAt: u.updatedAt,
              },
              year: (tasks.find((t) => t.id === u.id)?.projectYear) ? String(tasks.find((t) => t.id === u.id)!.projectYear) : undefined,
            }));
            recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, 'predecessor_convert_hash').catch(() => {});
          }
        };
        commitChunks().catch(e => console.error("Background convert to hash error:", e));

        if (showToast) {
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Chuyển đổi thành công",
            message: `Đã quét và chuyển đổi ${result.changedCount} công việc sang định dạng '#' (Subtask Code & Predecessor)!`,
            type: "success"
          });
        }
      } else if (showToast) {
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Không có thay đổi",
          message: "Tất cả công việc đã theo đúng định dạng '#' hoặc không có công việc nào cần chuyển đổi.",
          type: "info"
        });
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error("Convert to hash error:", e);
      if (showToast) {
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Lỗi chuyển đổi",
          message: e?.message || "Có lỗi xảy ra khi quét chuyển đổi định dạng '#'.",
          type: "error"
        });
      }
    } finally {
      isConvertingToHashRef.current = false;
      setIsConvertingToHash(false);
    }
  }, [tasks, projects, hasWritePermission]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasAutoHealedRef.current) return;
    if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0 || !projects || projects.length === 0) return;
    if (!hasWritePermission) return;
    // 15 giây đầu sau khi mở app, tasks mới chỉ là bản cũ từ Dexie: không tự ghi lên Firestore
    if (getAppBootAgeMs() < BOOT_SYNC_GUARD_MS) return;

    hasAutoHealedRef.current = true;
    handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash(false).catch(() => {});
  }, [tasks, projects, hasWritePermission, handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash]);

  return {
    isSyncingPredecessors,
    handleSyncAllPredecessors,
    isConvertingToHash,
    handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useDetailTaskReorder.ts ===
import React, { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, TakaDeltaItem } from '../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { db, APP_ID, writeBatch } from '../lib/firebase';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { recordBatchDeltas } from '../lib/deltaSyncService';
import { 
  sortTasksByPredecessorsAndDates, 
  updatePredecessorsStrings, 
  healAllTasksPredecessors, 
  reorderAndCalculateTasks,
  buildTaskNoMap,
  getPredecessorCodeUpdates
} from '../lib/ganttUtils';
import { reorderTasksStateUnified } from '../lib/taskStateService';

interface UseDetailTaskReorderParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  selectedTaskIds: Set<string>;
  setSelectedTaskIds: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Set<string>>>;
}

export function useDetailTaskReorder({
  tasks,
  projects,
  selectedTaskIds,
  setSelectedTaskIds,
}: UseDetailTaskReorderParams) {
  const [draggingTaskIds, setDraggingTaskIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [dragOverTaskId, setDragOverTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dropPosition, setDropPosition] = useState<'before' | 'after' | null>(null);

  const draggingTaskNames = useMemo(() => {
    if (draggingTaskIds.length === 0) return '';
    return tasks.filter(tk => draggingTaskIds.includes(tk.id)).map(tk => tk.name).join(', ');
  }, [draggingTaskIds, tasks]);

  const handleSortSubTasks = useCallback(async (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[]) => {
    try {
      const oldTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
      const sorted = sortTasksByPredecessorsAndDates(groupTasks, projects, tasks);

      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      const updatesPerTask = new Map<string, any>();
      const now = new Date().toISOString();

      sorted.forEach((t, index) => {
        const newCode = `${p.code}#${index + 1}`;
        if (t.orderIndex !== index || t.taskCodePhu !== newCode) {
          updatesPerTask.set(t.id, { 
            orderIndex: index, 
            taskCodePhu: newCode, 
            updatedAt: now 
          });
        }
      });

      let allUpdatedTasks = tasks.map(t => {
        const up = updatesPerTask.get(t.id);
        return up ? { ...t, ...up } : t;
      });

      const newTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, allUpdatedTasks);
      const oldCodeToNewCode = getPredecessorCodeUpdates(oldTaskNoMap, newTaskNoMap, projects, allUpdatedTasks);

      const predUpdates = updatePredecessorsStrings(oldCodeToNewCode, allUpdatedTasks, projects, oldTaskNoMap);
      if (predUpdates.length > 0) {
        const predMap = new Map(predUpdates.map(pu => [pu.id, pu]));
        predUpdates.forEach(pu => {
          const existingUpdates = updatesPerTask.get(pu.id) || {};
          updatesPerTask.set(pu.id, { ...existingUpdates, predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt });
        });
        allUpdatedTasks = allUpdatedTasks.map(t => {
          const pu = predMap.get(t.id);
          return pu ? { ...t, predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt } : t;
        });
      }

      // Heal all remaining legacy or out-of-sync predecessors
      const healed = healAllTasksPredecessors(allUpdatedTasks, projects);
      if (healed.changedCount > 0) {
        allUpdatedTasks = healed.updatedTasks;
        healed.updatesToSave.forEach(u => {
          const existingUpdates = updatesPerTask.get(u.id) || {};
          updatesPerTask.set(u.id, { ...existingUpdates, predecessor: u.predecessor, updatedAt: u.updatedAt });
        });
      }

      // Optimistic UI update in Zustand & sync project dates immediately (0ms)
      reorderTasksStateUnified(allUpdatedTasks, { affectedProjectIds: [p.id] });

      updatesPerTask.forEach((updates, taskId) => {
        const tRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks", taskId);
        batch.update(tRef, updates);
      });

      try {
        batch.commit().catch(e => console.error("Batch commit failed", e));
        const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = Array.from(updatesPerTask.entries()).map(([taskId, patch]) => ({
          docId: taskId,
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
          action: 'update',
          isPatch: true,
          data: patch,
          year: p.year ? String(p.year) : undefined,
        }));
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, useAppStore.getState().currentUser?.email || 'reorder_tasks').catch(() => {});
      } catch (error: any) {
        console.error("Batch commit failed", error);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
        return;
      }

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Sắp xếp thành công",
        message: "Đã đánh lại số thứ tự và tự động điền lại Predecessor theo Task code mới.",
        type: "success"
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    }
  }, [tasks, projects]);

  const handleMoveTask = useCallback(async (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[], index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    if ((direction === 'up' && index === 0) || (direction === 'down' && index === groupTasks.length - 1)) return;

    try {
      const oldTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
      const sorted = [...groupTasks];
      const targetIndex = direction === 'up' ? index - 1 : index + 1;
      const [movedTask] = sorted.splice(index, 1);
      sorted.splice(targetIndex, 0, movedTask);

      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      const updatesPerTask = new Map<string, any>();
      const now = new Date().toISOString();

      sorted.forEach((t, newIdx) => {
        const newCode = `${p.code}#${newIdx + 1}`;
        if (t.orderIndex !== newIdx || t.taskCodePhu !== newCode) {
          updatesPerTask.set(t.id, { 
            orderIndex: newIdx, 
            taskCodePhu: newCode, 
            updatedAt: now 
          });
        }
      });

      let allUpdatedTasks = tasks.map(t => {
        const up = updatesPerTask.get(t.id);
        return up ? { ...t, ...up } : t;
      });

      const newTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, allUpdatedTasks);
      const oldCodeToNewCode = getPredecessorCodeUpdates(oldTaskNoMap, newTaskNoMap, projects, allUpdatedTasks);

      const predUpdates = updatePredecessorsStrings(oldCodeToNewCode, allUpdatedTasks, projects, oldTaskNoMap);
      if (predUpdates.length > 0) {
        const predMap = new Map(predUpdates.map(pu => [pu.id, pu]));
        predUpdates.forEach(pu => {
          const existingUpdates = updatesPerTask.get(pu.id) || {};
          updatesPerTask.set(pu.id, { ...existingUpdates, predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt });
        });
        allUpdatedTasks = allUpdatedTasks.map(t => {
          const pu = predMap.get(t.id);
          return pu ? { ...t, predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt } : t;
        });
      }

      // Heal any remaining legacy or out-of-sync predecessors
      const healed = healAllTasksPredecessors(allUpdatedTasks, projects);
      if (healed.changedCount > 0) {
        allUpdatedTasks = healed.updatedTasks;
        healed.updatesToSave.forEach(u => {
          const existingUpdates = updatesPerTask.get(u.id) || {};
          updatesPerTask.set(u.id, { ...existingUpdates, predecessor: u.predecessor, updatedAt: u.updatedAt });
        });
      }

      // Optimistic UI update in Zustand & sync project dates immediately (0ms)
      reorderTasksStateUnified(allUpdatedTasks, { affectedProjectIds: [p.id] });

      updatesPerTask.forEach((updates, taskId) => {
        const tRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks", taskId);
        batch.update(tRef, updates);
      });

      try {
        batch.commit().catch(e => console.error("Batch commit failed", e));
        const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = Array.from(updatesPerTask.entries()).map(([taskId, patch]) => ({
          docId: taskId,
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
          action: 'update',
          isPatch: true,
          data: patch,
          year: p.year ? String(p.year) : undefined,
        }));
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, useAppStore.getState().currentUser?.email || 'move_task').catch(() => {});
      } catch (error: any) {
        console.error("Batch commit failed", error);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
        return;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    }
  }, [tasks, projects]);

  const handleDetailTaskDragStart = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => {
    const tasksToMove = selectedTaskIds.has(taskId)
      ? Array.from(selectedTaskIds)
      : [taskId];
    setDraggingTaskIds(tasksToMove);
    e.dataTransfer.setData(
      "application/json",
      JSON.stringify({
        type: "task-reorder",
        tasks: tasksToMove,
      })
    );
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
    try {
      const cell = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).querySelector("td");
      if (cell) e.dataTransfer.setDragImage(cell, 10, 10);
    } catch (err) {}
  }, [selectedTaskIds]);

  const handleDetailTaskDragOver = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "move";
    if (draggingTaskIds.includes(taskId)) return;
    const rect = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
    const relY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const pos: 'before' | 'after' = relY < rect.height / 2 ? 'before' : 'after';

    if (dragOverTaskId !== taskId || dropPosition !== pos) {
      setDragOverTaskId(taskId);
      setDropPosition(pos);
    }
  }, [draggingTaskIds, dragOverTaskId, dropPosition]);

  const handleDetailTaskDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => {
    const related = e.relatedTarget as Node | null;
    if (related && (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).contains(related)) {
      return;
    }
    if (dragOverTaskId === taskId) {
      setDragOverTaskId(null);
      setDropPosition(null);
    }
  }, [dragOverTaskId]);

  const handleDetailTaskDragEnd = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    setDraggingTaskIds([]);
    setDragOverTaskId(null);
    setDropPosition(null);
    const tr = e.currentTarget as HTMLTableRowElement;
    if (tr) tr.removeAttribute('draggable');
  }, []);

  const handleDetailTaskDrop = useCallback(async (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, targetProject: Project) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const position = dropPosition || 'before';
    setDragOverTaskId(null);
    setDropPosition(null);
    setDraggingTaskIds([]);

    try {
      let payloadStr = e.dataTransfer.getData("application/json");
      if (!payloadStr) {
        const textPlain = e.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain");
        if (textPlain) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(textPlain);
          if (!parsed.type) parsed.type = "task-reorder";
          payloadStr = JSON.stringify(parsed);
        }
      }

      if (!payloadStr) return;
      const data = JSON.parse(payloadStr);
      if (data.type !== "task-reorder" || !data.tasks || !Array.isArray(data.tasks)) return;

      const tasksToMoveIds: string[] = data.tasks;
      if (tasksToMoveIds.length === 0) return;
      if (tasksToMoveIds.includes(targetTask.id)) return;

      const result = reorderAndCalculateTasks(
        tasks,
        projects,
        targetProject,
        tasksToMoveIds,
        targetTask.id,
        position
      );
      if (!result) return;

      // Optimistic local state update in Zustand & sync project dates immediately
      reorderTasksStateUnified(result.allUpdatedTasks);

      const writeBatches: any[] = [];
      let currentWriteBatch = writeBatch(db);
      let writeCount = 0;

      for (const tu of result.taskUpdates) {
        const tRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks", tu.id);
        currentWriteBatch.update(tRef, tu.updates);
        writeCount++;
        if (writeCount >= 400) {
          writeBatches.push(currentWriteBatch.commit());
          currentWriteBatch = writeBatch(db);
          writeCount = 0;
        }
      }

      for (const pu of result.predecessorUpdates) {
        const alreadyInBatch = result.taskUpdates.some((tu) => tu.id === pu.id);
        if (!alreadyInBatch) {
          const tRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks", pu.id);
          currentWriteBatch.update(tRef, {
            predecessor: pu.predecessor,
            updatedAt: pu.updatedAt,
          });
          writeCount++;
          if (writeCount >= 400) {
            writeBatches.push(currentWriteBatch.commit());
            currentWriteBatch = writeBatch(db);
            writeCount = 0;
          }
        }
      }

      if (writeCount > 0) writeBatches.push(currentWriteBatch.commit());
      await Promise.all(writeBatches);

      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = [];
      result.taskUpdates.forEach((tu) => {
        deltaItems.push({
          docId: tu.id,
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
          action: 'update',
          isPatch: true,
          data: tu.updates,
        });
      });
      result.predecessorUpdates.forEach((pu) => {
        if (!result.taskUpdates.some((tu) => tu.id === pu.id)) {
          deltaItems.push({
            docId: pu.id,
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
            action: 'update',
            isPatch: true,
            data: { predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt },
          });
        }
      });
      if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, useAppStore.getState().currentUser?.email || 'drag_reorder').catch(() => {});
      }

      setSelectedTaskIds(new Set());
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("DetailTab drop error:", err);
    }
  }, [dropPosition, tasks, projects, setSelectedTaskIds]);

  return {
    draggingTaskIds,
    dragOverTaskId,
    dropPosition,
    draggingTaskNames,
    handleSortSubTasks,
    handleMoveTask,
    handleDetailTaskDragStart,
    handleDetailTaskDragOver,
    handleDetailTaskDragLeave,
    handleDetailTaskDragEnd,
    handleDetailTaskDrop,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useEnrichedData.ts ===
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { enrichProjects, getUserAllowedStores } from '../lib/utils';
import { Task, DelegationGroup } from '../types';
import { deduplicateTasks } from '../lib/taskDeduplicationService';
import { rollupParentTaskDatesAndStatus } from '../lib/taskRollupService';
import { isTaskDeletedInTracker } from '../lib/taskDeletedTracker';

let _lastProjectsRef: any = null;
let _lastRawTasksRef: any = null;
let _lastDelegationGroupsRef: any = null;
let _lastCurrentUserRef: any = null;
let _lastEnrichedResult: {
  enrichedProjects: any[];
  filteredTasks: any[];
  visibleDelegationGroups: any[];
} | null = null;

export function useEnrichedData() {
  const projects = useAppStore(state => state.projects);
  const rawTasks = useAppStore(state => state.tasks);
  const delegationGroups = useAppStore(state => state.delegationGroups);
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;

  return useMemo(() => {
    if (
      _lastProjectsRef === projects &&
      _lastRawTasksRef === rawTasks &&
      _lastDelegationGroupsRef === delegationGroups &&
      _lastCurrentUserRef === currentUser &&
      _lastEnrichedResult
    ) {
      return _lastEnrichedResult;
    }

    const deduped = deduplicateTasks(rawTasks);
    const tasks = rollupParentTaskDatesAndStatus(deduped, delegationGroups);
    const enriched = enrichProjects(projects, tasks, delegationGroups);
    
    if (!currentUser || currentUser.role === "admin") {
      const res = { enrichedProjects: enriched, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups };
      _lastProjectsRef = projects;
      _lastRawTasksRef = rawTasks;
      _lastDelegationGroupsRef = delegationGroups;
      _lastCurrentUserRef = currentUser;
      _lastEnrichedResult = res;
      return res;
    }

    // 1. Index tasks by project code for O(1) project permission matching
    const tasksByCodeMap = new Map<string, Task[]>();
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      if (!t.projectCode) return;
      const codeParts = String(t.projectCode).toLowerCase().split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      codeParts.forEach(cp => {
        let list = tasksByCodeMap.get(cp);
        if (!list) {
          list = [];
          tasksByCodeMap.set(cp, list);
        }
        list.push(t);
      });
    });

    // Extract user party permissions once into O(1) Set
    const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
      ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
          .filter((k) => currentUser.partyPermissions![k] && k.toLowerCase() !== "all")
          .map((k) => k.toLowerCase().trim())
      : [];
    const username = String(currentUser.username || "").toLowerCase().trim();
    const userId = String(currentUser.id || "").toLowerCase().trim();
    const userPartySet = new Set(userParties);

    const hasUserPartyMatch = (partyStr: string | undefined) => {
      if (!partyStr) return false;
      const pPartyList = partyStr.toLowerCase().split(/[,;/+]+/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      return pPartyList.some((party) => userPartySet.has(party) || party === username || party === userId);
    };

    // 2. Filter enrichedProjects with O(1) task lookup
    const allowedStores = getUserAllowedStores(currentUser);
    const enrichedProjects = enriched.filter((p) => {
      // Store check
      const store = String(p.store || "").toUpperCase().trim();
      let hasStorePerm = allowedStores.includes(store);
      if (!hasStorePerm && (store === "HCM" || store === "HN")) {
        hasStorePerm = allowedStores.includes(store);
      } else if (!hasStorePerm && store !== "HCM" && store !== "HN") {
        hasStorePerm = allowedStores.length >= 2;
      }

      // Location check (Dynamic)
      const loc = String(p.location || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      let permLoc = loc;
      if (["md-b1", "md-l1", "md-l2", "md-l3", "md-l4"].includes(permLoc)) {
        permLoc = permLoc.replace("md-", "");
      }
      const isStorewideLoc = loc === 'store' || loc === 'all' || loc === 'storewide' || loc === 'whole store' || loc === 'all floors';
      const hasLocPerm =
        currentUser.locationPermissions?.all ||
        isStorewideLoc ||
        (currentUser.locationPermissions?.[permLoc] ?? false);

      // Party check for project
      const pMatch = hasUserPartyMatch(p.party);

      const pCodeParts = String(p.code || "").toLowerCase().split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const pYear = p.year !== undefined && p.year !== null ? String(p.year).trim() : '';
      const pStore = p.store ? String(p.store).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

      let tMatch = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < pCodeParts.length; i++) {
        const candidateTasks = tasksByCodeMap.get(pCodeParts[i]);
        if (candidateTasks) {
          for (let j = 0; j < candidateTasks.length; j++) {
            const t = candidateTasks[j];
            const tStore = t.projectStore ? String(t.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
            if (pStore && tStore && pStore !== tStore) continue;
            const tYear = t.projectYear !== undefined && t.projectYear !== null ? String(t.projectYear).trim() : '';
            if (pYear && tYear && pYear !== tYear) continue;

            if (hasUserPartyMatch(t.party)) {
              tMatch = true;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if (tMatch) break;
      }

      // Mandatory Store & Location permission checks
      if (!hasStorePerm || !hasLocPerm) {
        return false;
      }

      // If By-Party Access is enabled for user, require party match
      if (currentUser.byPartyAccess === true && currentUser.partyPermissions?.['all'] !== true) {
        return pMatch || tMatch;
      }

      return true;
    });

    // 3. Pre-index visible projects into O(1) set & map for fast task filtering
    const visibleProjectKeys = new Set<string>();
    const projectPartyByCodeKeyMap = new Map<string, string>();

    enrichedProjects.forEach((p) => {
      const pYear = String(p.year || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      const pStore = String(p.store || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      const rawCode = String(p.code || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      
      visibleProjectKeys.add(`${rawCode}_${pYear}_${pStore}`);
      projectPartyByCodeKeyMap.set(`${rawCode}_${pYear}_${pStore}`, String(p.party || ''));

      const pCodeParts = rawCode.split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      pCodeParts.forEach(part => {
        visibleProjectKeys.add(`${part}_${pYear}_${pStore}`);
        projectPartyByCodeKeyMap.set(`${part}_${pYear}_${pStore}`, String(p.party || ''));
      });

      if (p.linkCodes) {
        const linkParts = String(p.linkCodes).toLowerCase().split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        linkParts.forEach(part => {
          visibleProjectKeys.add(`${part}_${pYear}_${pStore}`);
          projectPartyByCodeKeyMap.set(`${part}_${pYear}_${pStore}`, String(p.party || ''));
        });
      }
    });

    let filteredTasks = tasks.filter((t) => {
      if (!t || t.isDeleted) return false;
      const taskCode = String(t.projectCode || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      const taskYear = String(t.projectYear || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      const taskStore = String(t.projectStore || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      const taskKey = `${taskCode}_${taskYear}_${taskStore}`;

      if (visibleProjectKeys.has(taskKey)) return true;

      return enrichedProjects.some(p => {
        const pStore = String(p.store || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        const pYear = String(p.year || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        if (taskStore && pStore && taskStore !== pStore) return false;
        if (taskYear && pYear && taskYear !== pYear) return false;

        if (t.projectId && p.id && String(p.id) === String(t.projectId)) return true;

        const pCode = String(p.code || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        return pCode && pCode === taskCode;
      });
    });

    if (currentUser.byPartyAccess === true && currentUser.partyPermissions?.['all'] !== true) {
      filteredTasks = filteredTasks.filter((t) => {
        const taskCode = String(t.projectCode || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        const taskYear = String(t.projectYear || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        const taskStore = String(t.projectStore || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        const taskKey = `${taskCode}_${taskYear}_${taskStore}`;

        const projectParty = projectPartyByCodeKeyMap.get(taskKey) || '';
        const pMatch = hasUserPartyMatch(projectParty);
        const tMatch = hasUserPartyMatch(t.party);

        return pMatch || tMatch;
      });
    }

    // Consolidate virtual tasks from p.taskSummaries ONLY when a project has NO real tasks in memory yet (lazy loading placeholder)
    const allExistingIds = new Set(filteredTasks.map(t => t.id));
    enrichedProjects.forEach(p => {
      if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
        const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const pYear = String(p.year || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toLowerCase();

        // Check if real tasks exist in memory for this project
        const projectTasks = filteredTasks.filter(ft => {
          if (!ft || ft.isDeleted) return false;
          const ftCode = String(ft.projectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          const ftStore = ft.projectStore ? String(ft.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
          const ftYear = ft.projectYear !== undefined && ft.projectYear !== null ? String(ft.projectYear).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

          if (pStore && ftStore && pStore !== ftStore) return false;
          if (pYear && ftYear && pYear !== ftYear) return false;

          if (ft.projectId && p.id && String(ft.projectId) === String(p.id)) return true;
          if (ft.projectId && p.id && String(ft.projectId) !== String(p.id)) return false;
          return Boolean(ftCode && pCode && ftCode === pCode);
        });

        // Consolidate virtual tasks from p.taskSummaries when in-memory tasks are missing or partial
        if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > projectTasks.length) {
          const existingSet = new Set<string>();
          projectTasks.forEach(ft => {
            if (ft.id) existingSet.add(String(ft.id).toLowerCase());
            if (ft.taskCodePhu) existingSet.add(String(ft.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
            if (ft.name) existingSet.add(String(ft.name).trim().toLowerCase());
          });

          p.taskSummaries.forEach((ts, idx) => {
            const tsId = ts.id || `ts_${p.code || p.id}_${p.store || 'HCM'}_${p.year || ''}_${idx}`;
            const tsCode = ts.taskCodePhu ? String(ts.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
            const tsName = ts.name ? String(ts.name).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

            if (isTaskDeletedInTracker(ts.id, ts.taskCodePhu, ts.name)) {
              return;
            }

            const hasMatch = (ts.id && existingSet.has(String(ts.id).toLowerCase())) ||
                             (tsCode && existingSet.has(tsCode)) ||
                             (tsName && existingSet.has(tsName));

            if (!hasMatch && !allExistingIds.has(tsId)) {
              allExistingIds.add(tsId);
              const vTask = {
                id: tsId,
                name: ts.name || `Task ${idx + 1}`,
                start: ts.start || p.computedTakStart || p.start || '',
                finish: ts.finish || p.computedTakCompl || p.handover || '',
                projectCode: p.code || '',
                projectStore: p.store || 'HCM',
                projectYear: p.year ? String(p.year) : '',
                party: ts.party || p.party || '',
                runningStatus: ts.runningStatus || 'On process',
                duration: ts.duration || '',
                parentTaskId: ts.parentTaskId,
                taskCodePhu: ts.taskCodePhu || (p.code ? `${p.code}#${idx + 1}` : undefined),
                orderIndex: ts.orderIndex !== undefined ? ts.orderIndex : idx,
                projectId: p.id,
                ...ts
              } as Task;
              filteredTasks.push(vTask);
            }
          });
        }
      }
    });

    // 4. Filter visibleDelegationGroups
    const visibleDelegationGroups = delegationGroups.filter((group) => {
      const isCreator = group.createdBy === currentUser.id;
      const isSubTaskInvolved = group.subTasks?.some(
        (st) =>
          st.createdBy === currentUser.id ||
          (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id)),
      );
      const groupHasParty = group.subTasks?.some((st) => {
        const pPartyList = String(st.party || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .split(",")
          .map((s) => s.trim())
          .filter(Boolean);
        if (userPartySet.has("all")) {
          return true;
        }
        return (
          pPartyList.some((p) => userPartySet.has(p)) ||
          pPartyList.includes(username)
        );
      });
      return isCreator || isSubTaskInvolved || groupHasParty;
    });

    const res = { enrichedProjects, filteredTasks, visibleDelegationGroups };
    _lastProjectsRef = projects;
    _lastRawTasksRef = rawTasks;
    _lastDelegationGroupsRef = delegationGroups;
    _lastCurrentUserRef = currentUser;
    _lastEnrichedResult = res;
    return res;
  }, [projects, rawTasks, delegationGroups, currentUser]);
}

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useAppStore } from "../store/useAppStore";
import { getUserAllowedStores } from "../lib/utils";
import { useProjectsHydration } from "./useFirebaseDataParts/useProjectsHydration";
import { useTasksHydration } from "./useFirebaseDataParts/useTasksHydration";
import { useCostsHydration } from "./useFirebaseDataParts/useCostsHydration";
import { useDelegationsHydration } from "./useFirebaseDataParts/useDelegationsHydration";
import { useStaticAndAuthHydration } from "./useFirebaseDataParts/useStaticAndAuthHydration";

export function useFirebaseData() {
  const user = useAppStore((state) => state.user);
  const currentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.currentUser);

  const userCanSee = currentUser?.role === "admin" || !!currentUser?.canSee;
  const userRole = currentUser?.role;

  const allowedStores = useMemo(
    () => getUserAllowedStores(currentUser),
    [currentUser]
  );

  // Stable Query Signature
  const querySignature = useMemo(() => {
    if (!user?.uid || !userCanSee) return null;
    return `${user.uid}_${userRole}_${allowedStores.slice().sort().join("-")}`;
  }, [user?.uid, userCanSee, userRole, allowedStores]);

  // Sub-hook 1: Auth, Static Configs, Offline Queue & Sleep/Wake Guard
  useStaticAndAuthHydration();

  // Sub-hook 2: Projects Delta Sync & Local Hydration
  useProjectsHydration({ querySignature, userRole, allowedStores });

  // Sub-hook 3: Tasks Delta Sync & Local Hydration
  useTasksHydration({ querySignature, userRole, allowedStores });

  // Sub-hook 4: Costs Delta Sync & Local Hydration
  useCostsHydration({ querySignature, userRole, allowedStores });

  // Sub-hook 5: Delegation Groups Delta Sync & Local Hydration
  useDelegationsHydration({ querySignature, userRole, allowedStores });
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useFirebaseDataParts/firebaseQueryHelpers.ts ===
import { query, where } from "firebase/firestore";

export function buildStoreAndYearQuery(
  colRef: any,
  storeField: string,
  yearField: string,
  yearValue: string,
  userRole?: string,
  allowedStores: string[] = []
) {
  let q = colRef;

  // 1. Year Filter
  if (yearValue && String(yearValue).toLowerCase() !== "all") {
    q = query(q, where(yearField, "in", [String(yearValue), Number(yearValue)]));
  }

  // 2. Store Filter
  if (userRole !== "admin") {
    if (allowedStores.length === 0) {
      q = query(q, where(storeField, "==", "NONE_NO_ACCESS"));
    } else if (allowedStores.length === 1) {
      const singleStore = allowedStores[0];
      q = query(q, where(storeField, "in", [singleStore, singleStore.toLowerCase()]));
    }
  }

  return q;
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useFirebaseDataParts/tasksHydrationHelpers.ts ===
import { Task, Project } from "../../types";

/**
 * Checks if incoming doc from Firestore/cache is staler than existing local doc in memory.
 */
export function isStaleCacheDoc(existingDoc: Task | undefined, newDoc: Task): boolean {
  if (!existingDoc) return false;
  if (!existingDoc.updatedAt || !newDoc.updatedAt) return false;
  try {
    const existingTime = new Date(existingDoc.updatedAt).getTime();
    const newTime = new Date(newDoc.updatedAt).getTime();
    if (isNaN(existingTime) || isNaN(newTime)) return false;
    return existingTime > newTime;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Extracts set of project keys/codes to hydrate from active project IDs.
 */
export function extractKeysToHydrate(activeProjectIds: string[], projects: Project[]): Set<string> {
  const keys = new Set<string>();
  if (!Array.isArray(activeProjectIds) || activeProjectIds.length === 0) return keys;

  const idSet = new Set(activeProjectIds.map(id => String(id)));

  (projects || []).forEach((p) => {
    if (!p) return;
    const pId = String(p.id || '');
    const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim();
    if (idSet.has(pId) || idSet.has(pCode)) {
      if (pCode) keys.add(pCode);
      if (p.linkCodes) {
        p.linkCodes.split(/[,;/]+/).forEach(c => {
          const trimmed = c.trim();
          if (trimmed) keys.add(trimmed);
        });
      }
    }
  });

  // Also include raw IDs if no project matched
  activeProjectIds.forEach(id => keys.add(String(id)));

  return keys;
}

/**
 * Groups active projects by year string.
 */
export function groupActiveProjectsByYear(
  activeProjectIds: string[],
  projects: Project[],
  globalYearFilter?: string
): Map<string, Project[]> {
  const map = new Map<string, Project[]>();
  if (!Array.isArray(projects)) return map;

  const activeIdSet = new Set(activeProjectIds.map(id => String(id)));

  projects.forEach((p) => {
    if (!p) return;
    const pId = String(p.id || '');
    const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim();

    if (activeIdSet.has(pId) || activeIdSet.has(pCode)) {
      const year = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (globalYearFilter || '2026');
      const list = map.get(year) || [];
      list.push(p);
      map.set(year, list);
    }
  });

  return map;
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useFirebaseDataParts/useCostsHydration.ts ===
import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { collection, onSnapshot, getDocsFromCache, getDocsFromServer } from "firebase/firestore";
import { useAppStore } from "../../store/useAppStore";
import { usePerformanceStore } from "../../store/usePerformanceStore";
import { db, APP_ID } from "../../lib/firebase";
import { Cost } from "../../types";
import { PRIMARY_ACTIVE_YEARS, SECONDARY_ACTIVE_YEARS } from "../../lib/utils";
import { buildStoreAndYearQuery } from "./firebaseQueryHelpers";
import { hydrateCostsFromLocal, offloadPersistSnapshot } from "../../lib/backgroundSyncWorker";
import { deleteLocalRecord } from "../../lib/localDb";
import { pullAndApplyDeltas } from "../../lib/deltaSyncService";
import { getLoadedMarkers, hasMarker, markLoaded } from "../../lib/loadedMarkers";

// Delta-first: sau lần tải đầy đủ đầu tiên, hủy onSnapshot lớn, dựa vào Dexie + kênh delta.
// Bật TỪNG CÁI sau khi đã test. Mặc định tắt = hành vi hiện tại.
const DELTA_FIRST = { projects: false, tasks: false, costs: false, delegations: false };


interface UseCostsHydrationProps {
  querySignature: string | null;
  userRole?: string;
  allowedStores: string[];
}

const TTL_DURATION_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000; // 15 minutes

// Chuyển updatedAt (ISO string / Firestore Timestamp / number) về ms
const tsOf = (v: any): number => {
  if (!v) return 0;
  const n =
    typeof v === "string" ? Date.parse(v)
    : typeof v?.toMillis === "function" ? v.toMillis()
    : Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
};
// Snapshot lấy từ cache cục bộ có thể cũ hơn dữ liệu đã nhận qua delta -> không cho ghi đè.
// Chỉ áp dụng cho snapshot fromCache; snapshot từ server luôn được tin (tránh lệch đồng hồ)
const isStaleCacheDoc = (existing: any, incoming: any): boolean => {
  if (!existing) return false;
  const e = tsOf(existing.updatedAt);
  const i = tsOf(incoming?.updatedAt);
  return e > 0 && i > 0 && i < e;
};

export function useCostsHydration({
  querySignature,
  userRole,
  allowedStores,
}: UseCostsHydrationProps) {
  const isCostsRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.isCostsRequested);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setIsCostsLoading = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsCostsLoading);
  const setCloudStatus = useAppStore((state) => state.setCloudStatus);

  const costsPool = useRef<Map<string, () => void>>(new Map());
  const costsTTLTimeouts = useRef<Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>>(new Map());
  const prevSigCosts = useRef<string>("");

  // Atomic batching buffers for Costs updates
  const pendingCostsMap = useRef<Map<string, Cost> | null>(null);
  const pendingCostsChanged = useRef<Map<string, Cost>>(new Map());
  const pendingCostsRemoved = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const costsBatchTimer = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const batchCostsUpdate = useCallback((docChanges: any[], fromCache: boolean = false) => {
    if (!pendingCostsMap.current) {
      const currentCosts = useAppStore.getState().costs || [];
      const map = new Map<string, Cost>();
      currentCosts.forEach((c) => map.set(c.id, c));
      pendingCostsMap.current = map;
    }

    docChanges.forEach((change) => {
      const id = change.doc.id;
      const rawDocData = change.doc.data();
      const data = { id, ...rawDocData } as Cost;
      const isTrueDelete = Boolean(data.isDeleted || (change.type === "removed" && (!rawDocData || rawDocData.isDeleted === true)));

      if (isTrueDelete) {
        pendingCostsMap.current!.delete(id);
        pendingCostsChanged.current.delete(id);
        pendingCostsRemoved.current.add(id);
      } else if (change.type === "removed") {
        // Doc left sub-query scope — do NOT delete from Dexie
      } else {
        if (fromCache && isStaleCacheDoc(pendingCostsMap.current!.get(id), data)) return;
        pendingCostsMap.current!.set(id, data);
        pendingCostsChanged.current.set(id, data);
        pendingCostsRemoved.current.delete(id);
      }
    });

    if (costsBatchTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(costsBatchTimer.current);
    }

    costsBatchTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      if (pendingCostsMap.current) {
        const updatedList = Array.from(pendingCostsMap.current.values());
        useAppStore.getState().setCosts(updatedList);
        
        const changed = Array.from(pendingCostsChanged.current.values());
        const removed = Array.from(pendingCostsRemoved.current);
        pendingCostsChanged.current.clear();
        pendingCostsRemoved.current.clear();
        
        if (changed.length > 0) offloadPersistSnapshot('taka_costs', changed);
        removed.forEach((id) => { deleteLocalRecord('taka_costs', id).catch(() => {}); });
        
        pendingCostsMap.current = null;
      }
    }, 80);
  }, []);

  // Sleep/Wake Recovery Listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleSleepWakeRecovery = () => {
      // 1. KHÔNG hủy listener khi thức giấc.
      
      if (useAppStore.getState().isCostsRequested) {
        hydrateCostsFromLocal(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter).catch(() => {});
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("taka_sleep_wake_recovery", handleSleepWakeRecovery);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("taka_sleep_wake_recovery", handleSleepWakeRecovery);
    };
  }, []);

  // Cleanup on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      costsPool.current.forEach((u) => u());
      costsPool.current.clear();
      costsTTLTimeouts.current.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t));
      costsTTLTimeouts.current.clear();
      if (costsBatchTimer.current) clearTimeout(costsBatchTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!querySignature || !isCostsRequested) {
      if (!isCostsRequested) {
        setIsCostsLoading(false);
        Array.from(costsPool.current.keys()).forEach((key) => {
          if (!costsTTLTimeouts.current.has(key)) {
            const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
              const unsub = costsPool.current.get(key);
              if (unsub) unsub();
              costsPool.current.delete(key);
              costsTTLTimeouts.current.delete(key);
              usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_costs_${key}`);
            }, TTL_DURATION_MS);
            costsTTLTimeouts.current.set(key, timeoutId);
          }
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    costsTTLTimeouts.current.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t));
    costsTTLTimeouts.current.clear();

    if (prevSigCosts.current !== querySignature) {
      costsPool.current.forEach((u) => u());
      costsPool.current.clear();
      prevSigCosts.current = querySignature;
    }

    const isAllYears = globalYearFilter === "all" || globalYearFilter === "ALL";
    const liveTargetYears = isAllYears ? PRIMARY_ACTIVE_YEARS : [globalYearFilter];

    setIsCostsLoading(true);

    liveTargetYears.forEach(async (year) => {
      if (!costsPool.current.has(year)) {
        const localCount = await hydrateCostsFromLocal(year);
        const currentCosts = useAppStore.getState().costs || [];
        const hasLocalCosts =
          localCount > 0 || currentCosts.some((c) => String(c.projectYear || "") === String(year));
        const isClosedOrPastYear = Number(year) < 2026;

        const deltaManaged =
          (hasLocalCosts && isClosedOrPastYear) ||
          (DELTA_FIRST.costs && hasMarker(await getLoadedMarkers(), 'costs_year', year));
        if (deltaManaged) {
          costsPool.current.set(year, () => {});
          setIsCostsLoading(false);
          pullAndApplyDeltas(year)
            .then(() => setCloudStatus("online"))
            .catch(() => {});
          usePerformanceStore
            .getState()
            .trackGetDoc(
              `taka_costs_${year}`,
              true,
              localCount,
              "Dexie Local-First Costs (0 Read full collection)"
            );
          return;
        } else {
          const colRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_costs");
          const qCosts = buildStoreAndYearQuery(
            colRef,
            "projectStore",
            "projectYear",
            year,
            userRole,
            allowedStores
          );

          usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener(`taka_costs_${year}`);
          const unsub = onSnapshot(
            qCosts,
            (snapshot) => {
              usePerformanceStore.getState().trackSnapshot(`taka_costs_${year}`, snapshot);
              setIsCostsLoading(false);
              const fromCache = snapshot.metadata.fromCache;
              batchCostsUpdate(snapshot.docChanges(), fromCache);

              if (DELTA_FIRST.costs && !fromCache) {
                markLoaded('costs_year', year).catch(() => {});
                const u = costsPool.current.get(year);
                costsPool.current.set(year, () => {});
                u?.();
                usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_costs_${year}`);
              }
            },
            (e) => {
              setIsCostsLoading(false);
              console.error("Costs listener error:", e);
            }
          );
          costsPool.current.set(year, unsub);
        }
      } else {
        setIsCostsLoading(false);
      }
    });

    if (isAllYears) {
      SECONDARY_ACTIVE_YEARS.forEach(async (year) => {
        if (costsPool.current.has(year)) return;
        try {
          const colRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_costs");
          const qCosts = buildStoreAndYearQuery(
            colRef,
            "projectStore",
            "projectYear",
            year,
            userRole,
            allowedStores
          );
          let snapshot;
          try {
            snapshot = await getDocsFromCache(qCosts);
            if (snapshot.empty) {
              snapshot = await getDocsFromServer(qCosts);
            }
          } catch {
            snapshot = await getDocsFromServer(qCosts);
          }

          if (snapshot && !snapshot.empty) {
            const liveCosts = useAppStore.getState().costs || [];
            const costMap = new Map<string, Cost>();
            liveCosts.forEach((c) => costMap.set(c.id, c));

            snapshot.forEach((docSnap) => {
              const data = { id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() } as Cost;
              if (!data.isDeleted) {
                costMap.set(docSnap.id, data);
              }
            });

            const updatedList = Array.from(costMap.values());
            useAppStore.getState().setCosts(updatedList);
          }
        } catch {}
      });
    }
  }, [
    querySignature,
    userRole,
    allowedStores,
    isCostsRequested,
    globalYearFilter,
    setIsCostsLoading,
    setCloudStatus,
  ]);
}

export function useDelegationsHydration({
  querySignature,
  userRole,
  allowedStores,
}: UseDelegationsHydrationProps) {
  const isDelegationsRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.isDelegationsRequested);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setIsDelegationsLoading = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsDelegationsLoading);
  const setCloudStatus = useAppStore((state) => state.setCloudStatus);

  const delegationsTTLTimeouts = useRef<Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>>(new Map());
  const yearDelegationsCache = useRef<Map<string, Map<string, DelegationGroup>>>(new Map());

  const pendingDelegationsRemoved = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const delegationsBatchTimer = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

        pendingDelegationsMap.current!.set(id, data);
        pendingDelegationsChanged.current.set(id, data);
        pendingDelegationsRemoved.current.delete(id);

        if (changed.length > 0) offloadPersistSnapshot('taka_delegations', changed);
        removed.forEach((id) => { deleteLocalRecord('taka_delegations', id).catch(() => {}); });
        
        pendingDelegationsMap.current = null;
      }
    }, 100);
  }, []);

  // Sleep/Wake Recovery Listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleSleepWakeRecovery = () => {
      // KHÔNG hủy listener và KHÔNG xóa cache năm khi thức giấc (xem giải thích ở B1).
      if (useAppStore.getState().isDelegationsRequested) {
        hydrateDelegationsFromLocal(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter).catch(() => {});
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("taka_sleep_wake_recovery", handleSleepWakeRecovery);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("taka_sleep_wake_recovery", handleSleepWakeRecovery);
    };
  }, []);

  // Cleanup on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      delegationsPool.current.forEach((u) => u());
      delegationsPool.current.clear();
      delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t));
      delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.clear();
      yearDelegationsCache.current.clear();
      if (delegationsBatchTimer.current) clearTimeout(delegationsBatchTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!querySignature) return;

    const isAllYears = globalYearFilter === "all" || globalYearFilter === "ALL";
    const targetYears = isDelegationsRequested
      ? isAllYears
        ? PRIMARY_ACTIVE_YEARS
        : [globalYearFilter]
      : [];
    const currentSig = `${querySignature}_${targetYears.join(",")}_${isDelegationsRequested}`;

    if (prevQuerySigDelegations.current !== querySignature) {
      if (prevQuerySigDelegations.current !== "") {
        delegationsPool.current.forEach((u) => u());
        delegationsPool.current.clear();
        delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t));
        delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.clear();
        yearDelegationsCache.current.clear();
      }
      prevQuerySigDelegations.current = querySignature;
    }
    prevSigDelegations.current = currentSig;

    const activeYearsSet = new Set(targetYears);
    Array.from(delegationsPool.current.keys()).forEach((year) => {
      if (!activeYearsSet.has(year)) {
        if (!delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.has(year)) {
          const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
            const unsub = delegationsPool.current.get(year);
            if (unsub) unsub();
            delegationsPool.current.delete(year);
            delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.delete(year);
            yearDelegationsCache.current.delete(year);
            usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_delegation_groups_${year}`);
            if (
              delegationsPool.current.size === 0 &&
              !useAppStore.getState().isDelegationsRequested
            ) {
              useAppStore.getState().setDelegationGroups([]);
            }
          }, TTL_DURATION_MS);
          delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.set(year, timeoutId);
        }
      } else {
        if (delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.has(year)) {
          clearTimeout(delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.get(year)!);
          delegationsTTLTimeouts.current.delete(year);
        }
      }
    });

    if (targetYears.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    setIsDelegationsLoading(true);

    targetYears.forEach(async (year) => {
      if (!delegationsPool.current.has(year)) {
        const localCount = await hydrateDelegationsFromLocal(year);
        const isClosedOrPastYear = Number(year) < 2026;
        const currentDelegations = useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups || [];
        const hasLocalDelegations =
          localCount > 0 ||
          currentDelegations.some((d) => String(d.projectYear || "") === String(year));

        const deltaManaged =
          (hasLocalDelegations && isClosedOrPastYear) ||
          (DELTA_FIRST.delegations && hasMarker(await getLoadedMarkers(), 'delegations_year', year));
        if (deltaManaged) {
          delegationsPool.current.set(year, () => {});
          setIsDelegationsLoading(false);
          pullAndApplyDeltas(year)
            .then(() => setCloudStatus("online"))
            .catch(() => {});
          usePerformanceStore
            .getState()
            .trackGetDoc(
              `taka_delegation_groups_${year}`,
              true,
              localCount,
              "Dexie Local-First Delegations (0 Read full collection)"
            );
          return;
        }

        delegationsPool.current.set(year, () => {});
        setIsDelegationsLoading(false);

        if (!yearDelegationsCache.current.has(year)) {
          yearDelegationsCache.current.set(year, new Map());
        }
        const yearMap = yearDelegationsCache.current.get(year)!;
        if (localCount > 0) {
          const localItems = await getLocalDelegations(year);
          localItems.forEach((d) => {
            if (d.id) yearMap.set(d.id, d);
          });
          pullAndApplyDeltas(year)
            .then(() => setCloudStatus("online"))
            .catch(() => {});
        }

        const colRef = collection(
          db,
          "artifacts",
          APP_ID,
          "public",
          "data",
          "taka_delegation_groups"
        );
        const qDelegations = buildStoreAndYearQuery(
          colRef,
          "projectStore",
          "projectYear",
          year,
          userRole,
          allowedStores
        );

        usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener(`taka_delegation_groups_${year}`);
        const unsub = onSnapshot(
          qDelegations,
          (snapshot) => {
            usePerformanceStore
              .getState()
              .trackSnapshot(`taka_delegation_groups_${year}`, snapshot);
            setIsDelegationsLoading(false);
            batchDelegationsUpdate(snapshot.docChanges(), snapshot.metadata.fromCache);

            if (DELTA_FIRST.delegations && !snapshot.metadata.fromCache) {
              markLoaded('delegations_year', year).catch(() => {});
              const u = delegationsPool.current.get(year);
              delegationsPool.current.set(year, () => {});
              u?.();
              usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_delegation_groups_${year}`);
            }
          },
          (e) => {
            delegationsPool.current.delete(year);
            setIsDelegationsLoading(false);
            console.error("Delegation groups listener error:", e);
          }
        );
        delegationsPool.current.set(year, unsub);
      }
    });
  }, [
    querySignature,
    userRole,
    allowedStores,
    isDelegationsRequested,
    globalYearFilter,
    setIsDelegationsLoading,
    setCloudStatus,
  ]);
}
