import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { collection, onSnapshot, getDocsFromCache, getDocsFromServer } from "firebase/firestore";
import { useAppStore } from "../../store/useAppStore";
import { usePerformanceStore } from "../../store/usePerformanceStore";
import { db, APP_ID } from "../../lib/firebase";
import { Project } from "../../types";
import { PRIMARY_ACTIVE_YEARS, SECONDARY_ACTIVE_YEARS } from "../../lib/utils";
import { buildStoreAndYearQuery } from "./firebaseQueryHelpers";
import {
  bootstrapLocalStore,
  offloadPersistSnapshot,
  hydrateProjectsFromLocal,
} from "../../lib/backgroundSyncWorker";
import { deleteLocalRecord } from "../../lib/localDb";
import {
  fetchYearsMeta,
  setMemoryYearsMeta,
  isYearCacheValid,
  loadYearDataFromLocal,
  saveYearDataToLocal,
  YearsMetaMap,
} from "../../lib/yearsFingerprintService";
import { startDeltaSyncService, pullAndApplyDeltas } from "../../lib/deltaSyncService";
import { getLoadedMarkers, hasMarker, markLoaded } from "../../lib/loadedMarkers";

// Delta-first: sau lần tải đầy đủ đầu tiên, hủy onSnapshot lớn, dựa vào Dexie + kênh delta.
// Bật TỪNG CÁI sau khi đã test. Mặc định tắt = hành vi hiện tại.
const DELTA_FIRST = { projects: false, tasks: false, costs: false, delegations: false };


interface UseProjectsHydrationProps {
  querySignature: string | null;
  userRole?: string;
  allowedStores: string[];
}

// Chuyển updatedAt (ISO string / Firestore Timestamp / number) về ms
const tsOf = (v: any): number => {
  if (!v) return 0;
  const n =
    typeof v === "string" ? Date.parse(v)
    : typeof v?.toMillis === "function" ? v.toMillis()
    : Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
};
// Snapshot lấy từ cache cục bộ có thể cũ hơn dữ liệu đã nhận qua delta -> không cho ghi đè.
// Chỉ áp dụng cho snapshot fromCache; snapshot từ server luôn được tin (tránh lệch đồng hồ)
const isStaleCacheDoc = (existing: any, incoming: any): boolean => {
  if (!existing) return false;
  const e = tsOf(existing.updatedAt);
  const i = tsOf(incoming?.updatedAt);
  return e > 0 && i > 0 && i < e;
};

export function useProjectsHydration({
  querySignature,
  userRole,
  allowedStores,
}: UseProjectsHydrationProps) {
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalYearFilter);
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const setCloudStatus = useAppStore((state) => state.setCloudStatus);

  const projectsPool = useRef<Map<string, () => void>>(new Map());
  const prevSigProjects = useRef<string>("");
  const remoteYearsMetaRef = useRef<YearsMetaMap>({});

  // Atomic batching buffers for Projects and Tasks updates to prevent JS main thread freezing
  const pendingProjectsMap = useRef<Map<string, Project> | null>(null);
  const pendingProjectsChanged = useRef<Map<string, Project>>(new Map());
  const pendingProjectsRemoved = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const projectsBatchTimer = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const batchProjectsUpdate = useCallback((docChanges: any[], fromCache: boolean = false) => {
    if (!pendingProjectsMap.current) {
      const currentProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
      const map = new Map<string, Project>();
      currentProjects.forEach(p => map.set(p.id, p));
      pendingProjectsMap.current = map;
    }

    docChanges.forEach((change) => {
      const id = change.doc.id;
      const rawDocData = change.doc.data();
      const data = { id, ...rawDocData } as Project;
      const isTrueDelete = Boolean(data.isDeleted || (change.type === "removed" && (!rawDocData || rawDocData.isDeleted === true)));

      if (isTrueDelete) {
        pendingProjectsMap.current!.delete(id);
        pendingProjectsChanged.current.delete(id);
        pendingProjectsRemoved.current.add(id);
      } else if (change.type === "removed") {
        // Doc left sub-query scope — do NOT delete from Dexie
      } else {
        if (fromCache && isStaleCacheDoc(pendingProjectsMap.current!.get(id), data)) return;
        const existing = pendingProjectsMap.current!.get(id);
        const resolvedData = existing ? {
          ...data,
          taskCount: data.taskCount !== undefined ? data.taskCount : (existing.taskCount ?? 0),
          taskSummaries: data.taskSummaries !== undefined ? data.taskSummaries : (existing.taskSummaries || []),
        } : data;
        pendingProjectsMap.current!.set(id, resolvedData);
        pendingProjectsChanged.current.set(id, resolvedData);
        pendingProjectsRemoved.current.delete(id);
      }
    });

    if (projectsBatchTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(projectsBatchTimer.current);
    }

    projectsBatchTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      if (pendingProjectsMap.current) {
        const updatedList = Array.from(pendingProjectsMap.current.values());
        updatedList.sort((a, b) => (a.no || 0) - (b.no || 0));
        useAppStore.getState().setProjects(updatedList);
        // Chỉ ghi Dexie phần thay đổi; xóa khỏi Dexie phần đã bị xóa (chống "sống lại")
        const changed = Array.from(pendingProjectsChanged.current.values());
        const removed = Array.from(pendingProjectsRemoved.current);
        pendingProjectsChanged.current.clear();
        pendingProjectsRemoved.current.clear();
        if (changed.length > 0) offloadPersistSnapshot('taka_projects', changed);
        removed.forEach((id) => { deleteLocalRecord('taka_projects', id).catch(() => {}); });
        const setNotifs = useAppStore.getState().setAllProjectsForNotifs;
        if (setNotifs) setNotifs(updatedList);
        pendingProjectsMap.current = null;
      }
    }, 40);
  }, []);

  // Stage 3 & Delta Pipeline Startup
  useEffect(() => {
    bootstrapLocalStore().catch(() => {});

    fetchYearsMeta().then((meta) => {
      remoteYearsMetaRef.current = meta;
      setMemoryYearsMeta(meta);
    });

    const stopDeltaSync = startDeltaSyncService();
    return () => {
      stopDeltaSync();
    };
  }, []);

  // Sleep/Wake Recovery Listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleSleepWakeRecovery = () => {
      // KHÔNG hủy listener khi thức giấc.
      // Hủy xong mà không effect nào tạo lại => mất realtime Projects, và bộ đếm activeListeners
      // không giảm => deltaInvalidateService tưởng doc đã có listener phủ rồi bỏ qua việc đọc lại.
      // Socket chết do iOS treo đã có initNetworkRecovery (syncResilience) xử lý.
      hydrateProjectsFromLocal(
        useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter,
        useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter
      ).catch(() => {});
    };

    window.addEventListener("taka_sleep_wake_recovery", handleSleepWakeRecovery);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("taka_sleep_wake_recovery", handleSleepWakeRecovery);
    };
  }, []);

  // Unmount cleanup
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      projectsPool.current.forEach((u) => u());
      projectsPool.current.clear();
      if (projectsBatchTimer.current) clearTimeout(projectsBatchTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Main Unified Global Delta Sync for Projects
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!querySignature) return;

    if (prevSigProjects.current !== querySignature) {
      projectsPool.current.forEach((u) => u());
      projectsPool.current.clear();
      prevSigProjects.current = querySignature;
    }

    const isAllYears = globalYearFilter === "all" || globalYearFilter === "ALL";
    const liveTargetYears = isAllYears ? PRIMARY_ACTIVE_YEARS : [globalYearFilter];

    liveTargetYears.forEach(async (year) => {
      if (!projectsPool.current.has(year)) {
        // Step 1: Instant Local-First Dexie Hydration (0ms, 0 Read)
        const localCount = await hydrateProjectsFromLocal(year, globalStoreFilter);

        const isClosedOrPastYear = Number(year) < 2026;
        const hasLocalData =
          localCount > 0 ||
          (useAppStore.getState().projects || []).some((p) => String(p.year) === String(year));

        const deltaManaged =
          (hasLocalData && isClosedOrPastYear) ||
          (DELTA_FIRST.projects && hasMarker(await getLoadedMarkers(), 'projects_year', year));
        if (deltaManaged) {
          projectsPool.current.set(year, () => {});
          pullAndApplyDeltas(year)
            .then(() => setCloudStatus("online"))
            .catch(() => {});
          usePerformanceStore
            .getState()
            .trackGetDoc(
              `taka_projects_${year}`,
              true,
              localCount,
              "Dexie Local-First Projects Hydration (0 Read full collection)"
            );
          return;
        }

        if (false && isClosedOrPastYear && isYearCacheValid(year, remoteYearsMetaRef.current)) {
          const cached = loadYearDataFromLocal(year);
          if (cached && cached.projects && cached.projects.length > 0) {
            batchProjectsUpdate(
              cached.projects.map((p) => ({
                type: "added",
                doc: { id: p.id, data: () => p },
              }))
            );
            usePerformanceStore
              .getState()
              .trackGetDoc(
                `taka_projects_${year}`,
                true,
                cached.projects.length,
                "Metadata Fingerprint Cache Hit"
              );
            projectsPool.current.set(year, () => {});
            return;
          }
        }

        const colRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_projects");
        const qProjects = buildStoreAndYearQuery(colRef, "store", "year", year, userRole, allowedStores);

        usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener(`taka_projects_${year}`);
        const unsub = onSnapshot(
          qProjects,
          (snapshot) => {
            usePerformanceStore.getState().trackSnapshot(`taka_projects_${year}`, snapshot);
            batchProjectsUpdate(snapshot.docChanges(), snapshot.metadata.fromCache);
            setCloudStatus("online");

            if (DELTA_FIRST.projects && !snapshot.metadata.fromCache) {
              markLoaded('projects_year', year).catch(() => {});
              const u = projectsPool.current.get(year);
              projectsPool.current.set(year, () => {});
              u?.();
              usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_projects_${year}`);
            }

            if (!snapshot.metadata.fromCache) {
              const yearProjects = snapshot.docs
                .map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() } as Project))
                .filter((p) => !p.isDeleted);
              if (yearProjects.length > 0) {
                const updatedAt = remoteYearsMetaRef.current[year]?.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString();
                saveYearDataToLocal(year, updatedAt, { projects: yearProjects });
                offloadPersistSnapshot("taka_projects", yearProjects);
              }
            }
          },
          (e) => {
            console.error("Projects listener error:", e);
            setCloudStatus("offline");
          }
        );
        projectsPool.current.set(year, unsub);
      }
    });

    if (isAllYears) {
      SECONDARY_ACTIVE_YEARS.forEach(async (year) => {
        if (projectsPool.current.has(year)) return;
        try {
          const colRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_projects");
          const qProjects = buildStoreAndYearQuery(colRef, "store", "year", year, userRole, allowedStores);
          let snapshot;
          try {
            snapshot = await getDocsFromCache(qProjects);
            if (snapshot.empty) {
              snapshot = await getDocsFromServer(qProjects);
            }
          } catch {
            snapshot = await getDocsFromServer(qProjects);
          }

          if (snapshot && !snapshot.empty) {
            const currentProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
            const projectMap = new Map<string, Project>();
            currentProjects.forEach((p) => projectMap.set(p.id, p));

            snapshot.forEach((docSnap) => {
              const data = { id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() } as Project;
              if (!data.isDeleted) {
                projectMap.set(docSnap.id, data);
              }
            });

            const updatedList = Array.from(projectMap.values());
            updatedList.sort((a, b) => (a.no || 0) - (b.no || 0));
            useAppStore.getState().setProjects(updatedList);
          }
        } catch {
          // Ignore cache misses
        }
      });
    }
  }, [querySignature, userRole, allowedStores, globalYearFilter, globalStoreFilter, batchProjectsUpdate, setCloudStatus]);
}

export function useStaticAndAuthHydration() {
  const setCurrentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.setCurrentUser);
  const setUser = useAppStore((state) => state.setUser);
  const setCloudStatus = useAppStore((state) => state.setCloudStatus);
  const setToast = useAppStore((state) => state.setToast);

  const activeTab = useAppStore((state) => state.activeTab);
  const isTaskModalOpen = useAppStore((state) => state.isTaskModalOpen);
  const isProjectModalOpen = useAppStore((state) => state.isProjectModalOpen);
  const modalInitialTab = useAppStore((state) => state.modalInitialTab);
  const setIsTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsTasksRequested);
  const setIsCostsRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsCostsRequested);
  const setIsDelegationsRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsDelegationsRequested);

  const user = useAppStore((state) => state.user);
  const appUsers = useAppStore((state) => state.appUsers);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalYearFilter);

  const lastActiveTimestampRef = useRef<number>(Date.now());

  // 1. Sleep / Wake Guard
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleSleepWake = () => {
      const isVisible = typeof document !== "undefined" && document.visibilityState === "visible";
      if (!isVisible) {
        lastActiveTimestampRef.current = Date.now();
        return;
      }

      const now = Date.now();
      const elapsedSleepMs = now - lastActiveTimestampRef.current;
      lastActiveTimestampRef.current = now;

      const IS_LONG_SLEEP = elapsedSleepMs > 10 * 60 * 1000; // > 10 min
      if (IS_LONG_SLEEP) {
        // Dispatch recovery event to sub-hooks
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("taka_sleep_wake_recovery", { detail: { elapsedSleepMs } })
        );

        // Check iOS 40MB storage budget and log audit
        enforceStorageBudget().catch(() => {});
        const sleepMinutes = Math.round(elapsedSleepMs / 60000);
        usePerformanceStore
          .getState()
          .trackGetDoc(
            "sleep_wake_recovery",
            true,
            0,
            `Awoke after ${sleepMinutes}m sleep - Zero Read Delta Sync bypass`
          );
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", handleSleepWake);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", handleSleepWake);
    window.addEventListener("focus", handleSleepWake);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", handleSleepWake);
      window.removeEventListener("pageshow", handleSleepWake);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", handleSleepWake);
    };
  }, []);

  // 2. Tri-Gate Lazy trigger & Visibility Tracker
  useEffect(() => {
    const evaluate = () => {
      const tabsRequiringTasks: TabId[] = [
        "gantt",
        "detail",
        "calendar",
        "taskDelegation",
        "taskDelegationCalendar",
      ];
      const isChatOnly = isProjectModalOpen && modalInitialTab === "chat";
      const isLayoutTab = activeTab === "layout";
      const needsTasks =
        tabsRequiringTasks.includes(activeTab) ||
        isTaskModalOpen ||
        (isProjectModalOpen && !isChatOnly && !isLayoutTab);

      const tabsRequiringCosts: TabId[] = ["cost", "budget"];
      const needsCosts =
        tabsRequiringCosts.includes(activeTab) ||
        (isProjectModalOpen && !isChatOnly && !isLayoutTab);

      const tabsRequiringDelegations: TabId[] = ["taskDelegation", "taskDelegationCalendar"];
      const needsDelegations = tabsRequiringDelegations.includes(activeTab);

      if (needsTasks) {
        setIsTasksRequested(true);
        hydrateTasksFromLocal(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter).catch(() => {});
      }
      if (needsCosts) {
        setIsCostsRequested(true);
        hydrateCostsFromLocal(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter).catch(() => {});
      }
      if (needsDelegations) {
        setIsDelegationsRequested(true);
        hydrateDelegationsFromLocal(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter).catch(() => {});
      } else {
        const store = useAppStore.getState();
        const openProjectKeys: string[] = [];
        if (store.editingProject?.id) openProjectKeys.push(store.editingProject.id);
        if (store.editingProject?.code) openProjectKeys.push(store.editingProject.code);
        if (store.editingTask?.projectId) openProjectKeys.push(store.editingTask.projectId);
        if (store.editingTask?.projectCode) openProjectKeys.push(store.editingTask.projectCode);
        if (openProjectKeys.length > 0) {
          hydrateDelegationsForProjects(openProjectKeys).catch(() => {});
        }
      }
    };

    evaluate();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", evaluate);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", evaluate);
    window.addEventListener("focus", evaluate);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", evaluate);
      window.removeEventListener("pageshow", evaluate);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", evaluate);
    };
  }, [
    activeTab,
    isTaskModalOpen,
    isProjectModalOpen,
    modalInitialTab,
    setIsTasksRequested,
    setIsCostsRequested,
    setIsDelegationsRequested,
  ]);

  // 3. Auth Effect
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedAuth = safeGetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1");
    if (savedAuth) {
      try {
        const parsedUser = JSON.parse(savedAuth);
        const localReadNotifsStr = safeGetItemLocal(`taka_read_notifs_${parsedUser.id}`);
        if (localReadNotifsStr) {
          const localReadNotifs = JSON.parse(localReadNotifsStr);
          if (Array.isArray(localReadNotifs)) {
            parsedUser.readNotifs = Array.from(
              new Set([...(parsedUser.readNotifs || []), ...localReadNotifs])
            );
          }
        }
        setCurrentUser(parsedUser);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Error parsing savedAuth", e);
      }
    } else {
      const guestReadNotifsStr = safeGetItemLocal("taka_read_notifs_guest");
      if (guestReadNotifsStr) {
        try {
          const guestRead = JSON.parse(guestReadNotifsStr);
          const cur = useAppStore.getState().currentUser;
          if (cur && cur.id === "guest" && Array.isArray(guestRead)) {
            setCurrentUser({ ...cur, readNotifs: guestRead });
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }

    let isMounted = true;
    const unsubAuth = onAuthStateChanged(auth, (u) => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      setUser(u);
    });

    if (!auth.currentUser) {
      signInAnonymously(auth).catch(console.error);
    }

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      unsubAuth();
    };
  }, [setCurrentUser, setUser]);

  // 4. Static / Global Config Data Fetch Effect & Offline Draft Sync
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.uid) return;

    const testConnection = async () => {
      try {
        const timeSinceBoot = Date.now() - FIREBASE_HOOK_BOOT_TIME;
        if (timeSinceBoot < 15000) {
          setTimeout(testConnection, 15000 - timeSinceBoot);
          return;
        }

        // Chỉ dùng MỘT bộ phát lại duy nhất (đối chiếu với bản trên server, bỏ lệnh cũ/không hợp lệ).
        const { synced, failed } = await processPendingSync();
        if (synced > 0) {
          setToast({
            title: "Sync Complete",
            message: `Đã đồng bộ ${synced} thay đổi offline lên server.`,
          });
        }
        if (failed > 0) setCloudStatus("offline");
      } catch (error) {
        setCloudStatus("offline");
        if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes("permission")) {
          setToast({
            title: "Authentication / Database Error",
            message: "Missing or insufficient permissions.",
          });
        }
      }
    };
    testConnection();
    window.addEventListener("online", testConnection);

    const unsubStaticConfig = setupStaticConfigSync();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("online", testConnection);
      unsubStaticConfig();
    };
  }, [user?.uid, setCloudStatus, setToast]);

  // 5. Sync Profile Effect
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!appUsers || appUsers.length === 0) return;
    const cur = useAppStore.getState().currentUser;
    if (cur && cur.id !== "guest") {
      const found = appUsers.find((u) => u.id === cur.id);
      if (found) {
        const localReadNotifsStr = safeGetItemLocal(`taka_read_notifs_${cur.id}`);
        let localReadNotifs: string[] = [];
        if (localReadNotifsStr) {
          try {
            localReadNotifs = JSON.parse(localReadNotifsStr);
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        const mergedReadNotifs = Array.from(
          new Set([...(found.readNotifs || []), ...(cur.readNotifs || []), ...localReadNotifs])
        );

        const hasChanged =
          cur.role !== found.role ||
          cur.username !== found.username ||
          cur.canSee !== found.canSee ||
          cur.canWrite !== found.canWrite ||
          cur.byPartyAccess !== found.byPartyAccess ||
          JSON.stringify(cur.storePermissions) !== JSON.stringify(found.storePermissions) ||
          JSON.stringify(cur.locationPermissions) !== JSON.stringify(found.locationPermissions) ||
          JSON.stringify(cur.partyPermissions) !== JSON.stringify(found.partyPermissions) ||
          JSON.stringify(cur.preferences) !== JSON.stringify(found.preferences);

        if (hasChanged) {
          const updated: AppUser = {
            ...cur,
            ...found,
            readNotifs: mergedReadNotifs,
          };
          setCurrentUser(updated);
          safeSetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1", JSON.stringify(updated));

          if (
            found.preferences?.defaultStore &&
            cur.preferences?.defaultStore !== found.preferences.defaultStore
          ) {
            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalStoreFilter(found.preferences.defaultStore);
          }
          if (
            found.preferences?.defaultYear &&
            cur.preferences?.defaultYear !== found.preferences.defaultYear
          ) {
            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(String(found.preferences.defaultYear));
          }
          if (
            found.preferences?.currency &&
            cur.preferences?.currency !== found.preferences.currency
          ) {
            useAppStore.getState().setCurrency(found.preferences.currency);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }, [appUsers, setCurrentUser]);

  // 6. Cold Storage Archive Fetcher
  useEffect(() => {
    if ((globalYearFilter !== "all" && globalYearFilter !== "ALL") || isArchiveLoaded) return;

    let isCancelled = false;

    const fetchArchive = async () => {
      try {
        const { getDownloadURL, ref } = await import("firebase/storage");
        const { storage } = await import("../../lib/firebase");

        const archiveRef = ref(storage, "archives/taka_archive.json");
        const url = await getDownloadURL(archiveRef);
        const res = await fetch(url);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Network response was not ok");
        const data = await res.json();

        if (isCancelled) return;

        const currentProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
        const newProjects = [...currentProjects];
        const pMap = new Map(newProjects.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
        (data.taka_projects || []).filter((p: any) => !p.isDeleted && p.year && Number(p.year) < 2024).forEach((p: any) => {
          if (!pMap.has(p.id)) pMap.set(p.id, p);
        });
        useAppStore.getState().setProjects(Array.from(pMap.values()));

        const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];
        const newTasks = [...currentTasks];
        const tMap = new Map(newTasks.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
        (data.taka_tasks || []).filter((t: any) => !t.isDeleted && t.projectYear && Number(t.projectYear) < 2024).forEach((t: any) => {
          if (!tMap.has(t.id)) tMap.set(t.id, t);
        });
        const rawLoadedTasks = Array.from(tMap.values());
        const { dedupedTasks } = deduplicateTasksInMemory(
          rawLoadedTasks,
          useAppStore.getState().projects
        );
        useAppStore.getState().setTasks(dedupedTasks);

        const currentCosts = useAppStore.getState().costs || [];
        const newCosts = [...currentCosts];
        const cMap = new Map(newCosts.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
        (data.taka_costs || []).filter((c: any) => !c.isDeleted && c.projectYear && Number(c.projectYear) < 2024).forEach((c: any) => {
          if (!cMap.has(c.id)) cMap.set(c.id, c);
        });
        useAppStore.getState().setCosts(Array.from(cMap.values()));

        const currentDelegations = useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups || [];
        const newDelegations = [...currentDelegations];
        const dMap = new Map(newDelegations.map((d) => [d.id!, d]));
        (data.taka_delegation_groups || []).filter((d: any) => !d.isDeleted && d.projectYear && Number(d.projectYear) < 2024).forEach((d: any) => {
          if (!dMap.has(d.id)) dMap.set(d.id, d);
        });
        useAppStore.getState().setDelegationGroups(Array.from(dMap.values()));

        isArchiveLoaded = true;
        console.log("Archive data successfully loaded into memory");
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("No archive data found or error fetching archive", err);
      }
    };

    fetchArchive();

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
    };
  }, [globalYearFilter]);
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { collection, onSnapshot, query, where } from "firebase/firestore";
import { useAppStore } from "../../store/useAppStore";
import { usePerformanceStore } from "../../store/usePerformanceStore";
import { db, APP_ID } from "../../lib/firebase";
import { Task } from "../../types";
import { buildStoreAndYearQuery } from "./firebaseQueryHelpers";
import {
  offloadPersistSnapshot,
  hydrateTasksFromLocal,
  hydrateTasksForProjects,
  hydrateDelegationsForProjects,
} from "../../lib/backgroundSyncWorker";
import { loadNotificationTasks } from "../../lib/notificationTaskService";
import { deduplicateTasksInMemory } from "../../lib/taskDeduplicationService";
import { cleanOrphanTasks } from "../../lib/taskStateService";
import { rollupParentTaskDatesAndStatus } from "../../lib/taskRollupService";
import { deleteLocalRecord } from "../../lib/localDb";
import { pullAndApplyDeltas } from "../../lib/deltaSyncService";
import { getLoadedMarkers, hasMarker, markLoaded } from "../../lib/loadedMarkers";
import { getAppBootAgeMs, BOOT_SYNC_GUARD_MS } from "../../lib/projectDatesService";
import { markTasksDeleted } from "../../lib/taskDeletedTracker";

// Delta-first: sau lần tải đầy đủ đầu tiên, hủy onSnapshot lớn, dựa vào Dexie + kênh delta.
// Bật TỪNG CÁI sau khi đã test. Mặc định tắt = hành vi hiện tại.
const DELTA_FIRST = { projects: false, tasks: false, costs: false, delegations: false };


interface UseTasksHydrationProps {
  querySignature: string | null;
  userRole?: string;
  allowedStores: string[];
}

const TTL_DURATION_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000; // 15 minutes

import { isStaleCacheDoc, extractKeysToHydrate, groupActiveProjectsByYear } from "./tasksHydrationHelpers";

export function useTasksHydration({
  querySignature,
  userRole,
  allowedStores,
}: UseTasksHydrationProps) {
  const isTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.isTasksRequested);
  const expandedProjectIds = useAppStore((state) => state.expandedProjectIds);
  const searchActiveProjectIds = useAppStore((state) => state.searchActiveProjectIds);
  const visibleActiveProjectIds = useAppStore((state) => state.visibleActiveProjectIds);
  const visibleActiveProjectIdsRef = useRef(visibleActiveProjectIds);
  visibleActiveProjectIdsRef.current = visibleActiveProjectIds;

  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setIsTasksLoading = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsTasksLoading);
  const setAllTasksForNotifs = useAppStore((state) => state.setAllTasksForNotifs);
  const setCloudStatus = useAppStore((state) => state.setCloudStatus);

  const tasksPool = useRef<Map<string, () => void>>(new Map());
  const tasksTTLTimeouts = useRef<Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>>(new Map());
  const knownHydratedProjectCodes = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const prevQuerySigTasks = useRef<string>("");
  const prevSigTasks = useRef<string>("");

  // Atomic batching buffers for Tasks updates
  const pendingTasksMap = useRef<Map<string, Task> | null>(null);
  const pendingTasksChanged = useRef<Map<string, Task>>(new Map());
  const pendingTasksRemoved = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const tasksBatchTimer = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const batchTasksUpdate = useCallback((docChanges: any[], fromCache: boolean = false) => {
    if (!pendingTasksMap.current) {
      const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];
      const map = new Map<string, Task>();
      currentTasks.forEach((t) => map.set(t.id, t));
      pendingTasksMap.current = map;
    }

    docChanges.forEach((change) => {
      const id = change.doc.id;
      const rawDocData = change.doc.data();
      const data = { id, ...rawDocData } as Task;
      const isTrueDelete = Boolean(data.isDeleted || (change.type === "removed" && (!rawDocData || rawDocData.isDeleted === true)));

      if (isTrueDelete) {
        markTasksDeleted([id, data.taskCodePhu, data.name]);
        pendingTasksMap.current!.delete(id);
        pendingTasksChanged.current.delete(id);
        pendingTasksRemoved.current.add(id);
      } else if (change.type === "removed") {
        // Doc left sub-query scope (e.g. year/project filter change) — do NOT add to pendingTasksRemoved (do NOT delete from Dexie)
      } else {
        if (fromCache && isStaleCacheDoc(pendingTasksMap.current!.get(id), data)) return;
        pendingTasksMap.current!.set(id, data);
        pendingTasksChanged.current.set(id, data);
        pendingTasksRemoved.current.delete(id);
      }
    });

    if (tasksBatchTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(tasksBatchTimer.current);
    }

    tasksBatchTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      if (pendingTasksMap.current) {
        const rawList = Array.from(pendingTasksMap.current.values());
        const projects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
        const { dedupedTasks } = deduplicateTasksInMemory(rawList, projects);
        const { cleaned: unrolledTasks } = cleanOrphanTasks(dedupedTasks);
        const rolledUpTasks = rollupParentTaskDatesAndStatus(unrolledTasks, useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups);
        rolledUpTasks.sort((a, b) => {
          if (a.projectCode !== b.projectCode) {
            return (a.projectCode || "").localeCompare(b.projectCode || "");
          }
          return (a.orderIndex || 0) - (b.orderIndex || 0);
        });
        const finalTasks = rolledUpTasks;
        useAppStore.getState().setTasks(finalTasks);
        
        // Self-healing an toàn:
        // - chỉ xét các dự án có task thay đổi trong lô này (không quét toàn bộ P x T)
        // - bỏ qua snapshot từ cache và 15 giây đầu sau khi mở app (dữ liệu cục bộ có thể cũ/thiếu)
        // - KHÔNG chữa theo hướng giảm: ít task hơn taskCount đã lưu nghĩa là có thể mới tải một phần
        if (!fromCache && getAppBootAgeMs() >= BOOT_SYNC_GUARD_MS && pendingTasksChanged.current.size > 0) {
          const touchedIds = new Set<string>();
          const touchedCodes = new Set<string>();
          pendingTasksChanged.current.forEach((t) => {
            if (t.projectId) touchedIds.add(String(t.projectId));
            if (t.projectCode) touchedCodes.add(String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase());
          });

          // Gom task theo dự án 1 lần: O(T)
          const byId = new Map<string, Task[]>();
          const byCode = new Map<string, Task[]>();
          finalTasks.forEach((t) => {
            if (t.projectId) {
              const k = String(t.projectId);
              const arr = byId.get(k);
              if (arr) arr.push(t);
              else byId.set(k, [t]);
            }
            if (t.projectCode) {
              const k = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase();
              const arr = byCode.get(k);
              if (arr) arr.push(t);
              else byCode.set(k, [t]);
            }
          });

          const currentProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
          let projectsNeedUpdate = false;
          const healedProjects = currentProjects.map((p) => {
            const codeKey = String(p.code || "").trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!touchedIds.has(String(p.id)) && !(codeKey && touchedCodes.has(codeKey))) return p;

            const merged = new Map<string, Task>();
            (byId.get(String(p.id)) || []).forEach((t) => merged.set(t.id, t));
            if (codeKey) (byCode.get(codeKey) || []).forEach((t) => merged.set(t.id, t));
            const pTasks = Array.from(merged.values());
            if (pTasks.length === 0) return p;

            // Có thể mới tải một phần task: không bao giờ ghi số liệu nhỏ hơn lên server
            if (pTasks.length < (p.taskCount || 0)) return p;

            const hasDiscrepancy =
              pTasks.length !== (p.taskCount || 0) ||
              !p.taskSummaries ||
              p.taskSummaries.length !== pTasks.length;
            if (!hasDiscrepancy) return p;

            projectsNeedUpdate = true;
            import("../../lib/projectDatesService")
              .then(({ calculateProjectComputedDates, syncProjectDatesToFirestore }) => {
                const computed = calculateProjectComputedDates(p, pTasks, useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups);
                syncProjectDatesToFirestore(p.id, computed).catch(() => {});
              })
              .catch(() => {});
            const summaryItems = pTasks.map((t) => ({
              id: t.id,
              name: t.name || "",
              start: t.start || "",
              finish: t.finish || "",
              taskCodePhu: t.taskCodePhu,
              duration: t.duration,
              runningStatus: t.runningStatus,
            }));
            const validStarts = pTasks.map((t) => t.start).filter(Boolean).sort();
            const validFinishes = pTasks.map((t) => t.finish).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));
            return {
              ...p,
              taskCount: pTasks.length,
              taskSummaries: summaryItems,
              computedTakStart: validStarts[0] || p.start || '',
              computedTakCompl: validFinishes[0] || p.handover || (p as any).takCompl || '',
            };
          });
          if (projectsNeedUpdate) {
            useAppStore.getState().setProjects(healedProjects);
          }
        }
        
        const finalIds = new Set(finalTasks.map(t => t.id));
        const changed = Array.from(pendingTasksChanged.current.values()).filter(t => finalIds.has(t.id));
        const removed = Array.from(pendingTasksRemoved.current);
        pendingTasksChanged.current.clear();
        pendingTasksRemoved.current.clear();
        if (changed.length > 0) offloadPersistSnapshot('taka_tasks', changed);
        removed.forEach((id) => { deleteLocalRecord('taka_tasks', id).catch(() => {}); });

        const setNotifs = useAppStore.getState().setAllTasksForNotifs;
        if (setNotifs) setNotifs(finalTasks);
        pendingTasksMap.current = null;
      }
    }, 200);
  }, []);

  // Sleep/Wake Recovery Listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleSleepWakeRecovery = () => {
      // 1. KHÔNG hủy listener khi thức giấc.
      // Hủy xong mà không effect nào tạo lại => mất realtime tasks/costs/delegations
      // Socket chết do iOS treo đã có initNetworkRecovery (syncResilience) xử lý bằng deltaResync
      
      if (useAppStore.getState().isTasksRequested) {
        hydrateTasksFromLocal(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter).catch(() => {});
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("taka_sleep_wake_recovery", handleSleepWakeRecovery);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("taka_sleep_wake_recovery", handleSleepWakeRecovery);
    };
  }, []);

  // Cleanup on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      tasksPool.current.forEach((u) => u());
      tasksPool.current.clear();
      tasksTTLTimeouts.current.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t));
      tasksTTLTimeouts.current.clear();
      if (tasksBatchTimer.current) clearTimeout(tasksBatchTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Lightweight Notification Query for Tasks (0 Read from Dexie with Safe Fallback)
  useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    let intervalId: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

    if (!querySignature || isTasksRequested) {
      return;
    }

    const fetchNotifs = async () => {
      if (isCancelled) return;
      try {
        const loadedNotifTasks = await loadNotificationTasks();
        if (isCancelled) return;
        setAllTasksForNotifs(loadedNotifTasks);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("[useTasksHydration] Notification lightweight tasks query error:", e);
      }
    };

    fetchNotifs();

    const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 4 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 4 hours
    intervalId = setInterval(fetchNotifs, POLL_INTERVAL_MS);

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      if (intervalId) clearInterval(intervalId);
    };
  }, [querySignature, isTasksRequested, setAllTasksForNotifs]);

  // Main Tasks Sync Logic
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!querySignature) return;

    const activeProjectIds = isTasksRequested
      ? [...new Set([...expandedProjectIds, ...searchActiveProjectIds])]
      : [];
    const currentSig = `${querySignature}_${activeProjectIds.join(",")}_${isTasksRequested}`;

    if (prevQuerySigTasks.current !== querySignature) {
      if (prevQuerySigTasks.current !== "") {
        tasksPool.current.forEach((u) => u());
        tasksPool.current.clear();
        tasksTTLTimeouts.current.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t));
        tasksTTLTimeouts.current.clear();
      }
      prevQuerySigTasks.current = querySignature;
    }
    prevSigTasks.current = currentSig;

    if (activeProjectIds.length === 0) {
      Array.from(tasksPool.current.keys()).forEach((key) => {
        if (!tasksTTLTimeouts.current.has(key)) {
          const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
            const unsub = tasksPool.current.get(key);
            if (unsub) unsub();
            tasksPool.current.delete(key);
            tasksTTLTimeouts.current.delete(key);
            usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_tasks_${key}`);
          }, TTL_DURATION_MS);
          tasksTTLTimeouts.current.set(key, timeoutId);
        }
      });
      setIsTasksLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    let isCancelled = false;
    const runTasksSync = async () => {
      const currentProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
      const keysToHydrate = extractKeysToHydrate(activeProjectIds, currentProjects);

      await Promise.all([
        hydrateTasksForProjects(Array.from(keysToHydrate)),
        hydrateDelegationsForProjects(activeProjectIds),
      ]);
      if (isCancelled) return;
      const markers = await getLoadedMarkers();

      setIsTasksLoading(true);

      const projectsByYear = groupActiveProjectsByYear(activeProjectIds, currentProjects, globalYearFilter);

      const neededKeys = new Set<string>();
      let needTasksDeltaSync = false;

      projectsByYear.forEach((projs, year) => {
        if (projs.length > 10) {
          const yearKey = `year_${year}`;
          neededKeys.add(yearKey);

          if (tasksTTLTimeouts.current.has(yearKey)) {
            clearTimeout(tasksTTLTimeouts.current.get(yearKey)!);
            tasksTTLTimeouts.current.delete(yearKey);
          }

          projs.forEach((p) => {
            const pKey = `proj_${p.id}`;
            if (tasksPool.current.has(pKey)) {
              const u = tasksPool.current.get(pKey);
              if (u) u();
              tasksPool.current.delete(pKey);
              usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_tasks_${pKey}`);
            }
          });

          if (!tasksPool.current.has(yearKey)) {
            const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];
            const hasLocalYearTasks = currentTasks.some(
              (t) => String(t.projectYear || "") === String(year)
            );
            const isClosedOrPastYear = Number(year) < 2026;

            const deltaManaged =
              (hasLocalYearTasks && isClosedOrPastYear) ||
              (DELTA_FIRST.tasks && hasMarker(markers, 'tasks_year', year));
            if (deltaManaged) {
              tasksPool.current.set(yearKey, () => {});
              setIsTasksLoading(false);
              needTasksDeltaSync = true;
              usePerformanceStore
                .getState()
                .trackGetDoc(
                  `taka_tasks_${yearKey}`,
                  true,
                  currentTasks.length,
                  "Dexie Local-First Tasks (0 Read full collection)"
                );
            } else {
              const colRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks");
              const qTasks = buildStoreAndYearQuery(
                colRef,
                "projectStore",
                "projectYear",
                year,
                userRole,
                allowedStores
              );

              usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener(`taka_tasks_${yearKey}`);
              const unsub = onSnapshot(
                qTasks,
                (snapshot) => {
                  usePerformanceStore.getState().trackSnapshot(`taka_tasks_${yearKey}`, snapshot);
                  setIsTasksLoading(false);
                  batchTasksUpdate(snapshot.docChanges(), snapshot.metadata.fromCache);
                  setCloudStatus("online");

                  if (DELTA_FIRST.tasks && !snapshot.metadata.fromCache) {
                    markLoaded('tasks_year', year).catch(() => {});
                    const u = tasksPool.current.get(yearKey);
                    tasksPool.current.set(yearKey, () => {});
                    u?.();
                    usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_tasks_${yearKey}`);
                  }
                },
                (e) => {
                  setIsTasksLoading(false);
                  console.error("Tasks consolidated listener error:", e);
                  setCloudStatus("offline");
                }
              );
              tasksPool.current.set(yearKey, unsub);
            }
          }
        } else {
          const visibleSet = new Set(
            (visibleActiveProjectIdsRef.current || []).map((id) => String(id))
          );
          const sortedProjs = [...projs].sort((a, b) => {
            const aVis = visibleSet.has(a.id) || visibleSet.has(a.code) ? 1 : 0;
            const bVis = visibleSet.has(b.id) || visibleSet.has(b.code) ? 1 : 0;
            return bVis - aVis;
          });

          sortedProjs.forEach((p) => {
            const projKey = `proj_${p.id}`;
            const yearKey = `year_${year}`;

            if (tasksPool.current.has(yearKey)) {
              neededKeys.add(yearKey);
              return;
            }

            neededKeys.add(projKey);

            if (tasksTTLTimeouts.current.has(projKey)) {
              clearTimeout(tasksTTLTimeouts.current.get(projKey)!);
              tasksTTLTimeouts.current.delete(projKey);
            }

            if (!tasksPool.current.has(projKey)) {
              const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];
              const hasLocalProjTasks =
                currentTasks.some((t) => String(t.projectCode || "") === String(p.code)) ||
                knownHydratedProjectCodes.current.has(p.code);
              const isClosedOrPastYear = Number(year) < 2026;

              const deltaManaged =
                (hasLocalProjTasks && isClosedOrPastYear) ||
                (DELTA_FIRST.tasks && (hasMarker(markers, 'tasks_proj', p.code) || hasMarker(markers, 'tasks_year', year)));
              if (deltaManaged) {
                tasksPool.current.set(projKey, () => {});
                setIsTasksLoading(false);
                needTasksDeltaSync = true;
                usePerformanceStore
                  .getState()
                  .trackGetDoc(
                    `taka_tasks_${projKey}`,
                    true,
                    1,
                    "Dexie Local-First Project Tasks (0 Read)"
                  );
              } else {
                const qTasks = query(
                  collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks"),
                  where("projectCode", "==", p.code)
                );

                usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener(`taka_tasks_${projKey}`);
                const unsub = onSnapshot(
                  qTasks,
                  (snapshot) => {
                    knownHydratedProjectCodes.current.add(p.code);
                    usePerformanceStore.getState().trackSnapshot(`taka_tasks_${projKey}`, snapshot);
                    setIsTasksLoading(false);
                    batchTasksUpdate(snapshot.docChanges(), snapshot.metadata.fromCache);
                    setCloudStatus("online");

                    if (DELTA_FIRST.tasks && !snapshot.metadata.fromCache) {
                      markLoaded('tasks_proj', p.code).catch(() => {});
                      const u = tasksPool.current.get(projKey);
                      tasksPool.current.set(projKey, () => {});
                      u?.();
                      usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_tasks_${projKey}`);
                    }
                  },
                  (e) => {
                    setIsTasksLoading(false);
                    console.error("Tasks listener error:", e);
                    setCloudStatus("offline");
                  }
                );
                tasksPool.current.set(projKey, unsub);
              }
            }
          });
        }
      });

      if (needTasksDeltaSync) {
        pullAndApplyDeltas()
          .then(() => setCloudStatus("online"))
          .catch(() => {});
      }

      Array.from(tasksPool.current.keys()).forEach((key) => {
        if (!neededKeys.has(key)) {
          if (!tasksTTLTimeouts.current.has(key)) {
            const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
              const unsub = tasksPool.current.get(key);
              if (unsub) unsub();
              tasksPool.current.delete(key);
              tasksTTLTimeouts.current.delete(key);
              usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener(`taka_tasks_${key}`);
            }, TTL_DURATION_MS);
            tasksTTLTimeouts.current.set(key, timeoutId);
          }
        }
      });
    };

    runTasksSync().catch((err) => {
      console.warn("[useTasksHydration] runTasksSync error:", err);
    });

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
    };
  }, [
    querySignature,
    userRole,
    allowedStores,
    isTasksRequested,
    expandedProjectIds,
    searchActiveProjectIds,
    globalYearFilter,
    batchTasksUpdate,
    setIsTasksLoading,
    setCloudStatus,
  ]);
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useGanttDragDrop.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../types';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import {  db, APP_ID , writeBatch } from "../lib/firebase";
import { parseDateTime, formatToDatetimeLocal } from '../lib/utils';
import { debounce } from 'lodash';
import { scheduleDependentTasks } from '../lib/ganttUtils';
import { syncProjectDatesByCode } from '../lib/projectDatesService';
import { recordBatchDeltas } from '../lib/deltaSyncService';
import { createPatchDeltaItem } from '../lib/deltaPatchService';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';

export function useGanttDragDrop(tasks: Task[], projects: Project[]) {
  const [optimisticTasks, setOptimisticTasks] = useState<Record<string, Task>>({});

  const debouncedSave = useRef(
    debounce(async (updatedTasks: Task[]) => {
      try {
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        const projectsToSync = new Set<string>();

        updatedTasks.forEach(t => {
          const ref = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id);
          batch.update(ref, {
            start: t.start,
            finish: t.finish,
            computedTakStart: (t as any).computedTakStart || null,
            computedTakCompl: (t as any).computedTakCompl || null,
            duration: t.duration,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          });
          if (t.projectCode) {
            projectsToSync.add(`${t.projectCode}|${t.projectStore || ''}|${t.projectYear || ''}`);
          }
        });
        batch.commit().catch(e => console.error("Batch commit failed", e));
        
        const deltaItems = updatedTasks.map((t) => {
          const prev = tasks.find((item) => item.id === t.id);
          return createPatchDeltaItem({
            docId: t.id,
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
            previous: prev,
            updated: t,
            action: 'update',
            year: t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
          });
        });
        const currentUser = useAppStore.getState().currentUser;
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username || 'gantt_drag').catch(() => {});

        projectsToSync.forEach(key => {
          const [code, store, year] = key.split('|');
          syncProjectDatesByCode(code, store || undefined, year || undefined);
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Error saving Gantt drag dates:", e);
      }
    }, 500)
  ).current;

  // handleTaskBarDrag will be called on mouse move.
  // It expects the INITIAL task before dragging started, so that deltaDays is applied correctly.
  const handleTaskBarDrag = useCallback((initialTask: Task, deltaDays: number) => {
    const tStart = parseDateTime(initialTask.start);
    const tFinish = parseDateTime(initialTask.finish);
    
    if (isNaN(tStart.getTime()) || isNaN(tFinish.getTime())) return;

    tStart.setDate(tStart.getDate() + deltaDays);
    tFinish.setDate(tFinish.getDate() + deltaDays);

    const newStart = formatToDatetimeLocal(tStart);
    const newFinish = formatToDatetimeLocal(tFinish);

    const newTask = { ...initialTask, start: newStart, finish: newFinish };
    
    // We apply dependencies on top of the original tasks + this new task
    // To be perfectly accurate, we should merge optimisticTasks, but 
    // for a single drag session, using the original tasks array is fine.
    const updates = scheduleDependentTasks(newTask, tasks, projects);
    const nextOptimistic = { [initialTask.id]: newTask };
    
    const tasksToSave: Task[] = [newTask];
    updates.forEach(updatedDep => {
      if (updatedDep.id) {
        nextOptimistic[updatedDep.id] = updatedDep;
        tasksToSave.push(updatedDep);
      }
    });

    setOptimisticTasks(prev => ({ ...prev, ...nextOptimistic }));
    
    debouncedSave(tasksToSave);
  }, [tasks, projects, debouncedSave]);

  const clearOptimisticTasks = useCallback(() => {
    setOptimisticTasks({});
  }, []);

  return {
    optimisticTasks,
    handleTaskBarDrag,
    clearOptimisticTasks
  };
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useLocationOptions.ts ===
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { getEffectiveStoreFilter } from '../lib/utils';
import { useEnrichedData } from './useEnrichedData';

export function useLocationOptions() {
  const { enrichedProjects, filteredTasks } = useEnrichedData();
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  const locationVisibility = useAppStore(state => state.locationVisibility);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  
  return useMemo(() => {
    const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
    const isAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'admin';
    const locPerms = currentUser?.locationPermissions || {};
    const hasAll = isAdmin || locPerms['all'];

    // 1. For non-admin users (contractor/partner accounts like ksm-01), strictly enforce year & task/project presence
    if (!isAdmin) {
      const userProjects = enrichedProjects.filter(p => {
        if (effectiveStore && effectiveStore !== 'all') {
          const pStore = String(p.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
          if (pStore && pStore !== effectiveStore.toUpperCase().trim()) return false;
        }
        if (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all') {
          const pYear = String(p.year || '').trim();
          if (pYear && pYear !== String(globalYearFilter).trim()) return false;
        }
        return true;
      });

      const userTasks = (filteredTasks || []).filter(t => {
        if (effectiveStore && effectiveStore !== 'all') {
          const tStore = String(t.projectStore || '').toUpperCase().trim();
          if (tStore && tStore !== effectiveStore.toUpperCase().trim()) return false;
        }
        if (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all') {
          const tYear = String(t.projectYear || '').trim();
          if (tYear && tYear !== String(globalYearFilter).trim()) return false;
        }
        return true;
      });

      // If user has NO projects and NO tasks in this period (e.g. y2027), DO NOT show any locations!
      if (userProjects.length === 0 && userTasks.length === 0) {
        return [];
      }

      // Collect locations where the user actually has projects or tasks in this period
      const activeLocs = new Set<string>();
      userProjects.forEach(p => {
        if (p.location && String(p.location).trim()) {
          activeLocs.add(String(p.location).trim());
        }
      });
      userTasks.forEach(t => {
        if (t.location && String(t.location).trim()) {
          activeLocs.add(String(t.location).trim());
        }
      });

      // Filter active locations by user's locationPermissions and locationVisibility
      const permittedLocations = Array.from(activeLocs).filter(loc => {
        if (!loc || String(loc).trim() === '') return false;
        if (hasAll) return true;
        const lLower = String(loc).toLowerCase().trim();
        return locPerms[lLower] || locPerms[`md-${lLower}`];
      });

      return permittedLocations.filter(loc => locationVisibility[loc] !== false).sort();
    }

    // 2. Admin flow: all possible locations configured in store or found in projects
    const allKnownLocations = Array.from(
      new Set([
        ...locations,
        ...enrichedProjects.map(p => p.location).filter(Boolean)
      ])
    );

    // Filter locations strictly by user RBAC permissions
    const permittedLocations = allKnownLocations.filter(loc => {
      if (!loc || String(loc).trim() === '') return false;
      if (hasAll) return true;
      const lLower = String(loc).toLowerCase().trim();
      return locPerms[lLower] || locPerms[`md-${lLower}`];
    });

    // Filter by locationVisibility config
    return permittedLocations.filter(loc => locationVisibility[loc] !== false).sort();
    
  }, [enrichedProjects, filteredTasks, locations, globalStoreFilter, globalYearFilter, currentUser, locationVisibility]);
}

import React, { useCallback } from 'react';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { setDoc } from '../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../lib/firebase';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { safeSetItemLocal, safeGetItemLocal } from '../lib/storage';
import { recordDelta } from '../lib/deltaSyncService';

export function useNotificationActions() {
  const currentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.currentUser);
  const setCurrentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.setCurrentUser);
  const appUsers = useAppStore((state) => state.appUsers);
  const setAppUsers = useAppStore((state) => state.setAppUsers);
  const setToast = useAppStore((state) => state.setToast);
  const tasks = useAppStore((state) => state.tasks);
  const setTasks = useAppStore((state) => state.setTasks);
  const projects = useAppStore((state) => state.projects);

  const onTogglePushEnabled = useCallback(async (enabled: boolean) => {
    if (!currentUser || currentUser.id === 'guest') return;
    try {
      setDoc(
        doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_users", currentUser.id),
        { notification: enabled },
        { merge: true }
      );
      const updatedUser = { ...currentUser, notification: enabled };
      setCurrentUser(updatedUser);
      setAppUsers(appUsers.map((u) => (u.id === updatedUser.id ? updatedUser : u)));
      safeSetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1", JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  }, [currentUser, appUsers, setCurrentUser, setAppUsers]);

  const onToggleRead = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    if (!currentUser) return;
    try {
      const prev = currentUser.readNotifs || [];
      const next = prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id];
      const updatedUser = { ...currentUser, readNotifs: next };
      setCurrentUser(updatedUser);
      
      if (currentUser.id !== "guest") {
        setAppUsers(appUsers.map((u) => (u.id === updatedUser.id ? updatedUser : u)));
        safeSetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1", JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
        setDoc(
          doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_users", currentUser.id),
          { readNotifs: next },
          { merge: true }
        );
      }
      safeSetItemLocal(`taka_read_notifs_${currentUser.id}`, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error setting read notification", e);
    }
  }, [currentUser, appUsers, setCurrentUser, setAppUsers]);

  const onMarkAllRead = useCallback(async (activeNotifications: any[]) => {
    if (!currentUser) return;
    try {
      const activeIds = activeNotifications.map((n) => n.id);
      const prev = currentUser.readNotifs || [];
      const next = Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...activeIds]));
      const updatedUser = { ...currentUser, readNotifs: next };
      setCurrentUser(updatedUser);
      
      if (currentUser.id !== "guest") {
        setAppUsers(appUsers.map((u) => (u.id === updatedUser.id ? updatedUser : u)));
        safeSetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1", JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
        setDoc(
          doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_users", currentUser.id),
          { readNotifs: next },
          { merge: true }
        );
      }
      safeSetItemLocal(`taka_read_notifs_${currentUser.id}`, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  }, [currentUser, appUsers, setCurrentUser, setAppUsers]);

  const onActionAgree = useCallback(async (notif: any) => {
    if (!currentUser) return;
    if (notif.action === 'cross_year_rollover' && notif.actionData?.taskId) {
      try {
        const taskId = notif.actionData.taskId;
        const newYear = notif.actionData.newYear;
        const taskToUpdate = tasks.find((t: any) => t.id === taskId);
        
        if (taskToUpdate) {
          const updatedTask = { ...taskToUpdate, projectYear: newYear, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
          const projExists = projects.find((p: any) => p.code === taskToUpdate.projectCode && p.store === taskToUpdate.projectStore && Number(p.year) === Number(newYear));
          
          if (!projExists) {
            const oldProj = projects.find((p: any) => p.code === taskToUpdate.projectCode && p.store === taskToUpdate.projectStore && Number(p.year) === Number(taskToUpdate.projectYear));
            if (oldProj) {
              const newProjId = `${oldProj.id}_${newYear}`;
              const newProj = { ...oldProj, id: newProjId, year: newYear, no: Date.now() };
              setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', newProjId), newProj);
              recordDelta({ docId: newProjId, collectionName: 'taka_projects', action: 'create', data: newProj, year: String(newYear) }).catch(console.error);
            }
          }
          
          setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', taskId), updatedTask, { merge: true });
          setToast({ title: "Rolled Over", message: `Task successfully rolled over to ${newYear}` });
          
          const prev = currentUser.readNotifs || [];
          if (!prev.includes(notif.id)) {
            const next = [...prev, notif.id];
            const updatedUser = { ...currentUser, readNotifs: next };
            setCurrentUser(updatedUser);
            setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', currentUser.id), { readNotifs: next }, { merge: true }).catch(console.error);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Error rolling over task", e);
        setToast({ title: "Error", message: "Failed to roll over task" });
      }
    }
  }, [currentUser, tasks, projects, setCurrentUser, setToast]);

  const onActionReject = useCallback(async (notif: any) => {
    if (!currentUser) return;
    try {
      const prev = currentUser.readNotifs || [];
      if (!prev.includes(notif.id)) {
        const next = [...prev, notif.id];
        const updatedUser = { ...currentUser, readNotifs: next };
        setCurrentUser(updatedUser);
        safeSetItemLocal(`taka_read_notifs_${currentUser.id}`, JSON.stringify(next));
        if (currentUser.id !== 'guest') {
          setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', currentUser.id), { readNotifs: next }, { merge: true }).catch(console.error);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error rejecting notification", e);
    }
  }, [currentUser, setCurrentUser]);

  const onNotificationClick = useCallback(async (notif: any) => {
    if (!currentUser) return;
    try {
      const prev = currentUser.readNotifs || [];
      if (!prev.includes(notif.id)) {
        const next = [...prev, notif.id];
        const updatedUser = { ...currentUser, readNotifs: next };
        setCurrentUser(updatedUser);
        safeSetItemLocal(`taka_read_notifs_${currentUser.id}`, JSON.stringify(next));
        if (currentUser.id !== "guest") {
          setAppUsers(appUsers.map((u) => (u.id === updatedUser.id ? updatedUser : u)));
          safeSetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1", JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
          setDoc(
            doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_users", currentUser.id),
            { readNotifs: next },
            { merge: true }
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error on notification click", e);
    }
  }, [currentUser, appUsers, setCurrentUser, setAppUsers]);

  const onQuickCompleteTask = useCallback(async (notif: any) => {
    if (!currentUser) return;
    try {
      const taskId = String(notif.targetId || notif.actionData?.taskId || '').trim();
      if (!taskId) return;
      const targetTask = tasks.find((t: any) => String(t.id) === taskId);
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      const finishDate = targetTask?.finish || nowIso.substring(0, 10);

      const updatedFields = {
        runningStatus: 'Completed',
        finish: finishDate,
        updatedAt: nowIso,
      };

      if (targetTask) {
        const updatedTask = { ...targetTask, ...updatedFields };
        const nextTasks = tasks.map((t: any) => String(t.id) === taskId ? updatedTask : t);
        setTasks(nextTasks);
      }

      setDoc(
        doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', taskId),
        updatedFields,
        { merge: true }
      ).catch((err) => console.error("Error updating task in Firestore:", err));

      recordDelta({
        docId: taskId,
        collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
        action: 'update',
        data: updatedFields,
        year: targetTask?.projectYear ? String(targetTask.projectYear) : undefined,
        updatedBy: currentUser.email || currentUser.username,
      }).catch(console.error);

      await onToggleRead(notif.id);

      setToast({
        title: "Task Completed",
        message: `Task "${targetTask?.name || notif.title}" marked as completed.`,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error quick completing task:", e);
      setToast({ title: "Error", message: "Failed to mark task as completed." });
    }
  }, [currentUser, tasks, setTasks, onToggleRead, setToast]);

  const onSnoozeNotif = useCallback((notifId: string, hours: number) => {
    try {
      const raw = safeGetItemLocal('taka_snoozed_notifs');
      let snoozedMap: Record<string, number> = {};
      if (raw) {
        try { snoozedMap = JSON.parse(raw); } catch {}
      }
      const until = Date.now() + hours * 3600 * 1000;
      snoozedMap[notifId] = until;
      safeSetItemLocal('taka_snoozed_notifs', JSON.stringify(snoozedMap));
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taka_snoozed_notifs_changed'));
      const durationLabel = hours < 24 ? `${hours}h` : `${Math.round(hours / 24)}d`;
      setToast({
        title: "Notification Snoozed",
        message: `Reminder snoozed for ${durationLabel}.`,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error snoozing notification:", e);
    }
  }, [setToast]);

  const onClearStaleNotifs = useCallback(async (activeNotifications: any[]) => {
    if (!currentUser) return;
    try {
      const fourteenDaysMs = 14 * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
      const now = Date.now();
      const staleIds = activeNotifications
        .filter((n) => (now - n.generatedAt > fourteenDaysMs) || (n.diffMs < -fourteenDaysMs))
        .map((n) => n.id);

      if (staleIds.length === 0) {
        setToast({ title: "Clean Inbox", message: "No stale notifications older than 14 days." });
        return;
      }

      const prev = currentUser.readNotifs || [];
      const next = Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...staleIds]));
      const updatedUser = { ...currentUser, readNotifs: next };
      setCurrentUser(updatedUser);
      if (currentUser.id !== "guest") {
        setAppUsers(appUsers.map((u) => (u.id === updatedUser.id ? updatedUser : u)));
        safeSetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1", JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
        setDoc(
          doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_users", currentUser.id),
          { readNotifs: next },
          { merge: true }
        ).catch(console.error);
      }
      safeSetItemLocal(`taka_read_notifs_${currentUser.id}`, JSON.stringify(next));
      setToast({
        title: "Stale Notifications Archived",
        message: `Archived ${staleIds.length} notifications older than 14 days.`,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error clearing stale notifications:", e);
    }
  }, [currentUser, appUsers, setCurrentUser, setAppUsers, setToast]);

  return {
    onTogglePushEnabled,
    onToggleRead,
    onMarkAllRead,
    onActionAgree,
    onActionReject,
    onNotificationClick,
    onQuickCompleteTask,
    onSnoozeNotif,
    onClearStaleNotifs
  };
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useOffscreenImage.ts ===
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  getMemoryCachedImage,
  setMemoryCachedImage,
  getCachedBlobFromIDB,
  setCachedBlobToIDB,
  fetchAndCacheImageBlob,
  normalizeImageCacheKey,
} from '../lib/imageDBCache';
import { resolveR2UrlToHttp } from '../components/PictureMapping/lib/r2Upload';

/**
 * Custom hook to load & decode floorplan images off the Main Thread.
 * Features:
 * - 0ms In-Memory LRU Cache Hit
 * - IndexedDB Persistent Storage for instant offline / cold-boot (<30ms)
 * - Automatic resolution and caching for Cloudflare R2 links (r2:// and signed URLs)
 * - Worker-based createImageBitmap() off-thread decoding
 * - Fallback to Blob ObjectURL and HTMLImageElement.decode()
 */
export function useOffscreenImage(url: string | undefined | null, crossOrigin: string = 'anonymous') {
  const [image, setImage] = useState<HTMLImageElement | ImageBitmap | null>(() => {
    if (url) {
      const cached = getMemoryCachedImage(url);
      if (cached) return cached;
    }
    return null;
  });

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'loading' | 'loaded' | 'failed'>(() => {
    if (url && getMemoryCachedImage(url)) return 'loaded';
    return url ? 'loading' : 'failed';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!url || typeof url !== 'string' || !url.trim()) {
      setImage(null);
      setStatus('failed');
      return;
    }

    // 1. Instant In-Memory Cache Hit (0ms)
    const memCached = getMemoryCachedImage(url);
    if (memCached) {
      setImage(memCached);
      setStatus('loaded');
      return;
    }

    let isMounted = true;
    let createdBlobUrl: string | null = null;
    setStatus('loading');

    async function loadWithIndexedDBCache() {
      try {
        // Step A: Check IndexedDB (works across r2://, key, and signed URL)
        let blob = await getCachedBlobFromIDB(url!);

        // Step B: If missing from IDB, fetch and cache (auto-resolves r2:// to presigned HTTP)
        if (!blob) {
          blob = await fetchAndCacheImageBlob(url!);
        }

        if (blob) {
          // Step C: Try offscreen decoding using createImageBitmap
          try {
            if (typeof createImageBitmap === 'function') {
              const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(blob);
              if (isMounted) {
                setMemoryCachedImage(url!, bitmap);
                setImage(bitmap);
                setStatus('loaded');
                return;
              } else {
                if ('close' in bitmap && typeof bitmap.close === 'function') {
                  bitmap.close();
                }
                return;
              }
            }
          } catch (_bitmapErr) {
            // Fallthrough to ObjectURL decoding if createImageBitmap is not supported or failed
          }

          // Step D: Decode via Blob ObjectURL
          createdBlobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const img = new Image();
          img.src = createdBlobUrl;

          const onBlobImgDone = () => {
            if (isMounted) {
              setMemoryCachedImage(url!, img);
              setImage(img);
              setStatus('loaded');
            }
          };

          if (typeof img.decode === 'function') {
            img.decode().then(onBlobImgDone).catch(onBlobImgDone);
          } else {
            img.onload = onBlobImgDone;
            img.onerror = () => {
              if (isMounted) setStatus('failed');
            };
          }
          return;
        }

        // Step E: If direct blob fetch failed (e.g. CORS limitation or expired link), fallback to HTMLImageElement
        let fallbackSrc = url!;
        if (fallbackSrc.startsWith('r2://') || (!fallbackSrc.startsWith('http://') && !fallbackSrc.startsWith('https://') && !fallbackSrc.startsWith('blob:') && !fallbackSrc.startsWith('data:'))) {
          const resolved = await resolveR2UrlToHttp(fallbackSrc);
          if (resolved) {
            fallbackSrc = resolved;
          } else {
            if (isMounted) setStatus('failed');
            return;
          }
        }

        const fallbackImg = new Image();
        if (crossOrigin) fallbackImg.crossOrigin = crossOrigin;
        fallbackSrc = fallbackSrc.trim();
        fallbackImg.src = fallbackSrc;

        const onFallbackDone = () => {
          if (isMounted) {
            setMemoryCachedImage(url!, fallbackImg);
            setImage(fallbackImg);
            setStatus('loaded');
          }
        };

        const tryNoCorsFallback = () => {
          const directImg = new Image();
          directImg.src = fallbackSrc;
          directImg.onload = () => {
            if (isMounted) {
              setMemoryCachedImage(url!, directImg);
              setImage(directImg);
              setStatus('loaded');
            }
          };
          directImg.onerror = () => {
            if (isMounted) setStatus('failed');
          };
        };

        if (typeof fallbackImg.decode === 'function') {
          fallbackImg.decode().then(onFallbackDone).catch(() => {
            tryNoCorsFallback();
          });
        } else {
          fallbackImg.onload = onFallbackDone;
          fallbackImg.onerror = () => {
            tryNoCorsFallback();
          };
        }
      } catch (_err) {
        if (isMounted) setStatus('failed');
      }
    }

    loadWithIndexedDBCache();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [url, crossOrigin]);

  return [image, status] as const;
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/usePaginatedTasks.ts ===
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { collection, query, where, orderBy, limit, startAfter, getDocs, DocumentData, QueryDocumentSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../lib/firebase';
import { Task } from '../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { getEffectiveStoreFilter } from '../lib/utils';

export function usePaginatedTasks(isActiveTab: boolean) {
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);
  const [lastDoc, setLastDoc] = useState<QueryDocumentSnapshot<DocumentData> | null>(null);
  
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  
  // Anti cursor drift & dedup
  const taskMapRef = useRef<Map<string, Task>>(new Map());

  const fetchTasks = useCallback(async (isNextPage: boolean = false) => {
    if (!isActiveTab) return;
    if (loading) return;
    if (isNextPage && !hasMore) return;

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      let q = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks") as import("firebase/firestore").Query;
      
      const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
      
      if (effectiveStore && effectiveStore !== "all") {
         q = query(q, where("projectStore", "==", effectiveStore));
      }
      
      if (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== "all") {
         const yNum = parseInt(globalYearFilter, 10);
         q = query(q, where("projectYear", "in", [globalYearFilter, yNum]));
      }
      
      // orderBy is required when using startAfter/limit for pagination, 
      // but firestore needs a composite index if combining where + orderBy.
      // If no composite index exists, this will throw an error. 
      // We'll order by projectCode as a safe fallback or just limit if orderBy fails.
      // Assuming no composite indexes, we can just fetch and paginate on an ordered field if allowed, 
      // otherwise, we might just rely on limit and startAfter without orderBy if supported, 
      // or we order by document ID (which is supported).
      q = query(q, orderBy("__name__"));

      if (isNextPage && lastDoc) {
        q = query(q, startAfter(lastDoc));
      }

      q = query(q, limit(20));

      const snapshot = await getDocs(q);

      if (!isNextPage) {
        taskMapRef.current.clear(); // Reset on fresh load
      }

      snapshot.docs.forEach(docSnap => {
        taskMapRef.current.set(docSnap.id, { id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() } as Task);
      });

      setTasks(Array.from(taskMapRef.current.values()));
      
      if (snapshot.docs.length > 0) {
        setLastDoc(snapshot.docs[snapshot.docs.length - 1]);
      }
      
      if (snapshot.docs.length < 20) {
        setHasMore(false);
      } else {
        setHasMore(true);
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error paginating tasks:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [isActiveTab, loading, hasMore, lastDoc, globalStoreFilter, globalYearFilter, currentUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActiveTab) {
      // Reset and fetch first page
      setLastDoc(null);
      setHasMore(true);
      taskMapRef.current.clear();
      fetchTasks(false);
    }
  }, [isActiveTab, globalStoreFilter, globalYearFilter]); // re-run when filters change

  return { tasks, loading, hasMore, loadMore: () => fetchTasks(true) };
}

        const pKey = `${p.code || ""}-${p.year || ""}-${p.store || ""}`;
        const projectTasks = tasksByProj.get(pKey) || [];
        projectTasks.forEach(t => {
          updateMinMax(t.start);
          updateMinMax(t.finish);
        });
      });
