        wrapper.style.height = originalHeight;
        wrapper.style.position = originalWrapperPos;
        wrapper.style.overflow = originalWrapperOverflow;
        page.style.overflow = originalPageOverflow;
        
        if (dashedOverlay) dashedOverlay.style.display = '';
        
        // Restore hidden elements
        hiddenElements.forEach(({ el, display }) => {
            el.style.display = display;
        });

        const pdfPageWidth = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
        const pdfPageHeight = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();

        // Calculate slicing
        const usableWidthPx = (printWidth - 20) * 3.78 / (printScale / 100);
        const usableHeightPx = (printHeight - 20) * 3.78 / (printScale / 100);
        
        const wrapperActualWidth = naturalWidth;
        const wrapperActualHeight = naturalHeight;
        
        // Adjust usable dimensions by the SAME factor to preserve aspect ratio
        let scaleAdjustment = 1;
        
        if (printScaleMode === 'fit-page') {
          scaleAdjustment = Math.max(1, wrapperActualWidth / usableWidthPx, wrapperActualHeight / usableHeightPx);
        } else if (printScaleMode === 'fit-cols') {
          scaleAdjustment = Math.max(1, wrapperActualWidth / usableWidthPx);
        } else if (printScaleMode === 'fit-rows') {
          scaleAdjustment = Math.max(1, wrapperActualHeight / usableHeightPx);
        }
        
        const finalUsableWidthPx = usableWidthPx * scaleAdjustment;
        const finalUsableHeightPx = usableHeightPx * scaleAdjustment;

        // Calculate columns
        const cols = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(wrapperActualWidth / finalUsableWidthPx - 0.05));
        
        const pageBreaks = [];
        let domStartY = 0;
        const targetHeightForScale = pdfPageHeight - 20;
        const scaleY = targetHeightForScale / finalUsableHeightPx;
        const headerPdfHeight = headerHeight * scaleY;

        while (domStartY < wrapperActualHeight - 0.5) {
            let domEndY_theoretical;
            let actualPdfStartY;
            
            if (pageBreaks.length === 0) {
                domEndY_theoretical = domStartY + finalUsableHeightPx;
                actualPdfStartY = 10;
            } else {
                domEndY_theoretical = domStartY + finalUsableHeightPx - headerHeight;
                actualPdfStartY = 10 + headerPdfHeight;
            }
            
            if (domEndY_theoretical >= wrapperActualHeight) {
                pageBreaks.push({
                    domStartY,
                    domEndY: wrapperActualHeight,
                    actualPdfStartY,
                    eraseStartPdf: null
                });
                break;
            }
            
            let breakY = domStartY;
            for (let i=0; i<validBoundaries.length; i++) {
                if (validBoundaries[i] > domStartY && validBoundaries[i] <= domEndY_theoretical + 1) {
                    breakY = validBoundaries[i];
                }
            }
            
            if (breakY === domStartY) {
                breakY = domEndY_theoretical;
            }
            
            const actualPdfEndY = actualPdfStartY + (breakY - domStartY) * scaleY;
            
            pageBreaks.push({
                domStartY,
                domEndY: breakY,
                actualPdfStartY,
                eraseStartPdf: actualPdfEndY
            });
            
            domStartY = breakY;
        }
        
        // Render each slice
        let pageCount = 0;
        for (let r = 0; r < pageBreaks.length; r++) {
          const pb = pageBreaks[r];
          for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            if (pageCount > 0) {
              pdf.addPage(format, orientation);
            }
            
            const margin = 10;
            const targetWidth = pdfPageWidth - margin * 2;
            const targetHeight = pdfPageHeight - margin * 2;
            
            const totalPdfWidth = (wrapperActualWidth / finalUsableWidthPx) * targetWidth;
            const totalPdfHeight = (wrapperActualHeight / finalUsableHeightPx) * targetHeight;
            
            const xOffset = margin - (c * targetWidth);
            
            // Map pb.domStartY to pb.actualPdfStartY
            // Add a tiny 2px safety buffer to prevent the header from overlapping the row due to subpixel rendering
            const yOffset = pb.actualPdfStartY - (pb.domStartY * scaleY);
            
            pdf.addImage(dataUrl, 'JPEG', xOffset, yOffset, totalPdfWidth, totalPdfHeight);
            
            if (pb.eraseStartPdf) {
                // ERASE ALL THE WAY TO THE BOTTOM OF THE PAGE
                const eraseHeight = pdfPageHeight - pb.eraseStartPdf;
                if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) {
                    pdf.setFillColor(30, 30, 32); // #1e1e20
                } else {
                    pdf.setFillColor(255, 255, 255); // #ffffff
                }
                // Also erase the left and right margins to be safe, just erase everything below eraseStartPdf
                pdf.rect(0, pb.eraseStartPdf - 0.2, pdfPageWidth, eraseHeight + 2, 'F');
            }
            
            // ALWAYS erase the bottom margin even if we don't have eraseStartPdf
            if (!pb.eraseStartPdf || pb.eraseStartPdf > margin + targetHeight) {
                if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) {
                    pdf.setFillColor(30, 30, 32); // #1e1e20
                } else {
                    pdf.setFillColor(255, 255, 255); // #ffffff
                }
                pdf.rect(0, margin + targetHeight, pdfPageWidth, pdfPageHeight - (margin + targetHeight), 'F');
            }
            
            // ALWAYS erase the top margin
            if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) {
                pdf.setFillColor(30, 30, 32); // #1e1e20
            } else {
                pdf.setFillColor(255, 255, 255); // #ffffff
            }
            pdf.rect(0, 0, pdfPageWidth, margin, 'F');
            
            // Draw Dynamic Filter Header (Store, Year, Project Code)
            if (printFilterHeader) {
                const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
                const filterContext = getPrintFilterContext({
                  activeTab,
                  globalStoreFilter: useAppStore.getState().globalStoreFilter,
                  globalYearFilter: useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter,
                  currentUser: useAppStore.getState().currentUser,
                  detailTabFilterCode: useAppStore.getState().detailTabFilterCode,
                                    layoutTabFilters: useAppStore.getState().layoutTabFilters,
                });
                drawPdfFilterHeader(pdf, filterContext, pdfPageWidth, margin, isDark);
            }
            
            if (r > 0) {
               // Draw the header overlay
               pdf.addImage(headerDataUrl, 'JPEG', xOffset, margin, totalPdfWidth, headerPdfHeight);
            }
            
            // Draw Legend
            pdf.setFontSize(8);
            pdf.setTextColor(100, 100, 100);
            const legendY = pdfPageHeight - 4;

            // Footer Left info (Page number & Print date)
            pdf.setFontSize(7.5);
            pdf.setTextColor(130, 130, 130);
            let footerLeftText = `Page ${pageCount + 1} of ${pageBreaks.length * cols}`;
            if (printDate) {
              footerLeftText += ` • Printed: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`;
            }
            pdf.text(footerLeftText, margin, legendY);
            
            // Completed
            let currentLegendX = pdfPageWidth - margin - 18;
            pdf.text("Completed", currentLegendX, legendY);
            pdf.setFillColor(34, 197, 94); // Green 500
            pdf.rect(currentLegendX - 4, legendY - 2.5, 3, 3, 'F');

            // In Process
            currentLegendX -= 24;
            pdf.text("In Process", currentLegendX, legendY);
            pdf.setFillColor(59, 130, 246); // Blue 500
            pdf.rect(currentLegendX - 4, legendY - 2.5, 3, 3, 'F');

            // Upcoming
            currentLegendX -= 22;
            pdf.text("Upcoming", currentLegendX, legendY);
            pdf.setFillColor(100, 116, 139); // Slate 500
            pdf.rect(currentLegendX - 4, legendY - 2.5, 3, 3, 'F');

            
            pageCount++;
          }
        }
      }
      
      pdf.save(`gantt_chart_${new Date().getTime()}.pdf`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Export to PDF failed:", err);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: "PDF export failed. Please try again." });
    } finally {
      setIsExportingPDF(false);
    }
  };




  return {
    printDates,
    printScale,
    ganttPrintPages,
    handleExportToExcel,
    handlePrintToPDF
  };
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/usePushNotifications.ts ===
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { onMessage } from "firebase/messaging";
import { messaging } from "../lib/firebase";
import { safeGetItemLocal } from "../lib/storage";

export function usePushNotifications() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const setupMessaging = async () => {
      const msg = await messaging();
      if (msg) {
        onMessage(msg, (payload) => {
          console.log("Message received in foreground: ", payload);
          if (payload.notification) {
            // Check if current user has notifications enabled
            const savedAuth = safeGetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1");
            if (savedAuth) {
              const user = JSON.parse(savedAuth);
              if (user.notification === false) return;
            }

            function formatPushMessage(original: string) {
              if (!original) return original;
              let text = original;

              if (text.startsWith("You were mentioned in a comment: ")) {
                return text.replace("You were mentioned in a comment: ", "");
              }

              if (text.includes("Delegation task:")) {
                return text.replace(/ by [^,]+(, status:)/, "$1");
              }

              if (text.includes(" deadline ")) {
                const parts = text.split(" - ");
                let lastPart = parts[parts.length - 1];
                lastPart = lastPart.replace(
                  /(days |hours|hour\)) by .+$/,
                  "$1",
                );
                return lastPart;
              }
              return text;
            }

            const bodyToSpeak = formatPushMessage(payload.notification.body || "");
            
            // Trigger native notification if in background/minimized
            if (document.hidden) {
              new Notification(payload.notification.title || "Taka App", {
                body: bodyToSpeak,
                icon: "/icon-192x192.png",
                badge: "/icon-192x192.png"
              });
            } else {
               // Foreground alert handled by Toast usually, but we could add sound here.
            }
          }
        });
      }
    };

    setupMessaging();
  }, []);
}

import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { useVirtualizer } from '@tanstack/react-virtual';

export interface UseTableVirtualizerOptions {
  count: number;
  estimateSize?: number;
  overscan?: number;
}

/**
 * Universal High-Performance Table Virtualizer bọc @tanstack/react-virtual
 * Giới hạn số lượng DOM nodes trên bảng lớn (chỉ render ~20-30 rows hiển thị trên màn hình)
 */
export function useTableVirtualizer({
  count,
  estimateSize = 46,
  overscan = 8,
}: UseTableVirtualizerOptions) {
  const parentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count,
    getScrollElement: () => parentRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => estimateSize,
    overscan,
  });

  return {
    parentRef,
    virtualizer,
    virtualItems: virtualizer.getVirtualItems(),
    totalSize: virtualizer.getTotalSize(),
  };
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useTaskFilters.ts ===
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { safeGetItemLocal, safeSetItemLocal, safeRemoveItemLocal, safeGetItemSession, safeSetItemSession, safeRemoveItemSession } from "../lib/storage";
import { AppUser } from '../types';
import { getDefaultStoreFilter } from '../lib/utils';

export function useTaskFilters(currentUser: AppUser) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(() => {
    return safeGetItemSession("taka_detail_search") || "";
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      safeSetItemSession("taka_detail_search", searchTerm);
    }, 350);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchTerm]);

  const [yearFilter, setYearFilter] = useState(() => {
    return safeGetItemSession("taka_detail_year") || "all";
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    safeSetItemSession("taka_detail_year", yearFilter);
  }, [yearFilter]);

  const [storeFilter, setStoreFilter] = useState(() =>
    getDefaultStoreFilter(currentUser),
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    safeSetItemLocal(`taka_store_filter_${currentUser.id}`, storeFilter);
  }, [storeFilter, currentUser.id]);

  const [locationFilter, setLocationFilter] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    try {
      const stored = safeGetItemSession("taka_detail_location");
      if (!stored || stored === "all") return [];
      const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    safeSetItemSession("taka_detail_location", JSON.stringify(locationFilter));
  }, [locationFilter]);

  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState(() => {
    return safeGetItemSession("taka_detail_status") || "all";
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    safeSetItemSession("taka_detail_status", statusFilter);
  }, [statusFilter]);

  const [actStatusFilter, setActStatusFilter] = useState(() => {
    return safeGetItemSession("taka_detail_act_status") || "all";
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    safeSetItemSession("taka_detail_act_status", actStatusFilter);
  }, [actStatusFilter]);

  return {
    searchTerm, setSearchTerm,
    yearFilter, setYearFilter,
    storeFilter, setStoreFilter,
    locationFilter, setLocationFilter,
    statusFilter, setStatusFilter,
    actStatusFilter, setActStatusFilter
  };
}


=== FILE: src/hooks/useTaskModalLogic.ts ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Task } from '../types';
import { useAppStore } from "../store/useAppStore";
import { useEnrichedData } from './useEnrichedData';
import { useTaskModalFormState } from './taskModal/useTaskModalFormState';
import { executeTaskSave } from './taskModal/taskModalSaveService';
import { hydrateDelegationsForProjects, hydrateDelegationsForTasks, hydrateTasksForProjects } from '../lib/backgroundSyncWorker';
import { ensureProjectTasksLoaded } from '../lib/taskStateService';

export interface UseTaskModalLogicProps {
  task: Task | null;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  prefillProjectCode: string | null;
  prefillProjectYear?: string | number | null;
  prefillProjectStore?: string | null;
  isReadOnly?: boolean;
  onNavigateToDelegation?: (groupId: string, taskId?: string) => void;
  initialTab?: 'details' | 'chat';
}

export function useTaskModalLogic({
  task,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  prefillProjectCode,
  prefillProjectYear,
  prefillProjectStore,
  isReadOnly = false,
  onNavigateToDelegation: _onNavigateToDelegation,
  initialTab = 'details'
}: UseTaskModalLogicProps) {
  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const theme = useAppStore(state => state.theme);
  const appUsers = useAppStore(state => state.appUsers);
  const subAppUsers = useAppStore(state => state.subAppUsers);
  const parties = useAppStore(state => state.parties);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const isArchiveYear = globalYearFilter !== 'all' && Number(globalYearFilter) < new Date().getFullYear();
  const canWrite = !isReadOnly && (currentUser?.role === 'admin' || currentUser?.canWrite) && !isArchiveYear;

  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const nodeRef = React.useRef(null);
  const setToast = useAppStore(state => state.setToast);
  const cloudStatus = useAppStore(state => state.cloudStatus);

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'details' | 'chat'>(initialTab);
  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState<{isOpen: boolean, title: string, message: string, onConfirm: () => void}>({
    isOpen: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    onConfirm: () => {}
  });
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State Sub-Hook
  const {
    formData,
    setFormData,
    dateErrors,
    setDateErrors,
    nameRef,
    resolvedPredecessors,
    handlePredecessorChange,
    handleApplyPredecessorDates,
    handleDateChange,
    handleDurationChange,
    toggleDurationManual
  } = useTaskModalFormState({
    task,
    isOpen,
    prefillProjectCode,
    prefillProjectYear,
    prefillProjectStore,
    projects,
    tasks,
    t
  });

  // Escape key handler
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (confirmModal.isOpen) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose, confirmModal.isOpen]);

  // JIT Targeted Local-First Task & Delegation Hydration
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const pCode = task?.projectCode || prefillProjectCode;
      const pId = task?.projectId;
      const keys = [pId, pCode].filter(Boolean) as string[];
      if (keys.length > 0) {
        hydrateTasksForProjects(keys).catch(() => {});
        hydrateDelegationsForProjects(keys).catch(() => {});
        if (pCode) {
          ensureProjectTasksLoaded(pCode).catch(() => {});
        }
      }
      if (task?.id) {
        hydrateDelegationsForTasks([task.id]).catch(() => {});
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, task?.id, task?.projectId, task?.projectCode, prefillProjectCode]);

  const setEditingProject = useAppStore(state => state.setEditingProject);
  const setIsProjectModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.setIsProjectModalOpen);
  const setModalInitialTab = useAppStore(state => state.setModalInitialTab);
  const setIsTaskModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.setIsTaskModalOpen);

  const handleOpenProjectComments = () => {
    if (task) {
      const parentProject = projects.find(p => p.code === task.projectCode && String(p.year) === String(task.projectYear) && p.store === task.projectStore);
      if (parentProject) {
        setIsTaskModalOpen(false);
        setEditingProject(parentProject);
        setModalInitialTab('chat');
        setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setActiveTab(initialTab);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, task?.id, initialTab]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (isSubmitting) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    e.preventDefault();

    await executeTaskSave({
      formData,
      task,
      projects,
      tasks,
      cloudStatus,
      currentUser,
      t,
      setToast,
      onClose,
      setIsSubmitting
    });
  };

  const handleUnlinkParentInModal = async () => {
    if (!task?.id) return;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const prevTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;

    // 1. Optimistic update
    const updatedTasks = prevTasks.map(t =>
      t.id === task.id ? { ...t, parentTaskId: undefined, parentId: undefined, updatedAt: now } : t
    );
    useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);
    setFormData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, parentTaskId: undefined, parentId: undefined }));

    // 2. Dexie update
    try {
      const { localDb } = await import('../lib/localDb');
      await (localDb.tasks.update as any)(task.id, { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now });
    } catch (e) {}

    // 3. Firestore update
    try {
      const { doc, deleteField } = await import('firebase/firestore');
      const { writeBatch } = await import('../lib/firestoreWrites');
      const { db, APP_ID } = await import('../lib/firebase');
      const { recordDelta } = await import('../lib/deltaSyncService');
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', task.id);
      batch.update(docRef, { parentTaskId: deleteField(), parentId: null, updatedAt: now });
      await batch.commit();

      recordDelta({
        docId: task.id,
        collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
        action: 'update',
        isPatch: true,
        data: { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now },
        year: task.projectYear ? String(task.projectYear) : undefined,
        updatedBy: currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username,
      }).catch(() => {});

      setToast({ title: "Success", message: "Task unlinked from parent modular task." });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(prevTasks);
      setToast({ title: "Error", message: "Failed to unlink task on server." });
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteTaskInModal = () => {
    if (!task?.id) return;
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: "Delete Task",
      message: `Are you sure you want to delete task "${task.name || ''}"? This action cannot be undone.`,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        const prevTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
        const taskId = task.id;

        // Unlink subtasks if this was a parent task
        const parentCode = task.taskCodePhu ? String(task.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        const childrenToUnlink = prevTasks.filter(t => {
          if (t.id === taskId) return false;
          const rawParent = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
          if (rawParent) {
            const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
            return String(rawParent) === taskId || (parentCode && rawStr === parentCode);
          }
          return false;
        });

        // 1. Optimistic delete in Zustand & Dexie & projects sync
        const { deleteTaskStateUnified } = await import('../lib/taskStateService');
        await deleteTaskStateUnified([task || taskId]);
        if (childrenToUnlink.length > 0) {
          const unlinkedChildIds = new Set(childrenToUnlink.map(c => c.id));
          const tasksAfterUnlink = useAppStore.getState().tasks.map(t => 
            unlinkedChildIds.has(t.id) ? { ...t, parentTaskId: undefined, parentId: undefined, updatedAt: now } : t
          );
          useAppStore.getState().setTasks(tasksAfterUnlink);
        }

        // 2. Commit batch to Firestore
        try {
          const { doc, deleteField } = await import('firebase/firestore');
          const { writeBatch } = await import('../lib/firestoreWrites');
          const { db, APP_ID } = await import('../lib/firebase');
          const { recordBatchDeltas } = await import('../lib/deltaSyncService');
          const batch = writeBatch(db);
          batch.delete(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', taskId));
          childrenToUnlink.forEach(child => {
            const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', child.id);
            batch.update(docRef, { parentTaskId: deleteField(), parentId: null, updatedAt: now });
          });
          await batch.commit();

          const deltaItems: any[] = [
            { docId: taskId, collectionName: 'taka_tasks', action: 'delete', isPatch: false, data: null },
            ...childrenToUnlink.map(c => ({
              docId: c.id, collectionName: 'taka_tasks', action: 'update', isPatch: true,
              data: { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now }
            }))
          ];
          recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});

          setToast({ title: "Success", message: "Task deleted successfully." });
          onClose();
        } catch (err: any) {
          console.error(err);
          setToast({ title: "Error", message: "Failed to delete task on server." });
        }
      }
    });
  };

  return {
    handleUnlinkParentInModal,
    handleDeleteTaskInModal,
    projects,
    tasks,
    delegationGroups,
    currentUser,
    permissionMatrix,
    locations,
    theme,
    appUsers,
    subAppUsers,
    parties,
    globalYearFilter,
    isArchiveYear,
    canWrite,
    t,
    nodeRef,
    setToast,
    cloudStatus,
    nameRef,
    formData,
    setFormData,
    dateErrors,
    setDateErrors,
    isSubmitting,
    activeTab,
    setActiveTab,
    confirmModal,
    setConfirmModal,
    resolvedPredecessors,
    handleOpenProjectComments,
    handlePredecessorChange,
    handleApplyPredecessorDates,
    handleSubmit,
    handleDateChange,
    handleDurationChange,
    toggleDurationManual
  };
}

export type TaskModalLogicType = ReturnType<typeof useTaskModalLogic>;


=== FILE: src/hooks/useTaskPredecessor.ts ===
import React, { useCallback } from 'react';
import { Task, TaskPredecessor } from '../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../lib/firebase';
import { writeBatch } from '../lib/firestoreWrites';

// Hàm phụ trợ tính toán ngày tháng
const addDays = (dateStr: string, days: number): string => {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateStr;
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
  return d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
};

const getDuration = (start: string, finish: string): number => {
  const d1 = new Date(start);
  const d2 = new Date(finish);
  if (isNaN(d1.getTime()) || isNaN(d2.getTime())) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor((d2.getTime() - d1.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
};

export function useTaskPredecessor() {
  const tasks = useAppStore(state => state.tasks);
  const setTasks = useAppStore(state => state.setTasks);

  // Phát hiện vòng lặp đồ thị có hướng (Cyclic Detection)
  const isCyclic = useCallback((taskId: string, targetPredecessorId: string): boolean => {
    if (taskId === targetPredecessorId) return true;
    const targetTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === targetPredecessorId);
    if (!targetTask || !targetTask.predecessors) return false;
    return targetTask.predecessors.some(pred => isCyclic(taskId, pred.taskId));
  }, [tasks]);

  const updatePredecessors = async (taskId: string, newPredecessors: TaskPredecessor[]) => {
    const currentTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
    if (!currentTask) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy công việc");

    if (newPredecessors.some(pred => isCyclic(taskId, pred.taskId))) {
      throw new Error("Phát hiện vòng lặp phụ thuộc (Cyclic Dependency). Liên kết bị từ chối.");
    }

    // 1. THUẬT TOÁN LẬP LỊCH TỰ ĐỘNG (AUTO-SCHEDULE)
    let newStart = currentTask.start;
    let newFinish = currentTask.finish;
    const duration = getDuration(currentTask.start, currentTask.finish);

    if (newPredecessors.length > 0) {
      let maxTargetDate: Date | null = null;
      let controllingType = 'FS';

      newPredecessors.forEach(pred => {
        const pTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === pred.taskId);
        if (pTask) {
          let compareDateStr = pTask.finish; // Mặc định kết thúc của task trước
          if (pred.type === 'SS' || pred.type === 'SF') compareDateStr = pTask.start;
          
          const compareDate = new Date(compareDateStr);
          if (!isNaN(compareDate.getTime())) {
            if (!maxTargetDate || compareDate > maxTargetDate) {
              maxTargetDate = compareDate;
              controllingType = pred.type;
            }
          }
        }
      });

      if (maxTargetDate) {
        const targetDateStr = maxTargetDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        
        switch (controllingType) {
          case 'FS':
            newStart = addDays(targetDateStr, 1);
            newFinish = addDays(newStart, duration);
            break;
          case 'SS':
            newStart = targetDateStr;
            newFinish = addDays(newStart, duration);
            break;
          case 'FF':
            newFinish = targetDateStr;
            newStart = addDays(newFinish, -duration);
            break;
          case 'SF':
            newFinish = targetDateStr;
            newStart = addDays(newFinish, -duration);
            break;
        }
      }
    }

    // 2. CHUẨN HÓA DỮ LIỆU HIỂN THỊ GANTT CHART
    // Phải tạo chuỗi hiển thị đúng format mã task (Ví dụ: L1-115FS; L1-113SS)
    const legacyString = newPredecessors.map(pred => {
      const pTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === pred.taskId);
      if (!pTask) return '';
      const code = pTask.taskCodePhu || pTask.projectCode || '';
      const typeStr = pred.type === 'FS' ? '' : pred.type;
      return `${code}${typeStr}`;
    }).filter(Boolean).join('; ');

    // 3. ĐỒNG BỘ TRẠNG THÁI (UI & DATABASE)
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedFields = {
      predecessors: newPredecessors,
      predecessor: legacyString,
      start: newStart,
      finish: newFinish,
      updatedAt: now
    };

    setTasks(tasks.map(t => t.id === taskId ? { ...t, ...updatedFields } : t));

    const editingTask = useAppStore.getState().editingTask;
    if (editingTask && editingTask.id === taskId) {
      useAppStore.getState().setEditingTask({ ...editingTask, ...updatedFields });
    }

    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    const taskRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', taskId);
    batch.update(taskRef, { ...updatedFields, updatedAt: now });
    await batch.commit();
  };

  return { updatePredecessors, isCyclic };
}

};

export function LanguageProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState<Language>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetItemLocal('taka_language');
    return (saved as Language) || 'en';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    safeSetItemLocal('taka_language', language);
  }, [language]);

  const t = (text: string): string => {
    if (language === 'en') return text;
    return jaDictionary[text] || text;
  };

  return (
    <LanguageContext.Provider value={{ language, setLanguage, t }}>
      {children}
    </LanguageContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useLanguage() {
  const context = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useLanguage must be used within a LanguageProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

} from './utils';
import { Task, DelegationGroup, DelegationSubTask } from '../types';

describe('Kiểm thử Logic Tính toán % và Phân loại Act Status (Actual Status & Progress)', () => {
  describe('getActStatusPercent', () => {
    it('trả về đúng 100% cho trạng thái Completed và Approved', () => {
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Completed')).toBe(100);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('approved')).toBe(100);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Finished')).toBe(100);
    });

    it('trả về đúng 80% cho trạng thái Pending Approval và ReqApproval', () => {
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Pending Approval')).toBe(80);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Pending Completed')).toBe(80);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('ReqApproval')).toBe(80);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Review Late')).toBe(80);
    });

    it('trả về đúng 50% cho trạng thái Accepted, On process và In Progress', () => {
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Accepted')).toBe(50);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('On process')).toBe(50);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('In Progress')).toBe(50);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Delayed')).toBe(50);
    });

    it('trả về đúng 30% cho trạng thái Correction Needed và Rejected', () => {
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Correction Needed')).toBe(30);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Needs Rework')).toBe(30);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Rejected')).toBe(30);
    });

    it('trả về đúng 0% cho trạng thái Planned, Assigned và Critical Delay', () => {
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Planned')).toBe(0);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Assigned')).toBe(0);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Upcoming')).toBe(0);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Critical Delay')).toBe(0);
      expect(getActStatusPercent('Cancel')).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('getSubTaskProgressScore', () => {
    it('tính đúng điểm số hoàn thành cho từng trạng thái subTask', () => {
      expect(getSubTaskProgressScore({ delegationStatus: 'Completed' })).toBe(1.0);
      expect(getSubTaskProgressScore({ status: 'Approved' })).toBe(1.0);
      expect(getSubTaskProgressScore({ approvalStatus: 'ReqApproval', delegationStatus: 'Pending completed' })).toBe(0.8);
      expect(getSubTaskProgressScore({ delegationStatus: 'Accepted' })).toBe(0.5);
      expect(getSubTaskProgressScore({ status: 'On process' })).toBe(0.5);
      expect(getSubTaskProgressScore({ delegationStatus: 'Rejected' })).toBe(0.3);
      expect(getSubTaskProgressScore({ delegationStatus: 'Assigned' })).toBe(0.0);
      expect(getSubTaskProgressScore({})).toBe(0.0);
    });

      expect(res.label).toBe('In Progress');

      expect(res.label).toBe('Critical Delay');
    });

    it('nhận diện đúng Completed khi toàn bộ subtask hoàn thành', () => {
      const subTasks: Partial<DelegationSubTask>[] = [
        { id: 'st1', delegationStatus: 'Completed', status: 'Completed' },
        { id: 'st2', delegationStatus: 'Approved', status: 'Approved' }

      expect(res.label).toBe('Completed');
    });

    it('nhận diện đúng task không có delegation nhưng có runningStatus Completed', () => {
      const task: Partial<Task> = { runningStatus: 'Completed' };

      expect(res.label).toBe('Completed');
    });
  });

  describe('computeDelegationGroupProgressPercent & computeActProgressPercent', () => {
    it('tính đúng tiến độ % nhóm ủy quyền với các subtask có trạng thái khác nhau', () => {
      const group: Partial<DelegationGroup> = {

      expect(pct).toBe(75);
    });

    it('tính đúng computeActProgressPercent của dự án khi có task ủy quyền và task thường', () => {
      const tasks: Task[] = [

          id: 't1',
          projectCode: 'P1',
          name: 'Task 1 (Có delegation)',
          start: '2026-03-01',
          finish: '2026-03-10',
          duration: '10',
          durationManual: false,
          finishManual: false,

          id: 't2',
          projectCode: 'P1',
          name: 'Task 2 (Thuần túy hoàn thành)',
          start: '2026-03-05',
          finish: '2026-03-15',
          duration: '10',
          durationManual: false,
          finishManual: false,
          runningStatus: 'Completed',
        },
      ];

      const groups: DelegationGroup[] = [
        {
          id: 'g1',
          parentTaskId: 't1',

      // t1 có subtask Accepted -> 50%
      // t2 runningStatus Completed -> 100%

=== FILE: src/lib/aggregationService.ts ===
import {
  collection,
  query,
  where,
  getCountFromServer,
  getAggregateFromServer,
  sum,
  average,
} from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';

export interface CollectionCountParams {
  collectionName: 'taka_projects' | 'taka_tasks' | 'taka_costs';
  year?: string;
  store?: string;
}

/**
 * Đếm số lượng document trực tiếp từ Firestore Server (chỉ tính 1 READ cho toàn bộ kết quả đếm)
 */
export async function getCollectionCount({
  collectionName,
  year,
  store,
}: CollectionCountParams): Promise<number> {
  try {
    let q = query(collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', collectionName));

    if (year && String(year).toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
      q = query(q, where('year', 'in', [String(year), Number(year)]));
    }

    if (store && String(store).toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
      q = query(q, where('store', 'in', [store, store.toLowerCase()]));
    }

    const snapshot = await getCountFromServer(q);
    return snapshot.data().count;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[aggregationService] Error getting count for ${collectionName}:`, err);
    return 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Tính tổng chi phí / ngân sách tài chính bằng Firestore Aggregation Query
 * Trả về tổng mà không cần tải hàng trăm/nghìn documents về client
 */
export async function getFinancialAggregates(
  year?: string,
  store?: string
): Promise<{
  totalBudget: number;
  totalActual: number;
  docCount: number;
}> {
  try {
    let q = query(collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs'));

    if (year && String(year).toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
      q = query(q, where('year', 'in', [String(year), Number(year)]));
    }

    if (store && String(store).toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
      q = query(q, where('store', 'in', [store, store.toLowerCase()]));
    }

    // Tận dụng getAggregateFromServer với sum
    const snapshot = await getAggregateFromServer(q, {
      totalBudget: sum('budget'),
      totalActual: sum('actualPaymentTotal'),
    });

    const data = snapshot.data();
    const countSnap = await getCountFromServer(q);

    return {
      totalBudget: Number(data.totalBudget) || 0,
      totalActual: Number(data.totalActual) || 0,
      docCount: countSnap.data().count || 0,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[aggregationService] getFinancialAggregates fallback:', err);
    return {
      totalBudget: 0,
      totalActual: 0,
      docCount: 0,
    };
  }
}


=== FILE: src/lib/auditLogService.ts ===
import { collection, addDoc, serverTimestamp } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { AuditLog } from '../types';

/**
 * Ghi log kiểm toán (Append-only) cho các biến động quan trọng (Rule 4)
 */
export async function recordAuditLog(log: {
  action: 'CREATE' | 'UPDATE' | 'DELETE';
  entityType?: string;
  docPath: string;
  docId: string;
  data: any;
  previousData?: any;
}): Promise<void> {
  const user = useAppStore.getState().currentUser;
  if (!user) return;

  const auditPayload: any = {
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    serverTime: serverTimestamp(),
    userId: user.id,
    userEmail: user.email || user.username || 'unknown',
    action: log.action,
    entityType: log.entityType || resolveEntityType(log.docPath),
    docPath: log.docPath,
    docId: log.docId,
    data: log.data,
    previousData: log.previousData || null,
  };

  try {
    const colRef = collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'audit_logs');
    await addDoc(colRef, auditPayload);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[auditLog] Failed to record audit log:', err);
  }
}

function resolveEntityType(docPath: string): string {
  if (docPath.includes('taka_projects')) return 'project';
  if (docPath.includes('taka_tasks')) return 'task';
  if (docPath.includes('taka_costs')) return 'cost';
  if (docPath.includes('taka_delegation')) return 'delegation';
  if (docPath.includes('taka_users')) return 'user';
  return 'unknown';
}


=== FILE: src/lib/autoDeltaQueue.ts ===
import type { TakaDeltaItem } from '../types';

/**
 * Auto-delta queue (additive, no firebase import to avoid circular deps).
 *
 * Many mutation paths (costs, budget, delegations, chat, project edits...) write to Firestore without
 * calling recordDelta(), so other devices only saw them through full-collection listeners (or never, for
 * past years / collapsed projects). The firebase.ts write wrappers call queueAutoDelta() for every write to
 * the 4 core collections; a coalesced "invalidate" delta is emitted so other devices re-read just that doc.
 * Paths that already record an explicit delta are detected via markExplicitDelta() and skipped (no double cost).
 */

type Logical = TakaDeltaItem['collectionName'];

const FS_TO_LOGICAL: Record<string, Logical> = {
  taka_projects: 'taka_projects',
  taka_tasks: 'taka_tasks',
  taka_costs: 'taka_costs',
  taka_delegation_groups: 'taka_delegations',
};

export const LOGICAL_TO_FS: Record<Logical, string> = {
  taka_projects: 'taka_projects',
  taka_tasks: 'taka_tasks',
  taka_costs: 'taka_costs',
  taka_delegations: 'taka_delegation_groups',
};

const FLUSH_DELAY_MS = 200;
const MAX_ITEMS_PER_DELTA = 300;
const EXPLICIT_BEFORE_MS = 5000;
const EXPLICIT_AFTER_MS = 15000;

const explicitMarks = new Map<string, number>();
const pending = new Map<string, { docId: string; collectionName: Logical; action: 'invalidate' | 'delete'; queuedAt: number }>();
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

const keyOf = (c: string, id: string) => `${c}:${id}`;

export function resolveLogicalCollection(docPath: string): Logical | null {
  if (!docPath) return null;
  if (docPath.includes('taka_projects')) return 'taka_projects';
  if (docPath.includes('taka_tasks')) return 'taka_tasks';
  if (docPath.includes('taka_costs')) return 'taka_costs';
  if (docPath.includes('taka_delegation')) return 'taka_delegations';
  return null;
}

export function markExplicitDelta(items: Array<{ docId?: string; collectionName?: string }>): void {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const it of items) {
    if (it.docId && it.collectionName) explicitMarks.set(keyOf(it.collectionName, it.docId), now);
  }
  if (explicitMarks.size > 5000) {
    const cutoff = now - 60000;
    for (const [k, t] of explicitMarks) if (t < cutoff) explicitMarks.delete(k);
  }
}

export function unmarkExplicitDelta(items: Array<{ docId?: string; collectionName?: string }>): void {
  for (const it of items) {
    if (it.docId && it.collectionName) explicitMarks.delete(keyOf(it.collectionName, it.docId));
  }
}

export function queueAutoDelta(docPath: string, docId: string, kind: 'write' | 'delete'): void {
  const collectionName = resolveLogicalCollection(docPath);
  if (!collectionName || !docId) return;
  pending.set(keyOf(collectionName, docId), {
    docId,
    collectionName,
    action: kind === 'delete' ? 'delete' : 'invalidate',
    queuedAt: Date.now(),
  });
  if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = setTimeout(flushAutoDeltas, FLUSH_DELAY_MS);
}

async function flushAutoDeltas(): Promise<void> {
  timer = null;
  const entries = Array.from(pending.values());
  pending.clear();

  const items: TakaDeltaItem[] = [];
  for (const e of entries) {
    const mark = explicitMarks.get(keyOf(e.collectionName, e.docId));
    // Delete deltas are cheap and authoritative: always emit. Writes covered by an explicit delta are skipped.
    if (e.action === 'invalidate' && mark && mark >= e.queuedAt - EXPLICIT_BEFORE_MS && mark <= e.queuedAt + EXPLICIT_AFTER_MS) {
      continue;
    }
    items.push(
      e.action === 'delete'
        ? { docId: e.docId, collectionName: e.collectionName, action: 'delete', data: {} }
        : { docId: e.docId, collectionName: e.collectionName, action: 'update', data: {}, isPatch: true, invalidate: true }
    );
  }
  if (items.length === 0) return;

  try {
    const { recordBatchDeltas } = await import('./deltaSyncService');
    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += MAX_ITEMS_PER_DELTA) {
      await recordBatchDeltas(items.slice(i, i + MAX_ITEMS_PER_DELTA));
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[autoDelta] Failed to record auto deltas:', err);
  }
}


=== FILE: src/lib/backgroundSyncWorker.ts ===
import {
  localDb,
  bulkPersistProjects,
  bulkPersistTasks,
  bulkPersistCosts,
  bulkPersistDelegations,
  upsertLocalRecord,
  patchLocalRecord,
  deleteLocalRecord,
  getLocalProjects,
  getLocalTasks,
  getLocalTasksForProjects,
  getLocalCosts,
  getLocalDelegations,
  getLocalDelegationsForProjects,
  getLocalDelegationsForTasks,
} from './localDb';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { usePerformanceStore } from '../store/usePerformanceStore';
import { pullAndApplyDeltas } from './deltaSyncService';
import { TakaDelta, Project, Task, Cost, DelegationGroup } from '../types';
import { deduplicateTasks } from './taskDeduplicationService';
import { initBroadcastSyncListener } from './broadcastSyncService';
import { purgeOldDeltas } from './deltaPurgeService';
import { enforceStorageBudget } from './storageBudgetService';

/**
 * Nạp tức thì (Instant Boot ~5ms, 0 Read) dữ liệu từ Dexie Local-First Engine vào Zustand Store
 */
export async function bootstrapLocalStore(): Promise<{
  projectCount: number;
  taskCount: number;
  costCount: number;
}> {
  const start = performance.now();
  try {
    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    const currentYear = store.globalYearFilter;

    // Boot siêu tốc (~5ms, 0 read): Chỉ nạp Projects cần thiết của năm hiện tại
    // Tuân thủ triệt để Tri-Gate lazy loading: KHÔNG đọc Task, Cost hay Delegation khi chưa kích hoạt cờ
    const [projects, tasks, costs, delegations] = await Promise.all([
      getLocalProjects(currentYear),
      store.isTasksRequested ? getLocalTasks(currentYear) : Promise.resolve([]),
      store.isCostsRequested ? getLocalCosts(currentYear) : Promise.resolve([]),
      store.isDelegationsRequested ? getLocalDelegations(currentYear) : Promise.resolve([]),
    ]);

    if (projects.length > 0 && (!store.projects || store.projects.length === 0)) {
      const normalizedProjects = projects.map(p => ({
        ...p,
        taskCount: Math.max(p.taskCount ?? 0, p.taskSummaries?.length ?? 0),
      }));
      store.setProjects(normalizedProjects);
    }
    if (tasks.length > 0 && store.isTasksRequested && (!store.tasks || store.tasks.length === 0)) {
      store.setTasks(deduplicateTasks(tasks, projects));
    }
    if (costs.length > 0 && store.isCostsRequested && (!store.costs || store.costs.length === 0)) {
      store.setCosts(costs);
    }
    if (delegations.length > 0 && store.isDelegationsRequested && (!store.delegationGroups || store.delegationGroups.length === 0)) {
      store.setDelegationGroups(delegations);
    }

    const duration = Math.round(performance.now() - start);
    if (projects.length > 0) {
      usePerformanceStore
        .getState()
        .trackGetDoc('dexie_local_db', true, projects.length, `Local-First Boot in ${duration}ms`);
    }

    // Tự động kiểm tra và bảo đảm ngân sách bộ nhớ 40MB iOS
    setTimeout(() => {
      enforceStorageBudget().catch(() => {});
    }, 1000);

    return {
      projectCount: projects.length,
      taskCount: tasks.length,
      costCount: costs.length,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[backgroundSyncWorker] bootstrapLocalStore error:', err);
    return { projectCount: 0, taskCount: 0, costCount: 0 };
  }
}

/**
 * Nạp tức thời Projects từ Dexie khi mở app hoặc chuyển năm (0ms UI, 0 Firestore Read)
 */
export async function hydrateProjectsFromLocal(year?: string, storeFilter?: string): Promise<number> {
  try {
    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    const targetYear = year || store.globalYearFilter;
    if (store.projects && store.projects.length > 0) {
      if (!targetYear || targetYear === 'all' || targetYear === 'ALL') return store.projects.length;
      const hasForYear = store.projects.some(p => String(p.year || '') === String(targetYear));
      if (hasForYear) return store.projects.length;
    }

    const localProjects = await getLocalProjects(targetYear, storeFilter);
    if (localProjects && localProjects.length > 0) {
      const currentStore = useAppStore.getState();
      if (!currentStore.projects || currentStore.projects.length === 0) {
        const sorted = [...localProjects]
          .map(p => ({
            ...p,
            taskCount: Math.max(p.taskCount ?? 0, p.taskSummaries?.length ?? 0),
          }))
          .sort((a, b) => (a.no || 0) - (b.no || 0));
        currentStore.setProjects(sorted);
        usePerformanceStore
          .getState()
          .trackGetDoc('dexie_projects_hydration', true, localProjects.length, `Instant Local-First Projects Hydration (0ms, 0 Read)`);
        return localProjects.length;
      }
    }
    return 0;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[backgroundSyncWorker] hydrateProjectsFromLocal error:', err);
    return 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Nạp tức thời Tasks từ Dexie khi người dùng chuyển sang tab yêu cầu Tasks (0ms UI, triệt tiêu Spinner)
 */
export async function hydrateTasksFromLocal(year?: string): Promise<number> {
  try {
    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    const targetYear = year || store.globalYearFilter;
    if (store.tasks && store.tasks.length > 0) {
      if (!targetYear || targetYear === 'all' || targetYear === 'ALL') return store.tasks.length;
      const hasForYear = store.tasks.some(t => String(t.projectYear || '') === String(targetYear));
      if (hasForYear) return store.tasks.length;
    }

    const localTasks = await getLocalTasks(targetYear);
    if (localTasks && localTasks.length > 0) {
      const currentStore = useAppStore.getState();
      if (!currentStore.tasks || currentStore.tasks.length === 0) {
        const deduped = deduplicateTasks(localTasks, currentStore.projects);
        currentStore.setTasks(deduped);

        // Instant local reconciliation: sync taskCount & taskSummaries for projects from cached tasks
        if (currentStore.projects && currentStore.projects.length > 0) {
          const updatedProjects = currentStore.projects.map(p => {
            const pTasks = deduped.filter(t => 
              (t.projectId && String(t.projectId) === String(p.id)) ||
              (t.projectCode && String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase() === String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase())
            );
            if (pTasks.length > 0 && pTasks.length !== (p.taskCount || 0)) {
              const summaryItems = pTasks.map(t => ({
                id: t.id,
                name: t.name || '',
                start: t.start || '',
                finish: t.finish || '',
                taskCodePhu: t.taskCodePhu,
                duration: t.duration,
                runningStatus: t.runningStatus,
              }));
              const validStarts = pTasks.map(t => t.start).filter(Boolean).sort();
              const validFinishes = pTasks.map(t => t.finish).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));
              return {
                ...p,
                taskCount: pTasks.length,
                taskSummaries: summaryItems,
                computedTakStart: validStarts[0] || p.start || '',
                computedTakCompl: validFinishes[0] || p.handover || (p as any).takCompl || '',
              };
            }
            return p;
          });
          currentStore.setProjects(updatedProjects);
        }

        usePerformanceStore
          .getState()
          .trackGetDoc('dexie_tasks_hydration', true, deduped.length, 'Instant Local-First Tasks Hydration (0ms)');
        return deduped.length;
      }
    }
    return 0;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[backgroundSyncWorker] hydrateTasksFromLocal error:', err);
    return 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Nạp tức thì Tasks của các dự án cụ thể từ Dexie vào Zustand (0ms UI, không chờ Firestore)
 */
export async function hydrateTasksForProjects(projectIdsOrCodes: string[]): Promise<number> {
  if (!projectIdsOrCodes || projectIdsOrCodes.length === 0) return 0;
  try {
    const localTasks = await getLocalTasksForProjects(projectIdsOrCodes);
    if (!localTasks || localTasks.length === 0) return 0;

    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    const existingTasks = store.tasks || [];
    const existingIds = new Set(existingTasks.map(t => t.id));
    const newTasksToAdd: Task[] = [];

    for (const t of localTasks) {
      if (!existingIds.has(t.id)) {
        newTasksToAdd.push(t);
      }
    }

    if (newTasksToAdd.length > 0) {
      const merged = deduplicateTasks([...existingTasks, ...newTasksToAdd], store.projects);
      store.setTasks(merged);
      usePerformanceStore
        .getState()
        .trackGetDoc('dexie_tasks_partial_hydration', true, newTasksToAdd.length, `Local-First Hydration for ${projectIdsOrCodes.length} projects (0ms)`);
      return newTasksToAdd.length;
    }
    return 0;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[backgroundSyncWorker] hydrateTasksForProjects error:', err);
    return 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Nạp tức thời Costs từ Dexie khi người dùng chuyển sang tab yêu cầu Chi phí (0ms UI)
 */
export async function hydrateCostsFromLocal(year?: string): Promise<number> {
  try {
    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    if (store.costs && store.costs.length > 0) {
      if (!year || year === 'all' || year === 'ALL') return store.costs.length;
      const hasForYear = store.costs.some(c => String(c.projectYear || '') === String(year));
      if (hasForYear) return store.costs.length;
    }
    const localCosts = await getLocalCosts(year);
    if (localCosts && localCosts.length > 0) {
      const currentStore = useAppStore.getState();
      if (!currentStore.costs || currentStore.costs.length === 0) {
        currentStore.setCosts(localCosts);
        usePerformanceStore
          .getState()
          .trackGetDoc('dexie_costs_hydration', true, localCosts.length, 'Instant Local-First Costs Hydration (0ms)');
        return localCosts.length;
      }
    }
    return 0;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[backgroundSyncWorker] hydrateCostsFromLocal error:', err);
    return 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Nạp tức thời Delegations từ Dexie khi người dùng chuyển sang tab Phân quyền (0ms UI, lọc theo năm)
 */
export async function hydrateDelegationsFromLocal(year?: string): Promise<number> {
  try {
    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    const targetYear = year || store.globalYearFilter;

    // Nếu store đã nạp delegations của năm này, giữ nguyên (0 Read)
    if (store.delegationGroups && store.delegationGroups.length > 0) {
      if (!targetYear || targetYear === 'all' || targetYear === 'ALL') {
        return store.delegationGroups.length;
      }
      const hasForYear = store.delegationGroups.some(d => String(d.projectYear || '') === String(targetYear));
      if (hasForYear) return store.delegationGroups.length;
    }

    const localDelegations = await getLocalDelegations(targetYear);
    if (localDelegations && localDelegations.length > 0) {
      const currentStore = useAppStore.getState();
      const existing = currentStore.delegationGroups || [];
      const dMap = new Map(existing.map(d => [d.id, d]));
      // Store data (from Firestore listeners / deltas) is fresher than Dexie: never overwrite it
      localDelegations.forEach(d => { if (!dMap.has(d.id)) dMap.set(d.id, d); });
      const merged = Array.from(dMap.values());
      currentStore.setDelegationGroups(merged);
      usePerformanceStore
        .getState()
        .trackGetDoc('dexie_delegations_hydration', true, localDelegations.length, `Instant Local-First Delegations Hydration for ${targetYear || 'all'} (0ms, 0 Read)`);
      return localDelegations.length;
    }
    return 0;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[backgroundSyncWorker] hydrateDelegationsFromLocal error:', err);
    return 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Nạp tức thì Delegations của các dự án cụ thể từ Dexie vào Zustand (0ms UI, không tải cả kho 4000 items)
 */
export async function hydrateDelegationsForProjects(projectIdsOrCodes: string[]): Promise<number> {
  if (!projectIdsOrCodes || projectIdsOrCodes.length === 0) return 0;
  try {
    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    const currentProjects = store.projects || [];
    const expandedKeys = new Set<string>();

    projectIdsOrCodes.forEach((key) => {
      const trimmed = String(key).trim();
      if (!trimmed) return;
      expandedKeys.add(trimmed);
      const matched = currentProjects.find(
        (p) => String(p.id) === trimmed || String(p.code) === trimmed || String(p.no) === trimmed
      );
      if (matched?.code) expandedKeys.add(String(matched.code).trim());
      if (matched?.id) expandedKeys.add(String(matched.id).trim());
    });

    const localDelegations = await getLocalDelegationsForProjects(Array.from(expandedKeys));
    if (!localDelegations || localDelegations.length === 0) return 0;

    const existing = store.delegationGroups || [];
    const dMap = new Map(existing.map(d => [d.id, d]));
    let hasNew = false;
    localDelegations.forEach(d => {
      if (!dMap.has(d.id)) {
        dMap.set(d.id, d);
        hasNew = true;
      }
    });

    if (hasNew) {
      store.setDelegationGroups(Array.from(dMap.values()));
      usePerformanceStore
        .getState()
        .trackGetDoc('dexie_delegations_by_project', true, localDelegations.length, `Instant Delegations Hydration for ${projectIdsOrCodes.length} projects (0ms)`);
      return localDelegations.length;
    }
    return 0;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[backgroundSyncWorker] hydrateDelegationsForProjects error:', err);
    return 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Nạp tức thì Delegations của các task cụ thể từ Dexie vào Zustand (0ms UI)

export async function hydrateDelegationsForTasks(taskIds: string[]): Promise<number> {
  if (!taskIds || taskIds.length === 0) return 0;

    return 0;

    return 0;

/**
 * Ghi nhận các Delta nhận được từ server vào Dexie Local Database ngầm
 */
export async function applyDeltasToLocalDatabase(deltas: TakaDelta[]): Promise<void> {
  if (!deltas || deltas.length === 0) return;

  // Thực hiện giao dịch bất đồng bộ ngoài luồng render UI
  setTimeout(async () => {
    try {
      await localDb.transaction('rw', [localDb.projects, localDb.tasks, localDb.costs, localDb.delegations], async () => {
        const processDeltaItem = async (
          docId?: string,
          collectionName?: any,
          action?: string,
          data?: any,
          isPatch?: boolean
        ) => {
          if (!docId || !collectionName) return;
          if (collectionName === 'taka_delegation_groups') collectionName = 'taka_delegations';
          if (action === 'delete' || data?.isDeleted === true) {
            await deleteLocalRecord(collectionName, docId);
          } else if (action === 'update' || isPatch) {
            await patchLocalRecord(collectionName, docId, data || {});
          } else {
            await upsertLocalRecord(collectionName, { id: docId, ...data });
          }
        };

        for (const delta of deltas) {
          if (delta.action === 'batch_update' && Array.isArray(delta.batchItems)) {
            for (const item of delta.batchItems) {
              await processDeltaItem(item.docId, item.collectionName, item.action, item.data, item.isPatch);
            }
          } else if (delta.docId && delta.collectionName) {
            await processDeltaItem(delta.docId, delta.collectionName, delta.action, delta.data, delta.isPatch);
          }
        }
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[backgroundSyncWorker] applyDeltasToLocalDatabase error:', err);
    }
  }, 0);
}

/**
 * Lưu snapshot từ Firestore vào Dexie Local Database mà không làm nghẽn Main Thread
 */
export function offloadPersistSnapshot(
  collectionName: 'taka_projects' | 'taka_tasks' | 'taka_costs' | 'taka_delegations',
  items: any[]
): void {
  if (!items || items.length === 0) return;

  // Đẩy sang Microtask để UI duy trì 60 FPS
  setTimeout(async () => {
    try {
      switch (collectionName) {
        case 'taka_projects':
          await bulkPersistProjects(items as Project[]);
          break;
        case 'taka_tasks':
          await bulkPersistTasks(items as Task[]);
          break;
        case 'taka_costs':
          await bulkPersistCosts(items as Cost[]);
          break;
        case 'taka_delegations':
          await bulkPersistDelegations(items as DelegationGroup[]);
          break;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[backgroundSyncWorker] offloadPersistSnapshot error on ${collectionName}:`, err);
    }
  }, 0);
}

let syncCoordinatorTimer: any = null;

/**
 * Khởi chạy Background Sync Coordinator
 * Điều phối đồng bộ hai chiều giữa Dexie Local Engine và Firestore Delta Bus
 */
export function startBackgroundSyncCoordinator(intervalMs: number = 30000): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};

  // 1. Boot local store ngay lập tức
  bootstrapLocalStore().catch(() => {});

  // 2. Kích hoạt BroadcastChannel Multi-Tab Synchronization
  const cleanupBroadcast = initBroadcastSyncListener();

  // 3. Khởi chạy ngầm Auto-Purge dọn dẹp các delta cũ (>48h) không làm nghẽn UI
  setTimeout(() => {
    purgeOldDeltas(48).catch(() => {});
  }, 5000);

  // 4. Định kỳ kích hoạt Delta Sync
  const runSync = async () => {
    try {
      const year = useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter;
      await pullAndApplyDeltas(year);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[backgroundSyncWorker] runSync error:', err);
    }
  };

  if (syncCoordinatorTimer) {
    clearInterval(syncCoordinatorTimer);
  }

  syncCoordinatorTimer = setInterval(runSync, intervalMs);

  return () => {
    if (syncCoordinatorTimer) {
      clearInterval(syncCoordinatorTimer);
      syncCoordinatorTimer = null;
    }
    cleanupBroadcast();
  };
}

=== FILE: src/lib/broadcastSyncService.ts ===
import { TakaDelta, Project, Task, Cost, DelegationGroup } from '../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { upsertLocalRecord, patchLocalRecord, deleteLocalRecord } from './localDb';
import { applyFieldPatch } from './deltaPatchService';

const CHANNEL_NAME = 'taka_multi_tab_sync_v1';
const TAB_ID = typeof window !== 'undefined'
  ? `tab_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}_${Date.now()}`
  : 'server_tab';

export interface MultiTabSyncMessage {
  type: 'DELTA_APPLIED' | 'DIRECT_MUTATION';
  senderTabId: string;
  deltas?: TakaDelta[];
  timestamp: number;
}

let broadcastChannel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
let isListenerInitialized = false;

export function getBroadcastChannel(): BroadcastChannel | null {
  if (typeof globalThis === 'undefined' || !('BroadcastChannel' in globalThis)) {
    return null;
  }
  if (!broadcastChannel) {
    try {
      broadcastChannel = new (globalThis as any).BroadcastChannel(CHANNEL_NAME);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[broadcastSync] BroadcastChannel init failed:', e);
      return null;
    }
  }
  return broadcastChannel;
}

export function resetBroadcastChannelForTesting(): void {
  broadcastChannel = null;
  isListenerInitialized = false;
}

export function broadcastAppliedDeltas(deltas: TakaDelta[]): void {
  if (!deltas || deltas.length === 0) return;
  const channel = getBroadcastChannel();
  if (!channel) return;

  try {
    const message: MultiTabSyncMessage = {
      type: 'DELTA_APPLIED',
      senderTabId: TAB_ID,
      deltas,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };
    channel.postMessage(message);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[broadcastSync] Failed to post delta message to channel:', err);
  }
}

type Coll = 'taka_projects' | 'taka_tasks' | 'taka_costs' | 'taka_delegations';

export function initBroadcastSyncListener(): () => void {
  if (isListenerInitialized || typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return () => {};
  }
  const channel = getBroadcastChannel();
  if (!channel) {
    return () => {};
  }
  isListenerInitialized = true;

  const handleMessage = (event: MessageEvent<MultiTabSyncMessage>) => {
    const msg = event.data;
    if (!msg || msg.senderTabId === TAB_ID) return;
    if (msg.type !== 'DELTA_APPLIED' || !Array.isArray(msg.deltas) || msg.deltas.length === 0) return;

    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    const projectMap = new Map<string, Project>((store.projects || []).map((p) => [p.id as string, p]));
    const taskMap = new Map<string, Task>((store.tasks || []).map((t) => [t.id as string, t]));
    const costMap = new Map<string, Cost>((store.costs || []).map((c) => [c.id as string, c]));
    const delegMap = new Map<string, DelegationGroup>((store.delegationGroups || []).map((d) => [d.id as string, d]));

    const projectsUpdated = new Map<string, Project>();
    const tasksUpdated = new Map<string, Task>();
    const costsUpdated = new Map<string, Cost>();
    const delegUpdated = new Map<string, DelegationGroup>();

    const projectsDeleted = new Set<string>();
    const tasksDeleted = new Set<string>();
    const costsDeleted = new Set<string>();
    const delegDeleted = new Set<string>();

    const processItem = (
      docId: string,
      collectionName: Coll,
      action: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete',
      data: any,
      invalidate?: boolean
    ) => {
      if (!docId) return;
      // Tín hiệu "invalidate" không mang dữ liệu: để pipeline delta của chính tab này tự đọc
      if (invalidate) return;

      const deleted: Set<string> = 
        collectionName === 'taka_projects' ? projectsDeleted :
        collectionName === 'taka_tasks' ? tasksDeleted :
        collectionName === 'taka_costs' ? costsDeleted :
        delegDeleted;

      const updated: Map<string, any> = 
        collectionName === 'taka_projects' ? projectsUpdated :
        collectionName === 'taka_tasks' ? tasksUpdated :
        collectionName === 'taka_costs' ? costsUpdated :
        delegUpdated;

      const existingMap: Map<string, any> = 
        collectionName === 'taka_projects' ? projectMap :
        collectionName === 'taka_tasks' ? taskMap :
        collectionName === 'taka_costs' ? costMap :
        delegMap;

      if (action === 'delete') {
        deleted.add(docId);
        updated.delete(docId);
        deleteLocalRecord(collectionName, docId).catch(() => {});
        return;
      }

      const existing = updated.get(docId) || existingMap.get(docId);
      if (action === 'create' && data && Object.keys(data).length > 0) {
        // Bản đầy đủ: hợp nhất lên bản đang có (nếu có) và upsert Dexie
        const merged = existing ? applyFieldPatch(existing, data) : { id: docId, ...data };
        updated.set(docId, merged);
        upsertLocalRecord(collectionName, merged).catch(() => {});
        return;
      }

      // action 'update' (bản vá): chỉ vá bản ghi ĐÃ CÓ. Không tạo bản ghi thiếu field.
      patchLocalRecord(collectionName, docId, data || {}).catch(() => {});
      if (existing && data && Object.keys(data).length > 0) {
        updated.set(docId, applyFieldPatch(existing, data));
      }
    };

    msg.deltas.forEach((delta) => {
      if (delta.action === 'batch_update' && Array.isArray(delta.batchItems)) {
        delta.batchItems.forEach((item) => {
          processItem(item.docId, item.collectionName as Coll, item.action, item.data, item.invalidate);
        });
      } else if (delta.docId && delta.collectionName) {
        processItem(delta.docId, delta.collectionName as Coll, delta.action as any, delta.data);
      }
    });

    if (projectsUpdated.size > 0) store.optimisticUpdateProjects(Array.from(projectsUpdated.values()) as (Project & { id: string })[]);
    if (projectsDeleted.size > 0) store.optimisticDeleteProjects(Array.from(projectsDeleted));
    if (tasksUpdated.size > 0) store.optimisticUpdateTasks(Array.from(tasksUpdated.values()) as (Task & { id: string })[]);
    if (tasksDeleted.size > 0) store.optimisticDeleteTasks(Array.from(tasksDeleted));
    if (costsUpdated.size > 0) store.optimisticUpdateCosts(Array.from(costsUpdated.values()));
    if (costsDeleted.size > 0) store.optimisticDeleteCosts(Array.from(costsDeleted));

    if (delegUpdated.size > 0 || delegDeleted.size > 0) {
      const current = store.delegationGroups || [];
      const next = current
        .filter((d) => !delegDeleted.has(d.id as string))
        .map((d) => (delegUpdated.has(d.id as string) ? delegUpdated.get(d.id as string)! : d));
      
      delegUpdated.forEach((d, id) => {
        if (!next.some((n) => n.id === id)) next.push(d);
      });
      store.setDelegationGroups(next);
    }
  };

  channel.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);

  return () => {
    channel.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
  };
}


=== FILE: src/lib/budgetTreeService.ts ===
import { 
  calculatePaidBreakdown, 
  calculateBudgetRemaining, 
  BudgetRollupChild, 
  BudgetRollupResult 
} from './financialService';

export function calculateParentBudgetRollup(children: BudgetRollupChild[]): BudgetRollupResult {
  const totalBudget = children.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.budget) || 0), 0);
  const totalActual = children.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.totalActual) || 0), 0);
  const totalSupportingFee = children.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.totalSupportingFee) || 0), 0);
  const hasForc = children.some(c => Boolean(c.hasForc));
  const remaining = calculateBudgetRemaining(totalBudget, totalActual, totalSupportingFee);

  return {
    totalBudget,
    totalActual,
    totalSupportingFee,
    hasForc,
    remaining
  };
}

export interface BudgetNode {
  id: string;
  isSelf: boolean;
  isParentNode: boolean;
  code: string;
  name?: string;
  year?: string | number;
  store?: string;
  location?: string;
  type?: string;
  note?: string;
  budget: number;
  totalBudget: number;
  ownActual: number;
  totalActual: number;
  ownSupportingFee: number;
  totalSupportingFee: number;
  hasForc: boolean;
  remaining: number;
  project: any;
  parentId?: string;
  children: BudgetNode[];
  filteredChildren?: BudgetNode[];
  isSearchMatch?: boolean;
}

export interface BudgetTreeResult {
  roots: BudgetNode[];
  projectMap: Map<string, any>;
  codeToProjects: Map<string, any[]>;
}

export function buildBudgetTree(projects: any[], costs: any[]): BudgetTreeResult {
  const projectMap = new Map<string, any>();
  const codeToProjects = new Map<string, any[]>();

  projects.forEach(p => {
    const key = `${String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.year || '')}_${String(p.store || '')}`;
    const projectCosts = costs.filter(c => {
      const costCode = String(c.projectCode || (c as any).code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (costCode !== pCode) return false;

      const costYear = String(c.projectYear || (c as any).year || '').trim();
      const pYear = String(p.year || (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '')).trim();
      const matchesYear = !costYear || !pYear || costYear === pYear;
      if (!matchesYear) return false;

      const costStore = String(c.projectStore || (c as any).store || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const matchesStore = !costStore || !pStore || costStore === pStore;
      if (!matchesStore) return false;

      return true;
    });

    const computedActual = projectCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.actual) || 0), 0);
    const computedForc = projectCosts.filter(c => c.costType === 'forc').reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.actual) || 0), 0);
    const computedSupportingFee = projectCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.supportingFee) || 0), 0);

    const fin = p.financial || { totalApproved: p.budget || 0, totalActualPaid: p.actual || 0, totalForecastPaid: 0 };
    const hasCosts = projectCosts.length > 0;

    const finalActual = hasCosts ? computedActual : (fin.totalActualPaid || p.actual || 0);
    const finalForc = hasCosts ? computedForc : (fin.totalForecastPaid || 0);
    const finalSupportingFee = hasCosts ? computedSupportingFee : (p.supportingFee || 0);

    const pData = {
      ...p,
      ownActual: finalActual,
      ownForc: finalForc,
      ownSupportingFee: finalSupportingFee,
      hasForc: finalForc > 0,
      ownBudget: fin.totalApproved || p.budget || 0,
    };
    projectMap.set(key, pData);

    const codeKey = String(p.code).trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!codeToProjects.has(codeKey)) {
      codeToProjects.set(codeKey, []);
    }
    codeToProjects.get(codeKey)!.push(pData);
  });

  const parentToChildrenMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
  const linkedChildIds = new Set<string>();

  projects.forEach(p => {
    if (p.parentId && String(p.parentId).trim()) {
      const parentCode = String(p.parentId).trim().toUpperCase();
      if (codeToProjects.has(parentCode)) {
        if (!parentToChildrenMap.has(parentCode)) {
          parentToChildrenMap.set(parentCode, []);
        }
        const key = `${String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.year || '')}_${String(p.store || '')}`;
        const pData = projectMap.get(key) || p;
        parentToChildrenMap.get(parentCode)!.push(pData);
        linkedChildIds.add(p.id || `${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.store}-${p.no}`);
      }
    }
  });

  const roots: BudgetNode[] = [];

  projects.forEach(p => {
    const pId = p.id || `${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.store}-${p.no}`;
    if (linkedChildIds.has(pId)) {
      return;
    }

    const key = `${String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.year || '')}_${String(p.store || '')}`;
    const pData = projectMap.get(key) || p;
    const parentCode = String(p.code).trim().toUpperCase();

    const selfBudget = pData.ownBudget ?? 0;
    const selfActual = pData.ownActual ?? 0;
    const selfSupportingFee = pData.ownSupportingFee ?? 0;
    const selfRemaining = selfBudget - selfActual + selfSupportingFee;

    const selfChild: BudgetNode = {
      id: `${pId}_self`,
      isSelf: true,
      isParentNode: false,
      code: p.code,
      name: p.name,
      year: p.year,
      store: p.store,
      location: p.location,
      type: p.type,
      note: p.note,
      budget: selfBudget,
      totalBudget: selfBudget,
      ownActual: selfActual,
      totalActual: selfActual,
      ownSupportingFee: selfSupportingFee,
      totalSupportingFee: selfSupportingFee,
      hasForc: pData.hasForc,
      remaining: selfRemaining,
      project: p,
      children: [],
    };

    const linkedProjects = (parentToChildrenMap.get(parentCode) || []).map((childP: any) => {
      const childId = childP.id || `${childP.code}-${childP.year}-${childP.store}-${childP.no}`;
      const cBudget = childP.ownBudget ?? 0;
      const cActual = childP.ownActual ?? 0;
      const cSupportingFee = childP.ownSupportingFee ?? 0;
      const cRemaining = cBudget - cActual + cSupportingFee;

      return {
        id: childId,
        isSelf: false,
        isParentNode: false,
        code: childP.code,
        name: childP.name,
        year: childP.year,
        store: childP.store,
        location: childP.location,
        type: childP.type,
        note: childP.note,
        budget: cBudget,
        totalBudget: cBudget,
        ownActual: cActual,
        totalActual: cActual,
        ownSupportingFee: cSupportingFee,
        totalSupportingFee: cSupportingFee,
        hasForc: childP.hasForc,
        remaining: cRemaining,
        parentId: childP.parentId,
        project: childP,
        children: [],
      };
    });

    const allChildren = [selfChild, ...linkedProjects];
    const rollup = calculateParentBudgetRollup(allChildren);

    const parentNode: BudgetNode = {
      ...pData,
      id: pId,
      isParentNode: true,
      isSelf: false,
      totalBudget: rollup.totalBudget,
      totalActual: rollup.totalActual,
      totalSupportingFee: rollup.totalSupportingFee,
      ownSupportingFee: selfSupportingFee,
      hasForc: rollup.hasForc,
      remaining: rollup.remaining,
      children: allChildren,
      project: p,
    };

    roots.push(parentNode);
  });

  return { roots, projectMap, codeToProjects };
}

export interface BudgetFilterOptions {
  globalYearFilter?: string;
  effectiveStore?: string;
  globalLocationFilter?: string[];
  codeFilter?: string;
  searchTerm?: string;
  moneyFilter?: 'all' | 'has_money' | 'has_budget' | 'has_act_forc';
}

export function filterBudgetRoots(roots: BudgetNode[], options: BudgetFilterOptions = {}): BudgetNode[] {
  const {
    globalYearFilter = 'all',
    effectiveStore = 'all',
    globalLocationFilter = [],
    codeFilter = '',
    searchTerm = '',
    moneyFilter = 'all'
  } = options;

  const cleanCode = (codeFilter || '').replace(/["']/g, '').trim().toLowerCase();

  return roots.filter(node => {
    const pYear = node.year ? String(node.year) : (node.project?.start ? String(node.project.start).substring(0, 4) : null);
    const matchesYear = globalYearFilter === 'all' || pYear === globalYearFilter;
    const matchesStore = effectiveStore === 'all' || node.store === effectiveStore;
    const matchesLocation = globalLocationFilter.length === 0 || (node.location && globalLocationFilter.includes(node.location));

    const hasBudget = (node.totalBudget || 0) !== 0;
    const hasActForc = (node.totalActual || 0) !== 0;
    let matchesMoney = true;
    if (moneyFilter === 'has_money') matchesMoney = hasBudget || hasActForc;
    else if (moneyFilter === 'has_budget') matchesMoney = hasBudget;
    else if (moneyFilter === 'has_act_forc') matchesMoney = hasActForc;

    const baseParentMatch = matchesYear && matchesStore && matchesLocation && matchesMoney;

    const matchesCode = !cleanCode || String(node.code || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanCode) ||
      (node.children && node.children.some(c => String(c.code || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanCode)));
    if (!matchesCode) return false;

    if (searchTerm) {
      const lowerTerm = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
      const isParentMatch = [
        node.code, node.name, node.store, node.location, node.type, node.note, node.year,
        node.totalBudget, node.totalActual, node.remaining
      ].some(val => String(val ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(lowerTerm));

      const anyChildMatch = node.children && node.children.some(child => [
        child.code, child.name, child.store, child.location, child.type, child.note, child.year,
        child.budget, child.totalActual, child.remaining
      ].some(val => String(val ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(lowerTerm)));

      if (!isParentMatch && !anyChildMatch) return false;
    }

    return baseParentMatch;
  });
}

export function calculateBudgetGlobalTotals(filteredRoots: BudgetNode[]) {
  const totalBudget = filteredRoots.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.totalBudget || 0), 0);
  const totalActual = filteredRoots.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.totalActual || 0), 0);
  const totalSupportingFee = filteredRoots.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.totalSupportingFee || 0), 0);
  const totalRemaining = totalBudget - totalActual + totalSupportingFee;
  return { totalBudget, totalActual, totalSupportingFee, totalRemaining };
}
