=== FILE: src/lib/changeFlashService.ts ===
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
/**
 * Smart Change Flash & Live Edit Awareness Service (Notion, Jira & Google Sheets Standard)
 * 
 * Provides instantaneous, high-performance visual feedback when data is updated remotely:
 * 1. Highlights recently updated rows with a subtle emerald green pulse (Smart Change Flash).
 * 2. Auto-fades after 2.5 seconds with zero residual CPU/DOM overhead.
 * 3. Tracks active collaborative editing presence between teammates.
 */


export interface FlashEntry {
  docId: string;
  collectionName: string;
  updatedBy?: string;
  timestamp: number;
}

// In-memory registry of flashed document IDs (O(1) lookups)
const activeFlashMap = new Map<string, FlashEntry>();
const listeners = new Set<(flashedIds: Set<string>) => void>();
let cleanupTimer: any = null;

// Registry of user editing presence: docId -> { email, timestamp }
const activeEditingPresenceMap = new Map<string, { email: string; timestamp: number }>();
const presenceListeners = new Set<() => void>();

function notifyListeners() {
  const currentSet = new Set(activeFlashMap.keys());
  listeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try {
      fn(currentSet);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[changeFlash] Listener error:', e);
    }
  });
}

function scheduleCleanup() {
  if (cleanupTimer) return;
  cleanupTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    cleanupTimer = null;
    const now = Date.now();
    let hasExpired = false;

    for (const [id, entry] of activeFlashMap.entries()) {
      if (now - entry.timestamp >= 2500) {
        activeFlashMap.delete(id);
        hasExpired = true;
      }
    }

    if (hasExpired) {
      notifyListeners();
    }

    if (activeFlashMap.size > 0) {
      scheduleCleanup();
    }
  }, 300);
}

/**
 * Triggers a smart change flash on a document ID (e.g. from Delta Sync or Realtime listener)
 */
export function triggerChangeFlash(docId: string, collectionName: string, updatedBy?: string) {
  if (!docId) return;
  activeFlashMap.set(docId, {
    docId,
    collectionName,
    updatedBy,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
  });
  notifyListeners();
  scheduleCleanup();
}

/**
 * Batches multiple flash triggers into a single notification to avoid layout churn
 */
export function triggerBatchChangeFlash(
  entries: Array<{ docId: string; collectionName: string; updatedBy?: string }>
) {
  if (!entries || entries.length === 0) return;
  const now = Date.now();
  entries.forEach((e) => {
    if (e.docId) {
      activeFlashMap.set(e.docId, {
        docId: e.docId,
        collectionName: e.collectionName,
        updatedBy: e.updatedBy,
        timestamp: now,
      });
    }
  });
  notifyListeners();
  scheduleCleanup();
}

/**
 * Hook to check if a specific row/docId is currently in "Smart Flash" state.
 * Only re-renders rows that match the changed ID.
 */
export function useIsRowFlashed(docId?: string | null): { isFlashed: boolean; updatedBy?: string } {
  const [isFlashed, setIsFlashed] = useState<boolean>(() => (docId ? activeFlashMap.has(docId) : false));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!docId) return;

    const handleUpdate = (flashedIds: Set<string>) => {
      const active = flashedIds.has(docId);
      setIsFlashed(active);
    };

    // Set initial
    setIsFlashed(activeFlashMap.has(docId));

    listeners.add(handleUpdate);
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(handleUpdate);
    };
  }, [docId]);

  const entry = docId ? activeFlashMap.get(docId) : undefined;
  return {
    isFlashed,
    updatedBy: entry?.updatedBy,
  };
}

/**
 * Broadcasts that the current user is actively viewing/editing a task or project
 */
export function setLocalEditingPresence(docId: string, email: string) {
  if (!docId || !email) return;
  activeEditingPresenceMap.set(docId, { email, timestamp: Date.now() });
  presenceListeners.forEach((fn) => fn());
}

/**
 * Clears local editing presence when a modal closes
 */
export function clearLocalEditingPresence(docId: string) {
  if (!docId) return;
  activeEditingPresenceMap.delete(docId);
  presenceListeners.forEach((fn) => fn());
}

/**
 * Hook to retrieve active collaborator presence for a document
 */
export function useEditingPresence(docId?: string | null, currentUserEmail?: string): { isCollaborating: boolean; collaboratorEmail?: string } {
  const [presence, setPresence] = useState<{ isCollaborating: boolean; collaboratorEmail?: string }>({ isCollaborating: false });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!docId) return;

    const check = () => {
      const p = activeEditingPresenceMap.get(docId);
      if (p && p.email !== currentUserEmail && Date.now() - p.timestamp < 60000) {
        setPresence({ isCollaborating: true, collaboratorEmail: p.email });
      } else {
        setPresence({ isCollaborating: false });
      }
    };

    check();
    presenceListeners.add(check);
    return () => {
      presenceListeners.delete(check);
    };
  }, [docId, currentUserEmail]);

  return presence;
}


=== FILE: src/lib/cleanup.ts ===
import { safeGetItemLocal, safeSetItemLocal, safeRemoveItemLocal, safeGetItemSession, safeSetItemSession, safeRemoveItemSession } from "./storage";
export function cleanupLocalStorage() {
  try {
    const keysToRemove: string[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
      const key = localStorage.key(i);
      if (!key) continue;

      // Clean up old notification metadata to prevent unbound growth
      if (key.startsWith('taka_notified_')) {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(safeGetItemLocal(key) || '[]');
          if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 300) {
            // Keep only the most recent 300 notification IDs
            safeSetItemLocal(key, JSON.stringify(data.slice(-300)));
            console.log(`[Cleanup] Trimmed notification history for ${key}`);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          keysToRemove.push(key); // Remove if malformed
        }
      }

      // Identify malformed or broken view preferences
      if (
        key.startsWith('taka_col_widths_') || 
        key.startsWith('taka_visible_cols_') ||
        key.startsWith('taka_delegation_') ||
        key.startsWith('taka_budget_') ||
        key.startsWith('taka_gantt_')
      ) {
        try {
          const val = safeGetItemLocal(key);
          if (val) {
            // If it's supposed to be an object/array, parse it.
            // If it fails, we remove it.
            if (val.startsWith('{') || val.startsWith('[')) {
              JSON.parse(val);
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          keysToRemove.push(key);
        }
      }
    }

    // Remove identified bad keys
    if (keysToRemove.length > 0) {
      keysToRemove.forEach(key => {
        safeRemoveItemLocal(key);
      });
      console.log(`[Cleanup] Removed ${keysToRemove.length} broken/outdated keys.`);
    } else {
      console.log('[Cleanup] LocalStorage is clean.');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Cleanup] Error during LocalStorage cleanup:', error);
  }
}


=== FILE: src/lib/colorMappingLogic.ts ===
import { Project } from "../types";
import { getStatus } from "./utils";

export const STATUS_COLORS = {
  "Canceled": "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.75)", // slate-400
  "Upcoming": "rgba(203, 213, 225, 0.6)",  // slate-300
  "On process": "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.75)",// amber-500
  "Handover": "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.75)",  // sky-400
  "Completed": "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.75)", // emerald-500
  "Default": "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.1)"    // transparent slate
};

const STATUS_PRIORITY = {
  "On process": 5,
  "Handover": 4,
  "Upcoming": 3,
  "Completed": 2,
  "Canceled": 1,
  "Default": 0
};

export function computeColorMap(projects: Project[]): Record<string, string> {
  const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {};
  const currentPriority: Record<string, number> = {};

  for (const p of projects) {
    if (!p.code) continue;
    
    // Project code might contain multiple units like "L1-01, L1-02"
    const unitNames = String(p.code).split(',').map(c => c.trim().toUpperCase()).filter(Boolean);
    const status = getStatus(p.start, p.handover, p.opening, p.code);
    const priority = STATUS_PRIORITY[status as keyof typeof STATUS_PRIORITY] || 0;
    
    for (const unitName of unitNames) {
      if (!currentPriority[unitName] || priority > currentPriority[unitName]) {
        currentPriority[unitName] = priority;
        colorMap[unitName] = STATUS_COLORS[status as keyof typeof STATUS_COLORS] || STATUS_COLORS["Default"];
      }
    }
  }

  return colorMap;
}

  rulesVersion?: number;

/**
 * Tải trước dữ liệu tĩnh từ LocalStorage vào Zustand Store để app mở tức thì (0ms, 0 Read)
 */
export function loadCachedStaticConfig(): {
  locations: string[];
  locationVisibility: Record<string, boolean>;
  parties: string[];
  jpyRate: number;
  usdRate: number;
  rules: NotificationRule[];
  r2Config: { accountId: string; bucketName: string; accessKeyId: string; secretAccessKey: string } | null;
  permissions: PermissionMatrix;
  subAppUsers: any[];
  appUsers: AppUser[];
} {
  let locations: string[] = [];
  let locationVisibility: Record<string, boolean> = {};
  let parties: string[] = ["Shimizu", "Landlord", "Takashimaya", "CP"];
  let jpyRate = 160;
  let usdRate = 25000;
  let rules: NotificationRule[] = [];
  let r2Config = null;
  let permissions: PermissionMatrix = {} as PermissionMatrix;
  let subAppUsers: any[] = [];
  let appUsers: AppUser[] = [];

  try {
    const rawLocs = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.LOCATIONS);
    if (rawLocs) locations = JSON.parse(rawLocs);

    const rawVis = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.LOCATION_VISIBILITY);
    if (rawVis) locationVisibility = JSON.parse(rawVis);

    const rawParties = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.PARTIES);
    if (rawParties) parties = JSON.parse(rawParties);

    const rawJpy = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.JPY_RATE);
    if (rawJpy) {
      const num = Number(rawJpy);
      if (!isNaN(num) && num > 0) jpyRate = num;
    }

    const rawUsd = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.USD_RATE);
    if (rawUsd) {
      const num = Number(rawUsd);
      if (!isNaN(num) && num > 0) usdRate = num;
    }

    const rawRules = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.RULES);
    if (rawRules) rules = JSON.parse(rawRules);

    const rawR2 = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.R2_CONFIG);
    if (rawR2) r2Config = JSON.parse(rawR2);

    const rawPerms = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.PERMISSIONS);
    if (rawPerms) permissions = JSON.parse(rawPerms);

    const rawSubUsers = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.SUB_APP_USERS);
    if (rawSubUsers) subAppUsers = JSON.parse(rawSubUsers);

    const rawAppUsers = safeGetItemLocal(CACHE_KEYS.APP_USERS);
    if (rawAppUsers) appUsers = JSON.parse(rawAppUsers);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("Failed to parse cached static config:", e);
  }

  return { locations, locationVisibility, parties, jpyRate, usdRate, rules, r2Config, permissions, subAppUsers, appUsers };
}

/**
 * Gửi tín hiệu tăng số phiên bản của một danh mục cấu hình khi Admin chỉnh sửa.
 * Giúp các client khác tự động kích hoạt tải lại chỉ 1 document tương ứng.
 */
export async function bumpConfigVersion(
  type: "locations" | "parties" | "rates" | "rules" | "permissions" | "sub_app_users" | "app_users"
): Promise<void> {
  const versionRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "versions");
  const now = Date.now();
  const updatePayload: Record<string, any> = {
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  if (type === "locations") updatePayload.locationsVersion = now;
  if (type === "parties") updatePayload.partiesVersion = now;
  if (type === "rates") updatePayload.ratesVersion = now;
  if (type === "rules") updatePayload.rulesVersion = now;
  if (type === "permissions") updatePayload.permissionsVersion = now;
  if (type === "sub_app_users") updatePayload.subAppUsersVersion = now;
  if (type === "app_users") updatePayload.appUsersVersion = now;

  try {
    await setDoc(versionRef, updatePayload, { merge: true });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to bump config version:", e);
  }
}

/**
 * Đồng bộ danh mục cấu hình tĩnh theo cơ chế Cache + Versioning.
 * Thay vì mở nhiều onSnapshot liên tục, chỉ lắng nghe 1 document version nhẹ duy nhất.
 */
export function setupStaticConfigSync(): Unsubscribe {
  const versionRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "versions");
  usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener("taka_config/versions");

  const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(
    versionRef,
    async (docSnap) => {
      usePerformanceStore.getState().trackSnapshot("taka_config/versions", docSnap);
      useAppStore.getState().setCloudStatus("online");
      const localVersions = getLocalConfigVersions();
      const store = useAppStore.getState();

      const remoteData: ConfigVersions = docSnap.exists() ? (docSnap.data() as ConfigVersions) : {};
      const needsInit = !docSnap.exists();

      // 1. Locations
      const localLocs = store.locations;
      const remoteLocVer = remoteData.locationsVersion || 1;
      if (localVersions.locationsVersion !== remoteLocVer || localLocs.length === 0 || needsInit) {
        try {
          const locDoc = await getDoc(
            doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "locations")
          );
          if (locDoc.exists()) {
            const list = locDoc.data()?.list || [];
            const visibility = locDoc.data()?.visibility || {};
            const uniqueList = [...new Set(list)] as string[];
            store.setLocations(uniqueList);
            store.setLocationVisibility(visibility);
            cacheLocations(uniqueList, visibility);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching locations config:", err);
        }
      }

      // 2. Parties
      const localParties = store.parties;
      const remotePartyVer = remoteData.partiesVersion || 1;
      if (localVersions.partiesVersion !== remotePartyVer || localParties.length === 0 || needsInit) {
        try {
          const partyDoc = await getDoc(
            doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "parties")
          );
          if (partyDoc.exists() && partyDoc.data()?.list) {
            const list = partyDoc.data()?.list;
            store.setParties(list);
            cacheParties(list);
          } else {
            const defaultParties = ["Shimizu", "Landlord", "Takashimaya", "CP"];
            store.setParties(defaultParties);
            cacheParties(defaultParties);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching parties config:", err);
        }
      }

      // 3. Exchange Rates
      const remoteRateVer = remoteData.ratesVersion || 1;
      if (localVersions.ratesVersion !== remoteRateVer || needsInit) {
        try {
          const rateDoc = await getDoc(
            doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_settings", "exchange_rates")
          );
          if (rateDoc.exists()) {
            const data = rateDoc.data();
            const jpy = data.jpyRate !== undefined ? Number(data.jpyRate) : 160;
            const usd = data.usdRate !== undefined ? Number(data.usdRate) : 25000;
            store.setJpyRate(jpy);
            store.setUsdRate(usd);
            cacheExchangeRates(jpy, usd);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching exchange rates config:", err);
        }
      }

      // 4. Notification Rules
      const remoteRuleVer = remoteData.rulesVersion || 1;
      if (localVersions.rulesVersion !== remoteRuleVer || store.notificationRules.length === 0 || needsInit) {
        try {
          const rulesSnap = await getDocs(
            collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_rules")
          );
          const loaded: NotificationRule[] = [];
          rulesSnap.forEach((d) => {
            loaded.push({ id: d.id, ...d.data() } as NotificationRule);
          });
          store.setNotificationRules(loaded);
          cacheRules(loaded);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching notification rules config:", err);
        }
      }

      // 5. R2 Config
      const remoteR2Ver = remoteData.r2Version || 1;
      if (localVersions.r2Version !== remoteR2Ver || store.r2Config === null || needsInit) {
        try {
          const r2Doc = await getDoc(
            doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "r2_credentials")
          );
          if (r2Doc.exists()) {
            const data = r2Doc.data() as { accountId: string; bucketName: string; accessKeyId: string; secretAccessKey: string };
            if (data.accountId && data.accessKeyId) {
               store.setR2Config(data);
               cacheR2Config(data);
            }
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching r2 config:", err);
        }
      }

      // 6. Permissions Matrix
      const remotePermsVer = remoteData.permissionsVersion || 1;
      if (localVersions.permissionsVersion !== remotePermsVer || Object.keys(store.permissionMatrix || {}).length === 0 || needsInit) {
        try {
          const permsDoc = await getDoc(
            doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_settings", "permissions")
          );
          if (permsDoc.exists()) {
            const data = permsDoc.data() as PermissionMatrix;
            store.setPermissionMatrix(data);
            cachePermissions(data);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching permissions config:", err);
        }
      }

      // 7. Sub App Users
      const remoteSubUsersVer = remoteData.subAppUsersVersion || 1;
      if (localVersions.subAppUsersVersion !== remoteSubUsersVer || store.subAppUsers.length === 0 || needsInit) {
        try {
          const subUsersSnap = await getDocs(
            collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_sub_app_users")
          );
          const loaded: any[] = [];
          subUsersSnap.forEach((docSnap) => {
            loaded.push({ id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() });
          });
          store.setSubAppUsers(loaded);
          cacheSubAppUsers(loaded);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching subAppUsers config:", err);
        }
      }

      // 8. App Users (taka_users versioning)
      const remoteAppUsersVer = remoteData.appUsersVersion || 1;
      if (localVersions.appUsersVersion !== remoteAppUsersVer || store.appUsers.length === 0 || needsInit) {
        try {
          const usersSnap = await getDocs(
            collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_users")
          );
          const loaded: AppUser[] = [];
          usersSnap.forEach((docSnap) => {
            loaded.push({ id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() } as AppUser);
          });
          store.setAppUsers(loaded);
          cacheAppUsers(loaded);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error fetching taka_users config:", err);
        }
      }

      // Cập nhật lại versions vào local cache
      setLocalConfigVersions({
        locationsVersion: remoteLocVer,
        partiesVersion: remotePartyVer,
        ratesVersion: remoteRateVer,
        rulesVersion: remoteRuleVer,
        r2Version: remoteR2Ver,
        permissionsVersion: remotePermsVer,
        subAppUsersVersion: remoteSubUsersVer,
        appUsersVersion: remoteAppUsersVer,
        globalRestoreCutoff: remoteData.globalRestoreCutoff,
        dataFingerprint: remoteData.dataFingerprint,
        updatedAt: remoteData.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    },
    (err) => {
      console.warn("Config versions listener error:", err);
    }
  );

  return () => {
    unsubscribe();
    usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener("taka_config/versions");
  };
}

=== FILE: src/lib/csvUtils.ts ===

export function downloadCSV(csvContent: string, fileName: string) {
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  if (link.download !== undefined) {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.setAttribute('href', url);
    link.setAttribute('download', fileName);
    link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }
}

export function parseCSV(csvText: string): string[][] {
  const lines = csvText.split(/\r?\n/);
  return lines.map(line => {
    const result = [];
    let current = '';
    let inQuotes = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
      const char = line[i];
      if (char === '"') {
        if (inQuotes && line[i+1] === '"') {
           current += '"';
           i++;
        } else {
           inQuotes = !inQuotes;
        }
      } else if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) {
        result.push(current.trim());
        current = '';
      } else {
        current += char;
      }
    }
    result.push(current.trim());
    return result;
  }).filter(row => row.length > 1 || (row.length === 1 && row[0] !== ''));
}

export function generateCSV(headers: string[], data: any[][]): string {
  const csvRows = [];
  csvRows.push(headers.join(','));
  
  for (const row of data) {
    const values = row.map(value => {
      const escaped = String(value).replace(/"/g, '""');
      return `"${escaped}"`;
    });
    csvRows.push(values.join(','));
  }
  
  return csvRows.join('\n');
}

=== FILE: src/lib/delegationMaintenanceService.ts ===
import { collection, query, where, getDocs, doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from './firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { DelegationGroup } from '../types';
import { deleteLocalRecord } from './localDb';

/**
 * Kiểm tra xem một DelegationGroup có phải là placeholder rỗng tự động tạo khi import hay không:
 * - Có tối đa 1 subtask
 * - Subtask không có tên cụ thể, không có comment, không có báo cáo, không có đính kèm file
 * - Trạng thái là Assigned mặc định hoặc rỗng
 * - Không có phê duyệt
 */
export function isEmptyDelegationGroup(group: DelegationGroup): boolean {
  if (!group || !group.subTasks || group.subTasks.length === 0) return true;
  if (group.subTasks.length > 1) return false; // Có từ 2 subtask trở lên -> Genuine

  const sub = group.subTasks[0];
  const hasName = Boolean(sub.name && sub.name.trim().length > 0);
  const hasComments = Boolean(sub.comments && sub.comments.trim().length > 0);
  const hasReport = Boolean(sub.report && sub.report.trim().length > 0);
  const hasChildReport = Boolean(sub.childReport && sub.childReport.trim().length > 0);
  const hasFile = Boolean(sub.fileUrl || sub.childFileUrl);
  const hasAttachments = Boolean(sub.attachments && sub.attachments.length > 0);
  const hasNonDefaultStatus = Boolean(
    sub.status && sub.status !== 'Assigned' && sub.status !== 'Pending' && sub.status !== ''
  );
  const hasApproval = Boolean(
    sub.approvalStatus && sub.approvalStatus !== 'Pending' && sub.approvalStatus !== ''
  );

  // Nếu có bất kỳ nội dung thực tế nào -> Tuyệt đối KHÔNG xóa
  if (hasName || hasComments || hasReport || hasChildReport || hasFile || hasAttachments || hasNonDefaultStatus || hasApproval) {
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}

/**
 * Quét toàn bộ Delegation Groups trên Firestore hoặc in-memory để thống kê số lượng rỗng
 */
export async function scanEmptyDelegations(yearFilter?: string | number): Promise<{
  totalScanned: number;
  emptyCount: number;
  genuineCount: number;
  emptyGroups: DelegationGroup[];
}> {
  try {
    const colRef = collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups');
    let q = query(colRef);

    if (yearFilter && String(yearFilter).toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
      const yearStr = String(yearFilter);
      const yearNum = Number(yearFilter);
      q = query(colRef, where('projectYear', 'in', [yearStr, yearNum]));
    }

    const snap = await getDocs(q);
    const emptyGroups: DelegationGroup[] = [];
    let genuineCount = 0;

    snap.docs.forEach((d) => {
      const data = { id: d.id, ...d.data() } as DelegationGroup;
      if (isEmptyDelegationGroup(data)) {
        emptyGroups.push(data);
      } else {
        genuineCount++;
      }
    });

    return {
      totalScanned: snap.docs.length,
      emptyCount: emptyGroups.length,
      genuineCount,
      emptyGroups,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[delegationMaintenance] scanEmptyDelegations error:', err);
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Dọn dẹp an toàn các empty delegation groups theo từng lô 400 documents
 */
export async function pruneEmptyDelegations(
  emptyGroupIds: string[],
  onProgress?: (processed: number, total: number) => void
): Promise<{ deletedCount: number }> {
  if (!emptyGroupIds || emptyGroupIds.length === 0) {
    return { deletedCount: 0 };
  }

  const BATCH_SIZE = 400;
  let deletedCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < emptyGroupIds.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const chunk = emptyGroupIds.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
    const batch = writeBatch(db);

    chunk.forEach((id) => {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', id);
      batch.delete(docRef);
    });

    await batch.commit();

    // Đồng thời xóa khỏi Dexie Local Database
    for (const id of chunk) {
      await deleteLocalRecord('taka_delegations', id);
    }

    deletedCount += chunk.length;
    onProgress?.(deletedCount, emptyGroupIds.length);
  }

  // Cập nhật lại Zustand Store
  const store = useAppStore.getState();
  const currentGroups = store.delegationGroups || [];
  const idSet = new Set(emptyGroupIds);
  const remaining = currentGroups.filter((g) => !idSet.has(g.id));
  store.setDelegationGroups(remaining);

  return { deletedCount };
}


=== FILE: src/lib/deltaApplyService.ts ===
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { usePerformanceStore } from '../store/usePerformanceStore';
import { TakaDelta, TakaDeltaItem, Project, Task, Cost, DelegationGroup } from '../types';
import { localDb } from './localDb';
import { applyDeltasToLocalDatabase } from './backgroundSyncWorker';
import { triggerBatchChangeFlash } from './changeFlashService';
import { broadcastAppliedDeltas } from './broadcastSyncService';
import { applyFieldPatch } from './deltaPatchService';
import { getTasksForProject, calculateProjectComputedDates } from './projectDatesService';
import { resolveInvalidations } from './deltaInvalidateService';
import { 
  deltaTime, 
  getLastDeltaSyncTime, 
  getRestoreCutoffTimestamp, 
  markRestoreVersionCompleted
} from './deltaSyncService';
import { CLIENT_SESSION_ID, DELTA_COLLECTION, LAST_SYNC_KEY } from './deltaConstants';
import { safeSetItemLocal } from './storage';
import { markTasksDeleted } from './taskDeletedTracker';

/**
 * Applies a list of (already de-duplicated) deltas to Zustand + Dexie. Shared by the real-time listener and the
 * safety poll. Returns the number of deltas processed.
 */
export function applyIncomingDeltas(deltas: TakaDelta[]): number {
  if (!deltas || deltas.length === 0) return 0;

  // Ghi nhận vào Performance Store để giám sát
  usePerformanceStore
    .getState()
    .trackGetDoc(DELTA_COLLECTION, false, deltas.length, `Pulled ${deltas.length} deltas`);

  const lastSyncTime = getLastDeltaSyncTime();
  let maxTime = lastSyncTime;
  const store = useAppStore.getState();

  // Map chứa các thay đổi gộp để cập nhật nguyên tử vào Zustand
  let updatedProjects = [...(store.projects || [])];
  let updatedTasks = [...(store.tasks || [])];
  let updatedCosts = [...(store.costs || [])];
  let updatedDelegations = [...(store.delegationGroups || [])];

  let projectsChanged = false;
  let tasksChanged = false;
  let costsChanged = false;
  let delegationsChanged = false;

  const invalidations: TakaDeltaItem[] = [];

  const applyItem = (
    docId: string,
    collectionNameRaw: string,
    action: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete',
    data: any,
    year?: string
  ) => {
    // Một số nơi ghi delta với tên đường dẫn thật `taka_delegation_groups`
    const collectionName =
      collectionNameRaw === 'taka_delegation_groups' ? 'taka_delegations' : collectionNameRaw;
    if (
      collectionName === 'taka_delegations' &&
      !store.isDelegationsRequested &&
      store.delegationGroups.length === 0
    ) {
      return;
    }

    // [Safety Guard] Prevent old deltas (e.g. synthetic or out-of-order) from clobbering newer state
    const tsOf = (v: any): number => {
      if (!v) return 0;
      const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Date.parse(v) : typeof v?.toMillis === 'function' ? v.toMillis() : Number(v);
      return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
    };

    const isDelete = action === 'delete' || data?.isDeleted === true;

    // Chỉ bỏ qua khi delta CÓ updatedAt hợp lệ và CŨ HƠN bản đang giữ.
    // Delta xóa, delta không có data, và delta vá không mang updatedAt luôn được áp dụng
    // (thứ tự đã do serverTime quyết định). Tuyệt đối không đọc data.updatedAt khi data có thể null.
    const isStaleVsLocal = (existing: any): boolean => {
      if (isDelete || !data) return false;
      const incoming = tsOf(data.updatedAt);
      if (!incoming) return false;
      return tsOf(existing?.updatedAt) > incoming;
    };

    switch (collectionName) {
      case 'taka_projects': {
        const idx = updatedProjects.findIndex((p) => p.id === docId);
        if (isDelete || data?.isDeleted) {
          if (idx !== -1) {
            projectsChanged = true;
            updatedProjects = updatedProjects.filter((p) => p.id !== docId);
          }
          break;
        }
        if (idx !== -1 && isStaleVsLocal(updatedProjects[idx])) return;
        
        projectsChanged = true;
        if (idx !== -1) {
          updatedProjects[idx] = applyFieldPatch(updatedProjects[idx], data) as Project;
        } else if (action === 'create') {
          // Ghost record guard: only add if action is 'create', never resurrect from an 'update' patch
          updatedProjects.push({ id: docId, ...data } as Project);
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'taka_tasks': {
        const idx = updatedTasks.findIndex((t) => t.id === docId);
        if (isDelete || data?.isDeleted) {
          markTasksDeleted([docId, data?.taskCodePhu, data?.name]);
          if (idx !== -1) {
            tasksChanged = true;
            updatedTasks = updatedTasks.filter((t) => t.id !== docId);
          }
          break;
        }
        if (idx !== -1 && isStaleVsLocal(updatedTasks[idx])) return;

        tasksChanged = true;
        if (idx !== -1) {
          updatedTasks[idx] = applyFieldPatch(updatedTasks[idx], data) as Task;
        } else if (action === 'create') {
          // Ghost record guard: only add if action is 'create', never resurrect from an 'update' patch
          updatedTasks.push({ id: docId, ...data } as Task);
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'taka_costs': {
        const idx = updatedCosts.findIndex((c) => c.id === docId);
        if (isDelete || data?.isDeleted) {
          if (idx !== -1) {
            costsChanged = true;
            updatedCosts = updatedCosts.filter((c) => c.id !== docId);
          }
          break;
        }
        if (idx !== -1 && isStaleVsLocal(updatedCosts[idx])) return;

        costsChanged = true;
        if (idx !== -1) {
          updatedCosts[idx] = applyFieldPatch(updatedCosts[idx], data) as Cost;
        } else if (action === 'create') {
          // Ghost record guard: only add if action is 'create', never resurrect from an 'update' patch
          updatedCosts.push({ id: docId, ...data } as Cost);
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'taka_delegations': {
        const idx = updatedDelegations.findIndex((g) => g.id === docId);
        if (isDelete || data?.isDeleted) {
          if (idx !== -1) {
            delegationsChanged = true;
            updatedDelegations = updatedDelegations.filter((g) => g.id !== docId);
          }
          break;
        }
        if (idx !== -1 && isStaleVsLocal(updatedDelegations[idx])) return;

        delegationsChanged = true;
        if (idx !== -1) {
          updatedDelegations[idx] = applyFieldPatch(updatedDelegations[idx], data) as DelegationGroup;
        } else if (action === 'create') {
          // Ghost record guard: only add if action is 'create', never resurrect from an 'update' patch
          updatedDelegations.push({ id: docId, ...data } as DelegationGroup);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  };

  deltas.forEach((delta) => {
    if (deltaTime(delta) > maxTime) {
      maxTime = deltaTime(delta);
    }

    if (delta.docId === 'sys_restore_signal' || delta.data?.type === 'VERSION_RESTORE') {
      const cutoff = delta.data?.restoreCutoff || deltaTime(delta);
      if (cutoff > getRestoreCutoffTimestamp()) {
        markRestoreVersionCompleted(cutoff, true);
        localDb.projects.clear().catch(() => {});
        localDb.tasks.clear().catch(() => {});
        localDb.costs.clear().catch(() => {});
        localDb.delegations.clear().catch(() => {});
      }
      return;
    }

    // 1. Skip self-mutations on this same tab/session to prevent typing jitter (Rule 2)
    if (
      delta.sessionId &&
      delta.sessionId === CLIENT_SESSION_ID
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (delta.action === 'batch_update' && Array.isArray(delta.batchItems)) {
      delta.batchItems.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.invalidate) {
          invalidations.push(item);
          return;
        }
        try {
          applyItem(item.docId, item.collectionName, item.action, item.data, item.year);
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('[deltaSync] applyItem failed (batch item skipped):', item.docId, err);
        }
      });
    } else if (delta.docId && delta.collectionName) {
      try {
        applyItem(delta.docId, delta.collectionName, delta.action as any, delta.data, delta.year);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[deltaSync] applyItem failed (delta skipped):', delta.docId, err);
      }
    }
  });

  // Cập nhật nguyên tử 1 lần duy nhất vào Zustand (0ms UI re-render)
  if (tasksChanged && !projectsChanged) {
    const delegationGroups = store.delegationGroups || [];
    const isTasksRequested = store.isTasksRequested;
    updatedProjects = updatedProjects.map(p => {
      const pTasks = getTasksForProject(p, updatedTasks);
      if (isTasksRequested || pTasks.length > 0) {
        const computedDates = calculateProjectComputedDates(p, pTasks, delegationGroups);
        return {
          ...p,
          ...computedDates,
          taskCount: pTasks.length,
          taskSummaries: computedDates.taskSummaries || [],
        };
      }
      return p;
    });
    projectsChanged = true;
  }

  if (projectsChanged) store.setProjects(updatedProjects);
  if (tasksChanged) store.setTasks(updatedTasks);
  if (costsChanged) store.setCosts(updatedCosts);
  if (delegationsChanged) store.setDelegationGroups(updatedDelegations);

  // Trụ cột 3: Kích hoạt Smart Change Flash cho các dòng vừa nhận thay đổi từ đồng nghiệp (Google Sheets standard)
  const flashEntries: Array<{ docId: string; collectionName: any; updatedBy?: string }> = [];
  deltas.forEach((d) => {
    if (d.action === 'batch_update' && Array.isArray(d.batchItems)) {
      d.batchItems.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.action === 'create' || item.action === 'update') {
          flashEntries.push({ docId: item.docId, collectionName: item.collectionName, updatedBy: d.updatedBy });
        }
      });
    } else if ((d.action === 'create' || d.action === 'update') && d.docId && d.collectionName) {
      flashEntries.push({ docId: d.docId, collectionName: d.collectionName, updatedBy: d.updatedBy });
    }
  });
  if (flashEntries.length > 0) {
    triggerBatchChangeFlash(flashEntries);
  }

  // Lưu các delta vào Dexie Local-First Database ngầm
  applyDeltasToLocalDatabase(deltas).catch(() => {});

  // Phát tín hiệu delta đã nạp sang các tab khác (giúp các tab phụ không cần gửi request lên Firestore)
  broadcastAppliedDeltas(deltas);

  // Cập nhật mốc đồng bộ mới nhất
  safeSetItemLocal(LAST_SYNC_KEY, String(maxTime));

  // Resolve signal-only (invalidate) items: re-read just those docs, then apply them like normal deltas
  if (invalidations.length > 0) {
    resolveInvalidations(invalidations)
      .then((synthetic) => {
        if (synthetic.length > 0) applyIncomingDeltas(synthetic);
      })
      .catch((err) => console.warn('[deltaSync] invalidate resolve failed:', err));
  }

  return deltas.length;
}

=== FILE: src/lib/deltaInvalidateService.ts ===
import { collection, documentId, getDocsFromServer, query, where } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { localDb } from './localDb';
import { LOGICAL_TO_FS } from './autoDeltaQueue';
import type { TakaDelta, TakaDeltaItem } from '../types';
import { usePerformanceStore } from '../store/usePerformanceStore';

/**
 * Resolves "invalidate" delta items: re-reads only the changed docs from the server (1 read per doc,
 * in chunks of 30 ids) and returns synthetic deltas (create/delete) that the normal apply pipeline understands.
 *
 * Read-saving relevance filter: for tasks/costs/delegations a doc is re-read only if this device already holds it
 * (Zustand or Dexie) or the collection is currently requested (Tri-Gate). Projects are always re-read.
 */

type Logical = TakaDeltaItem['collectionName'];
const CHUNK = 30;
const MAX_DOCS = 1500;

function sleep(ms: number) {
  return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
}


/**
 * B2: Checks if a document is already covered by a live active onSnapshot listener.
 * If so, the real-time listener will receive the update natively, so invalidate re-read is skipped.
 */
function isCoveredByLiveListener(coll: Logical, docId: string): boolean {
  try {
    const stats = usePerformanceStore.getState().collectionStats;
    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    const currentYear = store.globalYearFilter || '2026';

    if (coll === 'taka_projects') {
      const proj = store.projects?.find((p) => p.id === docId);
      const year = proj?.year ? String(proj.year) : (currentYear !== 'all' ? currentYear : null);
      if (year && (stats[`taka_projects_${year}`]?.activeListeners || 0) > 0) return true;
      if (currentYear !== 'all' && (stats[`taka_projects_${currentYear}`]?.activeListeners || 0) > 0) {
        if (!proj || String(proj.year) === String(currentYear)) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    if (coll === 'taka_tasks') {
      const task = store.tasks?.find((t) => t.id === docId);
      const year = task?.projectYear ? String(task.projectYear) : (currentYear !== 'all' ? currentYear : null);
      if (year && (stats[`taka_tasks_year_${year}`]?.activeListeners || 0) > 0) return true;
      if (task?.projectId && (stats[`taka_tasks_proj_${task.projectId}`]?.activeListeners || 0) > 0) return true;
      return false;
    }

    if (coll === 'taka_costs') {
      const cost = store.costs?.find((c) => c.id === docId);
      const year = cost?.projectYear ? String(cost.projectYear) : (currentYear !== 'all' ? currentYear : null);
      if (year && (stats[`taka_costs_${year}`]?.activeListeners || 0) > 0) return true;
      return false;
    }

    if (coll === 'taka_delegations') {
      const group = store.delegationGroups?.find((g) => g.id === docId);
      const year = group?.projectYear ? String(group.projectYear) : (currentYear !== 'all' ? currentYear : null);
      if (year && (stats[`taka_delegation_groups_${year}`]?.activeListeners || 0) > 0) return true;
      return false;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[deltaInvalidate] isCoveredByLiveListener error:', err);
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * B1 & B2: Relevance filter:
 * 1. Filter out documents already covered by active onSnapshot listeners (B2: 0 redundant read).
 * 2. For tasks/costs/delegations, only re-read if Tri-Gate is currently requested on this device
 *    or the document is already held locally in Zustand/Dexie (B1: stop wasted reads on unrequested slices).
 */
async function filterRelevant(coll: Logical, ids: string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  if (!ids || ids.length === 0) return [];

  // Always re-read invalidated project docs to guarantee cross-device sync
  if (coll === 'taka_projects') return ids;

  const store = useAppStore.getState();

  if (coll === 'taka_tasks') {
    if (store.isTasksRequested) return ids;
    const storeTaskIds = new Set((store.tasks || []).map((t) => t.id));
    const relevant: string[] = [];
    const missing: string[] = [];
    for (const id of ids) {
      if (storeTaskIds.has(id)) relevant.push(id);
      else missing.push(id);
    }
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      try {
        const dexieDocs = await localDb.tasks.where('id').anyOf(missing).toArray();
        dexieDocs.forEach((d) => relevant.push(d.id));
      } catch {}
    }
    return relevant;
  }

  if (coll === 'taka_costs') {
    if (store.isCostsRequested) return ids;
    const storeCostIds = new Set((store.costs || []).map((c) => c.id));
    const relevant: string[] = [];
    const missing: string[] = [];
    for (const id of ids) {
      if (storeCostIds.has(id)) relevant.push(id);
      else missing.push(id);
    }
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      try {
        const dexieDocs = await localDb.costs.where('id').anyOf(missing).toArray();
        dexieDocs.forEach((d) => relevant.push(d.id));
      } catch {}
    }
    return relevant;
  }

  if (coll === 'taka_delegations') {
    if (store.isDelegationsRequested) return ids;
    const storeGroupIds = new Set((store.delegationGroups || []).map((g) => g.id));
    const relevant: string[] = [];
    const missing: string[] = [];
    for (const id of ids) {
      if (storeGroupIds.has(id)) relevant.push(id);
      else missing.push(id);
    }
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      try {
        const dexieDocs = await localDb.delegations.where('id').anyOf(missing).toArray();
        dexieDocs.forEach((d) => relevant.push(d.id));
      } catch {}
    }
    return relevant;
  }

  return ids;
}

async function fetchChunk(coll: Logical, ids: string[]) {
  const col = collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', LOGICAL_TO_FS[coll]);
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await getDocsFromServer(query(col, where(documentId(), 'in', ids)));
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt === 1) console.warn('[deltaInvalidate] fetch failed:', err);
      else await sleep(2000);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export async function resolveInvalidations(items: TakaDeltaItem[]): Promise<TakaDelta[]> {
  if (!items || items.length === 0) return [];

  const byColl = new Map<Logical, Set<string>>();
  for (const it of items) {
    if (!it.docId) continue;
    if (!byColl.has(it.collectionName)) byColl.set(it.collectionName, new Set());
    byColl.get(it.collectionName)!.add(it.docId);
  }

  const out: TakaDeltaItem[] = [];
  let budget = MAX_DOCS;

  for (const [coll, idSet] of byColl) {
    let ids = await filterRelevant(coll, Array.from(idSet));
    if (ids.length > budget) ids = ids.slice(0, budget);
    budget -= ids.length;

    const chunks: string[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += CHUNK) {
      chunks.push(ids.slice(i, i + CHUNK));
    }

    const snaps = await Promise.all(chunks.map((chunk) => fetchChunk(coll, chunk)));
    snaps.forEach((snap, idx) => {
      if (!snap) return;
      const chunk = chunks[idx];
      const found = new Set<string>();
      snap.forEach((d) => {
        found.add(d.id);
        const data = d.data() as Record<string, any>;
        if (data?.isDeleted) {
          out.push({ docId: d.id, collectionName: coll, action: 'delete', data: {} });
        } else {
          const y = data?.year ?? data?.projectYear;
          out.push({ docId: d.id, collectionName: coll, action: 'create', data, year: y ? String(y) : undefined });
        }
      });
      // Docs that no longer exist on the server were hard-deleted
      chunk.forEach((id) => {
        if (!found.has(id)) out.push({ docId: id, collectionName: coll, action: 'delete', data: {} });
      });
    });
  }

  if (out.length === 0) return [];
  const now = Date.now();
  return [
    {
      id: `invalidate_resolved_${now}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
      action: 'batch_update',
      batchItems: out,
      updatedBy: 'invalidate',
      sessionId: 'invalidate_resolved',
      timestamp: new Date(now).toISOString(),
      // 0 so resolving never advances lastSyncTime
      numericTime: 0,
    },
  ];
}


=== FILE: src/lib/deltaOrchestratorService.ts ===
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { pullAndApplyDeltas } from './deltaPullService';
import { initNetworkRecovery } from './syncResilience';
import { startDeltaRealtimeListener } from './deltaRealtimeListener';
import { purgeOldDeltas } from './deltaPurgeService';

let syncIntervalTimer: any = null;
let isHibernating = false;
let lastActivityTime = Date.now();
const IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes inactivity threshold

/**
 * Tự động Dọn dẹp Delta cũ (Delta Retention TTL & Pruning)
 */
export async function pruneExpiredDeltas(retentionDays: number = 7): Promise<number> {
  return purgeOldDeltas(retentionDays * 24);
}

/**
 * Khởi động Background Delta Sync Poller với Adaptive Tab Hibernation & Inactivity Sleep
 * - Khi ẩn tab hoặc người dùng không hoạt động > 5 phút: Tạm dừng định thời hoàn toàn (0 Idle Read).
 * - Khi quay lại tab hoặc tương tác: Lập tức sync tức thì (0ms) và kích hoạt lại interval.
 */
export function startDeltaSyncService(intervalMs: number = 30 * 60 * 1000): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};

  // Real-time channel (onSnapshot). The interval below is only a slow safety-net poll (B5).
  const stopRealtime = startDeltaRealtimeListener();

  let lastTriggerAt = 0;
  const triggerSync = () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastTriggerAt < 15000) return;
    lastTriggerAt = now;
    const year = useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter;
    pullAndApplyDeltas(year).catch(() => {});
  };

  const stopPolling = () => {
    if (syncIntervalTimer) {
      clearInterval(syncIntervalTimer);
      syncIntervalTimer = null;
    }
  };

  const startPolling = () => {
    stopPolling();
    syncIntervalTimer = setInterval(() => {
      // Check for hidden tab or inactivity sleep
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
        hibernate();
        return;
      }
      if (Date.now() - lastActivityTime > IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        hibernate();
        return;
      }
      triggerSync();
    }, intervalMs);
  };

  const hibernate = () => {
    if (isHibernating) return;
    isHibernating = true;
    stopPolling();
  };

  const wakeAndSync = () => {
    lastActivityTime = Date.now();
    if (isHibernating || !syncIntervalTimer) {
      isHibernating = false;
      triggerSync(); // Sync immediately on wake
      startPolling();
    }
  };

  // 1. Initial boot sync & start timer
  triggerSync();
  startPolling();
  const stopNetworkRecovery = initNetworkRecovery(() => triggerSync());

  // 2. Tab Visibility Listener (Page Visibility API - Hibernation)
  const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
      wakeAndSync();
    } else {
      hibernate();
    }
  };

  // 3. Online network reconnection
  const handleOnline = () => {
    wakeAndSync();
  };

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
  window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);

  return () => {
    stopPolling();
    stopNetworkRecovery();
    stopRealtime();
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
  };
}

/**
 * Kích hoạt đồng bộ Delta ngay lập tức khi ứng dụng thức giấc từ trạng thái ngủ sâu (iOS Sleep/Wake Guard)
 */
export async function triggerImmediateDeltaSync(year?: string): Promise<number> {
  lastActivityTime = Date.now();
  isHibernating = false;
  return pullAndApplyDeltas(year || useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter);
}

import {

describe('deltaPatchService (Stage 3: Field-Level Granular Patching)', () => {
  const baseTask: Task = {
    id: 'task_001',
    name: 'Thi công vách thạch cao tầng 1',
    taskCodePhu: 'TK-01',
    projectCode: 'HCM-TAK-2026',

    updatedAt: '2026-10-01T08:00:00.000Z',
  };

  describe('isEqualValue', () => {

      expect(isEqualValue('hello', 'hello')).toBe(true);
      expect(isEqualValue('hello', 'world')).toBe(false);
      expect(isEqualValue(42, 42)).toBe(true);
      expect(isEqualValue(42, 43)).toBe(false);
      expect(isEqualValue(null, undefined)).toBe(true);
      expect(isEqualValue(null, 'null')).toBe(false);
    });

    it('compares arrays and objects correctly', () => {
      expect(isEqualValue(['A', 'B'], ['A', 'B'])).toBe(true);
      expect(isEqualValue(['A', 'B'], ['B', 'A'])).toBe(false);
      expect(isEqualValue({ x: 1 }, { x: 1 })).toBe(true);
      expect(isEqualValue({ x: 1 }, { x: 2 })).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('computeFieldPatch', () => {
    it('returns full object when previous is null or undefined (create action)', () => {
      const patch = computeFieldPatch(null, baseTask);
      expect(patch).toEqual(baseTask);
    });

    it('returns only changed fields when dragging Gantt bar (dates and duration)', () => {
      const draggedTask: Task = {
        ...baseTask,
        start: '2026-10-03 08:00',
        finish: '2026-10-07 17:00',
        duration: '4',
        updatedAt: '2026-10-02T10:00:00.000Z',
      };

      const patch = computeFieldPatch(baseTask, draggedTask);

      // Changed fields
      expect(patch.start).toBe('2026-10-03 08:00');
      expect(patch.finish).toBe('2026-10-07 17:00');
      expect(patch.updatedAt).toBe('2026-10-02T10:00:00.000Z');

      // Unchanged fields MUST NOT be included
      expect(patch.name).toBeUndefined();
      expect(patch.comments).toBeUndefined();
      expect(patch.party).toBeUndefined();
      expect(patch.textColor).toBeUndefined();
      expect(patch.runningStatus).toBeUndefined();

      // Essential identifiers are kept
      expect(patch.id).toBe('task_001');
      expect(patch.projectCode).toBe('HCM-TAK-2026');
    });

    it('reduces payload size by over 80% compared to full task object', () => {
      const updatedTask: Task = {
        ...baseTask,
        runningStatus: 'Completed',
        updatedAt: '2026-10-02T12:00:00.000Z',
      };

      const patch = computeFieldPatch(baseTask, updatedTask);
      const metrics = measurePayloadDiff(updatedTask, patch);

      expect(metrics.savedBytes).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(metrics.percentSaved).toBeGreaterThan(60);
    });

    it('detects removed fields by setting them to null', () => {
      const withParty = { ...baseTask, party: 'Contractor A' };
      const withoutParty = { ...baseTask };
      delete (withoutParty as any).party;

      const patch = computeFieldPatch(withParty, withoutParty);
      expect(patch.party).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('applyFieldPatch (Conflict Avoidance)', () => {
    it('cleanly applies patch without clobbering concurrent field edits by another user', () => {
      // User A edited schedule dates
      const userAPatch = {
        id: 'task_001',
        start: '2026-10-10 08:00',
        finish: '2026-10-15 17:00',
        duration: '5',
        updatedAt: '2026-10-02T14:00:00.000Z',
      };

      // User B simultaneously edited status and party
      const userBLocalState: Task = {
        ...baseTask,
        runningStatus: 'On process',
        party: 'Nhà Thầu Mới HCM',
      };

      // Applying User A's patch to User B's state
      const merged = applyFieldPatch(userBLocalState, userAPatch);

      // User A's changes are applied
      expect(merged.start).toBe('2026-10-10 08:00');
      expect(merged.finish).toBe('2026-10-15 17:00');
      expect(merged.duration).toBe('5');

      // User B's concurrent changes are completely preserved! No clobbering!
      expect(merged.runningStatus).toBe('On process');
      expect(merged.party).toBe('Nhà Thầu Mới HCM');
      expect(merged.name).toBe(baseTask.name);
    });
  });

  describe('createPatchDeltaItem and createBatchPatchDeltaItems', () => {
    it('creates TakaDeltaItem with isPatch=true for updates', () => {
      const updatedTask: Task = {
        ...baseTask,
        runningStatus: 'Delayed',
        updatedAt: '2026-10-02T15:00:00.000Z',
      };

      const item = createPatchDeltaItem({
        docId: 'task_001',
        collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
        previous: baseTask,
        updated: updatedTask,
        year: '2026',
      });

      expect(item.action).toBe('update');
      expect(item.isPatch).toBe(true);
      expect(item.data?.runningStatus).toBe('Delayed');
      expect(item.data?.name).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('creates batch items correctly', () => {
      const items = createBatchPatchDeltaItems([
        {
          docId: 'task_001',
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
          previous: baseTask,
          updated: { ...baseTask, runningStatus: 'Completed' },
          year: '2026',
        },
        {
          docId: 'task_002',
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
          action: 'delete',
          updated: null,
          year: '2026',
        },
      ]);

      expect(items).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(items[0].isPatch).toBe(true);
      expect(items[0].action).toBe('update');
      expect(items[1].action).toBe('delete');
    });
  });
});


=== FILE: src/lib/deltaPatchService.ts ===
import { TakaDeltaItem } from '../types';

/**
 * Compares two values for equality in the context of entity field comparisons.
 */
export function isEqualValue(a: any, b: any): boolean {
  if (a === b) return true;
  if (a === null || a === undefined) return b === null || b === undefined;
  if (b === null || b === undefined) return false;

  // Primitive types
  if (typeof a !== 'object' || typeof b !== 'object') {
    return a === b;
  }

  // Dates
  if (a instanceof Date && b instanceof Date) {
    return a.getTime() === b.getTime();
  }

  // Arrays
  if (Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b)) {
    if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Plain objects
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Computes a field-level patch representing only the changed, added, or removed keys
 * between previous and current entity snapshots.
 *
 * Saves 80% - 95% bandwidth by stripping dozens of unchanged fields (e.g. comments, logs,
 * coordinates, checklists, member descriptions) while keeping essential identifiers.
 */
export function computeFieldPatch<T extends Record<string, any>>(
  previous: T | null | undefined,
  current: T
): Record<string, any> {
  if (!previous) {
    // New entity creation: return full object
    return { ...current };
  }

  const patch: Record<string, any> = {};
  let hasChanges = false;

  // Detect modified or added fields
  for (const key of Object.keys(current)) {
    // Always preserve essential identifier & discriminator metadata
    if (key === 'id') {
      patch.id = current.id;
      continue;
    }

    const prevVal = previous[key];
    const currVal = current[key];

    if (!isEqualValue(prevVal, currVal)) {
      patch[key] = currVal;
      hasChanges = true;
    }
  }

  // Detect removed fields (present in previous but absent/undefined in current)
  for (const key of Object.keys(previous)) {
    if (key === 'id') continue;
    if (previous[key] !== undefined && current[key] === undefined) {
      patch[key] = null;
      hasChanges = true;
    }
  }

  // If no functional fields changed, return minimal stub with timestamp
  if (!hasChanges) {
    patch.id = current.id;
    if (current.updatedAt) patch.updatedAt = current.updatedAt;
    return patch;
  }

  // Always include updatedAt if present on current
  if (current.updatedAt && !patch.updatedAt) {
    patch.updatedAt = current.updatedAt;
  }

  // Preserve projectCode/projectYear if present to support Tri-Gate / year filter routing
  if (current.projectCode && !patch.projectCode) {
    patch.projectCode = current.projectCode;
  }
  if (current.projectYear !== undefined && patch.projectYear === undefined) {
    patch.projectYear = current.projectYear;
  }

  return patch;
}

/**
 * Safely applies a field-level patch onto an in-memory entity.
 * Prevents concurrent clobbering: fields not present in the patch remain untouched.
 */
export function applyFieldPatch<T extends Record<string, any>>(
  target: T,
  patch: Record<string, any>
): T {
  if (!target) return { ...patch } as T;
  if (!patch) return target;

  const result: any = { ...target };

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(patch)) {
    if (value === null) {
      delete result[key];
    } else {
      result[key] = value;
    }
  }

  return result as T;
}

/**
 * Creates an optimized TakaDeltaItem containing only field-level changes.
 */
export function createPatchDeltaItem(params: {
  docId: string;
  collectionName: 'taka_projects' | 'taka_tasks' | 'taka_costs' | 'taka_delegations';
  previous?: any;
  updated: any;
  action?: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete';
  year?: string;
  forcePatch?: boolean;
}): TakaDeltaItem {
  const { docId, collectionName, previous, updated, year } = params;
  const action = params.action || (previous ? 'update' : 'create');

  if (action === 'delete') {
    return {
      docId,
      collectionName,
      action: 'delete',
      year,
    };
  }

  if (action === 'create' || !previous) {
    return {
      docId,
      collectionName,
      action: 'create',
      data: updated,
      isPatch: false,
      year: year || (updated?.projectYear ? String(updated.projectYear) : undefined),
    };
  }

  // Action is update: compute granular field diff
  const patch = computeFieldPatch(previous, updated);

  return {
    docId,
    collectionName,
    action: 'update',
    isPatch: true,
    data: patch,
    year: year || (updated?.projectYear ? String(updated.projectYear) : undefined),
  };
}

/**
 * Batch version: transforms multiple mutations into field-level granular delta items.
 */
export function createBatchPatchDeltaItems(
  items: Array<{
    docId: string;
    collectionName: 'taka_projects' | 'taka_tasks' | 'taka_costs' | 'taka_delegations';
    previous?: any;
    updated: any;
    action?: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete';
    year?: string;
  }>
): TakaDeltaItem[] {
  return items.map((item) => createPatchDeltaItem(item));
}

/**
 * Calculates raw byte size difference to monitor bandwidth optimization.
 */
export function measurePayloadDiff(
  fullObj: any,
  patchObj: any
): {
  fullBytes: number;
  patchBytes: number;
  savedBytes: number;
  percentSaved: number;
} {
  const fullStr = JSON.stringify(fullObj || {});
  const patchStr = JSON.stringify(patchObj || {});
  const fullBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(fullStr).length;
  const patchBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(patchStr).length;
  const savedBytes = Math.max(0, fullBytes - patchBytes);
  const percentSaved = fullBytes > 0 ? Number(((savedBytes / fullBytes) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 0;

  return {
    fullBytes,
    patchBytes,
    savedBytes,
    percentSaved,
  };
}


=== FILE: src/lib/deltaPullService.ts ===
import {
  collection,
  query,
  where,
  orderBy,
  limit,
  getDocsFromServer,
  Timestamp,
} from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { TakaDelta } from '../types';
import { resyncIfStale } from './syncResilience';
import { 
  deltaTime, 
  getLastDeltaSyncTime, 
  getRestoreCutoffTimestamp, 
  appliedDeltaIds,
} from './deltaSyncService';
import { DELTA_COLLECTION, CLOCK_SKEW_OVERLAP_MS, MAX_APPLIED_IDS, LAST_SYNC_KEY } from './deltaConstants';
import { applyIncomingDeltas } from './deltaApplyService';
import { safeSetItemLocal } from './storage';

let inFlightPullPromise: Promise<number> | null = null;
let lastPullCompletedAt = 0;

/**
 * Kéo các delta thay đổi từ server về client kể từ lastSyncTime và áp dụng vào Zustand
 * Tiết kiệm hơn 80% Read so với việc onSnapshot cả collection
 * B4: In-flight deduplication prevents concurrent identical queries across tabs/effects
 */
export async function pullAndApplyDeltas(yearFilter?: string): Promise<number> {
  if (inFlightPullPromise) {
    return inFlightPullPromise;
  }
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - lastPullCompletedAt < 3000) {
    return 0;
  }

  inFlightPullPromise = (async () => {
    const lastSyncTime = getLastDeltaSyncTime();
    const restoreCutoff = getRestoreCutoffTimestamp();

    // Device offline longer than delta retention -> deltas are gone, do a full resync.
    if (await resyncIfStale(lastSyncTime, LAST_SYNC_KEY)) return 0;

    const colRef = collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', DELTA_COLLECTION);

    try {
      const deltas: TakaDelta[] = [];
      let currentSince = Math.max(lastSyncTime - CLOCK_SKEW_OVERLAP_MS, restoreCutoff);
      let iteration = 0;
      const MAX_PAGES = 5;

      while (iteration < MAX_PAGES) {
        iteration++;
        const q = query(
          colRef,
          where('serverTime', '>', Timestamp.fromMillis(currentSince)),
          orderBy('serverTime', 'asc'),
          limit(500)
        );

        let snapshot: any;
        try {
          snapshot = await getDocsFromServer(q);
        } catch (serverErr) {
          // If offline or network still reconnecting (e.g. iOS waking up), do NOT advance sync cursor
          console.warn('[deltaSync] getDocsFromServer not reachable yet (device offline or reconnecting):', serverErr);
          return 0;
        }

        if (!snapshot || snapshot.empty) {
          break;
        }

        let pageMaxTime = currentSince;
        snapshot.forEach((d: any) => {
          const item = d.data() as TakaDelta;
          const itemId = item.id || d.id;
          if (appliedDeltaIds.has(itemId)) {
            if (deltaTime(item) > pageMaxTime) pageMaxTime = deltaTime(item);
            return;
          }
          appliedDeltaIds.add(itemId);
          if (appliedDeltaIds.size > MAX_APPLIED_IDS) {
            const oldest = appliedDeltaIds.values().next().value;
            if (oldest !== undefined) appliedDeltaIds.delete(oldest);
          }
          deltas.push(item);
          if (deltaTime(item) > pageMaxTime) {
            pageMaxTime = deltaTime(item);
          }
        });

        currentSince = pageMaxTime;
        if (snapshot.size < 500) {
          break;
        }
      }

      if (deltas.length === 0) {
        // Server confirmed 0 new deltas: advance sync cursor safely
        const safeRecentTime = Math.max(lastSyncTime, Date.now() - 60000);
        safeSetItemLocal(LAST_SYNC_KEY, String(safeRecentTime));
        return 0;
      }

      return applyIncomingDeltas(deltas);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[deltaSync] Error pulling deltas:', err);
      return 0;
    } finally {
      lastPullCompletedAt = Date.now();
      inFlightPullPromise = null;
    }
  })();

  return inFlightPullPromise;
}

=== FILE: src/lib/deltaRealtimeListener.ts ===
import { collection, onSnapshot, orderBy, query, where, Timestamp } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { onAuthStateChanged } from 'firebase/auth';
import { auth, db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { applyIncomingDeltas, filterUnappliedDeltas, getLastDeltaSyncTime, deltaTime, pullAndApplyDeltas } from './deltaSyncService';
import type { TakaDelta } from '../types';

/**
 * Real-time delta channel.
 *
 * One onSnapshot listener on taka_deltas replaces 25s polling:
 *  - idle cost = 0 reads (previously >= 1 read per poll, ~1100+/user/day)
 *  - changes arrive in ~1s instead of 25s - 3 min
 *  - billed once per delta doc; cached deltas (persistent cache) are free
 * The listener is detached when the tab has been hidden > 2 min and re-attached (since = lastSyncTime) on return.
 */

const OVERLAP_MS = 3 * 60 * 1000; // clock-skew window, duplicates filtered by delta id
const DETACH_AFTER_HIDDEN_MS = 2 * 60 * 1000;
const RETRY_MS = 30 * 1000;

export function startDeltaRealtimeListener(): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};

  let unsub: (() => void) | null = null;
  let buffer: TakaDelta[] = [];
  let flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  let detachTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  let retryTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  let signedIn = !!auth.currentUser;
  let stopped = false;

  const flush = () => {
    flushTimer = null;
    const batch = filterUnappliedDeltas(buffer);
    buffer = [];
    if (batch.length === 0) return;
    batch.sort((a, b) => deltaTime(a) - deltaTime(b));
    try {
      applyIncomingDeltas(batch);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[deltaRealtime] apply failed:', err);
    }
  };

  const detach = () => {
    if (unsub) {
      try { unsub(); } catch {}
      unsub = null;
    }
  };

  const attach = () => {
    if (stopped || unsub || !signedIn) return;
    const since = getLastDeltaSyncTime() - OVERLAP_MS;
    const q = query(
      collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_deltas'),
      where('serverTime', '>', Timestamp.fromMillis(since)),
      orderBy('serverTime', 'asc')
    );
    unsub = onSnapshot(
      q,
      (snap) => {
        snap.docChanges().forEach((c) => {
          if (c.type === 'added') buffer.push(c.doc.data({ serverTimestamps: 'estimate' }) as TakaDelta);
        });
        if (buffer.length > 0 && !flushTimer) flushTimer = setTimeout(flush, 20);
      },
      (err) => {
        console.warn('[deltaRealtime] listener error, retrying:', err);
        detach();
        if (!stopped && !retryTimer) {
          retryTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            retryTimer = null;
            attach();
          }, RETRY_MS);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  if (signedIn) attach();

  const onVisibility = () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
      if (detachTimer) clearTimeout(detachTimer);
      detachTimer = setTimeout(detach, DETACH_AFTER_HIDDEN_MS);
    } else {
      if (detachTimer) { clearTimeout(detachTimer); detachTimer = null; }
      // Force socket reconnect on iOS / Safari tab restore to recover from suspended WebChannel connections
      detach();
      attach();
      pullAndApplyDeltas().catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  const handlePageShow = (e: PageTransitionEvent) => {
    if (e.persisted) {
      detach();
      attach();
      pullAndApplyDeltas().catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  const handleOnline = () => {
    detach();
    attach();
    pullAndApplyDeltas().catch(() => {});
  };

  const handleFocus = () => {
    // When switching windows on desktop/laptop, trigger delta catch-up immediately
    pullAndApplyDeltas().catch(() => {});
  };

  const unsubAuth = onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
    signedIn = !!user;
    if (user) attach();
    else detach();
  });

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', handlePageShow as any);
  window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
  window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);

  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    unsubAuth();
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
    window.removeEventListener('pageshow', handlePageShow as any);
    window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    if (flushTimer) clearTimeout(flushTimer);
    if (detachTimer) clearTimeout(detachTimer);
    if (retryTimer) clearTimeout(retryTimer);
    detach();
  };
}

import { TakaDelta } from '../types';
import { safeGetItemLocal, safeSetItemLocal } from './storage';
import { 
  LAST_SYNC_KEY, 
  RESTORE_CUTOFF_KEY, 
  DELTA_COLLECTION, 
  CLIENT_SESSION_ID 
} from './deltaConstants';

export { 
  LAST_SYNC_KEY, 
  RESTORE_CUTOFF_KEY, 
  DELTA_COLLECTION, 
  CLOCK_SKEW_OVERLAP_MS, 
  MAX_APPLIED_IDS, 
  CLIENT_SESSION_ID 
} from './deltaConstants';

/**
 * Returns the timestamp cutoff after which version restore was executed.
 * Deltas generated before this timestamp are faulty historical changes and MUST NOT be re-applied.
 */
export function getRestoreCutoffTimestamp(): number {
  const raw = safeGetItemLocal(RESTORE_CUTOFF_KEY);
  if (raw) {
    const num = Number(raw);
    if (!isNaN(num) && num > 0) return num;
  }
  return 0;
}

/**
 * Prevents auto-reading / re-applying faulty historical changes generated before a version restore.
 * Call this function immediately when a version restore or full replace operation is executed.
 */
export function markRestoreVersionCompleted(cutoffMs?: number, isRemoteSignal?: boolean): void {
  const now = cutoffMs || Date.now();
  safeSetItemLocal(RESTORE_CUTOFF_KEY, String(now));
  safeSetItemLocal(LAST_SYNC_KEY, String(now));
  appliedDeltaIds.clear();
  console.log(`[deltaSync] Restore cutoff set to ${now} (${new Date(now).toISOString()}). Past deltas strictly blocked.`);

  if (!isRemoteSignal) {
    import('./deltaWriteService').then(({ recordDelta }) => {
      recordDelta({
        docId: 'sys_restore_signal',
        collectionName: 'taka_projects',
        action: 'update',
        data: { restoreCutoff: now, type: 'VERSION_RESTORE' },
        updatedBy: 'system_restore',
      }).catch(() => {});
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

export const appliedDeltaIds = new Set<string>();

/** Sync cursor time of a delta in ms: server arrival time when known, else the client time. */
export function deltaTime(d: TakaDelta): number {
  const ms = (d as any)?.serverTime?.toMillis?.();
  return typeof ms === 'number' ? ms : d.numericTime || 0;
}

/**
 * Đọc mốc thời gian đã đồng bộ delta lần cuối từ LocalStorage
 */
export function getLastDeltaSyncTime(): number {
  const restoreCutoff = getRestoreCutoffTimestamp();
  const raw = safeGetItemLocal(LAST_SYNC_KEY);
  let lastSync = 0;
  if (raw) {
    const num = Number(raw);
    if (!isNaN(num) && num > 0) lastSync = num;
  }
  if (lastSync === 0) {
    lastSync = Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000;
  }
  return Math.max(lastSync, restoreCutoff);
}

/**
 * Drops deltas that were already applied on this device (shared across poll + listener).
 */
export function filterUnappliedDeltas(items: TakaDelta[]): TakaDelta[] {
  const restoreCutoff = getRestoreCutoffTimestamp();
  const fresh: TakaDelta[] = [];

  for (const item of items) {
    const id = item.id;
    const itemMs = deltaTime(item);

    if (restoreCutoff > 0 && itemMs <= restoreCutoff) {
      if (id) appliedDeltaIds.add(id);
      continue;
    }

    if (!id) { fresh.push(item); continue; }
    if (appliedDeltaIds.has(id)) continue;
    appliedDeltaIds.add(id);
    if (appliedDeltaIds.size > 3000) {
      const oldest = appliedDeltaIds.values().next().value;
      if (oldest !== undefined) appliedDeltaIds.delete(oldest);
    }
    fresh.push(item);
  }
  return fresh;
}

export { pullAndApplyDeltas } from './deltaPullService';
export { startDeltaSyncService, triggerImmediateDeltaSync, pruneExpiredDeltas } from './deltaOrchestratorService';

import {
  serverTimestamp,
  Timestamp,
  doc,
  setDoc,
} from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { TakaDelta, TakaDeltaItem } from '../types';
import { touchYearMeta } from './yearsFingerprintService';
import { broadcastAppliedDeltas } from './broadcastSyncService';
import { markExplicitDelta } from './autoDeltaQueue';
import { CLIENT_SESSION_ID, DELTA_COLLECTION } from './deltaConstants';

/**
 * Ghi lại 1 delta change log khi có mutation phát sinh
 * Cho phép các máy trạm khác chỉ cần pull delta này thay vì tải lại toàn bộ collection
 */
export async function recordDelta(delta: {
  docId: string;
  collectionName: 'taka_projects' | 'taka_tasks' | 'taka_costs' | 'taka_delegations';
  action: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete';
  data: Record<string, any>;
  year?: string;
  updatedBy?: string;
  isPatch?: boolean;
}): Promise<void> {
  markExplicitDelta([{ docId: delta.docId, collectionName: delta.collectionName }]);
  const now = Date.now();
  const deltaId = `delta_${now}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
  const nowIso = new Date(now).toISOString();

  const deltaPayload: TakaDelta = {
    id: deltaId,
    docId: delta.docId,
    collectionName: delta.collectionName,
    action: delta.action,
    year: delta.year ? String(delta.year) : undefined,
    data: delta.data,
    isPatch: delta.isPatch,
    updatedBy: delta.updatedBy || useAppStore.getState().currentUser?.email || 'system',
    sessionId: CLIENT_SESSION_ID,
    timestamp: nowIso,
    numericTime: now,
    serverTime: serverTimestamp() as any,
    expireAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
  };

  try {
    const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', DELTA_COLLECTION, deltaId);
    await setDoc(docRef, deltaPayload);

    // Kích hoạt cập nhật fingerprint năm tương ứng
    if (delta.year) {
      touchYearMeta(delta.year).catch(() => {});
    }

    // Phát tín hiệu tức thì sang các máy trạm khác trong cùng trình duyệt (0 Read)
    broadcastAppliedDeltas([deltaPayload]);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[deltaSync] Failed to record delta to Firestore:', err);
  }
}

/**
 * Giai đoạn 2: Ghi gom hàng loạt mutation vào 1 Document Delta duy nhất (Giảm 90% Firestore Write)
 */
export async function recordBatchDeltas(
  items: TakaDeltaItem[],
  updatedBy?: string
): Promise<void> {
  if (!items || items.length === 0) return;
  markExplicitDelta(items.filter((i) => !i.invalidate));
  if (items.length === 1 && !items[0].invalidate) {
    const item = items[0];
    return recordDelta({
      docId: item.docId,
      collectionName: item.collectionName,
      action: item.action,
      data: item.data || {},
      year: item.year,
      isPatch: item.isPatch,
      updatedBy,
    });
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  const deltaId = `delta_batch_${now}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
  const nowIso = new Date(now).toISOString();

  const deltaPayload: TakaDelta = {
    id: deltaId,
    action: 'batch_update',
    batchItems: items,
    updatedBy: updatedBy || useAppStore.getState().currentUser?.email || 'system',
    sessionId: CLIENT_SESSION_ID,
    timestamp: nowIso,
    numericTime: now,
    serverTime: serverTimestamp() as any,
    expireAt: Timestamp.fromMillis(now + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
  };

  try {
    const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', DELTA_COLLECTION, deltaId);
    await setDoc(docRef, deltaPayload);

    // Kích hoạt cập nhật fingerprint các năm bị ảnh hưởng
    const affectedYears = new Set(items.map((i) => i.year).filter(Boolean));
    affectedYears.forEach((yr) => touchYearMeta(yr!).catch(() => {}));

    // Phát tín hiệu tức thì sang các máy trạm khác (0 Read)
    broadcastAppliedDeltas([deltaPayload]);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[deltaSync] Failed to record batch deltas to Firestore:', err);
  }
}

import { setDoc } from "../lib/firebase";
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from "./firebase";
import { safeGetItemLocal, safeSetItemLocal } from "./storage";
import { usePerformanceStore, DevicePerformanceData } from "../store/usePerformanceStore";
import { useAppStore } from "../store/useAppStore";

const DEVICE_ID_KEY = "taka_device_uuid";

export function getOrCreateDeviceId(): string {
  let id = safeGetItemLocal(DEVICE_ID_KEY);
  if (!id) {
    id = `dev_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10)}_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    safeSetItemLocal(DEVICE_ID_KEY, id);
  }
  return id;
}

export function detectDeviceInfo(): { platform: string; deviceName: string } {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !navigator) {
    return { platform: "Unknown", deviceName: "Web Client" };
  }

  const ua = navigator.userAgent;
  let browser = "Chrome";
  if (ua.includes("Firefox")) browser = "Firefox";
  else if (ua.includes("SamsungBrowser")) browser = "Samsung Browser";
  else if (ua.includes("Opera") || ua.includes("OPR")) browser = "Opera";
  else if (ua.includes("Edge") || ua.includes("Edg")) browser = "Edge";
  else if (ua.includes("Safari") && !ua.includes("Chrome")) browser = "Safari";

  let os = "Desktop";
  let isMobile = false;
  if (ua.includes("Win")) os = "Windows PC";
  else if (ua.includes("Mac") && !ua.includes("like Mac")) os = "MacBook/Mac";
  else if (ua.includes("Linux") && !ua.includes("Android")) os = "Linux PC";
  else if (ua.includes("Android")) {
    os = "Android Device";
    isMobile = true;
  } else if (ua.includes("iPhone")) {
    os = "iPhone";
    isMobile = true;
  } else if (ua.includes("iPad")) {
    os = "iPad Tablet";
    isMobile = true;
  }

  const isPWA = window.matchMedia("(display-mode: standalone)").matches || (navigator as any).standalone;
  const suffix = isPWA ? " (PWA App)" : "";

  return {
    platform: `${os}${suffix}`,
    deviceName: `${browser} on ${os}${suffix}`,
  };
}

let lastReportTimestamp = 0;
let isReporting = false;

/**
 * Report current device metrics to Firestore under `taka_device_metrics/{deviceId}`.
 * Strictly throttled: at most once every 60 seconds unless forced, saving writes.
 */
export async function reportDevicePerformance(forced: boolean = false) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!forced && now - lastReportTimestamp < 60_000) {
    return;
  }
  if (isReporting) return;

  try {
    isReporting = true;
    lastReportTimestamp = now;

    const deviceId = getOrCreateDeviceId();
    const { platform, deviceName } = detectDeviceInfo();

    const perfState = usePerformanceStore.getState();
    const appState = useAppStore.getState();
    const currentUser = appState.currentUser;

    const totalOps = perfState.serverReads + perfState.cacheReads;
    const hitRate = totalOps > 0 ? Number(((perfState.cacheReads / totalOps) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 100.0;

    // Determine top collection by query volume
    let topCol = "-";
    let maxEvents = 0;
    Object.entries(perfState.collectionStats).forEach(([name, stat]) => {
      if (stat.totalEvents > maxEvents) {
        maxEvents = stat.totalEvents;
        topCol = name;
      }
    });

    const elapsedSec = Math.floor((now - perfState.sessionStartTime) / 1000);

    const payload: DevicePerformanceData = {
      deviceId,
      deviceName,
      platform,
      userName: currentUser?.username || currentUser?.id || "Anonymous User",
      userRole: currentUser?.role || "user",
      serverReads: perfState.serverReads,
      cacheReads: perfState.cacheReads,
      activeListeners: perfState.activeListeners,
      cacheHitRate: hitRate,
      lastActiveAt: new Date().toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" }),
      lastActiveTimestamp: now,
      sessionDurationSec: elapsedSec,
      totalEvents: perfState.events.length,
      status: "online",
      topCollection: topCol,
    };

    const docRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_device_metrics", deviceId);
    setDoc(docRef, payload, { merge: true });
  } catch (err) {
    // Non-blocking catch to ensure telemetry never affects UI or operations
    console.debug("Telemetry device metric sync skipped:", err);
  } finally {
    isReporting = false;
  }
}
