import { Project } from '../types';
import { getStatus } from './utils';
import { drawPdfFilterHeader } from './printFilterHelper';

export interface ExportToExcelOptions {
  activeTab: string;
  sortedProjects: Project[];
}

export async function exportToExcel({ activeTab, sortedProjects }: ExportToExcelOptions): Promise<void> {
  const XLSX = await import('xlsx');
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();

  if (activeTab === 'general') {
    const wsData: (string | number)[][] = [];
    wsData.push(["Year", "Store", "Location", "Code", "Project", "Status", "Pj Start", "Pj Compl", "Opening"]);
    sortedProjects.forEach((p) => {
      wsData.push([
        p.year || "",
        p.store || "",
        p.location || "",
        p.code,
        p.name,
        getStatus(p.computedTakStart, p.computedTakCompl, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code),
        p.computedTakStart ? String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 10) : "",
        p.computedTakCompl ? String(p.computedTakCompl).substring(0, 10) : "",
        (p.computedOpening || p.opening) ? String(p.computedOpening || p.opening).substring(0, 10) : ""
      ]);
    });
    const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(wsData);
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, "General");
  } else {
    const table = document.querySelector('.print-paper table');
    if (table) {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.table_to_sheet(table, { display: true });
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, "Export");
    } else {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([["No data found"]]);
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, "Export");
    }
  }

  XLSX.writeFile(wb, `export_${activeTab}_${Date.now()}.xlsx`);
}

export interface ExportToPdfOptions {
  activeTab: string;
  printOrientation: string;
  printPaperSize: string;
  printDpi: number;
  printScaleMode: string;
  printScale: number;
  printWidth: number;
  printHeight: number;
  printFilterHeader: boolean;
  printFilterContext: any;
  printDate: boolean;
  printWatermark: string;
}

const PX_PER_MM = 3.779527559; // Standard 96 DPI CSS pixel-to-millimeter factor

export async function exportToPdf(options: ExportToPdfOptions): Promise<void> {
  const {
    activeTab,
    printOrientation,
    printPaperSize,
    printDpi = 150,
    printScaleMode = "fit-page",
    printScale = 100,
    printFilterHeader,
    printFilterContext,
    printDate,
    printWatermark,
  } = options;

  const orientation = printOrientation === "landscape" ? "l" : "p";
  const format = printPaperSize.toLowerCase();
  const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');

  // Fast path for Layout Plan Canvas (Fit to full page)
  if (activeTab === 'layout') {
    let dataUrl: string | null = null;
    let imgW = 1200;
    let imgH = 800;

    const exportFn = (window as any).__taka_layout_export;
    if (typeof exportFn === 'function') {
      const res = exportFn(printDpi || 200);
      if (res && res.dataUrl) {
        dataUrl = res.dataUrl;
        imgW = res.width;
        imgH = res.height;
      }
    }

    if (!dataUrl) {
      const stage = (window as any).__taka_layout_stage;
      const stageCanvas = document.querySelector('#live-layout-canvas-container canvas') as HTMLCanvasElement;
      if (stage && typeof stage.toDataURL === 'function') {
        const exportRatio = Math.min(2.0, Math.max(1.0, printDpi / 96));
        dataUrl = stage.toDataURL({ pixelRatio: exportRatio, mimeType: 'image/jpeg', quality: 0.90 });
        imgW = (stage.width ? stage.width() : 1200) * exportRatio;
        imgH = (stage.height ? stage.height() : 800) * exportRatio;
      } else if (stageCanvas) {
        dataUrl = stageCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.90);
        imgW = stageCanvas.width;
        imgH = stageCanvas.height;
      }
    }

    if (dataUrl) {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('jspdf');
      const pdf = new jsPDF({ orientation, unit: 'mm', format });

      const pdfPageWidth = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
      const pdfPageHeight = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
      
      // Tight outer margin (2mm) for near 100% full paper coverage
      const margin = 2;
      let usableWidth = pdfPageWidth - margin * 2;
      let usableHeight = pdfPageHeight - margin * 2;
      let topOffset = margin;

      if (printFilterHeader) {
        drawPdfFilterHeader(pdf, printFilterContext, pdfPageWidth, margin, isDark);
        topOffset += 8;
        usableHeight -= 8;
      }

      if (printDate) {
        usableHeight -= 3.5;
      }

      const isFillPage = printScaleMode === 'fill-page';

      let targetW = usableWidth;
      let targetH = usableHeight;
      let xPos = margin;
      let yPos = topOffset;

      if (isFillPage) {
        targetW = usableWidth;
        targetH = usableHeight;
        xPos = margin;
        yPos = topOffset;
      } else {
        const imgAspect = imgW / imgH;
        const pageAspect = usableWidth / usableHeight;

        if (imgAspect > pageAspect) {
          // Fits width exactly
          targetW = usableWidth;
          targetH = usableWidth / imgAspect;
        } else {
          // Fits height exactly
          targetH = usableHeight;
          targetW = usableHeight * imgAspect;
        }

        xPos = margin + (usableWidth - targetW) / 2;
        yPos = topOffset + (usableHeight - targetH) / 2;
      }

      pdf.addImage(dataUrl, 'JPEG', xPos, yPos, targetW, targetH, undefined, 'FAST');

      // Watermark
      if (printWatermark && printWatermark !== 'none') {
        try {
          pdf.saveGraphicsState();
          pdf.setGState(new (pdf as any).GState({ opacity: 0.12 }));
          pdf.setFontSize(printOrientation === 'landscape' ? 52 : 38);
          pdf.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
          pdf.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
          pdf.text(
            printWatermark.toUpperCase(),
            pdfPageWidth / 2,
            pdfPageHeight / 2,
            { align: 'center', angle: 45 }
          );
          pdf.restoreGraphicsState();
        } catch {
          // Fallback
        }
      }

      // Footer
      const footerY = pdfPageHeight - 3;
      pdf.setFontSize(7.5);
      pdf.setTextColor(130, 130, 130);
      let footerText = `Takashimaya PM • Layout Plan (${printFilterContext?.storeDisplay || 'HCM'} - ${printFilterContext?.yearDisplay || 'All'})`;
      if (printDate) {
        footerText += ` • Printed: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`;
      }
      pdf.text(footerText, margin, footerY);

      pdf.save(`layout_plan_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}_${Date.now()}.pdf`);
      return;
    }

    window.print();
    return;
  }

  const pages = document.querySelectorAll('.print-paper');
  if (pages.length === 0) return;

  const { jsPDF } = await import('jspdf');
  const pdf = new jsPDF({ orientation, unit: 'mm', format });

  const pdfPageWidth = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
  const pdfPageHeight = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
  const margin = 10;
  const targetWidthMm = pdfPageWidth - margin * 2;
  const targetHeightMm = pdfPageHeight - margin * 2;

  const currentScale = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(2.0, (printScale || 100) / 100));

  // Yield to avoid main thread freeze
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 30));

  for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
    const page = pages[i] as HTMLElement;
    const wrapper = page.querySelector('.print-content-wrapper') as HTMLElement;
    if (!wrapper) continue;

    // Hide overlays & non-printable elements
    const dashedOverlay = wrapper.querySelector('.hide-on-actual-print') as HTMLElement;
    if (dashedOverlay) dashedOverlay.style.display = 'none';

    const originalTransform = wrapper.style.transform;
    const originalWidth = wrapper.style.width;
    const originalHeight = wrapper.style.height;
    const originalPosition = wrapper.style.position;
    const originalOverflow = wrapper.style.overflow;

    const hiddenElements: { el: HTMLElement; display: string }[] = [];
    const elementsToHide = wrapper.querySelectorAll('.hide-on-actual-print, .print\\:hidden');
    elementsToHide.forEach((el: any) => {
      hiddenElements.push({ el, display: el.style.display });
      el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // Unscale to measure natural dimension accurately
    wrapper.style.transform = 'none';
    wrapper.style.width = 'max-content';
    wrapper.style.height = 'max-content';
    wrapper.style.position = 'static';
    wrapper.style.overflow = 'visible';

    const naturalWidth = Math.max(100, wrapper.scrollWidth);
    const naturalHeight = Math.max(100, wrapper.scrollHeight);

    wrapper.style.width = `${naturalWidth}px`;
    wrapper.style.height = `${naturalHeight}px`;

    // Calculate row boundaries for table row-split safety
    const validBoundaries = [0];
    const wrapperRect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
    const thead = wrapper.querySelector('thead');
    let headerHeight = 0;
    if (thead) {
      const theadRect = thead.getBoundingClientRect();
      headerHeight = Math.max(0, theadRect.bottom - wrapperRect.top);
    }

    const trElements = Array.from(wrapper.querySelectorAll('tbody tr'));
    trElements.forEach(tr => {
      validBoundaries.push(tr.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - wrapperRect.top);
    });
    validBoundaries.push(naturalHeight);
    validBoundaries.sort((a, b) => a - b);

    // Compute exact DPI and memory-safe pixel ratio
    // Target physical dimension per page: targetWidthMm
    // Desired output width for table across pages:
    const usableWidthPx = (targetWidthMm * PX_PER_MM) / currentScale;
    const usableHeightPx = (targetHeightMm * PX_PER_MM) / currentScale;
    const cols = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((naturalWidth - 2) / usableWidthPx));

    // Calculate optimal pixelRatio for requested DPI without memory bloat
    const desiredDpi = Math.max(96, Math.min(300, printDpi || 150));
    // Physical print resolution ratio relative to 96 DPI
    let effectivePixelRatio = desiredDpi / 96;

    // Safety cap: max 6,000,000 pixels on master canvas to guarantee instant rendering & 0 lag
    const MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS = 6_000_000;
    const requestedPixels = naturalWidth * effectivePixelRatio * naturalHeight * effectivePixelRatio;
    if (requestedPixels > MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS) {
      effectivePixelRatio = Math.sqrt(MAX_CANVAS_PIXELS / (naturalWidth * naturalHeight));
    }
    effectivePixelRatio = Math.max(0.65, Math.min(2.0, effectivePixelRatio));

    // High-speed lightweight DOM capture (skipFonts = true eliminates heavy font blocking)
    const htmlToImage = await import('html-to-image');
    const canvas = await htmlToImage.toCanvas(wrapper, {
      width: naturalWidth,
      height: naturalHeight,
      style: {
        transform: 'none',
        width: `${naturalWidth}px`,
        height: `${naturalHeight}px`
      },
      pixelRatio: effectivePixelRatio,
      backgroundColor: isDark ? '#1e1e20' : '#ffffff',
      skipFonts: true, // Crucial for instant rendering & avoiding lag
      cacheBust: false,
      filter: (node) => {
        if (node.classList && (node.classList.contains('hide-on-actual-print') || node.classList.contains('print:hidden'))) {
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      }
    });

    // Extract table header slice for multi-row repeating headers
    let headerDataUrl: string | null = null;
    const headerScaledHeight = Math.round(headerHeight * effectivePixelRatio);
    if (headerHeight > 0 && headerScaledHeight > 0 && headerHeight < naturalHeight) {
      try {
        const headerCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        headerCanvas.width = canvas.width;
        headerCanvas.height = headerScaledHeight;
        const hCtx = headerCanvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
        if (hCtx) {
          hCtx.fillStyle = isDark ? '#1e1e20' : '#ffffff';
          hCtx.fillRect(0, 0, headerCanvas.width, headerCanvas.height);
          hCtx.drawImage(
            canvas,
            0, 0, canvas.width, headerScaledHeight,
            0, 0, headerCanvas.width, headerCanvas.height
          );
          headerDataUrl = headerCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Header slice failed:', err);
      }
    }

    // Restore wrapper DOM style immediately
    wrapper.style.transform = originalTransform;
    wrapper.style.width = originalWidth;
    wrapper.style.height = originalHeight;
    wrapper.style.position = originalPosition;
    wrapper.style.overflow = originalOverflow;

    if (dashedOverlay) dashedOverlay.style.display = '';
    hiddenElements.forEach(({ el, display }) => {
      el.style.display = display;
    });

    // Calculate vertical page breaks based on row boundaries
    const headerPdfHeight = (headerHeight * currentScale) / PX_PER_MM;
    const pageBreaks: { domStartY: number; domEndY: number; actualPdfStartY: number }[] = [];
    let domStartY = 0;

    while (domStartY < naturalHeight - 0.5) {
      let domEndY_theoretical: number;
      let actualPdfStartY: number;

      if (pageBreaks.length === 0) {
        domEndY_theoretical = domStartY + usableHeightPx;
        actualPdfStartY = margin;
      } else {
        domEndY_theoretical = domStartY + usableHeightPx - headerHeight;
        actualPdfStartY = margin + headerPdfHeight;
      }

      if (domEndY_theoretical >= naturalHeight) {
        pageBreaks.push({
          domStartY,
          domEndY: naturalHeight,
          actualPdfStartY
        });
        break;
      }

      let breakY = domStartY;
      for (let j = 0; j < validBoundaries.length; j++) {
        if (validBoundaries[j] > domStartY && validBoundaries[j] <= domEndY_theoretical + 1) {
          breakY = validBoundaries[j];
        }
      }

      if (breakY === domStartY) {
        breakY = domEndY_theoretical;
      }

      pageBreaks.push({
        domStartY,
        domEndY: breakY,
        actualPdfStartY
      });

      domStartY = breakY;
    }

    // Per-page canvas tile slicing (Ultra-lightweight memory, instant PDF build)
    const tileCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const tileCtx = tileCanvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
    const totalPages = pageBreaks.length * cols;
    let pageCount = 0;

    for (let r = 0; r < pageBreaks.length; r++) {
      const pb = pageBreaks[r];
      const domSliceH = pb.domEndY - pb.domStartY;

      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        if (pageCount > 0) {
          pdf.addPage(format, orientation);
        }

        const domStartX = c * usableWidthPx;
        const domEndX = Math.min(naturalWidth, (c + 1) * usableWidthPx);
        const domSliceW = domEndX - domStartX;

        const srcX = Math.floor(domStartX * effectivePixelRatio);
        const srcY = Math.floor(pb.domStartY * effectivePixelRatio);
        const srcW = Math.min(canvas.width - srcX, Math.ceil(domSliceW * effectivePixelRatio));
        const srcH = Math.min(canvas.height - srcY, Math.ceil(domSliceH * effectivePixelRatio));

        const slicePdfW = (domSliceW * currentScale) / PX_PER_MM;
        const slicePdfH = (domSliceH * currentScale) / PX_PER_MM;

        if (srcW > 0 && srcH > 0 && tileCtx) {
          tileCanvas.width = srcW;
          tileCanvas.height = srcH;
          tileCtx.fillStyle = isDark ? '#1e1e20' : '#ffffff';
          tileCtx.fillRect(0, 0, srcW, srcH);
          tileCtx.drawImage(
            canvas,
            srcX, srcY, srcW, srcH,
            0, 0, srcW, srcH
          );

          const tileDataUrl = tileCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86);
          pdf.addImage(tileDataUrl, 'JPEG', margin, pb.actualPdfStartY, slicePdfW, slicePdfH, undefined, 'FAST');
        }

        // Add repeated header on subsequent rows (r > 0)
        if (r > 0 && headerDataUrl) {
          pdf.addImage(headerDataUrl, 'JPEG', margin, margin, slicePdfW, headerPdfHeight, undefined, 'FAST');
        }

        // Draw Filter Header
        if (printFilterHeader) {
          drawPdfFilterHeader(pdf, printFilterContext, pdfPageWidth, margin, isDark);
        }

        // Draw Watermark
        if (printWatermark && printWatermark !== 'none') {
          try {
            pdf.saveGraphicsState();
            pdf.setGState(new (pdf as any).GState({ opacity: 0.12 }));
            pdf.setFontSize(printOrientation === 'landscape' ? 48 : 36);
            pdf.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
            pdf.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
            pdf.text(
              printWatermark.toUpperCase(),
              pdfPageWidth / 2,
              pdfPageHeight / 2,
              { align: 'center', angle: 45 }
            );
            pdf.restoreGraphicsState();
          } catch {
            // Fallback
          }
        }

        // Footer & Status indicators
        const footerY = pdfPageHeight - 4;
        pdf.setFontSize(7.5);
        pdf.setTextColor(130, 130, 130);
        let footerLeftText = `Page ${pageCount + 1} of ${totalPages}`;
        if (printDate) {
          footerLeftText += ` • Printed: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`;
        }
        pdf.text(footerLeftText, margin, footerY);

        // Status Indicators for Gantt
        if (activeTab === 'gantt') {
          let currentLegendX = pdfPageWidth - margin - 18;
          pdf.text("Completed", currentLegendX, footerY);
          pdf.setFillColor(34, 197, 94);
          pdf.rect(currentLegendX - 4, footerY - 2.5, 3, 3, 'F');

          currentLegendX -= 24;
          pdf.text("In Process", currentLegendX, footerY);
          pdf.setFillColor(59, 130, 246);
          pdf.rect(currentLegendX - 4, footerY - 2.5, 3, 3, 'F');

          currentLegendX -= 22;
          pdf.text("Upcoming", currentLegendX, footerY);
          pdf.setFillColor(100, 116, 139);
          pdf.rect(currentLegendX - 4, footerY - 2.5, 3, 3, 'F');
        }

        pageCount++;
      }
    }
  }

  pdf.save(`export_${activeTab}_${Date.now()}.pdf`);
}


=== FILE: src/lib/financialAtomicService.ts ===
import { db, APP_ID } from "./firebase";
import { doc, increment } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { Cost } from "../types";
import { useAppStore } from "../store/useAppStore";
import { recordDelta } from "./deltaSyncService";
import { writeBatch } from "../lib/firestoreWrites";
import { calculatePaidBreakdown } from './financialService';

export async function saveCostWithAtomicSummary(
  projectId: string, 
  newCostData: Cost, 
  oldCostData: Cost | null, 
  budgetHierarchy?: { level3Id?: string, level2Id?: string, level1Id?: string }
): Promise<void> {
  const batch = writeBatch(db);

  // 1. Calculate Deltas
  const oldCalc = oldCostData ? calculatePaidBreakdown(oldCostData) : { actualPaid: 0, forecastPaid: 0, totalApproved: 0 };
  const newCalc = calculatePaidBreakdown(newCostData);

  const deltaActual = newCalc.actualPaid - oldCalc.actualPaid;
  const deltaForecast = newCalc.forecastPaid - oldCalc.forecastPaid;
  const deltaApproved = newCalc.totalApproved - oldCalc.totalApproved;
  const deltaBalance = deltaApproved - (deltaActual + deltaForecast);

  // 2. Cost Document
  const costRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', newCostData.id);
  batch.set(costRef, { ...newCostData }, { merge: true });

  // 3. Budget Hierarchy Cascade (Rule 3: Atomic Aggregates)
  if (budgetHierarchy) {
    if (budgetHierarchy.level3Id) {
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', budgetHierarchy.level3Id), {
        actualPaid: increment(deltaActual),
        forecastPaid: increment(deltaForecast),
        balance: increment(deltaBalance)
      });
    }
    if (budgetHierarchy.level2Id) {
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', budgetHierarchy.level2Id), {
        actualPaid: increment(deltaActual),
        forecastPaid: increment(deltaForecast),
        balance: increment(deltaBalance)
      });
    }
    if (budgetHierarchy.level1Id) {
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', budgetHierarchy.level1Id), {
        actualPaid: increment(deltaActual),
        forecastPaid: increment(deltaForecast),
        balance: increment(deltaBalance)
      });
    }
  }

  // 4. Create 1 single payload for taka_projects (Rule 3: Dot-Notation)
  const projectUpdates: Record<string, any> = {};

  // 4.1. Project Totals
  projectUpdates['financial.totalApproved'] = increment(deltaApproved);
  projectUpdates['financial.totalActualPaid'] = increment(deltaActual);
  projectUpdates['financial.totalForecastPaid'] = increment(deltaForecast);
  projectUpdates['financial.totalBalance'] = increment(deltaBalance);

  // 4.2. Store Logic
  const oldStore = (oldCostData?.projectStore || 'HCM').toUpperCase();
  const newStore = (newCostData.projectStore || 'HCM').toUpperCase();

  if (!oldCostData || oldStore === newStore) {
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalApproved`] = increment(deltaApproved);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalActualPaid`] = increment(deltaActual);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalForecastPaid`] = increment(deltaForecast);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalBalance`] = increment(deltaBalance);
  } else {
    // CHANGE OF STORE: subtract old from oldStore, add new to newStore
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${oldStore}.totalApproved`] = increment(-oldCalc.totalApproved);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${oldStore}.totalActualPaid`] = increment(-oldCalc.actualPaid);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${oldStore}.totalForecastPaid`] = increment(-oldCalc.forecastPaid);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${oldStore}.totalBalance`] = increment(-(oldCalc.totalApproved - (oldCalc.actualPaid + oldCalc.forecastPaid)));

    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalApproved`] = increment(newCalc.totalApproved);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalActualPaid`] = increment(newCalc.actualPaid);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalForecastPaid`] = increment(newCalc.forecastPaid);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalBalance`] = increment(newCalc.totalApproved - (newCalc.actualPaid + newCalc.forecastPaid));
  }

  // 4.3. Year Logic
  const oldYear = String(oldCostData?.projectYear || '2026');
  const newYear = String(newCostData.projectYear || '2026');

  if (!oldCostData || oldYear === newYear) {
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalApproved`] = increment(deltaApproved);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalActualPaid`] = increment(deltaActual);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalForecastPaid`] = increment(deltaForecast);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalBalance`] = increment(deltaBalance);
  } else {
    // CHANGE OF YEAR: subtract old from oldYear, add new to newYear
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${oldYear}.totalApproved`] = increment(-oldCalc.totalApproved);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${oldYear}.totalActualPaid`] = increment(-oldCalc.actualPaid);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${oldYear}.totalForecastPaid`] = increment(-oldCalc.forecastPaid);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${oldYear}.totalBalance`] = increment(-(oldCalc.totalApproved - (oldCalc.actualPaid + oldCalc.forecastPaid)));

    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalApproved`] = increment(newCalc.totalApproved);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalActualPaid`] = increment(newCalc.actualPaid);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalForecastPaid`] = increment(newCalc.forecastPaid);
    projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalBalance`] = increment(newCalc.totalApproved - (newCalc.actualPaid + newCalc.forecastPaid));
  }

  // Apply single update to project
  batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', projectId), projectUpdates);

  // Optimistic Update: Cập nhật tức thì vào Zustand Store in-memory (Rule 2)
  const optimisticStore = useAppStore.getState();
  optimisticStore.optimisticUpdateProjectFinancial(projectId, {
    'financial.totalApproved': deltaApproved,
    'financial.totalActualPaid': deltaActual,
    'financial.totalForecastPaid': deltaForecast,
    'financial.totalBalance': deltaBalance,
    [`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalApproved`]: newCalc.totalApproved - (oldStore === newStore ? oldCalc.totalApproved : 0),
    [`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalActualPaid`]: newCalc.actualPaid - (oldStore === newStore ? oldCalc.actualPaid : 0),
    [`financial.byStore.${newStore}.totalForecastPaid`]: newCalc.forecastPaid - (oldStore === newStore ? oldCalc.forecastPaid : 0),
    [`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalApproved`]: newCalc.totalApproved - (oldYear === newYear ? oldCalc.totalApproved : 0),
    [`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalActualPaid`]: newCalc.actualPaid - (oldYear === newYear ? oldCalc.actualPaid : 0),
    [`financial.byYear.${newYear}.totalForecastPaid`]: newCalc.forecastPaid - (oldYear === newYear ? oldCalc.forecastPaid : 0),
  });

  if (oldStore !== newStore && oldCostData) {
     optimisticStore.optimisticUpdateProjectFinancial(projectId, {
       [`financial.byStore.${oldStore}.totalApproved`]: -oldCalc.totalApproved,
       [`financial.byStore.${oldStore}.totalActualPaid`]: -oldCalc.actualPaid,
       [`financial.byStore.${oldStore}.totalForecastPaid`]: -oldCalc.forecastPaid,
     });
  }
  if (oldYear !== newYear && oldCostData) {
     optimisticStore.optimisticUpdateProjectFinancial(projectId, {
       [`financial.byYear.${oldYear}.totalApproved`]: -oldCalc.totalApproved,
       [`financial.byYear.${oldYear}.totalActualPaid`]: -oldCalc.actualPaid,
       [`financial.byYear.${oldYear}.totalForecastPaid`]: -oldCalc.forecastPaid,
     });
  }

  // 5. Commit batch
  batch.commit().catch(console.error);

  recordDelta({
    docId: newCostData.id,
    collectionName: 'taka_costs',
    action: oldCostData ? 'update' : 'create',
    isPatch: !!oldCostData,
    data: newCostData,
    year: String(newCostData.projectYear || '2026'),
  }).catch(() => {});

  const latestProjForSave = useAppStore.getState().projects.find(p => p.id === projectId);
  if (latestProjForSave?.financial) {
    recordDelta({
      docId: projectId,
      collectionName: 'taka_projects',
      action: 'update',
      isPatch: true,
      data: { financial: latestProjForSave.financial },
      year: String(latestProjForSave.year || newCostData.projectYear || '2026'),
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

export async function deleteCostWithAtomicSummary(
  projectId: string, 
  costToDelete: Cost, 
  budgetHierarchy?: { level3Id?: string, level2Id?: string, level1Id?: string }
): Promise<void> {
  const batch = writeBatch(db);

  // 1. Calculate Deltas for deletion
  const oldCalc = calculatePaidBreakdown(costToDelete);

  const deltaActual = -oldCalc.actualPaid;
  const deltaForecast = -oldCalc.forecastPaid;
  const deltaApproved = -oldCalc.totalApproved;
  const deltaBalance = deltaApproved - (deltaActual + deltaForecast);

  // 2. Cost Document (Mark Deleted)
  const costRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', costToDelete.id);
  batch.set(costRef, { id: costToDelete.id, isDeleted: true }, { merge: true });

  // 3. Budget Hierarchy Cascade
  if (budgetHierarchy) {
    if (budgetHierarchy.level3Id) {
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', budgetHierarchy.level3Id), {
        actualPaid: increment(deltaActual),
        forecastPaid: increment(deltaForecast),
        balance: increment(deltaBalance)
      });
    }
    if (budgetHierarchy.level2Id) {
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', budgetHierarchy.level2Id), {
        actualPaid: increment(deltaActual),
        forecastPaid: increment(deltaForecast),
        balance: increment(deltaBalance)
      });
    }
    if (budgetHierarchy.level1Id) {
      batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', budgetHierarchy.level1Id), {
        actualPaid: increment(deltaActual),
        forecastPaid: increment(deltaForecast),
        balance: increment(deltaBalance)
      });
    }
  }

  // 4. Create 1 single payload for taka_projects (Dot-Notation)
  const projectUpdates: Record<string, any> = {};

  projectUpdates['financial.totalApproved'] = increment(deltaApproved);
  projectUpdates['financial.totalActualPaid'] = increment(deltaActual);
  projectUpdates['financial.totalForecastPaid'] = increment(deltaForecast);
  projectUpdates['financial.totalBalance'] = increment(deltaBalance);

  const store = (costToDelete.projectStore || 'HCM').toUpperCase();
  projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${store}.totalApproved`] = increment(deltaApproved);
  projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${store}.totalActualPaid`] = increment(deltaActual);
  projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${store}.totalForecastPaid`] = increment(deltaForecast);
  projectUpdates[`financial.byStore.${store}.totalBalance`] = increment(deltaBalance);

  const year = String(costToDelete.projectYear || '2026');
  projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${year}.totalApproved`] = increment(deltaApproved);
  projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${year}.totalActualPaid`] = increment(deltaActual);
  projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${year}.totalForecastPaid`] = increment(deltaForecast);
  projectUpdates[`financial.byYear.${year}.totalBalance`] = increment(deltaBalance);

  batch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', projectId), projectUpdates);

  const optimisticStore = useAppStore.getState();
  optimisticStore.optimisticUpdateProjectFinancial(projectId, {
    'financial.totalApproved': deltaApproved,
    'financial.totalActualPaid': deltaActual,
    'financial.totalForecastPaid': deltaForecast,
    'financial.totalBalance': deltaBalance,
    [`financial.byStore.${store}.totalApproved`]: deltaApproved,
    [`financial.byStore.${store}.totalActualPaid`]: deltaActual,
    [`financial.byStore.${store}.totalForecastPaid`]: deltaForecast,
    [`financial.byStore.${store}.totalBalance`]: deltaBalance,
    [`financial.byYear.${year}.totalApproved`]: deltaApproved,
    [`financial.byYear.${year}.totalActualPaid`]: deltaActual,
    [`financial.byYear.${year}.totalForecastPaid`]: deltaForecast,
    [`financial.byYear.${year}.totalBalance`]: deltaBalance,
  });

  // 5. Commit
  batch.commit().catch(console.error);

  recordDelta({
    docId: costToDelete.id,
    collectionName: 'taka_costs',
    action: 'delete',
    data: { id: costToDelete.id, isDeleted: true },
    year: String(costToDelete.projectYear || '2026'),
  }).catch(() => {});

  const latestProjForDelete = useAppStore.getState().projects.find(p => p.id === projectId);
  if (latestProjForDelete?.financial) {
    recordDelta({
      docId: projectId,
      collectionName: 'taka_projects',
      action: 'update',
      isPatch: true,
      data: { financial: latestProjForDelete.financial },
      year: String(latestProjForDelete.year || year),
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

      interimStatus: 'Actual',
      balanceAmount: 20000000,

    };

      secondPaid: 35000000,

    };

    expect(result.forecastPaid).toBe(60000000);

  });

describe('9. Kiểm thử Nghiêm ngặt Biên Độ Tài Chính & Chống Sai Lệch Số Thực (Financial Boundary & Precision)', () => {
  it('kiểm thử chính xác ranh giới tỷ lệ 20% của getBudgetHealthStatus (Normal vs Warning vs Danger)', () => {
    const budget = 100000000; // 100 triệu
    
    // Ngay trên 20% (20.0001% = 20,000,100) -> normal
    expect(getBudgetHealthStatus(20000100, budget)).toBe('normal');

    // Đúng chính xác 20% (20,000,000) -> warning (0 <= Remaining <= 20% Budget)
    expect(getBudgetHealthStatus(20000000, budget)).toBe('warning');

    // Dưới 20% (19.9999% = 19,999,900) -> warning
    expect(getBudgetHealthStatus(19999900, budget)).toBe('warning');

    // Đúng chính xác 0 đồng -> warning
    expect(getBudgetHealthStatus(0, budget)).toBe('warning');

    // Âm 1 đồng (-1) -> danger (Remaining < 0)
    expect(getBudgetHealthStatus(-1, budget)).toBe('danger');
  });

  it('xử lý an toàn khi Budget = 0 hoặc không xác định', () => {
    // Budget = 0, Remaining > 0 -> normal
    expect(getBudgetHealthStatus(5000000, 0)).toBe('normal');
    // Budget = 0, Remaining = 0 -> normal
    expect(getBudgetHealthStatus(0, 0)).toBe('normal');
    // Budget = 0, Remaining < 0 -> danger
    expect(getBudgetHealthStatus(-1000000, 0)).toBe('danger');
  });

  it('làm tròn số nguyên chuẩn Math.round khi tính VAT cho số tiền lẻ, chống trôi số thực (Floating-Point Drift)', () => {
    // 10,000,005 x 8% = 800,000.4 -> Math.round -> 800,000
    const res8 = calculateVATAmount(10000005, 0.08);
    expect(res8.vatAmount).toBe(800000);
    expect(res8.totalAmount).toBe(10800005);

    // 10,000,007 x 8% = 800,000.56 -> Math.round -> 800,001
    const res8RoundUp = calculateVATAmount(10000007, 0.08);
    expect(res8RoundUp.vatAmount).toBe(800001);
    expect(res8RoundUp.totalAmount).toBe(10800008);

    // Thuế 0%
    const res0 = calculateVATAmount(50000000, 0);
    expect(res0.vatAmount).toBe(0);
    expect(res0.totalAmount).toBe(50000000);
  });

  it('calculateCostBalance tính đúng giá trị Balance = Actual - (firstPaid + secondPaid + thirdPaid)', () => {
    const actual = 100000000;
    const firstPaid = 50000000;
    const secondPaid = 40000000;
    const thirdPaid = 20000000; // Tổng = 110tr > 100tr
    
    const balance = calculateCostBalance(actual, firstPaid, secondPaid, thirdPaid);
    // 100tr - 110tr = -10tr phản ánh số tiền đã thanh toán vượt định mức
    expect(balance).toBe(-10000000);
  });
});

import { Cost } from "../types";

export interface CostInstallment {
  amount: number;
  status: 'Actual' | 'Forecast' | string;
}

// Thuật toán bóc tách số tiền Thực tế (Actual) và Dự kiến (Forecast)
export function calculatePaidBreakdown(cost: Partial<Cost>): { actualPaid: number; forecastPaid: number; totalApproved: number } {
  const installments = [
    { amount: Number(cost.advanceAmount || cost.advancePaid || cost.firstPaid || 0), status: cost.advanceStatus || cost.firstStatus || 'Actual' },
    { amount: Number(cost.interimAmount || cost.interimPaid || cost.secondPaid || 0), status: cost.interimStatus || cost.secondStatus || 'Forecast' },
    { amount: Number(cost.balanceAmount || cost.balancePaid || cost.thirdPaid || 0), status: cost.balanceStatus || cost.thirdStatus || 'Forecast' },
  ];

  let actualPaid = 0;
  let forecastPaid = 0;

  for (const inst of installments) {
    if (inst.status === 'Actual') {
      actualPaid += inst.amount;
    } else {
      forecastPaid += inst.amount;
    }
  }

  const totalApproved = Number(cost.approvedAmount || cost.amount || (actualPaid + forecastPaid));
  return { actualPaid, forecastPaid, totalApproved };
}

// 1.1. Công thức tính Số Dư Khoản Chi (Cost Balance sau 3 đợt thanh toán)
export function calculateCostBalance(
  actual: number,
  firstPaid: number = 0,
  secondPaid: number = 0,
  thirdPaid: number = 0
): number {
  return (Number(actual) || 0) - ((Number(firstPaid) || 0) + (Number(secondPaid) || 0) + (Number(thirdPaid) || 0));
}

// 1.2. Công thức tính Số Dư Ngân Sách Còn Lại (Budget Remaining)
export function calculateBudgetRemaining(
  budget: number,
  actual: number,
  supportingFee: number = 0
): number {
  return (Number(budget) || 0) - (Number(actual) || 0) + (Number(supportingFee) || 0);
}

// 1.3. Xác định trạng thái cảnh báo sức khỏe Ngân sách
export function getBudgetHealthStatus(
  remaining: number,
  budget: number
): 'normal' | 'warning' | 'danger' {
  if (remaining < 0) return 'danger';
  if (budget > 0 && remaining <= 0.2 * budget) return 'warning';
  return 'normal';
}

// 1.4. Công thức tính Thuế VAT & Tổng tiền hợp đồng
export function calculateVATAmount(amount: number, vatRate: number): { vatAmount: number; totalAmount: number } {
  const cleanAmount = Number(amount) || 0;
  const cleanRate = Number(vatRate) || 0;
  const vatAmount = Math.round(cleanAmount * cleanRate);
  const totalAmount = cleanAmount + vatAmount;
  return { vatAmount, totalAmount };
}

// 1.5. Cấu trúc và hàm Rollup Ngân Sách Cha - Con (Budget Parent-Child Rollup)
export interface BudgetRollupChild {
  budget?: number;
  totalActual?: number;
  totalSupportingFee?: number;
  hasForc?: boolean;
}

export interface BudgetRollupResult {
  totalBudget: number;
  totalActual: number;
  totalSupportingFee: number;
  hasForc: boolean;
  remaining: number;
}

// 1.6. Tính toán chênh lệch (Deltas) khi thêm/sửa chi phí
export function calculateCostDeltas(newCostData: Partial<Cost>, oldCostData: Partial<Cost> | null) {
  const oldCalc = oldCostData ? calculatePaidBreakdown(oldCostData) : { actualPaid: 0, forecastPaid: 0, totalApproved: 0 };
  const newCalc = calculatePaidBreakdown(newCostData);

  const deltaActual = newCalc.actualPaid - oldCalc.actualPaid;
  const deltaForecast = newCalc.forecastPaid - oldCalc.forecastPaid;
  const deltaApproved = newCalc.totalApproved - oldCalc.totalApproved;
  const deltaBalance = deltaApproved - (deltaActual + deltaForecast);

  return {
    oldCalc,
    newCalc,
    deltaActual,
    deltaForecast,
    deltaApproved,
    deltaBalance
  };
}

// 1.7. Tổng hợp chi phí theo danh sách khoản chi của Dự án
export function calculateCostsSummaryForProject(costs: Array<Partial<Cost>>) {
  const totalActual = costs.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.actual) || 0), 0);
  const totalForc = costs.filter(c => c.costType === 'forc').reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.actual) || 0), 0);
  const totalSupportingFee = costs.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.supportingFee) || 0), 0);
  const totalFirstPaid = costs.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.firstPaid) || 0), 0);
  const totalSecondPaid = costs.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.secondPaid) || 0), 0);
  const totalThirdPaid = costs.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.thirdPaid) || 0), 0);
  const totalBalance = costs.reduce((sum, c) => sum + calculateCostBalance(c.actual, c.firstPaid, c.secondPaid, c.thirdPaid), 0);
  const hasForc = costs.some(c => c.costType === 'forc');

  return {
    totalActual,
    totalForc,
    totalSupportingFee,
    totalFirstPaid,
    totalSecondPaid,
    totalThirdPaid,
    totalBalance,
    hasForc
  };
}

export { saveCostWithAtomicSummary, deleteCostWithAtomicSummary } from './financialAtomicService';

export const initAuth = (
  onAuthSuccess?: (user: User, token: string) => void,
  onAuthFailure?: () => void
) => {
  return onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user: User | null) => {
    if (user) {
      if (cachedAccessToken) {
        if (onAuthSuccess) onAuthSuccess(user, cachedAccessToken);
      } else if (!isSigningIn) {
        cachedAccessToken = null;
        if (onAuthFailure) onAuthFailure();
      }
    } else {
      cachedAccessToken = null;
      if (onAuthFailure) onAuthFailure();
    }
  });
};

export const googleSignIn = async (): Promise<{ user: User; accessToken: string } | null> => {
  try {
    isSigningIn = true;
    const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, provider);
    const credential = GoogleAuthProvider.credentialFromResult(result);
    if (!credential?.accessToken) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get access token from Firebase Auth');
    }

    cachedAccessToken = credential.accessToken;
    return { user: result.user, accessToken: cachedAccessToken };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Sign in error:', error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    isSigningIn = false;
  }
};

  return cachedAccessToken;
};

function cleanDataForAudit(data: any) {
  if (!data) return null;
  const clone: any = {};
  for (const key in data) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) {
      const val = data[key];
      if (val === undefined) {
        clone[key] = null;
      } else if (val !== null && typeof val === 'object' && val.constructor && val.constructor.name !== 'Object' && val.constructor.name !== 'Array') {
        clone[key] = `[Special: ${val.constructor.name}]`;
      } else {
        clone[key] = val;
      }
    }
  }
  return clone;
}

function writeAuditLogAsync(action: 'CREATE' | 'UPDATE' | 'DELETE', docRef: any, data?: any) {
  try {
    if (!docRef || !docRef.path) return;
    const path = docRef.path;
    
    // Ignore audit logs and noisy system collections
    if (path.includes('audit_logs') || path.includes('device_telemetry') || path.includes('taka_config')) return;
    
    const user = auth.currentUser;
    let userId = user?.uid;
    let userEmail = user?.email;

    if (!userId || !userEmail) {
      try {
        const storedAuth = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('taka_auth_v1') : null;
        if (storedAuth) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(storedAuth);
          if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
            userId = userId || parsed.id || parsed.username;
            userEmail = userEmail || parsed.email || parsed.username;
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    userId = userId || 'system';
    userEmail = userEmail || 'anonymous';
    
    const dbInstance = docRef.firestore;
    const logRef = doc(collection(dbInstance, 'audit_logs'));
    
    // Determine entity type from path
    let entityType = 'other';
    if (path.includes('taka_projects')) entityType = 'project';
    else if (path.includes('taka_tasks')) entityType = 'task';
    else if (path.includes('taka_costs')) entityType = 'cost';
    else if (path.includes('taka_delegation_groups')) entityType = 'delegation';
    else if (path.includes('taka_users')) entityType = 'user';
    else if (path.includes('taka_rules')) entityType = 'rule';

    // Capture previous state snapshot for Visual Diff Viewer
    let previousData: any = null;
    try {
      const storeGetter = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window as any).__TAKA_APP_STORE__?.getState : null;
      if (storeGetter) {
        const storeState = storeGetter();
        let existingDoc: any = null;
        if (entityType === 'project') existingDoc = storeState.projects?.find((p: any) => p.id === docRef.id);
        else if (entityType === 'task') existingDoc = storeState.tasks?.find((t: any) => t.id === docRef.id);
        else if (entityType === 'cost') existingDoc = storeState.costs?.find((c: any) => c.id === docRef.id);
        else if (entityType === 'delegation') existingDoc = storeState.delegationGroups?.find((d: any) => d.id === docRef.id);

        if (action === 'UPDATE' && data && typeof data === 'object' && existingDoc) {
          const prevSlice: Record<string, any> = {};
          Object.keys(data).forEach(k => {
            if (k.includes('.')) {
              const parts = k.split('.');
              let curr = existingDoc;
              for (let i = 0; i < parts.length && curr != null; i++) {
                curr = curr[parts[i]];
              }
              prevSlice[k] = curr !== undefined ? curr : null;
            } else {
              prevSlice[k] = existingDoc[k] !== undefined ? existingDoc[k] : null;
            }
          });
          previousData = cleanDataForAudit(prevSlice);
        } else if (action === 'DELETE' && existingDoc) {
          previousData = cleanDataForAudit(existingDoc);
        }
      }
    } catch {}

    const logData = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      userId,
      userEmail,
      action,
      entityType,
      docPath: path,
      docId: docRef.id,
      data: cleanDataForAudit(data),
      ...(previousData ? { previousData } : {})
    };
    
    // Fire and forget (Optimistic UI unaffected)
    firestoreSetDoc(logRef, logData).catch(err => {
      console.warn("Audit log failed:", err);
    });
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn("Error preparing audit log:", e);
  }
}

function writeBatchAuditLogAsync(
  dbInstance: any,
  ops: Array<{ action: 'CREATE' | 'UPDATE' | 'DELETE'; docRef: any; data?: any }>
) {
  try {
    if (!ops || ops.length === 0) return;
    if (ops.length === 1) {
      writeAuditLogAsync(ops[0].action, ops[0].docRef, ops[0].data);
      return;
    }

    const filteredOps = ops.filter((op) => {
      const p = op.docRef?.path || '';
      return !p.includes('audit_logs') && !p.includes('device_telemetry') && !p.includes('taka_config');
    });
    if (filteredOps.length === 0) return;

    const user = auth.currentUser;
    let userId = user?.uid;
    let userEmail = user?.email;

    if (!userId || !userEmail) {
      try {
        const storedAuth = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('taka_auth_v1') : null;
        if (storedAuth) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(storedAuth);
          if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
            userId = userId || parsed.id || parsed.username;
            userEmail = userEmail || parsed.email || parsed.username;
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    userId = userId || 'system';
    userEmail = userEmail || 'anonymous';

    const logRef = doc(collection(dbInstance, 'audit_logs'));

    const entityTypes = new Set<string>();
    filteredOps.forEach((op) => {
      const p = op.docRef?.path || '';
      if (p.includes('taka_projects')) entityTypes.add('project');
      else if (p.includes('taka_tasks')) entityTypes.add('task');
      else if (p.includes('taka_costs')) entityTypes.add('cost');
      else if (p.includes('taka_delegation_groups')) entityTypes.add('delegation');
      else if (p.includes('taka_users')) entityTypes.add('user');
      else if (p.includes('taka_rules')) entityTypes.add('rule');
    });
    const entityType = entityTypes.size === 1 ? Array.from(entityTypes)[0] : 'batch';

    const actions = new Set(filteredOps.map((o) => o.action));
    const primaryAction = actions.size === 1 ? Array.from(actions)[0] : 'UPDATE';

    const summaryItems = filteredOps.slice(0, 50).map((op) => ({
      action: op.action,
      docId: op.docRef?.id,
      docPath: op.docRef?.path,
      data: cleanDataForAudit(op.data),
    }));

    const logData = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      userId,
      userEmail,
      action: primaryAction,
      entityType,
      docPath: `batch (${filteredOps.length} items: ${Array.from(entityTypes).join(', ')})`,
      docId: `batch_${filteredOps[0].docRef?.id || Date.now()}`,
      data: {
        batchSize: filteredOps.length,
        entityTypes: Array.from(entityTypes),
        items: summaryItems,
      },
    };

    firestoreSetDoc(logRef, logData).catch((err) => {
      console.warn('Batch audit log failed:', err);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Error preparing batch audit log:', e);
  }
}

function handleOfflineQueue(action: 'set' | 'update' | 'delete', docRef: any, data?: any, error?: any) {
  // Server từ chối vĩnh viễn thì không xếp hàng: phát lại về sau chỉ gây ghi đè/xóa ngoài ý muốn.
  if (error && isPermanentWriteError(error)) return;
  let collectionPath = docRef.path;
  // Firestore path is usually something like "artifacts/APP_ID/public/data/taka_projects/project1"
  // We want to extract the collection path, which is everything before the last slash.
  if (collectionPath) {
    const parts = collectionPath.split('/');
    parts.pop(); // remove docId
    collectionPath = parts.join('/');
  }
  
  addPendingUpdate({
    collectionPath: collectionPath,
    action,
    docId: docRef.id,
    data: data || {}
  } as any);
}

import { removeUndefinedDeep } from "./firestoreSanitizer";

export function setDoc(docRef: any, data: any, options?: any) {
  const cleanData = removeUndefinedDeep(data);
  validateFirestoreData(docRef.path, cleanData, options?.merge === true);
  writeAuditLogAsync("CREATE", docRef, cleanData);
  queueAutoDelta(docRef.path, docRef.id, 'write');
  if (cleanData?.isDeleted) {
    const logical = resolveLogicalCollection(docRef.path);
    if (logical && docRef.id) deleteLocalRecord(logical, docRef.id).catch(() => {});
  }
  return firestoreSetDoc(docRef, cleanData, options).catch(error => {
    console.warn("Network error during setDoc. Saving to local IndexedDB queue.", error);
    handleOfflineQueue('set', docRef, cleanData, error);
    throw error;
  });
}

export function updateDoc(docRef: any, data: any) {
  const cleanData = removeUndefinedDeep(data);
  validateFirestoreData(docRef.path, cleanData, true);
  writeAuditLogAsync("UPDATE", docRef, cleanData);
  queueAutoDelta(docRef.path, docRef.id, 'write');
  if (cleanData?.isDeleted) {
    const logical = resolveLogicalCollection(docRef.path);
    if (logical && docRef.id) deleteLocalRecord(logical, docRef.id).catch(() => {});
  }
  return firestoreUpdateDoc(docRef, cleanData).catch(error => {
    console.warn("Network error during updateDoc. Saving to local IndexedDB queue.", error);
    handleOfflineQueue('update', docRef, cleanData, error);
    throw error;
  });
}

export function deleteDoc(docRef: any) {
  writeAuditLogAsync("DELETE", docRef);
  queueAutoDelta(docRef.path, docRef.id, 'delete');
  const logical = resolveLogicalCollection(docRef.path);
  if (logical && docRef.id) deleteLocalRecord(logical, docRef.id).catch(() => {});
  return firestoreDeleteDoc(docRef).catch(error => {
    console.warn("Network error during deleteDoc. Saving to local IndexedDB queue.", error);
    handleOfflineQueue('delete', docRef, undefined, error);
    throw error;
  });
}

export function writeBatch(dbInstance: any): WriteBatch {
  const batch = firestoreWriteBatch(dbInstance);
  const originalSet = batch.set.bind(batch);
  const originalUpdate = batch.update.bind(batch);
  const originalDelete = batch.delete.bind(batch);
  const originalCommit = batch.commit.bind(batch);

  const operations: any[] = [];
  const auditOps: Array<{ action: 'CREATE' | 'UPDATE' | 'DELETE'; docRef: any; data?: any }> = [];

  (batch as any).set = (docRef: any, data: any, options?: any) => {
    const cleanData = removeUndefinedDeep(data);
    validateFirestoreData(docRef.path, cleanData, options?.merge === true);
    operations.push({ action: 'set', docRef, data: cleanData, options });
    auditOps.push({ action: 'CREATE', docRef, data: cleanData });
    return originalSet(docRef, cleanData, options);
  };
  
  (batch as any).update = (docRef: any, data: any, ...moreFieldsAndValues: any[]) => {
    const cleanData = removeUndefinedDeep(data);
    validateFirestoreData(docRef.path, cleanData, true);
    operations.push({ action: 'update', docRef, data: cleanData });
    auditOps.push({ action: 'UPDATE', docRef, data: cleanData });
    return (originalUpdate as any)(docRef, cleanData, ...moreFieldsAndValues);
  };

  (batch as any).delete = (docRef: any) => {
    operations.push({ action: 'delete', docRef });
    auditOps.push({ action: 'DELETE', docRef });
    return originalDelete(docRef);
  };

  (batch as any).commit = () => {
    // Queue after the ops are handed to the SDK so the delta write is ordered after the data writes
    operations.forEach(op => {
      queueAutoDelta(op.docRef.path, op.docRef.id, op.action === 'delete' ? 'delete' : 'write');
      if (op.action === 'delete' || op.data?.isDeleted) {
        const logical = resolveLogicalCollection(op.docRef.path);
        if (logical && op.docRef.id) deleteLocalRecord(logical, op.docRef.id).catch(() => {});
      }
    });
    // B3: Batch audit log consolidation into 1 single document write
    writeBatchAuditLogAsync(dbInstance, auditOps);
    return originalCommit().catch(error => {
      console.warn("Network error during batch commit. Saving to local IndexedDB queue.", error);
      operations.forEach(op => {
         handleOfflineQueue(op.action, op.docRef, op.data, error);
      });
      throw error;
    });
  };

  return batch;
}


=== FILE: src/lib/firestoreSanitizer.ts ===
/**
 * Deeply strips `undefined` properties from objects/arrays so Firestore operations
 * (setDoc, updateDoc, writeBatch.set, writeBatch.update) never fail with:
 * "FirebaseError: Function WriteBatch.set() called with invalid data. Unsupported field value: undefined"
 *
 * Preserves custom objects/classes such as FieldValue (deleteField, serverTimestamp, increment)
 * and Date, RegExp, etc.
 */
export function removeUndefinedDeep<T = any>(val: T): T {
  if (val === undefined) {
    return undefined as unknown as T;
  }
  if (val === null || typeof val !== 'object') {
    return val;
  }

  // Handle Date
  if (val instanceof Date) {
    return val;
  }

  // Handle Arrays
  if (Array.isArray(val)) {
    return val
      .filter((item) => item !== undefined)
      .map((item) => removeUndefinedDeep(item)) as unknown as T;
  }

  // If object is not a plain object (e.g., Firestore FieldValue like deleteField() or serverTimestamp())
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(val);
  if (proto !== null && proto !== Object.prototype) {
    return val;
  }

  // Plain object: remove keys where value is undefined, recurse on nested values
  const result: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const [key, v] of Object.entries(val as Record<string, any>)) {
    if (v !== undefined) {
      result[key] = removeUndefinedDeep(v);
    }
  }
  return result as T;
}

import {
  setDoc as rawSetDoc,
  updateDoc as rawUpdateDoc,
  deleteDoc as rawDeleteDoc,
  writeBatch as rawWriteBatch,
  serverTimestamp,
  type WriteBatch,
} from 'firebase/firestore';
import { queueAutoDelta, resolveLogicalCollection } from './autoDeltaQueue';
import { removeUndefinedDeep } from './firestoreSanitizer';
import { deleteLocalRecord } from './localDb';
import { recordAuditLog } from './auditLogService';

/**
 * Thin drop-in replacements for Firestore write functions that ALSO emit an auto delta
 * (see autoDeltaQueue.ts) for the 4 core collections. Behaviour is otherwise identical to firebase/firestore
 * (no validation, no audit log, no offline-queue side effects), so swapping the import is risk-free.
 *
 * RULE: any file that writes taka_projects / taka_tasks / taka_costs / taka_delegation_groups must import
 * setDoc/updateDoc/deleteDoc/writeBatch from here (or from lib/firebase.ts), never from 'firebase/firestore'.
 */

export const setDoc = ((ref: any, data: any, ...rest: any[]) => {
  const cleanData = removeUndefinedDeep(data);
  queueAutoDelta(ref?.path, ref?.id, cleanData?.isDeleted ? 'delete' : 'write');
  // Inject serverTimestamp for consistency (Rule 15)
  if (cleanData && typeof cleanData === 'object' && !cleanData.isDeleted) {
    (cleanData as any).updatedAt = serverTimestamp();
  }
  
  // Audit log for financial/core changes (Rule 4)
  if (ref?.path && (ref.path.includes('taka_projects') || ref.path.includes('taka_costs'))) {
    recordAuditLog({
      action: 'UPDATE',
      docPath: ref.path,
      docId: ref.id,
      data: cleanData
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  if (cleanData?.isDeleted) {
    const logical = resolveLogicalCollection(ref?.path);
    if (logical && ref?.id) deleteLocalRecord(logical, ref.id).catch(() => {});
  }
  return (rawSetDoc as any)(ref, cleanData, ...rest);
}) as typeof rawSetDoc;

export const updateDoc = ((ref: any, data: any, ...rest: any[]) => {
  const cleanData = removeUndefinedDeep(data);
  queueAutoDelta(ref?.path, ref?.id, cleanData?.isDeleted ? 'delete' : 'write');
  // Inject serverTimestamp for consistency (Rule 15)
  if (cleanData && typeof cleanData === 'object' && !cleanData.isDeleted) {
    (cleanData as any).updatedAt = serverTimestamp();
  }

  // Audit log for financial/core changes (Rule 4)
  if (ref?.path && (ref.path.includes('taka_projects') || ref.path.includes('taka_costs'))) {
    recordAuditLog({
      action: 'UPDATE',
      docPath: ref.path,
      docId: ref.id,
      data: cleanData
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  if (cleanData?.isDeleted) {
    const logical = resolveLogicalCollection(ref?.path);
    if (logical && ref?.id) deleteLocalRecord(logical, ref.id).catch(() => {});
  }
  return (rawUpdateDoc as any)(ref, cleanData, ...rest);
}) as typeof rawUpdateDoc;

export const deleteDoc = ((ref: any) => {
  queueAutoDelta(ref?.path, ref?.id, 'delete');
  const logical = resolveLogicalCollection(ref?.path);

  // Audit log for financial/core changes (Rule 4)
  if (ref?.path && (ref.path.includes('taka_projects') || ref.path.includes('taka_costs'))) {
    recordAuditLog({
      action: 'DELETE',
      docPath: ref.path,
      docId: ref.id,
      data: { isDeleted: true }
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  if (logical && ref?.id) deleteLocalRecord(logical, ref.id).catch(() => {});
  return rawDeleteDoc(ref);
}) as typeof rawDeleteDoc;

export function writeBatch(dbInstance: any): WriteBatch {
  const batch: any = rawWriteBatch(dbInstance);
  const ops: Array<{ ref: any; kind: 'write' | 'delete'; isDeleted?: boolean }> = [];
  const origSet = batch.set.bind(batch);
  const origUpdate = batch.update.bind(batch);
  const origDelete = batch.delete.bind(batch);
  const origCommit = batch.commit.bind(batch);

  batch.set = (ref: any, data: any, ...rest: any[]) => {
    const cleanData = removeUndefinedDeep(data);
    if (cleanData && typeof cleanData === 'object' && !cleanData.isDeleted) {
      (cleanData as any).updatedAt = serverTimestamp();
    }
    ops.push({ ref, kind: 'write', isDeleted: !!cleanData?.isDeleted });
    return origSet(ref, cleanData, ...rest);
  };
  batch.update = (ref: any, data: any, ...rest: any[]) => {
    const cleanData = removeUndefinedDeep(data);
    if (cleanData && typeof cleanData === 'object' && !cleanData.isDeleted) {
      (cleanData as any).updatedAt = serverTimestamp();
    }
    ops.push({ ref, kind: 'write', isDeleted: !!cleanData?.isDeleted });
    return origUpdate(ref, cleanData, ...rest);
  };
  batch.delete = (ref: any) => { ops.push({ ref, kind: 'delete' }); return origDelete(ref); };
  batch.commit = () => {
    // Queue after the ops are handed to the SDK so the delta write is ordered after the data writes
    ops.forEach((o) => {
      queueAutoDelta(o.ref?.path, o.ref?.id, (o.kind === 'delete' || o.isDeleted) ? 'delete' : 'write');
      if (o.kind === 'delete' || o.isDeleted) {
        const logical = resolveLogicalCollection(o.ref?.path);
        if (logical && o.ref?.id) deleteLocalRecord(logical, o.ref.id).catch(() => {});
      }
    });
    return origCommit();
  };
  return batch as WriteBatch;
}
