const DB_NAME = 'taka_cache_db';
const STORE_NAME = 'taka_cache_store';

export async function getIDB(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
    request.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
      const db = (e.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME);
      }
    };
    request.onsuccess = (e) => {
      resolve((e.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result);
    };
    request.onerror = (e) => {
      reject((e.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).error);
    };
  });
}

export async function getFromIDB<T = any>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
  try {
    const db = await getIDB();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readonly");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.get(key);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve((request.result as T) ?? null);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("Failed to read from IndexedDB", e);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function saveToIDB(key: string, value: any): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const db = await getIDB();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.put(value, key);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("Failed to write to IndexedDB", e);
  }
}

export async function deleteFromIDB(key: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const db = await getIDB();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.delete(key);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("Failed to delete from IndexedDB", e);
  }
}

export async function clearAllIDB(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const db = await getIDB();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.clear();
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("Failed to clear IndexedDB", e);
  }
}

    expect(res.height).toBe(960);

    expect(res.width).toBe(960);

    expect(res.width).toBe(800);
    expect(res.height).toBe(600);
  });

  it('should handle zero or invalid dimensions gracefully', () => {
    const res = calculateTargetDimensions(0, 0, 1920, 1920);
    expect(res.width).toBe(1920);
    expect(res.height).toBe(1920);
  });

=== FILE: src/lib/imageCompression.ts ===
/**
 * Client-side High-Performance Image Compression & WebP Converter (Canva & Cloudinary Standard)
 * 
 * Automatically scales, optimizes, and encodes raw photos (up to 15MB) into ultra-lightweight WebP format
 * (~150KB - 300KB) directly in browser memory before uploading to Cloudflare R2 or Firebase Storage.
 */

export interface ImageCompressionOptions {
  maxWidth?: number;
  maxHeight?: number;
  quality?: number; // 0.1 to 1.0 (default: 0.82)
  outputFormat?: 'image/webp' | 'image/jpeg';
}

export interface CompressedImageResult {
  file: File;
  blob: Blob;
  originalSize: number;
  compressedSize: number;
  compressionRatio: number; // e.g. 85.5% saved
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/**
 * Checks if browser supports WebP canvas export
 */
export function isWebpSupported(): boolean {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 1;
    canvas.height = 1;
    return canvas.toDataURL('image/webp').indexOf('data:image/webp') === 0;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Calculates proportional dimensions given max constraints
 */
export function calculateTargetDimensions(
  srcWidth: number,
  srcHeight: number,
  maxWidth: number = 1920,
  maxHeight: number = 1920
): { width: number; height: number } {
  if (srcWidth <= 0 || srcHeight <= 0) {
    return { width: maxWidth, height: maxHeight };
  }

  let width = srcWidth;
  let height = srcHeight;

  if (width > maxWidth) {
    height = Math.round((height * maxWidth) / width);
    width = maxWidth;
  }

  if (height > maxHeight) {
    width = Math.round((width * maxHeight) / height);
    height = maxHeight;
  }

  return { width: Math.max(1, width), height: Math.max(1, height) };
}

/**
 * Compresses an image file to WebP format in browser memory
 */
export async function compressImageToWebp(
  file: File,
  options: ImageCompressionOptions = {}
): Promise<CompressedImageResult> {
  const {
    maxWidth = 1920,
    maxHeight = 1920,
    quality = 0.82,
    outputFormat = isWebpSupported() ? 'image/webp' : 'image/jpeg',
  } = options;

  const originalSize = file.size;

  // Non-image files or SVG bypass compression
  if (!file.type.startsWith('image/') || file.type === 'image/svg+xml') {
    return {
      file,
      blob: file,
      originalSize,
      compressedSize: originalSize,
      compressionRatio: 0,
      width: 0,
      height: 0,
    };
  }

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read image file'));
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to decode image data'));
      img.onload = () => {
        try {
          const { width, height } = calculateTargetDimensions(
            img.naturalWidth || img.width,
            img.naturalHeight || img.height,
            maxWidth,
            maxHeight
          );

          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = width;
          canvas.height = height;

          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          if (!ctx) {
            resolve({
              file,
              blob: file,
              originalSize,
              compressedSize: originalSize,
              compressionRatio: 0,
              width,
              height,
            });
            return;
          }

          // High-quality image smoothing
          ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
          ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);

          canvas.toBlob(
            (blob) => {
              if (!blob) {
                resolve({
                  file,
                  blob: file,
                  originalSize,
                  compressedSize: originalSize,
                  compressionRatio: 0,
                  width,
                  height,
                });
                return;
              }

              // If compressed blob is somehow larger than original (rare for small icons), keep original
              if (blob.size >= originalSize && originalSize > 0) {
                resolve({
                  file,
                  blob: file,
                  originalSize,
                  compressedSize: originalSize,
                  compressionRatio: 0,
                  width,
                  height,
                });
                return;
              }

              const ext = outputFormat === 'image/webp' ? '.webp' : '.jpg';
              const baseName = file.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '');
              const newFileName = `${baseName}${ext}`;

              const compressedFile = new File([blob], newFileName, {
                type: outputFormat,
                lastModified: Date.now(),
              });

              const compressedSize = blob.size;
              const savedBytes = Math.max(0, originalSize - compressedSize);
              const compressionRatio = originalSize > 0
                ? Number(((savedBytes / originalSize) * 100).toFixed(1))
                : 0;

              resolve({
                file: compressedFile,
                blob,
                originalSize,
                compressedSize,
                compressionRatio,
                width,
                height,
              });
            },
            outputFormat,
            quality
          );
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      };

      if (e.target?.result) {
        img.src = e.target.result as string;
      } else {
        reject(new Error('Empty file reader result'));
      }
    };

    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

import { extractR2Key, resolveR2UrlToHttp } from '../components/PictureMapping/lib/r2Upload';

/**
 * IndexedDB & Memory Cache Manager for CAD Floorplan Images.
 * Provides instant 0ms switching between floors/versions during and across sessions.
 * 
 * Features:
 * 1. Normalized persistent Cache Keys (immune to signed URL expiration / query param changes).
 * 2. Two-tier caching: In-Memory LRU (0ms) + IndexedDB Persistent Blob Store (<30ms).
 * 3. Background Preloader Queue for all floor plans across HCM / HN.
 * 4. Automatic offscreen bitmap decoding via createImageBitmap() with ObjectURL fallback.
 */

const DB_NAME = 'taka_cad_images_db';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_NAME = 'cad_blobs';
const MAX_MEMORY_CACHE = 20; // Safe in-memory cache limit for active floorplan images

// In-Memory LRU Cache for decoded ImageBitmap / HTMLImageElement
const memoryCache = new Map<string, ImageBitmap | HTMLImageElement>();
// In-Flight fetch promises to deduplicate network / IDB requests
const inFlightRequests = new Map<string, Promise<Blob | null>>();

/**
 * Normalizes an image URL into a persistent cache key.
 * Strips volatile S3/R2 signed query parameters (e.g. ?X-Amz-Signature, ?Expires)
 * so that fresh signed URLs reuse already-cached image blobs across sessions.
 */
export function normalizeImageCacheKey(url: string | undefined | null): string {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return '';
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';
  
  // Data URLs and Blob URLs use their direct string/prefix
  if (trimmed.startsWith('data:') || trimmed.startsWith('blob:')) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  // Unified persistent key for Cloudflare R2 objects across r2:// links, keys, and signed URLs
  const r2Key = extractR2Key(trimmed);
  if (r2Key) {
    return `r2_object_${r2Key}`;
  }

  try {
    const parsed = new URL(trimmed, typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : 'http://localhost');
    // If it contains AWS/R2 signed params, strip the search params for persistent storage key
    if (
      parsed.searchParams.has('X-Amz-Signature') ||
      parsed.searchParams.has('X-Amz-Credential') ||
      parsed.searchParams.has('x-amz-signature') ||
      parsed.searchParams.has('token') ||
      parsed.searchParams.has('expires')
    ) {
      return `${parsed.origin}${parsed.pathname}`;
    }
    return trimmed;
  } catch (_e) {
    return trimmed;
  }
}

function updateMemoryCache(cacheKey: string, img: ImageBitmap | HTMLImageElement) {
  if (!cacheKey) return;
  if (memoryCache.has(cacheKey)) {
    memoryCache.delete(cacheKey);
  } else if (memoryCache.size >= MAX_MEMORY_CACHE) {
    // Evict oldest item
    const firstKey = memoryCache.keys().next().value;
    if (firstKey) {
      memoryCache.delete(firstKey);
    }
  }
  memoryCache.set(cacheKey, img);
}

export function getMemoryCachedImage(url: string): ImageBitmap | HTMLImageElement | null {
  const key = normalizeImageCacheKey(url);
  if (!key) return null;
  const img = memoryCache.get(key);
  if (img) {
    // Cold freeze / GPU context loss protection: check if ImageBitmap was detached or image broken
    if ('width' in img && img.width === 0) {
      memoryCache.delete(key);
      return null;
    }
    // Move to end (most recently used)
    memoryCache.delete(key);
    memoryCache.set(key, img);
    return img;
  }
  return null;
}

export function setMemoryCachedImage(url: string, img: ImageBitmap | HTMLImageElement) {
  const key = normalizeImageCacheKey(url);
  if (!key) return;
  updateMemoryCache(key, img);
}

// IndexedDB Database Promise
let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase> | null = null;

function getDB(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;

  dbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.indexedDB) {
      reject(new Error('IndexedDB not supported in current environment'));
      return;
    }

    try {
      const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);

      request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {
        const db = (event.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
          db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME);
        }
      };

      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const db = request.result;
        // Clean up connection promise when closed by browser sleep / discard
        db.onclose = () => {
          dbPromise = null;
        };
        db.onversionchange = () => {
          try { db.close(); } catch (_) {}
          dbPromise = null;
        };
        resolve(db);
      };

      request.onerror = () => {
        dbPromise = null;
        reject(request.error);
      };
    } catch (err) {
      dbPromise = null;
      reject(err);
    }
  });

  return dbPromise;
}

function queryIDB(db: IDBDatabase, key: string): Promise<Blob | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const req = store.get(key);
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || null);
    req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
  });
}

export async function getCachedBlobFromIDB(url: string): Promise<Blob | null> {
  const key = normalizeImageCacheKey(url);
  if (!key) return null;

  try {
    let db = await getDB();
    try {
      return await queryIDB(db, key);
    } catch (_txErr) {
      // Reconnect if database connection was invalidated during cold freeze / long sleep
      dbPromise = null;
      db = await getDB();
      return await queryIDB(db, key);
    }
  } catch (_e) {
    dbPromise = null;
    return null;
  }
}

export async function setCachedBlobToIDB(url: string, blob: Blob): Promise<void> {
  const key = normalizeImageCacheKey(url);
  if (!key || !blob) return;

  try {
    let db = await getDB();
    try {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      store.put(blob, key);
    } catch (_txErr) {
      dbPromise = null;
      db = await getDB();
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      store.put(blob, key);
    }
  } catch (_e) {
    dbPromise = null;
    // Ignore IndexedDB write failures (e.g. quota exceeded or private browsing restrictions)
  }
}

/**
 * Fetches an image blob with deduplication, storing it in IndexedDB for subsequent visits.
 */
export async function fetchAndCacheImageBlob(url: string): Promise<Blob | null> {
  if (!url) return null;
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  const key = normalizeImageCacheKey(trimmed);

  // Check IDB first (normalized key matches across r2://, key, and signed URL)
  const existingBlob = await getCachedBlobFromIDB(trimmed);
  if (existingBlob) return existingBlob;

  // Deduplicate concurrent fetch requests for the same URL/key
  if (inFlightRequests.has(key)) {
    return inFlightRequests.get(key)!;
  }

  const fetchPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      let activeFetchUrl = trimmed;

      // If it is an r2:// link or raw key, resolve to a presigned HTTP URL
      if (activeFetchUrl.startsWith('r2://') || (!activeFetchUrl.startsWith('http://') && !activeFetchUrl.startsWith('https://') && !activeFetchUrl.startsWith('blob:') && !activeFetchUrl.startsWith('data:'))) {
        const resolved = await resolveR2UrlToHttp(activeFetchUrl);
        if (!resolved) return null;
        activeFetchUrl = resolved;
      }

      let res = await fetch(activeFetchUrl, { mode: 'cors' }).catch(() => null);

      // If fetch failed with 401/403 (expired signed URL), refresh signed URL from R2 and retry once
      if ((!res || !res.ok) && extractR2Key(trimmed)) {
        const refreshedUrl = await resolveR2UrlToHttp(trimmed);
        if (refreshedUrl && refreshedUrl !== activeFetchUrl) {
          res = await fetch(refreshedUrl, { mode: 'cors' }).catch(() => null);
        }
      }

      if (!res || !res.ok) {
        return null;
      }

      const blob = await res.blob();
      if (blob && blob.size > 0) {
        await setCachedBlobToIDB(trimmed, blob);
        return blob;
      }
      return null;
    } catch (_err) {
      return null;
    } finally {
      inFlightRequests.delete(key);
    }
  })();

  inFlightRequests.set(key, fetchPromise);
  return fetchPromise;
}

/**
 * Background Preloader: Silently pre-fetches and pre-caches floorplan images in IndexedDB & RAM.
 * Ensures that when users switch floors (B1, L1, L2, L3, L4, L5), the switch is instant (0ms).
 */
export function preloadFloorImages(urls: (string | undefined | null)[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  const validUrls = Array.from(new Set(urls.filter((u): u is string => !!u && typeof u === 'string' && !u.startsWith('data:'))));
  if (validUrls.length === 0) return;

  const runPreload = async () => {
    for (const url of validUrls) {
      try {
        await fetchAndCacheImageBlob(url);
      } catch (_e) {}
    }
  };

  if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
    (window as any).requestIdleCallback(() => runPreload(), { timeout: 3000 });
  } else {
    setTimeout(runPreload, 200);
  }
}

/**
 * Clears the IndexedDB CAD image cache and in-memory cache.
 */
export async function clearCadImageCache(): Promise<void> {
  memoryCache.forEach((img) => {
    if (img && 'close' in img && typeof (img as ImageBitmap).close === 'function') {
      try { (img as ImageBitmap).close(); } catch (_) {}
    }
  });
  memoryCache.clear();

  try {
    const db = await getDB();
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    store.clear();
  } catch (_e) {}
}

import { Project, Task, ActiveNotification } from '../types';

export interface LayoutUnitMatchResult {
  hasUnit: boolean;
  store: string;
  location: string;
  year?: string;
  unitCode: string;
  project?: Project | null;
  task?: Task | null;
  isComment: boolean;
  isTaskComment: boolean;
  isProjectComment: boolean;
}

export const extractFloorFromCodeOrName = (str?: string | null): string | null => {
  if (!str) return null;
  const s = String(str).trim();
  const m = s.match(/(?:^|[^a-zA-Z0-9])(B\d|L\d|\d+F|\d+L|GF|MF|RF|BASEMENT\s*\d?|LEVEL\s*\d?|FLOOR\s*\d?)(?:[^a-zA-Z0-9]|$)/i);
  if (m) {
    let token = m[1].toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (token.startsWith('BASEMENT')) token = token.replace('BASEMENT', 'B') || 'B1';
    if (token.startsWith('LEVEL')) token = token.replace('LEVEL', 'L') || 'L1';
    if (token.startsWith('FLOOR')) token = token.replace('FLOOR', 'L') || 'L1';
    if (/^\d+F$/.test(token)) token = 'L' + token.replace('F', '');
    if (/^\d+L$/.test(token)) token = 'L' + token.replace('L', '');
    return token;
  }
  return null;
};

/**
 * Searches if a notification (or project/task/delegation) has a corresponding unit on the Live Layout floor plans.
 * Returns location, store, year, matched unit code, and comment flags if found; returns null otherwise.
 */
export function findProjectLayoutUnit(
  notif: ActiveNotification,
  projectsList: Project[],
  tasksList: Task[]
): LayoutUnitMatchResult | null {
  if (!notif) return null;

  const targetType = notif.targetType;
  const targetId = notif.targetId ? String(notif.targetId).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const notifProjCode = notif.projectCode ? String(notif.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

  // 1. Locate the Project and/or Task objects
  let matchedProject: Project | null = null;
  let matchedTask: Task | null = null;

  const notifStore = notif.projectStore ? String(notif.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const notifYear = notif.projectYear ? String(notif.projectYear).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

  if (targetType === 'task') {
    matchedTask = tasksList.find((t) => t.id && String(t.id).toLowerCase() === targetId) || null;
    const taskProjCode = (matchedTask?.projectCode || notifProjCode).toLowerCase();
    const taskStore = (matchedTask?.projectStore || notifStore).toLowerCase();
    const taskYear = (matchedTask?.projectYear ? String(matchedTask.projectYear) : notifYear).toLowerCase();

    matchedProject =
      projectsList.find((p) => {
        const pStore = p.store ? String(p.store).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        if (p.id && matchedTask && (matchedTask as any).projectId === p.id) {
          if (taskStore && pStore && taskStore !== pStore) return false;
          if (taskYear && pYear && taskYear !== pYear) return false;
          return true;
        }
        const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (pCode && pCode === taskProjCode) {
          if (taskStore && pStore && taskStore !== pStore) return false;
          if (taskYear && pYear && taskYear !== pYear) return false;
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      }) || null;
  } else if (targetType === 'project') {
    matchedProject =
      projectsList.find((p) => {
        const pStore = p.store ? String(p.store).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        const idMatches = (p.id && String(p.id).toLowerCase() === targetId) || (p.no && String(p.no).toLowerCase() === targetId);

        const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const codeMatches =
          (pCode && pCode === targetId) ||
          (pCode && notifProjCode && pCode === notifProjCode) ||
          (p.linkCodes && extractAllProjectCodes(p).includes(targetId)) ||
          (p.linkCodes && notifProjCode && extractAllProjectCodes(p).includes(notifProjCode));

        if (idMatches || codeMatches) {
          if (notifStore && pStore && notifStore !== pStore) return false;
          if (notifYear && pYear && notifYear !== pYear) return false;
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      }) || null;
  } else if (targetType === 'task_delegation') {
    const delegationGroups = useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups || [];
    const matchedGroup = delegationGroups.find((g) => g.id && String(g.id).toLowerCase() === targetId) || null;
    
    const parentTaskId = matchedGroup?.parentTaskId || (matchedGroup as any)?.taskId;
    if (parentTaskId) {
      matchedTask = tasksList.find((t) => t.id && String(t.id).toLowerCase() === String(parentTaskId).toLowerCase()) || null;

          if (groupYear && pYear && String(groupYear) !== pYear) return false;

        }

        const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const codeMatches =

        if (codeMatches) {
          if (groupStore && pStore && groupStore !== pStore) return false;
          if (groupYear && pYear && String(groupYear) !== pYear) return false;

  const isTaskComment =
    notifId.startsWith('mention_') && !notifId.startsWith('mention_proj_') ||

    if ((matchedProject as any)?.unit) candidateKeys.add(String((matchedProject as any).unit).trim().toLowerCase());

  if (matchedTask?.projectCode) candidateKeys.add(String(matchedTask.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase());

  try {

            const hasUnit = unitIds.some((uid) => {

              return candidateKeys.has(strUid) || projectMatchesUnitCode(candidateArray, strUid);
            });

              const uCode = matchedProject?.code || (matchedProject as any)?.unit || notif.projectCode || unitIds[0];

                isTaskComment,
                isProjectComment,
              };
            }
          }
          const groupObj = v.groups?.find((g) => g.id === groupId);
          if (groupObj) {

            const gName = (groupObj.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            if ((gCode && candidateKeys.has(gCode)) || (gName && candidateKeys.has(gName))) {

                const uCode = matchedProject?.code || (matchedProject as any)?.unit || notif.projectCode || unitIds[0];
                return {
                  hasUnit: true,
                  store: vStore,
                  location: vLoc,
                  year: vYear,

                  project: matchedProject,
                  task: matchedTask,
                  isComment,
                  isTaskComment,
                  isProjectComment,
                };
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Check mapUnits on the version (or dynamic version payload)
      const vUnits = (v as any).mapUnits;
      if (vUnits && Array.isArray(vUnits)) {
        const foundUnit = vUnits.find(
          (u: any) =>
            (u.name && (candidateKeys.has(String(u.name).trim().toLowerCase()) || projectMatchesUnitCode(candidateArray, String(u.name)))) ||
            (u.id && (candidateKeys.has(String(u.id).trim().toLowerCase()) || projectMatchesUnitCode(candidateArray, String(u.id))))

        if (foundUnit) {

    const matchedUInfo = unitInfo.find(

        (u.name && (candidateKeys.has(String(u.name).trim().toLowerCase()) || projectMatchesUnitCode(candidateArray, String(u.name)))) ||
        (u.unitId && (candidateKeys.has(String(u.unitId).trim().toLowerCase()) || projectMatchesUnitCode(candidateArray, String(u.unitId))))
    );

    if (matchedUInfo) {

          isTaskComment,
          isProjectComment,

  }

    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(notif.projectCode) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(matchedProject?.code) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(notif.title) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName((matchedProject as any)?.unit) ||

  return {

    store: finalStore,
    location: finalLocation,
    year: targetYear,
    unitCode: String(finalCode),
    project: matchedProject,
    task: matchedTask,
    isComment,
    isTaskComment,
    isProjectComment,
  };
}

import { ComponentType, LazyExoticComponent, lazy } from 'react';

/**
 * Robust lazy loader with exponential backoff retry and chunk error handling.
 * Recovers from "Importing a module script failed" / "Failed to fetch dynamically imported module"
 * errors caused by network glitches, dev server restarts, or stale bundle hashes.
 */
export function lazyWithRetry<T extends ComponentType<any>>(
  componentImport: () => Promise<any>,
  namedExport?: string,
  retriesLeft = 3,
  interval = 400
): LazyExoticComponent<T> {
  return lazy(() => {
    return new Promise<{ default: T }>((resolve, reject) => {
      const attempt = (remaining: number, delay: number) => {
        componentImport()
          .then((module: any) => {
            if (namedExport && module[namedExport]) {
              resolve({ default: module[namedExport] });
            } else if (module.default) {
              resolve({ default: module.default });
            } else {
              const firstKey = Object.keys(module)[0];
              if (firstKey && module[firstKey]) {
                resolve({ default: module[firstKey] });
              } else {
                reject(new Error(`Module does not export component "${namedExport || 'default'}"`));
              }
            }
          })
          .catch((error: any) => {
            const errorMsg = String(error?.message || error || '');
            const isModuleScriptError =
              errorMsg.includes('Importing a module script failed') ||
              errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch dynamically imported module') ||
              errorMsg.includes('error loading dynamically imported module') ||
              errorMsg.includes('dynamically imported module') ||
              errorMsg.includes('Loading chunk') ||
              errorMsg.includes('MIME type') ||
              errorMsg.includes('not a valid JavaScript MIME type') ||
              error?.name === 'ChunkLoadError';

            if (remaining > 0 && isModuleScriptError) {
              setTimeout(() => {
                attempt(remaining - 1, delay * 1.5);
              }, delay);
            } else if (isModuleScriptError) {
              // If all retries failed and it is a chunk load error, try reloading once per session
              const reloadKey = 'chunk_reload_' + (namedExport || 'app');
              const hasReloaded = window.sessionStorage.getItem(reloadKey);
              if (!hasReloaded) {
                window.sessionStorage.setItem(reloadKey, 'true');
                window.location.reload();
                return;
              }
              window.sessionStorage.removeItem(reloadKey);
              reject(error);
            } else {
              reject(error);
            }
          });
      };

      attempt(retriesLeft, interval);
    });
  });
}


=== FILE: src/lib/loadedMarkers.ts ===
import { localDb } from './localDb';

const PREFIX = 'loaded:';
export type MarkerKind =
  | 'projects_year'
  | 'tasks_proj'
  | 'tasks_year'
  | 'costs_year'
  | 'delegations_year';

let cache: Set<string> | null = null;
let loading: Promise<Set<string>> | null = null;

export const markerKey = (kind: MarkerKind, id: string | number) =>
  `${PREFIX}${kind}:${String(id).trim().toLowerCase()}`;

export async function getLoadedMarkers(): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (cache) return cache;
  if (!loading) {
    loading = (async () => {
      try {
        const rows = await localDb.syncMeta.where('key').startsWith(PREFIX).toArray();
        cache = new Set(rows.map((r) => r.key));
      } catch {
        cache = new Set();
      }
      return cache as Set<string>;
    })();
  }
  return loading;
}

export function hasMarker(set: Set<string>, kind: MarkerKind, id: string | number): boolean {
  return set.has(markerKey(kind, id));
}

export async function markLoaded(kind: MarkerKind, id: string | number): Promise<void> {
  const key = markerKey(kind, id);
  const currentCache = await getLoadedMarkers();
  currentCache.add(key);
  try {
    await localDb.syncMeta.put({ key, value: String(Date.now()), updatedAt: Date.now() });
  } catch {}
}

export async function clearLoadedMarkers(): Promise<void> {
  cache = new Set();
  loading = null;
  try {
    await localDb.syncMeta.where('key').startsWith(PREFIX).delete();
  } catch {}
}

import Dexie, { type Table } from 'dexie';
import { Project, Task, Cost, DelegationGroup } from '../types';

export interface LocalSyncMeta {
  key: string;
  value: string;
  updatedAt: number;
}

/**
 * TakaLocalDB: IndexedDB Local-First Database bọc bởi Dexie.js
 * Cung cấp khả năng lưu trữ cục bộ có chỉ mục (indexed), truy vấn O(1) và nạp tức thì 0ms
 */
export class TakaLocalDB extends Dexie {
  projects!: Table<Project, string>;
  tasks!: Table<Task, string>;
  costs!: Table<Cost, string>;
  delegations!: Table<DelegationGroup, string>;
  syncMeta!: Table<LocalSyncMeta, string>;

  constructor() {
    super('TakaLocalFirstDB_v1');
    this.version(1).stores({
      projects: '&id, code, store, year, status, updatedAt',
      tasks: '&id, projectId, code, store, year, status, updatedAt',
      costs: '&id, projectId, code, store, year, status, updatedAt',
      delegations: '&id, projectId, code, store, year, status, updatedAt',
      syncMeta: '&key, updatedAt',
    });
    this.version(2).stores({
      projects: '&id, code, store, year, status, updatedAt',
      tasks: '&id, projectId, projectCode, code, projectStore, projectYear, store, year, status, updatedAt',
      costs: '&id, projectId, projectCode, code, projectStore, projectYear, store, year, status, updatedAt',
      delegations: '&id, projectId, projectCode, code, projectStore, projectYear, store, year, status, updatedAt',
      syncMeta: '&key, updatedAt',
    });
    this.version(3).stores({
      delegations: '&id, projectId, projectCode, parentTaskId, code, projectStore, projectYear, store, year, status, updatedAt',
    });
  }
}

const tsOf = (v: any): number => {
  if (!v) return 0;
  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Date.parse(v) : typeof v?.toMillis === 'function' ? v.toMillis() : Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
};

/**
 * Cập nhật hoặc thêm mới 1 bản ghi vào bảng tương ứng trong Local Database
 */
export async function upsertLocalRecord(
  collectionName: 'taka_projects' | 'taka_tasks' | 'taka_costs' | 'taka_delegations',
  item: any
): Promise<void> {
  if (!item?.id) return;
  try {
    const table = (() => {
      switch (collectionName) {
        case 'taka_projects': return localDb.projects;
        case 'taka_tasks': return localDb.tasks;
        case 'taka_costs': return localDb.costs;
        case 'taka_delegations': return localDb.delegations;
      }
    })();
    
    // [Safety Guard] If item is marked as deleted, remove it from local cache
    if (item?.isDeleted) {
      await table.delete(item.id);
      return;
    }

    // [Safety Guard] Only upsert if the incoming doc is newer than what we have
    const existing = await table.get(item.id);
    const existingTs = tsOf(existing?.updatedAt);
    const incomingTs = tsOf(item.updatedAt);
    if (existing && existingTs > 0 && incomingTs > 0 && existingTs > incomingTs) return;

    await table.put(item);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[localDb] upsertLocalRecord error on ${collectionName}:`, err);
  }
}

/**
 * Áp dụng field-level patch vào Local Database (Dexie)
 * Nếu bản ghi đã tồn tại: chỉ cập nhật các trường thay đổi (giữ nguyên các trường còn lại)
 * Nếu chưa tồn tại: thêm mới bản ghi
 */
export async function patchLocalRecord(
  collectionName: 'taka_projects' | 'taka_tasks' | 'taka_costs' | 'taka_delegations',
  id: string,
  patch: Record<string, any>
): Promise<void> {
  if (!id || !patch) return;
  try {
    const table = (() => {
      switch (collectionName) {
        case 'taka_projects': return localDb.projects;
        case 'taka_tasks': return localDb.tasks;
        case 'taka_costs': return localDb.costs;
        case 'taka_delegations': return localDb.delegations;
      }
    })();
    
    // Patch only existing rows. Creating a row from a partial patch produces ghost/incomplete records
    const existing = await table.get(id);
    if (!existing) return;

    // If patch marks doc as deleted, delete it from local Dexie immediately
    if (patch?.isDeleted) {
      await table.delete(id);
      return;
    }

    // Only skip if incoming patch is explicitly older than existing (both timestamps valid)
    const existingTs = tsOf(existing.updatedAt);
    const incomingTs = tsOf(patch.updatedAt);
    if (existingTs > 0 && incomingTs > 0 && existingTs > incomingTs) return;

    await (table as any).update(id, patch);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[localDb] patchLocalRecord error on ${collectionName}:`, err);
  }
}

/**
 * Xóa 1 bản ghi khỏi Local Database
 */
export async function deleteLocalRecord(
  collectionName: 'taka_projects' | 'taka_tasks' | 'taka_costs' | 'taka_delegations',
  id: string
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    switch (collectionName) {
      case 'taka_projects':
        await localDb.projects.delete(id);
        break;
      case 'taka_tasks':
        await localDb.tasks.delete(id);
        break;
      case 'taka_costs':
        await localDb.costs.delete(id);
        break;
      case 'taka_delegations':
        await localDb.delegations.delete(id);
        break;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[localDb] deleteLocalRecord error on ${collectionName}:`, err);
  }
}

/**
 * Đọc Tasks từ Local Database theo danh sách Project IDs hoặc Project Codes
 */
export async function getLocalTasksForProjects(projectIdsOrCodes: string[]): Promise<Task[]> {
  if (!projectIdsOrCodes || projectIdsOrCodes.length === 0) return [];
  try {
    const rawIds = projectIdsOrCodes.map(id => String(id).trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (rawIds.length === 0) return [];
    const [byProjId, byProjCode, byCode] = await Promise.all([
      localDb.tasks.where('projectId').anyOf(rawIds).toArray().catch(() => []),
      localDb.tasks.where('projectCode').anyOf(rawIds).toArray().catch(() => []),
      localDb.tasks.where('code').anyOf(rawIds).toArray().catch(() => []),
    ]);
    const mergedMap = new Map<string, Task>();
    for (const t of byProjId) {
      if (t && t.id && !t.isDeleted) mergedMap.set(t.id, t);
    }
    for (const t of byProjCode) {
      if (t && t.id && !t.isDeleted) mergedMap.set(t.id, t);
    }
    for (const t of byCode) {
      if (t && t.id && !t.isDeleted) mergedMap.set(t.id, t);
    }
    return Array.from(mergedMap.values());
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[localDb] getLocalTasksForProjects error:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

=== FILE: src/lib/mutationCoalescer.ts ===
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { setDoc, updateDoc } from './firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { addPendingUpdate } from './syncQueue';
import { touchYearMeta } from './yearsFingerprintService';
import { recordDelta } from './deltaSyncService';
import { markExplicitDelta, unmarkExplicitDelta } from './autoDeltaQueue';
import { isPermanentWriteError } from './syncQueue';

export interface CoalescedMutation {
  collectionPath: string; // Tên collection, vd: taka_tasks
  docId: string;
  data: Record<string, any>;
  isUpdate?: boolean;
  debounceMs?: number;
  maxWaitMs?: number;
  year?: string;
}

interface QueuedItem {
  collectionPath: string;
  docId: string;
  data: Record<string, any>;
  isUpdate: boolean;
  timer: any;
  firstQueuedAt: number;
  year?: string;
}

// Bảng lưu trữ in-memory các mutations đang chờ debounce
const mutationQueue = new Map<string, QueuedItem>();

/**
 * Thực hiện ghi document lên Firestore với cơ chế Coalescing (gom nhiều lần ghi liên tiếp trong 400-800ms thành 1)
 */
export function queueCoalescedMutation({
  collectionPath,
  docId,
  data,
  isUpdate = true,
  debounceMs = 500,
  maxWaitMs = 2000,
  year,
}: CoalescedMutation): void {
  const queueKey = `${collectionPath}/${docId}`;
  const now = Date.now();

  const existing = mutationQueue.get(queueKey);

  if (existing) {
    // 1. Gom (merge) dữ liệu mới vào dữ liệu đã có trong queue
    existing.data = {
      ...existing.data,
      ...data,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (year) existing.year = year;

    // 2. Kiểm tra maxWaitMs để không làm nghẽn quá lâu
    if (now - existing.firstQueuedAt < maxWaitMs) {
      clearTimeout(existing.timer);
      existing.timer = setTimeout(() => {
        flushQueueItem(queueKey);
      }, debounceMs);
    }
  } else {
    // Tạo item mới trong queue
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      flushQueueItem(queueKey);
    }, debounceMs);

    mutationQueue.set(queueKey, {
      collectionPath,
      docId,
      data: {
        ...data,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      isUpdate,
      timer,
      firstQueuedAt: now,
      year,
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Ghi 1 item từ queue xuống Firestore
 */
async function flushQueueItem(queueKey: string): Promise<void> {
  const item = mutationQueue.get(queueKey);
  if (!item) return;

  mutationQueue.delete(queueKey);
  clearTimeout(item.timer);

  const fullPath = `artifacts/${APP_ID}/public/data/${item.collectionPath}/${item.docId}`;
  const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', item.collectionPath, item.docId);

  const isCoreCollection = ['taka_projects', 'taka_tasks', 'taka_costs', 'taka_delegations'].includes(item.collectionPath);

  // Đánh dấu TRƯỚC khi ghi: await setDoc chờ server ack (có thể >1.5s trên iOS), nếu đánh dấu SAU
  // thì auto-delta xả trước và phát thêm 1 delta "invalidate" thừa.
  if (isCoreCollection) {
    markExplicitDelta([{ docId: item.docId, collectionName: item.collectionPath }]);
  }

  try {
    if (item.isUpdate) {
      await setDoc(docRef, item.data, { merge: true });
    } else {
      await setDoc(docRef, item.data);
    }

    // Touch year metadata if available to invalidate client cache fingerprints
    if (item.year) {
      touchYearMeta(item.year).catch(() => {});
    }

    // Record delta change log for Stage 2 Delta Sync
    if (
      ['taka_projects', 'taka_tasks', 'taka_costs', 'taka_delegations'].includes(
        item.collectionPath
      )
    ) {
      recordDelta({
        docId: item.docId,
        collectionName: item.collectionPath as any,
        action: item.isUpdate ? 'update' : 'create',
        data: item.data,
        isPatch: item.isUpdate,
        year: item.year,
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  } catch (err) {
    if (isCoreCollection) {
      unmarkExplicitDelta([{ docId: item.docId, collectionName: item.collectionPath }]);
    }
    console.error(`[mutationCoalescer] Error flushing ${queueKey}, buffering to syncQueue:`, err);
    // Server từ chối vĩnh viễn thì không xếp hàng (phát lại sau này chỉ gây ghi đè ngoài ý muốn)
    if (isPermanentWriteError(err)) return;
    // Lưu vào Offline Sync Queue chống mất dữ liệu (Rule 2 AGENTS.md)
    addPendingUpdate({
      collectionPath: `artifacts/${APP_ID}/public/data/${item.collectionPath}`,
      docId: item.docId,
      action: item.isUpdate ? 'update' : 'set',
      data: item.data,
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

/**
 * Đẩy toàn bộ các mutations còn đang chờ trước khi unmount hoặc navigate
 */
export async function flushAllCoalescedMutations(): Promise<void> {
  const keys = Array.from(mutationQueue.keys());
  await Promise.all(keys.map((key) => flushQueueItem(key)));
}

// Lắng nghe sự kiện trước khi đóng tab để flush toàn bộ
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    flushAllCoalescedMutations();
  });
}

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  getNotificationDateRange,
  filterTasksForNotificationWindow,
} from './notificationTaskService';
import { Task } from '../types';

describe('notificationTaskService (Method 1: Local-First Notification Optimization)', () => {

    const { past7, future14 } = getNotificationDateRange(refDate);
    const result = filterTasksForNotificationWindow(mockTasks, past7, future14);

    expect(result).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(result.map((t) => t.id)).toEqual(['task-overdue-recent', 'task-due-soon']);
  });

  it('sorts matched tasks ascending by finish date', () => {
    const { past7, future14 } = getNotificationDateRange(refDate);
    const result = filterTasksForNotificationWindow(mockTasks, past7, future14);

    expect(result[0].finish).toBe('2026-10-12');
    expect(result[1].finish).toBe('2026-10-20');
  });

  it('limits result count if maxCount is specified', () => {
    const { past7, future14 } = getNotificationDateRange(refDate);
    const result = filterTasksForNotificationWindow(mockTasks, past7, future14, 1);

    expect(result).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result[0].id).toBe('task-overdue-recent');
  });

  it('returns empty array when input is empty or null', () => {
    const { past7, future14 } = getNotificationDateRange(refDate);
    expect(filterTasksForNotificationWindow([], past7, future14)).toEqual([]);
    expect(filterTasksForNotificationWindow(null as any, past7, future14)).toEqual([]);
  });
});


=== FILE: src/lib/notificationTaskService.ts ===
import { collection, query, where, limit, getDocsFromCache, getDocsFromServer } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { getLocalTasks, bulkPersistTasks } from './localDb';
import { usePerformanceStore } from '../store/usePerformanceStore';
import { Task } from '../types';

/**
 * Returns the standard notification date window:
 * - Past 7 days (to detect overdue/recent tasks)
 * - Future 14 days (to detect upcoming deadlines)
 */
export function getNotificationDateRange(referenceDate: Date = new Date()): { past7: string; future14: string } {
  const past7 = new Date(referenceDate.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  const future14 = new Date(referenceDate.getTime() + 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  return { past7, future14 };
}

/**
 * Filters a list of tasks for deadline notifications within the target window.
 */
export function filterTasksForNotificationWindow(
  tasks: Task[],
  past7: string,
  future14: string,
  maxCount: number = 50
): Task[] {
  if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0) return [];

  const matched = tasks.filter((t) => {
    if (t.isDeleted) return false;
    if (!t.finish) return false;
    const finishDate = t.finish.substring(0, 10);
    return finishDate >= past7 && finishDate <= future14;
  });

  matched.sort((a, b) => (a.finish || '').localeCompare(b.finish || ''));
  return matched.slice(0, maxCount);
}

/**
 * Loads tasks for notification bell / deadline monitoring.
 *
 * Tối ưu hóa Firestore Read (Phương pháp 1):
 * - Ưu tiên 1 (Cache-First): Đọc 100% từ Dexie Local-First DB (0ms, 0 Firestore Read).
 * - Ưu tiên 2 (Cold-Boot Fallback): Chỉ khi Dexie hoàn toàn rỗng (lần đầu vào app trên máy mới/Incognito),
 *   mới kích hoạt truy vấn 50 tasks từ Firestore, sau đó lưu ngay vào Dexie để lần sau tiếp tục đạt 0 Read.
 */
export async function loadNotificationTasks(options?: {
  referenceDate?: Date;
  maxCount?: number;
  skipFirestoreFallback?: boolean;
}): Promise<Task[]> {
  const { past7, future14 } = getNotificationDateRange(options?.referenceDate);
  const maxCount = options?.maxCount || 50;

  try {
    // 1. Kiểm tra dữ liệu trong Dexie Local DB trước (0 Read Firestore)
    const localTasks = await getLocalTasks();

    if (localTasks && localTasks.length > 0) {
      const filtered = filterTasksForNotificationWindow(localTasks, past7, future14, maxCount);

      usePerformanceStore
        .getState()
        .trackGetDoc(
          'dexie_notif_tasks',
          true,
          filtered.length,
          `Notification tasks from Dexie Local DB (0 Firestore Read, pool: ${localTasks.length})`
        );

      return filtered;
    }

    // 2. Fallback: Nếu Dexie hoàn toàn rỗng (Cold Boot / Incognito) và chưa bị vô hiệu hóa
    if (options?.skipFirestoreFallback) {
      return [];
    }

    const qNotifTasks = query(
      collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks'),
      where('finish', '>=', past7),
      where('finish', '<=', future14),
      limit(maxCount)
    );

    let snapshot;
    try {
      snapshot = await getDocsFromCache(qNotifTasks);
      if (snapshot.empty) {
        snapshot = await getDocsFromServer(qNotifTasks);
      }
    } catch {
      snapshot = await getDocsFromServer(qNotifTasks);
    }

    const loadedNotifTasks: Task[] = [];
    snapshot.forEach((docSnap) => {
      const data = { id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() } as Task;
      if (!data.isDeleted) {
        loadedNotifTasks.push(data);
      }
    });

    // Lưu vào Dexie để các lần kiểm tra tiếp theo không phải đọc Firestore nữa
    if (loadedNotifTasks.length > 0) {
      bulkPersistTasks(loadedNotifTasks).catch((e) => {
        console.warn('[notificationTaskService] Error caching notif tasks to Dexie:', e);
      });
    }

    usePerformanceStore
      .getState()
      .trackGetDoc(
        'firestore_notif_tasks_fallback',
        false,
        loadedNotifTasks.length,
        'Cold-boot notification tasks loaded from Firestore and cached to Dexie'
      );

    return loadedNotifTasks;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[notificationTaskService] Failed to load notification tasks:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

import { setDoc } from "../lib/firebase";
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { getToken } from 'firebase/messaging';
import { messaging, db, APP_ID } from './firebase';

export const testLocalNotification = async () => {
  try {
    if (!('Notification' in window)) {
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "This browser does not support notifications. Please use Safari on iOS 16.4+ or Chrome/Edge." });
      return;
    }

    const isStandalone = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || (window.navigator as any).standalone;
    if (!isStandalone && /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: 'To receive notifications on iOS/iPadOS:\n1. Tap the Share button in Safari\n2. Select "Add to Home Screen"\n3. Open the app from the Home Screen' });
      return;
    }

    const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
    if (permission === 'granted') {
      if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
        const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
        await registration.showNotification('Test Notification', {
          body: 'This is a test notification from the PWA.',
          icon: '/manifest-icon-192.maskable.png'
        });
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Sent test notification request via Service Worker. Please check your notification center." });
      } else {
        new Notification('Test Notification', {
          body: 'This is a test notification from the browser.',
          icon: '/manifest-icon-192.maskable.png'
        });
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Sent test notification request via Browser. Please check your notification center." });
      }
    } else {
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Notification permission not granted. Please check browser/device settings." });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error showing local notification:', error);
    useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: 'Cannot display notification: ' + (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)) });
  }
};

export const requestNotificationPermission = async (userId: string, silent = false) => {
  try {
    console.log('Requesting notification permission...');
    
    // Check if notifications are supported
    if (!('Notification' in window)) {
      if (!silent) useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "This browser does not support notifications. Please use Safari on iOS 16.4+ or Chrome/Edge." });
      return;
    }

    // Check if in standalone mode (iOS requirement)
    const isStandalone = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || (window.navigator as any).standalone;
    if (!isStandalone && /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
      if (!silent) useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: 'To receive notifications on iPad/iPhone:\n1. Tap the Share button in Safari\n2. Select "Add to Home Screen"\n3. Open the app from the Home Screen' });
      return;
    }

    const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
    
    if (permission === 'granted') {
      console.log('Notification permission granted.');
      const msg = await messaging();
      if (msg) {
        // Ensure Service Worker is registered and ready
        if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) {
          if (!silent) useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Service Worker is not supported on this browser." });
          return;
        }

        const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
        console.log('Service Worker ready:', registration);

        const token = await getToken(msg, {
          vapidKey: 'BJD0gr0az3BCgcGFFymvboFJY8Ra3CzHNzb-NSwzLbDGrqgCHCfjTEwbnT7uqJVCUM0ocQi1fvziz13IZCPWJzU',
          serviceWorkerRegistration: registration
        });
        
        console.log('FCM Token:', token);
        
        // Save token to user document
        if (userId && userId !== 'guest') {
          setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_users', userId), {
            fcmToken: token,
            fcmTokenUpdatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            lastPlatform: navigator.platform,
            isStandalone: !!isStandalone
          }, { merge: true });
        }
        
        return token;
      } else {
        if (!silent) useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: "Failed to initialize Firebase Messaging." });
      }
    } else {
      console.log('Unable to get permission to notify.');
      if (!silent) useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Notification permission was denied. Please enable it in Settings -> Notifications -> Taka PM." });
    }
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Error requesting notification permission:', error);
    let errorMsg = 'Notification activation error: ';
    
    if (error?.code === 'messaging/permission-blocked') {
      errorMsg += 'Notification permission is blocked.';
    } else if (error?.code === 'messaging/failed-serviceworker-registration') {
      errorMsg += 'Service Worker registration failed. Try removing the app from Home Screen and adding it again.';
    } else {
      errorMsg += error?.message || 'Unknown error.';
    }
    
    if (!silent) useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: String(errorMsg + '\n\nPlease ensure you are using HTTPS and have added the app to your Home Screen.') });
  }
};

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { buildTaskNoMap, parsePredecessors, calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors } from './ganttUtils';
import { Project, Task } from '../types';

describe('Cross-Project Predecessor Resolution & Date Calculation', () => {
  const projects: Project[] = [
    {
      id: 'p1',
      code: 'HN-TKV-SMZ2',
      name: 'Shimazu Project 2',
      year: 2026,
      store: 'HN'
    } as Project,
    {
      id: 'p2',
      code: 'HN-TKV-IT',
      name: 'IT Project',
      year: 2026,
      store: 'HN'
    } as Project
  ];

  const tasks: Task[] = [
    {
      id: 'task-smz2-85',
      projectCode: 'HN-TKV-SMZ2',
      projectYear: 2026,
      projectStore: 'HN',
      name: 'Khai trương gian hàng',
      orderIndex: 84, // 85th task (index + 1 = 85)
      taskCodePhu: '5.1.1.1.9',
      start: '2026-09-25T22:00:00',
      finish: '2026-09-26T06:00:00',
      duration: '1'
    } as Task,
    {
      id: 'task-it-2',
      projectCode: 'HN-TKV-IT',
      projectYear: 2026,
      projectStore: 'HN',
      name: 'Setup IT Store',
      orderIndex: 1,
      start: '2026-09-30T21:00:00',
      finish: '2026-10-01T21:00:00',
      duration: '1'
    } as Task
  ];

  it('buildTaskNoMap indexes both taskCodePhu and project-sequential codes', () => {
    const map = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
    expect(map.has('5.1.1.1.9')).toBe(true);
    expect(map.has('hn-tkv-smz2-85')).toBe(true);
    expect(map.get('hn-tkv-smz2-85')?.[0]?.id).toBe('task-smz2-85');
  });

  it('parsePredecessors correctly identifies external project task with SS relationship', () => {
    const map = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
    const contextTask = tasks[1]; // task-it-2
    const parsed = parsePredecessors('HN-TKV-SMZ2-85SS', map, contextTask);

    expect(parsed).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(parsed[0].type).toBe('SS');
    expect(parsed[0].task).toBeDefined();
    expect(parsed[0].task?.id).toBe('task-smz2-85');
  });

  it('calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors recalculates start and finish based on external predecessor with SS', () => {
    const map = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
    const currentTask = { ...tasks[1], duration: '1' };
    const parsed = parsePredecessors('HN-TKV-SMZ2-85SS', map, currentTask);

    const result = calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors(currentTask, parsed);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    // For SS without lag, start should match predecessor start formatted
    expect(result?.start).toBe('2026-09-25T22:00');
    // For SS with duration 1 day, finish should be start + 1 day
    expect(result?.finish).toBe('2026-09-26T22:00');
    expect(result?.duration).toBe('1');
  });

  it('calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors handles FS with positive lag', () => {
    const map = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
    const currentTask = { ...tasks[1], duration: '2' };
    const parsed = parsePredecessors('HN-TKV-SMZ2-85FS+1', map, currentTask);

    const result = calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors(currentTask, parsed);
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    // For FS+1, start = finish of pred ('2026-09-26T06:00:00') + 1 day = '2026-09-27T06:00'
    expect(result?.start).toBe('2026-09-27T06:00');
    // duration 2 days => finish = '2026-09-29T06:00'
    expect(result?.finish).toBe('2026-09-29T06:00');
    expect(result?.duration).toBe('2');
  });
});

      const diffLocMatch = ranked.find(r => r.task.id === 't_diff_loc');

      expect(sameMatch?.isExternal).toBe(false);
      expect(diffLocMatch?.isExternal).toBe(true);
      expect(diffLocMatch?.diffDetails?.diffFactors).toContain('location');
    });
  });
});

import { Task, Project } from '../types';
import { computeTaskCode, splitPredecessors } from './ganttUtils';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';

/**
 * Extracts a trailing task number from a code or query string.
 * Examples:
 * - "B2-B208-2" -> 2
 * - "CP-01-05" -> 5
 * - "2" -> 2
 * - "-2" -> 2
 * - "#2" -> 2
 * - "smz2-85" -> 85
 * - "Handover" -> null
 */
export function extractTrailingTaskNumber(str: string): number | null {
  if (!str) return null;
  const m = str.trim().match(/(?:^|[-_#\s])0*(\d+)\s*$/);
  if (m) {
    return parseInt(m[1], 10);
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Bigram / Sorensen-Dice string similarity calculation (0 to 1).
 * Highly efficient O(N + M) implementation resilient to typos, transposed chars, and omitted characters.
 */
export function stringSimilarity(str1: string, str2: string): number {
  if (!str1 || !str2) return 0;
  const s1 = str1.trim().toLowerCase();
  const s2 = str2.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (s1 === s2) return 1;
  
  if (s1.length < 2 || s2.length < 2) {
    return (s1.includes(s2) || s2.includes(s1)) ? 0.75 : 0;
  }
  
  const bigrams1 = new Map<string, number>();
  for (let i = 0; i < s1.length - 1; i++) {
    const bg = s1.substring(i, i + 2);
    bigrams1.set(bg, (bigrams1.get(bg) || 0) + 1);
  }
  
  let intersection = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < s2.length - 1; i++) {
    const bg = s2.substring(i, i + 2);
    const count = bigrams1.get(bg) || 0;
    if (count > 0) {
      bigrams1.set(bg, count - 1);
      intersection++;
    }
  }
  
  const totalBigrams = (s1.length - 1) + (s2.length - 1);
  return (2 * intersection) / totalBigrams;
}

/**
 * Regex for predecessor relationship and lag suffix:
 * Matches trailing combinations like:
 * - FF, SS, SF, FS (e.g. "SS", "FF+2", "SF-1")
 * - Explicit plus lag: +1, +0.5, +2d
 * - Explicit space-separated minus lag: " - 2", " - 1d" (distinguishes from code hyphens like "SMZ2-85")
 */
const REL_LAG_REGEX = /(?:\s*(FS|SS|FF|SF)\s*(?:[+-]\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?|\s*\+\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:d)?|\s+-\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:d)?)$/i;

/**
 * Parses a single predecessor token into query (the task code/name search part)
 * and suffix (the relationship and lag part, e.g. "SS", "FF", "+1", "FF+2").
 */
export function parsePredecessorToken(token: string): { query: string; suffix: string } {
  if (!token) return { query: '', suffix: '' };
  const trimmed = token.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return { query: '', suffix: '' };

  const match = trimmed.match(REL_LAG_REGEX);
  if (match && match.index !== undefined && match.index > 0) {
    const query = trimmed.substring(0, match.index).trim();
    const suffix = match[0].trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
    return { query, suffix };
  }

  return { query: trimmed, suffix: '' };
}

export interface PredecessorContext {
  projectId?: string;
  projectCode?: string;
  projectYear?: number | string;
  projectStore?: string;
  projectLocation?: string;
  location?: string;
}

export interface ProjectDiffDetails {
  isDifferent: boolean;
  diffFactors: ('year' | 'store' | 'location' | 'code' | 'id')[];
  reasons: string[];
  contextInfo: {
    projectId?: string;
    code?: string;
    year?: string;
    store?: string;
    location?: string;
  };
  taskInfo: {
    projectId?: string;
    code?: string;
    year?: string;
    store?: string;
    location?: string;
  };
}

export function resolveProjectContext(
  context: PredecessorContext | undefined,
  projects: Project[]
): {
  projectId: string;
  code: string;
  year: string;
  store: string;
  location: string;
} {
  const ctxProjId = (context?.projectId || '').trim();
  let ctxCode = (context?.projectCode || '').trim();
  let ctxYear = context?.projectYear !== undefined && context?.projectYear !== null ? String(context.projectYear).trim() : '';
  let ctxStore = (context?.projectStore || '').trim();
  let ctxLoc = (context?.projectLocation || context?.location || '').trim();

  if ((!ctxYear || !ctxStore || !ctxLoc || !ctxCode) && (ctxProjId || ctxCode)) {
    const parent = projects.find(p => (ctxProjId && p.id === ctxProjId) || (ctxCode && p.code && p.code.trim().toLowerCase() === ctxCode.toLowerCase()));
    if (parent) {
      if (!ctxCode && parent.code) ctxCode = parent.code;
      if (!ctxYear && parent.year) ctxYear = String(parent.year);
      if (!ctxStore && parent.store) ctxStore = parent.store;
      if (!ctxLoc && parent.location) ctxLoc = parent.location;
    }
  }

  return {
    projectId: ctxProjId,
    code: ctxCode,
    year: ctxYear,
    store: ctxStore,
    location: ctxLoc
  };
}

export function resolveTaskProjectContext(
  task: Task,
  projects: Project[]
): {
  projectId: string;
  code: string;
  year: string;
  store: string;
  location: string;
} {
  const taskProjId = (task.projectId || '').trim();
  let taskCode = (task.projectCode || '').trim();
  let taskYear = task.projectYear !== undefined && task.projectYear !== null ? String(task.projectYear).trim() : '';
  let taskStore = (task.projectStore || '').trim();
  let taskLoc = (task.location || (task as any).projectLocation || '').trim();

  if ((!taskYear || !taskStore || !taskLoc || !taskCode) && (taskProjId || taskCode)) {
    const parent = projects.find(p => (taskProjId && p.id === taskProjId) || (taskCode && p.code && p.code.trim().toLowerCase() === taskCode.toLowerCase()));
    if (parent) {
      if (!taskCode && parent.code) taskCode = parent.code;
      if (!taskYear && parent.year) taskYear = String(parent.year);
      if (!taskStore && parent.store) taskStore = parent.store;
      if (!taskLoc && parent.location) taskLoc = parent.location;
    }
  }

  return {
    projectId: taskProjId,
    code: taskCode,
    year: taskYear,
    store: taskStore,
    location: taskLoc
  };
}

/**
 * Checks whether a candidate task differs from the current context in:
 * - year
 * - store
 * - location
 * - projectCode
 * - projectId
 * Returns detailed diff factors and human-readable explanation reasons.
 */
export function getTaskProjectDiffDetails(
  context: PredecessorContext | undefined,
  task: Task | undefined,
  projects: Project[]
): ProjectDiffDetails {
  if (!task) {
    return {
      isDifferent: false,
      diffFactors: [],
      reasons: [],
      contextInfo: {},
      taskInfo: {}
    };
  }

  const ctx = resolveProjectContext(context, projects);
  const tInfo = resolveTaskProjectContext(task, projects);

  const diffFactors: ('year' | 'store' | 'location' | 'code' | 'id')[] = [];
  const reasons: string[] = [];

  // 1. Year check (Khác Năm)
  if (ctx.year && tInfo.year && ctx.year.toLowerCase() !== tInfo.year.toLowerCase()) {
    diffFactors.push('year');
    reasons.push(`Năm: ${tInfo.year} (hiện tại: ${ctx.year})`);
  }

  // 2. Store check (Khác Chi nhánh: HCM vs HN)
  if (ctx.store && tInfo.store && ctx.store.toLowerCase() !== tInfo.store.toLowerCase()) {
    diffFactors.push('store');
    reasons.push(`Chi nhánh: ${tInfo.store} (hiện tại: ${ctx.store})`);
  }

  // 3. Location check (Khác Tầng / Khu vực: B2 vs 1F)
  if (ctx.location && tInfo.location && ctx.location.toLowerCase() !== tInfo.location.toLowerCase()) {
    diffFactors.push('location');
    reasons.push(`Vị trí/Tầng: ${tInfo.location} (hiện tại: ${ctx.location})`);
  }

  // 4. Project code check (Khác Mã dự án)
  if (ctx.code && tInfo.code && ctx.code.toLowerCase() !== tInfo.code.toLowerCase()) {
    diffFactors.push('code');
    reasons.push(`Mã dự án: ${tInfo.code} (hiện tại: ${ctx.code})`);
  }

  // 5. Project ID check
  if (ctx.projectId && tInfo.projectId && ctx.projectId !== tInfo.projectId) {
    if (!diffFactors.includes('code')) {
      diffFactors.push('id');
    }
  }

  return {
    isDifferent: diffFactors.length > 0,
    diffFactors,
    reasons,
    contextInfo: ctx,
    taskInfo: tInfo
  };
}

export function isTaskDifferentProject(
  context: PredecessorContext | undefined,
  task: Task | undefined,
  projects: Project[]
): boolean {
  return getTaskProjectDiffDetails(context, task, projects).isDifferent;
}

/**
 * Finds a task by full code, secondary code, id or closest match query.
 */
export function findTaskByQueryOrCode(
  tokenOrCode: string,
  tasks: Task[],
  projects: Project[],
  context?: PredecessorContext
): Task | null {
  if (!tokenOrCode) return null;
  const { query } = parsePredecessorToken(tokenOrCode);
  if (!query) return null;

  const qLower = query.toLowerCase();

  for (const t of tasks) {
    if (t.id && t.id.toLowerCase() === qLower) return t;
    if (t.taskCodePhu && t.taskCodePhu.trim().toLowerCase() === qLower) return t;
    const code = computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, t);
    if (code && code.toLowerCase() === qLower) return t;
  }

  const match = findClosestTaskMatch(query, tasks, projects, tasks, context?.projectCode, 650, context, tokenOrCode);
  return match?.task || null;
}

/**
 * Calculates a match score for a task against a search query.
 * Higher score = closer match.
 * Strongly prioritizes tasks belonging to the exact same parent project (same year, location, store, project code).
 */
export function scoreTaskPredecessorMatch(
  task: Task,
  rawQuery: string,
  projects: Project[],
  allTasks: Task[],
  currentProjectCode?: string,
  context?: PredecessorContext
): number {
  if (!rawQuery || !task) return 0;
  const q = rawQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return 0;

  const fullCode = (computeTaskCode(projects, allTasks, task) || task.taskCodePhu || task.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const codePhu = (task.taskCodePhu || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const name = (task.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const taskPCode = (task.projectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const currentPCode = (context?.projectCode || currentProjectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  // Resolve contexts
  const ctx = resolveProjectContext(context, projects);
  const tInfo = resolveTaskProjectContext(task, projects);

  const contextYear = ctx.year.toLowerCase();
  const contextStore = ctx.store.toLowerCase();
  const contextLocation = ctx.location.toLowerCase();
  const contextProjectId = ctx.projectId;

  const taskYear = tInfo.year.toLowerCase();
  const taskStore = tInfo.store.toLowerCase();
  const taskLocation = tInfo.location.toLowerCase();
  const taskProjectId = tInfo.projectId;

  const isSameCode = Boolean(taskPCode && currentPCode && taskPCode === currentPCode);
  const isSameProjectId = Boolean(contextProjectId && taskProjectId && contextProjectId === taskProjectId);
  const isSameYear = Boolean(contextYear && taskYear && contextYear === taskYear);
  const isDiffYear = Boolean(contextYear && taskYear && contextYear !== taskYear);
  const isSameStore = Boolean(contextStore && taskStore && contextStore === taskStore);
  const isDiffStore = Boolean(contextStore && taskStore && contextStore !== taskStore);
  const isSameLocation = Boolean(contextLocation && taskLocation && contextLocation === taskLocation);
  const isDiffLocation = Boolean(contextLocation && taskLocation && contextLocation !== taskLocation);

  const isExactSameParentProject = isSameProjectId || (isSameCode && !isDiffYear && !isDiffStore && !isDiffLocation);

  const qAlphaNum = q.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
  const fullCodeAlphaNum = fullCode.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
  const codePhuAlphaNum = codePhu.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
  const pCodeAlphaNum = taskPCode.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');

  // Numerical Conflict Guard:
  // If the search query explicitly contains a task number (e.g. "-2" in "B2-B208-2" or standalone "2" / "#2"),
  // and the candidate task has a different number (e.g. "-1" or "-3"),
  // they are FUNDAMENTALLY DIFFERENT tasks. They must NEVER match!
  const qTaskNum = extractTrailingTaskNumber(q);
  const candidateTaskNum = extractTrailingTaskNumber(fullCode) ?? extractTrailingTaskNumber(codePhu) ?? (task.orderIndex !== undefined ? task.orderIndex + 1 : null);
  if (qTaskNum !== null && candidateTaskNum !== null && qTaskNum !== candidateTaskNum) {
    return 0;
  }

  let baseScore = 0;

  // 1. Exact match on full code or code phu
  if (fullCode === q || codePhu === q) {
    baseScore = 1000;
  } else if (qAlphaNum && (fullCodeAlphaNum === qAlphaNum || codePhuAlphaNum === qAlphaNum)) {
    // 2. Alphanumeric exact match (ignoring dashes/dots/spaces)
    baseScore = 950;
  } else {
    // 3. User typed only digits or #digits (e.g. "85", "2", "#2", "-2")
    const digitMatch = q.match(/^[-#\s]*(\d+)$/);
    if (digitMatch) {
      const num = parseInt(digitMatch[1], 10);
      const codeNumMatch = fullCode.match(/[-#]0*(\d+)$/);
      const isNumMatch = (codeNumMatch && parseInt(codeNumMatch[1], 10) === num) ||
                         (task.orderIndex !== undefined && (task.orderIndex + 1) === num);

      if (isNumMatch) {
        if (isExactSameParentProject) {
          baseScore = 920;
        } else if (isSameCode) {
          baseScore = 860;
        } else {
          // Cross-project match for task number (in-scope projects will heavily outscore this via contextual weighting)
          baseScore = 760;
        }
      }
    } else if (fullCode.endsWith(q) || (codePhu && codePhu.endsWith(q))) {
      // 4. Code ends with query
      baseScore = 850;
    } else if (qAlphaNum.length >= 2 && fullCodeAlphaNum.endsWith(qAlphaNum)) {
      baseScore = 820;
    } else if (fullCode.startsWith(q) || (codePhu && codePhu.startsWith(q))) {
      // 5. Code starts with query
      baseScore = 800;
    } else if (qAlphaNum.length >= 2 && fullCodeAlphaNum.startsWith(qAlphaNum)) {
      baseScore = 780;
    } else if (fullCode.includes(q) || (codePhu && codePhu.includes(q))) {
      // 6. Code contains query
      baseScore = 750;
    } else if (qAlphaNum.length >= 2 && fullCodeAlphaNum.includes(qAlphaNum)) {
      baseScore = 720;
    } else {
      // 7. Project Code contains part of query and query contains task number
      const qParts = q.split(/[-_#\s]+/).filter(Boolean);
      if (qParts.length >= 2) {
        const candidatePCodePart = qParts.slice(0, -1).join('');
        const candidateNumPart = qParts[qParts.length - 1];
        if (pCodeAlphaNum.includes(candidatePCodePart.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')) && fullCode.endsWith(candidateNumPart)) {
          baseScore = 880;
        }
      }

      // 8. Task Name matching
      if (!baseScore) {
        if (name === q) {
          baseScore = 820;
        } else if (name.startsWith(q)) {
          baseScore = 760;
        } else if (name.includes(q)) {
          baseScore = 680;
        }
      }

      // 9. Fuzzy string similarity
      if (!baseScore && qAlphaNum.length >= 2) {
        const simFull = stringSimilarity(qAlphaNum, fullCodeAlphaNum);
        const simPhu = codePhuAlphaNum ? stringSimilarity(qAlphaNum, codePhuAlphaNum) : 0;
        const maxSim = Math.max(simFull, simPhu);
        if (maxSim >= 0.5) {
          baseScore = 500 + Math.round(maxSim * 250);
        } else if (q.length >= 4) {
          const simName = stringSimilarity(q, name);
          if (simName >= 0.6) {
            baseScore = 450 + Math.round(simName * 200);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (baseScore === 0) return 0;

  // Contextual priority weighting:
  // "nếu trong cùng task mẹ thì ưu tiên cùng year, cùng location, cùng project code"
  let score = baseScore;

  if (isExactSameParentProject) {
    score += 600;
    if (isSameLocation) score += 50;
  } else if (isSameCode) {
    if (isDiffYear) score -= 400;
    if (isDiffStore) score -= 200;
    if (isDiffLocation) score -= 100;
    if (isSameYear) score += 150;
    if (isSameStore) score += 80;
    if (isSameLocation) score += 40;
  } else {
    // Cross-project match:
    if (isSameYear) score += 150;
    if (isDiffYear) score -= 300;
    if (isSameStore) score += 80;
    if (isDiffStore) score -= 150;
    if (isSameLocation) score += 40;
  }

  return Math.max(1, score);
}

export interface RankedPredecessorMatch {
  task: Task;
  score: number;
  exactTaskCode: string;
  isExternal: boolean;
  diffDetails?: ProjectDiffDetails;
}

/**
 * Ranks all candidate tasks according to their match score for a given query.
 * Sorted descending by score.
 */
export function rankCandidateTasks(
  query: string,
  candidateTasks: Task[],
  projects: Project[],
  allTasks: Task[],
  currentProjectCode?: string,
  context?: PredecessorContext
): RankedPredecessorMatch[] {
  const effectiveContext: PredecessorContext = context || { projectCode: currentProjectCode };

  if (!query || !query.trim()) {
    return candidateTasks.map(t => {
      const diff = getTaskProjectDiffDetails(effectiveContext, t, projects);
      return {
        task: t,
        score: 0,
        exactTaskCode: computeTaskCode(projects, allTasks, t) || t.taskCodePhu || t.id,
        isExternal: diff.isDifferent,
        diffDetails: diff
      };
    });
  }

  const results: RankedPredecessorMatch[] = [];

  for (const t of candidateTasks) {
    const score = scoreTaskPredecessorMatch(t, query, projects, allTasks, currentProjectCode, effectiveContext);
    if (score > 0) {
      const exactCode = computeTaskCode(projects, allTasks, t) || t.taskCodePhu || t.id;
      const diff = getTaskProjectDiffDetails(effectiveContext, t, projects);
      results.push({
        task: t,
        score,
        exactTaskCode: exactCode,
        isExternal: diff.isDifferent,
        diffDetails: diff
      });
    }
  }

  results.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return results;
}

/**
 * Finds the single closest matching task for a given query string.
 * Returns null if no candidate reaches the threshold score.
 */
export function findClosestTaskMatch(
  query: string,
  candidateTasks: Task[],
  projects: Project[],
  allTasks: Task[],
  currentProjectCode?: string,
  minThreshold: number = 750,
  context?: PredecessorContext,
  predecessorTaskId?: string
): RankedPredecessorMatch | null {
  if (predecessorTaskId) {
    const exact = candidateTasks.find(t => t.id === predecessorTaskId);
    if (exact && !exact.isDeleted) {
      const diff = getTaskProjectDiffDetails(context, exact, projects);
      return {
        task: exact,
        score: 1000000, // Absolute priority for hard-linked ID
        exactTaskCode: computeTaskCode(projects, allTasks, exact) || exact.taskCodePhu || exact.id,
        isExternal: diff.isDifferent,
        diffDetails: diff
      };
    }
  }

  const ranked = rankCandidateTasks(query, candidateTasks, projects, allTasks, currentProjectCode, context);
  if (ranked.length > 0 && ranked[0].score >= minThreshold) {
    return ranked[0];
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Automatically resolves a raw predecessor string (e.g. "smz2-85, 2FF" or "85")
 * by finding the closest matching task codes and replacing the query part with
 * the exact task codes, preserving all relationships and lags.
 * If the user enters an explicit code with no high-confidence match (e.g. "B2-B208-2"),
 * the user's input is strictly preserved and NEVER forced to a different task number.
 */
export function resolvePredecessorString(
  rawValue: string,
  tasks: Task[],
  projects: Project[],
  currentProjectCode?: string,
  context?: PredecessorContext,
  predecessorTaskIds?: string[]
): string {
  if (!rawValue || typeof rawValue !== 'string') return '';
  const trimmed = rawValue.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';

  // Pool all available tasks including those in global store to ensure complete visibility across filters
  const storeTasks = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (useAppStore.getState?.()?.tasks || []) : [];
  const taskMap = new Map<string, Task>();
  (storeTasks || []).forEach(t => { if (t && t.id) taskMap.set(t.id, t); });
  (tasks || []).forEach(t => { if (t && t.id) taskMap.set(t.id, t); });
  const poolTasks = taskMap.size > 0 ? Array.from(taskMap.values()) : tasks;

  const knownCodes = new Set<string>();
  poolTasks.forEach(t => {
    if (t.taskCodePhu) knownCodes.add(t.taskCodePhu.trim().toLowerCase());
    const c = computeTaskCode(projects, poolTasks, t);
    if (c) knownCodes.add(c.trim().toLowerCase());
  });

  const parts = splitPredecessors(trimmed, knownCodes);
  if (parts.length === 0) return trimmed;

  const resolvedParts = parts.slice(0, 2).map((part, index) => {
    const { query, suffix } = parsePredecessorToken(part);
    if (!query) return part;

    // Check if query is already an exact known code
    const isAlreadyExact = knownCodes.has(query.toLowerCase());
    if (isAlreadyExact) {
      return query + suffix;
    }

    // Find the closest matching task with threshold (650+)
    const match = findClosestTaskMatch(
      query, 
      poolTasks, 
      projects, 
      poolTasks, 
      currentProjectCode, 
      650, 
      context, 
      predecessorTaskIds && predecessorTaskIds[index] ? predecessorTaskIds[index] : undefined
    );
    if (match) {
      let finalSuffix = suffix;
      // If it's the second predecessor and has no relationship, default to FF per Gantt rules
      if (index === 1 && !/FF|SF/i.test(finalSuffix)) {
        if (/SS|FS/i.test(finalSuffix)) {
          finalSuffix = finalSuffix.replace(/SS|FS/ig, 'FF');
        } else {
          finalSuffix = 'FF' + finalSuffix;
        }
      }
      return match.exactTaskCode + finalSuffix;
    }

    // Preserve the user's typed input if no high-confidence match is found
    return part;
  });

  return resolvedParts.join(', ');
}

    }

    expect(calculated).not.toBeNull();
    // Start should be driven by t1 (FS) finish: 2027-04-02T21:00
    // Finish should be driven by t3 (FF) finish: 2027-04-06T21:00
    expect(calculated?.start).toBe('2027-04-02T21:00');
    expect(calculated?.finish).toBe('2027-04-06T21:00');
  });
});
