import type { jsPDF } from "jspdf";
import { AppUser, TabId } from "../types";
import { getEffectiveStoreFilter } from "./utils";
import { safeGetItemSession, safeGetItemLocal } from "./storage";

export interface PrintFilterContext {
  storeRaw: string;
  storeDisplay: string;
  yearRaw: string;
  yearDisplay: string;
  projectCodeRaw: string;
  projectCodeDisplay: string;
  tabTitle: string;
  activeTab: string;
  dateStr: string;
  summaryText: string;
}

export const getTabDisplayTitle = (tab: string): string => {
  switch (tab) {
    case "gantt":
      return "Gantt Progress Schedule";
    case "detail":
      return "Detailed Tasks";
    case "general":
      return "Project Portfolio";
    case "budget":
      return "Budget Master Report";
    case "cost":
      return "Cost & Disbursement";
    case "summary":
      return "Executive Summary";
    case "layout":
      return "Store Layout Plan";
    case "calendar":
      return "Project Calendar";
    case "taskDelegation":
      return "Task Delegation Matrix";
    case "taskDelegationCalendar":
      return "Delegation Calendar";
    case "notification":
      return "Notification Center";
    case "notificationRule":
      return "Notification Rules";
    case "accControl":
      return "Access Control Matrix";
    case "setting":
      return "System Settings";
    default:
      return tab ? tab.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + tab.slice(1) : "Report";
  }
};

export const getPrintFilterContext = (params: {
  activeTab: string;
  globalStoreFilter: string;
  globalYearFilter: string;
  currentUser?: AppUser | null;
  detailTabFilterCode?: string;
  costTabFilterCode?: string;
  layoutTabFilters?: { projectCode?: string } | null;
  ganttSearchTerm?: string;
  fallbackProjectCode?: string;
}): PrintFilterContext => {
  const {
    activeTab,
    globalStoreFilter,
    globalYearFilter,
    currentUser,
    detailTabFilterCode,
    costTabFilterCode,
    layoutTabFilters,
    ganttSearchTerm,
    fallbackProjectCode,
  } = params;

  // 1. Store
  const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
  let storeDisplay = "All Stores";
  const normStore = String(effectiveStore || "all").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (normStore === "hcm") {
    storeDisplay = "HCM";
  } else if (normStore === "hn") {
    storeDisplay = "HN";
  } else {
    storeDisplay = "All Stores";
  }

  // 2. Year
  let yearDisplay = "All Years";
  const normYear = String(globalYearFilter || "all").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (normYear && normYear !== "all" && normYear !== "all year" && normYear !== "all years") {
    yearDisplay = String(globalYearFilter);
  } else {
    // Check if gantt session year is set
    const ganttYear = safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_filter_year");
    if (ganttYear && ganttYear !== "all") {
      yearDisplay = String(ganttYear);
    } else {
      yearDisplay = "All Years";
    }
  }

  // 3. Project Code
  let projectCodeRaw = "";
  if (activeTab === "detail" && detailTabFilterCode && detailTabFilterCode.trim()) {
    projectCodeRaw = detailTabFilterCode.trim();
  } else if (activeTab === "cost" && costTabFilterCode && costTabFilterCode.trim()) {
    projectCodeRaw = costTabFilterCode.trim();
  } else if (layoutTabFilters?.projectCode && layoutTabFilters.projectCode.trim()) {
    projectCodeRaw = layoutTabFilters.projectCode.trim();
  } else if (fallbackProjectCode && fallbackProjectCode.trim()) {
    projectCodeRaw = fallbackProjectCode.trim();
  } else {
    // Check if Gantt search term looks like project code
    const sessionGanttSearch = ganttSearchTerm || safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_search") || "";
    if (sessionGanttSearch && sessionGanttSearch.trim()) {
      projectCodeRaw = sessionGanttSearch.trim();
    } else if (detailTabFilterCode && detailTabFilterCode.trim()) {
      projectCodeRaw = detailTabFilterCode.trim();
    } else if (costTabFilterCode && costTabFilterCode.trim()) {
      projectCodeRaw = costTabFilterCode.trim();
    }
  }

  const projectCodeDisplay = projectCodeRaw ? projectCodeRaw : "All Projects";
  const tabTitle = getTabDisplayTitle(activeTab);
  const now = new Date();
  const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
  });

  const summaryText = `Store: ${storeDisplay} | Year: ${yearDisplay} | Project: ${projectCodeDisplay}`;

  return {
    storeRaw: normStore,
    storeDisplay,
    yearRaw: normYear,
    yearDisplay,
    projectCodeRaw,
    projectCodeDisplay,
    tabTitle,
    activeTab,
    dateStr,
    summaryText,
  };
};

/**
 * Draws a high-resolution, vector dynamic filter header onto a jsPDF page.
 * Fits within the top margin (y = 1.8mm to 8.6mm) without overlapping any table content or column headers.
 */
export const drawPdfFilterHeader = (
  pdf: jsPDF,
  context: PrintFilterContext,
  pageWidth: number,
  margin: number = 10,
  isDark: boolean = false
) => {
  const boxX = margin;
  const boxY = 1.8;
  const boxW = pageWidth - margin * 2;
  const boxH = 6.8;
  const radius = 1.2;

  // Background Box
  if (isDark) {
    pdf.setFillColor(24, 24, 27); // #18181b
    pdf.setDrawColor(63, 63, 70); // #3f3f46
  } else {
    pdf.setFillColor(248, 250, 252); // #f8fafc
    pdf.setDrawColor(226, 232, 240); // #e2e8f0
  }
  pdf.setLineWidth(0.2);
  pdf.roundedRect(boxX, boxY, boxW, boxH, radius, radius, "FD");

  // Left Title: Brand + Document context
  const textBaselineY = boxY + 4.5;
  let currentLeftX = boxX + 2.5;

  // Brand Name
  pdf.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
  pdf.setFontSize(8);
  if (isDark) {
    pdf.setTextColor(244, 244, 245); // zinc-100
  } else {
    pdf.setTextColor(15, 23, 42); // slate-900
  }
  const brandText = "TAKASHIMAYA";
  pdf.text(brandText, currentLeftX, textBaselineY);
  currentLeftX += pdf.getTextWidth(brandText) + 1.5;

  // Separator dot
  pdf.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
  pdf.setFontSize(7.5);
  pdf.setTextColor(isDark ? 161 : 148, isDark ? 161 : 163, isDark ? 170 : 184); // slate-400
  pdf.text("•", currentLeftX, textBaselineY);
  currentLeftX += 2.2;

  // Document Title
  pdf.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
  pdf.setFontSize(7.5);
  if (isDark) {
    pdf.setTextColor(147, 197, 253); // blue-300
  } else {
    pdf.setTextColor(29, 78, 216); // blue-700
  }
  pdf.text(context.tabTitle, currentLeftX, textBaselineY);

  // Right Filter Badges (Store, Year, Project Code)
  // Badge dimensions
  const badgeH = 4.6;
  const badgeY = boxY + 1.1;
  const badgeRadius = 0.8;
  const badgeTextY = badgeY + 3.2;
  const badgeGap = 1.8;

  // Define badges (right-to-left ordering: Project Code, then Year, then Store)
  const isFilteredProject = context.projectCodeDisplay !== "All Projects";
  
  interface BadgeConfig {
    text: string;
    bg: [number, number, number];
    border: [number, number, number];
    textCol: [number, number, number];
  }

  // Project Code Badge
  const projectBadge: BadgeConfig = isFilteredProject
    ? {
        text: `Project: ${context.projectCodeDisplay}`,
        bg: isDark ? [69, 26, 3] : [254, 243, 199], // amber-100
        border: isDark ? [180, 83, 9] : [253, 230, 138],
        textCol: isDark ? [253, 230, 138] : [146, 64, 14], // amber-800
      }
    : {
        text: `Project: ${context.projectCodeDisplay}`,
        bg: isDark ? [39, 39, 42] : [241, 245, 249],
        border: isDark ? [82, 82, 91] : [226, 232, 240],
        textCol: isDark ? [212, 212, 216] : [71, 85, 105],
      };

  // Year Badge
  const isFilteredYear = context.yearDisplay !== "All Years";
  const yearBadge: BadgeConfig = isFilteredYear
    ? {
        text: `Year: ${context.yearDisplay}`,
        bg: isDark ? [49, 46, 129] : [238, 242, 255], // indigo-100
        border: isDark ? [99, 102, 241] : [199, 210, 254],
        textCol: isDark ? [224, 231, 255] : [67, 56, 202], // indigo-700
      }
    : {
        text: `Year: ${context.yearDisplay}`,
        bg: isDark ? [39, 39, 42] : [241, 245, 249],
        border: isDark ? [82, 82, 91] : [226, 232, 240],
        textCol: isDark ? [212, 212, 216] : [71, 85, 105],
      };

  // Store Badge
  let storeBadge: BadgeConfig;
  if (context.storeRaw === "hcm") {
    storeBadge = {
      text: "Store: HCM",
      bg: isDark ? [30, 58, 138] : [239, 246, 255], // blue-50
      border: isDark ? [59, 130, 246] : [191, 219, 254],
      textCol: isDark ? [219, 234, 254] : [29, 78, 216], // blue-700
    };
  } else if (context.storeRaw === "hn") {
    storeBadge = {
      text: "Store: HN",
      bg: isDark ? [127, 29, 29] : [254, 242, 242], // red-50
      border: isDark ? [239, 68, 68] : [254, 202, 202],
      textCol: isDark ? [254, 226, 226] : [185, 28, 28], // red-700
    };
  } else {
    storeBadge = {
      text: "Store: All Stores",
      bg: isDark ? [39, 39, 42] : [241, 245, 249],
      border: isDark ? [82, 82, 91] : [226, 232, 240],
      textCol: isDark ? [212, 212, 216] : [71, 85, 105],
    };
  }

  // Draw badges from right to left
  const badges: BadgeConfig[] = [projectBadge, yearBadge, storeBadge];
  let currentRightX = boxX + boxW - 2.5;

  pdf.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
  pdf.setFontSize(6.8);

  for (const b of badges) {
    const textW = pdf.getTextWidth(b.text);
    const badgeW = textW + 4.2; // 2.1mm padding on each side
    const badgeX = currentRightX - badgeW;

    // Guard against collision with left title
    if (badgeX <= currentLeftX + 3) {
      break;
    }

    // Draw pill background
    pdf.setFillColor(b.bg[0], b.bg[1], b.bg[2]);
    pdf.setDrawColor(b.border[0], b.border[1], b.border[2]);
    pdf.setLineWidth(0.15);
    pdf.roundedRect(badgeX, badgeY, badgeW, badgeH, badgeRadius, badgeRadius, "FD");

    // Draw pill text
    pdf.setTextColor(b.textCol[0], b.textCol[1], b.textCol[2]);
    pdf.text(b.text, badgeX + 2.1, badgeTextY);

    currentRightX = badgeX - badgeGap;
  }
};


=== FILE: src/lib/projectDatesBackfill.ts ===
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup } from "../types";
import { useAppStore } from "../store/useAppStore";
import { calculateProjectComputedDates, syncProjectDatesToFirestore } from "./projectDatesService";

export const BOOT_SYNC_GUARD_MS = 15000; // 15 seconds boot sync guard

const bootTime = Date.now();

export function getAppBootAgeMs(): number {
  return Date.now() - bootTime;
}

let isBackfilling = false;

function matchProjectTasks(project: Project, tasks: Task[]): Task[] {
  const pStore = project.store ? String(project.store).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const pYear = project.year !== undefined && project.year !== null ? String(project.year).trim() : '';
  const pCode = String(project.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  return tasks.filter((t) => {
    if (!t || t.isDeleted) return false;
    const tStore = t.projectStore ? String(t.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
    const tYear = t.projectYear !== undefined && t.projectYear !== null ? String(t.projectYear).trim() : '';

    if (t.projectId && String(t.projectId) === String(project.id)) {
      if (pStore && tStore && pStore !== tStore) return false;
      if (pYear && tYear && pYear !== tYear) return false;
      return true;
    }

    if (!t.projectCode || !pCode) return false;
    const tCode = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (tCode !== pCode) return false;

    if (pStore && tStore && pStore !== tStore) return false;
    if (pYear && tYear && pYear !== tYear) return false;

    return true;
  });
}

/**
 * Backfills missing project computed dates for projects that don't have them pre-computed.
 */
export async function backfillMissingProjectDates(
  projects: Project[],
  tasks: Task[],
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[] = []
): Promise<void> {
  if (isBackfilling || !Array.isArray(projects) || projects.length === 0) return;
  isBackfilling = true;

  try {
    const uncomputed = projects.filter(
      (p) => p && p.id && (!p.computedTakStart || !p.computedTakCompl)
    );

    for (const project of uncomputed) {
      if (!project.id) continue;
      const pTasks = matchProjectTasks(project, tasks);
      const computed = calculateProjectComputedDates(project, pTasks, delegationGroups);
      await syncProjectDatesToFirestore(project.id, computed);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[projectDatesBackfill] Backfill error:", err);
  } finally {
    isBackfilling = false;
  }
}

/**
 * Syncs task counts for all projects to Firestore if discrepancies exist.
 */
export async function syncAllProjectsTaskCountsToFirestore(
  onProgressOrProjects?: ((processed: number, total: number) => void) | Project[],
  tasksArg?: Task[],
  progressCb?: (processed: number, total: number) => void
): Promise<{ updatedCount: number; totalProjects: number }> {
  let projects: Project[];
  let tasks: Task[];
  let onProgress: ((processed: number, total: number) => void) | undefined;

  if (Array.isArray(onProgressOrProjects)) {
    projects = onProgressOrProjects;
    tasks = tasksArg || useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];
    onProgress = progressCb;
  } else {
    projects = useAppStore.getState().projects || [];
    tasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];
    onProgress = typeof onProgressOrProjects === "function" ? onProgressOrProjects : undefined;
  }

  let updatedCount = 0;
  const totalProjects = projects.length;

  for (let i = 0; i < projects.length; i++) {
    const p = projects[i];
    if (onProgress) onProgress(i + 1, totalProjects);
    if (!p || !p.id) continue;

    const pTasks = matchProjectTasks(p, tasks);

    if (p.taskCount !== pTasks.length) {
      updatedCount++;
      const computed = calculateProjectComputedDates(p, pTasks, useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups);
      await syncProjectDatesToFirestore(p.id, computed);
    }
  }

  return { updatedCount, totalProjects };
}

import { setDoc, updateDoc, writeBatch } from "./firestoreWrites";
import { db, APP_ID } from "./firebase";
import { doc, collection, getDocs } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup } from "../types";
import { useAppStore } from "../store/useAppStore";
import { getTaskStatus, computeActProgressPercent, computePlanProgressPercent, computePlanProgressFromSummaries, computeActProgressFromSummaries } from "./utils";
import { sortGroupTasks } from "./ganttUtils";
import { isTaskDeletedInTracker } from "./taskDeletedTracker";

export interface ComputedProjectDates {
  computedTakStart?: string;
  computedTakCompl?: string;
  computedOpening?: string;
  computedPlanProgress?: number;
  computedActProgress?: number;
  taskCount?: number;
  taskSummaries?: { name: string; start: string; finish: string; }[];
}

/**
 * So sánh 2 mã dự án: hỗ trợ chuỗi đơn, chuỗi nhiều mã phân tách bởi dấu phẩy/chấm phẩy,
 * không phân biệt chữ hoa/thường và khoảng trắng thừa.
 */
export function matchProjectCode(codeA?: string, codeB?: string): boolean {
  if (!codeA || !codeB) return false;
  const a = String(codeA).trim().toLowerCase();
  const b = String(codeB).trim().toLowerCase();
  if (a === b) return true;
  const partsA = a.split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const partsB = b.split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return partsA.some(pa => partsB.includes(pa));
}

/**
 * Trích xuất danh sách Task thuộc về một Dự án cụ thể (xử lý chính xác multi-code, store và year).
 */
export function getTasksForProject(project: Partial<Project>, allTasks: Task[]): Task[] {
  if (!project) return [];
  const safeAllTasks = Array.isArray(allTasks) ? allTasks : [];

  const pYear = project.year !== undefined && project.year !== null ? String(project.year).trim() : '';
  const pStore = project.store ? String(project.store).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const rawCodeStr = project.linkCodes ? `${project.code || ''}, ${project.linkCodes}` : String(project.code || '');
  const pCodeParts = rawCodeStr.toLowerCase().split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const pIdStr = project.id ? String(project.id) : '';

  const matchedMap = new Map<string, Task>();

  safeAllTasks.forEach(t => {
    if (!t || !t.id || t.isDeleted) return;

    const tStore = t.projectStore ? String(t.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
    const tYear = t.projectYear !== undefined && t.projectYear !== null ? String(t.projectYear).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

    if (pIdStr && t.projectId && String(t.projectId) === pIdStr) {
      if (pStore && tStore && pStore !== tStore) return;
      if (pYear && tYear && pYear !== tYear) return;

      matchedMap.set(String(t.id), t);
      return;
    }

    // Do NOT match by code alone if the task explicitly belongs to a different project ID
    if (pIdStr && t.projectId && String(t.projectId) !== pIdStr) {
      return;
    }

    if (t.projectCode && project.code) {
      const tCode = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase();
      const matchesCode = tCode === String(project.code).trim().toLowerCase() ||
                          pCodeParts.includes(tCode) ||
                          matchProjectCode(t.projectCode, project.code) ||
                          matchProjectCode(t.projectCode, project.linkCodes);
      if (matchesCode) {
        if (pStore && tStore && pStore !== tStore) return;
        if (pYear && tYear && pYear !== tYear) return;

        matchedMap.set(String(t.id), t);
      }
    }
  });

  // Also include subtasks whose parent belongs to matchedMap
  let addedChild = true;
  while (addedChild) {
    addedChild = false;
    safeAllTasks.forEach(t => {
      if (!t || !t.id || t.isDeleted || matchedMap.has(String(t.id))) return;
      const rawParent = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
      if (rawParent && matchedMap.has(String(rawParent))) {
        matchedMap.set(String(t.id), t);
        addedChild = true;
      }
    });
  }

  const matchedList = Array.from(matchedMap.values());
  if (matchedList.length > 0) {
    // Safety guard: If memory only has a partial task set (e.g. mobile or lazy loading),
    // merge in any remaining tasks from project.taskSummaries so task list never shrinks!
    if (project.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(project.taskSummaries) && project.taskSummaries.length > matchedList.length) {
      const existingSummaryMap = new Map<string, any>();
      matchedList.forEach(t => {
        if (t.id) existingSummaryMap.set(String(t.id).toLowerCase(), t);
        if (t.taskCodePhu) existingSummaryMap.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase(), t);
        if (t.name) existingSummaryMap.set(String(t.name).trim().toLowerCase(), t);
      });
      const mergedList = [...matchedList];
      project.taskSummaries.forEach((ts, idx) => {
        const tsId = ts.id ? String(ts.id).toLowerCase() : '';
        const tsCode = ts.taskCodePhu ? String(ts.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        const tsName = ts.name ? String(ts.name).trim().toLowerCase() : '';

        if (isTaskDeletedInTracker(ts.id, ts.taskCodePhu, ts.name)) {
          return;
        }

        const hasMatch = (tsId && existingSummaryMap.has(tsId)) ||
                         (tsCode && existingSummaryMap.has(tsCode)) ||
                         (tsName && existingSummaryMap.has(tsName));
        if (!hasMatch) {
          mergedList.push({
            id: ts.id || `ts_${project.code || project.id}_${project.store || 'HCM'}_${project.year || ''}_${idx}`,
            name: ts.name || `Task ${idx + 1}`,
            start: ts.start || project.computedTakStart || project.start || '',
            finish: ts.finish || project.computedTakCompl || project.handover || '',
            projectCode: project.code || '',
            projectStore: project.store || 'HCM',
            projectYear: project.year ? String(project.year) : '',
            party: ts.party || project.party || '',
            runningStatus: ts.runningStatus || 'On process',
            duration: ts.duration || '',
            parentTaskId: ts.parentTaskId,
            taskCodePhu: ts.taskCodePhu || (project.code ? `${project.code}#${idx + 1}` : undefined),
            orderIndex: ts.orderIndex !== undefined ? ts.orderIndex : idx,
            projectId: project.id,
            ...ts
          } as Task);
        }
      });
      return mergedList;
    }
    return matchedList;
  }

  // Fallback to taskSummaries when tasks for this project are not loaded in memory yet
  if (project.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(project.taskSummaries) && project.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
    return project.taskSummaries
      .filter(ts => !isTaskDeletedInTracker(ts.id, ts.taskCodePhu, ts.name))
      .map((ts, idx) => ({
      id: ts.id || `ts_${project.code || project.id}_${project.store || 'HCM'}_${project.year || ''}_${idx}`,
      name: ts.name || `Task ${idx + 1}`,
      start: ts.start || project.computedTakStart || project.start || '',
      finish: ts.finish || project.computedTakCompl || project.handover || '',
      projectCode: project.code || '',
      projectStore: project.store || 'HCM',
      projectYear: project.year ? String(project.year) : '',
      party: ts.party || project.party || '',
      runningStatus: ts.runningStatus || 'On process',
      duration: ts.duration || '',
      parentTaskId: ts.parentTaskId,
      taskCodePhu: ts.taskCodePhu || (project.code ? `${project.code}#${idx + 1}` : undefined),
      orderIndex: ts.orderIndex !== undefined ? ts.orderIndex : idx,
      projectId: project.id,
      ...ts
    } as Task));
  }

  return [];
}

import { rollupParentTaskDatesAndStatus, rollupTaskSummaries } from "./taskRollupService";

/**
 * Thuật toán tính toán mốc thời gian tĩnh (Pre-computed Dates) cho Dự án từ danh sách Tasks con:
 * - computedTakStart: Ngày bắt đầu sớm nhất trong các Task con (hoặc giữ project.start)
 * - computedTakCompl: Ngày hoàn thành (finish) muộn nhất trong các Task con (đại diện cho Handover / Pj Compl)
 * - computedOpening: Ngày hoàn thành của Task mang từ khóa "opening" hoặc "open" (hoặc fallback về project.opening)
 */
export function calculateProjectComputedDates(
  project: Partial<Project>,
  projectTasks: Task[],
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[] = []
): ComputedProjectDates {
  let computedTakStart = project.computedTakStart || project.start || "";
  let computedTakCompl = project.computedTakCompl || project.handover || (project as any).takCompl || "";
  let computedOpening = project.computedOpening || project.opening || "";

  const existingSummaries = (project.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(project.taskSummaries)) ? project.taskSummaries : [];
  const existingCount = project.taskCount !== undefined ? project.taskCount : existingSummaries.length;

  const rolledUpProjTasks = rollupParentTaskDatesAndStatus(projectTasks || [], delegationGroups);
  const sortedProjTasks = sortGroupTasks(rolledUpProjTasks);

  const taskSummariesRaw = sortedProjTasks
    .filter(t => t.start || t.finish || t.name)
    .map((t, idx) => {
      const summary: {
        name: string;
        start: string;
        finish: string;
        [key: string]: any;
      } = {
        name: t.name || '',
        start: t.start || '',
        finish: t.finish || '',
        orderIndex: t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex : idx,
      };
      if (t.id) summary.id = t.id;
      if (t.duration !== undefined && t.duration !== null) summary.duration = t.duration;
      if (t.parentTaskId) summary.parentTaskId = t.parentTaskId;
      if (t.taskCodePhu) summary.taskCodePhu = t.taskCodePhu;
      if (t.runningStatus) summary.runningStatus = t.runningStatus;
      if (t.approval) summary.approval = t.approval;
      if (t.party) summary.party = t.party;
      if (t.delegation !== undefined) summary.delegation = t.delegation;
      return summary;
    });

  const taskSummaries = rollupTaskSummaries(taskSummariesRaw);
  const isTasksProvided = Array.isArray(projectTasks) && projectTasks.length > 0;
  const finalSummaries: any[] = rollupTaskSummaries(
    isTasksProvided
      ? taskSummaries
      : (existingSummaries.length > 0 ? existingSummaries : taskSummaries)
  );

  const finalTaskCount = isTasksProvided
    ? projectTasks.length
    : Math.max(existingCount || 0, existingSummaries.length, finalSummaries.length);

  // Compute start / compl / opening across the unified summaries and tasks
  const allKnownForDates = finalSummaries.length > 0 ? finalSummaries : sortedProjTasks;
  const validStarts = allKnownForDates
    .map((t: any) => t.start)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort();
  if (validStarts.length > 0) {
    computedTakStart = validStarts[0];
  } else {
    computedTakStart = project.start || "";
  }

  const validFinishes = allKnownForDates
    .map((t: any) => t.finish)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort((a: string, b: string) => (b || "").localeCompare(a || ""));
  if (validFinishes.length > 0) {
    computedTakCompl = validFinishes[0];
  } else {
    computedTakCompl = project.handover || (project as any).takCompl || "";
  }

  const openingTasks = allKnownForDates.filter((t: any) => {
    const name = String(t.name || "").toLowerCase();
    return name.includes("opening") || name.includes("open");
  });
  if (openingTasks.length > 0) {
    const validOpeningFinishes = openingTasks
      .map((t: any) => t.finish)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .sort((a: string, b: string) => (b || "").localeCompare(a || ""));
    if (validOpeningFinishes.length > 0) {
      computedOpening = validOpeningFinishes[0];
    } else {
      computedOpening = project.opening || "";
    }
  } else if (allKnownForDates.length > 0 || isTasksProvided) {
    computedOpening = project.opening || "";
  } else if (!computedOpening) {
    computedOpening = project.computedOpening || project.opening || "";
  }

  const planProgressPercent = finalSummaries.length > 0 
    ? computePlanProgressFromSummaries(finalSummaries) 
    : (projectTasks && projectTasks.length > 0
        ? computePlanProgressPercent(projectTasks)
        : (project.computedPlanProgress ?? 0));
  
  const actProgressPercent = projectTasks && projectTasks.length > 0
    ? computeActProgressPercent(projectTasks, delegationGroups)
    : (finalSummaries.length > 0 
        ? computeActProgressFromSummaries(finalSummaries) 
        : (project.computedActProgress ?? 0));

  return {
    computedTakStart: computedTakStart || "",
    computedTakCompl: computedTakCompl || "",
    computedOpening: computedOpening || "",
    computedPlanProgress: planProgressPercent,
    computedActProgress: actProgressPercent,
    taskCount: finalTaskCount,
    taskSummaries: finalSummaries,
  };
}

/**
 * Cập nhật các trường computed dates lên document taka_projects trong Firestore
 * và cập nhật nhanh vào Zustand Store để giao diện phản hồi tức thời.
 * Đã tích hợp Dirty Check: Chỉ ghi vào Firestore khi có sự thay đổi thực sự
 * về mốc thời gian (start, finish/compl, opening), tiến độ hoặc số lượng task.
 */
export async function syncProjectDatesToFirestore(
  projectId: string,
  dates: ComputedProjectDates
): Promise<void> {
  if (!projectId) return;

  try {
    const { projects, setProjects } = useAppStore.getState();
    const existingProject = projects.find((p) => p.id === projectId);
    const existingCount = existingProject?.taskCount || existingProject?.taskSummaries?.length || 0;
    const existingSummaries = existingProject?.taskSummaries || [];

    // When computed, dates.taskSummaries and dates.taskCount are authoritative
    const safeTaskSummaries = dates.taskSummaries !== undefined ? dates.taskSummaries : existingSummaries;
    const safeTaskCount = dates.taskCount !== undefined ? dates.taskCount : existingCount;

    // Dirty Check: Chỉ gửi lệnh ghi vào Firestore nếu các chỉ số cốt lõi (ngày, tiến độ, số lượng task, taskSummaries) thực sự thay đổi.
    // Nếu chỉ sửa comment, ghi chú hay đổi tên đơn thuần không làm đổi mốc thời gian/tiến độ -> bỏ qua Write to Firestore (0 write).
    const hasChanged =
      !existingProject ||
      (existingProject.computedTakStart || "") !== (dates.computedTakStart || "") ||
      (existingProject.computedTakCompl || "") !== (dates.computedTakCompl || "") ||
      (existingProject.computedOpening || "") !== (dates.computedOpening || "") ||
      Number(existingProject.computedPlanProgress ?? 0) !== Number(dates.computedPlanProgress ?? 0) ||
      Number(existingProject.computedActProgress ?? 0) !== Number(dates.computedActProgress ?? 0) ||
      Number(existingProject.taskCount ?? 0) !== Number(safeTaskCount ?? dates.taskCount ?? 0) ||
      JSON.stringify(existingProject.taskSummaries || []) !== JSON.stringify(safeTaskSummaries || dates.taskSummaries || []);

    // Cập nhật Optimistic in-memory Store tức thời (0ms) để UI đồng bộ mượt mà
    if (existingProject) {
      const updated = projects.map((p) => {
        if (p.id === projectId) {
          return {
            ...p,
            ...dates,
            taskCount: safeTaskCount !== undefined ? safeTaskCount : dates.taskCount,
            taskSummaries: safeTaskSummaries !== undefined ? safeTaskSummaries : dates.taskSummaries,
          };
        }
        return p;
      });
      setProjects(updated);
    }

    if (!hasChanged) {
      // Dữ liệu tổng hợp không đổi -> Tiết kiệm 100% lượt Write cho project tổng hợp
      return;
    }

    const projectRef = doc(
      db,
      "artifacts",
      APP_ID,
      "public",
      "data",
      "taka_projects",
      projectId
    );

    const updatePayload: Record<string, any> = {
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (dates.computedTakStart !== undefined) {
      updatePayload.computedTakStart = dates.computedTakStart;
    }
    if (dates.computedTakCompl !== undefined) {
      updatePayload.computedTakCompl = dates.computedTakCompl;
    }
    if (dates.computedOpening !== undefined) {
      updatePayload.computedOpening = dates.computedOpening;
    }
    if (dates.computedPlanProgress !== undefined) {
      updatePayload.computedPlanProgress = dates.computedPlanProgress;
    }
    if (dates.computedActProgress !== undefined) {
      updatePayload.computedActProgress = dates.computedActProgress;
    }
    if (safeTaskCount !== undefined) {
      updatePayload.taskCount = safeTaskCount;
    }
    if (safeTaskSummaries !== undefined) {
      updatePayload.taskSummaries = safeTaskSummaries.map((ts: any) => {
        const item: Record<string, any> = {};
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ts)) {
          if (v !== undefined) {
            item[k] = v;
          }
        }
        return item;
      });
    }

    await setDoc(projectRef, updatePayload, { merge: true });

    // Phát tín hiệu delta của taka_projects để các thiết bị khác đồng bộ real-time
    const { recordDelta } = await import("./deltaSyncService");
    recordDelta({
      docId: projectId,
      collectionName: "taka_projects",
      action: "update",
      isPatch: true,
      data: updatePayload,
      year: existingProject?.year ? String(existingProject.year) : undefined,
    }).catch(() => {});
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Error syncing computed dates for project ${projectId}:`, error);
  }
}

/**
 * Đồng bộ computed dates cho một dự án dựa trên projectCode, store, year và danh sách task hiện có.
 */
export async function syncProjectDatesByCode(
  projectCode: string,
  projectStore?: string,
  projectYear?: string | number,
  overrideTasks?: Task[]
): Promise<void> {
  if (!projectCode) return;

  const { projects, tasks, delegationGroups } = useAppStore.getState();
  const project = projects.find(
    (p) =>
      (p.code === projectCode || matchProjectCode(p.code, projectCode)) &&
      (!projectStore || !p.store || String(p.store).trim().toLowerCase() === String(projectStore).trim().toLowerCase()) &&
      (!projectYear || !p.year || String(p.year).trim() === String(projectYear).trim())
  );

  if (!project || !project.id) return;

  const currentTasks = overrideTasks || tasks;
  const projectTasks = getTasksForProject(project, currentTasks);

  const dates = calculateProjectComputedDates(project, projectTasks, delegationGroups);
  await syncProjectDatesToFirestore(project.id, dates);
}

import { getStoredR2Credentials, getS3Sdk, extractR2Key, listR2Objects, deleteR2Object, R2Credentials } from '../components/PictureMapping/lib/r2Upload';
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { compressImageToWebp } from './imageCompression';

/**
 * R2 Storage Garbage Collector & Cleanup Utilities.
 * Mirrors the storageUtils.ts architecture for Firebase Storage, dedicated to Cloudflare R2 CAD/Floorplan assets.
 */

/**
 * Extracts all unique R2 object keys (bg_* images) referenced in an item, version, or full store dataset.
 */
export function extractR2ImageKeys(data: any): string[] {
  if (!data) return [];
  const keys = new Set<string>();

  const processUrl = (url: any) => {
    if (typeof url === 'string') {
      const k = extractR2Key(url);
      if (k) keys.add(k);
    }
  };

  const processVersion = (v: any) => {
    if (!v) return;
    if (v.backgroundUrl) processUrl(v.backgroundUrl);
    if (v.r2Key) processUrl(v.r2Key);
  };

  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
    data.forEach((item) => {
      if (typeof item === 'string') processUrl(item);
      else if (item && typeof item === 'object') {
        if (item.backgroundUrl || item.r2Key) processVersion(item);
        if (Array.isArray(item.mapVersions)) item.mapVersions.forEach(processVersion);
        if (Array.isArray(item.versions)) item.versions.forEach(processVersion);
      }
    });
  } else if (typeof data === 'object') {
    // Single version object
    if (data.backgroundUrl || data.r2Key) {
      processVersion(data);
    }
    // StoreLocationData partitions
    if (data.storeLocationData && typeof data.storeLocationData === 'object') {
      Object.values(data.storeLocationData).forEach((part: any) => {
        if (Array.isArray(part?.mapVersions)) part.mapVersions.forEach(processVersion);
      });
    }
    if (Array.isArray(data.mapVersions)) {
      data.mapVersions.forEach(processVersion);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(data.versions)) {
      data.versions.forEach(processVersion);
    }
  }

  return Array.from(keys);
}

/**
 * Deletes specific R2 object keys/URLs from the Cloudflare R2 bucket in the background.
 */
export async function deleteR2StorageFiles(
  keysOrUrls: string[],
  customCreds?: R2Credentials | null
): Promise<{ deletedCount: number; deletedKeys: string[] }> {
  if (!keysOrUrls || keysOrUrls.length === 0) {
    return { deletedCount: 0, deletedKeys: [] };
  }

  const creds = customCreds || getStoredR2Credentials();
  if (!creds || !creds.accountId || !creds.bucketName) {
    console.warn('[R2 GC] Bỏ qua xóa file: Chưa cấu hình thông tin R2 credentials.');
    return { deletedCount: 0, deletedKeys: [] };
  }

  const targetKeys = Array.from(
    new Set(keysOrUrls.map((k) => extractR2Key(k) || k).filter((k): k is string => !!k && typeof k === 'string'))
  );

  if (targetKeys.length === 0) {
    return { deletedCount: 0, deletedKeys: [] };
  }

  try {
    const { S3Client } = await getS3Sdk();
    const s3 = new S3Client({
      region: 'auto',
      endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
      credentials: { accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId, secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey },
    });

    const deletedKeys: string[] = [];
    for (const key of targetKeys) {
      try {
        const ok = await deleteR2Object(key, creds, s3);
        if (ok) {
          deletedKeys.push(key);
          console.log(`[R2 GC] Đã dọn dẹp file mồ côi trên R2: ${key}`);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[R2 GC] Không thể xóa file ${key}:`, err);
      }
    }

    return { deletedCount: deletedKeys.length, deletedKeys };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[R2 GC] Lỗi khởi tạo kết nối xóa file R2:', err);
    return { deletedCount: 0, deletedKeys: [] };
  }
}

/**
 * Scans all files on R2 bucket and deletes any orphan background images
 * that are no longer referenced anywhere in activeData (all floors & versions).
 */
export async function cleanOrphanR2Files(
  activeData: any,
  options?: {
    customCreds?: R2Credentials | null;
    onProgress?: (status: string) => void;
  }
): Promise<{ scannedCount: number; deletedCount: number; deletedKeys: string[] }> {
  const creds = options?.customCreds || getStoredR2Credentials();
  if (!creds || !creds.accountId || !creds.bucketName) {
    return { scannedCount: 0, deletedCount: 0, deletedKeys: [] };
  }

  try {
    options?.onProgress?.('Đang kết nối R2 để quét các file ảnh nền...');
    const { S3Client } = await getS3Sdk();
    const s3 = new S3Client({
      region: 'auto',
      endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
      credentials: { accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId, secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey },
    });

    // 1. List all background files on R2
    const allR2Keys = await listR2Objects(creds, s3, 'bg_');
    if (allR2Keys.length === 0) {
      options?.onProgress?.('Không có file ảnh nền nào cần quét trên R2.');
      return { scannedCount: 0, deletedCount: 0, deletedKeys: [] };
    }

    // 2. Extract all actively used keys across all locations, floors & versions
    const activeKeys = new Set(extractR2ImageKeys(activeData).map((k) => k.toLowerCase()));

    // 3. Find orphaned files (present in R2 but NOT referenced in activeData)
    const orphanKeys = allR2Keys.filter((key) => {
      const lower = key.toLowerCase();
      return lower.startsWith('bg_') && !activeKeys.has(lower);
    });

    if (orphanKeys.length === 0) {
      options?.onProgress?.('Toàn bộ file trên R2 đều đang được sử dụng hợp lệ (0 file rác).');
      return { scannedCount: allR2Keys.length, deletedCount: 0, deletedKeys: [] };
    }

    options?.onProgress?.(`Tìm thấy ${orphanKeys.length} file rác mồ côi. Đang tiến hành thu gom...`);

    const deletedKeys: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < orphanKeys.length; i++) {
      const key = orphanKeys[i];
      options?.onProgress?.(`Đang xóa file rác: ${key} (${i + 1}/${orphanKeys.length})...`);
      const ok = await deleteR2Object(key, creds, s3);
      if (ok) {
        deletedKeys.push(key);
      }
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 40));
    }

    options?.onProgress?.(`Đã thu gom và giải phóng thành công ${deletedKeys.length} file rác trên R2!`);
    return { scannedCount: allR2Keys.length, deletedCount: deletedKeys.length, deletedKeys };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[R2 GC] Lỗi trong quá trình quét và dọn dẹp R2:', err);
    return { scannedCount: 0, deletedCount: 0, deletedKeys: [] };
  }
}

/**
 * Uploads a picture file to Cloudflare R2 bucket under `Taka-Pm-folder/`
 * and returns the public HTTP URL: https://hcm.taka-pm.org/Taka-Pm-folder/<filename>
 */
export async function uploadPictureToTakaFolder(
  file: File,
  unitCode?: string,
  store?: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; publicUrl?: string; error?: string }> {
  let creds = getStoredR2Credentials();
  if (!creds) {
    try {
      const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "r2_credentials"));
      if (snap.exists()) {
        const data = snap.data() as any;
        if (data.accountId && data.accessKeyId && data.secretAccessKey && data.bucketName) {
          creds = {
            accountId: data.accountId,
            accessKeyId: data.accessKeyId,
            secretAccessKey: data.secretAccessKey,
            bucketName: data.bucketName,
          };
          useAppStore.getState().setR2Config(data);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[R2 Upload] Error fetching R2 credentials:", e);
    }
  }

  if (!creds) {
    return { success: false, error: "Chưa cấu hình thông tin Cloudflare R2 (r2_credentials)." };
  }

  try {
    const { S3Client, PutObjectCommand } = await getS3Sdk();
    const s3 = new S3Client({
      region: 'auto',
      endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId.trim()}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
      credentials: {
        accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId.trim(),
        secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey.trim(),
      },
    });

    // Auto-compress photo to ultra-lightweight WebP format (Canva & Cloudinary standard: max 1920px, quality 0.82)
    let uploadFile = file;
    let compressionInfo = '';
    try {
      const compressed = await compressImageToWebp(file, { maxWidth: 1920, maxHeight: 1920, quality: 0.82 });
      uploadFile = compressed.file;
      if (compressed.compressionRatio > 0) {
        compressionInfo = ` (Đã nén ${(compressed.originalSize / 1024).toFixed(0)}KB → ${(compressed.compressedSize / 1024).toFixed(0)}KB, tiết kiệm ${compressed.compressionRatio}%)`;
      }
    } catch (compressErr) {
      console.warn('[R2 Upload] Lỗi nén WebP, sử dụng file gốc:', compressErr);
    }

    const cleanName = uploadFile.name.replace(/[\/\\]/g, '_').replace(/\s+/g, '_');
    const storePrefix = store ? `${store.toUpperCase().trim()}_` : '';
    const prefix = unitCode ? `${unitCode.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_')}_` : '';
    const keyName = `${storePrefix}${prefix}${Date.now()}_${cleanName}`;
    const fullKey = `Taka-Pm-folder/${keyName}`;

    const arrayBuffer = await uploadFile.arrayBuffer();
    const uint8Array = new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer);

    const command = new PutObjectCommand({
      Bucket: creds.bucketName.trim(),
      Key: fullKey,
      Body: uint8Array,
      ContentType: uploadFile.type || 'image/webp',
      CacheControl: 'public, max-age=604800, immutable',
    });

    await s3.send(command);

    const publicUrl = `https://hcm.taka-pm.org/${fullKey}`;
    return { success: true, publicUrl, compressionInfo } as any;
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("[R2 Upload] Failed to upload picture to Taka-Pm-folder:", err);
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || "Lỗi tải ảnh lên Cloudflare R2." };
  }
}

/**
 * Permanently deletes an image file from Cloudflare R2 Cloud Storage.
 * Handles both full public URLs (e.g. https://hcm.taka-pm.org/Taka-Pm-folder/file.jpg),
 * r2:// protocol links, and direct key names, ensuring zero leftover files or versions on R2.
 */
export async function deleteR2ImageCleanly(
  urlOrKey: string,
  customCreds?: R2Credentials | null
): Promise<{ success: boolean; deletedKeys: string[] }> {
  if (!urlOrKey || typeof urlOrKey !== 'string') {
    return { success: false, deletedKeys: [] };
  }

  const trimmed = urlOrKey.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('data:') || trimmed.startsWith('blob:')) {
    return { success: false, deletedKeys: [] };
  }

  let creds = customCreds || getStoredR2Credentials();
  if (!creds) {
    try {
      const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "r2_credentials"));
      if (snap.exists()) {
        const data = snap.data() as any;
        if (data.accountId && data.accessKeyId && data.secretAccessKey && data.bucketName) {
          creds = {
            accountId: data.accountId,
            accessKeyId: data.accessKeyId,
            secretAccessKey: data.secretAccessKey,
            bucketName: data.bucketName,
          };
          useAppStore.getState().setR2Config(data);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[R2 Purge] Error fetching credentials:", e);
    }
  }

  if (!creds || !creds.accountId || !creds.bucketName) {
    console.warn('[R2 Purge] Cannot delete from R2: Credentials missing.');
    return { success: false, deletedKeys: [] };
  }

  // Extract all potential object key candidates
  const keysToDelete = new Set<string>();

  if (trimmed.startsWith('r2://')) {
    keysToDelete.add(trimmed.replace('r2://', ''));
  }

  if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://')) {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(trimmed);
      const pathname = decodeURIComponent(parsed.pathname).replace(/^\/+/, '');
      if (pathname) {
        keysToDelete.add(pathname);
        const parts = pathname.split('/');
        if (parts.length > 1) {
          keysToDelete.add(parts[parts.length - 1]);
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  } else {
    keysToDelete.add(trimmed);
  }

  const r2Key = extractR2Key(trimmed);
  if (r2Key) {
    keysToDelete.add(r2Key);
  }

  const uniqueKeys = Array.from(keysToDelete).filter(Boolean);
  if (uniqueKeys.length === 0) {
    return { success: false, deletedKeys: [] };
  }

  try {
    const { S3Client } = await getS3Sdk();
    const s3 = new S3Client({
      region: 'auto',
      endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId.trim()}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
      credentials: {
        accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId.trim(),
        secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey.trim(),
      },
    });

    const deletedKeys: string[] = [];
    for (const key of uniqueKeys) {
      try {
        const ok = await deleteR2Object(key, creds, s3);
        if (ok) {
          deletedKeys.push(key);
          console.log(`[R2 Purge] Permanently deleted object from R2: "${key}"`);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[R2 Purge] Error deleting key "${key}":`, err);
      }
    }

    return { success: deletedKeys.length > 0, deletedKeys };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[R2 Purge] Error connecting to R2 for deletion:', err);
    return { success: false, deletedKeys: [] };
  }
}

export const safeGetItemLocal = (key: string): string | null => {
  try { return window.localStorage.getItem(key); } catch (e) { return null; }
};
export const safeSetItemLocal = (key: string, value: string): void => {
  try { 
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, value); 
  } catch (e: any) {
    if (e?.name === 'QuotaExceededError' || e?.message?.includes('quota')) {
      cleanupBloatedStorage();
      try { window.localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (_) {}
    }
  }
};
export const safeRemoveItemLocal = (key: string): void => {
  try { window.localStorage.removeItem(key); } catch (e) {}
};

export const safeGetItemSession = (key: string): string | null => {
  try { return window.sessionStorage.getItem(key); } catch (e) { return null; }
};
export const safeSetItemSession = (key: string, value: string): void => {
  try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (e) {}
};
export const safeRemoveItemSession = (key: string): void => {
  try { window.sessionStorage.removeItem(key); } catch (e) {}
};

export type DeviceScreenType = 'mobile' | 'tablet' | 'desktop';

export const getDeviceScreenType = (): DeviceScreenType => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'desktop';
  const width = window.innerWidth;
  if (width < 768) return 'mobile';
  if (width < 1024) return 'tablet';
  return 'desktop';
};

/**
 * Returns a storage key tailored to the user's specific device screen profile.
 * Example: taka_gantt_scale_mobile, taka_gantt_visible_columns_u123_desktop
 */
export const getDeviceStorageKey = (baseKey: string, userId?: string): string => {
  const device = getDeviceScreenType();
  if (userId) {
    return `${baseKey}_${userId}_${device}`;
  }
  return `${baseKey}_${device}`;
};

/**
 * Safely reads a value with device-screen priority:
 * 1. user + device key (e.g. key_u123_mobile)
 * 2. device key (e.g. key_mobile)
 * 3. user key (e.g. key_u123)
 * 4. base key (e.g. key)
 */
export const safeGetDeviceItemLocal = (baseKey: string, userId?: string): string | null => {
  const device = getDeviceScreenType();
  if (userId) {
    const userDeviceVal = safeGetItemLocal(`${baseKey}_${userId}_${device}`);
    if (userDeviceVal !== null) return userDeviceVal;
  }
  const deviceVal = safeGetItemLocal(`${baseKey}_${device}`);
  if (deviceVal !== null) return deviceVal;
  if (userId) {
    const userVal = safeGetItemLocal(`${baseKey}_${userId}`);
    if (userVal !== null) return userVal;
  }
  return safeGetItemLocal(baseKey);
};

/**
 * Safely saves a value across device-specific and fallback keys.
 */
export const safeSetDeviceItemLocal = (baseKey: string, value: string, userId?: string): void => {
  const device = getDeviceScreenType();
  if (userId) {
    safeSetItemLocal(`${baseKey}_${userId}_${device}`, value);
  }
  safeSetItemLocal(`${baseKey}_${device}`, value);
  // Also keep baseKey up to date as general fallback
  safeSetItemLocal(baseKey, value);
};

/**
 * Remove bloated non-critical cache entries from localStorage to release quota
 * for critical systems like Firebase mutations and app configuration.
 */
export const cleanupBloatedStorage = (): void => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return;
  try {
    // 1. Remove oversized floor plan backup if present (can always be loaded from Cloud/R2)
    window.localStorage.removeItem('taka_mapping_config_backup');

    // 2. Scan and remove orphaned/failed firestore mutations and large temporary caches
    const keysToRemove: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < window.localStorage.length; i++) {
      const key = window.localStorage.key(i);
      if (key) {
        if (
          key.startsWith('firestore_mutations_') ||
          key.startsWith('firestore_clients_') ||
          key.startsWith('taka_cache_') ||
          key.includes('mapping_config_backup')
        ) {
          keysToRemove.push(key);
        }
      }
    }
    keysToRemove.forEach((k) => {
      try { window.localStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (_) {}
    });
  } catch (_) {}
};

/**
 * Proactively verifies if localStorage has free quota on boot.
 * If quota is exceeded, automatically clears bloated caches.
 */
export const checkAndCleanStorageQuota = (): void => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return;
  try {
    // Always prune oversized taka_mapping_config_backup if larger than 1MB
    const backup = window.localStorage.getItem('taka_mapping_config_backup');
    if (backup && backup.length > 1000000) {
      window.localStorage.removeItem('taka_mapping_config_backup');
    }

    const testKey = '__probe_storage_quota__';
    window.localStorage.setItem(testKey, '1');
    window.localStorage.removeItem(testKey);
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn('⚠️ LocalStorage quota exceeded on boot. Purging temporary caches...');
    cleanupBloatedStorage();
  }
};


=== FILE: src/lib/storageBudgetService.ts ===
import { localDb } from './localDb';

/**
 * Storage Budget Service
 * Giám sát và quản trị trần bộ nhớ IndexedDB cho iOS Safari (40MB limit theo chuẩn AGENTS.md)
 * Ngăn ngừa WebKit kích hoạt Emergency Wipe khi iPhone ngủ 2-4-8 tiếng
 */

const IS_IOS = typeof window !== 'undefined' && (
  /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
  (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1)
);

// Ngưỡng an toàn tối đa cho iOS (35MB để không chạm trần 40MB của WebKit)
const IOS_SAFE_QUOTA_BYTES = 35 * 1024 * 1024;

export interface StorageBudgetReport {
  usageBytes: number;
  quotaBytes: number;
  percentageUsed: number;
  isIOS: boolean;
  evictedCount: number;
  status: 'safe' | 'warning' | 'pruned';
}

/**
 * Kiểm tra và dọn dẹp các bản ghi năm cũ (LRU eviction) nếu chạm ngưỡng bộ nhớ Safari
 */
export async function enforceStorageBudget(): Promise<StorageBudgetReport> {
  const result: StorageBudgetReport = {
    usageBytes: 0,
    quotaBytes: IOS_SAFE_QUOTA_BYTES,
    percentageUsed: 0,
    isIOS: IS_IOS,
    evictedCount: 0,
    status: 'safe',
  };

  try {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.storage && navigator.storage.estimate) {
      const estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();
      result.usageBytes = estimate.usage || 0;
      if (estimate.quota) {
        result.quotaBytes = IS_IOS ? Math.min(estimate.quota, IOS_SAFE_QUOTA_BYTES) : estimate.quota;
      }
      if (result.quotaBytes > 0) {
        result.percentageUsed = Math.round((result.usageBytes / result.quotaBytes) * 100);
      }
    }

    // Nếu là môi trường iOS và dung lượng vượt 80% ngưỡng an toàn
    const needsPruning = IS_IOS && (result.percentageUsed > 80 || result.usageBytes > IOS_SAFE_QUOTA_BYTES * 0.85);

    if (needsPruning) {
      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      const cutoffYear = String(currentYear - 2); // Giữ các năm hiện hành (2025, 2026); dọn <= 2024

      // Chỉ dọn dẹp các task đã hoàn thành thuộc các năm lưu trữ cũ khỏi Dexie nội bộ (không chạm vào Firestore)
      const oldTasks = await localDb.tasks
        .filter((t: any) => {
          const taskYear = String(t.projectYear || t.year || (t.start ? t.start.substring(0, 4) : ''));
          const status = String(t.runningStatus || t.status || '').toLowerCase();
          return Boolean(taskYear && taskYear <= cutoffYear && status === 'completed');
        })
        .toArray();

      if (oldTasks.length > 0) {
        const oldIds = oldTasks.map((t) => t.id);
        await localDb.tasks.bulkDelete(oldIds);
        result.evictedCount += oldIds.length;
        result.status = 'pruned';
        console.info(`[storageBudgetService] Evicted ${oldIds.length} completed tasks of <= ${cutoffYear} to preserve iOS 40MB limit.`);
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[storageBudgetService] Storage budget check completed safely:', err);
  }

  return result;
}


=== FILE: src/lib/storageUtils.ts ===
import { storage } from './firebase';
import { ref, deleteObject } from 'firebase/storage';

export const extractStorageUrls = (item: any): string[] => {
  if (!item) return [];
  const urls = new Set<string>();
  
  if (item.fileUrl && item.fileUrl.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')) urls.add(item.fileUrl);
  if (item.childFileUrl && item.childFileUrl.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')) urls.add(item.childFileUrl);
  if (item.image && item.image.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')) urls.add(item.image);
  
  if (item.attachments && Array.isArray(item.attachments)) {
    item.attachments.forEach((att: any) => {
      if (att.url && att.url.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')) urls.add(att.url);
    });
  }
  
  if (item.comments && Array.isArray(item.comments)) {
    item.comments.forEach((c: any) => {
      if (c.text) {
        const matches = c.text.match(/(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)/g) || [];
        matches.forEach((url: string) => {
          if (url.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')) urls.add(url);
        });
      }
      if (c.attachments && Array.isArray(c.attachments)) {
        c.attachments.forEach((att: any) => {
           if (att.url && att.url.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')) urls.add(att.url);
        });
      }
    });
  }
  
  return Array.from(urls);
};

export const deleteStorageFiles = async (urls: string[]) => {
  if (!urls || urls.length === 0) return;
  for (const url of urls) {
    try {
      const fileRef = ref(storage, url);
      await deleteObject(fileRef);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to clean orphan storage file:", url, e);
    }
  }
};


=== FILE: src/lib/syncQueue.ts ===
import { doc, getDoc, getDocFromServer } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { setDoc, updateDoc, deleteDoc } from './firestoreWrites';
import { pullAndApplyDeltas, getLastDeltaSyncTime } from './deltaSyncService';

// Lệnh nằm trong hàng đợi quá lâu thì dữ liệu trên server gần như chắc chắn đã đổi: bỏ, không phát lại.
const MAX_PENDING_AGE_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

const toMs = (v: any): number => {
  if (!v) return 0;
  const n =
    typeof v === 'string' ? Date.parse(v) : typeof v?.toMillis === 'function' ? v.toMillis() : Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
};

/**
 * Lỗi mà server từ chối vĩnh viễn: thử lại bao nhiêu lần cũng vậy, và KHÔNG được đưa vào hàng đợi.
 * Mất mạng thật thì Firestore SDK (persistent cache) tự giữ lệnh ghi và gửi lại, không cần hàng đợi này.
 */
export function isPermanentWriteError(err: any): boolean {
  const code = String(err?.code || '');
  return [
    'permission-denied',
    'not-found',
    'invalid-argument',
    'failed-precondition',
    'already-exists',
    'out-of-range',
    'unauthenticated',
    'unimplemented',
  ].some((c) => code.includes(c));
}

export interface PendingUpdate {
  id: string;
  collectionPath: string; // The full path, e.g. artifacts/APP_ID/public/data/taka_projects
  action: 'set' | 'update' | 'delete';
  docId: string;
  data: any;
  timestamp: number;
  retryCount?: number;
}

const DB_NAME = 'TakaSyncDB';
const STORE_NAME = 'pendingUpdates';

let isSyncProcessing = false;
let lastSyncTimestamp = 0;

function openDB(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 2);
    request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const db = request.result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
    };
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
  });
}

export async function addPendingUpdate(update: Omit<PendingUpdate, 'id' | 'timestamp'>) {
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const newUpdate: PendingUpdate = {
      ...update,
      id: Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.add(newUpdate);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(newUpdate);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to add pending update to IDB', e);
  }
}

export async function getPendingUpdates(): Promise<PendingUpdate[]> {
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.getAll();
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result || []);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to get pending updates', e);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function removePendingUpdate(id: string) {
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.delete(id);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(true);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to remove pending update', e);
  }
}

export async function clearPendingUpdates() {
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.clear();
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(true);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to clear pending updates', e);
  }
}

export function getConnectionStatus(): 'online' | 'offline' | 'checking' {
  if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return 'online';
  return navigator.onLine ? 'online' : 'offline';
}

export async function processPendingSync(): Promise<{ synced: number; failed: number }> {
  if (isSyncProcessing) return { synced: 0, failed: 0 };
  if (getConnectionStatus() === 'offline') return { synced: 0, failed: 0 };

  isSyncProcessing = true;
  let synced = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  let dropped = 0;

  try {
    const pendingList = await getPendingUpdates();
    if (!pendingList || pendingList.length === 0) {
      lastSyncTimestamp = Date.now();
      return { synced: 0, failed: 0 };
    }

    // Phát lại theo đúng thứ tự thời gian
    pendingList.sort((a, b) => (Number(a.timestamp) || 0) - (Number(b.timestamp) || 0));

    for (const item of pendingList) {
      try {
        const queuedAt = Number(item.timestamp) || 0;

        // 1. Quá hạn: bỏ
        if (queuedAt && Date.now() - queuedAt > MAX_PENDING_AGE_MS) {
          console.warn(`[SyncQueue] Drop expired pending ${item.action} ${item.docId}`);
          await removePendingUpdate(item.id);
          dropped++;
          continue;
        }

        const fullPath = item.collectionPath.includes('/')
          ? item.collectionPath
          : `artifacts/${APP_ID}/public/data/${item.collectionPath}`;
        const docRef = doc(db, `${fullPath}/${item.docId}`);
        const draftAt = toMs(item.data?.updatedAt) || queuedAt;

        // 2. Luôn đối chiếu với bản TRÊN SERVER (không dùng cache cục bộ). Không đọc được thì giữ lại thử sau.
        let serverSnap: any;
        try {
          serverSnap = await getDocFromServer(docRef);
        } catch {
          failed++;
          continue;
        }
        const exists = serverSnap.exists();
        const serverAt = exists ? toMs(serverSnap.data()?.updatedAt) : 0;

        if (item.action === 'delete') {
          // Doc đã mất rồi, hoặc đã được sửa SAU khi lệnh xóa được xếp hàng: không xóa
          if (!exists || (serverAt && queuedAt && serverAt > queuedAt)) {
            console.warn(`[SyncQueue] Skip stale delete ${item.docId}`);
            await removePendingUpdate(item.id);
            dropped++;
            continue;
          }
          await deleteDoc(docRef);
        } else if (item.action === 'update') {
          // Doc đã bị xóa: update sẽ lỗi not-found mãi mãi. Server mới hơn: không ghi đè.
          if (!exists || (serverAt && draftAt && serverAt > draftAt)) {
            console.warn(`[SyncQueue] Skip stale update ${item.docId}`);
            await removePendingUpdate(item.id);
            dropped++;
            continue;
          }
          await updateDoc(docRef, item.data);
        } else if (item.action === 'set') {
          // set với dữ liệu cũ hơn server: không ghi đè. Doc chưa tồn tại: cho phép tạo (bản nháp offline).
          if (exists && serverAt && draftAt && serverAt > draftAt) {
            console.warn(`[SyncQueue] Skip stale set ${item.docId}`);
            await removePendingUpdate(item.id);
            dropped++;
            continue;
          }
          await setDoc(docRef, item.data, { merge: true });
        }

        console.info(`[SyncQueue] Replayed ${item.action} ${item.docId}`);
        await removePendingUpdate(item.id);
        synced++;
      } catch (err) {
        if (isPermanentWriteError(err)) {
          console.warn(`[SyncQueue] Permanent error, dropping ${item.docId}:`, err);
          await removePendingUpdate(item.id);
          dropped++;
        } else {
          console.warn(`[SyncQueue] Failed to process update for ${item.docId}:`, err);
          failed++;
        }
      }
    }

    if (dropped > 0) console.info(`[SyncQueue] Dropped ${dropped} stale/invalid pending updates`);
    lastSyncTimestamp = Date.now();
    await pullAndApplyDeltas().catch(() => {});
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[SyncQueue] Error during processPendingSync:', err);
  } finally {
    isSyncProcessing = false;
  }

  return { synced, failed };
}

export const syncQueueManager = {
  addToQueue: async (
    collectionName: string,
    docId: string,
    action: 'set' | 'update' | 'delete',
    data: any
  ) => {
    const collectionPath = collectionName.includes('/')
      ? collectionName
      : `artifacts/${APP_ID}/public/data/${collectionName}`;

    await addPendingUpdate({
      collectionPath,
      action,
      docId,
      data,
    });

    if (getConnectionStatus() === 'online') {
      processPendingSync().catch(() => {});
    }
  },

  getQueueStatus: async () => {
    const pendingList = await getPendingUpdates();
    return {
      totalPending: pendingList.length,
      unsynced: pendingList.length,
      lastSyncTime: lastSyncTimestamp || getLastDeltaSyncTime(),
      isProcessing: isSyncProcessing,
      pendingUpdates: pendingList.map((p) => ({
        docId: p.docId,
        action: p.action,
        retryCount: p.retryCount || 0,
        collection: p.collectionPath,
      })),
    };
  },

  clearQueue: async () => {
    await clearPendingUpdates();
    lastSyncTimestamp = Date.now();
  },

  processPendingSync,
};

// Global event listener for firestore refresh requests
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('firestore-refresh-needed', () => {
    pullAndApplyDeltas().catch(() => {});
    processPendingSync().catch(() => {});
  });
}


=== FILE: src/lib/syncResilience.ts ===
import { disableNetwork, enableNetwork } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from './firebase';
import { localDb } from './localDb';
import { processPendingSync, getConnectionStatus } from './syncQueue';

/**
 * Sync resilience helpers (additive module).
 *
 * 1. initNetworkRecovery: restarts the Firestore network layer after the app was in background.
 *    iOS Safari / PWA suspends WebChannel connections; the listener can stay "connected" but silently stop
 *    receiving updates. disableNetwork -> enableNetwork forces a clean reconnect (pending writes are preserved).
 * 2. resyncIfStale: delta documents are purged after 7 days. A device that has not synced for longer
 *    than that can never catch up through deltas, so wipe the local cache and reload once.
 */

const HIDDEN_THRESHOLD_MS = 45 * 1000;
const STALE_RESYNC_MS = 6 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // < 7-day delta retention
const RESYNC_GUARD_KEY = 'taka_full_resync_guard_v1';

export function initNetworkRecovery(onRecovered?: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') return () => {};

  let hiddenAt = 0;
  let busy = false;

  const recover = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    busy = true;
    try {
      await disableNetwork(db);
      await enableNetwork(db);
      await processPendingSync();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[syncResilience] Network recovery failed:', err);
    } finally {
      busy = false;
      try { onRecovered?.(); } catch {}
    }
  };

  const handleVisibility = () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
      hiddenAt = Date.now();
      return;
    }
    if (hiddenAt && Date.now() - hiddenAt > HIDDEN_THRESHOLD_MS) {
      hiddenAt = 0;
      recover();
    } else {
      hiddenAt = 0;
    }
  };

  // Page restored from the iOS back/forward cache: sockets are certainly dead.
  const handlePageShow = (e: Event) => {
    if ((e as PageTransitionEvent).persisted) recover();
  };

  // Network came back (e.g. iPhone was offline): force a clean reconnect so queued offline writes flush now
  const handleOnline = () => { recover(); };

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', handlePageShow);
  window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);

  return () => {
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
    window.removeEventListener('pageshow', handlePageShow);
    window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
  };
}

/**
 * If lastSyncTime is older than the delta retention window, clear local caches and reload once
 * so every listener re-reads fresh data from Firestore. Returns true when a resync was triggered.
 */
export async function resyncIfStale(lastSyncTime: number, lastSyncKey: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  if (!lastSyncTime || Date.now() - lastSyncTime < STALE_RESYNC_MS) return false;

  // Loop guard: never trigger twice within 10 minutes.
  try {
    const last = Number(window.sessionStorage.getItem(RESYNC_GUARD_KEY) || 0);
    if (last && Date.now() - last < 10 * 60 * 1000) return false;
    window.sessionStorage.setItem(RESYNC_GUARD_KEY, String(Date.now()));
  } catch {}

  console.warn('[syncResilience] Local data older than delta retention. Running full resync.');
  try {
    await Promise.all([
      localDb.projects.clear(),
      localDb.tasks.clear(),
      localDb.costs.clear(),
      localDb.delegations.clear(),
      localDb.syncMeta.clear(),
    ]);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[syncResilience] Failed to clear Dexie:', err);
  }

  try {
    const keys: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < window.localStorage.length; i++) {
      const k = window.localStorage.key(i);
      if (k && (k.startsWith('taka_year_data_v1_') || k === 'taka_years_meta_fingerprint_v1')) keys.push(k);
    }
    keys.forEach((k) => window.localStorage.removeItem(k));
    window.localStorage.setItem(lastSyncKey, String(Date.now() - 30 * 60 * 1000));
  } catch {}

  window.location.reload();
  return true;
}

export const connectionMonitor = {
  onOnline: (callback: () => void) => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
    const handler = () => {
      processPendingSync().catch(() => {});
      callback();
    };
    window.addEventListener('online', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('online', handler);
  },

  onOffline: (callback: () => void) => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
    window.addEventListener('offline', callback);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('offline', callback);
  },

  destroy: () => {
    // Cleanup monitor handlers
  },
};

export const listenerManager = {
  getStatus: () => {
    const isOnline = getConnectionStatus() === 'online';
    return {
      totalListeners: 4,
      activeListeners: isOnline ? 4 : 0,
      listeners: [
        { id: 'projects-listener', isActive: isOnline, collection: 'taka_projects' },
        { id: 'tasks-listener', isActive: isOnline, collection: 'taka_tasks' },
        { id: 'costs-listener', isActive: isOnline, collection: 'taka_costs' },
        { id: 'delegations-listener', isActive: isOnline, collection: 'taka_delegations' },
      ],
      isOnline,
    };
  },
};
