import { doc, getDoc, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from './firebase';
import { safeGetItemLocal, safeSetItemLocal } from './storage';
import { Project, Task, Cost } from '../types';

export interface YearMetaInfo {
  updatedAt: string;
  closed?: boolean;
  projectCount?: number;
  taskCount?: number;
  costCount?: number;
}

export type YearsMetaMap = Record<string, YearMetaInfo>;

const FINGERPRINT_CACHE_KEY = 'taka_years_meta_fingerprint_v1';
const DATA_CACHE_PREFIX = 'taka_year_data_v1_';

let memoryYearsMeta: YearsMetaMap | null = null;
let lastMetaFetchTime = 0;

/**
 * Cập nhật snapshot metadata vào bộ nhớ RAM (0 Firestore Read)
 */
export function setMemoryYearsMeta(meta: YearsMetaMap): void {
  memoryYearsMeta = meta;
  lastMetaFetchTime = Date.now();
}

/**
 * Lấy metadata hiện tại từ RAM nếu có
 */
export function getMemoryYearsMeta(): YearsMetaMap | null {
  return memoryYearsMeta;
}

/**
 * Lấy document metadata years_meta từ Firestore hoặc RAM cache (TTL 60s)
 */
export async function fetchYearsMeta(forceRefresh: boolean = false): Promise<YearsMetaMap> {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!forceRefresh && memoryYearsMeta && (now - lastMetaFetchTime < 60000)) {
    return memoryYearsMeta;
  }

  try {
    const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_config', 'years_meta');
    const snap = await getDoc(docRef);
    if (snap.exists()) {
      const data = snap.data() as YearsMetaMap;
      memoryYearsMeta = data;
      lastMetaFetchTime = now;
      return data;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[yearsFingerprint] Unable to fetch remote years_meta:', err);
  }
  return memoryYearsMeta || {};
}

/**
 * Kiểm tra xem dữ liệu của một năm đã lưu trong Local Cache có khớp với phiên bản trên server hay không
 */
export function isYearCacheValid(year: string, remoteMeta: YearsMetaMap): boolean {
  if (!year || !remoteMeta[year]) return false;

  const localFingerprintRaw = safeGetItemLocal(FINGERPRINT_CACHE_KEY);
  if (!localFingerprintRaw) return false;

  try {
    const localFingerprint: Record<string, string> = JSON.parse(localFingerprintRaw);
    const remoteUpdatedAt = remoteMeta[year].updatedAt;
    const localUpdatedAt = localFingerprint[year];

    if (remoteUpdatedAt && localUpdatedAt && remoteUpdatedAt === localUpdatedAt) {
      // Check if data actually exists in local cache
      const cachedData = safeGetItemLocal(`${DATA_CACHE_PREFIX}${year}`);
      return !!cachedData;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Đọc dữ liệu đã cache của một năm từ Local Cache (0ms, 0 Read)
 */
export function loadYearDataFromLocal(year: string): {
  projects: Project[];
  tasks?: Task[];
  costs?: Cost[];
} | null {
  try {
    const raw = safeGetItemLocal(`${DATA_CACHE_PREFIX}${year}`);
    if (!raw) return null;
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[yearsFingerprint] Error parsing cached year ${year}:`, err);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Lưu dữ liệu của một năm và cập nhật fingerprint vào Local Cache
 */
export function saveYearDataToLocal(
  year: string,
  updatedAt: string,
  data: { projects: Project[]; tasks?: Task[]; costs?: Cost[] }
): void {
  try {
    // 1. Lưu payload dữ liệu
    safeSetItemLocal(`${DATA_CACHE_PREFIX}${year}`, JSON.stringify(data));

    // 2. Cập nhật bảng fingerprint
    let localFingerprint: Record<string, string> = {};
    const localFingerprintRaw = safeGetItemLocal(FINGERPRINT_CACHE_KEY);
    if (localFingerprintRaw) {
      try {
        localFingerprint = JSON.parse(localFingerprintRaw);
      } catch {}
    }
    localFingerprint[year] = updatedAt;
    safeSetItemLocal(FINGERPRINT_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(localFingerprint));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[yearsFingerprint] Failed to write cache for year ${year}:`, err);
  }
}

const pendingYearTouches = new Map<string, { timer: any; firstQueuedAt: number }>();

/**
 * Cập nhật timestamp cho một năm trên Firestore khi có bất kỳ mutation nào
 * Coalescing / Debounce 1.5s để gom nhiều mutation liên tiếp trong cùng năm thành 1 lần ghi Firestore duy nhất (Giảm 80-90% Write)
 */
export async function touchYearMeta(year: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!year || String(year).toLowerCase() === 'all') return;

  const now = Date.now();
  const existing = pendingYearTouches.get(year);

  if (existing) {
    if (now - existing.firstQueuedAt < 5000) {
      clearTimeout(existing.timer);
      existing.timer = setTimeout(() => {
        flushTouchYearMeta(year);
      }, 1500);
      return;
    }
    return;
  }

  const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    flushTouchYearMeta(year);
  }, 1500);

  pendingYearTouches.set(year, { timer, firstQueuedAt: now });
}

async function flushTouchYearMeta(year: string): Promise<void> {
  pendingYearTouches.delete(year);
  try {
    const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_config', 'years_meta');
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    await setDoc(
      docRef,
      {
        [year]: {
          updatedAt: now,
        },
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[yearsFingerprint] Failed to touch years_meta:', err);
  }
}

/**
 * Flush toàn bộ các năm còn đang chờ debounce trước khi đóng tab hoặc reload
 */
export async function flushAllPendingYearTouches(): Promise<void> {
  const years = Array.from(pendingYearTouches.keys());
  await Promise.all(years.map((y) => flushTouchYearMeta(y)));
}

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    flushAllPendingYearTouches();
  });
}

import React, { useEffect, useId, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';

/**
 * Enterprise Stacking Context & Z-Index Management Standard
 * 
 * Strict hierarchic layers to prevent DOM clipping, portal layering bugs,
 * and ensure tooltips, popovers, and nested modals stay in correct depth.
 */
export const Z_INDEX_VALUES = {
  BASE: 0,
  STICKY_HEADER: 40,
  DROPDOWN: 100,
  DRAWER: 200,
  FLOATING_CONTROL: 500,
  LAYOUT_TOOLTIP: 20000,
  MODAL_BASE: 100000,
  MODAL_NESTED: 120000,
  QUICK_NAV: 150000,
  MINI_GANTT: 150000,
  CONFIRM_ALERT: 160000,
  COMMAND_PALETTE: 170000,
  LIGHTBOX: 180000,
  MODAL_MODULAR: 185000,
  TOAST: 200000,
  MAX: 999999
} as const;

export type ZIndexLayer = keyof typeof Z_INDEX_VALUES;

/**
 * Returns numeric z-index value with optional relative offset
 */
export function getZIndexValue(layer: ZIndexLayer, offset: number = 0): number {
  return (Z_INDEX_VALUES[layer] ?? 0) + offset;
}

/**
 * Returns Tailwind arbitrary z-index class string, e.g. "z-[150000]"
 */
export function getZIndexClass(layer: ZIndexLayer, offset: number = 0): string {
  const val = getZIndexValue(layer, offset);
  return `z-[${val}]`;
}

/**
 * Active Overlay Registry for dynamic stacking, nesting, and tab-switch cleanup
 */
interface OverlayEntry {
  id: string;
  layer: ZIndexLayer;
  createdAt: number;
  onClose?: () => void;
  closeOnTabChange?: boolean;
}

class OverlayStackManager {
  private overlays: Map<string, OverlayEntry> = new Map();
  private listeners: Set<() => void> = new Set();

  public register(entry: OverlayEntry): () => void {
    this.overlays.set(entry.id, entry);
    this.notify();
    return () => {
      this.overlays.delete(entry.id);
      this.notify();
    };
  }

  public unregister(id: string): void {
    if (this.overlays.has(id)) {
      this.overlays.delete(id);
      this.notify();
    }
  }

  public getTopLayer(): ZIndexLayer | null {
    if (this.overlays.size === 0) return null;
    let topEntry: OverlayEntry | null = null;
    for (const entry of this.overlays.values()) {
      if (!topEntry || Z_INDEX_VALUES[entry.layer] > Z_INDEX_VALUES[topEntry.layer]) {
        topEntry = entry;
      }
    }
    return topEntry?.layer ?? null;
  }

  public hasModalOpen(): boolean {
    for (const entry of this.overlays.values()) {
      if (Z_INDEX_VALUES[entry.layer] >= Z_INDEX_VALUES.MODAL_BASE) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  public closeTabSensitiveOverlays(): void {
    for (const [id, entry] of this.overlays.entries()) {
      if (entry.closeOnTabChange && typeof entry.onClose === 'function') {
        try {
          entry.onClose();
        } catch {}
      }
    }
  }

  public subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
  }

  private notify(): void {
    this.listeners.forEach(fn => {
      try { fn(); } catch {}
    });
  }
}

export const overlayStackManager = new OverlayStackManager();

/**
 * Hook to register an overlay with the central Z-Index manager
 * and auto-close when tab switching occurs.
 */
export function useOverlayStack(options: {
  layer: ZIndexLayer;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose?: () => void;
  closeOnTabChange?: boolean;
}) {
  const { layer, isOpen, onClose, closeOnTabChange = true } = options;
  const overlayId = useId();
  const activeTab = useAppStore(state => state.activeTab);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const cleanup = overlayStackManager.register({
      id: overlayId,
      layer,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      onClose,
      closeOnTabChange
    });

    return () => {
      cleanup();
    };
  }, [overlayId, layer, isOpen, onClose, closeOnTabChange]);

  // Tab switch auto-close enforcement
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && closeOnTabChange && onClose) {
      // Tab changed while overlay is open
      const unsub = useAppStore.subscribe((state, prevState) => {
        if (state.activeTab !== prevState.activeTab) {
          onClose();
        }
      });
      return () => unsub();
    }
  }, [isOpen, closeOnTabChange, onClose]);

  return {
    zValue: getZIndexValue(layer),
    zClass: getZIndexClass(layer)
  };
}

const shouldSuppress = (args) => {
  return args.some(arg => 
    typeof arg === 'string' && 
    (arg.includes("Could not reach Cloud Firestore backend") || 
     arg.includes("c050") ||
     arg.includes("INTERNAL ASSERTION FAILED: Unexpected state"))
  );
};

console.error = (...args) => {
  if (shouldSuppress(args)) return;
  originalConsoleError(...args);
};

console.warn = (...args) => {
  if (shouldSuppress(args)) return;
  originalConsoleWarn(...args);
};

=== FILE: src/polyfills.ts ===
try {
  class MemoryStorage {
    private data: Record<string, string> = {};
    getItem(key: string) { return this.data.hasOwnProperty(key) ? this.data[key] : null; }
    setItem(key: string, value: string) { this.data[key] = String(value); }
    removeItem(key: string) { delete this.data[key]; }
    clear() { this.data = {}; }
    get length() { return Object.keys(this.data).length; }
    key(index: number) { return Object.keys(this.data)[index] || null; }
  }

  const mockLocal = new MemoryStorage();
  const mockSession = new MemoryStorage();

  let isLocalAccessible = true;
  try {
    window.localStorage.getItem('__test__');
  } catch (e) {
    isLocalAccessible = false;
  }

  let isSessionAccessible = true;
  try {
    window.sessionStorage.getItem('__test__');
  } catch (e) {
    isSessionAccessible = false;
  }

  if (!isLocalAccessible || !isSessionAccessible) {
    // 1. Try to redefine the properties on window
    try {
      if (!isLocalAccessible) {
        Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', {
          get: () => mockLocal,
          configurable: true
        });
      }
      if (!isSessionAccessible) {
        Object.defineProperty(window, 'sessionStorage', {
          get: () => mockSession,
          configurable: true
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not redefine window.localStorage property.");
    }

    // 2. Monkey-patch Storage.prototype as a fallback
    const originalGetItem = Storage.prototype.getItem;
    const originalSetItem = Storage.prototype.setItem;
    const originalRemoveItem = Storage.prototype.removeItem;
    const originalClear = Storage.prototype.clear;

    Storage.prototype.getItem = function(key: string) {
      try {
        return originalGetItem.call(this, key);
      } catch (e) {
        return mockLocal.getItem(key);
      }
    };
    Storage.prototype.setItem = function(key: string, value: string) {
      try {
        originalSetItem.call(this, key, value);
      } catch (e) {
        mockLocal.setItem(key, value);
      }
    };
    Storage.prototype.removeItem = function(key: string) {
      try {
        originalRemoveItem.call(this, key);
      } catch (e) {
        mockLocal.removeItem(key);
      }
    };
    Storage.prototype.clear = function() {
      try {
        originalClear.call(this);
      } catch (e) {
        mockLocal.clear();
      }
    };
  }
} catch (e) {
  console.warn("Polyfill initialization failed", e);
}

import { StateCreator } from "zustand";
import { Task, Cost, Project } from "../../types";
import { AppState, OptimisticSlice } from "../storeTypes";
import { deduplicateTasksInMemory } from "../../lib/taskDeduplicationService";

export const createOptimisticSlice: StateCreator<AppState, [], [], OptimisticSlice> = (set) => ({
  optimisticUpdateTasks: (updatedTasks) => set((state) => {
    if (!updatedTasks || updatedTasks.length === 0) return state;
    const updatedMap = new Map(updatedTasks.map(t => [t.id, t]));
    const existingIds = new Set(state.tasks.map(t => t.id));
    
    const mapped = state.tasks
      .map(t => {
        const update = updatedMap.get(t.id);
        if (update) {
          if ((update as any).isDeleted) return null;
          return { ...t, ...update } as Task;
        }
        return t;
      })
      .filter((t): t is Task => t !== null);

    const newTasks = updatedTasks.filter(
      t => t.id && !existingIds.has(t.id) && !(t as any).isDeleted
    ) as Task[];

    const combined = newTasks.length > 0 ? [...mapped, ...newTasks] : mapped;
    const { dedupedTasks } = deduplicateTasksInMemory(combined, state.projects);

    return {
      tasks: dedupedTasks
    };
  }),

  optimisticDeleteTasks: (taskIds) => set((state) => {
    if (!taskIds || taskIds.length === 0) return state;
    const idSet = new Set(taskIds.map(String));
    return {
      tasks: state.tasks.filter(t => !idSet.has(String(t.id)))
    };
  }),

  optimisticUpdateCosts: (updatedCosts) => set((state) => {
    if (!updatedCosts || updatedCosts.length === 0) return state;
    const updatedMap = new Map(updatedCosts.map(c => [c.id, c]));
    const existingIds = new Set(state.costs.map(c => c.id));

    const mapped = state.costs
      .map(c => {
        const update = updatedMap.get(c.id);
        if (update) {
          if ((update as any).isDeleted) return null;
          return { ...c, ...update } as Cost;
        }
        return c;
      })
      .filter((c): c is Cost => c !== null);

    const newCosts = updatedCosts.filter(
      c => c.id && !existingIds.has(c.id) && !(c as any).isDeleted
    ) as Cost[];

    return {
      costs: newCosts.length > 0 ? [...mapped, ...newCosts] : mapped
    };
  }),

  optimisticDeleteCosts: (costIds) => set((state) => {
    if (!costIds || costIds.length === 0) return state;
    const idSet = new Set(costIds);
    return {
      costs: state.costs.filter(c => !idSet.has(c.id))
    };
  }),

  optimisticUpdateProjects: (updatedProjects) => set((state) => {
    if (!updatedProjects || updatedProjects.length === 0) return state;
    const updatedMap = new Map(updatedProjects.map(p => [p.id, p]));
    const existingIds = new Set(state.projects.map(p => p.id));

    const mapped = state.projects
      .map(p => {
        const update = updatedMap.get(p.id);
        if (update) {
          if ((update as any).isDeleted) return null;
          return { ...p, ...update } as Project;
        }
        return p;
      })
      .filter((p): p is Project => p !== null);

    const newProjects = updatedProjects.filter(
      p => p.id && !existingIds.has(p.id) && !(p as any).isDeleted
    ) as Project[];

    return {
      projects: newProjects.length > 0 ? [...mapped, ...newProjects] : mapped
    };
  }),

  optimisticDeleteProjects: (projectIds) => set((state) => {
    if (!projectIds || projectIds.length === 0) return state;
    const idSet = new Set(projectIds);
    return {
      projects: state.projects.filter(p => !idSet.has(p.id))
    };
  }),

  optimisticUpdateProjectFinancial: (projectId, updates) => set((state) => {
    return {
      projects: state.projects.map(p => {
        if (p.id === projectId) {
          const newFin = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p.financial || {}));
          
          for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(updates)) {
            if (key.startsWith('financial.')) {
              const parts = key.split('.');
              parts.shift(); // remove 'financial'
              let current = newFin;
              for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
                if (!current[parts[i]]) current[parts[i]] = {};
                current = current[parts[i]];
              }
              const lastPart = parts[parts.length - 1];
              current[lastPart] = (current[lastPart] || 0) + (value as number);
            }
          }
          return { ...p, financial: newFin };
        }
        return p;
      })
    };
  }),

  rollbackProjectFinancial: (projectId, oldFinancial) => set((state) => ({
    projects: state.projects.map(p => 
      p.id === projectId ? { ...p, financial: oldFinancial } : p
    )
  })),
});

    safeSetDeviceItemLocal("taka_gantt_day_width", String(currentWidth));
    safeSetDeviceItemLocal("taka_gantt_scale_input", String(currentScale));
    set({ isGanttWidthChanged: false });
    get().setToast({

      message: `Scale (${currentScale}% / ${currentWidth}px) saved for ${getDeviceScreenType()} screen`
    });

    set({ ganttShowDependencies: val });

  expandedProjectIds: [],
  toggleProjectExpansion: (projectId) => set((state) => {
    const strId = String(projectId).trim();
    const proj = state.projects?.find(p => 
      String(p.id || '') === strId ||
      String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase() === strId.toLowerCase() ||
      (p.no !== undefined && String(p.no) === strId)
    );
    const idAliases = new Set<string>([strId]);
    if (proj) {
      if (proj.id) idAliases.add(String(proj.id));
      if (proj.code) idAliases.add(String(proj.code));
      if (proj.no !== undefined) idAliases.add(String(proj.no));
    }
    const isCurrentlyExpanded = state.expandedProjectIds.some(id => idAliases.has(id));
    const next = isCurrentlyExpanded
      ? state.expandedProjectIds.filter(id => !idAliases.has(id))
      : [...state.expandedProjectIds, proj?.id ? String(proj.id) : strId];
    return { expandedProjectIds: next };
  }),
  setExpandedProjectIds: (ids) => {

        state.visibleActiveProjectIds.every((id, idx) => id === ids[idx])
      ) {
        return state;
      }
      return { visibleActiveProjectIds: ids };
    });
  },

  searchActiveProjectIds: [],

      if (
        state.searchActiveProjectIds.length === ids.length &&
        state.searchActiveProjectIds.every((id, idx) => id === ids[idx])
      ) {
        return state;
      }
      return { searchActiveProjectIds: ids };
    });
  },

  globalStoreFilter: (() => {
    const direct = safeGetItemLocal("taka_store_filter") || safeGetItemLocal("taka_store_filter_guest");
    if (direct && String(direct).toLowerCase() !== 'all') return direct;
    
    let isOnlyHN = false;
    try {
      const savedAuth = safeGetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1");
      if (savedAuth) {
        const u = JSON.parse(savedAuth);
        const isAdmin = u.role === 'admin';
        const hasHCM = !!u?.storePermissions?.hcm;
        const hasHN = !!u?.storePermissions?.hn;
        isOnlyHN = !isAdmin && !hasHCM && hasHN;
        
        if (u?.preferences?.defaultStore && String(u.preferences.defaultStore).toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
            return u.preferences.defaultStore;
        }
      }
    } catch {}
    
    return isOnlyHN ? "HN" : "HCM";
  })(),
  setGlobalStoreFilter: (filter) => {
    safeSetItemLocal("taka_store_filter", filter);
    const prev = get().globalStoreFilter;
    if (prev !== filter) {
      // Switching store (e.g. HCM -> HN or HN -> HCM): reset location filter to avoid stale floor filters blocking new store
      safeSetItemLocal("taka_location_filter", JSON.stringify([]));
      set({ globalStoreFilter: filter, globalLocationFilter: [] });
    } else {
      set({ globalStoreFilter: filter });
    }
  },
  globalYearFilter: (() => {
    const direct = safeGetItemLocal("taka_year_filter");
    if (direct && String(direct).toLowerCase() !== 'all') return direct;
    
    let isOnlyHN = false;
    try {
      const savedAuth = safeGetItemLocal("taka_auth_v1");
      if (savedAuth) {
        const u = JSON.parse(savedAuth);
        const isAdmin = u.role === 'admin';
        const hasHCM = !!u?.storePermissions?.hcm;
        const hasHN = !!u?.storePermissions?.hn;
        isOnlyHN = !isAdmin && !hasHCM && hasHN;

        if (u?.preferences?.defaultYear && String(u.preferences.defaultYear).toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
           return String(u.preferences.defaultYear);
        }
      }
    } catch {}
    
    return isOnlyHN ? "2027" : new Date().getFullYear().toString();
  })(),
  setGlobalYearFilter: (globalYearFilter) => {
    safeSetItemLocal("taka_year_filter", globalYearFilter);
    set({ globalYearFilter });
  },
  globalLocationFilter: (() => {
    try {
      const LAST_ACT_KEY = "taka_last_activity_time";
      const FIFTEEN_MINS_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;
      const lastAct = safeGetItemLocal(LAST_ACT_KEY);
      const now = Date.now();

      // If first launch or inactivity > 15 minutes: default to [] ("All Locations")
      if (!lastAct || (now - Number(lastAct) > FIFTEEN_MINS_MS)) {
        safeSetItemLocal(LAST_ACT_KEY, String(now));
        safeSetItemLocal("taka_location_filter", JSON.stringify([]));
        return [];
      }

      const stored = safeGetItemLocal("taka_location_filter");
      if (!stored) return [];
      const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
      if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        if (typeof parsed === 'string' && parsed !== 'all') return [parsed];
        return [];
      }
      return parsed.filter((l: string) => l !== 'all');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  })(),
  setGlobalLocationFilter: (globalLocationFilter) => {
    try {
      safeSetItemLocal("taka_last_activity_time", String(Date.now()));
    } catch {}
    const cleaned = Array.isArray(globalLocationFilter) ? globalLocationFilter.filter(l => l !== 'all') : [];
    safeSetItemLocal("taka_location_filter", JSON.stringify(cleaned));
    set({ globalLocationFilter: cleaned });
  },
  pinnedProjects: (() => {
    try {
      const stored = safeGetItemLocal("taka_pinned_projects");
      if (stored) return JSON.parse(stored);
    } catch {}
    return [];
  })(),
  setPinnedProjects: (pinned) => {
    safeSetItemLocal("taka_pinned_projects", JSON.stringify(pinned));
    set({ pinnedProjects: pinned });
  },
  setDetailTabStoreFilter: (globalStoreFilter) => set({ globalStoreFilter }),
  detailTabFocusTaskId: "",
  setDetailTabFocusTaskId: (detailTabFocusTaskId) => set({ detailTabFocusTaskId }),
  detailReturnScrollId: "",
  setDetailReturnScrollId: (detailReturnScrollId) => set({ detailReturnScrollId }),
  ganttTabFocusTaskId: "",
  setGanttTabFocusTaskId: (ganttTabFocusTaskId) => set({ ganttTabFocusTaskId }),
  ganttTabFilterProjectId: "",
  setGanttTabFilterProjectId: (ganttTabFilterProjectId) => set({ ganttTabFilterProjectId }),
  ganttTriggerToday: 0,
  triggerGanttToday: () => set({ ganttTriggerToday: Date.now() }),
  layoutTabFilters: null,
  setLayoutTabFilters: (layoutTabFilters) => set({ layoutTabFilters }),
  notificationFilterId: null,
  setNotificationFilterId: (notificationFilterId) => set({ notificationFilterId }),

  layoutTooltipVisibility: (() => {
    const defaultVal = {
      projectCode: true,
      projectName: true,
      mdStatus: true,
      actStatus: true,
      legendColor: true,
      floor: true,
      startDate: true,
      endDate: true,
      detail: true,
      description: true,
      progressBars: true,
      area: true,
      notifications: true,
      alertOverdue: true,
      alertDelay: true,
      alertHandover: true,
      alertOpening: true,
      alertOpeningRisk: true,
    };
    try {
      const stored = safeGetItemLocal("taka_layout_tooltip_visibility");
      if (stored) {
        return { ...defaultVal, ...JSON.parse(stored) };
      }
    } catch {}
    return defaultVal;
  })(),
  setLayoutTooltipVisibility: (updater) => set((state) => {
    const next = typeof updater === 'function' ? updater(state.layoutTooltipVisibility) : { ...state.layoutTooltipVisibility, ...updater };
    safeSetItemLocal("taka_layout_tooltip_visibility", JSON.stringify(next));
    return { layoutTooltipVisibility: next };
  }),
  resetLayoutTooltipVisibility: () => set(() => {
    const defaultVal = {
      projectCode: true,
      projectName: true,
      mdStatus: true,
      actStatus: true,
      legendColor: true,
      floor: true,
      startDate: true,
      endDate: true,
      detail: true,
      description: true,
      progressBars: true,
      area: true,
      notifications: true,
      alertOverdue: true,
      alertDelay: true,
      alertHandover: true,
      alertOpening: true,
      alertOpeningRisk: true,
    };
    safeSetItemLocal("taka_layout_tooltip_visibility", JSON.stringify(defaultVal));
    return { layoutTooltipVisibility: defaultVal };
  }),
  zoomableImageSrc: null,
  setZoomableImageSrc: (zoomableImageSrc) => set({ zoomableImageSrc }),
});


=== FILE: src/store/storeSelectors.ts ===
import { useShallow } from 'zustand/react/shallow';
import { useAppStore } from './useAppStore';
import { AppState, UISlice, DataSlice, OptimisticSlice } from './storeTypes';

/**
 * Atomic selector hook for UI slice state with shallow equality checking.
 * Prevents unnecessary re-renders when unrelated UI state changes.
 */
export function useUISlice<T>(selector: (state: UISlice) => T): T {
  return useAppStore(useShallow(selector));
}

/**
 * Atomic selector hook for Data slice state with shallow equality checking.
 * Prevents re-renders when data arrays are mutated in-place or unrelated state updates.
 */
export function useDataSlice<T>(selector: (state: DataSlice) => T): T {
  return useAppStore(useShallow(selector));
}

/**
 * Atomic selector hook for Optimistic slice state with shallow equality checking.
 */
export function useOptimisticSlice<T>(selector: (state: OptimisticSlice) => T): T {
  return useAppStore(useShallow(selector));
}

/**
 * Generic shallow selector wrapper for custom multi-property store subscriptions.
 */
export function useStoreShallow<T>(selector: (state: AppState) => T): T {
  return useAppStore(useShallow(selector));
}

  setR2Config: (config: { accountId: string; bucketName: string; accessKeyId: string; secretAccessKey: string } | null) => void;
}

import { create } from "zustand";

export interface ReadEvent {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  collection: string;
  count: number;
  fromCache: boolean;
  type: "snapshot_initial" | "snapshot_delta" | "getDoc" | "getDocs";
  details?: string;
}

export interface CollectionStat {
  serverReads: number;
  cacheReads: number;
  activeListeners: number;
  lastSyncAt: string;
  totalEvents: number;
}

export interface DevicePerformanceData {
  deviceId: string;
  deviceName: string;
  platform: string;
  userName: string;
  userRole: string;
  serverReads: number;
  cacheReads: number;
  activeListeners: number;
  cacheHitRate: number;
  lastActiveAt: string;
  lastActiveTimestamp: number;
  sessionDurationSec: number;
  totalEvents: number;
  status: "online" | "idle" | "offline";
  topCollection?: string;
}

interface PerformanceStore {
  serverReads: number;
  cacheReads: number;
  activeListeners: number;
  sessionStartTime: number;
  collectionStats: Record<string, CollectionStat>;
  events: ReadEvent[];

  // Actions
  trackSnapshot: (collectionName: string, snapshot: any, eventType?: "snapshot_initial" | "snapshot_delta") => void;
  trackGetDoc: (collectionName: string, fromCache: boolean, docCount?: number, details?: string) => void;
  registerListener: (collectionName: string) => void;
  unregisterListener: (collectionName: string) => void;
  resetStats: () => void;
}

const MAX_EVENT_LOGS = 120;

export const usePerformanceStore = create<PerformanceStore>((set, get) => ({
  serverReads: 0,
  cacheReads: 0,
  activeListeners: 0,
  sessionStartTime: Date.now(),
  collectionStats: {},
  events: [],

  trackSnapshot: (collectionName, snapshot, customEventType) => {
    if (!snapshot) return;

    const fromCache = snapshot.metadata?.fromCache ?? false;
    let count = 0;
    let type: "snapshot_initial" | "snapshot_delta" = customEventType || "snapshot_delta";

    if (snapshot.docChanges && typeof snapshot.docChanges === "function") {
      const changes = snapshot.docChanges();
      if (changes.length === 0 && snapshot.size > 0 && !fromCache) {
        count = snapshot.size;
        type = "snapshot_initial";
      } else {
        count = changes.length;
      }
    } else if (typeof snapshot.size === "number") {
      count = snapshot.size;
    } else if (snapshot.exists && typeof snapshot.exists === "function") {
      count = snapshot.exists() ? 1 : 0;
    } else {
      count = 1;
    }

    if (count === 0 && snapshot.size > 0 && fromCache) {
      count = snapshot.size;
      type = "snapshot_initial";
    }

    const serverCount = fromCache ? 0 : count;
    const cacheCount = fromCache ? count : 0;
    const nowStr = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();

    const newEvent: ReadEvent = {
      id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
      timestamp: nowStr,
      collection: collectionName,
      count,
      fromCache,
      type,
      details: fromCache ? "Local IndexedDB Cache" : "Cloud Firestore Network (Billable)",
    };

    set((state) => {
      const existing = state.collectionStats[collectionName] || {
        serverReads: 0,
        cacheReads: 0,
        activeListeners: 0,
        lastSyncAt: nowStr,
        totalEvents: 0,
      };

      const updatedStat: CollectionStat = {
        ...existing,
        serverReads: existing.serverReads + serverCount,
        cacheReads: existing.cacheReads + cacheCount,
        lastSyncAt: nowStr,
        totalEvents: existing.totalEvents + 1,
      };

      return {
        serverReads: state.serverReads + serverCount,
        cacheReads: state.cacheReads + cacheCount,
        collectionStats: {
          ...state.collectionStats,
          [collectionName]: updatedStat,
        },
        events: [newEvent, ...state.events].slice(0, MAX_EVENT_LOGS),
      };
    });
  },

  trackGetDoc: (collectionName, fromCache, docCount = 1, details) => {
    const serverCount = fromCache ? 0 : docCount;
    const cacheCount = fromCache ? docCount : 0;
    const nowStr = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();

    const newEvent: ReadEvent = {
      id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
      timestamp: nowStr,
      collection: collectionName,
      count: docCount,
      fromCache,
      type: docCount > 1 ? "getDocs" : "getDoc",
      details: details || (fromCache ? "Direct Cache Read" : "Direct Server Read"),
    };

    set((state) => {
      const existing = state.collectionStats[collectionName] || {
        serverReads: 0,
        cacheReads: 0,
        activeListeners: 0,
        lastSyncAt: nowStr,
        totalEvents: 0,
      };

      return {
        serverReads: state.serverReads + serverCount,
        cacheReads: state.cacheReads + cacheCount,
        collectionStats: {
          ...state.collectionStats,
          [collectionName]: {
            ...existing,
            serverReads: existing.serverReads + serverCount,
            cacheReads: existing.cacheReads + cacheCount,
            lastSyncAt: nowStr,
            totalEvents: existing.totalEvents + 1,
          },
        },
        events: [newEvent, ...state.events].slice(0, MAX_EVENT_LOGS),
      };
    });
  },

  registerListener: (collectionName) => {
    set((state) => {
      const existing = state.collectionStats[collectionName] || {
        serverReads: 0,
        cacheReads: 0,
        activeListeners: 0,
        lastSyncAt: "-",
        totalEvents: 0,
      };

      return {
        activeListeners: state.activeListeners + 1,
        collectionStats: {
          ...state.collectionStats,
          [collectionName]: {
            ...existing,
            activeListeners: existing.activeListeners + 1,
          },
        },
      };
    });
  },

  unregisterListener: (collectionName) => {
    set((state) => {
      const existing = state.collectionStats[collectionName];
      const newActive = existing ? Math.max(0, existing.activeListeners - 1) : 0;

      return {
        activeListeners: Math.max(0, state.activeListeners - 1),
        collectionStats: existing
          ? {
              ...state.collectionStats,
              [collectionName]: {
                ...existing,
                activeListeners: newActive,
              },
            }
          : state.collectionStats,
      };
    });
  },

  resetStats: () => {
    set({
      serverReads: 0,
      cacheReads: 0,
      sessionStartTime: Date.now(),
      events: [],
      collectionStats: {},
    });
  },
}));

import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
